prakrit: "निज्जरिय-जरा-मरणं वन्दित्ता जिण-वरं महावीरं,छप्पण्णय-गाहाऒ वॊच्छं सुयणस्स जॊग्गाऒ"
english: "Life is transient, Death is imminent, The plowman's business is heavy, And those who sleep in the shade Look as though they were sleeping."

prakrit: "पुरिसॆसच्च-समिद्धॆ,अलिय-दलिद्दॆसहावॆ-सन्तुट्ठॆ,तव-नियम-धम्म-मइऎविसमा विसमा हॊन्ति"
english: "Men have everything in common, Aliya - the downtrodden, Sahave - the contented, Thy - the law, The dharma, The wrong views exist."

prakrit: "गयणम्मि गहा सयणम्मिसुमिणयासउणया वणग्गॆसु,तह वाहरन्ति पुरिसं जह दिट्ठं पुव्व-कम्मॆहिं"
english: "Gone are the days When men would groan at the sight of a woman Whose face was smeared with ghee."

prakrit: "सव्वॆ ताह पसत्थासुमिणा सउणागहा य नक्खत्ता,ति-हुयण-मङ्गल-निलयं हियऎण जिणं वहन्तस्स"
english: "Everyone loves a good night's sleep: It is only by staying awake and enjoying oneself that one can conquer evil."

prakrit: "कत्थइ न करइमॊल्लं सुवण्णयं कत्थ दूहवॊ वन्दॊ,कत्थइसरल-सहावॊ जणॊन संमाणणं लहइ"
english: "One does not commit adultery, One is a good wife, One makes love, And one makes lovers."

prakrit: "दूर-त्थॊ डहइ रवी,अग्गी अङ्गॆहĩफरसिऒडहइ,डहइ पिय-विप्पऒगॊ,सुयणॊवि अ-दंसणॆ डहइ"
english: "Far away the fire is burning, The flames are pressing against her body, The drink is spilling over, The midday sun is threatening to set in."

prakrit: "डहऎ सुयण-विऒगॊ,डहइअ-णाहत्तणं पर-विऎसॆ,डहइय अब्भक्खाणं,डहइअ-कज्जंकयंपच्छा"
english: "Right is swollen - vigor, Right - bruised - on impact - poison, Right is impetuous, Left - stinging - itching."

prakrit: "सन्त-गुण-विप्पणासॆ असन्त-दॊसुब्भवॆयजं दुक्खं,तं सॊसॆइ समुद्दं; किं पुण हिययं मणुस्साणं?"
english: "Contentment is the remover of faults, Contempt is the healer of sorrows; What else is there for a man to gain?"

prakrit: "सन्तॆहि अ-सन्तॆहियपरस्स किं जम्पियॆहि दॊसॆहिं?,अत्थॊ जसॊ न लब्भइ,सॊयअ-मित्तॊ कऒ हॊइ"
english: "What do you think you are doing, Jumping in and out of bed? But if you can't find one, Who is a good friend?"

prakrit: "महुरॆण जिणह कडुयं,खमाए दप्पं गुरुं पणामॆण,सन्तॊसॆण यलॊहं,कलहं च अजम्पियव्वॆण"
english: "Forgiveness makes a man bitter, For forgiveness makes him wretched, And charity makes him wise; For contentment makes him violent, And strife makes him intolerable."

prakrit: "ऎक्क-सुकऎण तूसह जाव सयं दुक्कियाण वॊलॆइ,स-सरीरॆ वि न सक्का दियहॆ दियहॆ पियं काउं"
english: "Because you are so unhappy Your body is slipping away." "Dear friend, Don't let your anger get the better of you."

prakrit: "कह नाम तस्स पावं चिन्तिज्जइआगऎ विकॊहम्मि,उप्पल-दल-सुकुमालॊ जस्स घरॆओल्लिऒहत्थॊ?"
english: "What name can you give to that poor thing That grows wretched in the arbor, Like the lotus on the housetop?"

prakrit: "पिय-पाहुण-आगमणॆअ-पहुप्पन्तस्ससज्जण-जणस्स,मरणाऒअब्भहियंउप्पज्जइमाणसंदुक्खं"
english: "Dear friend, The arrival of your husband - Your arrival, your arrival, Your departure, Your absence - It's like a miracle of fire and water."

prakrit: "न हु अइ-भरियंधम्मइ; जह भरियं तह सुहावहं हॊइ;,पन्चम्मि न यकिलिम्मइगऒ वि पिय-पाहुणॊ हॊइ."
english: "I am not so full; the fuller the more pleasant; the thinner the feast, the less agreeable it is to drink."

prakrit: "तॆ धन्ना जॆ धम्मं सुट्ठु वि जाणन्ति सुट्ठु विकरन्ति,जीविय-सारम अ-सारं:खणॆण परियत्तऎ सव्वं"
english: "Blessed are those who, knowing Dharma and falsehood, renounce falsehood And distort it: The essence of life is immaterial: Everything is purified by renunciation."

prakrit: "सा माया सॊ य पिया,तं मित्तंबन्धवॊ यसॊ चॆव,जॊ हिय-निस्सॆस-करं धम्मस्स पहॆ नयं दॆइ"
english: "That love is dear to all beings, That affectionate ear, like that of a friend, Which in dharma heals all faults."

prakrit: "न वि तं करॆइ माया पिया य पुत्तॊ य बन्धव-जणॊ य,जं पुरिसस्सायरिया करन्ति धम्मं उवइसन्ता."
english: "No one calls her dear, Not even her sons or relatives. What men and women do On behalf of their husbands Shows the Dharma."

prakrit: "किं अच्छह वीसत्था? दियहा वॊलॆन्ति तुरिय-पहिय व्व;,तॆ य न गणन्ति तुब्भॆ,तुब्भॆहि न वि य गणिज्जन्ति."
english: "How come you're so restless? The days are fleeting, Like a traveler's trumpet, So you can't count them, Nor can you be counted."

prakrit: "तुट्ठा हॊन्ति मणुस्सा: इन्दमहॊ आगऒ त्ति रमणीऒ;,न वि जाणन्ति वराया: पडिया संवच्छर-सलाया!"
english: "People are torn to shreds: The fire is great, But the women are lovely; They do not know what to do With the bridegroom: The bedsheets are smeared all over!"

prakrit: "उच्चासणॊ मह-इच्छॊ,आणाइन्तॊ य निर-उवयारीऒ,अलसॊ पिय-जिम्मण रूसणॊ य न चिरं पिऒ हॊइ."
english: "Ascending to the highest position is a great desire, Being alone is meaningless, Being idle is drunken is useless, And being angry does not make one pure."

prakrit: "सहसत्ति पीइमन्ता अ-त्थक्कॆ जं व तं व जम्पन्ता,पासॆ य निवॆसन्तापिया यसत्तुत्तणम उवॆन्ति."
english: "One does not drink wine in abundance, One merely drinks whatever one wants to drink, One can only sigh when one has enough."

prakrit: "नीयं अइक्कमन्तॊ पुव्वाभासी पियाĩ जम्पन्तॊ,छन्दं अणुयत्तन्तॊ वॆसॊ वि जणॊ पियॊ हॊइ."
english: "When you are speechless, You become drunk, When you make noise, Everyone is drunk."

prakrit: "छन्दं जॊ अणुयत्तइ मम्मं रॊहइ गुणा पयासॆइ,न हु नवरि माणुसाण य,दॆवाण वि दुल्लहॊ हॊइ."
english: "The rhythm that follows angers me, multiplies manifold, For neither are women human beings; Even the devil is deluded."

prakrit: "आवं ति य ऎवं ति य वॊत्तव्वं पण्डिऎण पुरिसॆण:,इयरॊ वि हॊइ तुट्ठॊ,इयरं पि तत्तियं चॆव."
english: "Come, tell me," he said to the crowd, "One year you'll have a go at it, one year you will have a tear."

prakrit: "छज्जइ पहुस्स ललियं,पियाए माणं,खमा समत्थस्स,जाणन्तस्स य भणियं,मॊणं च अ-याणमाणस्स."
english: "Praise be to the plowman's pen, Dear man, For forgiveness is firm, For knowledge is eloquent, And flattery is dishonorable."

prakrit: "सहइ न कडुयं जम्पइ,दॊसॆ न लहइ गुणा पयासॆइ,रूसन्ताण न रूसइ,दक्खिण्ण-महाभडॊ सुयणॊ."
english: "One can neither bear bitterness nor yawn, one can neither abuse nor make angry people angry, For the south is like a great deep sleep."

prakrit: "सुयणॊ न चॆव रूसइ: अह रूसइ मन्गुलं न चिन्तॆइ:,अह चिन्तॆइ न जम्पइ; अह जम्पइ लज्जिऒ हॊइ."
english: "A sleeping person never gets angry; A angry person never has nasty thoughts; A thinking person never yells; A yawner is ashamed of himself."

prakrit: "जं दुज्जणस्स सुयणॊ लज्जाऎ सहइ छिन्न-लज्जस्स,तं जाणइ निल्लज्जॊ,ऎसॊ अ-समत्थऒ सहइ."
english: "That the wicked sleep, That they bear shame, Are torn to shreds - That they know how to stand; This they do unopposed."

prakrit: "अणुयत्तियं न याणइ,पियॆ वि भणिऎ वि अ-प्पियं भणइ,दाणॆण न सम्पज्जइ; नत्थि उवाऒ खल-यणस्स."
english: "One doesn't know right from wrong, One speaks wrongly even when one is angry, Charity does not prosper; This does not make one an evil person."

prakrit: "बज्झइ मन्तॆहि विसं,हत्थि रज्जूहि सॆउणा सलिलं;,पयइ-विसमस्स बन्धॊ न याणिमॊ दुज्जण-जणस्स."
english: "A thunderclap is a poison to the mind, A cunning twang is a weapon to the hand, And a vicious one is not to be trifled with."

prakrit: "सव्वस्स ऎस पयई: पियम्मि उप्पाइऎ पियं काउं:,सुयणस्स का वि पयई: अ-कऎ वि पिऎ पियं काउं."
english: "All are equal: beloved, beloved, are equal; Suyanna's enemies are all equal: none are equal to each other."

prakrit: "कज्जम्मि समावडिऎ अणुयत्तह दुज्जणं पयत्तॆण,विसम आसा किर जायइ अमयाओ विसं न संभवइ."
english: "If you have to go to work every day To make ends meet, You'd better wait a little while, Because getting there isn't always easy."

prakrit: "जइ वि खमा परिभूया,जइ वि खमन्तस्स आयरॊ नत्थि,तह वि खमा खमियव्वा; खम-सरिसॊ बन्धवॊ नत्थि."
english: "If there is no forgiveness, There is no room for regret, For forgiveness is inexhaustible; Forgiveness is not the same as friendship."

prakrit: "कह तस्स रूसियव्वं जस्स पणामॊ पुणॊ वि कायव्वॊ?,अच्चन्त-निग्गुणस्स वि कह सक्का रूसिउं तस्स?"
english: "How can one be angry with a man Whose reputation I have completely ruined?"

prakrit: "रॊसस्स खमा दण्डॊ,काम-गुणाणं निरुम्भणा दण्डॊ;,दुज्जण-जणस्स कलह-उज्जयस्स परिवज्जणा दण्डॊ."
english: "Forgiveness is the punishment for anger, detachment is the penalty for lust, strife is the sentence for wickedness, disharmony is the order for righteousness."

prakrit: "भद्दं पहू सुयाणं अवराहॆऊण बद्ध-वइराण,पणिवइय-वच्छलाणं मुहुत्त-चण्ड-एक्क-रॊसाणं."
english: "Foolish girl, Suhana is bound by what is unseemly, The husband is wont to sulk, And the wife is won over by what isn't."

prakrit: "बीहॆयव्वं दुज्जण-जणस्स निच्चं पलॊट्ट-जीहस्स,वर-रयण-निज्झरस्स व वयण-करालं वहन्तस्स."
english: "Fear has turned the wicked man upside down, The bridegroom has fallen at his feet, And the handmaidens carry on their shoulders."

prakrit: "अत्थक्कओ जम्पऎ पयइ-पायडं सव्व-लॊय-तत्तिल्लं;,तं माणुस-वॆयालं पुहई वि स-सन्किया भमइ."
english: "At the same time he jumps up and down, And all the people fall down, Yet even at the dawn of man's summer He is haunted by nightmares."

prakrit: "नीऒ खणॆण रच्चइ; रत्तॊ सन्तॊ विरच्चइ खणॆण,नीऒ विरत्त-मॆत्तॊ भामॆइ घरा-घरिं दॊसॆ."
english: "Nio is made of mud; on the other hand, blood flows through the mud; On the other, mud flows from house to house."

prakrit: "सुयणॊ चिरस्स रच्चइ; रत्तॊ सन्तॊ विरच्चइ चिरस्स;,सुयणॊ जइ वि विरच्चइ; तह वि न दॊसॆ पयासॆइ."
english: "A sleeping person becomes angry; When the blood is satisfied, it is angry; If the sleeper is unhappy, it's still angry; So does not a bad person get angry."

prakrit: "छुल्लुच्छलॆइ जं हॊइ ऊणयं रित्तयं कणयणॆइ;,भरियाई न वुच्चन्ति सुपुरिस-विण्णाण-भण्डाईं."
english: "She peeps through the rafters To find out what's really going on; People can't see her: She's covered with bruises."

prakrit: "तं खाह जं जरिज्जइ,तं जम्पह जं महा-यणॆ जॊग्गं;,तं जम्पन्ति सु-पुरिसा,कालॆण वि जं न लन्घॆइ."
english: "For what's worn out is worn out, What's grown with great vigor; A handsome man embraces it, Though time elapses."

prakrit: "तत्तिय-मॆत्तं जम्पहजॆत्तिय-मॆत्तस्स निक्कलं चवह,तंउक्खिवॆहभारं जं अद्ध-पहॆ न छड्डॆह."
english: "Tatya - mettam jampahjetyam - Mettamas nikkalam chavah, The weight of your arms that is half full Will not leave you."

prakrit: "वुज्झन्ति नाम भारा,तॆ च्चिय वुज्झन्ति वीसमन्तॆहिं,सील-भरॊ वॊढव्वॊ जावज-जीवंअ-वीसामॊ."
english: "The woodpecker's name is Bharara, the parrots are Varasa, and the peacock is Varasa." ""

prakrit: "जॊ सक्कयं न याणइ सुविसुद्ध-पाइयं पि वॊत्तुं-जॆ,मॊणंतुतस्स सरणं,नीसरणं अहव परिसाऎ."
english: "One who does not know what is right is wise - If one knows what is wrong - To turn one's back on oneself, one who is indifferent, To avoid embarrassment."

prakrit: "उच्चं न सिक्खिऒ अद्ध-सिक्खिऒ सिक्खिऒ कु-सालाऎ,जॊ वहइ विउस-वायं सॊ सरिसॊ सन्नियाऎण."
english: "One doesn't learn high, one learns low, One learns low; One who speaks with reason is almost a hermit."

prakrit: "कॊ कुवलयाण गन्धं करॆइ महुरत्तणं च उच्छूणं,वर-हत्थीण य लीलं,विणयं च कुल-प्पसूयाणं?"
english: "Who smells the jasmine, Who scents the mahuratna and the expanse, Who makes the lilies of the bridegroom's hands, And the weaves of the banyan?"

prakrit: "अणुयत्तह भणह पियं,जं कज्जं तंमुणॆहहियऎण:,महुरं लवइ मयूरॊ स-विसं च भुयन्गमं गिलइ."
english: "My dear, tell me, The cause for which you refused to budge: The bee that swallows an earthworm And the peacock that a wasp."

prakrit: "उच्छू महुरॊ सॊमॊ चन्दॊ चन्दणं चिय सु-सुरभिं,अभिजाऒ य कुलीणॊ; कॊ दॊसॊ आयरॊ च'ऎव?"
english: "Spring is hot, the moon is full, the sandalwood is fragrant, the fields are fragrant; who cares what kind of fire?"

prakrit: "जॊ गुड-कयाए वायाए जम्पऎ विस-कऎण हियऎण,सॊ बिल-गऒ व सप्पॊ वज्जॆयव्वॊ पयत्तॆण"
english: "One who is good - done good - Jumps with wisdom - Because one has reason to be, So goes the bull, And so does the fowler." ""

prakrit: "अ-द्दिट्ठॆ वि खल-यणॆ नाम-ग्गहणॆ वि हॊइ आसन्का,अलिय-पलत्तॆ वि अही अहि त्ति भण कॊ न बीहॆइ?"
english: "Even at a bad name, There must be something wrong with me. But who would be afraid to say such a thing To another person?"

prakrit: "सण्डॆव-पडिय-पच्चुट्ठिऎण सीऎण थरहरन्तॆण,थॆरॆण पहॆ रुन्नं तारुण्णं सम्भरन्तॆणं."
english: "One shakes with excitement Because one has grown thin, One remembers youth When one has wept before."

prakrit: "विवरीया थॆर-मई वारिज्जन्ती य जाइ थॆर-मई,कालॊ तॆत्तिय-थामं न पॆच्छसॆ पण्डुरं सीसं."
english: "The wise there - May inherit, The clever there - may, The crook there - Don't stop for a moment As you stealthily steer clear."

prakrit: "तं हि सरीरं तं जि मुहु,ताई जि लोयणयाĩ,नाइ विही सीसं चरइ,दिन्नौ पाउ जराए."
english: "She who nurses the body, He who nurses it, She who takes care of it, Forages it without a lead; The days are numbered."

prakrit: "तĩ पहु धणिय घरॆण घरु नयणिहĩ दाइय सो हु;,एवहि जर-नीहोडियौ,पडिजिय अच्छइ एहु."
english: "Your highness, Don't go out of the house into the middle of the night; It's my brother - in - law's." ""

prakrit: "लट्ठी-धरिय-कडॆवर गय-जॊवण ऎवम ऎव सन्तुट्ठ;,सहइ कडुयं पि भणिऒ: गऒ तुमं रूसिउं कालॊ!"
english: "The young man is always satisfied, Even when he is bitter He says:" "Go, you angry bitch!" ""

prakrit: "सिरु पलियũ मुहũ वलि-भरिउ; जर लग्गी हय नाम,मरणं होइ अचिन्तियũ; धम्मु करहि जिय नाम."
english: "Fill your mouth and nose with grief; if it is necessary, say your name; If it is impossible, speak your mind; Prostrate yourself by doing your dharma."

prakrit: "चय महिलं मुह-कडुयं,चय मित्तं नत्थि जत्थ सब-भावं,चय सामियं अ-दायं,चयाहि परिभूया वासं च."
english: "Choose a woman by the bitterness of her face, Choose not to be a friend But to have all manner of feelings, Select equanimity and righteousness, Choice by the disposition of one's neighbor."

prakrit: "आलत्तं चिय रूसइ,भिउडिं काऊण दॆइ उल्लावं,महिला-छलॆण पुरिसं बाहॆइ पुराणयं कम्मं."
english: "Trembling is the passion of nature, Staring at someone makes one angry, Deceiving a man deceives a woman - This is the old karma."

prakrit: "महिलाण ऎस पयई: सव्वस्स करॆन्ति वॆमणस्साइं;,तस्स न करॆन्ति नवरं जस्स अलं कामयन्तॆणं."
english: "Women are like this: Everyone calls him Vemanas, They do not call him Navram, As if they had no other work."

prakrit: "पिय-जण-अपत्त-भॊगा बालत्तणयम्मि गहिय-सामण्णा,अ-द्दिट्ठ-पिय-विऒगा जियन्ति मुणिणॊ सुहं लॊऎ."
english: "Dear friend, Your husband is gone, Childhood is at hand, Travel is on its way, Life is fleeting, Drunkenness prevails, And the pleasures of silence are won."

prakrit: "सु-लभॊ विमाण-वासॊ,ऎग-च्छत्ता य मॆइणी सु-लभा;,लॊगम्मि नवरि दु-लहा पाया जिण-वद्धमाणस्स."
english: "A good wife is characterized by good taste, A bad one by bad taste, And a sluggish one by poor manners."

prakrit: "उच्छू सहाव-महुरॊ,निम्बॊ कडुऒ हुयासणॊ डहणॊ,सुयणस्स दुज्जणस्स य पयइ-विसॆसॊ सहावॆण."
english: "Bees suffer with ugliness, lemons are bitter, poison is poison, And falsehood is poison for the wicked."

prakrit: "जं उप्पलस्स पत्तॆण छिज्जऎ किं व सत्थ-मग्गॆणं?,महुरम्मि भाणियव्वॆ,किं तॆ कडुऎण भणिऎण?"
english: "What do you mean by demanding truth?" asked the sage, "You'll have to say it out loud." "Why so bitter?"

prakrit: "महुर-वयणॆहĩ आसासिऎल्लया जॆ गया पर-विऎसं,तॆ ताĩ सम्भरन्ता,अन्नत्थ रइं न बन्धन्ति."
english: "Bees - The flowers of the sky have passed us by, But we trust in them; We make no bones about them."

prakrit: "कडुय-वयणॆहĩ निब्भच्छियल्लया छिन्न-पॆम-सम्बन्धा,तॆ ताĩ सम्भरन्ता,तत्तॊ यपरॆणवच्चन्ति."
english: "The bitter - spoken word is useless, The torn - up love - relationship is meaningless, He can't think of anything else, So keep at it."

prakrit: "धन्नाण हियं च मियं च गाहयं दॆस-काल-भणियं च,न य पर-लॊय-विरुद्धं गुण-पत्तट्ठं भणइ जीहा."
english: "Blessed is the man who knows what is good for him and what is bad for him, Not according to fancy, But according to nature."

prakrit: "ऎसा सत्ति-पहारॆ य कस-पहारॆ य बल-पहारॆ य,उच्छहइ दवावॆउं दु-विणीया अत्तणॊ जीहा."
english: "Such a thing - Guard or tight - guarded or strong - guarded - Succeeds only in inflicting pain on the weary soul."

prakrit: "जॊ दुज्जणॆण मॆत्ती करॆइ सुयणॊ त्ति नाम कलिऊण,सुविणय-लद्धॊ व निही पच्छा इच्छं न पूरॆइ."
english: "One who curses a poor man's name calls him a coward, One who is wont to curse does not grant a good wish."

prakrit: "दुज्जण-संसग्गीऎ आवाऎ उच्छु-खण्ड-महुराऎ;,विसम इव अणाय-गिलियंपच्छा हॊई अ-पत्थाऒ."
english: "The wicked come to rest, The miser's wife is tossed about, The bee is torn to shreds, And the grass is parched."

prakrit: "जइ कन्चणं गिरीऒ जायइ च हत्तीऒ,विणऒ य कुलीणाऒ,कॊ दॊसॊ आयरॊ चॆव?"
english: "If the conch shell falls off and the elephant walks on it, Or if it is a weaver or a nobleman, Who is to blame?"

prakrit: "पडिवयण-समत्थॆणं सहियव्वं दुज्जणस्स सुयणऎण:,न य पट्ठिम्मि निलीणॊ वसहस्स सिरिं हरइ काऒ."
english: "Forgive the wicked for sleeping rough And do not harm the head of a woman in distress If it falls asleep beside her husband."

prakrit: "ऎक्कॊ खमाए दॊसॊ सव्वालन्कार-भूसिय-गुणाऎ,अ-समत्थॊ त्ति गणिज्जइ जं पुरिसॊ दुज्जण-जणॆण."
english: "One bad man outweighs all good men; the wrong men outnumber bad men."

prakrit: "तिसु जॆ अ-दिट्ठ-पुव्वा राय-कुलॆ गुरु-कुलॆ य वॆसासु,विण्णाण-माण-लडहत्तणाण तॆ बाहिरा हॊन्ति."
english: "Those who have no sight, no speech, no teachers, no clothes, are outsiders to the wisdom of love and war."

prakrit: "नाऊण य विण्णाणं काऊण य समर-साहसं कम्मं,लन्घॆऊण य Mऎरुं पुण्णॆहĩ विणा सुहं कत्तॊ?"
english: "What is happiness without a good night's sleep, A good day's rest, And a good long sleep?"

prakrit: "कालॆ उवणिज्जन्ती थॆवा वि महॊसही जियावॆइ:,अमय-रस-मीसिऎण वि मयस्स किं लावय-रसॆण?"
english: "Even a woman who has just woken up in the morning Will outlive her husband:" "What good is it to me, my dear, If I give in to intoxication?" ""

prakrit: "न्हायस्स य धॊवत्ती जिमियस्स य जं च तं च तम्बॊलं,अवसर-पढिया गाहा,तिन्नि वि सग्गं विसॆसन्ति."
english: "Everything you do, Whether it's bathing or washing or anything else, Is set in stone by chance; They all pierce the whole heaven."

prakrit: "नीयं च लद्ध-पसरं सिप्पि-पौत्तं च अत्थ-संजुत्तं,महिलायत्तं च घरं,तिन्नि वि सूलं विसॆसन्ति."
english: "Right and wrong, Paganism and immorality, Womanhood and the home; All three suffer the same fate."

prakrit: "थक्कॆ भणियं सॊहइ,थक्कॆ भणियं सुहावहं हॊइ;,अ-त्थक्कॆ पुण भणियं कयं पि कज्जं विणासॆइ."
english: "Tired brother - in - law is pleasant, Tired sister - in-law is pleasant; At the same time, re - arising brother, some work is hard to weave."

prakrit: "किं तम्मॆह पलायह जं सरणं नत्थि ति-हुयणॆ सयलॆ,मॊत्तुं जिणॆन्द-वयणं,सॆसं सव्वं कलयलॆइ."
english: "Have you no desire to escape, You won't take it, You'll give it all up in a jiffy?"

prakrit: "सुयणॊ सरल-सहावॊ मइलिज्जन्तॊ वि दुज्जण-जणॆण,छारॆण दप्पणॊ व्विय अहिययरं निम्मलॊ हॊइ."
english: "A good man is simple, A bad man is polite, And a poor man is cruel when he is bullied."

prakrit: "सुयणस्स दुज्जणारूसियस्स कडुयाĩ भन्नमाणस्स,कमल-मौलॆ व्व भमरॊ बाहिर-हिण्डी भमइ रॊसॊ."
english: "Suyans, nasty rhinoceros, bitter gourd, lotus - hairy bee, Bees - The bee is angry outside."

prakrit: "जह जह अणुयत्तिज्जइ तह तह नीयत्तणस्स दॊसॆण,वट्टा-धूलो व खलॊ चडइ सिरॆ नत्थि सन्दॆहॊ."
english: "As the fire is quenched, So is the fragrance of stillness, Like coarse dust, Like sand on the head."

prakrit: "जॆण विणा न जिविज्जइ अणुणिज्जइ सॊ कयावराहॊ वि:,पत्तॆ य नगर-दाहॆ भण कस्स न वल्लहॊ अग्गी?"
english: "How can one go on living If one cannot live without it?" asked the hunter, "In this wretched town, tell me, Who doesn't like a fire?"

prakrit: "तं जम्पन्ति सु-पुरिसा तं चिय पमुहॆ करॆन्ति पडिवत्ती,रयणायरॊ व्व वॆलं कालॆण वि जं न लन्घॆइ."
english: "She embraces him, He embraces her, And calls her favorite wife's name Proudly, Despite the fact that she has not passed away in a long time."

prakrit: "पर-तत्ति-तग्गय-मणॊ दु-स्सीलॊ अलिय-जम्पऒ चवलॊ,जत्थ न दीसइ लॊऒ वणं पि तं च'ऎव रमणीयं."
english: "Par - tatti - knuckle - mano - womano - poor - silly - jump - oh! the forest is as picturesque as there is nothing to show for it."

prakrit: "जॊ जस्स निय-सहावॊ सज्जण-संगॆ वि सॊ तहा चॆव,बाणॊ धम्मॆ वि ठिऒ गुण-गहिऒ तह वि मारॆइ."
english: "One who is affectionate, even with gentlemen, speaks like that, One who speaks dharma, even if he lacks virtue, kills like that."

prakrit: "खल-संगॆ परिहरिऎ,पॆच्छह तिल्लॆण जं फलं पत्तं:,मयणाहि-सुरभि-गन्धं पहु-सीसं पावियं जॆण."
english: "Travel with the wind, See what the tiller throws at the fruit leaf: The fragrance of perfume, The scent of wine, Reach - Like a river in spate."

prakrit: "जॆहिं चिय उब्भविया जाण पसाऎण वड्ढिय-पयावा,समरा डहन्ति विंझं: खलाण संगॊ च्चिय विणासॊ."
english: "As the wind blows strong, So do the warriors pierce the Vindhya: Weave a tight embrace."

prakrit: "सुयणाण नॆउराण य सुव्वन्तॊ सुइ-मणॊरहॊ सद्दॊ,सॊ च'ऎव कण्ण-कडुऒ नियलाणं दड्ढ-पिसुणाणं."
english: "A sound sleep is like a needle in a man's eye, A stinging sting is like an angry twig in his eye."

prakrit: "नागॆहĩ वणं कागॆहĩ उववणं राउलं पिसुणऎहिं,रुद्धं मयरॆहĩ जलं: हय-विहि सुयणॊ कहिं जाउ."
english: "The forest is bare, The rivers are swollen, The creeks are swaying, And the rivers are overflowing with rainwater: Where can we go to sleep?"

prakrit: "तं नत्थि नरॆन्द-घरं सयलॆ महि-मण्डलॆ भमन्ताणं,जत्थ अ-कारण-कुविया दॊ तिण्णि खला न दीसन्ति."
english: "There is no end to it: The bees roam the streets, The houses are empty, The streets are deserted, And the crows have not returned."

prakrit: "अच्चन्त-निम्मलाण वि मॊल्ल-महग्घाण सार-गरुयाणं,मणियारओ व्व खल-यणॊ रयणाण वि कुणइ छिड्डाइं."
english: "Even a poor man or woman Can spoil a good man or a poor woman's beauty."

prakrit: "जासिं च'ऎव नईणं वसहा घुण्टन्ति पाणियं तिसिया,तासिं च'ऎव नईणं सिंगॆहिं तडी विणासॆन्ति."
english: "For as the stream of nectar Whirls the waters, So the banks of the river Weave themselves with the sound of the lute."

prakrit: "सरिसॆ माणुस-जम्मॆ,डहइ खलॊ सज-जणॊ सुहावॆइ:,लॊहं चिय सन्नाहॊ रक्खइ जीयं असी हरइ."
english: "We are all human beings - long live the good, the ugly, the decent, the pleasant: Life is what we lose By protecting the silence of the people."

prakrit: "जॊन्हा-जलॆण चन्दॊ धुवइ कलंकं दिसा-वहु-मुहाण,न य धुवइ निय-कलंकं; सव्वॊ मुज्झइ स-कज्जॆसु."
english: "The burning moon washes away the disgrace from a man's face, Not the dishonor from a woman's neck; All is well with me, my dear."

prakrit: "जॊ जस्स वट्टए हियए सॊ तं ठावॆइ सुन्दर-सहावं:,वग्घी-छावं जणणी भद्दं सॊमं च मन्नॆइ."
english: "What's worthless should be treated with kindness, And what's ugly should be considered filthy."

prakrit: "रत्तॊ दुट्ठॊ मूढॊ पुव्विं कु-ग्गाहिऒ य चत्तारि,उवऎसस्स अणरिहा; अरिहॊ पुण हॊइ मज्झ-त्थॊ."
english: "The blood is red, The foolish embrace the foolish, And the talkative cry, Unsure of the truth; Yet again my heart is full."

prakrit: "सव्वॊ परस्स पॆच्छइ वाल'-अग्गाऒ तणूणि छिड्डाणि;,नियय-कयाĩ न पॆच्छइ Hइमगिरी-सिहर-प्पमाणाइं."
english: "Everyone looks at each other, The fire is burning, The straw is splashing, Destiny is setting in, But he does not look at women - Bees, beehives, etc."

prakrit: "रत्ता पॆच्छन्ति गुणा,दॊसा पॆच्छन्ति जॆ विरज्जन्ति;,मज्झ-त्था पुण पुरिसा दॊसा वि गुणा वि पॆच्छन्ति."
english: "The husband multiplies, The enemies multiply, Those who avoid gain, And finally, Men multiply again, Even their enemies."

prakrit: "करिणॊ करि-सन्घट्टॆ,पत्थर-नियरॆ सुवण्ण-रॆह व्व,निव्वडइ वसण-कसवट्टयम्मि सारॊ कुलीणाणं."
english: "Do - In the evening, stone - nigh, golden - red, white - dotted - But in the evening all is calm."

prakrit: "सब्भाव-नॆहमइऎ रत्तॆ रच्चिजइ त्ति जुत्तम इणं,अण-हियऎ पुण हिययं जं दिज्जइ तं जणॊ हसइ."
english: "Everything is nectar - just like water in a sapling, But what one gives to another causes laughter."

prakrit: "हीरन्ति जॆ गुणॆहिं ववगय-नॆहा वि जॆ न नज्जन्ति,रुन्नं पि जॆसु अग्घइ तॆ पुत्त कलिम्मि अत्थमिया."
english: "Those who are content with their talents, Though they know nothing at all, Even when they cry, Such is the progress of humanity, My son."

prakrit: "विसम-सहावम्मि जणॆ न याणिमॊ कह गुणा विढप्पन्ति,हिम-सीयलॆ वि किरणॆ नॆच्छइ नलिणी मियन्कस्स."
english: "Those who suffer from nausea and vomiting Know not how to multiply by themselves. Even on a frostbite The naughty girl is afraid of the rays of the sun."

prakrit: "सॊहिय-संववहारॊ सब-भावॊ गरुयया खमा तुच्छा,विहडन्ति बन्धवाण य कलि-काल-पयाव-दॊसॆण."
english: "Friendship - Behaviour - All emotion - Forgiveness - Compassion - Contempt, Destroying ties of kali - kaala - payava - dosa."

prakrit: "कण्हस्स कालिऒ फण-मणिम्मि सिट्ठॊ अ आ अ आ आ आ,दॆह'-उप्पन्ना वि विसं चयन्ति दॆवॆ पराहुत्तॆ."
english: "Eyes stink of soot, Bees twitch and twitch, The devil scorns even the most subtle poison." ""

prakrit: "कॊ व न दुक्खं पत्तॊ? सुहं व भण कस्स सासयं अत्थि?,कस्स निरन्तर-पणऒ? सॊहग्गं कस्स अ-क्खलियं?"
english: "Who is not distressed? Who is happy and who is speechless? Whom are you constantly asking? Who are you unfaithful to?"

prakrit: "सव्वॊ पुव्व-कयाणं कम्माणं पावऎ फल-विवागं;,अवराहॆसु गुणॆसु य निमित्त-मॆत्तं परॊ हॊइ."
english: "All flowers yield good fruit, But one should not neglect what is good for one's self."

prakrit: "नौ वि करन्तह सु-पुरिसह,जइ दइवह न सुहाइ,का वि अवत्थ स सम्पडइ जा चिन्तणह न जाइ."
english: "If you do nothing else, you will have a good time; if you pity no one, then perhaps the thought of wealth will outlive you."

prakrit: "अन्नह परिचिन्तिज्जइ सहरिस-कण्ड'-उज्जुऎण हियऎण;,परिणमइ अन्नह च्चिय कज्जारम्भॊ विहि-वसॆण."
english: "Without knowing it, the hearth is illuminated by the rays of the sun - the kanda - The start of one's errand is doomed to fail."

prakrit: "विहिणा वि नडिज्जन्तॊ सव्वॊ च्चिय भणइ अट्ठमॊ चन्दॊ;,चन्दस्स ड़ाहु-गहणॆ,तइया कॊ अट्ठमॊ आसि?"
english: "Even when one is free, everyone says the eighth moon; When the moon is full, who is the eighth?"

prakrit: "विउपु नह-यलु रहवरारुढु,दु-प्पॆच्छा तसु किरण,अत्थ-सिहरु दुग्गमु सुणिज्जइ,विहि-विहियं थू परिणमइ,तेण सूरु राहĩ गिलिज्जइ."
english: "The tree does not wither, The path is uneven, The paths are crooked, The roads are impassable, The streets are slippery, The street is swollen by the sun."

prakrit: "भुवणप्फालु वि धणु समइ,वब्बुल-हॆट्ठि ट्ठिओ,ओहु पॆक्खु न किं गिलन्तइं,देवाह वि एह दस,विहि करन्तु किं किं पिलिज्जइ?"
english: "The plowman is so wealthy, The peacock is so wobbly, And the parrots are so hairy, So why not give birth to a flock of peacocks? Even the God of Love has ten wives. So why get married?"

prakrit: "धन्नु सुवण्णũ ति-हुयणहु,दिन्नौ होइ हरॆण,तस्स वि थू विहि-विहिउ धणु; सङ्करु नग्गइ तॆण."
english: "Blessed is the one who finds a treasure, Blessed are those who find one, Yet he destroys everything; For no one can snatch it away."

prakrit: "जा तइ-लुक्कह नाह किर सम्पइ फेडइ देइ;,तह वि जराऔ Hअरह धणु; गलि हड्डĩ परिहेइ."
english: "Go and hide, or else the whole world will break loose; Yet, dear go - between, The street is covered with bones."

prakrit: "अन्ने भणन्ति झणद्दण Hअरह तिइज्जौ भाउ,तस्स वि दइविं निम्मियौ सयणिउ कालौ काउ."
english: "Anna says," "You silly brother, Stop your anger! It's just the way things are." ""

prakrit: "विहि-विहियं चिय लब्भइ,अमयं दॆवाण Mअहुमहॆ ळच्छी,रयणायरॆ वि महिऎ,Hअरस्स भाऎ विसं जायं."
english: "The fire is burning brightly, We are angry, Mother - in - law is weeping, The crows are singing loudly, And the wind is blowing."

prakrit: "पुत्तय विहि-वसि विनडियइ,कॊ ति-णयणि साहारु?,जिं Hअर-वसहु वि तिण चरइ,ॐासुगि पवणाहारु."
english: "My son, Who is staying here? Who is going to help you? Even a heron will graze on you. I will take care of the birds."

prakrit: "जइ वि ति-णयणु ऎक्कु पुहइहिं,वन्दिज्जइ सुर-गणिहिं,तो वि तासि वढ किह णमिज्जइ?,सरणागौ जासु सिर अ,सिरहु लेवि ड़ाहिं गिलिज्जइ."
english: "If a woman puts on a turban, Says she is bound by vows, Then what is the use of raising her head again? The head is swallowed by the needle, The head by the string." ""

prakrit: "मज्झॆ जडाण निवसन्तयस्स कत्तॊ गुणाण वित्थारॊ?,Hअर-ससिणॊ तं बहुयं सा वि कला जं न सॆ झीणा."
english: "How many virtues do you attribute to me when you live in my own body?," "A lot of it comes from trees, But an art that is not so delicate." ""

prakrit: "थॆवॆहि वि हॊइ गुणॆहĩ गारवं नि-ग्गुणाण मज्झम्मि,भण्णन्ति जॆण मणुया,सरॆहĩ कूया वि कूय-सरा."
english: "The same people say that virtue alone triumphs over vice, That virtue alone vanishes, That vice versa is cursed."

prakrit: "जह मूसगस्स ऎक्कॆण वीहिणा दॊ वि वावडा हत्था,तह अ-मुणिअ-कल्लाणा थॆवॆण वि उत्तुणा हॊन्ति"
english: "As a peacock's tail is raised when struck by a lightning bolt, So is the fowler's bow when struck with a stone."

prakrit: "गुणवन्तयाण जाणह हॊन्ति गुणा पायडा मह'-अग्घाया,मणि-रयणं चिय गॊट्ठॆ गॊवा तक्कॆण मग्गन्ति."
english: "Those who know merit multiply, Payada, Maho - agghaya, Mani - rayana, Cheyya, Gothe, Goan - they ask for a token."

prakrit: "अ-भणन्ताण वि नज्जइ विण्णाणं सु-पुरिसाण चरिऎहिं,किं बॊल्लन्ति मणीऒ,जाओ सहस्सॆहĩ घॆप्पन्ति?"
english: "Aunt, You're not supposed to say a word. What do you mean you're talking like a man? Go and make love Like a bitch." ""

prakrit: "अट्ठत्तणाĩ आ आ अ आ जह'-इच्छाए नि-ग्गुणाणं पि,सज्जण-सलाहणिज्जा सॊक्खॆहĩ गुणा विढप्पन्ति."
english: "Though there is much ado, Though there be no desire, Even though there be virtue, A gentleman's good advice Brings out the virtues of true virtue."

prakrit: "पुव्व-कय-असुह-कम्मॊ पुरिसॊ अ-सुहस्स उव्वियन्तॊ वि,निवडइ अ-सुह-क्खलिऒ कलि-कलह-किलॆस-जालम्मि."
english: "A man who is full of faults, Who is unhappy with his actions, And who is content with his pleasures, Chooses the one who is unhappy With his past."

prakrit: "जाणइ सु-य-अन्धयारॆ वि वच्छऒ मायरं गवॆसन्तॊ,दइयं च मुणइ हिययं,वॆसं जाणन्ति नयणाĩ."
english: "One knows what is good and what is dark, One sees what is white, One feels pity and conceals what is blue."

prakrit: "जस्स न वण्णॆइ जणॊ सज्जण-गॊट्ठीसु गुण-सहस्साइं,किं तस्स जणणि-जॊव्वण-विउडण-मॆत्तॆण जम्मॆणं?"
english: "One who does not know the virtues of courtesy and politeness, How can one know what is due to politeness or politeness?"

prakrit: "मा दॊसु च्चिय गॆण्हह; विरलॆ य गुणॆ पसंसह जणस्स:,अक्ख-पौरॊ वि उयही भण्णइ रयणायरॊ लॊकॆ."
english: "Do not be negligent, my dear; you have rarely shown yourself worthy of being so, For even a wise man Can say the same thing About immodest people."

prakrit: "सव्वॊ गुणॆसु रज्जइ; गुण-रहियं कॊ जणं सम्मल्लियइ?,कुसुमं पि गन्ध-रहियं पत्तिय भमरा न सॆवन्ति."
english: "All virtues flow from one person to another; Who is it that shares a virtue with another? Even a bee that stinks of safflower Does not eat a leaf."

prakrit: "गुण-जाल-बद्ध-मूलॆ सच्च-फलॆ नॆय-पल्लव-सणाहॆ,नॆहमइयम्मि सुयणॆ,मित्त-दुमॆ कॊ न वीसमइ?"
english: "Virtuous - Trapped - Rooted - True - Fruit - Naked - Pallava - Slender - Like a needle in nectar, Friend - Who doesn't appreciate darkness?" ""

prakrit: "स-ब्भावियं सिणॆहं सम-दुक्ख-सहॆज्जयं सु-सीलं च,दूरालॊय-विहसियं कॊ मित्त-सुहं न सम्भरइ?"
english: "Friendship is equal to affection, to sorrow, to suffering, to happiness; who can't remember a friend when they are far apart?"

prakrit: "गुज्झस्स संनिहाणं,सुहस्स दुखस्स कहण-वीसमणं,ऎक्कं पि जस्स मित्तं नत्थि हु किं तस्स जीऎणं?"
english: "Praise be to the thunder, Love be to sorrow, Friendship be to jealousy What use is life to one who has no friends?"

prakrit: "तं मित्तं कायव्वं जं मित्तं वसण-दॆस-यालम्मि,आलिहिय-भित्ति-वाउल्लयं व न परम्मुहं ठाइ."
english: "Make a friend of him Who lives in a friend's country a refuge, A refuge, a wall, and not a hiding place."

prakrit: "बद्ध-सिणॆहॊ अइयार-वल्लहॊ अप्प-कज्ज-मइ-कुसलॊ,वज्जसु कऒ वि मित्तॊ ऎयावत्थॊ तुमं सु-यणु."
english: "Friend, You're a good man, A good man - Friend, Friend, Worker, More virtuous - That makes you feel good."

prakrit: "मज्झ-त्थॆण वि ससिणा चक्काण न तीरऎ पियं काउं;,विहडण-सन्घडणं चिय,पुणॊ वि मित्तॊ च्चिय करॆइ."
english: "Though I am busy making love, My lover is not so eager to meet, He always calls me his friend."

prakrit: "जह स-रसॆ तह सुक्खॆ वि पायवॆ वहइ अणुदिणं विंझॊ:,उच्छन्ग-वड्ढियं निग्गुणं पि गरुया न सिढिलन्ति."
english: "The wiser and drier one gets, the thinner the Vindhya, The more compressed one becomes And does not straighten out."

prakrit: "उत्तम-जण-संसग्गी कायव्वा जइ वि नि-प्फला हॊइ.,मॆरुस्स कडए लग्गं तणं पि तं कन्चणं हॊइ."
english: "If you make good friends, you are bound to fail. If you stick to a fence, you lose your cool." ""

prakrit: "एह न चिन्त महा-दुमह जिव महु मूलु पलीणु,निसि अन्धारी वप्पुडा सौणा कत्थ निलीणा."
english: "Don't think that this is a big deal - Two thousand bees should root here and there, Silly monkey, How stupid is that?"

prakrit: "जॊन्हा-जलॆण भुवण'-अन्तराĩ दॆ भरसु पुण्णिमा-यन्द:,कॊ जाणइ अ-थिरा कॆ-चिरं च तुह ऎरिसा रिद्धी?"
english: "Jonha - Jalen bhuvan" "- The full moon - Yanda: Filled with compassion, Who knows how angry you are And how you feel?" ""

prakrit: "दिज्जइ धणु मग्गन्ताहã; पत्त-परिक्खह काĩ?,किं वरिसन्तौ अन्क-हरु,जोवइ सम-विसमाĩ?"
english: "Is it wealth that you seek; Why leaf - sort?, Is it the fingers that inherit, Or the toes that are even?"

prakrit: "बलि-बन्धण पॆक्खेवि नरु,पत्त-परिक्ख करेह,ओहु भट्टौ न उच्छुडइ,जो नि-स्सीलह देइ."
english: "Try not to fall into sacrificial traps, Try to pierce a leaf; The same furnace will not boil over That does not produce breath."

prakrit: "दॆज्जसु मा सन्कॆज्जसु; ऎसा सु-महग्घ-रयण-निम्मविया,पुत्त स्री मयहर-थाल व्व य वारॆण सन्कमइ."
english: "Dispose, do not sulk; this is the way of a good man - Expensive raiyana - Nimmavya, my son - The thala of my husband's bow Is polluted by wind."

prakrit: "अण-अवरयं चिय दॆन्तॊ,कॊइ नरॊ हॊइ विउल-रिद्धिल्लॊ;,निच्चं चिय सन्चन्तॊ कॊइ सया दुग्गऒ हॊइ."
english: "One cannot hurt an innocent person, One cannot be cruel, One can only be cruel if one is dishonest."

prakrit: "राय'-अग्गि-चॊर-हरिऎ लक्ख-सहस्सॆ कहॆइ पर-नट्ठॆ,अब्भत्थिऒ उ जम्हा,दालिद्दं दाण-गहणं च."
english: "Rai" - The fire is bright, The greenery is lush, The trees are vigorous, The yokel is firm, The lentils are juicy, And the wheat is tender. "

prakrit: "थॆवा वि सा गणिज्जइ रिद्धी जा सयल-लॊय-सामन्ना:,पिज्जइ वाविए जलं,न उण समुद्दस्स थॆवं पि."
english: "Even the Thewa She counts as riddhi ja sayal - loi - samanna: Pizza is served without water, Not even in the middle of the sea."

prakrit: "तं तत्तियं जलं सायरस्स सॊ च्चॆव परम-वित्थारॊ;,ऎक्कं पि पलं तं नत्थि जं पिवासा निवारॆइ."
english: "That crystal clear water is the saviour of all souls; never again will it flow as though it prevented thirst."

prakrit: "ना खज्जइ ना पिज्जइ,ना दिज्जइ विहलाहं,धत्तूरा-हलु जइसि,सम्पै हॊइ खलाहं."
english: "It neither eats nor drinks, It neither burps nor stirs, It only stirs and stirs. The whole is empty."

prakrit: "चाइ-अण-कर-परम्पर-परियत्तण-खॆय-वसण-परिसन्ता,अत्था किवण-घर-त्था सत्थावत्था सुवन्ति व्व."
english: "Chai, anar, kar, parampara, parivartan, khai, vasana, parisanta, attha, kivan, ghar, tha, satthavattha, and the like."

prakrit: "सव्वायरॆण तइया थुत्थुक्किय-रक्खिया पयत्तॆण,किविणाणं जा रिद्धी पर-सावत्था कुमारि व्व."
english: "By all means spiteful girl, By protecting her husband, By going to bed sagging over his thighs."

prakrit: "ओहय अच्छइ थुत्थुकिय सम्पय किविण-घरेहĩ,थेरेण वि विवाहीय भुन्जेसी अवरेहĩ."
english: "Oh, what a thrill it is to have all these flowers in one's house, For even the unmarried Bhunjesi is averse to them."

prakrit: "सीसं पलिय-पलित्तं थण-अन्तरं वियलिया मुहॆ दन्ता,कम्पन्ति दॊ वि हत्था; तह वि मणं जॊव्वणं वहइ."
english: "The head is pale, The nipples are plump, The mouth has teeth that quiver, And the hands tremble; So too does the mind lose its youth."

prakrit: "दूरोणामिय-भमुहा,पऎ पऎ किं विसॆस-पुच्छन्ता,नट्ठं च जॊव्वणं महि-यलम्मि थॆरा गवॆसन्ति."
english: "How can one ask a strange question When one is abroad And one isn't? The young men go to and fro While the women are away."

prakrit: "परिहणु पर-करेहĩ परिहिज्जइ,दियहि दियहि अन्गं परिझिज्जइ,भूमिहि कर ठावेवि उठिज्जइ,तह वि धम्मु अणुदिणु न वि किज्जइ."
english: "When one does something, it is appreciated, when another does it, the earth is uplifted by one's action. Yet not a single day is devoted to dharma."

prakrit: "सिरि ऎक्क'-ऎक्कं पलियडं,पइट्ठं अग्गी-बाणु,नीसरु जॊव्वण-पाहुणा,जर खण्डेसी माणु."
english: "Siri ekka - Ekkam paliyadam, patham aggi - vaanu, nishra youth - guest, zara khandesi man."

prakrit: "भवियाण तं महायस संसार-समुद्द-निच्च-पडियाणं,निज्जामऒ सि सामिय दुग्गय-सलिलॆ निबुड्डाणं."
english: "Fate has made him the greatest traveler in the world, The sea the dirtiest, And nature the dreariest."

prakrit: "ऎअं गाहा-कॊसं जॊ पढइ वियड्ढ-विरइयं लॊकॆ,सॊ पावि विउल-रिद्धी जणम्मि सॊहग्गयं लहइ."
english: "A gentleman who reads nonsense, Like a man who is absent - minded, Gives birth to nonsense."

prakrit: "जिण-सासणम्मि भत्ती,पण्डिय-गॊट्ठी विसिट्ठ-संसग्गी,मुणिवर-दाण-पसन्गॊ न हॊइ थॆवॆहि पुण्णॆहिं."
english: "Life is like a bed of roses, Contiguous with one's husband, Venerable with another., Munivar - charity - There will be no more quarrels."

prakrit: "न य बाहइ कमल-वणं; अप्पा पीणइ पिऎइ मयरन्दं,ऎसॊ भमर-जुवाणॊ कॆणइ निउणत्तण-गुणॆण."
english: "No one is born with a lotus in his hand; he drinks only wine and myrrh from it; this is the nature of the beekeeper's youth, characterized by its freshness."

prakrit: "लज्जिज्जइ जॆण जणॆ,मइलिज्जइ निय-कुल-क्कमॊ जॆण,कण्ठ-ट्ठिऎ वि जीऎ,मा सुन्दर तं कुणिज्जासु."
english: "One who is ashamed is a coward, one who is filthy is a poor man, One who keeps his throat shut is a farmer's son; Do not trouble a handsome man."

prakrit: "आरॊग्ग-सारियं माणुसत्तणं सच्च-सारिऒ धम्मॊ,विज्जा निच्छय-सारा,सुहाĩ सन्तॊस-साराइं."
english: "Right belief in all humanity is true dharma, knowledge is pure, happiness is content - all is pure."

prakrit: "पत्तम्मि य पाहुणऎ,किं काही दुग्गऒ तुरन्तॊ वि?,अन्धॊ मलिऎहिं लॊयणॆहĩ अन्धॊ च्चिय वराऒ."
english: "Is there anything wrong with the path? Right away it's slippery. The blind man is crossing the road, And now the blind man has arrived." ""

prakrit: "जॆण ण किंचि वि कज्जं तस्स वि घरम आगयस्स जॆ सुयणा,निच्चं पहसिय-वयणा निय-सीसं आसणं दॆन्ति."
english: "Those who have no business in the house, If you go to sleep at all, Give yourselves a seat by the street."

prakrit: "विणु धम्मिं हिय-इच्छियĩ आसा-वहि वट्टन्ति,कण्डु कविलु जिमु काउरिस पर-लालह घुण्टन्ति."
english: "The bow twists in dharma, The wish - making woman turns nasty, The tendrils curl around the cow - eyed woman."

prakrit: "नमिऊण परमपुरिसं पुरिसुत्तमनाभिसम्भवं देवं,वुच्छं पाइयलच्छि त्ति नाममालं निसामेह"
english: "If you believe in the existence of a supreme god, You will find that your name alone is irresistible."

prakrit: "कमलासणो सयम्भू पियामहो चउमुहो य परमिट्ठी,थेरो विही विरिञ्चो पयावई कमलजोणी य"
english: "A lotus is like a sweetmeat, Like the lotus of love, Like a blanket of fire, Like an ornament on a lotus."

prakrit: "दक्खायणी भवाणी सेलसुया पव्वई उमा गोरी,अज्जा दुग्गा काली सिवा य कच्चायणी चण्डी"
english: "Dakshayani Bhavani Selsuya Pavai Uma Gori, Ajja Dugga Kali Siwa Ya Kachayani Chandi"

prakrit: "अक्को तरणी मित्तो मत्तण्डो दिणमणी पयङ्गो य,अहिमयरो पच्चूहो दियसयरो अंसुमाली य"
english: "Aunt, The woman is drunk, The gentleman is afraid, The landowner is negligent, The farmer is reckless, And the housewife is inconsiderate."

prakrit: "इन्दू निसायरो ससहरो विहू गहवई रयणिनाहो,मयलञ्छणो हिमयरो रोहिणिरमणो ससी चन्दो"
english: "Mother - in - law, The rainy season is long, The winter is hot, The hot sun is warm, The moon is dry, And the nights are rainy."

prakrit: "धूमद्धओ हुयवहो विहावसू पावओ सिही वण्ही,अणलो जलणो डहनो हुयासणो हव्ववाहो य"
english: "Smoke devours, Poison fills the air, Like fire that burns, Like poison that burns."

prakrit: "मयरद्धओ अणङ्गो रइणाहो वम्महो कुसुमबाणो,कन्दप्पो पञ्चसरो मयणो सङ्कप्पजोणी य"
english: "My husband is angry, My wife is sagging, My breasts are drooping, My heart is bursting with desire."

prakrit: "मयरहरो सिन्धुवई सिन्धू रयणायरो सलिलरासी,पारावारो जलही तरङ्गमाली समुद्दो य"
english: "Mother - in - law, The ocean is a mass of ripples, The rivers are silvery, The streams are smooth, The waters are crystal clear."

prakrit: "पीलू गओ मयगलो मायङ्गो सिन्धुरो करेणू य,दोघट्टो दन्ती वारणो करी कुञ्जरो हत्थी"
english: "Pilou gao, maygalo, mayang, sindhuro, karenu, doegatto, daanti, warana, karri, kunjar, haathi." ""

prakrit: "अम्बुरुहं सयवत्तं सरोरुहं पुण्डरीयमरविन्दं,राईवं तामरसं महुप्पलं पङ्कयं नलिणं"

prakrit: "बाला मूढा मन्दा अयाणुया बालिसा जडा मुक्खा,पामर-गहवइ-सेयाल-कासया दोणया हलिया"
english: "Child, dumb and dull, Ayanuya child, Jada mukha, palmar - wheat - millet - seyal - cotton - Both are plowed by the farmer."

prakrit: "पोरच्छो पिसुणो मच्छरी खलो मुहुमुहो य उप्फालो,कमलो कुसुमालो तक्करो य पाडच्चरो थेणो"
english: "Who is hotter, Who is thinner, Whose face is drier, And whose hair is paler?"

prakrit: "निद्धन्धसा निसंसा निच्चुड्डा निक्किवा अकरुणा य,रुन्दा पीणा थूला य मंसला पीवरा थोरा"
english: "Niddhandhasa, nisamsa, nidduddha, nikkiva, akuruna, runda, peena, thula, yasa, manasala, peevara, thora."

prakrit: "सरिसो समो सरिच्छो सङ्कासो सच्छहो समाणो य,कढिणा य कक्कसा निट्ठुरा खरा खप्पुरा फरुसा"
english: "All is well, All is sighing, All isn't well, Just talking - That's plain stupid." ""

prakrit: "उत्ताणा उत्तणुया थिन्ना थड्डा य गव्विया दरिया,लोला लालस-लोलुय-उल्लेहडलम्पडा लुद्धा"
english: "Utthana uttanya thinna thadda ya gavya dariya, lola lalasa-loluy-ullehadlampada luddha"

prakrit: "सन्नं खिन्नं सुठियं उव्वायं नीसहं किलन्तं च,आइग्गं उव्विग्गं उच्चेयं वुन्नम उत्तत्थं"
english: "Slow and dragging, Wavy and slippery, Now and then wobbly and crooked, High and lofty are the virtues of virtue."

prakrit: "घडिअं विणिम्मियं विहियम आहियं विरइयं कयं जणियं,घत्तं कवलियम असियं विलुम्पियं वम्फियं खइयं"
english: "The clock is ticking, We are busy chatting, Struggling to make ends meet, And the kitchen is overflowing with people."

prakrit: "सच्चविय-दिट्ठ-पुलइय-नियच्छियाइं निहालियत्थंमि,पव्वालियमाउम्बालियं च सलिलुच्छयं जाण"
english: "I know what is true - sight, touch, intention, and what is false."

prakrit: "रोमञ्चियम आरेइयम ऊसलियं पुलइयं च कण्ठइअं,पामुक्कं विच्छड्डियम अवहत्थियम उज्झियं चत्तं"
english: "Romanchium aureum, flute, and flute - these are the songs that make the people sing; the sound of the trumpet, of the pyre, is irresistible."

prakrit: "निट्ठुइयं खिरियं छिप्पियं च नीसन्दियं च पज्झरियं,वेयडियं पज्झुत्तं खचियं विच्छुरिययं जडियं"
english: "Silly girl, Silly boy, I've got to hide behind a blanket, To cover my face with mud and mud."

prakrit: "वोलीणं वुक्कन्तं अइच्छियं वोलियं अइक्कन्तं,पडिहत्थम उद्धुमायं अहिरेमइयं च अप्फुण्णं"
english: "A wall grows taller, a wall grows thinner, and a fence rises higher."

prakrit: "हक्खुत्तं उच्चूढं उक्खित्तुप्पाडियाĩ उद्धरियं,कोवासियं वियसियं विणिद्दमुम्मिल्लमुप्फुल्लं"
english: "The hunter has lifted up the hunter's field, The huntsman has raised it, The cowherd has pierced it, And the weasel has not budged."

prakrit: "बज्जरिय-सिद्ध-सूइय-उप्फालिय-पिसुणियाĩ साहिययं,पव्वायं वसुयायं सुसियं वायं मिलाणत्थे"
english: "Bajariya - Siddha - Suiya - Upphaliya - Pisuniya - Sahyam, Pavayam Vasuyayam Susyam Vayam Milanatheyathey."

prakrit: "विच्छूढं उच्छित्तं पणुल्लियं पिल्लियं गलत्थिययं,पेढालनियक्कलवट्टुलाĩ परिमण्डलत्थंमि"
english: "I can see the python climbing up, screeching loudly, Pulliam moving erratically, And the bird peeping through the fence"

prakrit: "टिविडिक्कियचिञ्चिल्लियचिञ्चइयपसाहियाĩ मण्डिययं,आलुङ्खियम आलिद्धं छिक्कं छित्तं परामुसियं"
english: "Tweedieckie, Chinchillie, Little girl, Auntie, It's the fire of love, Like a bunch of peacock's tail feathers Waved by the hunter"

prakrit: "सामग्गियम अवयासियम आलिङ्गिययम उवऊढम ओसत्तं,अग्घइ छज्जइ रेहइ विरायए सोहए सहइ"
english: "Contentment, detachment, embrace, undiminished affection, Resist fire and rain, Endure separation with pleasure."

prakrit: "सइ अविरयम अविरामं अणुवेलं सन्तयं सया निच्चं,छायं छउयं लयणं तणुयं तलिणं किसं खामं"
english: "Aunt, The silence is unbearable, The sighs are endless, The shadows are shadowy, The lines are thin, The bottom is bare."

prakrit: "ललियं वग्गुं मञ्जुं मञ्जुलयं पेसलं कलं महुरं,कोमलयं सुहफंसं सोमालं पेलवं मउ य"
english: "A lotus is like a lotus, A rose is like an emerald, A jasmine like a pearl Is like a sweetmeat, And a sweetwood flower is like milk."

prakrit: "वियडं विउलं पिहुलं वित्थिन्नं वित्थयं उरु विसालं,खउरियम उच्चिंवलयं पट्टुहियं जाण कलुसजलं"
english: "Vivid wood, Spattered all over the place, Like water spattered on the surface of a tree, Looks like a lotus Placed on top of the tree"

prakrit: "गाढं बाढं बलियं धणियं दढमइसएण अच्चत्थं,सइदंसणं सइसुहं चिन्तादिट्ठंमि सइलम्भं"
english: "Because I can see so much fire and water, I must stop to think what it is that I see."

prakrit: "अब्भासं अब्भन्नं आसन्नं सविहमन्तियं नियडं,कलियं विइयं विण्णायम अहिगयं बुज्झियं मुणियं"
english: "Love is bound to come, Friendship is destined, Love is woven between the two, For love's sake and for fear of the other."

prakrit: "सामलम असियं सामं कालं कसिणं सिएयरं कण्हं,सेयं सियं वलक्खं अवदायं पण्डु धवलं च"
english: "Samalam uss samalam kaalam kaasam kachaman seyaram kanoon, seyam walaakham awadayam pandu and dhavalam." ""

prakrit: "कविलं कविसं पिङ्गं पिसङ्गयं पिङ्गयं कडारं च,अरुणं सोणं रत्तं पाडलम आयम्बिरं तम्बं"
english: "Poems pierce the cowgirl's pyre, Pecks piercing the cudgel, And Arun pours out red ghee On the lotus of Ayambira"

prakrit: "फसलं सबलं सारं किम्मीरं चित्तलं च बोगिल्लं,इत्तो नामग्गामं गाहाचलणेसु चिन्तेमि"
english: "The field is overcast, The fields are fragrant, And I am thinking of the roads that lead to this village."

prakrit: "अमरावई सुरपुरी तिविट्ठयं तह सुरालओ नाऒ,अलया कुबेरनयरी तित्थाहिवई जिणो अरहा"
english: "Amaravai Surapuri Twists And turns. Alaya Kubernayari Titthaahiwai Jina Arha." ""

prakrit: "कमला सिरी य लच्छी हेरम्बो गयमुहो गणाहिवई,रिक्खं उडु नक्खत्तं पुन्नयणा गुज्झया जक्खा"
english: "Kamala Siri, if you want to see your lover's face again, Count her off with a bunch of peacock feathers." ""

prakrit: "नन्दणम अमरुज्जाणं कणयगिरी सुरगिरी सुमेरू य,फलिहगिरी कइलासो विहस्सई सुरगुरू धिसणो"
english: "Nandanam is immortal, Kanayagiri is heavenly, Fruitfulness is eternal, And the wise are wise."

prakrit: "वासवसुओ जयन्तो पुलोमतणया सई य इन्दाणी,अइरावणो सुरगओ विज्जू सोयामणी य तडी"
english: "Vasavasu, Just like the waterfall in a pond, Like the full moon in the sky, So does the river in heaven Like the banks of the Soyamoni."

prakrit: "असणी वज्जं कुलिसं सुराउहं तियसचावम इन्दधणुं,अङ्गारओ य भोमो उसणो सुक्को दइच्चगुरू"
english: "Such a wretch, Cool, sober, Such a wealthy man, Whose business it is to pollute the skies, Is only to please the wretched."

prakrit: "भुयणं जयं च लोओ नरनाहो पत्थिवो निवो राया,मित्तो सही वयंसो मन्ती सइवो अमच्चो य"
english: "Forgiveness is everything, For love is nothing but death, For friendship is truth, And falsehood is nothing else than delusion."

prakrit: "अन्तेवासी सीसो छलिओ छप्पण्णओ छइल्लो य,अड्ढा इब्भा धणिणो बन्धू सयणो सणाही य"
english: "The inmate is a lead hunter, Fifty-six are hunters, And one hundred and fifty are wealthy friends." ""

prakrit: "विप्पो दिओ दियाई य अङ्गया नन्दणा सुया तणया,अहियाओ कुलजाओ अणुजीवी सेवओ भिच्चो"
english: "Vippo diyai ya angada nandana suyaya, ahaya kulja, anujiva sevayo bhikkho." ""

prakrit: "नीसामन्ना गरुया अहमा इयरा य पायया नीया,रहयारा वड्ढइणो वच्छीवा वच्छवाला य"
english: "The poor man is proud, I am proud, Your feet are bare, You grow old, You fool, You coward."

prakrit: "सासाĩ छत्तधन्नाĩ गामणी भोइओ य गामवई,कुम्भारो य कुलालो गोवाला वल्लवा गोवा"
english: "Mother - in - law, It's the headman's village, It is the farmer's wife who runs the village, And the cowherd is the cool cowboy in Goa."

prakrit: "आवणिया वाणियया मायङ्गा तह जनङ्गमा पाणा,पाउग्गिओ य सहिओ केवट्टो धीवरो दासो"
english: "Aunt, The path is slippery, The paths are narrow, The roads are impassable, And the streets are deserted."

prakrit: "बन्दीओ करमरिओ पुप्फच्चिणियाऒ पुप्फलाईओ,थम्भो थेवो विन्दू खव्वो हस्सो य वामणओ"
english: "Prisoners, blacksmiths, parrots, crickets, crows, doves, peacocks, The south wind is a laughingstock To the left."

prakrit: "रोयणिया लामाओ मूओ मूयल्लिओ य तुण्हिक्को,वयपरिणामो य जरा थेरी जरई गयवया य"
english: "You silly girl, Are you ready for the big day?" he growled, Turning his head away As if he had just arrived.

prakrit: "सोवणयं रइमन्दिरमाली तह माउया सही अत्ता,परयत्तो परछन्दो विक्खाओ विस्सुओ पयडो"
english: "Lovely lady, Mother - in - law, You're right, Aunt, A shadow falls when you look at it Like a poisonous snake."

prakrit: "नक्खा नहा कररुहा केसा चिहुरा सिरोरुहा वाला,चलणा कमा य पाया पओहरा तह थणा सिहिणा"
english: "Aunt, What's that on your face That you brushed off With a sharp arrow? It must have been the feet That made the walk So delicious."

prakrit: "पाणी हत्था य करा कत्ती चम्मम अइणं छवी खल्ला,दसणा रयणा दन्ता सिरोहरा कन्धरा गीवा"
english: "Water, haththa ya katti, Chammam, ain't that the image of a poor man, Dasna raina daanta, Sirohara kandhara geewa"

prakrit: "वयणं मुहं च आणणमच्छी नयणं च लोयणं नित्तं,नासा घाणं घोणा सीसं सिरम उत्तमङ्गं च"
english: "To lie on your back, To turn your face away, To stare at your eyes, To lie still, Is nothing but filthiness, To sigh loudly, To sulk profusely."

prakrit: "भालम अलियं निडालं मंसू खड्डं च मासुरी कुच्चं,उयरं जढरं तुन्दं बप्फं बाही य नयणजलं"
english: "Bhalam aliyam, nidalam, manasu, kuchcham, masoori, uttara jadaram, tumhara, bapham, bahi ya, nayanamalayam." ""

prakrit: "इन्दियम अक्खं करणं छाया कन्ती छवी य लायन्नं,पिसियं सुल्लं मंसं कीलालां सोणियं रुहिरं"
english: "India's eye makes shadow, Which casts a shadow, Like the lotus of a peacock's tail." ""

prakrit: "खुङ्खुणओ नक्कसिरा वच्चं विट्ठा पुरीसमुच्चारो,लञ्छणम अङ्को चिन्धं घम्मजलं समजलं सेओ"
english: "Aunt, A bunch of gooseflesh hangs around your neck, Like water dripping from a sweat on your forehead."

prakrit: "रमणं तियं नियम्बो कच्छा कञ्ची य मेहला रसणा,मुत्तावली य हारो मउली मउडो किरीडो य"
english: "Raman, you are innocent, Kaccha, Kanji, Mehla, Rasna, Muttawali, Yaa, The necklace is made of cow dung cakes."

prakrit: "नीरङ्गी अङ्गुट्ठी आहरणं भूसणं अलङ्कारो,विन्नासो विच्छित्ती कन्नायंसो य तलवत्तं"
english: "One who decorates an ornament with pearls will get it wrong, For without them It is as if one had pierced the head of a virgin."

prakrit: "तलिमं तप्पं सयणं च अङ्गराओ विलेवणं चच्चा,बाउल्ली पुत्तलिया विवणी तह आवणो हट्ठो"
english: "The bottom is bare, The limbs are mangled, The bow is bowed, The bracelets are tied, And the road is impassable."

prakrit: "छत्ताइं आवत्ताĩ हंसयं नेउरं च मञ्जीरं,भद्दासणाĩ सीहासणाĩ उवहाणम ऊसीसं"
english: "The roof is covered with gooseflesh, The nectar is smeared all over the floor, The elephant sits astride its head And its tail is prickly."

prakrit: "वायायणो गवक्खो अद्दाओ दप्पणो य आयरिसो,वेरुलिओ वेडुज्जो कलहोयं रुप्पयं रययं"
english: "The wind blows the cow - dung cakes, The women sit astride their husbands, And the begging bowl turns to rubble."

prakrit: "सोवीरम आरनालं नेहो पिम्मं रसो य अणुराओ,पीढं विट्ठरम आसणम अहिरोहणिया य निस्सेणी"
english: "Take a bath in the holy water of the God of Love, Make yourself comfortable in it, And do not be negligent when you sit in it."

prakrit: "सीरं हलं च नङ्गलम आउहम अत्थं च पहरणं होइ,माढी कवयम उरत्थयम असिमुट्ठी पालिया य छरू"
english: "The plowman's name should be Nangalam and I should wear it at the same time. But kavyam's meaning is the same As that of an unfinished palya." ""

prakrit: "चक्काĩ रहङ्गाइं सित्थं जीवा गुणो पडञ्चा य,तलिमं पट्ठं च तलं विवञ्चिया वल्लई वीणा"
english: "The virtuous qualities of the soul are manifested in the rakhis of the wheel, The lute is captivating both beneath and behind the drum."

prakrit: "छीरं पयं च दुद्धं सिसिरं दहियं चिरड्ढिहिल्लं च,अज्जं सप्पिं च घयं अमयं च सुहा य पीऊसं"
english: "Little by little I will drink milk, mustard seed, curdled rice, and freshly squeezed nectar."

prakrit: "पारावओ कवोओ चडओ घरघण्टओ य कलविङ्को,चिल्ला घारी सउणी भिङ्घारी झिल्लिया चीरी"
english: "Paravo kavo, chadao ghar ghar ya kalavinko, cheela ghari sunni bhringari jhilliya cheeri."

prakrit: "चक्कायओ रहङ्गो कयवाओ कुक्कुडो य तम्बसिहो,वरलाओ हंसीओ कणइल्लो पूसओ कीरो"
english: "Either you bitch, or you cuckoo, Or you play the flute. Either you laugh Or you brush your teeth."

prakrit: "गहरो वओ य गद्धो सारङ्गो चायओ य बप्पीहो,पिच्छाĩ पेहुणाइं नीडं निड्डं कुलायं च"
english: "Foolish girl, donkey, sarong, tea or beverage? The only thing holding back my tears Is the need to sleep and cool down."

prakrit: "कोलो किडी वराहो भुल्लुङ्की य भसुया महासद्दा,कलहो बालो हत्थी करेणुया गयवहू करिणी"
english: "Kolo kidi varaho bhulunki ya bhusuya mahasadda, kalho baalo hasthi karrunuya gayuya karruni"

prakrit: "करिमयरो जलहत्थी कडुयाला कुम्बरा य लहुमच्छा,रिच्छो य अच्छहल्लो लङ्गूलं वालही छिप्पं"
english: "Aunt, You're a water buffalo, A bitter gourd, A lotus bud, A bear with long hair Is hiding in a hole."

prakrit: "तालूरो आवत्तो कुलीरकुरुविल्लया य कक्कडया,उग्गालो छिञ्छोली जम्बालो खञ्जणो पङ्को"
english: "The plowman's son is a coolie, The crows are crows, The farmer's daughter is a parrot, And the goose is a lame duck."

prakrit: "अयडो अडो य कूवो मेयलकन्ना य नम्मया रेवा,पल्ललमखायतल्लं पुक्खरिणी दीहिया सरसी"
english: "O that a well might be dug, Or that a river might be planted Through it, Would that the grass of the field Had blossomed?"

prakrit: "रोहो वप्पो य तडो सालूरा दद्दुरा य मण्डुक्का,अरहट्ठो घडिजन्तं केयारो वप्पिणं वप्पो"
english: "Weeping, Aunt, A flock of parrots standing on the bank Of the river, A swarm of bees hovering around The mango blossom."

prakrit: "नारुट्ठो कूसारो ओहारा कमढकच्छहा कुम्मा,गोयावरी य गोला डिण्डीरो पुप्फओ फेणो"
