prakrit: "नाऊण य वुत्तन्तं सव्वं अन्नुन्नवज्जरिज्जन्तं,अक्कोसन्ति बहुविहं सुमङ्गलं नयरनारीओ"
english: "From the moment they hear the name They take it all in their stride, Like lovers making love Among many others."

prakrit: "एयस्स पडउ विज्जू सुत्तो मा एस बुज्झउ पावो,निद्दोसोवि धणवई अवहरिओ जेण पावेण"
english: "Come on, you fool, Don't sleep on this water. It must be the water that makes the rivers swell." ""

prakrit: "हा! पाव! किं न आसी खयरीओ तुह सरूवजुत्ताओ,मुद्धाए वसुमईए जेण तुमे खण्डियं सीलं?"
english: "Hey! Phew! Aren't you ashamed of yourself, you fool, That you sealed the block?" ""

prakrit: "ता पाव! इण्हि पावसु अणज्जकज्जम्मि निरय! निल्लज्ज!,नियदुच्चेट्ठियसरिसं इहपरलोए फलं कडुयं"
english: "So what! It's raining water! No need to waste it! Stop it! The only bitter fruit is this one, Which, for all my hard work, has already been plucked." ""

prakrit: "एयं न होइ जोग्गं नामं एयस्स दुट्ठचरियस्स!,पावो अमङ्गलो एस जेण एयं कयं पावं"
english: "This is not to be, my dear, What a traitor! For what use is a poor man supposed to be?"

prakrit: "कन्नकडुएहिं एवं असब्भवयणेहिं तेण लोएणं,अक्कोसिओ स बहुहा सुदीणवयणो तहिं वरओ"
english: "Because she has grown so thin On account of her dark and uneven complexion, She is very delicate When it comes to making love."

prakrit: "तेणेव देवेण तहिं मायावित्ताइं रोवमाणाइं,अणुसासियाइं सम्मं तुण्हिक्काइं तु जायाइं"
english: "Then the gods will make you cry out in such a way That your tears will go to your ears."

prakrit: "तत्तो सुरेण भणिया मुञ्चन्ती थूलअंसुयपवाहं,भद्दे! वसुमइ! इण्हिं को तुह हिययस्स उच्छाहो?"
english: "So what do you mean, you silly girl, You stupid bitch! Who's the one who made you laugh?" ""

prakrit: "अह तीए वज्जरियं लज्जाए समोणमन्तवयणाए,जं किञ्चि तुम सामिय! आइससि तहिं समुच्छाहो"
english: "Ah, the shyness of that poor girl! Whatever you think you know, You already know." ""

prakrit: "भणियं सुरेण सुन्दरि! जइ एवं ता करेसु पव्वज्जं,जिणवरभणियं धम्मं कम्ममहाकन्दकोद्दालं"
english: "Daughter - in - law, be beautiful! If you must go and do that, my dear, As long as you follow the dharma, Karma, love, etc., are bound to prevail."

prakrit: "जइवि हु सुन्दरि! तुमए अयाणमाणाए एयमायरियं,तहवि हु इमस्स ओसहं होउ पव्वज्जा"
english: "How lovely you are! You have grown so large in my heart That it is impossible for me to conceal it."

prakrit: "तत्तो य वसुमईए तहत्ति बहु मन्नियं तयं वयणं,महईए विभूईए नियबन्धवअणुमया ताहे"
english: "So long as I live, I will give much credit to my playing, For the bees are bound by the laws of nature."

prakrit: "तत्थेव य नयरीए सुहम्मनामस्स पवरसूरिस्स,मयहरियाए बहुविहसाहुणिगणसेवियकमाए"
english: "That is why the eyes of the fair lady rejoice over the pleasant name, And the ears of the generous hostesses rejoice."

prakrit: "चन्दजसानामाए समप्पिया सुरवरेण सयमेव,तीएवि य आगमविहिणा दिन्ना दिक्खा वसुमईए"
english: "When the moon is full The sun always shines, And when it is dark The sun never rises."

prakrit: "सोवि सुमङ्गलखयरो गुरुरोसेणावि तेण देवेण,दट्ठूण दीणवयणो न मारियो कहवि हु दयाए"
english: "She loves kindness, And hates being angry with her master. But when she sees kindness She doesn't kill It, For it is kindness itself."

prakrit: "नेऊण माणुसुत्तरगिरिस्स परओ स उज्झिओ वरओ,अह सो तियसो पत्तो निययविमाणम्मि वेगेण"
english: "Though I am only a child, I can give birth to a son, And after that a daughter - in - law."

prakrit: "सावि हु वसुमइअज्जा समिईगुत्तीसु सम्ममुवउत्ता,सज्झायज्झाणजुत्ता उज्जुत्ता विणयकरणम्मि"
english: "I will never forget how she shook her head When I tried to kiss her lips And her lips twitched as if to show affection."

prakrit: "पुव्वसयसहस्साइं बहूणि काऊण पवरसामन्नं,संलेहणाए सम्मं झोसित्ता निययदेहं तु"
english: "Your heart is set on embracing me, Your arms wrapped around my husband, As if you were his lover."

prakrit: "अणुरायवसा तं चिय झायन्ती सुरवरं निए हियए,कयअणसणा वसुमई कालं काऊण उववन्ना"
english: "Long live nature, For how long can one waste away Living in the dark?"

prakrit: "ईसाणनामम्मि बिइज्जकप्पे चन्दज्जुणे दिव्वविमाणयम्मि,देवस्स चन्दज्जुणनामगस्स चन्दप्पहा नाम पहाणदेवी"
english: "Isnanamammi biijjakappe Chandajjunane divvavimanayammi, devasa Chandajjunaamagasa Chandappaha naam pahanadevi."

prakrit: "एसोवि परिसमप्पइ वसुमइसुरलोयपावणो नाम,सुरसुन्दरिनामाए कहाए छट्ठो परिच्छेओ"
english: "Aunt, What's your name?" she whispered, Carefully paraphrasing her lovely name.

prakrit: "अह पुव्वसङ्गएणं समयं चन्दज्जुणेण देवेण,गạ̄धाणुरायरत्ता भुञ्जइ दियलोगसोक्खाइं"
english: "Oh! the time the moon gives one's lover, When the nights are over And the pleasures of love are roasted by the rays of the moon"

prakrit: "चन्दप्पहदेवीए सुरलोए सुरवरेण तेण समं,बोलीणो बहुकालो दिव्वसुहं अणुहवन्तीए"
english: "The goddess of the moon equals him in pitch and melody, Speaking for a long time In search of the pleasure of daylight."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाइवि विच्छायं पिच्छिऊण नियदइयं,भयभीया सा देवी तं देवं एवमुल्लवइ"
english: "Oh! what a cruel god! A creeper is destined to follow a scorpion. Fearful is the god Who cannot be destroyed."

prakrit: "सामिय! कीस ससङ्को अरइपरद्धोव्व दीससि तुमन्ति,तह कन्त! रुइविवज्जियदेहो दीणोव किं इण्हिं?"
english: "Samia! How can you look away From my heart When all you do Is cry out loud? What is the use of crying?" ""

prakrit: "सुक्कइ कीस अकम्हा कुसुमसमूहो सिरम्मि सञ्जमिओ?,वसणाणि तुज्झ सामिय! सामलवन्नाणि किं अहुणा?"
english: "How can you say:" "A bunch of safflowers are dry, Your head is wet?" "You are right! Are you ashamed of your face?"

prakrit: "थरहरइ कीस दिट्ठी कामम्मि य सịधिलआयरो इण्हिं,मोडसि य कीस अङ्गं पुणो पुणो,देव! वज्जरसु?"
english: "Why tremble at the sight of a woman whose limbs are twisted by desire? How can you restore the limp body if you turn your back on it? God, you fool!" ""

prakrit: "अह चन्दज्जुणदेवो एवं पुट्ठो पियाए वज्जरइ,किं न याणसि सुन्दरि! जेण ममं पुच्छसि इमं तु?"
english: "Ah, the moon - eyed god, And his son is pining away. Don't you know you are a handsome man? If you ask me, Is this you?" ""

prakrit: "देवस्स चवणसमए इमाणि जायन्ति सुयणु! लिङ्गाणि!,ता मज्झवि चुइसमओ आसन्नो वट्टइ इयाणिं"
english: "At the time of the festival of Gods and Goddesses, women go to sleep! They go to bed early." ""

prakrit: "एवं निसम्म वयणं देवी अइवल्लहस्स देवस्स,उपन्नगरुयसोया दुक्खं नरओवमं पत्ता"
english: "And what a wretched thing it is to fall in love with a god So reckless is the path of sin."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाइवि सो देवो तीइ पिच्छमाणीए,खरतरपवणसमुद्धयदीवोव्व अदंसणीभूओ"
english: "Oh! dear! That god is so slippery when he sees her, So utterly helpless are the gods When they hear of her misfortune."

prakrit: "दट्ठूण चुयं देवं देवी चन्दप्पहा सुदुक्खत्ता,मुच्छाविरमे करुणं विलविउमेवं समारद्धा"
english: "When the gods are seen, The moon - faced goddess is happy; In a fistful of kisses Compassion is as smooth as a bow"

prakrit: "हा! नाह! पाणवल्लह! मोत्तूण ममं गओ कहिं देव!,तुमए रहिया सामिय! कं सरणमहं पवज्जामि?"
english: "Ha! Na! Paanwallah! Motun maam, kahaan deva!, You shamian!, Which stream do I worship?" ""

prakrit: "खणलवमेत्तम्पि तुमं विणा मए नेव नाह! अच्छन्तो,मोत्तूण ममं इण्हिं कत्थ गओ लोयणाणन्द!"
english: "My poor girl, I can't live without you! My dear, Where have you been all this while, Loynananda?" ""

prakrit: "तं चेव मज्झ सरणं तं नाहो जीवियं तुमं देव!,तुमए मुक्का सामिय! भण इण्हिं कत्थ वच्चामि?"
english: "You fool, You devil! How can I escape from you If you threaten my life?"

prakrit: "हा! कत्थ गओ वल्लह! एत्थ अणाहं ममं पमोत्तूणं,को मह सरणं इण्हिं सामिय! तुमए पमुक्काए?"
english: "" "Hey! Where have you been! You silly girl! Here I am trying to seduce you. Who is going to guide me? You stupid bitch!"

prakrit: "सो चेव देवलोगो देवसहस्सोवसोहिओ रम्मो,तुह विरहियाए इण्हिं भावइ नरओवमो मज्झ"
english: "So, my dear, The gods rejoice, And my heart sighs for your separation. I am nothing like a man." ""

prakrit: "तं चिय इमं विमाणं रम्मं मणिकणगरयणविच्छुरियं,तुमए मुक्कं भावइ घडियालयसच्छहं नाह!"
english: "Because the wind whirls the moon, You fool, I don't want to see the clock!"

prakrit: "किङ्करवग्गोपि इमो चाडुकरो विणयकरणतल्लिच्छो,परमाहम्मियसरिसो भासइ तुह नाह! विरहम्मि"
english: "You silly girl, Don't be so naïve: You look so different From my favorite!"

prakrit: "पुंनागनागचम्पयनमेरुमन्दाररेहिरं रम्मं,उज्जाणं तुह विरहे असिपत्तवणंव पडिहाइ"
english: "Love without fire, Love without passion, Is an inexhaustible supply of poison."

prakrit: "वरमज्जणवावीओ निम्पलजलपूरियाओ रम्माओ,भासन्ति तुज्झ विरहे वेयरणिनईए तुल्लाओ"
english: "Wretched women, full of nectar, Make love in your absence Like the petals of a creeper."

prakrit: "धन्नाओ नारीओ जाओ मयं अणुसरन्ति भत्तारं,एयम्मि देवभावे कत्तो एयारिसं मज्झ?"
english: "Blessed are the women who instruct me:" "Come, my lovely lady, Where in the world am I supposed to make love?" ""

prakrit: "एमाइ पलवमाणा सा देवी हणइ नियय हत्थेहिं,अङ्गाइं सुदुक्खत्ता कन्दन्ती करुणसद्देण"
english: "This is the goddess of plenty: Destroyed are her hands and feet, Her limbs remain intact, And she shows compassion."

prakrit: "मुच्छिज्जइ पुणरुत्तं नीसाहारा य पडइ भूमीए,सम्पत्तचेयणा सा पुणरवि एवं समुल्लवइ"
english: "If she is swooned over again And finds no support She falls to the ground, If she finds no treasure She falls again And is completely destroyed."

prakrit: "हा! नाह! किं न पेच्छसि विलवन्तिं जं न देसि उल्लावं,किं वा रुट्ठो वल्लह! किं अवरद्धं मए तुज्झ?"
english: "Oh! no! Why don't you see the lamentations you made When you weren't there? They're just words. What's wrong with you?" ""

prakrit: "पणयकुवियाए सामिय! चाडुसहस्साणि मज्झ कुव्वन्तो,इण्हिं कीस अकण्डे विलवन्तिं मुञ्चसि ममं तु?"
english: "You silly girl, You're the one who made me cry. How come you're so stubborn And want to stay with me?"

prakrit: "हा! नाह! किं न याणसि अइगुरुअणुरायमोहिया एसा,मह विरहे कह होही जेण अकण्डे तुमे मुक्का?"
english: "Hey! Nah! Don't you see That, my poor girl, You're so attractive. How can you separate yourself From me If you bump into one?" ""

prakrit: "एवं बहुप्पगारं पिययमविरहम्मि कन्दमाणा सा,जाया उम्मूलियकमलिणिव्व विच्छायमुहकमला"
english: "And the lotus flower, Which does not budge When separated from the sweetwood flower, Is like a scorpion stuck in a nectar."

prakrit: "दट्ठूण गरुयसोयं गुरुदुक्खसमोहयं तयं देविं,तीए निद्धवयंसा सयम्पभा एवमुल्लवइ"
english: "When she sees a god, She is moved with compassion, When she feels sorrow, And when she feels grief She is utterly devoid of purity."

prakrit: "जाणियजिणवयणावि हु संसारसरूवयं सुणेऊण,इयरमहिलव्व पियसहि! विलवसि किं एरिसं बहुहा?"
english: "I have heard so much about you from all over the world, You stupid girl! Is this what you want to hear?" ""

prakrit: "पियसहि! न हु साहारो बहुणावि हु विलविएण जं अत्थि,ता किं छालियगलथणसमेण विहलेण रुन्नेण?"
english: "Thirsty! Can't you help it? I'm overjoyed at the thought of crying So why cry when one can't help it If one has only to sigh?" ""

prakrit: "जइ विलवसि सयहुत्तं पिट्टसि देहं करेसि गुरुसोयं,तहवि हु न एइ दइओ कालकयन्तेण जो नीओ"
english: "If you moan, Your body trembles, And you groan, There is no mercy in passing the time That is not yours."

prakrit: "तो एयं नाऊणं नेहं सịधिलेसु मुञ्च गुरुसोगं,उज्जम जिणिन्दधम्मे एवंविहदुक्खसमणम्मि"
english: "Therefore, do not take my name from me: It is my teacher's song; It shines through In the midst of jinn and sorrow."

prakrit: "सो तवसञ्जमरूवो देवभवे नत्थि वट्टमाणाए,सम्मत्तसुद्धिहेउं सुन्दरि! ता उज्जमं कुणसु"
english: "So do not confuse her with a god, For she has a round mind. Please, my handsome one, Make her bright." ""

prakrit: "गन्तूण विदेहेसुं वन्दसु तिलोक्कबन्धवजिणिन्दे,केवलिणो तह साहू सञ्जमकरणुज्जए धीरे"
english: "Destroyed abroad, Vanadasu, bound and chained for a while, Only the sahucar can restore order Slowly."

prakrit: "सासयजिणभवणट्ठियजिणिन्दबिम्बाणि परमभत्तीए,कुलसेलदीवपव्वयठियाणि गन्तूण पणमेसु"
english: "Dear mother - in - law, Please allow me the pleasure of going to your husband's house, Wherever he may stay For the rest of my life."

prakrit: "एवं विसुद्धसम्मत्तसञ्जुया पाविऊण मणुयत्तं,लद्धुं जिणवरदिक्खं हयकम्मा वयसि सिद्धीए"
english: "And if you want to achieve wisdom, You have to fight to the death."

prakrit: "एवंविहदुक्खाइं तत्थ गया नेव पाविसि अवस्सं,जरमरणरोगसोगेहिं वज्जिया होसि आकालं"
english: "And the sorrows that remain Have not quite reached that stage, For sooner or later you will be consumed by a contagious disease."

prakrit: "एवं सयम्पभाए भणिया चन्दप्पहा तहिं देवी,मोत्तुण दइयसोगं समागया एत्थ लोयम्मि"
english: "And when the moon was full of moonbeams The goddess was there: Here is the place where mercy meets death."

prakrit: "सहिया सयम्पभाए वन्दित्ता जिणवरिन्दबिम्बाइं,नन्दीसरम्मि ताहे समागया एत्थ भरहम्मि"
english: "Friend, my life is full of joys and sorrows, And my heart overflows with gratitude."

prakrit: "तत्थ य पेच्छइ नयरे रायगिहे पवरबाहिरूज्जाणे,समणगणसेवियकमं ससुरासुरमणुयपरियरियं"
english: "There she is, staring out at the ragged street, Paying lip service to her husband's return." ""

prakrit: "धम्मं वागरमाणं सुहङ्करं नाम केवलिं ताहे,गयणाओ ओयरिया सा देवी पियसहिसमेया"
english: "Dharma is eloquent, a pleasant name only for her, And the goddess is full of affection when she sings."

prakrit: "वन्दिय सुहङ्करं तं सुहं करन्तं तु भवियसत्ताणं,सेसम्पि समणसङ्घं उवविट्ठा उचियदेसम्मि"
english: "When you make a man happy You make him happy. Whenever you meet him You cause such excitement That it makes him angry."

prakrit: "अह सो भयवं तीए सदेवमणुयासुराइपरिसाए,गम्भीरभारईए एवं भणिउं समाढत्तो"
english: "Oh! what a dread she must have felt When, with a heavy heart, she said:" "I agree." ""

prakrit: "अइदुलहो मणुयभवो सुकुलुप्पत्ती जिणिन्दधम्मो य,पत्तम्मि तम्मि उज्जमह सव्वहा मा पमाएह"
english: "O wretched man, If this is the dharma of victory, Do not trouble yourself By illuminating the whole sky with your leaves."

prakrit: "करगहियसलिलसरिसं खणे खणे झिज्जए इमं आउं,तम्हा जिणवरधम्मे मा हु पमायं कुणह तुम्हे"
english: "Come to me, you stubborn man, I beg of you, So don't go walking around in your bedroom Wretched body."

prakrit: "कुससूइअग्गसङ्गयजललवतुल्लम्मि जीवियव्वम्मि,उज्जमह भावसारं अइविसमा जेण कम्मगई"
english: "Life is like a lotus Slipping from the nectar of a flower, Like a flame burning in the heat of passion Which burst into action."

prakrit: "जम्हा पमायमूलं दुक्खं सव्वम्पि एत्थ संसारे,चउसुवि गईसु नियमा तेण इमो होइ मोत्तव्वो"
english: "Whatever sorrow there is in this world Because of my husband, It is only by his rules That I become immortal."

prakrit: "एसो जम्मनिमित्तं रोगजरामरणदुक्खसयहेऊ,एयवसगा य सत्ता भमन्ति भवसागरे घोरे"
english: "Come, let us suffer the death and wretchedness of illness for our sake, For all the time the powers that be roam the skies."

prakrit: "मोत्तुण ता पमायं करेह वरउज्जमं जिणिन्दस्स,धम्मम्मि तग्गयमणा संसारसमुद्दबोहित्थे"
english: "When she dies, you better keep her alive, For the dharma deceives the whole world."

prakrit: "परमत्थबन्धुभूए इमम्मि धम्मम्मि उज्जमं कुणह,निद्धूयसव्वपावा पावह तो मोक्खसोक्खाइं"
english: "May the supreme friend illuminate my dharma, May the path of purity, May I attain liberation."

prakrit: "नाउं कहन्तरं सा देवी चन्दप्पहा इमं भणइ,भयवं! कत्थुववन्नो दइओ चन्दज्जुणो मज्झ?"
english: "Name me, after all, the goddess Chandapaha: In this she speaks fearfully! Where is the compassion of a young man For the moon?" ""

prakrit: "मह कित्तियं च आउं इओ चुयाए य कत्थ मह जम्मो?,दइएण तेण होज्ज नवा दंसणं मज्झ?"
english: "How much longer can I go on like this? How can I make him happy? Let him be, then, If I ever see him again?"

prakrit: "एवं च पुच्छिओ सो बहुमाणजुयाए तीए देवीए,भयवं सुहङ्करो अह एवं भणिउं समाढत्तो"
english: "And ask how she is Being so demanding of young ladies: She is so fearful of handsome men That she replies:" "I am." ""

prakrit: "भद्दे! सो तुह दइओ इह चेव य भारहम्मि वासम्मि,वेयड्ढपव्वयवरे उत्तरसẹ̄धीए रम्माए"
english: "Foolish one, your mercy is such that it buries all our burdens. Instead of weeping, the poor girl replies," "Please, tell me." ""

prakrit: "नयरम्मि चमरचञ्चे भाणुगईनामयस्स खयरस्स,पियजायाकुच्छीए उप्पन्नो पुत्तभावेण"
english: "Never mind the gooseflesh: It's only because of your son's fancy That you start to get angry." ""

prakrit: "पलिओवमाणि अट्ठ ओ तुह आउ आसि समुदियं मद्दे!,इण्हिं तु वासलक्खं अवसेसं चिट्ठए आउं"
english: "Come on, you silly woman! The sea is getting thinner By the way. I think you must have written the letter to her by mistake." ""

prakrit: "पुन्नम्मि वासलक्खे चइऊण तुमम्पि तीइ सẹ̄धीए,सुरनन्दणम्मि नयरे खयरस्स ओ असणिवेगस्स"
english: "If you want to see your lover again, You have to go elsewhere. But if you don't, It's only because you are unhappy."

prakrit: "धूया होहिसि भद्दे! पवरा उ पियङ्गुमञ्जरीनामा,पुव्वदइएण समयं तत्थ य तुह दंसणं होही"
english: "Foolish girl, you're washed away! It's only a matter of time before you blossom into a lovely flower." ""

prakrit: "तत्तो य भणइ देवी नायव्वो सो मए कहं भयवं!,कहवा पाणिग्गहणं होही मह तेण समयम्पि?"
english: "So what do I fear from the goddess? She is a naïve woman. How can she know when it's time for her?"

prakrit: "अह केवलिणा भणियं निसुणसु जत्ताए जिणवरिन्दस्स,उम्मिट्ठकरिवराओ मोइस्सइ जो तुमं भद्दे!"
english: "Oh! only you, silly girl, Stop your anger When you are busy making love!"

prakrit: "सो चेव य नायव्वो एसो सो पुव्ववल्लहो मज्झ,पुणरवि विसेसदंसणमेवं तुह होहिही तेण"
english: "So whatever you do, young man or woman, It's as if you were the only one who can see me again."

prakrit: "तुह माउलधूयाए पाणिग्गहणम्मि कणगमालाए,काउं तीए रूवं एही सो मित्तकज्जेण"
english: "Your mother - in - law put a garland of emeralds on your husband's neck, For what use is a jewel in his hands?"

prakrit: "जो तत्थ कणगमालारूवो होही स पुव्वदइउत्ति,नायव्वो नीसङ्कं भद्दे! चन्दप्पभे! तुमए"
english: "The flower that grows on the lotus Is poisonous to the eyes, But you, O moon - eyed woman, Are a cruel poison." ""

prakrit: "तयणन्तरं च होही पाणिग्गहणम्पि तेण सह तुज्झ,जाईसरणेण तुमं सुमरिस्ससि मह इमं वयणं"
english: "I will never forget how, after the quarrel, I took you for a walk in the water And you with me."

prakrit: "एवं पियसहि! धारिणि! केवलिवयणं निसम्म सा देवी,जाया हरिसियहियया केवलिणो नमिय पयकमलं"
english: "And the poor thing! Dear lady! Only after a long search Does the goddess give way, Except when the lotus is still moist." ""

prakrit: "तत्तो उप्पइया सा सासयजिणचेइयाइं सव्वाइं,वन्दित्ता तित्थयरे महाविदेहेसु सव्वेवि"
english: "There she is, all over her mother - in - law's face, And everywhere along her path, All great gods."

prakrit: "सट्ठाणं सम्पत्ता तं चिय देवं मणेण चिन्तेन्ती,अह अन्नया कयाइवि सावि चुया आउयखयम्मि"
english: "I have so much wealth that I think of him as a god. Either he dies or I live to see him again."

prakrit: "एवं च ठिए जा सा वसुमई अज्जा देवी चन्दप्पहा य सुरलोए,सा हं पियङ्गुमञ्जरिनामा इह सुयणु! सञ्जाया"
english: "And just like that, When the crescent moon appeared in front of the God of Love, She said:" "Foolish girl, do not sleep here!" ""

prakrit: "दठ्ठूण देवनिवहं जाईसरणम्मि अज्ज उप्पन्ने,सम्भरिओ सो देवो पाणप्पिओ आसि जो सग्गे"
english: "Behold, the day has come For the gods to visit you. But, my lord, The God of Love is always with you."

prakrit: "चिरपरिचियस्स पियसहि! गाढं उक्कण्ठिया अहं इण्हिं,तस्सङ्गमइच्छाइ समुच्छुगं इण्हि मह चित्तं"
english: "Long - sighted, thirsty and thirsty! My heart is full of longing." ""

prakrit: "तं कइय दिणं होही जम्मि ससिणेहनिद्धदिट्ठीए,पुव्वभवनेहबद्धं पेच्छिस्सं वल्लहं तमहं?"
english: "How can I describe that day When my eyes were glued to my cheeks As if they were flowers?"

prakrit: "कह सो मे दट्ठव्वो सिग्घं कह तेण सङ्गमो होही,एवंविहचिन्ताए जाया सोगाउरा अहयं"
english: "How can I tell if he sees me or not? I am completely at a loss as to what to do with him."

prakrit: "तं चिय चितन्तीए 'वक्खित्तमणाइ आगयावि तुमं,पियसहि! नो सच्चविया तेण न सम्भासिया भद्दे!"
english: "She thought to herself," "You fool, you coward! Don't be so hasty!" ""

prakrit: "तं जं तुमए पुट्ठं जायं किं सोगकारणं तुज्झ,पियसहि! धारिणि! तं तुह नीसेसं साहियं एयं"
english: "That which you gave to me should grieve you no longer, my dear! My lord, I beg of you to spare me that disgrace."

prakrit: "अह धारिणीए भणियं केवलिवयणं न अन्नहा भद्दे!,ता कीस कुणसि सोयं एवं एएण होयव्वं?"
english: "Oh! my poor girl, Don't eat just because you want to eat! How can you then be so mean And thus become so?"

prakrit: "हसिऊण मए भणियं एवं एयन्ति नत्थि सन्देहो,नवरं अइउक्कण्ठा तुवरइ मह माणसं सुयणु!"
english: "Laugh at my brother - in - law, Don't doubt him, My man, sleep with me only when I am awake!"

prakrit: "एत्थन्तरम्मि पिययम! चम्पगमाला समागया जणणी,भणइ लहु पुत्ति! मज्जसु भुञ्जसु कुण पवरसिङ्गारं"
english: "Here comes the sweetmeat! The girl with the golden bracelet Says," "My son! Please, Bhunjasu! Who is going to master the bow?" ""

prakrit: "भणियं च मए किं अम्मि! कारणं जं अइप्पगे चेव,जाया भोयणवेला,अम्माए तओ इमं भणियं"
english: "" "Mother - in - law, what do I say! Because whatever you say must be said in secret, For if I tell you something, you don't know how to say it."

prakrit: "उज्जाणे जिणभवणे होही ण्हवणं जुगादिदेवस्स,महया विच्छड्डेणं अत्थमणं जाव सूरस्स"
english: "When the sky is bright, Life is full of wonders, When the gods are busy making fun of it, And when the sun is out, It's pure joy."

prakrit: "तत्थ य पुरवत्थव्वो वच्चइ ण्हवणस्स पेक्खओ लोगो,अम्हेवि गमिस्सामो परियणसहियाइं तत्थेव"
english: "There you are, my dear, Looking down the road at the bustle of youth. There we go, Our household helpers at our side."

prakrit: "तेणेव कारणेणं पभायसमयम्मि भोयणं सिद्धं,ता होसु लहुं पउणा जिणभवणे जेण वच्चामो"
english: "For the simple reason that I am ready to depart at the right time, It may be that by surviving the ordeal I have reached my goal."

prakrit: "एवं नियजणणीए वयणं सोऊण उट्ठिया झत्ति,कयभोयणाइचेट्ठा आरụ̄धा सन्दणे पवरे"
english: "And when he had spoken, She looked up at him With trembling eyes And her face fell As if it were her own." ""

prakrit: "नियपरियणपरियरिया गया य उज्जाणभूसणे तत्थ,जिणमन्दिरम्मि सम्मं पूइत्ता वन्दिओ भयवं"
english: "As soon as the festival is over I will go there, wearing a bright mask," he said, "For fear of the God of Love."

prakrit: "दिट्ठं जिणिन्द ण्हवणं कीरन्तं भत्तिजुत्तखयरेहिं,वित्तप्पाये न्हवणे नियपरियणसञ्जुया अहयं"
english: "I have become so addicted to the sight of the living creature That I never want to see him again."

prakrit: "आरụ̄धा रहपवरे वलिया नयरस्स अभिमुहा जाव,उम्मिट्ठो नयराओ नीहरिओ करिवरो ताव"
english: "And behold, the plowman's daughter - in - law is making her way towards the barber." ""

prakrit: "तं दट्ठुं संमुहमिन्तं तुरया मह रहवरस्स उत्तट्ठा,उम्मग्गेण पयट्ठा भग्गो सो सन्दणो ताहे"
english: "The moment I saw him I was blown away. But the sandalwood tree is the ruin of my life." ""

prakrit: "भूमीए अहं पडिया मुच्छाए विगयचेयणा जाया,तेण परं जं जायं पिययम! तमहं न जाणामि"
english: "On earth, I am spoilt for choice, So whatever you drink I don't know." ""

prakrit: "नवरं दिट्ठो सि तुमं वीयन्तो निययउत्तरीएण,दट्ठूण तुमं जाओ गरुओ हिययम्मि आणन्दो"
english: "You look at the bridegroom As though you were about to depart, But when you look at him He sees that he has already arrived"

prakrit: "तत्तो मज्झ विगप्पो पिययम! एसो मणम्मि सञ्जाओ,एयं तं सञ्जायं केवलिणा जं तयाइट्ठं"
english: "So what's wrong with me, dear? This is the way of a gentleman. This is how a gentleman acts." ""

prakrit: "पुव्वभवसङ्गओ सो ता नूणं एस वल्लहो मज्झ,रमइ य इमम्मि दिट्ठी मणं च आणन्दमुव्वहइ"
english: "Love, my dear, Is nothing like a flower, But pleasure, like seeing one's soul in the mirror, Makes one happy."

prakrit: "अमएणव संसित्तं दिट्ठम्मि इमम्मि मह सरीरम्पि,वियसियनयणो एसोवि दीसए साणुरागोव्व"
english: "I will never forget how she looked at me, When I gazed at her body, When tears streamed down her cheeks."

prakrit: "ता मह पाणपिओ सो अवस्समेसॊत्ति जाव चिन्तेमि,ताव य परियणसहिया समागया तत्थ मह धाई"
english: "Then I will drink water, And then I will go to sleep. As long as my friends are present, That is my medicine."

prakrit: "अभिनन्दिऊण तीए आपुट्ठो ताहिं पिययम! तुमन्ति,वच्चमो नियनयरे उस्सूरं वट्टए जेण"
english: "Thanks for the compliment, sweetheart! You're right, I've a secret I don't know about." ""

prakrit: "एवं भणिउं चलिया तत्तो य मए विचिन्तियं एयं,पुन्नेहिं पिओ दिट्ठो इण्हिं न चएमि छड्डेउं"
english: "And let me tell you, Just look at me again And I won't let you go." ""

prakrit: "एयस्स वयणपङ्कयपलोयणं मोत्तु मह इमा दिट्ठी,पङ्कनिबुड्डा दुब्बलगाइव्व न सक्कए गन्तुं"
english: "Oh! my poor girl, My eyes are glued to your cheeks, I can't stop twitching." ""

prakrit: "अविय एवंविहे मुहुत्ते नयणजुयं मिलइ कस्सवि जणस्स,हत्थिव्व पकखुत्तो दुक्खुत्तारं दढं होइ"
english: "Without a moment's silence The young men run towards each other. But when the hands are held in one's heart The sorrow is bound to increase."

prakrit: "एसा वि मज्झ धाई चलिया एयं पमोत्तु मणदइयं,लज्जाए वज्जरिउं अहम्पि सक्केमि नो किम्पि"
english: "This is just my way of putting it: It fills my heart with pride. I can't help it if I sound too arrogant."

prakrit: "ता मज्झ इमं जुत्तं गिण्हामि इमस्स किञ्चि आभरणं,तं चिय पलोइऊणं जेण मणं निव्वुइं कुणइ"
english: "So what do I count as my jewels? They must be worn by men Who think they can nail me to the nail."

prakrit: "मणवल्लहेण एएण विरहिया नियमिहम्मि सम्पत्ता,तं चेव पुलइऊणं सन्धीरिस्सामि नियहिययं"
english: "A man devoid of love Can make us squander our wealth, But to him who buys it By force Is the law of the evening."

prakrit: "अन्नं च किल एस इत्थिरूवो पाणिग्गहणम्मि कणगमालाए,एही,तत्थ य होही पुणोवि किल दंसणं इमिणा"
english: "There must be something wrong with the rice That has made it stick to the water's surface." "Oh! there it is!" "I can't believe I'm going to touch the rice again."

prakrit: "इय तइया केवलिया आइट्ठं मज्झ तेण एयस्स,तं चेव य आभरणं साभिन्नाणं तहिं होही"
english: "Here you are, Just the way I am, Right there with you, Right where you belong, Decorated by your jewels."

prakrit: "एवं विचिन्तिऊणं मुद्दारयणं तु तुम्ह हत्थाओ,गहियं वल्लह! तइया नियया य समप्पिया मुद्दा"
english: "And you, my handsome hussy, You're the one who has to think about the matter. What's the matter with you, dude?" ""

prakrit: "पियकरफासपवित्तं परिहित्ता तम्पि गुरुपमोएण,चलिया वलन्तगीवा सपरियणा नयरसंमुहिया"
english: "Drunken lovers, Proud mother - in - law, Moving from one song to the next, Facing a noisy audience."

prakrit: "अह धारिणिनामाए कन्ने होऊण मज्झ उल्लवियं,एयं केवलिवयणं निव्वडियं ताव इक्कं तु"
english: "Oh! my poor girl, My eyes are glued to your face. Only by closing them Do you see me now."

prakrit: "ता एस देवजीवो पुव्विं जो आसि तुज्झ वल्लहओ,एवं तीए भणिए सरोसमेवं मए भणियं"
english: "So this divine being, who is dear to you, comes and says to me,'I am like a snake.'"" "

prakrit: "बन्धसु निजुत्तिमङ्गे गुत्तं कुन्तलकलावमज्झम्मि,नहवाहणविज्जाणं पडिघायसमत्थमच्चत्थं"

prakrit: "एवं विहिए होहिसि पणट्ठवियणो पुणण्णवसरीरो,ता एस मणी सययं संनिहिओ भद्द! कायव्वो"

prakrit: "सयमेव अहम्पि तुमं सुन्दर! रक्खेमि ताओ खयराओ,नवरं समुच्छुगो हं अइगरुयपओयणवसेण"

prakrit: "जं तेण समं जुज्झे अवस्स तुह होइ पाणचाउत्ति,ता मह वयणाउ तुमे वारहडी नेव कायव्वा"

prakrit: "किञ्च सङ्कुइय केसरी जं उप्पइउमणो गयस्स वहणट्ठा,सोण्डीरत्तं किं तत्तिएण उवहासयं लहइ?"

prakrit: "लद्धावसरो पच्छा साहियविज्जो करिज्जं जं रुइयं,झाडपलियञ्चणेणवि तुरियगई सिग्घओ चेव"

prakrit: "किं बहुणा? एसॊ च्चिय दिव्वमणी मन्दपभावाओ तस्स विज्जाओ,काही,किं तुह कज्जं ससरीरायासकरणेण?"

prakrit: "एवं सुरेण भणिए काऊणं अञ्जलिं पयत्तेण,विहियपणामेण मए भणियं जं आणवेसित्ति"

english: "Sambhasein hain, Guru bhairav, Nehsar mam, So kanta jutta, In the presence of so many different kinds of women, So devoted are the singers to their lovers That, as soon as they see the God of Love, They turn their backs on him."

prakrit: "एसोवि परिसमप्पइ दिव्वमणिसमप्पणॊत्ति नामेण,सुरसुन्दरीकहाए सत्तमओ वरपरिच्छेओ १७५०"
english: "In this way the world will come to an end. The plowman's name will never be forgotten, For he has perfected beauty sevenfold since 1750."

prakrit: "अहयम्पि तओ दक्खिणदिसामुहो सह पियाए सञ्चिलिओ,चिन्तेमि य किं काही खयरो नहवाहणो इण्हिं?"
english: "Now that you have drunkenly kissed me on the mouth, I wonder if you are afraid or not." ""

prakrit: "कयसुररक्खस्स महं बहुविज्जादप्पिओवि सो खयरो,न हु सक्किस्सइ काउं अवयारं गरुयरोसोवि"
english: "Worse, you'll cause me a lot of embarrassment. But don't be alarmed: I have a hard time making love to someone else."

prakrit: "दिव्वमणिणो पभावा संनिज्झेणं च तहय देवस्स,पुन्नाणुभावसरिसं होही भवियव्वयादिट्ठं"

prakrit: "एमाइबहुविगप्पे चिन्तेमाणो वयामि जा तत्थ,ताव य मह दइयाए भणियं भयवेविरतणूए"

prakrit: "ता पिय! किम्पि उवायं चिन्तसु पीडा न होई जह तुम्ह,अहयम्पि विरहगुरुदुक्खभाइणी जह न होमित्ति"

prakrit: "वलियग्गीवं तत्तो पुलोइऊणं मइवि संलत्तं,एमेव कीस सुन्दरि! गरुयविसायं समुव्वहसि?"
english: "The moment I see you, girl, Why are you dressed so casually? You'd better take care of yourself, my dear!"

prakrit: "जइ ता अतक्किओवि हु एज्ज इमो खयरविन्दपरियरिओ,ता होज्ज भयं गरुयं,विन्नाए किं भयं सुयणु!?"
english: "If that's all I care about, my dear, It must be because I'm scared. Otherwise, why be afraid?"

prakrit: "देवेण चेव कहियं आगमणमिमस्स तुज्झ पच्चक्खं,ता किं एयं दट्ठुं भयाउरा सुयणु! सञ्जाया?"
english: "Deven, tell me, When is the last time you looked at me, And why are you so afraid of the sight of me?"

prakrit: "देवस्स दिव्वमणिणो पभावओ सुयणु! सुन्दरं होही,मा मा कुणसु विसायं एन्तं दट्ठूण एयन्ति"

prakrit: "अन्नो न कोवि इण्हिं काउं सक्किज्जए उवाउत्ति,एसो जं सिग्घगई आसन्नो वट्टइ इयाणिं"

english: "Get up, sit down, get ready for the rainy season," said the doe, "And tell me the secret of your redemption."

prakrit: "अविय सम्मद्दंसणमूलो पञ्चमहव्वयमहल्लदढखन्धो,समिईगुत्तीतवसञ्जमाइसाहापसाहिल्लो"
english: "Without a shadow of a doubt, The five great vows meet at the foot of the great altar."

prakrit: "विविहाभिग्गहगोच्छो मणहरसीलङ्गपत्तसोहिल्लो,वरलद्धिकुसुमकलिओ सग्ग 'पवग्गाइसुहफलओ"
english: "Loads of lovely flowers, Like the petals on a lotus leaf, Look like the fruit of the sweet nectar of the God of Love."

prakrit: "चारित्तकप्परुक्खो वित्थरओ साहिओ जिणाणाए,दुहतावतावियाणं जियाण सरणं अणन्नसमं"
english: "Wretched tree, With branches scattered about, Friendships won; A life spent in suffering Is an inexhaustible struggle."

prakrit: "चवलाइं इन्दियाइं दुक्खनिमित्तं च विसयसङ्गोवि,कोहाइणो कसाया निबन्धणं दोग्गइए उ"
english: "The cowherd sang hymns of distress to indifferent Indians; The butcher's bow twisted by the axe"

prakrit: "एक्कसि कओ पमाओ जीवं पाडेइ भवसमुद्दम्मि,भीमो य भवो बहुसो पयासिओ तीए परिसाए"
english: "One cow gives life to another buffalo, Yet one buffalo gives birth to many buffalo calves."

prakrit: "सूरिस्स तस्स वयणं परमामयसच्छहं निसामित्ता,संविग्गा सा परिसा जहागयं पडिगया सव्वा"
english: "When the sun is high The supreme pleasure is for naught, And when the moon is low The whole heavenly realm vanishes."

prakrit: "सोऊण सुधम्मनामो धम्ममई गुरुगिरं निसामित्ता,संसारभउव्विग्गो पणमिय सूरिं इमं भणइ"
english: "When he speaks, I do so out of courtesy; When I speak, He speaks in such a way As to please the world."

prakrit: "इच्छामि तुम्ह मूले निरवज्जं गिण्हिउं सुपव्वज्जं,जणगेहिं अणुन्नाओ भीओ जरजम्ममरणाणं"
english: "I wish you good health, Rooted in your roots, And counted among your favorites. Yet, for all my affection, I fear that my husband may die."

prakrit: "भणियं गुरुणा य तओ होउ अविग्धं तुहेत्थ वत्थुम्मि,अम्मापिऊहिं मुक्को अह सो पव्वाविओ गुरुणा"
english: "My daughter - in - law, You are incompetent. I will deal with you as you wish. But my husband is stubborn And so is my tutor."

prakrit: "अब्भसियदुविहसिक्खो सञ्जमतवविणयकरणउज्जुत्तो,विहिणागुरुपामूले अहिज्जिउं सो समाढत्तो"
english: "Awesome girl, If you ask me how I learned to weep, It's only because my parents refused to drink my blood."

prakrit: "सिग्घ महामई सो जाओ सुत्तत्थतदुमभयविहिन्नू,चुद्दसपुव्वी गुरुसाहुसम्मओ गुणगणावासो"
english: "Sigh, great lady! So go the arrow, Fear the bow, Count the marks You have made On the husband's shoulder,"

prakrit: "नाऊण जोगयं से सुहरिक्खे सूरिणा नियपयम्मि,अहिसित्तो सूरीवि य संलिहियतणू गओ मोक्खं"
english: "If you want to be happy, make sure you have a good night's sleep; if you have to be unhappy, keep at it."

prakrit: "समणगणसम्परिवुडो सुहम्मसूरीवि विविहदेसेसु,बोहिन्तो भवियजणं विहरइ पुरगामनगरेसु"
english: "People gather around each other, See the beautiful scenery in all sorts of different places, And when they arrive people flock to their destinations." ""

prakrit: "धणवाहणोवि कमसो वड्ढन्तो पञ्चधाइपरियरिओ,पत्तो कुमरभावं अहिज्जिओ तह कलानिवहं"
english: "The poorer the carrier, The more mature the five branches, The paler the leaf and the less prominent the bud."

prakrit: "पत्तो य जोव्वणं सो कामिणिजणहिययचोरणसमत्थं,पिउणा य तन्निमित्तं वरिया वररुवसम्पन्ना"
english: "Youth is like stealing from a lover, Drink is like surrendering to your lover, And the bridegroom's wealth is like that."

prakrit: "सिरिसुप्पइट्ठनयरे धूया हरिदत्तपवरइब्भस्स,विणयवईसंमूया 'णङ्गवई नाम वरकन्ना"
english: "Sirisuppa, On this day the gods bathe in the fragrance of turmeric water." "The name of the bridegroom is Varakanna" "In all decency."

prakrit: "महया विच्छड्डेणं परिणीया सोहणम्मि सा लग्गे,धणवाहणेण तत्तो आणीया निययनयरीए"
english: "Aunt, The moment I see you, You'd better take care of yourself," Said the traveler's wife.

prakrit: "अह सो तीए रत्तो जोव्वणवररुवसोउमल्लेसु,गाढं विसयासत्तो गयंवि कालं न याणाइ"
english: "Oh! she is so full of juveniles That she does not know how long she has to walk, Though she is well into her twenties."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया सुधम्मो विहरन्तो मुणिवरो तहिं पत्तो,विजयवईनयरीए वासारत्तस्स पारम्भे"
english: "Ah! what a pleasure it is to visit such a beautiful place, So that the sage may taste the heat of the rainy season With triumphant victory."

prakrit: "साहूहिं तत्थ वसही विमग्गिया ताहि सत्थवाहेण,धणभूइणा विदिन्ना सुविसुद्धा जाणसालासु"
english: "The poor girl lives there, And the poor girl in the village Lives there Because she knows best what's good for her."

prakrit: "नियपरियणेण सहिओ सत्थाहो एइ गुरुसमीवम्मि,सामाइयाइजुत्तो संविग्गो सुणइ जिणघम्मं"
english: "Friend, be vigilant: This is the teacher's third party. But when he comes in contact with others He hears all sorts of nonsense."

prakrit: "धणवाहणो उ दइयासुरयसुहासत्तमाणसो धणियं,पिउणा भणिओवि दढं न ए इ गुरुवन्दओ कहवि"
english: "A generous man, full of kindness and good humour, Is a poor man at heart. If he says he drinks, His master will not tell him so." ""

prakrit: "अहतं विसयासत्तं गुरुरागं धम्मकरणनिरवेक्खं,परिचत्तसेसकज्जं दट्ठुं लहुभायरं गुरुणो"
english: "Without a trace of dharma in a guru's raga, A guru who is afraid of spiteful people Will look at you with familiarity."

prakrit: "जाया एसा चिन्ता भाया मे रागमोहिओ वरओ,जिणवयणबाहिरमई इन्दियविसएसु आसत्तो"
english: "If I had to think about it this way The angry bridegroom would have done the same to me as I do outside India."

prakrit: "दुल्लहमवि मणुयत्तं पावित्ता धम्मविरहिओ एसो,गच्छिस्सइ नरयम्मि घोरासु य तिरियजोणीसुं"
english: "Come, devoid of dharma, O woman devoted to kindness, Let the horrors of old age overtake you."

prakrit: "केणावि उवाएणं बोहेमि रागमोहियं एयं,एवं विचिन्तिऊणं गुरुणा सद्दाविओ भाया"
english: "Somebody said,'I'm very angry,'And someone thought,'My teacher, it's true.'"" "

prakrit: "महया उवरोहेणं समागओ वन्दिऊण तो सूरिं,उवविट्ठो से पुरओ अह सूरि भणिउमाढत्तो"
english: "When the moon is full the sun rises, When the clouds gather around it," he says solemnly.

prakrit: "पोग्गलपरियट्टेहिं बहूहिं सम्पाविऊण मणुयत्तं,हारेसु मा मुहाए विसयामिसमोहिओ भद्द!"
english: "At the mere mention of your husband's name you would be doing a disservice to humanity:" "Don't lose heart!" ""

prakrit: "विसएसु दढं सत्ता सत्ता बन्धन्ति असुहकम्माइं,तव्वसओ संसारे भमन्ति अहमासु जोणीसु"
english: "Such wicked men dominate power, Such incompetent women; Yet, proud women roam the world."

prakrit: "वहबन्धमारणाई नाणाविहवेयणाओ नरएसु,पाविन्ति विसयगिद्धा दूसहाओ दीहरं कालं"
english: "She is not afraid to strike a deal, Not worth the trouble, Just two hundred and fifty rupees."

prakrit: "अच्छउ ता परलोए इहेव पाविन्ति गुरुयदुक्खाइं,विसयपसत्ता दुद्दन्तइन्दिया देहिणो बहवे"
english: "Well, then, my dear, The misfortunes of so many masters Are a drain on the body of India, Which is already overflowing with sorrow."

prakrit: "मोत्तूण निययजूहं करेणुसुहसुरयफासपडिबद्धो,बद्धो वारीबन्धे फासेण गओ गओ निहणं"
english: "Mortally wounded by a sharp arrow Shot from behind the hunter's ear, The prisoner is bound and bound to the fence And must be put to death."

prakrit: "रसणिन्दियम्मि लुद्धो विद्धो गलएण मच्छओ निहओ,धाणिन्दियम्मि सत्तो पत्तो उरगोवि मरणदुहं"
english: "A mosquito bites a lotus Because it pierces through the skin of the raisin. But a yokel sticking out seven petals From the nectar of the waterlily Is the poison of death."

prakrit: "उज्जोइयसयलदिसं दीवसिहं पेच्छिउं पयङ्गोवि,तग्गहणरओ मरणं पत्तो नणु चक्खुदोसेण"
english: "When he rose again I saw a cloud of smoke rising from the pyre, And when he fell I could not help but taste death."

prakrit: "गोरीसद्दासत्तो निच्चलतड्डवियकन्नजुयलिल्लो,सवणिन्दियदोसेणं मिओ मओ वाहबाणेण"
english: "Silly girl, The pain in my groin Is unbearable, But the anger of all my lovers Makes me want to cry."

prakrit: "एक्किक्किन्दियवसगा एए सव्वेवि पाविया निहणं,पञ्चिदियवसगाणं नराण पुण का गई होज्जा?"
english: "With the one - day festival approaching, All the poor people have left. How come the folk songs of the five days Have become stale again?"

prakrit: "ता पञ्चिदियवसगो विसयसुहं सेविऊण मा भद्द!,धम्मोवज्जणरहिओ वच्चसु घोरम्मि नरयम्मि"
english: "So do not be alarmed at the sight of the God of Love, Who is angry at you, For He is angry with you And does not care what you say."

prakrit: "किज्जउ धम्मम्मि मई विसयसुहं उज्झिऊण ता इण्हिं,सहलीकरेसु सुन्दर! अइदुलहं मणुयजम्मन्ति"
english: "Why, dharmamami, if you want to awaken the ecstasy of longing, You'd better take me with you! For this is the birthright of humankind." ""

prakrit: "एयं गुरुणो वयणं निसम्म धणवाहणो इमं भणइ,इच्छामि तुम्हवयणं किं पुण निसुणेह मह भणियं"
english: "This is the master's speech: The archer speaks from it, I want to hear what you have to say; In my heart I speak plainly."

prakrit: "अइनेहपरा वरई खणमवि विरहं न सक्कए सọ̄धुं,दइया 'णङ्गवई मह तेण न सक्केमि तं मोत्तुं"
english: "Aunt, I can't bear to be separated from you." "She begged me," "Please, don't let me touch you So that I wouldn't die" ""

prakrit: "तुब्भम्पि वन्दणत्थं आगमणं तेण होइ न मज्झ,मह विरहे सा वरई इण्हिम्पि हु अच्छए किच्छं"
english: "You fool, That doesn't make me want to come. How can I help you If my husband refuses to come to me?"

prakrit: "तत्तो गुरुणा भणियं चञ्चलचित्ताणं महिलिआण कए,को व सकन्नो पुरिसो हारिज्जा अप्पयं भद!"
english: "So, teacher, tell me, Being a woman of indecisive mind, Who can beat a man so completely?" ""

prakrit: "पवणुद्धुयधयचञ्चलचित्तासुं महिलिआसु आसत्तो,जो धम्मम्मि पमायइ,सो काउरिसो न सप्पपुरिसो"
english: "If a woman has purity of mind, Who practices dharma, She is either cowherd or she is not."

prakrit: "अविय अन्तोविसभरियाओ मणहररुवाओ बज्झवित्तीए,गुञ्जाफलसरिसाओ हॊन्ति सभावेण महिलाओ"
english: "The women are so full of delight That the thunderclaps are deafening, And the guzzlers are bursting with joy."

prakrit: "सच्चदयसोयरहिया अकज्जनिरयाओ साहसधणाओ,भयजणणीओ,तासुं को व सकन्नो रइं कुज्जा?"
english: "Honest friends, Impossible enemies, Rich men, fearful women, Who are they to blame?"

prakrit: "रत्ताओ हरन्ति धणं पाणेवि हरन्ति तह विरत्ताओ,रागेवि विरागेवि य भयङ्करा दुट्ठजुवईओ"
english: "Hearts are lost, Wealth is lost, So is detachment; Angry, frustrated, Or menacing young men."

prakrit: "अन्नं चिन्तेन्ति मणे नियन्ति अन्नं धडेन्ति अन्नेण,चलचित्ताणं ताणं को नाम हविज्ज वल्लहओ?"
english: "They think of food, They govern the mind, They control the food. For who among us has a good name when it comes to good judgment?"

prakrit: "मारेन्ति पइ जारस्स कारणे तम्पि हन्दि! अन्नट्ठा,वीसासन्ति य अन्नं सब्भावं नेय पयडेन्ति"
english: "" "My brother - in - law is angry because my husband is dead! It's the fire of love That consumes all my food."

prakrit: "किं बहुणा भणिएणं जाओ य हणन्ति निययपुत्तम्पि,को नाम पिओ तासिं हविज्ज चवलाण महिलाण?"
english: "Do you mean to tell me, daughter - in - law, Who gave your husband the name You gave him For being such a fickle woman?"

prakrit: "ता भद्द! एरिसाणं तडिच्छडाडोवचवलहिययाणं,महिलाण कए को इह हविज्ज सịधिलायरो धम्मे?"
english: "That's nasty! It's just the way things are. Instead of dragging the woman across the fence, Who is this gentleman looking out for?" ""

prakrit: "इय गुरुभणियं सोउं विहसिय धणवाहणेण संलत्तं,अन्नाओ जुवईओ एवंविहदुट्ठचरियाओ"
english: "Behold, my master's wife, Who was so distressed at the sight of him That she clung to his bracelets While he was abroad, Said the young men." ""

prakrit: "मह महिला पुण सरला पइव्वया सच्चसीलदयजुत्ता,अणुरत्ता सुविणीया थिरनेहा गुरुजणे भत्ता"
english: "A virtuous woman, full of kindnesses, Kindhearted and truthful, Makes everyone happy."

prakrit: "सरिसा सा कह होज्जा असुद्धचरियाण अन्नमहिलाण?,लोहतुरङ्गाईणं दीसइ गुरु अन्तरं लोए"
english: "How come, Sarisa, how come, you clever woman?, The iron bracelet shows the innermost parts of the guru." ""

prakrit: "तत्तो गुरुणा भणियं मणोहरा तुज्झ जइवि सा महिला,तहवि हु उवभुज्जन्ता सरणी सा नरयनयरस्स"
english: "Your master said," "You're right, my dear." "Whatever you say to that woman, That's because I'm jealous of her round breasts."

prakrit: "जह किम्पागफलाइं भुत्ताइं दुहावहाइं इह हॊन्ति,तह इत्थीसुरयसुहं मणहरमवि दोग्गइं नेइ"
english: "As the nectar of a lotus spoils the blossom of a fruit, So does the pleasant fragrance of a fragrant lotus."

prakrit: "जह विसमीसं सरसम्पि भोयणं जीवियं हरइ भुत्तं,तह सुन्दरावि रमणी रमिया नणु दोग्गइं देइ"
english: "The more a woman's life is ruined At the stroke of the twentieth day, The more beautiful and attractive her beloved will be."

prakrit: "ता उज्झसु अणुरायं कुगइनिमित्ताए निययदइयाए,पञ्चमहव्वयजुत्तो होसुं तुमं चरणनिरउत्ति"
english: "So arrange for me to come to you on the auspicious day of Kugai, May the flame of the five great vows steady your steps."

prakrit: "एवं दिवसे दिवसे संवेगकरेहिं महुरवयणेहिं,बोहिज्जन्तो मणयं जाओ अह पयणुरागो सो"
english: "And every day I get more and more emotional. The more I think about it, the more satisfied I become As a traveller."

prakrit: "अन्नदिणे एगन्ते गुरुपुरओ अञ्जलिं करेऊण,धणवाहणो स एवं वज्जरई परमसंविग्गो"
english: "At the same time, Gurupur must perform Anjali, the bearer of wealth, and the wise must attain to the supreme goal."

prakrit: "तुम्हाणममयभूए वयणे निसुएवि मज्झ हिययाओ,किं नो सक्कइ रागो विसंव दुट्ठस्स सप्पस्स?"
english: "You fool, Don't you see that my heart is bursting with anger? Is there any reason why I should be angry?"

prakrit: "भयवं! ताव न तुट्टइ दइयाए उवरि सव्वहा रागो,नवरं करेमि एक्कं जइ जुत्तं तुम्ह पडिहाइ"
english: "Don't be afraid! Everyone is angry. I'll do it again As soon as I see you." ""

prakrit: "सुरयसुहनिप्पिवासो दिक्खं गिण्हामि तुम्ह पामूले,दइयाए समं अहयं दंसणमित्तेण सन्तुट्ठो"
english: "When I see you, my dear, I count my days as long as you are alive. At the same time I am content with my existence."

prakrit: "एवं ववत्थियम्मि जइ जोग्गं देह मज्झ तो दिक्खं,तीए अदंसणेणं सक्केमि न जीवियं धरिउं"
english: "And if I see your body as it is now, I cannot help staring at it."

prakrit: "तव्वयणं सोऊण य सुधम्मसूरि विचिन्तए एवं,पेच्छह अइदुरन्तो रागो कह विलसए लोए?"
english: "When you think of your lover, Whom do you wish you had with you, And when you ask him Why he is so angry?"

prakrit: "एवम्पि ता दिज्जउ पव्वज्जा ताहि गहियसुत्तत्थो,सयमेव विवेगजुओ उज्झिस्सइ रागसम्बन्धं"
english: "Give it to me, dear go - between. Always discerning. Always stirring up anger."

prakrit: "एवं विचिन्तिऊणं अणङ्गवइयाए सञ्जुओ ताहे,धणवाहणो सभाया गुरुणा पव्वाविओ विहिणा"
english: "And Sanju is there to distract and distract, The moneylender's master's wife Is there to restrain him." ""

prakrit: "चन्दजसानामाए मयहरियाए समप्पिया सावि,साहुणिगणमज्झगया सिक्खइ वरसाहुणीकिरियं"
english: "Aunt, When the moon is full of moonlight She forgets how to sleep. When the rain clouds gather She learns how to make rain."

prakrit: "एवं च ताण दोण्हवि परोप्परं जाव तुट्टइ न रागो,बहुणावि हु कालेणं सुत्तत्थ विसारयाणम्पि"
english: "In the same way, when two people are at loggerheads, one doesn't get angry. Sometimes it's just the way things happen." ""

prakrit: "ताव य गुरुणा भणियं एगन्ते भारईए महुराए,एयं न जुत्तमहुणा उत्तमसत्ताण तुम्हाण"
english: "Aunt, If your husband comes home early enough, You'd better take care of him, Not so long ago."

prakrit: "अविरइजुवइजणेवि हु सवियारपलोयणम्मि साहुस्स,पायच्छित्तं गरुयं भणियं सुत्ते जिणिन्दस्स"
english: "I will never forget how my parents made me feel When I slept soundly, When I tried to escape, And when I fell asleep on my feet."

prakrit: "जं पुण साहुणि विसए सवियारपलोयणं तु साहुस्स,तं भद्द! गुरुअणत्थस्स कारण वन्नियं समए"
english: "The more you tolerate your lover's flattery, the uglier you become! It is only because of your parents'incompetence That you are content." ""

prakrit: "इयरमहिलाजणेवि हु दिट्ठीपाओ न होइ जुत्तोति,किं पुण समणीविसए अबोहिबीयस्स मूलम्मि?"
english: "Though I did not see the woman in person, I could see her feet. So why am I still such a stubborn fool?"

prakrit: "ता उज्झिय अविवेयं रागं अवहत्थिऊण भावेण,परिहरसु सव्वहच्चिय दिट्ठिकुसीलत्तणं एयं"
english: "So lift up your senses, Unhindered by anger, With emotion that takes your eyes off everything you touch."

prakrit: "एवं गुरुणा भणिओ संविग्गो सोवि चिन्तए एवं,अइरागपरवसस्स ओ धी!धी! मह निव्विवेयस्स"
english: "And the teacher said:" "Be careful what you think of me: I am completely exhausted." ""

prakrit: "जो हं पणट्ठलज्जो गयरायपयम्मि वट्टमाणोवि,साहुजणनिन्दणिज्जं रागं न चएमि छड्डेउं"
english: "I will not give in to the taunts of my friends, Who turn their backs on me As I walk past."

prakrit: "लद्धूणवि निरवज्जं पव्वज्जं दुट्ठरागपडिबद्धो,होहामि पुन्नरहिओ दीहरसंसारआभागी"
english: "Stuck in the mud for so long, Destroyed by fire and water, I will never be the same again."

prakrit: "ही जीव! पाव! भमिहिसि नारयतिरिएसु दीहरं कालं,अविसयपयट्टरागो लद्धूणवि धम्ममणवज्जं"
english: "O soul! Wretchedness! How long will you go on dancing in the mud? The arrow of the God of Love cannot be stopped But must be struck with the bow of Dharma." ""

prakrit: "एवं भावेन्तस्सवि धणवाहणसाहुणो न उत्तरइ,अणुरागो तव्विसए ताएवि य तस्स उवरिम्मि"
english: "And when he calls out to me, I do not answer, For if I tell him so, he does not answer."

prakrit: "एवं वच्चइ कालो सञ्जमतवविणयकरणनिररयाणं,गुरुआणासम्पाडणपराण अह ताण दोण्हम्पि"
english: "And just like that, when I heard my husband speak, I could not help laughing When he tried to reason with my teacher."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाइवि भगिणीए वसुमईए सञ्जुत्ता,चलिया 'णङ्गवई वियारभूमिए बहियाओ"
english: "Oh! my poor girl! It's springtime already, Let's go and wash the bare ground." ""

prakrit: "दिट्ठो य ताहि एगो महिलासहिओ नरो उ उम्मत्तो,धूलिरयधूसरङ्गो जरचीवरचीरियाइन्नो"
english: "Look, you fool, There's only one woman left. The rays of a dusted rainbow Slippery through the mud."

prakrit: "उगायन्तो बहुहा नच्चन्तो डिम्भसत्थपरिकिन्नो,तं दुट्ठुमणङ्गवई सुइरं पुलएइ तं जुयलं"
english: "One grows many flowers, One tastes little, Like the plucking of an egg, Like a needle sticking out of the nail of one's pen."

prakrit: "तत्तो तीए भणियं भगिणीए सुलोयणाए अणुहरइ,अज्जो! एसा जुवई गहगहियनरस्स पासत्था"
english: "There she is, embracing her brother - in - law's firm embrace." "Ah! Such a young woman is the pastime of a proud husband!" ""

prakrit: "भणियं च वसुमईए सुइरं निज्झाइऊण सविसायं,सच्चिय एसा अम्हं भगिणी ओ सुलोयणा नाम"
english: "Spring and summer, Spring and autumn are welcome. Truly, such is the name of our sister - in - law, Silly girl."

prakrit: "परिणीया आसि पुरा सुबन्धुणा मेहलावइपुरीए,दिट्ठा कणगरहेणं कयाइ अह रायउत्तेणं"
english: "Parineeta, come on, full of beautiful women, Look how they compose themselves While raising their voice."

prakrit: "अन्तेउरम्मि छụ̄धा अइगुरुअणुरायहरियहियएण,सयलोरोहपहाणा जाया अह तस्स वल्लहिया"
english: "Aunt, It's only because the trees aren't blossoming again That the fire of love has gone out of control." ""

prakrit: "एयं मह पच्चक्खं सव्वम्पि हु सासुरे वसन्तीए,वित्तं,तुमएवि सुयं अज्जे! लोयप्पवायाओ"
english: "Here are my emeralds: They all belong to my mother - in - law. Finance, they belong to you! Take them with you, dear girl." ""

prakrit: "एसो गहगहियनरो दीसइ सरिसो उ रायउत्तस्स,ता एसो कणगरहो एसावि सुलोयणा नूणं"
english: "Such a man is always full of trouble, Such is the behavior of a sulking nun."

prakrit: "भणियमणङ्गवईए सम्भासेमो इमं तु नियभगिणिं,किं अम्हे परियाणइ,अहवाविअ भम्भला एसा"
english: "You're right, my dear, It's just the way things work. Are you angry with me, My dear, Or are you angry at me?"

prakrit: "तत्तो गन्तुं दोहिवि महुरं आभासियावि सा जाहे,नवि जाणइ किञ्चि फुडं बोल्लइ य बहुअसम्बध्धं"
english: "There you go, Two bees sitting side by side, Knowing nothing at all What to eat or drink But plenty of it."

prakrit: "ताहे दोवि जणाइं सुधम्मसूरिस्स पायमूलम्मि,करुणापराहिं अज्जाहिं ताहि नीयाइं सविसायं"
english: "That the two of them met at the foot of the pyre Succeeded in making love, Without showing mercy - Such are the rules of etiquette."

prakrit: "भणिओ अज्जाहिं गुरू एसा अम्हाण जिट्ठभगिणी ओ,किं होइ नवा भयवं! जाया उम्मत्तिया कहवा?"
english: "Tell me, Teacher, How is it that I am so stubborn Now! What is to be afraid of? How can you say yes?" ""

prakrit: "भणियं गुरुणा तत्तो नाणेण वियाणिऊण परमत्थं,सच्चिय सुलोयणा सा कणगरहो एस जुवराया"
english: "Friend, a wise man is worth more than a wise woman, A true gentleman is worth less than a jeweler."

prakrit: "जोगो मइमोहकरो सीसे खित्तो इमाण सुत्ताण,एक्काए सवत्तीए ईसावसगाढकुद्धाए"
english: "If I lose my temper, It's only because I'm angry. Everyone loses their cool."

prakrit: "तस्स वसेणं दोण्हवि मइसंमोहो इमाणं सञ्जाओ,रन्ना य तओ विज्जा बहवे सद्दाविआ तत्थ"
english: "The only reason you live there is that both the buffalo and the tiger know so much about each other. In the forest, too, knowledge flows. That's where the Sadawiyas live."

prakrit: "न य केणवि पउणाइं कयाइं कालेण रक्खगनराण,कहवि पमायपराणं नीहरियाइं इमाइं तु"
english: "No one knows how long it will take for the clouds to recede, only you."

prakrit: "भणियं च वसुमईए भयवं! एयाण मूढचित्ताणं,जइ पेच्छह उवयारं,पडिजोगं देह चिन्तेउं"
english: "The land is empty And the people are afraid! Such is the mind - set. If you look down the road You will see that the body is empty." ""

prakrit: "तत्तो गुरुणा तेसिं दिन्नो उम्मायनासणपडिट्ठो,पडिजोगो,जायाइं दोण्णिवि अह सत्थचित्ताइं"
english: "Then the teacher gave it to me:" "Respect the woman's position." "Dear friends, The truth is that both are true."

prakrit: "दट्ठूण भगिणिजुयलं सुलोयणा विम्हिया इमं भणइ,किं नाम इमं सुमिणं किंवा मइविब्भमो एस?"
english: "Look! A bunch of naughty girls are dancing around In this damned mess. What's her name, Daughter - in - law, Or my own?"

prakrit: "सा कत्थ अम्ह नयरी सा य विभूई य ते अलङ्कारा,कह धूलिघूसराइं इह म्हि सम्पावियाइन्ति?"
english: "Where is that beauty, That she looks so beautiful Ornamentally? How can dusty thickets satisfy me?" ""

prakrit: "दोन्निवि गहियवयाओ कत्थ व भगिणीओ मज्झ इहइं तु?,ता नूण इन्दयालं एयं अहवावि सुमिणन्ति"
english: "How are you both, my lovely wife, And how are you my dear?" he asked, Then, with a heavy heart, They both kissed.

prakrit: "तत्तो य वसुमईए कहियं उम्मायकारणं सव्वं,जाव य गुरुमाहप्पा नट्ठो तुम्हाण उम्माओ"
english: "It was then that I said:" "I agree with you on everything." "Your parents disapproved."

prakrit: "जइया य तुमं भद्दे! छụधा अन्तेउरम्मि जुवरन्ना,तइयच्चिय खयरेणं मायाइ सुमङ्गलेण अहं"
english: "" "You bastard! You're right, Your breasts are getting thinner By the way. I'm completely at a loss What to do with your breasts Now that you're gone."

prakrit: "भुत्ता पभूयकालं धणवइदेवेण बोहिया तत्तो,जाया चन्दजसाए पयमूले सुयणु! पव्वइया"
english: "When the moon is full, The God of Love takes his bow in his hand, And when he falls asleep at the root of the pyre, He is gone!"

prakrit: "एसावि अणङ्गवई धम्मं सोऊण भवभयुव्विग्गा,नियभत्तुणा समेया पव्वइया एत्थ गच्छम्मि"
english: "Such a person is averse to Dharma, so do not be afraid of it, For at the same time he is always on the move."

prakrit: "ता सुयणु! न सुविणमिणं सच्चं चिय जं इमं दिट्ठं,एसो सो अम्ह गुरु सुधम्मनामो महासत्तो"
english: "That's sleep! No need to whisper the truth What I saw in my dream. This is the greatness of our teacher's name." ""

prakrit: "तत्तो दोवि जणाइं सुधम्मसूरिस्स परमविणएणं,वन्दन्ति हरिरिसाइं पयकमलं सयलदोसहरं"
english: "Then both of them said:" "May the pleasures of love find their supreme expression," "And bowed their heads as they kissed the lotus of their beloved."

prakrit: "तत्तो संवेयकरिं गुरुणो सोऊण देसणं पवरं,पडिबुद्धाइं दोन्निवि कमेण पव्वाइयाइन्ति"
english: "The master thought that at that moment the whole place was deserted, For both their affections had been swallowed up by the lotus."

prakrit: "मयहरियाए पासे भगिणीजुअलेण सञ्जुया तत्तो,सञ्जमगुरुविणयरया सुलोयणा कुणइ विविहतवं"
english: "By my side the breasts of the bridegroom bend As if they had been struck with a sharp arrow, And by the wives of the bridesmaids The modesty of the groomsmen Diffuses."

prakrit: "एवं चन्दजसाए पयमूले ताण अच्छमाणाणं,तिण्हम्पि हु भगिणीणं वोलीणा वासरा बहवे"
english: "And when the moon was full of twigs It looked like a flock of parrots Flying out of the hole in the rafters."

prakrit: "मुणिणो कणगरहस्स उ धणवाहणसाहुणो य सञ्जाओ,भो चित्तवेग! तइया अन्नोन्नं गरुयनेहॊत्ति"
english: "Silly girl, Don't be so hasty! It's your heart that's beating! You're making a mess of it." ""

prakrit: "पञ्चमहव्वयजुत्ता समिईगुत्तीसु सम्ममुवउत्ता,नाणाविहतवनिरया गिण्हन्ति य सुत्तअत्थाई"
english: "The arrows of the five great vows meet at the right moment; Those struck with the reed Count only the days and nights."

prakrit: "गुरुआणाए निरया दोन्निवि पालेन्ति चरणकरणाइं,एवं पभूयकालो वोलीणो ताव दोण्हम्पि"
english: "The Guru took care of both the parents'feet, And when he had passed away they clung to each other."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाइवि थोवं नियआउयं मुणेऊणं,सूरी संलिहियतणू अणसणविहिणा मओ सम्मं"
english: "Oh! what a cruel man you are, Thinking how hard it is for you To go on sipping wine Without spilling it all over your face."

prakrit: "बीयम्मि देवलोगे पवरे चन्दज्जुणे विमाणम्मि,जाओ विमाणसामी देवो उ ससिप्पभो नाम"
english: "Beemami devaloge, paavare Chandajune vimanammee, Jao vimanasammee devo, Ussipabho naame." ""

prakrit: "धणवाहणोवि साहू अतुट्टरागो चरित्तु सामन्नं,कालं काउं विहिणा उप्पन्नो बीयकप्पम्मि"
english: "The hunter's hunter and his hunter are at loggerheads, Time is of the essence," says the farmer.

prakrit: "सामाणियठाणम्मि देवस्स ससिप्पहस्स सो जाओ,भासुरसरीरधारी देवो विज्जुप्पहो नाम"
english: "The God of Love's mother - in - law is asleep, The god of fair skin is named Vijjuppa." ""

prakrit: "सावि हु अणङ्गवइया अविगयरागा चरित्तु सामन्नं,विज्जुप्पहस्स जाया देवी अह चन्दरेहत्ति"
english: "Savai hu anangavya, Avigayraga charitu samannam, Vijjupa hastas jaya devi Ah, the crescent of the moon."

prakrit: "सम्भरिय पुव्ववेरं बहूवसग्गे करित्तु अइभीमे,अग्गिकुमारसुरेणं सुम्बन्धुजीवेण पावेण"
english: "Aunt, If you want to spend the night with your beloved's daughter - in - law, You better burn the pyre So that her relatives can live a happy life."

prakrit: "कणगरहो सो साहू सुलोयणाए समं तु अज्जाए,निहओ तं उवसग्गं विसहन्तो सम्मभावेण"
english: "You are as hard as a cotton swab, And you are as smooth as a sponge."

prakrit: "कालं काउं दोन्निवि उवन्नाइं तु बीयकप्पम्मि,चन्दज्जुणे विमाणे सामाणियदेवभावेण"
english: "You fool, Time has both, And you fool, Because the moon is like a god in a plane."

prakrit: "कणगरहो ओ विहुप्पहनामो इयरा सयम्पभा नाम,सावि तइज्जा भगिणी वसुमइया आउयखयम्मि"
english: "My poor girl, This year's name may be yours, My dear sister - in - law; The rainy season is approaching."

prakrit: "पुव्वदइयस्स जाया चन्दज्जुणनामगस्स देवस्स,तत्थेव किल विमाणे देवी चन्दप्पभा नाम"
english: "Tomorrow the moon will be full, Tomorrow the clouds will appear, And then the sky will reveal the name of the moon god."

prakrit: "एवं एगविमाणे दिव्वसुहं ताण अणुहवन्ताणं,सव्वेसिं अन्नोन्नं अइगरुया आसि पीईओ"
english: "And just like that, The pleasures of daylight, Unhaven, Are dear to all beings."

prakrit: "पलिओवमाणि अट्ठ उ दिव्वसुहं तत्थ अणुहवेऊणं,देवो विज्जुप्पहो सो चइऊण इमम्मि वेयड̣धे"
english: "The plowman's wife prays for the pleasure of seeing her husband again." "God, you fool, doesn't know how to weep" "? "

prakrit: "दक्खिणसẹ̄धीइ पुरे रमणीए रयणसञ्चए पवरे,पवणगइखयरपुत्तो उप्पन्नो बउलवइयाए"
english: "The south wind stirs the whole expanse of the lovely river, Like the plowman's son blowing on the wind." ""

prakrit: "एवं चि ठिए जो धणवाहणजीवो देवो विज्जुप्पहो य दियलोए,सो य तुमं इह सुन्दर! उप्पन्नो चित्तवेगॊत्ति"
english: "And by the way, the God of Wealth, Who is a living being, Is as good as a wise man, So you look so handsome! You're beyond reproach." ""

prakrit: "देवीवि चन्दरेहा तत्तो आउक्खए चुया सन्ती,उप्पन्ना वेयड̣धे नयरे सिरिकुञ्जरावत्ते"
english: "The goddess was so full of moonlight That she could not sleep at all. Instead, Sirikunjar used to bathe in the sky With his eyes closed." ""

prakrit: "खयरस्स अमियगइणो पियाए भज्जाए चित्तमालाए,कुच्छीए सम्भूया पियधूया कणगमालत्ति"
english: "Proud woman, When she is drunk her heart is full, When her breasts are bristling with desire, And when she is angry they are sighing."

prakrit: "भो चित्तवेग! पुव्विं तुब्भं जो आसि रागसम्बन्धो,सामन्नमुवगयाणवि तस्स फलं एरिसं जायं"
english: "O mindfulness! Whichever of you comes across as angry, When faced with adversity His fruit is bound to wither." ""

prakrit: "रुवं बलं च दित्ती रिद्धीवि य आसि थेविया तुम्ह,देवभवे तुह आउं विमज्झिमं थवेयं आसि"
english: "May you always be with me, O god, If you give me the strength to cry, I will come to you And keep you safe."

prakrit: "एत्थवि माणुस्स-भवे अवरोप्पर-दंसणाओ आरब्भ,दुसहं विओय-दुक्खं सञ्जायं तुम्ह दोण्हम्पि"
english: "Here and there humankind - from all directions - is suffering, both for your sake and for yours - suffering."

prakrit: "तुमएच्चिय अणुभूयं विओयदुक्खं सुदूसहं जमिह,भो चित्तवेग! किंवा कहिएणं तेण तुह पुरओ?"
english: "You, my dear, live in such a way That it is painful to look at, Or do you want to be touched by it?"

prakrit: "काऊणवि सामन्नं सरागभावो तुमे न जं चत्तो,तस्स फलेणं एसा दूसहा तुह आवया जाया"
english: "You do not deserve to die, For what you gain Is not yours to lose."

prakrit: "देवभवे तुह मित्तो चन्दज्जुणनामगो य जो आसि,चइऊण सोवि तत्तो चित्तगई एत्थ सञ्जाओ"
english: "Dear God, Your name is Chandrajjuna, come what may, For where the moon is, There the heart is fixed." ""

prakrit: "वसुमइनामा अज्जा देवी चन्दप्पहा य दियलोए,सावि य पियङ्गुमञ्जरिनामा इह भद्र! उप्पन्ना"
english: "Wasu meenama ajja devi, Chandappaha ya diyaloe, Savi ya peengumanjarinama ya bhadra! Uppanna." ""

prakrit: "जं पुव्वसङ्गओ सो चित्तगई तेण तुम्ह सञ्जाओ,अन्नोन्नं गुरुनेहो सुन्दर! सइदंसणेणम्पि"
english: "That the flower is with you Is heartwarming, my dear: You are so beautiful! Our eyes have seen it all." ""

prakrit: "तेणं उवायपुव्वं घडिया सा तुज्झ कणगमालाओ,इण्हिं सकम्म्वसओ जाओ तुह तीइ सह विरहो"
english: "That lovely girl, Your bracelets are falling at your feet. May I part with you, my dear." ""

prakrit: "भो चित्तवेग! बहुणा किंवा भणिएण एत्थ अन्नेण?,जं चेव आसि पुट्ठं तं चिय तुह ताव साहेमि"
english: "" "My dear, Is that your intention?" "You look at me, Or say:" "Here I am." "Whatever comes of my son I swear to you."

prakrit: "कणगरहो सो साहू अइप्पिओ आसि तुज्झ अन्नभवे,तत्तो य देवलोए विहुप्पहो नाम जो देवो"
english: "Be reasonable! Aunt, your food will be plentiful, As will the name of the god of plenty." ""

prakrit: "सो य अहं तुह वल्लहमित्तो अज्जवि तत्थ वसामि दिवम्मि,कारणमित्थमिमं तु पडुच्च मे अइसङ्गयओ सि तुमन्ति"
english: "That's why I love you so much And where I live to this day, Because you always make me feel so welcome."

prakrit: "एसो एत्थ समप्पइ चिरपरिचियवन्नणॊत्ति नामेण,सुरसुन्दरिकहाए अट्ठमओ वरपरिच्छेओ"
english: "Come, let's finish this thing. In the name of a well - known person We shall mark the eighth day of our wedding." ""

prakrit: "अह भणइ चित्तवेगो सुरवर! मह कहसु केण कज्जेण,तइया मणिं समप्पिय कत्थ गओ आसि तुरियगई?"
english: "" "My lord, tell me, How can I help you?" "When did you finish your speech You forgot where you left off."

prakrit: "तो भणइ सुरो सुन्दर! निसुणसु एयम्पि वज्जरिज्जन्तं,अज्ज अहं आणत्तो ससिप्पहेणं तु देवेण"
english: "" "So tell me, Your voice is lovely! Stop bothering me till the very next morning. I swear I've got a secret. It's all your doing."

prakrit: "गच्छ विहुप्पह! खिप्पं जम्बूद्वीवम्मि भरहखेत्तम्मि,नयरे कुसग्गनामे धणवाहणमुणिवरसमीवे"
english: "" "Go - between! It's a full moon in the sky." "Without a trace Of rain clouds Lurking in the horizon."

prakrit: "सो पुव्ववेरिएणं दिट्ठो झाणम्मि सण्ठिओ तत्थ,तं दट्ठु कुविओ सो काही अइगरुयउवसग्गं"
english: "He looked at the flower seller's face, Then he looked at her breasts, And behold, something grew on his cheeks." ""

prakrit: "ता तस्स रक्खणट्ठा सिग्धं वच्चाहि तम्मि नयरम्मि,अहमवि इन्दाणत्तिं समाणिउं आगमिस्सामि"
english: "So protect him, keep him safe, For I will surely meet him again in the near future."

prakrit: "तत्तो तहत्ति भणिउं वेगेण समागओ अहं इहइं,तावय दइयासहिओ पलायमाणो तुमं दिटिठो"
english: "There he said," "I'm off in a hurry, So take pity, I ran away when I saw you." ""

prakrit: "ओहिनाणेण मए नायं जह एस सो हि विज्जुपहो,मह मित्तो नहवाहणभयाउरो वच्चए तुरियं"
english: "Because of him I do not know who he is, For the fear of my friends and lovers Has turned me upside down."

prakrit: "नहवाहणोवि एसो पटिठविलग्गो इमस्स एइत्ति,ताहे करेमि किञ्चिवि उवगारं पुव्वमित्तस्स"
english: "Here I am, bathing in the river, Going down the path again, And then I'll do something To appease you."

prakrit: "एवं विचिन्तिऊणं तुम्ह समीवम्मि आगओ अहयं,तइया य मणी दिव्वो समप्पिओ जीवरक्खट्ठा"
english: "And thinking how you must be getting on with your life, I will put out this fire."

prakrit: "तत्तो य गओ तुरियं घणवाहणमुणिवरस्स पासम्मि,दिट्ठो य मए देवो उवसग्गं तस्स कुणमाणो"
english: "There you go, Turiam, Standing beside the lotus of my heart. Look! My god, This is the way of good men."

prakrit: "भणियं च मए रे! रे! तियसाहम! कत्थ वच्चसे इण्हिं,देविदवन्दियाणं मुणीण एवं करेमाणो?"
english: "" "My brother - in - law, my dear! Where have you been for so long, Mr God?" "Are you going to bow down and worship him?"

prakrit: "उप्पायन्तो पीडं मुणीण समसत्तुमित्तवग्गाणं,पाविट्ठ! कत्थ वच्चसि दिट्ठीमग्गम्मि मह पडिओ?"
english: "Wretched man, Where have you been? My poor girl, You're the only one who's had your way. Where did you get your eye in?"

prakrit: "एवं च मए भणिए भवणवई सो सुरो ससम्भन्तो,नट्ठो सहसा ताव य सुक्कज्झाणे पविट्ठस्स"
english: "And as I said, Bhavana va ̄ nava ̄ ya, so the tune is complete, except that all of a sudden you taste as if you were in a trance." ""

prakrit: "मुणिणो मोहावगमा उप्पन्नं केवलं वरं नाणं,केवलिमहिमा विहिया तओ मए परमविणएणं"
english: "A sage's penance is nothing but a blessing, But my loving - kind heart is sufficient to support me in my supreme victory."

prakrit: "सोउं दुन्दुहिसद्दं देवा मणुया य आगया बहवे,कहिओ तेसिं धम्मो केवलिणा मोक्खसुहहेऊ"
english: "O god of sorrows, If this fire were to burn, Say :'Only dharma can bring about liberation '." ""

prakrit: "पत्थावं लहिऊणं पुट्ठो सो केवली मए एवं,भयवं! किं अवरद्धं इमस्स देवस्स तुम्हेहिं"
english: "Only because I threw away the stone You scared the hell out of me. What more do you want me to do?" ""

prakrit: "जेणेसो पावमई जीवियववरोवणम्मि उज्जुत्तो?,तो भणइ मुणी निसुणसु जह वेरं आसि अन्न भवे"
english: "What makes you think I'm angry?" asked the sage, "You fool, tell me to rest, so that there may be food for the poor."

prakrit: "धायइसण्डविदेहे चम्पानामेण आसि वरनयरी,तीए पउमो राया जुवराया समरकेउत्ति"
english: "Daughter - in - law, If you come to Champaner in the middle of the night, You'll have to go up in flames Like a warrior's wife."

prakrit: "जिणवयणभावियप्पा सहोयरा दोवि नेहसञ्जुत्ता,पालेन्ति देसविरइं रज्जधुरं तह य नीईए"
english: "Love based on love, Jealousy based on jealousy, And love based on enmity should not be taken for granted."

prakrit: "अत्थाणमुवगयाणं नाहियवाई समागओ कविलो,वज्जरइ नत्थि जीवो न य सव्वन्नू न नेव्वाणं"
english: "Poets come together only when there is no true love, For neither do they live nor do they learn anything."

prakrit: "जिणमयसत्थत्थवियाणएण जुवराइणा जिओ वाए,दिट्ठन्तहेउकारणनाणाविहजुत्तिनिवहेण"
english: "For what reason do women live if they cannot bear to look at each other?"

prakrit: "जुवरन्नो पडिवयणं जाहे न चएइ किम्पि सो दाउं,ताहे मन्तिमहत्तमसामन्ताईहिं उवहसिओ"
english: "Young girls, If you don't want to go to bed soon, Give it to me, My darling, As long as you keep your cool."

prakrit: "जाओ य विलक्खो सो दढं पउट्ठो य समरकेउस्स,कह णु महायणमज्झे एएणं धरिसिओ अहयं?"
english: "Go, for who is it that is angry with you, Or is it a warrior's son? How can you take me, my dear, for granted?"

prakrit: "एवं विचिन्तयन्तो अइगुरुरोसेण धमधमन्तो सो,अत्थाणमण्डवाओ नीहरिओ चिन्तए एवं"
english: "And the thinker is tormented by angry anger, So are the nymphs of the Atman Mandava, And so on."

prakrit: "न य केणइ पुव्वमहं पराइओ वाइणा इहं लोए,पावेण इमेण पुणो सभाए मज्झम्मि कह विजिओ?"
english: "No one has touched me before, Not even in this world, So why should I go to my next meeting?"

prakrit: "ता रयणीए भवणे इमस्स गन्तूण गहियकरवालो,छिन्दामि उत्तिमङ्गं जेण मणं निव्वुइं लहइ"
english: "Well, you silly girl, I'm going to leave you in this damned mess. I'll do it again if you tell me what it is that bothers me."

prakrit: "रोद्दज्झाणोवगओ एवं सो चिन्तिऊण रयणीए,गहियाउहो पविट्ठो वासहरे समरकेउस्स"
english: "Look at the moonlight And think how it makes the nights darker." "Oh! summer houses for holy cows!" ""

prakrit: "वच्चोहरभितीए पच्छन्नो अच्छए पलीणो सो,काऊण गोसकिच्चं समागओ तत्थ जुवराया"
english: "Aunt, It's only a matter of time before things get better. Who's going to help you out?"

prakrit: "दीवयवग्गकरेहिं नरेहिं उज्झोइएण मग्गेणं,वच्चोहरगमणिच्छा अह जाया रायउत्तस्य"
english: "The lamp is burning, I beg of you to kindle it, For now I don't know which way to turn."

prakrit: "पुरिसेहिं तत्थ दिट्ठो वच्चोहरसण्ठिओ स दुट्ठमई,आयड्ढन्तो खग्गं गहिओ बद्धो य सहसत्ति"
english: "The eyes of a man are ever fixed on his wife, The ears of others on her thighs, The cheeks of women sitting astride their husbands."

prakrit: "जुवरन्ना नाओ सो नाहियवाई स एस कविलॊत्ति,नूणं वायम्मि जिओ मज्झ वहट्ठा इह पविट्ठो"
english: "Youth is nothing but poetry, Love is bound to last, For as long as I am alive This is the sacred thread."

prakrit: "दठ्ठूण दीणवयणं वेवन्तसरीरयं तयं कविलं,परिचत्तजीवियासं जाया करुणा कुमारस्स"
english: "Look at that poor girl's wretched body, Which is so thin on paper That compassion has no place in her life."

prakrit: "भणियं कुमरेण तओ जीवन्तो ताव इण्हि मुक्को सि,मोत्तूण मज्झ देसं ठाएयव्वं तुमे पाव!"
english: "You fool, If you want to live as long as I live You have to sacrifice your life For my country's sake!"

prakrit: "इय भणिओ सो नट्ठो गन्तूणं ताहि दूरदेसम्मि,भिल्लजणाइन्नाए अवट्ठिओभिल्लपल्लीए"
english: "Tell me, isn't that the way to go? It's the same as going to a distant place. The villains have already left, But the village is empty." ""

prakrit: "अह अन्नया य पउमो पुत्तं अहिसिञ्चिऊण रज्जम्मि,जुवराइणा समेओ पव्वइओ गुरुसमीवम्मि"
english: "Oh! my son! There is a thread tied around his ear. At the same time as the jeweler's wife She walks towards her teacher." ""

prakrit: "दोन्निवि गुरुणा सहिया विहरन्ता बहुविहेसु देसेसु,सत्थेण समं चलिया रयणपुरं नाम वरनयरं"
english: "The two masters walked side by side, Visiting and seeing many different places. At the same time they walked - The town of Rayanpur was named after Varnayar." ""

prakrit: "सत्थाओ कहवि भट्ठा दोन्निवि अडवीए मोहिया मुणिणो,सम्पत्ता पल्लीए पाणयअट्ठा पविट्ठा ते"
english: "There must be something very special about the two pots of water: They are both sweet and fragrant, And the water in the well is holy."

prakrit: "दिट्ठा य परियडन्ता कविलेणं कहवि पच्चभिन्नाया,कुद्धो य दढं एसो दट्ठूण मुणिं समरकेउं"
english: "A poet's imagination is made of many different things: Whether he sees or doesn't see, That is how the foolish bow down."

prakrit: "चिन्तेइ ताहे कविलो इमेण वाएवि निज्जिओ अहयं,निव्विसओ आणत्तो तइया य इमेण पावेण"
english: "If you think about it, You'd better keep it to yourself. If you take it for granted, This is how you get it."

prakrit: "ता कवडेणं केणवि वइरस्सन्तं करेमि इण्हिम्पि,इय चिन्तिऊण वन्दइ ते मुणिणो परमविणएण"
english: "I will do anything for you, my dear, As long as you are careful not to fall into that trap."

prakrit: "नीया य निजे गेहे विसमीसं भत्तपाणयं दिन्नं,भणिया य विणयपुव्वं भयवं! एत्थेव भुञ्जेह"
english: "O that I should give you a drink of poison, O sister - in - law! Fearful is the sin of swearing by yourself!" ""

prakrit: "अद्धाणगमणखिन्ना निव्वियणे एत्थ एगदेसम्मि,भुञ्जिय वीसमिउं तो पभायकाले वएज्जाह"
english: "Here's an egg with traces of nectar, On the twentieth day of spring The rainy season is on its way."

prakrit: "एवं भणिया तेणं सुहभावा वीसमित्तु खणमेगं,सज्झायं काऊणं पारद्धा भोयणं काऊं"
english: "And tell me, brother - in - law, What it is to be proud of your wife's beauty And how you cherish her beauty."

prakrit: "संनिहियदेवयाए मुणिअणुकम्पाए तयं विसं हरियं,भोत्तूण तओ दोन्निवि सज्झायं काउमारद्धा"
english: "When the gods are swooning, When the lotuses are green, They both bow before each other Like cowherds."

prakrit: "चिन्तेइ तओ कविलो हन्त विसेणं न किं मया एए,नूणं मन्तबलेणं अवहरिया होज्ज विससत्ती"
english: "If you think about it, Poet, don't you see that I am different? It is only through your imagination That you become different."
