prakrit: "दुव्विहियविहिविहाणा पडियाए भीसणे य रन्नम्मि,जाओ सि मज्झ पुत्तय! करेमि किं मन्दभग्गा हं?"
english: "Two hundred and ninety feet high, Running in the middle of the forest, Go, my son! Am I a sloth?" ""

prakrit: "जायम्मि तुमे पुत्तय! रन्नम्पि हु सम्पयं इमं वसिमं,नट्ठं भयं असेसं उच्छङ्गगए तुमे वच्छ"
english: "Whatever you do, my son! I will follow you all the way to your house. Never mind the fear That hangs over you." ""

prakrit: "तुह मुहपलोयणेणं सम्पन्नमणोरहा भविस्सामि,रविकरपहयन्धयारे जायम्मि दिणम्मि सकयत्था"
english: "I will never forget how richly your affection has made me, As long as I do not have to look at your face In the mirror."

prakrit: "एमाइ भणन्तीए पहसमखिन्नाए नीसहङ्गाए,वियणाविगमाओ तहिं समागया मे तहिं निद्दा"
english: "I swear I didn't hear you when you told me you were pregnant," she said, "I did not hear you say that when I met you."

prakrit: "तत्तो खणन्तराओ पडिबुद्धा झत्ति मन्दभग्गा हं,केणावि हु उल्लवियं एयं सद्दं सुणेऊणं"
english: "Well, you fool, Suddenly I'm in a hurry, But someone needs to hear me say it again." ""

prakrit: "निउणं जोयन्तेणवि पभूयकालाओ पाव! दिट्ठो सि,काहामि वइरअन्तं अणुहव दुव्विहियफलमिण्हिं"
english: "When I see you, dear girl, The days are fleeting! My eyes, my dear, Are glued to both your cheeks And your lips." ""

prakrit: "एयं सद्दं सोच्चा भीया,को एस एवमुल्लवइ?,इय चिन्तिय जाव अहं नियउच्छङ्गं पलोएमि"
english: "I thought to myself,'Who's this fool?'But now that I know how to think, I turn my back on him." ""

prakrit: "ता नत्थि तत्थ पुत्तो विचिन्तियं ताहि हा! किमेयन्ति,किं कहवि होज्ज पडिओ अहवा केणावि अवहरिओ?"
english: "That's not the case, my son. I don't know what to do! Have you ever fallen asleep or been absent?" ""

prakrit: "किंवा सुमिणं एयं किंवा मइविब्भमो महं एसो?,एमाइ चिन्तयन्ती गवेसिंउ ताहि पारद्धा"
english: "Is this my dream, or my imagination coming from me?" she asked, her mind wandering.

prakrit: "इओ तओ तत्थ गवेसयन्ती सुयं महाराय! अपाउणन्ती,सिरम्मि वज्जेणव ताडिया हं घसत्ति मुच्छाइ वसं गयत्ति"
english: "There she is, Going to and fro, Lovely girl! Your face above my cheeks, Like a banner proclaiming victory, Hasn't sunken." ""

prakrit: "एसोवि परिसमप्पइ कमलावइपुत्तहरणनामॊत्ति,सुरसुन्दरिनामाए कहाए दसमो परिच्छेओ"
english: "Aunt, How come there are only ten paragraphs in a poem about lotuses?"

prakrit: "अह लद्धचेयणा हं मुच्छाविरहम्मि गरुयसोगिल्ला,नियहिययं कुट्टिन्ती पलविउमेवं समाढत्ता"
english: "Oh! you stubborn girl, You'll have to kneel down And cover your face with your hands So that by nature You don't look like a child."

prakrit: "हा! निद्दएण केणवि अडवीपडियाए दुक्खतवियाए,तक्खमेत्तुप्पन्नो पुत्तो हरिओ अहन्नाए"
english: "Oh! sleepiness has made some people miserable. But my son, Hari's pride has been destroyed." ""

prakrit: "किल पुत्तयस्स वयणं पिच्छिस्समहं पभायसमयम्मि,नवरं हयासविहिणा एयं मह अन्नहा विहियं"
english: "My son, When the wind has blown, I can hardly sleep at all. Without my husband being present, This is the occupation of my heart."

prakrit: "अडविपवेसाईयं दुक्खं दाऊण दूसहं देव!,किं अज्जवि न हु तुट्ठो अवहरिओ जेण मह पुत्तो?"
english: "The God of Suffering, Who is so averse to suffering, Isn't my son still a broken man Because he refuses to bow down?"

prakrit: "वणदेवयाओ! तुम्हं सरणम्मि समागयाए मह पुत्तो,हरिओ,ता किं जुज्जइ एत्थवि वेहा करेउं जे?"
english: "Venerable God! You have won the battle in all directions, my son; what more can I do if I have to go to war?"

prakrit: "हा पुत्त! कहमरण्णे मुक्का हं सरणवज्जिया तुमए,हा! कहमुच्छङ्गगओ सहसा अद्दंसणीभूओ?"
english: "My son, how come you, my shrewd bitch, Suddenly lose sight of the bracelets?" ""

prakrit: "नूणं निट्ठुररूवं सद्दं सोऊण जस्स पडिबुद्धा,तेणं चिय अवहरिओ पिसायरूवेण केणावि"
english: "A man who sleeps soundly, Whose clothes are tied behind his back, Can pierce anyone with his slipper."

prakrit: "जस्स पभावाओ तया सहसा गयणाओ गयवरो पडिओ,सोवि मणी अकयत्थो जाओ मह मन्दभागाए"
english: "Those who heard me sang the song so suddenly they fell at my feet. So please, my poor thing, don't go away." ""

prakrit: "जं कण्ठनिबद्धेवि हु तम्मी अङ्कट्ठिओवि हा पुत्त!,हरिओ निक्करुणेणं केणावि अद्दिस्सरूवेण"
english: "The thing that is tied around my neck Is hanging on tight, my son!" "One can hardly help laughing When he lets out a cry of distress."

prakrit: "एमाइ बहुविगप्पं पलवन्तीए तहिं सुदीणाए,मद्दुक्खदुक्खिया इव खीणा रयणीवि सहसत्ति"
english: "I have grown so thin on many occasions, So long have I been pregnant, And so long has my husband been abroad."

prakrit: "अइकरुणं कन्दन्तिं दट्ठुंव ममं ससोयवयणिल्ला,निवडन्तथूलतारयअंसूहिंव रुयइ नहलच्छी"
english: "Look at my round breasts. No need to cry. They are covered with gooseflesh."

prakrit: "एत्थन्तरम्मि सूरो सुयावहारयनिहालणत्थंव,नासियघणन्धयारो आरụधो उदयगिरिसिहरं"
english: "Here and there the sun sets, The midnights are long, The nights are dark, And the heights of Udayagiri Are breathtaking."

prakrit: "अह अद्धपहरमेत्ते दियहे अइदुक्खिया अहं तत्थ,अइकरुणं कन्दन्ती इओ तओ जाव वियरामि"
english: "Oh! my poor girl, I am so miserable Now That I am exhausted From sighing all the time."

prakrit: "ताव कमण्डलुहत्था मिउवक्कलवसणधारिणी तत्थ,परिणयवया पसन्न समागया तावसी एगा"
english: "There's that lotus blossom And the woman sitting on top of it Is ecstatic at seeing her husband again." ""

prakrit: "दट्ठुं ममं रुयन्तिं विविहपलावेहिं तत्थ वणगहणे,सञ्जायगरुयकरुणा समागया मज्झ पासम्मि"
english: "When he saw me, He burst into tears And looked at me with such longing. My heart overflowed with compassion When he met me."

prakrit: "महुरवयणेण तीए आपुट्ठा सुयणु! कीस तं रुयसि,कत्तो समागया इह भीसणरन्नम्मि इक्कल्ला?"
english: "You fool, Why are you crying? Isn't this the only time you make love?" ""

prakrit: "काउं तीइ पणामं तत्तो वियलन्तअंसुयाए मए,कुञ्जरहरणाईओ सिट्ठो सव्वोवि वुत्तन्तो"
english: "What makes you think I'm pregnant?" she muttered, her tears streaming down her cheeks. Everyone looked at her as she took a seat.

prakrit: "अह तावसीए भणियं इमस्स जोगा न होसि तं सुयणु!,तहवि हु किमित्थ कीरइ सकम्मवसगम्मि जियलोए?"
english: "Hey, you fool, If you can't wake me up this early, go to sleep! How can I then revive my husband?" ""

prakrit: "सुन्दरि! कम्मवसाणं सत्ताणं इह भवे वसन्ताणं,एवंविहदुक्खाइं हवन्ति जं एत्थ न हु चोज्जं"
english: "Beauties! Let there be spring in the cycle of karma, For where there are sorrows There are those for whom there is no pleasure."

prakrit: "जं किञ्चि असुहकम्मं अन्नभवे सञ्चियं तुमे आसि,तस्स विवागाओ इमं समागयं सुयणु! गुरुवसणं"
english: "Whatever unhappiness, hunger, or nausea you experience, Come to me alone, my dear. Try sleeping with that person!"

prakrit: "ता अन्नभवविढत्ते दुक्खम्मि समागयम्मि को सोगो?,किं वावि विलविएणं सरीरायासभूएणं?"
english: "So who is to grieve when grief seeps in through the empty stomach?, Is it to lament the loss of one's body?"

prakrit: "एत्तो उ समासन्ने अच्छइ अम्हाण आसमो रम्मो,आगच्छ सुयणु! अणुचियमेयं ठाणं जओ तुज्झ"
english: "It's only a matter of time, my dear. I hope to see you again. I promise, I'll be right there by your side." ""

prakrit: "वायइ सीयलपवणो एत्थ ओ तं अभिणवपसूया सि,सुकुमालसरीराए मा होज्ज विरूवयं किञ्चि"
english: "You silly girl, Here you are, Sucking in your breath. Please, don't be so rude. There's nothing wrong with you." ""

prakrit: "इय भणिय तावसीए नीया हं आसमम्मि रम्मम्मि,पडिजग्गिया य सम्मं निक्कारणवच्छलत्तेण"
english: "She said,'No, you're right, I'm having sex with you,'But the girl refused to budge Anymore." ""

prakrit: "अह कइवयदिवसेहिं सञ्जाया सत्थदेहिया मणयं,अन्नम्मि दिणे नीया तीए हं कुलवइसमीवे"
english: "Ah, what a long day this has been, A long day at a time, A lonely one at that."

prakrit: "तीएवि पुव्वभणिओ वुत्तन्तो साहिओ कुलवइस्स,करुणापरेण तेणवि अणुसट्ठा महुरवयणेहिं"
english: "The flowers bloom, The flowers wither, And with compassion they sigh." ""

prakrit: "वच्छे! इह संसारे सुलहाइं एरिसाइं दुक्खाइं,अकयम्मि सुहनिमित्ते धम्मे परलोयबन्धुम्मि"
english: "" "Behold! This is the reconciliation of worlds, Such are the sorrows: For while I am happy, I am bound in another's embrace by Dharma."

prakrit: "जायन्ति दूसहाइं जेणं चिय एत्थ दुसहदुक्खाइं,तेणेव चत्तरज्जा वणवासमुवागया धीरा"
english: "As long as there are sorrows and sorrows, There must be patience among the forest dwellers."

prakrit: "एवं भणमाणस्स उ कुलवइणो तीइ तावसीइ अहं,कन्ने होउं भणिया भयवं वरनाणजुत्तो 'यं"
english: "And when she speaks she mutters," "I am so selfish." "When I speak she scares me to death."

prakrit: "तो पुच्छ इच्छियत्थं भणियाए ताहि विणयपणयाए,पुट्ठो मए महायस! केण हिओ नन्दणो मज्झ?"
english: "So why ask a question When he has spoken it so eloquently? My son, you are a great man! Who is more virtuous than me?" ""

prakrit: "किं जीवइ अहव मओ पिक्खिस्समहं कयाइवि नवत्ति?,अह भणियं कुलवइणा सम्मं दाऊण उवओगं"
english: "How long can I go on living, You fool?" asked the doe. "I will go on till my husband is well."

prakrit: "वच्छे! उच्छङ्गत्थो तुह तणओ अवहिओ उ देवेण,पाणविओयणहेउं पुव्वविरुद्धेण कुद्धेण"
english: "" "Cursed be your thighs! Stop dragging your feet! It's the god of thunder, Jumping against the flower in the water That makes him swallow you."

prakrit: "वेयड्ढगिरिनिउञ्जे नेऊण सिलायलम्मि विउलम्मि,मुक्को छुहाभिभूओ किल किच्छेणेस मरउत्ति"
english: "On the pyre of a bull The nail marks the crossroads: A nail pierces through the nail mark, And the nail bristles with bitterness."

prakrit: "अह कहवि विहिवसेणं समागओ तत्थ नहयरो एक्को,नियभारियासमेणो तेण य पुत्तॊत्ति सो गहिओ"
english: "When you meet someone different, It's not just one person. Once you've met someone else You'd better take care of yourself."

prakrit: "खयरस्स तस्स गेहे वुड्डिं जाही सुहेण,तत्तो य,सम्पत्तजोव्वणो सो मिलिही तुह हत्थिणपुरम्मि"
english: "Well, you're right, The wood there looks lovely, But the young gentleman's wealth Is entirely in your hands."

prakrit: "एवं च तेण भणिए पणट्ठसोगा नरिन्द! जाया हं,फलमूलकयाहारा विणयपरा तावसिजणस्स"
english: "And he said:" "Praise be to you, Narinda! Come, you who like to pluck fruit But cannot pluck it yourself." ""

prakrit: "पिय! कइवयदिवसाइं अच्छामि तहिं तु आसमे जाव,ता अन्नदिणे कुलवइ मूले धम्मं सुणिन्तीए"
english: "Dear friend, How many days can I wish you were there And you were in heaven When everyone else is still listening To the Dharma at its root?"

prakrit: "बहुतावसिसहियाए सहसा आसेण वेगजुत्तेण,अवहरिओ सम्पत्तो रायसुओ तत्थ एगागी"
english: "When a man of many talents comes calling, Speaks quickly, And when he leaves, Writes prolifically."

prakrit: "अह अतिहिवच्छलेहिं तावसकुमरेहिं विहियसंमाणो,आगम्म विहियविणओ उवविट्ठो कुलवइ समीवे"
english: "Ah, the silence of our village, So long ago," he said, "The fire of love has reached its climax."

prakrit: "कुलवइणा सो पुट्ठो को सि तुमं आगओ कुओ भद्द!?,तत्तो य तेण भणियं कहेमि निसुणेह भयवं! ति"
english: "You fool, Who are you to tell me that you're angry?" he asked, Then her brother-in-law said, "I'm afraid she might be angry."

prakrit: "सिद्धत्थपुरे राया सुग्गीवो नाम आसि विक्खाओ,कणगवई से देवी तीए सुओ सुरहनामो हं"
english: "A sage's name is Vikhao, so please, my dear, tell me how pleasant it is for a goddess to weep."

prakrit: "अइवल्लहॊत्ति पिउणा जुवरायपयम्मि बालभावेवि,अहिसित्तो अवमन्निय पुत्तं जिट्ठं तु सुप्पइट्ठं"
english: "You silly child, You shameless son of a bitch, You dreamt you were pregnant."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाइवि खयवाहीए मयम्मि जणयम्मि,तस्स पए हं राया अहिसित्तो मन्तिवग्गेण"
english: "Oh, my! There must be something else going on in the world Which I know isn't quite right."

prakrit: "जिट्ठस्स अन्नजणणीतणयस्स उ तस्स सुप्पइट्ठस्स,विज्जाहरेण केणवि कयउवयारेण दिन्नाओ"
english: "As much food as you want, so much sleep as you need. Somebody will give you something in return for your knowledge."

prakrit: "नहगामिणिपमुहाओ विज्जाओ तप्पभावओ तेण,काऊण य सङ्गामं अहिट्ठियं अप्पणा रज्जं"
english: "Because they are unable to comprehend the meaning of love, They turn their backs on one another."

prakrit: "तस्स भएण अहम्पि हु समागओ पुरवरीए चम्पाए,जणणिसमेओ पासे मायामहकित्तिधम्मस्स"
english: "Because I am so proud of him, I will go to him again and again, But my heart is set on him."

prakrit: "तेणवि नियदेसन्ते दिन्नं गामाण सहस्सयं एगं,तत्थ य जणणीसहिओ भयवं! अच्छामि अहयन्ति"
english: "They never give a damn. The village is at a standstill. Therefore, my friends, be afraid! For I have done something wrong." ""

prakrit: "कइवयदिणेहिं इन्तो इमाइ अडवीइ वाणियगसत्थो,मह पुरिसेहिं विलुत्तो पत्तं वित्तं तहिं पउरं"
english: "Every day I hear the same thing over and over again: It's my husband on the farm, Leaving me with a wilted leaf That has run out of seeds."

prakrit: "अन्नं च तत्थ पत्ता तुक्खारतुरङ्गमा बहुविहीया,ताणावाहणहेउं अज्जेव पभायसमयम्मि"
english: "There was plenty of food and water, And the leaves were strewn all over the place In all sorts of different colours."

prakrit: "बाहिं नीहरिओ हं कमेण तुरगे ओ जाव वाहेमि,ताविक्केणं सहसा हरिओ विवरीयसिक्खेण"
english: "I will never forget how my arms shook When I tried to cross them. Suddenly the greens gave way Because they looked different."

prakrit: "अविय जह जह ओक्खञ्चिज्जइ तह तह वेगं पगिण्हमाणेण,भयवं! तुरगंमेण इहाणिओ आसमे तुम्ह"
english: "The faster she climbs the more fearful she becomes of the arrows!" "With these arrows you are." ""

prakrit: "एवं च जाव साहइ सो सुरहो कुलवइस्स वुत्तन्त,तुरयमणुमग्गलग्गं ताव य सिन्नपि से पत्तं"
english: "And as the wind blows, So does the cool breeze blowing, Like a bunch of peacock's tail feathers Slipping from its beak." ""

prakrit: "अह भणियं सुरहेणं भयवं! वच्चामि निययठाणम्मि,जं किञ्चि मए इण्हिं कायव्वं तं च आइससु"
english: "" "Oh, I am afraid of sounding good! I am about to leave. Whatever I have to do to come back to you, please, come to me."

prakrit: "एत्थन्तरम्मि रयणी खयं गया साहिउंव परमत्थं,सम्मं नियच्छ वच्छे! न होइ सो वल्लहो एस"
english: "Now that the girl has reached her climax The path is clearer than ever! Otherwise, my dear, you'd better come." ""

prakrit: "जाए पभायसमए दिट्ठो सो सामलेण देहेण,तत्तो गुरुसोगाए विचिन्तियं हा! न सो एसो"
english: "If you set eyes on him every day, He can take care of you, But if you neglect his friends, Be careful not to fall into his trap!"

prakrit: "सो तत्तकञ्चणनिभो रूवेण अणङ्गरूवसारिच्छो,चित्तगएण इमस्स जो सारिच्छं नत्थि थेवम्पि"
english: "So you start to notice that her face is smeared with red ghee, Like a mark on the cheek of someone you know." ""

prakrit: "ता किं करेमि इण्हिं सरणविहूणा परव्वसा अहयं,इय चिन्ततीए तया भएण कम्पो समुप्पन्नो"
english: "What am I to do, then, Being so wrapped up in my thoughts?"

prakrit: "अह सो दट्ठूण ममं अंसुजलासारसित्तगण्डयलं,भयभीयं कम्पन्तिं एवं भणिउं समाढत्तो"
english: "Oh! when he saw me I was drenched with gooseflesh," she said, trembling with fear And closing her eyes.

prakrit: "किं सुयणु! तुमं बीहसि भूयपिसाउत्तिसङ्किरी मज्झ,निसुणसु जो हं जेण व हरिया कज्जेण य मयच्छि!"
english: "Why, darling, why, you fool, You'd better take me in your arms, my poor girl! For all the green grass I have on my back You'll ruin my life."

prakrit: "वेयड̣धे वरनयरं गङ्गावत्तन्ति अत्थि सुप्रसिद्धं,तत्थ य राया सिरिगन्धवाहणो आसि विक्खाओ"
english: "The wretched river turns into the great river Ganges, So well known is the man who carries the fragrant essence of the river."

prakrit: "मयणावलीदेवीए तणओ नहवाहणॊत्ति से आसि,बीओ य मयरकेऊ तइओ पुण मेहनाउत्ति"
english: "Come, my lovely lady, Come with me in your arms. May I never forget how you made her feel again."

prakrit: "नहवाहणोवि साहियविज्जो अह जोव्वणं तु सम्पत्तो,वरिया य तन्निमित्तं वरकन्ना कणगमालत्ति"
english: "Young and wealthy you are, Bridegroom! There is something very special about the bridegroom That makes him feel so welcome."

prakrit: "सा उण विवाहसमए विज्जाहरचित्तवेगनामेण,अवहरिउं परिणीया रुट्ठो एसो तओ तस्स"
english: "She was so busy with her wedding that she lost consciousness and fell asleep on top of her husband." ""

prakrit: "अणुमग्गं गन्तूणं बद्धो सो नागिणीए विज्जाए,गहिऊण कणगमालं समागओ निययनयरम्मि"
english: "He has fixed his destination on the front door, He has prepared the knowledge of the women, And has arranged for them to meet in person."

prakrit: "तत्तो विज्जाच्छेओ जाओ नहवाहणस्स जेणेसो,महिलासमेयविज्जाहरस्स जाओ 'वगारित्ति"
english: "There goes the traveler's wife, And there goes the woman's traveler, Whom you imagine to be a barber." ""

prakrit: "चिरपरिचियदेवेणं दिन्नाओ चित्तवेगखयरस्स,विज्जाओ तेण जाओ विज्जाहरचक्कवट्टी से"
english: "A familiar god gives pleasure to the senses, So go through the cycle of knowledge."

prakrit: "सयमेव नहयरिन्दा सव्वेवि हु पणइमुवगया तस्य,इय मुणिउं मह जणओ संविग्गो भणिउमाढत्तो"
english: "I've never been so angry. Everything I do Depends on who you are. I suppose I know someone who does."

prakrit: "पिच्छह भो! मणुयाणं मणोरहा अन्नहा विसड्ढन्ति,विहिणो वसेण नवरं अन्नह कज्जाण परिणामो"
english: "" "Fool! The man's heart is bursting at the seams. If you settle for nothing, you'll reap the rewards of your hard work."

prakrit: "किर नियतणयं काउं विज्जाहरचक्कवट्टिणं,करिही,कयकिच्चो पव्वज्जं केवलिजणयस्स पासम्मि"
english: "What is the use of setting a wheel on fire, darling? Somebody has to go past a gentleman." ""

prakrit: "तं पुण अन्नह जायं ता किं कज्जं इमेण रज्जेणं,नरयाइनिमित्तेणं,सेवामो तायपयजुयलं"
english: "If you want to eat rice again, what business is it of making rice flour available to you? It is only service to men." ""

prakrit: "संसारो हु असारो घोरा अइदारुणा य नरयम्मि!,दुसहाओ वियणाओ चित्तो कम्माण परिणामो"
english: "The world is ours to govern, It is cruel and inhumane! But to suffer the consequences of one's actions Is intolerable."

prakrit: "चवलो इन्दियगामो रागद्दोसा य दुज्जया लोए,अणवट्ठियं च चित्तं किम्पागफलोवमा विसया"
english: "In this wretched world of ours, Wherever you are, There is anger and resentment, And wherever your mind is distracted There is something else afoot."

prakrit: "अइदुसहो पियविरहो बम्महललियं विवायकडुयन्ति,नरयपुरवत्तिणीओ सेविज्जन्ताओ जुवईओ"
english: "Weeping, The young men go on making love, And the poor women mutter nonsense." ""

prakrit: "कुससूइविसमसण्ठियपवणाहयसलिलचञ्चलं जीयं,सामन्नं सव्वेसिं मरणं सत्ताणं संसारे"
english: "Life is but a succession of uncertainties, Like the passing away of all the souls in the world."

prakrit: "वञ्चणपरा य जीवा दुट्ठकसाएहिं ताविओ लोओ,असुहफलो घरवासो मणुयत्तं तह य नो सुलहं"
english: "Betrayal is the way to save a life, So take it easy, Failure is the man of the house, So there will be no reconciliation."

prakrit: "दुलहा धम्मम्मि मई बहुविग्घसमाउलं अहोरत्तं,पयईए चला लच्छी पेम्मं सुविणोवमं लोए"
english: "The bridegroom, May the dharmamati multiply manifold, Come, go and enjoy the pleasures of love In this world."

prakrit: "आरियखेत्ताईया अइदुलहा सम्पया य जियलोए,अइदारुणमन्नाणं जीवा मिच्छत्तवामụ̄धा"
english: "Ariyakhetai, if you wish to live long, You would have to sacrifice your life For committing a mistake." ""

prakrit: "परिहायन्ता भावा धम्मे अइनिन्दिओ पमाउत्ति,खिज्जइ तणुसामत्थं आउयमवि थोवयं होइ"
english: "One who is devoted to Dharma destroys his enemies, For what's the use of being dependent on Him Will be for nothing else."

prakrit: "नारयतिरियनरा 'मरगईसु गुरुदुसहदुक्खतवियाण,मोत्तूणं जिणधम्मं जियाण सरणं जओ नन्नं"
english: "Narayathiriyan:" "Margaisu gurudus, My sorrowful life, My victory is my victory." ""

prakrit: "तम्हा तायसमीवं गन्तुं सहलीकरेमि मणुयत्तं,नहवाहणेण भणियं अहमवि तायमणुगमिस्सं"
english: "I will go with you As long as I am humane, But by not bathing I mean the love of my husband."

prakrit: "सामित्तं काऊणं आणानिद्देसकारगस्सावि,कह सेवं काहामो सम्पइ भिच्चस्स निययस्स?"
english: "Consciousness alone cannot produce wisdom, For what service can a meek monk render?"

prakrit: "भणियं ताएण तओ कायव्वमिमं विवेयजुत्ताणं,तत्तो नियसुयसहिओ तक्कालुचियं करेऊण"
english: "If I tell you the truth, You reassure me, Then I'll do my best to appease you."

prakrit: "सुरवाहणकेवलिणो मूले काऊण निम्मलचरित्तं,निट्ठवियअट्ठकम्मो अन्तगडो केवली जाओ"
english: "Aunt, If you want to taste the fresh nectar You'd better stop and go elsewhere."

prakrit: "अह चित्तवेगखयराहिवेण तत्थेव निययनयरम्मि,दाउं सदेसखण्डं अहिसित्तो खयरराया हं"
english: "Ah! for lack of passion There must have been something wrong with me then, For all my anger has turned to jealousy."

prakrit: "एवं च ठिए कारणवसेण केणइ पभायसमयम्मि,नियनयरा एगागी चलिओ हं रयणदीवम्मि"
english: "And just in case, someone misjudges the timing of your arrival, go ahead and join us on the river bank."

prakrit: "नहपट्ठिएण दिट्ठा सुन्दरि! हम्मियतलम्मि पासुत्ता,तं सि तओ अवहरिया मेत्तलसरसल्लिएण मए"
english: "Lovely girl, I've no time for words! It's just the way things happen. So let me tell you, you silly girl, That my heart is made of water." ""

prakrit: "ता मा रोवसु सुन्दरि! पाणाणवि सामिणी तुमं मज्झ,भुञ्जिहिसि मए सद्धिं भोए वेयड्ढसेलम्मि"
english: "Don't cry! You silly girl, You fool! Just forget about me And go to bed." ""

prakrit: "तव्वयणं सोउणं वज्जेणव ताडिया सुदुक्खत्ता,इय चिन्तिउं पयत्ता हाहा! मह पावपसरस्स"
english: "When you blow into the fire, That is the joy of toddy tadka. Once you think of it, Haha! It's my turn to shed blood." ""

prakrit: "मज्झ कएणं ताओ पारद्धो गरुयसत्तुणा ताव,अहमवि इमेण हरिया अन्नत्थ निबद्धरागावि"
english: "That which is dear to me Makes sense, But what does it matter If it means that everything I have Is devoted to food?"

prakrit: "धा! मह! जीएणं न तायआसासणं न पियलाभो,सत्तुञ्जयदिन्नाए होज्ज सुही ताव ताओवि"
english: "Oh! dear! There is no hope of surviving This day, Nor of getting drunk. May all three be happy in the next day." ""

prakrit: "मणवल्लहस्स तस्स उ लाभेण हविज्ज अहव सुहिया हं,मह पावपरिणईए एत्तो एक्कम्पि नो जायं"
english: "It is my pleasure to make love to you, my dear, For there is nothing I can do About it."

prakrit: "एवं विचिन्तयन्ती भणिया हं तेण ताव एत्थेव,चिट्ठउ तुमं जाव अहं आसन्ने वंसिगहणाम्मि"
english: "And look! I was so anxious to see you. So here I am. Let me go and stay while you write." ""

prakrit: "गन्तूणं विज्जाए पन्नत्तीए लहुं पयच्छामि,जावसहस्समेत्तं पारम्भियपुव्वसेवाए"
english: "I travel through the whole world in search of knowledge, But my love for nature Is based on faithful service."

prakrit: "इय भणिऊण गओ सो अहमवि गुरुसोयताविया तत्थ,किङ्कायव्वमụ̄धा सरणविहूणा भयुप्पित्था"
english: "By saying this, he means the lover of his master, That at the very least, Kinkayavam implies," "Fear the bowdlerized woman." ""

prakrit: "हरिणिव्व जूहभट्ठा सतरलतारं दिसाओ पुलयन्ती,अंसुजलपुन्ननयणा रुयमाणी जाव चिट्ठामि"
english: "I will never forget how the hunter drew the line in the direction of the rainbow, When I saw the woman weeping for her husband Who had just given birth."

prakrit: "ताव य तत्थासन्नं पिच्छामि विसालसालसोहिल्लं,पवणाकम्पियफलभरविनमियगुञ्जोहसङ्किन्नं"
english: "Then I slipped away And fell at my feet like a log of nectar Filled with the fragrance of raisins." ""

prakrit: "मणहरिफलं पसरन्तपरिमलं बहलपत्तलच्छायं,तप्फलभक्खणनिवडन्तजन्तुसन्ताणकयसद्द"
english: "The scent of the nectar is like a lotus, Spreading from the tip of the leaf, Like the plucked petals of an animal Eating fruit."

prakrit: "निवडन्तससन्ततडप्फडन्तमयविहगकलियभूवीढं,तरुयरमुच्चं मच्चुं जन्तुसन्ताणनासयरं"
english: "Like the nail marks on the cheek of a parrot, Like the nails of an elephant's tail, A flock of parrots is hovering around its head"

prakrit: "तं दट्ठुं विसरुक्खं विचिन्तियं गरुयदुक्खतवियाए,पियसहि! हंसिणि! तइया मरणम्मि निबद्धचित्ताए"
english: "Look at that man Whose heart is bursting with anger, Thirsty for more pain, Laughing! Your heart is set on death." ""

prakrit: "किं काहामि अहन्ना रहिया पियबन्धुजणणिजणएहिं,विहिणा विडम्बिया हं जीवन्ती इय विचिन्तेन्ती"
english: "Why am I so anxious to meet my dear friend? She is completely distraught at being separated And thinks that I am alive."

prakrit: "गन्तुं तस्स समीवे गहिऊण फलं मुहम्मि पक्खित्तं,मा मह हविज्ज एरिसविडम्बणा अन्नजम्मेवि"
english: "Come, let's go. Let the fruit of that nectar Fall at my side. Don't let it get in my heart. It must be the ripe bananas From the paddy field." ""

prakrit: "इय भणिऊण ससोयं खणन्तरं जाव तत्थ अच्छामि,ताव य गुरुविसवियणाए विब्भला महियले पडिया"
english: "By saying this I mean to tell my father - in - law:" "There must be something wrong with me." "By doing this he means to cause embarrassment to his master."

prakrit: "तओ भमियंव वणतरूहिं उव्वत्तिययंव सयलवसुहाए,सन्धीहिं विहडियं पिव विसीइयं सव्वअङ्गेहिं"
english: "So the fields tremble, The trees sway, The streams flow, And at dusk the whole forest melts." ""

prakrit: "तत्तो य अकहणीयं पावियवत्थन्तरं तया भद्दे!,जाणामि नेव किञ्चिवि तदुत्तरं जं महं जायं"
english: "So disgusting! Once you've had your way, I don't know what it's like to be me." ""

prakrit: "केवलमुच्छङ्गगयं कस्सवि तरुणस्स अमयभूयस्स,विसनिव्ववणसमत्थं मणिसलिलं पाययन्तस्स"
english: "Only a handful of songs, Not a single youth, Is enough to satisfy the man's thirst."

prakrit: "खणमेत्तं तेन चिय मज्झ सरीरं पसिञ्चमाणस्स,सयमङ्गाइं कोमलकरेहिं परिमद्दयन्तस्स"
english: "Because you love me, You purify my body, Make my limbs more supple, And give me more pleasure."

prakrit: "जलसित्ततालवेण्टयहत्थाए विहियसिसिरवायाए,चिरदिट्ठं पियसहीए पियंवयाए कहिज्जन्तं"
english: "The thirst for water fills the heart with longing." "As the thirsty lover would say."

prakrit: "सयलं मह वुत्तन्तं चित्तपडालोयणाइपज्जन्तं,हरिसभरपुलइयङ्गं खणन्तरं निसुणमाणस्स"
english: "Right from the moment I touched him To the moment he took me in his arms, I could not help but sigh as I squeezed through the grass."

prakrit: "अप्पाणं पासित्ता पणट्ठविसवेयणा समासत्था,सुमिणंव मन्नमाणा पडिबुद्धा हंसिए! तइया"
english: "Laughing all the time, Keeping yourself busy, Paying attention to what's going on!" ""

prakrit: "उम्मीलियनयणजुया ताव य पेच्छामि मयणपडिरूवं,महहिययनिग्गयं पिव तरुणनरं चित्तसंवाइं"
english: "I love the way young men dress, Like bees in a manger, Like young men making love In a meadow."

prakrit: "तं दट्ठु चिन्तियं मे किं मन्ने इन्दजालमेयन्ति?,किं वावि अन्नजम्मो उयाहु किं सुविणयं एयं?"
english: "What do you think I mean by that look on your face? It's like eating rice. What good is it for?" ""

prakrit: "किंवा मइसंमोहो किंवावि हु सच्चमेव एयन्ति?,अहवा नहि नहि एयं कत्तो मह इत्तिया पुन्ना?"
english: "Or am I really so deluded? No, I'm not. How is this my fault?" ""

prakrit: "जं सो मणवल्लहओ दीसिज्ज जणो इमेहिं नयणेहिं,जं से उच्छङ्गगया इमस्स पुण सम्भवो कत्थ?"
english: "How is it possible for me to regain the good man I once was, Who deprived me of what I once had?"

prakrit: "एवं विचिन्तयन्ती पियंवयाए इमं समुल्लविया,सुरसुन्दरि! किं अज्जवि उव्वुण्णमुहिव्व पुलएसि?"
english: "And what a strange woman you are, Lovely beauty! Are you still pulling that wide smile?" ""

prakrit: "एसो हु रयणदीवो भगिणी य पियंवया अहं तुज्झ,साहियविज्जो एसो मह भाया मयरकेउत्ति"
english: "Here I am, my divine sister - in - law, Or I am yours as a lover; Here, my dear brother, Is my lover's wife." ""

prakrit: "एवं च तीए भणिए एसोच्चिय सॊत्ति हरिसिया चित्ते,सज्झसवेविरदेहा सङ्किन्नरसन्तरं पत्ता"
english: "And she said:" "Associação est, asociación est, hrisia est, sajosa est, estrada est, a letter after the arrow." ""

prakrit: "उट्ठेत्तु तदङ्काओ पियंवयाए समीवमल्लीणा,अद्धच्छिपेच्छिएहिं पेच्छित्ता तं अपेच्छन्तं"
english: "When he gets up, his wife looks at him, Unsure when he'll be back."

prakrit: "बहुविहरोगायङ्केहि पीडिया निव्वुइं न पाविन्ति,घिप्पन्ति जराइ तओ मरेन्ति तत्तो सुनिव्विन्ना"
english: "The sufferings of many a traveler Are such that one cannot touch them, For when they are drunk they are fatal, For then one hears them."

prakrit: "जइ कइवि हु देवत्तं पाविन्ति तहिम्पि जायए दुक्खं,ईसाविसायभयसोयलोहसन्तत्तचित्ताण"
english: "If at all I touch a god It is only to cause sorrow, For fear of the God of Love leads to filial purity."

prakrit: "पररिद्धिं पेच्छन्ता भिच्चा विव सामिएण आणत्ता,जायन्ति चवणसमए देवावि हु दुक्खिया धणियं"
english: "A beggar seeks refuge with a wise man, But in his spare time, like a god, He is a miser."

prakrit: "चुलसीइजोणिलक्खेक्कसङ्कुले इह भवे भमन्तेहिं,तं नत्थि किम्पि ठाणं अणन्तुखत्तो न जं एन्तं"
english: "It must be the gooseflesh on your round breasts That makes you shiver, But don't be so hasty." ""

prakrit: "सव्वत्थवि दुक्खत्ता जायन्ति जिणिन्दधम्मपरिहीणा,ता भो देवाणुपिया! करेह जिणदेसियं धम्मं"
english: "All souls experience suffering Where there is no dharma, It is the wrath of God! For behold, dharma prevails." ""

prakrit: "सो दुविगप्पो भणिओ जइधम्मो तह गिहत्थधम्मो य,दुविहस्सवि विन्नेयं सम्मत्तं गुणगणावासं"
english: "So both parties said :'What is dharma?'But if I refused, He would have counted the difference in merit." ""

prakrit: "तत्तत्थसद्दहाणं सुहायपरिणामरूवयं तं तु,जीवाइणो पयत्था तत्तं पुण होइ विन्नेयं"
english: "Then you will bear fruit, For as long as you live, You will prosper."

prakrit: "जीवा 'जीवापुन्नं पावासवसंवरा य निज्जरणा,बन्धो मुक्खो य तहा तत्ताणि इमाणि नव हॊन्ति"
english: "Life goes on, As long as one keeps oneself alive, Friend, if one keeps silent These days there are new ones in the world."

prakrit: "सुहुमा बायर बेइन्दिया य तेइन्दिया य चउरिन्दी,सन्नी अस्सन्नी खलु चोद्दस पज्जत्त 'पज्जत्ता"
english: "Suhuma bayer, Bayindiya ya taindia ya chaurindi, Sunny Assanni khalu chaudas, Pajjatta." ""

prakrit: "धम्मा 'धम्मा ' 'गासा तियतियभेया य तहेव कालो य,खन्धा देसपएसा परमाणू अजीव चोद्दसहा"
english: "Dharma, Dharma," "Gone are the days When love was but a trickle, Like the atoms of the atom in a bowl Exposed to the light of day."

prakrit: "सायं उच्चागोयं सत्ततीसं च नामपगईओ,तिण्णि य आउणि तहा बायालं पुन्नपगडीओ"
english: "The evening is long, Thirty-seven names are familiar, But when the three arrive The bylanes repeat the sound."

prakrit: "नाणन्तरायदसगं दंसण नव मोहपगइछव्वीसं,नामस्स चउत्तीसं तिण्ह य एक्किक्क पावाउ"
english: "There are nine vows of love, Sixty-four vows in a name, And one day you will be alone."

prakrit: "इन्दिय कसाय अव्वय किरिणा पण चउर पण य पणवीसा,जोगा तिन्नेव भवे बायालं आसवो भणिओ"
english: "India's butcher is vain, Kirina is clever, But her husband is clever. Wherever she may be, Tell me, I hope by now"

prakrit: "समिई गुत्ती धम्मो अणुप्पेहपरीसहा चरित्तं च,सत्तावन्नं भेया पणतियभेयाइ संवरणे"
english: "The same bunch of dharmas, unique in their nature, Are devoted to the pursuit of power As to the protection of property."

prakrit: "अणसणभेयाइ तवो बारसहा तेण निज्जरा भणिया,कणगावलिभेयाओ अहव तवो 'णेगहा होइ"
english: "If you want to escape from your neighbor's house, Be careful not to fall into his trap."

prakrit: "पयइठिईअणुभागपएसभेया चउव्विहो बन्धो,अट्ठविहकम्मविगमो मोक्खो पुण सासओ भणिओ"
english: "Friend, tell my mother - in - law:" "First let me break up with you, And then let me have my way again." ""

prakrit: "एएसिं सद्दहाणे अरिहं देवो सुसाहुणो गुरुणो,इय पडिवत्तिनिमित्तं सम्मत्तं होइ विन्नेयं"
english: "Assume the good teacher, my dear, That by reason of this indifference I have come to agree."

prakrit: "सावज्जजोगपरिवज्जणं तु मणवयणकायजोगेहिं,एसो जईण धम्मो दुरणुचरो मन्दसत्ताणं"
english: "Sacrifice, separation, you heartless wretch; This is the path to dharma, The path to detachment."

prakrit: "कायव्वा जेण दया छण्हवि पुढवाइयाण जीवाण,सव्वोवाहिविसुद्धं भणियव्वं सच्चयं वयणं"
english: "As the doer shows compassion, So the leader leads the life; He speaks truth to truth to all beings."

prakrit: "तिणमित्तम्पि अदिन्नं न य घित्तव्वं असुद्धचित्तेण,धारेयव्वं च सया नव गुत्तिसणाहबम्भवयं"
english: "A man's heart is not made of mud, Nor is his will made of clay, Yet he has acquired a new strength."

prakrit: "धम्मोवगरणवज्जो थेवोवि परिग्गहो न कायव्वो,आहारचउक्कम्पि हु रयणीए नेव भोत्तव्वं"
english: "A woman who is devoted to dharma Should not be circumcised, For a woman who has run out of food Should never stray."

prakrit: "समिईउ पञ्च गुत्तीउ तिन्नि निच्चं च सेवियव्वाओ,जेयव्वा तह उइया बाबीसपरीसहा सम्मं"
english: "Come, join us in worship - five bunches, three niches, and service - until victory is won over us all."

prakrit: "कायव्वं सत्तीए वेयवच्चं च सूरिपमुहाण,नरतिरिदेवोहकया उवसग्गा तह य सहियव्वा"
english: "When things go awry The God of Love turns up the heat, But when things don't go well He is prepared to suffer it."

prakrit: "सद्दाइसु विसएसुं रागद्दोसा न चेव कायव्वा,बायालदोससुद्धो भोत्तव्वो कारणे पिण्डो"
english: "Don't try to make love While you're busy making love. It only makes you angry."

prakrit: "वेयणवेयावच्चे ईरियट्ठाए य सञ्जमट्ठाए,तह पाववत्तियाए छठ्ठं पुण धम्मचिन्ताए"
english: "When jealousy has reached its climax, One thinks of Dharma for the sixth time after reaching puberty."

prakrit: "कायव्वो सज्झाओ परिहरियव्वाओ सव्वविकहाओ,उज्जमियव्वं सययं सब्भिन्तरबाहिरतवम्मि"
english: "When things are going well, Everyone is prospering, And when they are bright, Everything seems to be going smoothly."

prakrit: "मोत्तूण अट्टरुद्दे झाएयव्वाणि धम्मसुक्काणि,भवेयव्वो य अणिच्चयाइवरभावणानिवहो"
english: "When the pearl is struck with an axe The young men rejoice in Dharma, Though they are deprived of true feelings."

prakrit: "अब्भसियव्वो विणओ पावा सच्छन्दया न कायव्वा,निच्चम्पि अणुट्ठेओ दसप्पयारोवि जइधम्मो"
english: "You fool, If you want to eat and drink freely You can't do it alone. But if you don't, gather yourself together And sacrifice your life For the sake of the poor."

prakrit: "खन्ती मद्दव अज्जव मुत्ती तवसञ्जमे य बोद्धब्वे,सच्चं सोयं आकिञ्चणं च बम्भं जइधम्मो"
english: "Truth alone triumphs Over falsehood, falsehood triumphs over falsehood And falsehood prevails over truth."

prakrit: "वसियव्वं मुणिमज्झे नो कायव्वा कुसीलसंसग्गी,पञ्चविहोवि पमाओ परिहरियव्वो पयत्तेण"
english: "Living in the moonlight, There is no need to make haste, There are five ways to escape." ""

prakrit: "मज्जं विसयकसाया निद्दा विगहा य पञ्चमी भणिया,इयं पञ्चविहपमाओ जीवं पाडेइ संसारे"
english: "The fifth brother, Who is wise in all respects, Gives life to the world Through these five vows."

prakrit: "किं बहुणा धीदुब्बलमणतावकरो उ जावजीवाए,बोढव्वो अट्ठारससीलङ्गसहस्सपब्भारो"
english: "How can a man with large breasts Survive If he acts so rashly?"

prakrit: "कीरन्तो जइधम्मो खिप्पं मोक्खम्मि नेइ नरनाह!,दीहरकालेणं पुण सावगधम्मोवि तं सव्वं"
english: "Kiranto jaayidhammo khippam mokshammi nai naranah!, In broad daylight, Once again, all this will be cursed." ""

prakrit: "पञ्च य अणुव्वयाइं गुणव्वयाइं च हॊन्ति तिन्नेव,सिक्खावयाइं चउरो सावगधम्मो दुवालसहा"
english: "The five vows are characterized by virtuous conduct and virtuous behavior; the four vows are to be practiced with due solemnity."

prakrit: "एमाइवित्थरेणं दुविहेवि हु साहियम्मि धम्मम्मि,पत्थावं नाऊणं रन्ना सूरी इमं पुट्ठो"
english: "In this damned world, Which is bristling with fire and water, I pledge allegiance to the dharma of love."

prakrit: "कमलावईइ पुत्तो अडवीए जयमेत्तओ केण,अवहरिओ,पुव्वकयं किंवा वेरं सरन्तेण?"
english: "Who is the victor, my son, Who has struck the lotus? It is the hunter, Not the flower, Or is the enemy, The hunter?"

prakrit: "वुड̣धिङ्गओ स कत्थ व भयवं! कइया व अम्ह सो मिलिही?,एयं सवित्थरेणं साहेह अणुग्गहं काउं"
english: "How afraid we all are of him! Where have we got him?" asked the hunter, "So how can I help him?

prakrit: "नाऊण य उवगारं कहिज्जमाणे पभूयलोयस्स,अह केवलिणा भणियं कहिमो आयन्नसु नरिन्द!"
english: "Now tell me, you fool, How can I help you If you say:" "My brother - in - law, I beg of you, Come!" ""

prakrit: "धायइसण्डे दीवे पुरच्छिमद्धम्मि भरहखित्तम्मि,अत्थि पुरी पोराणा नामेणं अवरकङ्कत्ति"
english: "In midday the lamp is kindled, In the middle of the night it fills with excitement, And then the fire is quenched with the name of Purana."

prakrit: "तीए अम्बडवणिणो महिला नामेण अत्थि अच्छुत्ता,तीए कमेण जाया वररूवा तिन्नि पुत्ताओ"
english: "Aunt, The name of that lovely woman does not suit her. But her actions have proved fatal To all three of her sons."

prakrit: "मण्डणमल्हणचन्दणनामा,तेसिं च तिन्नि महिलाओ,लच्छिसरस्सइसम्पयनामाओ पवररूवाओ"
english: "The moonlit night, And the three women in it, Are a blessing in disguise."

prakrit: "पयईइ तणुकसाया अन्नोन्नं पवरपीइसञ्जुत्ता,दाणरया सन्तुट्ठा सुहेण अच्छन्ति ते वणिणो"
english: "Give thanks, O sweetwood tree, For always bearing fruit, If you are content with what you give, You will do well."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाइवि लच्छी वण्ठेण निन्ननामेण,दिट्ठा,अब्भुववन्नो सो तीए रुवलावन्ने"
english: "Oh! look! There must be something very special about that girl's face Which looks like a banner proclaiming her immodesty."

prakrit: "पत्थेइ य तं बहुसो सा पुण तं नेच्छई मणेणावि,अह अन्नया तलाए तोयनिमित्तं गया लच्छी"
english: "Well, you'd better take it, my dear. I don't think she likes you very much anymore. So I went and fried you for your sake." ""

prakrit: "तुरयारụधो अह निन्नओवि पत्तो 'णुमग्गओ तीए,वियणे गहिया मड्डाइ रोविया तुरयपट्ठीए"
english: "The trumpet blares loudly," "You're not the only one with a trumpet!" "They twine round her neck And make her weep."

prakrit: "विलवन्ती वेगपहाविएण तुरएण पाडिया अडविं,भिल्लेहिं समं जुज्झम्मि मारिओ निन्नओ रन्ने"
english: "The forest is bursting at the seams with the trumpet call of love, For in the same battle as yesterday the hunter has killed his wife." ""

prakrit: "गहियाभरणा लच्छी मुक्का भिल्लेहिं तत्थ अडवीए,हिण्डन्ती तत्थ मूढदिसा असिया सीहेण छुहिएण"
english: "Aunt, When he touches you with his thick, prominent fists, You look at him with suspicious eyes, And when he looks at you with suspicious faces."

prakrit: "अह सा मल्हणपत्ती सरस्सती मोहिलेण वणिएण,पत्थिज्जन्ती पइणो साहेइ जहट्ठियं सव्वं"
english: "Ah, the garland of emeralds, The rustle of pearls, Like a banner proclaiming the victory of righteousness: All this in my heart."

prakrit: "अह मल्हणेण रन्नो गन्तुं सिट्ठम्मि तम्मि वुत्तन्ते,उद्दालियदविणो मोहिलोवि निव्वासिओ रन्ना"
english: "Oh! the hunter's wife is running away, Sitting astride her husband. The hunter is distracted by his wife Who is busy making love In the forest."

prakrit: "पुव्वसयसहस्साइं बहूणि परिवालिऊण नियमाउं,तिन्निवि कालं काउं निबद्धमणुयाउया तत्तो"
english: "Aunt, Allow me to take you for a ride, For all three of you have been waiting patiently For this moment."

prakrit: "जम्बुद्दीवे एत्थं अत्थि पुरी मेहलावती नाम,एरवए वरखेत्ते आरियदेसम्मि वित्थिन्ना"
english: "Jambuddivye attha puri mehlavati naam, erway varakhette aariyadesammi vitthinna."

prakrit: "भीमरहो तत्थासी राया कुसुमावली उ से देवी,तीए पुत्तताए उववन्नो मण्डणो ताव"
english: "Mother - in - law, Tathāsī Rāya Kusumavālī is a goddess. Therefore, my son, do not scold her." ""

prakrit: "जाओ य उचियसमए देवकुमारोवमो विसालच्छो,कणगरहो से नामं विहियं उचियम्मि समयम्मि"
english: "Come, let us go and see how the gods conduct themselves: At the right time they give birth to gods, At the wrong time their names are mentioned."

prakrit: "कमसो जोव्वणपत्तो विसुद्धवंसाण रायकन्नाण,रायसिरीपमुहाणं पवराणं गाहिओ पाणिं"
english: "At least the youthful path, The path of the wise and the tree of wisdom, Are watered by the waves of the sun."

prakrit: "जुवराय पए ठविओ भुजइ माणुस्सए पवरभोए,अन्तेउरमज्झगओ देवो विव देवलोगम्मि"
english: "The God of Love dwells in the world, In men He embraces, And in men He disciplines."

prakrit: "तीइ नयरीइ इब्भा सहोयर दोन्नि आसि सत्थाहा,सागरदत्तो य तहा समुद्ददत्तो य सुपसिद्धा"
english: "She is a true woman, Both my brother and sister - in - law are faithful, The ocean is dear, And the sea is dear to me."

prakrit: "अह सो निन्नयवण्ठो निहओ भिल्लेहिं तत्थ अडवीए,कइवयभवगहणाइं हिण्डित्ता तिरियजाईसु"
english: "Oh! you silly girl, Don't turn your back on me: There must be something on your mind."

prakrit: "उव्वट्टिऊण पुत्तो सागरदत्तस्स सत्थवाहस्स,धन्नाए भारियाए सुबन्धुनामो समुप्पन्नो"
english: "Wretched son, The ocean is my only refuge. Blessed are the good wives for sharing my pleasant name."

prakrit: "सोवि हु मल्हणजीवो कालं काऊण आउपज्जन्ते,जाओ सुदंसणाए भज्जाए समुद्ददत्तस्स"
english: "Long - eyed people, Time is running out for me. Go and see for yourself: The ocean is empty." ""

prakrit: "पुत्तो धणवइनामो सुरुवजुत्तो कलासु पत्तट्ठो,एत्तो य अत्थि नयरी विजया तत्थेव एरवए"
english: "My son, If you want to make a name for yourself, You'd better start with a pen and write on it. There must be something about that woman's victory."

prakrit: "तीए समिद्धिजुत्तो धणभूई नाम आसि सत्थाहो,महिला सुन्दरिनामा पुत्तो य सुधम्मनामॊत्ति"
english: "Aunt, The name of the rich man is Asi Satthaho, And the name of a beautiful woman is Puttu, Which means" "good mother." ""

prakrit: "अह चन्दणोवि वणिओ मरिउण तओ सुधम्मनामस्स,एगोयरो कणिट्ठो जाओ धणवाहणो नाम"
english: "Ah! the name of the moneylender's son - in - law, When he dies His name will be remembered for good."

prakrit: "तत्थेव य एरवए सुपइट्ठपुरम्मि आसि हरिदत्तो,इब्भो तस्स य महिला विणयवई विणयसञ्जुत्ता"
english: "Then, behold, there was a goodly maiden, Blessed be she: Yet all the women swooned at the sound of her voice."

prakrit: "पुत्तो उण वसुदत्तो अह सा लच्छी तया ओ अडवीए,सीहहया मरिऊणं भभिऊण तिरिक्खजोणीसु"
english: "My son, Vasudeva, I have grown thin, So what do you expect From your wife If you dream that she is about to die?"

english: "As the forest fires burn, So do the shrubs in the forest, Which bear the fruit of many trees."

english: "So again the enemy struck at my heart with a sharp arrow, But it missed the mark by a whisker."

english: "So at that time the arrows of the God of Love flew high. Only when they touched the roots of the tree Can they be destroyed." ""

english: "The name of the moon god is due to him." "Who gave him such a bold description In his youth?" ""

prakrit: "परदारपसत्तो सो सुमङ्गलो तेण छिन्नवरविज्जो,मुक्को परओ माणूसनगस्स देवेण कुद्धेण"
english: "Behind the curtain, That lovely mass of grass Is scattered all over, But even after it has been punched, The gods spit on the man's throat." ""

prakrit: "पडिबोहिया उ देवेण वसुमई जायतिव्वसंवेगा,सूरिसुहम्मपवत्तिणिपयमूले अज्जिया जाता"
english: "Fallen trees will wither as soon as they are planted, And the roots of the holy lotus will be rooted out by the sun's rays."

prakrit: "एवं च अणङ्गवई वसुमइअज्जाइ संयुया तत्थ,मयहरिचन्दजसाए पयमूले कुणइ उग्गतवं"
english: "And the uneven surface of the sky, Wherever it may be, Like the full moon on the horizon, Promotes harmony."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाइवि वियारभूमिं गयाहिं एयाहिं,दिट्ठं तं उम्मत्तं मिहुणं बहुडिम्भपरियरियं"
english: "Oh! my! How hast thou ever been to a wretched land? Yet thou seest the lotus of my heart Which is covered with many petals."

prakrit: "उग्गायन्तं बहुहा नच्चन्तं धूलिधूसरसरीरं,तं दट्ठुमणङ्गवई सविसाया एवमुल्लवइ"
english: "A lot of smoke rises from the fire, Dust drips from the rafters, And the sight of it is enough to satisfy any craving."

prakrit: "अज्जे! वसुमइ! एसा भगिणीइ सुलोयणाइ अणुहरइ,जरदण्डिखण्डवसणा गहगहियनरस्स पासत्था"
english: "Ah! spring! Such a woman welcomes a suloinette, Like the juice of an apricot shoot Dripping down a deep vein." ""

prakrit: "भणियं च वसुमईए सुइरं निज्झाइऊण सविसायं,एसो सो कणगरहो एसावि सुलोयणा नूणं"
english: "Spring is spring, autumn is winter, and spring is spring." ""

prakrit: "तत्तो गन्तुं दोहिवि महुरं आभासियं तयं जुयलं,उग्गायइ हसइ नच्चइ बोल्लइ असमञ्जसं बहुयं"
english: "There you go, Both bees adoring each other And the jasmine twining around you, Laughing wildly, Speaking indistinctly, Like a bunch of parrots."

prakrit: "ताहे दोवि जणाइं सुहम्मसूरिस्स पायमूलम्मि,करुणापराहिं अज्जाहिं ताहिं नीयाइं सविसायं"
english: "So tell me, you silly girl, You're both handsome hussies. Today, out of compassion, They're the only ones Who get it right." ""

prakrit: "अइसयनाणी य गुरु पुट्ठो उम्मायकारणं ताहिं,गुरुणावि ताण सिट्ठो पुव्वुत्तो सयलवुत्तन्तो"
english: "Teacher, if you ask me what made me happy, It's that flower sitting on your head That makes me happy."

prakrit: "भणिओ अज्जाहिं गुरु भयवं! जइ अत्थि कोवि पडिजोगो,ता एयाण पउञ्जह जइ पिच्छह किञ्चिं उवगारं"
english: "Say:" "My lord, I am afraid! If you have to go anywhere else, tell me: There must be something wrong with your skirt." ""

prakrit: "तत्तो गुरुणा तेसिं दिन्नो उम्मायनासणपडिट्ठो,पडिजोगो जायाइं दोन्निवि अह सत्थचित्ताइं"
english: "Then the teacher gave it to me, And I bowed before my mother - in - law, For both were won over by true feelings."

prakrit: "अह ताण वसुमईए सिट्ठो सव्वोवि पुव्ववुत्तन्तो,एयस्स गुरुपभावा नट्ठो तुम्हाण उम्माओ"
english: "When you sit here All the flowers are blooming. Please, teacher, don't act so rashly As to cause embarrassment to yourself."

prakrit: "इय सोऊणं दोन्निवि सुहम्मसूरिस्स परमविणएण,वन्दन्ति चरणजुयलं अह सूरी भणिउमाढत्तो"
english: "These two beauties, because they are both extremely beautiful, Make my bed resplendent."

prakrit: "भोगसुहलालसाणं परदाररयप्पियाण पुरिसाण,बहुविहविडम्बणाओ इह परलोए य जायन्ति"
english: "The pleasures of love, Which men devour at every turn, Are multiplied by the delights of love."

prakrit: "पावन्ति विसयतिसिया वहबन्धणमारणाइदुक्खाइं,नाऊण कुमर! एवं भोगपिवासं परिच्चयसु"
english: "Long - eyed girl, These are the sorrows of married life: Now think of your lover!" ""

prakrit: "परदारपसत्तेणं जं पावं चिक्कणं तए बद्धं,पुप्फसरिसो विवागो रज्जब्भंसाइओ तस्स"
english: "The foot that steps on the fence Is tied to the bangle of your foot, But when the girl steps on it It is as if a rope has been broken."

prakrit: "एत्तोवि अणन्तगुणं कडुयविवागं फलं तु परलोए,पाविज्जइ दुव्विसहं नारयतिरियाइसंसरणे"
english: "So bitter a fruit as this One will last a hundred years, But you'll have to bear the brunt of it Both in winter And in winter."

prakrit: "एमाइदेसणाए आविब्भूयम्मि चरणपरिणामे,पव्वावियइं गुरुणा दोन्निवि निव्विन्नचित्ताइं"
english: "At every step of the way The landowner steps in, And at every step His master instructs him."

prakrit: "मयहरियाए पासे भगिणीजुयलेण सञ्जुया तत्तो,सम्मं गुरुविणयरया सुलोयणा कुणइ विविहतवं"
english: "When my brothers and sisters gather around me As a young couple, The ways in which they conduct themselves Are varied To the extent that they appeal to their elders."

prakrit: "एवं चन्दजसाए पयमूले ताण अच्छमाणीणं,तिण्हम्पि हु भगिणीणं गयाणि बहुपुव्वलक्खाणि"
english: "And when the moon was full of twigs It seemed to me that the bracelets on my brother's shoulder Were a multitude of bracelets."

prakrit: "मुणिणो कणगरहस्सवि घणवाहणसाहुणा समेयस्स,वोलीणाओ बहुया वरिसाणं कोडिकोडीओ"
english: "Foolish girl, If you want to have a good laugh At the sound of your husband's voice You'd better stop."

prakrit: "अह अणसणेण सूरि कालं काऊण बीयकप्पम्मि,जाओ ससिप्पहसुरो विमाणचन्दज्जुणाहिवई"
english: "Ah, how strange it is to behold The sun rising in the morning, Like the flame of the moon rising from a saucer."

prakrit: "घणवाहणोवि मरिउं जाओ सामाणिओ सुरो तस्स,विज्जुप्पहॊत्ति इयरा देवी से चन्दरेहत्ति"
english: "The man with the heavy vehicle Is about to die, And his wife is about to join him, Because the moonlight has been stolen from her by a demoness named Iara."

prakrit: "वसुमइअज्जावि तहा पुव्वुवन्नस्स तत्थ देवस्स,चन्दज्जुणस्स जाया देवी चन्दप्पहा नाम"
english: "Spring is coming, flowers are blooming, and then the gods. The moon - eyed girl's name should be Chandappa." ""

prakrit: "एत्तो य सो सुबन्धू दइयाइ गुरुविरहसोयसंसत्तो,हट्टघरकाणणाईसु कत्थवि य धिइं अपाविन्तो"
english: "Here she is, Lovely girl, Pretending to be away from her teacher, Paying attention to what's going on in the house." ""

prakrit: "कणगरहस्स पउट्ठो चिन्तेन्तो विविहमारणोवायं,रोद्दज्झाणोवगओ विलवन्तो दीणवयणिल्लो"
english: "When one thinks of his wife's breasts One hears all sorts of sighs, When one speaks of her lover's face One thinks of her breasts"

prakrit: "रयरमियहसियजम्पियसहरिसअवगुहणाइं दइयाए,पुणरुत्तं सुमरन्तो जाओ सो गहगहिउव्व"
english: "Please, my handsome husband, give me your round breasts, so that when they are full again they may fall at your feet."

prakrit: "तओ निययघरम्मि न चिट्ठइ हिण्डइ उज्जाणकाणणइसु,कत्थ गया केण हिया कीस निलुक्का सि जम्पन्तो"
english: "You always tell me you're not at home," he said, "So why don't you stop and take a look?

prakrit: "कह रुट्ठा मह सुन्दरि! जेण न दंसेसि अप्पयं सिग्घं,हुं हुं दिट्ठा दिट्ठा पसीय मह देसु पडिवयणं"

prakrit: "जं जं पिच्छइ लोयं तं तं पुच्छइ,तए पिया दिट्ठा?,एमाइं विलवमाणो नीहरिओ ताओ नयरीओ"
english: "She asks him every time he slips," "Do you see that man?" "I can't understand why he keeps slipping."

prakrit: "उम्मत्तयरूवेणं हिडन्तो विविहगामनयरेसु,दुहिओ दीणो वियणो छुहापिवासाहिं सन्तत्तो"
english: "If you touch a woman's breasts You cause distress To those around her Who suffer from nausea and vomiting."

prakrit: "कइयावि हु सम्पत्तो अणेयतावसजणाउरे रम्मे,नाणादुमसयगहणाम्मि आसमे विविहफलपउरे"

prakrit: "तत्थ य से कुलवइणा मणयं सञ्जायसत्थचित्तस्स,नियधम्मो परिकहिओ तस्सवि सो परिणओ ताहे"

prakrit: "गिण्हिय तावसदिक्खं दइयागुरुविरहजायवेरग्गो,कयकन्दफलाहारो घोरतवं चरिउमारद्धो"

prakrit: "दोमासियतेमासियचउम्मासाइयं तवं विविहं,काउं पभूयकालं अतुट्टवेराणुबन्धो सो"
english: "Two months are long, One month is short, And the next month is long."

prakrit: "मरिऊण य उववन्नो परमाहम्मियसुरेसु अम्बरिसी,उववन्नमेत्तओ सो पुव्वभवालोयणं कुणइ"
english: "When she dies, her lover mutters," "The pleasures of love never cease." ""

prakrit: "नाऊण पुव्ववइरं विहङ्गनाणेण आसुरुत्तो सो,चिन्तेइ कत्थ वइरी सा वा मह दुट्ठमहिलत्ति?"
english: "You fool, When I tried to seduce you with my favorite flower, You fool? Where do you think I am Going, You silly girl, Or a heavy woman?"

prakrit: "दुस्सीला सा पावा अणुरत्तं तह ममं परिच्चइय,आसत्ता कणगरहे सच्चिय ता वइरिणी पढमं"
english: "That poor girl's reputation is such that she despises me, But if she really cares, It's because she loves to be read to."

prakrit: "तारिसदुक्खं दिन्नं तइया मह जेहिं दुट्ठसीलेहिं,इण्हिं गन्तुं दोन्निवि हन्तव्वाइं मए ताइं"

prakrit: "इय चिन्तिऊण वेगेण आगओ रोसफुरफुरन्तो सो,संलेहणसुसियङ्गो जत्थच्छइ कणगरहसाहू"

prakrit: "धम्मज्झाणोवगयस्स तस्स पडिमागयस्स रयणीए,पिउवणठियस्स मुणिणो घोरुवसग्गे कुणइ पावो"
english: "When the dharma is chanted, The path is paved with paddy fields, And when the farmer is sagging, He walks on the horse's back."

prakrit: "काउं पिसायरूवं उक्कत्तइ निसियकत्तियाहत्थो,मंसाइं सरुहिराइं सम्भारियपुव्वकयवइरो"

prakrit: "भीमट्टहासपुव्वं उड्ढं उक्खिविय खिवइ खोणीए,दुव्विसहगुरुकसाघायताडणं कुणइ पुणरुत्तं"

prakrit: "मुञ्चइ धूलीवरिसं खणेण उवलोहपूरियं कुणई,जलणवरिसेण वरिसइ छिन्दइ खणेण अङ्गाइं"
english: "One scratches the surface with dust, pinches the tip of an iron nail, cuts the skin with a burning needle, and rubs it against one's body."

prakrit: "काऊण हत्थिरूवं सुतिक्खदन्तेहिं देई वेहाइं,नियकाइयाए सिञ्चइ लोलइ चलणेहिं भूमीए"
english: "Whom do you want me to hand over for safekeeping? The land is slippery when irrigated, Destroyed by nature's fury?"

prakrit: "किं बहुणा भणिएणं निग्घिणहियएण तेण असुरेण,मुणिदेहे दुव्विसहा विहियानरओवमा वियणा"
english: "What do you mean she didn't say anything to you?" he whispered, His face darkened by the tears welling up in her eyes.

prakrit: "तीइ वियणाइ साहू अचलियचित्तो पसत्थसुहलेसो,धम्मज्झाणोवगओ निन्दन्तो निययदुच्चरियं"

prakrit: "कयअणसणो महप्पा कालं काऊण बीयकप्पम्मि,चन्दज्जुणम्मि जाओ विहुप्पहो नाम देवॊत्ति"
english: "What a great time to be sowing seeds. Go to the moonlit night. The name of the god is Vihupa."

prakrit: "अम्बरिसी मुणिदेहं पाणविमुक्कम्पि गरुयरोसेणं,छिन्दिय सयहा पत्तो सुलोयणज्जासमीवम्मि"

prakrit: "सावि हु पभायसमए काउस्सग्गे ठिया सुहज्झाणे,साहुणिमज्झोवगया सुमरावियपुव्वदुच्चरिया"
english: "Behold, my lover, While I was with you for the whole night, You wasted away my pleasantries, Like wine wasted away in a fire."

prakrit: "लोहमयपुरिसपडिमं फुलिङ्गजालाउलं विउव्विय,पावे! परपुरिसपिए! अवगूहसु वल्लहं एयं"
english: "Behold the flame of a flame burning brightly, Come! Forgive me, my dear! For this is the power of the senses." ""

prakrit: "इय भणिय तेण समयं गाढं बन्धितु जलियदण्डेहिं,हणिऊण तक्खणेणं सावि तओ मारिया तेण"
english: "Saying this, he took his time:" "The fire is burning brightly, And when the fire has burnt deeply enough, He will surely be put to death." ""

prakrit: "अविचलियसुद्धभावा कालं काउं विहुप्पहसुरस्स,उप्पन्ना पियदेवी सयम्पभा नाम तत्थेव"

english: "If you want to please the gods With your beauty, You'd better take care of everything else."

prakrit: "तत्तो रन्ना भणियं जाव य पुत्तेण सङ्गमो ताव,काहामि तओ सहलं मणुयत्तं तुह पासम्मि"
english: "There you are, Running out to meet my son, Saying:" "I have a hard time keeping up with you." ""

prakrit: "एत्थन्तरम्मि पणमिय धणदेवो भणइ सुप्पइट्ठगुरुं,तइया पल्लीभङ्गे जाए घोरम्मि सङ्गामे"
english: "Here at this hour The god of wealth calls a sleeper, And there at the break of dawn He goes about the village In rapturous concert."

prakrit: "कणगवईइ बलेणं हएसु नट्ठेसु भिल्लसुहडेसु,किं जायं तुम्हाणं कहवा समणत्तणं पत्तं?"
english: "You fool, Don't be so naïve As to say that you're pregnant. What do you mean by reconciliation?"

prakrit: "भणियं गुरुणा निसुणसु तइया समरङ्गणम्मि जुज्झन्तो,सरनियरवरिसविहुरियदेहो पडिओ धरावट्ठे"
english: "Foolish girl, Stop your anger! You're fighting on the battlefield. The arrows of the God of Love fall on deaf ears."

prakrit: "दिट्ठो य तं पएसं समागएणं सुचित्तवेगेणं,खयरेण तेण नीओ सिणेहसारेण वेयड̣धे"
english: "Look at him! He is so eager to meet you, So anxious are you, my dear, To arrange a wedding banquet for him."

prakrit: "विहिओ य तक्खणं चिय ओसहिसामत्थओ अहं सत्थ,दिन्ना य पवरविज्जा पुव्वुवगारं सरन्तेण"
english: "Behold, I am at peace, For I cannot bear to leave this wretched field If it does not yield the flowers I desire."

prakrit: "पन्नत्तीनामेणं विहिणा सा साहिया मए तत्थ,तत्तो समागओ हं सिद्धत्थपुरम्मि खयरजुओ"
english: "There I was, Stretching out my name, And meeting you there I felt like a young man In a deserted town."

prakrit: "कणगवईइ समेयं सुरहं निद्धाडिऊण देसाओ,सिद्धत्थपुरे जाओ राया हं ताहि धणदेव!"
english: "Decide for yourself, my dear, That in due course you will attain to purity: I am the god of wealth!"

prakrit: "परिवालिऊण रज्जं कइवि हु वरिसाण कोडिकोडीओ,अहिसिञ्चिऊण रज्जे जयसेणं निययपुत्तमहं"
english: "If I had to walk on strings Wrapped around my wrists Like a pair of scissors Wrapped round my waist, I would not walk on them."

prakrit: "धणवाहणकेवलिणो पयमूले जायतिव्वसंवेगो,पव्वइओ सह पञ्चहिं सएहिं वररायउत्ताणं"
english: "The plowman's son has grown so thin on the paddy field That he is unable to support the bridegroom For five days." ""

prakrit: "अब्भसियसाहुकिरिओ जाओ कमसो य बारसङ्गविऊ,धणवाहणकेवलिणा अहिसित्तो ताहि सूरिपए"
english: "No need to be angry, you fool," he whispered. "At least you'll be able to reason with each other."

prakrit: "काऊण य सेलेसिं खविउं चत्तारि सेसकम्माइं,सो अम्ह गुरु पत्तो निव्वाणं भद्द! धणदेव!"
english: "Whom are you looking out for? Your ears are burning And your cheeks are closing. So hideous is the secret of your master's name! Dependent on him!"

prakrit: "इय सुपइट्ठसूरी जाव य परिकहइ निययवुत्तन्तं,तावय गयणाहिन्तो एगो खयरो समोइन्नो"
english: "A good wife is one who goes about her business as usual, One who does not give a damn When called upon."

prakrit: "कयसूरिपणामेणं भणियं अह तेण विणयपणएण,वेयड̣धाओ वद्धावओ अहं आगओ तुम्ह"
english: "I will never forget how you made me feel When you threatened to burn me alive With your sharp arrows."

prakrit: "संसिद्धसयलविज्जो पव्वइउमणेण चित्तवेगेण,अहिसित्तो निययपए तुम्ह सुओ मयरकेउत्ति"
english: "Because you are so determined To attain purity Of mind, You have proved fatal To me."

prakrit: "सो खयरविन्दसहिओ तुम्हाणं पायवन्दओ एही,इय नयरे अज्जेव य इय तुम्ह पियं निवेएमि"
english: "This is how you treat me, my poor girl. I will never forget how you made me feel."

prakrit: "तव्वयणं सोऊणं हरिसवसूससियरोमकूवेण,दिन्नं अङ्गविलग्गं पभूयदव्वं च से रन्ना"
english: "The plowman's daughter has grown very thin, Her hair is drooping, Her limbs are limp, And her face is smeared with red ghee."

prakrit: "आणन्दिया देवी ओयारणयं करेइ खयरस्स,अङ्गम्मि अमायन्तं हरिसं सुरसुन्दरी पत्ता"
english: "Aunt, It's safe for you to walk in the shade of the Goda, A leaf as beautiful as the nectar of an emerald"

prakrit: "पणमिय सूरिं राया पुरं पविट्ठो सपरियणो ताहे,आणवेइ कुट्टवाले सिग्घं नयरं विसोहेह"
english: "The sun of penance sets on a pure heaven, Like the bow of a horn pierced through by a sharp arrow."

prakrit: "अवणीय कयवराओ सिग्घं सारवह सयलसरणीओ,मयणाहिकुङ्कुमुम्मीसिएणं नीरेण सिञ्चेह"
english: "Ungrateful coward, Straightforward woman, Water your eyes with the nectar of a young cucumber."

prakrit: "विरएह सरसतामरसमीसकुसुमोवयारमणवज्जं,पच्छाइयगयणाओ करेह वरहट्टसोहाओ"
english: "Foolish girl, Don't overdo it! Every time you shake your head You cause embarrassment to those around you Who are busy making love." ""

prakrit: "पइमन्दिरं च बन्धह वन्दणालाओ विविहरूवाओ,धवलहरमालियाओ विचित्तवन्नेहिं भूसेह"
english: "The temples are closed, The vows are varied, The garlands of gold Are scattered all over The ground."

prakrit: "निम्मलजलपण्डिपुन्ने कञ्चणकलसे ठवेह दारेसु,उब्भेह वेञ्जयन्तीओ भवणदारेसु विविहाओ"
english: "Fettered by the nectar of neem leaves, The girl's breasts are like pots of water Powdered by the rays of the sun."

prakrit: "वरफुल्लतोरणाइं मञ्चाइं करेह एयमग्गम्मि,गोरोयणसिद्धत्थयदुव्वाजुयसोत्थियालिहणं"
english: "Perform a play on the trumpet call of the God of Love, Eyamagammi, Goroyana siddhathayaduvvujuja sothiyalighana"

prakrit: "अन्नं च एवमाई करेह कारेह पउरलोएण,इय ते रन्ना भणिया सविसेसं करिउमाढत्ता"
english: "There must be something wrong with the food. Once you've had it, It's time to sort it out." ""

prakrit: "हल्लुत्तावलपउरे इओ तओ सञ्चरन्तभिच्चयणे,अन्तेउरम्मि रन्नो पियंवया झत्ति सम्पत्ता"
english: "The plowman's daughter has grown so thin on the riverbank That she is constantly on the run. Soon her husband will be at her disposal." ""

prakrit: "सुरसुन्दरीइ दिट्ठा उवगụ̄धा हरिसनिब्भरङ्गीए,दिन्नासणोवविट्ठा अह पुट्ठा पुव्ववुत्तन्त्तं"
english: "A pretty girl's eyes, When she sees a garland of raisins, Are like a bunch of peacock's tail feathers Waved by the midday sun."

prakrit: "भणियं पियंवयाए अत्थि तुमं ताव तेण उक्खित्ता,वेयालेण अहं पुय पडिया मुच्छाइ भूमीए"
english: "You fool, My daughter - in - law loves you so much That you make me squirm When I try to kiss your cheek."

prakrit: "तत्तो खणन्तराओ मुच्छाविरमम्मि सोगसन्तत्ता,हा! कत्थ गया भगिणी कीस न सो आगओ भाया?"
english: "By the way, my poor daughter - in - law must be moaning loudly. How is it that her brother-in - law didn't start the fire?"

prakrit: "नूणं तेण पिसाएण होज्ज विहियं असोहणं किम्पि,एमाइ चिन्तयन्ती गवेसिउं ताहि लग्गा हं"
english: "What makes you think I'm angry? It makes me so angry That I start to think I am."

prakrit: "अह तत्थ रयणदीवे समन्तओ हिण्डिऊण गयणत्था,भमिया लवणसुद्दे पलोययन्ती तुमं बहुहा"
english: "Ah! there you are, my handsome hussyman, Running after the salty pastures of the forest." ""

prakrit: "फलयविलग्गो दिट्ठो समुद्दमज्झम्मि वीइनिवहेण,तोलिज्जमाणदेहो अह भाया मयरकेउत्ति"
english: "Look at the mango blossom, The sea is brimming with nectar, It looks like a man making love"

prakrit: "उक्खिविऊण तत्तो नीओ जिणमन्दिरम्मि अह तम्मि,पुट्ठो य कह णु पडिओ समुद्दमज्झम्मि,अह तेण"
english: "Look at that woman standing in front of her husband's house." "Daughter, how did she come to be called his wife?" ""

prakrit: "वेयालदंसणाई विज्जाच्छेयाइसयलवुत्तन्तो,कहिओ अह मह तेणवि भणियं सुरसुन्दरी कत्थ?"
english: "Tell me, my dear, How come you think I look so beautiful When you take my eyes off your cheeks?"

prakrit: "भणियं मएवि भाओय पिसायरूवेण सावि अवहरिया,इय सोउं गुरुमोग्गरहउव्व सो मुच्छिओ सहसा"
english: "My brother - in - law's wife sighed bitterly, Now that her husband was back at work She turned her face away suddenly." ""

prakrit: "पासट्ठियखयरेहिं सीयलपवणाइकरणओ बहुहा,सत्थीकओवि कुमरो मुच्छिज्ज जाहिं पुणरुत्तं"
english: "The pastime of cooking rice is abundant, But the potter's mustache grows thin As he puts it on his back."

prakrit: "ताहे गन्तुं तायस्स साहिओ नहयरेहिं वुत्तन्तो,तं सोउं गुरुसोगो ताओवि समागओ तत्थ"
english: "There you go, When his friends come calling, There he will meet their teacher, And then there you will be."

prakrit: "कहकहवि हु सण्ठविउं नीओ वेयड्ढपव्वए कुमरो,बहवे खयरकुमारा आणत्ता ताहि ताएण"
english: "Tell me, you stubborn girl, Why don't you take care of your husband? It's because he wants you." ""

prakrit: "छक्खण्डभरहमज्झे गामागरपट्टणेसु भमिऊणं,सुरसुन्दरिवुत्तन्तं आणेह जहट्ठियं सिग्घं"
english: "A flock of parrots, Hanging over the village fence, Brings out the most beautiful flowers So long as you do not touch them."

prakrit: "इय भणिउं पट्ठविया बहवे विज्जाहरा ओ ताएण,कुमरोवि विणोइज्जइ तायादेसाउ मित्तेहिं"
english: "Tell me, you fool," he said. "That girl has already passed the examination, And now her friends are waiting for her."

prakrit: "पियविरहसोयसम्पीडियस्स कुमरस्स कइवि दिवसाणि,वच्चन्ति जाव ताव य अन्नम्मि दिणम्मि तत्थ पुरे"
english: "Proud lady, How many days has this been going on, And how long has it been since I've had a drink of water?"

prakrit: "सम्पत्तो चउनाणी चारणसमणो दुवालसङ्गविऊ,दमघोसो नामेणं सहसम्बवणे समोसरिओ"
english: "Wealth begets wealth, Love begets love, And anger begets hatred."

prakrit: "तस्स य वन्दणहेउं विणिग्गओ कुमरसञ्जुओ ताओ,वन्दित्ता उवविट्ठो महिवट्ठे परियणसमेओ"
english: "There's the garland of lotuses on her head, Like the jeweler's bracelet Wrapped around her waist." ""

prakrit: "संसाररुन्द सायरुत्तारणजाणवत्तसङ्कासो,मुणिणावि तेसिं धम्मो अणवज्जो कहिउमाढत्तो"
english: "The sages of the world, Afraid of the wretchedness of existence, Sigh but their dharma is indistinguishable."

prakrit: "सारीरमाणसाणं दुक्खाणं खयं समिच्छमाणेहिं,जीवाण अभयदाणं मणवइकाएहिं कायव्वं"
english: "All my anger, All my resentment, Is concentrated in my desire to live, To sacrifice my life As if it were my own."

prakrit: "जरमरणदुक्खपउरं संसारं ते तरन्ति लीलाए,सच्चमणवज्जवयणं सयावि भासन्ति जे जीवा"
english: "The world is full of sorrows caused by germs, They float in ecstasy, And all living beings pretend to worship truth."

prakrit: "दोगच्चवाहिजरमरणसोयपियविप्पओगवसणाइं,जायन्ति न जीवाणं जे ओ अदिन्नं न गिण्हन्ति"
english: "Two hundred thousand vessels of fire, my dear, Spattered with smoke, Are so useless for the living That they cannot be counted as invisible."

prakrit: "वज्जन्ति जे अबम्भं जीव मणवयणकायजोगेहिं,निद्धूयसयलकम्मा वयन्ति ते सासयं ठाणं"
english: "One who understands the subtleties of life, Who knows how to weep and wail, Is dependent on one's mother - in - law"

prakrit: "धम्मोवगरणवज्जं परिग्गहं जे कयाइ न धरेन्ति,ते भवजलहिं तरिऊणं जन्ति अयरामणं ठाणं"
english: "Those who cannot abide by dharma, bound by vows, Should drink water only when there is no one to guide them."

prakrit: "एमाइसमणधम्मे कहिए समणेण जिणवरुद्दिट्ठे,पत्थावं नाऊणं कुमरेण मुणी इमं पुट्ठो"
english: "Tell me, mother - in - law, That by swearing fealty to one's rival you won't hurt the feelings of another."

prakrit: "भयवं! विज्जाच्छेओ कीस कओ मज्झ तेण देवेण?,मुणिणावि वइरकारणमक्खायं तस्स नीसेसं"
english: "How scared you must be! What makes you think I'm going to give in to your anger?"

prakrit: "तं मुणिवयणं सोउं उप्पन्नं मयरकेउकुमरस्स,जाईसरणं सहसा ईहापोहं करिन्तस्स"
english: "You silly girl, Don't overdo it: It's just the way things happen." ""

prakrit: "सरिऊण य पुव्वभवं भणियं कुमरेण एवमेयन्ति,हरिऊण कत्थ मुक्का भयवं! सुरसुन्दरी तेण?"
english: "When a woman tries to seduce her elder brother's daughter - in - law, How can she be so afraid of being punched? Such is the beauty of a beautiful woman!"

prakrit: "तत्तो मुणिणा भणियं चुयस्स देवस्स तस्स हत्थाओ,गयणाओ निवडिया सा पडिया कुसुमायरुज्जाणे"
english: "So sage, tell me, God, Use your hands for that very thing. Or sing a song while your husband is away." ""

prakrit: "हत्थिणपुरम्मि अच्छइ सम्पइ सा तुज्झ कुमर! जणणीए,कमलावईइ पासे तत्तो कुमरेण वज्जरियं"
english: "Aunt, It's your lotus on the elephant's forehead That's doing the trick! A lotus grows on the farmer's back When he sits astride it." ""

prakrit: "किं मह न होइ जणओ एसो जणणीव कणगमालत्ति,तत्तो मुणिणा सिट्ठो सुरावहाराइवुत्तन्तो"
english: "Wouldn't it be great if this man were a bunch of jasmine, Sitting cross-legged While making love?"

prakrit: "अह चित्तवेगरन्ना भणियं मुणिवयणभावियमणेण,किं कुमर! तं न सुमरिसि जं तइया देवभावम्मि"
english: "" "Ah, my poor thing! You fool, Don't you remember what it was That made you feel like a god!"

prakrit: "तुमए चिय मह सिट्ठं अवहरिओ पुव्ववेरियसुरेण,तो चित्तवेगखयराहिवस्स गेहम्मि वड̣धिहिसि?"
english: "Are you sure you don't want to sit on my lap And make love to me again?" he asked, "So what do you mean you're afraid of falling asleep?"

prakrit: "एयं तं सञ्जायं ता पुणरवि पुत्त! ताओ विज्जाओ,साहेसु,चयसु सोगं निययपए जेण ठावेमि"
english: "My son, let me repeat that thought again. But that, my dear, will take care of the rest of my grief." ""

prakrit: "मोत्तूण विसयसङ्गं भवभमणुब्भन्तमाणसा अम्हे,इच्छामो पव्वज्जं निरवज्जं सम्पयं काउं"
english: "We wish we had a pearl necklace, A vast expanse of flowers, And an endless stream of goodies."

prakrit: "इय सुरसुन्दरि! जाव य ताओ वज्जरइ ताव सहसत्ति,दमघोसवन्दणत्थं धरणिन्दो आगओ तत्थ"
english: "Oh! beautiful fire! When it rises It rises again, Then with one hundred and fifty. For the sound of its breath Is like a burning fire." ""

prakrit: "दठ्ठूणमयरकेउं सुइरं निज्झाइऊण वज्जरइ,जाणसि कुमार! सो हं पुव्वभवे आसि तुह जणओ"
english: "" "You know how it feels to shake off that stubborn nail mark, my boy! It's only because the moon is in your sky That you know how to bend it."

prakrit: "भीमरहो नामेणं मज्झ य अइवल्लहो तुमं आसि,कुसुमावलिसम्भूओ कणगरहो नाम पुत्तॊत्ति"

prakrit: "निय-कुल-कमागएणं विहिणा पत्तम्मि लग्गदियहम्मि,आणन्दियपउर-जणं नच्चन्तविलासिणिसणाहं"
english: "Niyam - kul - kamagain, Vihina patamim laggadiyammi, anandiya pura - One who does not like to be touched by bad omens"

prakrit: "वज्जन्त-वज्ज-आउज्ज-गहिर-संसद्द-पूरिय-दियन्तं,वत्तं पाणि-ग्गहणं महाविभूईए अह तेसिं"
english: "Vajjanta - Vajja - Awjja - Gire - Sansad - Puriya - Diyant, Vattam Pani - The eclipse of the sky Is a great miracle for me."

prakrit: "समुचियपडिवत्तीए खयरा संमाणिया नरिन्देण,दिन्नं च महा-दाणं पउराई भोजिओ लोओ"
english: "Foolish girl, Don't be so naïve: The whole world needs a good man, Not just you And me."

prakrit: "जिण-मन्दिरेसु विहिया महिमा परमायरेण सव्वेसु,जिण पडिमाणं वत्थाएहिं विविया महा-पूया"
english: "Living in temples, Exaltation above all glories., Speaking as one speaks, Marriage is a great virtue." ""

prakrit: "वर-वत्थ-पत्त-कम्बल-असणाईएहिं समणसङ्घोवि,सव्वोवाहि-विसुद्धेहिं पूइओ परमभत्तीए"
english: "Bride - to - be, Leaves, Blankets, Assignments, All vows, Vindications, Prayers to the Supreme Being."

prakrit: "गय-तुरय-पवर-सन्दण-गामागर-नगर-पट्टणाईयं,दिन्नं सामन्ताणं जहोचियं तत्थ नरवइणा"
english: "Gaia - turaya - pavara - sandal - village - town - urban. Wherever the landowner wants to settle There has to be a man."

prakrit: "अह अन्नादिणे राया महाविभूईइ परियणसमेओ,सुरिस्स वन्दणत्थं नीहरिओ खयरसञ्जुत्तो"
english: "Ah! the nights are long, They unfold in all directions, Like the rays of a rainbow Scorching the skies."

prakrit: "अभिवन्दिऊण सूरिं अवसेस-तवस्सिणे य सव्वेवि,उवविट्ठा अह गुरुणा कहिओ जिणदेसिओ धम्मो"
english: "When everyone calls out," "Praise be to you, O teacher!" "Say:" "Long live the dharma." ""

prakrit: "अह वन्दिऊण सूरिं देवी कमलावई इमं भणइ,भयवं! अन्नम्मि भवे आसि कयं कि मए पावं?"
english: "Ah, the Vandiune Surimadevi speaks through the lotus:" "Fear not! There must be something wrong with me, Why should I?" ""

prakrit: "सुयविरहजणियदुक्खं जस्स वसाओ सुदुस्सहं पत्तं?,अह केवलिणा भणियं देवाणुपिए! निसामेसु"
english: "The pathos of being separated from one's self Is like a good man's path?" "Oh! Only God can heal a brother!" "Rest assured."

prakrit: "जो सो 'वरकङ्काए अम्मड वणिऒत्ति आसि मे कहिओ,मण्डण-पभिईण पिया अच्छुत्त-भारिया-सहिओ"
english: "Tell me, would you mind if I told you that I was pregnant?" said the barber, Smiling bitterly at his wife's disapproval.

prakrit: "सो भमिऊण भवोहं मरु-देसे हरिसऊय गामम्मि,मेहरो अज्जुण नामो इहेव भरहम्मि उववन्नो"
english: "Behold, the landowner's son - in - law has blown up the village bower. His name will never be mentioned again." ""

prakrit: "अच्छुत्तावि हु तत्तो भमिउण भवेसु विविह-रूवेसु,महिला अज्जुणगस्स उ बन्धुसिरी नाम उववन्ना"
english: "Well done, you fool, There must be something very wrong with you: You silly girl, Don't you see your friend's name has come up?"

prakrit: "अवरोप्पर पिईए किसि--कम्म-रयाण वच्चए कालो,दोण्हवि दयापराणं पयईए तणु-कसायाणां"
english: "Who is going to drink from the fire? It's going to be black and white," he whispered, "And the two of them are going to kiss."

prakrit: "पत्ते पाउस-काले पडिए अह पणियम्मि पउरम्मि,निय पलिहईइ दोहिवि किसि-कम्मं काउमाढत्तं"
english: "The leaves have fallen in the rainy season, The housewives are busy making ends meet, And the shepherds are busy plundering the fields For no other reason than business."

prakrit: "तत्थ य एगो कमलो सगब्भ हरिणीए सङ्गओ वसइ,पलिहइपरिपेरन्ते चरइ तणं तीइ सञ्जुत्तो"
english: "At that moment the lotus dwells in the company of all the deer; It is like a grasshopper foraging on the grass of the field."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया पविट्ठं खित्ते दट्ठूण हरिणजुयलं तं,अज्जुणओ हक्कन्तो चलिओ नीसारणठ्ठाए"
english: "Oh! my poor girl, When you see a deer juxtaposed against a sacred tree, You'd better keep away!"

prakrit: "अज्जुण-भएण हरिंणी गुरु-हारा वेग-धाविया सहसा,सञ्जाय-पसव-समया वियणा-विहलङ्घला पडिया"
english: "Aunt, The hunter's wife has lost her way, The traveler is hurrying, The wedding feast is approaching And the wind is blowing." ""

prakrit: "नट्ठो सारङ्गोवि हु पुणो पुणो अज्जुणं निरुविन्तो,दइया-विओग-विहुरिय-हियओ गुरु-सोय-सन्तत्तो"
english: "A nut is a sarangavi, A pear is a pearl, A young man makes pearls again, A kind person is wise, A busy person is generous, A teacher is kind, And a good son is wise."

prakrit: "करुणापरेण नीया हरिणीवि हु अज्जुणेण नियठाणं,सीयलजलेण सित्ता मुच्छा-विरमे पसूया य"
english: "Aunt, I have to restrain you, Because you treat me with kindness, And you torture me with your frown, Because I sit in the cool of the water."

prakrit: "जायं कोड्डावणयं हरिण-सिलिम्ब तु मुद्धड-सहावं,हरिणीइ वट्टियं तं दिन्नो य थणो तओ तस्स"
english: "A deer that has been bitten by a stag Is a fool's boy, A stag that has had his way Is a coward's girl, And a thief that has lost his tail."

prakrit: "दट्ठूण तं सुरुवं विलास-सुसिणिद्ध-नयण-सोहिल्लं,बन्धुसिरीए भणियं मह होइ खिल्लणं एयं"
english: "When he sees her, He says," "She has begun to enjoy herself, She is completely at ease, Lovely lady, My next door neighbor, I am completely exhausted." ""

prakrit: "तत्तो य वाम-पाए बद्धं तं कोमलाइ रज्जूए,हरिणीवि विगय-वियणा भएण नट्ठा तयं मोत्तुं"
english: "If a stag is tied to her left foot It is because she has tender tendrils. If a deer is twisted around her thighs She will surely die."

prakrit: "मिलिया कमलस्स तओ पुणो पुणो एइ तम्मि ठाणम्मि,सिसु-नेहाओ,न पुणो अल्लियइ भएण सा तत्थ"
english: "Milia lotus, Once again this will trouble you, Sissu - Nehao. If it does not trouble you again, That is why"

prakrit: "उव्विग्गमणा वरई सिलिम्ब-नेहेण विमण-दुम्मणिया,न चरइ तणं न य पियइ पाणियं भमइ खिज्जन्ती"
english: "The landowner's daughter - in - law is like a silly bird: She does not fly, Does not eat grass, Drinks water, And is afraid of stray cattle."

prakrit: "बीयदिणेवि हु हरिणिं दुरụधुल्लन्ति तहेव दट्ठूणं,जाय-करुणाए मुक्को स सिलिम्बो बन्धुसिरियाए"
english: "Every day I keep an eye on the deer To see which one has stuck its toe in the mud." - Silambo Bandhusiriya, The One Who Fists With Compassion

prakrit: "अह सो बन्धण-मुक्को गन्तुं माऊण सभय-नेहाए,मिलिओ दट्ठूण तयं सारङ्गी निव्वुया जाया"
english: "Ah! the silence that follows the clenched fist: See how the sarangi sways When you meet it." ""

prakrit: "मज्झिम-गुण-सञ्जुत्तो दयापभावाओ अज्जुणो तत्तो,मरिऊण समुप्पन्नो एसो राया अमरकेऊ"
english: "Majjhim-guṇa-sanjutta, compassionate feelings, are inevitable in today's world; this is the path to immortality that leads to death."

prakrit: "बन्धुसिरीवि हु तत्तो निबद्ध-मणुयाउया मया पच्छा,इह उप्पन्ना भद्दे! देवी कमलावई तं सि"
english: "Friend, you are so stubborn - Please forgive me, you fool! The lotus of the goddess is just that." ""

prakrit: "जाया य तुम्ह दोण्हवि पुव्वभवब्भासओ गरुय-पीई,जीव-दया-करणाओ विउला भोगा समणुपत्ता"
english: "However much you both try to conceal your feelings, Life, being compassionate, is unable to reconcile them."

prakrit: "कमलो हरिणीए समं विओइओ जं च तत्थ खणमेगं,तक्कम्मुदया रन्नो जाओ तुम्हं सह विओगो"
english: "The lotus is as big as a deer's tail, And just like that, a thunderclap rings out." "With you, my boy, go the fires of nature."

prakrit: "जं च कओ एणीए विरहो लीवेण अट्ठ पाहरिओ,तत्थ य तए निबद्धं कम्मं सुय-विरह-दुक्ख-फलं"
english: "Whatever you do In separation, Protect it with your own eyes, For then you will stick to what you have done - Separation - The fruit of suffering."

prakrit: "उदयाओ तस्स जाओ विरहो तणएण जाय-मेत्तेण,खीणं च तयं सम्पइ अट्ठहिं लक्खेहिं वरिसाणं"
english: "Come, let there be withering away of affection: Friendship, love, and affection find their consummation in the succession of eight hundred thousand words."

prakrit: "खणमित्त-सञ्चियम्पि हु देइ विवागं सुदीह-कालीयं,सुहमसुहं वा कम्मं भाव-विसेसेण जीवाण"
english: "Calmness and concentration are the causes of happiness - Time, pleasure, or karma. Life is determined by emotion."

prakrit: "इय नाऊण विवागं पमाय- निव्वत्तियस्स कम्मस्स,दूरेण कम्म-बन्धस्स कारणं मुयह जत्तेण"
english: "This is the reason why people go on making false promises - they do it out of politeness, because they want to avoid committing a mistake."

prakrit: "इय गुरु-वयणं सोउं परिसा सव्वावि तत्थ संविग्गा,दिक्खाभिमुही जाया भीया संसार-दुक्खाण"
english: "This guru-vayana sows that the whole world is afflicted with that disease. Even the sorrow of this world, Which turns on its head, Is intolerable."

prakrit: "नरवइ-देवीण पुणो विसुद्ध-लेसाहिं वट्टमाणाण,जायं जाई-सरणं ईहापोहं करेन्ताण"
english: "The man-goddess has perfected the subtlety of love again, Which makes love blossom Every time she steps in front of him."

prakrit: "सुमरिय-पुव्व-भवाणं आगय-संवेग-भाविय-मणाण,चरणावरण-खयाओ सञ्जाओ चरण-परिणामो"
english: "Sumariya - flowers - feelings, fire - emotion - fate - manana, footwork - eating, decorating, steps - results."

prakrit: "तत्तो य अमरकेऊ पुत्तं अहिसिञ्चिऊण रज्जम्मि,तक्कालुचियं काउं करणिज्जं तिव्व-संवेगो"
english: "Then why am I immortal? My son, The ropes are tied to my wrists. Who is going to bend them Under the weight of my anger?"

prakrit: "अणुसासिऊण पुत्तं आपुच्छित्ता य परियणं सयलं,कमलावईए सहिओ पव्वइओ गुरु-समीवम्मि"
english: "My son, If you want to make love quickly, Make love with a lotus As soon as you touch it - Your husband is your mentor."

prakrit: "सिरिदेवं निय-पुत्तं कुडुम्ब-चिन्ताए सण्ठवेऊण,रन्ना सह पव्वइओ धणदेवो भारिया-सहिओ"
english: "Be careful not to fall into the trap of thinking that my son is dead. The God of Wealth is always with me, My wife is patient."

prakrit: "खयरोवि चित्तवेगो चित्तगइ-प्पमुह-खयर-सञ्जुत्तो,निव्विन्न-काम-भोगो पव्वइओ सूरि-पासम्मि"
english: "Anxious mind, Preoccupied with pleasure, Pretends to be distracted - Love, passion, passion - Love is the essence of purity."

prakrit: "खयरीवि कणगमाला पव्वइया सूरि-वयण-पडिबुद्धा,सहिया पियङ्गुमञ्जरिमाईहिं पभूय-खयरीहिं"
english: "Aunt, The jasmine flowers are like a garland of emeralds Placed on top of each other By the rays of the sun."

prakrit: "नरवाहणोवि राया रज्जं दाऊण मयरकेउस्स,पव्वइओ पय-भूले केवलिणो सुप्पइट्ठस्स"
english: "The king's wife is a miser, And his husband is a robber. For he has only slept when he forgot how to sleep."

prakrit: "रन्ना सह पव्वइया खयर-नरिन्दाण दस सहस्साओ,कमलावइ-पमुहाणं वीस-सहसाइं महिलाण"
english: "The woman who ran away with her husband, Khayr - Narinda, put up with it ten times, the woman who threw herself on the lotus - Twenty times more."

prakrit: "इय तीस-सहस्साइं समयं पव्वावियाइं केवलिणा,संनिहिय-देवयाए उवणीयं तेसिं मुणि-लिगं"
english: "This thirty-something hour Has only been won by loving wives, The God of Love has lifted up his bow."

prakrit: "ता भणइ मयरकेऊ चरणं पडिवज्जिउं असत्तो म्हि,गिहि-पाउग्गं धम्मं ता भयवं! अम्ह साहेसु"
english: "He says," "My lord, If I were to fall at your feet I would not fall. For fearful of your dharma, My lord!" ""

prakrit: "भणियं गुरुणा निसुणसु थूलग-जीवाण निरवराहाण,निसिरन्ति जे न दण्डं तेवि हु पाविन्ति निव्वाणं"
english: "My lord, Stop wasting away - Life is meaningless, Those who refuse to give in Are condemned just as much as those who do not."

prakrit: "थूलमसच्चं भासं मण-वइ-काएहिं जे न कप्पेन्ति,सुर-मणुएसर-सोक्खं भोत्तूण वयन्ति ते मोक्खं"
english: "Those who do not tremble at the sound of the drum - That is, those who are completely absorbed in the pleasure of singing - Are liberated."

prakrit: "थूलमदत्तं वज्जन्ति जे सया तिविह-करण-जोगेहिं,सव्वत्थक्खय-वित्ता होऊण वयन्ति ते सिद्धिं"
english: "One who understands the subtleties of nature, Who is able to conceal everything, Is able to become wise."

prakrit: "सन्तोसो स-कलत्ते अहवा पर-दार-वज्जणमुदारं,काउं सुरङ्गणाओ भोत्तूण वयन्ति निव्वाणं"
english: "Contentment is the lotus - Ahava par - Dar - Vajjana - Mudara, Where are the tunnels? But the bamboo poles speak the truth."

prakrit: "इच्छा-परिमाणं सेविऊण लद्धूण विउल-रिद्धीओ,देव-नरेसर-भावे कमेण गच्छन्ति निव्वाणं"
english: "When one serves a desire, One is bound by it, And when one refuses, One falls by the wayside."

prakrit: "एमाइ-वित्थरेणं गिहि-धम्मे साहियम्मि केवलिणा,तो भणइ मयरकेऊ होमि समत्थो इमं काउ"
english: "Only when one is alone with one's neighbor Does he say:" "My husband is dead." "How can one know the truth?"

prakrit: "तत्तो य गुरु-समीवे सुरसुन्दरी-मयरकेउ-पमुहेहिं,सम्मत्त-रयण-मूलो सावग-धम्मो-पवन्नोति"
english: "There the Guru is - Surasundari by his side, Mayrakeu by her side, Sammatta by her husband's side, Rooted in charity, Prominent in dharma."

prakrit: "अह चित्तवेग-पमुहा मुणिण सूरिस्स पाय-मूलम्मि,गहणासेवण-रूवं सिक्खं अब्भसिउमाढत्ता"
english: "Ah! the path of penance, Rooted in the sunshine of love, Like the thread of affection Which binds a Sikh woman's womb."

prakrit: "कमलावइ-पमुहाओ अज्जाओ सुव्वयाइ-गणिणीए,पासम्मि साहु-किरियं सिक्खन्ति पढन्ति अङ्गाइं"
english: "Kamala va ̄ mi ̄ -pamu ̄ ha ̄ yo ajja ̄ o Suvavyayoi - the counting women, The passerby's friends - They learn the kiri ̄ m By reading the limbs."

prakrit: "छट्ठट्ठम-दसम-दुवालसाइं विविहं तवं पकुव्वन्ति,विणयं गुरुण सम्मं वेयावच्चं च सव्वेवि"
english: "The twigs of the sixth and tenth flowers ripen in all sorts of different ways; they are woven by everyone, from the weaver to the teacher."

prakrit: "अह चित्तवेग-मुणिणा चोद्दस-पुव्वाइं तत्थ पạधियाइं,भिन्नक्खर-पुव्वधरो जाओ अचिरेण कालेण"
english: "Ah! the mood - The sighs of remorse, The four hundred and fifty flowers, Then the steps, The different shapes, And the passage of time."

prakrit: "अह सुप्पइट्ठ-सूरिं ठविऊण चित्तवेग-मुणिं,कय-अणसणो महप्पा निव्वाणमणुत्तरं पत्तो"
english: "Ah, the excitement of dreaming, The churning of the mind, When will you find the answer to a great riddle?"

prakrit: "अह चित्तवेग-सूरी गामागर-नगर-मण्डियं वसुहं,विहरइ-सुप्पडिबद्धो बोहिन्तो भविय-जण-नियरं"
english: "Ah, the mood - Suri, village, town, market - Vasu, Viharai, Soppadikto, Bohinto, Bhavya, Jana - niram." ""

english: "Why look at the lotus - The forest is fragrant, The people are ecstatic, How can one make love on the first day With a woman who is full of men?"

english: "Lovely girl, I can think of anything but gods!," "Duva" "meaning duality," Dua-sama-ta. "" Uttara means "" Consciousness ""; Te "

english: "Here is the pyre - Spattered with bees, Scorched with worms, Like the fire of the God of Love - Destroyed, Like a sapless snake - Guru."
