english: "Oh! flowers - Varying dreams They both tell me so, But anger makes their eyes grow darker As they travel abroad."

prakrit: "सप्पो सप्पॊत्ति पयम्पिरीइ देवीइ कलयलं सोच्चा,अह खग्ग-वग्ग-हत्था समागया अङ्ग-रक्खा से"
english: "A snake is pure, Lovely goddess, If you think of the joys of love, You'd better protect your body With hands and arms."

prakrit: "भुयगोवि हु भय-सम्भम-वेविर-देहो कयावराहॊत्ति,नासन्तो हणिऊणं खडाखण्डीकओ तेहिं"
english: "A coward is one who is afraid, Angry, anxious, Anxious, But who does not know how to weep?"

prakrit: "तयणन्तरमुच्छलिओ महन्त-कोलाहलो परियणस्स,समयं चिय निव-देवी-देह-ट्ठिय-विस-वियारेण"
english: "After the festival The bustle of the moon - The clamor of the clouds, The passage of time - The gods - In the flesh - The trees - The vices - The vessels."

prakrit: "वाहिप्पन्ति पहाणा गारुडिया गारुडेसु पत्तट्ठा,कीरन्ति मन्त-जावा आणाविज्जन्ति मूलीओ"
english: "Vāhippanti, pāhana, garudiya, garudesu, patatā, kiranti, mantra, java, and vijjanti are the roots of the plant."

prakrit: "अभिमन्तिय-तोएणं दिज्जन्तच्छिन्न-सलिल-धाराओ,बज्झन्ति कण्डयाइं पउणीकीरन्ति अगयाई"
english: "Abhimantiya - Toenam djantantantak - Salil - Dharao, bajjanti kandayais, paanikeeranti aagayai"

prakrit: "इय गारुडियसणाहे नहयरनिवहम्मि आउलीभूए,घय-सित्तेव्व हुयासे पबलीभूए विस-वियारे"
english: "These gooseflesh swooping down from the rafters, With sweat streaming down their cheeks, Look as though they had been plucked from the river."

prakrit: "नरनाहो अव्वत्तं दिव्व-मणिं आणहत्ति भणमाणो,पिक्खन्ताणं खयराण तत्थ जाओ विगयचिट्ठो"
english: "O demon, if you want to touch a divine object You have to go there in search of another."

prakrit: "एत्थन्तरम्मि विन्नाय-वइयरा राइणो पिया भगिणी,पभणइ पियंवया वच्च वच्च लहु बाहुवेग! तुमं"
english: "Here's the message:" "Dear sister - in - law, The arms of my favorite will soon be tied behind my back! It's you." ""

prakrit: "गन्तूण भाणुवेगस्स नन्दणं चन्दवेगखयरेसं,मह वयणेण मग्गसु नयरे सिरि कुञ्जरावत्ते"
english: "Destroy yourself, O moon - eyed girl, For not caring what the moon Says About you Makes me wretched."

prakrit: "भणसु य जो सो विज्जा-पसाहणुज्जएण रक्खट्ठा,तुमए नीओ पुव्विं दिव्व-मणी मह समीवाओ"
english: "You fool, Protect me from the arrows of the God of Wisdom, For you, O God of Love, Are a blessing to me."

prakrit: "सो ̣धोइज्जउ सिग्ध इय भणिओ सो गओ तुरिय-वेगो,गन्तुं खणन्तराओ समागओ चन्दवेगेण"
english: "So take a bath," he said simply, "And then go to bed. The moonlight fills the house."

prakrit: "खयरेण समं ताहे मणि-सलिल-पयाण-पुव्वयं विहियं,नीसेस-विस-विगारेण वज्जियं जुवलयं जुगवं"
english: "Like corn, So is the nectar of jasmine, Like wine, Like poison, Like a flame kindled by fire."

prakrit: "तुट्ठो नहयर-वग्गो पियंवया तह य परियण-समग्गा,रायावि भव-सरूवं चिन्तेतो आगओ नगरं"
english: "Thinking how much love there is in a fragmented city, Like a fire in the middle of the night, Like the flames of a fire burning in the sky."

prakrit: "एत्तो तत्तो विविहावयाहिं घिप्पन्त-जीव-साराणं,सरणं नत्थि जियाणं जिणिन्द-धम्मं पमोत्तूण"
english: "There are so many different kinds of beings, All the essence of life, Living beings who do not know the true Dharma."

prakrit: "सूल-अहि-विस-विसूइय-पाणिय-सत्थग्गि-सम्भमेहिं च,देहन्तर-सङ्कमणं करेइ जीवो मुहुत्तेण"
english: "Life is momentary only because it is swollen - non - existent - poisonous - watery - fragrant - possible - And after death - suffering."

prakrit: "ता एरिसम्मि चवलम्मि जीविए विसय-मोहिया जीवा,मोह-महा-गह-घत्था तहवि हु धम्मे पमायन्ति"
english: "So this is how the ecstatic soul lives On account of her agility, Enthusiasts - Great and deep - There, too, I find refuge in Dharma."

prakrit: "अह नहयर-निवहेणं वोलीणा आवयत्ति तुट्ठेणं,गयपुरमागन्तूणं वद्धावणयं कयं रन्नो"
english: "Oh! what a field it is To be plucked out of my mother's womb By the waves of the river As if they were clouds Moving through it."

prakrit: "सुर-सुन्दरीवि देवी दियहं तं चेव पढमयं काउं,गब्भवई सञ्जाया निन्नेहा नियय-दइयम्मि"
english: "Lovely lady, The passage of time is enough for me, For as long as I am awake My mind is glued to your heart."

prakrit: "जह जह वड्ढइ गब्भो तह तह देवीवि गब्भ-माहप्पा,निट्ठूर-हियया चिन्तइ मारेमि निवं सहत्थेण"
english: "As the womb grows older, So does the mind of the divine mother - in - law. I shall bear with you till death do me part."

prakrit: "आभासियावि रूसइ निट्ठुरमुल्लवइ नेच्छए भोगं,दट्ठोट्ठ-भिउडि-भीमा दिट्ठम्मि परम्मुहा ठाई"
english: "Aunt, The pleasure of staring at you Is for naught But the sight of you - The sight of your lover - Makes your heart grow fonder."

prakrit: "तं विवरीय-सरूवं दट्ठूण पियंवया भणइ भद्दे,कीस तुमे निन्नेहा बहु मन्नसि नेव रायाणं?"
english: "You silly girl, You look so different And you think you're lying, Why don't you believe me?"

prakrit: "सुरसुदंरीइ भणियं दोसेण इमस्स पाव-गब्भस्स,मह मड्डाइ पओसो उप्पज्जइ पाव-कम्माए"
english: "Lovely girl, Don't blame me for your poor footwork. Please, mother - in - law, Please, forgive me for my footwork!"

prakrit: "ता गन्तुं नर-वइणो साहिज्जसु जेण अन्नहाभावं,न करेइ मज्झ उवरिं वियलिय-नेहं ममं दट्ठुं"
english: "It's like going to bed, Like starving for food, Without me having to lift it - Like looking at me."

prakrit: "अन्नं च भणसु दइयं दट्ठव्वा नेव पाव-कम्मा हं,जाव न जाइ पसवो पावय-गब्भस्स गब्भस्स"
english: "Food and drink, Compassion and good conduct are the new duties of a husband. But if a husband is absent Going to bed, Pay attention - The burden is on the wife."

prakrit: "गन्तुं पियंवयाए सिट्ठं सव्वम्पि मयरकेउस्स,तं सोउं रायावि हु विम्हिय-चित्तो इमं भणइ"
english: "When I meet my lover, He says:" "Everything is hunched over in my heart," "But when I talk to him I speak plainly."

prakrit: "अव्वो! जा मह विरहं देवी निमिसम्पि सọ̄धुमसमत्था,सा गब्भस्स पभावा अदंसणं निट्ठुरा महइ"
english: "Ah! the silence of the God of Love, Which is like the smoke from the fire of separation, Is intolerable Even to the observer of nature." ""

prakrit: "ता किं न होज्ज सॊ च्चिय पुव्व-विरुद्धो सुबन्धु-जीवो 'यं,भवियव्वाया-वसेणं उववन्नो देवी-कुच्छीए?"
english: "Wouldn't it be better for you, my dear, To live as a man of virtue than as a god of pleasure?"

prakrit: "एमाइ चिन्तयन्तो देवीए अदिन्न-दंसणो राया,निय-वइरिय-सङ्काए जावच्छइ दूमिओ चित्ते"
english: "The goddess is so indifferent When I think of her, That her anger melts away, And her fierce mind is consumed by worry."

prakrit: "ताव य देविं दट्ठुं असुहज्झवसाय-दारुणं रन्नो,मन्ने पिय-मित्ता इव साम-मुहा से थणा जाया"
english: "So when he sees the goddess, Unhappy business - The poor man runs away, As if he were a lover And is weighed down by grief."

prakrit: "नर-वर-वर-सुह-सङ्गम-सुह-विरहुक्कण्ठियेव देवीए,उज्झिय साम-च्छय गण्ड-यलं पण्डुरं जायं"
english: "Deities who are in harmony - Bridegroom, Groom, Bride - to - be, And the God of Love - Are bound together in secret."

prakrit: "सव्वेहिवि गरुयत्तं पत्तं न मएत्ति लद्ध-पत्थावं,वित्थरियं से उदरं नर-वइणो वेरि-उग्गमणे"
english: "All glory to God, Not a leaf is lost But a creeper, Like a man's bowels, Is scattered abroad."

prakrit: "दट्ठूणव उदरस्सवि गरुयत्तं जाय-तिव्व-अभिमाणं,वड्ढइ नियम्ब-बिम्बं मा जिणिज्जत्ति चिन्ताए"
english: "The moment you see her, Your stomach churns And you feel proud, Don't think too much about life As you grow older."

prakrit: "कमसो पसवण-समए सम्पत्ते ससहरम्मि मूलत्थे,पाव-ग्गहावलोइय-लग्गे लग्गाइ विट्ठीए"
english: "At least Passover - Wealth should be rooted in our roots, Roots should be tied to our foreheads And feet should be wrapped around our necks."

prakrit: "सुरसुन्दरी-पसूया महया किच्छेण दारयं ताहे,हित्थ-हियएण रन्ना वाहरिओ पवर-जोइसिओ"
english: "Lovely girl, The bee has pierced the door with its tiny buds, And the crows are running wild Because they know the path is wide."

prakrit: "पुट्ठो य कहसु तणयस्स गुण-गणं एयस्स समय-जायस्स,घूणिय-सिरेण तेणवि भणियं नर-नाह! निसुणेसु"
english: "Put it this way: The quality of her breasts Makes her look so thin At the same time As her thighs." "No, you bastard! Get off her!" ""

prakrit: "एरिस-समए जाओ जणयस्स न सुन्दरो हवइ बालो,वड्ढन्तो पिउ-गेहे हणइ कुलं राय-लच्छिं च"
english: "Aries - You're right, you're not that handsome. But as you grow older Your parents will value your family And your wealth will increase."

prakrit: "देव! न रूसेयव्वं जाव तुमं नेव पेच्छसे एयं,तावच्चिय तुह कुसलं पाणाणवि संसओ दिट्ठे"
english: "My god, don't be so angry. You're the only one who doesn't see me. The world has seen your faults too." ""

prakrit: "रन्ना भणियं भद्दय! को कोवो एत्थ वत्थु-परमत्थे,सत्थ-समत्थिय-मज्झत्थ-तत्त-बुद्धीहिं कहियम्मि?"
english: "Run, brother - in - law! Who is angry and why not? Where is the wisdom?" ""

prakrit: "कय-उवयारम्मि गए स-ट्ठाणं अह निवेण वाहित्ता,भणिया सुहासणत्था पियंवया सोय-तविएण"
english: "Why, my dear, Have you gone to bed? It's already late, My brother - in - law is abroad, And I'm going to bed early."

prakrit: "पढम-सुय-जम्म-दियहे हरिसो किर होइ जणणि-जणयाणं,तं पुण दिव्व-वसेणं अम्हं अन्नारिसं जायं"
english: "Padam, suy, jam, diye, let me see how things go. Once we have settled in, I will go elsewhere." ""

prakrit: "ता भद्दे! तं गच्छसु बालं घित्तूण धावि-सञ्जुत्तं,निय-सासुरए सिग्घं वुड̣धिं तत्थेव नेयव्वो"
english: "" "That's nasty! Get your hair tied up, goose pimples on the head," "His mother - in - law whispered."

prakrit: "तीए तहत्ति भणिउं नीओ सुरनन्दणम्मि नयरम्मि,सिट्ठो तव्वुत्तन्तो खयराहिव-नियय-दइयस्स"
english: "She said,'No, you're not welcome. Sitting here thinking how lucky you are To have found love again." ""

prakrit: "जलणप्पह-खयराहिव-पिय-भज्जा-चित्तलेह-तणयस्स,जलकन्तस्स उ सव्वो तेणवि बहु मन्निया एसा"
english: "Water, fire, drink, roast, sieve, lotus - all this is very much to be desired."

prakrit: "ताहे जलकन्तेणवि जम्मण-महिमाइ-सयल-कायव्वं,काऊण कयं नामं सुह-दियहे मयणवेगॊत्ति"
english: "A river of water flows through it, Brings glory, Makes beauty, And what is the use of calling its name?"

prakrit: "कमसो पवड्ढमाणो पत्तो सो जोव्वणं मयणवेगो,अविणीओ दुस्सीलो अकच्च-निरओ कयग्घो य"
english: "A leaf is worth less than a leaf, A youth is worth more than a nail, A miser is worthless if he does not act honestly."

prakrit: "जलकन्त-खयर-पुत्तो कञ्चणदेवीइ गब्भ-सम्भूओ,जलवेगो से मित्तो जाओ सहपạधिय-रमिउत्ति"
english: "Water hyacinth - Son of khyar - The goddess of weeds, Garbh - Sambhu, Go and make friends with the water buffalo." ""

prakrit: "सुरसुन्दरीइ कइयावि सीह-सुमिणेण सूइओ तणओ,उप्पन्नो बीओवि य सुह-तिहि-नक्खत्त-जोगम्मि"
english: "Lovely girl, If your heart is set on making love, You'd better take care of it."

prakrit: "रुवेण अणङ्ग-समो सूरो चाई पियंवओ दक्खो,नामेण 'णङ्गकेऊ सुविणीओ जणणि-जणयाण"
english: "Aunt, The south wind blows hotter than the south wind, And the midwives yawn because their husbands are abroad."

prakrit: "कमसो जोव्वण-पत्तो जुवराय-पयम्मि ठाविओ एसो,साहिय-विज्जो वियरइ इच्छाए खयर-नयरेसु"
english: "Come, let us settle down for a while. Young and leafy, juicy and fragrant: There must be something very special going on in our hearts."

prakrit: "महु-मासे सम्पत्ते राया अन्तेउरेण सञ्जुत्तो,अट्ठाहिय-महिमट्ठा पत्तो वेयड्ढ-कूडम्मि"
english: "In the month of May, wealth is poured forth in endless streams, And on the eighth day - the great festival of Veda - Koodami."

prakrit: "महया विच्छड्डेणं पत्ता वेयड्ढ-वासिणो खयरा,गन्धव्व-नट्ठ-पउरा वट्टइ अट्ठाहिया जाव"
english: "Mahaya vichaddenam patra vaidha-vasoon khyra, gandhabva-nattha-paura wattey aatahiya jawa."

prakrit: "ताव य गङ्गावत्ताउ आगया खयर-नियर-परिचरिया,वर-रूववई कन्ना अणङ्गवेगत्ति नामेण"
english: "So do not go to the river Ganges, For fear of the fire - The attendants are standing by, Not caring what the bridegroom may do With his bare breasts."

prakrit: "दिट्ठा सा जुवरन्ना तीएवि सिणिद्ध-दिट्ठि-पाएण,विद्धो अणङ्ग-बाणेहिं झत्ति आयल्लयं पत्तो"
english: "A girl's eyes are like jewels: they pierce, pierce and pierce. But a man's lips are like gooseflesh."

prakrit: "पुच्छइ अणङ्गकेऊ वसन्तनामं वयसियं,भद्द!,कस्सेसा वर-विलया कस्स व धूया ओ किंनामा?"
english: "I beg of you, tell me," "What is the name of that spring?" "Foolish one! Whom do you mean, The bridegroom's wife? And what is that name?"

prakrit: "भणियं वसन्तएणं गङ्गावत्तम्मिं आसि वर-राया,सिरि-गन्धवाहणॊत्ति य महिला मयणावली तस्स"
english: "When spring comes, When the Ganges is full, The bridegroom is ready, And the woman who smells of my perfume Is ready to welcome him."

prakrit: "तीए य तिण्णि तणया पढमो नहवाहणो,मयरकेऊ,तइओ य मेहनाओ विज्जा-बल-गव्विआ सूरा"
english: "Those three are the reed beds I bathe in, My dear, Those are the beds of wisdom."

prakrit: "पिउणा सह पव्वइए जाए नहवाहणे,मयरकेऊ,जाओ राया सोवि य वियणे विज्जं पसाहिन्तो"
english: "Drink, go and bathe, my dear, For the poison that has been sown in this wretched field Will soon be exhausted."

prakrit: "पिउणा तुज्झ पमाएण मारिओ छिन्न-वंस-जालीए,गुरु-करुणागएणं तुह पिउणा ठाविओ रज्जे"
english: "Drinking will kill your lover, Shattered will be the fence, Guru - Compassion will settle you for a drink."

prakrit: "एसो उ मेहनाओ,दिन्नाणि पभूय-गाम-नयराणि,चित्तगइ-खयर-धूया दिन्ना पउमोयरा पवरा"
english: "Here comes the buffalo, The nights are long, The village is deserted, The rivers are swollen, The roads are muddy, The streets are deserted And the roads are impassable."

prakrit: "तीए एसा धूया कन्ना नामेण मयणवेगत्ति,एयं च कुमर! मग्गइ पियंयमाए पिययमस्स"
english: "What a stupid girl, You're so naïve As to call her by that name, You bastard! I beg of you, sweetheart." ""

prakrit: "जलकन्तस्स उ पुत्तो कञ्चणदेवीइ कुच्छि-सम्भूओ,जलवेगो,किं दिन्ना नवित्ति सम्मं न याणामि"
english: "My son, Can't I go to the river for a drink?" asked the waterman, "My daughter - in - law, Can you hear me? I don't know what to do with you."

prakrit: "इय सोऊण कुमारो वज्जरइ वसन्त! सुणसु मह वयणं,एयं कन्ना-रयणं विणा उ मह नत्थि जीयासा"
english: "" "Here is my son! Spring is in full swing! Listen to me when I say it. Without you I have no life" "-Ryan."

prakrit: "जइ जीविएण कज्जं अहयं वा वल्लहो जइ य तुज्झ,ता गन्तूणं तायं तह भणसु जहा लहुं लहइ"
english: "Whether you are worthy of my life or yours is entirely up to you," he said, "you will meet the same fate as the buffalo."

prakrit: "अह सो बाल-वयंसो नाऊणं निच्छयं कुमारस्स,गन्तूण य तं रन्नो जहट्ठियं साहए सव्वं"
english: "Ah! the boy! We have only this name To give to our youngest son: To go where he pleases, We will all go together."

prakrit: "रन्नावि मेहनाओ वाहरिऊणं विमग्गिओ कन्नं,तेणवि य तस्स दिन्ना वियसिय-वयणारविन्देण"
english: "The farmer makes his wife shed tears, Brings tears to her eyes, And puts them on her cheeks."

prakrit: "गङ्गावत्ते वत्तं पाणिग्गहणं महा-विभूईए,नीया य मयणवेया कुमरेणं नियय-नयरम्मि"
english: "The great waterfall is like a panorama with the river Ganges flowing through it, Like a banner proclaiming the destiny of the virgin."

prakrit: "सोऊण पाणिग्गहणं जलवेगो दुमिओ य चित्तेण,कन्ना-विओय-दुहिओ दुक्खं नरओवमं पत्तो"
english: "If you burn the cow - dung cakes with your other two hearts, You will cause great sorrow - A man's anger melts away."

prakrit: "रुट्ठो अणङ्गकेउस्स चिन्तए विविह-मारणोवाए,लद्धोवाओ गन्तूण साहए मयणवेगस्स"
english: "Stop being angry - The thoughts of anger, of being threatened, Of being bullied into submission - These are the emotions I feel when I am angry."

prakrit: "मित्त! तुमं न वियाणसि जेट्ठ-सुओ तं हि मयरकेउस्स,सुरसुन्दरीइ पुत्तो इहाणिओ जन्म-दिवसम्मि"
english: "Friend, you're not to be trifled with. Anyway, my dear, It's your birthday, my handsome son." ""

prakrit: "अवमन्निओ सि मित्तय! जणएण तुमं सुनिट्ठुर-मणेण,तुज्झ कणिट्ठो भाया जुवरज्जे जेण अहिसित्तो"
english: "Disgrace on your part, my friend! To think you're so nice Makes your eyes grow dark As if they were juveniles." ""

prakrit: "माया-वित्ताणि य तुज्झ दंसणं कहवि नेय इच्छन्ति,वेरिय-सरिसं धारेन्ति जेण दूर-ट्ठियं निच्चं"
english: "Deceit - The seeds of delusion How much you desire to be seen By others They take all the time That is due to your presence In distant places."

prakrit: "न य लहसि तुमं गन्तुं तीइ दिसाएवि जत्थ तुह जणओ,ता पिउ-परिभूएणं वयंस! किं तुज्झ जीएण?"
english: "If you don't see the way in which I see you, You'd better take care of your father. Will you survive?" ""

prakrit: "एमाइ-वयण-महु-सप्पि-होमिओ तस्स गुरु-पओसग्गी,जलिओ जम्म-परम्पर-निबद्ध-सम्बन्ध-जोगेण"
english: "Ema - Vayana - Honey - Sapphi - Homoeo Tasa - Guru - Pausaggi, Jalio Jamma - Tradition - Commitment - Relationship - Jogain"

prakrit: "अह सो रोस-वसट्टो पभणइ दंसेहि वेरियं पियरं,दंसेमि अवन्नाए जेण फलं तस्स पावस्स"
english: "Oh! she puts on her robes And gathers the very best of you, For as long as I keep at it The fruit thereof will last."

prakrit: "भणइ तओ जलकन्तो सो तुज्झ पिया अणेग-खयरेहिं,रक्खिज्जइ तिक्खालिय-खग्ग-गयावग्ग-हत्थेहिं"
english: "If you think you're hot, Protect your sharp, scruffy, goosefleshy hands."

prakrit: "रूव-परिवत्तिणिं मित्त! गेण्ह एयं कुलागयं विज्जं,जेण जहिच्छिय-अत्थस्स साहगो होसि अइरेण"
english: "Friend, there must be something wrong with you! You have grown so thin on this earth That you are beyond reproach." ""

prakrit: "दिन्ना य तेण विज्जा रन्नं गन्तूण साहिया कमसो,गयपुरमागम्म ठिओ चेडी-रूपेण देवि-गिहे"
english: "Come, stop at Gaypuram. The goddess of wisdom will come in the form of a chedi." ""

prakrit: "सुरसुन्दरीइ चेडी ललियं हरिऊण दूर-देसम्मि,मोत्तूण तीइ रूवेण सो ठिओ निव-वहट्ठाए"
english: "Lovely Chedi Laliam, Hurrying far and wide, Laying her face on the lotus So that it does not budge." ""

prakrit: "कसिणाहि-डसण-दिवसाउ नर-वई दिव्व-अङ्गुलीएण,कर-सण्ठिएण चिट्ठइ सुरयाइयं पमोत्तूणं"
english: "Aunt, Cut and paste, Give and take, Man, with your finger and forefinger, Write with your hand and tongue To welcome the sun."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया नरिन्दो भोत्तूणं खयर-कञ्चुइ-समग्गो,देवी-घरं पविट्ठो दिट्ठो चेडीइ पावाए"
english: "Oh! dear Narindo! For what use is a poor man's house? It's like looking into the eyes of a holy woman."

prakrit: "मोत्तूणं अङ्गरक्खे बाहिं देवीए विहिय-मङ्गिल्लो,वास-हरम्मि पविट्ठो रयण-विचित्तम्मि देवि-जुओ"
english: "The pearl is limp, The arm is heavy, The body is shrivelled, The heart is firm, The mind is pure, The tongue is sharp, The other is weak."

prakrit: "परिहासाइहिं खणं अच्छित्ता सुरय-सेवणारम्भे,मिल्लइ अङ्गुलीयं देवी आभरण-ठाणम्मि"
english: "Jokes apart, When the sun begins to set, The goddess finds a jewel on her finger." ""

prakrit: "पारद्धम्मि य सुरए सहसा आयड̣धिऊण करवालं,चेडी-वेसेण ठिओ तणय-कयन्तो तहिं पत्तो"
english: "If you want to taste the fresh nectar That seeps from between your lips You'd better stop and brush your teeth Under the shade of a lotus."

prakrit: "जणणी-सुरयासत्तं जणयं घाएउमुज्जओ तणओ,हा! हा! कट्ठठमकज्जं धिरत्थु संसार-वासस्स"
english: "Mother - in - law - The sun has completely destroyed everything I had, Stirring the bowels of my heart!" "Ah! The arrows of the God of Love pierce through my heart."

prakrit: "जाणतो निय-पुत्तो पियरं घाएइ जणणि-सञ्जुत्तं,दोस-परद्धो जम्हा अहो! दुरन्तो इमो दोसो"
english: "You know, son - in - law, That my love has reached the stage of consummation, And friends have already arrived! Far be it from my fault." ""

prakrit: "रागाओ होइ दोसो दोसाओ होइ वेर-सम्बन्धो,वेराओ पाणि-घाओ तत्तो गुरु-कम्म-बन्धॊत्ति"
english: "If you are angry, you are guilty, there is enmity, And if you spit water, then there is friendship between a guru and a karma."

prakrit: "कम्म-गुरू पाणि-गणो निवडइ तिरि-नरय-दुक्ख-गहणम्मि,दुक्ख-परद्धो पावं कुणमाणो भमइ पुणरुत्तं"
english: "The master of karma chooses between water and fire, Man chooses between fire and water, Sufferer - between, Love triumphs over, And delights - Between good and evil."

prakrit: "नरयाओ तिरियत्ते तिरियत्ताओ पुणोवि नरयम्मि,दुक्ख-सय-सम्पउत्तं भव-परियट्टं कुणइ जीवो"
english: "Males become pale, females become pale again, The soul goes on multiplying, Suffering, suffering, and suffering."

prakrit: "एवं नाऊण जणा राग-द्दोसाण वज्जणं कुणह,भव-सय-किलेस-बहुलं संसारं जेण उत्तरह"
english: "And do not cause anger or bitterness by saying such things As these. For what is the answer In a world full of monsters and monsters?"

prakrit: "उग्गिन्न-खग्गमबलं अवलोइय नरवईवि विम्हहिओ,चिन्तेइ अहो! धट्ठा मज्झ वहट्ठा इह पविट्ठा"
english: "Wretched body, Like a man possessed by a powerful demon, Thinking only of itself! This is the way of holiness." ""

prakrit: "लल्लक्क-मुक्क-हुङ्कार-पुव्वयं थंमणीए विज्जाए,थंमिय-देहा जाया निच्चिट्ठा चित्त-मुत्तिव्व"
english: "Lallak - Mukka - Hunkara - The flowers bloom, The body freezes, The mind is exhausted." ""

prakrit: "देवीवि विम्हिय-मणा भणइ य ललिए! किमेवमारद्धं,पावे! केण पउत्ता दुट्ठेणं घाइया रन्नो?"
english: "Long - eyed lady, How can I forgive you? Who is it, dear girl, That makes your husband cry so loudly?"

prakrit: "रन्ना भणियं इत्थीए साहसं एरिसं न सम्भवइ,ता देवि! कोवि दुट्ठो दिट्ठो कालेण पुरिसो 'यं"
english: "It's not possible for me to run away, my dear! For how long can I keep my eyes closed!" ""

prakrit: "पर-विज्जा-च्छेयकरिं विज्जं आवाहिऊण नर-वइणा,चिर-काल-साहियाओ छिन्नाओ तस्स विज्जाओ"
english: "Man, if you want to master a subject, You have to master it, For if you master it over and over again, It's your own knowledge."

prakrit: "तच्छेयाओ जाओ पयइत्थो सो पकम्पमाण-तणू,भणियं निवेण अणुहरइ देवि! एसो कुमारस्स"
english: "Go and pluck them out. He will come, go and plunder them. The goddess will plunder you with her bow! Such is the lotus." ""

prakrit: "ता नूणं सो एसो पढमो तुह पुत्तओ न अन्नॊत्ति,तं सुणिय इमा जाया भय-लज्जा-सोय-सम्भन्ता"
english: "No, I didn't mean to offend you, my son. But listen - I'm so scared - So shy - So content." ""

prakrit: "तम्मि य दिणम्मि सुरनन्दणाओ जलकन्त-सन्तिओ दूओ,फुड-वयणो नामेणं समागओ राय-कज्जेण"
english: "Give me your heart, Your eyes, your ears, and your nose. I'll explain it to you in due course."

prakrit: "सो वाहरिओ रन्ना पुट्ठो किं भद्द! होइ सो एसो,सो जो पियंवयाए पासे सम्पेसिओ आसि?"
english: "Come on! What's so ugly about running away? Come on, you who want to meet your lover in person?" ""

prakrit: "जम्म-दिणे नेमित्तिय-वयणाओ जायमेत्तओ पुत्तो,भणियं च तेण एवं एसो मयणवेगॊत्ति"
english: "Everyday routine - playing the violin - My son, the flute is with him And this is how I got married"

prakrit: "सोऊण तस्स वयणं राया सोयाउरो विचिन्तेई,अज्जवि पुव्व-विरुद्धो वइरी पट्ठिं न छड्डइ"
english: "When he speaks to her She does not speak a word, And when he speaks she does not utter a single word."

prakrit: "धी! संसार-सहावो पुत्तोवि हु दारुणो हवइ वइरी,पिच्छ अकारण-कुविओ ववसइ एयारिसं पावं"
english: "Daughter! My son - in - law, I am cruel, And vainglorious: He is slipping away for no good reason, And I am acting as if I were him."

prakrit: "मन्तीहिं समंमन्तं गुत्तं काऊण ताण वयणेणं,कट्ठ-हरे सो छụधो नर-वइ-हिय-पुरिस-कय-रक्खो"
english: "What makes you think he's so stubborn? He's such a hard nut to crack, So keep it to yourself, Man - yes, man - Why?"

prakrit: "तत्थवि कलुसिय-हियओ पिय-वह-परिणाम-निच्छय-मईओ,कोहेण धमधमन्तो किच्छेणं गमइ दियहाइं"
english: "At the same time, Calusia - Here, drink - There - Consequences - Desperate - Mayo, Angry at the torment of anger, Loses its sting."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाइवि पज्जोसवणा-दिणम्मि सम्पत्ते,चारागार-नर-गणे विसुज्झमाणे निवाणाए"
english: "Oh! what a waste of time and energy It is to till the grasslands, To till the paddy fields, To make the men live in a state of desperation."

prakrit: "सुमरइ तणयं जेट्ठं कट्ठ-हरे सण्ठियं नर-वरिन्दो,चिन्तइ हा! कट्ठं न हु जुत्तं मज्झ एरिसयं"
english: "" "A swarm of grasshoppers, Like a flock of geese, Looks like a herd of deer Standing in close proximity To one's neighbor, Thinking how lucky I am To have them all!"

prakrit: "जइवि हु कयावराहो दुस्सीलो हन्दि! नन्दणो मज्झ,तहवि हु तम्मि निरुद्धे रज्ज-सुहं न पसंसामि"
english: "If I were a miser, I would not like to be stuck in a rut." "Thanks to you, my friend."

prakrit: "पज्जोसवणावि हु मह न य सुज्झइ तम्मि बन्धण-ठियम्मि,इय चितिऊण मुक्को पेसल-वयणेहिं आलविओ"
english: "You fool, I don't think you know how to kiss her. Instead of kissing her, he licks her lips." ""

prakrit: "मुञ्चसु पुत्त! विसायं कुणसु पसायं कुमार-भुत्तीए,दिक्खाइ गहण-समए नियय-पए तं ठविस्सामि"
english: "My son, tell me," "Whom are you looking out for? A handsome young man is among you. I'll stop him As soon as I see him." ""

prakrit: "देसन्ते गाम-सयं दाउं पच्चइय-नियय-नर-सहिओ,पट्ठविओ सोवि गओ अमुक्क वेरो निय-मणम्मि"
english: "At the same time as the village, The emerald trees - Destiny - Man - Friend, On the way they flow, One thing is certain: They are destined to last a lifetime."

prakrit: "चिन्तेइ सो कयग्धो विविहोवाएहिं मारणं पिउणो,रत्तीए लहइ निद्दं न य सो कूडाइं चिन्तेन्तो"
english: "Thinking how he would manage to kill so many different women While he slept soundly, He could hardly think twice."

prakrit: "तत्थ य पव्वय-गहणे पल्ली-पासम्मि संवसन्तस्स,मूलीए गवेसन्तो धूम-मुहो आगओ जोगी"
english: "There you are, Decorated with jewels, Surrounded by villagers, Scorched by the rays of the sun - Ah, the flame of the Jogi's fire." ""

prakrit: "उवयरिओ सो तेणं सयणासण-भोयणाईहिं,तुट्ठेण तेण दिन्नं अद्दिस्सं अञ्जणं तस्स"
english: "You fool, That very same woman, Who in a dream gave birth to a son, Has given birth to another son."

prakrit: "अञ्जिय-लोयण-जुयलो अद्दिस्सो सो मणेण चिन्तेइ,मारेमि वेरियं तं जेण मणं निव्वुइं लहइ"
english: "If you think about it, You'd better stop. I'll do whatever you say," He said, laughing. "That's the way of love."

prakrit: "एस मह रज्ज-लम्भो हन्तव्वो जं पिया स-हत्थेण,वेरिय-जणेण दिन्नं रज्जं नरयं विसेसेइ"
english: "This is my razor - held in my hand, That which I hold in my heart With my beloved's hand, Which, given to me by another man, Makes the king worthless."

prakrit: "अह सो अद्दिस्स-तणू वञ्चिय सयलम्पि रक्खण-नरोहं,आगम्म गयपुरम्मी रन्नो छिद्दं पलोएइ"
english: "Ah, the poor thing, Protect yourselves from the arrows of the God of Love, For tomorrow the streets of Gaypuram Will be deserted."

prakrit: "वच्चोहर-ट्ठिओ सो सरीर-चिन्तत्थमागयं पियरं,मणि-रहियं पट्ठीए पावो छुरियाए"
english: "Wretched tree, That body - Thinking which is dear to me, Stops at the foot of the peacock's leaf."

prakrit: "दुट्ठं अपिच्छमाणो य नर-वई तक्खणेण निक्खन्तो,पभणइ रुम्भह दांरं अद्दिस्सो अच्छए कोवि"
english: "I don't know what makes a man so angry. But if he does, It's only because the door is ajar." ""

prakrit: "हण हण भणमाणेहिं कुन्तग्गाहेहिं रुद्ध-दारम्मि,मरण-भयाओ पडिओ वेट्ठय कूवे मयणवेगो"
english: "Money is flowing from the well, The bolt of an axe is hanging on the door, Fear of death is lurking, And the path to the well is slippery."

prakrit: "पावं चितेइ नरो वेरिय-लोयस्स कूर-परिणामो,नवरं निवडइ तस्सेव दुक्खयं इयर-पुन्नेहिं"
english: "One step at a time Makes people unhappy - The crooks are angry - The consequences are obvious, The bridegroom chooses the painful year - The year of redemption."

prakrit: "रायाविं अङ्गरक्खेहिं तक्खणं वẹ̄धिओ परूढ-वणो,जाओ मणि-सलिलेणं सिञ्चन्तो वेयणा-रहिओ"
english: "The nights are long, The trees are tall, The rivers are broad, And the streams are broad. Go, irrigate with turmeric water And make beds of reeds."

prakrit: "देसन्ताओ पत्ता भणन्ति परिरक्खगा नरा देव!,अद्दिस्सो होऊणं नट्ठो मयणवेगो म्ह"
english: "Those who speak falsehood say:" "Protect me, not God!" "Do not try to be false."

prakrit: "अह राया संविग्गो चिन्तइ तणयस्स विलसियं एयं,जाणन्तो किं अज्जवि निरुज्जमो धम्म-करणम्मि?"
english: "Ah, what a cruel man! Thinking how fragile a thing it is to be thin, You know how discouraging it still is To neglect dharma?"

prakrit: "भोगासत्तो जिण-धम्म-वज्जिओ कहवि जइ मओ हॊन्तो,अट्ट-ज्झाणोवगओ का मज्झ गई तओ हॊन्ता?"
english: "If there were a mood for passion, How could there be a mood For jinn and dharma? One can't understand why one's heart is empty."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाइवि विन्नत्तो सो निउत्त-खयरेण,कुसुमायरम्मि सूरी समागओ चित्तवेगॊत्ति"
english: "Ah! what a strange thing it is to hear someone say such a thing."

prakrit: "पहसिय-वयणो-राया-दाऊणं पारिओसियं तस्स,अन्तउरेण सहिओ सम्पत्तो सूरि-पासम्मि"
english: "Pahasiya - Vayano - Raya - Dawan: Pariosyam tasa, Antahure sahayo samprato suri - Pasammi"

prakrit: "ति पयक्खिणिऊण मुणिं वन्दइ विणओणमन्त-सिर-कमलो,तह अमरकेउमाई वन्दिय भत्तीइ उवविट्ठो"
english: "Aunt, When a poor woman puts on her pearl necklace And puts on a lotus on her head, That immortal woman's bow Looks just like that."

prakrit: "संसारुव्वेयकरी राग-द्दोसाइ-सत्तु-निम्महणी,संवेगकरी विहिया वित्थरओ देसणा गुरुणा"
english: "The observer of the world is the raga - dodosai - sattu - nimahani, the observer of emotions is the vihya - vithara, and the observer is the guru."

prakrit: "तं सोउं संविग्गो पुच्छइ राया कहेहि मे भयवं!,किं वहइ वेर-भावं मह पुत्तो मयणवेगॊत्ति?"
english: "That was her reply:" "I am afraid!" "She kept asking," "Is that jealousy My son?" ""

prakrit: "कत्थ व चिट्ठइ सम्पइ,पभणइ सूरी सुणेहि नर-नाह!,जो सो सुबन्धु-जीवो आसि सुरो कालबाणो ते"
english: "How much love there is between a man and a woman Whom he has never met Before - No, he is a handsome man - The sound of poetry is the reward of time."

prakrit: "काउं विज्जा-च्छेयं सुरसुन्दरी-हरण-समय-खीणाऊ,उप्पन्नो वण-महिसो दवेण दड̣धो मओ रन्ने"
english: "How much knowledge you possess, How much beauty you seek, How little time you spend elsewhere, How long you yearn for the buds of the jasmine?"

prakrit: "खय-किमि-कुलाउलाए गब्भे छुहियाए सारमेईए,जाओ सुणओ ताव य पञ्चम-दिवसे मया जणणी"
english: "Well, Kimi, let me touch you on the cheek. Listen, by the fifth day you'll be mine." ""

prakrit: "डिम्भ-कयत्थण-दुहिओ भुक्खाइ मओ तओवि विप्प-गिहे,जाओ गलि-गोरहओ तोत्तय-घाएहिं विद्दविओ"
english: "Fettered by grief, Scorched by anger, Wretched by grief And bruised by illness, Go - between the alleys, Gorah - between parrots, Parrots - between wounds."

prakrit: "गलियत्तण-खिन्नेणं दिन्नो विप्पेण घञ्चिय-वरस्स,तिल-जन्तम्मि वहन्तो अहोनिसिं दुब्बलो जाओ"
english: "Drenched by tears, Scorched by anger, Wretched by grief, Like a sesame seed, You have grown thin."

prakrit: "किमि-काय-खइय-देहो पाए घसिऊण दीहरं कालं,गोसीस-तरु-गणड̣धे हिमवन्ते पन्नगो जाओ"
english: "Kimi, kya, khaiye, dhoong - dragging the herd for long periods of time, Gosis, Toor, Ganad - The herd is hiding in the snow." ""

prakrit: "डसिओ तेण नर-वर! पण्होत्तर-वावडो सह पियाए,तुह अङ्गरक्ख-निहओ उप्पन्नो मयणवेगो सो"
english: "Foolish man! Once your husband is drunk with wine, You'll have to wash your body - Your eyes will be red." ""

prakrit: "पुव्व-कय-वेर-वसओ पुत्तोवि वहुज्जओ इमो तेण,अद्दिस्सो हणइ तुमं सॊ च्चिय वच्चो-हरे तइया"
english: "Daughter - in - law, You live in the same village As I do, So you must have learned something else too - You're green."

prakrit: "कोतक्कन्तो भय-सम्भमेण पडिओ स वच्च-कूवम्मि,वच्चाहारो तहियंव सो ठिओ दीहरं कालं"
english: "A coward falls into a well of water Out of fear, But the farmer holds on to the water For a long time."

prakrit: "असुद्ध-विसोहय-पुरिसेहिं-दार-पिहणे कयाइ अवणीए,रत्तीए निग्गओ सो नट्ठो य भएण तुह राय!"
english: "Friend, How odd it is for you To leave your wife Behind at the door And leave her alone If that's not your opinion!"

prakrit: "पावोदएण अणुचिय-आहार-निसेवणेण से कोढं,जायं वेयण-पउरं सम्पइ सो भमइ दुक्खत्तो"
english: "A person who is leprous by nature - by diet, by distillation - Who consumes poison - Suffers grief."

prakrit: "सोऊण सूरि-वयणं संविग्गो जाय-विरइ-परिणामो,सुरसुन्दरि-बीय-सुयं अणङ्गकेउं ठविय रज्जे"
english: "When the sun is hot - The passion is gone - The separation is the result, The beauty is in the seeds - The pleasure is in hanging on to one's limbs."

prakrit: "जिण-चेइयाण पूयं काउं दाऊण विविह-दाणाइं,वत्थासणाइएहिं सम्माणेऊण मुणि-सङ्घं"
english: "Give as much respect As you can muster For your husband's wide and varied gifts." "With due respect, sage - guild, That is to say, with due respect."

prakrit: "बहु-विज्जाहर-सहिओ पव्वइओ जाय-तिव्व-संवेगो,सुह-लग्गे सम्पत्ते पय-मूले चित्तवेगस्स"
english: "A man of many talents Is a man of few talents, Proud of his wealth, Contentment is the root of all happiness."

prakrit: "सुरसुन्दरीवि सोउं वेर-निमित्तं सुदारुणं दुक्खं,पव्वइया गणिणीए पय-मूले कणगमालाए"
english: "A pretty woman loves a handsome man, And a good man is distressed for her faults."

prakrit: "इय तिन्निवि मिलियाओ वय-पडिवत्तीए पुव्व-भगिणीओ,ताणं च पुव्व-दइया मित्ता ते तिन्निवि मिलिया"
english: "These three have met many times - brothers and sisters, old and young - And they have all met one another."

prakrit: "चित्तगइ-वायगस्स ओ पासे पạधिऊण अङ्ग-सुत्ताइं,अत्थं सुणेइ मूले गुरुणो सिरि-चित्तवेगस्स"
english: "Chittagai - Vayagasa: On the other hand, seeing the limbs and limbs, One hears at once the sighs of the original master - Chittavegas." ""

prakrit: "कालेण मयरकेऊ सुत्तत्थ-विसारओ महा-सत्तो,पञ्चविहम्पि य तुलणं करेइ एगागि-पडिमट्ठा"
english: "Time has shown me such a thing: Sutta-visara, great power, That when compared with five great vows They resemble one another."

prakrit: "तव-भावणाए भाविय अत्ताणं सत्त-भावणब्भासं,कुणमाणो पेयवणे रत्तीए ठाइ उस्सग्गं"
english: "In every state of being, there is the expression of seven emotions, The quality of being drunk is everywhere."

prakrit: "एत्थंरम्मि सूरी विहरन्तो पाविओ पुरिं चम्पं,पडिमाए मयरकेऊ पइदियहं ठाइ पेयवणे"
english: "Here is Suri, Traveler, Purim Champam for the poor. Mother - in - law, Please let me have a drink with my husband." ""

prakrit: "चित्तगइ-वायगोवि य वायण-समयम्मि साहु-मज्झ-गओ,विगह-पमायासत्तो हरिओ केणावि देवेण"
english: "Be careful not to fall into the trap of saying:" "Time, my friend, is running out." "Anybody can give advice on this matter."

prakrit: "अह मुणिणो विम्हइया गुरुण साहिन्ति हरण-वुत्तन्तं,उवउत्तो पुव्व-गए नाउं तं वइयरं सूरी"
english: "Ah! the sage Vimhya! The moment he sees his master He sniffs at him, But the flower has departed And his name is Vaiyar Suri." ""

prakrit: "आमन्तिऊण समणे पवत्तिणिं सयल-साहुणि-समेयं,वज्जरइ गुरू अज्जा! वज्जह वेरं सुदूरेण"
english: "When he calls her by the name of her husband, She mutters:" "Your master is dead!" "And when he mutters something else, She turns away."

prakrit: "जो सो मोहिल-जीवो सुमङ्गलो पर-भवम्मि रुट्ठेण,धणवइ-जीव-सुरेण हय-विज्जो माणुस-नगस्स"
english: "One who is captivated by a pleasant creature - On top of a pleasant one - Struggles with moods, Is dominated by a weak creature - Sound - Visible - Human - Nerves."

prakrit: "परओ मुक्को तइया हिडन्तो मणुय-विरहिए रन्ने,डसिओ कुक्कुड-सप्पेण सो मओ भमइ संसारे"
english: "However much you try to escape, You'll end up hiding in the mud, Running away from people, Running after cuckoos - That's how the world turns." ""

prakrit: "नायर-तिरिय-नरेसुं दारुण-दुक्खाइं तत्थ अणुहविउं,सिद्धत्थपुरे जाओ सुरहो सो कणगवइ-पुत्तो"
english: "Nair - Tiriya - The son of a cow - His fierce anger and sorrows have reached such a pitch That he can make any man happy." ""

prakrit: "खय-वाहीए मयम्मी सुग्गीवे नर-वई इमो जाओ,तक्कम्मुदया रज्जं अहिट्ठिंयं सुप्पइटठेणं"
english: "Foolish girl, I've no time for pleasantries. Go, Imo, please, don't let the ropes fall asleep here and there." ""

prakrit: "रज्ज-ब्भट्ठो चम्पाए आगओ कित्तिधम्म-नर-वइणा,देसन्ते गाम-सयं दिन्नं से धूय-तणयस्स"
english: "King - thief, Come, how can man - nasty! One day you will be washing clothes in the village - The next." ""

prakrit: "दुन्नयकारी भीमेण राइणा कित्तिघम्म-तणएण,निव्वासिओ अडन्तो निव्विन्नो ताव-सो जाओ"
english: "How annoying it is to be bullied by nasty women. If the bullies object, The bull sleeps soundly."

prakrit: "काऊण य बाल-तवं जोइसवासी सणिच्छरो जाओ,सरिऊण पुव्व-वइरं इहागओ चित्तगइ-पासे"
english: "Who is so fond of flowers That they resemble the petals of a peacock's tail?"

prakrit: "छिद्दं गवेसयन्तो विगह-पमत्तो य वायगो अज्ज,अवहरिउं पक्खित्तो सुरेण सो लवण-जलहिम्मि"
english: "Today the wind blows, If you look down the road, It's only salt and water." ""

prakrit: "सुह-परिणामो भयवं सुक्क-ज्झाणेण दड्ढ-कम्मंसो,सम्पइ भव-भय-मुक्को अन्तगडो केवली जाओ"
english: "Fearful of consequences, Afraid of the prospect of happiness, Strong-willed to act, Will never give in, Fearing the ultimate doom."

prakrit: "सोऊण सूरि-वयणं समणा समणी य परम-संविग्गा,तावय पेयवणाओ समागओ अमरकेउ मुणी"
english: "One who observes sunrise and sunset observes the supreme vows, One who drinks wine keeps immortality at bay."

prakrit: "भणइ य गुरु-आणाए धणदेव-जुओ अहं तु पेयवणे,भयवं! गओ पहाए पासे मुणि-मयरकेउस्स"
english: "I am afraid you will drink, my dear!" said the teacher, "But look! There you are, sage - Mother - in - law."

prakrit: "तहियं य न सो दिट्ठो दिट्ठा य चिया फुरन्त-इङ्गाला,गन्धोदग-कुसुम-वासं च निवडियं दीसए तत्थ"
english: "There will be no more sight for you, No more burning, burning, and burning fires. The scent of jasmine and safflower will find their way into your eyes."

prakrit: "दुगुणाणिय संवेगो पभणइ सूरीवि नाय-परमत्थो,दुक्खत्तो हिण्डन्तो इहागओ मयणवेगो सो"
english: "A weak wife finds it difficult to conceal her feelings, But when she is sorrowful She turns away, For this is what true love is all about."

prakrit: "पेयवणे पडिमत्थं पियरं दट्ठण चिन्तए पावो,इण्हिं करेमि सहलं निय-जम्म-वेरियं हन्तुं"
english: "When I think of my drink, When I see my lover's drink, I dare not make such a mistake."

prakrit: "दारुय-भरियं सगडं भग्गं मोत्तूण तत्थ सागडिओ,उस्सूरन्ति पइट्ठो वसमे घित्तूण नयरीए"
english: "The sea is full of bees, The pearl is fragrant, And the sea is rough. There is nothing you can do About it Except that it blooms all the time."

prakrit: "जाए तमन्धयारं तहि ओ कट्ठेंहिं तेंण पावेण,पच्छाइऊण दड̣धो चीया-जलणेण सो साहू"
english: "Wherever you go There he will find you," replied the hunter, Putting out the flames of his pyre. "

prakrit: "देहं स दहइ सिही सुक्क-ज्झाणेण सोवि कम्माइं,अविचल-चित्तो भयवं अन्तगडो केवली जाओ"
english: "The body is burning, The senses are quenching, The mind is restless, Fear is closing in. So how can one go on?"

prakrit: "एवं समुल्लवन्तस्स सूरिणो उल्लसन्त-विरियस्स,खविए कम्म-चउक्के उप्पन्नं केवलं नाणं"
english: "And all the wretched sunshine Is a source of delirium, A mere coin tossed around by the arrows of karma."

prakrit: "तह अमरकेउ-मुणिणो धणदेव-जइस्स कणगमालाए,कमलावइ-सुरसुन्दरि-पियङ्गुवरमञ्जरीए य"
english: "There are immortals - the bow - The God of Love - The jasmine - The lotus - The beautiful - The pearl - The mango - The stringed string." ""

prakrit: "सुह-भावाणमिमाणं उप्पण्णं केवलं वरं नाणं,देवेहिं कया महिमा मोक्खं पत्ताणि कालेण"
english: "Love is nothing but an expression of one's own feelings. What glory has a god to bestow When he proclaims liberation?"

prakrit: "पावेण मयणवेगो भमिही संसार-सायरमणन्तं,ता भो भव्वा! उज्झह राग-द्दोसे महा-सत्तू"
english: "Proud lady, Go to the center of the universe, go to the sky! Your anger is as powerful as anger." ""

prakrit: "इत्थ य कहा समप्पइ सुरसुन्दरि-नामिया पुरा भणिया,राग-द्दोसे-विमुक्कं पणमह भतीइ जिणइन्दं"
english: "How can one explain this? It's a lovely girl - Namiya, a full brother - in - law, Rag - dosa - Vimukkam, Your big brother -in - law has conquered." ""

prakrit: "निच्च-पलोयण-निरया तग्गय-चित्ता विमुक्क-वावारा,अत्थ-पयाण-रहिया जासिं वयणम्पि न लहन्ति"
english: "Though distressed, Though distracted, Though unable to move, Though constantly in motion - The wind does not blow."

prakrit: "निय-अत्थ-पयाणेवि हु रस-रहियाओ न दिन्ति सब्भावं,परमत्थ-विरहियाणं अन्नत्थ-निबद्ध-चिन्नाओ"
english: "Niyya - atma - payanevi hu rasa - rakho na dindi sabbhava, paramath - virodhiyana annatha - nirmidha - chinnaon"

prakrit: "तासु वर-वेसियासुव सुवन्न-रयणुच्छलन्त-सोहासु,बहल-निरतर-वन्नय-सञ्जाय-सरीर-सोहासु"
english: "The bridegroom is handsome, The wife is voluptuous, The nights are long, The women are busy, The vows are solemn, The body is elegant."

prakrit: "आसत्तं सुवियड̣धाण माणसं जइवि अणुदिणं नूणं,तहवि हु मह विन्नत्तिं सुणन्तु इह सज्जणा सरला"
english: "Hope is good, wealthy man, Every day is new. Yet listen to my pleas. It is quite plain, young gentleman." ""

prakrit: "निरलङ्काराच्छन्दाणुवत्तिणी ललिय-कोमल-सरीरा,दालिद्दिय-वर-कुल-बालियव्व एसा कहा तुम्ह"
english: "How are you going to describe her? She has a smooth, supple, and well - nourished body, Like a young pomegranate in a manger." ""

prakrit: "उवणीया सुयणाणं अन्नासत्तावि वारयं दाउं,अवियडạधावि वियड̣धा जह होइ तहा जइज्जाह"
english: "Give me a good night's sleep, And a bad one at that. But the more you sweat The more you'll gain."

prakrit: "आसि जिणो जय-बन्धू तित्थयरो वद्धमाण-नामॊत्ति,संसार-जलहि-मज्जन्त-जन्तु-जण-जाणवत्त-समो"
english: "Come, let's win - Friend, However long your life lasts, The world will go on - Water, Sweat, Trees, Bees, People, Knowledge - Like this"

prakrit: "सीसो तस्स सुहम्मो तत्तो जम्बू तओ य पभवॊत्ति,एवं सूरीण परम्पराए ता जाव वइरॊत्ति"
english: "A kiss is as pleasant as a kiss, A hug is as auspicious as kissing, And true love is as fierce as tradition."

prakrit: "साहाए तस्स सूरी जिणेसरो नाम आसि विक्खाओ,तत्तो य निम्मल-गुणो उज्झाओ अल्लओ नाम"
english: "Help me, my dear, If your name should come to mind Is a distraction, If it should bring out the virtues of kindness, It is an odd name."

prakrit: "सीसो य तस्स सूरी सूरोव्व सयावि जणिय-दोसन्तो,आसि सिरि-वद्धमाणो पवड्ढमाणो गुण-सिरीए"
english: "Be nice to him or her, Be pleasant to each other, Be courteous and polite - Siri is the supreme virtue."

prakrit: "रागो य जस्स धम्मे आसि पओसो य जस्स पावम्मि,तुल्लो य मित्त-सत्तुसु तस्स य जाया दुवे सीसा"
english: "Anger, which comes from dharma, Destroys the soul, Tullo, which goes from friend to friend, Either of the two leads."

prakrit: "दुव्वार-वाइ-वारण-मरट्ट-निट्टवण-निट्ठुर-मइन्दो,जिण-भणिय-सुद्ध-सिद्धन्त-देसणा-करण-तल्लिच्छो"
english: "Duvvara-vy-varana-maratta-nittavana-nitur-mindo, Jina-bhanyasa-suddha-siddhanta-desana-karana-trying eyes."

prakrit: "जस्स य अईव-सुललिय-पय-सञ्चारा पसन्न-वाणीया,अइकोमला सिलेसे विविहालङ्कार-सोहिल्ला"
english: "Just like everything - smooth, flowing, pleasant, expressive - Vaniya, Like sewing a lotus, Various ornaments - Pleasant."

prakrit: "लीलावइत्ति-नामा सुवन्न-रयणोह-हारि-सयलङ्गा,वेसव्व-कहा वियरइ जयम्मि कय-जण-मणाणन्दा"
english: "Leelavaitti - Nama suvanna - Raynoh - Haari - Saylanga, Vesava - Kaha vireyi jayammi kaya - People - Manananda"

prakrit: "एगा ताण जिणेसर-सूरी सूरोव्व उक्कड-पयावो,तस्स सिरि बुद्धिसागरसूरी य सहोयरो बीओ"
english: "Ega tan jinesar - Suri, surroove, ukkad - payaavo, tasa sirri, the sun of wise men, Ya sahyoro beo."

prakrit: "पुन्नं-सरदिन्दु-सुन्दर-निय-जस-पब्भार-भरिय-भुवण-यलो,जिण-भणिय-सत्थ-परमात्थ-वित्थरासत्त-सुह-चित्तो"
english: "Punnam - saradindu - beautiful - close - as in weight - full - earth - yellow, as in speech - truth - supreme - wisdom - perplexity - pleasant - mind."

prakrit: "जस्स य मुह-कुहराओ विणिग्गया अत्थ-वारि-सोहिल्ला,बुह-चक्कवाय-कलिया रङ्गन्त-सुफक्किय-तरङ्गा"
english: "Just like the face - The mist is dispersed by the wind, At the same time - The trees are illuminated, The flowers are plucked - The buds are colored - The swirls are fragrant."

prakrit: "तडरुह-अवसद्द-महीरुहोह-उम्मूलणम्मि सुसमत्था,अज्झाय-पवर-तित्था-पञ्चग्गन्थी नई पवरा"
english: "Tadruha-vasada-mahiruhoha-ummulanammi suasamatha, ajjhaya-pavara-tittha-panchaganthi nai pavara"

prakrit: "तेसिं सीस-वरो धणेसर-मुणी एयं कहं पायडंचड्डावल्लि-पुरी-ठिओ स-गुरुणो आणाए पाढन्तरा,कासी विक्कम-वच्छरम्मि य गए बाणङ्क-सुन्नोडुपेमासे भद्दवए गुरुम्मि कसिणे बीया-धणिट्ठा-दिणे"
english: "Whom are you looking out for? Your husband is rich - Your wife's elder sister, Your husband's younger brother, Your parents'wives - in - law, Your elders - on your knees, Your arms wrapped around your husband, Your arrows pierced through his ears, And your breasts pinched by the arrows of the God of Love?"

prakrit: "साहु-धणेसर-विरइय-सुबोह-गाहा-समूह-रम्माए,रागग्गि-दोस-विसहर-पसमण-जल-मन्त-भूयाए"
english: "Sahu - Dhanesar - Viraiya - Suboh - Gaha - Samooh - Ramaya, Ragaggi - Dosa - Visahar - Pasaman - Jal - Mant - Bhuya"

prakrit: "एसोवि पुव्व-सूइय-निव्वाण-विहाण-वन्नणो नाम,सुरसुन्दरी कहाए सोलसमो इह परिच्छेओ"
english: "Such is the name of the flower - The needle - The snake - The tree - The beautiful lady says:" "To the soul, these are the signs." ""

prakrit: "नमिऊण जिण-वर’इन्दे तियसेसर-वन्दिए धुय-किलेसे,विउसजण-बोहणत्थं धुत्तक्खाणं पवक्खामि"
english: "I will wipe away the dust from your face, Which is covered with gooseflesh, Like washing up the laundry in a fire."

prakrit: "ललिय-समिद्ध-जणवया अत्थि पुरी सुरपुरिं विसेसन्ती,उज्जुय-जणाहिवासा उज्जेणी नाम नामेणं"
english: "Name the lily - Accumulated - Janavaya Atthi Puri Surpurim Viseshanti, Ujjaya - The flame of the janahivasama Ujjayani."

prakrit: "तीसे उत्तरपासे नाणाविह-कुसुम-गुम्म-लय-गहणं,महुयरि-गणोवगीयं उज्जाणं नन्दण-सरिच्छं"
english: "To the girl on the other side of the fence are nāṇavihā - safflower - gumma - laya - ghana, bee - gnawing song - ujjana - nandana - sarichchā." ""

prakrit: "तत्थ’उज्जाण-गिहम्मी नाणाविह-रूव-कम्म-णिज्जुत्ता,धुत्ताण सयाणेगा समागया कह वि हिण्डन्ता"
english: "There must have been something wrong with him - The jeweler's coin, The jeweller's jewel, The blacksmith's bow, And he must have known something was wrong." ""

prakrit: "माया-णियडि-पहाणा अकज्ज-णिच्च’उज्जुया निरणुकम्पा,थी-बाल-वुड्ढ-वीसत्थ-घाइणो वञ्चण’एक्कपरा"
english: "Maya - niyadi - pahana akajja - bare - eyed woman, Ujjuya - naked woman, thi - hair - grown - wispy - worn - one deceitful person." ""

prakrit: "धूव’अञ्जण-जोगेहि य ओसोयणि-थम्भणीहिं विज्जाहिं,सर-वण्ण-भेय-कुसला तेसि पहू पञ्च’ इमे कमसो"
english: "Dhuva'anjan'- Wretched girl, Wherever you are, There must be something on your mind. The way you conduct yourself, Like a buffalo calf, Is entirely up to you."

prakrit: "मूलसिरि कण्डरीओ एलासाढो ससो य खण्डवणा,एक्क’एक्कस्स य तेसिं धुत्ताणं पञ्च-पञ्चसया"
english: "Moolshiri kandriyo elasadho saaso ya khandavana, ek ekkasa ya terse dhutthana pañcāya"

prakrit: "धुत्तीणं पञ्चसया खण्डवणाए य नवरि परिवारो,सव्वाण वि ताण पहू मूलसिरी लोय-विक्खाओ"
english: "The poor girl's family is ruined in five hundred pieces, And the young bridegroom's household. Even so, everyone is burdened With the burden Of erasing their roots."

prakrit: "वट्टइ य ताण कालो जलय-समुच्छन्न-सूर-ससि-मग्गो,इन्दधणु-विज्जु-गज्जिय-जलयर-मुहलो वरिसयालो"
english: "Vatai ya tana kala jala - samushpanda - sur - sapling - maggo, Indadhanu - vijju - gajjia - water - muhallo Varisayalo"

prakrit: "सत्ताह-दुद्दिणम्मि य समन्तओ भरिय-वप्प-कूव-सरे,कय-चिक्खिल्ल-चिलिप्फिल-दुस्सञ्चारासु रच्छासु"
english: "Aunt, If you want to be rich - Fill up the pots and pans with milk - You'd better take care of yourselves - Don't be stingy - Be playful - Try to avoid nasty people."

prakrit: "एयारिसम्मि काले ते धुत्ता सीय-वद्दलाभिहया,भुक्ख’अत्ता बेन्ति तहिं को अम्हं देज्ज भत्तं ति"
english: "That damned girl, You'd better wash her hands. My mother - in - law can give me anything I want."

prakrit: "अह भणइ मूलदेवो जं जेण सुयं व समणुभूयं वा,सो तं कहेउ सव्वं मिलियाण’ एयाण धुत्ताणं"
english: "Say,'To the god of origin, Whoever it is who wishes to be treated with kindness and courtesy, Everything is fair.'That is falsehood." ""

prakrit: "जो तं न पत्तिएज्जा असच्च-वयणं ति तेण सव्वेसिं,धुत्ताण समुइयाणं दायव्वं भत्त-पाणं ति"
english: "One who does not care, Who is dishonest, Is responsible for everything, Is liable to be treated with disrespect."

prakrit: "जो पुण पुराण-भारह-रामायण-सुइ-समुत्थ-वयणेहिं,तं वयणं समत्थित्ता महायणं पत्तियावेज्ज"
english: "One who recites the Puna Purana, the Bharaha, the Ramayana, the Sui, the Samutha, speaks the same language, that is, the path to the greatness."

prakrit: "सो धुत्ताण अहिवई महामई अत्थि सत्थ-णिम्माओ,मा देउ किञ्चि कस्स वि इय भणिए मूलदेवेण"
english: "So, my poor girl, Don't let anyone tell you this: It's the original god." ""

prakrit: "ते सव्वे विय भणिया इय होउ सुसोहणं तए भणियं,किन्तु तुमं पढमं चिय कहेहि जं ते समणुभूयं"
english: "They all speak in such a way That it is pleasant to speak of, but you, my dear, tell me something that I do not understand."

prakrit: "अह भणइ मूलदेवो जं अणुभूयं मए तरुण-भावे,तं निसुणेह अवहिया कहिज्जमाणं सुजुत्तीए"
english: "Oh! what a foolish thing it is to say that I have a young brother - in - law. How can I help falling asleep to him?"

prakrit: "तरुणत्तणम्मि अहयं इच्छिय-सुह-सम्पयं अहिलसन्तो,धारा-धरण’अट्ठाए सामि-गिहं पत्थिओ सुइरं"
english: "Youthful woman, I desire happiness, We yearn for abundance, We cling to the stream, We bend our necks so that our feet do not slip."

prakrit: "छत्त-कमण्डलु-हत्थो पन्थं वाहेमि गहिय-पच्छयणो,मत्तं पव्वय-मेत्तं पेच्छामि य गयवरं इन्तं"
english: "I see the lotus of the roof, The palm of my hand, And the grasshopper of my heart, And I drink wine with great relish. For here I am again"

prakrit: "मेहम इव गुलगुलिन्तं पभिन्न-करडा-मुहं महामत्तं,दट्ठूण वणगय’इन्दं भएण वेवन्त-गत्तो हं"
english: "When he sees me, My face is smeared with gooseflesh, My eyes are red, I swear that because I am blind I have gone astray."

prakrit: "अत्ताणो य असरणो कत्थ निलुक्कामि हं ति चिन्तन्तो,तो सहसा य अइगओ कमण्डलुं मरण-भयभीओ"
english: "If you think how long I have to stay up here, you'd better hurry, for I fear the lotus might die."

prakrit: "अह सो वि मत्त-हत्थी ऊसविय-करो सरोस-रत्त’अच्छो,मज्झाणुमग्ग-लग्गो कमण्डलुं अइगओ सिग्घं"
english: "Oh! he is still drunk - Hands clenched - Do your best - Blood running down his cheeks - The flame of the kamandal Is burning brightly."

prakrit: "तो हं भय-सम्भन्तो समन्तओ विद्दुयं पलोयन्तो,हत्थिं कमण्डलुम्मी वामोहेऊण छम्मासं"
english: "So I am full of fear, Running after the wise man, But my hand is overshadowed by the lotus of my hand."

prakrit: "गीवाऎ निग्गओ हं हत्थी वि ममाणुमग्गओ निन्तो,लग्गो वाल’अग्ग’अन्ते कुण्डिय-गीवाऎ छिद्दम्मि"
english: "The fire that burns in the fire is sprayed from the coil - The nail marks the tip of the elephant's hand And the nail mark from the nail - nail mark."

prakrit: "अहम अवि य नवरि पुरओ गङ्गं पेच्छामि रङ्गिर-तरङ्गं,फेण-णियर’अट्टहासं वणगय-दन्त-क्खय-तड’अग्गं"
english: "Ah, the freshly plucked flowers - I love the colorful waves of the Ganges, The flame of the nectar, The burst of laughter, The clenched fingernails, The teeth, The girdle, The fire"

prakrit: "उम्मी-सहस्स-पउरं झस-मयर-ग्गाह-कुम्म-परियरियं,जुवइ-हियय व्व’ अगाहं उयहि व्व सुदूर-परपारं"
english: "Aunt, The jasmine is full of flowers, The mynah is thick, The lotus is abundant, The yoke is long, The fire is unbearable, And the sky is vast."

prakrit: "पहम अन्नं अलहन्तो तो हं इसु-वेय-वाहिणिं सिग्घं,बाहाहिं समुत्तिण्णो गोपयम इव भारहिं विउलं"
english: "If I take food first, I am bound to fall in love with the drinker's sweetmeat. But if I take it all in one gulp, It is as if I were a cow in distress."

prakrit: "तो सामि-गिहं गन्तुं छुह-तण्हा-परिसहेहिं सहमाणो,छम्मासा सीसेणं धरेमि धारा-धर’अट्ठाए"
english: "So bear with me, my friend, As I go along, Touching and squeezing and clutching at the river - I will hold on to that secret thread."

prakrit: "धारेऊण य धारं पयओ अहिवन्दिऊण महसेणं,सम्पत्तो उज्जेणिं तुब्भेहिं समं च मिलिओ हं"
english: "When the stream is full of water, When the river is empty, You meet it with the great rainbow, When wealth is overflowing, You are on equal footing with it."

prakrit: "तो जइ सच्चं एयं तो मे हेऊहिं पत्तियावेह,अह मन्नह अलियं तं धुत्ताणं देह तो भत्तं"
english: "So, if this is true, I have to forgive you, my dear: The body is worthless if it is false."

prakrit: "अह भणइ कण्डरीओ को भणिही तुमम असच्च-वयणं ति,भारह-पुराण-रामायणाणि पुरिसो वियाणन्तो"
english: "Oh! you fool, You dishonest swordsman, Who, for all the burdens of the Puranas and the Ramayanas, Has become a recluse."

prakrit: "परिभणइ मूलदेवो सो हत्थी कुण्डियाऎ कह माओ,कह भमिओ छम्मासं कमण्डले तम्मि वणहत्थी"
english: "Mother, tell me, Who is this elephant running around with its trunk clutching at my waist? It seems to be hiding under the shade of a lotus."

prakrit: "सुहुम-च्छिद्देण कमण्डलाऒ कह निग्गओ अहं सो य,निग्गन्तुं वणहत्थी वाल’अग्ग’अन्ते कहं लग्गो"
english: "How can I put out the flames With my bare hands? It must be me. So how can a wild elephant put out a fire With his bare arms?"

prakrit: "कह गङ्गा उत्तिण्णा बाहाहिं मए सुदूर-परपारा,कह छम्मासं धरिया भुक्खिय-तिसिएण’ उदय-धारा"
english: "How can the Ganges lift me When I am far away, How can it hide my face When it is still a rising torrent?"

prakrit: "अह भणइ कण्डरीओ जं सुम्मइ भारहे पुराणे य,तं जइ सव्वं सच्चं तो सच्चं तुज्झ वि य वयणं"
english: "Oh! you fool, What a heavy burden it is to bear: If all this be true, tell me the truth yourself."

prakrit: "हत्थी कमण्डलुम्मी अहं पि माओ कहं ति जं भणसि,एत्थ दियाइ-पसिद्धं वयणं सुण पच्चय-णिमित्तं"
english: "Hasti kamandalummi, I beg of you, Mao, say what you have to say: Here is the lamp - Just listen to it play out loud - Rest assured." ""

prakrit: "बम्भाणस्स मुहाओ विप्पा खत्तिय-जणो य बाहासु,ऊरूसु निग्गया किर वइसा सुद्दा य पाएसु"
english: "Aunt, If you dare to use your arms To yawn, You'll find it easier to swallow."

prakrit: "बम्भाणस्स सरीरे जइ माओ एत्तिओ जण-समूहो,तो कह कमण्डलुम्मी न मासि तं वणगय-समग्गो"
english: "If Mother - in - law is so much a crowd of people, how come the lotus does not bend before her?"

prakrit: "अन्नं च बम्भ-विण्हू उड्ढं च अहो य बे वि धावन्ता,अन्तं जस्स न पत्ता वास-सहस्सेण दिव्वेण"
english: "The goose has run out of food And the buffalo has flown away, Yet in the end nothing will be done But for the kindness of my husband."

prakrit: "लिङ्गं महप्पमाणं कह मायं तस्स’ उमा-सरीरम्मि,एवं जइ कुण्डियाए हत्थी माओ त्ति को दोसो"
english: "How can I blame my body If it is limp? And if it is crooked, Who is to blame?"
