prakrit: "तस्स बहुमज्झ-देसे पेच्छं वडपायवं मण’अभिरामं,मेह-णिउरम्ब-भूयं सउण-सहस्साण आवासं"
english: "From his vast mother - in - law One sees abundance, Mana - Abhiram, Meh - niramba - the earth, Gold - the abode of happiness."

prakrit: "तस्स य हेट्ठे जक्खो कमलदल’अक्खो गुणेहिं परिकिण्णो,सन्निहिय-पाडिहेरो देइ वरं सो वर-त्थीणं"
english: "There you have it: A lotus bud, Eyes closed, Qualities to be judged upon, The bridegroom's bracelets scattered all over the street." ""

prakrit: "जक्खस्स तस्स जत्ता वट्टइ बहुजण-समाउला मुइया,तत्थ’ एइ जणो मुइओ धूव-बली-पुप्फ-हत्थ-गओ"
english: "As soon as he touches her, The crowd disperses, And then he dies." "She's the one who washed him away - Sacrifice - Pupf - Hand - Go"

prakrit: "ण्हाय-पसाहिय-जिमिओ सव्वालङ्कार-भूसिय-सरीरो,नाणाविह-वत्थ-धरो चन्दण-परिवण्णग-विलित्तो"
english: "Nature - The pastime - The jimmy - All ornament - The husks - The body, the coin - The vessels - The sandal - The wind - The wilting."

prakrit: "तो हं सकोउहल्लो उवागओ तं महायण-समूहं,जक्खस्स कमे नमिउं रममाणे घोडहे पेच्छं"
english: "So yes, you fool, It's the great crowd. But how can I describe it When I think of my favorite horse?"

prakrit: "सन्नद्ध-बद्ध-कवया गहिय’आउह-पहरणा य अइबहुला,कलयल-रवं करेन्ता पडिया चोरा नवरि तत्थ"
english: "Ready - bound - Poet, Covered with gooseflesh, Watching with bated breath, Trembling with excitement - There goes the thief's wife." ""

prakrit: "तो सो सबाल-वुड्ढो स-इत्थिओ जणवओ सपसुवग्गो,अह घोडएहिं सहिओ वालुङ्कं अइगओ सव्वो"
english: "So, you clever woodcutter," he said, "Here are my breasts: They all bend at the same speed As the horse."

prakrit: "तत्थ वि ते घोडहए रमन्त-पेच्छा जणे य मुइय-मणे,चोरा वि पडिणियत्ता नट्ठो गामो त्ति जम्पन्ता"
english: "There he is, riding a horse, Looking down the road at people dying, Thieves hiding out in the mud, Jumping about the village streets." ""

prakrit: "नवरि तहिं पसुवग्गो चरमाणो आगओ सुवीसत्थो,एक्काऎ पसूऎ तओ ओइलियं चिब्भडं सहसा"
english: "The wife is so full of petals The fire is so hot That the only thing on her body Is her oily cheeks."

prakrit: "सा अयगरेण घत्था सो वि य ढेङ्कीऎ नवरि ओइलिओ,सा तत्थ’ एव निलीणा तुङ्गे वडपायवे विउले"
english: "She is so angry, So angry is her husband, And he is so jealous That she makes him weep bitterly."

prakrit: "तस्स अहे खन्धारो नवरि ठिओ राइणो य मत्त-गओ,ढेङ्की-पाए जमिओ वड-पारोहो त्ति काऊण"
english: "Aunt, Wait till the rain stops, Or get drunk. Who is going to plow the land in distress? It's the elders." ""

prakrit: "आउञ्चियम्मि पाए कड्ढिज्जइ गयवरो गुलगुलिन्तो,तो रवइ मेण्ठ-वग्गो केणावि गओ समुक्खित्तो"
english: "If you find someone who has gone astray, You'd better stop and go elsewhere."

prakrit: "सोऊण ताण सद्दं सम्पत्ता सद्दवेहिणो जोहा,इसु-चाव-गहिय-हत्था कलयल-रावं करेमाणा"
english: "A virtuous man is one who brings wealth, who brings prosperity, Who brings prosperity - Such is the behavior of a clever man, Who uses his hands To conciliate rivals."

prakrit: "छिन्ना य तीऎ पङ्खा से सीसं हत्थिएहिं दक्खेहिं,सा विलवन्ती पडिया पव्वय-सिहर व्व महि-वट्ठे"
english: "The bird's head is covered with feathers From the elephant's hand To the doe's foot, Which is drooping like a beehive." ""

prakrit: "फालाविया य रन्ना पोट्टे दिट्ठो य अयगरो विउलो,सगडस्स ईदरो विव खोडी विव महियले पडिया"
english: "Fallavia, look! There's a field of acacia flowers in front of you. There are plenty of them all over the place."

prakrit: "अह भणइ नर-वर’इन्दो फालिज्जउ एस अयगरो विउलो,एयस्स वि मा मज्झे माणुस-तिरियं च होज्जाहि"
english: "Oh! you fool," said the woman, "Get away with you! There must be something very human about you."

prakrit: "अह फालियम्मि उयरे दिट्ठा सा छालिया महाकाया,तीए वि उयर-मज्झे रमणिज्जं चिब्भडं दिट्ठं"
english: "Oh! the false woman's high gaze, That peacock's big eye, Yet at the same time her handsome face Looks like a lotus."

prakrit: "ही ही अहो महल्लं ति चिब्भडं जाव जम्पए राया,तो घोडया वि रमिउं नवरि ठिय’आओज्ज-वंस-करा"
english: "Hey, hey, the headman's son - in - law is about to jump off, so have fun with the mare." "Come on, you bastard!" ""

prakrit: "निग्गन्तुं च पवत्तो वालुक्काओ तओ जण-समूहो,जह सलभाण य सेणा रेप्फ-बिलाओ विणिक्खमइ"
english: "A swarm of crickets hangs down from the sky, Like an army of wiles piercing through the rafters."

prakrit: "नमिऊण नर-वर’इन्दं तो सो सचउप्पओ जणो सव्वो,निय-णिय-ठाणाइं गओ अहं पि पत्तो इमं नयरिं"
english: "If you ask me,'Is this really the case with men?'Everyone will tell you,'I've reached my goal in life,'But I don't know how." ""

prakrit: "एयं मे अणुभूयं पच्चक्खम इह’ एव माणुसे लोए,जो मे न पत्तियायइ धुत्ताणं देउ सो भुत्तिं"
english: "This is the world I want to see: A man who does not forgive has forgotten that I forgave him."

prakrit: "अह भणइ एलसाढो पत्तिज्जामो न किञ्चि सन्देहो,पडिभणइ कण्डरीओ गामो कह चिब्भडे माओ"
english: "Hey, you silly girl, Don't doubt it, There's something wrong with your hair." ""

prakrit: "पडिभणइ एलसाढो पुराण-भारह-सुईसु दिट्ठ’अत्थो,किं तुह विण्हुपुराणं कण्ण-सुइ-पहं न पत्तं ते"
english: "You fool, Puranas - burdens - Needles stare at you. Why don't you people have woven leaves Like needles in your eyes?"

prakrit: "पुव्विं आसि जगम इणं पञ्चमहाभूय-वज्जियं गहिरं,एग’अण्णवं जलेणं महप्पमाणं तहिं अण्डं"
english: "The full moon is like a panchambhūya - The middle one is deep, And the first one burns like an egg." ""

prakrit: "वीई-परम्परेणं घोलन्तं अच्छिउं सुचिर-कालं,फुट्टं दुभाग-जायं अद्धं भूमीऎ संवुत्तं"
english: "A lotus blooms with the passage of time, But when it is half full The earth is empty."

prakrit: "तत्थ सुरासुर-णारय-मणुय-चउप्पय-मयं जयं सव्वं,जइ मायं ता गामो कह नु न माएज्ज वालुङ्के"
english: "Tath surasura-narya-manuya-chauppaya-maya jayam sab, jaise maa tha, village kahaan nahin maaajja waalunkay."

prakrit: "अन्नं च इमं सुव्वइ अरणीपव्वम्मि धम्मपुत्तस्स,कहियं सुयम-अणुभूयं मक्कण्डेणं च अन्न-जुए"
english: "Food is everything in this forest - The sacred thread between forest and forest, Love is everything between a swarm of bees And a cluster of bees."

prakrit: "सो किल जुग’अन्त-समए उयएण’ एग’अण्णवी-कए लोए,वीई-परम्परेणं घोलिन्तो उयय-मज्झम्मि"
english: "So kill the jug - The end is near, The fire is out, And the midday sun is setting On the horizon." ""

prakrit: "पेच्छइ गय-तसथावर-पणट्ठ-सुर-णर-तिरिक्खजोणीयं,एग’अण्णवं जगम इणं पञ्चमहाभूय-पब्भट्ठं"
english: "She stares at the horizon - The sky is blue, The trees are white, The paths are smooth, The roads are meandering, And the streets are deserted."

prakrit: "एवं-विहे जगम्मी पेच्छइ नग्गोहपायवं अह सो,मन्दरगिरि व्व तुङ्गं महासमुद्दं व वित्थिण्णं"
english: "And behold, the fire of heaven Looks like a pyre Slipping down from the sky, Like a tower in the middle of the night."

prakrit: "खन्धम्मि तस्स सयणं अच्छइ तहिं बालओ मण’अभिरामो,सम्पुण्ण-सरीर’उयओ मिउ-मद्दव-कुञ्चिय-सुएसो"
english: "Aunt, It's alright for you to sit in silence While the hair and mind are busy, The whole body is busy, I'm busy - Anxious - Tired."

prakrit: "हत्थो पसारिओ से रिसिणा एह’एहि वच्छ भणिओ य,खन्धे ममं विलग्गसु मा मरिहिसि उयय-वाहीए"
english: "This is what the bear said:" "Get away from me! Don't go walking away Because I'm about to die." ""

prakrit: "तेण य घेत्तुं हत्थो ओइलिओ सो रिसी तओ तस्स,पेच्छइ उयरम्मि जयं ससेल-वण-काणणं सव्वं"
english: "She holds his hand, Oily is she, And he holds her tightly. She looks up to see what he has to say - The forest, The trees - Everything to see."

prakrit: "दिव्वं वास-सहस्सं कुच्छीए सो रिसी परिभमन्तो,अन्तं न च’एव पत्तो विणिग्गओ रिसिवरो तत्तो"
english: "He dwells in the day - The raisin is swirling around in the air, There is no end to it: Either the leaf is withering or the receiver is thirsty."

prakrit: "जइ दारयस्स उयरे ससुरासुर-माणुसं जयं मायं,तो चिब्भडम्मि गामो कह नु न माएज्ज कण्डरिय"
english: "If the God of Love conquers humankind, why not the headman's son?"

prakrit: "ढेङ्कोयरे अयगरो तस्स पसूए य चिब्भडं उयरे,तत्थ वि य जण-समूहो कह माओ भणसि सुणसु इमं"
english: "There you are, go - between, With your cheeks slightly raised, And your face towards the crowd:" "Tell me, Mother - in - law, how can I hear you?" ""

prakrit: "मुट्ठी-गेज्झ-सुमज्झाऎ केसवो देवईऎ कुच्छिम्मि,वुत्तो तस्स य उयरे ससेल-वण-काणणा पुहई"
english: "A handful of gooseflesh - a nice bunch of hair - Is the god of crooks, But on top of that he has grown thin - The forest - The pearl of his ear."

prakrit: "अह भणइ कण्डरीओ चिब्भड-पसु-अयगर’आइ-मज्झम्मि,अच्छन्तो कह न मओ एयं मे पत्तियावेह"
english: "Oh! you silly girl," said the doe, "My cheeks and forehead are red. Please, tell me, please, don't turn your back on me."

prakrit: "भणइ य एलासाढो तद्दियसं च’एय निग्गओ तं सि,पुहई कह न विवज्जइ वसुदेव-सुयस्स पोट्ट-त्था"
english: "Tell me, brother - in - law, That your heart is set on it, And your eyes are glued to your cheeks. How can I possibly explain it to you?" - Vasudeva, The secret of love's potency.

prakrit: "पोट्टे किसि-वाणिज्जं सङ्गामा बहुविहा य आरम्भा,आवाह-विवाहा वि य उस्सव-पसवा य वट्टन्ति"
english: "A lot of business meetings start early, marriages break up early, and the festival of Utsav and Passover starts late."

prakrit: "कह पुण हवेज्ज एयं जयं तु उयरे वि जस्स जं वुत्थं,बम्भाण-केसवाणं पुव्विं किर भण्डणं आसि"
english: "How long have you been here, my dear?" asked the warrior, "The victory is yours, However large it may be, And how valuable it is to you."

prakrit: "कत्ता अहं ति बम्भा भणइ जओ वयण-बाह-ऊरूहिं,पाएसु य निक्खन्तं चाउव्वण्णं जगम इणं ति"
english: "How can I describe her? She can make out everything from the mouth to the nose, From the lips to the cheeks, And from the heart to the ears."

prakrit: "पडिभणइ तं अणन्तो बम्भाणं सपरिहास-वयणेहिं,तं सि मम चेड-रूवं न जुज्जए एरिसं वोत्तुं"
english: "He stares at you, With a broad smile on his face. Stop trying to reason with me, For he knows how to fight." ""

prakrit: "अब्भा-भूमिय-ओट्ठे पव्वय-दाढे समुद्द-जीहाले,पविसेहि मज्झ उयरे जा पेच्छ सविब्भमं पुहइं"
english: "The earth trembles, The sea is rough, The rivers are swollen, And the rivers are in spate."

prakrit: "मह च’एव समुप्पन्नो जल-सयणे नाहि-णिग्गए पउमे,बम्भाण तं न सोहसि गुरु-पुरओ एत्तियं वोत्तुं"
english: "You fool, My daughter - in - law doesn't know how to splash water. But don't be so hasty: Your parents will come for you."

prakrit: "जस्स पभावेण’ उम्मिल्लियाइं तं च’एव कह कयग्घाइं,कुमुयाइं अत्त-सम्भावियाइं चन्दं उवहसन्ति"
english: "How can one say:" "I love you because you love me" "? Possibilities trumpet the moon. "

prakrit: "अह भणइ कण्डरीओ पोराण-सुईसु कत्थ य सुयं ते,ढेङ्की महप्पमाणा जस्स’ उयरे एत्तियं मायं"
english: "Oh! the tendrils of the old needle - Tell me, dear girl, How old is she, And how young is she?"

prakrit: "परिभणइ एलसाढो दोवइ-देवी-सयंवरे पत्ता,जह किर धणुं पविट्ठा महिहर-णागा य अग्गी य"
english: "She treats everyone like husband and wife, Like two gods at the same time, Like a sacred fire - The fire of fire."

prakrit: "दुपय-णर’इन्दस्स धणुं सुमहल्लं देवया-परिग्गहियं,जो आरुहिओ विन्धइ वामे अच्छिम्मि सूयरियं"
english: "The arrow of the God of Love, Who pierces the arrow in the left eye, Is like the sun in the right eye."

prakrit: "जिज्जइ कलासु कुसला किर कण्णा तस्स दोवई सोउं,रायाणो तं धणुहं आरुहिउं तो समाढत्ता"
english: "If you want to master an art, Use both your hands And your eyes. If you treasure a treasure, Write it down."

prakrit: "न चयन्ति आरुहेउं अह ससिपालो महाबलो ताहे,सन्धेऊण पयत्तो नवरि धणुं तं अयत्तेणं"
english: "Aunt, It's too early to tell if I'm feeling well or not. But when the evening comes The hunter's bow must be pricking him." ""

prakrit: "तो कण्हेणं ताहे गरुलो नागा गया य सङ्खा य,चक्कं नङ्गल-मुसलं मन्दर-मेरू य पक्खित्ता"
english: "So looking down the road, The poor Naga is gone, And the elephant is stuck in the mud." ""

prakrit: "सन्धेइ तो वि जाहे ता ससि-सूर’अग्गि-उयहि-सेला य,पक्खित्ता सव्व च्चिय वसुहा अह धणु-हरे तम्मि"
english: "Even in the evening, If it is sunny, The trees will blossom, The fire will burn, The flowers will bloom, And the hare will rejoice."

prakrit: "अद्ध’अङ्गुल-मेत्ते किर असन्धिए केसवेण बाणं सो,पाएण वि मोयविउं ताहे पडिओ सह-धणू णं"
english: "Aunt, Why don't you stick your finger in my hair And shoot an arrow? Even if I die, I'll fall by the wayside."

prakrit: "पत्थेण य तं गहियं अह अइभारेण न सहई धरणी,भीमस्स तओ हत्थे आरुहियं तं पयत्तेण"
english: "The earth cannot support a stone that is so heavy or so heavy. I must touch it with my bare hands To rescue it." ""

prakrit: "कण्ण-विदिण्णेण सरेण विन्धिउं अज्जुणेण तं राहं,लद्धा दोवइ-कन्ना वीर-पडागं हरन्तेण"
english: "To pierce through the slit in his eye, To cut through the thin line in his path, Is to defeat a brave warrior Who has fought twice."

prakrit: "जइ तं महल्ल-धणुयं नाग’अग्गि-गया य अइगया जत्थ,तो कह न होइ ढेङ्की महई जत्थ’ एत्तियं मायं"
english: "If that great - eyed nymph went up in flames As though she had arrived by air, How could it be that the buffalo has arrived by boat?"

prakrit: "रामायणे वि सुव्वइ सीया-हरणे जडाउ-गिद्धो त्ति,पङ्ख’आउहो महप्पा जुज्झेणं रामणस्स ठिओ"
english: "Even in the Ramayana, everything is hunted down - deer, jade, vultures, doves, buffaloes, and elephants." ""

prakrit: "तेण वि से रुट्ठेणं चन्दाहासेण लूडिया पङ्खा,तो लुय-पङ्खो पडिओ मन्दर-सिहरो व्व महि-वट्ठे"
english: "Because he did not want to meet her, The women of the village plundered the feathers of the chandahasa tree. So the men of Lui fell at their feet Like buffaloes in a temple." ""

prakrit: "सीयाए सो भणिओ सीलवईणं सईण तेएणं,दट्ठूण राम-दूयं होहिन्ति पुणो वि ते पङ्खा"
english: "The seer said:" "Seal the fence and seal it." "When Rama saw him He was angry again And so were his wings."

prakrit: "कस्सइ कालस्स तओ हणुयन्तो राहवेण आणत्तो,सीया-पउत्ति-हेउं हिण्डन्तो आगओ तहियं"
english: "In any season, Whether it be for the wind or the road, As for me, my husband is always with me, And I am always ahead of him."

prakrit: "चिन्तेइ य हणुयन्तो अहो गिरी एस उन्नओ ’ईव,एत्थ’ आरुहिऊण अहं पुलएमि समन्तओ वसुहं"
english: "To think that you are making love Is like climbing a mountain, Like climbing a tree: Here I am, Like a spring in bloom."

prakrit: "संलत्तो य खगेणं को ’सि तुमं एरिसेण वेसेण,सो भणइ राम-दूओ अहं ति सीयं गवेसामि"
english: "Foolish girl, Who is it that keeps you locked up all the time, She says Rama - Duo, I'm going to her." ""

prakrit: "भणिओ जडाउणा सो राम-वहू रावणेण विलवन्ती,तेलोक्क-डामरेणं लङ्कापुर-पट्टणं नीया"
english: "Say :'He is the brother in law of Rama, The demon in Ravana's bow, The lamp in Telokka, The dam in Lankapur, The bower in Pattana.'"" "

prakrit: "मा भमसु अरण्णाइं सीया-देवीऎ मग्गण’अट्ठाए,दहरह-सुयस्स सिग्घं गन्तूण पियं निवेएहि"
english: "Bees seek shelter in the jungles of the forest, The gods seek refuge there, And lovers seek refuge in the thickets of the Goda."

prakrit: "अहम अवि सीय’अट्ठाए जुज्झन्तो निसियराहिवेण’ एवं,असिणा दुवे वि पङ्खे छेत्तूण अजङ्गमो मुक्को"
english: "Aunt, There must be something wrong with you," He muttered, "And if you refuse to budge, You'll break both of your wings And punch me in the face."

prakrit: "अह भणइ वाउ-पुत्तो जं सि ठिओ रावणस्स जुज्झेण,जं वा वि अम्ह कहियं होहि त्ति तुमं पि पियभागी"
english: "Ah! you fool, My son - in - law, The fight between Ravana and me has reached its climax. But if I tell you the truth, You too will be made to drink."

prakrit: "सोऊण दूय-वयणं तो से जाया पुणण्णवा पङ्खा,आयासेण’ उप्पइओ गओ य सग्गं निरुवसग्गं"
english: "If you give love to a man It is only because he loves you That you give birth to new ones."

prakrit: "आख्यास्यति खगः स्वर्गे पितुर दशरथस्य मे,एकस्त्रीपरिपाल्ये ’पि न रामः शक्तुम अर्हति"
english: "Legend has it: In the heavenly abode of Dasaratha, The husband of one woman Says:" "No one can match Rama's power." ""

prakrit: "मन्दर-सिहर’आगारो जइ आसि जडाउ खहयरो गिद्धो,ता कह न होइ ढेङ्की कण्डरिय महप्पमाणाओ"
english: "If a vulture attacks a man - elephant, Or if a tiger attacks a fowler, It cannot harm him at all." ""

prakrit: "एलासाढेण’ एवं कण्डरिओ जम्पिओ भणइ ताहे,एलासाढ इयाणिं कहेहि जं ते समणुभूयं"
english: "With a broad smile and trembling voice, He says:" "With broad lips He speaks what needs to be said." ""

prakrit: "एत्थ बिलं एत्थ रसो एसो सो पव्वओ जहिं धाऊ,एवं लक्ख-गएणं नडिज्जमाणो परिभमामि"
english: "Here is the field, here is the street, There is the river, And I will guide you into the woods."

prakrit: "लद्धो य आगमो मे जह पुव्व-दिसाऎ जोयण-सहस्से,नवरं गन्तूण गिरिं सहस्सवेही रसो तहियं"
english: "The moment I see you, young and old, I will go to my husband's house," he said, "And there I will stay for a while."

prakrit: "जोयण-वित्थिण्णाए सिलाऎ तं रस-बिलं समुच्छन्नं,उक्खिविऊण सिलं सो घित्तव्वो कणय-कुण्डाओ"
english: "Silly girl, If you squeeze the juice out of it, You'll spoil the dish. But when you suck it in, It's just a bunch of mud."

prakrit: "आसा-पास-णिबद्धो जोयण-सइएहिं कमेहिं तो अहं,गन्तूण गिरि-पएसे उक्खिविय सिलं रसं गहिउं"
english: "Come, let's have a drink. If I lose my temper, I'll go and steal your juices By climbing up and down the mountainside."

prakrit: "परिढक्किऊण य बिलं सिलाऎ तो आगयं इमं भवणं,तो जाओ मे विभओ धणय-सरिच्छो रस-पसाया"
english: "If you happen to stitch a bill around it, It's bound to fall by the wayside, So go ahead, I've a bunch of money - Mustard seeds - The juice has been squeezed out."

prakrit: "अह पणइणि-परिकिण्णो थुव्वन्तो तह य मागह-सएहिं,वर-तरुणि-सम्पउत्तेहिं नाडएहिं च गिज्जन्तो"
english: "Oh! the husband - The wife is spitting, So is the mother - in - law, The bridegroom - the young wife - All the while whispering nada." ""

prakrit: "अच्छामि विलसमाणो अच्छरसा-परिगओ धणवइ व्व,तालायर-माहण-भिक्खुयाण दाणं पयच्छामि"
english: "I seek refuge in good people, In wealth and kindness, In the charity of the bhikkhu, In love and affection."

prakrit: "तो धणय-विहव-सरिसं नाऊण ममं विणिग्गय-जसोहं,चोरा सामत्थेउं रत्तिं पडिया मम गिहम्मि"
english: "So the rich man - Vihav - Succeeds in calling me - As if I were a thief. The nights go by In my anger." ""

prakrit: "सन्नद्ध-बद्ध-पट्टेहिं तेहिं गहिय’आउह-प्पहारेहिं,कय-सीह-णाय-बोलेहिं वेढियं मज्झ वर-भवणं"
english: "Prepared - bound - bandaged - like that - Covered with gooseflesh, Like a fence around a fence - My husband's house." ""

prakrit: "परिसञ्चियस्स अत्थस्स कारणे मरणम आगयं तेहिं,स-भुय-बल-ज्जियम अत्थं न देमि हरिउं विचिन्तेउं"
english: "I am about to die because of that arrow which pierced through my heart. But I will not allow the arrow to pierce through my body."

prakrit: "सहसा य उट्ठिओ हं धणुअं घेत्तूण सर-सहस्सं च,तो भण्डणम आढत्तं चोराण महन्त-भीसणयं"
english: "If you happen to get up suddenly And grab hold of a rich man's head And toss him about a thousand times, You'd better stop! It's the thief's great pride." ""

prakrit: "सत्त’अट्ठ-दस-दुवालस अहयं एक्केण सर-पहारेणं,जत्तो वलामि तत्तो पेसेमि जम’आलयं चोरे"
english: "I have only one head - guard, seven, eight, ten - couplets. As far as I am concerned, the thief has already reached the temple." ""

prakrit: "तो चोराण सयं मे मुहुत्त-मेत्तेण घाइयं तहियं,हय-सेसा सयराहं पडिया मज्झोवरिं सव्वे"
english: "So choran saam mein muhut-meten ghyam thayyam, yeah - those are all my favorite pastimes." ""

prakrit: "तो मं खण्डाखण्डिं काउं सीसं च छिन्निउं मज्झ,बयरीए ठविऊणं मुसिऊण घरं गया चोरा"
english: "So, tell me, What do you mean, A thief came to my house By slapping me on the head And squeezing me." ""

prakrit: "स-रुहिर-स-कुण्डलं चिय सीसं मे बयरि-तरुवर’आरूढं,वीसत्थम अणुव्विग्गं खायइ बोरे कसकसस्स"
english: "In my head I have grown a pair of gooseflesh, And on the twentieth day I eat a bunch of acacia flowers." ""

prakrit: "तं सीसं सूर’उयए दिट्ठं लोएण बयरि-उवरिम्मि,बयराइं खायन्तं एस स-जीओ त्ति काऊण"
english: "At the sound of that trumpet The people looked on In bewilderment." "Who is going to live with these people While they eat the gooseflesh?" ""

prakrit: "मज्झं अङ्गोवङ्गा जणेण पिण्डेवि मेलिया तुरियं,जाओ पुणो वि तो ’हं निरुवहय-सरीर-लायण्णो"
english: "A man dressed in plainclothes Threw a towel at me. If I had to go again I would have to make do with naked flesh."

prakrit: "एयं मे अणुभूयं सयम एव इमम्मि माणुसे लोए,जो पुण न पत्तियइ मं धुत्ताणं देउ सो भुत्तिं"
english: "This is the world of the meek and the immortal man; he who does not purify himself by washing is a waster."

prakrit: "भणइ ससो सब्भूयं कह सक्का भाणिउं अलियम एयं,जं पोराण-सुईए भारह-रामायणे आयं"
english: "Tell me, father - in - law, How can I explain everything to you? Alas! It is the same as saying:" "The burden of old age has come from the Ramayana." ""

prakrit: "जमयग्गी आसि रिसी पत्ती तस्स’ आसि रेणुया नामं,तीए सीलवईए नमन्ति कुसुम’अत्थिए रुक्खा"
english: "A bunch of raisins fall from a leaf That grows on it. Renuya's name is given to her by the seal Who is bowing her head At the touch of a twig." ""

prakrit: "दिट्ठो य णाऎ राया अस्सावहिओ मणो य से खुहिओ,न नमन्ति तओ रुक्खा ताहे जमयग्गिणा रामो"
english: "Aunt, If you don't see him, You won't appreciate what he says: He bristles at your rebuke, But Rama is ready for a duel."

prakrit: "रुट्ठेण समाणत्तो सीसं छिन्दाहि दुट्ठ-सिलाए,तेण वि सीसं छिन्नं झडत्ति पिउ-वयण-कारेण"
english: "When he is angry, His head is torn to shreds And his skirt is torn asunder By his wife's braid."

prakrit: "भणइ तओ जमयग्गी वरसु वरं पुत्त जो तुहं इट्ठो,सो भणइ मज्झ माया पुणो वि जीवन्तिया होउ"
english: "Say,'My son, the boon you gave me will come true'; say,'May my love live on again '." ""

prakrit: "इय होउ त्ति पभणिए जाया सा तक्खणेण सज्जीवा,जइ सब्भूयं एयं तुमं पि जीवो ’सि तं सच्चं"
english: "Be this as it may: By being this way you have always prospered. By living as you do In all circumstances That is true."

prakrit: "राया वि जरासन्धो समर-परक्कम-पयाव-विक्खाओ,सो सन्धिओ जराए राय-सहस्साहिवो जाओ"
english: "Raya vi jarasandho samara - parakkam - payava - vikhao, so the treaties go a bit like raya - sahasa." ""

prakrit: "अन्नं च इमं सुव्वइ सुन्द-णिसुन्दा सहोयरा सूरा,बल-वीरिय-सम्पन्ना सुर-लोय-भयं जणेमाणा"
english: "Food and drink are the essence of happiness; sweet and salubrious are the pleasures of love; strength, virility, abundance, melody, longing, and fear are the gifts of love."

prakrit: "सामत्थेउं सुरेहिं तिलोत्तमा तेसिं वह-णिमित्तं तु,निम्मविया तिल-मेत्तं एक्क’एक्क-सुरस्स घेत्तूणं"
english: "Everything is fine, Tilottama, That's all - At the moment you arrive, Nimmavya, sesame - Friendship, One - One - Get over the sulkiness."

prakrit: "अङ्गोवङ्ग-सु-य-अङ्गय-लावण्ण-गुणागरा अणोवम्मा,कमलागर-वत्थव्वा लच्छि व्व सयं समुत्तिण्णा"
english: "Angovanga-suya-angaya-lavanna-gunaagara anovamma, kamalagara-vathavasa lacchi, Such is the state of equanimity."

prakrit: "विणय’ओणामिय-गत्ता सर-सामल-विकय-कमल-दल-णयणा,नमिऊण सुर-समूहं महुर’उल्लावा समुल्लवइ"
english: "Weaves of nectar - Onam - Gatta Sar - Samal - Vikaya - Lotus - Dal - Nayana, Sounds of humming - Group of bees" Loud cheering "

prakrit: "जं कायव्वं तं आणवेह देवेहिं जम्पियं इणमो,सुन्द-णिसुन्दा सुर-सत्थ-कण्टया ते समुद्धरसु"
english: "Whatever you do, bring it to me; I will give it to you in due course; Beautify yourselves, my darling, Use your ears to discern the sea."

prakrit: "इय होउ त्ति य भणिउं तिलॊत्तमा गेण्हिउं सुर’आणत्तिं,पत्ता खणेण य तहिं सुन्द-णिसुन्दासुरा जत्थ"
english: "Behold, I have told you so," said the doe, "And so on. Once you have pecked at the leaf You will notice that it is a lovely mass."

prakrit: "हार’अद्धहार-केऊर-भूसिया जण-मण’उस्सव-ब्भूया,विथड’उन्नय-थण-वट्टा दो वि जणे ते पलोभेइ"
english: "The necklace, The plowman's bracelets, The woman's breasts, The husband's arms, The wife's thighs, And the breasts - There are two ways in which one can escape." ""

prakrit: "तो ते मयण-वसगया तीऎ कए जुज्झिउं अह पवत्ता,निहणं च गया दोन्नि वि परोप्परं सत्थ-घाएहिं"
english: "So she went to bed, And the fire was quenched, And they both slept soundly." ""

prakrit: "स्त्रीणां क्र̥ते भ्रात्र̥युगस्य भेदः सम्बन्धिभेदे स्त्रिय एव मूलम,अप्राप्तकामा बहवो नरेन्द्रा नारीभिर उत्सादित-राजवंशाः"
english: "The difference between the eras of brotherhood and that of women: In relation to men, women are the root; In the absence of women, the stream of wealth flows through the Utsadid dynasty:" ""

prakrit: "अच्छरसा जइ एवं तिलोत्तमा निम्मिया सुर-गणेहिं,तो कह तुज्झ वि अङ्गा लाइज्जन्ता न लग्गेज्जा"
english: "If you want to enjoy yourself and your lover's pleasantries, how can you not decorate your body with them?"

prakrit: "अन्नाण’ अङ्गावयवा जइ लग्गा संमिलिस्सिया सन्ता,तो ससरीरावयवा भणसु तुहं किं न लग्गन्ति"
english: "If you think you look like a sage, You'd better not look like one."

prakrit: "सुव्वइ य पवण-तणओ बालत्ते अञ्जणं ति नामेणं,जणणिं पुच्छइ अम्मो को मे छुहियस्स आहारो"
english: "Every time I think of her name She keeps asking me who I am And how I know she loves me."

prakrit: "रत्ताइं वण-फलाइं आहारो तुज्झ तेण अह सूरं,गहिउं समुट्ठियं तो तेणावि तल-प्पहारेणं"
english: "The nights are long, The fruits are white, Your voice is high, And when I gather you up, You thrash me to the bottom."

prakrit: "सय-सिक्करो कओ सो जणणी से दट्ठुं तं पइण्ण’अङ्गं,भत्तु-सयासे गन्तुं विलवइ सोग’आउरा कलुणं"
english: "Friend, tell me, When you meet him He'll give you a glance At your penis, And when you talk to him You will give him a hug."

prakrit: "दट्ठुं नियय-कलत्तं रोयन्तिं बहुविहाइं कन्दन्तिं,दट्ठूण य हणुयन्तं पुत्तं परलोय-सङ्कन्तं"
english: "To see is destiny - To weep, To cry, To groan, To sulk, To stammer and sigh - To neglect one's child."

prakrit: "तो पवणो परिकुविओ पायाले पविसिउं ठिओ ताहे,स-सुरासुरं जगम इणं पवण-णिरोहेण आदन्नं"
english: "So let the wind blow, Let it settle on the footpath, For the heaven and the earth rejoice because of this breeze."

prakrit: "गन्तुं च तत्थ दिट्ठो पसाइओ सुर-वरेहिं सो पवणो,अङ्गाइं तस्सुयस्स वि सङ्घाएउं कऒ सजीओ"
english: "While I was away, The wind stirred the whole body, So why am I still alive When my limbs are still tingling?"

prakrit: "एक्का य तस्स हणुया न य दिट्ठा सुर-वरेहिं सव्वेहिं,हणुयाऎ एस अन्नो हणुयन्तो तो कओ नामं"
english: "Not everyone sees you, not just this one," he said. "But if you do, what's your name going to be?"

prakrit: "जइ सच्चं पवण-सुओ खण्डाखण्डि-कओ वि संमिलिओ,तो कह सक्का वोत्तुं तुज्झ अउव्वं वयणम एयं"
english: "If you want to know the truth, tell me, Silly girl, Where did you get that from? It had to be you."

prakrit: "दसरह-तणय-कहाए सीया-देवीऎ हरण-सम्बन्धे,सेउं सन्धावेउं लङ्का-दीवं गए रामे"
english: "Dussehra - The weeds - Where did the lily - goddess say about the deer - So at dusk the lilies of Lanka went to Rama." ""

prakrit: "दसमुह-राम-बलाणं दोण्ह वि भड-वाययं वहन्ताणं,सङ्गामम्मि पलग्गे हणहणं सद्द’आउले घोरे"
english: "The twang of the cudgel - Rama - Bowls both fiercely - The wind blows wildly, Swirls wildly as one embraces one's lover"

prakrit: "मन्दोयरि-दइय-भड’उक्कडेहिं न’एगाइं वाणर-सयाइं,असि-परसु-अद्धचन्द-प्पहार-छिन्न’अङ्ग-म-अङ्गाइं"
english: "Mandoir - Compassion - Fettered, Not pricked, These are the words of the proverb - Saying, As if they could be passed on - The moon - Spring - Shattered limbs - My limbs."

prakrit: "सत्ती-पहर-णिरुद्धे महियलि पडियम्मि लक्खण-कुमारे,रामे सोगाभिहए विलवन्ते पवण-तणएण"
english: "In winter the bees sit motionless, In summer the flowers bloom, And in winter the trees wither."

prakrit: "गन्तुं दोण-गिरीओ उवणीया ओसही जलन्तीओ,निस्सल्लो त्ति पभावा झडित्ति सत्ती वि निस्सरिया"
english: "Gone are the days - The hearth was scorched by the same fire, In vain did it break out, And in vain did the stillness of the hearth."

prakrit: "जे निसियर-कुद्ध’उग्घाएहिं समरम्मि अभिहया पवया,सञ्छिन्न-भिन्न-गत्ता ते वि य सव्वे समासत्था"
english: "Those who are naïve - Foolish, Those who have grown weary of adversity, And those who have drifted apart - All the same, They are alike."

prakrit: "विवइण्ण-सरीरा वि य जइ सव्वे वाणरा समुज्जीया,खण्ड-सहस्सो कऒ एलसाढ तो जीवसि तुमं पि"
english: "Though they are scattered abroad, All the poets have joined together, One hundred and fifty per cent of them, So live thou!"

prakrit: "अन्नं च जण-पगासा निहिया सुय-पुत्थएसु बहुएसु,किं वा तुम्हेहि इमा न सुया महसेण-उप्पत्ती"
english: "You sleep well, you eat well, You sweat profusely, So why not sleep on your own? It's the fire of the great rainbow."

prakrit: "हिमसेल-गुह-गयाइं दो वि महामेहुणं निसेवन्ति,दिव्वं वास-सहस्सं गिरिसुय ससिभूसणो च’एव"
english: "The frostbite - The two gooseflesh - Succeed in banishing the great fire, The burning fire of the God of Love - One hundred thousand girdles fall as one kisses a sapling."

prakrit: "तं सोऊण पउत्तिं देवा किर तिहुयणम्मि आदन्ना,सव्व’आयरेण मिलिउं गब्भ’उवघायं विचिन्तन्ति"
english: "Tell me, my dear, Is there room in your heart For everyone to think What it is to be pregnant?"

prakrit: "सुइरं सामत्थेउं तिहुयण-उज्जोय-कारओ जलणो,महुर’अक्खर-वयण-पयम्पिएहिं भणिओ सुरगणेहिं"
english: "Swelling flame - The flame of the karaoke is burning, The bees are hovering, The wind is blowing And the doe is saying:" "Spring has arrived." ""

prakrit: "एक्कस्स वि ता कीरइ कज्जं अब्भत्थिएहिं जिय-लोए,किं पुण महाणुभावो जं जम्पइ सुर-समूहो त्ति"
english: "What use is one to conceal one's affairs, In this world of the living? For what good is a great feeling When it is accompanied by a loud noise?"

prakrit: "जस्स य कएण सव्वे देवा चिन्तोवहिं समोइण्णा,तस्स य जत्तेण तुमं हुयवह एक्को समत्थो ’सि"
english: "As all gods think and agree, so you must be." ""

prakrit: "पविसित्तु गुहा-विवरे हर-पुरओ अप्पयं पयंसेसु,तो तुह कयाइ विलिओ मेहुण-तत्तिं विसज्जेज्जा"
english: "Every one knows how to dig a hole in the ground, So why waste your time looking for a friend?"

prakrit: "वेसाणरेण भणियं को धावइ अभिमुहं मुहुत्तं पि,इहरा वि उमा-वइणो किं पुण एयारिसे भावे"
english: "Proud lady, Why do you look at my brother - in - law As if he were running away?"

prakrit: "नर-सिर-कवाल-माल’आउलस्स खट्टङ्ग-वग्ग-हत्थस्स,जस्स रई पेय-वणे को तस्स जणो समल्लियइ"
english: "The man - the head, the crows, the garland, the ox, the donkey, the elephant, The drink - the bamboo - Is offered to anyone who wishes it."

prakrit: "जो दारुवणे रिसि-आसमम्मि विणियंसणो पलायन्तो,वहिओ उद्धुय-लिङ्गो को तं विवुहो समालवइ"
english: "One who flees after seeing the distorted image of the God of Love, takes the Vindhya Linga in his stride." ""

prakrit: "किं बहुणा जण-मज्झे जो नच्चइ उद्धिएण लिङ्गेणं,बलवन्तो वज्जहरो तस्स वि निस्संसयं भाइ"
english: "How can a big man - If he likes to have sex with a tall man, then a strong man - Have no doubts?"

prakrit: "जइ कह वि सूलपाणी कुप्पइ हिमगिरि-गुहा-पविट्ठस्स,को जाणइ किं मे होहिइ त्ति मा सङ्कडे छुहह"
english: "Who knows what will become of me If I touch your breasts, If you touch me anywhere?"

prakrit: "एत्थ’अन्तरे य भणिओ सप्पणयं बहुयलोयणेण’ एवं,सव्व-सुराणं वयणं हुयवह इणमो निसामेहि"
english: "Here it is said," "Speak deeply, give thought, and speak with all your heart." ""

prakrit: "मा भाहि उमा-वइणो हुयवह जेण’ एरिसो उमा-सत्तो,गय-तुरय-पुरिस-दमणो किं च इमो आगमो न सुओ"
english: "Don't be so naïve: Uma - You're the only one who knows, Uma - The secret is hidden, Guy - The trumpet is blowing, Men - The bow is bowed - I have nothing to tell you."

prakrit: "हत्थी दम्मइ संवच्छरेण मासेण दम्मइ तुरङ्गो,महिला पुण किर पुरिसं दमेइ एक्केण दिवसेणं"
english: "Man, dammit, if you have to stretch out your arms You have to bend your back. Why should a man ever hurt a woman?"

prakrit: "जं भणइ उमा-देवी करेइ तं पसुवई अकज्जं पि,किं वा देहाणुगयं उमं वहन्तो न दिट्ठो ते"
english: "What Uma - devi says, the calf says, without saying a word. Why not look at her body As it embraces me?"

prakrit: "मुञ्चसु आसङ्कम इणं रुद्दो रुट्ठो वि ते सरीरस्स,न करेइ किं पि पीडं पव्वइ-चित्तावरक्खाए"
english: "Munch on it, Hold on to it, Roll it over and rub it against your body. There's nothing you can do About it - It only bothers you." ""

prakrit: "इय होउ त्ति य जलणो गन्तुं हिमवन्तगिरि-गुहं विउलं,पेच्छइ तिउरन्तयरं रइ-कज्ज-समुग्गयम अईणं"
english: "Behold the fire that burns in the glacier - The caveman's son, Staring into the abyss As if he had nothing to do with it"

prakrit: "अब्भासत्थं दट्ठुं महदेवो उट्ठिओ समारूढो,हुं हुं उमाऎ भणिओ उद्धुय-लिङ्गो ’णलं भणइ"
english: "Look at the waterfall, The gods are standing there Watching. I said," "Mother - in - law, the linga is overflowing" ""

prakrit: "उट्ठ नि-य-अञ्चिय-वयणं पिब रेयं मा करेहि विक्खेवं,रुद्देण हुयवहो घडघडस्स तो पाइओ रेयं"
english: "Get up, have a drink, Don't overdo it, It's going to break. But if the thunder is caused by crying, Then get a drink." ""

prakrit: "उयर-गएण य रेएण सो पलित्त’अग्गिणा व डज्झन्तो,मुय-मरणो सम्भन्तो कह कह वि महोयहिं पत्तो"
english: "He ran away because it was raining heavily, He was burnt alive and wounded, And I feared that he might die. How can anyone tell if he is really alive?"

prakrit: "दाऊणम अङ्गुलिं हुयवहेण उग्गालिओ जले रेओ,उग्गालियम्मि रेए ताहे जलणो समासत्थो"
english: "A burning flame burns on the fingers of one's hand, Like the rays of a flame in the sky."

prakrit: "तप्पभिइं चिय सुम्मइ जण-सुइ-वाय’आगयं इमं वयणं,रेय-पभावा किर सागरम्मि रयणाण उप्पत्ती"
english: "Trembling and sighing, People are swooning and whispering, The fire is in the air, The ocean is raging And the moon is rising."

prakrit: "लवण-जलाओ अग्गी नील’उप्पल-सुरहि-कमल-गन्ध’अड्ढं,सरम एगं गन्तुं जे रेय-विसेसं समुग्गिलइ"
english: "The salt - burning fire, the blue flame, the fragrance of the lotus, The scent of the nectar - all add up to an egg that swells like a rainbow."

prakrit: "जं भण्णइ कित्तिय सह उयं ति फुड-वियड-पायडं ताओ,छक्किर अच्छरसाओ तं पउम-सरं समोइण्णा"
english: "Whatever you say, Say it aloud, Speak it out, Use it sparingly, And say it out loud."

prakrit: "ता मज्जिउम आढत्ता तम्मि सरे नयण-मण’अभिरामम्मि,मज्जन्तीणं जोणीसु ताण बीयं अणुपविट्ठं"
english: "So what do you think? My heart is bursting at the seams. The seeds have been sown by the young wife's passion." ""

prakrit: "पउम-सरे मज्जित्ता पुणर अवि ता जोइस’आलयं पत्ता,पइदिवसं चिय तासिं छण्ह वि परिवड्ढए उयरं"
english: "Aunt, Allow me to repeat for you The rest of your speech:" "Temple leaves, Tomorrow I'll pick them up again and again." ""

prakrit: "काल’अन्तरेण केण य समयं चिय ता तहिं पसूयाओ,एक्क’एक्कम उत्तिम’अङ्गं बाह’ऊरु-सरीर-रुण्डाइं"
english: "Time, whatever time it takes, Travels in it alone, With one limb in each hand, With the other in each body."

prakrit: "ता ता वि विम्हिय-मणा दंसन्ति परोप्पर’एक्क-म-एक्कस्स,पेच्छसु अच्छेरम इणं लोगम्मि अभूय-पुव्वं तु"
english: "So you look at each other all the time, One at a time, At another person's anger, At yet another person - You fool." ""

prakrit: "बाह’ऊरू य सरीरं सीसाणि य नियय-णियय-ठाणेसु,लग्गाइं तक्खण च्चिय महसेणो छम्मुहो जाओ"
english: "Bahu" ur body, Seems to be in a state of flux, But if you touch it, it is like being touched by a rainbow. "

prakrit: "कोमारबम्भयारी न’इच्छइ मणसा वि जुवइ-सञ्जोयं,सव्व-जणम्मि पगासो दक्खिण-देसे ठिओ रण्णे"
english: "The poor girl does not wish to be affronted. Even the youths want to be comforted. But everyone's greed is for the south - The south is a slippery slope."

prakrit: "चउसु य दिसासु जहियं धावइ लोगो भवन्तर-दिस’अट्ठा,सीसेण य छम्मासं धरेइ धारं बर’अट्ठाए"
english: "Look! The stream is overflowing with rainwater. People are running out of it Every day." "It's like a river bursting at the seams."

prakrit: "जइ महसेण’अङ्गाइं पिह-गब्भ-विणिग्गयाइं लग्गाइं,तो तुज्झ न लग्गेज्जा ताइं किम एग’उयर-वत्थाइं"
english: "If the buffalo's limbs are tied behind its back, Don't you see that they are tied around your waist?"

prakrit: "छिन्ना नासा कण्णो य लग्गए लोय-विइयम एयं पि,परमाणु-पमाणाओ पगम्पिओ लग्गसि तुमं पि"
english: "Little girl, Don't touch me if you don't want to. Anyway, you'd better take care of yourself, darling: You're the only one who touches me When I'm not there."

prakrit: "तो भणइ एलसाढो पुरिसो कह छिन्नएण सीसेणं,भुक्ख’अत्तो बयराइं खाएउं सक्कए कह नु"
english: "So he says," "Well, tell me, young man, How did you manage to tear the lid off?" "You guessed it:" "I'm going to eat those bastards." ""

prakrit: "भणइ ससो राहू किर सीस-च्छिन्नो जयम्मि सुइ-वाओ,तह विय गयणे हिण्डइ आभंसइ चन्द-सूरे य"
english: "Tell me, Mother - in - law, Why do you stay awake All day long Betraying the pleasures of love?"

prakrit: "अह भणइ एलसाढो कह गम्मइ तं विगिट्ठम अद्धाणं,कह वा वि जोयण-सयं कमेहिं अक्कमइ भूमीए"
english: "Oh! tell me, Elsewhere, How can I describe it in such a way? Anything at all? It must be the land of the blind."

prakrit: "पडिभणइ ससो जन्ने बलिस्स विण्हू दियाइ-वेसेण,तिण्णि कमे जाइत्ता हरइ स-सेलं वसुमइं सो"
english: "The poor thing is the mother - in - law who has been made a scapegoat By wearing a woollen dress. But to her credit, The girl has outlived her true nature."

prakrit: "जइ सव्वा वि वसुमई तिण्णि न पुण्णा कमे महुमहस्स,को दोसो जइ तुज्झं एक्क-कमो जोयण-सयं तु"
english: "If all three of you settle down, You'll never make love again. Who's to blame if one or more of you goes astray? It's you." ""

prakrit: "पुणर अवि एलासाढो भणइ सिला सा मए अइमहल्ला,कह उक्खित्ता गरुया एयं मे पत्तियावेहि"
english: "Well, Sila, tell me, Your Highness, Is this my house? I've got to tell you something, darling: It's already empty." ""

prakrit: "भणइ ससो किं न सुयं तुमए रामायणे कहिज्जन्तं,रामस्स रावणस्स य सङ्गामे वट्टमाणम्मि"
english: "Tell me, father - in - law, Did you not hear me say that in the Ramayana, That Rama walked in the company of Ravana?"

prakrit: "लक्खणकुमार-पडणे हणुएणं दोण-पव्वओ तुङ्गो,ओसहि-मग्गन्तेणं स-मूल-डालो समुक्खित्तो"
english: "Look! The hunter's bow is about to fall - Two plowmen are riding on it, And he has already covered the whole face With gooseflesh."

prakrit: "महइ-सिला-सङ्घाओ सेलो जइ वाणरेण उक्खित्तो,जोयण-पमाण-मेत्तं उक्खिवसि सिलं न सन्देहो"
english: "Bees, seals, flocks, And whatever else the wind throws at you, Do not doubt that you bear true affection."

prakrit: "लोए वि पयरइ सुई वड्ढन्ती मेइणी महुमहेणं,काउं वराह-रूवं स-सेल-वण-काणणा धरिया"
english: "In the world, even a needle pierces a beehive While it is growing, Like a garland of jewels In a forest, Like an earring."

prakrit: "जइ तेण समुक्खित्ता न नज्जई कत्थई ठिएणं ति,उक्खिवसि ता तुमं पि य धरणियल-त्थो सिला दो वि"
english: "If you can't stand to look at her, If she won't look at you, You'd better leave her alone On earth."

prakrit: "एलासाढो जाहे ससेण अइसन्धिओ भणइ ताहे,जं ते सुयम अणुभूयं कहेहि सव्वं अपरिसेसं"
english: "As soon as he speaks with his mother - in - law He speaks without saying a word."

prakrit: "छेत्तम्मि य अच्छन्तो तत्तो पव्वयवराऒ ओयरिउं,उच्छित्तो मि गएणं पव्वय-मेत्तेण मत्तेण"
english: "If you want to rest, lie down on your feet. If you have to lie down, lie low And talk nonsense."

prakrit: "थरथरथरन्त-गत्तो हाहा गहिओ मएण चिन्तन्तो,विवलाइउम अचयन्तो परिभममि तहिं तहिं च’एव"
english: "It makes me shiver, it makes me think, But when I think of him I forget everything I've ever done."

prakrit: "भी-उव्विग्गेण मए दिट्ठो तिल-पायवो अइमहल्लो,तत्थ विलग्गो मि अहं वणगय-भय-वेविर-सरीरो"
english: "Even though I look at you with such wide eyes, I am in a molehill, And apart from you I am speechless - Fear, confusion, body - all the same."

prakrit: "पत्तो य सो वणगओ आरुसिओ तिल-दुमं समन्तेणं,परिभमइ गुलगुलिन्तो कुलाल-चक्कं व्व आइट्ठो"
english: "Wait a moment, you fool," She muttered, "Stop your needless sulkiness And settle down for a drink of water."

prakrit: "तेण भमन्तेण य सो चालिज्जन्तो तिले दवदवस्स,वासासु जल-हरो इव जल-णिवहं मुञ्चई घोरं"
english: "When he walks on the river bank It seems to him that the lake is dead, And when he steps on it He feels like drinking water." ""

prakrit: "तिल-चक्केण व्व तिला ते सव्वे पीलिया गयवरेणं,तत्थ पवूढा सरिया तेल्लोया नाम नामेणं"
english: "Because of the sesame seeds, they all turn yellow. Therefore the name Powdered Mustard Oil should not be used." ""

prakrit: "खुत्तो य वणगओ सो खल-चलणीए य तेल्ल-पङ्कम्मि,आरडिऊण य विरसं भुक्खिय-तिसिओ मओ हत्थी"
english: "A fool who speaks nonsense, A crook who makes a mess of things, A teetotaller who piles on oil, A recluse who screams nonsense - That's how I got my hands."

prakrit: "गय-भय-सन्तत्त-मणो अहयं पुण-जायओ त्ति मन्नन्तो,कहकह वि तिल-दुमाओ दिवस’अवसाणे समोइण्णो"
english: "Gone are the days - Fear, rest - Believe me, my dear, If I give in to it again It will be as good as dead."

prakrit: "कुसिओ दिइं च काउं भरिओ तेल्लस्स सो मए हत्थी,ताहे दस तेल्ल-घडे पाउं भक्खेमि खल-भारं"
english: "Fill me with khusi and dahi, That's my hand full of oil. In ten pots of oil I have run out of fuel." ""

prakrit: "तेल्लस्स सुपडिपुण्णं तं दिइयं गेण्हिउं गओ गामं,गाम-बहिं तं दिइयं पायव-साहाऎ निक्खिविउं"
english: "The oil is perfumed, His days are numbered, I will go to his village, And his days are spent elsewhere in the village."

prakrit: "निययं भवणम अइगओ पुत्तं पेसेमि तिल्ल-दिइयस्स,जाहे उ न पावेई रुक्खं पाडित्तु तो गेण्हे"
english: "Destroyed tree, my son; If you cannot find it, burn it."

prakrit: "एयं मे अणुभूयं सयम एव इमम्मि माणुसे लोए,जो न उ पत्तियइ महं सो देउ महायणे भत्तं"
english: "This is how I feel: I am completely alone, This is just another human being's world. But someone who cannot stand me Should reward me with a great victory."

prakrit: "सव्व-कला-पत्त’अट्ठा भणइ ससं खण्डवाणई धुत्ती,अत्थ’ एस आगमो मे भारह-रामायणे य सुओ"
english: "Everything black and white disappears, Everything brown and smeared with dust, Yet in this world we sleep heavily - The Ramayana."

prakrit: "खण्डा ससेण भणिया भारह-रामायणे पुराणे वा,एयारिसाइं य सहेउयाइं भण कत्थ भणियाइं"
english: "Khanda sasena bhanya, bharaha - The Ramayana is old, What do you think the servants of the air force said?" ""

prakrit: "कह तिल-दुमो महल्लो तेल्लाण य कह महाणई वूढा,कह पीया य दस-घडा कह खल-भारो मए खइओ"
english: "How can a sesame-seed, Which is burnt in a fire, Have oil in a palace, Beef in a big pot, Drink water in a pan, And have something to eat?"

prakrit: "खण्डाऎ ससो भणिओ सच्चं तं लोय-बाहिरो तं सि,किं कइयाइ सुओ ते बालो वि जणो पयम्पन्तो"
english: "You fool," said the father-in-law, "you fool, you coward." How can one sleep when one's hair is still greasy? "

prakrit: "जह किर पाडलिपुत्ते निम्मविया मास-पायवा भेरी,तो किं सो तिलरुक्खो महप्पमाणो न हॊज्जाहि"
english: "If the cowherd is fond of mangoes, Why not give him a hot bath with sesame seeds?"

prakrit: "सुव्वइ य भारहम्मि वि गयाण पुण एत्थ दाण-सलिलेणं,महई नई पवत्ता हय-गय-रह-वाहिणी घोरा"
english: "Every time I hear my husband sing, There's always something to sing about. The bee keeps on singing And the crickets keep on singing."

prakrit: "तेषां कटतटभ्रष्टैर गजानां मदबिन्दुभिः,प्रावर्तत नदी घोरा हस्त्यश्वरथवाहिनी"
english: "Because of the droplets of elephants straying from their banks, The meandering river girdles the elephant - faced path."

prakrit: "जइ गय-मय-सलिलेणं हय-गय-रह-वाहिणी नई विउला,सरिया तया पवत्ता तो तेल्लोया कह न होइ"
english: "Jaise gaya-maybe-salilena hai-gaya-rah-vahini nai viola, saariya toh pavatta toh teloya kaha nahin hai." ""

prakrit: "रज्जाऒ धाडिएणं सुव्वइ लोयम्मि भीमसेणेणं,गन्तूण इक्कचक्कं घोरो बग-रक्खसो वहिओ"
english: "The hunter finds it difficult to sleep in the sun, For Bhima's army is everywhere, And the traveler carries around a flock of parrots."

prakrit: "भत्तं तण्डुल-कुम्भं महिसं तह मज्ज-घड-सहस्सं च,जं तस्स भत्त-पाणं उवणीयं तेण तं भुत्तं"
english: "The buffalo, rice, jasmine, and myriad other things - Whatever the buffalo wants, I'll spoil for it."

prakrit: "जइ बग-रक्खस-भत्तं भुत्तं भीमेण तो किम एगेणं,भारेण वि तं जिमिओ भार-सयं किं न भक्खेसि"
english: "If you want to scare away the tiger, Why not go ahead and scare it away? It must be because it is so heavy. But don't you think you are burdened too?"

prakrit: "सुव्वइ य कुम्भयण्णो सुत्त-विउद्ध’उट्ठिओ नियय-कालं,सो पियइ घड-सहस्सं खायइ न’एगे नर-सए य"
english: "Every potter sows," muttered the sage, "In due course she will drink, In case she runs out of flour She will not eat a thousand grains Of rice Now that men have had time to spare."

prakrit: "जइ पियइ कुम्भयण्णो सुत्त-विउद्ध’उट्ठिओ घड-सहस्सं,दसहिं घडएहिं किं सस किं पन्नासं न पीया ते"
english: "When the potter is drunken, He mutters," "There must be something going on." "Ten times, perhaps, Why didn't you drink fifty?"

prakrit: "अन्नं च इमं सुव्वइ पुराण-सुइ-णिग्गयं इमं वयणं,असुराण जह वह’अत्था अगत्थिणा सायरो पीओ"
english: "Food is everything in this Purana - Sui - The guideline is here, The demon is the one who" "Drinks so much liquor Without realizing it." ""

prakrit: "सग्गाओ अवइण्णा गङ्गा हर-जड-विणिग्गया सन्ती,जण्हु-रिसि-आसमपयं मज्झेण उवागया नवरं"
english: "Friend, the unbroken Ganges is everywhere - The roots, the branches, the blossom of jasmine, The new moon, As if it were my own."

prakrit: "पीया य तेण रिसिणा वास-सहस्सं च भामिया उयरे,तो जण्हुएण मुक्का किर भण्णइ जण्हवी तेणं"
english: "If a woman's affection, Which runs to and fro, Exceeds that of her husband, How can a man ever say:" "She's pregnant?" ""

prakrit: "जइ उयहिं अगत्थी णं पीया गङ्गा य जण्हु-रिसिणा य,तो जइ दस तेल्ल-घडा पीया य तए किम अच्छेरं"
english: "If you do not drink the water of the holy river Ganges, Like a man who is angry with his wife, So what good is it if you drink ten pots of oil?"

prakrit: "भणइ ससो सो दिइओ सुमहन्तो कह मए समुक्खित्तो,अह उक्खित्तो कह पुण नीओ एगागिणा गामं"
english: "Tell me, mother - in - law, How did you meet me When I was still a child And how did you manage to escape again Into another village?"

prakrit: "उच्च-प्फलियं दाउं हसिऊणं खण्डवाणई भणइ,नूणं सस न कयाइ वि सुओ तुमे गरुल-वित्तन्तो"
english: "You swallow it all! You laugh so much And mutter nonsense:" "Never mind that you sound so proud." ""

prakrit: "कासव-रिसि-पत्तीओ कड्डू विणया अहेसि तीयम्मि,दोहिं वि ताहिं सवत्तीहिं किं पि किल पणिययं छिप्पं"
english: "You're the one who wove the turtle - the creeper - the leaf - and the cudgel. Still, you hide something you once did from everyone." ""

prakrit: "जा पणिययम्मि जिप्पइ तीए दासत्तणं च कायव्वं,जावज्जीवाए च्चिय अहवा दायव्वयं अमयं"
english: "Whatever you do, keep it alive And enslave it: Either you revive it Or you destroy it, O god of death."

prakrit: "विणया जिय कड्डूए करेइ दासत्तणं सवत्तीए,कड्डू वि सवत्ती-वेहएण विणयं विमाणेइ"
english: "The weaver destroys slavery by what he has woven, the blacksmith destroys weaving by how he has spun it."

prakrit: "विणया किर गुरु-भारा दासत्ते परम-दुक्खिया जाया,तत्थ’ एव सा पसूया तीसे अण्ड-त्तयं जायं"
english: "If a weaver's master - burdened servant becomes extremely sorrowful, That is when his flock becomes dependent on him."

prakrit: "दासत्तण-मोक्ख’अट्ठा भिन्दइ तत्थ’ एगम अण्डयं विणया,तत्थ किल अण्डयम्मी जाया विच्छू असम्पुण्णा"
english: "Slavery - moksha," "At the very moment when an egg is laid It is pierced through, At the moment when the egg yolk is released It is impossible for a scorpion to penetrate." ""

prakrit: "दुम्मण-मणा य विणया परितप्पइ अण्डयं विणट्ठं मे,अन्नह चिन्तेमि अहं तं पि य मे अन्नहा होइ"
english: "A poor man's heart is made of twigs, An egg is laid on a young hen, And I think to myself:" "She must be eating bread." ""

prakrit: "मुच्चेज्ज पराहीणत्तणस्स अहं नाम दास-णामस्स,कह वि दुरासाऎ मए अण्डं भिन्न’अत्थिए भिन्नं"
english: "My name is Das -Namas," muttered the hunter, "And yet my eggs are different Because they taste so different."

prakrit: "अद्धिइ-लद्धाए विलविऊण आसा-णिबद्ध-हिययाए,कइहि वि दिवसेहिं तओ पुणो वि बिइय’अण्डयं भिन्नं"
english: "Once upon a time, When women were bound and girded with long braids, Sometimes they bristled again But the eggs were different." ""

prakrit: "बिइय’अण्डम्मि अणूरू जाओ किल सो वि मायरं भणइ,अम्मो तुम्हेहि इमं किम अकाले अण्डयं भिन्नं"
english: "Daughter - in - law, if you ask me What makes an egg different, I'll tell you the same."

prakrit: "जो ते मणोरहो चिन्तिओ त्ति सो पूरिओ मए होन्तो,एण्हिं अयङ्गमो किं करेमि अहयं पराहीणो"
english: "If I thought that man was dead, He would be completely dead. So what am I to do now that he has passed away?"

prakrit: "एयं पि ताव तइयं परिरक्खसु अण्डयं पयत्तेण,जो को वि एत्थ होही सो दुक्ख-विमुक्खओ तुम्हं"
english: "Here you are, Protecting the egg yolk. Whoever it is That is suffering, You are the remover of sorrows."

prakrit: "रह-सारही अणूरू ठविओ सूरेण जो जगे अरुणो,सयम एव य विणयाए कमेण तइ’अण्डयं भिन्नं"
english: "Be nice to the man Who wakes you up and says," "You're different than an egg." ""

prakrit: "अहिकुल-भय-सञ्जणणो जणवय-विम्हावणो महाघोरो,विणया-मण-परिओसो जाओ य महाबलो गरुडो"
english: "Ahikula - Fear - Consciousness, Janabaya - Vimhava, Mahaghoru, Vinyasa - Mana - Parioso Jao, Ya Mahabalo Garuda"

prakrit: "बालत्ते रममाणो नागे कड्डू-सुए विहाडेइ,पइदिवसं कड्डूए विणया खिंसिज्जए एवं"
english: "From boy to girl Ramona walks around in rags, And every day the rags are tied And the cudgels are torn."

prakrit: "विणयाऎ दासियाए पुत्तेणं गरुडएण सोमाला,मारिय अहि-पोयलया चञ्चू-चलण-प्पहारेहिं"
english: "Weaver's maidservant has given her son Garuda to Somala, while his wife has given him goose pimples." ""

prakrit: "एयारिसाइं विणया सोऊणम अभिक्खणं च रोवन्ती,पुच्छिज्जइ गरुडेणं रोअसि किं कारणं अम्मे"
english: "Mother - in - law! Why are you crying?" asked the doe, Weaving her skirt And embracing her young husband.

prakrit: "पुत्तय जीय-णिमित्तं पत्ता दासत्तणं सवत्तीए,रत्तिं दिवा य दुहिया करेमि आणत्तियं तीसे"
english: "My son, Stop being a slave after a long time, For I can make a lamp burn faster Than he can burn."

prakrit: "कह मुच्चेज्जसि अम्मे अमएणं तं च जाणइ पिया ते,कत्थ पिया बदरी-आसमम्मि गरुडो गओ तहियं"
english: "How dare you ask me, Mother - in - law, That he knows what I want, When my lover has gone astray - Our pride has gone there."

prakrit: "बदर’आसमम्मि गन्तुं गरुडो पाएसु निवडिओ पिउणो,वियल’इन्दिएण तेण वि फासेण’ उवलक्खिओ पुत्तो"
english: "Worse," said the doe, "you'll have to go and get a drink." The weasel is so spoilt by the water He can still spit at you, my son. "

prakrit: "गरुडेण जम्पियं भुक्खिओ मि भणियं च कासवेण’ एवं,बारस-जोयण-हत्थी तत्तुल्लो कच्छओ बीओ"
english: "The stag, hungry and thirsty, Is like a turtle in a manger, Like a bird in a herd of geese Standing on its back."

prakrit: "अमरिस-भुयङ्ग-वसओ जुज्झन्ति महासरे महाकाया,रत्तिं दिवा य दोन्नि वि सर-सङ्खोभं करेमाणा"
english: "The God of Love, the God of Death, Makes great battles with great warriors. Either the two agree or they disagree."

prakrit: "भक्खेहि ते तुमं गच्छिऊण मा पुत्त भुक्खिओ अच्छ,गन्तूण एक्क-म-एक्केण तेण ते दो वि परिभुत्ता"
english: "My son, don't be so hasty: It's only because they know each other That they turn their backs on you."

prakrit: "तत्तो य पडिणियत्तो पेच्छइ वडपायवं महाविडयं,पलय-महामेहं पि व स-सउण-कोलाहलं विउलं"
english: "There on the plain you see the great fire of love, The flame of fire and water, And the bustle of silence."

prakrit: "चउमुह-बीय-विणिग्गयाण वालखिल्लाण तस्स हेट्ठम्मि,उग्गं तप्पन्ति तवं रिसीणम अद्ध’उट्ठ-कोडीओ"
english: "The farmer's son, Who has already plucked the first seeds, Stops at the very top And screeches loudly As if he has spilled the juice."

prakrit: "सो तत्थ समल्लीणो भग्गो वडपायवो कडकडन्तो,मा होही रिसि-वज्झा चञ्चू वडपायवं गुविलं"
english: "So what's the matter with you? It's a mess of rubies, A tight slap on the back, No need to bend over - The gooseflesh is everywhere." ""

prakrit: "तो सहसा उक्खिविउं छाएमाणो व्व नह-यलं सव्वं,किन्नर-मरुय-णरामर-विम्हयम अउलं जणेमाणो"
english: "Suddenly the sky is overcast, Everything is empty, The eunuchs have passed away, The crows are dying, The trees have withered."

prakrit: "सागर-जल-पक्खित्ते बहुविह-वण-सण्ड-मण्डिओद्देसे,दीवम्मि सुवित्थिण्णे मुञ्चइ वडपायवं गरुडो"
english: "The sea, the water, the birds, The trees, the shrubs, The treetops, The lampstands, With their white petals, Look like wilting eagles."

prakrit: "वडदुम-लङ्क-णिमित्तं लङ्का-दीओ त्ति तो कयं नामं,दससीसस्स’आवासो आसि जहिं निसियर-पइस्स"
english: "What's the name of that wretched lamp that grows out of the eaves? It is the house of ten sages Where there is no more dearth of money."

prakrit: "हिमवन्ते गय-कच्छव भक्खेउं सो गओ पिउ-सयासं,भणइ य ताय न धाओ भक्खेहि तओ निसाए त्ति"
english: "The snowman has gone - The tortoise has run away, He has gone to his father's house, He says he won't run away But he refuses to budge."

prakrit: "भक्खेऊण निसाए अमय-पवत्तिं पपुच्छिउं पियरं,अमयं पुत्त कहेमो वोलेउं नरय-पायाले"
english: "My son, If you ask me what made me angry, I will tell you the truth."

prakrit: "धगधगधगन्त-हुयवह-पज्जलिय’आवेढिअं समन्तेणं,रक्खिज्जइ सव्व-सुरासुरेहिं सययं अमय-कुण्डं"
english: "The nectar of the fire - Like a flame burning brightly, Resisting the impulse to kindle it - Protects the fresh water - Like an inexhaustible fire."

prakrit: "को पुण तस्स उवाओ अमय’अत्थी कासव’अङ्गओ अहयं,अत्थि उवाओ जह घिप्पइ त्ति अइदुक्करो सो उ"
english: "Who is not a good turtle? It has indifferent parts. But he who is indifferent Is indifferent to what is true."

prakrit: "सप्पि-महो-दहि-सलिल’आइएण सन्तप्पिए ’णले धणियं,गहणं होज्ज न होज्ज व गहिए वि उवद्दवाणेगा"
english: "Sapphi, maho, dahi, salil," "Come, let's have some peace." "There must be something wrong with the bath - Even the donkey will complain."

prakrit: "कासव-रिसि-वयणेणं गन्तुं गरुडेण दो वि सम्पयया,पङ्खाणि य घय-महु-पाणिएण सन्तप्पिओ अग्गी"
english: "The turtle, the stag, And the doe, Having passed through the thickets, Are content to feast their eyes On the water That drips from the fire"

prakrit: "तित्तेण हुयवहेण य अमय-सयासं पवेसिओ गरुडो,गहियं च नेण अमयं देवेहिं वि किल समुग्घुट्ठं"
english: "A swarm of gnats falls at your feet, Like a river in spate, Like nectar from the God of Love."

prakrit: "अमयं कुण्ड-त्थं चिय विहगेण’ एगेण नीयम उक्खिविउं,सोऊणम इणं वयणं खुहियं ससुरासुरं भुवणं"
english: "Foolish girl, If you want to see my husband again, You'd better take him with you," He whispered, "Then you'll do it again."

prakrit: "जो जत्तो च्चिय देवो सहसामयम अवहडं निसामेइ,सो अहर-फुरन्त’ओट्ठो तत्तो च्चिय मग्गिओ लग्गो"
english: "As soon as the God of Love lets loose His patience, He will come running to and fro, And then he will pursue me."

prakrit: "मुग्गर-मुसण्ढि-पट्टिस-गय-कणग-प्परसु-भिण्डिमालेहिं,हल-मुसल-लउड-वलया-सूल’आउह-पहरण-समग्गो"
english: "Mugger - stag - Pattis - Guya - Kanag - Papersu - okra - jasmine - Plow - Mussel - Loud - Vlya - Sool - Auh - Guard - The whole village."

prakrit: "कलयल-रवो सुराणं पूरेइ नह’अङ्गणं निरवसेसं,हण छिन्द भिन्द गिण्हह मा मुयह रसायल-गयं पि"

english: "My son, If you sleep well, blame it all on your own body."

prakrit: "अह भणइ खण्डवाणा तुब्भे जाणह कुलं च गोत्तं च,मज्झं माया-वित्तं भणिया तो मूलदेवेणं"
english: "I speak Khandavana, you know the clan and the gotra, but if you speak Maya-Vitya, it is to the original god." ""

prakrit: "पाडलिपुत्ते नयरे तं सि सुया नागसम्म-विप्पस्स,सोमसिरीए धूया गोयम-गोत्तम्मि विक्खाया"
english: "While bathing in the river, She slept soundly, Wrapped her hair in a towel, And washed them with soap."

prakrit: "सा भणइ न’अवि अहं सा तुम्हे सारिक्ख-विम्हिया मज्झं,सिप्पिय-धूया अहयं राउल-रययस्स विक्खाया"
english: "She doesn't say:" "I am not your wife," "She says:" And when I tell you the truth, She brushes me aside With a spiky brush. "" "

prakrit: "बहु-धण-धन्न-समिद्धं अम्ह घरं राय-रिद्धि-सम-सरिसं,नामेण दड्ढिया हं नीया गोएहिं कम्मेहिं"
english: "My family is very wealthy, My wealth is abundant, My affairs are peaceful, I am careful not to fall into the trap of name calling."

prakrit: "दण्डभड-भोइयाणं रन्नो अन्तेउरस्स सव्वस्स,सिप्पिय-सहस्सम अहियं जं धोवइ मज्झ वत्थाइं"
english: "The poor thing is that all the trees in the forest are dead, And the paddy field is empty. I've nothing to wash away But the mud of my field."

prakrit: "वत्थाण महासयडं भरित्तु अह बहुविह-प्पगाराणं,पुरिस-सहस्सेण समं पत्त’आसि नइं सलिल-पुण्णं"
english: "Vatana mahasadam bharittu ah multivyah -pagarana, puris - sahasasena samatha patra ahuti nahi salil - punya"

prakrit: "छडछडछडस्स तहियं हुं हुं सिण्टा-रवं करेन्तेहिं,अन्नुन्नम अइसयन्तेहिं तेहिं कुन्द’इन्दु-धवलाइं"
english: "I will never forget how they kicked at me When I touched them With my fingers, When I kissed them While they were kissing."

prakrit: "धोयाइं वत्थाइं मज्झं पुरिसेहिं चुक्ख-भूयाइं,तो आयव-दित्ताइं उव्वाइयाइं मुहुत्तेणं"
english: "Washing utensils, Wiping the mud from men's purses, Are like blowing the trumpet Out of the fire of love."

prakrit: "आयो य महावाओ समन्तओ पायवे य भञ्जन्तो,तो तेणं पवणेणं वत्थाइं हियाइं सव्वाइं"
english: "Come, come! When the great hunter has struck the good man, He will tell all the wise men what to do."

prakrit: "गच्छह तुब्भे चुइया रयं ति कम्मारिया मए भणिया,जो दोसो अवराहो व को वि सो होहिई मज्झं"
english: "You fool, That blacksmith told me to shut up, My brother - in - law said:" "Who's to blame, And who is to blame?" ""

prakrit: "राउल-भएण तो हं गोहा-रूवं करेत्तु रयणीए,आया नयर’उज्जाणं ससलिल-घण-सन्निहं रम्मं"
english: "If I were a cowherd, I would wear cow - dung cakes. For no one knows what it is to wear a cow - ox - head."

prakrit: "विउले नयर’उज्जाणे समन्तओ हिण्डिया सुवीसत्था,अह पच्छिमम्मि जामे भय-चिन्ता मे समुप्पन्ना"
english: "When the wind blows strong, The Hindia sighs loudly, Like a man suffering from fear in the west." ""

prakrit: "गोहं चम्म-णिमित्तं मंस-णिमित्तं च जणवओ हणइ,तो को होज्ज उवाओ जह मरण-भयं न होज्जामि"
english: "Bees are poisonous to humans, So why should anyone care if I don't fear death?"

prakrit: "किं होज्ज कयं सु-कयं कत्थ गया निव्वुई लहेज्जं ति,परिभममि समन्तेणं भय-पवण-समाहया तहियं"
english: "How can I know what's good and what isn't?" she asked, her voice shaking with fear And trembling with excitement.

prakrit: "बहुयाइं विचिन्तेउं गोहा-रूवं तयं पयहिऊणं,रत्तासोय-सयासे चूय-लया हं परावत्ता"
english: "The cowherd looks at many women As if she were pregnant, But with tears in her eyes She turns away every time she sees him."

prakrit: "दुस्सीला इव जुवई तिमिर-पडं गुण्ठिया गया रयणी,कमल’आगर-तुट्ठियरो सहसा य समुट्ठिओ सूरो"
english: "You fool, Young girl, The lotus is twisted round and round, But suddenly it's all sunshine." ""

prakrit: "दिन्नो य अम्ह अभओ रन्ना पउरेण चाउ-वण्णेण,जह उब्भिण्डन्तु तहिं राउल-रयगाइं सव्वाइं"
english: "The day we set foot in the forest The fuller the grass grows, The thinner the fields grow And the poorer the cattle."

prakrit: "तो सो पडहग-सद्दो नव-पाउस-घण-रवं विसेसन्तो,आपूरेइ समन्तऒ स’अब्भन्तर-बाहिरं नयरं"
english: "So she'll fall - Suddenly, with a fresh drizzle, Strong wind, And completely exhausted, With tears streaming down her face."

prakrit: "सोउं पडहग-सद्दं तो तं मोत्तूण चूय-लय-भावं,लावन्न-गुण’आइण्णा पुणर अवि इत्थी समुप्पन्ना"
english: "Tis the nature of love - Love, Love, Virtue, Virtuous love, In the same way that love is pure."

prakrit: "तस्स य सगडस्स तहिं नाड-वरत्ता य तज्जणीओ य,रयणीऎ कोल्हुएहिं साणेहिं भक्खिया सव्वे"
english: "There's the good lady, There are the good wives, And everyone is busy making love."

prakrit: "अह नवरि मज्झ पिउणा नाड-वरत्ता य मग्गमाणेणं,लद्धा मूसय-छेप्पा नाड-वरत्ता तहिं वलिया"
english: "Oh! the husband does not make me drink, Nor does he ask me how I am. The landowner's son - in - law scorns him For not doing so."

prakrit: "तो किं एत्थं सच्चं भणइ ससो बम्भ-केसवा अन्तं,न गया जइ लिङ्गस्स उ तो कह वयणं तुह असच्चं"
english: "So what's the truth in this? It's all bullshit. If you have a penis, how can you say you have one?"

prakrit: "रामायणे य सुव्वइ जह हणुयन्तस्स आसि लङ्गूलं,महई-महप्पमाणं वत्थ-सहस्सेहिं नेगेहिं"
english: "In the Ramayana, all that one hears while bathing is the languor of jasmine flowers."

prakrit: "वेढित्तु रक्खसेहिं सित्तं तेल्लस्स घड-सहस्सेहिं,लङ्का-पुरी-वह’अत्था पलीवियं मन्द-पुण्णेहिं"
english: "Veedhitu raksha se sityam, Telasa ghoda sahasa se, Lanka puri - That'attha puliviyam mud - Punnehin."

prakrit: "सा देवलोय-सरिसा लङ्का-पुरि सव्वलोय-विक्खाया,आलीविया समन्ता हणुएणं वाउ-पुत्तेणं"
english: "She is divine - Sarisa, Lanka, Puri, all glories - Vikhaya, Olivia, Samantha, the daughter - in - law of the hunter."

prakrit: "जइ सच्चं लङ्गूलं सुमहन्तं आसि वाउ-पुत्तस्स,तो ते मूसिय-छेप्पा किन्न हवइ इद्दहा रज्जू"
english: "If truth be told, son of a bitch, If the plowman comes with a good hand It's only because he knows how to bend a log."

prakrit: "अन्नं च इमं सुव्वइ पोराण-सुईसु निग्गयं वयणं,जह किर गन्धारि-वरो रण्णे कुरुवत्तणं पत्तो"
english: "Food suffuses him as well As old needles do, So does the scent of the myrtle - Like the fragrant leaves of a weeping cucumber."

prakrit: "राया आसी किर सो महाबल-परक्कमो अहिय-तेओ,सक्को देवाहिवई परज्जिओ जेण समरम्मि"
english: "How is it possible for a demon to come in such a way? It's only the God of Love Who protects the enemy."

prakrit: "सो तं अहिक्खिवन्तो सुरगुरु-सत्तो अरण्ण-मज्झम्मि,जाओ महा-अयगरो रज्ज-पब्भट्ठा य पण्डु-सुया"
english: "So he is only ahikhivanto surguru - seven forests - in the middle of the night, Go - between great and great - Either the rag - bhatta or the pond - suhya." ""

prakrit: "तम्मि अरण्णम्मि ठिया एगागी निग्गओ नवरि भीमो,तेण’ अयगरेण खद्धो उवलद्ध-सुई य धम्म-सुओ"
english: "The young wife is so absorbed in making love That she paces up and down in the forest, Like a needle pierced by a sharp arrow - This is dharma."

prakrit: "पत्तो अयगर-मूलं सत्तय-पुच्छाओ कहयइ तस्स,उग्गिलइ अयगरो सो भीमं सावस्स-य-अन्तम्मि"
english: "The path is uneven - The root is straight - Ask her what she wants, and she will reply:" "It's empty - There's nothing left to do." ""

prakrit: "जाओ पुणर अवि राया जइ सच्चं तो तुमं पि सब्भूयं,गोहा चूय-लया वि य गन्तूण पुणण्णवा जाया"
english: "If you want to be pure, you must be pure. Even if you eat cow - dung cakes The destination is not pure."

prakrit: "तो भणइ खण्डवाणा धुत्ते एवं गए वि कज्जम्मि,मज्झं कुणह पणामं जाहे भत्तं पयच्छामि"
english: "So he says," "The farmer has washed away his clothes And gone to work." "Please, tell me, Who pays the rent? I'll pay him."

prakrit: "जइ कह वि पराजिज्जह सव्वे वि य समुइया मए तुब्भे,तो तुम्ह न’अत्थि लोए काणा वि कवड्डिया मुल्लं"
english: "If you lose everything I have in common with you, you are not worthless. Even in this world A coward's son is valuable."

prakrit: "तो ते भणन्ति धुत्ता को सत्तो निज्जिणित्तु अम्हेहिं,माया-णियडि-पहाणो हरी वि सक्कं जइ हवेज्जा"
english: "So they say,'Dhutta ko satto nijjinittu amehin, maya-niyadi - Wear green and get the job done."

prakrit: "तो सा अवगय-तोसा ते धुत्ते खण्डवाणई भणइ,पेच्छह एत्ताहिं चिय सव्वे वि करेमि हय-वयणे"
english: "So she ignores him - He brushes her aside And says," "I've done everything you asked me to do in this way." ""

prakrit: "तेसिं वत्थाण कए रायाणं पुच्छिउं परि-य-अडामि,गाम’आगर-पुर-पट्टण-जणवय-परिमण्डियं वसुहं"
english: "I will ask the messenger why he is talking like that. The village, the hamlet, the town, the neighborhood, are scattered about." ""

prakrit: "अन्नं च ममं चउरो चेड-रुया जायया चिर-पणट्ठा,तेसिं च कएण अहं परिहिण्डन्ती इहं पत्ता"
english: "The grass is stained all over me And I am crying all the time. That is why I am covering this leaf with my hands."

prakrit: "ते चेडा तुब्भे हि य ताणि य वत्थाणि ते परिहियाणि,जइ वि न पत्तियह’ एयं तो देह महायणे भत्तं"
english: "They are torn to shreds And if they fall by the wayside They are destroyed. But if they fail, It is the body that suffers the greatest harm."

prakrit: "तो ते लज्जिय-विलिया भणन्ति अइसन्धिया तुमे अम्हं,मेढी-भूया एण्हिं बुद्धि-पयारेण जाया सि"
english: "So they blush and mutter,'You're right, you're wrong,'But my wretched heart is already so full of wisdom."

prakrit: "एयस्स भरस्स तुमं एक्का जोग्गा जयम्मि विक्खाया,सत्ताह-वद्दलम्मी दे भत्तं सव्व-धुत्ताणं"
english: "Ah, you fool, The only way to win the victory Is to conquer it all With your own hands."

prakrit: "सा भणइ विहसमाणा पुव्विं विन्नवियया मए तुब्भे,भो गव्वम उव्वहन्ता ओहसह जणं अबुद्धीया"
english: "She says," "I beg of you, my poor girl, You rebuke me, But when I speak she refuses to listen." ""

prakrit: "तो ते भणन्ति सुन्दरि चायो घट्टो कओ हवइ जाहे,ताहे सत्तइ-जाई एसा पुरिसस्स पयईओ"
english: "So they say,'How come you're such a pretty girl?'But that doesn't explain why men act in such a way." ""

prakrit: "उप्पत्तिय-बुद्धीए अम्हे अभिसन्धिया तुमे सुयणु,तो सव्वे वि भणामो अम्हं भत्तं पयच्छाहि"
english: "You fool, my dear, You're asleep, so everyone thinks I'm asleep." ""

prakrit: "बाढं ति भाणिऊणं पेयवणं सा गया सुबीहणयं,सिव-डायणि-पेय-पिसाय-भूय-सद्द’आउलं विउलं"
english: "The bird said," "She has gone to get a drink." "The fowler - The witch - Has had his way - Drinks - Pisses - The landowner - Sad'owl - Weeping."

prakrit: "तूली-गण्डुवहाणय-पडिसिर-चन्दोवयाण ठाणे य,चित्त-पड-पट्ट-साडय-कोयंवय-काय-डज्झन्तं"
english: "Thigh - bristling wind, Feast - blowing of the moon, Heart - beating - stripping - dragging - Somebody's business - Something like lightning."

prakrit: "तरु-कुसुम-केसर’उप्पास-वास-तल-चत्त’-अलत्तय-विचित्तं,लुलिय’अद्ध-इन्द-पउरं पव्विद्ध-कलेवरं घोरं"
english: "Taru - safflower - Saffron," "Uppasa - Vasa - Tal - Chat" "- Alattaya - Vichitta, Lulia" "Adha - Indha - Pure and fragrant - Kalevar - Ghoram" ""

prakrit: "रूविणियाण थम्भिय-मच्छिय-सङ्घाय-भिणिभिणायन्तं,मडय-चिय’अन्तोवरि-डज्झमाण-सिलिसिलिसिलायन्तं"
english: "The ruby is like a column of smoke rising from the fire, Like a congregation of bees sitting side by side, Like an undergrowth in a thicket of ants."

prakrit: "विज्जा-साहण-रभस’उट्ठियन्त-णच्चन्त-मडय-वेयालं,भीम’अट्टहास-हुङ्कार-ताल-सद्दाल-गम्भिरं"
english: 'Vijaya - sahana - rhabhas ','Udhyant - nachant - mada - veyalam, bheema ', Attahasa - hunkaara - taala - sadala - ghabhiram '.

prakrit: "वस-रुहिर-क्कय-कद्दम-समन्तओ भीम-किमि-कुल’आइण्णं,आमिस-कज्ज-समुज्जय-णिट्ठय-बहुविहग-जुज्झन्तं"
english: "Vasa - Ruhir - Kakaya - Kaddam - Samantao - Bhima - Kimi - Kul - Ayanna, Aamis - Kajja - Samujjaya - Nitthaya - Bahuvihaga - Until the war"

prakrit: "रुहिर’उग्गाल-भलभलं सहस्स-सूला-विभिन्न-मुच्छन्तं,वितिरिच्छ-भमन्त-सियाल-कोल-णिवडन्त-घुट्टन्तं"
english: "Ruhir," "rhinoceros - uggal, bhalbhalam, sahassa, sulk, twitch, scatter - bhamant, sial - kol - nivadant - ghutant"

prakrit: "अइदुग्गन्धिय-वायन्त-मारुयं सव-सवन्त-णीसद्दं,बीभच्छ’उव्वेवणयं भय-सञ्जणयं सुराणं पि"
english: "The blind man is afraid of the dark, The fierce wind is threatening, And all the savages are waiting for him." ""

prakrit: "एवं विहे मसाणे पेच्छइ अविणट्ठयं विगय-जीवं,अचिर-विमुक्कं बालं खण्डा तं गेण्हिउं ण्हवइ"
english: "And just like that she looks at the unbroken tree - life, Suddenly startled by the fragment of a hair That does not grow back."

prakrit: "अब्भङ्गेऊण तयं जर-चीवर-सुसङ्गयं करेऊणं,उज्जेणीऎ पविट्ठा सेट्ठिस्स घरं धण-समिद्धं"
english: "Now that she has broken down, let her make love again, Let the firewood burn bright, And the treasure chest of the house is set free."

prakrit: "दिट्ठो य णाऎ सेट्ठी आसण-विट्ठो जणेण परिकिण्णो,भणिओ य नाऎ भाओ सुत्तिय-धूया मि दुग्गइया"
english: "Look at that girl sitting on the bed Looking out for someone. Tell her you're not sleeping. Wash her naked And make her miserable."

prakrit: "कइवय-दिवस-पसूया अबन्धवा असरणा विदेस-त्था,तुब्भे महप्पभावा पिइ-हर-मुल्लं ममं देह"
english: "Anyway - The days are long, The nights are fleeting, And the nights unreturning. So drink up your heavy burden - Every morsel is my body."

prakrit: "सेट्ठी वाउल-चित्तो पुणो पुणो तीऎ उच्चरन्तीए,रुसिओ भणेइ पुरिसे सिग्घं नीणेह दमिअं त्ति"
english: "Loud whispering, Her mind again and again, The Russians say:" "The sigh of a man Destroys the whole body." ""

prakrit: "निग्गच्छसु त्ति भणिया अह जम्पइ मा छिव’ अस्स बालस्स,अन्नं ठाणं बप्पि-क्कयं ति तो मे म पेल्लेह"
english: "Don't touch me, you stupid bitch!" she whispered. "Stop eating, boy, That's why I'm thirsty."

prakrit: "निग्गच्छेउं न’इच्छइ तेहिं य पुरिसेहिं पेल्लिया सहसा,धरणीयले निवडिआ भणइ महं मारिओ पुत्तो"
english: "I don't want to be kicked by that man. Suddenly his wife, Exhausted from the earth, Says she will kill me, my son." ""

prakrit: "हा मज्झ अणाहाए नाहो होहि त्ति चिन्तयन्तीए,सो वि मणोरह-तन्तू छिन्नो निच्छित्त-गत्तेहिं"
english: "No, I didn't mean to offend you," she said, "You'd better stop and think again."

prakrit: "भो पेच्छह जण समुदय इमेण धण-गव्विएण वणिएण,अट्ठारस-दोस-विवज्जियाऎ माराविओ पुत्तो"
english: "Look at that man Whose arms are tied around his neck. Eighteen hundred and ninety two - My son, I am about to be killed." ""

prakrit: "अह पहरिउम आरद्धा सीसे य उरे य सा असाहारं,भणइ य सेट्ठी मज्झं भग्गं भिक्खा-कवालं त्ति"
english: "Oh! I beg of you," she said, "If you ask me what I want you to eat, you'd better stop."

prakrit: "तो सॆट्ठी आदन्नो सव्व-पयत्तेण परियण-समग्गो,अणुणेइ विलवमाणिं करेह मा सुयणु बोलं ति"
english: "So sethi, Aadanno, sabse pyaten paryan, samagoron, unke liye vilvamani karein, no need to fall asleep." ""

prakrit: "दिन्ना य कण्णिया से भणिया घेत्तूण वच्चसू पुत्तं,मा रुयसु मा य कन्दसु तुह एत्तिय जीवणं दिन्नं"
english: "My son, Don't cry for the tears that fall from your eyes. This is the life I want for you."

prakrit: "घेत्तूण कण्णियं मयं कलेवरं च सा तओ अइक्कन्ता,सेट्ठिस्स निराबाहं जायं दाण-प्पभावेणं"
english: "Catch me by the throat, My lover and breasts by the arrow, For there is nothing I can do But give in charity."

prakrit: "त्यागेन भूतानि वशीभवन्ति त्यागेन वैराण्य अपि यान्ति नाशम,परो ’पि बन्धुत्वम उपैति दानात त्यागो हि सर्वव्यसनानि हन्ति"
english: "By renunciation, ghosts dominate, By renouncing enmity, etc., We perish, By favoring one's neighbor, We forsake charity, And by renouncing all other passions."

prakrit: "सिसु-मडयं छड्डेउं खण्डा विउल’अत्थ-लाह-परिसुद्धा,मणि-कणय-रयण-मोत्तिय-चमर-समिद्धं गया हट्टं"
english: "Sisu - The lotus is peeled off, The blade is pierced, The bead - the nail - Is polished, The pearl - the rhinoceros - Is piled on top of the jasmine."

prakrit: "काऊण य विणिओयं तेसिं धुत्ताण सीय-विहुराणं,बहु-खज्ज-पेज्ज-कलियं सुसक्कयं भोयणं देइ"
english: "Whom are you looking out for? Your face is smeared with red ghee, Your hair is strewn all over the place, And your cheeks, breasts, and buds Look like doves."

prakrit: "भुत्तायन्तेहिं तओ सव्वेहिं वि हट्ठ-तुट्ठ-मणसेहिं,भणिया य खण्डवाणा सुजीवियं जीवियं तुज्झ"
english: "Destroyed are all your hands and feet, Wretched man, For a good life is yours to ruin."

prakrit: "जं ते बुद्धि-बलाओ धुत्त-जणो निज्जिणित्तु सयराहं,सन्तप्पिओ खुह’अत्तो विउलेणं भत्त-पाणेणं"
english: "One who is full of wisdom, Strong and fearful, Who is always vigilant, Is content to be content," That is, To make use of what one has. "

prakrit: "सुस्सिक्खिया वि पुरिसा ताइं न जाणन्ति जम्पियव्वाइं,जाइं असिक्खिआओ कत्तो वि लहन्ति महिलाओ"
english: "Well - educated men don't know what it's like to be hot - eyed women."

prakrit: "पढिऊण य सत्थाइं पुरिसा नाऊण तेसिम अत्थाइं,न समत्था पडिवयणे उप्पन्न-मई जहा महिला"
english: "If you want to know the meaning of a man's name You have to study until he knows it. But if you don't know it yourself You can't understand how it feels to be a woman."

prakrit: "अधीत्य शास्त्राणि विम्र̥श्य चार्थान न तानि वक्तुं पुरुषाः समर्थाः,यानि स्त्रियः प्रत्यभिधानकाले वदन्ति लीलारचिताक्षराणि"
english: "A man who does not know how to interpret the Scriptures well is not as competent as a woman who knows how to reason."

prakrit: "चन्द’इन्द-वाउ-सूरा अग्गी धम्मो य लोय-विक्खाया,लोएण दूमिया ते वम्मह-रइ-राग-दोसेहिं"
english: "The moon is indifferent - Vavu - Sura, The fire is dharma, The world is divided, The fault is with the world, And the fault with the raga." ""

prakrit: "सुव्वइ य आगमम्मी जह कण्हो सव्व-बीय-मज्झ-गओ,सुहुमेसु बायरेसु य तिल-तुस-मेत्तेसु दव्वेसु"
english: "May all good things come to an end, may all seeds wither, may no one prosper, may only sesame seeds wilt, may never wither."

prakrit: "जइ सव्वगओ कण्हो चिन्तिज्जइ जत्थ तत्थ सो च’एव,चिन्तेन्तओ वि सो च्चिय तम्हा सो किं विचिन्तेइ"
english: "Wherever the eye of the beholder is attentive, there it remains attuned. Yet, even when the mind is occupied, What do you think of?"

prakrit: "अन्नं पि अलिय-वयणं सुव्वइ लोयम्मि निग्गयं इणमो,जह पवण-गणाहिवई सेलसुयावयव-उप्पन्नो"
english: "I will never forget how she put all my affection into words:" "Food is everything, The fire is everywhere, And people are everywhere." ""

prakrit: "बम्भाण-समुप्पत्ती तिलोत्तमा-उव्वसी य दोणस्स,उप्पत्ति छम्मुहस्स य नरकुब्बर आसि ताणं च"
english: "Bombhaan - Samuppatti Tilottama - Uvsasi ya donasa, Upatti chhammuasa ya narakubbar aisi taanasa."

prakrit: "कण्हस्स य निग्गमणं जह कोवा सेयकुण्डली जाओ,जह सिरकवाल-मज्झे रुहिरम्मि नरो समुप्पन्नो"
english: "The darker the cow's hair, The thinner the nail marks, The more fragrant the lotus."

prakrit: "जइ जायवस्स माया-उप्पत्ती हलहरस्स लोगम्मि,जह जाया सेलसुया विक्खाया जीव-लोयम्मि"
english: "As the joys of love, so the plowman's log, As the seller's field, So the wise man's life."

prakrit: "जइ होन्ति पव्वयाणं पुत्ता धूया कुडुम्ब-धम्मो वा,तो तं इमम्मि लोए जम्बूदीवे न माएज्जा"
english: "If a hunter's son washes the kudumb and dharma, That doesn't mean that the gods are innocent." ""

prakrit: "एयाइं चप्फलाइं भारह-रामायणे निबद्धाइं,सञ्चालणम असहन्ता जह जुत्ति-कयं सुवण्ण व्व"
english: "Such weight, Such concentration in the Ramayana, As if the yoke were something golden, Is intolerable."

prakrit: "एयं लोइय-सत्थं गद्दह-लिण्ड व्व बाहिरे मट्ठं,जाव’ अन्तं जोइज्जइ तुस-भुस-बुस-मीसियं सव्वं"
english: "Here's the thing: The mattress is bare, The bedsheets are bare, And at the very end you will see everything - The husks, the bushes, The mice." ""

prakrit: "तो ते भणामि सव्वे कुसमय-कुस्सुइ-पहेण मुत्तूण,सव्वन्न-देसियम्मि य लग्गह मग्गे पयत्तेणं"
english: "So I say, All good times, all bad times, All falsehoods, Are bound to come to an end."

prakrit: "एयं धुत्तक्खाणं सोऊणं लोइयस्स परम’अत्थं,तह कुणह निच्छिय-मइं जह दरिसण-सुद्धि होइ परा"
english: "It is the ultimate'atman'who destroys dhrutakhana; it is the pure soul - I am what it is - who purifies the world."

prakrit: "चित्तउड-दुग्ग-सिरि-सण्ठिएहिं सम्मत्त-राय-रत्तेहिं,सुचरिय-समूह-सहिया कहिया एसा कहा सुवरा"
english: "Chittood - Dugga - Siri - Santhee - Sammat - Rai - Ratte - The well - to - do Group - Sahya - Someone tell me, How come?" ""

prakrit: "सम्मत्त-सुद्धि-हेउं चरियं हरिभद्द-सूरिणा रइयं,निसुणन्त-कहन्ताणं भव-विरहं कुणउ भव्वाणं"
english: "Be content - be happy - be clever - be sharp - be vigilant, be fearless - never say never - Make things right."

prakrit: "सेयम्बर-वर-सूरी हरिभद्दो कुणउ अम्ह भद्दाइं,जस्स ससि-सङ्ख-धवले जिण’आगमे एरिसा भत्ती"
english: "Foolish girl, Don't be so naïve: The seeds will start to sprout And the flowers will turn white." ""

prakrit: "पसुवइणो रोसारुणपडिमासङ्कन्तगोरिमुहअन्दम,गहिअग्घपङ्कअं मिअ सञ्झासलिलञ्जलिं णमह"
english: "The cowherd's face grows dark with the cow's cry, But the lotus of his eye Looks like a lotus Placed on top of his head."

prakrit: "अमिअं पाउअकव्वं पढिउं सोउं च जे ण आणन्ति,कामस्स तत्ततत्तिं कुणन्ति ते कह ण लज्जन्ति"
english: "Shame on those who do not bring the nectar of love, Those who drink it and sleep in it."

prakrit: "सत्त सआइं कइवच्छलेण कोडीअ मज्झआरम्मि,हालेण विरइआइं सालङ्काराण गाहाणं"
english: "In the middle of the night the hunter gathers seven hundred gooseflesh, In the center of the forest The hunter makes hundreds of thousands of goose pimples"

prakrit: "उअ णिच्चलणिप्पन्दा भिसिणीवत्तम्मि रेहइ वलाआ,निम्मलमरगअभाअणपरिट्ठिआ सङ्खसुत्ति व्व"
english: "Oh! the man who dwells in the thicket of reeds, Like a bunch of parrots sitting on a tender neem tree."

prakrit: "ताव च्चिअ रइसमए महिलाणं विब्भमा विराअन्ति,जाव ण कुवलअदलसच्छहाइ मउलन्ति णअणाइं"
english: "However long a woman has been abroad, Her eyes, like the petals on a lotus, Have not yet opened."

prakrit: "णोहलिअम अप्पणो किं ण मग्गसे मग्गसे कुरवअस्स,एअं खु सुहअ तुह हसइ वलिअमुहपङ्कअं जाआ"
english: "You fool, Don't you find it hard to smile? Your smile has turned your face away." ""

prakrit: "ताविज्जन्ति असोएहि लडहविलआउ दइअविरहम्मि,किं सहइ को वि कस्स वि पाअपहारं पहुप्पन्तो"
english: "Aunt, There must be something very wrong with you. Without mercy, Why should anyone put up with it If it means harming someone?"

prakrit: "अत्ता तह रमणिज्जं अंहं गामस्स मण्डणीहूअं,लुअतिलवाडिसरिच्छं सिसिरेणकअं भिसिणिसण्डं"
english: "Mother - in - law, That lovely setting of the lotus in our village, Like a sesame field dripping with water, Is a pleasure to behold."

prakrit: "किं रुअसि ओणअमुही धवलाअन्तेसु सालिछॆत्तेसु,हरिआलमण्डिअमुही णडि व्व सणवाडिआ जाआ"
english: "Why cry, Onam face whitewashed? It looks like a river in bloom Facing a verdant field." ""

prakrit: "सहि एरिसि च्चिअ गई मा रुव्वसु तंसवलिअमुहअन्दं,एआण वालवालुङ्कितन्तुकुडिलाण पॆम्माणं"
english: "Friend, this is just the way things happen: Stop your tears, don't turn your face away. It starts with a trembling girdle"

prakrit: "पाअपडिअस्स पइणो पुट्ठिं पुत्ते समारुहन्तम्मि,दढमण्णुदूमिआइ विहासो घरिणीअ णिक्कन्तो"
english: "When her husband took her on his lap And her son tried to kiss her on the mouth The housewife could not help laughing."

prakrit: "सच्चं जाणइ दट्ठं सरिसम्मि जणम्मि जुज्जए राओ,मरउ ण तुमं भणिस्सं मरणं पि सलाहनिज्जं से"
english: "You know the truth, young man, Just look at me and you'll be right. Don't die, you buffalo, Since death would be more advisable."

prakrit: "रन्धणकम्मणिउणिए मा जूरसु रत्तपाडलसुअन्धं,मुहमारुअं पिअन्तो धूमाइ सिही ण पज्जलइ"
english: "Don't bother cooking: The fragrance of red ghee does not illuminate the flame that fills your mouth with smoke."

prakrit: "घरिणीअ महाणसकम्मलग्गमसिमइलिएण हत्थेण,छित्तं मुहं हसिज्जइ चन्दावत्थं गअं पइणा"
english: "The husband laughed at his wife's face Which, smudged with soot That stuck to her hand from kissing her lips, Looked like the moon."

prakrit: "किं किं दे पडिहासइ सहीहि इअ पुच्छिआइ मुद्धाए,पढमुग्गअदोहलिणीअ णवर दइअं गआ दिट्ठी"
english: "What are you doing?" she asked, her face clouded by tears. The young wife, completely at a loss for words, looked away.

prakrit: "अमअमअ गअणसेहर रअणीमुखतिलअ चन्द दे छिवसु,छित्तो जेहि जिअअमो ममं पि तेहिं चिअ करेहिं"
english: "Come, let me touch you with the moonlight That grows on your face As long as you don't touch me"

prakrit: "एहिज्ज सो पउत्थो अहअं कुप्पॆज्ज सो वि अणुणॆज्ज,इअ कस्स वि फलइ मणोरमाण माला पिअअमम्मि"
english: "Here's my husband, I'm angry, And there's someone who can give me a garland of flowers." ""

prakrit: "दुग्गअकुडंवअट्ठी कह णु मए धोइएण सोढव्वा,दसिओसरन्तसलिलेण उअह रुण्णं व पडएण"
english: "How can one help washing my hands so that I don't get wet? Let a tear fall from one's eye Due to the sweat running down their cheeks."

prakrit: "कोसंवकिसलवण्णअ तण्णअ उण्णामिएहि कण्णेहिं,हिअअट्ठिअं घरं वच्चमाण धवलत्तणं पाव"
english: "Aunt, I can hear you whispering, There's a lot of smoke coming from the house next door." ""

prakrit: "अलिअपसुत्तअ विणिमीलिअच्छ दे सुहअ मज्झ ओआसं,गण्डपरिउं वणापुलइअङ्ग ण पुणो चिराइस्सं"
english: "Hey, sweetheart, Just look at me again. I hope I don't have to go through this again."

prakrit: "असमत्त मण्डण च्चिअ वच्च घरं से सकोउहल्लस्स,वोलाविअहलहलअस्स पुत्ति चित्ते ण लग्गिहिसि"
english: "Unsure what to do next, You'll be kicked out of the house First thing in the morning, Then something else."

prakrit: "आअरपणामिऒट्टं अघडिअणासं असंहअणिडालं,वण्णघिअलित्तमुहिए तीए परिउंवणं भरिमो"
english: "I will never forget how, When her face was smeared with red ghee, I covered her face with gooseflesh."

prakrit: "आणासआइ देन्ती तह सुरए हरिसविअसिअकवोला,गोसे वि ओणअमुही अह से त्ति पिअं ण सद्धहिमो"
english: "I will never forget how she shook her head When she tried to kiss his cheek, But when she refused, I could not help laughing."

prakrit: "पिअविरहो अप्पिअदंसणं च गरुआइ दो वि दुक्खाइ,जीअ तुमं कारिज्जसि तीअ णमो आहिजाईए"
english: "Being separated from what is dear And being forced to look at what isn't Are two causes of grief. I bow to what you have to do."

prakrit: "ऎक्को वि कालसारो ण देइ गन्तुं पआहिण चलन्तो,किं उण वाहाउलिअं लोअणजुअलं पिअअमाए"
english: "One does not pass in time But walks with the path. Why, my dear, do you groan for the flame of love?"

prakrit: "ण कुणन्तॊ च्चिअ माणं णिसासु सुहसुत्तदरविवुद्धानं,सुण्णइअपासपरिमुसणवेअणं जइ सि जानन्तो"
english: "Don't be so naïve: You know the pain of falling asleep beside one's lover And waking up in the middle of the night To discover that the bed is empty."

prakrit: "पणअकुविआण दोण्ह वि अलिअपसुत्ताण माणइल्लाण,णिच्चलणिरुद्धणीसासदिण्णअण्णाण को मल्लो"
english: "But the poor thing is that both of them are sleeping soundly. So do not neglect the sleep of your beloved." ""

prakrit: "णवलइपहरं अङ्गे जहिं जहिं महइ देअरो दाउं,रोमञ्च दन्दराई तहिं तहिं दीसइ वहूए"
english: "Where there is a beehive, There is a nail mark on the head, And where there is nail marks, There the wife shows it all."

prakrit: "अज्ज मए तेण विणा अणुहूअसुहाइ सम्भरन्तीए,अहिणवमेहाण रवो णिसामिओ वज्झपडतो व्व"
