prakrit: "णूमन्ति जे पहुत्तं कुविअं दास व्व जे पसाअन्ति,तॆ च्चिअ महिलाण पिआ सेसा सामि च्चिअ वराआ"
english: "Those who grovel at the sight of the woman, And those who make love to her husband, Are slaves to one another."

prakrit: "तइआ कअग्घ महुअर ण रमसि अण्णासु पुप्फजाईसु,वद्धफलभारगरुइं मालइम एण्हिं परिच्चअसि"
english: "Why, my dear, don't you see That the jasmine is enjoying yourself But you are enjoying the pearl blossom Now that it is heavy with fruit?"

prakrit: "अविअण्हपॆच्छणिज्जेण तक्खणं मामि तेण दिट्ठेण,सिविणअपीएण व पाणिएण तण्ह च्चिअ ण फिट्टा"
english: "Aunt, A glimpse of that man, Seen through his own eyes, Is like drinking water in a dream: It has not quenched my thirst."

prakrit: "सुअणो जं देसम अलङ्करेइ तं चिअ करेइ पवसन्तो,गामासण्णुम्मूलिअ महावडट्ठाणसारिच्छं"
english: "A handsome man does what is right for the country; The village headman's wish is like a great banner."

prakrit: "सो णाम सम्भरिज्जइ पब्भसिओ जो खणं पि हिअआहि,सम्भरिअव्वं च कअं गअं च पॆम्मं णिरालंवं"
english: "That is why I take pride in my name, Even though I don't know it, Because love is bound to last."

prakrit: "णासं व सा कवोलेअज्ज वितुह दन्तमण्डलं वाला,उब्भिण्णपुलअवइवेढपरिगअं रक्खइ वराई"
english: "The poor girl, Whose teeth are now scattered all over the street, Is protecting herself with a fence of gooseflesh."

prakrit: "दिट्ठा चूआ अग्घाइआ सुरा दक्खिणाणिलो सहिओ,कज्जाइं चिअ गरुआइ मामि को वल्लहो कस्स"
english: "Aunt, The fire is burning, The wine is wafting from the south, And my business has come to a standstill. Who cares?"

prakrit: "रमिऊण पअं पि गओ जाहे उवऊहिउं पडिणिउत्तो,अहअं पउत्थवइअ व्व तक्खणं सो पवासि व्व"
english: "After making love I will go to his house, then to my wife's, and after a while I will return." ""

prakrit: "अविअण्हपॆच्छणिज्जं समसुहदुक्खं विइण्णसब्भावं,अण्णॊण्णहिअअलग्गं पुण्णेहि जणो जणं लहइ"
english: "A man so pure in love, So abundant in pleasures and pains, Is like a man so virtuous elsewhere."

prakrit: "दुक्खं देन्तो वि सुहं जणेइ जो जस्स वल्लहो होइ,दइअणहदूमिआण वि वड्ढइ थणआण रोमञ्चो"
english: "One who gives sorrow also gives happiness, As one who loves also grows through compassion, So does the follower of love."

prakrit: "धरिओ धरिओ विअलइ उवएसो पिअसहीहि दिज्जन्तो,मअरद्धअवाणपहारजज्जरे तीअ हिअअम्मि"
english: "Hold on, hold on," she whispered, her heart pounding against her lover's chest.

prakrit: "तडसण्ठिअणीडॆक्कन्तपीलुआरक्खणॆक्कदिण्णमणा,अगणिअविणिवाअभआ पूरेण समं वहइ काई"
english: "A flock of parrots sitting side by side, Yellow with a prominent mark on the head, Looks just like a doe sitting cross-legged."

prakrit: "वहुपुप्फभरोणामिअभूमीगअसाह सुणसु विण्णत्तिं,गोलाअडविअडकुडङ्ग महुअ सणिअं गलिज्जासु"
english: "Whom are you looking out for?" whispered the landowner, "Listen carefully, sweetwood trees in a thicket."

prakrit: "णिप्पच्छिमाइ असई दुक्खालोआइ महुअपुप्फाइं,चीए वन्धुस्स व अट्ठिआइ रुअरी समुच्चिणइ"
english: "Aunt, When the rain stops, The bees gather sweetwood flowers, And when the rainy season starts They burst into tears."

prakrit: "ओ हिअअ मडहसरिआजलरअहीरन्तदीहदारु व्व,ठाणे ठाणॆ च्चिअ लग्गमाण केणा 'वि डज्झिहिसि"
english: "Oh! you muddy waterlily, Standing guard on the river bank, Whom else can you blame for the waterlogging in Thane?"

prakrit: "जो तीअ अहरराओ रत्तिं उव्वासिओ पिअअमेण,सॊ च्चिअ दीसइ गोसे सवत्तिणअणेसु सङ्कन्तो"
english: "The girl who keeps repeating the same words over and over again As her lover does, Suffers the same fate as her husband."

prakrit: "गोलाअडट्ठिअं पॆच्छिऊण गहवइसुअं हलिअसोण्हा,आढत्ता उत्तरिउं दुक्खुत्ताराइ पअवीए"
english: "When the plowman's daughter Saw her husband standing on the river bank She clambered up By the most difficult route."

prakrit: "चलणोआसणिसण्णस्स तस्स भरिमो अणालवन्तस्स,पाअङ्गुट्ठावेढिअकेसदढाअड्ढणसुहॆल्लिं"
english: "I will never forget how, when he lay in silence at my feet, I felt like twisting his hair round my toes."

prakrit: "फालेइ अच्छभल्लं व उअह कुग्गामदेउलद्दारे,हेमन्तआलपहिओ विज्झाअन्तं पलालग्गिं"
english: "Fallen good lotus, Oh! the doors of that wretched hut, Remaining shut until the full moon."

prakrit: "कमलाअरा ण मलिआ हंसा उड्डाविआ ण अ पिउच्छा,केण वि गामतडाए अब्भं उत्ताणिअं छूढं"
english: "Not a lotus is damaged, Not a goose has been scared away, But someone has pushed a cloud on its back In the village."

prakrit: "केण मणे भग्गमणोरहेण संलाविअं पवासो त्ति,सविसाइ व अलसाअन्ति जेण वहुआइ अङ्गाइं"
english: "Whom do you think you are betraying By acting so rashly? It is your wife's limbs that are limping And her breasts are limp."

prakrit: "अज्ज वि वालो दामोअरो त्ति इअ जम्पिए जसोआए,कण्हमुहपेसिअच्छं णिहुअं हसिअं वअवहूहिं"
english: "Even to this day, my son - in - law sighs, His eyes fixed on my face, His lips quivering with laughter."

prakrit: "ते विरला सप्पुरिसा जाण सिणेहो अहिण्णमुहराओ,अणुदिअह वड्ढमाणो रिणं व पुत्तेसु सङ्कमइ"
english: "Those wretched sappers Know that love, Without a trace of pretence, Grows bigger by the day When debts, Not sons, Get compressed."

prakrit: "णच्चणसलाहणणिहेण पासपरिसण्ठिआ णिउणगोवी,सरिगोविआण चुंवइ कवोलपडिमागअं कण्हं"
english: "Aunt, If you dare, You'd better kiss that man's cheek, If he tries to touch you With his fingers or with your tongue."

prakrit: "सव्वत्थ दिसामुहपसरिएहि अण्णॊण्णकडअलग्गेहिं,छल्लिं व मुअइ विञ्झो मेहेहि विसङ्घडन्तेहिं"
english: "The whole horizon is slippery, The banks of the Goda are bare, The Vindhya Range is slipping, The sky is dark, And the clouds are dispersing."

prakrit: "आलोअन्ति पुलिन्दा पव्वअसिहरट्ठिआ धणुणिसण्णा,हत्थिउलेहि व विञ्झं पूरिज्जन्तं णवब्भेहिं"
english: "At the approach of the sun The Pulindas kneel behind their bows The moment they see the Vindhya full of flowers With their hands clasped behind their backs."

prakrit: "वणदवमसिमइलङ्गो रेहइ विञ्झो घणेहि धवलेहिं,खीरोअमन्थणुच्छलिअदुद्धसित्तो व्व महुमहणो"
english: "The Vindhya Range is white, Like the lotus of the forest, Like a drop of milk dripping from a nectar."

prakrit: "वन्दीअ णिहअवन्धवविमणाइ वि पक्कलो त्ति चोरजुवा,अणुराएण पुलइओ गुणेसु को मच्छरं वहइ"
english: "Even on the pretext that she is pregnant, The kidnappers trick the young man into believing That their daughter - in - law is a traitor."

prakrit: "अज्ज कइमो वि दिअहो वाहवहू रूवजॊव्वणुम्मत्ता,सोहग्गं धणुरुम्पच्छलेण रच्छासु विक्किरइ"
english: "Today, on any given day, Bride - to - be, Lovely girl, Declares her happiness On the lotus of her skirt."

prakrit: "उक्खिप्पइ मण्डलिमारुएण गेहङ्गणाहि वाहीए,सोहग्गधअवडाअ व्व उवह धणुरुम्परिञ्छोली"
english: "See how the wood shavings Swirl above the courtyard, Like a banner proclaiming prosperity." ""

prakrit: "गअगण्डत्थलणिहसणमअमइलीकअकरञ्जसाहाहिं,एन्तीअ कुलघराओ णाअं वाहीअ पइमरणं"
english: "The plowman's daughter has grown very thin, Her limbs are swollen, And her husband is absent." "The landowner's son is dying."

prakrit: "णववहुपॆम्मतनुइओ पणअं पढमघरिणीअ रक्खन्तो,अलिहिअदुप्परिअल्लं पि णेइ रण्णं धणुं वाहो"
english: "The hunter protects his first wife Even though she is only a novice. But still the hunter carries the bull through the forest Even though it is half dead."

prakrit: "हासाविओ जणो सामलीअ पढमं पसूअमाणाए,वल्लहवाएण अलं मम त्ति वहुसो भणन्तीए"
english: "Laughing at the man who once made me swear that he would never lie to me again, She keeps saying that he is her husband."

prakrit: "कइअवरहिअं पॆम्मं ण त्थि च्चिअ मामि माणुसे लोए,अह होइ कस्स विरहो विरहे हॊन्तम्मि को जिअइ"
english: "Love without deceit does not exist, For who would separate or be separated From a human being Would survive?"

prakrit: "अच्छेरं व णिहिं मिव सग्गे रज्जं व अमअपाणं व,आसि म्ह तं मुहुत्तं विणिअंसणदंसणं तिस्सा"
english: "Well, my dear, It's just that I haven't seen you in a while, Or else I won't see you again."

prakrit: "सा तुज्झ वल्लहा तं सि मज्झ वेसो सि तीअ तुज्झ अहं,वालअ फुडं भणामो पॆम्मं किर वहुविआरं ति"
english: "You love her, I love you, She hates you, And you hate me."

prakrit: "अहअं लज्जालुइणी तस्स अ उम्मच्छराइ पॆम्माइं,सहिआअणो वि णिउणो अलाहि किं पाअराएण"
english: "I am shy And he is ready for anything, But my friends will help me out, So what should I wear?"

prakrit: "महुमासमारुआहअमहुअरझङ्कारणिब्भरे रण्णे,गाइ विरहख्हरावद्धपहिअमणमोहणं गोवी"
english: "The rainy season is over, The forest is overcast with bees, And the cowgirl's song About parted lovers Troubles the lonely traveler."

prakrit: "तह माणो माणधणाइ तीअ एमेअ दूरम अणुवद्धो,जह से अणुणीअ पिओ ऎक्कग्गाम च्चिअ पउत्थो"
english: "So rejoice, my dear, That she has reached such a distance That her husband can see her only once." ""

prakrit: "सालोअ च्चिअ सूरे घरिणी घरसामिअस्स घॆत्तूण,णॆच्छन्तस्स वि पाए धुअइ हसन्ती हसन्तस्स"
english: "Long - eyed housewife, As soon as you reach home You will find her laughing And wiping away tears."

prakrit: "वाहरउ मं सहीओ तिस्सा गॊत्तेण किं थ भणिएण,थिरपॆम्मा होउ जहिं तहिं पि मा किं पि णं भणह"
english: "Wait a moment, you fool, I don't know what to say. But tell me, dear girl, Wherever you are Going, Don't say anything." ""

prakrit: "रूअं अच्छीसु ठिअं फरिसो अङ्गेसु जम्पिअं कण्णे,हिअअं हिअए णिहिअं विओइअं किं थ दॆव्वेण"
english: "Tears were still running down her cheeks, Her limbs quivering, And her eyes closing." "What on earth is there to hide?" ""

prakrit: "सअणे चिन्तामइअं काऊण पिअं णिमीलिअच्छीए,अप्पाणो उवऊढो पसिढिलवलआहि वाहाहिं"
english: "He thinks only of his wife, Looks a little lower, Lifts herself upside down And shows no emotion." ""

prakrit: "परिभूएण वि दिअहं घरघरभमिरेण अण्णकज्जम्मि,चिरजीविएण इमिणा खविअ म्हो डड्ढकाएण"
english: "Every day I go from door to door Scorched by hunger, Destroyed by long life And burn me as dead."

prakrit: "वसइ जहिं चेअ खलो पोसिज्जन्तो सिणेहदाणेहिं,तं चेअ आलअं दीवओ व्व अइरेण मइलेइ"
english: "He who dwells where there is nothing to eat, Lives in heaven, Destroys it with a lamp and fire."

prakrit: "हॊन्ती वि णिप्फल च्चिअ धणरिद्धी होइ किविणपुरिसस्स,गिम्हाअवसन्तत्तस्स णिअअछाहि व्व पहिअस्स"
english: "However abundant, A miser's wealth is negligible, Like the traveler's shadow When he is scorched by the summer heat."

prakrit: "फुरिए वामच्छि तए जइ एहिइ सो पिओ ज्ज ता सुइरं,सम्मीलिअ दाहिणअं तुइ अविअण्हं पुलोइस्सं"
english: "O my left eye, If my husband comes home today Thanks to your kindness, I will reward you with a good long look at him While keeping my right eye tightly shut."

prakrit: "सुणहपउरम्मि गामे हिण्डन्ती तुह कएण सा वाला,पासअसारि व्व घरङ्घरेण कइआ वि खज्जिहइ"
english: "Your husband lives in the village, Your business is with you, And at home someone is having a hard time finding you."

prakrit: "अण्णण्णं कुसुमरसं जं किर सो महइ महुअरो पाउं,तं णीरसाण दोसो कुसुमाणं णेअ भमरस्स"
english: "That the bee wants to drink the nectar Of one flower after another Is the fault of the flowers themselves, Not of the bee."

prakrit: "रच्छापइण्णणअणुप्पला तुमं सा पडिच्छए एन्तं,दारणिहिएहि दोहि वि मङ्गलकलसेहि व थणेहिं"
english: "There you are, staring out the window At the sight of your lover, Both auspicious and inauspicious."

prakrit: "ता रुण्णं जा रुव्वइ ता झीणं जाव झिज्जए अङ्गं,ता णीससिअ वराईअ जाव सासा पहुप्पन्ति"
english: "She wept as long as she had tears to weep, She grew as thin as her limbs, And, poor thing, She reached her mother - in - law's feet." ""

prakrit: "समसॊक्खदुक्खपरिवड्ढिआण कालेण रूढपॆम्माण,मिहुणाण मरइ जं तं खु जिअइ इअरं मुअं होइ"
english: "In the course of time, with all its sorrows and tribulations, a man's affection is set at naught; the one who dies survives, the other is dead."

prakrit: "हरिहिइ पिअस्स णवचूअपल्लवो पढममञ्जरिसणाहो,मा रुअसु पुत्ति पत्थाणकलसमुहसण्ठिओ गमणं"
english: "Dear girl, don't cry. A fresh mango shoot with its new blossom Placed on top of it Will surely stop your lover from touching the jasmine." ""

prakrit: "जो कह वि मह सहीहिं छिद्दं लहिऊण पेसिओ हिअए,सो माणो चोरिअकामुओ व्व दिट्ठे पिए णट्ठो"
english: "Whatever it is that my friends want me to drink That I take pride in, That I drink at the sight of stolen lovers."

prakrit: "सहिआहि भण्णमाणा थणए लग्गं कुसुम्भउप्फं ति,मुद्धवहुआ हसिज्जइ पप्फोडन्ती णहवआइं"
english: "Her friends said," "The girl's breasts are clinging to her hips." "They laughed and clapped their hands."

prakrit: "उम्मूलेन्ति व हिअअं इमाइ रे तुह विरज्जमाणस्स,अवहीरणवसविसãठुलवलन्तणअणद्धदिट्ठाइं"
english: "You fool, My eyes are glued to your breasts, They wander in and out of my sight."

prakrit: "ण मुअन्ति दीहसासे ण रुअन्ति चिरं ण हॊन्ति किसिआओ,धण्णाउ ताउ जाणं वहुवल्लह वल्लहो ण तुमं"
english: "No more sighing, No more crying, Thanks be to him, For he knows you are no more than a kindred spirit."

prakrit: "णिद्दालसपरिघुम्मिरतंसवलन्तद्धतारआलोआ,कामस्स वि दुव्विसहा दिट्ठिणिवाआ ससिमुहीए"
english: "The drowsy glances of a moon - faced woman, Her eyes darting to and fro, Are irresistible Even to the God of Love."

prakrit: "जीविअसेसाइ मए गमिआ कह कह वि पॆम्मदुद्दोली,एण्हुं विरमसु रे डड्ढ हिअअ मा रज्जसु कहिं पि"
english: "Life is too short for me, Tell me, darling, How can I help it? Stop wasting away, Don't look anywhere else." ""

prakrit: "अज्जाइ णवणहक्खअणिरिक्खणे गरुअजॊव्वणुत्तुङ्गं,पडिमागअणिअणअणुप्पलच्चिअं होइ थणवट्ठं"
english: "Mother - in - law! The breasts of the fairies Are pallid from the sight of their young wives." ""

prakrit: "विरहकरवत्तदूसह फालिज्जन्तम्मि तीअ हिअअम्मि,अंसू कज्जलमइलं पमाणसुत्तं व पडिहाइ"

prakrit: "दुण्णिक्खेवअम एअं पुत्तअ मा साहसं करिज्जासु,ऎत्थ णिहित्ताइ मणे हिअआइ पुणो ण लब्भन्ति"

prakrit: "णिव्वुत्तरआ वि वहू सुरअविरामट्ठिइं अआणन्ती,अविरअहिअआ अण्णं पि किं पि अत्थि त्ति चिन्तेइ"

prakrit: "णन्दन्तु सुरअसुहरसतण्हावहराइ सअललोअस्स,वहुकइअवमग्गविणिम्मिआइ वेसाण पॆम्माइं"
english: "Praise be to the fragrant flowers of the God of Love, Which are scattered all over the place Like the jewels of affection."

prakrit: "अप्पत्तमण्णुदुक्खो किं मं किसिअ त्ति पुच्छसि हसन्तो,पावसि जा चलचित्तं पिअं जणं ता तुह कहिस्सं"

prakrit: "ईसालुओ पई से रत्तिं महुअं ण देइ उच्चेउं,उच्चेइ अप्पण च्चिअ माए अइउज्जुअसहाओ"

prakrit: "अच्छोडिअवत्थद्धन्तपत्थिए मन्थरं तुमं वच्च,चिन्तेसि थणहराआसिअस्स मज्झस्स वि ण भङ्गं"

prakrit: "उद्धच्छो पिअइ जलं जह जह विरलङ्गुली चिरं पहिओ,पावालिआ वि तह तह धारं तणुअं पि तणुएइ"

prakrit: "भिच्छअरो पॆच्छइ णाहिमण्डलं सा वि तस्स मुहअन्दं,तं चट्टुअं करङ्कं दोण्ह वि काआ विलुम्पन्ति"

prakrit: "जेण विणा ण जिविज्जइ अणुणिज्जइ सो कआवराहो वि,पत्ते वि णअरडाहे भण कस्स ण वल्लहो अग्गी"
english: "If you cannot live without it, you'd better stay on good terms with it. Even a leaf without fire will burn you."

prakrit: "वङ्कं को पुलइज्जउ कस्स कहिज्जउ सुहं व दुक्खं व,केण समं व हसिज्जउ पामरपउरे हअग्गामे"
english: "Who will tell me happiness or sorrow, Who will equal me and who will laugh When my husband is away?"

prakrit: "फलहीवाहणपुण्णाहमङ्गलं लङ्गले कुणन्तीए,असईअ मणोरहगब्भिणीअ हत्था थरहरन्ति"
english: "The husbandman puts the plow on its full plowshare, And the hand of his attractive wife trembles." ""

prakrit: "पहिउल्लूरणसङ्काउलाहि असईहि वहलतिमिरस्स,आइप्पणेण णिहुअं वडस्स सित्ताइ पत्ताइं"
english: "Like the trumpet call of a traveler, This is an angry storm brewing, Like water spattered on the leaves of a young bull."

prakrit: "भञ्जन्तस्स वि तुह सग्गगामिणो णइकरञ्जसाहाओ,पाआ अज्ज वि धम्मिअ तुह कह धरणिं चिअ छिवन्ति"
english: "Vanzantasa too is angry with you, my dear, But even today, in your dharma, How can you touch me?"

prakrit: "अच्छउ दाव मणहरं पिआइ मुहदंसणं अइमहग्घं,तग्गामछॆत्तसीमा वि झत्ति दिट्ठा सुहावेइ"
english: "Well, my dear, The sight of your beloved's face is a pleasure to behold, Even if it means crossing a thin line."

prakrit: "णिक्कम्माहि वि छॆत्ताहि पामरो णेअ वच्चए वसहिं,मुअपिअजाआसुण्णइअगेहदुक्खं परिहरन्तो"
english: "Aunt, There must be something very wrong with you," he said, sitting motionless on the farm And wiping away any lingering aches and pains.

prakrit: "झञ्झावाउत्तिणघरविवरपलॊट्टन्तसलिलधाराहिं,कुड्डलिहिओहिदिअहं रक्खइ अज्जा करअलेहिं"
english: "The storm has ripped the thatch from the roof And the waves are bouncing off it. The good lady tried to cover the wall with her hands To protect me during the day."

prakrit: "गोलाणईअ कच्छे चक्खन्तो राइआइ पत्ताइं,उप्फडइ मक्कडो खॊक्खेइ अ पॊट्टं च पिट्टेइ"
english: "When the farmer tastes the bitter nectar, The farmer licks the leaves, When the corn is ripe He rubs it all off And knocks it over."

prakrit: "गहवइणा मुअसेइहडुण्डुमदामं चिरं वहेऊण,वग्गसआइं णेऊण णवरि अज्जाहरे वद्धं"
english: "Bees sit motionless On the banks of the Goda, Stretching their necks for a long time."

prakrit: "सिहिपेहुणावअंसा वहुआ वाहस्स गव्विरी भमइ,गअमॊत्तिअरइअपसाहणाण मज्झे सवत्तीण"
english: "The gooseflesh of a woman's breasts Is like a flock of geese falling from a rafter's cudgel." ""

prakrit: "वङ्कच्छिपॆच्छिरीणं वङ्कुल्लविरीण वङ्कभमिरीणं,वङ्कहसिरीण पुत्तअ पुण्णेहि जणो पिओ होइ"
english: "Aunt, Only someone who is handsome Can become a father, If his wife is ugly, If her son is ugly."

prakrit: "भम धम्मिअ वीसत्थो सो सुणहो अज्ज मारिओ तेण,गोलाअडविअडकुडुङ्गवासिणा दरिअसीहेण"
english: "Your holiness, It's safe for you to walk in the village now. The dog that bothered you Has been killed by a fierce lion Who lives in the thickets of the Goda"

prakrit: "वाएरिएण भरिअं अच्छिं कण्णरइउप्पलरएण,फुक्कन्तो अविअण्हं चुंवन्तो को सि दॆव्वाणं"
english: "The wind fills the air with good people, Eyes welling up with tears, Who is the devil when he kisses someone absent?"

prakrit: "सहि दुम्मेन्ति कलंवाइं जह मं तह ण सेसकुसुमाइं,णूणं इमेसु दिअहेसु वहइ गुलिआधणुं कामो"
english: "Friend, The kadamba flowers give me more pain Than all other flowers put together. It's as if these days The God of Love has a bow that shoots arrows"

prakrit: "णा 'हं दूई ण तुमं पिओ त्ति को अम्ह ऎत्थ वावारो,सा मरइ तुज्झ अअसो एअं धम्मक्खरं भणिमो"
english: "I am not her go - between, You are not her lover, So what do you think? But let me tell you the truth: She is dying, And the disgrace is yours."

prakrit: "तीअ मुहाहि तुह मुहं तुज्झ मुहाओ अ मज्झ चलणम्मि,हत्थाहत्थीअ गओ अइदुक्करकारओ तिलओ"
english: "From her face to your face And from your face to my feet, Going from one to the other, The dot painted on her forehead Has performed a real miracle."

prakrit: "सामाइ सामलिज्जइ अद्धच्छिपलोइरीअ मुहसोहा,जंवूदलकअकण्णावअंसभमिरे हलिअउत्ते"
english: "The girl's face grows pale As the plowman gathers the plowshares Around her earrings."

prakrit: "दूइ तुमं चिअ कुसला कक्खडमउआइ जाणसे वॊत्तुं,कण्डूइपण्डरं जह ण होइ तह तं करॆज्जासु"
english: "Dude, you're cool. Come on, you stupid bitch. Call her by the name That doesn't have a tendon." ""

prakrit: "महिलासहस्सभरिए तुह हिअए सुहअ सा अमाअन्ती,दिअहं अणण्णकम्मा अङ्गं तणुअं पि तणुएइ"
english: "With all women your heart is made of nectar, Yet each day the parts that are immaterial grow thinner."

prakrit: "खणमॆत्तं पि ण फिट्टइ अणुदिअह विइण्णगरुअसन्तावा,पच्छण्णपावसङ्क व्व सामली मज्झ हिअआओ"
english: "But that does not make me happy. Every day the same pain, undiminished, Like being haunted by a secret sin."

prakrit: "अण्णुअ णा 'हं कुविआ उवऊहसु किं मुहा पसाएसि,तुह मण्णुसमुप्पाएण मज्झ माणेण वि ण कज्जं"
english: "You fool, What makes you think I'm angry? Stop your needless groveling And take me in your arms."

prakrit: "दीहुण्हपउरणीसासपअविओ वाहसलिलपरिसित्तो,साहेइ सामसवलं व तीअ अहरो तुह विओए"
english: "The tears running down her cheeks, Like a flood of tears, Fell without you."

prakrit: "सरए महद्दहाणं अन्तोसिसिराइ वाहिरुण्हाइं,जाआइ कुविअसज्जणहिअअसरिच्छाइ सलिलाइं"
english: "Eager to taste the fresh nectar, The women sigh, Get annoyed, And leave without saying a word."

prakrit: "आअस्स किं णु काहं किं वॊच्छं कह णु होहिइ इमं ति,पढमुग्गअसाहसआरिआइ हिअअं थरहरेइ"
english: "Come, tell me, what do you want to say?" she muttered, trembling at her first chance to be adventurous.

prakrit: "णेउरकोडिविलग्गं चिउरं दइअस्स पाअपडिअस्स,हिअअं पउत्थमाणं उम्मोअन्ति च्चिअ कहेइ"

prakrit: "तुज्झ 'ङ्गराअसेसेण सामली तह खरेण सोमारा,सा किर गोलातूहे ण्हाआ जंवूकसाएण"

prakrit: "चिरिडिं पि अआणन्ता लोआ लोएहि गोरवब्भहिआ,सोणारतुल व्व णिरक्खरा वि खन्धेहि वुब्भन्ति"

prakrit: "आअंवन्तकवोलं खलिअक्खरजम्पिरिं फुरन्तॊट्ठिं,मा छिवसु त्ति सरोसं समोसरन्तिं पिअं भरिमो"

prakrit: "सा तइ सहत्थदिण्णं अज्ज वि रे सुहअ गन्धरहिअं पि,उव्वसिअणअरघरदेवअ व्व ओमालिअं वहइ"

prakrit: "केलीअ वि रूसेउं ण तीरए तम्मि चुक्कविणअम्मि,जाइअएहि वि माए इमेहि अवसेहि अङ्गेहिं"

prakrit: "उप्फुल्लिआइ खेलउ मा णं वारेहि होउ परिखामा,मा जहणभारगरुई पुरिसाअन्ती किलिम्मिहइ"
english: "Play bunny hops. Don't let them get in your way. They hurt when you push them aside."

prakrit: "पउरजुआणो गामो महुमासो जॊव्वणं पई ठेरो,जुण्णसुरा साहीणा असई मा होउ किं मरउ"
english: "The village is full of young men, The rainy season is getting younger, The hot summer is over, So why die?"

prakrit: "वहुसो वि कहिज्जन्तं तुह वअणं मज्झ हत्थसन्दिट्ठं,ण सुअं ति जम्पमाणा पुणरुत्तसअं कुणइ अज्जा"

prakrit: "पाअडिअणेहसब्भावणिब्भरं तीअ जह तुमं दिट्ठो,संवरणवावडाए अण्णो वि जणो तह च्चेअ"

prakrit: "गेण्हह पुलोअह इमं पहसिअवअणा पइस्स अप्पेइ,जाआ सुअपढमुब्भिण्णदन्तजुअलङ्किअं वोरं"

prakrit: "अच्छउ ता जणवाओ हिअअं चिअ अत्तणो तुह पमाणं,तह तं सि मन्दणेहो जह ण उवालम्भजॊग्गो सि"

prakrit: "अप्पच्छन्दपहाविर दुल्लहलम्भं जणं विमग्गन्त,आआसवहेहि भमन्त हिअअ कइआ वि भज्जिहिसि"

prakrit: "फुट्टन्तेण वि हिअएण मामि कह णिव्वरिज्जए तम्मि,अद्दाए पडिविंव व्व जम्मि दुक्खं ण सङ्कमइ"

prakrit: "पासासङ्की काओ णे 'च्छइ दिण्णं पि पहिअघरिणीए,ओणत्तकरअलोअलिअवलअमज्झट्ठिअं पिण्डं"

english: "Oh! the silence of those dark nights," said the girl, "Two or three of your friends stealthily wiping away the tears that had been shed by her."

prakrit: "तुह मुहसारिच्छं ण लहइ त्ति सम्पुण्णमण्डलो विहिणा,अण्णमअं व घडेउं पुणो वि खण्डिज्जइ मिअङ्को"

prakrit: "अज्जं गओ त्ति अज्जं गओ त्ति अज्जं गओ त्ति गणिरीए,पढम च्चिअ दिअहद्धे कुड्डो रेहाहि चित्तलिओ"
english: "Today he has gone, today he has come," said the countess. "Nowadays, dear girl, The lines on the wall Are blurred."

prakrit: "ण वि तह पढमसमागमसुरअसुहे पाविए वि परिओसो,जह वीअदिअहसविलक्खलक्खिए वअणकमलम्मि"
english: "The pleasure of that first night Was nothing compared to seeing your husband again."

prakrit: "जे समुहागअवोलन्तवलिअपिअपेसिअच्छिविच्छोहा,अह मण्णे मअणसरा जणस्स जे हॊन्ति ते हॊन्तु"
english: "Those who look at me with such longing As when I am alone, Are captivated by what I have and what I am about to experience."

prakrit: "इअरो जणो ण पावइ तुह जहणारुहणसङ्गमसुहॆल्लिं,अणुहवइ कणअदोरो हुअवहवरुणाण माहप्पं"
english: "The pleasure of riding your thighs Is for special people only. Take the golden girdle: It must be the God of Love"

prakrit: "जो जस्स विहवसारो तं सो देइ त्ति किं थ अच्छेरं,अणहॊन्तं पि हु दिण्णं दोहग्गं तइ सवत्तीणं"
english: "What good is it to give one's affections to another? But to give them to another would be an injustice."

prakrit: "चन्दसरिसं मुहं से सरसो अमअस्स मुहरसो तिस्सा,सकअग्गहरहसुज्जलचुंवणअं कस्स सरिसं से"
english: "The moonlit night is like a mustard seed with a nectar - like seal: Whom else can one match the scent of the sunshine?"

prakrit: "उप्पण्णत्थे कज्जे अइचिन्तन्तो गुणागुणे तम्मि,चिरआलमन्दपॆच्छित्तणेण पुरिसो हणइ कज्जं"
english: "When one ponders over one's duties, one always finds merit in them. But when one considers ones past, one forgets what one has done."

prakrit: "वालअ तुमाहि अहिअं णिअअं चिअ वल्लहं महं जीअं,तं तइ विणा ण होइ त्ति तेण कुविअं पसाएमि"
english: "Well, you're right, my dear, The more you like me the more I'll regret it if I don't have you."

prakrit: "पत्तिअ ण पत्तिअन्ती जइ तुज्झ इमे ण मज्झ रुइरीए,पुट्ठीअ वाहविन्दू पुलउब्भेए ण भिज्जन्ता"
english: "Don't cry for me If I don't have you in my arms. The water in your cupped hands Doesn't boil over Without spilling over." ""

prakrit: "तं मित्तं काअव्वं जं किर वसणम्मि देसआलम्मि,आलिहिअभित्तिवाउल्लअ व्व ण परंमुहं ठाइ"
english: "Make a friend of the man Who, wherever or whenever it may be, Stands by you in adversity."

prakrit: "वहुआइ णइणिउञ्जे पढमुग्गअसीलखण्डणविलक्खं,उड्डेइ विहङ्गउलं हाहा पक्खेहि व भणन्तं"
english: "The girl's breasts tremble When she sees the nail marks on her forehead: They look like spiky parrots Flying out of the hole in her back."

prakrit: "सच्चं भणामि वालअ ण त्थि असक्कं वसन्तमासस्स,गन्धेण कुरुवआणं मणं पि असइत्तनं ण गआ"
english: "I tell you the truth, spring is not quite there. The scent of the kuruva has not yet made me in the least unfaithful."

prakrit: "ऎक्कॆक्कमवइवेढणविवरन्तरदिण्णतरलणअणाए,तइ वोलन्ते वालअ पञ्जरसउणाइअं तीए"
english: "Every time she steps in front of you She can see you are slipping away." ""

prakrit: "ता किं करेउ जइ तं सि तीअ वइवेढपॆल्लिअथणीए,पाअङ्गुट्ठग्गुक्खित्तणीसहङ्गीअ वि ण दिट्ठो"
english: "What is she to do If, wobbling on tiptoe And squeezing her breasts against the fence, She still can't see you?"

prakrit: "पिअसम्भरणपलॊट्टन्तवाहधाराणिवाअभीआए,दिज्जइ वङ्कग्गीवाइ दीवओ पहिअजाआए"
english: "Fearful of the stream of tears Rolling down her face, She turns her head aside While the lamp is turned on."

prakrit: "तइ वोलन्ते वालअ तिस्सा अङ्गाइ तह णु वलिआइं,जह पुट्ठिमज्झणिवडन्तवाहधाराउ दीसन्ति"
english: "On your way back you twisted round so many limbs That the stream of tears running down your back could see."

prakrit: "ता मज्झिमॊ च्चिअ वरं दुज्जणसुअणेहि दोहि वि ण कज्जं,जह दिट्ठो तवइ खलो तहेअ सुअणो अईसन्तो"
english: "So please, my poor girl, There's nothing wrong with being nice to each other, For if you lose sight of one thing, You'd better be nice to one another."

prakrit: "अद्धच्छिपॆच्छिअं मा करेहि साहाविअं पलोएहि,सो वि सुदिट्ठो होहिइ तुमं पि मुद्धा कलिज्जिहिसि"
english: "Don't be so hasty: you'll make a fool of yourself If you don't do as well as you think you do."

prakrit: "दिअहं खुडुक्किआए तीए काऊण गेहवावारं,गरुए वि मण्णुदुक्खे भरिमो पाअन्तसुत्तस्स"
english: "I will never forget How, for all her resentment, She dropped off at my feet Like wheat flour."

prakrit: "पाणउडीअ वि जलिऊण हुअवहो जलइ जण्णवाडम्मि,ण हु ते परिहरिअव्वा विसमदसासण्ठिआ पुरिसा"
english: "The fire that burns in the outcast's house Is a burning fire: There is nothing wrong with that, my dear."

prakrit: "जं तुज्झ सई जाआ असईओ सुहअ जं च अम्हे वि,ता किं फुट्टउ वीअं तुज्झ समाणो जुआ ण त्थि"
english: "The reason why your wife is still with us Is obvious, my dear: There's no other young man like you."

prakrit: "सव्वस्सम्मि वि डड्ढे तह वि हु हिअअस्स णिव्वुइ च्चेअ,जं तेन गामडाहे हत्थाहत्थिं कुडो गहिओ"
english: "Even though everything I had went up in flames I am overjoyed. For he took the axe from my hand In this village."

prakrit: "जाऎज्ज वणुद्देसे खुज्जो वि हु णीसहो सिढिलवत्तो,मा माणुसम्मि लोए चाई रसिओ दरिद्दो अ"
english: "Though I am happy in the wilderness I am content on the bare steps. Therefore, in this world, do not trouble yourself: You are a poor man."

prakrit: "तस्स अ सोहग्गगुणं अमहिलसरिसं च साहसं मज्झ,जाणइ गोलाऊरो वासारत्तद्धरत्तो अ"
english: "His unmanly bliss And my unwomanly boldness Are known only to the swollen waters of the Goda"

prakrit: "ते वोलिआ वअस्सा ताण कुडुङ्गाण खण्णुआ सेसा,अम्हे वि गअवआओ मूलुच्छेअं गअं पॆम्मं"
english: "That volley of arrows, Which pierced the bow of that bow, Is nothing compared to the thrashing of the horn of love."

prakrit: "थणजहणणिअंवोवरि णहरङ्का गअवआण विलआणं,उव्वसिआणङ्गणिवासमूलवन्ध व्व दीसन्ति"
english: "The breasts of women wearing plumes of nectar Look like bracelets affixed to the ends of their thighs."

prakrit: "जस्स जहिं चिअ पढमं तिस्सा अङ्गम्मि णिवडिआ दिट्ठी,तस्स तहिं चेअ ठिआ सव्वङ्गं केण वि ण दिट्ठं"
english: "Wherever one's eye falls first There it stays. No one has ever seen the whole of it."

prakrit: "विरहे विसं व विसमा अमअमआ होइ सङ्गमे अहिअं,किं विहिणा समअं चिअ दोहिं पि पिआ विणिम्मविआ"
english: "Separation is like a poison, Dissolution is like nectar; Together we come, separated we fall."

prakrit: "अद्दंसणेण पुत्तअ सुट्ठु वि णेहाणुवन्धघडिआइं,हत्थउडपाणिआइ व कालेण गलन्ति पॆम्माइं"
english: "My son, Even if you sleep tight, Your hands are tied behind your back, And when you go out your hands are wet."

prakrit: "पइपुरऒ च्चिअ णिज्जइ विञ्छुअडट्ठे 'ति जारवॆज्जघरं,णिउणसहीकरधरिआ भुअजुअलन्दोलिरी वाला"
english: "Before her husband's eyes the scorpion peeped through the house, Like a handmaiden's bracelet Wrapped around her waist." ""

prakrit: "विक्किणइ माहमासंमि पामरो पारिडिं वइल्लेण,णिद्धूममुम्मुरे सामलीअ थणए णिअच्छन्तो"
english: "It's the first month of the year: The farmer is busy parading the plow, He wants to see his wife's breasts After she has had a good sleep."

prakrit: "सच्चं भणामि मरणे ठिअ म्हि पुण्णे तडम्मि तावीए,अज्ज वि तत्थ कुडुङ्गे णिवडइ दिट्ठी तह च्चेअ"
english: "I swear that even in death I will never forget how, even now, My gaze falls, as ever, On that damned pond."

prakrit: "अन्धअरवोरपत्थिं व माउआ मह पइं विलुम्पन्ति,ईसाअन्ति मह च्चिअ छॆप्पाहिन्तो फणो जाओ"
english: "Mother - in - law, My husband leaves me in the dark. At the same time, go upstairs To hide me." ""

prakrit: "अप्पत्तपत्तअं पाविऊण णवरङ्गअं हलिअसोण्हा,उअह तणुई ण माअइ रुन्दासु वि गामरच्छासु"
english: "Aunt, A plowman's daughter, Wearing a freshly dyed dress, Is crying loudly But does not see her village." ""

prakrit: "वक्खेवआइ पिअजम्पिआइ परहिअअणिव्वुइअराइ,विरलो हु जाणइ जणो उप्पण्णे जम्पिअव्वाइं"
english: "Venerable women, Who after growing up Have grown so thin On their husbands'behalf, Rarely do I know a man Who has grown so tall On his own"

prakrit: "छज्जइ पहुस्स ललिअं पिआइ माणो खमा समत्थस्स,जाणन्तस्स अ भणिअं मोणं च अआणमाणस्स"
english: "Pride leads to greed, Forgiveness leads to complacency, And falsehood leads to dishonesty"

prakrit: "वेविरसिण्णकरङ्गुलिपरिग्गहक्खलिअलेगणीमग्गे,सॊत्थि च्चिअ ण समप्पइ पिअसहि लेहम्मि किं लिहिमो"
english: "Dear friend, I can't finish this letter. What shall I write next?" he whispered.

prakrit: "दॆव्वम्मि पराहुत्ते पत्तिअ घडिअं पि विहडइ णराणं,कज्जं वालुअवरणं व कह वि वन्धं चिअ ण देइ"
english: "The devil chases after the parrot, But at the same moment it turns its back on the doe, Which, for some reason, does not want to be bound."

prakrit: "मामि हिअअं व पीअं तेण जुआणेण मज्जमाणाए,ण्हाणहलिद्दाकडुअं अणुसॊत्त जलं पिअन्तेण"
english: "Mother, That young man Who downriver drank the water That was bitter with my turmeric soap Did not dare to drink it."

prakrit: "जिविअं असासअं चिअ ण णिअत्तइ जॊव्वणं अइक्कन्तं,दिअहा दिअहेहि समा ण हॊन्ति किं णिट्ठुरो लोओ"
english: "Life is transient, Youth passes never to return, Tomorrow is not the same as today. So why are people so stubborn?"

prakrit: "उप्पाइअदव्वाण वि खलाण को भाअणं खलॊ च्चेअ,पिक्काइ वि णिंवफलाइ णवर काएहि खज्जन्ति"
english: "Even the most generous of people find fault with a poor man's speech; Even the pickiest of people squander the fruits of their anger For no other reason."

prakrit: "अज्ज मए गन्तव्वं घणन्धआरे वि तस्स सुहअस्स,अज्जा णिमीलिअच्छी पअपरिवाडिं घरे कुणइ"
english: "Today, when I reach my destination It's still pleasant to be there," She says, rubbing her eyelid Against the wall of her house.

prakrit: "सुअणो ण कुप्पइ च्चिअ अह कुप्पइ विप्पिअं ण चिन्तेइ,अह चिन्तेइ ण जम्पइ अह जम्पइ लज्जिओ होइ"
english: "A gentleman never gets angry; When he gets angry he never has nasty thoughts. When he has naughty thoughts he never expresses them: When he expresses them he is ashamed of himself."

prakrit: "सो अत्थो जो हत्थे तं मित्तं जं णिरन्तरं वसणे,तं रूअं जत्थ गुणा तं विण्णाणं जहिं धम्मो"
english: "So the friend who has a hand, The one who resides forever, Is as numerous as the sky in which dharma is practiced."

prakrit: "चन्दमुहि चन्दधवला दीहा दीहच्छि तुह विओअम्मि,चउजामा सअजाम व्व जामिणी कह वि वोलीणा"
english: "The moon is bright, The moonlit night is long, In your absence I will never forget how quickly the nights get longer."

prakrit: "अउलीणो दोमुहओ ता महुरो भोअणं मुहे जाव,मुरओ व्व खलो जिण्णम्मि भोअणे विरसम आरसइ"
english: "When a woman has two faces She turns her face away, When a man has three."

prakrit: "तह सोण्हाइ पुलइओ दरवलिआवङ्गतारअं पहिओ,जह वारिओ वि घरसामिएण आलिन्दए वसिओ"
english: "So did the traveler's daughter - in - law, Whom the master of the house had made his abode embracing, At the sound of the doorbell."

prakrit: "लहुअन्ति लहुं पुरिसं पव्वअमॆत्तं पि दो वि कज्जाइं,णिव्वरणम अणिव्वूढे णिव्वूढे जं अणिव्वरणं"
english: "Love is like a lotus, Like the pearl of a man's hand, But it serves two purposes: To renew, To restore, And to restore."

prakrit: "कं तुङ्गथणुक्खित्तेण पुत्ति दारट्ठिआ पलोएसि,उण्णामिअकलसणिवेसिअग्घकमलेण व मुहेण"
english: "Why are you staring out the window at me With such longing? It's as if you're sitting on top of a lotus Placed in front of your eyes."

prakrit: "वइविवरणिग्गअदलो एरण्डो साहइ व्व तरुणाणं,ऎत्थ घरे हलिअवहू ऎद्दहमॆत्तत्थणी वसइ"
english: "Aunt, Here lives a plowman's wife With young men in her arms."

prakrit: "गअकलहकुम्भसंणिहघणपीणणिरन्तरेहि तुङ्गेहिं,गूससिउं पि ण तीरइ किं पुण गन्तुं हअथणेहिं"
english: "Goose pimples, Tears running down her cheeks, Sweating profusely, Can't take it anymore?" ""

prakrit: "मासपसूअं छम्मासगब्भिणिं ऎक्कदिअहजरिअं च,रङ्गुत्तिण्णं च पिअं पुत्तअ कामन्तओ होहि"
english: "Dear son, Where are you going? It's summer, Spring, autumn, and the moonlight of the sky?"

prakrit: "पडिवक्खमण्णुपुञ्जे लावण्णउडे अणङ्गगअकुम्भे,पुरिससअहिअअधरिए कीस थणन्ती थणे वहसि"
english: "You silly girl, Why are you twisting your skirt so much In front of the men?"

prakrit: "घरिणीघणथणपॆल्लणसुहॆल्लिपडिअस्स हॊन्तपहिअस्स,अवसउणङ्गारअवारविट्ठिदिअहा सुहावेन्ति"
english: "The pleasures of love, Which at first glance seem to find their way into the hearts of housewives, Now, with sighs and groans, Appear to me as pleasant as day."

prakrit: "सा तुज्झ कए वालअ अणिसं घरदारतोरणणिसण्णा,ओसूसइ वन्दणमालिअ व्व दिअहं चिअ वराई"
english: "She is your daughter - in - law, Standing in the doorway Looking out for you, Bowing her head As if she were the bridegroom of the day."

prakrit: "हसिअं सहत्थतालं सुक्खवडं उवगएहि पहिएहिं,पत्तअफलाण सरिसे उड्डीणे पूसविन्दम्मि"
english: "Laughing and clapping, The wheels seem to be drying up, Like a bunch of fruit falling from a flight of leaves At the sound of a trumpet."

prakrit: "अज्ज म्हि हासिआ मामि तेण पाएसु तह पडन्तेण,तीए वि जलन्तिं दीववत्तिम अब्भुत्तअन्तीए"
english: "Today I smiled, Mother - in - law, The moment I saw her I could not help laughing."

prakrit: "अणुवत्तणं कुणन्तो वेसे वि जणे अहिण्णमुहराओ,अप्पवसो वि हु सुअणो परव्वसो आहिआईए"
english: "One who practices good manners is just like anyone else; one who does not practice good men is already a good man."

prakrit: "अणुदिअहवड्ढिआअर विण्णाणगुणेहि जणिअमाहप्पो,पुत्तअ अहिआअजणो विरज्जमाणो वि दुल्लक्खो"
english: "My son, Don't overdo it. Even in your absence You seem to have mastered the subtleties of nature."

prakrit: "विण्णाणगुणमहग्घे पुरिसे वेसत्तणं पि रमणिज्जं,जणणिन्दिए उण जणे पिअत्तणेणा 'वि लज्झामो"
english: "Though I am handsome, I am ashamed that I have ever worn such a thing In my life."

prakrit: "कह णाम तीअ तह सो सहावगरुओ वि थणहरो पडिओ,अहवा महिलाण चिरं को वि ण हिअअम्मि सण्ठाइ"
english: "How come that her breasts, which were so firm at the time, now sag like this?" asked the woman, Not caring what people might say to her.

prakrit: "सुअनु वअणं छिवन्तं सूरं मा साउलीअ वारेहि,एअस्स पङ्कअस्स अ जाणउ कअरं सुहप्फंसं"
english: "Daughter - in - law, Don't cover your face with your shawl. Let the sun find out which is more pleasant To touch." ""

prakrit: "माणोसहं व पिज्जइ पिआइ माणंसिणीअ दइअस्स,करसम्पुडवलिउद्धाणणाइ मइराइ गण्डूसो"

english: "Tears were streaming down her cheeks, She could see the traveler's hands Slipping off her hips." ""

prakrit: "णक्खुक्खुडिअं सहआरमञ्जरिं पामरस्स सीसम्मि,वन्दिं मिव हीरन्तिं भमरजुआणा अणुसरन्ति"
english: "A swarm of bees pursues the mango blossom In the middle of the thicket, Like a flock of young henchmen."

prakrit: "सूरच्छलेण पुत्तअ कस्स तुमं अञ्जलिं पणामेसि,हासकडक्खुम्मिस्सा ण हॊन्ति देवाण जॊक्कारा"
english: "My son, Who are you to blame? A laughing woman Wouldn't play the God of Jokes." ""

prakrit: "मुहविज्झविअपईवं णिरुद्धसासं ससङ्किउल्लावं,सवहसअरक्खिऒट्ठं चोरिअरमिअं सुहावेइ"
english: "May the God of Love, Who protects all beings, Give pleasure to the stolen eye"

prakrit: "गेअच्छलेण भरिउं कस्स तुमं रुअसि णिब्भरुक्कण्ठं,मण्णुपडिरुद्धकण्ठद्धणिन्तखलिअक्खरुल्लावं"

prakrit: "वहलतमाहअराई अज्ज पउत्थो पई घरं सुण्णं,तह जग्गेसु सअज्जिअ ण जहा अम्हे मुसिज्जामो"
english: "It's pitch - dark outside, My husband left today, And the house is deserted. Please, neighbor, do keep watch: I don't want to be burgled."

prakrit: "सञ्जीवणोसहं मिव सुअस्स रक्खइ अणण्णवावारा,सासू णवब्भदंसणकण्ठागअजीविअं सोण्हं"
english: "Life is dear to me, My husband is alive, Protecting my life, Like a good mother at the sight of her newborn son."

prakrit: "णूणं हिअअणिहित्ताइ वससि जाआइ अम्ह हिअअम्मि,अण्णह मणोरहा मे साहसु कह तीअ विण्णाआ"
english: "You live in my heart With your wife locked in your own, So how can you explain it to me?"

prakrit: "तइ सुहअ अईसन्ते तिस्सा अच्छीहि कण्णलग्गेहिं,दिण्णं घोलिरवाहेहि पाणिअं दंसणसुहाणं"
english: "You look so well, Your eyes are glued to my cheeks, The water in my eyes Succeeds in closing my eyes."

prakrit: "उप्पॆक्खागअ तुह मुहदंसणपडिरुद्धजीविआसाइ,दुहिआइ मए कालो कॆत्तिअमॆत्तो व्व णेअव्वो"
english: "How much longer can I go on In this misery, My will to live dependent On seeing your face Revealed?"

prakrit: "वोलीणालक्खिअरूअजॊव्वणा पुत्ति कं ण दूमेसि,दिट्ठा पणट्ठपोराणजणवआ जम्मभूमि व्व"
english: "You silly girl, Don't hurt the young man. When he sees you He is just like a farmer's son." ""

prakrit: "परिओसविअसिएहिं भणिअं अच्छीहि तेण जणमज्झे,पडिवण्णं तीअ वि उव्वमन्तसेएहि अङ्गेहिं"
english: "She said to herself," "It's all right, my dear." "When he said that, She looked away, And then her limbs trembled."

prakrit: "ऎक्कक्कमसन्देसाणुराअवड्ढन्तकोउहल्लाइं,दुक्खं असमत्तमणोरहाइ अच्छन्ति मिहुणाइं"
english: "The pleasures of loneliness, Like an endless stream of tears, Are irresistible to the heart."

prakrit: "जइ सो ण वल्लहॊ च्चिअ गॊत्तग्गहणेण तस्स सहि कीस,होइ मुहं ते रविअरफंसविसट्टं व तामरसं"
english: "If he is not dear to you, tell me, my friend, How come that at the mere mention of his name Your face opens like a lotus Touched by the rays of the sun?"

prakrit: "माणदुमपरुसपवणस्स मामि सव्वङ्गणिव्वुइअरस्स,अवऊहणस्स भद्दं रइणाडअपुव्वरङ्गस्स"
english: "Proud mother, All my affection is for your husband, Not for nothing is the forest on fire Covered with acacia flowers."

prakrit: "णिअआणुमाणणीसङ्क हिअअ दे पसिअ विरम ऎत्ताहे,अमुणिअपरमत्थजणाणुलग्ग कीस म्ह लहुएसि"
english: "Dear friend, Please lift me up from my slumber. Why are you bothering about knowing the true meaning of love?"

prakrit: "ओसहिअजणो पइणा सलाहमाणेण अइचिरं हसिओ,चन्दो त्ति तुज्झ वअणे विइण्णकुसुमञ्जलिविलक्खो"
english: "That man's advice to your wife: Laugh all the time, For the moon looks like a lotus Bleached by your lips."

prakrit: "झिज्जन्तेहि अणुदिणं पच्चक्खम्मि वि तुमम्मि अङ्गेहिं,वालअ पुच्छिज्जन्ती ण आणिमो कस्स किं भणिमो"
english: "If you ask me,'Why my body grows thinner by the day, I don't know what to say to whom."

prakrit: "अङ्गाणं तणुआरअ सिक्खावअ दीहरोइअव्वाणं,विणआइक्कमआरअ मा मा णं पम्हसिज्जासु"
english: "First you taught me how to weep, Then you made me drink. Then I told you how long it would take for me To weep."

prakrit: "अण्णह ण तीरइ च्चिअ परिवड्ढन्तगरुअं पिअअमस्स,मरणविणोएण विणा विरमावेउं विरहदुक्खं"
english: "There is no end to it, my dear, For the grief of separation Leaves me without a will to die."

prakrit: "वण्णन्तीहि तुह गुणे वहुसो अम्हेहि छिञ्छईपुरओ,वालअ सअम एअ कओ सि दुल्लहो कस्स कुप्पामो"
english: "You're the only one who knows how to describe yourself, my darling. Whom else can I blame?"

prakrit: "जाओ सो वि विलक्खो मए वि हसिऊण गाढम उवऊढो,पढमोसरिअस्स णिअंसणस्स गण्ठिं विमग्गन्तो"
english: "He was embarrassed But I laughed and gave him a hug When he groped for the knot Of my skirt and found it Already undone." ""

prakrit: "कण्डुज्जुआ वराई अज्ज तए सा कआवराहेण,अलसाइअरुण्णविअम्भिआइ दिअहेण सिक्खविआ"
english: "The poor thing is a poor girl, Today she is a criminal, Tomorrow she will teach you how to weep."

prakrit: "अवराहेहि वि ण तहा पत्तिअ जह मं इमेहि दुम्मेसि,अवहत्थिअसब्भावेहि सुहअ दक्खिण्णभणिएहिं"
english: "Dear friend, The wrongs you have done me Are nothing like as hurtful As these polite words devoid of true feeling."

prakrit: "मा जूर पिआलिङ्गणसरहसभमिरीण वाहुलइआणं,तुण्हिक्क परुण्णेनं इमिणा माणंसिणि मुहेणं"
english: "Do not scold your wife for wearing a skirt That does not suit you."

prakrit: "मा वच्च पुप्फलाविर देवा उअअञ्जलीहि तूसन्ति,गोलाणईअ पुत्तअ सीलुम्मूलाइ कूलाइं"
english: "My son, don't go picking flowers. The gods will spice it up, And the angels will spit on it." ""

prakrit: "वअणे वअणम्मि चलन्तसीससुण्णावहाणहुङ्कारं,सहि देन्ती णीसासन्तरेसु कीस म्ह दूमेसि"
english: "Why are you bothering me While my face is still smeared with red ghee? You know what I mean when you tell me you're pregnant."

prakrit: "सब्भावं पुच्छन्ती वालअ रोआविआ तुह पिआए,ण त्थि च्चिअ कअसवहं हासुम्मिस्सं भणन्तीए"
english: "You fool, When I asked what had really happened The girl's reply brought tears to my eyes:" "There's nothing wrong with saying that." ""

prakrit: "ऎत्थ मए रमिअव्वं तीअ समं चिन्तिऊण हिअएण,पामरकरसेउल्ला णिवडइ तुवरी वविज्जन्ती"
english: "Here I am, Thinking the same way as her: The husks of a palm leaf Slipping off Like specks of turmeric." ""

prakrit: "गहवइसुऒच्चिएसु वि फलहीवॆण्टेसु उअह वहुआइ,मोहं भमइ पुलइओ विलग्गसेअङ्गुली हत्थो"
english: "Look! The landowner's son has already plucked the cotton But his young daughter - in - law is wasting away, Losing all trace of her favorite."

prakrit: "अज्जं मोहणसुहिअं मुअ त्ति मॊत्तुं पलाइए हलिए,दरफुडिअवॆण्टभारोणआइ हसिअं व फलहीए"
english: "Today, my dear, all I have to do is run away, Thinking how pleasantly surprised I am To see the plowman's wife smile and pluck up the fruit."

prakrit: "णीसासुक्कम्पिअपुलइएहि जाणन्ति णच्चिउं धण्णा,अम्हारिसीहि दिट्ठे पिअम्मि अप्पा वि वीसरिओ"
english: "Lucky are they who catch a glimpse of you, Lucky are the ones who know how to dance. When they see you They completely forget about you."

prakrit: "तणुएण वि तणुइज्जइ खीणेण वि खिज्जए वला इमिणा,मज्झत्थेण वि मज्झेण पुत्ति कह तुज्झ पडिवक्खो"
english: "Because you are thin, You are delicate, And because you are fragile, You make me miserable. How can I ever forgive you, my son?"

prakrit: "वाहि व्व वॆज्जरहिओ धणरहिओ सअणमज्झवासो व्व,रिउरिद्धिदंसणं मिव दूसहणीओ तुह विओओ"
english: "Wayfarer, traveler, Friend of mine, The sight of you alone makes it difficult for me To bear your absence."

prakrit: "को त्थ जअम्मि समत्थो थइउं वित्थिण्णणिम्मलुत्तुङ्गं,हिअअं तुज्झ णराहिव गअणं व पओहरे मॊत्तुं"
english: "How can I help you If you refuse to budge? Your whole body is a mass of mud, Like the nail marks on your cheek."

prakrit: "आअण्णेइ अडअणा कुडुङ्गहॆट्ठम्मि दिण्णसङ्केआ,अग्गपअपॆल्लिआणं मम्मरअं जुण्णपत्ताणं"
english: "Dear friend, The fire that burns in your heart, Stirred by the rays of the sun, Is the ruin of my old self."

prakrit: "अहिलेन्ति सुरहिणीससिअपरिमलावद्धमण्डलं भमरा,अमुणिअचन्दपरिहवं अपुव्वकमलं मुहं तिस्सा"
english: "Now behold, Bees cover the whole circumference of your face With lotuses That do not open When the moon is full."

prakrit: "धीरावलंविरीअ वि गुरुअणपुरओ तुमम्मि वोलीणे,पडिओ से अच्छिणिमीलणेण पम्हट्ठिओ वाहो"
english: "In front of her parents She showed no emotion When you passed by, But a tear that clung to her lashes Fell when she closed her eyes."

prakrit: "भरिमो से सअणपरंमुहीअ विअलन्तमाणपसराइ,कइअवसुत्तुव्वत्तणथणअलसप्पॆल्लणसुहॆल्लिं"
english: "I will never forget how she turned her back on me, When I tried to kiss her again And again."

prakrit: "फग्गुच्छवणिद्दोसं केण वि कद्दमपसाहणं दिण्णं,थणअलसमुहपलॊट्टन्तसेअधोअं किणो धुअसि"
english: "Why are you trying to wash away that powder Which someone foolishly threw at you? It has already been washed away by the sweat Streaming off the nipples."

prakrit: "किं ण भणिओ सि वालअ गामणिधूआइ गुरुअणसमक्खं,अणिमिसम ईसीसि वलन्तवअणणअणद्धतिट्ठेहिं"
english: "What do you mean she didn't say anything to you? It was the village headman's daughter - in - law's face. She stammered so much that she could not help laughing." ""

prakrit: "णअणब्भन्तरघोलन्तवाहभरमन्थराइ दिट्ठीए,पुणरुत्तपॆच्छरीए वालअ किं जं ण भणिओ सि"
english: "You silly girl, How can you say she didn't say a word? She looked at you all the time But her eyes were red." ""

prakrit: "जो सीसम्मि विइण्णो मज्झ जुआणेहि गणवई आसि,तं चिअ एण्हिं पणमामि हअजरे होहि सन्तुट्ठा"
english: "One who has sown seeds must first be grazed by young men; today I promise he will be satisfied with just that."

prakrit: "अन्तोहुत्तं डज्झइ जाआसुण्णे घरे हलिअउत्तो,उक्खाअणिहाणाइ व रमिअट्ठाणाइ पॆच्छन्तो"
english: "In the house left empty by his wife's death The plowman is consumed by grief, Staring at where they used to make love As though at hiding places destroyed by fire."

prakrit: "णिद्दाभङ्गो आवण्डुरत्तणं दीहरा अ णीसासा,जाअन्ति जस्स विरहे तेण समं कीरिसो माणो"
english: "The nights are long and the nights uneventful. But how can one be as proud As one who is separated?"

prakrit: "तेण ण मरामि मण्णूहि पूरिआ अज्ज जेण रे सुहअ,तग्गअमणा मरन्ती मा तुज्झ पुणो वि लग्गिस्सं"
english: "That does not make me wretch, my dear. But as soon as I die I will dedicate myself to you again."

prakrit: "अवरज्झसु वीसद्धं सव्वं ते सुहअ विसहिमो अम्हे,गुणणिब्भरम्मि हिअए पत्तिअ दोसा ण माअन्ति"
english: "Do your worst, have no fear: I can take anything from you, my dear. In my heart, so brimful of your virtues, There is no room for any faults."

prakrit: "भरिउच्चरन्तपसरिअपिअसम्भरणपिसुणो वराईए,परिवाहो विअ दुक्खस्स वहइ णअणट्ठिओ वाहो"
english: "Tears flow from her eyes, Wafting from anger to anger, Like tears streaming down the cheeks of a woman in distress."

prakrit: "जं जं करेसि जं जं जम्पसि जह जह तुमं णिअच्छेसि,तं तम अणुसिक्खिरीए दीहो दिअहो ण सम्पडइ"
english: "Everything you do, Everything you say, Every trick of your eyes - One day is too short."

prakrit: "भण्डन्तीअ तणाइं सॊत्तुं दिण्णाइ जाइ पहिअस्स,ताइ च्चेअ पहाए अज्जा आअड्ढइ रुअन्ती"
english: "The traveler has become so addicted to gossip That he suddenly bursts into tears." ""

prakrit: "वसणम्मि अणुव्विग्गा विहवम्मि अगव्विआ भए धीरा,हॊन्ति अहिण्णसहावा समेसु विसमेसु सप्पुरिसा"
english: "Be patient if the stream is uneven, Be vigilant when it is wide, Be careful not to fall into trouble When you are alone."

prakrit: "अज्ज सहि केण गोसे कं पि मणे वल्लहं भरन्तेण,अम्हं मअणसराहअहिअअवणप्फोडणं गीअं"

prakrit: "उट्ठन्तमहारम्भे थणए दट्ठूण मुद्धवहुआए,ओसण्णकवोलाए णीससिअं पढमघरिणीए"
english: "When she saw the high breasts Of her husband's new wife The first wife sighed And her face fell."

prakrit: "गरुअछुहाउलिअस्स वि वल्लहकरिणीमुहं भरन्तस्स,सरसो मुणालकवलो गअस्स हत्थॆ च्चिअ मिलाणो"
english: "Gorgeous girl, Face to face, Mustard seed, black lotus, Are you ready to meet your lover?"

prakrit: "पसिअ पिए का कुविआ सुअणु तुमं परअणम्मि को कोवो,को हु परो णाह तुमं कीस अउण्णाण मे सत्ती"
english: "You silly girl, Why are you so angry at your lover, Who is jealous of you And why aren't you angry with yourself?"

prakrit: "एहिसि तुमं ति णिमिसं व जग्गिअं जामिणीअ पढमद्धं,सेसं सन्तावपरव्वसाइ वरिसं व वोलीणं"
english: "That's how you stay awake three minutes, First thing in the morning, Then later on the following morning." ""

prakrit: "अवलंवह मा सङ्कह ण इमा गहलङ्घिआ परिब्भमइ,अत्थक्कगज्जिउब्भन्तहित्थहिअआ पहिअजाआ"
english: "Catch her! No need to be afraid of this woman Running around in circles: She is not possessed by a demon, Just a traveler's wife Startled by a sudden thunderclap."

prakrit: "केसररअविच्छड्डे मअरन्दो होइ जॆत्तिओ कमले,जइ भमर तॆत्तिओ अण्णहिं पि ता सोहसि भमन्तो"
english: "A swarm of gnats is as lethal as a flock of geese: If the swarm is too thin, You'd better rejoice." ""

prakrit: "पॆच्छन्ति अणिमिसच्छा पहिआ हलिअस्स पिट्ठपण्डुरिअं,धूअं दुद्धसमुद्दुत्तरन्तलच्छिं विअ सअण्हा"
english: "The traveler looks down at the plowman's back, Unsure how long he has to walk, Smoke rising from the milkmaid's lap." ""

prakrit: "कह मे परिणइआले खलसङ्गो होहिइ त्ति चिन्तन्तो,ओणअमुहो ससूओ रुअइ व साली तुसारेण"
english: "Whom do you think I am playing with when I'm pregnant?" his mother-in-law burst into tears As she kissed him on the mouth.

prakrit: "सञ्झाराऒत्थइओ दीसइ गअणम्मि पडिवआचन्दो,रत्तदुऊलन्तरिओ थणणहलेहो व्व णववहूए"
english: "The waning moon veiled by the moonlight at dawn Looks like the nail mark on the young bride's bosom Showing through in the thick blood."

prakrit: "अइ दिअर किं ण पॆच्छसि आआसं किं मुहा पलोएसि,जाआइ वाहुमूलम्मि अद्धअन्दाण परिवाडिं"
english: "Oh! dear! why don't you see me? What do you expect of my face? It's like walking around in complete darkness." ""

prakrit: "वाआइ किं भणिज्जउ कॆत्तिअमॆत्तं व लिक्खए लेहे,तुह विरहे जं दुक्खं तस्स तुमं चेअ गहिअत्थो"
english: "How can I put it in words? One can say so little in a letter. But the sorrow I feel in your absence Is something you know of yourself."

prakrit: "मअणग्गिणो व्व धूमं मोहणपिच्छिं व लोअदिट्ठीए,जॊव्वणधअं व मुद्धा वहइ सुअन्धं चिउरभारं"
english: "Like a bunch of peacock's tail feathers, Like a column of smoke rising from the fire of love, Like the pearl of youth Waved by the conjuror to distract his audience, This is the burden of a happy wife."

prakrit: "रूअं सिट्ठं चिअ से असेसपुरिसे णिअत्तिअच्छेण,वाहॊल्लेण इमीए अजम्पमाणेण वि मुहेण"
english: "With tears streaming down her cheeks She could not help laughing But turn her back on him As she tried to kiss his cheek."

prakrit: "रुन्दारविन्दमन्दिरमअरन्दाणन्दिआलिरिञ्छोली,झणझणइ कसणमणिमेहल व्व महुमासलच्छीए"
english: "The line of bees around the lotus is like a rainbow illuminated by the rays of the moon."

prakrit: "कस्स करो वहुपुण्णप्फलॆक्कतरुणो तुहं विसम्मिहइ,थणपरिणाहे मम्महणिहाणकलसे व्व पारोहो"
english: "What are you doing? You're making a mess of it, Your breasts look like potsherds Stuck in the mud."

prakrit: "चोरा सभअसतण्हं पुणो पुणो पेसअन्ति दिट्ठीओ,अहिरक्खिअणिहिकलसे व्व पोढवइआथनुच्छङ्गे"
english: "Thieves repeatedly steal glances at me As if they were potsherds protecting me."

prakrit: "उव्वहइ णवतणङ्कुररोमञ्चपसाहिआइ अङ्गाइं,पाउसलच्छीअ पओहरेहि परिपॆल्लिओ विञ्झो"
english: "Look! There are new conch shells on the horizon, Feathered on the raindrops, Scorched by the first rays of the sun."

prakrit: "आम वहला वणाली मुहला जलरङ्कुणो जलं सिसिरं,अण्णणईण वि रेवाइ तह वि अण्णे गुणा के वि"
english: "Aunt, The water in the mango grove Is like a sesame field covered with acacia flowers, Visible even to the naked eye But incomprehensible only to the untrained eye."

prakrit: "एह इमीअ णिअच्छह परिणअमालूरसच्छहे थणए,तुङ्गे सप्पुरिसमणोरहे व्व हिअए अमाअन्ते"
english: "Oh! what a miserly woman! Your breasts are like pearls in a garland of emeralds: They are immortalised like the lotuses of a snake."

prakrit: "हत्थाहत्थिं अहम अहमिआइ वासागमम्मि मेहेहिं,अव्वो किं पि रहस्सं छण्णं पि णहङ्गणं गलइ"
english: "Aunt, It's too early to tell what I think, But there's something mysterious brewing In the kitchen." ""

prakrit: "कॆत्तिअमॆत्तं होहिइ सोहग्गं पिअअमस्स भमिरस्स,महिलामअणछुहाउलकडक्खविक्खेवघॆप्पन्तं"
english: "How much happiness Can my errant husband get From the moment he touches me While my eyes are glued to his cheeks?"

prakrit: "णिअधणिअं उवऊहसु कुक्कुडसद्देण झत्ति पडिवुद्धो,परवसहिवाससङ्किर णिअए वि घरम्मि मा भासु"
english: "You fool, Don't be so naïve: You live in another man's house, And he in yours."

prakrit: "खरपवणरअगलत्थिअगिरिऊडावडणभिण्णदेहस्स,धुक्काधुक्कइ जीअं व विज्जुआ कालमेहस्स"
english: "A swarm of grasshoppers, Flying down from the sky, Scorches the ground Like smoke rising from a lightning bolt."

prakrit: "मेहमहिसस्स णज्जइ उअरे सुरचावकोडिभिण्णस्स,कन्दन्तस्स सविअणं अन्तं व पलंवए विज्जू"
english: "May the rainy season wither, may the dry deciduous forest dry up, May the raptures cease, And may the arrows of the God of Love escape"

prakrit: "णवपल्लवं विसण्णा पहिआ पॆच्छन्ति चूअरुक्खस्स,कामस्स लोहिउप्पङ्गराइअं हत्थभल्लं व"
english: "The traveler's wife is so busy picking flowers That he licks them with his hands When he tries to kiss her breasts." ""

prakrit: "महिलाणं चिअ दोसो जेण पवासम्मि गव्विआ पुरिसा,दो तिण्णि जाव ण मरन्ति ता ण विरहा समप्पन्ति"
english: "Women are to blame only because their husbands are poor. But if two or three of them die There will be no more separation."

prakrit: "वालअ दे वच्च लहुं मरइ वराई अलं विलंवेण,सा तुज्झ दंसणेण वि जीवॆज्ज ण ऎत्थ सन्देहो"
english: "Fool, the poor girl is dying. Stop dragging your feet. The mere sight of you will revive her. No doubt of it." ""

prakrit: "तंमिरपसरिअहुअवहजालोलिपलीविए वणाभोए,किंसुअवणं ति कलिऊण मुद्धहरिणो ण णिक्कमइ"
english: "A swarm of bees pursues the parrot, Like a flame burning in a forest, But the foolish doe will not object Because she does not know how to weep."

prakrit: "णिहुअणसिप्पं तह सारिआइ उल्लाविअं म्ह गुरुपुरओ,जह तं वेलं माए ण आणिमो कत्थ वच्चामो"
english: "My gurus, tell me, How come I didn't realize that you called me that?"

prakrit: "पच्चग्गुप्फुल्लदलुल्लसन्तमअरन्दपाणलेहलओ,तं ण त्थि कुन्दकलिआइ जं ण भमरो महइ काउं"
english: "A swarm of bees is hovering over the freshly plucked nectar, But there is nothing the bee will not do To the jasmine's bud." ""

prakrit: "सो को वि गुणाइसओ ण आणिमो मामि कुन्दलइआए,अच्छीहिं चिअ पाउं अहिलस्सइ जेण भमरेहिं"
english: "Well, my mother - in - law! There must be something very special about the jasmine That makes her so attractive."

prakrit: "ऎक्क च्चिअ रूअगुणं गामणिधूआ समुव्वहइ,अणिमिसणअणो सअलो जीए देवीकओ गामो"
english: "The village headman's daughter is such a beauty That she has on her own turned all the men of the village into gods By making them unable to blink."

prakrit: "मण्णे आसाऒ च्चिअ ण पाविओ पिअअमाहररसस्स,तिअसेहि जेण रअणाअराहि अमअं समुद्धरिअं"
english: "Let there be no need for you to weep, For the nectar of immortality is such a poison as is poured out by the rays of the sun."

prakrit: "आअण्णाअड्ढिअणिसिअभल्लमम्माहआइ हरिणीए,अद्दंसणो पिओ होहिइ त्ति वलिउं चिरं दित्थो"
english: "Oh! what a pitiful deer! That deer was so fond of looking at you That it was as if it had been given to it By a hunter."

prakrit: "विसमट्ठिअपिक्कॆक्कंवदंसणे तुज्झ सत्तुघरिणीअ,को को ण पत्थिओ पहिआणं डिम्भे रुअन्तम्मि"
english: "You stupid housewife, Who doesn't cry when the wheels are turned upside down?" ""

prakrit: "मालारी ललिउल्लुलिअवाहुमूलेहि तरुणहिअआइं,उल्लूरइ सज्जुल्लूरिआइ कुसुमाइ दावेन्ती"
english: "The garland seller plucks at the young lady's lips, Brings out the jeweler's bracelets, And the housewife puts them on display."

prakrit: "मज्झो पिओ कुअण्डो पल्लिजुआणा सवत्तीओ,जह जह वड्ढन्ति थणा तह तह झिज्जन्ति पञ्च वाहीए"
english: "Dear girls, The younger the village, The thinner the body grows And the thinner its five wives grow."

prakrit: "मालारीए वॆल्लहलवाहुमूलावलोअणसअण्हो,अलिअं पि भमइ कुसुमग्घपुच्छिरो पंसुलजुआणो"
english: "Look at the garland girl Placing a garland of jasmine flowers Around her neck, Like a young girl picking flowers." ""

prakrit: "रसिअजणहिअअदइए कइवच्छलपमुहसुकइणिम्मइए,सत्तसअम्मि समत्तं सट्ठं गाहासअं एअं"
english: "Friend, tell me, How come that you turn your back on me When all you want to do is fall asleep?"

prakrit: "अकअण्णुअ घणवण्णं घणवण्णन्तरिअतरणिअरणिअरं,जइ रे रे वाणीरं रेवाणीरं पि णो भरसि"
english: "Aunt, There is so much fire in such a large canopy That you must have filled it with the rays of the sun."

prakrit: "मन्दं पि ण आणइ हलिअणन्दणो इह हि डड्ढगामम्मि,गहवइसुआ विवज्जइ अवॆज्जए कस्स साहामो"
english: "The plowman's son-in-law does not bring the plow, This damned village is burning, The landowner's daughter is dying, So who can help us?"

prakrit: "ऎक्कक्कमपरिरक्खणपहारसमुहे कुरङ्गमिहुणम्मि,वाहेण मण्णुविअलन्तवाहधोअं धणुं मुक्कं"
english: "When the stag steps in front of the doe To face the arrow, The hunter throws away his bow Drenched with mud." ""

prakrit: "ता सुहअ विलंव खणं भणामि कीअ वि कएण अलम अहवा,अविआरिअकज्जारम्भआरिणी मरउ ण भणिस्सं"
english: "Well, my lord, I've got to tell you something: I'm off for a while. But don't be alarmed: She must be dying soon." ""

prakrit: "भोइणिदिण्णपहेणअचक्खिअदुस्सिक्खिओ हलिअउत्तो,ऎत्ताहे अण्णपहेणआण छीवॊल्लअं देइ"
english: "The plowman is so spoilt by the sweets The women give him to eat That he now licks them with his finger."

prakrit: "पच्चूसमऊहावलिपरिमलणसमूससन्तवत्ताणं,कमलाण रअणिविरमे जिअलोअसिरी महंमहइ"
english: "Aunt, When the lotus opens It opens wide And opens wide, Like a banner proclaiming victory over adversary, The flame of jasmine rises high in the night sky"

prakrit: "वाउव्वॆल्लिअसाहुलि थएसु फुडदन्तमण्डलं जहणं,चडुआरअं पइं मा हु पुत्ति जणहासिअं कुणसु"
english: "You silly girl, Don't make a laughingstock Of your doting husband."

prakrit: "वीसत्थहसिअपरिसक्किआण पढमं जलञ्जली दिण्णो,पच्छा वहूअ गहिओ कुडंवभारो णिमज्जन्तो"
english: "Aunt, The fire burning brightly lit by the twig Saved my husband's life." ""

prakrit: "गम्मिहिसि तस्स पासं सुन्दरि मा तुअर वड्ढउ मिअङ्को,दुद्धे दुद्धं मिव चन्दिआइ को पॆच्छइ मुहं दे"
english: "You're right, you look so beautiful By the way, don't turn your face away. Let the moon - eyed woman give you a mouthful of milk."

prakrit: "जइ जूरइ जूरउ णाम मामि परलोअवसणिओ लोओ,तह वि वला गामणिणन्दणस्स वअणे वलइ दिट्ठी"
english: "Aunt, If you insist on being polite, keep your eyes closed. One can't help it if one's eyes stray Toward the headman's son." ""

prakrit: "गेहं व वित्तरहिअं णिज्झरकुहरं व सलिलसुण्णइअं,गोहणरहिअं गॊट्ठं व तीअ वअणं तुह विओए"
english: "Like a house without furnishings, Like the basin of a waterfall without water, Like a cowshed without cattle, Her face without you."

prakrit: "तुह दंसणेण जणिओ इमीअ लज्जाउलाइ अणुराओ,दुग्गअमणोरहो विअ हिअअ च्चिअ जाइ परिणामं"
english: "This woman is so shy That the feelings aroused in her By the sight of you, Like a bad man, find Fulfillment only in the mind."

prakrit: "जं तणुआअइ सा तुह कएण किं जेण पुच्छसि हसन्तो,अह गिम्हे मह पअई ऎव्वं भणिऊण ओरुण्णा"
english: "That girl is so thin That whenever you ask her why she's laughing you reply:" "It's because it's summer." "How could she say that to me?"

prakrit: "वण्णक्कमरहिअस्स वि एस गुणो णवरि चित्तकम्मस्स,णिमिसं पि जं ण मुञ्चइ पिओ जणो गाढम उवऊढो"
english: "Virtuous conduct is the new virtue of the mind, For the moment that I do not wish to lose sight of what is dear to me, I shall lose heart."

prakrit: "अविहत्तसन्धिवन्धं पढमरसुब्भेअपाणलोहिल्लो,उव्वॆल्लिउं ण आणइ खण्डइ कलिआमुहं भमरो"

prakrit: "दरवेविरोरुजुअलासु मउलिअच्छीसु लुलिअचिहुरासु,पुरिसाइरीसु कामो पिआसु सज्जाउहो होइ"
english: "The God of Love makes women resplendent With his loving glances, Eyes closed with long sighs, And hair tossed around with love."

prakrit: "जं जं ते ण सुहाअइ तं तं ण करेमि जं मम' आअत्तं,अहअं चिअ जं ण सुहामि सुहअ तं किं मम' आअत्तं"
english: "Whatever does not please me, I shall not do; but what does not satisfy me, my dear, is my pleasure."

prakrit: "वावारविसंवाअं सअलावअवाण कुणइ हअलज्जा,सवणाण उणो गुरुसंणिहे वि ण णिरुञ्झइ णिओअं"
english: "Wretched nature alone does not heal, For even with her parents standing by One cannot quench one's thirst."

prakrit: "किं भणह मं सहीओ मा मर दीसिहइ सो जिअन्तीए,कज्जालाओ एसो सिणेहमग्गो उण ण होइ"
english: "Tell me, am I right? He will live, I will die, But business as usual Is not the way of love."

prakrit: "ऎक्कल्लमओ दिट्ठीअ मइअ तह पुलइओ सअण्हाए,पिअजाअस्स जह धणुं पडिअं वाहस्स हत्थाओ"

prakrit: "णलिणीसु भमसि परिमलसि सत्तलं मालइं पि णो मुअसि,तरलत्तणं तुह अहो महुअर जइ पाडला हरइ"

prakrit: "दोअङ्गुलअकवालअपिणद्धसविसेसणीलकञ्चुइआ,दावेइ थणत्थलवण्णिअं व तरुणी जुअजणाणं"
english: "Two-fingered girl, Leaning on her left breast, Young man knows how to gamble."

prakrit: "रक्खेइ पुत्तअं मत्थएण ऒच्छोअअं पडिच्छन्ती,अंसूहि पहिअघरिणी ऒल्लिज्जन्तं ण लक्खेइ"

prakrit: "सरए सरम्मि पहिआ जलाइ कन्दॊट्टसुरहिगन्धाइ,धवलच्छाइ सअण्हा पिअन्ति दइआण व मुहाइं"
english: "The whole course of the journey Is lit up with the fragrance of raindrops, The rays of the sun Are illuminated by our loving - kindnesses And our faces are smeared with red."

prakrit: "अब्भन्तरसरसाओ उवरिं पव्वाअवद्धपङ्काओ,चङ्कम्मन्तम्मि जणे समूससन्ति व्व रच्छाओ"
english: "There is a shower of raindrops on the horizon, Clouds hovering above, And a sea of peacock feathers hovering over the horizon."

prakrit: "मुहपुण्डरीअछाआइ सण्ठिए उअह राअहंसे व्व,छणपिट्ठकुट्टणुच्छलिअधूलिधवले थणे वहइ"
english: "Look at her breasts Powdered with the flour She grinds for the festival, Like two white geese sitting in the shade Of the lotus of her face."

prakrit: "तह तेण वि सा दिट्ठा तीअ वि तह तस्स पेसिआ दिट्ठी,जह दोण्ह वि समअं चिअ णिव्वुत्तरआइ जाआइ"
english: "So he looked at her, So she at him, That at the same moment they both consummated their love."

prakrit: "वाउलिआपरिसोसणणिउञ्जपत्तलणसुलहसङ्केआ,सोहग्गकणअकसवट्ट गिम्ह मा कह वि झिज्जिहिसि"

prakrit: "दुस्सिक्खिअरअणपसिक्खएहि घिट्ठो सि पत्थरे ताव,जा तिलमॆत्तं वट्टसि मरगअ का तुज्झ मुल्लकहा"

prakrit: "विञ्झारुहणालावं पल्ली मा कुणउ गामणी ससइ,पच्चुज्जिविओ जइ कह वि सुणइ ता जीविअं मुअइ"

prakrit: "पुच्छिज्जन्ती ण भणइ गहिआ पप्फुरइ चुंविआ रुअइ,तुण्हिक्का णववहुआ कआवराहेण उवऊढा"

prakrit: "जाइ वअणाइ अम्हे वि जम्पिमो ताइ जम्पइ जणो वि,ताइं चिअ तेण पजम्पिआइ हिअअं सुहावेन्ति"

prakrit: "कुलपालिआऎ पॆच्छह जॊव्वणलाअण्णविब्भमविलासा,पवसन्ति व्व पवसिए एन्ति व्व पिए घरं एन्ते"
english: "The husbandman's wife bemoans the absence of youth and poverty In his house." ""

prakrit: "पइपुरऒ च्चिअ रभसेण चुम्बिओ देवरो अडअणाए,मह वअणं मइरागन्धिअं ति हाआ तुहं भणइ"
english: "Before her husband's eyes The buffalo kisses the god, But you rebuke me by saying:" "My husband is dead." ""

prakrit: "तह अडअणाऎ रुण्णं पइमरणे बाहरुद्धकण्ठीए,अणुमरणसङ्किणो जह जारस्स वि सङ्किअं हिअअं"
english: "There were tears welling up on her cheeks As if to signify the death of her lover." ""

prakrit: "वाणीरकुडुङ्गुड्डीणसउणिकोलाहलं सुणन्तीए,घरकम्मवावुडाए वहूऎ सीअन्ति अङ्गाइं"
english: "Listening to the shrill cries of the weeping gooseflesh, The wife's limbs tremble As she steps out of the house."

prakrit: "णॊल्लेइ अणॊल्लमणा अत्ता मं घरभरम्मि सअलम्मि,खणमॆत्तं जह सञ्झाऎ णवर ण व होइ वीसामो"
english: "Mother - in - law, I am so busy going round the house That I cannot sleep at night If I am not busy."

prakrit: "ठाणेठाणे वलिआ वलणेवलणे सवेडसकुडुङ्गा,ण गओ सि अम्ह गामं दिअर ण दिट्ठा तुए मुरला"
english: "Thane thane valiya, Valane valane saavesakudunga, Not so long ago you left our village, But the sight of you is nothing like a mural."

prakrit: "महुएहि किं व वालअ हरसि णिअम्बाहि जइ वि मे सिअअं,साहामि कस्स रण्णे दूरे गामो अहं ऎक्का"
english: "Honey, what's that to me? Aunt, If you ever see me again, I'll tell you the truth. Whom else can I call to in this remote village? I'm all by myself." ""

prakrit: "कालक्खरदूसिक्खिअ धम्मिअ रे णिम्बकीडअसरिच्छ,दॊण्ण वि णिरअणिवासो समअं जइ होइ तहि होदु"
english: "Look at the passage of time, you silly worm, It's only a matter of time before both of you become immortal."

prakrit: "पन्थअ ण ऎत्थ सन्थरम अत्थि मणं पत्थरत्थले गामे,उण्णअपओहरे पॆक्खिऊण जइ वससि ता वससु"
english: "In a village of pebbles, Wherever you are, There is no place for you to live. But if you live by the peeping of the treetops, There you will live."

prakrit: "विहलक्खणं तुमं सहि दट्ठूण कुडेण तरलतरदिट्ठिं,वारप्फंसणिहेण अ अप्पा गरुओ त्ति पाडिअविहिण्णो"
english: "When I saw you, my friend, I could see the water running down my back. It was like dancing on top of my husband." ""

prakrit: "अइविउलं जलकुम्भं घॆत्तूण समागअ म्हि सहि तुरिअं,समसेअसलिलणीसासणीसहा वीसमामि खणं"
english: "Come with me, my friend, Let me gather a bunch of water. Maybe I'll have to boil it all over Again."

prakrit: "अणुमरणे हसइ जणो रॊत्तुं वि ण लब्भइ जहॆच्छं,ता ऎत्थ किं करिस्सं चोरिअरमणे विवज्जन्ते"
english: "One cannot help laughing When he dies, One cannot stop laughing When one sees him, So how can one explain his actions By stealing?"

prakrit: "मा पुत्ति वङ्कभणिअं जम्पसु पुरओ तुमं छउल्लाणं,हिअएण जं च भणिअं तं पि हआसा विआणन्ति"
english: "My son, stop yelling at me. All you do is stare at me, Saying what I have to say." ""

prakrit: "वङ्कभणिआइ कत्तो कत्तो अद्धच्छिपॆच्छिअव्वाइ,ऊससिउं पि ण तीरइ छउल्लपरिवारिए गामे"
english: "What do you mean, you stupid girl, You can't make it in this village?" he whispered.

prakrit: "तत्थ वि हॊन्ति सहीओ पुत्तलि मा रुवसु जत्थ दिण्णा सि,तत्थ वि णिउञ्जलीला तत्थ वि गिरिवाहिणी गोला"
english: "There she is, Daughter - in - law, Don't cry so long as you are with her, There she has her bow hanging loose, And there the sparrow - eyed girl."

prakrit: "कस्स व ण होइ रोसो दट्ठूण पिआऎ सव्वणं अहरं,सभमरकमलग्घाइरि वारिअवामे सहसु एण्हिं"
english: "There will be no one to make you angry. But all the rest of us, dear friends, Will put up with it all The rest of the way."

prakrit: "छप्पत्तिआ वि खज्जइ णिप्पत्ते पुत्ति ऎत्थ को दोसो,णिअपुरिसे वि रमिज्जइ परपुरिसविवज्जिए गामे"
english: "Aunt, Who is to blame here? Even a teaspoonful of rice Is to blame elsewhere In a village divided on account of its abundance."

prakrit: "अमुणिअपरपुरिससुहो जम्पउ जं किं पि अण्णओ लोओ,णिअपुरिसेहि वि अम्हे परपुरिसो त्ति च्चिअ रमामो"
english: "Blessed are the meek ones Who rejoice over the foolish, For whatever is dear to me Remains true to me, Even in the midst of foolish people."

prakrit: "माए घरोवअरणं अज्ज खु ण त्थि त्ति साहिअं तुमए,ता भण किं करणिज्जं एमेअ ण वासरो ठाइ"
english: "Mother - in - law, you're not at home right now. Tell me, What am I to do If this isn't the place to stay?"

prakrit: "सच्छन्दरमणदंसणसंवड्ढिअगरुअवम्महविलासं,सुविअड्ढवेसविलआरमिअं को वण्णिउं तरइ"
english: "The arrows of the God of Love, Which pierce through the eye of the beholder, Sound like a banner proclaiming His holiness."

prakrit: "सामण्णसुन्दरीणं विब्भमम आवहइ अविणऒ च्चेअ,धूमो वि हु पज्जलिआणं महुरो होइ सुरभिदारूणं"
english: "The beauty of a beautiful woman illuminates the whole spectrum. Even smoke spoils the fragrance of jasmine." ""

prakrit: "अव्वो कालस्स गई सो वि जुआ सरसकव्वदुल्ललिओ,पढइ परासरसद्दं अम्हे वि णिअं पइं गमिमो"
english: "Ah, the passage of time: This young man, swollen by ecstasy, Is reading aloud From our house." ""

prakrit: "पणमह माणस्स हला चलणे किं देवएहि अण्णेहिं,जस्स पसाएण पिओ घोलइ पाअन्तपासेसु"
english: "Well, my lord, how can a man walk on water If he does not know what to do with it?"

prakrit: "अणुणअपसरं पाअपडनूसवं रभसचुम्बणसुहॆल्लिं,एआइ अ अण्णाइ अ अवसो व्व कओ फलइ माणो"
english: "Without a trace of pride, Like the pleasure of a rapturous kiss on the mouth, One cannot help but rejoice at what one has to offer."

prakrit: "जइ पुत्तलि बहुएहिं अणुणअसॊक्खेहि अत्थि दे कज्जं,ताव रुअ गेण्ह माणं खणमॆत्तं तम्मि सुहअम्मि"
english: "If your son has many talents, Give as much effort as you can muster. For it is more pleasant to have a husband than to have one."

prakrit: "आणा अणालवन्तीऎ कीरए दीसए पराहुत्तो,णिन्तम्मि णीसिसिज्जइ पुत्ति अपुव्वॊक्खु दे माणो"
english: "Come on, you naughty girl, Don't be so naïve: Give me that gooseflesh That begs your name."

prakrit: "जञ्जं भणह सहीओ आम करिस्साम सव्वहा तन्तं,जइ तरह रुम्भिउं मह धीरं समुहागए तम्मि"
english: "Well done brother - in - law! We'll do it together As soon as we have a chance to kiss."

prakrit: "अल्लिअइ दिट्ठिणिब्भच्छिओ वि विहुओ वि लग्गए सिअए,पहओ वि चुम्बइ बला अलज्जए कह णु कुप्पिस्सं"
english: "There you are, staring at me, Whom else do you want to kiss?" he whispered, "How can I kiss you?"

prakrit: "हिमजोअचुण्णहत्थाओ जस्स दप्पं कुणन्ति राईओ,कह तस्स पिअस्स मए तीरइ माणो हला काउं"
english: "Like the lotus of the moon, Which grows thicker with the rays of the sun, How can my lover rejoice when he touches me?"

prakrit: "किं भणह मं सहीओ करेहि माणं ति किं थ माणेण,सब्भाववाहिरे तम्मि मज्झ माणेण वि ण कज्जं"
english: "What do you think I should do, Your Majesty? For all my feelings you owe me nothing But your pride."

prakrit: "जइआ पिओ ण दीसइ भणह हला कस्स कीरए माणो,अह दिट्ठम्मि वि माणो ता तस्स पिअत्तणं कत्तो"
english: "If my husband does not show up, Tell me, What do you expect him to do? Even if he does, What will he get for doing it?"

prakrit: "जाणिमि कआवराहं जाणिमि अलिआइ भणइ सअलाइ,अणुणेन्ते उण जाणे कआवराहं व अप्पाणं"
english: "I know when I am in sin, I speak plainly, But to think of myself as one who is in sin Is quite extraordinary."

prakrit: "अवराहसहस्साइं भरिमो हिअएण तम्मि अद्दिट्ठे,दिट्ठम्मि उण पिअसही ऎक्कं पि हु णं ण सम्भरिमो"
english: "I can't believe I'm still staring at you When I see you. Dear friend, There is nothing I can do About it."

prakrit: "भणभण जञ्जं पडिहाइ तुज्झ तन्तं सहामिमो अम्हे,असहत्तणं च जीअं च वल्लभे दोइ ण घडन्ति"
english: "I will always be with you, dear friend, As long as you do not hurt me, As both are inevitable."

prakrit: "एअं चिअ मह णामं भणभण दे सुहअ किं विलक्खो सि,पडिहाइ जं ण तुज्झ वि ममं पि किं देण णामेण"
english: "That's my name. Please, my dear, tell me, Are you embarrassed? If my name doesn't appeal to you What use is it to me?"

prakrit: "सुहअ मुहुत्तं सुप्पउ जं ते पडिहाइ तं पि भण्णिहिसि,अज्ज ण पॆच्छन्ति तुहं णिद्दागरुआइ अच्छीइ"
english: "Ah, the moment you say sleep, You must have said what you wanted to say. It's as if you hadn't noticed By now you were sound asleep." ""

prakrit: "मा वेलवेसु बहुअं पुत्तअ अलिएहि गॊत्तेहिं,एसा वि जाणइ च्चिअ परिहासुम्मिस्सभणिआइं"
english: "My son, don't overdo the joke: You know how to be funny."

prakrit: "अइ चण्डि किं ण पॆच्छसि जइ सो वाहरइ अण्णगॊत्तेण,अह दे इच्छइ मच्छरपणच्चिअच्छं मुहं दट्ठुं"
english: "Oh! why don't you see Chandi If she is about to fly away? Oh! She wants to see the mosquito's hideous face." ""

prakrit: "वेआरिज्जसि मुद्धे गॊत्तक्खलिएहि मा खु तुं रुवसु,किं व ण पॆच्छइ अण्णह ऎद्दहमॆत्तेहि अच्छीहिं"
english: "You fool, don't you see that I'm crying. What do you mean you can't cry?"

prakrit: "सॊत्तुं सुहं ण लब्भइ अव्वो पॆम्मस्स वङ्कविसमस्स,दुग्घडिअमञ्चअस्स व खणेखणे पाअपडणेण"
english: "Love does not bring happiness Simply because one's feet are covered with gooseflesh."

prakrit: "ऎक्कसअणम्मि सुमुही विमुही गरुएण माणबन्धेण,सिविणकलहम्मि हॊन्ती परम्मुही सम्मुही जाआ"
english: "One moment she turned her back on him, And the next she fell at his feet, As if in a dream." ""

prakrit: "वड्ढउ ता तुह गव्वो भण्णसि रे जइ विहण्डणं वअणं,सच्चं ण एइ णिद्दा तुए विणा देहि ओआसं"
english: "You grow up, you coward, If you say that out loud, It's true: Without you, my dear, There would be no sleep."

prakrit: "कअविच्छेओ सहिभङ्गिभणिअसब्भाविआवराहाए,झडि आपल्लवइ पुणो णअणकवोलेसु कोवतरू"
english: "Don't be so naïve: Once you've had your way, You'll start acting strangely again."

prakrit: "उम्मूलन्ति व हिअअं अणुणिज्जन्तीओ माणवन्तीओ,सम्भरिअमण्णुणिब्भरबाहभरोरुम्भिअमुहीओ"
english: "You stupid girl, You stupid woman, You shameless girl, Who for the first time Faces a barrage of kisses From all over The world."

prakrit: "ण वि तह तक्खणसुअमण्णुदुक्खविअणाओ वि रुवन्ति,जह दिट्ठम्मि पिअअमे अणुणिज्जन्तीओ तरुणीओ"
english: "The grief and anger they suffer at the moment they hear about their husbands'lapses Do not make young women cry so loud."

prakrit: "हिअए रोसुक्खित्तं पाअपहारं सिरेण पत्थन्तो,ण हओ दइओ माणंसिणीऎ थोरंसुअं रुण्णं"
english: "Oh! the angry woman's foot falls flat on her head. Please, my poor woman, Don't cry so much." ""

prakrit: "पिअअमविइण्णचसअं अचक्खिअं पिअसहीऎ देन्तीए,अभणन्तीऎ वि माणंसिणीऎ कहिऒ च्चिअ विरोहो"
english: "Dear friend, The anger I felt at my husband's absence Was unbearable, And even at that I could not help laughing."

prakrit: "वच्चिहिइ सो घरं से लहिहिइ ओआसम एहिइ सआसं,भणिहिइ जं भणिअव्वं पच्चुत्तं किंणु पाविहिइ"
english: "She will come to your house, Then leave, Then wait her chance, Then say what she has to say. But what will she get for reply?"

prakrit: "तणुआइआ वराई दिअहेदिअहे मिअङ्कलेह व्व,बहलपओसेण तुए णिसंस अन्धारिअमुहेण"
english: "You silly girl, It's only because you live in the dark that I see you every day."

prakrit: "दावन्तेण तुह मुहं भुमआभङ्गम्मि हॊन्तणवसोहं,अकएण उवकअं अज्ज मण्णुणा मज्झ पसिअच्छि"
english: "Because your face is smeared with red ghee, I can see the smoke rising from your mouth."

prakrit: "भिउडी ण कआ कडुअं णा 'लविअं अहरअं ण पज्जुट्ठं,उवऊहिआ ण रुण्णा एएण वि जाणिमो माणं"
english: "A coward is not bitter, A lover is not jealous, A woman is not angry, She does not cry, And I know this because she respects me."

prakrit: "किं पि ण जम्पसि कामं भणिअं च करेसि तं तहा तुरिअं,हिअअं रोसुव्वेअं ति तुज्झ विणऒ च्चिअ कहेइ"
english: "You don't have to say a word. If you say something you mean it, She mutters it to you In anger." ""

prakrit: "परिपुच्छिआ ण जम्पसि चुम्बिज्जन्ती बला मुहं हरसि,परिहासमाणविमुहे पसिअच्छि मणं म्ह दूमेसि"
english: "You don't know how to kiss a woman on the mouth. You know what I mean when I say you kissed me."

prakrit: "अइ पीणत्थणउत्थम्भिआणणे सुअणु सुणसु मह वअणं,अथिरम्मि जुज्जइ ण जॊव्वणम्मि माणो पिए कादुं"
english: "Listen to me when I tell you this: Youth does not last forever. So don't be afraid to get drunk."

prakrit: "तरलच्छि चन्दवअणे थोरत्थणि करिअरोरु तणुमज्झे,दीहा ण समप्पइ सिसिरजामिणी कह णु दे माणो"
english: "The moon is hotter than the sun, The nights are longer, And the nights are shorter." How can a sesame seed woman manage that?

prakrit: "सुहआ वि सुण्डरी वि हु तरुणी वि हु माणिणि त्ति आ पुत्ति,चन्दणलट्ठि व्व हुअङ्गदूमिआ किं डु दूमेसि"
english: "I am beautiful, I am young, And your wife is decent. What have you to do with your hair That has become like a sheet of sandalwood paste?"

prakrit: "पडिवक्खस्स वि पुरओ समुहं भणिआ सि तेण पसिअ त्ति,अवलम्बिअस्स माणिणि माणस्स अ किं फलं अण्णं"
english: "With a broad smile on her face She said:" "You're right." "What more do you expect From persisting in your anger?"

prakrit: "कड्ढेसि चलिअवलए हत्थे मुञ्चेसि अहमुही बाहं,पडिरुम्भसि णीसासे बहुअं ते माणविण्णाणं"
english: "When you walk away, you shake your hand, You shake my arm, And when you fall asleep, You make me feel like a schoolboy."

prakrit: "तुह वल्लहस्स गोसम्मि आसि अहरो मिलाणकमलदलो,इअ णववहुआ सोऊण कुणइ वअणं महीसमुहं"
english: "Your lover is coming to visit, And the lotus is blooming. The young wife has painted her face like a rainbow."

prakrit: "मह देसु रसं धम्मे तमवसम आसं गमागमा हर णे,हरवहु सरणं तं चित्तमोहम अवसरउ मे सहसा"
english: "I will give you the rasa of Dharma, For as long as I have it, I will cherish it forever."

prakrit: "राईसु चन्दधवलासु ललिअम आफालिऊण जो चावं,ऎक्कच्छत्तं च्चिअ कुणइ भुअणरज्जं विअम्भन्तो"
english: "Rice is like a lotus covered with moonlight: When it is ripe, the earth's energy is stirred up So that it does not dry up."

prakrit: "लहिऊण तुज्झ वाहुप्फंसं जीए स को वि उल्लासो,जअलच्छी तुह विरहे ण हु 'ज्जला दुव्वलाणं सा"
english: "As long as your arms are alive, He can rejoice, For apart from you there is no such thing as jealousy."

prakrit: "वारिज्जन्तो वि उणो सन्दावकअत्थिएण हिअएण,थणहरवअस्सएणं विसुद्धजाई ण चलइ से हारो"
english: "Even an heirloom is damaged by a storm So don't be alarmed if it happens again."

prakrit: "सअलकरणपरवीसामसिरिविअरणं ण सरसकव्वस्स,दीसइ अह व णिसम्मइ सरिसं अंसंसमॆत्तेण"
english: "Making love Is not the same as making love, It's more like making love Than making love."

prakrit: "सहि णवणिहुवणसमरम्मि अङ्कवालीसहीऎ णिविडाए,हारो णिवारऒ च्चिअ उच्छीरन्तो तदा कहं रमिअं"
english: "Friend, How can I make fun of a man Who has lost his cool And whose fingers are bristling?"

prakrit: "सो णत्थि ऎत्थ गामे जो एअं महमहन्तलाअण्णं,तरुणाणं हिअअलुडिं परिसक्कन्तिं णिवारेइ"
english: "So here in this village, Who is not so great Aunt, Is instructing the young men In all sorts of ways."

prakrit: "सो सुद्धसामलङ्गो धम्मिल्लो कलिअललिअणिअदेहो,तीए खन्धाहि वलं गहिअ सरो सुरअसङ्गरे जअइ"
english: "Tis the festival of jasmine, O blossoming lotus, Which like a palm leaf Succeeds in all its beauty."

prakrit: "होमि वहत्थिअरेहो णिरङ्कुसो अह विवेअरहिओ वि,सिविणे वि तुमम्मि पुणो पत्तिहि भत्तिं ण सुमरामि"
english: "I will never forget how, wobbling on and off, I could never sleep again."

prakrit: "सज्जेइ सुरहिमासो ण आपणेइ जुअइजणलक्खसहे,अहिणअसहआरमुहे णअपल्लवपत्तणे अणङ्गसरे"
english: "A decent woman loves her young son - in - law, Not so much for the pleasure Of looking at him As for the embarrassment He causes her."

prakrit: "देशी दुःसन्दर्भा प्रायः सन्दर्भितापि दुर्बोधा,आचार्यहेमचन्द्रस तत तां सन्द्र̥भति विभजति च"
english: "A native's misfortune is often referenced but incomprehensible, Such is the nature of the moon, So is the confusion and division of it."

prakrit: "समग्रशब्दानामनुशासने चिकीर्षिते संस्क्र̥तादिभाषाणां षण्णां शब्दानुशासने सिद्धहेमचन्द्रनाम्नि सिद्धिरूपनिबद्धा. इदानीं लोपागमवर्णविकारादिना क्रमेण पूर्वैरसाधितपूर्वा देश्याः शब्दा अवशिष्यन्ते. तत्सङ्ग्रहार्थमयम आरम्भः. तत्रादौ शिष्ट-समय इत्य अधिक्र̥त-देवता नमस्क्रियते."
english: "The whole of Sanskrit is illuminated by the sound of the pen, And the full moon is reflected in the syllables of all the languages. Now, with the passing of the dark night, The words of the former country, Which had been previously illuminated, Slowly disappear. With them the arrows of the God of Love begin. So polite is the speech - Time, So reverent is the worship of the gods." ""

prakrit: "गमणयपमाणगहिरा सहिअयहिअयहिअयङ्गमरहस्सा,जयइ जिणिन्दाण असेसभासपरिणामिणी वाणी १"
english: "Traveler, if you have to travel a long way, Make sure you have a hearty laugh: The more you conquer, the more likely it is that you'll win." 1

prakrit: "गमास्तात्पर्यभेदिनः सद्र̥शपाठाः. नया वस्त्वेकदेशग्राहिणः स्याद्वादाविरोधिनो 'भिप्रायविशेषाः. नैगमसङ्ग्रहव्यवहारर्जूसूत्रशब्दसमभिरूढैवम्भूताभिधानाः. सप्त प्रमाणानि स्याद्वादगोचराणि प्रत्यक्षादीनि. तैर्गम्भीरा मन्दबुद्धीनामस्ताघाः. अथ च सह्र̥दयं सचेतनं ह्र̥दयं येषां तेषां ह्र̥दयङ्गमरहस्या. अत एव जयति निःशेषतीर्थिकभाषोत्कर्षेण वर्तते. जयन्तर्थेन च नमस्कार आक्षिप्यते. अयमपर उत्कर्षो यदशेषभाषारूपत्वेन परिणमते. यद आह—देवा दैवीं नरा नारीं शबराश्चापि शाबरीम,तिर्यञ्चो ’पि हि तैरश्चीं मेनिरे भगवद्गिरम"
english: "From sweat to anger: Sadraspatha. From the perception of a new object: The reflections of an adversary. From a steady stream of gifts. From an endless stream of love Proves indisputable. From heart to heart, Wherever they are, With a smile on their lips. Wherever there is silence, There is salutation. By the touch of affection One's self is illuminated.

prakrit: "सैवम्भूता जिनेन्द्राणाम अर्हतां वाणी जयतीति सम्बन्धः ."
english: "Saivambhuta jinendranama arhatam vaani jayati relations."

english: "Jivyotsu - pravrttaye" "Fearful pursuits await me." ""

prakrit: "णीसेसदेसिपरिमलपल्लविअकुऊहलाउलत्तेण,विरइज्जइ देसीसद्दसङ्गहो वण्णकमसुहओ २"
english: "Lovely girl, When the clouds gather Around you, You lose faith And become indifferent. Happy are the colors of your skin 2"

english: "It's a month of contrasts." ""

english: "That which is not marked with a mark is not straight, nor is it polished, Nor is it numbered with the hundredths of a lac." 3

english: "Nowadays, people speak different languages with different accents."

english: "May all virtuous people Take refuge in the mother - in - law., Young men devoted to dharma See that good people prosper." 1

english: "Shame on those who do not know how to read and write., Those who appreciate the essence of lust." 2.

english: "Wrapped in a girdle wrapped around her husband's neck, She embraces him with her prominent arms. 3 The name of the god of victory Is described as" "One who embraces a wise woman." ""

prakrit: "एक्कत्थे पत्थावे जत्थ पढिज्जन्ति पउरगाहाओ ।,तं खलु वज्जालग्गं वज्ज त्ति य पद्धई भणिया ॥ ४ ॥"
english: "On the same stone, Wherever it is worn out, It is straight and straight. 4 The way of a wise man's speech Is plain." ""

english: "Everyone who reads this Vazhalagga Is gifted with an opportunity.," "How strange it is for a girl to be such a girl!" "5."

prakrit: "दुक्खं कीरइ कव्वं कव्बम्मि कए पउञ्जणा दुक्खं ।,सन्ते पउञ्जमाणे सोयारा दुल्लहा हुन्ति ॥ १ ॥"
english: "A poem about sorrow is like a poem about grief. For as the poems of sorrow grow, So do the beds of sorrow." 1

prakrit: "सक्कयमसक्कयं पि हु अत्थो सोयारसङ्गमवसेण ।,अप्पुव्वरसविसेसं जणेइ जं तं महच्छरियं ॥ २ ॥"
english: "Though I am at rest, I am completely at peace With myself," says the sage, "She gives me rest only when I am awake." 2

english: "Mutahalam va kavam sahava vimalam suvanna sanghadyam., Soyarkanna kuhurrammi payadyam payadam hoi." "3."

english: "Silly women, Silly men, Without a trace of pride They have no life." 1

english: "Salankarahi salakhanahi annannarayarayahi.," "The husband who has renounced his wife Has an anxious mind." "2."

english: "Such a woman is the wife of a wise man, Such an one is the husband of a virtuous woman., Without virtue one cannot find one." 3

english: "Happy the first day! Happy the yearning of the bridegroom. Happy the night of her wedding." "4."

english: "How can one describe a woman's beauty? 5." "I don't know which is more beautiful Than this."

prakrit: "सव्वो गाहाउ जणो वीसत्थो भणइ सव्वगोठ्ठीसु ।,परमत्थो जो ताणं सो नाओ महछइल्लेहिं ॥ ६ ॥"
english: "All sinners are alike, I speak for myself. But he who speaks for others is not worthy of my name." 6

prakrit: "गाहा रुअइ वराई सिक्किज्जन्ती गवारलोएहिं ।,कीरइ लुञ्चपलुञ्चा जह गाई मन्ददोहेहिं ॥ ७ ॥"
english: "Gone are the cries of the bridegroom, Covered with gooseflesh, Like the nail marks on the cheek of a cow." 7.
