english: "Tears flow from the temples of the God of Love, The rays of the moon illuminate the whole sky." 4

prakrit: "सन्धुक्किज्जइ हियए परिमलआणन्दियालिमालाहिं ।,उल्लाहि वि दिसिमणिमञ्जरीहि लोयस्स मयणग्गी ॥ ५ ॥"
english: "Sandhukkizhai hain, Parimal anandiyalimalahin, Ullahi ve Disimanimanjari hain Loyas mayanaggi." "5."

prakrit: "गहिऊण चूयमञ्जरि कीरो परिभमइ पत्तलाहत्थो ।,ओसरसु सिसिरणरवर लद्धा पुहवी वसन्तेण ॥ ६ ॥"
english: "Look! A swarm of mice has covered the whole surface of a leaf. Once the full moon is over They will hide under the rays of the scorching sun." 6

prakrit: "किं करइ तुरियतुरियं अलिउलघणवम्मलो य सहयारो ।,पहियाण विणासासङ्किय१ व्व लच्छी वसन्तस्स ॥ ७ ॥"
english: "What to do, Turiyaturiam, If you cannot bear to look at him again?" "The traveler is wearing a skirt1 Like a lac on a spring day7."

prakrit: "लङ्कालयाण पुत्तय वसन्तमासम्मि लद्धपसराणं ।,आवीयलोहियाणं बीहेइ जणो पलासाणं ॥ ८ ॥"
english: "" "A son of Lanka, Spring is laden with excitement. The man who sows seeds with steaming blood Is a man of penance." "8"

prakrit: "एक्को च्चिय दुव्विसहो विरहो मारेइ गयवई भीमो ।,किं पुण गहियसिलीमुहसमाहवो फग्गुणो पत्तो ॥ ९ ॥"
english: "One bitter enemy has been separated, And Bhima has been killed., Why, silly girl, Is there a trace of deceit in your mouth? 9" ""

prakrit: "होसइ किल साहारो साहारे अङ्गणम्भि वड्ढन्ते१ ॥,पत्ते वसन्तमासे वसन्तमासाइ सोसेइ ॥ १० ॥"
english: "The courtyard grows larger with the help of the hosiery, The leaves are absorbed by the spring in the month of spring" 10.

prakrit: "किङ्करि करि म अजुत्तं जणेण जं बालओ त्ति भणिओ सि ।,धवलत्तं देन्तो कण्टयाण साहाण मलिणत्तं ॥ ११ ॥"
english: "You fool, I beg of you what you have to say. If you give a damn, you cause embarrassment. 11" ""

prakrit: "मा रज्ज१ सुहञ्जणए सोहञ्जणए य दिट्ठमत्तिम्मि ।,भज्जिहिसि य साहसिया सा हसिया सव्वलोएण ॥ १२ ॥"
english: "Don't be alarmed: It's a miracle you ever saw her. But you, my brave girl, Smile and make everyone laugh." 12

prakrit: "अवरेण तवइ सूरो सूरेण य ताविया तवइ रेणू ।,सूरेणपरेण पुणो दोहिं पि हु ताविया पुहवी ॥ १ ॥"
english: "By them your sunshine is turned into sunshine, By the sunshine into moonlight both the days and the nights are past." 1

prakrit: "गिम्हे दवग्गिमसिमइलियाइ दीसन्ति विञ्झसिहराइं ।,आससु पउत्थवइए न हुन्ति नवपाउसब्भाइं ॥ २ ॥"
english: "In summer the valleys seem to sigh heavily, The heights of the Vindhya seem to recede, But we are not housewives Like new husbands." 2

prakrit: "डुहिऊण निरवसेसं ससावयं सुक्खरुक्खमारूढो ।,किं सेसं ति दवग्गी पुणो वि रण्णं पलोएइ ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "Drowning and drying up forever are the pleasures of mother - in - law. Why not plow the forest again? 3." ""

prakrit: "मूलाहिन्तो साहाण निग्गमो होइ सयलरुक्खाणं ।,साहाहि मूलबन्धो जेहि कओ ते तरू धन्ना ॥ ४ ॥"
english: "Moolahinto sahanam niggamum ho gayilrukkhanam, sahahi moolabandho jahenge, taru dhanna. 4." ""

prakrit: "भग्गो गिम्हप्पसरो१ मेहा गज्जन्ति लद्धसम्भाणा ।,मोरेहि वि उग्घुट्ठं पाउसराया चिरं जयउ ॥ १ ॥"
english: "" "Fettered by the summer heat, I can count on a good fight. But more than that, The rainy season is upon us." "1"

prakrit: "कक्खायपिङ्गलच्छो कसणङ्गो चडुलविज्जुजीहालो ।,पहियधरिणीइ दिट्ठो मेहो उक्कापिसाओ व्व ॥ २ ॥"
english: "Whom are you looking out for? A flock of parrots is hovering above you. 2 The cloud is closing in on you." ""

prakrit: "गज्जन्ति घणा भग्गा य पन्थया पसरियाउ सरियाओ ।,अज्ज वि उज्जुयसीले पियस्स पन्थं पलोएसि ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "There are many ways in which anger can be destroyed. Even now, in broad daylight, You follow the path of the thirsty." 3

prakrit: "अणुझिज्जिरीउ आलोइऊण पहियस्स पहियजायाओ ।,धारामोक्खणिहेणं मेहाण गलन्ति अंसूणि ॥ ४ ॥"
english: "Traveler, if you must travel alone, Travel on wheels That are lightened by the current.," "The summer sun disappears without a trace." "4."

prakrit: "उच्चं उच्चावियकन्धरेण भणियं व पाउसे सिहिणा ।,के के इमे पउत्था मोत्तूण घरेसु घरिणीओ ॥ ५ ॥"
english: "With high pitched bows I will welcome the rain. Who is this, my poor peasant, Who has pearls in his house?" 5.

prakrit: "जा नीलजलहरोदार१गज्जिए मरइ नेय तुह जाया ।,ता पहिय तुरियतुरियं वह वह उल्लवइ कलकण्ठी ॥ ६ ॥"
english: "Go, don't let the blue rainbow fall from your hand. It will all be lost by accident." 6

prakrit: "अमुणियपयसञ्चारा दीसन्ति भयङ्करा भुयङ्ग व्व ।,विसविसमा दुल्लङ्घा मेहा महिमण्डले लग्गा ॥ ७ ॥"
english: "In my wildest dreams I see clouds of smoke rising from the sky. 7" "The sky seems to swirl like a rainbow."

prakrit: "सुसइ व पङ्कं न वहन्ति निज्झरा बरहिणो न नच्चन्ति ।,तणुआयन्ति नईओ अत्थमिए पाउसणरिन्दे ॥ १ ॥"
english: "They do not take naps, Do not wash their hands, And do not like to be touched by the wind." 1 The Naiyas, on the other hand, Are addicted to the rain.

prakrit: "उयह१ तरुकोडराओ गच्छन्ती पूसयाण२ रिञ्छोली ।,सरए जरिओ व्व दुमो पित्तं व सलोहियं वमइ ॥ २ ॥"
english: "Look! There is a flock of parrots Going to and fro, A flock of crickets Running down the road, And a swarm of bees Flying through the thickets." 2

prakrit: "जाणिज्जइ न उ पियमप्पियं पि लोयाण तभ्मि हेमन्ते ।,सुयणसमागम वग्गी निच्चं निच्चं सुहावेइ ॥ १ ॥"
english: "I do not know whether you will find it again. But if you do, I will surely rejoice." 1

prakrit: "डज्झन्तु सिसिरदियहा पियमप्पियं जणो वहइ ।,दंहवयणस्स व हियए सीयायवणक्खओ जाओ ॥ १ ॥"
english: "Dear girl, Sisirdiya is wearing a pyjama. But look at that bird standing in front of her! 1." ""

prakrit: "अवधूयअलक्खणधूसराउ दीसन्ति फरुसलुक्खाओ ।,उय सिसिरवायलइया१ अलक्खणा दीणपुरिस व्व ॥ २ ॥"
english: "The twilight shadows cast by the sunshine.," "Look!" "With sighs and groans One forgets how rich one is." 2. "

prakrit: "चोराण कामुयाण य पामरपहियाण कुक्कुडो रडइ ।,रे पलह रमह वाहयह२ वहह तणुइज्जए रयणी ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "The cuckoo cries out, For he is a stolen lover, Or because he has run out of pastime. 2 The young wife is reduced to tears." 3

prakrit: "ता धणरिद्धी ता सुन्दरत्तणं ता वियड्ढिमा लोए ।,जा तरुणीयणकडुयत्तणाइ न हु हुन्ति पलियाइं ॥ १ ॥"
english: "He is wealthy, She is beautiful, And he is generous. If young men do not have tender breasts, Let them alone." 1

prakrit: "न तहा लोयम्मि कडक्खियम्मि न हु जम्पियं तह च्चेय ।,जह जह१ तरुणीयणलोयणेसु सीसे पडन्ताणं ॥ २ ॥"
english: "A flame that does not burn is not a flame that cannot be quenched, Nor is it something that rises or falls, As young men embrace their lovers." 2

prakrit: "रमियं जहिच्छियाए धूलीधवलम्मि गाममज्झम्मि ।,डिम्भत्तणस्स दियहा य णं कया जरयदियह व्व ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "Love is like dust on the head of the village headman. What do you think you are doing When you kiss his cheek?" 3

prakrit: "सङ्कुइयकम्पिरङ्गो ससङ्किरो दिन्नसयलपयमग्गो ।,पलियाण लज्जमाणो न गणेइ अइत्तए दिन्नं ॥ ४ ॥"
english: "Slender girl, Don't be ashamed. Give it to me, please. 4."

prakrit: "वम्महमक्खणदिव्वोसहीइ अङ्गं च कुणइ जरराओ ।,पेच्छह निट्ठुरहियओ एण्हिं सेवेइ तं कामो ॥ ५ ॥"
english: "Wretched eyes, Which, like a lamp, make whole the limbs of a woman., On the other hand, Whom it serves, It serves, Like a servant in distress." 5

prakrit: "उज्झसु विसयं परिहरसु दुक्कयं कुणसु नियमणे धम्मं ।,ठाऊण कण्णमूले इट्ठं सिट्ठं व पलिएण ॥ ६ ॥"
english: "" "Be vigilant, Remove troublesome things, Control dharma." "Hold on to your breath, Keep your eyes closed, And do not turn your back on others."

prakrit: "जीयं जलबिन्दुसमं उप्पज्जइ जोव्वणं सह जराए ।,दियहा दियहेहि समा न हुन्ति किं निट्ठुरो लोओ ॥ ७ ॥"
english: "Life ebbs and flows, Youth is bound to it. For one day is not as long as the next. So why are people so stubborn?" ""

prakrit: "वरिससयं नरआऊ तस्स वि अद्धेण हुन्ति राईओ ।,अद्धस्स य अद्धयरं हरइ जरा बालभावो य ॥ ८ ॥"
english: "When the husband is not with his wife, He is with her always., But when he is away, It is only a child's fancy." 8

prakrit: "को एत्थ सया सुहिओ कस्स व लच्छी थिराइ पेम्माइं ।,कस्स व न होइ पलियं भण को न हु खण्डिओ विहिणा ॥ ९ ॥"
english: "Who is happy here, Whom are you looking for, And how are you enjoying yourselves? 9" "If I don't have someone to turn to, I won't go anywhere." ""

prakrit: "गहचरिय देवचरियं ताराचरियं चराचरे चरियं ।,जाणन्ति सयलचरियं महिलाचरियं न याणन्ति१ ॥ १ ॥"
english: "The cowherd knows what the gods and goddesses wear, The star - eyed woman does not know what the women wear." 1

prakrit: "बहुकूडकवडभरिया मायारूवेण रञ्जए हिययं ।,महिलाए सब्भावं अज्ज वि बहवो न याणन्ति१ ॥ २ ॥"
english: "The woman does not know how to shed all her emotions Even today," said the doe, her hair heavily dyed with red ghee.

prakrit: "घेप्पइ मच्छाण पए आयासे पक्खिणो य पयमग्गो ।,एक्कं नवरि न घेप्पइ दुल्लक्खं कामिणीहिययं ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "When a mosquito bites a bird That flies only when it is hungry, Such a wife does not spit on her lover Who is naked." 3

prakrit: "इह लोए च्चिय दीसइ सग्गो नरओ य किं परत्तेण ।,धणविलसियाण सग्गो नरओ दालिद्दिय२जणाणं ॥ १ ॥"
english: "In this world, Friend, man or what shall we return to? For a man who is proud of his wealth Is worthless When compared with a woman who is poor." 1

prakrit: "विहडन्ति सुवा विहडन्ति बन्धवा विहडेइ सञ्चिओ अत्थो ।,एक्कं नवरि न विहडइ नरस्स पुव्वक्कयं कभ्मं ॥ २ ॥"
english: "Friend, friend, treasure - There must be something wrong with that woman. One cannot hurt her: It must be the actions of a nervous man." 2

prakrit: "अवहरइ जं न विहियं जं विहियं तं पुणो न नासेइ ।,अइणिउणो नवरि विही सित्थं पि न बड्ढिउं देइ ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "What she does not eat, What she drinks, She does not drink again. Without a husband like this One, She will not prosper." 3

prakrit: "जं चिय विहिणा लिहियं तं चिय परिणमइ सयललोयस्स ।,इय जाणिऊण धीरा विहुरे वि न कायरा हुन्ति ॥ ४ ॥"
english: "What I write without my heart becomes my soul. Knowing this, even a coward does not become coward." ""

prakrit: "पाविज्जइ जत्थ सुहं पाविज्जइ मरणबन्धणं जत्थ ।,तेण तहिं चिय निज्जइ नियकम्मगलत्थिओ जीवो ॥ ५ ॥"
english: "Where there is poverty, there is happiness, and where there is immortality, there also is virtue." 5

prakrit: "ता किं भएण किं चिन्तिएण किं जूरिएण बहुएण ।,जइ सो च्चेव वियम्भइ पुव्वकओ पुण्णपरिणामो ॥ ६ ॥"
english: "What is there to be afraid of, What to think of, Or to be ashamed of? 6 If she is really afraid She will come back again." ""

prakrit: "को दाऊण समत्थो को वा हरिऊण जस्स जं विहियं ।,परिणमइ फलं पुत्तय पुव्वक्कम्माणुसारेण ॥ ७ ॥"
english: "Who is to blame or who is to be blamed? Whatever the case may be, the result will be the same as that of my son." 7

prakrit: "रायङ्गणम्मि परिसण्ठियस्स जह कुञ्जरस्स माहप्पं ।,विञ्झसिहरम्मि न तहा ठाणेसु गुणा विसट्टन्ति१ ॥ १ ॥"
english: "Rayanganami is a vast expanse of space, Kunjarasa is a mass of space., Vindhya Siharami is not so vast That its dimensions are vast." 1

prakrit: "अज्झाकवोलपरिसण्ठियस्स जह चन्दणस्स माहप्पं ।,मलयसिहरे वि न तहा ठाणेसु गुणा विसट्टन्ति ॥ २ ॥"
english: "Like the lotus of the moon, Which on the other hand is like a lotus, Even on the holiest of nights It does not increase in size." 2

prakrit: "वरतरुणिणयणरिसण्ठियस्स जह कज्जलस्स माहप्पं ।,दीवसिहरे वि न तहा ठाणेसु गुणा विसट्टन्ति ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "The brighter the summer nights, The more brilliant the hotter the nights." 3

prakrit: "केसाण दन्तणहठक्कुराण वहुयाण वहुयणे तह य ।,थणयाण ठाणचुक्काण मामि को आयरं कुणइ ॥ ४ ॥"
english: "The hair is bristling, The teeth are clenched, The arms are pallid, The breasts are firm, And the skirt is like a mirror to my mother." 4

prakrit: "ठाणं न मुयइ धीरो ठक्कुरसङ्घस्स दुट्ठवग्गस्स ।,ठन्तं पि१ देइ जुज्झं ठाणे ठाणे जसं लहइ ॥ ५ ॥"
english: "Wait a moment, you stubborn wretch, Wait a few seconds, Hold your breath, Hold on tight, Fight the battle with all your might. 5." ""

prakrit: "गहियविमुक्का तेयं जणन्ति२ सामाइणो नरिन्दाणं ।,दण्डो तह च्चिय ट्ठिय आमूलं हणइ टङ्कारो ॥ ६ ॥"
english: "The cow gives birth to a pair of parrots. But the hunter takes it in his stride. 6." ""

prakrit: "उयहिवडवाणलाणं परोप्परुल्हवणसोसणमणाणं ।,अमुणियमज्झपजलणाण वइयरो जिणइ जियलोए ॥ ७ ॥"
english: "" "Consciousness alone triumphs over delusion, ignorance prevails over wisdom." "7."

prakrit: "जइ नत्थि गुणा ता किं कुलेण गुणिणो कुलेण न हु कज्जं ।,कुलमकलङ्कं गुणवज्जियाण गरुयं चिय कलङ्कं ॥ १ ॥"
english: "If there is no multiplication, why not multiplication by multiplication? One's kulena is not kujja., The kulama kalanka must be multiplied by merit, For it is the kalanga of the soul." ""

prakrit: "गुणहीणा जे पुरिसा कुलेण गव्वं वहन्ति ते मूढा ।,वंसुप्पन्नो वि धणू गुणरहिए नत्थि टङ्कारो ॥ २ ॥"
english: "Fools devoid of virtue go to the feet of men. Even a man without virtue is not worthy of being called a fool." 2

prakrit: "जम्मन्तरं न गरुयं गरुयं पुरिसस्स गुणगणारुहणं ।,मुत्ताहलं हि गरुयं न हु गरुयं सिप्पिसम्पुडयं ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "After all, there is no such thing as a strong man. But when it comes to a strong woman, It's not the strength of the head That counts. 3." ""

prakrit: "खरफरुसं सिप्पिउडं रयणं तं होइ जं अणग्घेयं ।,जाईइ किं व किज्जइ गुणेहि दोसा फुसिज्जन्ति ॥ ४ ॥"
english: "To weep as a supplicant When one has sipped kharif juice Is to be what one has longed for. For what exactly is karma's fault? 4." ""

prakrit: "जं जाणइ भणइ जणो गुणाण विहवाण अन्तरं गरुयं ।,लब्भइ गुणेहि विहवो विहवेहि गुणा न घेप्पन्ति ॥ ५ ॥"
english: "One who says what one knows gains merit, One who treats difference favourably, Shows merit, But lacks merit." "5."

prakrit: "ठाणं गुणेहि लब्भइ ता गुणगहणं अवस्स कायव्वं ।,हारो वि नेय पावइ गुणरहिओ तरुणिथणवट्टं ॥ ६ ॥"
english: "When merit is manifested, merit is acquired. Even in defeat Virtuous people lose merit" 6.

prakrit: "पासपरिसण्ठिओ वि हु गुणहीणे किं करेइ गुणवन्तो ।,जायन्धयस्स दीवो हत्थकओ निप्फलो च्चेय ॥ ७ ॥"
english: "Even when I'm around, I don't know what to do. When the lamp goes out, The palm of my hand fails 7." ""

prakrit: "परलोयगयाणं पि हु पच्छत्ताओ न ताण पुरिसाणं ।,जाण गुणुच्छाहेणं जियन्ति वंसे समुप्पन्ना ॥ ८ ॥"
english: "Though distressed, I will forgive, For men suffer no pain. 8 By choosing virtue, one conquers vice." ""

prakrit: "मुत्ताहलं व पहुणो गुणिणो किं करइ वेहरहियस्स ।,जत्थ न पविसइ सूई तत्थ गुणा बाहिर च्चेय ॥ १ ॥"
english: "What are you going to do with that valuable treasure? The more you treasure it, the thinner the treasure will be." 1

prakrit: "पियकेलिसङ्गमोसारिएण हारेण चिन्तियं एयं ।,अवसररहिया गुणवन्तया वि दूरे धरिज्जन्ति ॥ २ ॥"
english: "It's as if I lost faith in a drunken brawler. Even a virtuous man devoid of opportunity is carried away by distance." 2

prakrit: "ता निग्गुण च्चिय वरं पहुणवलम्भेण जाण परिओसो ।,गुणिणो गुणाणुरूवं फलमलहन्ता किलिस्सन्ति ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "Then realize your faults by reaching out for the auspicious boon.," "Virtuous people gain merit By embracing the auspicious fruit." "3."

prakrit: "निग्गुण गुणेहि नियणिग्गुणत्तणं देहि अम्ह सड्ढीए ।,कलिकाले किं कीरइ गुणेहि पहुणो न घेप्पन्ति ॥ ४ ॥"
english: "Give me the subtlety of virtue, That I may master it. For what goodness in time Does not attain to virtue?" 4.

prakrit: "सव्वत्तो वसइ धरा सन्ति नरिन्दा गुणा वि अग्घन्ति ।,ता किं सहन्ति गुणिणो अणायरं अत्थवन्ताणं ॥ ५ ॥"
english: "Everything is dependent on fire, but fire destroys virtue., Why should it tolerate virtue If it does not exist?" 5.

prakrit: "जस्स न गेण्हन्ति गुणा सुयणा गोट्ठीसु रणमुहे सुहडा ।,नियजणणिजोव्वणुल्लरणेण किं तेण जाएण ॥ १ ॥"
english: "Those who do not know how to count gainfully settle scores Have a good time at war. Why should anyone care who does?" 1

prakrit: "किं तेण जाइएण वि पुरिसेँ पयपूरणे वि असमत्थेँ ।,जेण न जसेण भरियं सरि व्व भुवणन्तरं सयलं ॥ २ ॥"
english: "Why, then, was it that I could not fill my stomach with water When he was gone? 2." "As though I had nothing to eat, So how can I get enough?" ""

prakrit: "देसे गामे नयरे रायपहे तियचउक्कमग्गे वा ।,जस्स न पसरइ कित्ती धिरत्थु किं तेण जाएण ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "There is nothing wrong with going from village to village. Don't spread the word. How long can you go on like that?" 3

prakrit: "किं तेण आइएण व किं वा पसयच्छि तेण व गएण ।,जस्स कए रणरणयं नयरे न घराघरं होइ ॥ ४ ॥"
english: "What makes you come? Or what makes you go? Go - between. For there is no going from house to house Except by running." "4."

prakrit: "उड्ढं वच्चन्ति अहो वयन्ति मूलङ्कुर व्व भुवणम्मि ।,विज्जाहियए कत्तो कुलाहि पुरिसा समुप्पन्ना ॥ १ ॥"
english: "The flies fly high, The roots bend, The ground twists, And in the middle of the sky a flock of parrots Assemble a crowd of men." 1

prakrit: "नियकम्मेहि वि नीयं उच्चं पुरिसा लहन्ति सण्ठाणं ।,सुरमन्दिरकूवयरा उड्ढद्धमुहा य वच्चन्ति ॥ २ ॥"
english: "Though bound by duty, Men flaunt their might., In beautiful temples, Couples fly with their faces upside down." 2.

prakrit: "एक्कम्मि कुले एक्कम्मि मन्दिरे एक्ककुक्खिसम्भूया ।,एक्को नरसयसामी अन्नो एक्कस्स असमत्थो ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "One family, One temple, One beehive, One tree., One Narsayami, That is, One unbalanced tree." 3.

prakrit: "सज्जणसलाहणिज्जे पयम्मि अप्पा न ठाविओ जेहिं ।,सुसमत्था जे न परोवयारिणो तेहि वि न किं पि२ ॥ ४ ॥"
english: "If you are not fond of courting gentlemen, do not trouble yourself. Even a polite person who is not affectionate Will not trouble you." 4

prakrit: "हिट्ठकयकण्टयाणं पयडियकोसाण मित्तसमुहाणं ।,मामि गुणवन्तयाणं कह कमले वसउ न हु कमला ॥ १ ॥"
english: "Friend, tell me, Mother - in - law, How could you live with so few? 1." "Kamala, my dear."

prakrit: "अन्नन्न१लग्गकयपत्तपरियणे निहयगुरुजडाजाले ।,मित्तालोयणसुहिए कह कमले वसउ न हु कमला ॥ २ ॥"
english: "Dear girl, How come you live in such a world? One cannot love another. 2." "Kamala, you bastard!" ""

prakrit: "पयडियकोसगुणड्ढे तह य कुलीणे सुपत्तपरिवारे ।,एवंविहे वसन्ती कमले कमले कयत्था सि ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "Lovely couple, Such good people make a good family., And while they live here One loses one's short stature." 3.

prakrit: "जडसंवाहियफरुसत्तणस्स निण्हवियणियगुणोहस्स ।,रे कमल तुज्झ कमला निवसइ रत्ताण पत्ताण ॥ ४ ॥"
english: "The essence of nature resides in the lotus.," "O lotus, your lotus lives in the bloodstream." "4"

prakrit: "जह पलहिगुणा परछिद्दछायणे१ तह नु कमल जइ तुज्झ ।,ता इह सयले लोए का अवमा तव ठविज्जन्ति ॥ ५ ॥"
english: "As the lotus grows in the shadow cast by the sky, So does your lotus. In this world, humiliation is yours to inflict." ""

prakrit: "अलियालावे वियसन्त कमल कलिओ सि रायहंसेहिं ।,ता सुन्दरं न होही तुज्झ फलं कालपरिणामे ॥ १ ॥"
english: "Aliya, please, grow a lotus, For it must be very beautiful. Your fruit will last a lifetime." ""

prakrit: "अप्पं२ परं न याणसि नूणं सउणो सि लच्छिपरियरिओ ।,उज्जलसमुहो पेच्छह ता वयणं पि हु न ठावेइ ॥ २ ॥"
english: "But don't be alarmed: If you hear a new sound, You'll stumble across it. But if you see a bright face It's not the same as speaking." 2

prakrit: "लच्छीए परिगहिया उड्ढमुहा जइ न हुन्ति ता पेच्छ ।,जेहिं चिय उड्ढविया तं चिय नालं न पेच्छन्ति ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "If a man has a pale face He cannot see it. If he has pale eyes He cannot look into the drain." 3

prakrit: "लच्छिणिलयत्तणुत्ताणवयण गुणिणो सयाणुलग्गस्स ।,नियणालस्स वि विमुहो ता पङ्कय कस्स समुहो सि ॥ ४ ॥"
english: "If you cannot control yourself, You are bound to fall in love with someone else. 4 Which group are you supposed to belong to?"

prakrit: "वड्ढावियकोसो जं सि कमल परिसोसिएहि पत्तेहिं ।,अच्छउ ता लच्छिवओ तं चिय नामं पि हारिहिसि ॥ ५ ॥"
english: "The elder you become, The more you cherish the lotus, The poorer your name will be." 5

prakrit: "मित्तो सूरो कयपत्तपरियरो लच्छियालओ कमलो ।,पयहीणस्स सहारो केणावि न सक्किओ निमिसं ॥ ६ ॥"
english: "Friend, the sun is hot, The lanky lotus is limp, But with a helpless wife No one will prosper." 6

prakrit: "सरसाण सूरपरिंसण्ठियाण कमलाण कीस उवयारो ।,उक्खयमूला सुक्खन्तपङ्कया कह न सण्ठविया ॥ ७ ॥"
english: "Why should anyone care if a lotus is fragrant? 7." "Because the flowers are dry, Tell me, please, How can I help?" ""

prakrit: "छण्डिज्जइ हंस सरं कत्तो वासो परम्मुहे दिव्वे ।,जाव न ठवेइ चलणे कूडबओ मत्थए एण्हिं ॥ १ ॥"
english: "Deer, tell me, Mother - in - law, Where did the goose settle on my head? It must be the doe's tail That does not budge When pushed against it." 1

prakrit: "पढमं चिय जे विगया घणागमे साहु ताण हंसाणं ।,जेहि न दिट्ठं उच्चासणट्ठियं खलबयकुडुम्बं ॥ २ ॥"
english: "Reader, If you dare to breathe deeply, Make laughter of yourself., Wherever you do not look, There is nothing wrong with you." 2

prakrit: "इयरविहङ्गमपयपन्तिचित्तला जत्थ पुलिणपेरन्ता ।,तत्थ सरे न हु जुत्तं वसियव्वं रायहंसाणं ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "Where there is affection, There is no room for jealousy. 3." "Wherever there is jealousy, There must be compassion."

prakrit: "विविहविहङ्गमणिवहेण मण्डियं पेच्छिऊण कमलवणं ।,मुक्कं माणब्भरिएहि माणसं रायहंसेहिं ॥ ४ ॥"
english: "A lotus opens When you look at the crowd of people dressed in different attires." "Face to face with a man who is so full of joy" "4."

prakrit: "अद्धत्थमिए सुरे जं दुक्खं होइ चक्कवायस्स ।,तं होउ तुह रिऊणं अहवा ताणं पि मा होउ ॥ १ ॥"
english: "The more sorrow you cause, the better. Either you suffer or you suffer. 1." ""

prakrit: "भूमीगयं न चत्ता सूरं दटठूण चक्कवाएण ।,जीयग्गल व्व दिन्ना मुणालिया विरहभीएण ॥ २ ॥"
english: "Do not let the ground shake At the sight of a dying pig., For fear of alienating the sage Who has spent his life elsewhere." 2.

prakrit: "अग्गि व्व पउमसण्डं चिय व्व नलिणी मडो व्व अप्पा णं ।,चक्केण पिंयाविरहे मसाणसरिसं सरं दिट्ठं ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "The fire is burning, The rice is wilting, The maid is weeping, And the farmer's wife is swooning over him." 3

prakrit: "आसासिज्जइ चक्को जलगयपडिबिम्बदंसणासाए ।,तं पि हरन्ति तरङ्गा पेच्छह निउण्णत्तणं विहिणो ॥ ४ ॥"
english: "The wheel of hope is like a panorama of burning jasmine. But to see her swinging the wave Brings new tenderness." "4."

prakrit: "आसन्ति सङ्गमासा गमन्ति रयणिं सुहेण चक्काया ।,दियहा न य हुन्ति विओयकायरा कह नु वोलन्ति ॥ ५ ॥"
english: "When he comes, he goes with him, And when he leaves, He greets him with a pleasant laugh. 5" "How will you ever get home If you don't show up?" ""

prakrit: "अलियं जम्पेइ जणो जं पेम्मं होइ अत्थलोहेण ।,सेवालजीवियाणं कओ धणं चक्कवायाणं ॥ ६ ॥"
english: "Alas! For all that love entails, There must surely be someone who loves., For to live a life of service Is to inherit wealth." 6

prakrit: "सुसिएण निहसिएण वि तह कह वि हु चन्दणेण महमहियं ।,सरसा वि कुसुममाला जह जाया परिमलविलक्खा ॥ १ ॥"
english: "How great is the glory of the moon Because of its fragrance? Even the jasmine That grows on the lotus Falls into the Parimalavilakkha." 1.

prakrit: "परसुच्छेयपहरणेण निहसणेँ नेय उज्झिया पयई ।,चन्दण संनयसीसो तेण तुमं वन्दए लोओ ॥ २ ॥"
english: "Because you refused to partake of the good moonlight, The sky was overcast with moonlight." 2

prakrit: "उत्तमकुलेसु जम्मं तुह चन्दण तरुवराण मज्झम्मि ।,दुज्जीहाण खलाण य निच्चं चिय तेण अणुरत्तो ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "I agree with you. The sandalwood paste on your forehead Is the best thing that has happened to me. Or else I will regret it." 3

prakrit: "एक्को चिय दोसो तारिसस्स चन्दणदुमस्स विहिघडिओ ।,जीसे दुट्ठभुयङ्गा खणं पि पासं न मेल्लन्ति ॥ ४ ॥"
english: "One mistake can only be made by scattering the drops of sandalwood on the star. Even a stray kite dies in the neighborhood." 4

prakrit: "बहुतरुवराण मज्झे चन्दणविडवो भुयङ्गदोसेण ।,छिज्जइ निरावराहो साहु व्व असाहुसङ्गेण ॥ ५ ॥"
english: "Too much sandalwood powder in one sitting., Reduced to ashes With inebriated breath." 5.

prakrit: "जाओ सि कीस पन्थे अहवा जाओ सि कीस फलिओ सि ।,अह फलिओ सि महादुम ता सउणबिडम्बणं सहसु ॥ १ ॥"
english: "" "Go, what have you to do?" "Or," "How are you going to bear fruit?'O, bear fruit! For it is a great bounty." 1 "

prakrit: "नीरस-करीर-खरखइरसङ्कुले विसमसमिमरुद्देसे ।,का होज्ज गई पहियाण जं सि वडपायव न होन्तो ॥ २ ॥"
english: "Drenched to the point of exhaustion, Scorched by aches and pains, Who has a wheel turned upside down If you are not a good husband?" 2

prakrit: "भूमीगुणेण वडपायवस्स जइ तुङ्गिमा इहं होइ ।,तह वि हु फलाण रिद्धी होसइ बीयाणुसारेण ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "If you want to multiply by the quality of the soil, do so first. But if you want the fruit to ripen, do it according to the seed." 3

prakrit: "किं ताल तुज्झ तुङ्गत्तणेण गयणद्धरुद्धमग्गेण ।,छुहजलणताविएहि वि उवहेप्पसि जं न पहिएहिं ॥ १ ॥"
english: "Why cling to your skirt So tightly? Even if you touch it with your hands, You will avoid it." 1

prakrit: "छायारहियस्स निरासयस्स दूरयरदावियफलस्स ।,दोसेहि समा जा का वि तुङ्गिमा तुज्झ रे ताल ॥ २ ॥"
english: "The shadow of despair, The fruit of a distant night., It's only a matter of time before you break out in a sweat. 2." ""

prakrit: "जेहिं नीओ वड्ढिं तालो सयसलिलदाणसेवाए ।,तस्सेव जो न फलिओ सो फलिओ कह नु अन्नस्स ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "One who does not bear fruit, How can one eat food? 3" "If a watermelon is boiled, Then what is the use of eating it?"

prakrit: "मउलन्तस्स य मुक्का तुज्झ पलासा पलास सउणेहिं ।,जेण महुमाससमए नियवयणं झत्ति सामलियं ॥ १ ॥"
english: "Foolish girl, Your face is like a lotus in your eyes. For in the rainy season I quickly manage to arrange an appointment." ""

prakrit: "अच्छउ ता फलणिवहं फुल्लणदियहम्मि कलुसियं वयणं ।,इय कलिऊण पलासो झड त्ति मुक्को सपत्तेहिं ॥ २ ॥"
english: "Well, that's the fruit of one flower Placed in front of the eaves.," "The jasmine is so plump That it does not budge Even after a week." "2."

prakrit: "दट्ठूण किंसुया साहा तं बालाइ कीस वेलविओ ।,अहवा न तुज्झ दोसो को न हु छलिओ पलासेहिं ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "Look! What makes you think he's having a good time? It's your own fault, not someone else's. 3." ""

prakrit: "गुरुविहववित्थरुत्थम्भिरे वि किविणम्मि अत्थिणो विहला ।,भण फलिए वि पलासे मणोरहा कस्स जायन्ति ॥ ४ ॥"
english: "Though the tree is wide open With branches falling from it, It is empty at present. Even after the paddy has been sown Who will supply the manorahs for the field?" 4.

prakrit: "सच्चं पलास जं फुल्लिओ सि फलिओ सि रहणिउञ्जेसु ।,जइ होज्ज सुखज्जफलो मणं पि ता तुज्झ को मुल्लो ॥ ५ ॥"

english: "Do not harm a guest, Do not trouble a friend while drinking, And do not harm an annoying person While lying in silence." 1

english: "I am so fond of poets That I know no one is dear to me. But do not be alarmed by their outbursts." 1

english: "Aunt, There is still room for the scent of the mango blossom On the lotus of my face. I can't find it anywhere." 2

english: "One who observes the path shown by the lotus plant simply does so by weaving the petals of the safflower tree with stone." 4

english: "What do you see there, you silly girl? One can't touch you with one's hands If you're alone." ""

prakrit: "अइचम्पियं विणस्सइ दन्तच्छेएण होइ विच्छायं ।,ढलहलयं चिय मुच्चइ पाइयकव्वं च पेम्मं च ॥ ७ ॥"
english: "Because the tooth is cut open, The tooth is pierced, The girdle is loosened, The pyre is closed, And love is kindled." 7

prakrit: "खुहइ न कडुयं जम्पइ लेइ न दोसे गुणे पसासेइ ।,रूसन्ताण न रूसइ दक्खिण्णमहोयही सुयणो ॥ १ ॥"
english: "She neither expresses bitterness Nor acts with malice. So do not be angry with a child Who is angry Even if he falls asleep on the right side." 1

prakrit: "सुयणस्स होइ सुक्खं न तेत्तियं जेत्तियं दुहं होइ ।,जं जं पिच्छह दुहियं तं तं अणुसोयमाणस्स ॥ २ ॥"
english: "To be happy is not the same as to be unhappy. What is slippery is to be happy with." 2

english: "The swollen moon veils the horizon, Reflecting the rays of the sun, But does not pierce the spot That is black." 3

prakrit: "सच्चुच्चरणा पडिवन्नपालणा गरुयभारणिव्वहणा ।,धीरा पसन्नवयणा सुयणा चिरजीवणा होन्तु ॥ ४ ॥"
english: "Truthfulness, self - control, humility, patience, and peaceful sleep are the keys to long life." 4

english: "Even on a sunny day She serves drowsy people, Not sparing the forest. Even in death She sells valuable things For a paltry sum." ""

english: "There is no house, There are no temples, And still no roads. Where, for no other reason, Do not two or three poor people meet." 1

english: "A warrior destroys a house, A demon destroys another. Without him, my daughter - in - law would not survive." 7

english: "A woman who knows what to wear should be careful not to break the fast. But if she knows how to treasure a life, she will protect it." 2

english: "What is the use of sulking and sulking? If you refuse to budge, you will be robbed." 6

english: "Destroyed is the family's wealth, For destroyed is not the woman, Nor is destroyed the son - in - law." 9

english: "After all, what's important is not the merit of the man., But the quality of the woman." ""

english: "12)" "Wisdom is truth, Friendship is not immodesty, Everything is happiness, But unhappiness is the root of all suffering." ""

prakrit: "पढमारम्भमणहरं घणलग्गं माणरायरमणिज्जं ।,पेम्मं सुरिन्दचावं व चञ्चलं झत्ति वोलेइ ॥ १ ॥"
english: "From the moment one begins to read, One can appreciate many meanings in one's own eyes. Love, like a good poem, Vanishes With the slightest jerk." 1

prakrit: "खणभङ्गुरेण विसमेण हारिणा दुण्णिवारपसरेण ।,अणवट्ठियसब्भावेण सव्वहा होउ पेम्मेण ॥ २ ॥"
english: "Destroyed by wretchedness, Defeated by adversity, All made possible by unfaithful love." 2.

prakrit: "जइ देव मह पसन्नो मा जम्मं देहि माणुसे लोए ।,अह जम्मं मा पेम्मं,अह पेम्मं मा विओयं च ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "If God is pleased with me, I will not allow my body to be consumed by man., Oh, no, no. Love, oh, no love at all." 3.

prakrit: "अन्नं तं सयदलियं पि मिलइ रसगोलिय व्व जं पेम्मं ।,अम्हं मयच्छि मुत्ताहलं व फुट्टं न सङ्घडइ ॥ ४ ॥"
english: "Love is what food is, Like a juicy concoction of sweetmeats, But I do not want a quarrel or a quarrel." 4

prakrit: "दढणेहणालपसरियसब्भावदलस्स रइसुयन्धस्स ।,पेम्मुप्पलस्स मुद्धे माणतुसारो च्चिय विणासो ॥ ५ ॥१"
english: "When he sees you, He gives satisfaction to your eyes, When you kiss his cheek. But when he touches your cheek, You turn your back on him. 5 | 1" ""

prakrit: "अव्वो जाणामि अहं पेम्मं च इवेइ लोयमज्झम्मि ।,थिरआसाए रइयं न पीडियं नवरि दिव्वेण ॥ ६ ॥२"
english: "Oh, I know that this is love and the same for the world. Try not to fall into trouble While making love." ""

prakrit: "जा न चलइ ता अमयं चलियं पेम्मं विसं विसेसेइ ।,दिट्ठं सुयं व कत्थ वि मयच्छि विसगब्भिणं अमयं ॥ ७ ॥"
english: "If you do not move, it is bound to happen. Love, though it be fleeting, Succeeds in vanishingly small things." 7

prakrit: "भग्गं न जाइ घडिउं दुज्जणहिययं कुलालभण्डं व ।,सयखण्डं पि घडिज्जइ कञ्चणकलसो सुयणचित्तं ॥ ८ ॥"
english: "Do not be alarmed: The clock is ticking, The poor farmer is angry, And the rice bowl is rattling. 8" "A good man's heart is like no other."

prakrit: "भग्गं पुणो घडिज्जइ कणयं कङ्कणयणेउरं नयरं ।,पुण भग्गं न घडिज्जइ पेम्मं मुत्ताहलं जच्चं ॥ ९ ॥"
english: "Fear clocks in all the time, Like a bracelet on a wife's bracelet. But love, like a pearl, lasts only a moment." 9

prakrit: "सो को वि न दीसइ सामलङ्गि जो घडइ विघडियं पेम्मं ।,घडकप्परं च भग्गं न एइ तेहिं चिय सलेहिं ॥ १० ॥१"
english: "She will not allow anyone to spoil what is to be had. But do not trouble yourself with gossip. Such is the nature of true love." ""

prakrit: "दन्ते तिणाइ कण्ठे कुवारयं सुन्दरं च तुह एयं ।,माणमडप्फरणडिए तुह माणो केण निद्दिट्ठो ॥ १ ॥"
english: "To you it is as if the teeth were brimful, To the ears it is ugly, And the hair on the head as if they were beautiful." 1 Why sleep, my dear, When you rejoice?

prakrit: "एमेव कह वि मा णंसिणीइ तह महमहाविओ माणो ।,जह खेमकुसलसम्भासभेत्त सो पिओ जाओ ॥ २ ॥"
english: "Tell me, then, That great women rejoice. As for Khemkusha, who has attained the state of consciousness, He must drink." 2

prakrit: "वासारत्ते पावासियाण विरहग्गितावतवियाणं ।,अङ्गेसु लग्गमाणो पढमासारो छमच्छमइ ॥ १ ॥"
english: "In the rainy season, the wind distorts the wind.," "The arrows struck at the midday sun." "1"

prakrit: "जेहिं सोहग्गणिही दिट्ठो नयणेहि ते च्चिय रुयन्तु ।,अङ्गाइ अपावियसङ्गमाइ ता कीस खिज्जन्ति ॥ १ ॥"
english: "One who has not had a good look at someone must be crying. What makes one angry If one's limbs are immovable?" ""

prakrit: "तुह सुरयपवरतरुपल्लवग्गकवलाण लद्धमाहप्पो ।,मह मणकरहो मुद्धे दक्खाकबलं पि परिहरइ ॥ २ ॥"
english: "Foolish girl, you're not supposed to fight. But the strength of your heart Makes it go away." 2

prakrit: "विरहग्गिजलणजालाकरालियं कुवलयच्छि मह अङ्गं ।,तुह रमणमहाणइपाणिएण मुद्धे पविज्झाहि ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "The flame of separation is like a bucket of water: it is my organ., Filled with the purest water Because of your loving - kindness." 3

prakrit: "रेहइ पियपडिरुम्भण१ पसारियं सुरयमन्दिरद्दारे ।,हेलाहल्लावियथोरथणहरं भुयलयाजुयलं ॥ ४ ॥"
english: "The plowman is so full of water That he knocks on the door of the Sun Temple every day.," "Yellow jasmine, twisted by the storm." "4."

prakrit: "ता जाइ ता नियत्तइ ठाणं गन्तूण झत्ति वाहुडइ ।,पियविरहो घोडा विग्गहो व्व हियए न सण्ठाइ ॥ ५ ॥"
english: "Whatever she sets out to do, Let her hasten on." "Dear friend, Don't be so hasty As to spoil the horse." 5 "

prakrit: "न जलन्ति न धगधगन्ति न सिमसिमन्ति न मुयन्ति धूमवत्तीओ ।,अङ्गाइ अणङ्गपरव्वसाइ एमेव डज्झन्ति ॥ ६ ॥"
english: "They neither burn nor burn, They do not scorch nor wither, They only stink because their limbs are paralyzed." 6

prakrit: "वड्ढसि विरहे हस्ससि समागमे हा निसे निसंसा सि ।,भद्दे तुमं पि महिला तह वि हु दुक्खं न याणासि ॥ ७ ॥"
english: "When you grow up, You laugh without ceasing, You are careless, Worse still is your wife. 7" "You do not know sorrow."

prakrit: "ता किं करेमि माए निज्जियरूवस्स कामदेवस्स ।,दड्ढं पि डहइ अङ्गं निद्धूमो सङ्खचुण्णु व्व ॥ १ ॥"
english: "So what do I do, you stubborn and stubborn girl? 1." ""

prakrit: "हारेण मामि कुसुमच्छडायलुप्पन्नचिच्चिणा दड्ढो ।,वम्मीसणो न मन्नइ उलूविओ तेण मं डहइ ॥ २ ॥"
english: "Look, mother - in - law! The lotus of my face is smeared with red ghee. But wretched woman, do you not believe it? It scares me to death." 2

prakrit: "जे के वि रसा दिट्ठीउ जाउ जे भरहभाविया भावा ।,ते नच्चिज्जन्ति अणच्चिया वि सहसा पिए दिट्ठे ॥ १ ॥"
english: "Anyone who has a good feeling should look at the juice. Even a nasty person will suddenly see the drink." 1.

prakrit: "सो कत्थ गओ सो सुयणवल्लहो सो सुहासियसमुद्दो ।,सो मयणग्गिविणासो जो सो सोसेइ मह हिययं१ ॥ २ ॥"
english: "Where did he go wrong He was not a good man And there was no need for him to be sober?" "I have a hard time finding out who he is." ""

prakrit: "सो मासो तं पि दिणं सा राई सव्वलक्खणसउण्णा ।,अमयं व तं मुहुत्तं जत्थ पिओ झत्ति दीसिहिइ२ ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "So let me give you that mustard seed, Which at that moment my husband gave me as quickly as he could." 3

prakrit: "हिययट्ठिओ वि पिओ तह वि हु नयणाण होइ दुप्पेच्छो ।,पेच्छह विहिणा न कया मह उयरे जालयगवक्खा ॥ ४ ॥१"
english: "Though my heart is set on burning, I am still very discerning. Instead of burning my heart, I burn with burning fire." 4: 1

prakrit: "होही तं किं पि दिणं जत्थ पिओ बाहुपञ्जरणिबद्धो ।,वित्ते सुरयपसङ्गे पुच्छिहिइ पवासदुक्खाइं२ ॥ ५ ॥"
english: "Oh! what shall I give her If her arms are tied around me?" The farmer asks curtly, Feigning sleep: "It's the pains of old age."

prakrit: "दिन्नं गेण्हइ,अप्पेइ पत्थियं,असइ,भोयणं देइ ।,अक्खइ गुज्झं पुच्छेइ पडिवयं जाण तं रत्तं ॥ ६ ॥"
english: "She gives milk, You give milk, We give her flowers. One day she will ask the guzzler What it is that needs blood." 6

prakrit: "अहवा तुज्झ न दोसो तस्स उ रूवस्स हियकिलेसस्स ।,अज्जावि न प्पसीयइ ईसायन्ति व्व गिरितणया३ ॥ १ ॥"
english: "Oh! you are not to blame, you silly girl! Even now people do not reply Because they are jealous." ""

prakrit: "कस्स कहिज्जन्ति फुडं दूहविणट्ठाइ सहि कज्जाइं ।,अहवा लोयपसिद्धं न फलन्ति समक्कडारामा ॥ २ ॥"
english: "Who is to say," "Friend, let's work together?" "Or" "The principle of detachment does not work in harmony." "2."

prakrit: "सा दियहं चिय पेच्छइ नयणा पडियाइ दप्पणतलम्मि ।,एएहि तुमं दिट्ठो सि सुहय दोहिं पि अच्छीहिं ॥ १ ॥"
english: "She looks at me with such longing That both eyes are fixed on you." "1."

prakrit: "दुक्खेहि वि तुह विरहे बालय दुक्खं ठियं,अह च्चाए ।,अंसूजलेहि रूण्णं नीसासेहिं पि नीससियं ॥ २ ॥"
english: "Though I am sorrowful, In your absence I remain miserable., Even though I weep for you With tears in my eyes, I never cease to be sorrowful." 2

prakrit: "बालय नाहं दूई तीइ पिओ सि त्ति नम्ह वावारो ।,सा मरइ तुज्झ अअसो त्ति तेण धम्मक्खरं भणिमो१ ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "Child, my dear, I am not her lover. She is dying, For your part, I dare say, So speak the dharma." ""

prakrit: "सा सुहय सामलङ्गी जा सा नीसाससोसियसरीरा ।,आसासिज्जइ१ सहसा जाव न सासा समप्पन्ति२ ॥ ४ ॥"
english: "She is happy, She is content., Hope not, Suddenly, Go and finish your love.," 4.

prakrit: "परपुरपवेसविन्नाणलाहवं सुहय सिक्खियं कत्थ ।,जेण पविट्ठो हियए पढम च्चिय दंसणे मज्झ ॥ ५ ॥"
english: "How can I learn happiness When my husband is absent? 5." "As for me, I see the first sign of holiness In a man's heart."

prakrit: "उद्धच्छो पियइ जलं जह जह विरलङ्गुली चिरं पहिओ ।,पावालिया वि तह तह धारं तणुयं पि तणुएइ ॥ १ ॥"
english: "The drier the water, The thinner the traveler's fingers. Even so the stream is thin" "1."

prakrit: "अहिणवगज्जियसद्दं मोराण य कलयलं निसामन्तो ।,मा पवस धिट्ठ पन्थिय,मरिहिसि,किं ते पउत्थेण ॥ २ ॥"
english: "Non - existence is the greatest virtue. Moran, do not trouble yourself: You must die, my dear. 2" "Is that the way?"

prakrit: "वासारत्ते वाउद्धुएण वासं विमग्गमाणेण ।,पहिएण पहियघरिणो रुयाविया थरहरन्तेण ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "When the wind blows, The wretched tree is destroyed. 3 The cry of the housewife Is like a shuddering thunder." ""

prakrit: "सिहिरडियं घणरडियं दूरं पि घरं घणत्थणं रमणिं ।,सम्भरिऊण सएसं पहिएण घणग्घणं रूण्णं ॥ ४ ॥"
english: "Though the road is long, I make sure that I get home quickly." 4 The traveler's thick, thick hair grows thicker as he travels along the river.

prakrit: "तइ वोलन्ते बालय तिस्सा वलियाइ तह नु अङ्गाइं ।,जह पट्ठिमज्झणिवडन्तवाहधारा व दीसन्ति ॥ ५ ॥"
english: "Thou returnest with a bolt of lightning, Thy limbs so large, That streams of water run down from the jars of thine ear." 5.

prakrit: "इय तरुणितरुणसम्भरणकारणं तुरगतरणरणुच्छलियं ।,रइयं इय वरकुलयं पाइयसीलेण लीलेण ॥ १ ॥"
english: "The reason why this young girl is so anxious to make love is because she looks so fresh., In this way the lotus is enriched with the leaves of the python." 1

prakrit: "हे हियय अव्ववट्ठिय अगणिज्जन्तो वि तं जणं महसि ।,कन्दु व्व सिलावडियं अलद्धपसरं नियत्तिहिसि ॥ १ ॥"
english: "O man, If you are so distressed by what is said and done, You are bound to suffer the same fate." 1

prakrit: "सातम्मि हियय दुलहम्मि माणुसे अलियसङ्गमासाए ।,हरिण व्व मूढ मयतण्हियाइ दूरं हरिज्जिहिसि ॥ २ ॥"
english: "The seventh time the bridegroom is absent from the crowd. Far be it from the deer Or the foolish maidens! 2." ""

prakrit: "नयणाइ नयन्ति नयन्तु,हियय को एत्थ तुज्झ वावारो ।,होहिन्ति इमाइ तडे तुह पडिहिइ वम्महचडक्का ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "Don't be alarmed: It's your husband. Where are you going? It could be that he has a crush on you." 3

prakrit: "नयणाइ फुससु मा रुयसु अणुदिणं,मुयसु तस्स अणुबन्धं ।,गाइज्जइ किं मरिऊण पञ्चमं मुद्ध हरिणच्छि ॥ ४ ॥"
english: "Foolish girl, don't cry every day, stay awake and do your best. One can't die just by looking at the fifth seal." 4

prakrit: "इन्दीवरच्छि सयवारवारिया कीस तं जणं महसि ।,जइ कणयमयच्छुरिया ता किं घाइज्जए अप्पा ॥ ५ ॥"
english: "Aunt, Why are you so fond of me? If you want to be affectionate With someone else, Why bother at all?" 5.

prakrit: "परघरगमणालसिणी परपुरिसविलोयणे य जच्चन्धा ।,परआलावे बहिरा घरस्स लच्छी,न सा घरिणी ॥ १ ॥"
english: "A housewife loves to be pampered by strangers. Deaf people stay indoors all the time, not housewives." 1

prakrit: "अज्जेव पियपवासो,असई दूरे,विडम्बए मयणो ।,चरणुग्गओ वि अग्गी कया वि सीसं समारुहइ ॥ २ ॥"
english: "The stranger is a drunkard's son, We are far away, Struggling with distractions. Even the fire of our feet Resolves in our heads." 2

prakrit: "भद्दं कुलङ्गणाणं जासिं मणकमलकोसमणुपत्तो ।,मयणभमरो वराओ वच्चइ निहणं तहिं चेव ॥ १ ॥"
english: "A poor man's penance Is like the lotus of a lotus. But when a good woman walks in front of a bad man, She does the same." 1

prakrit: "सकुलकलङ्कं नियकन्तवञ्चणं अजसपडहणिग्घोसो ।,सरिसवमेत्ते च सुहे को दूइ विडम्बए अप्पं ॥ २ ॥"
english: "Praise be to the good man, Who in all decency has selected and selected the right people.," "With almost no success Has given way to happiness." "2"

prakrit: "जेण समं सम्बन्धो गिण्हह नामं पुणो पुणो तस्स ।,पुच्छेइ मित्तवग्गं भण्णइ एवंविहा रत्ता ॥ १ ॥"
english: "If you ask her how things are, She'll tell you that her name is new. And the marriage will go well." 1

prakrit: "असई असमत्तरया सयडं दटठूण गाममज्झम्मि ।,धन्ना हु चक्कणाही निच्चं अक्खो हिओ जिस्सा ॥ २ ॥"
english: "Blessed are the eyes which do not shine While looking at each other Through the thickets of the village streets." 2

prakrit: "डिम्भत्तणभ्मि डिम्भेहि रामिया जोव्वणे जुवाणेहिं ।,थेरी वि गयवएहिं मया वि असई पिसाएहिं ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "The woman with the dimpled eyes Is like a young man in his youth. Even now that she has gone away I perceive her as still a child." 3

prakrit: "भयवं हुयास एक्कम्ह दुक्कयं खमसु जं पई रमिओ ।,निहणइ पावं जाराणुमरणकयणिच्छया असई ॥ ४ ॥"
english: "Fear not, my dear: One can only regret what one has to say." "4 The poor thing is that she does not want to die."

prakrit: "सङ्केयकुडङ्गोड्डीणसउणकोलाहलं सुणन्तीए ।,घरकम्मवावडाए वहूइ खिज्जन्ति अङ्गाइं१ ॥ ५ ॥"
english: "You hear the rustle of crickets singing the dainties of the cucumber tree. The women in the household groan as they shake their limbs." ""

prakrit: "जारठ्ठविणिम्मियमेहलावलिं जा न बन्धइ निवम्बे ।,ताव च्चिय नवकामालिणीइ रमणं व पज्झरियं ॥ ६ ॥"
english: "Do not be bound by false vows. For then the newlywed bridegroom will enjoy the pleasures of love and affection." 6

prakrit: "जारमसाणसमुब्भवभूईसुहफंससिज्जिरङ्गीए ।,न समप्पइ नवकामालिणीइ उद्धूलणारम्भो ॥ ७ ॥"
english: "The pleasure of fornication Is compounded by the bright hues of your lips. But do not stop until the newlywed has begun to pluck them." 7

prakrit: "बहले तमन्धयारे रमियपमुक्काण सासुसुण्हाणं ।,समयं चिय अब्भिडिया दोण्हं पि सरद्दहे हत्था ॥ ८ ॥"
english: "The mother - in - law is overjoyed at the outpouring of affection. Time, my dear, has turned both of us upside down." 8

prakrit: "सम्पत्तिया वि खज्जइ पत्तच्छेयभ्मि,माभि को दोसो ।,निययवई वि रमिज्जइ परपुरिसविवज्जिए गामे ॥ ९ ॥"
english: "Wealth also spoils the field, Cut the leaf, Blame the mother - in - law., But politeness also makes one rejoice. 9 In a village one divides oneself." ""

prakrit: "रच्छातुलग्गवडिओ नालत्तो जं जणस्स भीयाए ।,सो चेय विरहडाहो अज्ज वि हियए छमच्छमइ ॥ १० ॥"
english: "Aunt, The man you love is not worth the trouble. Even now I can see him in your heart." 10

prakrit: "अच्छीहि तेण भणियं मए वि हियएण तस्स पडिवन्नं ।,जा पत्तियं पि जायं घुणहुणियं ता हयग्गामे ॥ ११ ॥"
english: "If I tell you the truth, It's only because I told you so. Even if I misbehave, I'll get away with it." 11

prakrit: "सिञ्चन्तो वि मियङ्को जोण्हासलिलेण पङ्कयवणाइं ।,तह वि अणिट्ठयरो च्चिय,सकलङ्को कस्स पडिहाइ ॥ १२ ॥"
english: "Even an irrigated cow gives milk That is mixed with the juice of the nectar. Who is to blame? 12." ""

prakrit: "अत्ता जाणइ सुण्हं सुण्हा जाणेइ अत्तचरियाइं ।,वच्चउ सुहेण कालो मा फुट्टउ बिल्ल बिल्लेण ॥ १३ ॥"
english: "Mother - in - law knows what is to be heard And what is not to be eaten. Please, my son, for the sake of your happiness Do not break the billet." 13

prakrit: "पढमं चिय मह रेहा असईमज्झम्मि उब्भिओ हत्थो ।,सरणामि तुज्झ पाया सुरसरि दूयत्तणं कुणइ ॥ १४ ॥"
english: "My poor thing is that I can't put my hands anywhere else on you. I promise I'll make your feet smell good." 14

prakrit: "सीसेण कह न कीरइ निउम्बणं मामि तस्स गणयस्स ।,असमत्तसुक्कसङ्कमणवेयणाजेण मह मुणिया ॥ १ ॥"
english: "Tell me, Mother, Why don't you take my breasts as your own? It's my uncircumcised breasts That cause me to sigh." 1

prakrit: "धुत्तीरएण धम्मिय जो होइ चडाविएण एक्केण ।,सो कुरयाण सएण वि न होइ लिङ्गस्स परिओसो ॥ १ ॥"
english: "One who is dharmic by virtue of being dhurtir is one who is extremely virtuous., So regardless of what the Quran says, one should avoid touching the lingam." "1."

prakrit: "धम्मिय धम्मो सुव्वइ दाणेण तवेण तित्थजत्ताए ।,तरुणतरुपल्लवुल्लूरणेण धम्मो कहिं दिट्ठो ॥ २ ॥"
english: "The dharma seals all dharmas By charity alone., Where can one look for dharma If one turns one's gaze away While one is young?" 2.

prakrit: "तोलिज्जन्ति न केण वि सव्वङ्गायारगोवणसमत्था ।,अन्नं उण हिययतुलाइ दिट्ठं चिय तुलन्ति ॥ १ ॥"
english: "No one is as sharp as a cow in every way. One's eyes, moistened by affection, match that of a buffalo." 1

prakrit: "पज्झरणं रोमञ्चो वयणे सच्चं सया महादिट्ठी ।,एयं पुणो वि सिक्खसु मुद्धे अत्थक्कविन्नाणं ॥ १ ॥"
english: "The truth is always more important than words. So learn again how to reason honestly." 1

prakrit: "करफंसमलणचुम्बणपीलणणिहणाइ हरिसवयणेहिं ।,अत्ता मायन्दणिहीण किं पि कुमरीउ सिक्खवइ ॥ २ ॥"
english: "Mother - in - law, teach a virgin anything without medicine. 2." ""

prakrit: "अमुणियजम्मुप्पत्ती सव्वगया बहुभुयङ्गपरिमलिया ।,मयणविणासणसीला हरो व्व वेसा सुहं देउ ॥ १ ॥"
english: "Immutable jasmine, endowed with many different shades.," "Give pleasure to those who languish in a state of delusion." "1"

prakrit: "सव्वङ्गरागरत्तं दंसइ कणवीरकुसुमसारिच्छं ।,गब्भे कह वि न रत्तं वेसाहिययं तह च्चेव ॥ २ ॥"
english: "The whole sky looks like a lotus, But blood does not mix with it anywhere. 2." ""

prakrit: "उव्वूढभुवणभारो वि केसवो थणहरेण राहाए ।,मालइदल व्व कलिओ लहुइज्जइ को न पेम्मेण ॥ १ ॥"
english: "Even a hair heavy with long hair Stands on its breast. Love does not spoil a bud Like a garland." 1

prakrit: "तह रुण्णं तीइ तडट्ठियाइ राहाइ कण्हविरहम्मि ।,जह से कज्जलमइलं अज्ज वि जउणाजलं वहइ ॥ २ ॥"
english: "There were tears welling up in her eyes And the road was slippery. So that even to this day the lotus carries the water of youth." 2

prakrit: "छीए जीव न भणियं परियणमज्झम्मि पोढमहिलाए ।,छोडेइ चिहुरभारं पुण बद्धं केण कज्जेण ॥ १ ॥"
english: "We do not live in the same village As the woman who fell asleep on our husband's bed., Leaving the weight of our face firmly on our shoulders For some reason." 1

prakrit: "कुलबालिया पसूया पुत्तवई सुरयकज्जतत्तिल्ला ।,एरिसगुणसम्पन्ना भण कीस न वासिया पइणा ॥ २ ॥"
english: "Cool girl, My son, The sun has not yet risen. Tell me, Why, my dear, Is there no woman Who possesses such qualities?" 2

prakrit: "कस्स कएण किसोयरि वरणयरं वहसि उत्तमङ्गेणं ।,कण्णेण कण्णवंहणं वाणरसङ्खं च हत्थेण ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "Whom do you blame? A pair of white robes, Like the bracelets on a wife's bosom, Are tied around her ear And covered with gooseflesh?" 3

prakrit: "लङ्कालएण रत्तम्बरवेसिण दिन्नपुप्फयाणेण ।,दहवयणेणेव कयं सीयाहरणं पलासेण ॥ १ ॥"
english: "Because of the lampshade, For the festival of diyas is over., For who can describe what it is Like to be naked? 1." ""

prakrit: "गुरुविरहसन्धिविग्गहणिम्मवणो अत्थि को वि जइ मत्तो ।,पढमिक्कमञ्जरिं अङ्गुलिं व उब्भेइ सहयारो ॥ १ ॥"
english: "In the absence of a teacher One cannot help laughing Even if one's limbs are paralyzed by intoxication." 1.

prakrit: "चञ्चुपुडकोडिवियलियमायन्दरसोहसित्तदेहस्स ।,कीरस्स मग्गलग्गं भमरउलं भमइ गन्धड्ढं ॥ २ ॥"
english: "A swarm of bees pursues the parrot Whose feathers are smeared with red ghee, Like the petals of a beehive." 2

prakrit: "सच्चं चेव पलासो असइ पलं विरहियाण महुमासे ।,तित्तिं अवच्चमाणो जलइ व्व छुहाइ सव्वङ्गं ॥ ३ ॥"
english: "Truth alone triumphs, not separation alone. But when it is consumed, The whole heaven is set on fire." 3

prakrit: "सुहियाण सुहञ्जणया दुक्खञ्जणया य दुक्खियजणस्स ।,एए सोहञ्जणया सोहञ्जणया वसन्तस्स ॥ ४ ॥"
english: "Happy is the man of pleasure, sorrow is the person of pain.," "Oh, beautiful is the spring of pleasure." "4."

prakrit: "विज्जुभुयङ्गमसहियं चवलबलायाकवालकयसोहं ।,गज्जियफुडट्टहासं भइरवरूवं नहं जायं ॥ १ ॥"
english: "The joy of riding a lightning bolt Is nothing like that of laughing at a thunderclap." 1

prakrit: "अनेनैव पद्धतिक्रमेण गाथारत्नकोशप्रक्रमा ज्ञातव्याः."
english: "By other methods the chronological order of the ballads is known."

prakrit: "पणमह पुरिसॊत्तमनाहितणयमुहनलिणवासिणिं वाणिं,जीए पवयणजोन्हं सुकइचओरा परिलिहन्ति"
english: "Aunt, The words of a man without a name Sound familiar to those affronted:" "The pleasures of love find their way into everyone's heart." ""

prakrit: "सुकइवयण'ण्णवाओ विचित्तरयणाणि सुत्तिरयणाणि,गहिऊण कओ कोसो अओ अ गाहारयणकोसो"
english: "By drying up the fields You only cause annoyance, By making them look like crickets, And by making them resemble parrots."

prakrit: "पढमं चिय पढमजिणस्स नमह नहमणिमऊहरमणिज्जं,अङ्कुरिअमॊक्खपायवबीयनिहाणं व पयकमलं"
english: "Aunt, Please, do not touch me If you are about to read this. A lotus grows on my head Like the petals of a fruit tree."

prakrit: "पडिवज्जन्तो वि सया कलन्तरं नेअ जस्स मुहचिन्हं,पावइ चन्दो तं कमलकुलगिहं नमह वीरजिणं"
english: "Even a poor man's face reveals nothing, For the moon is like a lotus Surrounded by lotuses."

prakrit: "तं पणमह तिगिन्निच्छलंण निवसइ निवेसकलम्मि,जस्स परिमाणनिवहो व्व भुवणनिम्माणपडिवन्नो"
english: "That lotus dwells in the shadow of the moon, Like a column of water rising from the sky."

prakrit: "पढमं चिय धवलकओववीयमम्बुरुहगोयरं नमह,हरिनिजजढरमोखित्तनालसुत्तं पिव सयम्भुं"
english: "At first I frowned, But when he said that, I could not help laughing:" "The goose is white and its beak is yellow." ""

prakrit: "सेसफणामणिदप्पणविंविज्जन्तस्स कोलरूवस्स,धरणिधरणम्मि हरिणो वराहजूहाइयं नमह"
english: "Bow before the deer That steps on the riverbank To face the water That flows from the pond."

prakrit: "तं नमह जस्स वच्छे लच्छिमुहं कॊत्थुहम्मि सङ्कन्तं,दीसइ मयपरिहीणं ससिविम्बं सूरविंवम्मि"
english: "Praise be to the sunshine, Which, like a lac on a buffalo's back, bends the trunk of a helpless sapling."

prakrit: "रक्खतु वो रोमलया मायामहिलत्तणे महुमहस्स,गूढोयरतामरसाणुसारिणी भमरमाल व्व"
english: "Protect her! The bee is hiding in the shade of the mango tree, Like a jasmine spitting poison in the dark." ""

prakrit: "वियडससिमण्डलायन्तसलिलभरियम्मि भुवणवलयम्मि,हरिणो हरिणच्छायाविलासपरिसण्ठियं जयइ"
english: "A swarm of gnats hovers over the slanting deer, The deer triumphs over the shady grasshopper."

prakrit: "तं नमह जस्स रेहइ वियडजडाहारपासपडिलग्गं,रइकलहकुविअपव्वइविभिण्णवलयं व ससिखण्डं"
english: "Praise be to her who dwells in the expanse of the sky, In the thickets on the banks of the Vindhya, Where one can hear the wind blowing, And in the hollows of the trees."

prakrit: "पणमह पणयपकुव्वियगोरीचलणग्गलग्गपडिविंवं,दससु नहदप्पणेसुं एयारहतणुहरं रुद्दं"
english: "A flock of parrots is hovering over the waterfall, Moving from side to side Like a flock of geese Moving in unison." ""

prakrit: "तं नमह जो जडायडलीलासन्दाणियं समुव्वहइ,गोरीकवोव्वरियकन्तिसेसं पिव मयङ्कं"
english: "Praise be to her who, wearing a garland of jewels, Assemble at dawn To feast her eyes on the fairies."

prakrit: "पमुवइणो रोसारुणपडिमासङ्कन्तगोरिमुहयन्दं,गहिय'ग्घपङ्कयं पिव सञ्झासलिलञ्जलिं नमह"
english: "Bow before the lotus of the wife's face. Reflecting on the fragrance of the holy lotus, The woman greets her husband with a soft sigh." ""

prakrit: "नन्दउ सच्छन्दगई निम्मलपयपूरगारवमहग्घो,जलहिपडिरुद्धपसरो सुकईण सरस्सईपवहो"
english: "Nanda, please, do not swallow the lotus That has just been plucked from the neem tree By a snake stuck in the jasmine's snout."

prakrit: "आसंसारं कइपुङ्गवेहिं तद्दियहगहियसारो वि,अज्ज वि अभिन्नमुद्दो व्व जयइ वायापरिप्फन्दो"
english: "Though the sky was overcast with clouds, Yet today it is overcast With clouds Like a victory banner."

prakrit: "पणमह पणमन्तमहाकइन्दसङ्कन्तनयणपडिविंवं,कयनीलुप्पलपूयं व भारईचरणनहनिवहं"
english: "I will never forget how, With my mind glued to my pen, I plucked at the tips of the young shoots That pierced through my hair."

prakrit: "तं नमह भारइं जीए चरणनहदप्पणेसु सङ्कन्ता,बहुवयणा होन्ति फुडं पणमन्ता तक्खणे कइणो"
english: "Toh namah bharain jiye charan nahadapanesu sankanta, how come the many - eyed hunter has no time for words like that?"

prakrit: "सरसा वि हु कव्वकहा परिओसं कुणइ कस्स वि मणम्मि,फुल्लन्ति न सयलतरू वरतरुणीचरणफंसेण"
english: "Even the headman's daughter acts like a poetess to any man. She does not blossom But grows as a flower on the twigs of her husband's wife."

prakrit: "ललिए महुर'क्खरिए जुवईजणवल्लहे ससिङ्गारे,सन्ते पाइयकव्वे को सक्कइ सक्कयं पढिउं?"
english: "Long - eyed girl, Young man or maiden, How can I describe how happy I am To read your heart?"

prakrit: "पाइयकव्वं पढिउं गुम्फेउं तह य कुज्जयपसूणं,कुवियं च पसाहेउं अज्ज वि वहवे न याणन्ति"
english: "Even to this day they do not know what to read in a pyre, What to eat in a cave, And what to drink in a well."

prakrit: "चिन्तामन्दरमन्थाणमन्थिए वित्थियम्मि अत्थाहे,उप्पज्जन्तिकइहिययसायरे कव्वरयणाइं"
english: "Thoughts confine one to thoughts, Though emotions distract one from them, Like poems composed in ecstasy."

prakrit: "अणवरयबहुलरोमञ्चकञ्चुयं जणियजणमणाणन्दं,जं न धुणावइ सीसं कव्वं पिम्मं च किं तेण?"
english: "What makes a man who does not wash his hair blush As though he did not know how to brush his teeth?"

prakrit: "कइणो जयन्तु ते जलहिणो व्व उवजी विऊण जाण पयं,अन्ने विजणा भुवणे कुणन्ति घन्नाण उक्करिसं"
english: "How can one conquer that waterless forest If one knows how to weed it out?"

prakrit: "हिययाइं सज्जणांणं रञ्जइ कसिणेइ खलयणमुहांइ,कव्वं सुहासिअं पि हु जाण नमो ताण सुकईणं"
english: "Here men paint their faces, Some sulk, And poets make their faces appear swollen. But we know how to make them dry."

prakrit: "सालङ्काराहिं मणोहराहिं अन्नुन्नरायरसियाहि,गाहाहिं पणइणीहिं वि डज्झइ हिययं अयन्ती हिं"
english: "Aunt, There must be something very special about your husband. Even his favorite wife is afraid She won't come."

prakrit: "छन्दं अयाणमाणेहि जा कया सा न होइ रमणीआ,किं गाहा न हु सेवा? अहवा गाहा वि सेवा वि"
english: "If the song goes on like this, Will it not be more beautiful? Why not sing it? Or sing it again And again?" ""

prakrit: "अद्धक्खरभणियाइं नूणं सविलासअद्धहसियाइं,अद्धच्छिपॆच्छिआइं वि गाहाहिं विणा न नज्जन्ति"
english: "Silly women speak nonsense, Silly men laugh, But without their husbands They make no sound."

prakrit: "अइचम्पिय विणस्सइ दन्तच्छेएण होइ विच्छायं,ढलहलयं विय मुच्चइ पाइयकव्वं च पिम्मं च"
english: "A tooth is pierced by an invisible nail, It falls off and becomes lodged in the mouth of the pyre."

english: "There is no room for doubt: The sky is white, The rivers are red, The roads are impassable, And the paths are slippery."

prakrit: "छिन्नाण सोसियाण य दाहं पत्ताण छिद्दभरियाण,अहममुहदूसियाण वि सुहो उ सद्दो सुवंसाण"
english: "To steal is to suffer, To burn is to splinter, To smile is to be happy, And to lament is to enjoy."

prakrit: "हियए जाओ,नोचेव पसरिओ,नेय पयडिओ लोए,ववसायपायवो सुपुरिसाण लक्खिज्जइ फलेहिं"
english: "Go away, spread abroad your knowledge, For in this wretched land, Like a good man's business, There will be abundant fruit."

prakrit: "न हु महुमहस्स वच्छे,मत्थे कमलाण,नेय खीरोए,ववसायपायवे सुपुरिसाण लच्छी फुडं होइ"
english: "I don't see bees in the sky, I see lotuses on the forehead, Never see cucumbers. Anybody who travels by sea Will find a good supply of these delicious flowers."

prakrit: "सब्भावखलाण वि कुणइ किं पि सुयणत्तणं सुयणसङ्गो,झीणस्स वि कज्जलमीसि घडइणयणस्स लायण्णं"
english: "With all your affection you cause distress. Anything that makes you drowsy Makes you sound like a slut." ""

prakrit: "सच्चरियनिम्मलाणं अलिअपराण वि सिरीओ वड्ढन्ति,सच्छिद्दाणं मुत्ताण रायवच्छत्थलारोहो"
english: "Though still a child, His true nature Makes him grow taller. But when he grows taller He is like a banner proclaiming victory."

prakrit: "किं इत्तिएण गयणङ्गणस्स गरुअत्तणं समोसरइ?,सज्जणहिययस्स न जित्तितेएण सरिसाइयं तेण"
english: "Is this the reason why the Gyananganas are so averse to boldness?, It is because they cannot win over their elders That they are so won over."

prakrit: "सुयणो तुसारसरिसो ताविज्जन्तो विलाइ,न हु जलइ,इयरो दीवयसरिसो कयनेहो जलइ अहिअयरं"
english: "I will not burn," whispered the doe, "Nor will I quench my thirst By burning all the days of my life."

prakrit: "सुयणत्तणं न केण वि अन्तोमलिणाण तीरए काउं,सीसेण वहन्तस्स वि हरस्स वङ्को च्चिय मयङ्को"
english: "Don't let anyone deceive you by lying on your back. Even someone who is angry with you Will turn your back on you."

prakrit: "पुरिसा जे गुणरहिया कुलेण गव्वं वहन्ति ते मूढा,वंसुप्पण्णं पि धणु गुणरहिअं भणह किं कुणइ?"
english: "Foolish men are those who take merit for granted, But what good is it to be wealthy and virtuous Despite one's virginity?"

prakrit: "गुरुआ वि जेसु मडहा सङ्कन्ता दप्पणेसु दीसन्ति,जुत्तमिणं जं दिज्जइ जणेण छारं मुहे तस्स"
english: "The Guru also shows us what it takes to shrink back and forth, But what he gives us is the shadow of a man."

prakrit: "पुरिसाण कुलीणाण वि न कुलं विणयस्स कारणं होइ,चन्दा'मय-लच्छिसहोयरं पि मारेइ किं न विसं?"
english: "If the husband's weakness is not the cause of his family's unhappiness, shouldn't Chanda also kill her lover?" ""

prakrit: "जह कणयं तह परिमाणपत्थरं बे वि तुलइ नाराओ,अहवा निरक्खराणं गुण-दोसवियारणा कत्तो?"
english: "The more the particle, the more the scale; Where is the slogan, Ahava niraksharana, Virtuous speech?"

prakrit: "दोमुहं! निरक्खर! लोहमइय! नाराय! कित्तियं भणिमो,गुञ्जाहिं समं कणयं तुलन्त न गओ'सि पायालं"
english: "Two faces! Impudent! Iron - faced! What do you mean, Narayan? Don't be so touchy As to cause confusion." "You fool!" ""

prakrit: "विद्दवियगुणो दोसॆक्कपायडो नेहखवणतत्तिल्लो,दीवो व्व खलो आसन्नसण्ठिओ कं न मइलेइ?"
english: "Why not get rid of the odd quality dotted all over? It's like a lamp illuminating an approaching setting." ""

prakrit: "सज्जणसङ्गेण वि दुज्जणस्स न हु कलुसिमा समोसरइ,ससिमण्डलमज्झपरिट्ठिओ वि कसिणो च्चिय कुरङ्गो"
english: "Even with a decent man, There is no room for any malice. But even with a modest one, A cunning monkey has his way"

prakrit: "गुणलेसो विन सुयण! तुज्झ घडन्तस्स किं पि उव्वरिओ,मन्ने दोसमओ च्चिय तेण जए दुज्जणो घडिओ"
english: "Virtuous people, sleep! No matter what happens to you, Resolve, for the wrong time has been set aside For the sake of the wrong one." ""

prakrit: "मलिणायारं दट्ठूण मण्डलो भसउ तस्स न हु दोसो,दुट्ठखलो अपरॊक्खे विमलसहावाण वि भसेइ"
english: "You are not to blame if you see a garland of lotuses. Even a spiky bee can be found roasting in the open field."

prakrit: "वसइ जहिं चेव खलो पोसिज्जन्तो वि नेहदाणेण,तं चेव आलयं दीवओ व्व अचिरेण मइलेइ"
english: "Wherever there is a habitation, Destroyed even by nature, There is a temple of lamps Which will soon be destroyed."

prakrit: "अकुलीणो दोमुहओ ता महुरो भोयणं मुहे जाव,मुरओ व्व खलो जिन्नम्मि भोयणे विरसमारसइ"
english: "A lonely man has two faces, A poor man has three, And a poor woman has three."

prakrit: "निद्धम्मो गुणरहिओचावविमुक्को य लॊद्दसम्भूओ,विन्धइ जणस्स हिययं पिसुणो वाण व्व भग्गन्तो"
english: "Niddhamma, virtuous woman, Fettered by greed, Is as fragile as a bow When pierced by a sharp arrow"

prakrit: "न सद्दइ अब्भत्थणियं,असइ गयाणं पि पिट्ठिमंसाइं,दट्ठूण भासुरमुहं खलसीहं को न वीहेइ?"
english: "Never mind the gossip, Not even when you're singing are you scared? But who doesn't like a sulking Khalasi when he sees one with a pale face?"

prakrit: "खलसङ्गे परिचत्ते पॆच्छह तॆल्लेण जं फलं पत्तं,मयणाहिसुरहिवासं पहुसीसं पावियं तेण"
english: "The fruit leaf you plucked from the field Looks like a lotus As you walked up to it To welcome the rainy season." ""

prakrit: "होही खलु त्ति कलिऊण णियमणे मामि जन्तदियएहि,पत्तेहिं नवरि मुक्को फलिओ वि तिलो अवेक्खाए"
english: "Oh! what a cruel man he is, Aunt! In his spare time he has given birth to many animals, And now the young wife throws away even a handful of berries."

prakrit: "सो सद्दो,तं धवलत्तणं च,रयणायरम्मि उप्पत्ती,सङ्खस्स हिययकुडिलत्तणेण सव्वं पि पब्भट्ठं"
english: "So sad, so bullish, The river is overflowing with rain clouds, And everything is ruined Because of the mud and mud of the lake."

prakrit: "मेहा इव दोजीद्दा पयं समासाइऊण अइकलुसा,सच्छन्दगमणसीला सयलं पि जणं कयत्थन्ति"
english: "May be he is not alive, just keeping his cool, Where else can one go when one's mind is free?"

prakrit: "सुयणो मुहा किलम्मइ,हरइ खलो ज्जेव नवर पहुहिययं,तरुणो फलाइ गहिउं तरइ कई,न उण पञ्चमुहो"
english: "A swine's face grows pale, A young man's cheeks grow pale, And a young wife puts on her jewels. She has no more than five faces."

prakrit: "लहुवित्तस्स वि पहुणो गरुया लीयन्ति सुद्धहिययस्स,मडहे वि दप्पणे सङ्कमन्ति गरुआ वि गयवइणो"
english: "Even in lethargy One attains greatness, Only when one is mature Does one attain greatness."

prakrit: "तेयस्सीण पसाओ लहू वि वियडं घडेइ महिमाणं,ऎक्केण वि रविकिरणेण गयणमक्कमइ हरिणङ्को"
english: "Because of him, even blood begets glory, And because of Ravikiran, deer for song." ""

prakrit: "पगइखलेसुं पि पियंवएसु पहुणो वहन्ति परिओसं,कुडिलहिययस्स सङ्खस्स हरइ हिययं सरो मुहरो"
english: "Even with her feet ajar, The woman embraces her lover, Her face darkened by the marks on her body." ""

prakrit: "उन्नयसिहो वि दीवो न हणइ हिट्ठट्ठियं तिमिरनियरं,अहवा'भिमाणमुक्कं पहुणो पालेन्ति रिउवग्गं"
english: "Though you lift it up, The lamp does not touch it." "With a trembling heart It is as if you had reached the mouth of a mountain"

prakrit: "नीया वि समत्थेहि गहिया उच्चं लहन्ति सण्ठाणं,धूलिकणा पुहवीए चरन्ति गयणम्मि वाएणं"
english: "The wind blows thick and high, The grasshopper hovers over the grasshoppers, And the cow makes love in the air."

prakrit: "हिट्ठट्ठियजडनियरं तह य सुपत्ताइं उत्तमङ्गम्मि,जह धरइ तरू तह जइ पहू वि ता किं न पज्जत्तं?"
english: "If a woman puts on her best foot, If her husband puts on his best, If he keeps it, Then why not her husband?"

prakrit: "नविणा जं सहइ गुणो वि,सहइ दोसो वि जीए परियरिओ,कम्मणमेगं भुयणस्स सरह तं भयवइं लच्छिं"
english: "What's new I bear with me in my virtues, what's lacking in my faults I preserve in my life; but what do I fear from the world around me In the cloud of karma."

prakrit: "गुणगरुयाण वि धणवज्जियाण न हवन्ति चितिया अत्था,लक्खेण वि दीवाणं न दिणं दिणनाहविरहम्मि"
english: "A lamp does not illuminate a person, Not even with the help of a lamp Does not cause grief."

prakrit: "लच्छी-सरस्सईणं लच्छी गरुई,सरस्सई लहुई,इहरा कहमीसरमणुसरन्ति सम्पम्नविज्जा वि"
english: "Lachchi - Mustard seeds attract lachchi, mustard seeds are poisonous, How can one describe the fragrance of a lotus When one looks at it?"

prakrit: "लच्छीए गुणा नियमेण होन्ति,न गुणेहिं हवइ पुण लच्छी,विज्जूओ खलु समेहा हवन्ति,मेहा न सह विज्जू"
english: "Virtuous people prosper by virtue of their merit, virtuous people achieve virtue through virtue, wise people attain virtue through merit, and wise people do not attain merit."

prakrit: "अइसीयलकरपसरो जाओ सम्पुण्णमण्डलो राया,इय चिन्तिऊण लच्छी सव्वङ्गं तम्मि निवसेइ"
english: "After a hard day's work, The whole mandala grows dark, And by thinking of it, Lachchhi lets the whole world dwell in him."

prakrit: "लच्छीलयाइ मूलं गुण-सत्तिपयं परिट्ठियं लोए,जेण अहोगमणं चेव ताण परिवड्ढणे तीए"
english: "Lethargy is the root of virtue - Being content is everything, For as long as one does not give in, stresses increase."

prakrit: "दिन्ताण दाणमेव हि संसै,न य परिभवं कुणइ को उ,दाणेण विरहिआणं न ढलइ लोगो करीणं पि"
english: "Charity alone triumphs, Not one person makes a difference, And charity does not make a difference."

prakrit: "कोडिं दिन्ता वि नमन्ति,मग्गणत्थं धरन्ति जे जीयं,ताण धणूण व पुरिसाण कह णु मा होउ टङ्कारो"
english: "Those who code bow their heads, Those who count live. How can a man be so cruel And men so mean?"

prakrit: "सो वंसगुणो च्चिय एस को वि चावाण फुरियसाराण,जं गुणमुक्काण वि मग्गणाण लक्खं समप्पन्ति"
english: "Therefore, merit alone begets merit, And merit alone consumes millions." ""

prakrit: "चावाण नवरि ऎक्काण सहइ चारुत्तणम्मि टङ्कारो,सहलो मग्गणनिवहो विसज्जिओ जेण नमिऊण"
english: "A clever woman puts up with it all The moment she touches you, But if you refuse to give in You'll be condemned to silence."

prakrit: "दिन्तो जलं पि जलओ स वल्लहो होइ सयल्लोयाणं,निच्चं पसारियकरो करेइ मित्तो वि सन्तावं"
english: "He who burns water by day becomes dearer to all beings, And who scatters mud by himself - Such is the happiness of a friend."

prakrit: "दिन्ति फलाइं जहिच्छं कप्पदुमा,नेय किपि जम्पन्ति,धूमलियजलहरा पाणियं पि दाऊण गज्जन्ति"
english: "Days are like bananas in a bowl, Nays are like water in a jug, But dusty waters scorch the cucumbers."

prakrit: "लहइ गरुयत्तणं चिय दिन्ताण करो विमुक्कदाणो वि,अच्छरियं लहुयायइ सुवण्णभरिओ वि लिन्ताणं"
english: "Aunt, If you're so proud, You'd better stop being angry, For there's something very beautiful About wearing a braid."

prakrit: "न वि तह दूमेइ मणं गयस्स वन्धो व्व करिणिविरहो व्व,दाणविओयविमुहिए जह भमरउले भमन्तम्मि"
english: "Not so much the anger of the hunter as the resentment heaped on his wife By the bees that crawl on her breast."

prakrit: "जो सहइ समरमज्झे मुणाललीलाए पहरणसयाइं,नूणं दाणावसरे तस्स वि हिययं चमक्केइ"
english: "One who puts up a brave front, Protects oneself against the rays of the moon, And shines brightly Even while making offerings to the gods."

prakrit: "जडसंसग्गुल्लसिओ विलसन्तो विरसवाणिओ निच्चं,पयडियवहुविहदोसो किं जलही? न हि,कुसामी वि"
english: "If you groan, If you moan, You mutter, Why, my poor girl, Are you still burning? You're not angry At all." ""

prakrit: "पलए महागुणाणां हवन्ति सेवारिहा लहुगुणा वि,अत्थमिए दिणनाहे अहिलसइ जणो पईवं पि"
english: "So long as the husband is in the service of great virtues The poor wretched man is only to be treated as a pauper."

prakrit: "ओलग्गिओ'सि धम्म'म्ह हॊज्ज इण्हिं नडिद! वच्चामो,आलिहियकुञ्जरस्स व तुह दाणं केण वि न दिट्ठं"
english: "" "Fool, my dharma is dead! No one has ever seen you before." "With a trembling voice One can hardly help laughing."

prakrit: "जे केइ पहू महिमण्डलम्मि ते उच्छुदण्डसारिच्छा,सरसा जडाण मज्झे विसमा पत्तेसु दीसन्ति"
english: "All those glorified by the lotus plant themselves on the headstone, Showing the leaves only on the tip of the head, And the hair on the body."

prakrit: "इण्हिम्पहुणो पहुणो पहुत्तणं,किं चिरन्तणपहूणं?,दोसगुणा गुणादोसाजेहिं कया,न हु कया तेहिं"
english: "What is the use of embracing one's neighbor, Who is the husband of long - suffering?, What are the virtues of a good wife, And what are they not?"

prakrit: "अप्पायत्तं सम्पयमवणेइ पहू परम्मुहो,न गुणं,ठाणं उवरि निरुम्भइ मणीण जलही,न उण छायं"
english: "Anger consumes everything, There is no merit in it, It consumes nothing, It burns everything, It casts no shadow."

prakrit: "तोसो मणस्स कस्स वि आवइपडियम्मि भिच्चवग्गम्मि,सरियामु दरिद्दासुं सरियाद्दिवई समुल्लसइ"
english: "To whom then can one turn one's back? A begging bowl, Like a poor man's cupped hand, Is perfectly usable in broad daylight."

prakrit: "अच्छउ का वि अपुव्वा रिद्धी ताराहिवस्स रिद्धीसु,जा का वि पुराणा तारयाण रिद्धी हया सा वि"
english: "Well, my dear, The only thing that really matters Is the abundance of abundant stars. Even an old star Is worthless in this way."

prakrit: "सुहिए सुहियाइं रविम्मि,दुक्खिए दुक्खियाइं कमलाइं,तह वि हु न तेण ताणं अवयरिओ पङ्कयकलङ्को"
english: "Happy are the joyous women, sorrowful are the sorrowful lotuses; Yet, for some reason, they never cease to trouble us."

prakrit: "जह जह पावन्ति पयं उन्नयमुन्नययरं दिणयरु व्व,लहूईभवन्ति सन्तावयन्ति तह तह दढं केई"
english: "The more one touches a person's foot, The higher their position in the mirror, And the bloodier they become The more difficult it is to bear."

prakrit: "तारावइणा जं तारयाण रिद्धेण निहणिया रिद्धी,सयलकलाठाणस्स वि तेणं चिय झिज्झए लच्छी"
english: "The rafters twine round the star Whomsoever it may please, And though they may cause embarrassment to others, They seem to suit him well."

prakrit: "परिवाराणं सुयणत्तणं पि पिसुणे पहुम्मि न हु किं पि,पडिकूलम्मि रविसुए सुहा वि अवरे गहा विहला"
english: "Though the whole family is asleep, I do not know what to do. Though my husband is well, He is already gone." ""

prakrit: "महुमासवासराणं निडालसञ्जणियसेयबिन्दूणं,काण वि परिवुडिढमहीयलस्स सन्तावमावहइ"
english: "The bee swallows the drops of nectar from the nidra, Even the ears twitch When the moon is full."

prakrit: "अकयव्वओ न सोहइ विहवो विहवो व्व अङ्गणानिवहो,कत्थ वि अपत्तभोगो सुवण्णतारुण्णओभवै"
english: "No pleasure is to be had in a festival, no feast, only in a courtyard. However extravagant the feast, It is overshadowed by the blossom of gold."

prakrit: "किं वंसेण गुणेण य? किंवा कोडीए? तुज्झ रे चाव!,जायन्ति जस्स पुरओ मग्गणया मुक्कसिक्कारा"
english: "Is it by virtue of descent? Or is it by way of enchantment? Your name is Chava! Anyone can understand what you are asking for." ""

prakrit: "कसिणं काऊण मुहं,पच्छा रत्तं मुहेण होऊणं,दिण्णं फलं पलासेण तं पि सउणेहिं परिचत्तं"
english: "Whose face should one cover, Whose blood should one smear, Whom one recognizes by the shade of one's face When one has ripe fruit?"

prakrit: "लोहमयस्स वि मलिणस्स गाढमुट्ठिस्स कोसनिरयस्स,किवणस्स किवाणस्स य आयारेणेव भिण्णत्तं"
english: "Iron nasty, But filthy, With clenched fists, Kosa niryasa, Somebody's business, Or business as usual, Is quite different."

prakrit: "अन्धारिऊण वयणं दीहं रसिऊण मामिखत्थेहिं,पउरं पि कहव दिण्णं जलएण जलं अलं तेण"
english: "Because it was dark, I could hear the rustle of the lamp, And because it was burning I could not help laughing."

prakrit: "करिणो हरिनहरविदारियस्स दीसन्ति मुत्तिया कुम्भे,अहव किवणाण मरणे पयड च्चिय होन्ति भण्डारा"
english: "Dear farmer, The pearl of the jasmine is in the jars of the potsherd's house, Or perhaps someone has stashed it away to die?"

prakrit: "दीसन्ति जोयसिद्धा,अञ्जणसिद्धा तहेव दीसति,दालिद्दजोयसिद्धा पासे वि ठिया न दीसन्ति"
english: "Those who rejoice give thanks, Those who disapprove give thanks; Those who are sagging do not spare a single one."

prakrit: "महुरॊल्लावसलूणो ललियपओ रूवजाइपरिसुद्धो,तह वि न अग्घइ अधणो पच्चक्खकईण कव्वं व"
english: "The lotus of the peacock's cupped face Is smeared with red ghee, Yet it does not burn, Like poetry painted on an emerald leaf."

prakrit: "उप्पज्जन्ति तहिं चिय,वियसन्ति तहिं,तहिं विलिज्जन्ति,पुण्णसरे कमलाइं व मणोरहा रोरहिययम्मि"
english: "The fire burns there, the weeping there, and the wailing there. The lotus blooms again And the manorah starts to cry."

prakrit: "सन्ता वि गुणविसेसा नराण पयडा हवन्ति ता कत्तो,जाताण दप्पणाण व कओ ण भूईए सक्कारो?"
english: "Where are the good people, If there are good people and bad people, Where is the pride In living beings And who is not a ruler of the earth?"

prakrit: "जे जे गुणिणो जे जे य माणिणो जे विढत्तविन्नाणा,दालिद्द! रे वियक्खण! ताण तुमं साणुराओ सि"
english: "All you worthies, All you fools, You coward! You fool, you fool! You deceiver." ""

prakrit: "सन्तवइ गसइ सव्वं जइ विधूमेण पढममन्धेइ,उअरभरणत्थिणो तह वि निच्चमगणिं अणुसरन्ति"
english: "Everything that is said and done in a poem Is recited in front of the reader, Even so much confusion prevails among the readers."

prakrit: "सन्ता वि गुणा गुणवन्तयाण दालिद्दतमभरक्कन्ता,अत्थॊज्जोएण विणा पयडा वि न पायडा होन्ति"
english: "A saint is one who multiplies virtues, One who pours out generosity, Yet without virtue no one prospers."

prakrit: "अप्पाणं चिय दुभरं जाण जए कि व तेहिं जाएहिं?,सुसमत्था विन परोवयारिणी ते वि न किं पि"
english: "Do you realize how miserable it is for you to go there?" she asked, "Without a good man's help, what is there to drink?"

prakrit: "लच्छीकरकमलवियासरेणुपूरिज्जमाणनयणेहिं,दीसन्ति नेय रोरा पुरओ वि ठिया धणड्ढेहिं"
english: "Look! When the lotuses are smeared with lotus flowers, They make one sweat Even when one is angry."

prakrit: "हरइ परिहीणविहवस्स नूण नियपणइणो वि अप्पाणं,सव्वङ्गमसम्पुण्णस्स घडइ न हु जामिणी ससिणो"
english: "Every unfaithful wife plans for something new, Even if it's just herself. The consummation of all her affairs Does not occur, Silly girl."

prakrit: "धीराण रमइ घुसिणारुणम्मि न तहा पियाथणुच्छङ्गे,दिट्ठी रिउगयकुम्भत्थलम्मि जह बहलसिन्दूरे"
english: "Be patient: The woman you kissed Didn't look at you with such longing. She looked at you While you seduced her." ""

prakrit: "सो केण विज्झविज्जइ वीरपयावानलो तिणिक्खन्तो?,उप्पत्तिकारणं जस्स खग्गधाराजलो च्चेय"
english: "Who, then, can enlighten a brave man Who has triumphed over him?," As the water in a cascade overflows, "

prakrit: "साविक्खो दहवयणो वरप्पयाणेण साहसुक्करिसो,सन्ते वि करसमूहे ऎक्कॆक्कं जो सिरं लुयए"
english: "Savikho dahavayana: The bridegroom is bolder than he, For there is only one tax collector Who takes away the head."

prakrit: "सुपओहराए सुहडो पुलयसणाहाइ खग्गलट्ठीए,जायइ मउलिअनयणो दइआइ व कण्ठलग्गाए"
english: "A good man is as good as a policeman's bow When faced with a sharp arrow As if it were the bow of a doe."

prakrit: "इक्कत्तो रुयइ पिया अण्णत्तो समरतूरनिग्घोसो,नेहेण रणरसेण य भडस्स दोलाइयं हिययं"
english: "When a warrior is away Weeping bitterly, When he is away Traveling with the warriors."

prakrit: "अज्ज वि विहुरम्मि पहू अज्ज वि पहरन्ति वइरिसङ्घाया,अज्ज वि मज्झत्था जयसिरी वि रे जीव! मा वच्च"
english: "Still shivering, Still twitching, Yet my life hangs in the balance." ""

prakrit: "तं नत्थि जं न सिज्झइ ववसायसमुज्जयस्स धीरस्स,जं सीसमॆत्तसेसो राहू ससि-दिणयरे गलइ"
english: "That which does not satisfy one's needs is not business, just perseverance; what remains of the seed, however, passes in a day or two."

prakrit: "अघडियपरावलवा जह जह गरुयत्तणे न विहडन्ति,तह तह गरुआण हवन्ति बद्धमूलाओ कित्तीओ"
english: "The more powerful a person is, the less likely he is to fall into sin."

prakrit: "दिग्गयकओलवियलियमयपङ्कामोयवासियमणस्स,भसलस्स कण्णतालाहयस्स मरणं पि रमणिज्जं"
english: "Death is as pleasant as a tear in the eye of a fowler, As pleasurable as a clenched fist, As painful as it is to touch."

prakrit: "खग्गम्मि निवासो जयसिरीए,समरम्मि होइ सा हत्थे,हत्थट्ठिए वि विहवे विमुक्क धीरा विसूरिन्ति"
english: "May the poor dwell in triumph, May the brave be able to stretch out their arms. Even with bare hands They tremble With fear and tremble."

prakrit: "विवरुम्मुहा वि गरुया उवयारी होन्ति सयललोयस्स,कुम्मेण निययपिट्ठिट्ठियं पि भुवणं समुद्धरियं"
english: "Aunt, Even an old woman Can make a happy woman, But a poor woman can make a sea of fools By sitting on her back."

prakrit: "चित्तुत्तिन्नो वि तुलागओ वि मित्तो तहा वि न हु मुक्को,को हरिउं तस्स नहङ्गणस्स गम्भीरिमं तरइ?"
english: "Though captivated, Still a friend, Yet without a fist, Who can defeat him On the most solemn of occasions?"

prakrit: "सब्भावं पहुहियए,जीयं सग्गे,जसं जए सयले,ठविऊण रणे सीसं कयकज्जो नच्चिओ सुहडो"
english: "May all feelings be satisfied, may all beings be happy; As the saying goes, While making love One cannot help laughing."

prakrit: "कुलमुद्धरन्ति एगे वडवीयकणङ्कुरेण सारिच्छा,अन्ने वालयसरिसा जाया मूलं विणासन्ति"
english: "Kulamudharanti eke vadavyaka nakuren sarichcha, anne valayasa sarisha jaya moola knitthi"

prakrit: "कह नाम सहिज्जइ कायरेण समुहिन्तगयघडावीढे,गरुयगयचलणचम्पियकरोडिकडुओ कडक्कारो?"
english: "What name can you give to someone whose songs are sung in unison, Who is angry because a dog has bitten him?"

prakrit: "तुङ्गत्तणं गयन्दे सङ्गरसारत्तणं च केसरिणो,सङ्गामसूरिमा तुङ्गिमा य सरभे समप्पन्ति"
english: "The singing of the trumpet and the playing of the harp is saffron, And the dancing of the flute Accompany everything."

prakrit: "महिऊण महाजलहिं महुमहणो तत्थ सुयइ वीसत्थो,एयं नीइविरुद्धं,छज्जइ सव्वं समत्थाणं"
english: "The bee sleeps where the bees feast, It is opposed to water, It destroys everything."

prakrit: "उम्मूलेइ न पवणो तिणाइं किल उण्णओ असाराइं,भञ्जेइ महल्लतरू,गरुया गरुए विरोहन्ति"
english: "The landowner does not care whether the wind blows or heaves, The farmer worries whether his field is empty, The shepherd is weary of growing cattle."

prakrit: "धीरो अरिकरिकुम्भयडपाडणॊच्छलियमॊत्तियच्छुरिओ,रेहइ रणम्मि जयसिरिसियक्खएहिंअहिसित्तो"
english: "Be patient! Aunt, There must be something very special about your husband That makes him smile."

prakrit: "समरे धारागोयर मुञ्चन्तिवेरिमण्डलग्गेण,तंतम्मि वला खलु निवसिरीए लच्छीए विप्पन्ति"
english: "In summer the valleys are strewn with gooseflesh, Like circles of emeralds; The women who live in the thickets Are bedraggled."

prakrit: "सच्चं कलानिहि च्चिय चन्दो तेयम्मि जो पणट्ठम्मि,पवसियतवणस्स वि गयणचक्कमक्कमइ पाएहिं"
english: "The true artist is one who finds the moon at his feet, Who in a steady stream, Even with pure wind, Makes sense in a song cycle."

prakrit: "पइणो सुलहाइं धाणाइं दिन्ति,पत्ती य दिन्ति पुण पाणे,गरुयत्तं तह वि पईण न उण पत्तीण,अच्छरियं"
english: "One gives coriander seeds to flowers, another gives nectar, and yet one doesn't get enough of it." ""

prakrit: "सुहडाण समरवज्जन्ततूरवररवणघणजलासित्तो,पुलयच्छलेण उच्छाहमहिरुहो मुयइ किसलाइं"
english: "Lovely summer nights, With thunder and lightning streaming down from the horizon, Like a flock of parrots Flying out of the sky, Are a blessing in disguise."

prakrit: "सत्तूण पायवीढे लुढन्ति माणंसिणो वि जं कह वि,तं अब्भत्थिन्ति महिं विवरं पायालगमणत्थं"
english: "Anything a man can say, Even if it means slipping down the stairs, Is beyond my reach."

prakrit: "हियइच्छिअमलहन्तो पञ्जरसउणु व्व धीरववसाओ,कोससयसम्पुडनिरुद्धपसरो तडप्फडइ"
english: "If you want to taste the nectar You'd better be patient, For after it has clung to your flesh It rushes away."

prakrit: "उव्वहसि कीस गव्वं ऎत्थ जए गयवई अहं ऎक्को?,तुह वेरियाण नरवइ! महिलासत्थावि गयवइणो"

prakrit: "नूणं धणुम्मि तुह पहु! सङ्कमइ विवक्खजीवियं समरे,इहरा तम्मि सजीवे कह रिउणो होन्ति अज्जीवा?"
english: "I will never forget how lucky you were! My poor girl, Life is fleeting, So how can you live without your husband?"

prakrit: "सम्पुण्णकोसदण्डं जलदुग्गगयं पिढलइ कमलवणं,दिट्ठम्मि जम्मि,कह सो सूरो? मा भुवणमक्कमउ"
english: "The lotus has swollen all over her body, Like a log burnt by fire, But when she sees it, Where is the sun? So do not be alarmed." ""

prakrit: "वहुलक्खएण वहुसो महापसाएण तुज्झ नरनाह!,पणइसमूहो चन्दो व्व वन्दणिज्जो जए जाओ"
english: "Because the wind blows hard You are doomed! For the moon is like a victory banner." ""

prakrit: "तुह रिउणो नाह! सुहत्थिणो वि भद्दत्तणं कह वहन्तु?,जाण दुह च्चेय गई — ऎक्के मन्दा,मया अण्णे"
english: "Don't cry! How can you bear to be angry Even with a good friend?" She muttered again And again. "One bad man, I don't know."

prakrit: "बहुसोहग्गाओ अविहवाऒ वट्टन्ति तुज्झ वेरीण,अन्तेउरीओनहु नहु नरनाह! नयरीओ"
english: "Too many lovers, Too few women, Wretched women like you. So do not harm women!" ""

prakrit: "हरहास-हंस-हारिन्दु-कुन्द-बलहद्द-सङ्खधवलेण,तुज्झ जसेण रिऊणं साहसु कह मयलियं वयणं?"
english: "With a flock of parrots, geese, ducks, crows, and minnows, How dare you cry?"

english: "Not so much the lotus as the fact that you're not there! Nor the dryness that plagues you. Or the awkwardness with which you act"

prakrit: "उद्दामपियालवणो सरलत्तणजणियजणमणाणन्दो,ससहरकन्दरविसमो नरनाह! तुमं हिमगिरि व्व"
english: "You stubborn man, You simpleton, You heartless wretch! You're like a glacier." ""

prakrit: "अथिरा वि थिरा लच्छी,थिरा वि भमिरी तए कया कित्ती,अह मुयइ च्चिय तुह दंसणेण महिलायणो पयइं"
english: "Athira vi thira lacchi, thira vi bhamiri? How is it then, my dear, That the sight of you has made me feel like a woman?"

prakrit: "समरम्मि तुज्झ खग्गे विमलत्तणएण झत्ति सङ्कन्ता,पडिमामिसेण सयला नज्जइ सरणागया रिउणो"
english: "The warrior is so distracted by your anger That he suddenly bursts into tears. But my mother does not want me to cry so loudly."

english: "The water jug is still there, Not yours! Aunt, The nail marks the throat of the raven That was pining away." ""

english: "Look how the girl is embracing him, Thinking how she must be feeling At the mere mention of his name."

prakrit: "रिउरमणीआणणकाणणेसु विलसन्तपत्तवल्लीओ,नीयाओ खयं तरवारिवारिणा जस्स अच्छरियं"
english: "You silly girl, Don't be so naïve: The swordsmen have done what's best for you."

prakrit: "समरम्मि जो समग्गे विवक्खवग्गे पलायमाणम्मि,सम्मुहमप्पाणं चिय पॆच्छइ करवालसङ्कन्तं"
english: "The warrior who runs away in the thick of the action, Seeks refuge with his wife In the darkest hour."

prakrit: "पणईण देव! दिन्तो बहुसो लक्खाइं उत्तुणो कीस?,पडिवक्खाण वि तुह दिति गयवरा रयणकोडीओ"
english: "Dear god! How is it that you bring up so many millions in a day? Even the sound of the lute Succeeds in making you what you are." ""

prakrit: "जाहे च्चिय तं चलणे णयाण उवरिं करं पसारेसि,लच्छी भुयट्ठिया वो ताहे च्चिय तेसु सङ्कमइ"
english: "The more you spread your arms around him As he walks, The thinner his arms become, The more fearful he becomes."

prakrit: "अग्गमहिसीओ जाया सव्व च्चिय पत्थिवा न सन्देहो,अण्णह खलाहिलासो कह ताण मणम्मि विप्फुरइ?"
english: "There is no doubt that everything that happens in a fire burns well. So how can one's mind, wretched as it is, be destroyed?"

prakrit: "दट्ठूण तुज्झ उदयं पुव्वावर-दक्खिणॊत्तरदिसामु,इय मच्छरेण नरवर! पॆच्छ रवी रायमुव्वहइ"
