prakrit: "सञ्झावसरे सञ्झावहूए उवरिं भमाडिऊण रविं,खिप्पइ आरत्तियदीवओ व्व तुह रायरायस्स"
english: "At twilight The rain clouds hover above Your bosom, Slipping away like a river in spate." ""

prakrit: "जस्स य समरे अरिकुम्भिपहरसङ्कन्तमॊत्तिओ खग्गो,अरिजीअलुद्धजमजीहदन्तपन्तीओ उवहसइ"
english: "As soon as the summer is over And the rainy season is almost over, Dear God, There must be plenty of fresh water in the offing."

prakrit: "अरिकुम्भिकुम्भनिब्भेयपूररुहिरच्छडारुणच्छाओ,परिकुवियजमकडक्खो व्व जस्स खग्गो रणे सहइ"
english: "Like a flock of parrots falling from a tree, Like a herd of geese stuck in the mud, The God of Love endures forever."

prakrit: "अलिकुलकुवलयकज्जलतमालनीलम्मि जस्स धारहरे,सइ रणसराओ नासन्ति रायहंसा पवरपक्खा"
english: "The rays of the sky are blue, Like the rays of a rainbow. There are no jasmine races, But only swans" wings. "

prakrit: "जस्स करे करवालो छज्जइ ताविच्छगुच्छसच्छाहो,समरम्मि हढायडिढयजयलच्छीवेणिदण्डो व्व"
english: "As the doer chases after the tame bird, So the warrior shoots at the stick That shoots red flashes of lightning."

prakrit: "अरिकामिणीण कुङ्कुम-कत्थूरी-कज्जलाइं अङ्गेसु,जस्स करवालधाराजलेण सहस त्ति धोआइं"
english: "Take kumkum, kathuri, and kajjalai from Arikamini, which were washed away by the waters of the Karawal stream"

prakrit: "जस्स असिभिण्णअरिकरिकुम्भत्थलगलियमॊत्तियगणेण,बीएण व जणिआ समरभूमिपडिएण कित्तिलया"
english: "Which was torn to shreds by the arrows of the God of War, As if they had been struck by lightning and lightning?"

prakrit: "नहयलविसालफलए ससहरखडियाए तारसारीहि,जस्स पयावो कित्ती य दो वि दीवन्तिअविरामं"
english: "The plowman's daughter - in - law has grown very thin On the date of her arrival At the fair. How long will her husband remain abroad?"

prakrit: "मेहं व सजलधारं रणगयणसमुण्णयं तमालनिहं,दट्ठूण जस्स खग्गं पलाइयं रायहंसेहि"
english: "I have tasted the lotus flower, Like water draining from a crystal goblet."

prakrit: "करिकुम्भदलणसंसत्तमॊत्तिओ जस्स रणभरे खग्गो,सत्तूण सग्गमग्गो व्व सहइ नक्खत्तसञ्जुत्तो"
english: "Conscious of the trembling of the kumbha Which fills the sky with rain clouds, He is sympathetic to those who struggle with it."

prakrit: "समरम्मि जस्स खग्गो विभिण्णरिउकुम्भिकुम्भरुहिरुल्लो,रेहइ जयसिरिचलणालत्तयपयपन्तिरत्तो व्व"
english: "The warrior's wife, Whom all the gods worship, Stands in thrall to all the joys and triumphs of love."

prakrit: "जस्स करवालदण्डेण खण्डिआ रेहए रणमहीए,अरिकुञ्जरदन्ता अङ्कुर व्व नज्जन्ति जसतरुणो"
english: "Just like the twigs of the acacia tree, Which are torn to shreds by the rays of the Karawal, The shoots of the arikunja tree Do not budge Like the roots of a tree."

prakrit: "विरसाइं जाइं पमुहे,अमयरसायन्ति जाइं परिणामे,कज्जाइं ताइं सुवियारियाइं न जणे हसिज्जन्ति"
english: "One doesn't laugh when things go wrong, One gets angry when things don't go well, And one gets jealous as a result."

prakrit: "सालूरी कसिणभुयङ्गमस्स जं खिवइ मत्थए चलणं,तं मन्ने कस्स वि मन्तवाइणो फुरइ माहप्पं"
english: "Aunt, Whatever you want to eat On the first day of spring, That's what I tell everyone: It's time to eat." ""

prakrit: "अम्बयफलं सुपक्कं कुहियं बिण्टं समुद्धओ वाओ,साहा डॊल्लणसीला न याणिमो कत्थ परिणामो?"
english: "The fresh nectar of the mango tree is like a bucket of water in the middle of the well, What are the consequences if you do not stir it?"

prakrit: "कज्जं फलं व सरसं जायइ नियकालपरिणईपडिय,तमकाले घिप्पन्तं दुहावहं होइ विरसं च"
english: "Time passes, mustard seeds and bitter berries wither, But in due course they become worthless."

prakrit: "तिसु जे अवुत्थपुव्वा रायकुले महियले य सेवासु,विण्णाण-नाण-लट्ठत्तणाण ते बाहिरा पुरिसा"
english: "Those who neglect virtue And those who neglect merit In service to virtue, Are outsiders only to men endowed with wisdom, wealth, and initiative."

prakrit: "सिद्धं तं मन्निज्जइ जं सिज्झइ साम-भेयनीईए,सिद्धं पि तं असिद्धं पहाणपुरिसक्खओ जत्थ"
english: "Prepared is the man who accepts what is put before him; prepared is he who puts himself before others."

prakrit: "अणुयत्तह भणह पियं जं कज्जं तं मुणेह चित्तेण,महुरं लवइ मऊरो सविसं च भुयङ्गमं गिलइ"
english: "My dear, whatever your business is, do it with a sober mind. Either the bees find the jasmine Or the bees swallow it whole."

prakrit: "गरुयाइं चिय साहइ पुरिसो कज्जाइं नत्थि सन्देहो,रोसो सुरङ्गधूलि व्व जस्स न हु पायडो होइ"
english: "Strong men cannot help themselves, neither can suspicious women. Anger is like a tunnel of darkness Through which one cannot escape."

prakrit: "सुहडो न सो पयङ्गो आवट्ठइ जो जडोपइट्ठो व्व,अपहारियसुहकज्जो निक्कज्जं चेव खग्गम्मि"
english: "A traveler is not so much a traveler as someone who, from the moment he touches her feet, sniffs out the pleasures of separation."

prakrit: "कडुयं पि नागरं चिय परिणाममयं,विसं न महुरं पि,रिउणो वि वरं सुयणा,मित्ताइं न उण खलपगई"
english: "A bitter tree is the fruit of a true tree, A poisonous bee is not a bee, A weeper is a blessing, And a good friend causes no harm."

prakrit: "समए च्चिय कीरन्ता फलन्ति किरिया सुहा व असुहा वा,मेहाणं पि जलाइं दहन्ति चित्तासु पडियाइं"
english: "Our hearts are burning, Our actions produce fruit, We rejoice, We lament, We sulk, And our minds are consumed."

prakrit: "किं चॊज्जं ठाणवसेण जं असन्तो वि जायए महिमा,सङ्घडइ महुरिमा घणगयाण लवणोयहिजलाणं"
english: "Why should anyone be proud Even if he doesn't have it? It's the damned thing about being proud."

prakrit: "पडिवक्खेसुं तेयस्सिणा वि चरियव्वमप्पमत्तेण,वुट्ठीसु रवी पुरकयवाओ च्चिय पयडइ पयावं"
english: "The doe is bewildered But the doe, Touching with all her might, Looks for Ravi's back And puts him to bed." ""

prakrit: "किम्पि पयं अहिरूढो लहुओ वि दढं तवेइ गरुयं पि,पयतलकण्टयलेसो वि दहइ आमत्थयं देहं"
english: "Why, dear girl, Are you so intent on burning my body Even with so many tears in your eyes?"

prakrit: "अवरेहिं वि जं सिज्झइ तम्मि कए किं परस्स उवयरियं,तरणिम्मि दलियतिमिरे उवयरइ जणस्स किं दीवो?"
english: "Why should anyone care what you put in front of them? What good is a lamp for someone who is so absorbed in fresh gruel?"

prakrit: "उवयरिएसु वि केसु वि अयसो विप्फुरइ सज्जणाणं पि,मलिणत्तणं पिजलसोहणेण विमलाण वि कराणं"
english: "Though it is hot, It still makes people shiver, And even though it is bitter, It makes men shiver."

prakrit: "देवघराण वि काण व वड्ढन्ताणं कमेण सङ्कोओ,केसिं पिपुणो जायइ वित्थारो पायवाण व्व"
english: "A god's house is also an eyesore And grown-ups get annoyed at his actions. But how can a man who has grown up Knowingly walk like a stray dog?"

prakrit: "लहुएण वि गुरुआलम्बणेणअहियं लहन्ति अपसंसं,नहभङ्गेण वि पडिमाओ देवयाणं अपुज्जाओ"
english: "Though jealousy consumes him, He still shows resentment By embracing his wife, Though he refuses to acknowledge her as a goddess."

prakrit: "पयमुन्नयमहिरोहन्ति केवि दुन्नयपहेण वच्चन्ता,मयगहिलविब्भमाणं गयाण पवियम्भए अग्घो"
english: "Who is not captivated by a good song When it is sung by a poor man's wife?"

prakrit: "गरुयायन्ति अणेगे वसणेसु अणाउला पुणो विरला,वहुसो सन्ति महग्घा जलणे कणयस्स पुणसुद्धी"
english: "The poor thing is a stranger, A stranger lives elsewhere, A virgin is still a virgin, An expensive fire burns again And the good girl recovers."

prakrit: "अवलंवियं तणाई विहलं धारन्ति अहव तुट्टन्ति,अवलंविय जे न हु तणसमा वि कि ताण उण भणिमो?"
english: "Dependent on the tension, Exposing it to the world, Or breaking it, If I'm not dependent on it, Is that what I mean by tension?"

prakrit: "अवियारिऊण कज्जं सहस च्चिय जे नरा पयट्टन्ति,डज्झन्ति ते वराया दीवसिहाए पयङ्गो व्व"
english: "Those who walk in silence Because they cannot sleep At night Fear the wrath of the sun."

prakrit: "अवरगुणेणं जाणं मडप्फरो ताण नाम को गव्वो?,वाउवसारूढनहङ्गणाण धूलीण को महिमा?"
english: "Who gives glory to the dust that hangs on the windmill, Who gives name to the mudflats on which one knows their worth?"

prakrit: "वङ्कभणियाइं कत्तो? कत्तो अद्धच्छिपिच्छियव्वाइं?,ऊससियं पि मुणिज्जइ छइल्लजणसङ्कुले गामे"
english: "Where are the bamboo shoots? Where are these tiny tots?," whispered the farmer, His wife sighing, "In a village of teeming villagers."

prakrit: "लीलावलोयणेण वि मुणन्ति जे हिययकज्जपरमत्थं,ते कारिमोवयारेहिं कह णु छइल्ला छलिज्जन्ति?"
english: "Those who, because of the lilies, bow before one's rival, How are they going to pacify those wretched women?"

prakrit: "सहस त्ति जं न दिट्ठो,सरहसचित्तेण जं न आलत्तो,उवयारो जं न कओ तं चिय कलियं छइल्लेहिं"
english: "Friend, what you do not see with your eyes, What you do without your lips, You conceal under your buds."

prakrit: "अक्खण्डियमुहरायापुव्वाभासी अभिन्नमुहराया,सिढिलन्ता वि सिणेहं छेया दुक्खेण नज्जन्ति"
english: "Face to face, speaking in tongues, Undisturbed, Even the lonely wife Shows no remorse."

prakrit: "रच्चावन्ति,न रच्चति,दिन्ति दुक्खं,न दुक्खिया होन्ति,असुणिवि णियत्तइण्हि दुक्खाराहा जए छेया"
english: "A person who is angry does not become angry, A day which is sorrowful is not sorrowful, A life which is unhappy does not last, Just like a sorrowful person"

prakrit: "मा रुयसु सुयण! छेयाण अग्गए झिज्झिहिन्ति नयणाइं,न हु भिज्जइ ताण मणं वज्जं पिव सलिलनिवहेण"
english: "" "Don't cry, girl! Your eyes are burning With excitement These days. I don't want to get wet Because they think you know how to play the flute."

prakrit: "रच्चन्ति नेय कस्स वि,रत्ता वि मयच्छि! न हु मुणिज्जन्ति,दिणकरकर व्व छेया अदिट्ठदोसा नियट्टन्ति"
english: "The hunter is not angry with anyone, I am angry with him! I will not bow down, For as long as I am busy making love, He will settle any unforeseen disputes."

prakrit: "रत्ते रत्ता,कसिणम्मि कसिणया,मज्झिमम्मि मज्झिमया,फलिहमणि व्व छयल्ला जत्थ गया तत्थ रङ्गिल्ला"
english: "Wherever the chariot goes, Where the farmer's wife is gone, There the garland of lotuses, Like the shadow of a lotus, Is without color."

prakrit: "जह पढमदिणे तह पच्छिमम्मि फरुसाइं नेय जम्पन्ति,व्वोछइल्लपुरिसा विरच्चमाणा वि दुल्लक्खा"
english: "As the days go by, The West hums along with the Persians; Yet, looking around, People groan." ""

prakrit: "जॊव्वणभरेण अह मण्डणेण हिययं हरन्ति रमणीओ,अङ्गनिवेसभवं चिय छेया मग्गन्ति चङ्गत्तं"
english: "With youth and plenty of pleasure They rob women of their senses, They rob them of their finery And turn them upside down."

prakrit: "विवरीयरए लच्छी बम्भं दट्ठूण नाहिकमलत्थं,हरिणो दाहिणनयणं करेणभण झम्पए कीस?"
english: "Why did you rush out to see the buffalo's body But did not realize that it was covered with mud? It looked like a deer's tail." ""

prakrit: "सिहिपिच्छकन्नऊरा जाया वाहस्स गव्विरी कीस,मुत्ताहलरइयपसाहणाण मज्झे सवत्तीण?"
english: "Why go to the river for a sweetmeat, you silly girl? It's my stepdaughter who has to suffer the same fate as me." ""

prakrit: "जइ सासुयाए भणिया पइवासहरम्मि दीवयं देसु,ता कीस पोढमहिला हसिऊण पलोवए हियय?"
english: "If your mother - in - law lets you light a lamp on the eve of your wedding, why is the poor woman laughing all the time?"

prakrit: "जइ सा सहीहिं भणिआ तुज्झ मुहं पुन्नचन्दसारिच्छं,ता कीस मुद्धडमुही करेण गण्डत्थलं फुसइ?"
english: "If she said she really wanted to see your face again, why would a cockroach pounce on your cheek?" ""

prakrit: "मडयावत्थाभरणा मुयमडएणं च मण्डियकरग्गा,मडयारूढा मुइया पियस्स मुयपाणियं देइ"
english: "Mother - in - law, If you ask me what made me angry, I will tell you the opposite."

prakrit: "दट्ठूण तं जुयाणं परियणमज्झम्मि पोढमहिलाए,उप्फुल्लदलं कमलं करेण मउलावियं कीस?"
english: "When you see that young man Proudly embracing my lovely wife, Why do you mutter that a lotus has been plucked from under one's body?"

prakrit: "अच्छीहिं पई,सिहणेहिं देवरो,गुरुअणो निअंवेण,तिन्नि विसूरेइवहू तं जाणहकेण कज्जेण?"
english: "Well - done, my lord, Teacher - come - go, you fool, Why should anyone know why these three foolish women are here?"

prakrit: "हिययं रोमुग्गिण्णंपायपहारं सिरेण इच्छन्तो,पहओ न पिओ माणंसिणीए थोरंसुयं रुयणं"
english: "Dear girl, If you want to taste the fresh nectar of love, Don't make your lover cry too much."

prakrit: "दट्ठ्र̥ण सामिसालं कण्ठं गहिऊण निब्भरं रुन्न,पत्ते वियालसमए ता कीस जुयज्जुया सिज्जा?"
english: "You look at me, Tears running down my cheeks, Why do you want to play ball when the leaves are still wet?"

prakrit: "हन्तूण वग्गयन्दं वाहो वाहाण मज्झयारम्मि,धुयइ सरं पियइ जलं तं जाणह केण कज्जेणं?"
english: "Do you know why the hunter's wife, Who is in the middle of the ship, Washes the riverbed and drinks the water There?"

prakrit: "अहिणवपेमसमागमजॊव्वणरिद्धी वसन्तमासम्मि,पवसन्तस्स य पिउणो भण कीस पलोइयं सीसं?"
english: "Spring is on its way, so what do you think it will be like when you meet her?" asked the peacock, "Tomorrow is the first day of spring."

prakrit: "विद्धो वाहेण मओ मएण वाहस्स वण्ठियं कण्डं,छिन्नं मयस्स सीसं तह वि मओ तं तणं चरइ"
english: "Foolish girl, The tendrils of my arms are tied around my waist, They pierce through my veins And still I feel them."

prakrit: "अमुणिय पयारिहरिसङ्कराणसद्दो णपलायन्ति,ताहि चिय गरुइगमणे! हा मुद्धे! कत्थ दीसिहिसि?"
english: "You fool, How come you refuse to listen to the whisperings of my friends? They are so loud! How old are you?" ""

prakrit: "जलजायजायवाहणगईए द्दरवहकलङ्कनयणीए,करनाससीससघणत्थणीए मह विम्हियं हिययं"
english: "I have heard so much about you From women who go to the river to bathe, From men who drink water to women who paint their houses."

prakrit: "दूरागय त्ति आयरपडिच्छियं पायमूलपडियं पि,उज्झन्ति फालिऊणं वेसा लेहं व गहिअत्थं"
english: "If you walk a long distance, You'll hit a nail on the head." ""

prakrit: "लोहमयी गुणमुक्का रत्तं दट्ठूण जीवियं हरइ,विसभल्लिय व्व वेसा जं पावइ तं विणासेइ"
english: "When one sees a handful of red blood, one loses one's life; Like a valuable ornament, it weaves whatever is desired."

prakrit: "सामन्नसुन्दरीणं विब्भममावहइ अविणओ चेव,धूमु च्चिय पज्जलियाण वहुमओ सुरहिदारूणं"
english: "The beauty of silence illuminates the whole panorama, Like smoke rising from a pyre." ""

english: "If the lamp does not shine brightly, what can we say?," "Because there is no fire in the sky, There must be something in the water." ""

english: "The more one expresses delight at seeing one's neighbor's face, the thinner will be his image in the eyes of the great man."

english: "Red as the moonlight, white as the shadow, Yellow as the youthful man's blood."

prakrit: "थेवेण वि विणएणं पुरिसा महिलासु जह पसीयन्ति,न तहा महिला पुरिसेसु कढिणहियया जओ नीया"
english: "However much men and women fall in love, It is not the case with women who outgrow their husbands."

prakrit: "दाणेण तं न,विणएण तंन,रूवेणतं न सोहग्गं,परमपराहअविसण्ठुलाहिं जं फुरइ वायाहिं"

prakrit: "जं नम्मयाए विहिओ विञ्झं मॊत्तण जलनिहीसङ्गो,तं नूणं रमणीओ सलूणपुरिसेसु रच्चन्ति"
english: "What our wise men do When the river is in spate With the full force of the Vindhya, Those lovely women fashion it into a saloon full of flowers."

prakrit: "परपुरपवेसविन्नाणलाहवं सुहय! सिक्खियं कत्थ?,जेण पविट्ठो हियए पढमं चिय दंसणे मज्झ"
english: "Blessed is the man who overcomes adversity! Where can I learn anything? For if a holy man taught me anything, I would rather die than learn it."

prakrit: "पायडियनेहसव्भावविब्भमं तीए जह अहं दिट्ठी,संवरणवावडाए अन्नो वि जणो तह च्चेय"
english: "The more I look at her, the more I realize that she is possessed by a demon."

english: "Dear girl, The bracelets on my hips are such that women won't catch them." ""

prakrit: "सामाइ नयणसॊत्ते मा जाणह तारओ त्ति डसणत्थं,मयणभुयङ्गो एसो वन्धिय भोयं ठिओ एसो"
english: "Don't touch me If you don't know how to brush your teeth. My brother - in - law: This is the way of a captive tiger."

prakrit: "ऎक्को वि कालसारो न देइ गन्तुं पयाहिणवलन्तो,किं पुण वाहाउलियं लोयणजुयलं पिययमाए?"

prakrit: "नूणं तिणयणभयकयरमणीरूवेण वियरइ अणङ्गो,अन्नह कह नयणसरेहिं ससिमुही भिन्दइ जुवाणे?"

english: "Friendship is sweeter when it is shared with others, When it is spent with one's neighbor It is more pleasant to be alone together."

english: "You fool, Don't you see That Kalimayan's long hair Is slipping When he touches you, Or does it fall when you push him aside?"

prakrit: "ईसा-मच्छररहिएहिं निव्वियारेहिं मामि! अच्छीहिं,इन्हिं जणोजणं पिव नियच्छए,कह न झिज्झामो?"
english: "Jesus - Mosquitoes are the way to go! Your mother - in - law is so nice To let you know she has a drink. How can I not be bothered?" ""

english: "Lovely girls, Who like to be pampered Have a good time frolicking, Flying and fluttering their wings And picking flowers."

prakrit: "नयणाइं सवाणियपत्तलाइं परपुरिसजीयहरणाइं,असियसियाइं व मुद्धे! खग्गाइं व कं न मारन्ति?"

prakrit: "वरतरुणिनयणपरिसण्ठियस्स जं कज्जलस्स माहप्पं,दीवयसिहासु न तहा ठाणेसु गुणा विवड्ढन्ति"
english: "The darker the festival, The more intricate the intricate details, Not to mention the dazzling beauty of the temples."

prakrit: "पियदंसणसरहसमउलियाइं जइ से न होन्ति नयणाइं,ता केणकन्नलइयंलक्खिज्जइ कुवलयं तिस्सा?"
english: "If you cannot make love While he is away, How can you look at someone else's face While you are away?"

prakrit: "हारो सिहीण,सवणाण कुण्डल,तह नियंवकिङ्किणिया,नयणाण पुणो विहवे वि मण्डणंकज्जलसलाया"
english: "The necklace is white, The bracelets are golden, So are the bracelets dazzling. Even the bright flame of the fair is resplendent."

prakrit: "अणुरायतन्तुआयड्ढियाइं जणसङ्कुले वि नयणाइं,वलिऊण सणियसणियं जत्थ पिओ तत्थ वच्चन्ति"
english: "Though they are young, They go wherever their parents are, Though they live in poverty."

prakrit: "सुहओ त्ति जियइ विद्धो,मरइ अविद्धो तह'च्छिबाणेहिं,इय सिक्खविया केणं अउव्वमेयं धणुव्वेयं?"
english: "Well, you live, you die, you go astray, So why should anyone harm me If I teach you this?"

prakrit: "नवजॊव्वणाण पिम्मन्धलाण मिहुणाण लोयभीयाणं,पच्छन्नं जं नयणेहिं सङ्गमो तं रइरहस्सं"
english: "Young and attractive, Friendly and affectionate, Fearful of small talk, But what I don't know About myself I keep secret."

prakrit: "ऎक्कं चिय सलहिज्जइ दिणेस-दियहाण नेहनिव्वहणं,आजम्ममॆक्कमॆक्केहिं जेहिं विरहो च्चिय न दिट्ठो"
english: "One day at a time it's safe to walk in silence, The next day the next. For those of you who are separated Don't look at me."

prakrit: "पियवल्लिविरहियाणं नेहो पत्ताण चेव निव्वडिओ,फिट्टन्ति जइ मयाणं वम्भजलद्दाइनयणाइं"
english: "Drunken women sigh as the waves crash against the rafters, But my heart is brimful of the moonlight."

prakrit: "सच्चं चिय ससिणेहो सो सुहओ पियसहीओ! जं अम्ह,ज्झत्ति परिपडुराइं तेण विणा होन्ति अङ्गाइं"

prakrit: "जइ न झुलुक्किज्जन्तो रूसणयदवेण मामि! मिहुणाणं,खङ्खरसिणेहदब्भो ता कहणु पुणन्नवीहोतो?"
english: "Mama, if you don't get scorched by the rays of the sun, How can you get angry again?"

english: "Mama! There must be something very special about your husband That he loves very much, That he is extremely fond of women, And that he loves her very much."

prakrit: "मह मणवल्ली तुह वयणमण्डवे निब्भरं समल्लीणा,रक्खिज्जसु सुक्कन्ती,सिञ्चिज्जसु नेहसलिलेण"
english: "I will protect you, my poor girl, By protecting you in all your troubles, By not spilling water on your body."

prakrit: "ऎक्काए नवरि नेहो पयासिओ तिहुयणम्मि जोन्हाए,जा झीणइ झीणे ससहरम्मि वड्ढइ अ वड्ढन्ते"
english: "A lonely bridegroom is like three young men in three directions: The thinner the pair, the larger the pair."

prakrit: "मयवहण! मह निमित्तं जं नियसि निसंस! कं नियन्तीयं,तं मन्ने मुद्दजीविरनेहस्स न गोयरे पडिओ"

english: "Hold on, hold on," she whispered, her heart beating faster than he could.

prakrit: "पहरद्धं पि न तवियं रवि-ससिविरमे सणिच्छर-बुहेहिं,पायडवंसेहिं व निप्फरेहिं किं कीरइ सुएहिं?"
english: "Protect yourself, Ravi, Why do you sleep soundly When you are busy making love? For what good is a good night's sleep Like that of a traveler?"

prakrit: "सव्वायरेण रक्खह तं पुरिसं जत्थ जयसिरी वसइ,अत्थमियम्मि मियङ्के तारेहिं न कीरए जोन्हा"
english: "May all beings be protected As long as there is prosperity for all beings. For who does not appreciate a star That vanishes in the middle of the night?"

prakrit: "सेसेण सिरं दिन्नं,पिट्ठी कुम्मेण भुवणभारस्स,कज्जारम्भे सरिसे वि अन्तरं होइ गरुआण"
english: "One gives the head, the other the back, And one puts on the arms. Even in the midst of hard work There is pride."

prakrit: "मित्तं पयस्स सलिलेण सच्छह जं न होइ किं तेण?,बिउणेइ मिलिज्जन्तं आवट्टइ आवईपडियं"
english: "Friend, Payas Salilen, tell me, If you don't like it, why not?" She stammered, Stirring the dish till it was ready to be eaten.

prakrit: "तं मित्तं कायव्वं जं मित्तं वसणपत्तकालम्मि,आलिहियभित्तिवाउल्लयं व न परम्मुहं ठाइ"
english: "Make a friend of the man Who, when he sits by, Stands by you in adversity, But refuses to budge."

prakrit: "धम्मेलग्गा इहमग्गणा वि पावन्ति उत्तमं ठाणं,गुणसङ्गिणो फुरन्ता गयणङ्गणगामिणो हुन्ति"
english: "A virtuous person achieves the highest state even when they are alone together, A man of virtuous character is one who goes on singing."

prakrit: "तिक्खो वि खरो वि सलोहओ वि परपीडगो वि लहुओ वि,लग्गो धम्मम्मि नरो सरो व्व गरुअं गुणं लहइ"
english: "Stiffness, sharpness, good manners, anger, and jealousy are the virtues of the dharma."

prakrit: "लीलाए कुवलयं कुवलयं व सीसे समुव्वहन्तेण,सेसेण सेसपुरिसाण पुरिसयारो वि पम्हुट्ठो"
english: "A flock of parrots flies out of the lake Like a bucket of water and a bunch of lead. Even a man's tail is pierced by a snake like this"

prakrit: "पूयफलेहिं चिय केवलेहिं पयडो न होइ मुहराओ,जाव न होइ सहाया निच्चं सच्चून्नया पत्ता"
english: "If you want to taste the fresh fruit, Do not scold your face, For there is no way You can help it Unless you are truthful."

prakrit: "हारो खित्तो महिमण्डलम्मि तरुणीए रइसमारम्भे,अवसररहियागुणवन्तयावि दूरे धरिज्जन्ति"
english: "Forgotten glories rob young women of their true potential."

prakrit: "कस्स वि गुणवुड्ढि च्चिय उच्चपयारोहणेसु निगडाइं,अइगारवेण पिच्छाण नीयनहगामिणो सिहिणो"
english: "No matter how good one's reputation, One cannot help falling in love with a man who is so high up in the hierarchy That he is slippery underfoot."

prakrit: "अहियमहियं कलाओ सङ्गहिय सिरीए तह कहं रविणो,अप्पं हरिणकेणं सित्तस्स वि जह न सङ्घडइ"
english: "Hey, my dear, How come you don't know how to make love And how come you're so busy making love?"

prakrit: "ऊहइ सो को वि कया वि भुवणपल्हत्थणापरो परणो,महिहरसिरेसु खेलन्ति जेण रच्छा इवतणाइं"
english: "Who cares if he falls asleep on top of his wife?" asked the doe, Playfully rubbing her eyelid Against the rachis behind her ear.

prakrit: "तं किं पि उवलखण्डं कया वि परमेसरी जणइ वसुहा,नरवइचूलाकुसुमेहिं जस्स किर दिज्जए अग्घो"
english: "Do you know what makes a man so hot And yet so full of love?"

prakrit: "दीवेसु तिमिरसङ्घाइरी इपप्फुरइ का वि सा कन्ती,तह वि हु पहाववञ्झेसु उवलखण्डेसु मणिसद्दो"
english: "The lamp is twinkling, The fire is boiling, And still the moon is shivering." ""

prakrit: "तस्स पईवस्स सयं कहं समत्था समत्थिमं कहिउं?,देवे गयम्मि सूरे जेण न सीयन्ति ववहारा"
english: "How can I talk to him When he's not with me?" The God of Love went on to say: "I don't know what kind of man I am."

prakrit: "तं धवलत्तं सो को वि भुवणसन्तावलोवगो महिमा,पसुसङ्गेणॆक्केणं ससिणो सव्वं पि सकलङ्कं"
english: "Glory to him, O son of the soil, Who is so fond of wild flowers, That at the moment of sowing the seeds Placed in a neem tree They attain everything."

prakrit: "अइवल्लहेसु कोवो वियम्भए,अहव अइविरुद्धेसु,अन्ने उण अवराहे वि होन्ति जॊग्गा अवॆक्खाए"
english: "Those who disagree with me are angry, Those who oppose me are jealous, And those who disagree are jealous."

prakrit: "अइगरुयमहावंसुब्भवाण सङ्घडियविहवाण,तुट्टन्ति गुणा अइधट्ठिमाए चावाण व नराणं"
english: "The arrows of the God of Love pierce through the whole sky, Cutting through the gaps in the sky with their sharp arrows."

prakrit: "सच्छाण सुचित्ताणं मुत्ताणं सुत्तिसम्पुडठियाणं,गुणसङ्गममलहन्ताण निप्फलो जम्मसंरम्भो"
english: "A good man disciplines good men, A clever woman disciplines bad men, And a good man practices good men."

prakrit: "न हु ऎत्तिएणहोही मलिणाण समुन्नईइ घणसमओ,कायव्वा अज्ज वि रायहंससुन्ना सरुच्छङ्गा"
english: "Not so long ago, my dear, I heard so much about you That I don't think I've ever seen you again."

prakrit: "अब्भत्थिया वि वङ्का गुणरहिया निमिसमॆत्तरङ्गिल्ला,इन्हिं कलिजुगसमए सुरिन्दधणुसच्छद्दा लोया"
english: "In this world of kalijuga, Surindadhānu's shadow is hidden, Not visible to the naked eye, Nor is there room for any other qualities."

prakrit: "सन्तगुणविप्पणासे असन्तदोसुब्भवे वि ज दुक्खं,तं सोसेइ समुद्दं,किं पुण हिययं मणुस्साणं?"
english: "Even an unhappy experience compounded by a penance for virtuous conduct Is an affliction to be endured in the world; what good is human life?"

prakrit: "कीरन्ति जाइं जॊव्वणवसेण अवियारिऊण कज्जाइं,वयपरिणामे सभारियाइं हियएखुडुक्कन्ति"
english: "Though they are young, They produce indecent acts, And when they are old, They cause embarrassment to those in authority."

prakrit: "दड्ढो चन्दणविडवी असेसवणरायमण्डणं इमिणा,हद्धी! छारस्स कए विक्कमियं हयहुयासस्स"
english: "Look at the moonlit sky, Lovely woman! There is a lot of smoke rising from the moonlight." ""

prakrit: "दिव्वम्मि पराहुत्तेपत्तियघडियं पि विहडइ नराणं,ज्जं वालुयधरणं व कह व बन्ध च्चिय न एइ"
english: "When the lamp is turned on its side And the clock is struck, There is nothing to stop it But the bow of the hand."

prakrit: "खण्डिज्जइ विहिणा ससहरो वि,सूरस्स होइ अत्थमणं,हयदिव्वपरिणईए कवलिज्जइ को न कालेण?"
english: "Destroyed even by a husband who is not worthy of his wife's favor, Who in the world would be worthless if he weren't worthy of her?"

prakrit: "जलणपवेसो चामीयरस्स भण कह न जुज्जए काउं,हद्धी! जस्स परिक्खन्ति पत्थरा मामि! गुणनियरं"
english: "" "Please, don't tell me you're burnt out! Don't try to fight it, sweetheart! That's the way you test stones. Mummy! Qualify your talents."

prakrit: "वसणाइं रिद्धिसमुद्धुरेसु लोएसु होन्ति पाएण,असमग्गसिरिं राहू वि गसइ,न हु जामिणीनाहं"
english: "In summer the roads are impassable, In winter the rivers are swollen, And people are dying for lack of water."

prakrit: "दीणत्तं कुणमाणो जणो सयं चेव मरणमहिलसइ,पडिवयणं जं कढिणं तं पुण मयमारणंतस्स"
english: "Being thin is the essence of virtue, And being thin is like being a dying woman. What you wear in marriage You give to me again and again."

prakrit: "ताव य कोवावसरो जाव विवेओ मणे ण विप्फुरइ,जलियं व भयवया हुयवहेण धूमो य विणियत्तो"
english: "If you travel to Goa, Consciousness will not trouble you. But if you smoke because you are afraid it will boil over, Then do not smoke." ""

prakrit: "सयलजणनयणकडुयं नित्थामं तह पयावपब्भट्ठं,नियतणयं धूमं पॆच्छिऊण छारं गओ अग्गी"
english: "Silly girl, Don't go up in flames Just look at the smoke rising from the fireplace."

prakrit: "दिवस-निसाघडमालं जीवियसलिलं जणस्स घॆत्तूणं,चन्दाइच्चवइल्ला काल'रहट्टं भमाडिन्ति"
english: "The moon is immortal, The nights are fleeting And the nights are long."

prakrit: "अत्थमणे छण्डिज्जइ नूणं सूरो वि निययकिरणेहिं,पुरिसस्स वसणकाले देहुप्पन्ना वि विहडन्ति"
english: "At the same time the sun is illuminated by the moon and the stars are set in motion; at the moment men settle down, they even pierce the body of the woman."

prakrit: "दीहरफणिन्दनाले महिहरकेसर-दिसामुहदलिल्ले,ओ पियइ कालभमरो जणमयरन्दं पुहइपउमे"
english: "Long - eyed girl, The directions are blurred, Oh! the joys of love Reached me when I was an infant."

prakrit: "परिगलियं तं पिम्मं गयाइ रूसण-पसाहियव्वाइं,इन्हिंवित्तविवाहो व्व हियय! तं निब्भरं सुयसु"
english: "I've heard so much about you from others:" "You silly girl, It's just the beginning of your marriage!" "Sleep tight."

prakrit: "मा वच्चह वीसम्भं नईण नारीण सइरचारीणं,पसरियपओहराओ कूलाइं कुलाइं पाडन्ति"
english: "Don't be alarmed: There are thousands of women walking around Wearing skirts That cover their thighs."

prakrit: "कह नाम तीए तं तह सहावघट्ठो वि सिहिभरो पडिओ,अहवा महिलाण चिरं को वा हिययम्मि सण्ठाइ?"
english: "What is her name, So that even at the slightest interruption She may be filled with sweetness? Or, Who is it that comforts women So much?"

prakrit: "महिहरतणया रयणारप्पिया नम्मया वहइ सलिलं,जुत्तं नीससइ जणो दीहं धूयाए जायाए"
english: "The rainy season has made it impossible for the river Narmadā to flow, For one day's water has been washed away, And the forest has been destroyed."

prakrit: "धवला मइलणसीला सिणेहपरिपूरिया वि तावेइ,दीवयसिह व्व महिला कज्जलमइलं घरं कुणइ"
english: "The white lady decorates the house with scorched earth, And the red lady with emeralds Fills the whole with love."

prakrit: "सग्गाओ हरं गङ्गा गया,हराओ गिरिं,तओ जलहिं,लद्धपसराण तित्ती महिलाण न एगपुरिसम्मि"
english: "The whole Ganges is gone, The hail has fallen, The flames are still there, And the parrots have fled, So that women won't see their husbands again."

prakrit: "महिलाओ कमलिणीओ व अणुरत्ताओ गुणेहिं जुत्ताओ,पिच्छन्तस्सेव य दिणवइस्स भमरेहिं जुत्ताओ"
english: "Women are like lotuses: They display their virtuous qualities, Like bees in a beehive That disappears after a day of frolicking."

prakrit: "मित्त'त्थमणुव्विग्गा दट्ठुं भमरेहिं कमलिणी मुक्का,अन्नासत्तं न रमन्ति महुलिहा ओ वि,किं चॊज्जं?"
english: "Dear bee, The jasmine is stung by the bee's sting, But the bee is not amused. What's the point?" ""

prakrit: "भद्दं कुलङ्गणाणं जासिं मणकमलकोसमणुपत्तो,मयणभमरो वराओ वच्चइ निहणं तहिं चेय"
english: "As soon as you touch a lotus leaf with your finger, That's what you do To a woman whose face is smeared with red ghee."

prakrit: "नेहक्खयं कुणन्ती पज्जलइसगुणवट्टिसङ्गेण,दीवयसिह व्व लच्छी अथिर च्चिय बहुअवाएहिं"
english: "Because of her bright complexion She shows no signs of deterioration, Like the flame of a lamp Which bursts forth from the fire of love."

prakrit: "दूरेण निहियभमुहा पए पए किम्पि किम्पि चिन्तन्ता,नट्ठं व जॊव्वणं महियलम्मि थेरा पलोयन्ति"
english: "Far away they stare at the horizon, Thinking how dim the horizon may be, While the young men run after the scent of bees."

prakrit: "किं वासरेहिं? किं वा सरेहिं? किं वा सरेहिं? पसयच्छि!,तारुन्न-समर-पयवज्जिएहि,बहुएहिं किं तेहिं?"
english: "What are you doing here? Are you really going to do it? Is it going to be all right? I'm off! You silly girl, Are you sure you don't want to go there?"

prakrit: "फणिणो सिराइं धुत्ता पियंवया जह विसाइं महुराइं,परिणामदारुणाओ वि परमहिलाओ तह सुहाओ"
english: "The bees that bathe in the nectar of the lotus, Drink good wine, Sweat good, Though they produce no fruit."

prakrit: "निवडन्ति च्चियौब्भडविवेयदण्डग्गगाढलग्गा वि,इन्दियगइन्दपरिपॆल्लणाहिं गुरुपावपङ्केसु"
english: "Even with a thick blanket of mud and mud on top of his body, I beg of you to forgive my parents for being so careless."

prakrit: "इह-परलोअभवाणं सुक्खाणं मद्दवो च्चिय उवाओ,चावाणअणमन्ताण गुणसमारोहणं कत्तो?"
english: "Ah! the pleasures of love, Which give pleasure to the senses: Where then, O woman, is the accumulation of virtues in the absence of desire?"

prakrit: "वयणिज्जं पिच्छिय विहडियम्मि गाढम्मि पिम्मगण्ठिम्मि,अजडाण सल्लविगमो,जडाण उण सल्लसम्भूई"
english: "The wind blows softly, The donkey falls asleep on its back, The ox runs away, And the donkey barks loudly." ""

prakrit: "जीयं पि जस्स दिज्जइ दियहेसु सिणेहनहरनहिलेसु,तस्स च्चेय कया वि हु तणं पि दिन्ताण उव्वेओ"
english: "As long as you give ear to what is unseemly, There is something for which you grow weary."

prakrit: "इहलोयभवाणं पि हु मूलं सुक्खाणमेणनयणाओ,दुक्खाण पुणो इहलोइयाण परलोइयाणं च"
english: "Love based on delusion is the root of happiness, suffering is rooted in delusion and renunciation."

prakrit: "जंजं पि भुवणकुहरे तं खु असेसं पि चञ्चलं चेव,तह वि जणजीवियाणं महिला पिम्मोणयपडाया"
english: "Though the sky was overcast with smoke, Yet she persisted in her desire to live As a woman beguiled by love."

prakrit: "रत्तासु वि जे रच्चन्ति महिलियासुं न ते वि सविवेया,जे उ विरत्तासु वि गाढरागिणो ताण भद्दाइं"
english: "Women do not understand what men want Even when they make love."

prakrit: "सिरिसीलसूरि-सिरिधम्मसूरि-सिरिसव्वदेवगच्छम्मि,चन्दप्पहसूरीणं अणुकमसो सिस्सलेसेणं"
english: "Siricilla - Suri - Siridhammasuri - Sirisabha - The god of thunder, The moon - faced sun - Mother - in - law is like a sesame seed."

prakrit: "विहितोजिणेसरसूरिणा नवोगाहरयणवरकोसो,भालिज्जठिएण इमो मणोहरो समणतोसकए"
english: "Aunt, If you want to satisfy a man's craving for fresh air, You'd better bring him to me."

prakrit: "ससि-बाण-सूरवरिसे,अट्ठावन्ना य पक्कमा ऎत्थ,गाहाणं अट्ठ सया,रइओ सहसो सिलोगाणं"
english: "From sapling to arrow, From tree to tree, From elephant to dog, From bird to bird, From lion to lion - The syllables of the Sahasa are wailed."

prakrit: "गाहाण रयणकोसं निच्चं जो हिययमन्दिरे ठाही,वित्थरइ तस्स कित्ती,नीसेसकलाओ विलसन्ति"
english: "Praise be to the great demon who builds temples in the sky, Who destroys them? The arts of the nieces prosper."

prakrit: "इति गाथारत्नकोशः सम्पूर्णः. ग्रन्थाग्रम: १०००"
english: "Iti Gatharatnakosha: Sampoorna:. Granthagram: 1000"

prakrit: "लङ्का लया पलासा वसन्तमासम्मि लद्धमाहप्पा,निव्वाहिऊण सीयं पच्छा कलियारया जाया"
english: "Lanka laya palasa Vasanthamasami ladhmahappa, The path to the jasmine is paved with bamboo shoots"

prakrit: "कलियामिसेण उब्भेवि अङ्गुली मालईए महमहियं,वारेउ जा समत्था मह इन्तं महुयरजुवाणं"
english: "When the jasmine puts her finger on the lotus It means great glory, For all the young men know that I have a bee in me."

prakrit: "नाऊण वि विन्नाणं काऊण वि समरसाहसं कम्मं,लङ्घेऊण वि मेरुं पुण्णेहि विणा सुहं कत्तो?"
english: "Without a name, Without recognition, With mutual affection, With longing, Without merit, What is happiness?"

prakrit: "थक्के भणियं सोहइ,थक्के भणियं सुहावहं होइ,अत्थक्के पुण भणियं कय पि कज्जं विणासेइ"
english: "A tired brother is happy, a tired one is cheerful, and suddenly, once again, the brother has something to work with."

prakrit: "जह मूसयस्स ऎक्केण वीहिणा दो वि वावडा हत्था,तह अमुणियकल्लाणा थेवेण वि उत्तुणा हुन्ति"
english: "As a Moses has two trumpets in one hand, So also a devil has one when he speaks in silence."

prakrit: "गुणजाणऎ च्चिय जणे हुति गुणा पायडा महग्घा य,मणिरयणाइ वि गो… … …"
english: "One who knows the virtues has many virtues, But if one's talents are expensive, Even a decent wife is worthless."

prakrit: "किं भणिमो नवजुवईण ताण सव्वङ्गचङ्गिमसुहस्स,दिट्ठीतिभायफंसे वि जाणममयं पि हु न किपि"
english: "How can I say that to a young woman Whose whole body Is bristling with excitement, Though my eyes and ears Are fixed on it?"

prakrit: "गयनेवच्छा वच्छे! अइदुसहा तं सि तरुणनयणाण,वम्महकरसङ्गहिया निप्पडियार व्व खग्गलया"
english: "You silly girl! There you have it, That young gentleman, Like the plowman's son Who fell in love with a mermaid." ""

prakrit: "दिट्ठीए तस्स ससहरकरसलिलज्झलझलासलोणाए,वाला ससिमणिधीउल्लिय व्व सेउल्लिया जाया"
english: "When he saw her, He was moved to tears by the tears that streamed down his cheeks; The girl's face looked like a lotus."

prakrit: "नवसङ्गरङ्गनट्टावएण नच्चाविया तहा अहयं,मामि! महं चिय हिययं न विम्हयं जेण पम्हुसइ"
english: "You're right, Mommy! Don't look at me Like you already know how to dance On a new song." ""

prakrit: "अमयमओ वि हु दाहं जणेइ,सञ्जीवणो वि मोहेइ,मउओ वि विन्धइ मणं,दिट्ठिच्छोहो मयच्छीणं"
english: "Though impermanent, I give birth to thirst, Though eternal, Though my mind is wrenched, Yet my eyes behold."

prakrit: "अइवङ्कदीहरा जणमणाइं मोहन्ति कुलवहुकडक्खा,अणिवारियविसमविसा रोसारुणकसिणभुयग व्व"
english: "The plowman's wife bemoans the absence of her husband, Like a banner proclaiming the victory of righteousness."

prakrit: "अन्नेसिं सोहग्गं न सहन्ति,न दिन्ति कहवि य सुहच्छिं,जीयं हरन्ति विरहे अहो! गुणा दुज्जणा तीए"
english: "They cannot bear other people's joys, Nor can they tell which ones are more pleasant, For they are lost In separation! Such is the nature of a wicked woman." ""

prakrit: "कुप्पन्ति वल्लहत्थे अपहुप्पन्तस्स निययअङ्गस्स,अन्नपहुप्पन्तस्स य पुणो असूयन्ति मिहुणाइं"
english: "When food is scarce The breasts grow thin, When clothes are worn out The limbs become brittle, And when the arms are empty The lovers part again."

prakrit: "अट्ठाणट्ठनिलयणं विसमियसयणं खलन्तमिउवयणं,वारत्तनिमियनयणं पच्छन्नरयं कहं सुहयं?"
english: "Where is the pleasure in looking at someone else's face, When you are alone, And when you are apart?"

prakrit: "वल्लहजणस्स दुक्खे निसुए विरहम्मि जायए सुक्खं,सुक्खम्मि पुणो दुक्खं पिम्मस्स गई अहो! विसमा"
english: "The unhappy person dies, Separation is complete, Happiness returns, Suffering returns! Woe to you!" ""

prakrit: "जस्सन्तरावयासो गउरवदक्खिन्नदुज्जणजणाण,तं पि हु पॆम्मं ति भणन्तयाण जीहा वि लज्जेइ"
english: "As soon as one knows that one is miserly Because one is proud, One can say that one loves oneself But one is ashamed of oneself."

prakrit: "तं सुयणा जं वसिया सि तक्खण च्चेय तस्स हिययम्मि,सो दुज्जणो उण न जो अज्ज वि निवसेइ तुह हियए"
english: "The sleeper that dwelt there Has grown thin Since then, And the wretched man that still dwells there Has not grown thin in your sight."

prakrit: "मं परिचियं पि उज्झिय दुल्लहलम्भे जणम्मि सङ्कन्त!,हा! हियय! हीणसाहस! लहसि तुमं दुक्खलक्खाइं"
english: "Aunt, Even my friends are annoyed When I tell them I'm pregnant!" "Hey! Hey! You coward! Maybe you're embarrassed." ""

prakrit: "वल्लहसयवासयमन्दिरेसु सञ्झब्भसरिसराएसु,पुरिसहियएसु पॆम्मावन्धो को नाम वामनयणाणं?"
english: "Who is Vamanayana, the name of the beloved who dwells in heavenly abodes, Who walks about freely, Who sits astride men?"

prakrit: "अवराहो वि हु वल्लहजणस्स परमं पमोयमप्पेइ,अहियं हरेइ हियय धूमो वि हु सुरहिवत्थूणं"
english: "Though absent, I am a man of great virtue, Though lost, Though my heart overflows with smoke."

prakrit: "जग्गिरसोहग्गाणं अविणयवाणी वि वरिसए हरिसं,सुहडनिवकायरो वि हु किं न हु जयमज्जइ जयम्मि?"
english: "Though the sky is red, Though the wind is blowing, Yet I persevere: Despite my many pleasures, Can't I have joy?"

prakrit: "सो अत्थो जो हत्थे,तं मित्तं जं निरन्तरं वसणे,तं रूवं जत्थ गुणा,त विन्नाणं जहिं धम्मो"
english: "So, what is dear to one's heart, That friend who stays constantly, That form which multiplies, That description whereof is dharma."

prakrit: "सो सुहओ परमप्पुव्विल्लनिहाणं व नट्ठसल्लं व,आसन्नो वि हु विहिओ हयविहि! कह नाम मह दूरे?"
english: "Behold, my beloved, Though I sit still, I cannot move! What name is too far away for me?" ""

prakrit: "दूरट्ठिओ वि सु च्चिय मह हियए जलहरो व्व सरसीए,से व्व ण नलिणीव णवणगएहि किं नाम अन्नेहिं?"
english: "Though I am far away, I can see the stream of water running through me. So why not take a bath? What is your name, Anna?" ""

prakrit: "कुविएण कयन्तेणं परिवारे वारियम्मिनिसिसमये,कुलबालियाए लज्जा महल्लिया सहयरी होइ"
english: "Because one can't bring one's relatives up in arms, One has to bear the shame of growing up in a village."

prakrit: "अइमुद्धमउयचवलो वलन्तनयणाइ तीए जन्तीए,दिट्ठिच्छोहो सविसेसदूसहो वालभुयगो व्व"
english: "You silly girl, Don't turn your back on me If you want to see her... You stupid bastard!"

prakrit: "सच्चं रई चिय इमा जमिमीइ ममंमणं पि गयनयणं,पहरेइ सो हयासो विसमेहिं सरेहि कुसुमसरो"
english: "Truly, my daughter - in - law knows how to make my heart sing. She protects my heart With all her might."

prakrit: "कोदण्डकोसलेणं सो अज्ज वि लज्जिरॊ च्चिय अणङ्गो,जं किर लक्खं भुयणाइं तिन्नि,बाणा पुणो पञ्च"
english: "To this day I am ashamed of my body," said the go - between. "Whoever has eaten one lakh bhuyanas Will have to eat five times as much?"

prakrit: "अमयरससारमुल्लञ्चिऊण चन्दाओ तुह मुहं विहियं,तस्स तलं जेण जणो सुयणु! कलङ्कॊ त्ति कित्तेइ"
english: "The moon is shining brightly on your face Like a banner proclaiming immortality. Anyone can sleep under it! What is the stigma?" ""

prakrit: "आयन्नाण गुणाणं रणरणओ,सुमरणम्मि दाहजरो,दिट्ठे हल्लप्फलओ,मिलियम्मि पियम्मि किम्पि सुहं"
english: "When one sees virtue, one renounces virtue, When one remembers virtue, One wonders how fruitful it is To attain it While one is busy making love"

prakrit: "दिट्ठं सिणिद्धनयणं वयणं विणओवरोहसोहिल्लं,करकमलकेसबन्धो य हरइ धीरं हियाहिन्तो"
english: "The sight of the lotus, Scorched by the rays of the sun, With its white blossom and twigs, Is enough to reassure anyone."

prakrit: "एसो अलद्धदुल्लहकामो वामेयरो करो फुरिओ,दाहिणनयणकयत्थस्स तुज्झ कह नाम वामत्तं?"
english: "Fool, what's your name, Left - handed girl?" ""

prakrit: "रूवं नयणाण गुणा मणस्स अवलोयणाइं चरणाणं,आलवणं सव्वङ्गस्स बन्धणं तस्स किं भणिमो?"
english: "What can I say to a man whose face is patterned after a jewel, Whose feet are plucked from the sky And whose limbs are bound together?"

prakrit: "‘सुमरिज्जसु’ त्ति पिम्मस्स बाहिरं,‘मह सुहे’ति न घडेइ,‘मा खिज्जसु’ त्ति अणुहवविरुद्धमिह किं भणामि अहं?"
english: "" "Please, don't you see I'm off in a good mood," "She won't make you happy." "What can I say against that expression?"

prakrit: "नयणाण वन्धणं मणविआरणं वेयणाइ सम्मोहो,अन्नाण दसणिज्जाण दुज्जणो तीय रूवसिरी"
english: "Wretched woman, If you ask me what it's like to be widowed, It's the wicked one Who turns every one of you upside down."

prakrit: "अमयमयवयणमविरामरमियमवियारवज्जरियकज्जं,जयइ पहुत्तं वालत्तणं व पॆम्म च लोयम्मि"
english: "Love is the ultimate truth, Like playing the flute, Like riding a horse, It conquers everything in the world."

prakrit: "गङ्गासङ्गेण विणा वि जलनिही होइ जलनिहिसया,गङ्गा उण तेण विणा भण कत्थ खणं पि वीसमउ?"
english: "Without the Ganges, the waters would not have flowed. How can I think of drinking water without the Ganga?" ""

prakrit: "घरिणी लच्छि व्व महानिहि व्व अमयं व पुन्नमुत्ति व्व,जत्थ'त्थि घरं त चिय,अन्नं रन्नं ति मन्नन्ति"
english: "A housewife is wealthy, immutable, and immutable; Wherever the house is, there is plenty to eat; The fields are precious."

prakrit: "ताओ गुणाण खाणी महिमडलमण्डणं सुमहिलाओ,दोसा वि जत्थ निहिया गुणरूवेणं परिणमन्ति"
english: "Those who appreciate virtue tend to glorify virtue, And those who despise virtue become virtuous."

prakrit: "ताण कुलवालियाणं न लहइ सच्चं सहावमहिमाणं,जाण पडिवक्खचडिया दोसा वि मणं न दूमिन्ति"
english: "True love does not hurt when one is angry, But true love knows no wrong."

prakrit: "ताण नमो समणीणं आजम्मं चरियवम्भचेराणं,पिम्मनडकवडनाडयविडंवणा जाण न खणं पि"
english: "Tane naam samnein aajm, charivambh cherenan, piman nadakwad naday vidwanana jaana nahi khana pyaar." ""

prakrit: "तीए तिजयं पि कीरउ निउञ्छणं पिच्छुलुच्छुजट्ठीए,छित्ता वि पीलिया वि हु जा न हु महुरत्तणं मुअइ"
english: "Because she is so thin, The nail marks are slippery, And even if she were jaundice, The full moon would not die."

prakrit: "महिला पसायगहिला सयम्पभा होइ,न उण सप्पुरिसो,ससिणा विणा वि रयणी हवइ,न दिवसो विणा रविणा"
english: "A woman should be able to support herself whenever she wants to; there is no need to curse her husband; without love there is neither day nor night."

prakrit: "मन्नामि मामि! कि वा मज्झ कए तुज्झ दुक्करं अन्नं?,सुहयस्समज्झजं किर अप्पा वि समप्पिओ तुमए"
english: "Mother, what's wrong with you? Why waste your time looking for me? You're the only one who can sort things out." ""

prakrit: "तं दच्छन्ति सहरिसं कयावराहं अहं ति सविलक्खं,पुणरवि चरणं दिस रोस मामि! नलमाणसं तइया"
english: "He sees how I look at him, And he at me:" "I'm completely at a loss." "Look at that angry mother at his feet Again! You're not being polite!"

prakrit: "तण्हाएतरलनयणो परिस्समे,अञ्चलम्मि वलहत्थो,दुक्खे सत्तो,धम्मम्मि विम्हिओ,तुह सुहे सुहिओ"
english: "In the midst of the thickets of mud, On the other side of the river, Right on the wrong side, In the middle of the dharma, Your pleasure is bound to increase."

prakrit: "जूयं धणाण,वसणं गुणाण,पडिपत्थणोवयाराण,वत्थुवियारो पिम्माण माणमुम्मूलइ समूलं"
english: "A gamble is a reward, a stay is a merit, a journey is a journey. But a wise man's heart is worthless."

prakrit: "लज्जा कुलमज्जाया दुन्नि कवाडाइं जेहिं भग्गाइं,हियएसु तेसु सहस त्ति दुक्खमक्खलियमल्लियइ"
english: "Shame on you, poor girl, Whoever broke the shackles of decency Would have to suffer the same as you."

prakrit: "पिम्मस्स पोढमहिलाजणस्स विहवस्स वारिवाहस्स,परमप्पणो मणस्स य मुणन्ति मुणिणो विणयरूवं"
english: "Next time There is a flood of women Wearing white robes, I will swoon as my husband sighs." ""

prakrit: "तित्थाण सुपुरिसाणं मणीण सन्ताणमोसहीणं च,महिमा महासईणं च कालकलुसस्स दूरेणं"
english: "A good man is worthless if he has no children, And a great woman is worth nothing if she puts time aside."

prakrit: "नयरं महूसवमयं,तुच्छा लच्छी,मणं महारम्भं,विहिनिहियं मह हियए तिसल्लयं सल्लए एयं"
english: "Never mind the monsoons, never mind the heat, My mind is so full of them, That I cannot get enough of them"

prakrit: "वित्तविवाहं च गिहं,पयपब्भट्ठो य नरवइनिओई,गयजॊव्वणा य महिला न पुव्वसोहं पि हु लहन्ति"
english: "Wealth and marriage are immaterial, Love based on poverty or infidelity, Youth based on youth and love based on gender."

prakrit: "विहवङ्गणाण गब्भो,निद्धणवङ्गाण दाणवसणाइं,ज च खवणाण कुच्चं तं अमयछलं हलाहलयं"
english: "The grasshopper is deaf, The weeper is naked, And the bitch is paralyzed."

prakrit: "अइकिविणो चेय तुमं जं इक्कम्मि वि गुणम्मि घिप्पन्ते,अप्परिमाणगुणो वि हु वहसि मुहमहोमुहं नाह!"
english: "Because you detest such a thing And such a quality; You are more valuable than all else, Not my face!"

prakrit: "न हु तुह गुणे गहिस्संदुण्ह पि जाण गहणम्मि,तुह गहणासहणेणं मह उण अइमुच्छगहणेणं"
english: "I don't know your worth, Not even in my wildest dreams. But in my heart of hearts I cherish your affection."

prakrit: "समरतिमिरम्मि सहलं दूयं पिव पेसिऊण पत्तवहं,अहिसारइ रिउलच्छिं महल्लिया जस्स चावलया"
english: "Aunt, If you want to drink water while you're busy kneading it, You can do so only with rice flour."

prakrit: "तइं गिण्हिय चावलए रिऊण लच्छी ति गहियचावलया,रत्ता तुमम्मि नरवइ! दरिसइ सरिसत्तणं नूणं"
english: "You're the only one who can count the rice You've got in your hands, You silly girl! There must be something on your mind." ""

prakrit: "उन्नमिऊण नहयले जलहर! तुह गज्जिय पि छज्जेइ,वज्जेण दहिउममएण सिञ्चिउं वयसि ज भुयणं"
english: "Get up, take a bath! Your husband is asleep, But you seem to be sipping water Because the storm has washed away your face." ""

prakrit: "जइ विहवीण विणीयं दिट्ठिपहे कहवि वच्चइ अवच्चं,ता अमय-चन्द-चन्दिम-चन्दणपङ्केहिं न हु किपि"
english: "If a woman's gaze is averted at what she sees, She is not indifferent to the nectar - the moon - The crescent - The petals of the moon."

prakrit: "मन्नन्ति दुहं पि सुहं महिलाओ अवच्चनेहगहिलाओ,परबाललालणं पि हु ज किर वझाओ झायति"
english: "Though they are sorrowful They rob women of their senses, But even though they are sagging They forsake their husbands."

prakrit: "धन्नाओ ताओ कुलवालियाओ निम्महियमोहमहिमाओ,दिट्ठ न वियडभिउडीपुडकियं जाहि परवयण"
english: "Blessed are the good women Who, proud of their beauty, Do not look at the foolish girl Who has passed by on her own."

prakrit: "मुत्तु मालइपमुहं कुसुमसमूहं महूसवदिणेसु,ऎक्क चिय गिज्जइ बालियाहिं नोमालियाकुसुमं"
english: "Pearls, garlands, bunch of safflowers, Springtime sunshine, When the clouds cover the dunes And the jasmine blossoms"

prakrit: "सुहडनरिन्दपयावो सुमन्तजावो पसूणसरचावो,तह य महासइसावो मा कयमव्वो! नियत्तेइ"
english: "Be kind, be courteous, and don't be so hasty: Never be angry!"

prakrit: "निच्चं वरिससु दाणं कुणेसु गमणं मणोहरगईए,दंससु दसणे चवले! जइ सि सुहत्थी-मं भद्दे!"

prakrit: "जोण्हाऊरिअकोसकन्तिधवले सव्वङ्गगन्धुक्कडेणिव्विग्घं घरदीहिआए सुरसं वेवन्तओ मासलं,आसाएइ सुमञ्जुगुञ्जिअरवो तिङ्गिच्छिपाणासवंउम्मिल्लन्तदलावलीपरिअओ चन्दुज्जुए छप्पओ"
english: "The whole sky is overcast with the scent of jasmine, And the moonlight is hiding behind the clusters of bees That crowd the housetops In the hope of catching a glimpse of the lovely bird."

prakrit: "इमिणा सरएण ससी ससिणा वि णिसा णिसाए कुमुअवणं,कुमुअवणेण व पुलिणं पुलिणेण व सहइ हंसउलं"
english: "Aunt, Even a sage's daughter In law Can make a fool of herself, If she has to pull a twig With her hands She will make a swan sit on it."

prakrit: "णवविसकसाअसंसुद्धकण्ठकलमणोहरो णिसामेसु,सरअसिरिचलणणेउरराओ इव हंससंलावो"
english: "When the moon is full The rays of the sun, Like a flock of geese moving in unison, Calm down."

prakrit: "सञ्चरइ सीअलाअन्तसलिलकल्लोलसङ्गणिव्वविओ,दरदलिअमालईमुद्धमउलगन्धुद्धुरो पवणो"
english: "The wind whirls the lotus leaf through the rafters, Like a lotus stuck in the mud." ""

prakrit: "एसा वि दसदिसावहुवयणविसेसावलि व्व सरसलिले,विम्भलतरङ्गदोलन्तपाअवा सहइ वणराई"
english: "This is what the forest dweller has to say:" "In a swarm of ten thousand young men, Fluttering their wings And swaying their wings, One can never help it." ""

prakrit: "एआĩ दियससम्भावणेक्कहिअआĩ पेच्छह घडन्ति,आमुक्कविरहवेअणाĩ चक्कवायाĩ वावीसु"
english: "It's the kind of thing that happens only to people with feelings of jealousy, Not to mention anger," he said.

prakrit: "एअं उअ विअसिअसत्तवत्तपरिमलविलोहविज्जन्तं,अविहाविअकुसुमासाअविमुहिअं भमइ भमरउलं"
english: "Look! A swarm of bees is hovering over me, Like a column of nectar rising from a flicker of acacia flowers."

prakrit: "चन्दुज्जुआवअंसं पविअम्भिअसुरहिकुवलआमोअं,णिम्मलतारालोअं पिअइ व रयणीमुहं चन्दो"
english: "When the moon is full The moon is pure, When the cool moon is fragrant, And when it is dark The moon looks like a rainbow."

prakrit: "ता किं बहुणा पअम्पिएण."
english: "So why get angry?" ""

prakrit: "अइरमणीआ रअणी सरओ विमलो तुमं च साहीणो,अणुकूलपरिअणाए मण्णे तं णत्थि जं णत्थि"
english: "You stupid girl, You're the only one who knows how to weep. What you don't know About incompatible people"

prakrit: "ता किं पि पओसविणोअमेत्तसुहअं म्ह मणहरुल्लावं,साहेह अउव्वकहं सुरसं महिलाअणमणोज्जं"
english: "So, my dear, What pleasure is there to be had in courting such a lovely woman?"

prakrit: "तं मुद्धमुहम्बुरुहाहि वअणअं णिसुणिऊण णे भणिअं,कुवलअदलच्छि एत्थं कईहि तिविहा कहा भणिआ"
english: "He looked at me with that puzzled expression on his face When I told him:" "There are so many of you out there That one day I might as well have said it." ""

prakrit: "तं जह दिव्वा तह दिव्वमाणुसी माणुसी तह च्चेअ,तत्थ वि पढमेहĩ कअं कईहĩ किर लक्खणं किं पि"
english: "The more divine a person is, the more obvious it is."

prakrit: "अण्णं सक्कअपाअअसङ्किण्णविहा सुवण्णरइआओ,सुव्वन्ति महाकइपुङ्गवेहि विविहाउ सुकहाओ"
english: "Blessed are the beautiful women Who sleep soundly, Who enjoy a good night's sleep, And who enjoy a varied pastime."

prakrit: "ताणं मज्झे अम्हारिसेहĩ अबुहेहĩ जाउ सीसन्ति,ताउ कहाओ ण लोए मिअच्छि पावन्ति परिहावं"
english: "There goes my mother - in - law's angry husband, Going to bed early, So how can I appease him If he comes home late?"

prakrit: "ता किं मं उवहासेसि सुअणु असुएण सद्दसत्थेण,उल्लविउं पि ण तीरइ किं पुण विअडो कहाबन्धो"
english: "Then why am I telling you all this While you're asleep, Sitting here for the day, Stirring the fire, Yet again you refuse to budge?"

prakrit: "भणिअं च पिअअमाए पियअम किं तेण सद्दसत्थेण,जेण सुहासिअमग्गो भग्गो अम्हारिसजणस्स"
english: "Tell me, dear friend, Why did you ever say that to me? Your modesty is such a disgrace."

prakrit: "उवलब्भइ जेण फुडं अत्थो अकअत्थिएण हिअएण,सो च्चेअ परो सद्दो णिच्चो किं लक्खणेण म्ह"
english: "If you grow old just because you can't breathe, You'd better take care of yourself," he said, "So why am I showing you these symptoms?"

prakrit: "एमेअ मुद्धजुअईमणोहरं पाअआए भासाए,पविरलदेसिसुलक्खं कहसु कहं दिव्वमाणुसिअं"
english: "Hey, you stupid girl, Tell me, silly girl, How come you're so naïve?"

prakrit: "तं तह सोऊण पुणो भणिअं उब्बिम्बबालहरिणच्छि,जइ एवं ता सुव्वउ सुसन्धिबन्धं कहावत्थुं"
english: "I'll tell you what," She said again, fluttering her skirt, "If I tell you the truth, It's all good sleep."

prakrit: "चउजलहिवलअरसणाणिबद्धविअडोवरोहसोहाए,सेसङ्कसुप्परिट्ठिअसव्वङ्गुव्वूढभुवणाए"
english: "The plowman's wife bewailed at the sound of the bolt Of the cudgel:" "It's as good as gold." ""

prakrit: "पलअवराहसमुद्धरणसोक्खसम्पत्तिगरुअभावाए,णाणाविहरअणालङ्किआए भअवइए पुहईए"
english: "The pleasures of love, Like the abundance of wealth, Have reached such a pitch That they are beyond reproach."

prakrit: "णीसेससस्ससम्पत्तिपमुइआसेसपामरजणोहो,सुव्वसिअगामगोहणरम्भारवमुहलिअदिअन्तो"
english: "Dear friend, I beg of you all the happiness That comes from embracing my past."

prakrit: "अइसुहिअपाणआवाणचच्चरीरवरमाउलारामो,णीसेससुहणिवासो आसअविसओ त्ति विक्खाओ"
english: "I will never forget how my eyes welled up with tears, When I tried to kiss his cheek, He could not help laughing."

prakrit: "जो सो अविउत्तो कअजुअस्स धम्मस्स सण्णिवेसो व्व,सिक्खट्ठाणं व पआवइस्स सुकआण आवासो"
english: "One who observes austerities, Who observes dharma, Resides in happiness both in learning and in passing."

prakrit: "सासणमिव पुण्णाणं जम्मुप्पत्ति व्व सुहसमूहाणं,आअरिसो आआराण सइ सुछेत्तं पिव गुणाणं"
english: "Righteousness, virtue, and the abundance of pleasures are the virtues of good people."

prakrit: "सुसणिद्धघाससन्तुट्ठगोहणालोअमुइअगोआलो,गेआरवभरिअदिसो वरवल्लइवेणुणिवहेसु"
english: "Calm, grass, sweetwood trees, Mute crows, Now look around you Like wretched wretches."

prakrit: "सुहावगाहणिम्मलजलासओ. तरुणतरुज्जाणरिद्धिरमणीओ. कमलसरसण्डमण्डिआसामुहो. सुस्साअफलभरोणमिअवच्छअलावासिअपहिअजणसमाउलो. सव्वोवसग्गभअरहिओ. चाउवण्णसमाउत्तो. णिच्चूसववड्ढिआणन्दो. विविहकाणणोवसोहिअभूमिभाओ. विविहकुसुमामोअवासिअदिअन्तरालो. अणवइण्णकलिकालो. अइट्ठपावो. अपरिचत्तधम्मो. अणुवलक्खिअपआवो अपणट्ठसोहो. अणुवजाअचोरराअभओ. अपरिमिअगुणगणणिवासो त्ति."
english: "Blessed are the tender jasmine trees. Young emerald trees. The lotus shade of the moon. The fragrant flowers of the amaranth tree. The white rose of the lotus. Everyone is full of joy. When a flower is plucked It opens wide with delight. When it opens it opens wide It opens like a panorama. With its wide expanse It opens the eyes of the God of Love. When the eyes are closed It opens with a clenched fist. When an object is hidden It opens its eyes wide." ""

prakrit: "जहिं च. कामवरिसी भअवं. पज्जण्णो कामदुहाओ सुरहीओ. सइफलाओ वणप्फईओ. अवञ्झाओ जुअईओ त्ति."
english: "Wherever there are lovers, There are lovers everywhere. Where two lovers make love. Where the plowman makes hay. There are gamblers everywhere."

prakrit: "दूरुण्णअगरुअपओहराओ कोमलमुणालवाहीओ,सइ महुरवाणिआओ जुअईओ णिण्णआउ व्व"
english: "Long - eyed women with delicate breasts hovering in the distance, Like jewellers making love In a barber's hands."

prakrit: "अच्छउ ता णिअछेत्तं सेसाइ वि जत्थ पामरवहूहिं,रक्खिज्जन्ति मणोहरगेआरवहरिअहरिणाहिं"
english: "Well, that's just the way it is. Wherever the farmer's wife is, Protect her husband From the arrows of the God of Love."

prakrit: "इअ एरिसस्स सुन्दरि मज्झम्मि सुजणवअस्स रमणीअं,णीसेससुहणिवासं णअरं णामं पइट्ठाणं"
english: "Here's Erisus, Lovely lady, Use your name for a night of pleasure." ""

prakrit: "तं च पिए वरणअरं वण्णिज्जइ जा विहाइ ता रअणी,उद्देसो सङ्खेवेण किं पि वोच्छामि णिसुणेसु"
english: "That's why my husband is so angry. If you ask me what I mean, I'll tell you the opposite." ""

prakrit: "जत्थ वरकामिणीचलणणेउरारावमणुसरन्तेहिं,पडिराविज्जइ मुहमुक्ककिसलअं राअहंसेहिं"
english: "Wherever the bridegroom's girdle Slipping from the treetops, Is propped against the woman's bosom, There will be tears welling up in her eyes."

prakrit: "जण्णग्गिधूमसामालिअणहअललोअणेक्करसिएहिं,णच्चिज्जइ ससहरमणिसिलाअले घरमऊरेहिं"
english: "The door is ajar, The houses are deserted, The streets are deserted And the streets deserted."

prakrit: "ण तरिज्जइ घरमणिकिरणजालपडिरुद्धतिमिरणिअरम्मि,अहिसारिआहĩ आमुक्कमण्डणाहिं पि सञ्चरिउं"
english: "The rays of the lantern do not illuminate the house, Nor do they pierce the walls of the house."

prakrit: "साणूरथूहिआधअणिरन्तरन्तरिअतरणिकरणिअरे,परिसेसिआअवत्तं गम्मइ सङ्गीअविलआहिं"
english: "Silly girl, You're the only one who can get away with this!" her friends whispered in unison.

prakrit: "सरसावराहपरिकुविअकामिणीमाणमोहलम्पिक्कं,कलअण्ठिउलं चिअ कुणइ जत्थ दोच्चं पिआण सआ"
english: "Silly girl, When you cross each other's paths It's as if you're crossing paths." ""

prakrit: "णिद्दअरअरहसकिलन्तकामिणीसेअजललवुप्फुसणा,पिज्जन्ति जत्थ णासञ्जलीहि उज्जाणगन्धवहा"
english: "The fragrance of fresh water drips from the woman's breasts Where the scent of nectar disappears."

prakrit: "घरसिरपसुत्तकामिणिकवोलसङ्कन्तससिअलावलअं,हंसेहि अहिलसिज्जइ मुणालसद्धालुएहि जहिं"
english: "In the house full of crows Lying motionless on the veranda, Laughing wildly, She sits astride the plowman's son."

prakrit: "मरहट्ठिआ पओहरहलिद्दपरिपिञ्जरम्बुवाहीए,धुव्वन्ति जत्थ गोलाणईए तद्दिअसिअं पावं"
english: "The feet of the martyr wash with the lotuses of the lotus, Like the petals of a yellow lotus."

prakrit: "अह णवर तत्थ दोसो जं गिम्हपओसमल्लिआमोओ,अणुणअसुहाĩ माणंसिणीण भोत्तुं चिअ ण देइ"
english: "Oh! the fault lies with me then, Mother - in - law, For not bothering so much with a woman whose face is smeared with ghee As with the pleasure of making love."

prakrit: "अह णवर तत्थ दोसो जं फलिहसिलायलम्मि तरुणीण,मयणवियारा दीसन्ति बाहिरठिएहि वि जणेहिं"
english: "Ah, the fault lies with that plump young woman. Even when she's outside Her clothes are showing." ""

prakrit: "अह णवर तत्थ दोसो जं विअसिअकुसुमरेणुपडलेण,मइलिज्जन्ति समीरणवसेण घरचित्तभित्तीओ"
english: "Ah, the fault of that young man Which, like a bunch of cucumbers Slipping from the house's attic, Goes to the street." ""

prakrit: "तत्थेरिसम्मि णअरे णीसेसगुणावगूहिअसरीरो,भुवणपवित्थरिअजसो राआ सालाहणो णाम"
english: "Praise be to Ra, whose name is derived from the fact that at that time he had no other qualities." ""

prakrit: "जो सो अविग्गहो वि हु सव्वङ्गावअवसुन्दरो सुहओ,दुद्दंसणो वि लोआणँ लोअणाणन्दसञ्जणणो"
english: "One who is uneducated is beautiful in all respects, And one who sees misfortune is a delight to the world."

prakrit: "कुवई वि वल्लहो पणइआण तह णअवरो वि साहसिओ,परलोअभीरुओ वि हु वीरेक्करसो तह च्चेअ"
english: "Anyone can be brave, Even a coward is brave, But a brave person is brave even when he is not."

prakrit: "सूरो वि ण सत्तासो सोमो वि कलङ्कवज्जिओ णिच्चं,भोई वि ण दोजीहो तुङ्गो वि समीवदिण्णफलो"
english: "The sun has no power, The moon has no blemish, The sky is black, And the sky is blue. Even the south wind does not blow."

prakrit: "बहुलन्तदिणेसु ससि व्व जेण वोच्छिण्णमण्डलणिवेसो,ठविओ तणुअत्तणदुक्खलक्खिओ रिउअणो सव्वो"
english: "A lot of people think that flowers bloom every day, That flowers bloom in the middle of the night, That people wither under the weight of sweat And tears."

prakrit: "णिअतेअपसाहिअमण्डलस्स ससिणो व्व जस्स लोएण,अक्कन्तजअस्स जए पट्ठी ण परेण सच्चविआ"
english: "A man who is content with his position in the world, Who is unable to follow the path of righteousness, Is a man of truth."

prakrit: "ओसहिसिहापिसङ्गाण वोलिआ गिरिगुहासु रअणीओ,जस्स पयावाणलकन्तिकवलिआणं पिव रिऊणं"
english: "The women of the mountain range sitting astride the elephant - faced sanctum sanctorum, Whom the cunning hunter's tailor must have made his wife drink."

prakrit: "आलिहिअइ जो वम्महणिभेण णिअवासभवणभित्तीसु,लडहविलआहĩ णहमणिकिरणारुणिअग्गहत्थेहिं"
english: "Alas for that woman Who, with her bare breasts, Held the walls of a palatial mansion In thrall to the arrows of the God of Love."

prakrit: "हिअए च्चेअ विलाअन्ति सुइरपरिचिन्तिआ वि सुकईण,जेण विणा दुहिआण व मणोरहा कव्वविणिवेसा"
english: "Well done, my dear, Even on the thought of going to bed you will be fine, For without you I would not have passed away Having spent so much time in penance."

prakrit: "इअ तस्स महापुहईसरस्स इच्छापहुत्तविहवस्स,कुसुमसराउहदूओ व्व आगओ सुअणु महुमासो"
english: "This is the summer solstice." "That was the wish of one of his great lovers: The rainy season was like a fire burning with kusuma flowers."

prakrit: "पत्थाणं पढमागअमलआणिलपिसुणिअं वसन्तस्स,बहुलच्छलन्तकोइलरवेण साहन्ति व वणाइं"
english: "Spring is like a lotus Placed on the surface of a leaf, Like the tendrils of a coil Rolled through many a leaf"

prakrit: "गहिऊण चूयमञ्जरि कीरो परिभमइ पत्तलाहत्थो,ओसरसु सिसिरणरवइ पुहई लद्धा वसन्तेण"
english: "A swarm of crickets, Like a flock of mice, Swirls across a leafy expanse, Like water dripping from a sesame seed."

prakrit: "मउलन्तमउलिएसुं विअसिअविअसन्तकुसुमणिवहेसु,सरिसं चिअ ठवइ पअं वणेसु लच्छी वसन्तस्स"
english: "Bees follow the dry and fragrant flowers of the jasmine, They persist throughout the year But rarely do they find their way into the spring."

prakrit: "बहुएहि मि किं परिवड्ढिएहĩ बाणेहĩ कुसुमचावस्स,एक्केणं चिअ चूअङ्कुरेण कज्जं ण पज्जत्तं"
english: "Daughter - in - law, why are you bothering? It's just a bunch of chickpeas. There's nothing you can do About it." ""

prakrit: "घिप्पइ कणअमअं पिव पसाहणं जणिअतिलअसोहेण,अब्भहिअजणिअसोहं कणिआरवणं वसन्तेण"
english: "If you want to taste the fresh nectar You'd better take a bath in the water First, then drink it, Then enjoy it with your eyes closed."

english: "Aunt, Even if I fall asleep on the road It's impossible for me to walk again." ""

prakrit: "न य भिच्चा नेह करी न य तुरया नेय पोट्टिसो मन्ती,विजयाणन्दस्स कहं कह जाया एरिसावत्था"
english: "There is neither begging nor drinking, No trumpeting nor bowing. How can one describe the joys of victory?"

prakrit: "भणिअं भट्टकुमारेण देव विसमा जअम्मि कज्जगई,मण्णे तहावि एसो केण वि कज्जेण सम्पत्तो"
english: "They said," "Because the God of Love has become so busy, Wealthiness vanishes from our hearts." ""

prakrit: "परिवड्ढिअपहुसम्भावणाण एवंविहे महाकज्जे,असमत्तपेसणाणं मरणं चिअ सहइ पुरिसाण"
english: "A man's love is great, Like true love, Endures death, Like unquenchable passion."

prakrit: "ता जइ कहावि एसो सिंहलराआहि परिहवं पत्तो,ता एत्थ तुम्ह दारे णूणं णल्लिअइ जीअन्तो"
english: "So, if this lioness finds a way to escape, you'd better nail it to the door." ""

prakrit: "अह सो च्चिअ जोइक्खो णिअकज्जगईए किं विआरेण,आणेह मा विलम्बह दीसउ ता से मुहच्छाआ"
english: "Oh! what a waste of time it has been, my dear! So do not delay in showing him your face."

prakrit: "तो तक्खणराआणत्तदारवालाणुमग्गसंलग्गो,सच्चविओ कुघडन्तुत्तमङ्गकमलो णरिन्देण"
english: "So tell me, you stubborn bowman, How can a lotus blossom from a true woman's womb?"

prakrit: "समइच्छिऊण सुन्दरि आणत्तं से सुहासणं पहुणा,उवविट्ठो भट्टकुमारिलस्स पअपेसिअच्छिजुओ"
english: "When the girl's breasts meet, Lovely girl, Get ready to embrace your lover." ""

prakrit: "अह तत्थ सुहासणकअपरिग्गहो णिज्जणं विहेऊण,खणमेत्तसमासत्थो सच्छरिअं पुच्छिओ पहुणा"
english: "Ah! there you are, sniffing the scent of fresh acacia flowers, Stretching out your nose for a moment, Asking the honest questions that spring to mind."

prakrit: "हंहो तुह विजआणन्द एत्थ एवंविहं समागमणं,णीसेसजुत्तिरहिअं अहियं हिअअं म्ह दूमेइ"
english: "Yes, your victory is here, And my victory is at hand. The arrows of the God of Love rest on me And I on him."

prakrit: "तो अणुअम्पाणुगअं वअणं णिअसामिणो सुणेऊण,परिओसवसविसट्टन्तलोअणं तेण विण्णत्तं"
english: "So listen up, you fool, To what I am about to say: There must be something on his mind Going on in the neighborhood."

prakrit: "देव महन्ती खु कहा एसा सुमणोरहाण सम्भूई,कोऊहलेण सीसइ अवहिअहिअआ णिसामेह"
english: "How can such a thing be said of a God of Love? It is impossible for anyone to conceal his true nature."

prakrit: "मलआअलाहिवे वसिकअम्मि समिअम्मि पण्डिराअम्मि,पारद्धे रअणाअरपरपारुत्तारपरिअम्मे"
english: "Malayalis live in our neighbourhood, Pandira in our village, Pardes in our town, And Paravatar in our neighborhood."

prakrit: "भणिअं अमच्चसिरिपोट्टिसेण मा ता करेह परिअम्मं,सहस त्ति दण्डसज्झो ण होइ अम्हं सिलामेहो"
english: "Tell me, Don't be so hasty. Please, my dear, do something about it. But don't punish me for it: I'm in a hurry." ""

prakrit: "सामण्णो वि ण तीरइ दुग्गत्थो जोहिउं परभडेहिं,सो उण विहि सम्पुण्णो सूरो चाई सुभिच्चो अ"
english: "The poor man is unable to bear the pain Of being hunted down By others, So he has to make do with everything he has."

prakrit: "जुत्तिण्णुओ सहम्मो अहिएहĩ अलङ्घिओ महामाणी,मन्तुच्छाहपहाणो दुक्खं जोहिज्जइ परेहिं"
english: "Friend, I beg of you, Your Majesty, It is the sorrow of longing That should trouble others."

prakrit: "णअविक्कमोवहोज्जा सव्वाण वि पत्थिवाण एस मही,ण उणेक्कविक्कमरसा हवन्ति सिरिभाइणो पुरिसा"
english: "A gentleman is not so much a traveler as a man who travels widely, Not so much by himself As by Siribhai's wife."

prakrit: "ता सामणए सन्ते सन्ते पुरिसाण भेअविण्णाणे,दाणे वि सम्पडन्ते को दण्डे आअरं कुणइ"
english: "A man who is content in what he has to offer Disproportionately annoys men. Even a generous giver Is condemned to penance."

prakrit: "जं जह कमेण भणिअं पुव्वाअरिएहĩ अत्थसत्थेहिं,तं तह पडिवज्जन्ता सिरीए पुरिसा वरिज्जन्ति"
english: "The more a woman says, The thinner become her husband's penance; In the same way, men get away with falsehoods."

prakrit: "ता पेसिज्जउ दूओ सामेक्कालावमुहलपत्तट्ठो,परहिअअभावकुसलो दच्छो कालण्णुओ धीरो"
english: "So be patient: Wait till the time you see him face to face, But be patient while he acts on your feelings." ""

prakrit: "जइ सो तेणं चिअ उअणमेइ ता साह किं पआसेण,वाआए जो विवज्जइ विसेण किं तस्स दिण्णेण"
english: "If that be the case, tell me, What do you hope to gain by it? But what will you gain by your parting words?"

prakrit: "णिसुअं च मए जह तस्स सअलजिअलोअसारसम्भूआ,लीलावइ त्ति णामेण पिअसुआ जीविअब्भहिआ"
english: "Calm down, my dear, As long as I keep my senses, My life is enlivened by the name Leelavai."

prakrit: "तिस्सा सुजम्मदिअहे केण वि असरीरिआए वाआए,देवेण समाइट्ठं सिट्ठं देवण्णुएहिं पि"
english: "It's a good day, Somebody said something nasty, But the gods took it all in stride." ""

prakrit: "जह जो इमीए वरबालिआए होही वरो त्ति वरसमए,सो सअलपुहइणाहो लहिही दिव्वाउ सिद्धीओ"
english: "Whatever women wear, Whatever men wear, When it comes to bearing children, It's the perfection of a decent woman."

prakrit: "ता जइ कहावि सो अम्ह सामिणो तं कुमारिआरअणं,उवणेइ ता ण सिद्धं किं वा एत्थ म्ह पुहवीए"
english: "So whatever you say, That's my husband calling you by the virgin's name. What do you mean he's not ready? Or is it just me?" ""

prakrit: "अण्णं च एत्थ एवंविहाण रअणाण भाअणोम्ह पहू,इअ जाणिऊण सामं तेण समं बहुमअं अम्ह"
english: "Here and now, my dear, Let us settle on one accord, For I know that with him and her We have much in common."

prakrit: "तं तह सोऊण मए अमच्चसिरिपोट्टिसाहि णीसेसं,भणिअं अलं म्ह दूएण ता सअं चेअ वच्चामो"
english: "He said," "I am so sleepy Because I cannot sleep." "To his wife's annoyance I replied:" "It is because he does not know how to sleep" ""

prakrit: "सो जेण मज्झ दंसणसिणेहसम्भावणापरिग्गहिओ,देइ च्चिअ मह पहुणो तं णिअअकुमारिआरअणं"
english: "So, if someone tries to touch me, Please, give that feeling to the girl who reached out to me"

prakrit: "भणिअं पुणो वि सिरिपोट्टिसेण एवंविहम्मि कज्जम्मि,ण विरुज्झइ तुह गमणं सिङ्घलदीवाहिवाहुत्तं"
english: "I said," "Siripottisena, please, don't go away. Your going away will not spoil my marriage." ""

prakrit: "अह एवं बहुसो मन्तिऊण गोसम्मि णिअअकडआओ,सञ्चलिओ परमेसर परिमिअपरिवारपरिअरिओ"
english: "Oh! so many people think That my husband is gone, And my other wives are gone. Please, my lord, don't trouble the whole family."

prakrit: "तो तं सिरिकुलभवणं महुमहवासं दिसावहूणिलअं,भुवणपरिहाणिबद्धं व साअरं झत्ति सम्पत्तो"
english: "So the landowner's son, Who dwelt in the thicket of bees, Saw his wife sitting on the lotus leaf, And looked around for a glimpse of her."

prakrit: "पडिछन्दं पिव गअणङ्गणस्स वसुहावरोहसिचअं व,रिद्धिं व महापलअस्य जम्मभूमिं व भुवणाण"
english: "The plowman's field is strewn with reeds, The banks of the Goda are broad, The plain is heavily wooded And the ground is grass - grown."

prakrit: "दट्ठुं तम अम्बुरासिं णरवइ परिचिन्तअम्हि हिअएण,दुक्खुत्तारो एसो जह भणिओ पोट्टिसेण म्ह"
english: "When he sees you He is afraid of your anger, And when he sees me I am afraid of my enemies."

prakrit: "दीसइ पडुपवणुग्गअपडिरवपडिपुण्णदसदिसाअक्को,हल्लन्तुव्वेल्लमहल्ललहरिमालाउलोल्लोलो"
english: "The plowman's daughter is growing taller by the day, The banks of the river are brimful of flowers, And the valleys are bustling with water."

prakrit: "णिन्तच्छरो वि रामाणुलङ्घिओ णिव्विसो वि विसमइओ,करितुरअवज्जिओ वि हु पडिरक्खियमहिहरुग्घाओ"
english: "Even a poor man embraces Rama, But a miser hates him, Even a virtuous husband despises his wife."

prakrit: "असुरो वि सआ मत्तो मत्तो वि अमुक्कणिअअमज्जाओ,मज्जाअसण्ठिओ वि हु विरसो वि सवाणिओ च्चेअ"
english: "The asura is drunken, the drunkard is indifferent, The traveler is angry, And the wife is suspicious."

prakrit: "साहेइ जम्मि अज्ज वि पअडो पवअवइसाहसुप्फालो,महिमण्डलग्गहत्थो व्व रामचरिआĩ सेउवहो"
english: "Friend, even today my husband has fallen at my feet. May the arrows of the God of Love rest on his glorified hand."

prakrit: "दीसन्ति सिरिसुवासहररइअकुसुमोवआरसारिच्छा,वेलावणवीइविइण्णरअणघडिआ तडुच्छङ्गा"
english: "The days are fleeting, The nights long, The cucumbers springing, And the grasshoppers hovering above them."

prakrit: "अज्ज वि तडविअसिअसुरहिकुसुमसन्दोहवासिआसेहĩ,वारुणिविणिग्गमो केसरेहĩ साहिज्जए जम्मि"
english: "Even today," whispered the farmer, "The summer nights are long, And I can't get enough of his hair."

prakrit: "लक्खिज्जइ अज्ज वि गुञ्जिरालिउलवलअवाउललएहिं,महणुत्तिण्णेरावणमग्गो सत्तच्छअतरूहिं"
english: "Look! Even to this day I hear whispers of thunder and lightning, Like the rays of a rainbow Moving through the sky."

prakrit: "सेविज्जइ सरसोहंसकणइभवणेसु सिद्धमिहुणेहिं,जम्मि लवङ्गेलावणपरिमलपरिवासिओ पवणो"
english: "In a perfect town, Wherever you live, There must be plenty of fresh water to drink And where there is plenty of it, There is plenty to eat"

prakrit: "तत्थ सुरासुरसिरमउडकोडिपरिहट्टपाअवीढङ्कं,रामेसरं णमेऊण जाणवत्तं समारूढो"
english: "Then come the pleasures of love, Loud with the beating of drums, Like dancing to the tune of Rameswaram."

prakrit: "अकुलीणे वि सुअम्मे चलणविहूणे वि दच्छपअगमणे,बहुगुणमए वि लहुए णीरप्पणए वि बहुसङ्गे"
english: "Though lonely, Though walking in harmony, Though visible, Though manifold, Though dominated by love, Though abundant in gifts."

prakrit: "तो परिमिअपरिवारो आरूढो एरिसम्मि बोहित्थे,जा लङ्घिमो ण उअहिं ता णरवइ एक्कसरिआए"
english: "So the rest of the family went on making love. But if I don't take it in my stride, It will scare the hell out of me."

prakrit: "उम्मूलन्तो थलतरुवणाĩ आसामुहाĩ पूरन्तो,सङ्खोहन्तो दीवन्तराĩ उद्धाइओ पवणो"
english: "When the moon is full, The south wind blows, When the sky is dark, The wind stirs."

prakrit: "तो सो तुङ्गअराणिलसङ्खोहिअजलपणुल्लणुल्लसिओ,पुव्वोवहि सम्पत्तो गोलासरिसङ्गमं पोओ"
english: "So you go to the Golasar Sangam with your wealth strewn all over the place." ""

prakrit: "तत्थ वि विसमसिलाअडसञ्चुण्णिअसन्धिबन्धणो सहसा,सअखण्ड विसङ्घडिओ असमञ्जसकज्जबन्धो व्व"
english: "Even then the dissonant bondage is sudden, Like the uneven bondage of a fragmentary fragment."

prakrit: "भिण्णम्मि तम्मि पोए सव्वेहĩ वि जाणवत्तिएहĩ अहं,एक्कफलए णिसण्णो गोलामुहदारमुवणीओ"
english: "Everyone knows that I am what I am, except for the girl with the round face."

prakrit: "तत्थ लवणम्बुणिब्भरसोत्तुव्वत्तन्तविम्हलङ्गेण,ते जाणवत्तिआ पुच्छिअ म्हि साहेह को कत्थ"
english: "That brimstone Slipped from my hand And fell at my feet, So how can I help it?" she asked.

prakrit: "सिट्ठं च तेहĩ णरवइ अहोमुहत्थं विसण्णवअणेहिं,तं तुम्ह परिअणं भट्टउत्त कालेण परिगिलिअं"
english: "There she is, Stretching her face in the dark, Dismayed at the thought of your absence. Time has proved her worth." ""

prakrit: "किं कीरइ हअदेव्वाहि जेण तुम्हंविहा वि सप्पुरिसा,पावन्ति अहम्मजणोइआĩ वसणाĩ संसारे"
english: "What kind of a god is this Who, even though He loves you so much, Can find a place in the world That isn't his?"

prakrit: "ता वच्च सरीरधणाण होन्ति सुलहा पुणो वि सव्विहवा,तं जह झीणो वि ससी पावइ तं चेअ चिररिद्धिं"
english: "Then the body will heal, And all will be well again. But the thinner, thinner the body, The longer it will last."

prakrit: "एवं णरणाह णिसामिऊण तडिवडणदूसहं वअणं,कहकह वि मए मच्चूमुहाहि विणिअत्तिओ अप्पा"
english: "And behold, I will never forget how, when I speak to you with a clenched fist, You proved utterly useless."

prakrit: "परिचिन्तिअं हि णो ते सहाइणो णेअ ईहिअं कज्जं,ण अ सो णिअवक्खेवो ण सामिसम्भावणा ण जसो"
english: "Friendship is not a favor, It's a duty, Nor is it a virtue, Not to be compared with kindness."

prakrit: "ण तहा पहाणपरिअणविणासदुक्खं पि दूमए हिअअं,जह हिअअसमीहिअकज्जणिप्फलो मह समारम्भो"
english: "I will not make you suffer the same as I did when I tried to conceal my feelings from you."

prakrit: "पहुपेसणपत्तट्ठा पारद्धणिरालसेक्कणिव्वहणा,परितुलिउव्वूढभरा अण्णे च्चिअ के वि ते पुरिसा"
english: "The husband is so full of affection That he does not want to see his wife again, Despite the fact that she is completely naked."

prakrit: "अम्हारिसेहĩ कत्तो णअपोरिसबुद्धिदेव्वरहिएहिं,सिज्झन्ति महीवइणो एद्दहमेत्ताĩ कज्जाइं"
english: "What makes you think I'm so stupid? You stupid god, You stupid bee, That's my fault." ""

prakrit: "परिभाविऊण तह वि हु संसारसुहासुहाĩ णिअहिअए,बहु मण्णिअम्हि बोहित्थिएहĩ जं तं समुल्लविअं"
english: "Though I may perish, I take pleasure in the pleasures of this world; Much of what I possess Has already been absorbed by it."

prakrit: "कुग्गामकाहिलाहĩ वि उवएसो आवईसु को लहइ,बुड्डन्ताण तणाĩ वि हत्थवलम्बत्तणमुवेन्ति"
english: "Even an elephant in a hut Curses a woman in such a way That, even with its hands clasped, It twines itself around her breast."

prakrit: "ता गन्तूण सकडअं पुणो वि अण्णेहĩ णिअसहाएहिं,पारद्धकज्जणिव्वहणणिच्छए सज्जिमो अप्पा"
english: "Can't you see I'm off again?" he whispered. "My dear, I've got to get ready to go."

prakrit: "एवं विच्छूढविसाअणिच्चलं णिअमिऊण णिअहिअअं,सञ्चलिओ बोहित्थिअवअणुवइट्ठेण मग्गेण"
english: "And the scorpion peeped through the gaping hole:" "Stop, stop, stop!" "It was as if it had been hit by a bolt of lightning."

prakrit: "एलावणलवलिलवङ्गपरिमलालिद्धपाअवणिउञ्जं,परिलङ्घिऊण जलणिहिकूलासण्णं वणुद्देसं"
english: "Like the flame of a flame, Like a panorama of emeralds rising from the sky, Like the rays of a waterfall, A rainbow opens on the forest floor."

prakrit: "गिरिणो दिणपरिणइसमअपिञ्जराअवपसङ्गपिङ्गङ्गा,पेरन्ततरुवणन्तरिअकणअरूअ व्व दीसन्ति"

english: "Ah, what a foolish thing it is to fall in love with a woman whose face is smeared with red ghee. Without her husband I have no life."
