prakrit: "जस्स विलग्गन्ति णहंफुड-पडिसद्दा दिसा-अल-पडिक्खलिआ,जोण्हा-कल्लोला विअससि-धवलासु रअणीसु हसिअ-च्छेआ"
english: "Jus vilaganti naham phud - padisadda disa - al - padikhaliya, junha - kallola vyasasi - Dhavalasa queens laugh - sigh." ""

prakrit: "णट्टारम्भ-क्खुहिआजस्स भउब्भन्त-मच्छ-पहअ-जल-रआ,होन्ति सलिलुद्धुमाइअ-धूमाअन्त-वडवा-मुहा मअरहरा"
english: "The start of the fire - The flames rising from the fire, The mosquitoes hovering, The water running, The husks closing, The smoke rising - The wadwa - The mouth of the peacock."

prakrit: "अहिणव-राआरद्धाचुक्क-क्खलिएसु विहडिअ-परिट्ठविआ,मेत्ति व्व पमुह-रसिआणिव्वोढुं होइ दुक्करं कव्व-कहा"
english: "Non - violence - The arrows of the God of Love - Wrapped round the head of the hunter's wife, Like a poor cow in distress When her husband is abroad And her lover is abroad."

prakrit: "परिवड्ढइ विण्णाणंसंभाविज्जइ जसो विढप्पन्ति गुणा,सुव्वइ सुउरिस-चरिअंकिं तं जेण ण हरन्ति कव्वालावा"
english: "One can imagine a heavenly state Only when one has acquired the qualities one craves For, Like a good poem on poetry One cannot escape embarrassment."

prakrit: "इच्छाइ व धणरिद्धीजोव्वण-लद्ध व्व आहिआईअ सिरी,दुक्खं संभाविज्जइबन्धच्छाआइ अहिणवा अत्थ-गई"
english: "Like a young man armed with wealth and desire, Siri has come, Like a bond made of misery and chance, And like a non - existent object."

prakrit: "तं तिअस-बन्दि-मोक्खंसमत्थ-तेल्लोक्क-हिअअ-सल्लुद्धरणं,सुणह अणुराअ-इण्हंसीआ-दुक्ख-क्खअं दहमुहस्स वहं"
english: "There he is - a prisoner, a liberator, a teller, a healer - Listen to him, listen to him - Compassion - Suffering - With an angry expression There he gives vent to his anger."

prakrit: "अह पडिवण्ण-विरोहेराहव-वम्मह-सरेण माणब्भहिए,विद्धाइ वालि-हिअएराअ-सिरीअ अहिसारिए सुग्गीवे"
english: "Oh! the poor man - Viroherahaava - Varmaha - The whole of humanity is captivated by it, The sage - Hiera - Siri - The generous ones rejoice." ""

prakrit: "ववसाअ-रइ-पओसोरोस-गइन्द-दिढ-सिङ्खला-पडिबन्धो,कह कह वि दासरहिणोजअ-केसरि-पइजरो गओ घण-समओ"
english: "Vavasa - rai - Pausoras - Gaind - Stare - Seal - Friend, How can a servant help his wife - Saffron - Poison - Gone is the hour!"

prakrit: "गमिआ कलम्ब-वाआदिट्ठं मेहन्धआरिअं गअण-अलं,सहिओ गज्जिअ-सद्दोतह वि हु से णत्थि जीविए आसङ्घो"
english: "Gone are the kalambas - The sound of the wind has made them fragrant, And I hope my life endures, Despite the thunder and lightning."

prakrit: "तो हरि-वइ-जस-वन्थोराहव-जीअस्स पढम-हत्थालम्बो,सीआ-बाह-विहाओदहमुह-वज्झ-दिअहो उवगओ सरओ"
english: "So, Hari - Vai - jas - Vanthorahava - jis - padhama - handshake, siya - va - viha - mouthful - vajja - The day has come." ""

prakrit: "रइ-अर-केसर-णिवहंसोहइ धवलब्भ-दल-सहस्स-परिगअं,महुमह-दंसण-जोग्गंपिआमहुप्पत्ति-पङ्कअं व णह-अलं"
english: "The rays of the sun - red and saffron - yellow and white, The drums - red, the drums - white, the bees - darting - Yellow, the lotuses - Yellow and orange."

prakrit: "दिणमणि-मोह-प्फुरिअंगलिअं घण-लच्छि-रअण-रसणा-दामं,उदु-मअण-बाण-वत्तंणह-मन्दार-णव-केसरं इन्द-धणुं"
english: "Deer - Fettered by infatuation, Fingers thick with affection, Lashes long and wide, Lips broad and prominent, Bow - arrow - bow - arrows long and sharp, Temple - nine - Saffron is the weapon of the senses."

prakrit: "धुअ-मेह-महुअराओघण-समआअड्ढिओणअ-विमुक्काओ,णह-पाअव-साहाओणिअअ-ट्ठाणं व पडिगआउ दिसाओ"
english: "Look at the smoke, The bees, The howling wind, The midday breeze, The rivers, The streams, The banks, The valleys."

prakrit: "अहिणव-णिद्धालोआउद्देसासार-दीसमाण-जल-लवा,णिम्माअ-मज्जण-सुहादर-वसुआअ-च्छविं वहन्ति व दिअहा"
english: "Non - human beings - The midday sun, the midday moon, the water, the flame, The fire, the nectar, the fragrance, The grass - The flowers they carry - Are the rays of the sun."

prakrit: "सुह-संमाणिअ-णिद्दोविरहालुङ्खिअ-समुद्द-दिण्णुक्कण्ठो,असुवन्तो वि विवुद्धोपढम-विउद्ध-सिरि-सेविओ महुमहणो"
english: "Blessed are the meek, For though they seem to be sighing, They look on silently, For even when they are speechless They sigh loudly."

prakrit: "सोहइ विसुद्ध-किरणोगअण-समुद्दम्मि रअणि-वेला-लग्गो,तारा-मुत्ता-वअरोफुड-विहडिअ-मेह-सिप्पि-संपुड-मुक्को"
english: "Blessed are the wise - The rays of the sun, The ocean, The creeper, The lotus, The star, the pearl, The acacia, The courtyard, The meh, The sesame field, The pond, And the lotus."

prakrit: "सत्तच्छआण गन्धोलग्गइ खलइ हिअए कलम्बामोओ,कलहंसाण कल-रओठाइ ण संठाइ परिणअं सिहि-विरुअं"
english: "One can smell the fragrance of jasmine flowers, One can hear the rustle of acacia flowers, But silence does not bring happiness."

prakrit: "पीण-पओहर-लग्गंदिसाण पवसन्त-जलअ-समअ-विइण्णं,सोहग्ग-पढम-इण्हंपव्वाअइ सरस-णह-वअं इन्द-धणुं"
english: "Drink, wail, cling to the lamp - Spring, water, summer, spring, autumn, autumn - The arrows of the God of Love blossom - The bow of the moon - And the arrow of the god of Love."

prakrit: "पज्जत्त-सलिल-धोएदूरालोक्कन्त-णिम्मले गअण-अले,अच्चासण्णं व ठिअंविमुक्क-पर-भाअ-पाअडं ससि-बिम्बं"
english: "Lying flat - Slippery - Washing - Drenched - Wretched - Going - Alley, Standing - Facing - But still - The image of a banyan tree."

prakrit: "चिर-आल-पडिणिअत्तंदिसासु घोलन्त-कुमुअ-रअ-वेल्लविअं,भमइ अलद्धासाअंकमलाअर-दंसणूसुअं हंस-उलं"
english: "Long - eyed woman, The days are fleeting, The watermelons are swollen, The jasmine is hovering, And the lotuses are twining." ""

prakrit: "चन्दाअव-धवलाओफुरन्त-दिअस-रअणन्तरिअ-सोहाओ,सोम्मे सरअस्स उरेमोत्तावलि-विब्भमं वहन्ति णिसाओ"
english: "The moon - white, swollen - red, red, spotless - beautiful, full of fresh nectar - Like a banner proclaiming the victory of good over evil."

prakrit: "भमर-रुअ-दिण्ण-सण्णंघण-रोह-विमुक्क-दिणअर-अरालिद्धं,फरिस-सुहाअन्तं मिवपडिवुज्झइ जल-णिहित्त-णालं णलिणम"
english: "Bees - cry, Din - sniffles, frowns, sighs, moans, groans, twanges, twists, and turns." ""

prakrit: "वम्मह-धणु-णिग्घोसोकमल-वण-क्खलिअ-लच्छि-णेउर-सद्दो,सुव्वइ कलहंस-रओमहुअरि-वाहित्त-णलिणि-पडिसंलाओ"
english: "Worm - rich - poor - decrepit - forest - bare - lacquered - rough - mud - Every one stirs - Tears - streams - reeds - Sandstorms."

prakrit: "खुडिउप्पइअ-मुणालंदट्ठूण पिअं व सिढिल-वलअं णलिणिं,महुअरि-महुरुल्लावंमहुमअ-अम्बं मुहं व घेप्पइ कमलं"
english: "Aunt, A lotus grows on the lotus of my mouth, Like the nail mark on my hip And the nail marks on my cheek."

prakrit: "पज्जत्त-कमल-गन्धोमहु-तण्णाओसरन्त-णव-कुमुअ-रओ,भमिर-भमरोअइव्वोसञ्चरइ स-दाण-सीभरो वण-वाओ"
english: "Spring - The lotus - The fragrance - The scent - The grass - The nectar - The cucumber - The cry - The swarm of bees - The bee - The snake - The whole forest - The wind."

prakrit: "कण्टइअ-णूमिअङ्गीथोअ-त्थोओसरन्त-मुद्ध-सहावा,रइ-अर-चुम्बिज्जन्तंण णिअत्तेइ णलिणी मुहं मिव कमलं"
english: "Look! The lotus is sticking to my face, Like a string of pearls Stirred by the touch of a kiss."

prakrit: "परिघोलन्त-क्खलिअंसत्तच्छअ-कुसुम-धवल-रेणुक्खइअं,उप्पुसइ दाण-वङ्कंमुहुत्त-गअ-कण्ण-चामरं भमर-उलं"
english: "Drenched - with gooseflesh, Yellow - with fragrant flowers, Red - with salty grains, Banga - with prickly pearls, Go - with eyes - A swarm of bees."

prakrit: "इअ पहसिअ-कुमुअ-सरेभडि-मुह-पङ्कअ-विरुद्ध-चन्दालोए,जाए फुरन्त-तारेलच्छि-सअंगाह-णव-पओसे सरए"
english: "This is the path of the full moon - Pumpkin - Surrounded by bees - Mouth - Pankha - Opposite - Chandaloos, Which runs quickly - With twigs - Thighs - New - Poison."

prakrit: "झिज्जइ झीणा वि तणूअट्ठिअ-बाहं पुणो परुण्णं व मुहं,रामस्स अईसन्तेआसा-बन्धे व्व चिर-गए हणुमन्ते"
english: "Tears were still running down his cheeks, His face like a parrot's pail, And his arms like gooseflesh behind his back." ""

prakrit: "णवरि अ जहा-समत्थिअ-णिव्वत्तिअ-कज्ज-णिव्वलन्त-च्छाअं,पेच्छइ मारुअ-तणअंमणोरहं चेअ चिन्तिअ-सुहोवणअं"
english: "A novice sees what is normal, What is mundane, What does one do when one is busy making ends meet, And thinks how pleasant it is to be afflicted with illness."

prakrit: "पढमं चिअ मारुइणाहरिस-भरिज्जन्त-लोअणेण मुहेण,जणअ-तणआ-पउत्तीपच्छा वाआइ णिरवसेसं सिट्ठा"
english: "First you hit me with the nail of your eye, Then with the bow of your hand I kissed your cheek, And then with the tongue of my husband's wife." ""

prakrit: "दिट्ठ त्ति ण सद्दहिअंझीण त्ति सबाह-मन्थरं णीससिअं,सोअइ तुमं त्ति रुण्णंपहुणा जिअइ त्ति मारुई उवऊढो"
english: "Don't look at me, my darling, For all the time I've spent thinking about you, You always make me cry, And keep me alive By beating me to death."

prakrit: "चिन्ता-हअ-प्पहं मिवतं च करे खेअ-णीसहं व णिसण्णं,वेणी-बन्धण-मइलंसोअ-किलिन्तं व से पणामेइ मणिं"
english: "Worry - yes, I'll do it again. Take it all in stride: The braid, the bracelets, the nail marks, And the pearl necklace."

prakrit: "सो कर-अलञ्जलि-गओबाह-त्थवअ-पहओसिहन्त-मऊहो,णअणेहि दासरहिणादिट्ठो पीओ णु पुच्छिओ णु पउत्तिं"
english: "So do - Alanjali, Gaobah, Tathava, Pahavas, Sihanta, Mauho, Do drink wine from the hand of another slave Who asks you a question?"

prakrit: "सोअइ अ णं रहुवईविरलङ्गुलि-गलिअ-किरण-धारा-वअरं,वअणे विमलुज्जोअंदर रोत्तूण सलिलञ्जलिं व णिमेन्तो"
english: "Fallen asleep, Long - limp - street - rays - stream - wind, Vimalujjo's brother - in - law crying out loud." ""

prakrit: "तं दइआहिण्णाणंजम्मि वि अङ्गम्मि राहवेण ण णिमिअं,सीआ-परिमट्ठेण ववूढो तेण वि णिरन्तरं रोमञ्चो"
english: "Because he shows no mercy, Not even in my presence Can I find rest, Not in his absence Can I attain rest, But in his wretchedness."

prakrit: "बाह-मइलं पि तो सेदहमुह-चिन्ता-विअम्भमाणामरिसं,जाअं दुक्खालोअंजरढाअन्त-रवि-मण्डलं मिव वअणं"
english: "Bah - milam pe toh seedha muh - thought - delusion manmarisam, jaane dukkha laalo anjaradha - Ravi - Mandalay mein waane."

prakrit: "तो से चिर-मज्झत्थेकुविअ-कअन्त-भुमआ-लआ-पडिरूए,दिट्ठी दिट्ठ-त्थामेकज्ज-धुर व्व णिअए धणुम्मि णिसण्णा"
english: "So long - suffering! Aunt, The earth is flattered by the lotus. But how lucky am I to have seen it with my own eyes!"

prakrit: "खण मूलावद्धाएणिव्वण्णन्त-मसिणं समारूढाए,सज्जीअं मिव जाअंअणोणमन्तं पि राम-दिट्ठीअ धणुं"
english: "Though shackled to the ground The hunter's hunter-gatherer has reached his goal, But even as he is about to set sail The warrior's eye remains on Rama." ""

prakrit: "सुग्गीअस्स वि हिअअंराहव-सुकअ-पडिमोअणा-सत्तण्हं,अगणिअ-दहमुह-दप्पंणिव्वूढ-भरं व तक्खणं ऊससिअं"
english: "Even the well - to - doer's wife shows no remorse:" "She is so full of grief, So full of anger, So thin and thin." ""

prakrit: "चिन्तिअ-लद्धत्थं मिवभुमआ-विक्खेव-सूइआमरिस-रसं,गमणं राहव-हिअएरक्खस-जीविअ-हरं विसं व णिहित्तं"
english: "Thinking - laddu means earth - fragrance - poison - needles - juices, walking - path - arrows - creatures - Every poison is poison - nihilism."

prakrit: "सोह व्व लक्खण-मुहंवण-माल व्व विअडं हरि-वइस्स उरं,कित्ति व्व पवण-तणअंआण व्व बलाइ से विलग्गइ दिट्ठी"
english: "Like a lotus, Like a garland of jewels, Like an emerald tree in bloom, Like the apple of someone's eye Destroyed by stress and strain."

prakrit: "संखोहिअ-महि-वेढोतो सो कइ-सेण्ण-विलुलिअ-वणाहोओ,खुहिअ-समुद्दाहिमुहोमहणारम्भम्मि मन्दरो विअ चलिओ"
english: "Where is the snake - The buffalo - The stag - The doe - The crows - The wild goose - In the temple at the beginning of the great fire Facing the sea?"

prakrit: "चलिअं च वाणर-बलंचलिए तम्मि चल-केसर-सडुज्जोअं,गहिअ-दिसा-परिणाहंमऊह-जालं व दिणअरस्स फुरन्तं"
english: "Let's go - The banyan - With the twigs - Saffron - Decomposed on it, The flowers - The days - The fruit - The trees - The nets - And the days are fleeting."

prakrit: "वेरारणि-पज्जलिओतो सो रोस-पवणाहउद्धअ-मुहलो,वड्ढइ मग्गाणुगओलङ्का-वण-राइ-वण-दओ कइ-लोओ"
english: "The poor girl is bursting at the seams, Waking up in the middle of the night To find out what it is to be angry and demanding: A flock of peacock's tail feathers, A forest of parrots And a forest of crows."

prakrit: "वच्चइ अ चडुल-केसर-सडुज्जलालोअ-वाणर-परिक्खित्तो,सव्व-दिसा-आअड्ढिअ-पलअ-पलित्त-गिरि-संकुलो व्व समुद्दो"
english: "A flock of parrots, a flock of water - Saffron, red girdle, a weeper - A bird's eye view, A whole day of bees - Plumes of nectar - A complex of emeralds - Like the ocean."

prakrit: "घोलन्ति णिम्मलाओफुरन्त-दिअसअर-पाअडिअ-रूआओ,दाविअ-मग्गम्मि वि सेहिअए सोअन्धआरिअम्मि दिसाओ"
english: "Melt the lotus - The flowers are swollen - The days are long - The leaves are drooping - The same is the case with the midday sun."

prakrit: "आलोएइ अ विञ्झंधणु-संटःआणस्स साअरस्स भर-सहं,सन्धिअ-णइ-सोत्त-सरंअवहोवास-घडिअं व जीआ-बन्धं"
english: "The light is like a flood of nectar: The fire is swollen, The water is red, The stream is salty, The storm is torrential, The hour is fleeting And life is bound to it."

prakrit: "मसिणिअ-सिहरुच्छङ्गोविहुअ-णिअम्ब-वण-पाअडिअ-तुङ्ग-अडो,विञ्झेण भरिअ-कुहरोहेला-वाओ वि वाणराण ण सहिओ"
english: "Proud woman, A swarm of gnats, A flock of parrots, A forest of peacocks, A tree of reeds, A field of crickets, A thicket of bees - Even the sound of a horn Can't be endured."

prakrit: "पत्ता अ सीभराहअ-धाउ-सिला-अल-णिसण्ण-राइअ-जलअं,सज्झं ओज्झर-पहसिअ-दरि-मुह-णिक्कन्त-वउल-मइरामोअं"
english: "Leaf and pollen - Dhou, Sila, Al-Nisna, Rai, Jalayun, Sajjhar, Pahasi, Dari, Mukha, Nikant, Wole, Moiraman."

prakrit: "बोलन्ति अ पेच्छन्तापडिमा-संकन्त-धवल-घण-संघाए,फुड-फडिह-सिला-सङ्कुल-खलिओवरि-पत्थिए विअ णइ-प्पवहे"
english: "They speak with the pitch of an eyelid, Speak with a shrill voice, Swirl with a thunderclap, Play with food, Fiddle with a kite, Complex with flowers, Flicker with a nail - The paths are endless."

prakrit: "तड-पब्भार-भरन्तादलन्त-पाआल-गलिअ-जल-पइरिक्का,आवाए च्चिअ जाआपहअ-महा-वह-णिहा महा-णइ-सोत्ता"
english: "The pond is overflowing with water, The river is swollen, The paths are slippery, The streets are muddy, The rivers are swelling, And the streams are overflowing."

prakrit: "जलहर-णिद्दाअन्तंपाअव-गहणेसु सिसिर-णिद्दाअन्तं,सइ दुद्दिण-सामलअंपत्ता भग्ग-धुअ-चन्दण-रसा मलअं"
english: "Wet - smeared - Sandal - juicy jasmine, Sweat - salted - Slippery - red, Sly - milky - smooth - Scorched - red." ""

prakrit: "चन्दण-पाअव-लग्गेखुडिउव्वेलिअ-लआ-परिमल-च्छाए,सन्दाणिअ-णिम्मोएपेच्छन्ति महा-भुअङ्ग-वेढण-मग्गे"
english: "Sandal - Waved - Placed on the head - Yellow - Layered on the body - Parimal - Touched - Sandalwood - Wrapped - Painted on the forehead - Eyes wide open."

prakrit: "सेवन्ति तीर-वड्ढिअ-णिअअ-भरोव्वत्त-चन्दण-लआलिद्धे,रम्म-त्तण-दिप्प-वहेवण-गअ-दाण-कडुए गिरि-णइ-प्पवहे"
english: "They shoot arrows, grow large, weigh heavily, carry sandalwood logs, make kisses, and scrape the surface of the rafters."

prakrit: "तो तरुण-सिप्पि-संपुड-दर-दाविअ-जल-णिहित्त-मुत्ता-वअरं,पत्ता पत्तल-वउलंगअ-दाण-सुगन्धि-रअ-णवेलं वेलं"
english: "So youth - Slipper - Powder - Dye - Water - Sweat - Bees - Yellow, leaf - Leaf - Woolang - Grain - Fragrance - Red - A new vine."

prakrit: "विअसिअ-तमाल-णीलंपुणो पुणो चल-तरङ्ग-कर-परिमट्ठं,फुल्लेला-वण-सुरहिंउअहि-गइन्दस्स दाण-लेहं व ठिअं"
english: "The busy - tamarind - blue - eyed woman walks about - waves - curls - circles - swells - trees - shoots - gooseflesh - grains - leaves - still."

prakrit: "फेण-विसमङ्गराअंविद्दुम-दन्त-व्वणाणिअ-मुह-च्छाअं,मलिअ-वण-केस-कुसुमंपरिहुत्त-समुद्द-परिमलं व वहन्तिं"
english: "Foam - Vismayangara, Ornament - Tooth - Toes - To mouth - To cheeks - To garland - To forest - To hair - To safflower shoots - To the sea - To perfumes."

prakrit: "सिप्पि-उड-मउलिअच्छिंलआ-हरब्भन्तरेसु परिवड्ढन्तं,अणुराअ-परिट्ठविअंआअण्णन्तिं व किंणरुग्गीअ-रवं"
english: "Slipper - flying - Bees hovering ominously All over the place, Tears streaming down one's face At the sound of the trumpet."

prakrit: "इअ सिरि-पवरसेण-विरइए दहमुहवहे महाकव्वे पढुमो आसासओ समत्तो"
english: "O silence - Without a trace of anger - The great poem I am about to read Brings hope."

prakrit: "अह पेच्छइ रहु-तणओचडुलं दोस-सअ-दुक्ख-बोलेअव्वं,अमअ-रस-सार-गरुअंकज्जारम्भस्स जोव्वणं व समुद्दं"
english: "Oh! look! There goes the tension, The anger, The bitterness, The talk, The savor, The essence - The youth and the sea at the start of the rainy season."

prakrit: "गअणस्स व पडिविम्बंधरणीअ व णिग्गमं दिसाण व णिलअं,भुअणस्स व मणि-तडिमंपलअस्स व सावसेस-जल-विच्छड्डं"
english: "Consciousness, Wrapped in shackles, Visible to the naked eye, Is like a crystal goblet, Like a bucket of water between two conch shells."

prakrit: "भमिरुब्भड-कल्लोलंथोर-कराहअ-दिसा-मुहोत्थअ-सलिलं,सासअ-मएण बहुसोखोहिज्जन्तं दिसा-गएण व ससिणा"
english: "A swarm of bees - Stirring the lotus - Sighs, moans, sighs and groans; Mother - in - law shares my joys But the day passes - Singing and sighing"

prakrit: "अप्फुण्ण-विद्दुम-वणेगुप्पन्त-पडित्थिरे सलिल-कल्लोले,मन्दर-गूढ-प्पहरेअज्ज वि संखाअ-लोहिए व्व वहन्तम"
english: "Aplenty - Viddum - Vanguppant - Padithiray Salil - Kallolay, Mandar - Esoteric - Prakrit - Even today people think that iron is poisonous."

prakrit: "मुहल-घण-विप्पइण्णंजल-णिवहं भरिअ-सअल-णह-महि-विवरं,णइ-मुह-पल्हत्थन्तंअप्पाण-विणिग्गअं जसं व पिअन्तं"
english: "Fill your heart with water, With lotuses, Sweat, lotuses and lotuses... Just like water in a pan."

prakrit: "जोण्हाए व्व मिअङ्कंकित्तीअ व सुउरिसं पहाए व्व रविं,सेलं महा-णईअ वसिरीअ चिर-णिग्गआइ वि अमुच्चन्तं"
english: "Long - eyed woman, Like a doe in a swarm of bees, Like the rays of the sun On the horizon, She walks briskly Through the night But is unable to come to terms with it."

prakrit: "कालन्तर-जीअ-हरंगओणिअत्तन्त-पवण-घट्टिज्जन्तं,सल्लं व देह-लग्गंविअडं वडवा-मुहाणलं वहमाणम"
english: "Time after time, Life after death, Steady wind, Winds of passage, Sound and body after body: The mouth of the Vadava Is like a flood of water."

prakrit: "धुअ-वण-राइ-कर-अलंमलअ-महिन्द-त्थणोर-सोल्लण-सुहिअं,वेलालिङ्गण-मुक्कंछिविओसरिएहि वेलवन्तं व महिं"
english: "Smoke - The forest - The rice - The trees - The shrubs - The flowers - The jasmine - The sweetwood - The creeper - The bee - Like the creeper twisted around its beak."

prakrit: "ठाणे वि ठिइ-पहुत्तंपलए महि-मण्डलम्मि वि अमाअन्तं,पणअन्त-वामण-तणुंकमन्त-देह-भर-भरिअ-लोअं व हरिं"
english: "Even then, Mother - in - law, Though the mandalam be endless, Yet, on the other hand, Vamana - Exhausted - Fills the body With blood And greenery."

prakrit: "दीसन्तं अहिरामंसुव्वन्तं पि अविइण्ह-सोअव्व-गुणं,सुकअस्स व परिणामंउअहुज्जन्तं पि सासअ-सुह-प्फलअं"
english: "From day to day, From longing to pleasure, From pleasure to result, From love to pleasure."

prakrit: "उक्खअ-दुमं व सेलंहिम-हअ-कमलाअरं व लच्छि-विमुक्कं,पीअ-मइरं व चसअंबहुल-पओसं व मुद्ध-चन्द-विरहिअं"
english: "Look - the lotus, The lotus is red, The jasmine is pink, The pearl is yellow, The gooseflesh is white, The moon is pale, And the clouds are empty."

prakrit: "णिप्फण्ण-सुहालोअंविमल-जलब्भन्तर-ट्ठिअं वहमाणं,दर-कड्ढिअं व रइणाकरावलम्बिअ-करं रअण-संघाअं"
english: "Like a good tree, Like a spring of water, Like an abundance of nectar, Like the flour that has been squeezed out of it By the rays of the sun, It falls into disrepair."

prakrit: "महणाआस-विमुक्कंउच्छित्तामअ-विसङ्खलाणल-णिवहं,वासुइ-मुह-णीसन्दंवडवा-मुह-कुहर-पुञ्जिअं वहमाणं"
english: "Great sage - Vimukkam, towering above the sky - Water flowing through the gaps, Spring - face - Spring - clouds - mouth - mist - Capital - Vahaman." ""

prakrit: "धीरं व जल-समूहंतिमि-णिवहं मिव सपक्ख-पव्वअ-लोअं,णइ-सोत्ते व्व तरङ्गेरअणाइ व गरुअ-गुण-सआइ वहन्तं"
english: "Patience and multitude of waters - I am like a river, With streams of water and streams of fire and water, Like the waves of a lake."

prakrit: "पाआलोअर-गहिरेमहि-पइरिक्क-विअडे णह-णिरालम्बे,तेल्लोक्के व्व महुमहंअप्पाण च्चिअ गआगआइ करेन्तं"
english: "The path is slippery - deep, winding - wide, with streams of water running through it - Like oil spilled on a beehive As if it were the mouth of a snake."

prakrit: "अहिलीअ परमुहीहिंछिविओसरिएहि अणुसअ-विलोलाहिं,अणुणिज्जमाण-मग्गंवेवन्त-णिअत्त-पत्थिआहि णईहिं"
english: "Ahilye, I bow before you With my face to the sky, With my arms wrapped around my face, And with my back to the street."

prakrit: "जीअ-गरुईहि अज्ज विइच्छा-पज्जत्त-सुह-रसाहि मएन्तं,धण-रिद्धीअ सिरीअ असलिलुप्पण्णाइ वारुणीअ अ लोलं"
english: "Life is hard for me Today, Desperate for pleasure, Tired of being weighed down And weighed down by the arrows of the God of Love"

prakrit: "चडुलं पि थिईअ थिरंतिअसुक्खित्त-रअणं पि सारब्भहिअं,महिअं पि अणोलुग्गंअसाउ-सलिलं पि अमअ-रस-णीसन्दं"
english: "Aunt, There must be something very special about the trip: The pleasure of walking, The essence of the journey, And the pleasure of tasting wine."

prakrit: "पज्जत्त-रअण-गब्भेणह-अरु-पल्हत्थ-चन्द-अर-पारोहे,उअरब्भन्तर-सेलेसुरवइ-डिम्ब-णिहिए णिहि व्व वहन्तं"
english: "Pajjatta - the rain - The womb - the arrow - The palahtha - The moon - The arrows - The urabhantara - The celestial sun - The egg - The river flows through it."

prakrit: "परिअम्भिअं उवगएबोलीणम्मि अ णिअत्त-चडुल-सहावं,णव-जोव्वणे व्व कामंदइअ-समागम-सुहम्मि चन्दुज्जोए"
english: "Love, youth, Friendship, Blessed be the first day of spring, Like the pleasant moonlit nights."

prakrit: "दर-फुडिअ-सिप्पि-संपुड-पलोट्ट-सङ्ख-मुह-भरिअ-मुत्ता-णिअरं,मारुअ-दूरुच्छालिअ-जल-भरिअद्ध-वह-पडिणिअत्त-जलहरं"
english: "Foolish girl, Sip - Slipper - Sump - Pluck - Milk - Mouth - Fill - Fist - Young woman, Beat - Far - reaching girl, Fill with water - She's already married - Water - Jallahar."

prakrit: "मरगअ-मणि-प्पहाहअ-हरिआअन्त-जरढ-प्पवाल-किसलअं,सुर-गअ-गन्धुद्धाइअ-करि-मअरासण्ण-दिण्ण-मेह-मुह-वडं"
english: "Marga - Mani - Papahā - Hariyanta - Jardha - Papawala - Kislāṇa, Sur - Gā - Gandhudhaiya - Kari - Marasana - Din - Meh - Muh - Vāda"

prakrit: "मणिवालअं तीर-लआ-हर-प्पहोहासिअ-रम्म-णिवालअं,घण-वारिअं वेलालिङ्गणेण चडुलं महि-लङ्घण-वारिअं"
english: "Money - wearing bow - wearing necklaces, Laughing all the time, Waving the bow - waving the bull, Flying the bull - dragging the bull on its back."

prakrit: "ससि-मऊह-पडिपेल्लण-पक्खुब्भन्तअंसंचरन्त-धरणीहर-पक्खुब्भन्तअं,धीरअं सइ मुहल-घण-पअ-विज्जन्तअंअट्ठिअं च वलवाणल-पअविज्जन्तअं"
english: "A sapling, A beehive, A flock of parrots, Birds hovering and hovering, The landowner's bird, A patient man's bow, A thicket of palms, And a flock of geese sitting side by side."

prakrit: "णिअअ-विसाणल-पअविअ-मुत्ता-णिअर-परिघोलमाण-विसहरं,मीण-गइ-मग्ग-पाअड-सेआलोमइल-मणि-सिला-संघाअं"
english: "Women - Vissanals - Bees - pearls - nymphs - Circumstances - Trees of plenty, Pisces - minnows - mugs - pawns - apple - pearl - kite - confederacy."

prakrit: "सरि-संकुलं महुमह-वल्लहाइ लच्छीअ सार-सरिसं कुलं,महि-लाइअं णइ-मुह-पत्थिओणिअत्तिअ-वेला-महिलाइअं"
english: "Suri - the whole complex of bees - Lovely lotuses, Saras - the entire family, Mahi - the line of bees, Nai - the mouth - The line of leaves, And Vela - the women."

prakrit: "णइ-सहस्स-पडिउम्बण-णाअ-रसन्तअंपलअ-मेह-सम-दूसह-णाअ-रसन्तअं,पेलवेण पवणेण महुर-संचारिअंमउअ-मअ-खलन्तं व महु-रसं चारिअं"
english: "Love - Friendship - Love - Compassion - Contentment - Compliance - Love, Equality, Adversity - Contention, Love - Traveler, Mother - Conspiracy, Contempt - All four are the fruit of the bee."

prakrit: "कसण-मणि-च्छाआ-रस-रज्जन्तोवरि-परिप्पवन्त-प्फेणं,हरि-णाहि-पङ्कअ-क्खलिअ-सेस-णीसास-जणिअ-विअडावत्तं"
english: "Compassion - Money - Love - Taste - Lust - Trying - Fettering, Greenery - Weeping - Tears - Sweating - Sighs - Anger - Jealousy - Vindication."

prakrit: "सअरङ्गअं विद्दुम-पल्लव-प्पहा-घोलिर-सासअ-रङ्गअं,रवि-राइअं धरणि-अलं व मन्दराअड्ढण-दूर-विराइअं"
english: "The whole proscenium - the pallavas, the phalluses, the gholirs, the mother - in - law, the ranganas, the ravinas, the shrines, the alamas, and the temples, far and wide."

prakrit: "मुत्तालअं तिअस-विइण्ण-जीविअ-सुहामअ-जम्मुत्तालअं,वित्थिण्णअं पलउव्वेल्ल-सलिल-हेला-मलिउव्वि-त्थिण्णअं"
english: "Muttalan tias - Vindhya - Jiva - Suhaam - Jammuttalan, Vithinan paluvella - Salil - Hela - Maliuvvi - Thathinyan"

prakrit: "चिर-परूढ-सेआल-सिला-हरिअन्तअंपवण-भिण्ण-रव-दारुण-णीहरिअन्तअं,महुमहस्स णिद्दा-समए वीसाम-अंपलइ-डड्ढ-विज्झाअ-तलुव्वी-सामअं"
english: "The long - hunted - The teak - The kite - The greenery - The grass - The trees - The thickets - The shrubs - The bees - The nectar - The weasel - The amulet - The wood - The wisdom - The palm - The fire - The face - The lotus - The whole lotus."

prakrit: "असुरोवडण-विहट्टिअ-जल-विवरुट्ठिअ-रसाअलुम्हा-णिवहं,महण-वस-भिण्ण-भामिअ-दीवन्तर-लग्ग-मन्दर-अड-क्खण्डं"
english: "Asurvadana - The courtyard - The water - The fountains - The streams - The rivers - The great waters - The forest - The valleys - The diurnes - The logs - The temple - The ad - khandam."

prakrit: "एस अमअ-रस-संभवो त्ति संभाविअंणह-णिहं तमेण व चउद्दिसं भाविअं,गुण-महग्घ-सारं वसुहा-रक्खाणिअंणिअअ-जस-णिहाणं मिव सअर-क्खाणिअं"
english: "This nectar - Taste - Possible, This possibility - Not mine, not yours - Is a fourteenth future, Virtuous - Expensive - Everything is Vasuha - Protective - Just as I had with my first husband."

prakrit: "पवणुग्गाहिअ-जल-लव-णिवह-पहम्मन्त-मुहल-तीर-तल-वणं,ससि-सेल-मऊहोज्झर-परिवड्ढिअ-सलिल-मलिअ-पुलिणुच्छङ्गं"
english: "The wind blows, The water loves, The rivers flow, The clouds hover, The arrows shoot, The forest teems, The trees sway, The fountains twine, The shrubs sway, And the flowers twine."

prakrit: "मन्दर-मेह-क्खोहिअ-ससि-कलहंस-परिमुक्क-सलिलुच्छङ्गं,मरगअ-सेवालोवरि-णिसण्ण-तुण्हिक्क-मीण-चक्काअ-जुअं"
english: "Temple - Meh - Khohi - Plants - Trees - Staircases - Parimukkas - Decorated lawns, Margas - Servitors - Water - Sweat - Thighs - Pisces - Wheel - Lice"

prakrit: "पुण्ण-णइ-सोत्त-संणिह-जल-मज्झ-मुणिज्जमाण-चलिअ-तिमि-वहं,वलआ-मुह-मूल-समोसरन्त-मसि-रासि-कज्जलिअ-पाआलं"
english: "Pun - nai - fountain - spring - water - midday - early morning - walk - whale - stream, swallow - mouth - root - tingle - ink - raasi - kajjali - pearl"

prakrit: "तो उग्घाडिअ-मूलोपवअ-बलक्कन्त-महि-अलुद्धुच्छलिओ,दिट्ठीअ दिट्ठ-सारोणज्जइ तुलिओ त्ति राहवेण समुद्दो"
english: "So the grasshopper - Rooted, stunted, buffalo - Drunken, staring - Bowed, bowed - Her gaze fixed on Rahven's sea." ""

prakrit: "कालन्तर-परिहुत्तंदट्ठूण वि अप्पणो महोअहि-सअणं,जणअ-सुआ-बद्ध-मणोरामो पलअ-घरिणिं ण संभरइ सिरिं"
english: "After a long time, Though exhausted with love, I can't remember what it was like to be at home."

prakrit: "ईसि-जल-पेसिअच्छंविहसन्त-विइण्ण-पवअ-वइ-संलावं,अद्दिट्ठे व्व ण मुक्कंदिट्ठे उअहिम्मि लक्खणेण वि धीरं"
english: "Like water, Like passion, Like seed, Like wine, Like water in a pan, Like a banner proclaiming victory, Like the seal of victory, This man is patient even when he shows it."

prakrit: "हरिस-णिराउण्णामिअ-पीणअरालोअ-पाअडोवरिभाअं,पवआहिवो-वि पेक्खइअद्धुप्पइअं व रुम्भिऊण सरीरं"
english: "The deer - Niraunamiya - Drunken people - On the other side of the fence, Travelers - Even the blind man Can see Through the mud And kisses her body."

prakrit: "गरुडेण व जलण-णिहंसमुद्द-लङ्घण-मणेण वाणर-वइणा,अवहोवास-पसरिअंपक्ख-विआणं व पुलइअं कइ-सेण्णं"
english: "Like the burning bush, Like the flicker of a horn, Like a banner proclaiming the victory of righteousness, So too does the arrow point to God's direction."

prakrit: "साअर-दंसण-हित्थाअक्खित्तोसरिअ-वेवमाण-सरीरा,सहसा लिहिअ व्व ठिआणिप्फन्द-णिराअ-लोअणा कइ-णिवहा"
english: "Suddenly the words began to ring," "Love - bite - hit - tear" "And suddenly the words seemed to stop - Love - Where did they come from?"

prakrit: "पेच्छन्ताण समुद्दंचडुलो वि अउव्व-विम्हअ-रस-त्थिमिओ,हणुमन्तम्मि णिवडिओसगारवं वाणराण लोअण-णिवहो"
english: "Aunt, Even the churning of the ocean Makes a waterfall - Vimha, Ras, Thymi, Like a flood of nectar Dripping down from the moon - The rivers of the world are drained."

prakrit: "उअहिं अलङ्घणिज्जंदट्ठूण गआगअं च मारुअ-तणअं,मोहन्धआरिएसु विगूढो भमइ हिअएसु सिं उच्छाहो"
english: "Behold, the elephant has been torn to shreds And beaten to death; The lioness has been blown to smithereens By the trembling bee"

prakrit: "तो ताण हअ-च्छाअंणिच्चल-लोअण-सिहं पउत्थ-पआवं,आलेक्ख-पईवाण वणिअअं पइइ-चडुलत्तणं पि विअलिअं"
english: "So stretch, stretch, pull, pull - The lion is at hand and at the foot, The elephant is leaping, The hunter is standing, And the traveler is climbing."

prakrit: "कह वि ठवेन्ति पवङ्गासमुद्द-दंसण-विसाअ-विमुहिज्जन्तं,गलिअ-गमणाणुराअंपडिवन्थ-णिअत्त-लोअणं अप्पाणं"
english: "One cannot help but stare at one's face, One's breasts, Eyes, nose, and ears." ""

prakrit: "इअ सिरि-पवरसेण-विरइए कालिदास-कए दहमुहवहे महाकव्वे बिइओ आसासओ परिसमत्तो"
english: "This is the great poem of Kalidasa - Without a trace of pride The great poet has exhausted all hope."

prakrit: "तो ते कइ-माअङ्गेरूढ-विसाअ-मअ-भाविओमीलन्ते,आलाण-क्खम्भेसु वबाहूसु सिला-अल-ट्ठिएसु णिसण्णे"
english: "So where did they meet - Mother - Angry - Wretched - Proud - Silly - Sitting motionless?" ""

prakrit: "आहासइ सुग्गीओणिअअ-रवाहि फुड-णिन्त-जस-णिग्घोसम,धीराहि सार-गरुअंदन्तुज्जोआहि णिम्मलत्थं वअणम"
english: "With sighs and groans and moans, With long pauses, With trembling lips, With twanges and grindings, With bowels as thin as jasmine."

prakrit: "धरणि-धरणे भुअ च्चिअमहणम्मि सुरासुरा खअम्मि समुद्दा,हन्तव्वम्मि दहमुहेएण्हिं तुम्हे त्थ महुमहस्स सहाआ"
english: "Sitting on the riverbank Thinking how pleasant it is to walk on it, For the scorching heat of summer Has made you in such a state Of ecstasy."

prakrit: "मा सासअ-सोडीरंकह वि णिअत्तन्त-समुह-संठविअ-पअं,आअअ-वित्थक्कन्तंपणअन्तं व सुअणं परुम्हाह जसं"
english: "No mother - in - law - No relatives - No groups - No friends, Just silence and silence As one would expect from a gentleman."

prakrit: "रक्खस-वह-दुव्वोज्झोकज्जारम्भो समुद्द-लङ्घण-गरुओ,पढुमं चिअ रहुवइणाउवरिं हिअअ-तुलिओ भरो व्व विलइओ"
english: "The rakshasa - That - the start of a storm - Is like the ocean, dragging on and on. I will wait till the water recedes, Then pick it up and throw it away."

prakrit: "तुम्ह च्चिअ एस भरोआणा-मेत्त-प्फलो पहुत्तण-सद्दो,अरुणो छाआ-वहणोविसअं विअसन्ति अप्पणा कमल-सरा"
english: "You fool, My lovely girl, The lotus is overflowing with love, And Arun is busy dressing his wife In the shade Of the lotus."

prakrit: "तरिउं ण हु णवर इमंवेला-वण-वउल-कुसुम-वासिअ-सुरहिं,हत्थ-उडेहि समत्थातुम्हे पाउं पि फल-रसं व समुद्दं"
english: "I am not a novice, So are the jasmine, the weeper, the cucumber, the doe, The shrew, The water lily, The fruit fly, And the sea, Though I find it with my bare hands."

prakrit: "चिर-आल-कङ्खिआणंधुआवमाण-णिअलुण्णमन्त-सुहाणं,एसो णवर अवसरोअसरिस-समसीस-बन्धण-विमोक्खाणं"
english: "Long - eyed - The pleasures of love, Like a good night's sleep, Are an inexhaustible supply of fresh air - Time and again - Tying the knot - Liberation."

prakrit: "ते विरला सप्पुरिसाजे अभणन्ता घडेन्ति कज्जालावे,थोअ च्चिअ ते वि दुमाजे अमुणिअ-कुसुम-णिग्गमा देन्ति फलं"
english: "They produce a myriad of delicious juicy fruits, But when they are ripe they give no fruit at all."

prakrit: "खिण्णं चावम्मि करंचिर-आलुक्कण्ठिअं अमरिसम्मि मणं,मा दा देउ रहुवईबाणाहिमुहिं च बाह-गरुइं दिट्ठिं"
english: "Aunt, You're not supposed to kiss my cheek - The mango twigs are immortal - Your eyes are already fixed on my face."

prakrit: "ओवग्गउ तुम्ह जसोदहवअण-पआव-पत्थिव-परिग्गहिअं,विलुलिअ-समुद्द-रसणंणह-भवणन्तेउरं दिसा-वहु-णिवहं"
english: "Go ahead, you fool, Like the elephant in the forest, Moving around on foot, Moving across the sea, Running around in circles, Saying:" "Daughter - in - law!" ""

prakrit: "जं साहसं ण कोरइतं दअमाणेण जीविअं किर दइअं,जो अपडिमुक्क-सुकआसो वि गणिज्जइ जअम्मि जीअन्त-मुओ"
english: "One who does not dare to ask, How can one live on compassion? Even one who is completely free and happy Is counted as one who has finally lived."

prakrit: "किं व ण आणह एअंकज्जं परिपेलवं पि जह परिणामे,देइ परं संमोहंकुसुमं विस-पाअवस्स व मलिज्जन्तं"
english: "Why not give your feelings one day at a time, Even though they last a month? They last a year, Like the joys of love."

prakrit: "विहडन्तं पि समत्थाववसाअं पुरिस-दुग्गमं णेन्ति वहं,भुवणन्तर-विक्खम्भंदिअसअरो विहडिएक्क-चक्कं व रहं"
english: "They see the misery of men Who live in harmony with one another, In the confusion and confusion that follow, And in the confusion of one another."

prakrit: "कअ-कज्जे ताल-समेअइरा पेच्छह भुए अणुत्ताल-समे,णिहुओ राअस-हाओपडिवक्खस्स अ अवेउ राअ-सहाओ"
english: "Why, looking down the aisle at the thunderclap? It's like seeing a cloud of smoke rising up out of the sky, Like a flock of geese falling from the sky."

prakrit: "सङ्खोहिअ-मअरहरोसंभन्तुव्वत्त-दिट्ठ-रक्खस-लोओ,वेला-अड-मुज्झन्तेअह णे हसइ हिअएण मारुअ-तणओ"
english: "Be careful not to fall into the trap of laughing - The hunter's wife is so eager to catch a glimpse of the hunter That she shoots him dead While he is laughing loudly."

prakrit: "अव्वोच्छिण्ण-पसरिओअहिअं उद्धाइ फुरिअ-सूर-च्छाओ,उच्छाहो सुभडाणंविसम-क्खलिओ महा-णईण व सोत्तो"
english: "Loud beating of drums - Loud cheering, Loud crashing of trumpets - Like a great fire burning in the middle of the forest."

prakrit: "माणेण परिट्ठविआकुल-परिवाडि-घडिआ अणोणअ-उव्वा,चिन्तेउं पि ण तीरइओहुप्पन्ती परेण णिअअ-च्छाआ"
english: "What makes you think I'm pregnant?" he muttered, "You fool, don't look at me." She looked away in embarrassment But could not help laughing.

prakrit: "परिवड्ढन्तुच्छाहोविअलिअ-रण-मच्छरेहि अप्पत्त-गुणो,अअस-क्कन्तोसरिओकड्ढिज्जइ दुक्करं भडत्तण-सद्दो"
english: "The arrows of the God of Love travel through the sky, Like mosquitoes in a jungle, Like bees in a forest, Like crows in a thicket, Are hard to spot."

prakrit: "आहिअ-समराअमणावसणम्मि अ ऊसवे अ सम-राअ-मणा,अवसाअअ-विसमत्थाधीर च्चिअ होन्ति संसए वि समत्था"
english: "Ah, the arrows of the sky, The passage of the moon, And the passage of time - Love, jealousy, resentment - The whole world teems with them."

prakrit: "ववसाअ-सप्पिवासाकह ते हत्थ-ट्ठिअं ण पाहेन्ति जसं,जे जीविअ-सन्देहेविसं भुअङ्ग व्व उव्वमन्ति अमरिसं"
english: "Those who live by falsehood Do not see hands and feet as well as those who do, For such a being is as immortal As the suspicious limb."

prakrit: "सीहा सहन्ति बन्धंउक्खअ-दाढा चिरं धरेन्ति विसहरा,ण उण जिअन्ति पडिहआअक्खण्डिअ-ववसिआ खणं पि समत्था"
english: "Bees bear the brunt of it All the time - The beards stay on their feet Long enough to support them, But they don't live long enough."

prakrit: "अकअत्थ-पडिणिअत्ताकह समुहालोअ-मेत्त-पडिसंकन्तं,दप्पण-अलेसु व ठिअंणिअअं देच्छिह पिआ-मुहेसु विसाअं"
english: "Ungrateful people, Loving people, Friendly people, Steady people, Sitting idle And staring at one another - Such a waste of time."

prakrit: "णिज्जन्ति चिर-पअत्तासमुद्द-गहिरा वि पडिवहं णइ-सोत्ता,तीरेन्ति णिअत्तेउंअसमाणिअ-पेसणा ण उण सप्पुरिसा"
english: "She walks long and wide, Her face deep and expressive, Her hair hanging loose And her face hanging loose around her thighs."

prakrit: "जो लङ्घिज्जइ रइणाजो वि खविज्जइ खआणलेण वि बहुसो,कह सो उइअ-परिहओदुत्तारो त्ति पवआण भण्णउ उअही"
english: "One who is paralyzed by a limp, Who is embarrassed by one's absence, And who is offended by another's presence in the house, How can one help speaking plainly?"

prakrit: "चिन्तिज्जउ दाव इमंकुल-ववएस-क्खमं वहन्ताण जसं,लज्जाइ समुद्दस्स विदोण्ह वि किं होइ दुक्करं बोलेउं"
english: "Think about it, mother - in - law, How can I put it mildly When I'm embarrassed And embarrassed By what I have to say?"

prakrit: "किरणासणिं रहु-सुएसुहस्स किर णासणिं विमुञ्चउ मा दा,सेल-ससारअमे होतुम्हे जेऊण चन्द-सारअ-मेहो"
english: "Please, do not turn your back on me. For what pleasure is there in sleeping? It's just the moon And the clouds hovering around you."

prakrit: "बन्धव-णेहब्भहिओहोइ परो वि विणएण सेविज्जन्तो,किं उण कओवआरोणिक्कारण-णिद्ध-बन्धवो दासरही"
english: "Friend - in - law, Even a weaver's wife serves in a weaving factory. Why should a cow - eyed person Be a slave to one who is forced to weep?"

prakrit: "अइर-परूढ व्व लआसमरुच्छाहे उदुम्मि व विलम्बन्ते,अज्ज वि दाव मह इमामउलेइ च्चिअ फलं ण दावेइ सिरी"
english: "I am late in rising, Like a flock of parrots Struggling to climb a tree, But to-day I speak plainly, As if I had no more fruit."

prakrit: "केच्चिर-मेत्तं व ठिईएअ विसंवाइआ ण मोच्छिहि रामं,कमलम्मि समुप्पण्णातं चिअ रअणीसु किं ण मुञ्चइ लच्छी"
english: "Aunt, There is no escape from Rama's anger But only affection and affection. So why not ask the queen what she wants With all her heart?"

prakrit: "सअलुज्जोइअ-वसुहेसमत्थ-जिअ-लोअ-वित्थरन्त-पआवे,ठाइ ण चिरं रविम्मि वविहाण-पडिआ वि मइलदा सप्पुरिसे"
english: "The whole world is burning, The people are dying, The streets are empty, The rivers are overflowing, And the rivers are in spate."

prakrit: "सप्पुरिस-पाअड-वहंपढमं जं राहवेण अम्हासु-कअं,होज्ज व ण होज्ज व समंअम्हेहि कअं पि किं उण अकीरन्तं"
english: "Sapphurish - Paad - Vahampadam is what Rahaven asked us to do, To be what he is not And at the same time to be something we are not."

prakrit: "राहव-पत्थिज्जन्तोउद्धो दीसिहइ केच्चिरं व दहमुहो,दूरन्त-पेच्छिअव्वोसिहर-पडन्त-विअडासणि व्व वण-दुमो"
english: "The midday sun is rising high above the rakhas, The flames are fading, The forest is burning, The trees are withering, The roads are slipping, And the streets are deserted."

prakrit: "बालाअवं व एन्तंधुअ-अम्बालाअ-वंसु-णिवह-च्छाअं,कइ-सेण्णं रअणिअरातम-रअ-णिअर व्व पेच्छिउं पि अओग्गा"
english: "Like a child, Like a young bridegroom, Like an ambrosial wife, Like the breasts of a warrior's wife, I will never forget."

prakrit: "गरुअम्मि वि पडिवक्खेहोन्ति भडा अहिअ-वारिअ-प्पडिऊला,पडिगअ गन्धाइद्धाउद्धङ्कुस-रुद्ध-मन्थअ व्व गइन्दा"
english: "Even the poor girl's breasts Slippery, Like a bunch of peacock's tail feathers Waved by the hunter's wife, Slipping off as if by accident."

prakrit: "विसमम्मि वि अविसण्णोधारेइ धुरं धुरंधरो च्चिअ णवरं,किं दिणअरोवराएदिणस्स होइ अवलम्बणं ससि-बिम्बं"
english: "Even a poor woman can smell the smoke of fire, But staying awake all day long Doesn't make her thin."

prakrit: "मुक्क-सलिला जलहराअहिणव-दिण्ण-प्फला अ पाअव-णिवहा,लहुआ वि होन्ति गरुआसमर-मुहोहरिअ-मण्डलग्गा अ भुआ"
english: "Mukka - salila, jalhara,ahina, din, paphala, paava, nivaha, lahua, bhumi, hantey, garuasa, samara, muhoriya, mandalgama, bhuja." ""

prakrit: "दप्पं ण सहन्ति भुआपहरण-कज्ज-सुलहा धरेन्ति महिहरा,वित्थिण्णो गअण-वहोणिज्जइ कीस गरुअत्तणं पडिवक्खो"
english: "Mother - in - law can't bear to have her arms snatched - Why get angry? It's the wife's fault - She's so stubborn." ""

prakrit: "धीरं परिरक्खन्तागरुअं पि भरं धरेन्ति णवर सुउरिसा,ठाणं चिअ अमुअन्ताणीसेसं तिहुअणं खवेन्ति रवि-अरा"
english: "Be patient, Protect yourselves: Even the elders will bear with you The burdens of youth. But at the same time They will tear your heart apart Because of your immodesty."

prakrit: "काअर-पडिमुक्क-धुरंजिणन्ति पत्थाण-लङ्घिअग्ग-क्खन्धा,पढमं ता णिअअ-बलंपच्छा पहरेहि सुउरिसा पडिवक्खं"
english: "The cow - Feathered - Bees cover the road - Long - limp - Shoulder - To the girl on top of her - Strong - eyed girl Guarding the bower Of her bracelets"

prakrit: "अण्णेन्ति मङ्गलाइंअल्लिअइ सिरी जसो पवड्ढइ पुरओ,पडिवण्ण-रणुच्छाहेपडिवक्खुद्धरण-पत्थिअम्मि सुउरिसे"
english: "Dear lord, As soon as you touch my feet You will be missed - Like the rays of the moon in the sky, Like a banner proclaiming the joys of love"

prakrit: "वच्चन्ता अइभूमिंकड्ढिअ-सुहडासि-वत्त-वन्थावडिआ,णवर ण चलन्ति बीअंलुअ-वक्खा महिहर व्व वेरावन्धा"
english: "Vachanta ayabhumi nakadya - Suhdasi - Vattha - Vanthavadya, Navaratra does not move like a beehive - Vakada is like a verandah"

prakrit: "ता सोअइ रहु-तणओताव अ सीआ वि हत्थ-पल्हत्थ-मुही,ताव अ धरइ दहमुहोजाव विसाएण वो तुलिज्जइ धीरं"
english: "She sleeps in my arms, Tears come from her eyes, Sweats from her hands, Palms from her feet, Holds on to my breath, Makes me grow thin."

prakrit: "अण्णो अण्णस्स मणोतुम्ह ण आणे अणाहिओ मह अप्पा,णिव्वण्णन्तस्स इमंदर-रूढ-वण-प्पसाहणं हणुमन्तं"
english: "Dear friend, Your anger is not getting the better of me, my dear, It has only made your heart grow fonder." ""

prakrit: "पडिवक्खस्स अ लच्छिअं आसाएन्तएणंणिअअ-कुलस्स अ कित्तिअं आसाएन्तएणं,मरणं पि वरं लद्धअं णअ-णिम्माणएणंपुरिसेण चिरं जीविअं ण अ णिम्माणएणं"
english: "Life is transient, Death is fleeting, Destruction is inevitable, And immortality is inevitable."

prakrit: "एअ वि सिरीअ दिट्ठआ के सरलच्छिआएकर-कमलस्स अ छिक्कआ केसर-लच्छिआए,मुज्झन्ति सविण्णाणआ समर-समाणअम्मिएअ ममम्मि भणन्तए सम-रस-माणअम्मि"
english: "Even Siri's simple glances, Like the lotuses on a lotus And the saffron on a peacock's beak, Show me the subtleties of beauty In summer Time, Like my mother speaking with equal eloquence."

prakrit: "मा सोइज्जउ दुहिआ सीआ लोअएणंणलिणि व्व समोलुग्गआ सीआलोअएणं,दुहिए राहव-हिअए काम-इलन्तअम्मिजीविअम्मि अहिलोहिआ का मइलन्तअम्मि"
english: "Don't worry, my poor girl, It's only the rays of the sun That spoil the night sky: There's nothing left to do But to enjoy the pleasures of love."

prakrit: "चन्दअ व्व मेह-मइलिए रअणी-सारअम्मिकमलअम्मि व हिम-डड्ढए रअ-णीसारअम्मि,दुहिए राहव-हिअअए भम-रोअत्तअम्मिकुसुमम्मि व पव्वाअए भमरोअत्तअम्मि"
english: "The moon is like a lotus, The sky is red, The flowers are white, The snows are thick with frost, The bees sit astride the raptor, The rivers are swollen, And the crows are moaning."

prakrit: "कइआ णु विरह-विरइअ-दोब्बल्ल-पसाहणुज्झिआहरणाइं,णीसास-वस-पहोलिर-लम्बालअ-मलिअ-पम्हल-कओलाइं"
english: "How many people are there who are separated - separated - clinging to one another's necks, who live in the dark - behind one's back, who travel long distances - Mallis, stagflowers, cowboys?"

prakrit: "पिहुल-णिअम्ब-अल-क्खलिअ-सिढिल-वलअ-विवइण्ण-बाहु-लआइं,दच्छाम परिअण-त्थुअ-कअ-पेसण-लज्जिआ पिअ-कलत्ताइं"
english: "Pihu'l-nimb-al-khaliya-staircases-nails-doubles-arms-blades, Vindhya's relatives-trucks-lashes-shaming their husbands."

prakrit: "इअ जाहे भण्णन्तंण चलइ चिन्ता-भरोसिअन्त-सरीरं,आअड्ढण-णिच्चेट्ठंपङ्क-क्खुत्तं व गअ-उलं कइ-सेण्णं"
english: "Like the saying goes:" "Thoughts flow from one's heart to the next, Like clenched fists, Like arrows struck by lightning, Like an arrow pierced by lightning." ""

prakrit: "तो फुड-सद्दुद्धाइअ-वण-दव-भरिअ-गिरि-कन्दराआर-मुहो,रिउ-विक्कमम असहन्तोजम्पइ वाणर-वई पुणो वि हसन्तो"
english: "So the fowler - Straightforward - Forest - Deer - Filled - Gorgeous - Kandara - Face - Face, The wood - growler with unbearable fever - Venerable - Will smile again." ""

prakrit: "इअ अत्थिर-सामत्थेअण्णस्स वि परिअणम्मि को आसङ्घो,तत्थ वि णाम दहमुहोतस्स ठिओ एस पडिहडो मज्झ भुओ"
english: "At the same time I bow before my friends, And bow before those whom I detest." ""

prakrit: "अवहोआसम्मि महंहत्थ-अलाहअ-दलन्त-पत्थिअ-सलिलो,जा ण णिअत्तइ उअहीबोलीणं ताव होउ वाणर-सेण्णं"
english: "Ahoyasammi mahamanttha - alaha - dalanta - patthiya - salila, Jaan is not so much a matter of saying the words As of speaking them." ""

prakrit: "अहिआणं तोसि-हरेधरिअं मलअ-गिरिणो हसन्तो सिहरे,गुरु-भर-विसअंसेणंणेज्जामि भुएण जोअण-सअं सेणम"
english: "Ah, the lotus of your face - Green with a garland of garlands - Laughs loudly, Makes you tremble With excitement - I am ready for a fight with a young man"

prakrit: "समुह-मिलिएक्कमेक्केको इर आसण्ण-संसअम्मि सहाओ,जाव ण दिज्जइ दिट्ठीकाअव्वं दाव होइ चिर-णिव्वूढम"
english: "Team - One man for one day, One woman for all the rest of the world, Unless you are allowed to set eyes Even on one person For a long time."

prakrit: "अह व महण्णव-हुत्तंपत्थन्तस्स गअणं महं ण वहुत्तम,रुहिर-वसामिस-वत्तंहन्तूण व णिव्वुओ वसामि सवत्तम"
english: "Oh! it is not right for me to be angry When things go wrong. I will abide only by what is right and fair."

prakrit: "णिसुढिज्जन्त-भुअङ्गंमा मुज्झह मह सरोस-चलणक्कन्तम,जत्तो णमइ महि-अलंतत्तो णाम सअलो पअट्टउ उअही"
english: "Aunt, The path is smooth, My path is meandering, As long as I don't have to walk on water, My name is Salome."

prakrit: "ओ जमल-क्खम्भेहि वधरिएण भुएहि मह महोअहि-मज्झे"
english: "O earthworm, My heart overflows with anger."

prakrit: "उम्मूलिआइएणंसमइञ्छउ विञ्झ-संकमेण कइ-बलम"
english: "At the moment of embracing one's self, Which is weaker than the other?"

prakrit: "विवलाअन्त-भुअङ्गंउव्वत्तिअ-जलअरं विहिण्ण-महिहरम,मुह-मारुअ-विहुअ-जलंपेच्छह रअणाअरं करेमि थल-वहम"
english: "I will make the ground flow with the rays of the sun, With the waves crashing through my face, And with the waves washing over my face."

prakrit: "मज्झ-क्खुडिउम्मूलिअ-भुआ-भमाइअ-विमुक्क-सेसद्धन्तम,एत्तो-हुत्त-सुवेलंतत्तो-हुत्त-मलअं करेमि समुद्दम"
english: "Mother - in - law, Bees - buds - bees - beaks - goose pimples - sesquicentum, Here - hot - sweet - saliva - lotus - I will make the whole sea."

prakrit: "अह व सुवेलालग्गंपेच्छह अज्जेअ भग्ग-रक्खस-विडवम,सीआ-किसलअ-सेसंमज्झ भुआअड्ढिअं लअं मिव लङ्कम"
english: "Ah, the fragrance of a fragrant lotus Lying on my forehead Like a garland of jewels, Protecting me from the arrows of the God of Love."

prakrit: "ओ भग्ग-रक्खस-दुमंणिहअ-दसाणण-मइन्द-सुह-संचारम,रामाणुराअ-मत्तोमलेमि लङ्कं वण-त्थलिं व वण-गओ"
english: "O God of Love, Protection, Destruction, Mind, Bliss, Transmission, Ramanuara, Intoxicated with delights, I will go to the forest of Lanka - To the jungles of the forest"

prakrit: "इअ सिरि-पवरसेण-विरइए कालिदास-कए दहमुहवहे महाकव्वे तइओ आसासओ परिसमत्तो"
english: "O silence - Without power - Kalidasa's fierce face Is the climax of your hopes as a great poet."

prakrit: "अह पढम-वअण-णिहुअंपच्छा उम्हइअ-लज्जिअं कइ-सेण्णं,ससि-दंसण-पासुत्तंकमल-वणं व दिअसागमेण विवुद्धं"
english: "Ah, the first time - The wind has blown, The women are ashamed, The trees are stinking, The lotuses are wilting And the forest is bursting at the seams."

prakrit: "णवरि अ कइ-हिअआइंधुअन्धआर-विअडाइ गमणुच्छाहो,एक्को बहुआइ समंगिरि-सिहराइ अरुणाअवो व्व विलग्गो"
english: "Traveler, Where are you going? It's dark outside And the streets are deserted. One can't sleep without water. The streets are empty."

prakrit: "तो दप्प-मुह-पसाओआढत्तो ताण हिअअ-हसिउज्जोओ,रण-विक्कमग्ग-हत्थोणिअअ-सहाओ व्व पहरिसो वित्थरिउं"
english: "So thick - faced, Proud - Strained, Laughing and laughing - The hunter has scattered the spoils Like a saviour's bow." ""

prakrit: "बहलुद्धुअ-धाउ-रअंरिसहेण धुओज्झराहअ-कपोल-अलं,भिण्णं वाम-भुअ-सिरेउम्मूलिअ-वलिअ-पण्णअं गिरि-सिहरं"
english: "Covered with gooseflesh, scorched by the rays of the sun, shrivelled by the lotus of his left hand, bowed by his right hand, caved in by his wife's bow." ""

prakrit: "पुलउब्भेआअम्बंणीलो परिपुसइ विसम-कसण-च्छाअं,हिअअ-णिहित्त-पहरिसंससि-पडिभिण्ण-घण-संणिहं वच्छ-अडं"
english: "Pulubheya, Whom do you think is hiding under the blanket, Wretched calf, Headman, Watchman, Fettered calf, Covered with gooseflesh?"

prakrit: "विहडन्तोट्ठ-उड-दलंफुरन्त-दन्त-अर-बहल-केसर-वअरं,पहरिस-चन्दालोएहसिअं कुमुएण सुरहि-गन्धुग्गारं"
english: "Vihdantottatha - The fly - The twig - The tooth - The arrow - The flute - The saffron - The peacock - The scent - The garland of jasmine - The lotus of the moonlight"

prakrit: "विहडन्त-धरणि-बन्धोउहअ-भुअ-क्खेव-मुहल-वेविर-विडवो,विसम-पडन्त-विसहरोवेला-चन्दण-दुमो मइन्देण धुओ"
english: "Vihdant - Dharani - Bandhooh - Bhoo - Kkhev - Muhl - Vevir - Vidwoo, Visam - Padant - Visharovela - Sandal - The dust washes away with the sheath." ""

prakrit: "दिप्पन्त-दुरालोआदिविअस्स सधूम-सिहि-सिहावत्त-णिहा,सोम्मत्तणं णपत्ता हरिस-भरेन्ती वि विसहरस्स व दिट्ठी"
english: "Dependent - Duraloadivyas Sadum - Sweet - Strong - Neeha, Sommetana nipata haris - The one who fills one's heart with greed - Visaharasa vishaya - Visadharsa vidya."

prakrit: "सरहो वि दरि-मुहुग्गअ-पडिसद्द-प्फुडिअ-मलअ-अड-पब्भारं,मुञ्चइ विसअं णाअंमलेइ अङ्गं च रोस-विस-अण्णाअं"
english: "Even the poor man's face Is covered with gooseflesh, Like a mass of mud on top of a lotus, Like an indecent object stuck on his body."

prakrit: "अरुणाअम्ब-च्छाएतक्खण-मेत्त-पडिवुद्ध-पङ्कअ-सोहे,फुरइ णिमढस्स वि फुडंदिअसस्स मुहम्मि दिणअरो व्व अमरिसो"
english: "Aruna ̄ amba - Your face - Your eyes - Lovely - Wretched - Painted - Beautiful: Even on the darkest night There will be tears welling up in your eyes As if they were immortality."

prakrit: "विअडाहरन्तरालंकअं सुसेणस्स रोस-हसिएण फुडं,उप्पाअ-रुहिर-अम्बंमज्झ-प्फुडिअ-रइ-मण्डलं मिव वअणं"
english: "Loud beating of drums, Loud bursts of laughter, Applause, sighs, frowns, moans, growls, shakes - The district is full of mice."

prakrit: "हरिस-परिअम्भिएण अअद्धुल्लसिअ-रइ-बिम्ब-अम्ब-च्छविणा,पुरओ-हुत्तारम्भोमुहेण दिवसो व्व पाअडो वालि-सुओ"
english: "Foolish girl, The days are fleeting As long as you don't look down the road For your husband's absence Makes your life miserable."

prakrit: "णेच्छइ णिव्वूढ-भरोलहुअं दप्पुद्धअत्तणं पवण-सुओ,कअ-पेसणस्स सोहइधीरं चिअ महइ रक्खिउं वअणिज्जं"
english: "She wants to sleep sounding like a fire, To burn bright red with passion And to protect me from the pleasures of love."

prakrit: "णिब्भच्छिओअहि-रवंफुडिआहर-णिव्वडन्त-दाढा-हीरं,हसइ कइ-दप्प-पसमिअ-रोस-विरज्जन्त-लोअणो सुग्गीवो"
english: "Nibbhacchio - The hair on the head, The flowers on the body, The teeth on the molars, The smile on the cheeks, The thick sweat on the bosom, The anger, The absence - The people rejoice."

prakrit: "णवरि सुमित्ता-तणओआसङ्घन्तो गुरुस्स णिअअं च बलं,ण अ चिन्तेइ ण जम्पइउअहिं सदसाणणं तणं व गणेन्तो"
english: "Youthful beauty - When tension and tension meet, teachers and women gain strength. One doesn't think twice About what one knows But considers oneself as thin."

prakrit: "रहुणाहस्स वि दिट्ठीवाणर-वइणो फुरन्त-विद्दुम-अम्बं,वअणं वअणाहि चलाकमलं कमलाहि भमर-पन्ति व्व गआ"
english: "Even at this breathless glance The hunter's wife rushed out, Wrapped her skirt in her skirt, And walked on like a flock of lotuses."

prakrit: "तो वअ-परिणामोणअ-भुमआ-वलि-रुब्भमाण-दिट्ठि-च्छोहो,आसण्ण-धवल-मिहिआ-परिक्खलन्तोसहि-प्पहो व्व महिहरो"
english: "So the wind - As a consequence - Is earthy - Strong - Rubbish - Sight - Shining, Asanas - Loud - Smooth - With trials - Blossom - Like a beehive"

prakrit: "कर-वारिअ-कइ-लोओसुग्गीव-विइण्ण-भासुरच्छि-च्छोहो,जालाहअ-दुम-णिवहोफुलिङ्ग-पिङ्गलिअ-महिहरो व्व वण-दवो"
english: "Do - The hunter - Some - The shepherd - The heifer - The swallow - The fowler - The wood - The doe - The nymph - The stag - The bee - The forest - The crows."

prakrit: "जम्पइ रिच्छाहिवईउण्णामेऊण महि-अलद्धन्त-णिहं,खलिअ-वलि-भङ्ग-दाविअ-वित्थअ-बहल-वण-कन्दरं वच्छ-अडं"
english: "A bear leaps out of the forest, A buffalo hangs on by its tail, A bull is torn to shreds And a bear is trampled to death."

prakrit: "सग्गं अपारिजाअंकोत्थुह-लच्छि-रहिअं महुमहस्स उरं,सुमिरामि महण-पुरओअ-मुद्ध-अन्दं च हर-अडा पब्भारं"
english: "A swarm of bees is hovering over me, Like a column of red smoke rising from the treetops, Like the tip of a rafter's bow." ""

prakrit: "महुमह-हत्थम्मि मएणक्खुक्खुडिअ-सरसं महासुर-हिअअं"
english: "A swarm of bees - A flock of bees clinging to one's hand - Is like a large mustard seed."

prakrit: "दिट्ठा अणुधावन्तीअक्खित्तं णिअअ-हत्थ-कमलं व सिरी"
english: "Look at that woman staring at you - Hands - lotuses - And Siri."

prakrit: "तं च हिरण्णक्खस्स विसुमरामि महा-वराह-दाढा-भिण्णं,महि-मण्डलं व तुलिअंउक्खअ-हिअअ-गिरि-बन्धणं वच्छ-अडं"
english: "There is the deer - eyed woman, Visumarami - a large bull, Beard - braided, A buffalo - bandaged, A bull's tail - clutched, And a stag - a deer - tied." ""

prakrit: "धीरं हरइ विसाओविणअं जोव्वण-मओ अणङ्गो लज्जं,एक्कन्त-गहिअ-वक्खोकिं सीसउ जं ठवेइ वअ-परिणामो"
english: "Patience vanishes, Youth loses its vigor, Anger grows, Shame prevails, And what remains of one's anger Displays itself."

prakrit: "अणुहूअ-मुणेअव्वेविहडिअ-विसमक्खरे वि संघडिअत्थे,जोव्वण-मूढ-पहसिएमा अवमण्णह जरा-परिणउल्लावे"
english: "Even the twigs of the mango tree, With their twigs and branches, Are a struggle in itself: Youth, foolishness, and pride Make dishonor seem a trifle more real."

prakrit: "तुज्झ भुआसु णिसण्णोहरि-सत्थो पब्बलो सुराण वि समरे,मारुअ-लद्ध-त्थामोओवग्गइ महि-रओ वि ता दिअसअरं"
english: "Your arms are bristling, Your lips quiver, Your cheeks tremble, Your hair hangs loose And your thighs twine around your waist."

prakrit: "किं उण दुप्परिअल्लामज्जाआइक्कमुप्पह-वलिज्जन्ता,उअहि व्व सार-गरुआघडिआ वि विसंघडन्ति कज्जालावा"
english: "What makes you think I'm angry? One moment you are angry, The next you are embarrassed, And the whole village is in an uproar."

prakrit: "पच्चक्खाहि परोक्खंकह वि तुलग्ग-घडिआहि आगम-सुद्धं,संचालिअ-णिक्कम्पंअणुहूआहि वि महं सुअं चिअ गरुअं"

prakrit: "अह गमिअ-णिसा-समअंगम्भीरत्तण-दढ-ट्ठिअम्मि समुद्दे,रोसो राहव-वअणंउप्पाओ चन्द-मण्डलं व विलग्गो"
english: "Ah! the heat of summer, The midday heat of winter, The rustle of anger, The passage of the moon, And the separation of the world."

prakrit: "तो से तमाल-णीलंणिडाल-वट्टं पलोट्ट-सेअ-जल-लवं,भिउडी थिर-वित्थिण्णंकडअं विञ्झस्स विस-लअ व्व विलग्गा"
english: "So he is like a tamarind - blue - dotted with lotuses, Like water - sweet, Like a poison - Stirred by jealousy, Like wine - red."

prakrit: "अह जणिअ-भिउडि-भङ्गंजाअं धणु-हुत्त-वलिअ-लोअण-जुअलं,अमरिस-विइण्ण-कम्पंसिढिल-जडा-भार-बन्धणं तस्स मुहं"
english: "Ah! the woman - Beauties - Broken and wealthy - Scorched and wretched - A flame in the fire of love, A mass of nectar - Wiped out and trembling - Roots - Loads - Tie around her face."

prakrit: "पणअ-पडिभङ्ग-विमणोथोअ-त्थोअ-पडिवड्ढिआमरिस-रसो,तह सोम्मो वि रहु-सुओजाओ पलअ-रइ-मण्डल-दुरालोओ"
english: "Life goes on as usual, Once the trees have been cut down, Then the shrubs, once the flowers have had time to dry up, And then the trees, once dry, Fall over."

prakrit: "तो साहस-णिम्माणंअमित्त-दीसन्त-लच्छि-संकेअ-हरं,संठिअ-रोसालाणंगेण्हइ भुअ-दप्प-बीअ-लक्खं चावं"
english: "So, for the sake of boldness - Creating abundance - Seeing - Latching on - Signalling - Chewing on - Root - Thick - Seeds - Millions!"

prakrit: "अक्कन्त-धणु-भरोणअ-धरणि-अल-त्थल-पलोट्ट-जल-पब्भारो,थोअं पि अणारूढेउअही चावम्मि संसअं आरूढो"
english: "Ungrateful lotus - Rich - Filling - Standing - Scorched - Pulled - Water - Spattered - Already bruised by many a tear - This is how the Chavami worship the world."

prakrit: "धूमाइ धूम-कलुसेजलइ जलन्तारुहन्त-जीआ-बन्धे,पडिरव-पडिउण्ण-दिसंरसइ रसन्त-सिहरे धणुम्मि णह-अलं"
english: "Smoke fills the air, Lights up, Tremors flicker, Life hangs in the balance, Clouds break loose, Disperse the scent of jasmine - Thanks to the rays of the sun"

prakrit: "भिज्जउ महि त्ति व फुडंणत्थि समुद्दो त्ति दारुणं व पइण्णं,णासउ जअं ति व मणेचिरं तुलेऊण विलइअं णेण धणुं"
english: "Soak up the nectar of a sweetmeat, Scorch the sea with acacia flowers, Make the water soft and fragrant." ""

prakrit: "तो चिर-विओअ-तणुओसइ-बाहोमट्ठ-मउअ-जीआघाओ"
english: "So long - suffering - Weak - Exhausted - Wretched - Mouth - Mouse - Lifting"

english: "Go on, you stupid bastard, Go - get rich - make love - Foolish left - arm." ""

prakrit: "अह वाम-भुअप्फालण-पडिरव-पडिउण्ण-दस-दिसा-वित्थारं,संभरइ जाअ-सङ्कंपलअ-घणब्भहिअ-पेल्लणं तेल्लोक्कं"
english: "Ah, left - The shaking of the brow - The fall - The falling - The passage - The ten days - The dispersion - The churning - The trembling - The overflowing - The burning of the oil - The world of oil."

prakrit: "गेण्हइ अ सो अणाअर-परंमुह-पसारिअग्ग-हत्थावडिअं,खअ-सूर-मऊहाण वएक्कं उअहि-परिवत्तण-सहं बाणं"
english: "She sings, Then turns her face away, Then stretches out her hands, Then recoils, Then opens her mouth And shoots an arrow with great force."

prakrit: "तो संधन्तेण सरंरसन्तरोलुग्ग-भिउडि-भङ्गेण चिरं,णीससिऊण पुलइओअणुअम्पा-दूमिआणणेण समुद्दो"
english: "So the hunter walks through the streets Taken aback by the noise, The hunter pursues the poor girl, And the plowman is consumed by grief."

prakrit: "अह कड्ढिउं पउत्तोणिक्कम्प-णिराअ-दिट्ठि-सच्चविअ-सरं,वलिअ-भुअ-रुद्ध-मज्झंदढ-णिप्पीडिअ-गुणं धणुं रहुणाहो"
english: "Oh! the bracelets on your wrists, The pearls on your cheeks, The eyes on your eyes, The lips on your face, The hair on your forehead, The girdle on your thighs, The nipples on your hips - Such a handsome man!"

prakrit: "सर-मुह-विसम-प्फलिआणमन्त-धणु-कोडि-विप्फुरन्त-च्छाआ,णज्जइ कड्ढिज्जन्ताजीआ-सद्द-गहिरं रसन्ति रवि-अरा"
english: "Sir, mouth - Vissam - Blossoming - Brilliant - Wealthy - Cock - Whirring - Slender, Strong - Strong - Wretched - Lovely - Ravi - Ara"

english: "Food - Jia - Rav - Muhlantajjie, Arrow - Mukha - Jalantaggi - Singh, Flame - She - Padyuddha - Anna - The hunter with his bow bewildered."

english: "Happiness - Water - Sweating - Sighs - Tears - Sweat - Spattered on the head. But as soon as she touches him He falls again. Praise be to Rama!" ""

english: "So the ground - mysterious, thick, rich, thick - flowery, broad - smouldering, disappearing face - Eyes glued to the mirror, Sighs like seals, Surs - rays like arrows."

english: "Gone are the days When lightning, clouds, and the passage of the moon Looked like the ocean of darkness, When buffalo and buffalo fell at one's feet - The tree of Rama - The saros." ""

english: "The navel is like a lotus, The tip of the head Is like a pearl necklace, The mouth is like an emerald tree, The roots are like saffron - Yellow, saffron - Like the ocean."

english: "Long - eyed woman, Long - hunted woman, Head bowed man, Eyes bowed - Two hundred feet wide and two inches high - Mystery shrouds the whole of our society."

english: "The women sit astride their husbands, Throwing arrows at each other, Stirring the flames of their bosoms Like flowers falling from a scaffold."

prakrit: "भिण्ण-गिरि-धाउ-अम्बाविसम-च्छिण्ण-प्पवन्त-महिहर-वक्खा,खुब्भन्ति खुहिअ-मअराआवाआल-गहिरा समुद्दुद्देसा"
english: "Drenched with sweat, Scorched by sweat, Red with fever, Swollen by aches and pains, Bowed by the arrows of the God of Love - The ocean is deep."

english: "Wretched tree - Like a mosquito's beak, Bees - hair, beard, white, pearl - like a poison - Like an old man's bow, Wet with sweat - Like water in a basin."

english: "Blossoming - With twigs - In the thickets of the forest, With shrinking trees - With rustling vines - With pearly pearls - With overflowing water"

english: "Water - sweetwood - Mukkakhana - Friendship - Tithiya - Paddy - Vithiththara, Hanti Pasanna - Water - Milk - Mustard - Muhalla Samudravatta"

english: "Aunt, As I walked up and down the flight of stairs I could see my husband slipping away As he lay on his back." ""

english: "Today, even in the darkest part of the sky, Wherever you look, There's something very special about the deep sea." ""

english: "A lonely meander - Like a river in spate, Like the ocean in a rush, Like wine draining from the ocean."

english: "Every day glances - big pots - water pots - pots - temples - spires - hope - juices - teeth - feathers - whiskers - whales - flies"

english: "Ukkhit - The great arrow - The bow - The turban - The weeping - The wretched - The trembling - The swaying of the elephant's great tail - The doe - The river - There."

english: "Love without bounds - Friendship without limits - Blessed are the wealthy women Who, because they live together in harmony - Wear white robes - Be nice to each other."

english: "Modia - Viddum - Widowing lotus - Jalammy bead - Nihansana - Nisya, Sippy - Wood - Muzzle - Lag - Tooth - pearl - Rama - Sara."

english: "What's still scattered about Like a vast expanse of smoke, Looks like a bolt of lightning And pierces through with its sharp arrows."

prakrit: "खुहिअ-समुद्दुप्पइआबाणुक्कित्त-पडिएक्क-वित्थअ-वक्खा,विसम-भरोणअ-सिहराणहद्ध-वन्थ-वलिआ पडन्ति महिहरा"

english: "Like a waterfall, Like a river - Great waves - Steep girdle - Ad - wound"

english: "There are days when one does not see one's neighbor - mother - in - law, when one is alone - husband, wife, relatives, relatives - relatives, friends, lovers - Matthäus, doe - mother."
