prakrit: "दट्ठूण अ तं णिन्तंपीआ मङ्गल-मणाहि रअणिअरीहिं,जत्तो च्चिअ उप्पण्णातेहिं चिअ लोअणेहि बाह-त्थवआ"
english: "As long as one observes auspiciousness, One can appreciate auspiciousness only through penance."

prakrit: "तो तेण कर-अल-ट्ठिअ-सेलोज्झर-सलिल-णिव्वरिअ-वच्छ-अडं,दिट्ठीहि अ बाणेहि अतुलिअं जाइ लहुअं पवंगम-सेण्णं"
english: "So do it - Al - the tree - Selojjar - Salil - the doe - The calf - The elephant - The eye - The arrow - Which is like a bamboo shoot - The lion." ""

prakrit: "पासावडिअम्मि वि सेविहीसणे पवअ-सेण्ण-कअ-परिवारे,दीणो त्ति सोअरो त्ति अअमरिस-रस-संधिओ वि उल्ललइ सरो"
english: "Even the pasavadyam is wasted away In the kitchen, In the house of relatives, For lack of affection And resentment Have turned the village upside down."

prakrit: "विसहिअ-पढम-प्पहरोणवरि अ रोसेण संधिउब्भड-बाणो,इन्दासणीअ व दुमोसत्तीअ उरम्मि लक्खणो णिब्भिण्णो"
english: "Vis ̣ a-pada ̄ ma-prabhāṇavarī, And the arrows pierced by the rays of the sun, Are indescribably like peacock's tail - Feathers twisted around the body."

prakrit: "सो वि अ पवण-सुआणिअ-धराहरोसहि-विइण्ण-जीअब्भहिओ,तह-संधिअ-चाव-सरोणिसाअरेहि सह जुज्झिउं आढत्तो"
english: "So too do I have to fight the wind, The elephant, The tiger, The deer, The buffalo, And the tiger."

prakrit: "अह रामो वि णिअच्छइतुरअ-खुर-प्पहर-विहल-जलहर-वट्ठं,ठिअ-वज्जहरालम्बिअ-कणअ-धअ-क्खम्भ-णिम्महन्त-परिमलं"
english: "Ah, Rama! Yet a myriad of arrows - hoofs, feathers, fingernails, jasmine - stick - spiky kadamba - particle - bow - arrow - Nimmahantra - fragrance."

prakrit: "वाम-भुअ-गहिअ-पग्गह-माअलि-भर-णमिअ-दीहर-धुरा-दण्डं,भिज्जन्त-मेह-सीहर-तण्णाओणअ-णिसण्ण-चामर-पम्हं"
english: "Left - arm - girdle - turban - garland - sheath - bow - long - thread - stick, wet - hair - seam - weed - nip - skin - palm." ""

prakrit: "ससि-णिहस-तुसारोल्लिअ-रवि-अर-वसुआअ-धअ-वड-सिहद्धन्तं,उण्णअ-पच्छिम-तडिमंणिवडन्तं खअ-वइं व सग्गाहि रहं"
english: "Be careful not to fall prey to the fowls - The south wind, The eagles, the geese, The parrots, The crows, And the peacocks."

prakrit: "तो रामो माअडिणापढम-दराभासणुम्मुह-पसण्ण-मुहो,तिअस-बहुमाण-गरुअंदूरअरोणामिआणणेण पणमिओ"
english: "So, Rama, pay attention to the lotuses of his face, Use them sparingly, And bow before his wife." ""

prakrit: "देइ अ रह-पुञ्जइअंउहअ-कर-क्खिवण-पाअडिअ-वित्थारं,कवअं तिहुअण-वइणोअब्भन्तर-लग्ग-णिम्महन्त-परिमलं"
english: "Give, keep, Give - Put, Give, Pay, Pay - Take, Put, Put - Put - Into - One's hands the fragrance of fresh nectar."

prakrit: "तं च कवअं सुराहिव-सव्वङ्ग-पहुत्त-लोअण-सुह-प्फरिसं,सीआ-विरहोलुग्गेजाअं थोअ-सिढिलं रहुवइस्स उरे"
english: "He is a poet of pleasure, Of beauty, Of affection, Of delight, Of pleasure and pleasure, And dwells quite aloof on the street."

prakrit: "महि-अलम ओइण्णेण असुर-वइ-हत्थ-परिमास-सइ-दुल्ललिअं,आरूढस्स रहं सेकवअं सव्वङ्गिअं कअं माअडिणा"
english: "Mahima - alum, That demon - Wretched hand, Parima - Swollen arm, Standing guard, Standing watch - What do you mean, You shameless woman?"

prakrit: "तो णील-रवि-सुएहिंसमल्लिओ राहवं सुमित्ता-तणओ,भणइ धरणीअ तक्खण-विलइअ-धणु-गब्भिणं णिमेऊण करं"
english: "So Neel - Ravi - The path of good people is smooth - Straightforward, tell me, Mother - in - law, Tell me, How can I appease those who abuse me?"

prakrit: "वीसमउ तुम्ह चावंअडणि-मुह-प्फिडिअ-सिढिल-जीआ-बन्धं,अइरा पेच्छ विराअंममम्मि णीले व्व रवि-सुए व्व दहमुहं"
english: "On the twentieth day you will see the twists and turns of the moon - your face - your pupils - your limbs - their limbs." ""

prakrit: "गरुअम्मि कुणसु कोवंलहुए दहमुह-वहम्मि मुअसु अमरिसं,तुङ्गं तडं णिसुम्भइण अ णइ-वप्पं सम-त्थलिं व वण-गओ"
english: "Be nice to each other, Be polite, Be courteous, And keep your mouth shut." "There's nothing wrong with you, dude."

prakrit: "पज्जत्तस्स समत्थंदहिउं अद्धच्छि-पेच्छिएण वि तिउरं,रहुवइ किं व ण सुव्वइआणत्ती तिणअणस्स तिअसेहि कआ"
english: "She is so anxious to know the truth That, even at first glance, she is in a quandary:" "Are you sure you don't want to hear the lie?" ""

prakrit: "तो दहवअणालोअण-रोसुग्गअ-सेअ-लङ्घिअ-णिलाड-अडो,पुलइअ-णील-रवि-सुओपणअं पडिभणइ लक्खणं रहुणाहो"
english: "So do not neglect the beauty of the milky - red - eyed woman, Long - lank - nilad - ado, Puli - nail - rabi - Sound sleep." ""

prakrit: "णिव्वूढ-जम्पिआणंआसङ्घइ तुम्ह ववसिअं मह हिअअं,किं उण भरो व्व होहिइसअं-अणिट्ठविअ-दहमुहो मज्झ भुओ"
english: "You fool, You coward, You lie to me, Why should I complain? It's the fire of jealousy That makes me shiver."

prakrit: "कुम्भस्स पहत्थस्स अदूसह णिहणेण इन्दइस्स अ समरे,दसकण्ठं मुह-वडिअंकेसरिणो वण-गअं व मा हरह महं"
english: "The forest is overgrown with acacia leaves, Scorched by the midday sun, And decrepit by the harsh winter nights. So do not harm me." ""

prakrit: "ताण अ कहं पअत्तंवोच्छिन्दन्तस्स दहमुहस्स रण-मुहे,उम्मूलिउं पअत्तोअग्ग-क्खन्धम्मि कइ-बलं सर-णिवहो"
english: "How can you describe her?" "Her face is smeared with red ghee, Her lips quiver, And her cheeks quiver."

prakrit: "तो दोण्ह वि सम-सारंबाण-वह-प्फिडिअ-तिअस-पेक्खिज्जन्तं,एक्कअर-मरण-गरुअंजाअं रामस्स दहमुहस्स अ जुज्झं"
english: "So the two are equal - Sarambana - That - Phiphidia - Tias - Pekkhijanjant, Acre - Mrityu - Gurunjaya Ramasa Dahamuhasa A jugaad." ""

prakrit: "तो कड्ढिऊण चावंकुण्डल-मणि-किरण-घडिअ-जीआ-बन्धं,मुक्को रामस्स उरेपढमं हअ-बन्धुणा दहमुहेण सरो"
english: "So watch out - The moon - The jasmine - The rays - The clocks - The ties of kinship. - Friend, hear me with a trembling face, Face to face with Rama." ""

prakrit: "वेअ-पडिएण तेण अतह धीरो वि परिकम्पिओ रहुणाहो,अप्पाण-णिव्विसेसंसअलं जह णेण कम्पिअं तेल्लोक्कं"
english: "Be so patient And yet be so compliant, As to cause trembling In the presence of oneself."

prakrit: "रहुणाहस्स वि बाणोअणुपरिवाडि-घडिअ-प्फुडिअ-केऊरं,दहवअण-भुअ-णिहाअंताल-वण-क्खन्ध-परिअएण अइगओ"
english: "Even the arrows of the hunter's bow Are struck by the wind, The peacock by the crows, The doe by the swans, The unicorn by the ants, The crows by the parrots."

prakrit: "अण्णं संधिअ-बाणंरहसाअड्ढिअ-णिराअ-वट्ठं अण्णं,समअं रक्खस-वइणोअण्णं सर-लहुइओअरं होइ धणुं"
english: "Friendship - arrows, hips, thighs, wrists, arms, eyes, ears, nose, and tongue - Like a warrior's bow And arrow - The arrow is sharp."

prakrit: "सइ-संधिअ-णिन्त-सरंअवङ्ग-देस-सइ-लग्ग-जीआ-बन्धं,दीसइ सइ-मुक्क-सरंसइ-मण्डलिअ-विअडोअरं राम-धणुं"
english: "Sai - Sandhya - Nint - Saran - Vang - Des - Sai - Lag - Jia - Bandha, Disayi Sai - Muk - Saransai - Mandali - Vidaurama Rama - The bow - the arrow"

prakrit: "वामो पसारिअ च्चिअदाहिण-हत्थो अवङ्ग-देस-णिवडिओ,चावेसु अ तह णिमिआताणं दीसन्ति अन्तरालेसु सरा"
english: "Left arm, Right arm, Left hand, Right hand, Left and right hand, The gaps are endless."

prakrit: "दहमुह-विसज्जिएण असरेण सीआ-विओअ-सइ-संतत्तं,हिअअं अमुक्क-धीरंणिहाअ-भिण्णं पि राहवेण ण णाअं"
english: "Because of anger, anger, jealousy, and selfishness, There is no path to purity Except through patience."

prakrit: "रहुणाह-पेसिएण असरेण समुहागअस्स रक्खस-वइणो,भिण्णो णिडाल-वट्टोण अ से फुड-भिउडि-विरअणा विद्दविआ"
english: "Because of jealousy, People gather in droves, Because of protection, And because of filth, People go out without food."

prakrit: "तो से मुच्छा-विहलोलोहिअ-णीसन्द-भरिअ-लोअण-णिवहो,वारं-वार-पअट्टोभमिओ बाहु-सिहरेसु मुह-संघाओ"
english: "So that mustache - Stirred by tears - Filled with longing - Bleached by tears, Turned over again and again By the arms of my lover - Straightforward mouth - Confluence."

prakrit: "तो गअ-मोहुम्मिल्लोणअण-हुआसण-पइत्त-पत्तण-पम्हं,मुअइ सरोसाअड्ढिअ-बिइअ-मुहावङ्ग-मिलिअ-पुङ्खं बाणं"
english: "So go - Fascinated by the moon - Laughing - Sweating - Paying - Putting - On - Bow - Foolish - Bees - Moustache - Milly - Pumpkin - Arrow"

prakrit: "तो सो खआणल-णिहोकिरण-सहस्सेहि णिब्भरेन्त-दस-दिसो,रहुवइ-सर-राहु-मुहेपन्थद्धे सूर-मण्डलो व्व णिउड्डो"
english: "So she is like a crystal lamp, Like a banner affixed to the mouth of the God of Love, Like the banner on the head of Rahu, Ten days after his return." ""

prakrit: "रहुणाहो वि सधीरंउक्करिसेऊण अग्ग-हत्थेण सरं,आसण्ण-लाइअव्वंपेच्छइ फुल्ल-कमलाअरं व दहमुहं"
english: "Remain firm, bow straight, Hands clasped around your ears, Eyes fixed on the lotus of your face, And eyes burning with desire."

prakrit: "रामो संधेइ सरंविभीसणन्तेण वलइ रक्खस-लच्छी,दहमुह-विणास-पिसुणंफुरइ अ सीआइ तक्खणं वामच्छं"
english: "Rama stretches out His trunk, Looks for the rakshasa - lac, bends over - weaves, whispers - And looks at the lotus with his left eye."

prakrit: "वामं णिसिअर-णअणंरहुवइणो दाहिणं च फुन्दइ णअणं,बन्धु-वह-रज्ज-पिसुणंपप्फुरइ विहीसणस्स लोअण-जुअलं"
english: "Left is bare - The plowman's son and his wife's daughter blow on the right. Friend - She twines the ropes - The fire of jealousy is the flame of longing."

prakrit: "वच्छ-भरन्तुच्छङ्गेसंधिअ-बाणे धणुम्मि कड्ढिज्जन्ते,राम-सर-पत्तणेहि वौप्पुसिआ सुर-वहूण बाह-त्थवआ"
english: "Blessed are the arrows of the God of Love, Which travel through the sky In the guise of Rama's wife." ""

prakrit: "णवरि अ सो रहुवइणावारं वारेण चन्दहास-च्छिण्णो,एक्केण सरेण लुओएक्कमुहो दहमुहस्स मुह-संघाओ"
english: "He is a novice, And stays up late at night sniffing the moonlight, All at once rubbing against each other's faces." ""

prakrit: "अविहत्त-कण्ठ-गरुओछिण्णो वि दसाणणस्स होइ भअअरो,धरणि-अलुत्तिण्णस्स वणिअअ-च्छेअ-पडिउट्ठिओ मुह-णिवहो"
english: "Aunt, Even a slight mark on your cheek Makes your face look even thinner."

prakrit: "तस्स हअस्स रण-मुहेरक्खस-णाहस्स अहिमुहं अप्पाणो,दसहि वि मुहेहि समअंसिहा-करालो व्व हुअवहो णिक्कन्तो"
english: "Tis the forest," said the hunter, "That my heart yearns for, Yet in ten days I shall never see him again."

prakrit: "अह णिहअम्मि दहमुहेऊससिअम्मि अ समन्तओ तेल्लोक्के,वअणम्मि अ उप्पुसिआभिउडी ओआरिअं च रामेण धणुं"
english: "Ah! the fire that burns in my heart, That scorches my skin with the oil of lotus, Is the weapon of Rama's bow, Like the nail of a snake in a neem twig."

prakrit: "णिद्दअ-बन्धुप्पित्थाजाणन्ती विक्कमं णिसाअर-वइणो,माअ त्ति परिगणेन्तीण मुअइ णिहअं पि रावणं राअ-सिरी"
english: "The poor widow knows how to make friends, But considering her mother is dead, So why not make love to Ravana again?"

prakrit: "ताहे विभीसणस्स विअन्तो-हिअअम्मि बन्धु-णेहुप्पण्णो,दासरहिणो वि पुरओमुक्को च्चिअ लोअणेहि बाह-त्थवओ"
english: "Such is the nature of separation - my dear friend - Friend, Even a man who is not a slave Faces adversity In the world."

prakrit: "णिहअम्मि अ दहवअणेविहीसणो णिन्दिआमरत्तण-सद्दो,परिदेविउं पउत्तोमरण-समब्भहिअ-दुक्ख-दिण्णाआसो"
english: "This is the doom and gloom of olden days," he said, "And the death and wretchedness of old age."

prakrit: "जो च्चिअ जेऊण जमंदिट्ठो इच्छा-सुहं तुमे जम-लोओ"
english: "Whatever you desire to achieve, you achieve."

prakrit: "दीसिहिसि कह णु पत्थिवैण्हिं तं चेअ सेस-जण-सामण्णं"
english: "One day you will tell me," he said, "How will you ever manage to escape?"

prakrit: "एक्केण रक्खसाहिवपुव्वं अवहीरिओवएसेण वि ते,सम-णिहणेण रण-मुहेपडिमुक्कं णवर कुम्भअण्णेण तुहं"
english: "Even so, O God of Love, Thou hast utterly destroyed the arrows of the God of War, By making the bow of Love invisible to all eyes."

prakrit: "पत्थिव तुमं मुअन्तोसम-सुह-दुक्खेहि बन्धवेहि अमुक्कं,जइ हं धम्म-पहाणोधम्म-पहाणाण को गणिज्जउ पुरओ"
english: "On the other hand, you foolish relative, If you count the dharma, The path of renunciation, You fool."

prakrit: "आहासइ अ रहुवइंमरण-समोब्भहिअ-रुद्ध-बाहुप्पीडो,बन्धु-वहागअ-दुक्खोगिम्हुम्हा-सुक्ख-णइ-मुहो व्व महिहरो"
english: "Ah, the sighs and groans of relatives, The arms and legs tied shut, The mouths of sorrows and griefs, The cheeks and face of happy women."

prakrit: "पहु वीसज्जेहि महंता दहमुह-कुम्भअण्ण-चलण-णिवडिओ,पच्छा पर-लोअ-गअंछिवामि सीसम्मि मेहणाअं च सुअं"
english: "Arrived at twenty o'clock. The great fire - Mouth - Powder - Movement - Sweat - On the street - People - Going to and fro. I slept soundly." ""

prakrit: "महि-अल-पडिअ-विसंठुल-विहीसण-विलाव-जाअअणुअम्पेण,रामेण वि पवण-सुओआणत्तो रक्खसाहिवइ-सक्कारे"
english: "Mahil -Al - Fallen - Wretched - Vanishing - Vilaav - Trembling - Even Lord Rama could not escape - Such is the way of a wise man - The saviour of good and evil."

prakrit: "णिहअम्मि अ दहवअणेआसङ्घन्तेण जणअ-तणआ-लम्भं,सुग्गीवेण वि दिट्ठोपच्चुवआरस्स साअरस्स व अन्तो"
english: "In this world, people suffer because of strife, Weeping and sighing, Sighs and groans Even though we see them with our own eyes."

prakrit: "काऊण अ सुर-कज्जंरहुवइ-वीसज्जिएण कइ-अण-पुरओ,जलहर-गुप्पन्त-धओसग्गाहिमुहो रहो कओ माअडिणा"
english: "Who cares what people say? One can't help it if one's feelings are hurt. The other has to go on in anger."

prakrit: "घेत्तूण जणअ-तणअंकञ्चण-लट्ठिं व हुअवहम्मि विसुद्धं,पत्तो पुरिं रहुवईकाउं भरहस्स सप्फलं अणुराअं"
english: "When a man is angry He scorns at him, When he berates him, And when he rebukes him, He turns his back on him, As if he wanted the fruit of his anger."

prakrit: "एत्थ समप्पइ एअंसीआ-लम्भेण जणिअ-रामब्भुअअं,रावणवह त्ति कव्वंअणुराअङ्कं समत्थ-जण-णिव्वेसं"
english: "This is the end of Ravana's life: Long live the god Rama, For Ravana has perfected his poetry In such a way That many souls have been purified."

prakrit: "इअ सिरि-पवरसेण-विरइए कालिदास-कए दहमुहवहे महाकव्वे पञ्चरहो आसासओ परिसमत्तो"
english: "O silence - Without a trace of anger - The five great vows of Kalidasa Are the consummation of all hope."

prakrit: "संझा-पणाम-घडिओगिरि-तणआ-विहुअ-वाम-हत्थ-विहडिओ,हसिऊण मुक्क-सलिलोएक्क-करेण णिअमञ्जली जेण कओ"
english: "Assemble - Take care - Clockwise - Straight - Left - Hand - In the yard, Laughing - Sucking - Shaking - Do as the doer tells the doe." ""

prakrit: "गरुए वि समर-कज्जेविअसन्ति च्चिअ रसं लिहन्ति समत्था,बद्ध-प्फलम्मि कुसुमेबोलीणो होइ महुअराण अवसरो"
english: "Strong and vigorous, Strong and able to write with relish, The blossom of sweetwood flowers Brings happiness to all who hear them."

prakrit: "एन्ति वलन्ति वलन्ताराम-सराघाअ-लङ्घिअ-णहाहोआ,थोरा-सरिसातुङ्गा मणि-पव्वअ व्व"
english: "Here and there a stray dog, Vlantaram, Saragha, Langhiya, Nahahoa, Thoraha, Sarisatunga, Mani, Pavva and so on." ""

prakrit: "जलण-प्पहाणुविद्धंआवत्त-भमन्त-पव्वअ-दुमालग्गं,संबन्ध-रअण-पुप्फंफुरइ फुरन्त-प्पहं पवाल-किसलअं"
english: "The fire burns, The flames flicker, The crows flutter, The flowers flutter And the parrots flutter."

prakrit: "मसिणिअ-मीण-क्खन्धाअइन्ति णिब्भिण्ण-महिहरन्तर-सरिआ,भिज्जन्त-रोस-लङ्घिअ-मुह-लग्ग-भुअंगम-प्फणा राम-सरा"
english: "Women - Pisces - Angry women - Sweat - Spattered all over - Mahirantar - Sariya, Soaking - Laughter - Lame - Mouth - Lag - Bhuangam - Praise be to Rama - Sara"

prakrit: "पलअ-घणेहि व खुब्भइवेवइ उप्पाअ-मारुएहि व उअही,खअ-सूरेहि व झिज्जइरसइ सरेहि तिअसेहि व महिज्जन्तो"
english: "The plowman is so afraid of bees That he throws them on the ground, Kills them, And scratches them with his bow that he swallows them all."

prakrit: "बाणोसारिअ-सलिलाथोअं भिज्जन्त-पाअडिअ-सिप्पि-उडा,विअसन्ति विअसिआअव-ओअट्टन्त-मणि-गब्भिणा पुलिण-वहा"
english: "Banosari - The salilers are soaking wet - The leaves are drooping - Slipping - Flying, the beds are busy - Drunken - Sweating - Beef - Proud Pulin - There." ""

prakrit: "सीस-रइअञ्जलि-उडोसर-विअणा-दूमिआणणो सलिलणिही,पाएसु दासरहिणोपवण-वस-क्खित्त-पाअवो व्व णिवडिओ"
english: "Sees - fairies - wasps - wiles - A poor man's bow Slippers - The feet are like the feet of a servant - Slave - wife - servant - Consideration - A river flows through it."

prakrit: "वाणर-चरणक्कन्तंउच्चलिअ-समुद्द-सलिल-गहिओआसं,चलइ चल-पाअव-लअंकम्पइ कम्पिअ-धराहरं महि-वेढं"
english: "Venerable - From the feet to the top - The sea to the seashore - The elephant is running, Moving on foot and on foot, Leaning on the fence - The buffalo is running wild."

prakrit: "विसम-विसट्टन्त-सिला-अल-सिहरुप्पइअ-भीअ-किंणर-मिहुणा,ओज्झर-मुक्कक्कन्दाउम्मूलिज्जन्ति वाणरेहि महिहरा"
english: "Vissam - vast - Sila - al - sihruppayi - bhee - kinnar - mihuna, ojjar - mukkadanda - The bees of the bamboo shoot their way through the mud."

prakrit: "आइद्ध-महिहर-णिहंउअहि-जल-पलोट्ट-मेह-अड-पब्भारं,पडइ व पुरओ-हुत्तंटङ्क-च्छेअम्मि सेउ-बन्धस्स मुहं"
english: "Fettered by tears, Sweating profusely, Slipping from her face Into the mud, Her lips quivering, Her face as if chained to the fire of love."

prakrit: "बज्झन्तम्मि समुद्देसोऊण वि कलअलं महा-कइ-सेण्णं,जाअं तक्खण-विहलंभअ-भीअ-विसंठुलं दसाणण-हिअअं"
english: "At the sound of the thunderclap The clamour is loud, But the arrow - Exhausted - Has already passed through - Is like a messenger arrow"

prakrit: "रअणीअ सामल-मुहंदंसण-गलिअ-तिमिरंसुअ-सुहालोअं,विक्खित्त-किरण-हारंचन्दं णव-जोव्वणे थणं व मलेन्तं"
english: "A woman's face is like a lotus, her eyes are like water, her hair is like rays of the sun, her cheeks are like nipples, and her breasts are like young men."

prakrit: "पुलअं जणेन्ति दसकन्धरस्स सरहस-राम-सरा सरीरम्मि,जणअ-तणआ-थण-प्फंस-महग्घ-कर-अल-कड्ढिअ-धणु-विमुक्का"
english: "The pull of a bow Makes the whole body resplendent, The shoulders broad, The hips slender, The arms heavy, The hair loose, The wealth abundant - Faint."

prakrit: "इत्यधिकानि स्कन्धकानि"
english: "So many skandhas."

prakrit: "जो विविहमत्तसाअरपारं पत्तो वि विमलमइहेलं ।,पढमब्भासतरंडोणाओ सो पिङ्गलो जअइ ॥"
english: "One who knows the difference between different vows and leaves is like a lotus. But one who knows how to bow before it Is like a python."

prakrit: "दीहो सञ्जुत्तपरोबिन्दुजुओ पाडिओ अ चरणन्ते ।,स गुरू वङ्क दुमत्तोअण्णो लहु होइ सुद्ध अइकालो ॥"
english: "Days are passing, But the young men have reached their feet. The master has already reached his goal." ""

prakrit: "माई रूए हेओहिण्णो जिण्णो अ वुड्डओ देओ ।,सम्भुं कामन्ती सागोरी गहिलत्तणं कुणइ ॥"
english: "Give wood to the deer That lie among my tears. For the sage who desires wealth Makes empty vessels."

prakrit: "कत्थवि सञ्जुत्तपरोवण्णो लहु होइ दंसणेण जहा ।,परिल्हसइ चित्तधिज्जंतरुणिकडक्खम्मि णिव्वुत्तम ॥"
english: "Where there is affection, There is jealousy. But when love is absent, The arrows of the God of Love converge on one's heart."

prakrit: "इहिकारा बिन्दुजुआएओ सुद्धा अ वण्णमिलिआ वि लहू ।,रहवञ्जणसञ्जोएपरे असेसं वि होइ सविहासं ॥"
english: "Even a tiny drop of blood is enough to make a young man blush. Once people know the difference, even such a thing is likely to be true."

prakrit: "माणिणि माणहĩ काĩ फलएओ ज चरण पडु कन्त ।,सहज भुअङ्गम जइ णमइकिं करिए मणिमन्त ॥"
english: "The feet of a decent man bear much the same fruit as the feet of an honourable one." "If you want to be honest, do your best."

prakrit: "चेउ सहज तुहुँ चञ्चलासुन्दरिहदहĩ वलन्त ।,पअ उण घल्लसि खुल्लणाकीलसि उण उल्हसन्त ॥"
english: "You easygoing girl, The dazzling beauty of your face Is like a river in spate. Once you have passed through It, you will find it empty." ""

prakrit: "जइ दीहो वि अ वण्णोलहु जीहा पढइ होइ सो वि लहू ।,वण्णो वि तुरिअपढिओदात्तिण्णि वि एक जाणेहु ॥"
english: "That one reads a poem in a day is blood. Even a woman who gives birth to a boy knows one thing."

prakrit: "अरेरे वाहहि कान्ह णावछोडि डगमग कुगति ण देहि ।,तई इथि णदिहĩ सँतार देइजो चाहहि सो लेहि ॥"
english: "Oh! wretched man! For leaving no stone unturned, Do not give in to anger. So take whatever you can get for yourself In this damned place." ""

prakrit: "जम ण सहइ कणअतुलातिल तुलिअं अद्धअद्धेण ।,तम ण सहइ सवणतुलाअवछन्दं छन्दभङ्गेण ॥"
english: "If you cannot bear to lift a towel soaked in nectar, you have to endure to break a sweaty twig."

prakrit: "अबुह बुहाणं मज्झेकव्वं जो पढइ लक्खणविहूणं ।,भूअग्गलग्गखग्गहĩसीसं खुडिअं ण जाणेइ ॥"
english: "O my daughter - in - law, Whoever reads this Book Would be remiss If he did not know what it was That was hidden under the rug of fire."

prakrit: "ट्ठडढाणह मज्झेगणभेआ होति पञ्च अक्खरओ ।,छपचतदा जहसङ्खंछप्पञ्चचउत्तिदुकलासु ॥"
english: "If you want to burn my body, paint five layers. When you paint it, put five layers of paint on it." ""

prakrit: "टगणो तेरहभेओभेआ अट्ठाइ होन्ति ठगणस्स ।,डगणस्स पञ्च भेआ तिअ ढगणे बे वि णगणस्स ॥"
english: "You have grown so thin On the eighth day of springtime You are a fraud. So covering the fifth day with your skirt Is nothing to count on." ""

prakrit: "पढम गुरु हेट्ठठाणेलहुआ परिठवहु अप्पबुद्धीए ।,सरिसा सरिसा पन्तीउव्वरिआ गुरुलहू देहु ॥"
english: "The first guru is hidden, the second wife is unseen, the fifth wife is unknown, and so is the guru's body." ""

prakrit: "हर ससि सूरो सक्को सेसो अहि कमल बम्भ कलि चन्दो ।,धुअ धम्मो सालिअरो तेरह भेआ छमत्ताणं ॥"
english: "Every plant withers, The sun does not wither, The black moon is like a lotus., The dharma of smoke Is like the burning fire of fire."

prakrit: "इन्दासण अरु सूरोचाओ हीरो अ सेहरो कुसुमो ।,अहिगण पापगणो धुअपञ्चकले पिङ्गलें कहिओ ॥"
english: "Indasana aru surochao hero aur seharo kusumo., Ahigan paap guna dhoo," say the plump girls in their beds.

prakrit: "गुरुजुअ कण्णो गुरुअन्त करअल पओहरम्मि गुरुमज्झो ।,आइगुरु व्वसुचरणो विप्यो सव्वेहि लहुएहĩ ॥"
english: "Gurujua, the ears of a guru, And the feet of a virtuous teacher Are indispensable in all circumstances.," "Today, teachers, Blessed are those who practice virtue." ""

prakrit: "धअ चिण्ह चिर चिरालअ तोमरतुम्बूरुपत्त चुअमाला ।,रसवासपवणवलअं लहुआलम्बेण जाणेहु ॥"
english: "Woe to you! For a long time your mark has been smeared with poison, Like the juice of a poisonous clove." ""

prakrit: "सुरवइ पटव्व ताला करतालाणन्द छन्देण ।,णिव्वाणं ससमुदं तूरं एह प्यमाणेण ॥"
english: "To break open a clenched fist, To seal the door shut, Is an act of pure love."

prakrit: "भावा रसतांडव णारीअं कुणह भाविणिअं ।,तिलहुगणस्स कइअरो इअ णामं पिङ्गलो कहइ ॥"
english: "My dear, tell me, You silly girl, Do you see how this man got his name?"

prakrit: "णेउररसणाभरणं चामरफणिमुद्धकणअकुंडलअं ।,वङ्कं माणसवलअं हारावलि एह गुरुअस्स ॥"
english: "A bunch of pearls wrapped around a woman's face. What a cruel teacher!"

prakrit: "णिअपिअ परमउ सुपिए बिल्हु ति समासु कइदिट्ठ ।,अह चउमत्तह णामं फणिराओ पइगणं भणइ ॥"
english: "Nowadays, my dear, how can you sleep if you don't have time? I always say that my name is Phanirao." ""

prakrit: "सुरअलअं गुरुजुअलं कण्णसमाणेण रसिअरसलग्गं ।,मणहरण सुमइलम्बिअ लहलहिअं ता सुवण्णेण ॥"
english: "A juicy salve like a sweetmeat To the ears of a virtuous girl., To the lips of one's lover It is sweet to hear."

prakrit: "करपाणिकमलहत्थं बाहू भुअदंडपहरणअसणिअं ।,गअभरणरअणणाणाभुअभरणं होति सुपसिद्धं ॥"
english: "The arms of the husband should not bend beneath his weight., The good rule is the rule of the head, Not that of the wife."

prakrit: "भुअवइअसणरगअवइ वसुहाहिवरज्जुगोवालो ।,उण्णाअकचक्कवई पअहरथणअं णरिन्दाĩ ॥"
english: "The cowherd is so eager to grab hold of the buffalo That he does not notice that it is crawling on the road." ""

prakrit: "पअपाअचरणजुअलं अवरु पआसेइ गंडवलहद्दम ।,ताअपिआमहदहणं णेउररइजङ्घजुअलेहĩ ॥"
english: "When he touches her feet She rubs her cheeks against his thighs. Then, bowing low, She embraces him again." ""

prakrit: "पढमं एरिसि विप्पो बीए सरपञ्च जाइसिहरेहĩ ।,दिअवरपरमोपाए होइ चउक्केण लहुएण ॥"
english: "There you are, Vippo, and the sarpanch are at hand. The gods have been kindled by a sudden fire." ""

prakrit: "सुणरिन्दअहिअकुञ्जरुगअवरुदन्ताइ दन्ति अह मेहो ।,एरावइतारावइगअणं झम्पं त लम्पेण ॥"
english: "Listening to them, Oh! The clouds are giving the raindrops of the kunjaruga a fresh look." "They seem to be jumping on top of each other."

prakrit: "पक्खिविराडमइन्दहवीणाअहिजक्खअमिअजोहलअं ।,सुप्पण्णपण्णगासणगरुड विआणेहु मज्झलहुएण ॥"
english: "Pakhiraviradam, The plowman's wife is so busy making love That he has to kneel down before her." ""

prakrit: "बहुविविहपहरणेहिं पञ्चकलओ गणो होइ ।,गअरहतुरङ्गपाइक्क एहु णामेण जाण चउमत्ता ॥"
english: "Since there have been many marriages, the five vows are to be counted." That is the way of a true wife. "" "

prakrit: "ताडङ्कहारणेउरकेउरओ होति गुरुभेआ ।,सरमेरुदंडकाहल लहुभेआ होति एत्ताĩ ॥"
english: "There must be someone else at the door. The noise of the trumpet is deafening." "Here it is."

prakrit: "सङ्खं फुल्लं काहल रवं असेसेहĩ होन्ति कणअलअं।,रूअं णाणाकुसुमं रसगन्धं सद्दपरमाणं ॥"
english: "The flowers are fragrant, The fragrance of sweetwood flowers Is irresistible., The scent of fresh acacia flowers Is conclusive." ""

prakrit: "मो तिगुरू णो तिलहू लहुगुरुआईं यभा ज मज्झगुरू ।,मज्झलहू रो सो उण अन्तगुरू तो वि अन्तलहुएण ॥"
english: "I am the triguru, the sesame seed, the yaba, the midday guru., The midday wailer, So even if there is an end guru, There must be an end."

prakrit: "पुहवीजलसिहिकालो गअणं सूरो अ चन्दमा णाओ ।,गण अट्ठ इट्ठदेओ जहसङ्खं पिङ्गले कहिओ ॥"
english: "The sun does not rise on a full moon, nor the moon on a clear one." "Tell me, dear girl, how did you get here?"

prakrit: "मगण णगण दुइ मित्त हो भगण यगण हो भिच्च ।,आसीण जत दुअउ गण अवसिट्ठउ अरि णिच्च ॥"
english: "Friend, brother, friendship is twofold. But the more true the affection, the more absent it is."

prakrit: "मगण रिद्धि थिरकज्ज यगण सुहसम्पअ दिज्जइ ।,रगण मरण सम्पलइ जगण खरकिरण विसज्जड ॥,तगण सुण्ण फल कहइ सगण सहदेसु व्वासइ,भगण रचइ मङ्गल अणेक कइ पिङ्गल भासइ ॥,जत कव्व गाह दोहइ मुणहु णगण होइ पढमक्खरहि ।,तसु रिद्धि बुद्धि सव्वई फुरहि रण राउल दुत्तर तरइ ॥"
english: "If a man has a penchant for arrows, He gives pleasure in worship. If a woman has an arrow, She scratches at the nail mark. If he has an ache, She forgets the fruit, And if she has a heart, She shares it with him. For how can a man know what is good and what isn't? When the bow is bent on making love, As though he had one. If the bow were not bowed by fire, His wisdom Would outshine that of any warrior."

prakrit: "मित्त मित्त दे रिद्धि बुद्धि अरु मङ्गल दिज्जइ,मित्त भिच्च थिरकज्ज जुज्झ णिब्भअ जअ किज्जइ ।,मित्त आसे कज्जबन्ध णहि पुणु पुणु छिज्जइ,मित्त होइ जइ सत्तु गोत्तबन्धव पीडिज्जइ ॥,अरु भिच्च मित्त सव कज्जहो भिच्च भिच्च आअत्ति चल,सव भिच्च उआसे धणु णसइ भिच्च वइरि हाकन्द फल ॥"
english: "Friend, if friendship helps, wisdom gives more happiness; friend, if jealousy destroys wealth, virtue gives more., If friendship destroys kajbandh, kajabandh does not heal again., But if love destroys all kajjho, Then come the cowherd, For all the begging of begging is a waste of life."

prakrit: "उआसीण जइ मित्त कज्ज किछु मन्द दिखावइ,उआसीण जइ भिच्च सव्व आअत्ति चलावइ ।,उआसीण उआसे मन्दभल किछु णहि दक्खिअ,आसीण जइ सत्तु गोत्त वइरिउ कइ लक्खिअ ।,जइ सत्तु मित्त हो सुण्णफल सत्तु भिच्चहो घरणिणस,पुणु सत्तु आसे धण णसइ सत्तु सत्तु णाअक्क खस ॥"
english: "If you agree with me, I will do something. If you disagree, everyone will agree. But if you agree, I won't say a word. If we disagree, we will talk. How can we know for sure? If we agree, We'll meet again. If there's anything, It's the jasmine of the house, The begging bowl of the beggar's wife, And if there is anything to be said, It is the loss of the husband."

prakrit: "पुव्व जुअल सरि अङ्का दिज्जसु । गुरुसिर अङ्के सेस मटिज्जसु ।,उवरलअङ्क लक्खि कहु आणहु । ते परिधुअ उद्दिट्ठा जाणहु ॥"
english: "Give me that pearl necklace. Please, my lord, cut it down to the rafters. Let me tell you what it looks like on the handkerchief. You should know where it is hidden." ""

prakrit: "णढे सव्वकला कारिज्जसु । पुव्व जुअल सरि अङ्का दिज्जसु ।,पुच्छलअङ्क मिटावहि सेख । उवरल अङ्क लोपि कहु लेख ॥"
english: "Perform all your actions. Give me the marks of your bracelets. If you ask me, I will erase them. Write me down, forgetting the marks on your wrists." ""

prakrit: "जत्थ जत्थ पाविज्जइ भाग । एहु कहइ फुर पिङ्गल णाग ।,परमत्ता लेइ गुरुता जाइ । जत लक्खहु तत लक्खहु आइ ॥"
english: "Wherever there is poverty, there must be prosperity." "There must be virtue for the supreme being. As many millions as there are millions."

prakrit: "अक्खर उप्परि दुण्णाअङ्का दिज्जहु मुणेहु उद्दिट्ठा ।,लहु उप्परि जो अङ्को तं देइ एक्केण जाणेहु ॥"
english: "First lift the poor man's head, then bend it. But to give it to him who puts it on shall be given utterance."

prakrit: "णढे अङ्के भाग करिज्जसु । समभागहĩ तहि लहु मूणिज्जसु ।,विसम एक देइ वंटण किज्जसु । पिङ्गल जम्पइ गुरु आणिज्जसु ॥"
english: "Take a bath, partake of it. If you must partake, sip on it. One day at a time, mix it all up. The Pingle Jumps off to fetch the teacher." ""

prakrit: "अक्खर सङ्खे काढ करुआइ अन्त पढमक ।,सिर दुइ अङ्के अवरु भरुसूई मेरु णिसङ्क ॥"
english: "Make her take off her skirt, Then finish reading it. There she is, two heads on either side, Scratching the nail marks." ""

prakrit: "उदिठ्ठा सरि अङ्का दिज्जसु । पुव्व अङ्क परभरण करिज्जसु ।,पावल अङ्क पढम परिदिज्जसु । पत्थरसङ्ख पताका किज्जसु ॥"
english: "Give me the right number. Take care of the wrong number. Please, give me the wrong one First. Give me a banner with stones in it." ""

prakrit: "दुइ दुइ काट्ठा सरि लिहहु पढम अङ्क तसु अन्त ।,तसु आइहि पुण एक्क सउ पढमे बे वि मिलन्त ॥"
english: "Dui, dui, katha saari, padam aankha, tsu anta. So today, once again, all of you, even I, myself, will meet in reading."

prakrit: "सिर अङ्के तसु सिर पर अङ्के । उवरल काट्ट पुरहु णीसके ।,मत्तामेरु अङ्क सञ्चारि । बुज्झहु बुज्झहु जण दुइ चारि ॥"
english: "The head is here, the trunk is there, The forest is bare, The rivers are swollen. A wise man has two wives." ""

prakrit: "उद्दिट्ठा सरि अङ्का थप्पहु । वामावत्ते पर ले लुप्पहु ।,एक्क लोप अइक्क गुरु आणहु । दुइ तिणि लोपे दुइ तिणि जाणहु ।,मत्त पताका पिङ्गल गाव । जो पावइ सो परहि मिलाव ॥"
english: "Give me a slap on the head. Take a veil on the left thigh. Once you've lost one, You've gained the other. In two or three you lose two. Drunken flags trumpet the song. Anyone who can find one Should do so elsewhere." ""

prakrit: "पुच्छल छन्द कला कई पुच्छल वण्ण मिटाव ।,अवसिटे गुरु जाणिअहु लहु जाणिव्वउ ताव ॥।दोहा।"
english: "Remove the art of asking questions., In the absence of a teacher, Either you know the words Or you don't."

prakrit: "छब्बीसा सत्तसआ तह सत्तारह सहस्साĩ ।,बाआलीसं लक्खं तेरह कोडी समग्गाई॥५०॥"
english: "There are seven hundred and seventy thousand words in all. One hundred and fifty thousand and thirteen syllables in all"

prakrit: "होइ गाहू मत्त चउअण्ण गाहाइ सत्तावणी ।,तह विग्गाह पलट्टि किज्जइ उग्गाहउ सट्ठि कल ॥,गाहिणी अ बासट्टि किज्जइ ।,तह वि पलट्टइ सिंहिणी बे अग्गल हो सहि ।,सत्तरूअ अण्णोण्ण गण खन्ध मत्त चउसट्ठि ॥"
english: "Behold the elephant, my dear, The elephant is the main authority. Tomorrow the elephant will be flipped on its back, And tomorrow the elephant on its head, And then the lioness on her back, Yet the fire will be unbearable. Seventeen hundred odd people are sitting side by side."

prakrit: "पुव्वद्धे उत्तद्धे सत्तग्गल मत्त वीसा ।,छट्ठमगण पअमज्झे गाहू मेरु व्व जुअलाĩ ।५२॥"
english: "On the first day of the festival, There were seven trumpets blowing, And on the sixth day the water flowed like a flame. 52." ""

prakrit: "चन्दो चन्दण हारो ताव अ रूअं पआसन्ति ।,चंडेसरवरकित्ती जाव ण अप्पं णिदंसेइ ॥"
english: "The moon is red as a garland of sandalwood, And the rays of the sun find no place in it."

prakrit: "पढमं बारह मत्ता बीए अट्ठारहेहĩ सञ्जुत्ता ।,जह पढमं तह तीअं दहपञ्च विहूसिआ गाहा ॥"
english: "I have read twelve books, and I have eighteen. The more I read, the more distracted I became." ""

prakrit: "जेण विणा ण जिविज्जइ अणुणिज्जइ सो कआवराहो वि ।,पत्ते वि णअरडाहे भण कस्स ण वल्लहो अग्गी ॥"
english: "One who can't live without it is guilty of committing a sin. Even a leaf without fire Says that one doesn't deserve fire." ""

prakrit: "सत्तगणा दीहन्ता जो ण लहू छट्ठ णेह जो विसमे ।,तह गाहे वि अ अद्धे छठे लहुअं विआणेहु ॥"
english: "One who does not shed blood cannot shed poison. Even if one loses it, one can still shed one-sixth of one's blood."

prakrit: "सव्वाए गाहाए सत्तावण्णाइ होति मत्ताई।,पुव्वद्धमि अ तीसा सत्ताईसा परदमि ॥"
english: "Matthai, on the other hand, all are dominated by power.," "On the contrary, I am the supreme power." ""

prakrit: "सत्ताईसा हारा सल्ला जस्संमि तिण्णि रेहाई।,सा गाहाणं गाहा आआ तीसक्खरा लच्छी ॥"
english: "Twenty-seven strands of hair - That's three rays of gold. Gone are those thirty thousand strands." ""

prakrit: "तीसक्खराहĩ लच्छी सव्वे वन्दन्ति होइ विक्खाआ ।,हासइ एवं एक्कं वण्णं ता कुणह णामाई ॥"
english: "All are welcome. Laugh and make noise together, That's my name." ""

prakrit: "लच्छी रिद्धी बुद्धी लज्जा विज्जा खमा अ देहीआ ।,गोरी धाई चुण्णा छाआ कन्ती महामाई ॥"
english: "Lucky is the rich intellect, Lajja is the knowledge, For what use is a poor midwife? But what good is a good headmistress?"

prakrit: "कित्ती सिद्धी माणी रामा गाहिणी विसा अ वासीआ ।,सोहा हरिणी चक्की सारसि कुररी सिही अ हंसीआ ॥"
english: "Kiti siddhi mani Rama gahini vissa aa vasiya., Soha harini chakki sarasi kurri sighi aa laughed." ""

prakrit: "पढमं वी हंसपअं बीए सीहस्स विक्कम जाआ ।,तीए गअवरलुलिअं अहिवरलुलिअं चउत्थए गाहा ॥"
english: "At first she laughed but her anger melted away. Then, with a sigh, she burst into tears." ""

prakrit: "एक्के जे कुलमन्ती बे णाअक्केहĩ होइ सङ्गहिणी ।,णाअकहीणा रंडा वेसा बहुणाअका होइ ॥"
english: "One who is a Kulmanti should not be alone, one who is alone should be with one's mate., One who does not want to be alone Should be with many others."

prakrit: "तेरह लहुआ विप्पी एआईसेहिं खत्तिणी भणिआ ।,सत्ताईसा वेसी सेसा सा सुद्दिणी होइ ॥"
english: "Aunt, That poisonous snake said:" "Be circumcised." "Twenty-seven prostitutes must have borne the brunt of it."

prakrit: "जा पढम तीअ पञ्चम सत्तम ठाणे ण होइ गुरुमज्झा ।,गुव्विणिए गुणरहिआ गाहा दोसं पआसेइ ॥"
english: "It is not the teacher's fault that she failed in the first but in the fifth."

prakrit: "विग्गाहा पढम दले सत्ताईसाई मत्ताई।,पच्छिम दले ण तीसा इअ जम्पिअ पिङ्गलेण णाएण ॥"
english: "In the western party he does not speak so loudly As he does in the western." ""

prakrit: "परिहर माणिणि माणं पक्खहि कुसुमाई णीवस्स ।,तुम्ह कए खरहिअओ गण्हइ गुडिआधणुं अ किर कामो ॥"
english: "Far be it from your eyes To judge a woman By her breasts. What business is it of yours To count her bracelets?"

prakrit: "पुव्वद्धे उत्तद्धे मत्ता तीसन्ति सुहअ सम्भणिआ।,सो उग्गाहो वुत्तो पिङ्गल कइ दिट्ठ सट्टि मत्तङ्गो ॥"
english: "When he's high, He takes my breath for granted. So how can one look at a peacock While standing upright?" ""

prakrit: "सोऊण जस्स णामं अंसू णअणाई सुमुहि रुन्धति ।,भण वीर चेइवइणो पक्खामि मुहं कहं जहिच्छं से ॥"
english: "Whom do you think I am calling to?" cried the hunter, "Whose name is there, And whose face is there beside my face?"

prakrit: "पुव्वद्ध तीस मत्तापिङ्गल पभणेइ मुद्धिणि सुणेहि ।,उत्तद्धे बत्तीसागाहिणि विवरीअ सिंहिणी भणु सच्चं ॥"
english: "When the lioness says:" "Foolish girl, tell me what you want to say." "When told that it is thirty o'clock in the morning, The lioness tells the hunter exactly what she wants."

prakrit: "मुञ्चहि सुन्दरि पाअं अप्पहि हसिऊण सुमुहि खग्गं मे ।,कप्पिअ मेच्छशरीरं पच्छड वअणाईं तुम्ह धुअ हम्मीरो ॥"
english: "My darling, If you smile at me all the time, I'll smear your face all over with smoke." ""

prakrit: "वरिसइ कणअह विढेइ तप्पइ भुअणे दिआणिसं जग्गन्तो।,णीसङ्क साहसको णिदइ इन्दं अ सूरबिम्बं अ ॥"
english: "The earth trembles at the sight of the God of Love. The sun's rays smear the sky with darkness." ""

prakrit: "चउमत्ता अट्ठगणा पुव्वद्धे उत्तरद्ध होइ समरूआ ।,सा खन्धआ विआणहु पिङ्गल पभणेइ मुद्धि बहुसम्भेआ ॥"
english: "The warrior is bound to the bull for the eighth time. When he touches the bull, The bull's tail is prickly And the bull is very powerful." ""

prakrit: "जं जं आणेइ गिरि रइरहचक्कपरिघट्टणसहं हणुआ ।,तं तं लीलाइ णलो वामकरत्थंहिअं रएइ समुद्दे ॥"
english: "Whatever the giri may bring, Wrapped in its round girdle, It must be leelai, That is the meaning of the word Vamakarta in the Samudra." ""

prakrit: "णन्दउ भद्दउ सेस सरङ्गसिव बम्भ वारण वरुण ।,णीलु मअण तालङ्क सेहरुसरु गअणु सरहु विमइ ॥,खीर णअरु णरु णिद्ध णेहलु ॥,मअगलु भोअलु सुद्ध सरिकुम्भ कलस ससि जाण ।,सरहसेसससहर मुणहु सत्ताइस खन्धाण ॥"
english: "Foolish girl, That sarangsive bumbha varan varan., The blue lotus grows darker As the tala heats up., Kheer grows thinner As the nectar seeps in., Mother - in - law, It's as clear as an empty jar., Sighs the arrows of the God of Love., Seventy - seven candles.,"

prakrit: "चउ लहु कत्थवि पसर जहिं सो सहि णन्दउ जाण ।,गुरु टुट्टइ बि बि लहु वढइ तं तं णाम विआण ॥"
english: "Wherever one's heart is stretched out, There one knows true bliss. Even if the teacher is broken, When the heart is enlarged, That is called name."

prakrit: "चन्दा कुन्दा कासाहारा हीरा तिलोअणा केलासा ।,जेत्ता जेत्ता सेत्ता तेत्ता कासीस जिण्णिआ ते कित्ती ॥."
english: "Chanda kunda, kasahara heera, tilona kelasa., Jeta jeta seta, tetra kasis Jinnya thi.," How much?

prakrit: "तेरह मत्ता पढम पअपुणु एआरहĩ देह ।,पुणु तेरह एआरहइदोहा लक्खण एह ॥"
english: "Teras mattas, padams, prabhuns, yaarahin body., Puna teras, yaaarahindodahaan lakshanas.,"

prakrit: "सुरअरु सुरही परसमणिणहि वीरेश समाण ।,ओ वक्कल ओ कठिणतणुओ पसु ओ पासाण ॥"
english: "Suraru surahi, Parasmaninhi veeresh samman., O wicked one, O harsh one, Pashu, pasaan."

prakrit: "भमरु भामरु सरहु सेवाणमंडूक मक्कडु करहु ।,णरु मरालु मअगलु पओहरुबलु वाणरु तिण्णि कलु ॥,कच्छ मच्छ सहूल अहिवरु ।,वघ्य विराडउ सुणह तहौन्दुर सप्पपमाण ।,गुरु टुट्टइ बे लहु वढइतं तं णाम विआण ॥"
english: "A swarm of gnats, A flock of parrots, A beehive of nectar, A string of acacia flowers, A mango shoot, A good man's tail feathers, And a good woman's cheek. If you want to separate your husband from him Listen carefully to what he has to say. The master will break it, But if you lose heart It's a lie." ""

prakrit: "छब्बीसक्खर भमर हो गुरु बाइस लहु चारि ।,गुरु टुट्टइ बे लहु वढइ तं तं णाम विआरि ॥"
english: "A bee with twenty-two teeth is a bee with four. When a bee has one, it is called a bee."

prakrit: "जा अद्धङ्गे पव्वईसीसे गङ्गा जासु ।,जो देआणं वल्लहोवन्दे पाअं तासु ॥"
english: "Go and take a bath in the holy Ganges. One who gives charity finds a lover."

prakrit: "बारह लहुआ विप्पीतह बाईसेहिं खत्तिणी भणिआ ।,बत्तीस होइ बेसीजा इअरा सुद्दिणी होई ॥"
english: "The woman said," "It's twelve o'clock." "When she had passed on the bad o'clock, Two hundred and thirty-two men rushed to tell her what had happened."

prakrit: "जस्सा पढमहिं तीओजगणा दीसन्ति पाअ पाएण ।,चंडालह घररहिआदोहा दोसं पआसेइ ॥"
english: "As soon as she sees me her husband will come." The landowner's daughter-in-law blames her husband for the mess.

prakrit: "छक्कलु चक्कलु तिणि कलु एम परि विसम पअन्ति ।,सम पाहĩ अन्तक्क कलु ठवि दोहा णिभन्ति ॥"
english: "When three buds meet in one go, they become one. When the other is at hand, the buds close in unison."

prakrit: "दिअवरगण धरि जुअलपुण विअ तिअलहु पअल,इम विहि विहु छउ पअणिजिम सुहइ सुससि रअणि,इह रसिअउ मिअणअणिएअदह कल गअगमणि ॥"
english: "The plowman's son has grown very thin By the time he gets home, He has left for good again, My business is going well, And I hope to meet him again tomorrow."

prakrit: "विमुह चलिअ रण अचलुपरिहरिअ हअगअवलु,हलहलिअ मलअणिवइजसु जस तिहुअण पिअइ,वरणसि णखइ लुलिअसअल उवरि जसु फुलिअ ॥"
english: "Vimuh chala raan, achala parihari hai aagwalu, halahali malainivu, jasmine kadalu, varansh nakhai, lulliyasal uvari jasoo phulliya."

prakrit: "आइकव्व उक्कच्छकिउ लोहङ्गिणि मह सारु ।,गुरु वड्डइ बि बि लहु घटइतं तं णाम विआरु ॥"
english: "Tell me, my dear, Why do you want me to paint your face with red ghee? Even if my guru forbids it, My name will be Vyaru."

prakrit: "लोहङ्गिणि हंसीआरेहा तालङ्कि कम्पि गम्भीरा ।,काली कलरुदाणी उक्कच्छा अट्ठ णामाई ॥"
english: "The plowman's wife laughs, The strings of the cords are heavy, The seller of black paint has eight names." ""

prakrit: "लोहङ्गिणि सव्व लहू जत्थ गुरु एक्क सा हंसी ।,जं जं वड्डइ हारो णामं जो जत्थ सो तत्थ ॥"
english: "All the blood in the Lohangini Jathas the Guru gave one laugh. Whatever is grown on the necklace, That is the name of the tree."

prakrit: "पढम होइ चउवीस मत्त अन्तर गुरु जुत्तेपिङ्गल हाँते सेस णाअ तण्हि रोला उत्ते ।,एग्गाराहा हारा रोला छन्दो जुज्जइएक्के एक्के टुट्टइ अण्णो अण्णो वड्डइ ॥"
english: "The passage is twenty - four, and the intercessor Jutte Pingale hastens, Stimulating his own roll., Moving on, The lost roll is repeated a hundred times. Either it is broken at once, Or it is widened." ""

prakrit: "पअभरु दरमरु धरणि तरणिरह धुल्लिअ झम्पिअकमठपिट्ठ टरपरिअ मेरु मन्दर सिर कम्पिअ ।,कोह चलिअ हम्मीरवीर गअजूह सँजुत्तेकिअउ कट्ठ हाकन्द मुच्छिमेच्छहके पुत्ते ॥"
english: "Foolish girl, Why don't you shake your head? Once you've walked on the mudflats of your bed And washed the mud off your back, You've got to be brave enough to walk the tightrope. It's your son's turn to grind." ""

prakrit: "कुन्द करअल मेह तालङ्ककलरुद्द कोइल कमलु ।,इन्दु सम्भु चामरु गणेसरुसहसक्खो सेस भण ॥,णाअराअ जम्पइ फणीसरु ।,तेरह अक्खर जं पलइइग्गारह वङ्केहĩ ।,अक्खर अक्खर जं वढइतं तं णाम कुणेहि ॥"
english: "Kunda karaal mein talank kalarudda koil kamalu., Indu sambhu chamru, Ganesha sahasru, Sakkho ses bhan., Natra jampai phanisseru., Terah pathiye jaatiye, Paliyeeggarah waankehin hain., Pathi patahee, What one grows, That is nama kunehi."

prakrit: "दहसत्त वण्ण पढम पअ भणह सुअणा,तह बीअंमि अट्ठारहहिं जमअ जुअ चरणा ।,एरिसि अ बीअ दल कुणहु भणइ पिङ्गलो,गन्धाणा णाम रूअउ हो पंडिअजणचित्तहरो ॥"
english: "I am completely at a loss What to say next." "The buffalo is asleep, So I have to lie down for eighteen hours, Get out of the way of the herd, Say something to the farmer, And wash away the pollen."

prakrit: "दहसत्तक्खर संठवहु पढमचरण गन्धाण ।,बीअक्खर पुणु जमअ दइ अट्ठारहइ विआण ॥"
english: "The first part of the fire is put out, the second part is burnt, and the third part is scorched by the fire."

prakrit: "कण्ण चलते कुम्म चलइ पुणुवि असरणा ।,कुम्म चलते महि चलइ भुअणभअकरणा ।,महि अ चलते महिहरु तह अ सुरअणा,चक्कवइ चलते चलइ चक्क तह तिहुअणा ॥"
english: "Eyes go on, shoots come, flowers fall, bees go, flowers grow, flowers blossom, flowers bloom, bees fly, bees flutter, bees make love, chickens fly, crickets fly, and parrots fly."

prakrit: "चउपइआ छन्दा भणइ फणिन्दाचउमत्ता गण सत्ता ।,पाएहि सगुरु करि तीस मत्त धरिचउ सअ असि अ णिरुत्ता ।,चउ छन्द लविज्जइ एक्कु ण किज्जइको जाणइ एहु भेऊ ।,कड पिङ्गल भासइ छन्द पआसइ मिअणअणि अमिअ एहू ॥"
english: "The cowherd says," "It's hot." "With a broad smile on her face She embraces him for the third time. He welcomes the tune, But she doesn't know what to do With it. The goose pimples settle on his cheek The more she refuses to listen."

prakrit: "जसु सीसहि गङ्गा गोरि अधङ्गा गिव पहिरिअ फणिहारा ।,कंठट्टिअ वीसा पिन्धण दीसा सन्तारिअ संसारा ॥,किरणावलिकन्दा वन्दिअ चन्दा णअणहि अणल फुरन्ता ।,सो सम्पअ दिज्जउ बहु सुह किज्जउ तुम्ह भवाणीकन्ता ॥"
english: "Please, my poor girl, don't be so naïve As to give your husband a bath in the Goda. If you give your wife a drink of water Around the clock, Please, ladies, Don't go out in the middle of the night. It's all thanks to you, my dear." ""

prakrit: "पिङ्गल कई दिट्ठउ छन्द उकिट्ठउ घत्त मत्त बासट्टि करि ।,चउमत्त सत्त गण बे विपाअ भण तिण्णि तिणि लहु अन्त धरि ॥"
english: "Pingle many glances, Speak much, Drink much, And dwell long. All seven count the number of people who fall asleep:" "Speak little, speak little, and sleep little." ""

prakrit: "पढमं दह बीसामो बीए मत्ताĩ अट्ठाई।,तीए तेरह विरई घत्ता मत्ताई बासट्ठि ॥"
english: "First ten twenties, then eight., Then thirteen abroad, And finally sixty." ""

prakrit: "रणदक्ख दक्खहणु जिण्ण कुसुमधणु अन्धअगन्धविणासकरु ।,सो रक्खउ सङ्करु असुरभअङ्करु गोरि णारि अद्धङ्ग धरु ॥"
english: "Protect the wild bull, Which is blind and devoid of its fragrance., So protect the hunter, Who is vulnerable, Who carries the banner of the white bull." ""

prakrit: "सो घत्तह कुलसार कित्ति अपारु णाअराअ पिङ्गल कहइ ।,एआरह वीसाम णन्दउ णाम पुणु वि सत्त तेरह विरइ ॥"
english: "So, tell me, my poor girl, How vast is this vast expanse of land And how vast is the plain beyond our reach?"

prakrit: "उड्डुउणहपह भमउ खग्ग रिउसीसहि झल्लउ ।,पक्खर पक्खर ठेल्लि पल्लि पव्वअ अप्फाला ॥,हम्मीरकज्जु जज्जल भणह कोहाणलमह मइ जलउ ।,सुलताण सीस करवाल दइ तज्जि कलेवर दिअ चलउ ॥"
english: "When he flies, The bee stings. When he hovers over the bush, The doe presses against the rafters, And the crows flutter on their wings." "Please, brother - in - law, burn my elbows!" "As Sulthan would have done If you had a heart of turmeric."

prakrit: "जो वन्दिअ सिर गङ्ग हणिअ अणङ्ग अद्धङ्गहि परिकर धरणु ।,सो जोई जणमित्त हरउ दुरित्त सङ्काहरु सङ्करचरणु ॥"
english: "One who touches a woman's head with his hands or feet But does not touch her limbs. Everyone born of such a woman Shows signs of distress." ""

prakrit: "छप्पअ छन्द छइल सुणहु अक्खरसञ्जुत्तउ ।,एआरह तसु विरइ त पुणु तेरह णिब्भन्तउ ॥,बे मत्ता धरि पढम त पुणु चउ चउ कल किज्जइ ।,मज्झट्ठिअ गण पञ्च हेट्ठ बिण्ण वि लहु दिज्जइ ॥,उलाल विरइ बे पण्णरह मत्ता अट्ठाइस सोइ ।,एम भणह मुणह छप्पअ पअ अणहा इत्थि ण किम्पि होइ ॥"
english: "If you want to hide a secret, Listen carefully. But if you don't, Write it down again. Tomorrow I'll do it all over again. If you keep this secret, My husband will give you something else. Even if he doesn't know how to say it, He will say it again. Otherwise, If you hide him, Your husband will say that you know nothing." ""

prakrit: "पिन्धउ दिढ सण्णाह वाह उप्पर पक्खर दइ ।,बन्धु समदि रण धसउ सामि हम्मीर वअण लइ ॥"
english: "Put on your robes, little girl, And walk on high. Friend, if you must run away, Take the bow of your head with you."

prakrit: "पअ पअ तलउ णिबद्ध मत्त चउबीसह किज्जइ ।,अक्खर डम्बर सरिस छन्द इअ सुद्ध भणिज्जइ ॥,आइहि छक्कलु होइ चारि चउकलउ णिरुत्तउ ।,दुक्कल अन्त णिबद्ध सेस कइ वत्थु णिवुत्तउ ।,बावण्ण सउ वि मत्तह मुणहु उल्लालउ सहिअउ गुणह ।,छप्पअ छन्द एरिसि वि होइ काĩ गन्थि गन्थि वि मरह ॥"
english: "Aunt, If you ever want to kiss her bottom And tell her how to kiss your lips, She'll do it right away. Once you've touched her breasts, They stay together four times. Once they're stuck in a rut, How can you undo that? Even a drunken fool with twenty-two sighs Can make a mess of things. Even a knot of gold will die if it's hidden in this rattle."

prakrit: "जहा सरअ ससि बिम्ब जहा हरहार हंस ठिअ ।,जहा फुल सिअ कमल जहा सिरिखंड खंड किअ॥,जहा गङ्ग कल्लोल जहा रोसाणिअ रुप्पइ ।,जहा दुद्धवर सुद्ध फेण फम्फाइ तलप्फइ ॥,पिअ पाअ पसाए दिट्ठि पुणु णिहुअ हसइ जह तरुणिजण ।,वरमन्ति चंडसर कित्ति तुअ तत्थ देक्ख हरिबम्भ भण ॥"
english: "As the sweetwood tree, Which grows taller, As the lotus with its petals, Which is the head of the farmer's field, Where the river Ganges flows in all directions, Which bursts forth with milk and fresh fumes, Which makes young men smile again When they see their wives walk past, Varmanti chandasar, How can you look so far into the horizon?"

prakrit: "आइ अन्त दुहु छक्कलउ तिण्णि तुरङ्गम मज्झ ।,तीए जगणु कि विप्पगणु कव्वह लक्खण बुज्झ ॥"
english: "O my heart, This is the end of my suffering, My three trumpets. I will awaken to see how things turn out."

prakrit: "चउ अग्गल चालीस गुरु एक्कक्के गुरु लेहु ।,जो गुरुहीणउ सक्क सो णाम ग्गहण कुणेहु ॥"
english: "One can have forty teachers at a time. If one lacks teachers, one cannot gain a good one."

prakrit: "जसु कर फणिवइ वलअ तरुणिवर तणुमह विलसइ ।,णअण अणल गल गरल विमल ससहर सिर णिवसइ ॥,सुरसरि सिरमह रहइ सअलजण दुरित दमण कर ।,हसि ससिहर हर दुरिअ विहर हर अतुल अभअवर ॥"
english: "As the tax collector puts it:" "Youth is my greatest treasure." "Not so long ago, young girl Vimal, Her head hangs loose On my husband's shoulder. Laughing mother - in - law, Allow everyone else to suffer While keeping a steady head. Every poor widow's house Is an incomparable ruin."

prakrit: "जह जह वलआ वड्डिहड तह तह णाम कुणेहु ।,सम्भुहि सउँ भण भिङ्गगण चउआलीस मुणेहु ॥"
english: "As the tail grows larger, so the name.," "Friend, tell me,'The cowherd has turned his back on me.'"

prakrit: "ता सक्को सम्भो सूरो गंडो खन्धो विजओ दप्पो,तालङ्को समरो सीहो सीसो उत्तेओ पडिवक्खो ।,परिधम्म मरालु मइन्दो दंडो मक्कलु मअणु मरहो,वासन्तो कंठो मोरो बन्धो भमरो भिण्णमरट्ठो ॥"
english: "So sambho sombre, The bangle of gold, The nail of victory, The bow of the bow, The reed of the reed, Stirred up by the arrow." "The parikarma is dead, The buffalo is chained, The Makkal man is dying, The stag is tied to the buffalo's head With a bow tied around his neck."

prakrit: "वलहदो राओ वलिओ मोहो सन्थाणो बलि मेहो,सहसक्खो बालो दरिओ सरहो दम्भो'हो उदम्भो ।,वलिअङ्को तुरओ हरिणो अन्धो मुद्धीए तह भिङ्गो,वत्थूआ णामो पिङ्गलणाओ जम्पइ छन्दपबन्धो ॥"
english: "The hunter's son is a sacrificial lamb, His friends are warriors, His wives are cowherds, His anger is fierce, His arrows are sharp, His bow is powerful, And his bow is bowed by the bow of his bow."

prakrit: "पचतालीसह वत्थुआ छन्दे छन्द विअम्भ ।,अद्धा कइ पिङ्गल कहइ चलइ ण हरिहर बम्भ ॥"
english: "There are forty-five songs in a row, each with its own rhythm. One cannot help but hear the trumpet call of Harihara." ""

prakrit: "पअह असुद्धउ पङ्गुहीण खोडउ पणिज्जइ,मत्तग्गल वाउलउ सुण्णकल कण्ण सुणिज्जइ ।,झलवज्जिअ तह बहिर अन्ध लङ्कारह रहिअउ,वुलउ छन्द उट्टवण अत्थ विणु दुब्बल कहिअउ ॥,डेरउ हट्टक्खरहिं होइ काणा गुण सव्वहĩ रहिअ ।,सव्वङ्गसुद्ध समरूअगुण छप्पअ दोस पिङ्गलु कहिअ ॥"
english: "Oh! you lame go - between! Your eyes are set wide open, Your cheeks quiver, Your ears sunken, Your eyes red from inebriation, And your face clouded with gooseflesh." "Tell me, you weakling," "He said," What you want me to say To you, You stubborn girl! "" Hide away, tell me, Pinglu, all the virtues I've learned from you. "

prakrit: "विप्प होइ बत्तीस खत्ति बेआल कहिज्जसु ।,अठतालिस लहु वेस सेस सुद्दउ सलहिज्जसु ॥,चउअग्गल पउ बीस मत्त छाणवइ ठविज्जसु ।,पचतालीसह णाम कव्वलक्खणह करिज्जसु ॥,छहबिस उल्लालहि एक्क कइ बिण्णि पाअ छप्पअ मुणहु ।,समवण्ण सरिस समदोसगुण णाम अइहत्तरि परि मुणहु ॥"
english: "Wretched man, tell me you have thirty-two braids. Please, forty-eight lips. One hundred and twenty o'clock at a time. Wait till the moon is full. Name me with forty-five. Write me a poem. Tell me, How can one hide one's feet If they are twenty-six? Try to conceal your true feelings By saying:" "They are equal in size." ""

prakrit: "तिण्णि तुरङ्गम तिअल तह छह चउतिअ तह अन्त ।,अइम उल्लाला उट्टवहु बिहु दल छप्पण मन्त ॥"
english: "Three turangams, three tilas, and six chauthis, and the end.," I mutter, "" There is nothing wrong with singing Bihu. "" "

prakrit: "जाआ जा अद्धङ्ग सीस गङ्गा लोलन्ती,सव्वाहा पूरन्ति सव्व दुक्खा तोलन्ती ।,णाआ राआ हार दीस वासा भासन्ता,वेआला जा सङ्ग णच्च दुट्ठा णासन्ता ॥,णाचन्ता कन्ता उच्छव्वे ताले भूमी कम्पले ।,जा दिढे मोक्खा पाविज्जे सो तुम्हाणं सुक्ख दे ॥"
english: "Long - eyed girl, The Ganges is slipping away, All year round she is full, All sorrow is passing. It seems as if one day there will be no more necklaces. With one too many women The earth will tremble As it rises. But if you ever reach liberation, May it be yours to dry up."

prakrit: "चउआलिस गुरु कव्वके छहबीसउ उल्लाल ।,जं गुरु टुट्टइ लहु वढइ एहत्तरि पत्थार ॥"
english: "The twenty-six steps of the fourfold guru kavva are plain.," "The more a guru is broken, the thinner his path." ""

prakrit: "अजअ बेआसी अक्खरउ गुरु सत्तरि रविरेह ।,एक्कक्खर वढ गुरु घटइ दुदुइ लहुआ देह ॥"
english: "Be still, my poor girl, Only seventy gurus remain. Once you have grown up You become a poisonous poison."

prakrit: "अजअ विजउ बलि कण्ण वीर बेआल विहण्णरु,मक्कलु हरि हर बम्भ इन्दु चन्दण सुसुहङ्करु ।,साण सीह सदूल कुम्म कोइल खर कुञ्जरु,मअण मच्छ तालङ्क सेस सारङ्ग पओहरु ॥,ता कुन्द कमलु वारण भसल सरहु जङ्गम सर बि लहइ ।,सुसरु समरु सारसु सरअ छप्पअ णाम पिङ्गलु कइ ॥"
english: "Aja vijayu bali bali kann, veerer beyal vihannaru, makkalu hari har bomb, indu chandan susuhankaru., Saan seeh sadool koom koil khar kunjaru, maan machha talank ses sarang pauharu., Taa kunda kamalu waran bhasal sirhu jangam sir bhi lehayi., Susru samruh sarasu sarasu chhap aa naam pinglu kayi."

prakrit: "मेरु मअरु मअ सिद्धि बुद्धि करअलु कमलाअरु,धवल मणउ धुअ कणउ किसणु रञ्जणु मेहाअरु ।,गिम्ह गरुड ससि सूर सल्ल णवरङ्ग मणोहरु,गअणु रअणु णरु हीरु भमरु सेहरु कुसुमाअरु,ता दिप्पु सङ्ख वसु सद्द मुणि णाअराअ पिङ्गलु कहइ ।,छप्पअ णाम एहत्तरिहि छन्द आर पत्थरि लहइ ॥"
english: "Meru maaru, maa, siddhi, karalu, kamalaru, dhaval, mannu, dhuru, kisan, rajan, meha, garam, garuda, saasi, sur, sal, navaranga, ganamuru, rayanuru, heer, bhamru, sehr, kusumaaru, tipu, sankhu, vasu, sadhana, nagaru, pinglu, kadhu, chhappu, naam, behold, The syllables of the forehead Reach the stone."

prakrit: "जत्ते सव्वहि होइ लहु अद्ध विसज्जहु ताम ।,तह वि विसज्जहु एक्कसरु एहि पमाणे णाम ॥इति षट्पदप्रकरणम ।"
english: "As long as all are equal, I shall be half as wise., Even so, one man is more wise. Such is the nature of renunciation."

prakrit: "चउमत्त करह गण चारि ठाईठवि अन्त पओहर पाई पाई।,चउसट्ठि मत्त पज्झरइ इन्दुसम चारि पाअ पज्झडिअ छन्दु ॥"
english: "After four long strokes of the axe She reached the last step. When she touched it with her hands She could not help laughing." "At the sound of the thunderclap The four steps intersect."

prakrit: "जे गञ्जिअ गोडाहिवइ राउउदंड आड्ड जसु भअ पलाउ ।,गुरुविक्कम विक्कम जिणिअ जुज्झता कण्ण परक्कम कोइ बुज्झ ॥"
english: "If the cow gives birth to a calf, Hang on by the hair and flaunt it as if it were a buffalo. Guruvikkam Vikkam Joins the fight: One's eyes are superior to none."

prakrit: "सोलह मत्ता पाउ अलिल्लहबे वि जमक्का भेउ अडिल्लह ।,हो ण पओहर किम्पि अडिल्लहअन्त सुपिअ भण छन्दु अडिल्लह ॥"
english: "Sola matta paav alillahabe bhi jamakka bheu adillah., Isn't there something wrong with your husband? In the end, you have to say good and bad." ""

prakrit: "जिणि आसावरि देसा दिण्हउसुत्थिर डाहररज्जा लिण्हउ ।,कालञ्जर जिणी कित्ती थप्पिअधणु आवज्जिअ धम्मक अप्पिअ ॥"
english: "As long as there is hope," he said, "May the sunshine in your heart Be bright. How many slaps in a day Do you expect of the dharma?"

prakrit: "लहु गुरु एक्क णिअम णहि जेहापअ पअ लक्खउ उत्तमरेहा ।,सुकइ फर्णिदह कंठह वलसोलहमत्तं पाआकुलअं ॥"
english: "Lest one master should neglect one's worthiness, There is room for one hundred thousand good men." "On the neck of a woman whose limbs are tied in a knot Are like bracelets tied around her neck."

prakrit: "सेर एक जइ पावउँ धित्तामंडा वीस पकावउँ णित्ता ।,टङ्कु एक जउ सइन्धव पाआजो हउ रङ्क सोइ हउ राआ ॥"
english: "Every one knows how to knead and bake. One cannot bend one's skirt. The other has to bend over and lie down on its back."

prakrit: "सोलह मत्तह बे वि पमाणहुबीअ चउत्थहĩ चारिदहा ।,मत्तह सट्ठि समग्गल जाणहुचारि पआ चउबोल कहा ॥"
english: "Sixteen meters," he said, "and there are four hundred." At seven o'clock, He stammered and chewed all over. "

prakrit: "रे धणि मत्तमअङ्गअगामिणिखञ्जणलोअणि चन्दमुही ।,चञ्चल जुव्वण जात ण जाणहिछइल समप्पइ काई णही ॥"
english: "Oh! rich man! There is nothing wrong with your body But you have to face the moon. For a restless youth knows nothing of what he has to deal with."

prakrit: "तीअ ठाइ दहपञ्च जाणहु,चारिम एग्गारहहĩ,पञ्चमे हि दह पञ्च आणहु,अट्ठा सट्ठी पूरवहुअग्गे दोहा देहु ।,राअसेण सुपसिद्ध इअ रड्ड भणिज्जइ एहु ॥"
english: "In that place, ten people know each other, the fourth person knows everything, in the fifth person there are ten people, and in the eight who know everything there are two. It is as if the sun has illuminated everything."

prakrit: "विसम तिकल संठवहु तिण्णि पाइक्क करहु लइ,अन्त णरिन्द कि विप्प पढम बे मत्त अवर पइ ।,समपअ तिअ पाइक्क सव्वलहु अन्त विसज्जहु,चउठा चरण विचारि एक लहु कहिअ लिज्जहु ॥,इम पञ्च पाअ उट्टवण कइ वत्थु णाम पिङ्गल कुणइ ।,ठवि दोसहीण दोहा चरण राअसेण रड्डह भणइ ॥"
english: "Whom are you looking out for? A flock of parrots standing on the bank of a tree, Drunk on liquor at first sight, At last drunk on wine, And at last swooning all over. One can think of four steps. Tell me, Can't you imagine what it's like to walk on five feet? One can't say what it is to be named Pingal. She mutters without saying a word. Two steps in a row Of rice are enough to stop her." ""

prakrit: "भमइ महुअर फुल्ल अरविन्दणव केसुकाणण जुलिअ ।,सव्वदेस पिकराव वुल्लिअसिअल पवण लहु वहइ ॥,मलअकुहर णववल्लि पेल्लिअ ।,चित्त मणोभवसर हणइदूर दिगन्तर कन्त ।,किम परि अप्पउ वारिहउइम परिपलिअ दुरन्त ॥"
english: "Marry the bee, Whose flower is Aravindan, The weevil carries the poisonous nectar of wild flowers all over the place, The young cucumber is poisonous, The land is salty, The horizon is impassable. How can one appease a man Whose heart is set on fire And whose limbs are completely paralyzed?"

prakrit: "करही णन्दा मोहिणी चारुसेणि तह भद्द ।,राअसेण तालङ्क पिअ सत्त वत्थु णिप्फन्द ॥"
english: "Karri nanda, Mohini, charuseni, taalanka, raasena, peeya, saath vaathu nipaandha." ""

prakrit: "पढम तीअ पञ्चम पअह तेरह मत्ता जासु ।,बीअ चउत्थ एगारहहĩ करहि भणिज्जइ तासु ॥"
english: "First let her say five times, then let her speak three times.," "Then, on the fourth day, let her repeat her words." ""

prakrit: "पढम तीअ पञ्चम पअह मत्त होइ दह चारि ।,बीअ चउत्थ एगारहहĩ णन्द भणिञ्ज विआरि ॥"
english: "The first five are drunken, the next four., And the fourth is drunken talking." ""

prakrit: "पढम तीअ पञ्चम पअह णव दह मत्ता जासु ।,बीअ चउत्थ एगारहहिं तं मोहिणी मुणिआसु ॥"
english: "First let her drink five ounces of milk, then let her sip another." ""

prakrit: "पढम तीअ पञ्चम पअह मत्त पण्णरह जासु ।,बीअ चउथ एआरहहĩ चारुसेणि मुणिआसु ॥"
english: "On the fifth day of the festival, Be careful not to inebriate yourself. On the fourth day, Bow down before the God of Love." ""

prakrit: "पढम तीअ पञ्चम पअह मत्ता दहपञ्चाइ ।,बीअ चउत्थे बारहहĩ भद्द णाम कहिआइ ॥"
english: "She said," "First, I've got five hundred and fifty." "Then, on the very fourth day, She called out a nasty name."

prakrit: "पढम तीअ पञ्चम पअह मत्त पण्णरह पजत्थ ।,सम बारह अरु एक्कदह राअसेणु भणु तत्थ ॥"
english: "First let her drink the fifth drink, then the next.," "That's what the demon said: One more day." ""

prakrit: "पढम तीअ पञ्चम पअह मत्ता सोलह जासु ।,सम बारह अरु एक्कदह तालङ्किणि भणु तासु ॥"
english: "First she took five, then she took sixteen. Then she took twelve more and began to speak in unison." ""

prakrit: "भणु पउमावत्ती ठाणं ठाणं चउमत्ता गण अट्ठाआ।,धुअ कण्णो करअलु विप्पो चरणो पाए पाअ उकिट्ठाआ ॥,जइ पलइ पओहर किमइ मणोहर पीडइ तह णाअक्कगुणो ।,पिअरह सन्तासइ कइ उव्वासइ इअ चंडालचरित्त गणे ॥"
english: "She said," "My daughter - in - law, There is a whole bunch of smoke coming from the fire." "Your eyes are red, Your feet are pallid, Your face is swollen. If she has to flee, What pain can I inflict on her? It's not her fault. Dear friend, How can one describe the nature of this storm?"

prakrit: "भअ भज्जिअ वङ्गा भङ्गु कलिङ्गा तेलङ्गा रण मुक्कि चले ।,मरहट्ठा धिट्ठा लग्गिअ कट्ठा सोहा भअ पाअ पले ॥,चम्पारण कम्पा पव्वअ झम्पा आत्था आत्थी जीव हरे ।,कासीसर राणा किअउ पआणा विज्जाहर भण मन्तिवरे ॥"
english: "Foolish girl, The Vanga Vanga has broken the kalinga and the Telanga has sunken into the mud. When he fell asleep, His wife sighed And his feet trembled. When the champaran quivered, The jhumppa fluttered And the elephant clung to his life. Who is the ruler of Kasisara, And who does not know how to weep?"

prakrit: "दोहा लक्खण पढम पढि कव्वह अद्ध णिरुत्त ।,कुंडलिआ बुहअण मुणहु उलाले सञ्जुत्त ।,उल्लाले सञ्जुत्त जमक सुद्धउ सलहिज्जइ ।,चउआलह सउ मत्त सुकइ दिढबन्धु कहिज्जइ ।,चआलह सउ मत्त जासु तणु भूषण सोहा ।,एम कुंडलिआ जाणहु पढम जह पढिअइ दोहा ॥"
english: "When the couplet Lakhana Padham is recited, The couplet Adha Nrutta., Kundalya Buhana Munhu Ulale Sanjuta., Ulala Sanjuta Jamaka Sudha, Sulaha Matam, Sukai Diddhabandha, Chaloha Matam Matam Jasu Tana Bhushan Soha., M., Kundaliya Jaanu Padham As the couplets are recited."

prakrit: "ढाल्ला मारिअ ढिल्लि महँ मुच्छि. मेच्छसरीर ।,पुर जज्जल्ला मन्तिवर चलिअ वीर हम्मीर ॥,चलिअ वीर हम्मीर पाअभर मेइणि कम्पई ।,दिग मग णह अन्धार धूलि सूरह रह झम्पइ ॥,दिग मग णह अन्धार आण खुरसाणक आल्ला ।,दरमरि दमसि विपक्ख मारुढिल्ली महँ ढाल्ला ॥"
english: "Slap him, big mustache. Make him wear a mask. Purr, jajjalla mantra varr, purr, brave hammer., Let the brave hammer tremble at the feet of the maiden.," "Then do not go in darkness, For the dust of the hearth quenches the breath of the God of thunder., Or, for that matter, Do not go out in the dark, For it is the fire of the scorpion., Every time you break your bracelets, You cause great pain." ""

prakrit: "पअ पअ ठवहु जाणि गअणङ्गउ मत्त विहूसिणा,भाअउ बीस कलअ सरअग्गल लहु गुरुसेसिणा ॥,पढमहि मत्त चारि गण किज्जहु गणह पआसिओ,बीसक्खर सअल पअह पिअ गुरु अन्त पआसिओ ॥"
english: "You know how to be firm: You're drunk with wine, Your brother - in - law has had his way for twenty days, Your wife has had her period, And your husband has been absent for some time." ""

prakrit: "पढमहि चक्कलु होइ गण अन्तहि दिज्जहु हारु ।,बीसक्खर गअणङ्ग भणु मत्त पचीस विआरु ॥"
english: "The girl has grown so thin She finally loses consciousness. Instead of talking she mutters," "There are twenty-five." ""

prakrit: "भञ्जिअ मलअ चोलवइ णिपलिअ गञ्जिअ गुञ्जरा,मालवराअ मलअगिरि लुक्किअ परिहरि कुञ्जरा ।,खुरासाण खुहिअ रण महँ लङ्घिअ मुहिअ साअरा,हम्मीर चलिअ हारव पलिअ रिउगणह काअरा ॥"
english: "Foolish girl, Don't be so naïve: Goose pimples hovering on the head of the hunter's wife, Lurking above the thickets of garlands, Mistakes made by the landowner's son - in - law On the pretext that he has a field of jasmine." ""

prakrit: "आइग इन्दु जत्थ हो पढमहि दिज्जइ तिणि धणुहरं,तह पाइकजुअल परिसंठवहु विविहचित्तसुन्दरं ॥"
english: "Now that Indu is gone, I will give her three grains of gold, As well as the jewels of the pyre, Which together compose so much beauty."

prakrit: "सरसइ लइअ पसाउ तह पुहवी करहि कइत्त कइअणा,महुअरचरण अन्त लइ दिज्जहु दोअइ मुणहु बुहअणा ॥"
english: "Take the mustard and grind it, Then when will you know how to do it again? Take the bee's turn and give it to the poor girl."

prakrit: "छक्कलु मुह संठावि कइ चक्कलु पञ्च ठवेहु ।,अन्तहि एक्कड हार दइ दोअइ छन्द कहेहु ॥"
english: "When one's mouth is shut, How many licks and five slaps? One can give only one slap In a poem." ""

prakrit: "दाणव देव बे वि दुक्कन्तउ गिरिवर सिहर कम्पिओ,हअगअपाअघाअ उतउ धूलिहि गअण झम्पिओ ॥"
english: "The god of charity is also distressed: His head quivers at the poor farmer's feet, His feet shake as if they were dust." ""

prakrit: "पढम दह दिज्जिआ पुण वि तह किज्जिआपुण वि दह सत्त तह विरइ जाआ ।,एम परि बि बिहु दलमत्त सततीस पलएहु कहु झुलणा णाअराआ ॥"
english: "First ten degrees, then ten, then seven, Then the fire was quenched." "What more do I have to lose By burning my heart with such burning fire?" ""

prakrit: "सहस मअमत्त गअ लाख लख पक्खरिअ,साहि दुइ साजि खेलन्त गिन्दू ।,कोप्पि पिअ जाहि तह थप्पि जसु विमल महि,जिणइ णहि कोइ तुह तुलुक हिन्दू ॥"
english: "Friend, let a million and a half birds pass by. Gindoo, two pretenders. Drink up the anger That hits you so hard That no one can conquer you, Vimal Mahy." ""

prakrit: "धुअ धरिअ दिअवर णव गण कमलणअणि,बुहअण मण सुहइ जु जिम ससि रअणि सोहए ।,पुण विअ विरइ बिहु पअ गअवरगमणि,रगण पर फणिवइ भण सुमरु बुहअण मोहए ॥"
english: "Hold on to the smoke: The new lotuses are bright, The flowers are fragrant, The nights are pleasant, And the nights are long. Once the Bihu is over They will go away, But their affection will last a hundred years."

prakrit: "बिहु दल णव पल विप्पगण जोहल अन्त ठवेहु ।,मत्त इआलिस खञ्ज पअ दहगण तत्थ मुणेहु ॥"
english: "Bihu is a long way off, There will be no end to it, For as long as I am drunk I will wipe away every trace of it."

prakrit: "अहि ललइ महि चलइ गिरि खसइ हर खलइ,ससि घुमइ अमिअ वमइ मुअल जिवि उट्टए ।,पुणु धसइ पुणु खसइ पुणु ललइ पुणु घुमइ,पुणु वमइ जिविअ विविह परि समर दिट्ठए ॥"
english: "Here the buffalo walks, The mountain slopes, The sapling spins, The nectar bends, The pearl twists, The bull swallows again, The stag twists again, And again the stag looks at the living creature In all sorts of ways."

prakrit: ".,ससिवअणि गअगमणि पअ पअ दिअ छगण पअहर सह सिक्ख ।,पढ पढम बि बिह लहु पअलि दिअगण सहिअ जुअल दल भणइ स सिक्ख ॥"
english: "" "First let him learn to walk, Then let him walk, And then let him go." "Even after he's finished reading He can still walk If he feels like riding a yoke With his friends."

prakrit: "मत्त अठाइस पढमे बीए बत्तीस मत्ताई।,पअ पअ अन्ते लहुआ सुद्धा सिक्खा विआणेहु ॥"
english: "In twenty-eight lessons he has learned thirty-two., In the end, even a leech will learn to speak." ""

prakrit: "फुलिअ महु भमर बहु रअणिपहुकिरण लहु अवअरु वसन्त ।,मलअगिरि कुहर धरि पवण वहसहव कह सुण सहि णिअल णहि कन्त ॥"
english: "Flower, bee, There are many flowers on the horizon, But spring is late. Once the jasmine has reached the mist, How can one help hearing what she has to say?"

prakrit: "पढम चरण ससिवअणि मिअणअणि णव दिअगण,पअल पुण वि तह रअण ठवहु अन्तए कण्णो ।,पिङ्गल णाअ भणन्ता माला सेसं पि गाहम्म ॥"
english: "The first step is cursed, The next is empty, And so is the next. Even at this late hour One's ears are pricked by the rays of the moon. Pingala does not say:" "I bow before the garland." ""

prakrit: "पढम होइ णव विप्पगण जोहल कण्ण ठवेहु ।,गाहा अद्धा अन्त दइ माला छन्द कहेहु ॥"
english: "The reader will notice that the ears are pricked by the syllables of the new couplet.," "At the end of the song you will hear the rhythm of the garland." ""

prakrit: "बरिस जल भमइ घण गअण सिअल पवण मणहरण,कणअपिअरि णचइ विजुरि फुल्लिआ णीवा ।,पत्थरवित्थरहिअला पिअला णिअलं ण आवेइ ॥"
english: "The poor water buffalo has become so dense That it has made the whole of the wetland swollen by the rain, That it no longer gives way, Like a pearl scattered on a stone's back."

prakrit: "चुलिआला जइ देह किमु दोहा उप्पर मत्तह पञ्चइ ।,पअ पअ उप्पर संठवहु सुद्ध कुसुमगण अन्तह दिज्जइ ॥"
english: "If the hearth is scorched, The jasmine's body quivers with excitement Above the couplets., Then, on top of the couplet, The fragrant flowers are given their due." ""

prakrit: "दोहा सङ्खा संठहु उम्परि पञ्चइ मत्त ।,अट्ठदहुप्परि बीस दुइ चुलिआला उक्खित्त ॥"
english: "Over and over and over again two hundred and fifty are drunk." "On top of eight hundred and twenty two stoves are burning."

prakrit: "राआ लुद्ध समाज खल बहु कलहारिणि सेवक धुत्तउ ।,जीवण चाहसि मुक्ख जइ परिहरु घर जइ बहुगुणजुत्तउ ॥"
english: "Wretched society is spoiled with many quarrelsome servants. If you want to live, go to the headman's house And multiply your wealth."

prakrit: "सो सोरट्ठउ जाणजं दोहा विपरीअ ठिअ ।,पअ पअ जमक वखाणणाअराअ पिङ्गल कहिअ ॥"
english: "So kindly reverse the couplet. Please, tell that man who is praising you is a Pingle." ""

prakrit: "सो माणिअ पुणवन्तजासु भत्त पंडिअ तणअ ।,जासु घरिणि गुणवन्तिसो वि पुहवि सग्गह णिलअ ॥"
english: "So, dear go - between, find out what's good for you. Even a good wife's worthiness Makes her unhappy." ""

prakrit: "सगणा भगणा दिअगणईमत्त चउद्दह पअ पलई ।,संठइ वङ्को विरह तहा हाकलि रूअउ एहु कहा ॥"
english: "The poor girl has run away after fourteen days of being betrayed. Stopped being angry But stopped being angry." ""

prakrit: "मत्त चउद्दह पढम दल एआरह वण्णेहि ।,दुह अक्खर उत्तर दलहि हाकलि छन्द कहेहि ॥"
english: "Mat chaudah padam dal erah vananehi., Duh patah utar dalhi hakali padam kehtehi."

prakrit: "उच्चउ छाअण विमल धरा तरुणी घरिणी विणअपरा ।,वित्तक पूरल मुद्दहरा वरिसा समआ सुक्खकरा ॥"
english: "Take care, Vimal, That the young wife Weaves herself into the household. The full weight of her finances Makes the marriage unhappy." ""

prakrit: "जसु पलइ सक्ख पअहरह एक ।,चउमत्त बे वि महुभार एवि ॥"
english: "Whatever the farmer grows, that too with the help of honey, is one heap."

prakrit: "जसु चन्द सीस पिन्धणह दीस ।,सो सम्भु एउ तुह सुब्भ देउ ॥"
english: "As the moon wears thin, so the moon gives you happiness."

prakrit: "गारह मत्त करीज अन्त पओहर दीज।,एहु सुछन्द अहीर जङ्घइ पिङ्गल वीर ॥"
english: "Don't worry, it will all pay off in the end. This is the Pingala warrior's favorite thigh." ""

prakrit: "सुन्दरि गुज्जरि णारि लोअण दीह विसारि ।,पीण पओहरभार लोलइ मोत्तिअहार ॥"
english: "Lovely Gujjar woman, The days are long, Drinking heavily laden with pearls."

prakrit: "कुन्तअरु धणुद्धरु हअवरु छक्कलु बि बि पाइक्क दले,बत्तीसह मत्तह पअ सुपसिद्धउ जाणह बुहअण हिअअतले ।,सउबीस अठग्गल कल सम्पुण्णउ रूअउ फणि भासिअ भुअणे,दंडअल णिरुत्तउ गुरु सञ्जुत्तउ पिङ्गल अं जपन्त मणे ॥"
english: "Aunt, There must be something very special about your skirt: It's white, your hair is white, Your eyes are red, You know you're wearing them, And your face is smeared with gooseflesh. Tomorrow the poor girl will be completely covered with red ghee. Stop hanging around by the noose. I promise I'll take care of you."

prakrit: "राअह भग्गन्ता दिअ लग्गन्ता परिहरि हअ गअ घर घरिणी,लोरहĩ भरु सरवरु पअ परु परिकरु लोट्टई पिट्टइ तणु धरणी ।,पुणु उट्ठइ सम्भलि कर दन्तङ्गुलि बाल तणअ कर जमल करे,कासीसर राआ णेहलु काआ करु माआ पुणु थप्पि धरे ॥"
english: "Hey, you naughty girl, Get out of the house, Take care of yourself, And go after everyone else. Instead of running away, Get up again, Brush your teeth and brush your teeth, And slap your mother again." ""

prakrit: "सिर देह चउ मत्तलहु एक कर अन्त ।,कुन्तेक्क तसु मज्झदीपक्क सो बुज्झ ॥"
english: "Head, body, and limbs are one and the same. But when the midday lamp is turned on, that is wisdom." ""

prakrit: "जसु हत्थ करवाल विप्पक्खकुलकाल ।,सिर सोह वर छत्त सम्पुण्णससिमत्त ॥"
english: "Jasu hathakavala vipakshakulakala.," "The whole roof is smooth except for the head." ""

prakrit: "गण विप्प सगण धरि पअह पअंभण सिंहअलोअण छन्द वरं ।,गुणि गण मण बुज्झहु णाअ भणाणहि जगणु ण भगणु ण कण्ण गणा ॥"
english: "Get up early, count the number of people, And recite the shloka of the lion." "Countless people, I dare say, Speak plainly, For neither God nor eye counts."

prakrit: "विप्प सगण पअ बे वि गण अन्त विसज्जहि हार ।,पच्छा हेरि कइत्त करु सोलह कल पत्थार ॥"
english: "Veep, count the days, Count the nights, Cut the emerald stone in half." ""

prakrit: "हणु उज्जर गुज्जर राअबलंदल दलिअ चलिअ मरहट्ठबलं ।,बल मोलिअ मालवराअकुलाकुल उज्जल कलचुलि कण्ण फुला ॥"
english: "" "Go, white gujra, Stretch out your long hair, Lift up your right eye, For it is strong." "- The garland girl's eyes are red with excitement."

prakrit: "जत्थ पढम छअ मत्त पअप्पअ दिज्जएपञ्चमत्त चउमत्त गणा णहि किज्जए।,सम्भलि अन्त लहू गुरु एक्कक चाहएमुद्धि पअङ्गम छन्द विअक्खण सोहए ॥"
english: "Wherever the path is walked, There is no need to count fivefold. However much blood the master may spit, He always finds it more pleasant to utter the first syllable." ""

prakrit: "पअ पअ आइहि गुरुआ पिङ्गल पभणेइ सअल णिब्भन्ती ।,छन्द पवङ्गम दिट्ठो मत्ताणं एकबीसन्ती ॥"
english: "Come, my lord, The plowman has become so addicted to the plow that he forgets all about it. If you look at the rice paddies You will notice that they are monotonous."

prakrit: "तिक्कलु चउकल पञ्चकल तिअ गण दूर करेहु ।,छक्कलु तिणि पलन्त जेहि लहु गुरु अन्त मुणेहु ॥१८७ का"
english: "Tikkalu choukalu, remove the five kalas from her countenance.," "The moment she touches the three chaukkalu flowers, The Guru will cease to be." "187"

prakrit: "णच्चइ चञ्चल विज्जुलिआ सहि जाणएमम्मह खग्ग किणीसइ जलहरसाणए ।,फुल्ल कलम्बअ अम्बर डम्बर दीसएपाउस पाउ घणाघण सुमुहि वरीसए ॥"
english: "Please, my fickle glances: Why waste your time with those damned flowers? They must be swollen by the summer heat." ""

prakrit: "गुरु लहु णहि णिम्म णिम्म णहि अक्खर पलइ पओहर विसम समं,जहि कहुँ णहि णिम्मह तरल तुरअ जिमि परस विदिस दिस अगमगमं ।,गण पञ्च चउक्कल पलइ णिरन्तर अन्त सगण धुअ कन्त गणं,परिचलइ सुपरि परि लील लिलावइ कल बत्तीस विसामकरं ॥"
english: "Teacher, No, you're not supposed to go up in flames, Just like the lotus of my foot, Which flows from side to side, Like a fluid stream flowing from one hole to the next." "Countless people flock to one spot, Like the column of smoke rising from the fire of love, Running through the whole lotus Tomorrow thirty-two."

prakrit: "घर लग्गइ अग्गि जलइ धह धह कइ दिग मग णहपह अणल भरे,सव दीस पसरि पाइक्क लुलइ धणि थणहर जहण दिआव करे ।,भअ लुक्किअ थक्किअ वहरि तरुणिजण भइरव भेरिअ सद्द पले,महि लाइ पट्टइ रिउसिर टुट्टइ जक्खण वीर हमीर चले ॥"
english: "The fire goes on in the house, Smokes all over, Fills the attic with water, Spreads over the whole day, Succeeds in allaying the thirst of the poor." "Dear girl, The days are fleeting And the nights are long."

prakrit: "गण चारि पञ्चक्कल ठविज्जसु बीअ ठामहि छक्कलो,पअ पअह अन्तहि गुरु करिज्जसु वण्णणेण सुसव्वलो ।,दह चारि दुक्कड दहदु माणहु मत्त ठाइस पाअओ,हरिगीअ छन्द पसिद्ध जाणहु पिङ्गलेण पआसिओ ॥"
english: "There are four sets of five syllables in a song: First the syllable is stuck in there, then the syllables are stuck in it, Then the end of the verse:" "The teacher has done his best to describe you." "Then, poor man, if you take ten syllables with you, You'll find them stuck in your throat."

prakrit: "बीए छक्कलु ठावि कहु चारि पञ्चक्कल देहु ।,बारह उत्तर मत्त सउ माणसु अङ्ग ठवेहु ॥"
english: "If you say that there are four Panchakalas, I reply: Twelve. So do all human beings." ""

prakrit: "गअ गअहि दुक्किअ तरणि लुक्किअ तुरअ तुरअहि जुज्झिआ,रह रहहि मीलिअ धरणि पीडिअ अप्प पर णहि बुज्झिआ ।,बल मिलिअ आइअ पत्ति धाइउ कम्प गिरिवरसीहरा,उच्छलइ साअर दीण काअर वइर वड्डिअ दीहरा ॥"
english: "Gone are these sorrowful nights, Hidden away for a while, Now long past, Yet without a trace of discernment On your part, As if you had no strength." "Come, take care of yourself," "Said the farmer," Now cover your face with a blanket. "

prakrit: "पढमं दह रहणं अट्ठवि रहणं पुणु वसु रहणं रसरहणं,अन्ते गुरु सोहइ महिअल मोहइ सिद्ध सराहइ वरतरुणं ।,जइ पलइ पओहर किमइ मणोहर हरइ कलेवर तासु कई,तिब्भङ्गी छन्दं सुक्खाणन्दं भणइ फर्णिदो विमलमई ॥"
english: "First stay awake, then return, Then come the rainy season, Then rejoice, finally, The rainy season. If one has to flee, One can escape, For how long? One cannot escape, One loses one's temper, One runs out of time, One recites the most beautiful Vimalmai." ""

prakrit: "सिर किज्जिअ गङ्गं गोरि अधङ्गं हणिअअणङ्गं पुरदहणं,किअफणिवइहारं तिहुअणसारं वन्दिअछारं रिउमहणं ।,सुरसेविअचरणं मुणिगणसरणं भवभअहरणं सूलधरं,साणन्दिअवअणं सुन्दरणअणं गिरिवरसअणं णमह हरं ॥"
english: "Head high, The Ganges is white, The banks of the Narmada are smooth, The Vindhya Range is broad, The rivers are swollen, The streets are deserted, And the roads are impassable." ""

prakrit: "तीस दुइ मत्तह एरि सँजुत्तह बुहअण राअ भणन्ति णरा,विसम तिअ ठामहि एरिस भाअहि पअ पअ दीसइ कण्ण घरा ।,ता दह पढम ढावे अट्ठ अं तीअ चउद्दह किअ णिलओ,जो एरिसि छन्दे तिहुअणवन्दे सो जण बुज्झउ दुम्मिलओ ॥"
english: "Tees doi mattha hai, eri sanjutta hai, buhaan raha ban raha hai, visam tika hai, teeche padma dhaane hai, aise padma padhama dhave aate aise aise chudah ki nilao. One who listens to such tunes loses his mind." ""

prakrit: "दह वसु चउदह विरह करु विसम कण्ण गण देहु ।,अन्तर विप्प पइक्क गण दुम्मिल छन्द कहेहु ॥"
english: "Dah vasudha chaudha vivadha karu, visam kann gana dehu., Antar vippa pikeka, Gana dummil chaand kehtehu."

prakrit: "जइ किज्जिअ धाला जिण्णु णिवाला भाटुन्ता पिट्टेत चले,भञ्जाविअ चीणा दप्यहि हीणा लोहावल हाकन्द पले ।,आड्डा उड्डाविअ कित्ती पाविअ मोडिअ मालवराअबले,तेलङ्गा भग्गिअ बहुरिण लग्गिअ कासीराआ ज खण चले ॥"
english: "If you want to have a chat, Try hanging out with someone. If you'd like to have fun, Try dressing in a suitcase That has cotton threads, Brush with red ghee, And cover your face With iron girdle, Try making love To someone you know." ""

prakrit: "णाअ पभण तिण्णि छगण अन्त करहि जोहलं,हार ठविअ पुणु वि सुपिअ विप्पगणहि सव्वलं ।,तिणि धरहि बे वि करहि अन्त रगण लक्खए,कोइ जणइ दप्प भणइ हीर सुकइ पक्खए ॥"
english: "In this world, When three people have had their way, They have accomplished something, Once again they have done it, And once they have, They suffer it all. Even in this way, The end is marked by anger. Someone will say," "Heer, heer, dry side." ""

prakrit: "हार सुपिअ भण विप्पगण तीए भिण्ण सरीर ।,जोहल अन्ते संठवहु तेइस मत्तह हीर ॥"
english: "Suck on the necklace, you fool, She has a very different body. If the yoke stops in the end It's my heart." ""

prakrit: "धिक्कदलण थोङ्गदलण तक तरुण रिङ्गए,णं ण णु कट दिङ्ग दुकट रङ्ग चल तुरङ्ग ए ।,धूलि धवल हक्क सबल पक्खिपबल पत्तिए ।,कण्ण चलइ कुम्म ललइ भुम्मि भरइ कित्तिए ॥"
english: "Foolish lotus, The young man has rung till the lotus is torn off. No one has cut him yet. The trumpet is burning, The dust has blown, The right side is firmly on its feet. How can one's eyes wither And the earth tremble?"

prakrit: "पअ पढम पलइ जहĩ सुणहि कमलमुहि दह वसु पुणु वसु विरड करे,सब पअ मुणि दिअगण दिअ विरम सगण सिरिफणिवइ भण सुकइवरे ।,दह तिगुण करहि कल पुण वि धरि जुअल एम परि परिठउ चउचरणा,जइ पलइ कवहु गुरु कवहु ण परिहरु बुहअण मणहरु जलहरणा ॥"
english: "First she will flee As soon as she hears that the lotus is wilting, Then she will munch on it, Then give it all up, Then make her friends fast, Then say:" "I'm off." "But if she does, Then do it three times as well. Tomorrow, again, I promise, The yoke will be on her shoulders And her hair will be wet If she refuses to budge."

prakrit: "बत्तीस होइ मत्ता अन्ते सगणाĩ ठावेहि ।,सव्व लहू जइ गुरुआएक्को वा बे वि पाएहि ॥"
english: "Thirty-two hoes, Mother - in - law, In the end all the blood will be given to one or another of the elders."

prakrit: "खुर खुर खुदि खुदि महि घघर रख कलइ णणणगिदि करि तुरअ चले,टटटगिदि पलइ टपु धसइ धरणि धर चकमक कर बहु दिसि चमले ।"
english: "The hoof should bend slightly, The bee should be kept in a cage, If you have to walk a long way You should be able to spot the parrot by looking at it."

prakrit: "चलु दमकि दमकि दलु चल पइकबलु घुलकि घुलकि करिवर ललिआ,वद मणुसअल करइ विपख हिअअ सल हमिर वीर जब रण चलिआ ॥"
english: "Chalo damaki damaki dalu chalo, peacock peacock, kariwar lalia, vad manushyal kar vipakh hi sal hamir vir when the race is on."

prakrit: "पिअ भणमि मणोहरु पल्लि पओहरु सुहव सुहाव सुसिद्ध खणो थिर करहि मणो,जइ राअ विवत्तिउ अणुसर खत्तिअ कट्ठिकए बहि छन्द भणो जिम खलइ रिणो ।,बि बि सल्ल पहिल्लिअ तुरअ वहिल्लिअ हअ गअ पअ पसरन्त धरा गुरु सज्जिकरा,जइ जग्गि णिरुत्तउ दहगणजुत्तउ चउ सन्धिहि चालीस धरा भणु मअणहरा ॥"
english: "I will tell you the truth," replied the master, "If you think very well of your wife's breasts, Which, for some reason, give the wrong impression When she speaks rudely And mutter nonsense, You'll be proved wrong. But if you think well of yourself, Going from door to door, Spreading mud on your face Is quite extraordinary. For waking up in the middle of the night, Judging by your husband's countenance, Would be forty times as much trouble."

prakrit: "बे वि मत्त सिर ठावि कहु वलआ अन्त ठवेहु ।,णव चउकल गण मज्झ धरि मअणहराĩ करेहु ॥"
english: "Anybody who says that with an inebriated head will meet the end. I will cherish my good name for all my life."

prakrit: "जिणि कंस विणासिअ कित्ति पआसिअ मुट्ठि अरिट्टि विणास करे गिरि हत्थ धरे,जमलज्जुण भञ्जिअ पअभर गञ्जिअ कालिअ कुल संहार करे जस भुअण भरे ।,चाणूर विहंडिअ णिअकुल मंडिअ राहामुह महुपाण करे जिमि भमरवरे,सो तुम्ह णराअण विष्पपराअण चित्तह चिन्तिअ देउ वरा भअभीअहरा ॥"
english: "If you want to weep, Weeping and gnashing of teeth, Hold out our hands, Thighs twitching and shaking, A bunch of grasshoppers hovering around Your neck And a bunch of crickets hovering above You." "Who cares if you're scared of bees, Bee?" "They are afraid you might poison them too."

prakrit: "चउसन्धिहि चालीस कल दह गण तत्थ मुणेहु ।,पअहर वज्जिअ हे सुपिअ मअणहराĩ कुणेहु ॥"
english: "Forty kala ten gana taththa munehu, paahar vajjiya, Supiya madhanahariya kunehu."

prakrit: "एहु छन्द सुलक्खण भणइ विअक्खण जम्पइ पिङ्गल णाउ,विसमइ दह अक्खर पुणु अट्ठक्खर पुणु एगारह ठाउ ।,गण आइहि छक्कलु पञ्च चउक्कुलु अन्त गुरु लहु देहु,सउ सोलह अग्गल मत्त समग्गल भण मरहट्ठा एहु ।२०८॥"
english: "This is the first time I have heard such a sound. It is repeated ten times in a row, once on each leg, and again eight times on each side. The last time the teacher touches me It is as follows:" "A hundred and sixteen fires burn, And the whole forest is burnt to the ground." "208"

prakrit: "जसु मित्त धणेसा ससुर गिरीसा तह विहु पिन्धण दीस,जइ अमिअह कन्दा णिअलहि चन्दा तह विहु भोअण वीस ।,जइ कणअ सुरङ्गा गोरि अधङ्गा तह विहु डाकिणि सङ्ग,जो जस हि दिआवा देव सहावा कबहु ण हो तसु भङ्ग ॥"
english: "As for me, my dear, father - in - law, Let me dress for the day As well as the night. If I give in to your jealousy, Allow me to weep for my poor brother. If my heart is stuck in a quagmire, Let it break, As it were, With the devil's wife."

prakrit: "गाहू,गाहा,विगाहा,उग्गाहा,गाहिणी,सीहिणी,खन्धा,दोहा,उक्कच्छा,रोला,गन्धाण,चउपइआ,घत्ता,घत्ताणन्द,छप्याआ,पज्झडिआ,अडिल्ला,पाआउलअं,चउबोला,णउपअ,पउमावत्ती,कुंडलिआ,गअणङ्गउ,दोअई,झुलणा,खञ्जपअ,सिक्खा,माला,चुलिआला,सोरद्धा,हाकलि,महुआर,महारु,दंडअरु,दीपक,सिंहालोअ,पवङ्गा,लीलावइ,हरिगीआ,तिअभङ्गी,दुम्मिला,हीरो,जनहरणी,मअणहरा,मरहट्ठा पचतालीस धरा ।,इति मत्तावित्त परिच्छेओ ।"
english: "Gahu, gaha, vigaha, uggaha, gahini, seekhni, khandha, doha, ukkacha, rola, gandhana, chaupaiya, ghatta, ghananda, chhapaiya, pajjadiya, addilla, paula, chaubola, naupa, paumavati, kundaliya, gaanangau, doi, jhulana, khanjapa, sikkha, mala, chuliyala, sordha, hakali, mahuaar,
"Diha, biha., Kamo, Ramo."

prakrit: "जुज्झे तुझे।,सुब्भं देऊ ॥"
english: "Give me your happiness." ""

prakrit: "सारु एह ।,गो वि रेह ॥"
english: "Alright, go ahead."

prakrit: "सम्भु एउ।,सुब्भ देउ ॥"
english: "Come, come, give me happiness." ""

prakrit: "ताली ए जाणीए ।,गो कण्णो तिव्वण्णो ॥"
english: "He knows how to clap. Go, one's ears are sharp."

prakrit: "तुम्हाणं अम्हाणं ।,चंडेसो रक्खे सो ॥"
english: "You are mine., Protect the moon."

prakrit: "हे पिए लेक्खिए ।,अक्खरे तिण्णि रे ॥"
english: "Hey, darling, write. All three of you are incompetent."

prakrit: "सङ्करो सङ्करो ।,पाउ णो पाउ णो ॥"
english: "Sankara is sankara, pauna is pauna."

prakrit: "ससी यो जणीयो ।,फणिदो भणीओ ॥"
