prakrit: "जिणदरिसणुज्जया वि हु,जे नयणा ते हवन्ति सुपसत्था,मिच्छत्तमइलिया पुण,चित्तयरेणं व निम्मविया"
english: "I am content with my life, Those who are naïve are always happy, Mistakes are always wrong, Greed is always vicious."

prakrit: "जिणवरकहाणुरत्ता,दन्ता ते होन्ति कन्तिसंजुत्ता,सेसा सिलेसकज्जे,जाया वि हु वयणबन्धम्मि"
english: "The toothache of the wife, That toothache, That stinging ache, Is the lotus of the head, Whatever it is That binds the speech."

prakrit: "किं नासियाऎ कीरइ,बहुविहससुगन्धगन्धलुद्धाए?,सुसुयत्थगन्धगन्धं,जा न वि जाणेइ लोगम्मि"
english: "What is it that makes people laugh? The fragrance of many a pleasant scent Wafts through? The scent of delicious smells Makes people ignorant." ""

prakrit: "जे च्चिय संमउल्लावं,भणन्ति ते उत्तमा इहं ओट्टा,अन्ने सुत्तजलूगा-पट्टीसंवुक्कसमसरिसा"
english: "Those who think kindly, speak well, For this is the wrong way to go: There will be flames all over - Like the finish of a bandage."

prakrit: "जा जाणइ समयरसं,सा जीहा सुन्दरा हवइ लोए,दुवयणतिक्खधारा,सेसा छुरिय व नवघडिया"
english: "She knows the passage of time, She knows how to make beautiful breezes, Streams of twang, Knives and watches."

prakrit: "तं पि य हवइ पहाणं,मुहकमलं जं गुणेसु तइत्तिल्लं,अन्नं विलं व भण्णइ,भरियं चिय दन्तकीडाणं"
english: "She still has the breeze, The lotus of her face Is devoid of all its virtues, Food is delayed and wasted, Ants are full of toothaches."

prakrit: "जो पढइ सुणइ पुरिसो,सामण्णे उज्जमेइ सत्तीए,सो उत्तमो हु लोए,अन्नो पुण सिप्पियकओ च"
english: "A man who reads and listens, Who shines brightest when he speaks, Is superior in this world, And is always righteous."

prakrit: "सबायरेण एवं,पुरिसेणं उज्झिऊण मूढत्तं,होयव्वं नयमइणा,जिणसासणभत्तिजुत्तेणं"
english: "With soap and water, With men's arms arousing foolishness, With women who are naïve, With the burning fire of jealousy."

prakrit: "अह पउमचरियतुङ्गे,वीरमहागयवरेण निम्मविए,मग्गे परंपराए,अज्जवि कइकुञ्जराण गमो"
english: "Oh! good natured people! Decorate yourselves with the highest songs of valor. For what more can we ask for In this age of tradition?"

prakrit: "तह कइवरगयमयगन्धलोलुओ महुयरो व मग्गेणं,पयदाणबिन्दुदिट्ठी,अहमवि तेणं चिय पयट्टो"
english: "The scent of that fragrant kadamba flower, Like that of a beehive, Sounds like a dot in a python's eye."

prakrit: "सुत्ताणुसारसरसं,रइयं गाहाहि पायडफुडत्थं,विमलेण पउमचरियं,संखेवेणं निसामेह"
english: "Suttanusaarasa rasa, reyam gaaha pyadapudatham, vimalena paumachariyam, sankhavenna nisameha."

prakrit: "ठिईवंससमुप्पत्ती,पत्थाणरणं लवंकुसुप्पत्ती,निवाणमणेयभवा,सत्त पुराणेत्थ अहिगारा"
english: "Teeming trees, fragrant flowers, blossoming rivers of love, the joys of renunciation, the wonders of the seven Puranas."

prakrit: "पउमस्स चेट्ठियमिणं,कारणमिणमो'हिगारसंजुत्तं,तिसलासुएण भणियं,सुत्तं संखेवओ सुणह"
english: "Poems stick to my ears, Reasons give me goose pimples, Sayings quiver with a trembling breath. Listen to those who whisper them." ""

prakrit: "वीरस्स पवरठाणं,विउलगिरीमत्थए मणभिरामे,तह इन्दभूइकहियं,सेणियरण्णस्स नीसेसं"
english: "Venerable mountain, Like a field of emeralds, In the midst of a thicket of reeds, Such is the nature of the sky, Like the despair of an army."

prakrit: "कुलगरवंसुप्पत्ती,नीईए लोगकारणं चेव,उसभजिणजम्मणुब्भव,अहिसेयं मन्दरगिरिम्मि"
english: "Kulgara vamshappatti, neeya lokkarana cheva, uss bhajina jemmanubhava, aise mandaragiri meye."

prakrit: "उवएसं चिय विविहं,लोगस्स य अत्तिनासणं चेव,सामण्ण केवलुब्भव,अइसय कुसुमोहवुट्टीओ"
english: "Such is the diversity of my tastes, Such are the ecstasies of the world, Such the joys of love."

prakrit: "सबसुरा-'सुरमहियं,निवाणं परमसोक्खमाहप्पं,भरहस्स बाहुबलिणो,तह संगामं जहावत्तं"
english: "Subasura -" "Lovely woman, liberation is the supreme pleasure." "With a faithful wife there is bound to be trouble."

prakrit: "जाईण य उप्पत्ती,कुतित्थगण-विविहवेसधारीणं,विज्जाहरवंसस्स य,उप्पत्ती विज्जुदन्तस्स"
english: "Traveler, traveler, Dressed in a variety of costumes, Visiting the rainforests, Traveler."

prakrit: "उवसग्गं पि य घोरं,मुणिवरवसहस्स संजयन्तस्स,केवलनाणुप्पत्ती,विजाहरणं च धरणेणं"
english: "Wretched body, dark hair, sagging thighs, longing for victory, Only silence should be avoided."

prakrit: "अजियस्स य उप्पत्ती,पुण्णघणसुहा-'सुहं समोसरणे,विज्जाहरस्स दिन्नं,सरणं जह रक्खसिन्देणं"
english: "Praise be to the river, Blessed be the pleasures of love -" "I embrace happiness, Give pleasure to learning, Seek refuge in the arms of God." ""

prakrit: "दिन्नं रक्खसवइणा,ठाणं च वरो जहा कुमारस्स,सगरस्स य उप्पत्ती,दुक्खं सामण्ण निवाणं"
english: "Give protection, stay safe, Wherever there is adversity, There is rebirth for the brave. Resolve the sorrow."

prakrit: "अइकन्तमहारक्खो,जम्मणविहवस्स कित्तणं चेव,तह रक्खसवंसस्स य,षवत्तणं चेव नायव्वं"
english: "Protect them from the unbearable heat, Keep them out of our reach, And guard them against the dangers of the sun."

prakrit: "वाणरकेऊण तहा,वंसुप्पत्ती कमेण नायबा,तडिकेसिस्स य चरियं,उदहिकुमारेण सहियस्स"
english: "Aunt, You have to endure it all. Vansupatti is a poor man's wife. Try going to the river For the sake of the woodcutter's daughter." ""

prakrit: "किक्किन्धिअन्धयाणं,सिरिमालाखेयराण आगमणं,वहणं च विजयसीहस्स कोवणं असणिवेयस्स"
english: "The twilight of the horizon, The approach of the crescent moon, And the arrival of the arrow - The covenant of victory Are inseparable."

prakrit: "अन्धयवहं पवेसो,पायालंकारपुरवरे तइया,किक्किन्धिपुरनिवेसं,महुगिरिउवरिं मणभिरामं"
english: "Blind man, I am pining away, Thinking only of the flowers of the amaranth, Fearing the scent of the jasmine."

prakrit: "लङ्कागमण-पवेसं,सुकेसिपुत्ताण बलमहन्ताणं,निग्घायमरणहेऊ,मालिस्स य संपयं विउलं"
english: "Going to Lanka - Praise be to you, Happy youth, Strong mind, Reflective heart, Massage heal all wounds."

prakrit: "वेयड्डदक्खिणाए,सेढीए चक्कवालनयरम्मि,इन्दस्स य उप्पत्ती,विज्जाहरसेढिसामित्तं"
english: "The streets are deserted, The roads are slippery, The rivers are swollen, The Indus is in spate, The straight roads are impassable."

prakrit: "मालिस्स वहं जुज्झे,वेसमणकुमारजम्मणुप्पत्ती,कुसुमन्तवरुज्जाणे,सुमालिपुत्तस्स य पवेसं"
english: "Massage that jujube, Vesaman Kumar, Jummanuppatti, Kusumantavarujaane, Sumali Puttasa Ya Pahesam."

prakrit: "केकसिसहसंजोगं,निदरिसणं तत्थ परमसुमिणाणं,जणणं च दहमुहस्स य,विज्जासमुवासणं चेव"
english: "Friendship between crows, sleep, and the ultimate bliss, Are the pleasures of love, And knowledge is the refuge of the wise."

prakrit: "खोहं जक्खस्स अणाढियस्स तह आगमं सुमालिस्स,मन्दोयरीऎ लम्भ,कन्नाण निरिक्खणं चेव"
english: "Aunt, There's something odd about looking at you That I didn't realize when I met you, Like the length of a mandarin's skirt." ""

prakrit: "तह भाणुकण्णचरियं,कोवं वेसमणउन्भवं चेव,रक्खसजक्खाण रणं,धणयस्स तवो य नायवो"
english: "There the buffalo is dancing, The crow is dressed in disguise, The hunter is protecting the forest, The farmer is wealthy, And so is the boatman."

prakrit: "दहमुहलङ्कागमणं,अवलोयण पुच्छणं जिणहराणं,हरिसेणस्स य चरियं,पुण्णं तह पावमहणं च"
english: "To approach with trembling eyes, To ask questions while lying low, To groan while stammering, To purge oneself of faults."

prakrit: "गहणं मत्तमहागयभुवणालंकारनामधेयस्स,ठाणं जमस्स लद्धं,रिक्खरयाइच्चकिक्किन्धी"
english: "Take me, sweetheart, Let me put my name to your ornament, Then I'll give you a tight slap, Like the kick of a rickshaw."

prakrit: "दहवयण-दूसणाणं,पायालंकारपुरवरपवेसं,चन्दोयरस्स विरहे अणुराहादुक्खसंघट्ट"
english: "Dahavayana-dushnana, Paveshram at Payalankarpur, Anuraha dukkha Sanghatta in the absence of the moonlit night."

prakrit: "तं सो विराहियपुरे,सुग्गीवसिरीसमागमं चेव,वालिस्स खोह अट्ठावयनगस्स"
english: "You wretched man, You'll have to go through the ordeal of being widowed, And your wife will lose sight of you."

prakrit: "सुग्गीव सुताराए,लम्भं मरणं च साहसगइस्स,संतावं चिय परमं,यड्डगमं दहमुहस्स"
english: "The wise prosper, The tall and the dying are brave, Calmness is the supreme virtue, Jealousy is the greatest curse."

prakrit: "अणरण्ण-सहसकिरणाण ताण वेरग्ग जन्ननासं च,महुपुबभवक्खाणं,उवरम्भाए य अहिलासं"
english: "Tears flow from the nectar - The rays of ecstasy separate the soul and the world, Like a fragrance of jasmine."

prakrit: "विजाणं चिय लम्भ,महिन्दरायस्स लच्छिनासं च,दहमुहमन्दरगमणं,पुणरवि य नियत्तणं चेव"
english: "Knowledge is the supreme limb, Praise is the latent state, Destruction is the ultimate goal, Restoration is the eternal goal."

prakrit: "अणगारमहरिसिस्स वि,अणन्तविरियस्स केवलुप्पत्ती,रावणनियमग्गहणं,हणुयस्स समुब्भवं चेव"
english: "Even in inauspicious circumstances, Constant virility, Enlightened by the pretence of Ravana, Reduces the senses of the human body."

prakrit: "अट्ठावयस्स उवरिं,महिन्द-पल्हायदरिसणसिणेहं,पवणञ्जयस्स कोवं,तह अञ्जणउज्झणं चेव"
english: "Eighteen years of age is enough, I can never go back again, Traveler's anger is too great, So do not neglect what you have."

prakrit: "सिट्ठं च मुणिवरेणं,हणुयपरब्भवसमूहसंबन्धं,सूई हणुरूहपुरे,कया य पडिसूरनामेणं"
english: "Sit down, take a deep breath, Reflect on the pastime of making love: Needles pricked by honey, Or is it just a fancy name?"

prakrit: "भूयाडवीऎ मज्झे,पवणञ्जयखेयरस्स य निओगं,तह दरिसणूसवसुहं,विज्जाहरिअञ्जणाऎ समं"
english: "Earthly pleasure, Like the pleasure of seeing the horizon, Is equal to the knowledge of seeing."

prakrit: "पवणञ्जयपुत्तमहाबलस्स तह दारुणं रणं परमं,रजं दसाणणस्स य,जिणउस्सेहन्तरं चेव"
english: "Praise be to the powerful, The most beautiful forest is supreme, The king is known only by the wise, For through him all ends meet."

prakrit: "बल-केसव-पडिसत्तूण चेट्ठियं चक्कवट्टिपमुहाणं,दसरहरज्जुप्पत्ती,केगइवरसंपयं परमं"
english: "Strength - Kesava - Padisattuna Chettiyam Chakkavattipamuhanam, Dasaraharajuppatti, Kegaivarampadyam is the supreme"

prakrit: "इन्देण समं जुज्झं,काऊण य गिहियं दहमुहेणं,संवेगसमावन्नो,नरवइ दिक्खं समणुपत्तो"
english: "A fight is like an egg, A struggle is like a fire, An orgy is like fire, Love is like passion, And jealousy is like love."

prakrit: "रामस्स लक्खणस्स य,भरहस्स य तह य सत्तुनिहणस्स,उप्पत्ती सीयाए,विदेह तह सोगसंबन्धं"
english: "Rama is characterized by good looks, Bharahasa by good breath, and Sattunihasa by bad breath."

prakrit: "नारयसीयालिहणं,दद्दूण सहोयरस्स मूढत्तं,कन्नासयंवरत्थं,उप्पत्ती चावरयणस्स"
english: "Embracing Narayasi, Forgotten by falsehood, Friendship with foolishness, Virtuous by virtue of hard work, Endures forever."

prakrit: "दसरहनिवस्स दिक्खं,पासे मुणिसबभूयसरणस्स,ववगयभवाण कहणं,समागमं चेव सीयाए"
english: "Look at the Dussehra offering, Sigh at the passage, Bow before it, Speak plainly, Meeting is as simple as that."

prakrit: "केगइवरस्स लम्भ,रजं भरहस्स परममाहप्पं,तह लक्खणो य रामो,सीया य गया विदेसम्मि"
english: "Long live the God of Love, The supreme greatness of a king's heart, Such is the nature of Rama, So is the learning of the wise."

prakrit: "तह वज्जकण्णनरवइ-विचेट्ठियं वरकुमारिलम्भं च,वसिकाररुद्दभूई,विमोयणं वालिखिल्लस्स"
english: "So the Vajjakanna Narmadā - Wretched and wretched girl - Filled with anger, The archer with redemption." ""

prakrit: "अरुणुग्गामासन्ने,रामपुरिनिवेसणं परमरम्मं,वणमालासंजोयं,अइविरियसमुन्नई चेव"
english: "In the month of Arunugama, the pleasures of the forest, The ecstasy of the rainy season, Are bound to last forever."

prakrit: "लाभो जियषउमाए,कुल-देसविहूसणाण उवसग्गं,वंसगिरिमत्थओवरि,जिणहरकरणं च रामेण"
english: "Praise be to the Jishumā, the ornament of family and country, The ornament of the Vānsagiri tree, And the garland of jinn."

prakrit: "दढूण दाणविभवं,जडाउणो नियमलद्धमाहप्पं,नागरहारोहं चिय,संबुक्कविवायणं चेव"
english: "Look at the fragrance of the paddy, Hold on tight, Roll on, Like a banner proclaiming the goodness of the town, Try to describe it in all its glory."

prakrit: "केगइपुत्तागमणं,खरदूसणविग्गहं परमघोरं,सीयाहरणनिमित्तं,सोगं चिय सीयाहरणनिमित्तं,सोगं चिय रामदेवस्स"
english: "Going to bed early, Excruciating fever, Fear of the worst, Mourning for the first time, Grief for the last time: I bow before Ramdev."

prakrit: "सिग्धं विराहियस्स य,आगमणं दूसणस्स य वहं च,रयणजडिविजनासं,सुग्गीवसमागमं चेव"
english: "Destitution is straightforward, Adversity is either imminent or imminent, Illusion is inevitable, Prosperity is the only path to happiness."

prakrit: "साहसगइस्स य वहं,सीयाषडिवत्तिकारणं लम्भं,मिलणं विहीसणेणं,विज्जाबलकेसिसंपत्ती"
english: "Courage is what it takes, Longevity is what makes one happy, Friendship is what sets one apart, Wealth is what gives one strength."

prakrit: "तह कुम्भयण्ण-इन्दइभुयङ्ग पासेसु बन्धणं परमं,लक्खणसत्तिषहारं,तह य विसल्लागमं चेव"
english: "There the kumbhayana - the binding of the penis - is the supreme, the characteristic, the most difficult, And thus the path to enlightenment is sealed."

prakrit: "दहमुहषवेसणं चिय,भवणं जिणसन्तिसामिनाहस्स,तह पाडिहेरगमणं,लङ्काऎ पवेसणं चेव"
english: "The burning bush is burnt, The buildings are empty, The streets are deserted, Lanka is on the verge of collapse."

prakrit: "चक्कुप्पत्ती तह लक्खणस्स दहमुहविवायणं चेव,वरजुवईण पलावं,आगमणं चेव केवलिणो"
english: "Trembling and shaking with excitement, The young bride running away, The arrival of a gentleman only."

prakrit: "इन्दइपमुहाण तहा,दिक्खा सीयासमागमं वत्तं,नारयलकागमणं,साएयपुरीषवेसं च"
english: "Face to face with the moon, Look down into the sky, Look up into the horizon, Look for the pearl of the lotus, Look out for the shadow of a man"

prakrit: "पुवभवाण य चरियं,भरहगयाणं जहा समक्खायं,भरहस्स य पवज्जा,ठविओ चिय लक्खणो रज्जे"
english: "When the heart is full, When the limbs are firm And the hands are firm, Love's arrows are powerful."

prakrit: "लद्धा मणोरमा वि य,सिरिवच्छालीढदेहधारिस्स,मरणं च समावन्नं,सुमहल्लवणस्स संगामे"
english: "Laddha manorma viz., The stream of tears draining the body, Enduring death, In the company of harmonious beings."

prakrit: "महुरापुरिदेसस्स य,उवसग्गविणासणं जणवयस्स,सत्तरिसीण उवत्ती,सीयानिवासणं चेव"
english: "Bees purify the earth, Plumes of nectar are produced in the womb, Sweat is shed by the seventy, The sitting position of a lion is maintained."

prakrit: "अह वज्जजङ्घनरवइ,दिट्ठा सीया लवंकुसुप्पत्ती,जेऊण नरवरिन्दे,पियरेण समं कयं जुज्झं"
english: "Ah! the jingling fire of the vajja, A lovely beauty to behold, Like a pair of gooseflesh bracelets Wrapped around a man's neck. How can I compare with a pearl?"

prakrit: "सयलजणभूसणाणं,नाणुप्पत्ती सुराण आगमणं,वत्तं च पाडिहेरं,सीयाए भीसणभवोहं"
english: "A good man is full of pretence, A pleasant one is sure to come, And a harsh one is on the way."

prakrit: "घोरं तवोविहाणं,कयन्तवयणे सयंवरे खोहं,दिक्खा य कुमाराणं,भामण्डलदुग्गई चेव"
english: "A thick sheet of parrots, cooing loudly, Looks like the bow of a doe: There is nothing wrong with it."

prakrit: "हणुयस्स य पवजा,लक्खणपरलोगगमणहेउम्मि,लवणंकुसाण य तवो,रामपलावं च सोगं च"
english: "Praise be to the hunter, Criticism above reproach, Contempt below the surface, And grief above the flames of the pyre."

prakrit: "पुवभवदेवजणियं,दिक्खं चिय राघवस्स निग्गन्थं,केवलनाणुप्पत्तो,तहेव निवाणगमणं च"
english: "Praise be to the gods, See how they manage Raghava's wretchedness, Only through falsehood and falsehood Can the soul attain liberation."

prakrit: "सब पि एवमेयं,सुणन्तु इह सज्जणा य मज्झत्था,सिद्धिपहं संपत्तं,पउमं विमलेण भावेण"
english: "Everything is as it should be, listen to this gentleman. But my heart is full of gratitude. I am completely satisfied With what I get."

prakrit: "एयं अट्ठमरामदेवचरियं वीरेण सिटुं पुरा,पच्छा उत्तमसाहवेहि धरियं लोगस्स उब्भासियं,एत्ताहे विमलेण पायडफुडं गाहानिबद्धं कयं,सुत्तत्थं निसुणन्तु संपइ महापुण्णं पवित्तक्खरं"
english: "This is the place where the brave sit in solemn silence, Where then, O God of Love, Do people rise in ecstasy, Wherefore, with so much humility, Have the feet been fastened to the elephant's trunk? The supreme purity is consummated By discharging its duties."

prakrit: "इति पउमचरिए सुत्तविहाणो नाम उद्देसो समत्तो"
english: "It is only the intention of the name that determines the course of the cycle"

prakrit: "इह जम्बुदीवदीवे,दक्खिणभरहे महन्तगुणकलिओ,मगहा नाम जणवओ,नगरा-''गरमण्डिओ रम्मो"
english: "Oh! the jasmine, The south wind stirs up the great nectar, So tell me the name of the town -" "Garmondio Rummo." ""

prakrit: "गाम-पुर-खेड-कब्बड-मडम्ब-दोणीमुहेसु परिकिण्णो,गो-महिसि-वलवपुण्णो,धणनिवहनिरुद्धसीमषहो"
english: "Village - Pur - Khed - Kabbad - Madamba - The observer of two faces, The cow - buffalo - The expert of the tame, The tame hunter of the hunter."

prakrit: "सत्थाह-सेट्ठि-गहवइ-कोडुम्बियषमुहसुद्धजणनिवहो,मणि-कणग-रयण-मोत्तिय-बहुधन्नमहन्तकोट्ठारो"
english: "Satthah-setthi-gahvayi-kodumbiyasam, Smooth man's name, Mani-kanaga-rayana-pearl-mahantakothararo of great wealth."

prakrit: "देसम्मि तम्मि लोगो,विन्नाणवियक्खणो अइसुरूवो,बल-विहव-कन्तिजुत्तो,अहियं धम्मुज्जुयमईओ"
english: "Friend, The origin of separation arises from within, Strength, power, and perseverance. I, the follower of dharma, are bound together."

prakrit: "नड-नट्ट-छत्त-लङ्खयनिच्चनच्चन्तगीयसद्दालो,नाणाहारपसाहियभुजाविज्जन्तपहियजणो"
english: "The first man on the horizon, Standing at the foot of the cliff, Eager to grab a coin, Looks like a farmer's son."

prakrit: "अहियं वीवाहूसववियावडो गन्धकुसुमतत्तिल्लो,बहुपाण-खाण-भोयण–अणवरयंवड्डिउच्छाहो"
english: "Here I am, Trembling with the fragrance of my wife's perfume, Looking down the road at the many flowers, Eating out, Fearful, Undisturbed."

prakrit: "पुक्खरणीसु सरेसु य,उज्जाणेसु य समन्तओ रम्मो,परचक्क मारि-तक्कर-दुब्भिक्खविवज्जिओ मुइओ"
english: "The flowers are white, The fire is bright, The drowsy couple are making love, But when they meet the poor widow They are all dead."

prakrit: "तस्स बहुमज्झदेसे,पायारुब्भडविसालपरिवेढं,नयरं चिय पोराणं,रायपुरं नाम नामेणं"
english: "From that great land, Surrounded by vast expanse of paddy, Like an old man dying of thirst, Come, call Raipur by name."

prakrit: "वरभवण-तुङ्गतोरण-धवलट्टालय कलङ्कपरिमुक्कं,फलिहासु संपउत्तं,कविसीसयविरइयाभोयं"
english: "Varabhavana - Tungatarana - Dhavalattalaya Kalankaparimukkam, The fruit is abundant, Poets fear their enemies."

prakrit: "बहुभण्डसारगरुयं,जल-थलयसमिद्धरयणभरियघरं,नाणादेससमागय-वणियजणुल्लावसद्दालं"
english: "A village full of reeds, a house full of pots and pans, a town full of jewellers."

prakrit: "भवणङ्गणच्चणेसु य,मरगय-माणिक्ककिरणकब्बुरियं,अगुरुय-तुरुक्क-चन्दण-जणवयपरिभोयसुसुयन्धं"
english: "Look at the panorama, The garland of emeralds, The rays of the sky, The jasmine - The turkey - The sandal - The pleasures enjoyed by married couples."

prakrit: "चेइयघरेहि रम्म,आरामुज्जाण-काणणसमिद्धं,सर-सरसि-बावि-वप्पिण-सएसु अइमणहरालोवं"
english: "There's room in the house for a frown, A snuggle between your ears, A mustard seed - Like water in a well - Wrapped with mustard seeds."

prakrit: "चच्चर-चउक्कमणहर-पेच्छणयमहन्तमहुरनिग्धोसं,पण्डियजणसुसमिद्धं,अक्खलियचरित्तबहुसत्थं"
english: "The round breasts - The eyes of the beholder, The cheeks of the great sage, Are like the lips of a wise man, Exhausted by carelessness."

prakrit: "किं जंपिएण बहुणा. तं नयरं गुणसहस्सआवास,अमरपुरस्स य सोहं,घेत्तूण व होज निम्मवियं"
english: "What do you mean, daughter - in - law? That is the residence of virtuous people. The immortal man's beauty Is like a pyre, Like a fire burning in the middle of the night." ""

prakrit: "एवंविहे य नयरे,वसइ निवो तत्थ सेणिओ नाम,नरवइगुणेहि जुत्तो,वेसमणो चेव पञ्चक्खो"
english: "In this way the naysayers live, In that place the army is named, In men's clothes the virtues are personified, In disguise they are called the five vows."

prakrit: "भमरनिभनिद्धकेसो,वियसियवरषउमसरिसमुहसोहो,घण-पीण-कढिणखन्धो,थोरुन्नय-दीहबाहुजुओ"
english: "A flock of parrots, Like the fragrance of a beehive, Sighs loudly, Drinks heavily, Bowls long and straight."

prakrit: "वित्थिण्णपिहुलवच्छो,करयलसमगिज्झललियतणुमज्झो,मयरायसरिसकडियड,समहियवरहत्थिहत्थोरू"
english: "With trembling lips, Thighs twitching like thunder, Mother - in - law's bracelets, Hands clasped around her thighs."

prakrit: "कुम्मवरचारुचलणो,सोवण्णियपवओ व दिप्पन्तो,चन्दो व सोमवयणो,सलिलनिही चेव गम्भीरो"
english: "The potter walks, The sun rises, The moon sleeps, And everyone who walks on the lotus is very proud."

prakrit: "तं नत्थि जं न याणइ,नरिन्दविनाण-नाणमाहप्पं,सम्मत्तलद्धबुद्धी,गुरु-देवयपूयणसमत्थो"
english: "One who knows nothing at all, Through non - activity, through meditation, Through peaceful contemplation, Through the worship of one's Guru and Deity."

prakrit: "विविहकला-''गमकुसलो वि माणवो तस्स वरनरिन्दस्स,सुचिरं षि भण्णमाणो,गुणाण अन्तं न पाविज्जा"
english: "Vividhaka kala -" "A virtuous person is only virtuous when he knows what is good and what is bad." ""

prakrit: "अत्थेत्थ भरहवासे,कुण्डग्गामं पुरं गुणसमिद्धं,तत्थ य नरिन्दवसहो,सिद्धत्थो नाम नामेणं"
english: "At the moment one is full of energy, At the time one is filled with virtuous qualities, One who is completely satisfied with one's being is called a nymph."

prakrit: "तस्स य बहुगुणकलिया,भज्जा तिसल त्ति रूवसंपन्ना,तीए गब्भम्मि जिणो,आयाओ चरिमसमयम्मि"
english: "She has a lot of virtues, Does not burn with fuel, Has no silverware, Lives in her womb; Now comes the season of miracles."

prakrit: "आसणकम्पेण सुरा,मुणिऊण जिणेसरं समुप्पन्नं,सवे वि समुच्चलिया,परिओसुन्भिन्नरोमञ्चा"
english: "The trembling of the seats is sweet, The sighing of the bow Succeeds in everything, Everyone is busy making love, The pleasures of love differ."

prakrit: "आगन्तूण य नयरे,गन्धोदयवारिवरिसणं काउं,घेत्तूण जिणवरिन्दं,मन्दरसिहरम्मि संपत्ता"
english: "The visitor is invisible, The scent of the fragrant flowers is deafening, Life is full of complications, And wealth is the supreme pleasure of a temple."

prakrit: "ठविऊण पण्डुकम्बल–सिलाऎ सीहासणे मणिविचित्ते,अभिसिञ्चन्ति सुरिन्दा,खीरोदहिवारिकलसेहिं"
english: "Bees sit astride the white lotuses of the lotus - silhouetted against their backs, their wings drooping, their necks sunken by the rays of the sun."

prakrit: "आकम्पिओ य जेणं,मेरू अङ्गुट्टएण लीलाए,तेणेह महावीरो,नाम सि कयं सुरिन्देहिं"
english: "Foolish girl, Meru has become so thin on your toes That you look like a great warrior. How can you describe him?"

prakrit: "नमिऊण जिणवरिन्द,थोऊण पयाहिणं च काऊणं,पुणरवि माउसयासे,ठवेन्ति देवा तिलोयगुरुं"
english: "We bow before the God of Love, we bow before him, we kiss his lips, and he embraces us again."

prakrit: "सुरवइदिन्नाहारो,अङ्गुट्टयअमयलेवलेहेणं,उम्मुक्कबालभावो,तीसइवरिसो जिणो जाओ"
english: "Lovely woman, Thighs twitching, Eyes closing, Young man, Thirty years is a long time to be alive."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाई,संवेगंगओ जिणो मुणियदोसो,लोगन्तियपरिकिण्णो,पबज्जमुवागओ वोरो"
english: "Ah! what a cruel man! A man so full of feelings, Such a man as a sage, Like a man spoilt by greed, Is a wretched man."

prakrit: "अह अट्ठकम्मरहियस्स तस्स झाणोवओगजुत्तस्स,सयलजगुज्जोयगरं,केवलनाणं समुप्पन्नं"
english: "Ah! the heat of love, Like a bunch of peacock's tail feathers Slipping from its beak, Only the words ring true."

prakrit: "रुहिरं खीरसवण्णं,मलसेयविवज्जियं सुरभिगन्धं,देहं सलक्खणगुणं,रविप्पभं चेव अइविमलं"
english: "The fragrance of wine fills the heart, The scent of perfumed liquorice, The body is like a salve, The raindrops are like seven drops of nectar."

prakrit: "नयणा फन्दणरहिया,नहकेसा'वट्ठिया य निद्धा य,जोयणसयं समन्ता,मारीइ विवज्जिओ देसो"
english: "Be careful not to break the fast, be reckless, be stubborn, for marriage is more difficult than love."

prakrit: "जत्तो ठवेइ चलणे,तत्तो जायन्ति सहसपत्ताई,फलभरनमिया य दुमा,साससमिद्धा मही होइ"
english: "As the thirst goes on, So the longing goes on. Fruit fills the air. Mother - in - law's love is bound to fade."

prakrit: "आयरिससमा धरणी,जायइ इह अद्धमागही वाणी,सरए व निम्मलाओ,दिसाओ रय-रेणुरहियाओ"
english: "The earth trembles at the iris, The speech is slurred, The lines are smudged, The directions are silly."

prakrit: "ठायइ जत्थ जिणिन्दो,तत्थ य सीहासणं रयणचित्तं,जोयणघोसमणहरं,दुन्दुहि सुरकुसुमवुट्ठी य"
english: "Where there is a victory, There is a royal heart of gold, Where there are joys and sorrows, Wherever there are sighs and groans."

prakrit: "एवं सो मुणिवसहो,अट्ठमहापाडिहेरपरियरिओ,विहरइ जिणिन्दभाणू,बोहिन्तो भवियकमलाइं"
english: "And so the sage says:" "Behold the jasmine flowers, Pretending to bloom on the eighth day of spring." ""

prakrit: "अइसयविहूइसहिओ,गण-गणहर-सयलसङ्घपरिवारो,विहरन्तो चिय पत्तो,विउलगिरिन्दं महावीरो"
english: "It's the widows, The headman's family, The hunter's household, The traveler's flock, The tiger's great warrior." ""

prakrit: "नाऊण देवराया,विउलमहागिरिवरे जिणवरिन्दं,एरावणं वलग्गो,हिमगिरिसिहरस्स संकासं"
english: "No more gods, only jinns and vultures, Like the plowman's tail - The trouble with the winter snows is freezing."

prakrit: "सिंदूररइयकुम्भं,विरइयनक्खत्तमालकयसोहं,घण्टारवनिग्धोसं,गण्डयलुब्भिन्नमयलेहं"
english: "The lotus of vermilion, The ornament of pearl, Like the bow of a peacock's tail, Is like a varied line of rhinoceros."

prakrit: "गुमुगुमुगुमन्तमहुयर-निलोणमयसुरहिवासियसुयन्धं,चलचवलकण्णचामर-वाउछुवन्तधयमालं"
english: "Gumugumumumuntumhuyer - The fragrance of the blue lotus, The delight of those who dwell in it, The conch shell of a wobbly doe - The garland of bamboo shoots."

prakrit: "सामाणियपरिकिण्णो,अच्छरसुग्गीयमाणमाहप्पो,सबसुरासुरसहिओ,विउलगिरिं आगओ इन्दो"
english: "Like a common man, Proud woman, Friend of all fairies, Wretched fire inside."

prakrit: "दढूण जिणवरिन्द,करयलजुयलं करीय सीसम्मि,सको पहट्टमणसो,थोऊण जिणं समाढत्तो"
english: "Look at the deer, The jujubes have long hair, They can walk on their feet, Life is short if they keep to themselves."

prakrit: "मोहन्धयारतिमिरे,सुत्तं चिय सयलजीवलोयमिणं,केवलकिरणदिवायर!,तुमेव उज्जोइयं विमलं"
english: "O fire of love, Whose rays illuminate the sky, The flame of eternal life! You are the brightest Vimal."

prakrit: "संसारभवसमुद्दे,सोगमहासलिलवीइसंघट्टे,पोओ तुम महायस!,उत्तारो भवियवणियाणं"
english: "On the eve of the festival, In the midst of the rapturous festival, Go, you great one!" ""

prakrit: "संसारभवकडिल्ले,संजोगविओगसोगतरुगहणे,कुपहपणट्ठाण तुम,सत्थाहो नाह! उप्पन्नो"
english: "The senses of the world are distorted, circumstances are disturbed, anger and hatred are directed at you; do not trouble yourself!"

prakrit: "तुह नाह! को समत्थो,सब्भूयगुणाण कुणइ परिसंखा?,सुइरम्मि भण्णमाणो,अवि वाससहस्सकोडीहिं"
english: "Who is not worthy of your name? How can one appreciate all the virtues of nature?" The swearer said: "They are the buds of the God of Love."

prakrit: "थोऊण देवराया,अन्ने वि चउबिहा सुरनिकाया,भावेण कयपणामा,उवविट्ठा सन्निवेसेसु"
english: "Be nice to everyone, Be courteous at all times, Be considerate when making love, And always be polite."

prakrit: "मगहाहिवो वि राया,दट्टण सुरागमं जिणसगासे,भडचडयरेण महया,तो रायपुराओ नीहरिओ"
english: "Even the great elephants are afraid of the rain, The thickets give the jingling scent Of the jasmine. So do not neglect the Raipuras." ""

prakrit: "पत्तो य तमुद्देसं,मत्तमहागयवराओ उत्तिण्णो,थोऊण जिणवरिन्दं,उवविट्ठो मगहसामन्तो"
english: "Wait a moment, you fool, Don't turn your back on me: It's the moonlight of your face That keeps you awake."

prakrit: "पुवविणिम्मियभागं,जोयणपरिवेढमण्डलाभोयं,पायारतिउणमणिमय-गोउरवित्थिण्णकयसोहं"
english: "The fragrance of flowers, The joy of crossing swords, The pleasure of walking on treetops - Like a herd of cows Scorching the ground"

prakrit: "अह दोणि य वक्खारा,अट्टमहापाडिहेरसंजुत्ता,अट्ठ नाडयाई,दारे दारे य नच्चन्ति"
english: "Ah, the twang of two women, The rapture of eight dances, The crashing of doors and windows."

prakrit: "सोलस वरवावीओ,कमलुप्पलविमलसलिलपुण्णाओ,चउसु विदिसासु मज्झे,हवन्ति चत्तारि चत्तारि"
english: "Solas varvaveeyo, kamaluppalavimalasalilpunnao, chausuu vidishaasu majjhe, havanti chatari chatari"

prakrit: "भयवं पि तिहुयणगुरू,विचित्तसीहासणे सुहनिविट्ठो,छत्ताइछत्त-चामर-असोग-भामण्डलसणाहो"
english: "Though afraid, You are a wise teacher; Though distressed, You rejoice; Yet you forsake your neighbor And neglect him."

prakrit: "एवंविहम्मि तत्तो,सुरवरमेलीणजणसमूहम्मि,पत्तेयं पत्तेयं,वक्खारं कित्तइस्सामि"
english: "And here I am, sitting by myself, In the company of pleasant people, Leaving leaf after leaf, Cutting through the trees."

prakrit: "पढमम्मि य वक्खारे,परिसा निग्गन्थमहरिसीणं तु १,तयणन्तरं पि बीए,सोहम्माईसुरवहूणं२"
english: "Aunt, You're the only one who knows how to sort things out, First you frowned, Then you groaned, And then your wife sighed." ""

prakrit: "तइयम्मि य वक्खारे,परिसा अजाण गुणमहन्तीणं३,तत्तो परं तु नियमा,जोइसकन्नाण परिसा य४"
english: "You fool, A gentleman without knowledge is worthless. But you, being careful not to fall into error, Know the law."

prakrit: "वन्तरवहूण तत्तो५,परिसा उण भवणवासियवहूर्ण६,तत्तो परं तु नियमा,जोइसियाणं सुरवराण७"
english: "Vandaar vahuna tato 5, Parisa ut bhavana vasi vahurna 6, Tato par tu niyama, joysiyana suvaranya 7."

prakrit: "वन्तरभवणिन्दाणं ८,वक्खारेसु य हवन्ति परिसाओ९,सोहम्माईण तओ,देवाणं कप्पवासीणं १०"
english: "Vandalism - The headman's son, A wicked man's daughter, Is only a housekeeper's wife. 9 She is full of pleasures, A god of love is a cowboy" 10

prakrit: "अवरम्मि य वक्खारे,परिसा मणुयाण नरवरिन्दाणं ११,होइ तिरिक्वाण पुणो,परिसा पुवुत्तरे भागे१२"
english: "The poor girl has grown very thin, The men of the household are dying, The women are leaving, The traveler is returning, The husbands have run away, 12"

prakrit: "एवं पसन्नचित्ते,सुरवरमेलीणपत्थिवसमूहे,पुच्छइ धम्मा-'धम्म,तित्थयरं गोयमो नमिडं"
english: "And with a satisfied mind, Suravaramelina pathiva group, asks Dharma -" "Dharma, till then I will not go." ""

prakrit: "तो अद्धमागहीए,भासाए सबजीवहियजणणं,जलहरगम्भीररवो,कहेइ धम्मं जिणवरिन्दो"
english: "So the foolish girl, Speaking in all forms of life, Running with fever, Says the one who conquers Dharma." ""

prakrit: "दवं च होइ दुविहं,जीवा-'जीवा तहेव नायबं,जीवा हवन्ति दुविहा,सिद्धा संसारवन्ता य"
english: "Life is eternal, Life goes on forever, Life has two directions, The straight world is eternal."

prakrit: "जे होन्ति सिद्धजीवा,ताण अणन्तं सुहं अणोवमियं,अक्खयमयलमणन्तं,हवइ सया बाह परिमुक्कं"
english: "One who is fully alive, Who is constantly in a state of bliss, Is extremely discerning, Is always vigilant, Has always the upper hand."

prakrit: "तत्थ य संसारस्था,दुविहा तस-थावरा मुणेयवा,उभए वि हुन्ति दुविहा,पजत्ता तह अपज्जत्ता"
english: "That is the state of the world; the two are alike; the one is immutable, and the other is immaterial."

prakrit: "पुढवि जल जलण मारुय,वणस्सई चेव थावरा भणिया,बेइन्दियाइ जाव उ,दुविह तसा सन्नि इयरे य"
english: "The fire burns the water, The bamboo shoots the bamboo shoot, And the buffalo steps in to rescue it." "It's only two sunny years."

prakrit: "नं तं अजीवदवं,धम्मा-'धम्माइभेयभिन्नं च,भवाण सिद्धिगमणं,तं विवरीयं अभवाणं"
english: "There is no such thing as non - existence, dharma -" "The dharma is different and different, consciousness is the attainment of perfection, it is the absence of difference." ""

prakrit: "मिच्छत्त-जोगषच्चय,तह य कसाएसु लेससहिएसु,एएसु चेव जीवो,बन्धइ असुहं सया कम्मं"
english: "Wrong views, So that some people become lax, So do all living beings. Bondage is a cruel curse."

prakrit: "नाणेण दंसणेण य,चारित्त-तवेण सम्मसहिएणं,मण-वयण-कायगुत्तो,अज्जिणइ अणन्तयं पुण्णं"
english: "To touch a nail is to be treated with kindness, To cherish a fond affection, To weep with fondness, Is to cultivate a virtuous nature."

prakrit: "अट्ठविहभेयभिन्नं,कम्मं संखेवओ समक्खायं,बज्झन्ति य मुच्चन्ति य,जीवा परिणामजोगेणं"
english: "Eight different vows, A whole host of vows, Buzzing or closing the vows: The soul must suffer the consequences."

prakrit: "संसारषवन्नाणं,जीवाणं विसयसङ्गमूढाणं,जं होइ तक्खणसुहं,तं पुण दुक्खं अणेगविहं"
english: "The cycle of rebirth, the cycle of life, and the passage of time, Are the pleasures of one's being: To that extent, I must return suffering."

prakrit: "जाव य निमिसपमाणो,कालो वच्चेज नरयलोगम्मि,तावं चिय नत्थि सुहं,जीवाणं पावकम्माणं"
english: "Tomorrow is the last day of your life, The days are fleeting, Love does not last long, Life is like a curse."

prakrit: "दमणेसु ताडणेसु य,बन्धणनिब्भच्छणाइदोसेसु,दुक्खं तिरिक्खजीवा,अणुहवमाणा य अच्छन्ति"
english: "Be patient, be vigilant, avoid getting into trouble, turn your back on suffering, make amends, and act with decency."

prakrit: "संजोग-विप्पओगे,लाहा-'लाहे य राग-दोसेसु,मणुयाण हवइ दुक्खं,सारीरं माणसं चेव"
english: "Love is angry, hatred is vicious, Man has to suffer, All human beings suffer."

prakrit: "अप्पिड्डियदेवाण वि,दट्टण महिड्डिए सुरसमूहे,जं उप्पज्जइ दुक्खं,तत्तो गुरुयं चवणकाले"
english: "Even the god of sorrows, With thick, fragrant melodies, Who stirs up sorrow, Is a teacher in his spare time."

prakrit: "एयारिसम्मि घोरे,संसारे चाउरङ्गमग्गमि,दुक्खेहि नवरि जीवो,भट्ठो मणुयत्तणं लहइ"
english: "I have to travel a lot, I've to travel the world, You miserable young woman, You've got to know how to be humane."

prakrit: "लद्धे वि माणुसत्ते,सबराइकुलेसु मन्द विभवेसु,उत्तमकुलम्मि दुक्खं,उप्पत्ती होइ जीवस्स"
english: "War destroys humanity; The weakest prosper, The most virtuous suffer, And the last one survives."

prakrit: "उप्पन्नो वि हु सुकुले,वामण-बहिर-'न्ध-मूय-कुणि-खुज्जो,दुक्खेहि लहइ जीवो,निरोगषञ्चिन्दियं रूवं"
english: "Though thirsty, I am dry; Though weary, Out of sight, In darkness, Mute, Wretched - It is a miser's life; Ill - health is the ornament of the moon"

prakrit: "सबाण सुन्दराणं,लद्धे वि समागमे अपुण्णस्स,न हविज्ज धम्मबुद्धी,मूढस्स उ लोभ-मोहेणं"
english: "Everything is beautiful, Even in a fight there is no disharmony, There is no sense of dharma, It's foolishness and greed."

prakrit: "उप्पन्ना वि य बुद्धी,धम्मस्सुवरिं कुधम्म-हम्मेसु,तह वि य पुण भामिज्जइ,न लहइ जिणदेसियं धम्मं"
english: "Wisdom alone triumphs, Compassion alone vanishes, But dharma does not survive unless one renounces it."

prakrit: "लद्धण माणुसत्तं,जस्स न धम्मे सया हवइ चित्तं,तस्स किर करयलत्थं,अमयं नटुं चिय नरस्स"
english: "War is the essence of humanity; That which is not bound by Dharma must come from the mind; What can one do about it?"

prakrit: "केइत्थ धीरपुरिसा,चारित्तं गिहिऊण भावेण,अक्खण्डियचारित्ता,जाव ठिया उत्तमझुम्मि"
english: "How patient I am, How full of affection, Strong in character, Wherever I stand I always shine."

prakrit: "अन्ने पुणो वि केई,वीसं जिणकारणाइँ भावेउं,तेलोक्कखोभणकर,अणन्तसउक्खं समजन्ति"
english: "I will do it again," he said, "Because I feel like winning the bout." By hiding in the open, he understands the endless struggle.

prakrit: "अन्ने तवं विगिट्ट,काउं,थोवावसेससंसारा,दो तिण्णि भवे गन्तुं,निवाणमणुत्तरमुवेन्ति"
english: "There are three ways out, One way, the other, and one way or the other."

prakrit: "काऊण तवमुयारं,आराहिय धीबलेण कालगया,ते होन्ति वरअणुत्तर-विमाणवासेसु अहमिन्दा"
english: "Aunt, It's too late for that girl, She's already late for the wedding - The man who lives in the plane Is already late." ""

prakrit: "तत्तो चुया समाणा,हलहर-चक्कहरभोग-रिद्धीओ,भोत्तूण सुचिरकालं,धम्म काऊण सिज्झन्ति"
english: "There is plenty to eat, There are plenty to drink, And there are plenty of pastimes to pursue. But the good times are fleeting; Where is the dharma to be practiced?"

prakrit: "घेत्तूण समणधम्मं,घोरपरीसहपराइया अन्ने,भजन्ति संजमाओ,सेवन्ति अणुवयाणि पुणो"
english: "Get up, make love, Make love with your lover, Speak often, Serve often, Use often, And repeat yourself."

prakrit: "तुट्ठा हवन्ति अन्ने,दरिसणमेत्तेण जिणवरिन्दाणं,पच्चक्खाणनिवित्ति,न वि ते सुविणे वि गेहन्ति"
english: "The grasshopper hunts the goose, The hen makes a living by making love with a doe, And with emeralds she does not know how to weep."

prakrit: "मिच्छत्तमोहियमई,निस्सीला निवया गिहारम्भे,पविसन्ति महाघोरं,संगामं विसयरसलोला"
english: "Deceitful lover, Silly woman, Nivea's fever is fierce, The streets are thick with trouble, The streams are vast."

prakrit: "अन्ने वि करिसणाई,बावारा विविहजन्तुसंबाधा,काऊण जन्ति नरयं,तिबमहावेयणं घोरं"
english: "There are other people doing the same, There are many different kinds of animals, The only way is through fire, The other is through thunder."

prakrit: "माया-कुडिलसहावा,कूडतुला-कूडमाणववहारा,धम्मं असद्दहन्ता,तिरिक्खजोणी उवणमन्ति"
english: "Maya - the good wife, Koodatula - the bad wife, Dharma - the intolerant, The woman who walks about freely Makes love."

prakrit: "उज्जुयधम्मायारा,तणुयकसाया सहावभद्दा य,मज्झिमगुणेहि जुत्ता,लहन्ति ते माणुसं जम्मं"
english: "Brighter the dharma, The thinner the body, The sweeter the shoes, The more virtuous the person will become."

prakrit: "अणुवय-महवएहि य,बालतवेण य हवन्ति संजुत्ता,ते होन्ति देवलोए,देवा परिणामजोगेणं"
english: "Aunt, It's the rainy season, A rainy day, A hot sunny day, And the gods rejoice in the outcome." ""

prakrit: "दसण-नाण-चरित्ते,सुद्धा अन्नोन्नकरणजोएसु,देहे वि निरवयक्खा,सिद्धि पावेन्ति धुयकम्मा"
english: "Destroy wealth, earn wealth, be virtuous, be merciless even in body, attain perfection through dhuriyakarma."

prakrit: "तं अक्खयं अणन्तं,अबाबाहं सिवं परमसोक्खं,पावन्ति समणसीहा,कम्मट्ठविवज्जिया मोक्खं"
english: "He knows the endless, The boundless, The supreme pleasure of love, The arbiter of vows, The liberator of committed differences."

prakrit: "चउगइमहासमुद्दे,जीवा घोलन्ति कम्मपडिबद्धा,न य उत्तरेज केई,मोत्तु जिणधम्मबोहित्थं"
english: "On the eve of the festival, Lives are tossed about on the rafters, But no one has ever reached the top. The pearl is wrapped in a shawl." ""

prakrit: "संसारमहागिम्हे,दुक्खायवतिववेयणुम्हवियं,जिणवयणमेहसीयल-उल्हवियं सयलजियलोयं"
english: "The world is a vast expanse, The rivers of sorrow and longing, The valleys of happiness and prosperity."

prakrit: "अह ते सुणित्तु धम्मं,जिणवरमुहकमलनिग्गयं देवा,सम्मत्तलद्धबुद्धी,गया य निययाइँ ठाणाई"
english: "Oh! you who have heard Dharma, Who, faced with great difficulty, Have acquired discernment, Have learned to abide in destiny."

prakrit: "मगहाहिवो वि राया,वीरजिणं पणमिऊण भावेणं,सबपरिवारसहिओ,कुसग्गनयरं समणुपत्तो"
english: "Even the good elephant refuses to budge. The brave jinn feigning remorse. All the members of the family Compare. The poor girl's reply." ""

prakrit: "ताव य दिवसवसाणे,अत्थं चिय दिणयरो समल्लीणो,मउलन्ति य कमलाई,विरहो चक्कायमिहुणाणं"
english: "At the end of each day, When the nights are fleeting, When one can think long and steadily of finding one's soulmate, Is an odd sort of separation."

prakrit: "उच्छरइ तमो गयणे,मइलन्तो दिसिवहे कसिणवण्णो,सज्जणचरिउज्जोयं,नजइ ता दुजणसहावो"
english: "When you rise, you rise; When you fall, you faint; When a gentleman rises, You fail to help a poor man."

prakrit: "राया वि निययभवणे,मणिदीवजलन्तकिरणविच्छुरिए,सयणे सुहप्पसुत्तो,कुसुमपडोच्छइयषल्लके"
english: "Raya vi niyaya bhavane, Mani diyas, Watery rays scattered all over, Sayane suhappasutta, Kusumpadochaeya yaasaallake."

prakrit: "निदं सेवन्तो च्चिय,सुविणे वि पुणो पुणो जिणवरिन्दं,पेच्छइ पुच्छइ य तओ,संसय परमं पयत्तेणं"
english: "She sleeps soundly, He listens attentively, Lifestyles her all the time, Asks all the questions she has to answer, Says she has reached the ultimate pinnacle."

prakrit: "घणगुरुगभीरगज्जिय-निणायबहुतूरबन्दिसदेणं,अह उट्टिओ महप्पा,थुवन्तो मङ्गलसएहिं"
english: "A heavy, heavy girdle, Two long strokes in a cage, Oh! a lotus bud, A slap is a blessing"

prakrit: "चिन्तेऊण पवत्तो,भणियं वीरेण धम्मसंजुत्तं,चक्कहराइनराणं,भुवणमिणं हवइ परिहाणं"
english: "Thinking is the path, Speaking is the dharma of the brave, Traveling is the rainbow, Travel is the wind among the clouds."

prakrit: "पउमचरियम्मि एत्तो,मणो महं कुणइ परमसंदेहं,कह वाणरेहि निहया,रक्खसवसहा अइबला वि?"
english: "Proud lady, This is how I feel: The pinnacle of my being is threatened; How can a man with speech fail? Even a demon's life is threatened."

prakrit: "जिणवरधम्मेणं चिय,महइमहाकुलसमुब्भवा जाया,विज्जासयाण पारं,गया य बलगबिया वीरा"
english: "Through the fire of renunciation, Through the vast expanse of the great firmament, Through wisdom and power, Gone is the warrior's strength."

prakrit: "सुवन्ति लोयसत्थे,रावणपमुहा य रक्खसा सवे,वस-लोहिय-मंसाई-भक्खण-पाणे कयाहारा"
english: "Suvanti is on the right track, Ravana or Rakshasa is ahead, Vasasa - Lohia - Mansai - Eating - Drinking - Doing - Wrong"

prakrit: "किर रावणस्स भाया,महाबलो नाम कुम्भयण्णो त्ति,छम्मासं विगयभओ,सेज्जासु निरन्तरं सुयइ"
english: "Who is this Ravana? He is called by the name of Mahabala, The potter; He knows the skies, He constantly sleeps on the bed."

prakrit: "जइ वि य गएसु अङ्ग,पेल्लिज्जइ गरुयपवयसमेसु,तेल्लघडेसु य कण्णा,पूरिजन्ते सुयन्तस्स"
english: "If you go anywhere Your limbs are swollen, If you're heavy - bodied - your eyes are oily, You're doomed to sleep"

prakrit: "पडुपडहतूरसदं,न सुणइ सो सम्मुहं पि वजन्तं,न य उट्टेइ महप्पा,सेज्जाए अपुण्णकालम्मि"
english: "The plowman is a long way off, He does not hear me speak before him, Nor does he bother to say a word When I am late."

prakrit: "अह उढिओ वि सन्तो,असणमहा घोरपरिगयसरीरो,पुरओ हवेज जो सो,कुञ्जर-महिसाइणो गिलइ"
english: "Oh! you fool, We are satisfied with what we got up to, We have no more trouble getting up, But the whole air is swallowed up by the kunjar - a buffalo calf."

prakrit: "काऊण उदरभरणं,सुर-माणुस-कुञ्जराइबहुएसु,पुणरवि सेज्जारूढो,भयरहिओ सुयइ छम्मासं"
english: "Who cares for stomachs, Who is well - nourished, Who has a heart of gold, Who needs a good night's rest, And who is afraid of sleeping in the shade?"

prakrit: "अन्नं पि एव सुबइ,जह इन्दो रावणेण संगामे,जिणिऊण नियलबद्धो,लङ्कानयरी समाणीओ"
english: "Food is as good as gold in the company of Ravana, As long as he is controlled by the conqueror, As are the wives of Lankans."

prakrit: "को निणिऊण समत्थो,इन्दं ससुरा-'सुरे वि तेलोक्के,जो सागरपेरन्तं,जम्बुद्दीवं समुद्धरइ"
english: "Who cares, mother - in - law -" "Surely he who dwells in the midst of the sea, Like the jasmine in the middle of the ocean, Is wise." ""

prakrit: "एरावणो गइन्दो,जस्स य वजं अमोहपहरत्थं,तस्स किर चिन्तिएण वि,अन्नो वि भवेज मसिरासिं"
english: "Be reasonable! For what use is a bow, If it means anything at all, But to think of it? It must mean something to me."

prakrit: "सीहो मएण निहओ,साणेण य कुञ्जरो जहा भग्गो,तह विवरीयषयत्थं,कईहि रामायणं रइयं"
english: "As the tree is destroyed, So is the tree of life; As the potter's field is ruined, So are the poems of the Ramayana."

prakrit: "अलियं पि सबमेयं,उववत्तिविरुद्धपच्चयगुणेहिं,न य सद्दहन्ति पुरिसा,हवन्ति जे पण्डिया लोए"
english: "Alas, all the same, Virtuous men deviate from the norm, Not always able men, As in the Pandya world."

prakrit: "एवं चिन्तन्तो च्चिय,संसयपरिहारकारणं राया,जिणदरिसणुस्सुयमणो,गमणुच्छाहो तओ जाओ"
english: "And when you think about it, You fool, The cause of our sorrows Is burning bright, Like the fire that burns in our hearts, Gone too soon."

prakrit: "वरकमलनिबद्धा निग्गयालीसमत्ता,महुरसरनिनायाच्चन्तरम्मा षदेसा,तरुषवणवलम्गा पुप्फरेणुं मुयन्ता,विमलकिरणमन्ताइच्चभासा विसुद्धा"
english: "The bracelets on the bridegroom's bosom, Like a bunch of pearls sticking out of the jasmine's eye, Are a blessing to all women Who yearn for the pleasures of love, Like the rays of the moon In a whisper"

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए सेणियचिन्ताविहाणो नाम बिईयो समुद्देसओ समत्तो"
english: "In the name of this virtuous warrior and warrior Consciousness is bound to dominate the society."

prakrit: "अत्थाणिमण्डवत्थो,सबालंकारभूसियसरीरो,सामन्तमउडमोत्तिय-किरणसमुज्जलियपावीढो"
english: "Atmanimandavathotho, sabal - adorned bows, bow - faced pearls - The rays of the moon illuminate the whole sky."

prakrit: "सो तत्थ मगहराया,मुणिदरिसणकारणे कउच्छाहो,आरुहइ वरगइन्दं,परिहत्थं लक्खणषसत्थं"
english: "There she was, staring at the horizon, Touched by the rays of the moon, Touching the horizon with her sharp arrows, And looking down into the night sky."

prakrit: "अह निग्गओ पुराओ,गयवररहजोहतुरयपरिकिण्णो,वच्चइ नरिन्दवसहो,जत्थ'च्छइ गोयमो भयवं"
english: "Ah! the poor old man! Living in poverty, Like a flock of geese Struggling to find a mate. Wherever he may go I am afraid."

prakrit: "पत्तो य तं पएसं,मुणिवरगणसङ्घमज्झयारम्मि,पेच्छइ गणहरवसहं,सरयरविं चेव तेएणं"
english: "Leaf is what I wear, The congregation of sages gathers in my heart, I see flocks of elephants, All the way to the river for a drink."

prakrit: "ओयरिय गयवराओ,काऊण षयाहिणं मुणिं राया,पणमइ पहट्ठमणसो,अञ्जलिमउलं सिरे काउं"
english: "Foolish girl, Why are you hiding your face? It's the first time you've seen a woman kissed Before you kissed her lips."

prakrit: "दिन्नासीस चिय सो,उवविठ्ठो मुणिवरस्स पामूले,देहकुसलाइ सवं,पुच्छइ परमेण विणएणं"
english: "Dinnasis chias, behold, the lotus of the forehead, bowed by the hair of the body, Asks God to weave it."

prakrit: "नाऊण य पत्थावं,पुणरवि विणओवयारसंजुत्तो,संसयतिमिरावहरं,अह पुच्छइ गोयमं राया"
english: "Now tell me, You silly girl, Why don't you go back and sort it out again?" she whispered.

prakrit: "पउमचरियं महायस!,अहयं इच्छामि परिफुडं सोउं,उप्पाइया पसिद्धी,कुसत्थवादीहि विवरीया"
english: "Proud lady! I wish I had a good sleep At the end of it All. Praise be to the plowman's wife! A wrestler's widow." ""

prakrit: "जइ रावणो महायस!,निसायरो सुरवरो व अइविरिओ,कह सो परिहूओ च्चिय,वाणरतिरिएहि रणमज्झे"
english: "Jealous Ravana, you great warrior! How is it, my poor breasts, That you treat everyone with disrespect? The forest is teeming with swordsmen!"

prakrit: "रामेण कणयदेहो,सरेण भिन्नो मओ अरण्णम्मि,सुग्गीवसुतारत्थं,छिद्देण विवाइओ वाली"
english: "For Rama, the forest is sacred, For everyone is different, For a good song is pure, And for a loose marriage It is pure."

prakrit: "गन्तूण देवनिलयं,सुरवइ जिणिऊण समरमज्झम्मि,दढकढिणनियलबद्धो,पवेसिओ चारगेहम्मि"
english: "Destruction is the temple of God, Conquest is the middle of the battle, The dog is tightly bound, The hunter is in charge of the pastime."

prakrit: "सवत्थसत्थकुसलो,छम्मासं सुयइ कुम्भकण्णो वि,कह वाणरेहि बद्धो,सेउ च्चिय सायरजलम्मि"
english: "The plowman's son, Even the potter's ear sleeps in the shade. Who is bound by the string? It is only the water in the well That flows out." ""

prakrit: "भयवं! कुणह पसायं,कहेह तच्चत्थहेतुसंजुत्तं,संदेहअन्धयारं,नाणुज्जोएण नासेह"
english: "Fear! Be nice to each other, Be reasonable to some extent, Be suspicious of darkness, Be careful not to get into trouble." ""

prakrit: "तो भणइ गणहरिन्दो,सुणेहि नरवसह! दिन्नकण्णमणो,जह केवलीण सिटुं,अहमवि तुम्हं परिकहेमि"
english: "So you fool, you stupid coward! Just sit here for a while, my darling, And I'll take you in my arms." ""

prakrit: "न य रक्खसो त्ति भण्णइ,दसाणणो णेय आमिसाहारो,अलियं ति सबमेयं,भणन्ति जं कुकइणो मूढा"
english: "No, you are not telling me to be vigilant, Dasna says nothing, Aamisaharo says everything, Alias, I am telling you, the cook is a fool."

prakrit: "न य पीढबन्धरहियं,कहिज्जमाणं पि देइ भावत्थं,पत्थिव! हीणं च पुणो,वयणमिणं छिन्नमूलं व"
english: "I am not bound by any ties of kinship, For how can I give you my feelings? They are permanent! Weakness, too, must be got rid of." ""

prakrit: "पढमं खेत्तविभागं,कालविभागं च तत्थ वण्णेहं,महइमहापुरिसाण य,चरियं च जहक्कम सुणसु"
english: "I will tell you the difference between reading and writing, And time and space. Listen to me when I speak of great cities."

prakrit: "अत्थि अणन्ताणन्तं,आगासं तस्स मज्झयारम्मि,लोओ अणाइनिहणो,तिभेयभिन्नो हवइ निच्चो"
english: "There is no end to it, the fire is only in my heart, The people are indifferent, The winds blow with trepidation"

prakrit: "वेत्तासणसरिसो च्चिय,अह लोगो चेव होइ नायबो,झल्लरिसमो य मज्झे,उवरिं पुण मुरयसंठाणो"
english: "Wait a moment, you fool, I won't go, It's only the moonlight of spring. Once again it's the moon." ""

prakrit: "सबो य तालसरिसो,तीसु य वलएसु होइ परिणद्धो,मज्झम्मि तिरियलोओ,सायरदीवेसु बहुएसु"
english: "All are yearning for love, All are eager to please, The midday sun is hovering Over us, And the evening sun is rising Over us."

prakrit: "तस्स वि य मज्झदेसे,जम्बुद्दीवो य दप्पणायारो,एक्कं च सयसहस्सं,जोयणसंखाषमाणेणं"
english: "There must be something wrong with me, Like jealousy or anger, Like being haunted by a secret passion."

prakrit: "सो य पुण सबओ च्चिय,लवणसमुद्देण संपरिक्खित्तो,पउमवरवेइयाए,दारेसु समुज्जलसिरीओ"
english: "Well done to all of you," he said, reaching for the riverbank, "The whole street is brimful of water."

prakrit: "मज्झम्मि मन्दरगिरी,चउकाणणमण्डिओ रयणचित्तो,नवनउइ सहस्साई,समुस्सिओ दस य वित्थिणो"
english: "My mother - in - law's house is empty, My eyes are closed, My heart is heavy, I have to make new friends, My mind is full of trouble."

prakrit: "जोयणसहस्समेगं,अहोगओ वज्जपडलमल्लीणो,उवरिं च चूलियाए,सोहम्मं चेव फुसमाणो"
english: "The clouds are swollen with joy, The skies are red, The roads are slippery, And the streets are empty. Beauty alone is a curse."

prakrit: "छच्चेव य वासहरा,वासा सत्तेव होन्ति नायबा,चोदस महानईओ,नाभिगिरी चेव चत्तारि"
english: "The hut is empty, The forest is dry, The roads are muddy, The rivers are swollen, The navels are red."

prakrit: "वीसं वक्खारगिरी,चोत्तीस हवन्ति रायहाणीओ,वेयड्डषवया वि य,चोत्तीसं चेव नायबा"
english: "Twenty wretches, thirty-four hawkish women, In addition to the poor bridegroom, the twenty-fourth do not know what to do."

prakrit: "अट्ठ य सट्ठीओ तह,गुहाण सीहासणाण पुण तीसं,उत्तर-देवकुरूणं,मज्झे वरपायवे दिवे"
english: "Get up and sit down. Try again and again to grasp the crown of thorns. The gods reply:" "The lamps burn brightly When I am about to sacrifice my husband." ""

prakrit: "दो कञ्चणकूडसया,छ चेव दहा हवन्ति नायबा,चित्त-विचित्ता य दुवे,जमलगिरी होन्ति दो चेव"
english: "Two spiky dogs, Six chews, Ten howling nymphs, Two whims, Two jasmine hips,"

prakrit: "छ ब्भोगभूमिभागा,वरपायवमण्डिया मणभिरामा,एएसु य ठाणेसुं,हवन्ति जिणचेइयघराइं"
english: "Chha bhoga bhoomibhaga, varapayava mandya manabhirama, aesu or thanesu, havanthi houses of victory."

prakrit: "अह एत्तो लवणजले,दीवा चत्तारि होन्ति नायवा,जिणचेइएसु रम्मा,भोगेण य दिवलोगसमा"
english: "Oh! so much salt water! The lamp is burning brightly! No, Rama! But what do you want me to eat? It's the fire of Diwali." ""

prakrit: "जम्बुद्दीवे भरहस्स दक्खिणे रक्खसाण दीवो'थि,दीवो गन्धवाणं,अवरेण ठिओ विदेहस्स"
english: "The south wind stirs the jasmine, The lamp scents the fragrance Of fire., With them the scenes abound."

prakrit: "तत्तो एरवयस्स य,किन्नरदीवो उ होइ उत्तरओ,पुब विदेहस्स पुणो,पुत्रेण ठिओ वरुणदीवो"
english: "There it is, the yearning is gone, The eunuchs have returned, The vidyadas return, And the son - in - law is the god Varuna."

prakrit: "भरहेरवएसु तहा,हाणी वुड्डी य होइ नायबा,सेसेसु होइ कालो,खेत्तेसु अवट्ठिओ निच्चं"
english: "Come on, you fool, Don't be so naïve: The field is empty, The trees have withered, The fields are black."

prakrit: "जम्बुद्दीवाहिवई,अणाढिओ सुरवरो महड्डीओ,देवसहस्ससमग्गो,सामित्तं कुणइ सवेसिं"
english: "The God of Love, Who is great and powerful, Makes all people equal."

prakrit: "आसि पुरा भरहमिणं,उत्तरकुरुसरिसभोगसंपुण्णं,वरकप्परुक्खषउरं,सुसमासुसमासु अइरम्मं"
english: "Here comes the full moon, The full moon of the festival of lights, The flowers of the garland tree, The heat of summer."

prakrit: "तिण्णेव गाउयाई,उच्चत्तं ताण होइ मणुयाणं,चउरंसं संठाणं,आउठिई तिण्णि पल्लाइं"
english: "The three cows are gone, The man is in great distress, The four oxen are at a standstill, And here are the three flocks."

prakrit: "तुडियङ्ग१भोयणङ्गार,विहूसणङ्गा३ मयङ्ग४वत्थङ्गा५,गिह६ जोइ७दीवियङ्गा८ भायण९मल्लङ्ग१०कप्पदुमा"
english: "Tudiang 1, Bhoyangar, Vihusnanga 3, Mayang 4, Vatthanga 5, Gih6, Joi7, Divyang8, Bhayana9, Mallanga10, Kappaduma"

prakrit: "एएहि मणभिरामं,जहिच्छियं दसविहं महाभोगं,भुञ्जन्ति निच्चसुहिया,गयं षि कालं न याणन्ति"
english: "Oh! the passion of love, Like ten great pastimes roasted to a crisp, Can't know what time it is."

prakrit: "आउम्मि थोवसेसे,मिहुणं जणिऊण पंवरलायणं,कालं काऊण तओ,सुरवरसोक्खं पुण लभन्ति"
english: "From the moment you arrive, Friend, Who has spent the night before, Time will tell, And the pleasures of love will be renewed."

prakrit: "सीहादओ वि सोमा,न वि ते कुप्पन्ति एक्कमेक्कस्स,सच्छन्दसुहविहारी,ते वि हु भुञ्जन्ति सोक्खाइं"
english: "Life is transient, Not one can escape it all But those who enjoy it Enjoyably Even when they are hungry."

prakrit: "भरहेरवएसु तहा,हाणी वुड्डी य हवइ कालस्स,न य हाणी न य वुड्डी,सेसेसु य होइ खेत्तेसु"
english: "The rainy season is here, Deer - eyed woodies are here, Time is running out, There are no deer or woodies left. Either way, you're still farming."

prakrit: "एवं सुणिउं राया पुच्छइ साहुं पुणो पणमिऊणं,केण कएण मणूसो,उप्पज्जइ भोगभूमीसु"
english: "And when she hears Raya ask her what she wants done with her money again, Who is it that begs for it? It is the pleasure of the field." ""

prakrit: "तो भणइ गणहरिन्दो,जे एत्थं उज्जुया नरा भद्दा,ते भोगभूमिमग्गं,लहन्ति साहुप्पयाणेणं"
english: "So he says," "People of the village, If you do not want to be seen here shining brightly, Then go to the field of enjoyment. Take care not to fall asleep there." ""

prakrit: "जे कुच्छिएसु दाणं,देन्ति सुहभोगकारणनिमित्तं,ते कुञ्जराइ जाया,भुञ्जन्तिह दाणनं सोक्खं"
english: "Those who, being stingy, give charity for the sake of pleasure, become stingy; When roasted, the charity tastes better."

prakrit: "जह खेत्तम्मि सुकिट्टे,बीयं वड्डइ न तस्स परिहाणी,एवं सुसाहुदाणे,विउलं पुण्णं समज्जिणइ"
english: "As soon as a plant is dry, When it is not sown, It is distilled, And with good help, The farmer understands good"

prakrit: "एक्कम्मि जह तलाए,धेणुऎ सप्पेण पाणियं पीयं,सप्पे परिणमइ विसं,घेणुसु खीरं समुन्भवइ"
english: "One who fries, Drinks water at every drop, Turns into a snake, And swallows kheer with its mouth."

prakrit: "तह निस्सील-सुसीले,दिन्नं दाणं फलं अफलयं च,होही परम्मि लोए,पत्तविसेसेण से पुण्णं"
english: "Without a trace of sulkiness, Giving charity and unfailing fruit, In this wretched world, Purified by the absence of leaves."

prakrit: "एवं दाणविसेसो,नरवइ! कहिओ मए समासेणं,कुलगरवंसुप्पत्ती,भणामि एत्तो निसामेहि"
english: "And you coward, you bastard! Tell me, young and handsome, I'm so helpless." ""

prakrit: "जह चन्दो परिवड्डइ,ओसरइ य अप्पणो सभावेणं,उस्सप्पिणी वि वड्डइ,एवं अवसप्पिणीहाणी"
english: "As the moon turns, And recedes, So does her lover, And so does her husband."

prakrit: "तइयम्मि कालसमए,पल्लोवमअट्ठभागसेसम्मि,पढमो कुलगरवसभो,उप्पन्नो षडिसुई नामं१"
english: "At the same time, Pallavam is about eighty parts long. I've read Kulagarvasambho, But you have a clever name." ""

prakrit: "जाईसरो महप्पा,जाणइ जो तिण्णि जम्मसंबन्धे,तस्स य सुई पसन्ना,वसइ सुहं सबओ वसुहा"
english: "Everyone loves a good girl, Anyone who knows anything about women likes a good man, She is happy when everyone is happy."

prakrit: "एवं समइक्वन्ते,काले तो सम्मुई समुप्पन्नो२,खेमंकरो य एत्तो३,तओ य खेमंधरो जाओ४"
english: "And all the same, when the time comes, face to face with one another, With regret so long, Then with regret go one's ways."
