prakrit: "विन्नाण-सिप्परहिया,धम्मा-'धम्मेण वज्जिया पुहई,कल्लाण-पयरणाणं,न य पासण्डाण उप्पत्ती"
english: "Through learning - through sipparhaiah, through dharma, the wise attain enlightenment, Through worship - through travel, Without neglecting one's past."

prakrit: "तइया धणएण कया. नयरी वरकणगतुङ्गषागारा,नवजोयणवित्थिण्णा,बारस दीहा रयणपुण्णा"
english: "What are you doing with that bracelet? The bridegroom is about to depart, And the young couple are about to leave. It's only the twilight of the rainy season." ""

prakrit: "उसभजिणेण भगवया,गामा-''-गर-नगर-पट्टण-निवेसा,कल्लाण-पयरणाणि य,सयं च सिप्पाण उवइटुं"
english: "Because of that worship, Bhagavata, Gama -" "Be - grown - town - city - nivesa, village - journeyman, Always lift up your head." ""

prakrit: "रक्खण करणनिउत्ता,जे तेण नरा महन्तदढसत्ता,ते खत्तिया पसिद्धिं,गया य पुहइम्मि विक्खाया"
english: "Protect her, do not harm her, For she is not so great a warrior As she was once: She has reached her climax."

prakrit: "वाणिज्ज-करिसणाई,गोरक्खण-पालणेसु उज्जुत्ता,ते होन्ति वइसनामा,वावारपरायणा धीरा"
english: "Merchant - Compassionate, Gorakhana - observant, He gives solemn vows, Patience to behavior."

prakrit: "जे नीयकम्मनिरया,परपेसणकारया निययकालं,ते होन्ति सुद्दवग्गा,बहुभेया चेव लोगम्मि"
english: "One who is always vigilant, who is constantly thinking, is always a good observer; People with great affection are everywhere."

prakrit: "जेण य जुगं निविट्ठ,पुहईए सयलसत्तसुहजणणं,तेण उ जगम्मि घुटुं,तं कालं कयजुगं नाम"
english: "When the world stands still, When the full moon has set, That makes the world kneel. What is the name of that age?"

prakrit: "भज्जा सुमङ्गला जिण-वरस्स नन्दा तओ भवे बीया,भरहाइकुमाराणं,पुत्तसयं तस्स उप्पन्नं"
english: "Bhajja, Sumangala, Jina, Varasa, Nanda, There must be seeds in it. Dependent on your son's name, Your son is bound to it."

prakrit: "दोणि य वरधूयाओ,जोवण-लायण्ण-कन्ति-कलियाओ,बम्भी वि सुन्दरी वि य,जणम्मि विक्खायकित्तीओ"
english: "Both are rainy days, The young and the old, The tall and the lanky, The haughty and the beautiful, And the woman is full of vigor."

prakrit: "सामन्त-भड-पुरोहिय-सेणावइ-सेटि-भोइयाणं च,दावेइ रायनीई,लोगस्स वि लोगसंबन्धं"
english: "Feudal - elder - priest - patron - wife - sister - brother - in law. Even the people belong to the people."

prakrit: "एव रायवरसिरिं,भुञ्जन्तस्स उ अइच्छिओ कालो,नीलं वासं दटुं,संवेगपरायणो जाओ"
english: "Hey, you silly girl, Look! It's pitch black outside, It looks like a sapphire bush. Let the emotions take over." ""

prakrit: "कर्ट अहो! विलम्बइ,लोओ परपेसणेसु आसत्तो,उम्मत्तओ व नच्चइ,कुणइ य बहुचेट्ठियसयाई"
english: "" "Hey, Kurt! It's getting late. People are getting anxious." "They seem to be enjoying it too Much."

prakrit: "मणुयत्तणं असारं,विजुलयाचञ्चलं हवइ जीयं,बहुरोग-सोगकिमिकुल-भायणभूयं हवइ देहं"
english: "Human life is impermanent, The wind is a flicker of light, Life is a mass of diseases, And grief is a trickle - Nature is the wind."

prakrit: "दुक्खं सुहं ति मन्नइ,जीवो विसयामिसेसु अणुरत्तो,पुणरवि बहुं विनडिउं,न मुणइ आउं परिगलन्तं"
english: "She considers suffering as pleasure; The soul goes on making wishes; Once again she hears much lamentation; She does not sigh or groan."

prakrit: "एयं चिय विसयसुहं,असासयं उज्झिऊण निस्सङ्गो,सिद्धिसुहकारणत्थं,करेमि तव-संजमुज्जोयं"
english: "This is the pleasure of my wretchedness, To make you feel so empty, To cause you to feel so accomplished, I will perform your miracle."

prakrit: "जाव य चिन्तेइ इमं,संसारोच्छेयकारणं उसभो,ताव य भिसन्तमउडा,देवा लोगन्तिया पत्ता"
english: "When he thinks of her, The cause of his worldly dissolution is plain to see. But when he speaks of her It is as though God were a log."

prakrit: "काऊण सिरपणामं,भणन्ति साहु त्ति नाह! पडिबुद्धो,वोच्छिन्नस्स सुबहुओ,कालो इह सिद्धिमग्गस्स"
english: "Who is going to say:" "No, sir, don't be angry!" "Stupid old man, That's the way of a broken man. Tomorrow it's Siddhimaggas."

prakrit: "एए भमन्ति जीवा,पुणरुत्तं जम्मसायरे भीमे,जिणवयणपोयलग्गा,तरन्तु मा णे चिरावेहि"
english: "Ah! a flock of geese! Once again the jasmine sits astride me, Trying to stay alive. So don't swim too long." ""

prakrit: "एवं दढववसायस्स तस्स निक्खमणकारणे देवा,तुरियं च समणुपत्ता,सुरिन्दषमुहा चउवियप्पा"
english: "And the god is proud of his perseverance, And his trumpet is blowing loudly, Like the trumpet sound of a trumpet." ""

prakrit: "नमिऊण जिणवरिन्द,जयसदाला य सहरिसं तुट्ठा,धय-छत्त-चारुचामर-चलन्तकरपल्लवसणाहा"
english: "Foolish girl, The streets are deserted, The town is in ruins, The roof is leaking, The street is deserted, And the street is empty."

prakrit: "वजिन्दनील मरगय-चन्दणमणिखचियकणयपरिवेढं,आरुहइ सुरसमाहिय-खन्धं तु सुदंसणं सिबियं"
english: "Vazindanil Maragayya - Sandalwood leaves strewn all over the place, Touching the sweetwood tree - You have proved a good sight." ""

prakrit: "अह निग्गओ महप्पा,नयराओ 'सुर-नरिन्दपरिकिण्णो,तूरसहस्ससमाहय–बन्दियणुग्घुट्ठजयसद्दो"
english: "Ah! the empty lotus, Like the nail marks on your cheek, Like jewels pierced by a sharp arrow, Like shackles tied to your thighs."

prakrit: "वरबउल-तिलय-चम्पय-असोग-पुन्नाग-नागसुसभिद्ध,पत्तो पवरुज्जाणं,वसन्ततिलयं ति नामेणं"
english: "Varbula - tilaya - champaya - asoga - punanga - nagasusasiddha, the leaf is pure knowledge, spring is its name."

prakrit: "आपुच्छिऊण सवं,माया-पिय-पुत्त-सयण-परिवग्गं,तो मुयइ भूसणाई,कडिसुत्तय-कडय-वत्थाई"
english: "If you want to see everything, Love, affection, sons, wives, Circumcisions, You have to knead and knead."

prakrit: "सिद्धाण नमुक्कार,काऊण य पञ्चमुट्ठियं लोयं,चउहि सहस्सेहि समं,पत्तो य जिणो परमदिक्खं"
english: "Praise be to principle, Criticism be to the five great vows, Friendship be to all four equal, For by virtue of it one conquers all."

prakrit: "वइज्जाउहो वि ताहे,केसे मणिषडलयम्मि घेत्तूणं,काऊण सिरपणामं,खीरसमुद्दम्मि पक्खिवइ"
english: "Oh! what a traitor! How can a man grab at the tip of a blade, Who is going to hit him on the head With a sharp arrow?"

prakrit: "निक्खमणमहामहिमं,देवा काऊण सुरवरसमग्गा,नमिऊण जिणवरिन्द,गया य निययाइँ ठाणाई"
english: "Praise be to you, my dear, God, How delightful it is to make mention of you, As one who has reached the goal of victory."

prakrit: "चउहि सहस्सेहि समं,समणाणं जिणवरो महाभागो,गहिउववासो विहरइ,वसुहं संवच्छरं धीरो"
english: "All four are equal in happiness; the one who conquers renunciation obtains the greatest fortune; The one who renounces renunciation prospers; The other maintains chastity."

prakrit: "केएत्थ पढममासे,बीए तइए उ जाव छम्मासे,परिसहभडेहि ताव य,भग्गा समणा अपरिसेसा"
english: "Where have you been for so long, O moon - faced girl, So far from home It's been one heck of a ride."

prakrit: "भरहस्स भएण घरं,न एन्ति तण्हाछुहाकिलन्ता वि,लज्जाए गारवेण य,ताहे रण्णं परिवसन्ति"
english: "Being proud makes a house, Not so much for the cool of your shadow As for being ashamed of it." - The forest roams there.

prakrit: "अह ते छुहाकिलन्ता,फलाइँ गिण्हन्ति पायवगणेसु,अम्बरतलम्मि घुटुं,मा गेण्हह समणरूवेण"
english: "Oh! they are touching, Counting the steps to the fruit, Kneel at your feet, Do not bend your knees so as not to fall."

prakrit: "ताहे वक्कलचीवर-कुसपत्तनियंसणा फलाहारा,सच्छन्दमइवियप्पा,बहुभेया तावसा जाया"
english: "So, Vakalchivar - The poor Niyamasana has borne fruit, Blessed is the mother - in - law, Too much hatred has become too much."

prakrit: "ताव य जिणस्स पासे,पत्ता नमि-विणमि भोगवरकडी,काऊण सिरपणाम,पायब्भासे सुहनिविट्ठा"
english: "You're right, Leaves are for sale, I'm going to knit a skirt, You'd better take it with you, Your hair is going to be nicer."

prakrit: "भोगसमुहाण ताणं,धरणिन्दो आसणे तओ चलिए,सबपरिवारसहिओ,सो वि तहिं चेव संपत्तो"
english: "Stretch out your limbs for enjoyment, Sit in silence, Come with all your family, For then you will have plenty."

prakrit: "नमिऊण पायकमले,उवविठ्ठो जिणवरस्स आसन्ने,पेच्छइ तरुणजुवाणे,'दोण्णि जणे षङ्कयदलच्छे"
english: "On the lotus of her foot, Lifting up her thighs, She looks at the young men:" "They both tremble." ""

prakrit: "अह भणइ नागराया,भो भो! तुम्हेत्थ किंनिमित्तेणं,असिलट्ठिगहियहत्था,उभओ वि ठिया जिणसयासे?"
english: "Oh! you naughty girl! What are you doing here for? Your hands are tied in such a way That you look just like that!"

prakrit: "तो भणइ नमी वयणं,अम्हं नत्थेत्थ रायवरलच्छी,एयनिमित्तं च पहू!,जिणस्स पासं समल्लीणा"
english: "So I said," "It's the moonlight of the sky, I don't know what to do with it." "And for that reason too, Pahu!"

prakrit: "एवं च भणियमेते,धरणेणं तस्स बलसमिद्धाओ,दिन्नाओ तक्खणं चिय,विज्जाओ'णेयरूवाओ"
english: "And as the saying goes," "Hold on tight, keep it tight, make sure you don't slip." "Knowledge begets wisdom."

prakrit: "उवइट्ठो य नगवरो,वेयड्ढो ताण उत्तमो वासो,पन्नास जोयणाई,वित्थिण्णो सुद्धरययमओ"
english: "A man who walks upright is a good man, A woman who walks wide is good, And a woman who sits upright is wise."

prakrit: "उबिद्धो पणवीसा,दोसु य सेढीसु उभयओ रम्मो,छज्जोयणाइँ धरणिं,कोसो च्चिय होइ उबेहो"
english: "Foolish woman, The two banks are at loggerheads, Love is at hand, Betrayal is on the cards, Anger is brewing, But anger vanishes."

prakrit: "दक्खिणसेढी गन्तुं,रहनेउरचकवालपमुहाइं,पन्नास पुरवराई,कयाइँ नमिखेयरिन्देण"
english: "Go to the south, stay where you are, make love with your lover, make fifty offerings, For who needs a name?"

prakrit: "अह गयणवल्लहपुरं,उत्तरसेढीऎ"
english: "Ah, Gayanballahpuram, the seer of the north."

prakrit: "तत्तो य दसगमित्ता,उवरिं गन्धव-किन्नराईणं,वरभवणमण्डियाई,किंपुरिसाणं च नयराइं"
english: "There it is, Dasgamitta, above it the sulphurous kinarayana, behind the garland of garlands, and behind the lotuses."

prakrit: "उवरिं तओ वि गन्तुं,पञ्च'न्ने जोयणे सिहरपटुं,जिणभवणेसु मणहरं,उन्भासेन्तं दस दिसाओ"
english: "There you are, Still a long way to go, Five pairs of shoes on the headstone, One man's mind to live in, Ten directions to his face."

prakrit: "भवणेसु तेसु निययं,चारणसमणा वसन्ति गुणवन्ता,सज्झाय-झाणनिरया,तवतेयसिरीऎ दिप्पन्ता"
english: "Destiny is like a house, The pleasures of love dwell in the midst of it, Decorated with wisdom, Luminous with fresh air."

prakrit: "बहुगाम-नयर-पट्टण-आरामुज्जाण-काणणसमिद्धा,मणि-रयण-कञ्चणुज्जल-जलन्तघरनिवहपन्तीओ"
english: "Bahugam - Noir - Town - Pleasure - Contentment with ears, Mani - Rayana - Trembling fire - The flames of a burning house."

prakrit: "वरमहिसि-गाइपउरो,बहुविहधण्णेण मणहरालोओ,सबोसहिसंपन्नो,महु-खीर-घएण पज्झरिओ"
english: "Varmahisi - Gaipuro, lovely people with many talents, Who enjoy all sorts of pleasures, Who appreciate sweets - Kheer - Ghee."

prakrit: "अइउण्ह-सीयरहिओ,उवघायविवजिओ पयइसोमो,नज्जइ य देवलोओ,देसो विज्जाहराइण्णो"
english: "We are wise, We are clever, We make fools out of fools, We don't know which is which."

prakrit: "रविकिरणकोमलाहय-वियसियवरकमलसरिसवयणाओ,विज्जाहरजुवईओ,बहुविहलायण्णकलियाओ"
english: "Ravikiranakomlahaya - Vyasiavarakomala Sarisvayana, Vijjaharajuvayi, Bahu Vihalyanankaliya"

prakrit: "विज्जाहरा उ तत्थ वि,विजाबलदप्पगविया सूरा,देवा व देवलोए,भुञ्जन्ति जहिच्छिए भोए"
english: "The gods and goddesses roam the streets As though they had a feast." ""

prakrit: "एवंविहा उभयसेढिगया महन्ता,आहार-पाण-सयणा-''सणसंपउत्ता,विज्जाहरा अणुहवन्ति सुहं समिद्धं,धम्म करिन्ति विमलं च जिणोवइ८"
english: "Here both the plants are very large, The food - the water - the grass - is abundant, The pleasures of wisdom and learning are abundant, For by doing dharma One conquers both nature and matter." ""

prakrit: "इति पउमचरिए विज्जाहरलोगवण्णणो नाम तइओ उद्देसओ समत्तो"
english: "This is the name of the wise man who taught us wisdom: Your words are true."

prakrit: "अह भयवं तित्थयरो,झाणं मोत्तूण दाणधम्मट्टे,विहरेऊण पवत्तो,नगरा-''गरमण्डियं वसुहं"
english: "Ah! fear and trembling, Like a pearl tossed on to a grain bowl, Like an overflowing stream, Is the essence of the city -" "Spring is everywhere." ""

prakrit: "पउमेसु संचरन्तो,गयपुरनयरं कमेण संपत्तो,बहुगुणसयाण निलओ,वसइ निवो जत्थ सेयंसो"
english: "The husband roams the streets, The maidservants of Gayapur make wealth, The virtuous go out in the open, The forest is empty Where there is no water."

prakrit: "मज्झण्हदेसयाले,गोयरचरियाऎ अभिगओ नयरं,घरपन्तीऎ भमन्तो,दिट्ठो लोगेण तित्थयरो"
english: "In the middle of the night The hunter gathers the cattle, In the pastures the shepherd has led the flock, His eyes are fixed on the people."

prakrit: "चन्दो व सोमवयणो,तेएण दिवायरो व दिप्पन्तो,लम्बियकरग्गजुयलो,सिरिवच्छविहूसियसरीरो"
english: "The moon is dark and drowsy, The lamp is dim and gloomy, The jujube is limp, The rays of the crescent are piercing."

prakrit: "वरहार-मउड-कुण्डल-मणि-मोत्तियपट्ट-चामराईणि,उवणेइ जणवओ से,न तेसु चित्तं समल्लियइ"
english: "The bridegroom - The head - The bracelets - The beads - The pearl - The skirt - The women wear them with their husbands, But they satisfy no one."

prakrit: "केइन्थ गय-तुरङ्गम-रहवर-रयणाइमण्डणाडोवा,पुरओ ठवेन्ति तुट्ठा,चलणपणामं च काऊणं"
english: "Kainth gayi - Turangam - Rahavar - Rayanaimandanadowa, Purao thaventi tuttha, chalanapanamam kaunam"

prakrit: "सवङ्गसुन्दराओ,कन्नाओ पुण्णचन्दवयणाओ,देन्ति जणा सोममणा,भिक्खासण्णं अयाणन्ता"
english: "The swangs are beautiful, The ears are pure, The mind is generous, The eyes are fixed on the monks."

prakrit: "नं नं उवणेइ जणो,तं तं नेच्छइ जिणो विगयमोहो,लम्बन्तजडाभारो,नरवइभवणं समणुपत्तो"
english: "She does not look at you, She looks at you with such fondness, Long - eyed woman, Like a man possessed by a demon."

prakrit: "पासायतलत्थो विय,राया द₹ण जिणवरं एन्तं,संभरिय पुवजम्मं,पायब्भासं समल्लीणो"
english: "The passage is long, The path is narrow, Life is fleeting, Love is full of complications, Love has no bounds."

prakrit: "काऊण य 'तिक्खुत्तो,पयाहिणं सयलपरियणसमग्गो,चलणेसु तस्स पडिओ,हरिसवसुब्भिन्नरोमञ्चो"
english: "A man who is so sharp, Who can make a path seem smooth, Falls at his feet When he walks, With swelling girdles of green."

prakrit: "अह रयणभायणत्थं,अग्धं दाऊण सबभावेणं,चलणजुयलप्पणाम,करेइ विमलेण भावेणं"
english: "Ah, the feeling of fearfulness, The emotion of fire and water, The feeling of immodesty in one's conduct."

prakrit: "संमज्जिओवलित्ते,उद्देसे तस्स परमसद्धाए,सेयंसनरवरिन्दो,इक्खुरसं देइ परितुट्ठो"
english: "Be devoted to him, O God of Love, Purify him with the breath of ecstasy, The fire of love."

prakrit: "अह वोइउं पयत्तो,वाओ सुहसीयलो सुरहिगन्धो,षडिया य रयणवुट्ठी,कुसुमेहि समं नहयलाओ"
english: "Oh! the way you walk, The fragrance of pleasant breezes, Like the sound of a bolt of lightning As if it were a waterfall"

prakrit: "घुटं च अहो दाणं,दुन्दुहिघणगुरुगहीरसद्दालं,पत्तो परमब्भुदयं,वरकल्लाणं नरवरिन्दो"
english: "The knee is charity, The anvil is poverty, The bower is pride, The leaf is the supreme dawn, The bridegroom is the savior of souls."

prakrit: "तो अमर-चारणगणा,भणन्ति साधु त्ति परमपुरिस! तुमे,धम्मरहस्स महाजस! बीयं चकं समुद्धरियं"
english: "So immortal pastures, you sage, are supreme! You, great man of dharma! A sea of seed wheels." ""

prakrit: "एवं काऊण जिणो,पवत्तणं दाणवन्तचरियाए,सयडामुहउज्जाणे,पसत्थझाणं समारूढो"
english: "And who will win, Those generous givers of charity, Who gather here for the fair, And those generous ones for the feast?"

prakrit: "झायन्तस्स भगवओ,एवं घाइक्खएण कम्माणं,लोगा-'लोगपगासं,केवलनाणं समुप्पन्नं"
english: "Long live the gods, And shorten the horizon, People -" "People are angry, Only the past is remembered." ""

prakrit: "उप्पन्नम्मि य नाणे,उप्पज्जइ आसणं जिणिन्दस्स,छत्ताइछत्त चामर,तहेव भामण्डलं विमलं"
english: "Uppannami ya nane, uppajjayi asana jinindasa, chattaisatta chamara, thaiva bhamandalam vimalam"

prakrit: "कप्पडुमो य दिबो,दुन्दुहिघोसं च पुप्फवरिसं च,सवाइसयसमग्गो,जिणवरइड्ढेइ समणुपत्तो"
english: "The cupped lamp is bright, The fragrant grass is fragrant, And the flowers are fragrant." "To all the world's eyes This is the arrow of the God of Love."

prakrit: "नाऊण समुप्पत्ति,केवलनाणस्स आगया देवा,काऊण जिणपणामं,उवविठ्ठा सन्निवेसेसु"
english: "A new god is born, A new fire is kindled, A different kind of life is waged; Sit here and there and listen."

prakrit: "भणियं च गणहरेणं,भयवं जीवा अणन्तसंसारे,परिहिण्डन्ति अणाहा,ताणुत्तारं परिकहेहि"
english: "The landowner is always afraid, Lives are constantly threatened, People avoid touching them, Anxious thoughts paralyze him."

prakrit: "अह साहिउं पयत्तो,जलहरगम्भीरमहुरनिग्घोसो,सुरमणुयमज्झयारे,दुविहं धम्मं जिणवरिन्दो"
english: "Ah! the path of love, With streams of water and the roar of peacock's crows, With the sound of trumpets, Two dharmas are victorious."

prakrit: "पञ्च य महत्वयाई,समिईओ पञ्च तिण्णि गुत्तीओ,एसो हु समणधम्मो,जोगविसेसेण बहुभेओ"
english: "The five are important, the five are subtle, the three are complex. This is what I mean by equanimity: There are many different kinds of beings in the world."

prakrit: "पञ्चाणुबयजुत्तो,सत्तहि सिक्खावएहि परिकिण्णो,एसो विं सावयाणं,धम्मो उद्देसविरयाणं"
english: "The observer of five senses, the observer of seven, is like a saviour: Dharma is renunciation."

prakrit: "धम्मेण लहइ जीवो,सुर-माणुसपरमसोक्खमाहप्पं,दुक्खसहस्सावासं,पावइ नरयं अहम्मेणं"
english: "Through Dharma, the soul is enriched, through pleasure and pleasure, through human beings, through suffering, and through nature, through pride."

prakrit: "मेहेण विणा वुट्ठी,न होइ न य बीयवज्जियं सस्सं,तह धम्मेण विरहियं,न य सोक्खं होइ जीवाणं"
english: "One cannot live without milk, one cannot die without seeds, one must be separated by dharma, and one must not live happily ever after."

prakrit: "जइ वि हु तवं विगिट्ट,करन्ति अन्नाणिया पयत्तेणं,तह वि हु किंकरदेवा,हवन्ति चझ्या तओ तिरिया"
english: "Whatever you do, be vigilant, Do it with discerning eye, For even so I am a trembling god. But when I see you, I am astounded."

prakrit: "ते भवसहस्सपउरे,संसारे चाउरङ्गमग्गम्मि,दुक्खाणि अणुहवन्ता,अणन्तकालं परिभमन्ति"
english: "They roam the skies with bated breath, Moving through the circles of the world, Pretending to cause suffering, Endlessly pervading it."

prakrit: "जिणवरधम्मं काऊण,निव्वुया होन्ति केइ अहमिन्दा,कप्पालयाहिवत्तं,अवरे पावन्ति दढधम्मा"
english: "Who is the follower of Jina?, The Ahmindas of the nimvya hanties, The saviours of the Kappalaya, They attain the firm dharma."

prakrit: "जे वि य निग्गन्थाणं,थुई पउज्जन्ति सवभावेणं,ते तस्स फलगुणेणं,न य कुगइपहं पवज्जन्ति"
english: "Whatever goodness is, That is to be worshiped in all senses; It must bear fruit; We must not neglect what is good."

prakrit: "सोऊण धम्मवयणं,जिणवरकहियं नरा-'मरसमूहा,सम्मत्तलद्धबुद्धी,संवेगपरायणा मुइया"
english: "Stop saying dharma to her, Stop acting as if she were jinn -" "A bunch of men, with sagging senses, Have passed on the passion." ""

prakrit: "केइत्थ समणसीहा,हवन्ति ववगयपरिग्गहा-''रम्भा,पञ्चाणुबयजुत्ता,केइ पुण सावया जाया"
english: "Keith samanasīha, havanti vaṃgayaparigaggāha -" "Wretched fire, burning with five great fires, never to be burnt again." ""

prakrit: "एवं सुर-नरवसहा,कहावसाणे जिणं पणमिऊणं,सबइ परियणसहिया,गया य निययाइँ ठाणाई"
english: "And the good man, Who after a long talk Has won the prize, Has done it all With good reason, Has departed, As fate would have it."

prakrit: "विहरइ जत्थ जिणिन्दो,सो देसो सग्गसन्निहो होइ,जोयणसयं समन्ता,रोगादिविवजिओ रम्मो"
english: "Where there is plenty of life, There must be plenty of happiness. For love's sake, please, Make room for the diseased."

prakrit: "अह उसहसेणपमुहा,चउरासीयं तु गणहरा तस्स,उप्पन्ना य सहस्सा,तावइया चेव समणाणं"
english: "Ah, the beauty of that face, You who sit astride it, Such boldness, Such poignancy, Such plainness."

prakrit: "ताव य चक्कहरत्तं,संपत्तं भरहराइणा सयलं,हयगयजुवइसमग्गो,चउदसरयणाहियो धोरो"
english: "You clever hunter, Rich in treasure, Proud young man, Traveler of fourteen vows."

prakrit: "उसभजिणस्स भगवो,पुत्तसयं चन्दसूरसरिसाणं,समणत्तं पडिवन्नं,सए य देहे निरवयक्खं"
english: "That vegetarian God, The moonlit night is for my son's sake, Calmness has fallen, My body is undisturbed."

prakrit: "तक्खसिलाऎ महप्पा,बाहुबली तस्स निच्चपडिकूलो,भरहनरिन्दस्स सया,न कुणइ आणा-पणामं सो"
english: "Takshashila, you fool, There's nothing wrong with that. Please, my poor girl, Don't bring your purse."

prakrit: "अह रुट्ठो चक्कहरो,तस्सुवरिं सयलसाहणसमग्गो,नयरस्स तुरियचवलो,विणिग्गओ सयलबलसहिओ"
english: "O sweetwood tree, Wherever you look There is plenty of fresh grass on the horizon, Like the twang of a trumpet In a fireplace."

prakrit: "पत्तो तक्खसिलपुरं,जयसदुग्घुट्ठकलयलारावो,जुज्झस्स कारणत्थं,सन्नद्धो तक्खणं भरहो"
english: "Pato Takshashilpuram, Jai Sada, Ghatakala Lairavo, For the cause of war, Prepare to have the tank filled."

prakrit: "बाहुबली वि महप्पा,भरहनरिन्दं समागयं सोउं,भडचडयरेण महया,तक्खसिलाओ 'विणिज्जाओ"
english: "Even Bahubali is a great man, When he is full of jewels He gathers gold. When he has a fire He sets fire to it: The lotuses of the lotus Are poisonous." ""

prakrit: "बलदप्पगबियाणं,उभयबलाणं रसन्ततूराणं,आभिट्टं परमरणं,नच्चन्तकबन्धपेच्छणयं"
english: "The sound of the bull's horn, The twang of the cudgel, The rustle of the trumpet, The immolation of the pyre, The embrace of the dancer."

prakrit: "भणिओ य बाहुबलिणा,चक्कहरो किं वहेण लोयस्स?,दोण्हं पि होउ जुज्झं,दिट्टीमुट्ठीहि रणमज्झे"
english: "Tell me, you fool, What do you think is the matter with Lois? Let the two of you be at war. Let the mere glance of your fist brighten the field."

prakrit: "एवं च भणियमेत्ते,दिट्ठीजुझं तओ समन्भडियं,भग्गो य चक्खुपसरो,पढमं चिय निजिओ भरहो"
english: "And as the saying goes:" "When you see a pair of spectacles You are bound to stare at them, But when you taste a fragment Of something you do not know, It fills your soul." ""

prakrit: "पुणरवि भुयासु लग्गा,एक्ककं कढिणदप्पमाहप्पा,चलचलणपीणपेल्लण-करयलपरिहत्थविच्छोहा"
english: "Once again the ground resounds, Like a banner proclaiming victory, Like the nail mark on a young elephant's forehead That hangs down from its hip." ""

prakrit: "अद्धतडिजोत्तबन्धण-अवहन्थुवत्तकरणनिम्मविया,जुज्झन्ति सवडहुत्ता,अभग्गमाणा महापुरिसा"
english: "Impossible jyotbandhan - Avahantuwatkaran nimmeeya, jujanti savadhutta, abhaggamana mahapurisa"

prakrit: "एवं भरहनरिन्दो,निहओ भुयविक्कमेण संगामे,तो मुयइ चक्करयणं,तस्स वहन्थं परमरुट्टो"
english: "And my poor brother - in - law, If you happen to come in contact with a landowner's wife, You'd better turn around. There's the ultimate bread."

prakrit: "विणिवायणअसमत्थं,गन्तूण सुदरिसणं पडिनियत्तं,भुयबलपरक्कमस्स वि संवेगो तक्खणुप्पन्नो"
english: "Weaving is the same thing, Going to the right place is more difficult, Even going to the wrong place is difficult."

prakrit: "जंपइ अहो! अकज्जं,जं जाणन्ता वि विसयलोभिल्ला,पुरिसा कसायवसगा,करेन्ति एक्कक्कमवि रोहं"
english: "You fool, Those who know how to weep and wail knowingly, Like men who are butchers, Weep one day at a time."

prakrit: "छारस्स कए नासन्ति,चन्दणं मोत्तियं च दोरत्थे,तह मणुयभोगमूढा,नरा वि नासन्ति देविड्ढि"
english: "Sandalwood and pearls are threads, There is no thread for thread, So human beings are fools; Nor are there gods for men."

prakrit: "मोत्तु कसायजुज्झं,संजमजुज्झेण जुज्झिमो इण्हि,परिसहभडेहि समयं,जाव ठिओ उत्तमट्टम्मि"
english: "Mortally wounded young man, Struggling in the middle of the night, The passage of time Is a supreme ordeal."

prakrit: "नमिऊण जिणवरिन्दं,लोयं काऊण तत्थ बाहुबली,वोसिरियसबसङ्गो,जाओ समणो समियपावो"
english: "Name me, Jinnavarindam, Loyam Kaun Tath Bahubali, Vocereuse Basango, Go and make time for your husband."

prakrit: "काऊण सिरपणामं,चक्कहरो भणइ महुरवयणेहिं,मा गेण्हसु पबजे,भुञ्जसु रज्जं महाभागं"
english: "Who's the headman? The peacock speaks loudly, The doe speaks softly, And the doe does not budge. Bhunjasu is the great part of the rope."

prakrit: "संवच्छरपडिमत्थं,बाहुबली पणमिऊण चक्कहरो,सयलबलेण समग्गो,साएयपुरिं समणुपत्तो"
english: "At the foot of the Samvachara, Bahubali walks with the bow, At the feet of the God of Love, With the bow before his face."

prakrit: "बाहुबली वि महप्पा,उप्पाडिय केवलं तवबलेणं,निट्टवियअट्ठकम्मो,दुक्खविमोक्खं गओ मोक्खं"
english: "Bahubali is great, Uppadiya is only a showpiece, Sighs stop working, Liberation from suffering is the way out." ""

prakrit: "भरहो वि चक्कवट्टी,एगच्छत्तं इमं भरहवासं,भुञ्जइ भोगसमिद्धं,इन्दो इव देवलोयम्मि"
english: "She who fills the chakravatti with milk, Whose abode is at home in it, Roasts with rice flour, Is like a temple in heaven."

prakrit: "विज्जाहरनयरसमा,गामा नयरा वि देवलोयसमा,रायसमा गिहवइणो,धणयसमा होन्ति नरवइणो"
english: "In wisdom the night sky is red, In lawlessness the sky is blue, In wealth the winter is hot, And in prosperity the rainy season is hot."

prakrit: "चउसट्ठि सहस्साई,जुवईणं परमरूवधारीणं,बत्तीसं च सहस्सा,राईणं बद्धमउडाणं"
english: "Sixty-four is easy, youth is the supreme bow - bearer, light is difficult to bear, rain is bound to fall."

prakrit: "मत्तवरवारणाणं,चउरासीइं च सयसहस्साइं,तावइया परिसंखा,रहाण धय-छत्तचिन्धाणं"
english: "The drunkard vows, The naughty girls make love, And the women make love. The poor man is a laughingstock"

prakrit: "अट्ठारस कोडीओ,तुरयाणं पवरवेगदच्छाणं,किंकरनरनारीणं,को तस्स करेज परिसंखा"
english: "Eighteen puzzles, A fleeting glimpse of the moon, A trembling woman, Who has the slightest trace of courage?"

prakrit: "चोद्दस य महारयणा,नव निहओ'णेगभण्डपरिपुण्णा,जल-थलरयणावासा,रक्खिज्जन्ते सुरगणेहिं"
english: "The Chodas are the great warriors, The new warriors have perfected the bow and arrow, The warriors live on the surface of the water, Protecting the heavenly bodies"

prakrit: "पुत्ताण य पञ्च सया,अमरकुमारोवभोगदुल्ललिया,भरहस्स चक्कवइणो,रज्जविभूई समणुपत्ता"
english: "A son is five times as powerful, An immortal son is as powerful as a bow, A lover is as clever as a fowler, And a husband is as good as a king."

prakrit: "जस्स य जीहाण सयं,बुद्धिविभागो हवेज वित्थिण्णो,सो वि मणूसो न तरइ,तस्स कहेउं सयलरजं"
english: "As the soul lives, So the intellect is dispersed, Yet the mind is not quenched; To that person I will ascribe prosperity."

prakrit: "अह एवं परिकहिए,पुणरवि मगहाहिवो षणमिऊणं,पुच्छइ गणहरवसहं,मणहरमहुरेहि वयणेहिं"
english: "Oh! and look! Once again the elephant calls out, Asking how the crowd gets along, Blushing with delight." ""

prakrit: "वण्णाण समुप्पत्ती,तिण्हं पि सुया मए अपरिसेसा,एत्तो कहेह भयवं,उप्पत्ती सुत्तकण्ठाणं"
english: "The whole of the world is burning with fire, I have slept all day, And now I am so exhausted I dread to say the least."

prakrit: "हिंसन्ति सबजीवे,करेन्ति कम्मं सया मुणिविरुद्धं,तह विय वहन्ति गवं,धम्मनिमित्तम्मि काऊणं"
english: "Violence affects all living beings, Karma is always opposed by the sage, So the cow carries the poison. For Dharma's sake, the cow is sacred." ""

prakrit: "एवं च भणियमेत्ते,गणहरवसहो कहेइ भूयत्थं,निसुणेहि ताव नरवइ,एगमणो माहणुप्पत्तिं"
english: "And he said," "People say,'The earth trembles,'But when he speaks they don't. It's like saying,'Tomorrow the moon is hotter.'"" "

prakrit: "साएयपुरवरीए,एगन्ते नाभिनन्दणो भयवं,चिट्ठइ सुसङ्घसहिओ,ताव य भरहो समणुपत्तो"
english: "Dear wife, Once your husband is abroad You must be afraid to come. Once your wife has left You You must return with good company."

prakrit: "पणउत्तमङ्गमग्गो,करजुयलं करिय तस्स पामूले,तो भणइ चक्कवट्टी,वयणमिणं मे निसामेह"
english: "But come on, you stupid girl, If you ask me what I want to eat, I'll tell you it's rice flour. I can't take it"

prakrit: "भयवं! अणुग्गहत्थं,करन्तु समणा इमे समियषावा,भुञ्जन्तु मज्झ गेहे,परिसुद्धं फासुयाहारं"
english: "Fear not! Hold on to that hand, promise me it's time, Fill it with rice flour, Refine it with boiled rice." ""

prakrit: "तो भणइ जिणवरिन्दो,भरह न कप्पइ इमो उ आहारो,समणाण संजयाणं,कीयगडुद्देसनिष्फण्णो"
english: "So he says," "Life is abundant, We don't have to cover our hair, We eat our food, We use our senses, And we drink our way out of trouble." ""

prakrit: "एवं सुणित्तु वयणं,राया चिन्तेइ तागयमणेणं,उग्गं तवोविहाणं चरन्ति समणा समियमोहा"
english: "And listen to the sound of the lute, And think carefully about what is to be said: Time flies when one can hear and hear."

prakrit: "न य भुञ्जन्ति महरिसी,मह गेहे मग्गिया वि पुणरुत्तं,तो सावयाण दाणं,देमि फुडं अन्न-पाणाइ"
english: "Aunt, If you ask me what I eat and drink, It's always rice and water. I'll give you something else."

prakrit: "एते वि य गिहिधम्मे,पञ्चाणुवयगुणेसु उवउत्ता,भुञ्जावेमि य बहुसो,होही दाणस्स पुण्णफलं"
english: "Yet in Giddhism, the virtues of the five vows are manifested, For as much as I roast, So much is the fruit of charity"

prakrit: "सद्दाविया य तेणं,सायारचरित्तधारिणो सके,तुरियं च समल्लीणा,मिच्छत्ताई नरा तइया"
english: "A gentleman is clever, A gentleman can be clever, And a tyrant is clever; You are not to be trifled with."

prakrit: "न य ते रियन्ति भवणं,ददु जव-वीहियङ्कु रे पुरओ,कागणिरयणेण तओ,सुत्तं चिय सावयाण कयं"
english: "It's not a real building, Dadu, Young and old, Like painting a painting on paper, So why waste your time looking around?"

prakrit: "तो अन्न-पाण-दाणा''सणेसु संपूइयाण उष्पन्नं,गवं चिय अइतुङ्गं,वहन्ति इत्थं कयत्थ'म्हे"
english: "So, with the grains of rice and water at hand," She paces up and down, Her face covered with gooseflesh: "Where am I supposed to go from here?"

prakrit: "मइसायरेण भणिओ,भरहनरिन्दो सहाए मज्झम्मि,जह जिणवरेण भणियं,तं एक्कमणो निसामेहि"
english: "Tell me politely, My poor friend, What I want to say to you As soon as I speak Is nothing at all."

prakrit: "जाणं तुमे नराहिव! सम्माणो पढमसावयाण कओ,ते वीरस्स'वसाणे,होहिन्ति कुतित्थषासण्डा"
english: "Know that you are not a coward! Respectful young men, They are the servants of the brave. Maybe they have a bad reputation." ""

prakrit: "अलियवयणेसु सत्थं,काऊणं वेयनामधेयं ते,हिंसाभासणमित्तं,जन्नेसु पसू वहिस्सन्ति"
english: "They lie motionless on the bed, Wrapped around their necks, Behave violently, Like cattle in a herd."

prakrit: "विवरीयवित्तिधम्मा,आरम्भ-परिग्गहेसु अणियत्ता,सयमेव मूढभावा,सेसं पि जणं विमोहन्ति"
english: "Everyone follows a different religion, Everyone follows the same path, Everyone is always stupid, Everyone delights in their own way."

prakrit: "सोऊण वयणमेयं,परिकुविओ नरवई भणइ एवं,सिग्धं चिय नयराओ,सवे वि करेह निदेसा"
english: "When he speaks, Everyone speaks in a masculine voice, And when he speaks plainly, He does nothing at all."

prakrit: "लोगेण हम्ममाणा,सरणं तित्थंकरं समल्लीणा,तेण य निवारिया ते,पत्थरपहरेसु हम्मन्ता"
english: "A man's humility is praiseworthy, A woman's straightforwardness is salutary, And those averse to it Are wont to throw stones."

prakrit: "मा हणसुपुत्त! एए,जं उसभजिणेण वारिओ भरहो,तेण इमे सयल च्चिय,वुच्चन्ति य माहणा लोए"
english: "O son of man! Let the festival fill with that feast. For here I am, Sitting in silence While the gods watch over me." ""

prakrit: "जे वि य ते षढमयरं,पवजं गेण्हिऊण परिवडिया,ते वक्कलपरिहाणा,तावसपासण्डिणो जाया"
english: "Anyway, come on, you silly girl, Don't go walking around naked. It's just the way things happen." ""

prakrit: "ताण य सीस-पसीसा,मोहन्ता नणवयं कुसत्थेसु,भिग्गङ्गिरमादीया,जाया बीजं वसुमईए"
english: "It's the sesame seed, Sweat dripping from the nipple, Mistaking it for a beehive, Wherever the seed may be sown"

prakrit: "एसा ते परिकहिया,उप्पत्ती माहणाण भूयत्थं,एत्तो सुणसु नराहिव,पुरदेवजिणस्स निवाणं"
english: "This is the way of a traveler, The earth is overflowing with great wisdom, So listen, cowardice, For the soul of a great god must be destroyed."

prakrit: "भयवं तिलोयनाहो,धम्मपदं दरिसिऊण लोगस्स,अट्ठावयम्मि सेले,निवाणमणुत्तरं पत्तो"
english: "Be still and do not be afraid; people will recognize the word dharma By observing it eight times a day; They will find the answer in silence."

prakrit: "भरहो वि चक्कवट्टी,तिणमिव चइऊण रायवरलच्छो,जिणवरपहषडिवन्नो,अबाराहं सिवं पत्तो"
english: "Even the buffalo is spoilt for choice, The nights are long, The paths are slippery, Life is overwhelming, And the roads are impassable."

prakrit: "एवं मए सेणिय! तुज्झ सिट्ठा,लोगट्टिई पुवजणाणुचिण्णा,सुणाहि एत्तो विमलप्पहावा,चत्तारि नामेहि नरिन्दवंसा"
english: "And you, my braveheart! Your skirt is white, Your bracelets are pink, Listen here, Vimalapahava! The name of the banner is Narindavamsa." ""

prakrit: "इति पउमचरिए लोगट्टिइ-उसभ-माहणाहिगारो नाम चउत्थो उद्देसओ समत्तो"
english: "It is the lotus of the forehead - the name of the great warrior - That begs the question." ""

prakrit: "चत्तारि महावंसा,नरवइ पुहइम्मि जे उ विक्खाया,ताणं पुण बहुभेया,हवन्ति अवरस्स संजुत्ता"
english: "The rafters are great, The men are completely exhausted, They have grown very thin, The winter is long, And the rainy season is almost over."

prakrit: "इक्खाग पढमवंसो,बिइओ सोमो य होइ नायबो,विज्जाहराण तइओ,हवइ चउत्थो उ हरिवंसो"
english: "The first generation is here, the second is coming, the third is leaving, the fifth is studying, and the fourth is leaving."

prakrit: "भरहस्स पढमपुत्तो,आइच्चजसो त्ति नाम विक्खाओ,तस्स य सीहजसो च्चिय,पुत्तो तस्सेव बलभद्दो"
english: "If you trust him, you'll find out his name, If he doesn't trust you, you ll have a hard time."

prakrit: "वसुबल महाबलो चिय,अमियबलो चेव होइ नायबो,जाओ सुभद्दनामो,सायरभद्दो य रवितेओ"
english: "Vassubal is a great man, indecent is a bad man, naïve is a good man, good name only goes to him; the God of Love is Ravite."

prakrit: "ससिपह पभूयतेओ,तेयस्सी तावणो पयावी य,अइविरिओ य नरिन्दो,तस्स य पुत्तो महाविरिओ"
english: "Be nice to him, he's a handsome boy, she's your wife, you're a handsome girl, and your son is a handsome man."

prakrit: "उइयपरक्कमनामो,तस्स वि य महिन्दविक्कमो पुत्तो,सूरो इन्दजुइण्णो,महइ महाइन्दई राया"
english: "Uyyaparakamnamo, tasa vi ya mahindavikamo puttu, suro indjuin, mahai mahaindayi raaya." ""

prakrit: "तत्तो पभू बिभू वि य,अरिदमणो चेव वसहकेऊ य,राया वि य गरुडको,तह य मियङ्को समुप्पन्नो"
english: "So is the earth like the sky, The fire like an arrow, The sky like an eagle, And so is the fire like a flock of peacocks."

prakrit: "एते नरवरवसहा,पुहइं दाऊण निययपुत्ताणं,निक्खन्ता खायजसा,सिवमयलमणुत्तरं पत्ता"
english: "Such a man, Such an old man, So full of pretence, So utterly devoid of decency, Is the answer to every man's problem."

prakrit: "एसो ते परिकहिओ,आइच्च साइसंभवो वंसो,एत्तो सुणाहि नरवर! उप्पत्ती सोमवंसस्स"
english: "Come, let's go! It's the cycle of the senses, This is the way of a man, Listening! Once in a generation one goes to sleep." ""

prakrit: "उसभस्स बीयपुत्तो,बाहुबली नाम आसि विक्खाओ,तस्स य महप्पभावो,पुत्तो सोमप्पभो नाम"
english: "That brother - in - law's son, The name Bahubali has come, The same is the name of a great thinker, His son is Somappabho."

prakrit: "एत्तो महाबलो चिय,सुबलो बाहुबलि एवमाईया,सोमप्पहस्स वंसे,उप्पन्ना नरवई बहुसो"
english: "Here is a great man, A handsome man, And there are plenty of good men. Once you are old enough, You will outlive all men."

prakrit: "केएत्थ गया मोक्खं,पवजं गिहिऊण धुयकम्मा,अवरे पुण देवत्तं,पत्ता तव-संजमबलेणं"
english: "Where is the liberation, Why waste your time washing your feet? They are pure divinity, The leaf must match the leaf."

prakrit: "एवं तु सोमवंसो,नरवइ! कहिओ मए समासेणं,विज्जाहराण वंसं,भणामि एत्तो निसामेहि"
english: "And you, Somavamsa, are a cruel man! Tell me, young and wise, I am of such little worth." ""

prakrit: "नामेण रयणमाली,नमिरायसुओ महाबलसमिद्धो,तस्स वि य रयणवज्जो,रयणरहो चेव उप्पन्नो"
english: "Name me Rayanmali, you humbler girl, You are so powerful, So is the king of queens, And so is the god of love."

prakrit: "जाओ य रयणचित्तो,चन्दरहो वज्जसङ्घनाग्गे य,सेणो य वजदत्तो,राया वज्जद्धओ जाओ"
english: "Go, for the king's sake, The moon is bright, The warriors are vigorous, The sky is clear, And the arrows are powerful."

prakrit: "वज्जाउहो य वजो,सुवज्ज वजंघरो महासत्तो,वज्जाभ वज्जबाहू,वज्जङ्को नाम विक्खाओ"
english: "Wizard, great warrior, powerful warrior, wise warrior, spoil the name of the wizard."

prakrit: "अह वज्जसुन्दरो वि य,वज्जासो वजपाणिराया य,उप्पन्नो य नरवई,वज्जसुजण्हू य वज्जो य"
english: "Oh! the thunder is beautiful, The thunder is thunderous, The lightning is fierce, And the men are wise."

prakrit: "विजूमुहो सुवयणो,राया तह विजुदत्तनामो य,विजू य विजुतेओ,तडिवेओ बिजुदाढो य"
english: "Knowledge is supreme, Knowledge is transcendental, Wisdom is eternal, And trees produce lightning."

prakrit: "एए खेयरवसहा,विज्जा-बल-सिद्धिसारसंपुण्णा,दाऊण रायलच्छी,सुएसु कालेण वोलीणा"
english: "Ah, you stingy farmer, Full of wisdom and strength and accomplishment, You greedy farmer, Time is running out."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाई,दोसु वि सेढीसु सामिओ राया,नामेण विज्जुदाढो,अवरविदेहं गओ सहसा"
english: "Oh! what a strange land! Two hundred and ninety thousand rivers flow through it All at once."

prakrit: "दिट्ठो य संजयन्तो,तेण भमन्तेण संजमारूढो,घेत्तूण पावगुरुणा,इहाणिओ पञ्चसंगमयं"
english: "A man who sees with his eyes, Makes sense with his face, Gives pleasure with his feet, Is a member of the five unions."

prakrit: "ठविऊण गिरिवरिन्दे,पत्थरपहरेहि खेयरसमग्गो,आहणइ निरणुकम्पो,तह वि य जोगं न छड्ड इ"
english: "At the approach of the rafters, Like a field of pebbles piled high, She bends low But does not budge." ""

prakrit: "उवसग्गम्मि बहुविहे,तस्स सहन्तस्स जोगजुत्तस्स,समचित्तस्स भगवओ,उप्पन्नं केवलं नाणं"
english: "There are many ways to be happy; you have to endure it all. Be reasonable, my lord; You have only to give consideration."

prakrit: "एयम्मि देस काले,धरणिन्दो आगओ मुणिसयास,नमिऊण तस्स चलणे,विजाकोसं तओ हरइ"
english: "Tomorrow is my day," sighed the hermit, "Tomorrow morning dawns. If you refuse to follow him He is lost for lack of victory."

prakrit: "जिणभवण-मुणिवराणं,उवरिं गच्छेज्ज जो बलुम्मत्तो,सो विज्जापरिभट्टो,होही विज्जाहरो नियमा"
english: "Life is but a façade, You have to walk the tightrope, The one who stands firm On power is dominated by knowledge, And knowledge is the rule."

prakrit: "काउण समयमेयं,विज्जाओ समप्पिऊण धरणिन्दो,पुच्छइ मुणिवरवसहं,घोरुवसग्गस्स संबन्धं"
english: "Once upon a time, when knowledge was at an early age, People would ask me, Like sages, About horse races."

prakrit: "अह भणई संजयन्तो,चउगइवित्थिण्णदीहसंसारे,गामे उ सयडनामे,कह वि भमन्तो समुप्पन्नो"
english: "Oh! brother - in - law! There goes the traveler, Thinking how nice it is to be here: In the village it is commonplace; Nowadays people go to and fro." ""

prakrit: "वणियकुलम्मि हियकरो,नामेण अहं सुसाहुपडिसेवी,अज्जव-मद्दवजुत्तो,जाओ परिणामजोगेणं"
english: "Listen, you crook, I am a good servant by name. But come, you stubborn wretch, Go and reap the rewards."

prakrit: "कालं काऊण तओ,कुसुमावइसामिओ समुप्पन्नो,सिरिवद्धणो त्ति नामं,जाओ हं नरवई तइया"
english: "Time is of the essence, Daughter - in - law, Your name is Siri, Go - between!"

prakrit: "तत्थेव आसि गामे,विप्पो सो कुच्छियं तवं काउं,कालगओ सुरलोए,देवो अप्षिड्डिओ जाओ"
english: "Then he came to the village, Wrapped up his skirt, Covered his face with ghee, And walked off In the middle of the night." ""

prakrit: "तत्तो चुओ समाणो,जलणसिहो बम्भणो समुप्पन्नो,सिरिवद्धणस्स तइया,पुरोहिओ सञ्चवाई सो"
english: "There you are, dead body, burning fire, thunder, lightning, lightning and thunder: The whole earth is burning," he said.

prakrit: "वणियस्स तेण दबं,अवलत्तं तत्थ नियमदत्तस्स,गणियाऎ तओ विप्पो,नामामुदं निओ जूए"
english: "Vaniyas are suppressed by it, avalattam is given to them by the law, Gania is destroyed by them, Nyamudram is a new gamble."

prakrit: "गन्तूण तस्स गेहं,नामामुद्दच्छलेण रयणाई,चेडीए आणिऊणं,समप्पियाइं च वणियस्स"
english: "Destroy him, scream at his name, yawn at his enemies, mutter nonsense."

prakrit: "घेत्तूण य सबस्स,विप्पो निवासिओ पुरवराउ,वेरग्गसमावन्नो,काऊण तवं समाढत्तो"
english: "Get up and leave, you wretched man, Get away with the rafters. Who's there to sort this stuff out?"

prakrit: "मरिऊण य माहिन्दे,देवो होऊण वरविमाणम्मि,तत्तो चुओ समाणो,उप्पन्नो विजुदाढो त्ति"
english: "When he dies, I hope to be a god; When he returns, I promise, I will be just like him; Only you can teach me wisdom."

prakrit: "सिदिवद्धणो वि य तवं,काउं देवत्तणाउ चविऊणं,अवरविदेहम्मि तओ,जाओ हं संजयन्तमुणी"
english: "Even Siddhivaddhana is a torture, How can one tempt a god? But leave aside the gods. I am Sanjay's wife." ""

prakrit: "तेणाणुबन्धजणिओ,कोवग्गी दरिसणिन्धणाइण्णो,विज्जाहरस्स एण्हि,उवसग्गनिहेण पज्जलिओ"
english: "Friend, the fire of love, Which burns brightly Because it consumes water, Is like a fire burning in the middle of the forest, Like the flame of fire."

prakrit: "जो आसि नियमदत्तो,सो विहु धम्मं पुणो समज्जेउं,मरिऊण तुमं एसो,धरणिन्दत्ते समुप्पन्नो"
english: "One who comes and gives rules, let him understand Dharma again. But come, meek one, You are condemned to death." ""

prakrit: "सोऊण पगयमेयं,खामेऊणं मुणिं सधरणिन्दं,परिचयइ विसयसोक्खं,दिक्खाभिमुहो निवो जाओ"
english: "Go to sleep, lie low, recline on your feet, make your face look more attractive, and then go to sleep."

prakrit: "धरणिन्दो मुणिवसहं,काऊण पयाहिणं च तिक्खुत्तो,सबपरिवारसहिओ,निययट्ठाणं गओ सहसा"
english: "Righteous man, Strong woman, Strong man, Friend of all the family, Suddenly you are on your way."

prakrit: "अह तत्थ विजुदाढस्स नन्दणो दढरहो त्ति नामेणं,तस्स वि य पट्टबन्धं,काऊण तवं गओ मोक्खं"
english: "Oh! the name of that wise man, Who is so stubborn And yet so determined? Whom then can be delivered?"

prakrit: "तत्तो य आसधम्मो,जाओ अस्सायरो कुमारवरो,आसद्धओ नरिन्दो,पउमनिहो पउममाली य"
english: "There you are, my dear: Go, Assayers and bastards; Hope, Narindo; The husband is a virtuous man."
