prakrit: "ससिओ चुओ समाणो,कुलंधरो रायवलि समुप्पन्नो,अवरो त्थ 'पुस्सभूई,तत्थेव पुरोहिओ जाओ"
english: "Mother - in - law! A bunch of peacock feathers hang down from the head of the hunter's wife. When he touches her they are wiped away. Then go the priest." ""

prakrit: "मित्ता होऊण तओ,पीई छेत्तूण सइरिणीऎ कए,अह 'पुस्सभूइ एत्तो,इच्छद य कुलंधरं हन्तुं"
english: "If you want to be my friend, Cut the nail on the head of your lover's hand. If he touches me, I'll do it myself."

prakrit: "तरुमूलगयस्स तहा,धम्मं सोऊण साहुपासम्भि,नरवइपरिक्खिओ सो,उवसन्तो पुण्णजोएण"
english: "There you have grown thin, Dharma is asleep, Friendship is on the horizon, The trials of man are over, He will rise again and rejoice."

prakrit: "दट्ठ ण पुस्सभूई,विभवं धम्मस्स गहियवय-नियमो,कालं काऊण तओ,सणंकुमारे समुप्पन्नो"
english: "Sight is not to be erased, potentiality is to be acquired, Dharma and deep-rooted rules are to be followed. Time, my dear, is running out on us."

prakrit: "काऊण जिणवरतवं,तत्थेव कुलंधरो वि आयाओ,ते दो वि चुयसमाणा,धायइसण्डे समुप्पन्ना"
english: "Who's left alive? Even the coolest man came there. The two of them made love. The midwife did not want to meet." ""

prakrit: "नयरे अरिंजयपुरे,जयावईकुच्छिसंभवा जाया,कूरा-'मरधणुनामा,भिच्चा उसहस्स रायाणो"
english: "Nayre arinjayapure, jaya vaayi kuchchisimbhava jaya, kura -" "Name of the bridegroom, bheechha is the raayana of his anger." ""

prakrit: "अह नरवईण समयं पवज्जं गेण्हिऊण कालगया,परिनिबुओ नरिन्दो,ते सहसारे समुप्पन्ना"
english: "Ah, the passage of time: Time has passed, my dear, It's only a matter of time before I see you again."

prakrit: "ससि पढमं तत्थ चुओ,जाओ च्चिय मेहवाहणो एसो,आवलिओ वि हु एत्तो,सहस्सनयणो समुप्पन्नो"
english: "I'll frown at that tree," Goes the saying of the traveler. "Here I am too, A crowd of thousands gathers."

prakrit: "तो भणइ चक्कवट्टी,सहस्सनयणे विभू! 'परिकहेहि,पीई मे अहिययरा,केण निमित्तेण उप्पन्ना?"
english: "He says," "Chakkavatti, sahasasnayane vibhu!" "'Traveler, I'm still here. For what purpose uppanna? "" "

prakrit: "अह साहिउं पवत्तो,तित्थयरो पुबजम्मसंबन्धं,भिक्खादाणफलेणं,देवत्तं रम्भओ पत्तो"
english: "Ah! the festival of flowers, That festival of fairies, The fruit of the almsgiving, The festival of the God of Love."

prakrit: "सोहम्माउ चवित्ता,चन्दपुरे नरवइस्स भज्जाए,वरकित्तिनामधेओ,पवजं गेण्हिऊण मओ"
english: "Merry Christmas, Chandpur is bursting at the seams, Fettered by the vows of the bridegroom." ""

prakrit: "देवो होऊण चुओ,अवरविदेहे तओ समुप्पन्नो,चन्दमइ-महाघोसस्स नन्दणो रयणसंचपुरे"
english: "May there be gods, may there be others, May the moon illuminate the firmament - The fierce Narmadā is the patron saint of queens."

prakrit: "एत्तो पयावलो सो,षवजं गेण्हिऊण कालगओ,देवो पाणयकप्पे,होऊण चुओ भरहवासे"
english: "It's the rainy season, The rainy season is here, The God of Water has arrived, And the cucumbers are overflowing."

prakrit: "पुहईपुरम्मि जाओ,जसहरपुत्तो जयाऎ जसकित्ती,निक्खमिय पिउसगासे,विजयविमाणे समुप्पन्नो"
english: "Go to the full moon. Whomsoever it may please, Swarm over in triumph, Like the sapphires of an old man's bow."

prakrit: "तत्तो चुओ समाणो,जाओ सगरो त्ति चक्कवट्टि तुमं,चोद्दसरयणाहिवई,समत्तभरहाहिवो सूरो"
english: "There you are, darling, Go - between, You're the only one who can do it, Your face above your bosom, Like a warrior's bow." ""

prakrit: "जेण'न्तरेण दइओ,आवलिओ रम्भकस्स आसि पुरा,तेण'न्तरेण तुझं,सहस्सनयणे अहियनेहो"
english: "If anyone shows mercy to you, It is only because the round conch shell has come off, not because you have it, Not because there are too many of you."

prakrit: "सोऊण चरियमेयं,निययं पिउसन्तियं हरिसियच्छो,थोऊण समाढत्तो,सब्भूयगुणेहि तित्थयरं"
english: "Aunt, You're right; You always look out for your son. Anything you can think of That matches the qualities of your husband."

prakrit: "एत्थं तु अणाहाणं,सत्ताणं नाह! कारणेण विणा,उवयारपरो सि तुम,किण्ण महच्छेरयं एयं?"
english: "Here you are, untrained, without power! Without a cause, spitting all over. Whom is this buffalo chasing?" ""

prakrit: "नाह! तुम बम्भाणो,तिलोयणो संकरो सयंबुद्धो,नारायणो अणन्तो,तिलोयपुज्जारिहो अरुहो"
english: "No! You are a bomb, The tiller is a narrow sect, The hunter is a savage, The arrow is a bow - worshipper." ""

prakrit: "भणिओ रक्खसवइणा,भीमेणं मेहवाहणो ताहे,साहु कयं ते सुपुरिस! जं सि जिणं आगओ सरणं"
english: "Say:" "Rakshabandhan, Bhima is the lover of love, so why trouble yourself! The more you conquer, the clearer your victory will be." ""

prakrit: "तो सुणसु मज्झ वयणं भय-सोगविणासणं हियकरं च,पच्छा य होइ पच्छं,कालम्मि य निबुई कुणइ"
english: "So listen, my speech is full of fear and trembling. But if you ask me what it is I will tell you the truth."

prakrit: "अत्थेत्थ तुज्झ सत्तू,वेयड्डे खेयरा बलसमिद्धा,तेहि समं चिय कालं,कह नेहिसि सुयण! वीसत्थो?"
english: "At the same time thou hast a long life, Thy strength is bound to last; Where then, my dear, Is there room for more sleep?"

prakrit: "निसुणेसु सायरवरे,विद्रुम-मणि-रयणकिरणपज्जलिए,काणणवणेहि रम्मो,रक्खसदीवो त्ति नामेणं"
english: "Silly girls, The rays of the moon illuminate the night sky, Love speaks through the eyes, And protection is the name of the goddess."

prakrit: "सत्तेव जोयणसया,वित्थिण्णो सबओ समन्तेणं,तस्स वि य मज्झदेसे,अत्थि तिकूडो त्ति वरसेलो"
english: "Truth alone triumphs, Dissolution destroys everything, So too does anger. So much for the thunder of thunder."

prakrit: "नव जोयणाणि तुङ्गो,पन्नासं सबओ य वित्थिण्णो,सिहरं तस्स विरायइ,उब्भासेन्तं दस दिसाओ"
english: "Take a new yoke, all fifty are scattered abroad, The horizon is closing in on you, Ten directions until dawn."

prakrit: "सिहरस्स तस्स हे?,जम्बूणयकणगचित्तपायारा,लङ्कापुरि त्ति नामं,नयरी सुरसंपयसमिद्धा"
english: "Sihras tasa hai?, Jambuna kanaganagachitpayara, Lankapuri titi naam, Nayari sursampayasamiddha." ""

prakrit: "बन्धवजणेण समयं,सिग्घं गन्तूण तत्थ वीसत्थो,भय-सोगविप्पमुक्को,अभिणन्दन्तो सया वससु"
english: "Time for bondage, Love that lasts a month, Fear that fades, Friendship that languishes forever."

prakrit: "एवं भणिऊण तेणं,रक्खसवइणा जलन्तमणिकिरणो,विज्जाहि समं दिन्नो,हारो देवेहि परिगहिओ"
english: "And say :'Aunt, The rays of the moon illuminate the sky, And the rays of lightning equalize it. For the gods are worthy of being defeated.'"" "

prakrit: "पायालंकारपुर,धरणियलन्तरगयं च से दिन्नं,छज्जोयणमवगाढं,वित्थिण्णं 'बारस'द्धद्धं"
english: "Payalankarpur, singing with the drums of dharniyal, Loud with the beating of drums, Stirred by the piercing'baras '." ""

prakrit: "एवं रक्खसवइणा,भणिओ घणवाहणो सुपरितुट्ठो,नमिऊण जिणवरिन्दं,तेण समं पत्थिओ लकं"
english: "And the wretched woman said:" "A heavy vehicle is more beautiful than a bolt of lightning." "So is the fate of the elephant."

prakrit: "पेच्छइ य तुङ्गतोरण-धवलट्टालयविचित्तपागारं,उज्जाण-दीहियाहि य,चेइय-भवणेहि अइरम्मं"
english: "She observes the twists and turns of the horizon, The busy streets of Ujjain and Dihya, The emptiness of her palaces."

prakrit: "बन्धवजणेण सहिओ,जयसदुग्घुट्टकलयलारावो,लङ्कापुरिं पविट्ठो,जिणभवणं आगओ राया"
english: "Friend, endure the storm, Shout the trumpet, Purify the Lankan village, Resemble the fire of renunciation."

prakrit: "भावेण विणयषणओ,काऊण पयाहिणं तिपरिवारं,थोऊण सिद्धपडिमा,रायगिहं पत्थिओ ताहे"
english: "Discernment by emotion, Tenderness by speech, Like the path of righteousness, Is the path to wisdom."

prakrit: "लङ्कापुरीऎ सामी,भीमेणं मेहवाहणो ठविओ,विज्जाहरसुसमिद्धं,भुञ्जइ रज्जं सुरिन्दो व"
english: "Venerable woman, Behold the flame of love, Visnu's sweet nectar, Filling the bow with the string Surindo."

prakrit: "किन्नरगीयपुरवरे,भाणुवईगब्भसंभवा कन्ना,घणवाहणस्स भज्जा,नामेण य सुप्पभा जाया"
english: "King of eunuchs, How can you refuse to hear the thunder? The fire of many vessels Is the cause of sleepless nights."

prakrit: "अमरिन्दरूवसरिसो,पुत्तो घणवाहणस्स उप्पन्नो,सुप्पभदेवीतणओ,सो य महारक्खसो नामं"
english: "The son of Amrinder, Upanishad of many vessels, The god of dreams, Such is the name of the great rakṣa."

prakrit: "एवं गयवइ काले,भत्तीराएण चोइओ सन्तो,घणवाहणो वि अजियं,वन्दणहेउं समणुपत्तो"
english: "And when he leaves, The traveler is content elsewhere, Even with the heavy vehicle He has yet to arrive, Thanks to the courteous host."

prakrit: "सीहासणोवविट्ठो,दिट्ठो तित्थंकरो विमलदेहो,नज्जइ सरयसमए,नहस्स मज्झट्ठिओ सूरो"
english: "Behold the lotus of the throne, Look at the trumpet flame, Do not fall asleep during the festival; Behold, the sun in midday."

prakrit: "थोऊण जिणवरिन्दं,सब्भूयगुणेहि मङ्गलसएहिं,तत्थेव य विणिविट्ठो,सुर-नरपरिसाऎ मज्झम्मि"
english: "Hold on tight, all round long - eyed girl, All round good - looking girl, Wherever you are, You're safe," I muttered.

prakrit: "नाऊण कहन्तरयं,सगरो तित्थंकरं पणमिऊणं,पुच्छइ जिणवरसंखा,समतीया-'णागयाणं च"
english: "What's the matter with the name?" she asked, squeezing the tip of her finger between her fingers To show that it was her husband's. "" "

prakrit: "कइ वा समइक्कन्ता,होहिन्ति य केत्तिया महापुरिसा,तिन्थयर-चक्कवट्टी,बलदेवा वासुदेवा य?"
english: "Where is the equanimity, How many great men have you got, You stupid girl, Is it Vasudeva the god of fire?"

prakrit: "भणइ जिणो वइकन्तो,उसभो नामेण पढमतित्थयरो१,जेणेत्थ भरहवासे,लोगस्स निदेसिओ धम्मो"
english: "He says :'Conqueror,'But everyone replies :'In my name, my dear, Wherever you live There is trust.'People are guided by dharma." ""

prakrit: "सो ठविय सुयं रज्जे पवजं गेण्हिऊण कालगओ,बीओ य वट्टमाणो,अजिओ हं तेण पडितुल्लो२"
english: "It's only a matter of time before I see her again. Behold, my daughter - in - law has had her fair share of trouble."

prakrit: "तह संभवा३ 'भिणन्दण४ सुमई५ पउमप्पहो६ सुपासो७ य,ससि८ पुप्फदन्त९ सीयल१० वासुपुज्जो य१२ ॥ १४७॥"
english: "There may be 3." "Feasting, 4 Sucking, 6 Laughing, 8 Sweating, 9 Drinking, 10 Vasupujjo, 12. 147."

prakrit: "विमल१३मणन्तइ १४ धम्मो १५ सन्ती१६ कुन्थू१७ अरो१८ य मल्ली य१९,मुणिसुबय२० नमि२१ नेमि२२ पासो२३ वीरो२४ य तित्थयरो"
english: "Vimal 13 Manantai, 14 Dhamma, 15 Santhi, 16 Kunthu, 17 Aro, 18 Malli, 19 Munisubaya, 20 Nami, 21 Nemi, 22 Paso, 23 Veer, 24 Ya Titthyayaro." ""

prakrit: "एए बावीस जिणा,होहिन्ति कमेण 'णागए काले,ताणं तु चक्कवट्टी,सन्ती कुन्थू अरो चेव"
english: "Hey, you silly girl, It's only a matter of time before you start feeling guilty, So you're a fickle girl, Calm down and keep at it."

prakrit: "उत्तमकुलसंभूया,सबे खीरोयवारिअहिसित्ता,सबइ वि मोक्खगामी,केवलनाणी भवे सवे"
english: "All are virtuous, all are penitent, all seek liberation, only the wise prosper."

prakrit: "एए चउवीस जिणा,नामेहि जगुत्तमा समक्खाया,निसुणेहि चक्कवट्टी,जहक्कम कित्तइस्सामि"
english: "Twenty-four souls, Name alone sums up the ordeal, Silly girl, Where am I going to escape?"

prakrit: "भरहो य चक्कवट्टी१ समईओ संपयं तुम सगरो२,अवसेसा चक्कहरा,होहिन्ति अणागए काले"
english: "Foolish girl, you're running out of time. Time is running out for you. It's going to be like walking on water." ""

prakrit: "मघवं३ सणंकुमारो४,सन्ती५ कुन्थू६ अरो७ सुभूमो८ य,पउम९ हरिसेणनामो१०,जयसेणो११ बम्भदत्तो य१२"
english: "Maghavam3, Shanankumara4, Santee5, Kunthu6, Auro7, Subhumo8, Paum9, HarisenaNaam10, Jayasena11, BombadattoYa12."

prakrit: "अयलो१ विजओर भद्दो३,सुप्पभ४ सुदंसणो य नायबो५,आणन्दो६ नन्दणो७ पउमो ८ नवमो रामो य९ बलदेवो"
english: "Alone 1 triumphs over evil 3, in sleep 4 good vision or vanity 5, in love 6, 7, 8, 9, Ram is the new god, and so is Baladeva."

prakrit: "होही तिविट्ठ १ दुविठ्ठ२,सयंभु३ पुरिसोत्तमो४ पुरिससीहो५,पुरिसवरपुण्डरीओ६. दत्तो७ नारायणो ८ कण्हो९"
english: "Hohi, tivith 1, two - limbed 2, sambhu, 3, purisottamo, 4, purishasiddho, men's bracelets, 6. Datto, 7, Narayan, 8, Kannho, 9." ""

prakrit: "पढमो आसग्गीवो१,तारगर मेरग३ निसुम्भ४ महुकेढो५,बलि६ पल्हाओ७ रावण ८ तह य जरासिन्धु९ पडिसत्तू"
english: "The path is impassable1, The tarmac is porous3, The nectar of bees4, The sacrifice6, The plow 7, The Raven 8, And the rust 9."

prakrit: "एए महाणुभावा,पुरिसा अवसप्पिणीऎ कालम्मि,एत्तियमेत्ता य पुणो,हवन्ति ऊसप्पिणीए वि"
english: "Oh! great spirit! When a man is exhausted All the while he is busy making love Again, Even to one who is sagging."

prakrit: "एकं जिणवरसिटुं,धम्मं काऊण पंवरभत्तीए,एवंविहा मणुस्सा,होऊण सिवं परमुवेन्ति"
english: "One is dependent on life, the other on Dharma, and so on. Human beings, being like Siva, are supreme."

prakrit: "जे पुण धम्मविरहिया,जीवा बहुपावकम्मपडिबद्धा,ते चउगइवित्थिण्णे,भमन्ति संसारकन्तारे"
english: "Those who are completely devoid of dharma, whose lives are bound by many vows, They wander about in circles, In circles of the world."

prakrit: "एवं कालसभावं,सुणिऊणं महइपुरिससंबन्धं,घणवाहणो विरागं,तक्खणमेत्तेण संपत्तो"
english: "And the feeling of time, Listening for the beehive, The separation of a heavy vehicle, And wealth mixed with bitterness."

prakrit: "पञ्चिन्दियविसयविमोहिएण कन्ताषसत्तचित्तेणं,धम्मो च्चिय नाहिकओ,हा! कटुं वञ्चिओ अप्पा"
english: "Because he is so captivated by the five vows, He does not know what is true in Dharma." "Ah! Strong bow!" ""

prakrit: "इन्दधणुसुमिणसरिसे,विज्जुलयाचवलचञ्चले जीए,को नाम करेज रई,जो होज सचेयणो पुरिसो?"
english: "In the twilight sky, In the choppy glances of the sky, Who lives by name, Courage, Who is a wise man?"

prakrit: "ता उज्झिऊण रज,कन्ता पुत्ता धणं च धणं च,गेण्हामि परमबन्धु',पारत्तबिइज्जयं धम्मं"
english: "So get up, Raj, son, get rich. I will be a good friend to you all." ""

prakrit: "अहिसिञ्चिऊण रज्जे,सो हु महारक्खसं पढमपुत्तं,उम्मुक्कसवसङ्गो,पवज्जमुवागओ धीरो"
english: "It's the moonlight of spring, So you must be reading a great book, My friend, Be patient as I bow." ""

prakrit: "लङ्कापुरीऎ सामी,घणवाहणनन्दणो पहियकित्ती,विजाहराण राया,भुञ्जइ रजं सुरवरो व"
english: "The Lankapuri is the Sami, The traveler is the Sandalwood farmer, The conqueror is the Raya, The rooster is the king of jewels, And the elephant is the hunter."

prakrit: "भज्जा से विमलाभा,तीए पुत्ता कमेण उप्पन्ना,पढमो य देवरक्खो,उअही आइच्चरक्खो य"
english: "Bhajja se vimlabha, tere putra kamen uppanna, padhamo ya devarakkho, yahi ayakarakkho ya"

prakrit: "अजियजिणिन्दो य तओ,धम्मपहं दरिसिऊण लोयस्स,सम्मेयसेलसिहरे,सिवमयलमणुत्तरं पत्तो"
english: "If you want to know the true nature of dharma, go and see how it manifests itself In the world around you."

prakrit: "सगरो वि चक्कवट्टी,चउसट्ठिसहस्सजुवइकयविहवो,भुञ्जइ एगच्छत्तं,सयलसमत्थं इमं भरहं"
english: "Even rice flour is poisonous, Sixty-four thousand young men are addicted to it, One can roast it with an axe, But rice means the same as rice."

prakrit: "अमरिन्दरूवसरिसा,सट्ठिसहस्सा सुयाण उप्पन्ना,अट्ठावयम्मि सेले,वन्दणहेउं समणुपत्ता"
english: "Amarindaru varissa, Sathi sahasasa suyanna uppanna, Athavayammi sale, Vandanahe samanupatta."

prakrit: "वन्दणविहाणपूयं,कमेण काऊण सिद्धपडिमाणं,अह ते कुमारसीहा,चेइयभवणे पसंसन्ति"
english: "A man devoid of finery, A woman without finesse, Is dominated by her virginity, And a man who likes to be pampered."

prakrit: "मन्तीहि ताण सिटुं,एयाई कारियाइँ भरहेणं,तुम्हेत्थ रक्खणत्थं,किंचि उवायं लहुं कुणह"
english: "Sit on that stretch of the mind, Pay attention to what you have to do, Protect yourself, Or make some sort of fence."

prakrit: "दण्डरयणेण घायं,दाउं गङ्गानईऎ मज्झम्मि,सयरसुएण उ ताहे,परिखेवो पवयस्स कओ"
english: "A wound is inflicted by punishment, A bruise by the river Ganges, A thrashing by a sharp arrow, A painful ordeal to bear."

prakrit: "दट्ठूण य तं विवरं,नागिन्दो कोहजलणपज्जलिओ,सबे वि सयरपुत्ते,तक्खणमेत्तं डहइ रुट्टो"
english: "The moment you see him, The flames of the kohl burn, Everything goes smoothly, Only wisdom takes root."

prakrit: "न य दड्ढे 'दोण्णि नणे,ताणं मज्झट्ठिए कुमाराणं,काऊणं अणुकम्पं,जिणवरधम्मप्पभावेणं"
english: "The two do not meet, The young son glances at his mother, The wife turns her back on him, The couple embrace." ""

prakrit: "दत्र̥̄ण मरणमेयं,सयरसुयाणं समत्तखन्धारो,भइरहि-भीमेण समं,साएयपुरिं समणुपत्तो"
english: "Friend, at the moment of death, Make straightforward contact with your lover, At the moment when your brother - in - law is abroad Equal in dignity."

prakrit: "सयरस्स निवेयन्ता,सुयमरणं भीम-भगिरही सहसा,नयसत्थपण्डिएहिं,निवारिया ते अमच्चेहिं"
english: "Friend, do not be negligent; do not cause grief; Do not harm the innocent."

prakrit: "ते तत्थ पवरमन्ती,गन्तूण य षणमिऊण चक्कहरं,दिन्नासणोवविट्ठा,कयसन्ना जंपिउ पयत्ता"
english: "There it is, the almighty, Going to and fro, Running around in circles, Sitting idle, Jumping about in circles."

prakrit: "इह पेच्छ नरवइ! तुमं,लोयस्स अणिच्चया असारत्तं,को एत्थ कुणइ सोयं,जो पुरिसो पण्डिओ लोए?"
english: "Look at that man! You fool, You shameless bastard. Who's going to do this to a man who's just like you?" ""

prakrit: "आसि पुरा चक्कहरो,भरहो नामेण तुज्झ समविभवो,छक्खण्डा जेण इमा,दासि व वसीकया पुहई"
english: "Come, full circle; may my name suit you better: Mother, I beg of you, Take me in your arms Like a servant."

prakrit: "तस्सा''सि पढमपुत्तो,आइच्चजसो त्ति नाम विक्खाओ,जस्स य नामपसिद्धो,वंसो इह वट्टए लोए"
english: "Tassa," I muttered, "Today your name has been spoilt." In this wretched world, as in the case of the eponymous poem, It is worthless. "

prakrit: "एत्थ नरवई,वंसे बल-रिद्धि-कित्तिसंपन्ने,काऊण महारज्जं,वोलीणा दीहकालेणं"
english: "Here lies the man, Vanshe bal - riddhi - kitisampanne, Kaun maharajja, Wolina dihakaalena"

prakrit: "अच्छन्तु ताव मणुया,जे वि य ते सुरवई महिड्डीया,विभवेण पज्जलेउं,विज्झाणा हुयवहं चेव"
english: "Well done man, Whatever it is That gives pleasure to the senses, It quenches my thirst for knowledge."

prakrit: "जे वि य जिणवरवसहा,समत्थतेलोक्कनमियपयवीढा,आउरक्खयम्मि पत्ते,ते वि य मुञ्चन्ति ससरीरं"
english: "Whatever living beings put together, Whichever worlds lie between, And leaves which are uneven, They grind for one's life."

prakrit: "जह एक्कम्मि तरुवरे,वसिऊणं पक्खिणो पभायम्मि,वचन्ति दस दिसाओ,एक्कुडम्बम्मि तह जीवा"
english: "A flock of parrots, Living on ripe fruit, Travels in ten directions, Lives on a single branch."

prakrit: "इन्दधणुफेणसुविणय-विजुलयाकुसुमबुब्बुयसरिच्छा,इठ्ठजणसंपओगा,विभवा देहा य जीवाणं"
english: "The twang of the rainbow - Visually challenged, Like a bunch of peacock's tail feathers, Like the flourish of a man's limbs, Is the essence of life."

prakrit: "सोसन्ति जे वि उदहि,मेरुं भञ्जन्ति मुट्ठिषहरेहिं,कालेण ते वि पुरिसा,कयन्तवयणं चिय पविट्ठा"
english: "Anyone who touches a woman Succeeds in burning her, Sweating her fists, But in time she too will be purified. For what use is a woman made of gold?"

prakrit: "बलियाण जीवलोए,सबाण वि होइ अइबलो मच्चू,निहणं जेण अणन्ता,चक्कहराई इहं नीया"
english: "Sacrifice should be taken alive, Everything else should be as good as possible. But if you neglect it, Take care that it does not rot."

prakrit: "एवं मच्चुवसगए,ससुरा-'सुर-माणुसम्मि लोयम्मि,उम्मुक्ककम्मकलुसा,नवरं चिय सुत्थिया सिद्धा"
english: "And behold, my father - in - law -" "The human body is limp, You have to work hard, A novice is straightforward." ""

prakrit: "उत्तमकुलुब्भवाणं,एयाणं गुणसहस्सनिलयाणं,चरिए सुमरिज्जन्ते,कह चेव न फुट्टए हिययं?"
english: "Excellent speech, Such virtuous conduct, Such excellent character; How is it that nothing has been broken?"

prakrit: "जह ते कालेण निवा,इह मणुयभवे खयं समणुपत्ता,तह अम्हे वि य सबे,वच्चीहामो निरुत्तेणं"
english: "As long as he lives, It is conciliatory towards human beings, So also with us, We are bound to be dissatisfied."

prakrit: "अन्नं पि सुणसु सामिय! दीणमुहा भीम-भगिरही दो वि,एत्था''गयाण पेच्छसि,नूणं सेसा खयं पत्ता"
english: "Listen to me again, Samia! Both the poor girl and the poor man Face to face." "Here you are, singing along. There's nothing wrong with that"

prakrit: "ते पेच्छिऊण राया,तं चिय सोऊण निययसुयमरणं,घणसोयसल्लियङ्गो,मुच्छावसवेम्भलो पडिओ"
english: "When he looked at Raya, She looked at him, As if in remembrance of her former self:" "Long, thin hair, Like the twang of a mustache." ""

prakrit: "चन्दणजलोल्लियङ्गो,पडिबुद्धो पुत्तमरणदुक्खत्तो,अह विलविउं पयत्तो,नयणेसु य मुक्कसलिलोहो"
english: "Sandalwood water lilies, Wrapped in mud, Slipping from the lotus of your face, Oh! weeping women, Like pearls dipped in the moonlight."

prakrit: "हा! सुकुमालसरीरा,पुत्ता मह सुरकुमारसमरूवा,केण विहया अयण्डे,अविराहियदुट्ठवेरीण?"
english: "Ah! my handsome son! So what makes me look so handsome? It's only because my eyes are closed And my hair is loose." ""

prakrit: "हा! गुणसहस्सनिलया,हा! उत्तमरूव सोमससिवयणा,हा! निग्घिणेण विहिणा,वहिया मे निरणुकम्पेणं"
english: "Ha! Meritorious girl, ha! Decent girl, saviour of longing, ha: Destroyed by neglect, Destroyer of decency." ""

prakrit: "किं तुज्झ नत्थि पुत्ता,पावविही! बालया हिययइट्ठा,जेण मह मारसि इहं,सुयाण सढि सहस्साइं"
english: "Why not you, my poor girl! Child, tell me, If you kill me, I'll be right there with you." ""

prakrit: "एयाणि य अन्नाणि य,चक्कहरो विलविऊण बहुयाई,पडिबुद्धो भणइ तओ,वयणाई जायसंवेगो"
english: "It's Anna, The traveler is so full of quivering words, He mutters them out loud, He mumbles them that sound like poems."

prakrit: "हा! कटुं विसयविमोहिएण सुयणेहरज्जुबद्धेणं,धम्मो मए न चिण्णो,तरुणत्ते मन्दभग्गेणं"
english: "Ah! the burning fire of love, Which burns bright because it is bitter, Doesn't recognize me in the dharma, Fades away like a youthful man"

prakrit: "किं मज्झ वसुमईए?,नवहि निहीहि व रयणसहिएहिं!,जं दुल्लहलद्धाणं,पुत्ताण मुहं न पेच्छामि"
english: "What do you mean I'm pregnant? No, you're not! I don't want to see your son's face If I mess with his!"

prakrit: "धन्ना ते सप्पुरिसा,भरहाई जे महिं पयहिऊणं,निविण्णकामभोगा,निस्सङ्गा चेव पवइया"
english: "Happy the Sapphurisa, brother - in - law, Who gave me such pleasure At the mere mention of his name, Will never taste right again."

prakrit: "अह सो जण्हविपुत्तं,अहिसिञ्चेऊण भगिरहिं रजे,भीमरहेण समाणं,पवइओ जिणवरसयासे"
english: "Ah, the misfortune of being married, To let one's brother and sister rejoice while the other is busy making love, Is the pleasure of living for the first time."

prakrit: "काऊण तवमुयारं,उप्पाडिय केवलं सह सुएणं,आउक्खए महप्पा,सगरो सिद्धिं समणुपत्तो"
english: "Who is there to comfort you? Just lie down beside you, my dear, I promise, As long as I have no more trouble finding the right one."

prakrit: "अह भगिरही वि रज्जं,कुणइ महाभडसमूहपरिकिण्णो,साएयपुरवरीए,इन्दो जह देवनयरीए"
english: "Oh! my poor girl! Even the king's wife, Like a great host of monsters, Pretends to be blind; This is the God of Love."

prakrit: "अह भगिरही कयाई,गन्तूण य पणमिऊण मुणिवसहं,तत्थेव सन्निविट्ठो,नच्चासन्ने सुणिय धम्मं"
english: "Oh! what a foolish person! If you happen to come across a man Who is swooning over you With all his heart, You'd better stay close by, If you don't listen carefully To dharma."

prakrit: "सुयसागरमणगारं,पुच्छइ तं भगिरही कुमारवरो,केणेव कारणेणं,ताणं मझे दुवे न मया?"
english: "Your handsome son," she asked, "Is it because of someone else's fault you didn't kiss me?"

prakrit: "अह भणइ मुणिवरो सो,गच्छो सम्मेयपवयं चलिओ,सणियं विहरन्तो च्चिय,संपत्तो अन्तिमं गामं"
english: "" "Ah! you fool," "he said." "Let's go for a walk together: The rainy season is almost over, Wealth is at last reaching the village"

prakrit: "दह्ण समणसङ्घ,गामजणो तस्स कुणइ उवसग्गं,कुम्भारेण निसिद्धो,निन्दन्तो फरुसवयणेहिं"
english: "Look at the congregation, The villagers mock at him, The potters disapprove, The slandererer shows through to the funeral."

prakrit: "चोरत्तं पडिवन्नो,तत्थेगो गामवासिओ पुरिसो,तस्स'वराहनिमित्तं,गामो दड्डो नरिन्देणं"
english: "The thief has fallen, So have the men of the village, For the sake of the bridegroom. The village is burning." ""

prakrit: "कुम्भारो वि य अन्नं,गामं आमन्तिओ गओ तइया,सो तत्थ नवरि एक्को,न य दड्डो कम्मजोएणं"
english: "The potter has had his way, He has gone to the village, So the young wife is all by herself. There is nothing for the blind to do." ""

prakrit: "मरिऊण कुम्भयारो,वणिओ जाओ महाधणसमिद्धो,वाराडयम्मि एत्तो,गामो जाओ समं तेणं"
english: "The potter is dead, The hunter is gone, And the buffalo has had its fair share of trouble. Nowadays the wind blows so much, That the village is as thin as ever."

prakrit: "तत्तो वि करिय कालं,वणिओ सो नरवई समुप्पन्नो,गामा वि माइवाहा,जाया हत्थीण परिमलिया"
english: "Even then there was plenty of time, The forest is decrepit, The people are exhausted, The countryside is empty, The elephants are exhausted."

prakrit: "जाओ नरवइ समणो,देवो होऊण वरविमाणम्मि,तत्तो चुओ समाणो,भगिरहिराया तुम जाओ"
english: "Go, sacrifice a man, become a god, fly a plane, kiss him, and then you'll be gone."

prakrit: "जो वि हु सो गामजणो,कालं काऊण विविहजाईसु,कम्माणुभावजणिया,सगरस्स सुया समुप्पन्ना"
english: "Whoever I am is a man of the village, How varied the times are, Jealous of small talk, Well-versed in quarrels and quarrels."

prakrit: "सङ्घस्स निन्दणं कुणइ जो नरो राग-दोसपडिबद्धो,सो भवसहस्सघोरे,पुणरुत्तं भमइ संसारे"
english: "One who expresses disapproval at a conflict, Who holds a grudge, Shows affection, And then roams the world again."

prakrit: "सुणिऊण निययचरियं,भवपरियट्टं च सयरपुत्ताणं,समणो होऊण चिरं,भगीरही सिद्धिमणुपत्तो"
english: "To listen is to conduct, to think is to act, and to speak is to purify oneself; to suffer is to attain purity."

prakrit: "एयं ते परिकहियं,चरियं सयरस्स पत्थवुप्पन्नं,एत्तो मगहनराहिव!,जं पत्थुय तं च वो सुणसु"
english: "Here he is, Stretching out his broad hips, Touching the ground with his sharp arrows." "Listen to what he has to say!"

prakrit: "जो तत्थ सो महप्पा,लङ्कापुरिसामिओ महारक्खो,निक्कण्टयमणुकूलं,भुञ्जइ रजं महाभोगं"
english: "One who is there is a great king, A great ruler like Lankapuri, Friend of good times, And a great lover of roasts."

prakrit: "सो अन्नया कयाई,जुवईजणपरिमिओ वरुज्जाणे,रमिऊण वाविसलिले,पेच्छइ भमरं पउममज्झे"
english: "So what do you think? Aunt, Young lovers groan, Make love as they flutter their wings And look at the bee That has nipped in the bud."

prakrit: "जह पउमगन्धलुद्धो,नट्ठो च्चिय महुयरो अविन्नाणो,तह जुवइवयणकमले,आसत्तो चेव नट्ठो हं"
english: "A woman who smells good, Who is not addicted to sweets, Is a lotus lover by nature, And who isn't, Is always a bee."

prakrit: "सुइबुद्धिणा विहूणा,नियमेणं महुयरा विणस्सन्ति,कुसलो वि जं विणट्ठो,अहयं तं मोहदुल्ललियं"
english: "Wretched wife, The bees weave by rule, But whoever weaves by chance, I have set my heart on."

prakrit: "गन्धेण रसेण इमो,जइ एवं महुयरो खयं पत्तो,पढमं चेव विणट्ठो,पञ्चिन्दियवसगओ जो हं"
english: "Love is perfumed with fragrance, With jasmine and nectar Powdered with honey, Woven from scratch, Like five candied flowers That are mine."

prakrit: "भोत्तूण विसयसोक्खं,पुरिसो धम्मेण विरहिओ सन्तो,परिभमइ चाउरन्तं,पुणरुत्तं दीहसंसारं"
english: "Destroyed wisdom, For men separated by dharma Are content, For the whole world revolves around nature, And so is the world once again."

prakrit: "जाव य विरत्तभावो,अच्छइ लङ्काहिवो परिगणन्तो,ताव य सङ्घपरिवुडो,पत्तो सुयसायरो समणो"
english: "Either you are averse to going out, Either you welcome a Lankan elephant, Or you welcome one from the sangha, Either it is a good idea or a bad one."

prakrit: "तस-पाण-जन्तुरहिए,उज्जाणे फासुए सिलावट्टे,तत्थेव सन्निविट्ठो,समणेहि समं कयनिओगो"
english: "Be like an animal, Trapped in a thicket, Stuck in a silo, Sitting there Thinking how one can be equal to it."

prakrit: "उज्जाणपालएहि,सिट्टे समणागमे तओ राया,गन्तूण पययमणसो,पणमइ सुयसायरं साहुं"
english: "Ujjain palayehi, Sitte samanagam mein toh raaya, gataun payamanso, panamai suyasayaram saahoon."

prakrit: "सेसं च समणसङ्घ,जहक्कमं पणमिऊण उवविठ्ठो,पुच्छइ भवपरियट्टे,निययं राया मुणिवरिन्दं"
english: "The moment I see her, Wrapped in a towel, She asks me what I want to eat, I swear by nature"

prakrit: "अह साहिउं पयत्तो,समणो छउभत्थनाणविसएणं,भरहेत्थ पोयणपुरे,वसइ नरो हियकरो नामं"
english: "Oh! my dear, I beg of you, Please, do not trouble about this: It is only in my heart That I speak plainly. But let me dwell on the name of my lover."

prakrit: "भज्जा य माहवी से,पुत्तो पोइंकरो तुम तेसिं,जिणवरधम्मुप्पन्नो,हेमरहो नरवई तत्थ"
english: "Bhajja ya mahavi se, putro poyenkaro tum the, jinvaradhammuppanno, hemerho naravai taththa."

prakrit: "सो अन्नया कयाई,चेइयपूर्य रइत्तु भावेणं,पडुपडह-सङ्खसहियं,जयसदं जिणवरे कुणइ"
english: "So do not be negligent; keep your emotions to the fullest. Always be vigilant. Always act in a positive way."

prakrit: "उट्ठियमेत्तो सि तुम,सदं सोऊण हट्टतुट्ठमणो,अह घोसिउं पयत्तो,जिणस्स थुइमङ्गलविहाणं"
english: "Get up! You're the one who made me fall asleep. Try going to bed, you stupid coward. It's just the way things are." ""

prakrit: "कालं काऊण तओ,जक्खो जाओ महिड्डिसंपन्नो,अवरविदेहे पेच्छइ,कञ्चणनयरे मुणिवरस्स"
english: "Time is of the essence, For everyone knows what it is to be rich And what it takes to be poor."

prakrit: "उवसग्गं कीरन्तं,वारेऊण य रिऊ ससत्तीए,रक्खइ मुणिवरदेहं,जक्खो पुण्णं समज्जेइ"
english: "Aunt, When the rains stop, She protects the body of the sage. Anyone can understand virtue."

prakrit: "तत्तो चुओ समाणो,तडियङ्गयखेयरस्स वेयड्ढे,सिरिषभदेवीतणओ,जाओ उइओ वरकुमारो"
english: "There you are, my poor girl, Trees strewn all over the street, Deer - eyed women dancing in unison, Going to and fro." ""

prakrit: "तो वन्दणाऎ जन्तं,अह चारणविक्कम पलोएउं,विज्जाहराहिराया,कुणइ नियाणं तओ मूढो"
english: "So as much as I like dancing, I like to walk on grass, And I don't know how to walk, You'd better keep your eyes closed."

prakrit: "काऊण तवमुयारं,ईसाणे सुरवरो त्थ होऊणं,घणवाहणस्स पुत्तो,जाओ सि तुमं महारक्खो"
english: "Who cares how old you are, Such a handsome man you must be, Son of a hard worker. Go, make yourself master."

prakrit: "सुरभोगेसु न तित्ती,जो सि तुमं न य गओ सुचिरकालं,कह परितुट्ठो होहिसि,दियहाणं सोलसद्धेणं?"
english: "You will not taste good food, you will not be thirsty, For how long can you go without eating?"

prakrit: "सोऊण वयणमेयं,गओ विसायं तओ महारक्खो,आसन्नमरणभावो,भणइ नरिन्दो इमं वयणं"
english: "Listen to my playing, Go abroad, be a great protector; It is the feeling of impending death." Says Narindo, Speaking in this way.

prakrit: "विसयविसमोहिएणं,महिलानेहाणुरागरत्तेणं,कालो च्चिय न य नाओ,केत्तियमेत्तो वि वोलीणो"
english: "To fall in love with a strange man, To seduce a woman, Is not blackness itself something to be trifled with, Yet so much has passed."

prakrit: "न य गेहम्मि पलित्ते,कूवो खम्मइ सुतूरमाणेहिं,धाहाविए ण दम्मइ,आसो च्चिय तक्खणं चेव"
english: "No wheat will ripen, The well will boil, Like an attic. Without fire She will not be quenched. But this is the way of the tree."

prakrit: "अभिसिञ्चिऊण रज्जे,पुत्तं चिय देवरक्खसं राया,तह भाणुरक्खसं पि य,जुवरज्जे ठविय निक्खन्तो"
english: "When the water is hot, My son, Don't scold the God of Love, Drink the wine of jealousy, And stay up late with the jeweler."

prakrit: "वोसिरियसबसङ्गो,चइऊणं चउविहं च आहारं,आराहणाऎ कालं,काऊण सुरुत्तमो जाओ"
english: "Vocereous breasts, chewing gum And twenty - four servings of food, Time for making supplication, For who is going to tell us the truth?"

prakrit: "अह किन्नरगीयपुरे,सिरिधरविज्जाहरस्स वरदुहिया,रइवेगनामधेया,सा महिला देवरक्खस्स"
english: "Ah! a groveling girl, Standing on a flight of stairs, Two heavy ladys, Pretending to be pregnant, That woman is the God of Love."

prakrit: "गन्धवगीयनयरे,सुरसन्निभरायनामधेयस्स,जाया गन्धारिसुया,गन्धवा भाणुरक्खस्स"
english: "Gandhava geeyare, surasanbharayanamadhesa, jaya gandharisuya, gandhava vanurakshasa."

prakrit: "दस देवरक्खससुया,जाया छ च्चेव वरकुमारीओ,तह भाणुरक्खसस्स वि,तावइया चेव उप्पन्ना"
english: "There are ten gods and goddesses, Two hundred and fifty virgin girls, And one thousand buffalo and buffalo. So do not neglect one another."

prakrit: "अमरपुरसन्निभाई,सनामसरिसाइँ पट्टणवराई,रक्खससुएहि सिग्धं,कयाइँ बहुसन्निवेसाई"
english: "Amarpurasanbhai, townspeople at your feet, Protectors at your side, Where are you going to lodge your brother?"

prakrit: "संझायाल१सुवेलो२,मणपल्हाओ३ मणोहरो४ चेव,हंसद्दीवो५ हरिजो६,धन्नो७ कणओ८ समुद्दो य९"
english: "Samjhyala 1, Suvelo 2, Manapalhao 3, Manoharo 4, Chew, Laughing bull 5, Harejo 6, Wealthy bull 7, Ocean 8, Sea 9."

prakrit: "नामेण अद्धसग्गो१०,एव निवेसा महागुणसमिद्धा,उप्पाइया समत्था,महइमहारक्खससुएहिं"
english: "In name only, my poor go - between... And in my heart, my dear, the joys of great love."

prakrit: "आवत्तवियडमेहा,उक्कडफुडदुग्गहा महाभागा,तवणायवलियरयणा,कया य रविरक्खससुएहिं"
english: "It's been a long day, It has been a hard one, A long day of travel, A busy one at that, Is there anything you can do About it?"

prakrit: "वरभवण-तुङ्गतोरण-नाणाविहमणिमऊहपज्जलिया,सोहन्ति सन्निवेसा,रक्खसपुत्ताण कीलणया"
english: "Vara bhava - Tung torana - Coin - laden lotus flower - Placed on the pyre, Decorated with lotus flowers, Ornament of the God of Love"

prakrit: "राया उ देवरक्खो,बीओ पुण भाणुरक्खसनरिन्दो,घेत्तूण पवरदिक्खं,अबाबाहं समणुपत्तो"
english: "Ra ̄ ya ̄ u devara ̄ kkho, beau, Bees, once again, bow before the God of Love, Seize the heavenly scene, Then bow before it with open arms."

prakrit: "एवं तु महावंसे,वोलीणे मेहवाहणो जाओ,रक्खससुओ महप्पा,मणवेगाए समुप्पन्नो"
english: "And you are a great man. Once you are gone, great men go in search of you. But my lord, the God of Love, Has destroyed many a man."

prakrit: "तस्स य नामेण इमो,रक्खसवंसो जयम्मि विक्खाओ,तस्स वि आइच्चगई,महन्तकित्ती य उप्पन्नो"
english: "His name is Imo, The victory of the Rakshasa dynasty is certain, He too has arrived; The arrival of the great kite is certain."

prakrit: "सुप्षभदेवीतणया,रवि-चन्दसमप्पभा कुमारवरा,समणो होऊण चिरं,पिया य तेसिं गओ सग्गं"
english: "By the grace of the gods, Ravi - the moon - faced handsome boy, The chance of reconciliation is at hand. If he likes it, let him go."

prakrit: "नामेण मयणपउमा,आइच्चगइस्स वल्लभा भज्जा,आउणहनामधेया,महिला उ महन्तकित्तिस्स"
english: "By name my daughter - in - law; By nature a vallabha bhajja; By name a woman; By great merit."

prakrit: "आइच्चगइस्स सुओ,भीमरहो नाम नरवई जाओ,तस्सा''सि महिलियाणं,सहस्समेगं वरवहूणं"
english: "It's your turn, my dear, My name is Naravai Jao," Said the woman, "My husband is about to join us."

prakrit: "अट्ठत्तरं सयं चिय,पुत्ताणं अमररूवसरिसाणं,घेत्तूण य पबजं,भीमरहो पत्थिओ सिद्धिं"
english: "The eighth is righteousness itself, the son is immortal, the wife is supreme, the husband is pure, the head is pure and the feet are pure."

prakrit: "रक्खन्ति रक्खसा खलु,दीवा पुण्णेण रक्खिया जेण,तेणं चिय खयराणं,रक्खसनामं कयं लोए"
english: "Protection should be given to the raksha tree, the lamp should be illuminated, the rakhi should be nicely decorated, so why take the name rakshasa?"

prakrit: "एसो ते परिकहिओ,रक्खसक्सस्स उब्भवो तुज्झ,सेणिय! सुणाहि एत्तो,वंसे पुरिसा समासेण"
english: "" "Come, let that traveler depart. May the wrath of the God of Love arise from you, my dear!" "Listen: There must be a man by the same name."

prakrit: "भीमप्पहस्स पुत्तो,पढमो पूयारहो समुप्पन्नो,पबइओ खायजसो,रजे ठविऊण जियभाणुं"
english: "My son, I am full of longing, My husband is full of yearnings, My wife is exhausted And my life hangs in the balance."

prakrit: "जियभाणुस्स वि पुत्तो,संपरिकित्ती विसालवच्छयलो,सुग्गीवो तस्स सुओ,तस्स वि य भवे हरिग्गीवो"
english: "The poisonous snake is a son, The creeper is a vast shadow, The sucker is a pig, Everything that lives on it must be lost."

prakrit: "सिरिंगीवो सुमुहो वि य,सुवन्तो अमियवेगनामो य,आइच्चगइकुमारो,इन्दप्पभ इन्दमेहो य"
english: "A syringe is like a jasmine, A sweetwood tree is like nectar, A gooseflesh is like water flowing through it, And a rainbow is like the moon"

prakrit: "जाओ मयारिदमणो,पहिओ इन्दइ सुभाणुधम्मो य,एत्तो सुरारि तिजडो,महणो अङ्गारओ य रवी"
english: "Go, my poor man; The sun is hot here, And the moon is bright; It's the great fire of the sky, Or the sky is red."

prakrit: "चक्कार वज्जमझो,पमोय वरसीहवाहणो सूरो,चाउण्डरावणो वि य,भीमो भयवाह रिउमहणो"
english: "Chakkar Vajjamajho, Pamoy Varsihavahana Suro, Chaundaravana Vysya, Bhimo Bhairavaha Ryumahana."

prakrit: "निबाणभत्तिमन्तो उग्गसिरी अरुहभत्तिमन्तो य,तह य पवणुत्तरगई,उत्तम अणिलो य चण्डो य"
english: "Nibbāṇa-bhāṭimanto uggasiri aruhabhāṭimaṇu yajñā, so she sang aloud; the moon is like a good nectar." ""

prakrit: "लङ्कासोग मऊहो,महबाहु मणोरमो य रवितेओ,महगइ महकन्तजसो,अरिसंतासो य रायाणो"
english: "Bees worship Lanka, bees worship the great God, The nights are long, The scents are expensive, And the nights are rainy."

prakrit: "चन्दवयणो य महरवो,मेहज्झाणो तहेव गहखोभो,नक्खत्तदमणमाई,एवं विज्जाहरा नेया"
english: "The moon is a model of beauty, The sky is a panorama, The nose is that of humility, And the eyes are that of wisdom."

prakrit: "कोडीण सयसहस्सा,एवं विजाहरा बलसमिद्धा,लङ्कापुरीऎ सामी,बोलीणा दीहकालेणं"
english: "Kodina sayasahasa, and vijayahara balsamidha, Lankapuri saami, speaks in broad daylight."

prakrit: "पुत्ताण निययरज्जं,दाऊण परंपराऎ निक्खन्ता,देवत्तं सिवसोक्खं,केइ ससत्तीऎ संपत्ता"
english: "A son is pure energy, a daughter is pure tradition, a god is pure pleasure, and someone has inexhaustible wealth."

prakrit: "एवं गएसु नियमा,महयापुरिसेसु पउमगब्भाए,मेहप्पभस्स पुत्तो,कित्तीधवलो समुप्पन्नो"
english: "And gone are the rules, Proud brother, Who for so long has been a pleasure, My son, How difficult it is to balance them All."

prakrit: "विज्जाहरेहि समयं,आणाइस्सरियविविहगुणपुण्णो,लङ्कापुरीऎ रज्जं,कुणइ जहिच्छं सुरिन्दो व"
english: "A vast expanse of time, A myriad of different qualities, A lankapuri's razor, Like the nail marks on a needle."

prakrit: "एवं भवन्तरकएण तवोबलेणं,पावन्ति देव-मणुएसु महन्तसोक्खं,केएत्थ दड्डनीसेसकसाय-मोहा,सिद्धा भवन्ति विमला-'मलपङ्कमुक्का"
english: "And because of Bhavantaraka The bow grows thin, The gods and the humans attain great bliss, And from here on the Vimala -'The lotus bends - Becomes pure, Like the lotus of love." ""

prakrit: "इति पउमचरिए रक्खसवंसाहियारे पञ्चमुद्देसओ समत्तो"
english: "Praise be to the five pearls of the God of Love."

prakrit: "एसो ते परिकहिओ,रक्खसवंसो मए समासेणं,एत्तो सुणाहि नरवइ! वाणरवंसस्स उप्पत्ती"
english: "Come, follow me! My army is full of rakshasas. Listen, you cowards! The water of the Varnavamsa is salty." ""

prakrit: "वेयड्डनगवरिन्दे,मेहपुरं दक्खिणाऎ सेढीए,विज्जाहरसामन्तो,अहइन्दो अन्थि विक्खाओ"
english: "In the wretched village, On the south bank of the Mehpur, Staircase of wisdom, There lurks another ruin."

prakrit: "भज्जा य सिरिमई से,सिरिकण्ठो तीऎ गब्भसंभूओ,पुत्तो महागुणधरो,देवकुमारोवमसिरीओ"
english: "Foolish girl, don't be so hasty: Your hair is strewn all over with grease, Your face like a garland of peacock's feathers, And your eyes like jewels."

prakrit: "देवि त्ति नाम कन्ना,सिरिकण्ठसहोयरा विसालच्छी,सयलम्मि जीवलोए,रूवपडागा महिलियाणं"
english: "The name of the goddess is Kanna, Sirikantha sahoyara visala chachi, Sayalammi jeevaloye, Ruwapadaga mahilayana."

prakrit: "अह रयणपुराहिवई,वीरो पुप्फुत्तरो महाराया,तस्स गुणेहि सरिच्छो,पुत्तो पउमुत्तरो नाम"
english: "Oh! rayanpurahivai! Virodhi, my handsome son, Your highness, You have proved your worth. My son, your name is Pumutra." ""

prakrit: "सिरिकण्ठनिययबहिणी,मग्गइ पुप्फुत्तरो सुयनिमित्तं,न य तेण तस्स दिन्ना,दिन्ना सा कित्तिधवलस्स"
english: "A straightforward wife begs her young son for sleep; he will not give it to her, for he does not know how to sulk."

prakrit: "वित्तो चिय वीवाहो,दोण्ह वि विहिणा महासमुदएणं,सोऊण तन्निमित्तं,रुट्ठो पुप्फुत्तरो राया"
english: "Finance is my husband's, Both my husband and I are separated by a great chasm. Instead of sleeping, My son sleeps."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाई,सिरिकण्ठो वन्दणाऎ देवगिरिं,गन्तूण पडिनियत्तो,पेच्छइ कन्नं वरुजाणे"
english: "Oh! what a strange thing it is to be making love, To bow before a god of thunder, To fall at one's feet, To gaze into the eyes of a young bridegroom."

prakrit: "तीए वि सो कुमारो,दिट्ठो कुसुमाउहो ब रूवेण,दोहं पि समणुरागो,तक्खणमेत्तेण उप्पन्नो"
english: "She too is a virgin, Look at the lotus Blossom, Then the couple embrace. There must be something very special about that pair of hands."

prakrit: "मुणिऊण तीऎ भावं,हरिसवसुभिन्नदेहरोमञ्चो,अवगूहिऊण कन्नं,उप्पइओ नहयलं तुरिओ"
english: "Tears flow from her eyes, Sweat drips from her cheeks, Her hair hangs loose around her face, And her lips quiver." ""

prakrit: "पुप्फुत्तरो नरिन्दो,सिढे चेडीहि नियसुयासमग्गो,सन्नद्धबद्धकवओ,मग्गेण पहाविओ तस्स"
english: "Foolish boy, Narindo, go up and down the stairs again and again. Be prepared, cow - dung cakes. If you want to ride on foot You'll have to bend over."

prakrit: "बहुसत्थ-नीइकुसलो,सिरिकण्ठो जाणिऊण परमत्थं,लङ्कापुरिं पविठ्ठो,सरणं चिय कित्तिधवलस्स"

prakrit: "विविहकला-''गमकुसलो,मन्ती तं भणइ महुरवयणेहिं,तं कारणं सुणिज्जउ,जेणे' षवङ्गमा लिहिया"
english: "Vividhaka Kala -" "Gamakusa, mind you, she says, with great fondness. Listen to her cause, you who have written'Shavangama '." ""

prakrit: "पुवं पहाणपुरिसो,सिरिकण्ठो नाम आसि विक्खाओ,अमरपुरसरिससोहं,किकिन्धिपुरं कयं जेण"
english: "Poor man, Your name is Sirikantho, come on, you stupid bastard. How can you know what I mean when I say you are immortal?"

prakrit: "तेणं चिय पढमयरं,आहाराईसु पवरपीईए,घेत्तूण बन्धवा इव,देवब्भूया परिट्ठविया"
english: "They are my first love, Give me something to eat, Take me in their arms Like brothers in law."

prakrit: "तत्तो पभूइ जे वि हु,कुल-वंसे नरवई समुप्पन्ना,ताणं पि मङ्गलत्थं,तित्थं चिय वाणरा जाया"
english: "There I shall go, Whatever may be the number of men in the family, Accumulated for the moment, But only on auspicious days."

prakrit: "जेणं परंपराए,तुम्ह कुले वाणरा परिट्ठविया,तेणं इमे नराहिव! आलिहिया मङ्गलनिमित्तं"
english: "As the tradition goes, You cool talker, Parithviya, so this man is not worthy of death! Always be ready for good luck."

prakrit: "जं जस्स हवइ निययं,कुलोचियं मङ्गलं मणूसस्स,तं तस्स कीरमाणं,करेइ सुहसंपयं विउलं"
english: "What's in store for you, Destiny, Cool Wishes, Auspicious moods, Is in the nature of good fortune."

prakrit: "एवं सुणित्तु वयणं,भणइ निवो किं इमे धरणिपट्टे,आलिहिया कुलजेट्टा!,पाएसु जणेण छिप्पन्ति"
english: "And listen to the voice:" "Nivo, why are you hiding under this sheet of mud? It's just the way you hide your clothes!" ""

prakrit: "छत्तेसु तोरणेसु य,धएसु पासायसिहर-मउडेसु,काऊण रयणघडिए,ठावेह पवङ्गमे सिग्धं"
english: "Chhathesu toranesu ya, dhaesu pasai sehar-moudesu, kaun rayanghadiye, thaveh pawangame seedha." ""

prakrit: "एवं च भणियमेत्ते,छत्ताइ विणिम्मिया मणिविचित्ता,वाणरविविहायारा,दिसासु सबासु पज्जत्ता"
english: "As the saying goes:" "Though they speak alike, They hide their feelings, When they speak differently, They conceal everything." ""

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाई,राया अमरप्पभो य वेयड्ढे,जिणिऊण रिउ नियत्तो,भुञ्जइ रजं महाभोगं"
english: "Oh! what a cruel man! A cruel man, Though immortal, Is bent on conquering the earth. For roasting is the great pleasure of a king."

prakrit: "अमरप्पभस्स पुत्तो,नामेण कइद्धओ समुप्पन्नो,तस्स वि य हवइ भज्जा,सिरिप्षमा रूवसंपन्ना"
english: "My son, what do you mean by immortal speech? There must be something in that name And it must be bhajja. Siripasha must be covered with blood."

prakrit: "रिक्खरओ य अइबलो,गयणाणन्दो य खेयरनरिन्दो,गिरिनन्दो वि य एए,अन्नोन्नसुया''णुपुबीए"
english: "The rickshaw puller or the buffalo, The hunter or the hunter, The heron or the stag, The rest are mere pleasures." ""

prakrit: "एवं अणेयसंखा,वोलीणा वाणराहिवा वीरा,काऊण जिणवरतवं,सकम्मजणियं गया ठाणं"
english: "And Aneysankha, Vollina Vaaranahiva Veera, Kauna Jinavarathavam, The station of the wise man is gone."

prakrit: "जं जस्स हवइ निययं,नरस्स लोगम्मि लक्खणावयवं,तं तस्स होइ नाम,गुणेहि गुणषच्चयनिमित्तं"
english: "What's destined to happen, As characterized by inauspicious people, Shall have a name, Because of virtuous qualities."

prakrit: "खग्गेण खग्गधारी,धणुहेण धणुद्धरो पडेण पडी,आसेण आसवारो,हत्थारोहो य हत्थीणं"
english: "A pigeon falls when hit by a rake, A stag falls when struck by a bull, A doe falls when approached by a fowler, And a stag is hit by an elephant."

prakrit: "इक्खूण य इक्खागो,जाओ विज्जाहराण विज्जाए,तह वाणराण वंसो,वाणरचिन्धेण निबडिओ"
english: "Ikkhun ya ikkhago, jaao vijjaharana visjaye, taswarana vanso, tasaarana bande do." ""

prakrit: "वाणरचिन्धेण इमे,छत्ताइ निवेसिया कई जेण,विज्जाहरा जणेणं,वुच्चन्ति हु वाणरा तेणं"
english: "Aunt, There are many people who live in the same neighborhood As me, And I can see them all with my own eyes."

prakrit: "सेयंसस्स भयवओ,जिणन्तरे तह य वासुपुज्जस्स,अमरप्पभेण एयं,वाणरचिन्धं परिट्ठवियं"
english: "Fear the sea, For there is nothing more to be desired Than to taste the nectar of the immortal God."

prakrit: "अन्ने वि एवमाई,विज्जाहरपत्थिवा महासत्ता,सेवन्ति पुवचरियं,किक्किन्धिपुरे जहिच्छाए"
english: "Anything is possible, Visvesvaraya's great power, Sevanti pūcāryam, Just like Kikindipura."

prakrit: "एवं वाणरवंसस्स संभवो नरवई! समक्खाओ,अन्नं चिय संबन्धं,सुणाहि एत्तो पयत्तेण"
english: "And how is it possible for the forest to be barren? It's true, my dear, food is a relative of tea. Listen, pay attention!" ""

prakrit: "राया महोयहिरवो,किक्किन्धिपुरुत्तमे कुणइ रज्जं,विज्जुप्पभाऎ सहिओ,सुरलोगगओ सुरवरो व"
english: "Raya is a great hero, Kikkindhipurutame kune raja, Vijjupapa bhaajo, Surlogga, Surravara va.,"

prakrit: "अट्ठत्तरं सयं से,पुत्ताणं सुरकुमारसरिसाणं,बलदप्पगबियाणं,पडिवक्खगइन्दसीहाणं"
english: "From the eighth breath, From the sound of the son's trumpet, To the song of the bull's cudgel, And from the thunder of the rainbow."

prakrit: "मुणिसुबयस्स तित्थं,तइया बट्टइ भवोहमहणस्स,विज्जाहर-सुर-नरवइ-ससि-सूरसमच्चियकमस्स"
english: "Munisubhayastha titham, thayai batayi bhavohamanasa, vijjaharasura-sura-narvayi-sasi-surasamacchiyakamasasa."

prakrit: "लङ्कापुरीऎ सामी,तडिकेसो नाम नरवई तइया,रक्खसर्वसुब्भूओ,भुञ्जइ रज्जं महाभोगं"
english: "Lankapuri, sage, Your name is Naravai, Your protection is supreme, Your arms are plowable, And roasting is the great pleasure of a rope."

prakrit: "दोहं पि ताण एकं,अञ्चन्तसिणेहनिब्भर हिययं,नवरं पुणाइ देहं,अन्नोन्नं केवलं जायं"
english: "Both are one, The whole is composed of five senses, The new is the whole body, The old is nothing but flesh."

prakrit: "नाऊण वि तडिकेसं,पवइयं सबसङ्गओमुक्कं,राया महोयहिरवो,सो वि य दिक्खं समणुपत्तो"
english: "The river is extremely hot, Everything I have to do is face to face, Even the rivers are swollen."

prakrit: "अह भणइ मगहराया,तडिकेसो कम्मि कारणनिमित्ते,पवइओ खायजसो? कहेह भयवं! परिफुडं मे"
english: "I beg of you, Is the deficiency of water the cause of your wretchedness, Or is it that your husband has a fever?" "I am afraid so!" ""

prakrit: "तो भणइ गणहरिन्दो,तडिकेसो सुणसु पउमउज्जाणे,अन्तेउरेण सहिओ,रमिऊण सयं समाढत्तो"
english: "So say the hunter," "Listen to your husband when he calls you, Be patient with him when he returns, Make love while he is still alive." ""

prakrit: "वरबउल-तिलय-चम्पय-असोग-पुन्नाग-नागसुसमिद्धे,नन्दणवणे व सक्को,सुरवहुयासहगओ रमइ"
english: "Among the creepers - Tilai, Champaya, Asoga, Punanga, Nagas - The sweetwood tree, Like a snake, Rejoices with the sweetwood trees."

prakrit: "अह कोलणसत्ताए,सिरिचन्दाए पवंगमो सहसा,पडिओ य तीऎ उवरिं,नहेहि फाडेइ थणकलसे"
english: "Ah, the breasts of the nymph, Suddenly the moon bends over me, But she does not look down But tears at my breasts."

prakrit: "दट ठूण पणइणी सो,थणकलसुब्भिन्नरुहिरविच्छड्ड,राया वि हु तडिकेसो,बाणेण षवंगमं हणइ"
english: "That damned wife, With tears streaming down her cheeks, Who even for a moment Has the temerity to spit on her husband's cheek." ""

prakrit: "गाढप्पहरपरद्धो,मुच्छावसवेम्भलो पलायन्तो,पडिओ साहुसयासे,पवंगमो थोवंजीयासो"
english: "The donkey is covered with feathers, The buffalo has fled, He has fallen asleep on its back, The ox is limping."

prakrit: "अह पञ्चनमोक्कारो,दिन्नो से साहुणा'णुकम्पाए,मरिऊण समुप्पन्नो,उदहिकुमारो भवणवासी"
english: "O foolish traveler, The days are long, The weeks are short. When he dies, He is sure to rise again." ""

prakrit: "सरिऊण पुबजम्म,उदहिकुमारो तुरन्तमणवेगो,पत्तो उज्जाणवरे,निययसरीरस्स पूयत्थे"
english: "Aunt, It's early morning, The morning sun is rising, The afternoon sun is setting, The streets are brighter, The nights are darker."

prakrit: "दट्ठूण वाणरगणे,सबत्तो खेयरेहि हम्मन्ते,अह कुणइ महाघोरे,पवंगमे जल-थला-''यासे"
english: "Look at the swordsmen, All the crooks are laughing, They make loud noises, The water in the cauldron Is like" "Yes." ""

prakrit: "केएत्थ सिलाहत्था,अवरे गिरि-विविहरुक्खहत्था य,बुक्कारखं करेन्ता,हणन्ति चलणेण महिवढं"
english: "Where are these silhouettes? They look like bees walking on water." ""

prakrit: "दठूण वाणरगणे,तडिकेसो भणइ महुरवयणेहिं,को एस महासत्तो,जस्स इमं चेट्ठियं सहसा?"
english: "Look, you swordsman, How can you say that to a peacock While blowing a beehive? Who is this giant, Whom do I think I saw coming?"

prakrit: "जो सो तुमे नराहिव! सरेण भिन्नो पवंगमो मरिउं,सो साहुपभावेणं,उदहिकुमारो अहं जाओ"
english: "That which is yours perishes! But let me tell you the truth: I am going to die, my friend, Because I will rise again." ""

prakrit: "लङ्काहिवो पवुत्तो,उदहिकुमारं मणोहरगिराए,तं खमसु मज्झ सवं,अमुणियधम्मस्स पावस्स"
english: "The lankans are angry, The woodcutter is angry, He forgives me all my faults, I am innocent of his faults."

prakrit: "अह ते दोण्णि वि समयं,बन्धवनेहेण मुणिवरसयासं,गन्तूण पणमिऊण य,साहुं पुच्छन्ति जिणधम्मं"
english: "Ah! the time is ripe for both of them, For making love in secret, Asking what they want in return For what they get in return."

prakrit: "साहूण वि ते भणिया,मज्झ गुरू चिट्ठए समासन्ने,सन्तेण तेण तुभं,कह'हं साहेमि वो धम्म?"
english: "My brother - in - law said the same thing, My teacher wrote the same letter, And you replied in the affirmative:" "Yes, sir; That is the dharma." ""

prakrit: "जो गुरवे साहीणे,धम्म साहेइ पोढबुद्धीए,सो पवयणपन्भट्ठो,भण्णइ अच्चासणासीलो"
english: "One who respects virtue, who is versed in dharma, observes purity, says those in positions of authority." ""

prakrit: "ते दो वि तेण नीया,नमिऊण गुरुं तहिं चिय निविट्ठा,पुच्छन्ति मुणिवरं ते भयवं! साहेह को धम्मो!"
english: "They both bow before him, The master presses against him, And the sage asks," "Are you afraid? Praise be to the God of Love!" ""

prakrit: "जं तेहि पुच्छिओ सो कहेइ धम्म मुणी महाघोसो,जह बरहिणेहि घुटुं,नवपाउसमेहसङ्काए"
english: "Whatever she asks, the sage of dharma says with great pride, As though she were kneeling before a bridegroom, Reflecting on her new husband."

prakrit: "एक्के भणन्ति धम्मं,अमुणियपरमत्थवित्थया पुरिसा,न य जाणन्ति विसेसं,आरम्भ-परिग्गहेसु रया"
english: "They speak only Dharma, men devoid of purity, and they know nothing else; the Ray is the beginning and the end."

prakrit: "सायार निरायारो,दुविहो धम्मो जिणेहि उवइट्ठो,मन्नन्ति जे हु तइयं,दड्डा ते मोहजलणेणं"
english: "The scent is irresistible, The two dharmas are eternal, I believe in what is, And the fire is an illusion."

prakrit: "पढममहिंसा सच्चं,अदत्तदाणं तहेव नायबं,परदारस्स य विरई,संतोसो'णुवया पञ्च"
english: "First the violence is true, then the non - violence is pure heroism, Then the separation from the audience is pure bliss, And then the five youths are satisfied."

prakrit: "छठे च राइभत्तं,गुणवया तिणि चेव नायबा,चत्तारि य सिक्खाओ,गिहत्थधम्मो हवइ एसो"
english: "The sixth is renunciation, the third is virtue, the seventh is naïba, the fourth is learning, and the first is dharma."

prakrit: "अणगारमहरिसीणं,सुद्धो धम्मो पओगनिप्फण्णो,पञ्चमहवयकलिओ,पञ्च य समिई तिगुत्तो य"
english: "Anger is the poison of love, Truth is the weapon of dharma, Love is the arrow of the five great vows, And five vows are the arrows of the true God."

prakrit: "गच्छन्ति देवलोगं,पुरिसा सायारधम्मलद्धपहा,भुञ्जन्ति पवरसोक्खं,अच्छरसामज्झयारगया"
english: "Going to the gods, men walking in the shade of the moon, Sweating with the ecstasy of love, Going to church with good company."

prakrit: "महरिसिधम्मेण पुणो,अबाबाहं सुहं अणोवमियं,पावन्ति समणसोहा,विसुद्धभावा नरा जे उ"
english: "Through penance one can attain purity, Through non - violence one attains bliss, Through peaceful penance, Without showing ill will."

prakrit: "सावयधम्मुब्भूया,देवा चविऊण माणुसे लोए,समणत्तणेण मोक्खं,तिसु दोसु भवेसु वच्चन्ति"
english: "Sacrifice, my dear, is the path to liberation, To separate oneself from others, To renounce one's wrong views, Is the way to liberation."

prakrit: "जे वि हु तवं विगिटुं,करेन्ति अन्नाणिणो परं मूढा,तह वि य किंकरवग्गा,हवन्ति अप्पिड्डिया देवा"
english: "Whatever you do, be careful; you'll make a fool of yourself And someone else will. The devil is always at hand."

prakrit: "तत्तो चुया समाणा,संसारे बहुविहासु जोणीसु,दुक्खाइँ अणुहवन्ता,अणेयकालं परिभमन्ति"
english: "There is no end to suffering, For the world is full of contradictions, For time immemorial passes by."

prakrit: "वह-बन्ध-वेह-मारण-ताडण-निब्भच्छणाइबहुदोसं,दुक्खं तिरिक्खनीवा,अणुहवमाणा य अच्छन्ति"
english: "He can be bound, yoked, beaten, whipped, twisted and twisted like a weapon."

prakrit: "नरएसु वि नेरइया,फुलिङ्गजालाउले महादुक्खं,अच्छन्ति अणुहवन्ता,पुवं काऊण पावाइं"
english: "The Nares too are pale, The jasmine is awash with flowers, The trees are stunted, The flowers are drooping, And the paths are rocky."

prakrit: "करवत्त-जन्त-सामलि-असिवत्तावडण-कुम्भिपाएसु,एएसु चेव जीवा,महन्तदुक्खाइँ पावन्ति"
english: "Karavatta - the beast - Samli - Asivattavadana - Kumbipaesu, Such a being reaches the great sorrow."

prakrit: "जह नयरम्मि पविट्ठो,मूढो परिभमइ मग्गनासम्मि,तह धम्मेण विरहिओ,हिण्डइ जीवो वि संसारे"
english: "One who does not purify oneself, who is stupid, who surrounds oneself with falsehood, is separated from Dharma; the soul is bound to the world."

prakrit: "ते दो वि तग्गयमणा,मुणिवरमुहकमलनिग्गयं धम्मं,सुणिऊण निययचरियं,पुच्छन्ति पुणो पयत्तेणं"
english: "They both look down the road, Sigh, face the lotus, Hold on to dharma, Listen, business as usual, Ask to be shown the door again."

prakrit: "जइ एव धम्मरहिओ,जीवो परिभमइ दीहसंसारे,तो कह पुणाइ अम्हे,एत्थं परिहिण्डिया भयवं!"
english: "If people believe in dharma, When people live according to it, How can we benefit from it? Such is the fear of the Hindus!"

prakrit: "अह साहिउं षवत्तो,पुबभवं मुणिवरो महुरभासी,सुणह इओ एगमणा,कहेमि तुझं समासेणं"
english: "Oh! my poor thing, You silly bee, Listen to me now. I take your word for it."

prakrit: "एयम्मि परिभमन्ता,पुरिसा संसारमण्डले घोरे,घायन्ति एक्कमेकं,दोणि वि मोहाणुभावेणं"
english: "I travel a lot, Men travel the world, They touch each other, Both are a source of delights."

prakrit: "अह कम्मनिज्जराए,दोण्णि वि पुरिसा तओ समुप्पन्ना,वाणारसीऎ एक्को,जाओ वाहो महापावो"
english: "Oh! common people! Both men and women are equal. One man alone is the master of speech." ""

prakrit: "सावत्थीनयरीए,बीओ वि हु मन्तिनन्दणो जाओ,दत्तो नामेण तओ,पवइओ जायसंवेगो"
english: "In my next life, I too will go to meditation. But in your name, darling, Everything goes smoothly."

prakrit: "विहरन्तो संपत्तो,कासिपुरे सुत्थिए वरुज्जाणे,तसपाण-जन्तुरहिए,तत्थ ठिओ झाणजोएणं"
english: "Vihrant wealth, cotton buds, grooms, wild beasts, There stays the flame of youth."

prakrit: "लोगो वि पूयणत्थं,सम्मद्दिवी समागओ तस्स,भावेण विणयपणओ,पयाहिणं कुणइ परितुट्ठो"
english: "Logos is also pure meaning, harmony is everything to him, humility is everything through emotion, one must purify oneself by doing penance."

prakrit: "झाणोवओगजुत्तं,वाहो दटूण फरुसवयणेहिं,सत्थेसु कुणइ तिबं,विहीसियं तस्स दुट्टप्पा"
english: "The stream is smooth, The streams are sharp, The rivers are smooth, And the valleys are smooth. Vicious is the wickedness of that river."

prakrit: "अवसउणो य अलज्जो,पारद्धीफन्दियस्स जाओ मे,तिबं अमङ्गलं चिय,धणु पहरन्तो समुग्गिरइ"
english: "It's too late, my dear. Please, go away, you silly bitch. The rich man is back again."

prakrit: "साहू वि झाणजुत्तो,एवं चिन्तेइ तत्थ हियएणं,चूरेमि पावकम्मं मुट्ठिपहाराहयं सन्तं"
english: "The hunter knows how to make love, And when he thinks of it he hears it. I am content with a handful of sweetwood flowers."

prakrit: "तव-संजमेण पुवं,लन्तगजोगं समज्जियं कम्मं,झाणस्स'कुसलयाए,जोइसवासित्तणं पत्तं"
english: "Love blooms with concentration, Love languishes like a log, Karma is comprehensible, Jhanasa'collapses ', Jealousy is the leaf of renunciation."

prakrit: "तत्तो चुओ समाणो,इह तडिकेसो तुमं समुप्पन्नो,वाहो वि परिभमित्ता,संसारे वाणरो जाओ"
english: "There you are, darling, The stream teems with you, And the stream is all around you. The wind whirls the world."

prakrit: "जो सो बाणेण हओ,तडिकेस! तुमे पवंगमो मरिउं,सो साहुपभावेणं,उदहिकुमारो समुप्पन्नो"
english: "Be that as it may, you crook! The moment you step on my foot I will shoot you dead. For that is the nature of good men." ""

prakrit: "एयं मुणित्तु चरियं,परिचयह पुणब्भवेसु जं वत्तं,मा पुणरवि संसारं,वेरनिमित्तेण परिभमह"
english: "This is the path of the sage," he said. "Restore what is dear to you, do not trouble the world again. Traveler, traveler, for a difference."

prakrit: "मोत्तूण पुबवेरं,पणमह मुणिसुवयं पयत्तेणं,तो अरय-विरय-विमलं. सिवसुहवासं समजेह"
english: "When the pearl is full, When the lotus is dipped in the water, It is aray - viraya - vimal. Just understand the pleasures of love." ""

prakrit: "खामेऊण य एत्तो,उदहिकुमारो गओ निययभवणं,तडिकेसो वि य गिण्हइ,मुणिवरषासम्मि पवज्जं"
english: "Forgive me, my dear: It's only a matter of time before I make up my mind. Anything worth having Will be counted as your reward."

prakrit: "तस्स य गुणेहि सरिसो,पुत्तो लङ्काहिवो सुकेसो त्ति,एकन्तसुहसमिद्धं,भुञ्जइ रजं महाभोगं"
english: "His virtues are abundant, My son, Lankan elephants are happy, Friendship with one blossom Is a great pleasure to grind."

prakrit: "काऊण तवमुयारं,सम्मं आराहिऊण कालगओ,तडिकेससमणसीहो देवो जाओ महिड्डीओ"
english: "Who cares, As long as the rainy season lasts, As if the God of Love were still alive?"

prakrit: "एत्थन्तरे महप्पा,किक्किन्धिपुराहिवो कुणइ रजं,राया महोयहिरवो,ताव य विज्जाहरो पत्तो"
english: "Here is the greatness of the land, King Kinkindeepa's wives play the king, King Raya's lovers make love, And then there are the wise men."

prakrit: "अह तेण तक्खणं चिय,तडिकेसनिवेयणे समक्खाए,राया महोयहिरवो,तक्ख'गमेत्तेण संविग्गो"
english: "Oh! the pleasure of tasting it, The satisfaction of sipping it, Like drinking water in a sauna, Is irresistible." ""

prakrit: "अहिसिञ्चिऊण पुत्तं,पडिइन्दं रजभरधुराहारं,राया महोयहिरवो,पबइओ जातसंवेगो"
english: "My son, the winter nights are long, The rainy season is hot, And the rainy season has already set in."

prakrit: "झाणगइन्दारूढो,तवतिक्खसरेण निहयकम्मरिऊ,निक्कण्टयमणुकूलं,सिद्धिपुरि पत्थिओ धीरो"
english: "Foolish girl, Stop your anger with this arrow, Stop it now, It's only fair that you act decisively."

prakrit: "पडिइन्दो वि य राया,पुत्तं किक्किन्धिनामधेयं सो,अहिसिञ्चिऊण रज्जे,दिक्खं जिणदेसियं पत्तो"
english: "The landowner is at a loss, Son, tell me what's in a name. If you dare touch him, He'll give you a thrashing. See how he manages to stay alive."

prakrit: "चारित्त-नाण-दंसण-विसुद्धसम्मत्तलद्धमाहप्पो,काऊण तवमुयारं,सिवमयलमणुत्तरं पत्तो"
english: "The four vows - The coinage - The stinging breath - Are bound up with the vows of detachment, For who knows the answer to love's arrows?"

prakrit: "एत्थन्तरे नराहिव,वेयड्ढे दक्खिणिल्लसेढीए,विज्जाहराण नयरं,रहनेउरचक्कवालपुरं"
english: "Here live the cowherd, The hunter of the south wind, The woodman's son, Living in the circle of the crows."

prakrit: "तत्थेव असणिवेगो,राया विज्जाहराण सवे सिं,पुत्तो य विजयसीहो,बीओ पुण विज्जुवेगो त्ति"
english: "Then come, you stubborn wretch; You have mastered the trade of knowledge forever; My son, be victorious; Behold, I will master it again."

prakrit: "आइच्चपुराहिवई,मन्दरमालि त्ति नाम विक्खाओ,भज्जा से वेगवई,तीऎ सुया नाम सिरिमाला"
english: "Aichchhapurahivai, mandarmali mein naam vikhao, bhajja se vegvai, ti suya naam sirimala."

prakrit: "तीऎ सयंवरत्थं,विज्जाहरपत्थिवा समाहूया,आगन्तूण य तो ते,मञ्चेसु ठिया य सबइ वि"
english: "That is her true nature, That she gathers visitors from far and wide, That, even on the stage, She takes everything in her stride."

prakrit: "सबम्मि सुपडिउत्ते सिरिमालाभरणभूसियसरीरा,वरजुवइ-मन्तिसहिया,रायसमुदं समोइण्णा"
english: "All are wearing white robes. The bridegroom is dressed in a gray suit, His hair is tied in a knot, And his face is smeared with red ghee."

prakrit: "पासेसु चामराई,उवरिं पडिपुण्णनिम्मलं छत्तं,पुरओ य नन्दितूरं,घणगुरुगम्भीरसद्दालं"
english: "Passer-by's skin, Overgrown with acacia flowers, Lying low on the roof, Poor Nandita is a long way off, A heavy girdle of gold."

prakrit: "दट्टण तीऎ रूवं,जोबण-लायण्ण-कन्तिसंपुण्णं,वम्महसरेसु भिन्ना,बहवे आयल्लयं पत्ता"
english: "The thick, thick hair is like a lotus, The tips of the petals are red, Varmhasuras are white, The petals flow like a river."

prakrit: "केई भणन्ति एवं,कस्सेसा ललियजोवणापुण्णा,होही वरकल्लाणी,रूवपडाया इमा महिला"
english: "Somebody speaks, Somebody licks, Young ladies make love, Who is the bridegroom, Mother - in - law drapes her hair."

prakrit: "अन्ने भणन्ति पुवं,जेण तवो सुविउलो समणुचिण्णो,तस्सेसा वरमहिला,होही कम्माणुभावेणं"
english: "You fool, If you ask me what it is to be a good wife, I'd say she's a decent one. It's like being a poor wife."

prakrit: "सबत्थसत्थकुसला,नामेण सुमङ्गला भणइ धाई,निसुणेहि कहिज्जन्ते,सिरिमाले खेयरनरिन्दे"
english: "The whole place is deserted." "By name, Sumangala, they say, The midwife speaks, The nymphs speak, The shrill crows run amok."

prakrit: "जो एस विउलवच्छो,धीरो रविकुण्डलो कुमारवरो,ससिकुण्डलस्स पुत्तो,तडिप्पभागब्भसंभूओ"
english: "Whoever it is that makes such a fool of you, Brave boy of the rainbow, Succeeding son of the rainy moon, Will bear the brunt of it all."

prakrit: "अम्बरतिलयाहिवई,वरेसु एयं मणस्स जइ इट्ठो,माणेहि सुरयसोखं,मयणेण समं रई चेव"
english: "Amber is like a tilak in the sky, Varesu is like the moon If you stay here You'll enjoy the sunshine. The sky will remain the same For me."

prakrit: "अन्नो वि एस सुन्दरि,लच्छीविजंगयस्स वरपुत्तो,रयणपुरस्स य सामी,नामं विज्जासमुग्घाओ"
english: "No, she is a beauty, A handsome bridegroom is plump, And a handsome wife is waiting for her husband. Praise be to the name of the learned one."

prakrit: "एयस्स पासलग्गो,वज्जसिरीगब्भसंभवो एसो,वज्जाउहस्स पुत्तो,वज्जाउहपञ्जरो नामं"
english: "Ayas pasalgoda, vajjasirigabbhasambhava, aso, son of Vajjahuasa, Vajjauasa, is the name of a large pond." ""

prakrit: "अह मेरुदत्तपुत्तो,सिरिरम्भागब्भसंभवो एसो,मन्दरकुञ्जाहिवई,नामेण पुरंदरो राया"
english: "O son of Merudatta, may my good fortune come to pass! Such is the way of a virtuous wife. Purandar Raya is her name." ""

prakrit: "माणसवेगस्स सुओ,वेगवईनन्दणो वरकुमारो,नागपुरसामिओ सो,षवणगई नाम विक्खाओ"
english: "Suo motu humana, Vegavainandan varakumara, Nagaprasad Swami, Shavanagai naam Vikhao." ""

prakrit: "एए अन्ने य बहू,सिरिमाले! पेच्छ खेयरनरिन्दे,कुल-विभव-रूव-जोवण-विज्जासयरिद्धिसंपन्ने"
english: "Oh! my daughter - in - law! Silly girl! Eyes welling up with tears, Kul - Vibhava - Looks - Youth - Knowledge - All this wealth of knowledge!"

prakrit: "एयाण नरवईणं,जो सो हिययस्स वल्लहो तुज्झं,तस्स य करेहि वरतणु! मालं कण्ठम्मि सिरिमाले!"
english: "What a cruel man you are, That you love him so much, Let him do the same for me! A garland of emeralds hangs around his neck." ""

prakrit: "अवलोइऊण सवे,विज्जाहरपत्थिवे पयत्तेणं,बालाऎ मणभिरामा,किकिन्धि पाविया दिट्ठी"
english: "Traveler, Pay attention to every detail of the road. Child, my heart is heavy. Anybody can see the poor girl."

prakrit: "हंसगइगमणमणहर-लीलाए कविवरस्स गन्तूणं,सा छेयसिप्पियकया,माला कण्ठम्मि ओलइया"
english: "Laughing mother - in - law, The destination of the poet's farewell, She is so intoxicated, The garland melts from her throat."

prakrit: "दट्ठण विजयसीहो,किकिन्धि कुसुममालकयकण्ठं,रुट्ठो पवंगमाणं,आभासइ उच्चकण्ठेणं"
english: "To see is to be victorious, To kiss is to own is to grasp, To root is to swing, To feel is to lift one's head."

prakrit: "न य एत्थ नन्दणवणं,फलाउलं नेव निझरा रम्मा,न य वाणराण वन्दं,जेणेत्थ पवंगमा पत्ता"
english: "There is no bliss here, No fruit, No spring, No sound of the trumpet, Only a rippling leaf."

prakrit: "जेणेते दुरायारा,आणीया वाणरा इहं पावा,दूयाहमस्स सिग्धं,तस्स फुडं निग्गहं काहं"
english: "If you have to travel far and wide, You'd better be careful not to fall into the trap of falling asleep in the middle of the night; I've got to find a way out."

prakrit: "सोऊण वयणमेयं,गय-तुरयसमोत्थरन्तषाइक्कं,खुहियं पवंगमबलं,सागरसलिलं व उच्छलियं"
english: "Sound is like the lute, Like the trumpet, Like a banner proclaiming the victory of good over evil."

prakrit: "करपीणसमुप्फोडण-बुक्कारव-तुरयहिंसियरवेणं,बहिरीकयं व नज्जइ,भुवणमिणं तूरसद्देणं"
english: "Deceitful behavior - Begging the buck - Brings on the hunter's horn, Scares the outsider, Turns the bower upside down."

prakrit: "आलग्गा पवरभडा,विज्जाहरपत्थिवेहि सह जुझं,असि-कणय-चक्क-तोमर-घणपहरणपडणसुसमिद्धं"
english: "Trembling aloud, Struggling with the arrows of the God of Wisdom, Facing the curtain of fire and water."

prakrit: "हत्थी हत्थीण समं,अभिट्टो रहवरो सह रहेणं,तुरएण सह तुरङ्गो,पाइको सह पेयस्थेणं"
english: "An elephant is equal to a stag, a heron to a man of high standing, a crow to a trumpet, a doe to a beast of burden."

prakrit: "खेयर-पवंगमाणं,वट्टन्ते भेरवे महाजुज्झे,ताव य किक्किन्धिसही,सुकेसिराया समणुपत्तो"
english: "Ksheera - pavangam, Vattante bherave mahajujjje, Tave ya kikindhisahi, Sukesira samanupatho"

prakrit: "तो सो महोरगो इव,रक्खसनाहो उवढिओ पुरओ,विज्जाहरेहि समयं,जुज्झइ पसरन्तबलनिवहो"
english: "So beware! It is the rainy season, The rainy season is here, And the battle rages on." ""

prakrit: "एत्थन्तरम्मि जुझं,आवडियं दारुणं वरभडाणं,विच्छूढघायपउरं,अन्धयवर-विजयसीहाणं"
english: "Here and there the fight is on; the arrow is fierce, the bow is powerful; the scorpion is wounded; the blind man is victorious."

prakrit: "अन्धकुमारेण तओ,किक्किन्धिसहोयरेण रणमज्झे,छिन्नं च असिवरेणं,सीसं चिय विजयसीहस्स"
english: "The son of darkness, The forest is full of thorns, The roads are slippery, The streets are impassable, The army of victory is supreme."

prakrit: "सोऊण पुत्तमरणं,वज्जेण व ताडिओ असणिवेगो,परिदेविउं षयत्तो,सोगमहासागरे पडिओ"
english: "Son of a bitch, The clap of thorns fell without a sound. The God of Love, Satayto, Fell into the ocean of grief."

prakrit: "वहिऊण विजयसीह,पवंगमा रक्खसा य बलसहिया,आगासगमणदच्छा,किकिन्धिपुरं समणुपत्ता"
english: "Vahuna is the arrow of victory, Pavangama is the bow of protection, Vraksha is the weapon of strength, Agasa is the flame of fire, and Kikindipura is the banner of reconciliation."

prakrit: "राया वि असणिवेगो,सोगं मोत्तूण रोसपज्जलिओ,अह ताण मग्गलग्गो,समागओ सो वि किक्किन्धि"
english: "Decent people, When grief dies and roses burn, If you want peace, Work together."

prakrit: "सोऊण असणिवेगं,समागयं रणपयण्डसोडीरं,वाणरसुहडा'भिमुहा,विणिग्गया रक्खसभडा य"
english: "Trembling with excitement, The hunter gathers the reed beds, The flute flutters, The seller begs, And the hostages gather."

prakrit: "असि-कणय-परसु-पट्टिस-संघटुटुन्तघायषज्जलियं,बहुभडजीयन्तकरं,जुझं अइदारुणं लग्गं"
english: "Assi-kanya-parsu-pattis-sangyutuntu, Ghayashaljalyam, Bahu bhadjiyantakar, The battle rages on." ""

prakrit: "उग्गिष्णखग्गहत्थो,संपत्तो अन्धओ असणिवेगं,किक्विन्धी वि रणमुहे,आभिट्टो विजुवेगस्स"
english: "Wretched hands, Wealth without blindness, Slender eyes without speech, Eyes without sight."

prakrit: "निहओ अन्धकुमारो,चंडक्वेगेण समरमज्झम्मि,वोच्छिन्नजीवियासो,रणरसपरिमुक्कवावारो"
english: "Behold the son of darkness, The warrior's mother by the storm, He who survives the breakaway, The hunter who conquers the wilderness."

prakrit: "किकिन्धिनरवईण वि,कढिणसिला गिण्हिऊण विक्खित्ता,वच्छत्थलम्मि विउले,पडिया सा विजुवेगस्स"
english: "Though covered with gooseflesh, Like a swallow's cudgel, It is pierced by a sharp arrow, Like the bow of a lute."

prakrit: "सो असणिवेगपुत्तो,तं चेव सिलं महन्त-वित्थिण्णं,पेसेइ पडिपहेणं,वाणरनाहस्स आरुट्ठो"
english: "He is so impetuous, His tail is so broad, His feet are drooping, His mouth quivering." ""

prakrit: "नग-नयर-गोउरसमे,पडिया वच्छत्थले सिला सिग्धं,तेण पहरेण पत्तो,किक्किन्धिनराहिवो मोहं"
english: "In the town, in the fields, In the cowsheds, The kite flies straight through The fence, Like a banner proclaiming victory."

prakrit: "लङ्काहिवेण घेत्तु,नीओ पायालपुरवराभिमुहो,आसत्थो च्चिय पुच्छइ,कत्तो सो अन्धयकुमारो?"
english: "Lanka elephant, Take a bath, keep your face to the ground," she asks, "Where is that blind boy?"

prakrit: "सिटुं च निरवसेसं,सो तुज्झ सहोयरो समरमज्झे,राया'सणिवेगहओ,पत्तो य रणे महानिदं"
english: "Sit still, for a while; your friends will be at war with you, For the roads are impassable." ""

prakrit: "सोऊण बयणमेयं,सत्तिपहारोवमं अकण्णसुहं,मुच्छावलन्तनयणो,धस त्ति धरणीयले पडिओ"
english: "She fell at my feet in a deluge of tears, She took no pleasure in flattering me, She did not flinch But fell on the ground."

prakrit: "चन्दणजलोल्लियङ्गो,पडिबुद्धो विलविऊणमाढत्तो,नाणाविहे पलावे,भाइविओगाउरो कुणइ"
english: "Sandal - water lilies, Bow - tied, bow - shaped, reed - like palanquins, playful brother - in - law."

prakrit: "तो विलविऊण बहुयं,सुकेसि किक्किन्धिसाहणसमग्गो,पायालंकारपुरं,सिग्धं पत्ता भउविग्गा"
english: "So, foolish daughter - in - law, how are you going to satisfy your lover, Payalankarpuram, If you think straight you will blossom into a leaf."

prakrit: "अह पविसिऊण नयरे,कञ्चणवररयणतुङ्गपायारे,अच्छन्ति बन्धुसहिया,पमोयसोगं च वहमाणा"
english: "Ah! true lovers, Like travelers on a journey, Like lovers on a business trip, Like good friends in love."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाई,इन्दधणुं पेच्छिउं विलिजन्तं,सो असणिवेगराया,संवेगपरायणो जाओ"
english: "Oh! what a strange man! Looking down the road at the plowman's son, He seems to be in a trance." ""

prakrit: "विसयसुहमोहिओ हं,लद्धण वि माणुसत्तणं पावो,धम्मचरणाइरेगं,संजममग्गं न य षवन्नो"
english: "Praise be to the wise, For even after the battle There is no end to human suffering, For the path to dharma Is impassable."

prakrit: "अहिंसिञ्चिऊण रज्जे,सहसारं सबसुन्दरं पुत्तं,तडिवेगेण समाणं,जाओ समणो समियपावो"
english: "Friend, all is fair in this world: Non - violence is the raison d'etre of women; Friendship is the essence of love."

prakrit: "एत्थन्तरम्मि लत,भुञ्जइ निग्घायदाणवो सूरो,पडिवक्खअगणियमओ,जो ठविओ असणिवेगेणं"
english: "Here and then there is addiction, The man who roasts, The woman who hides, And the man who keeps his eyes closed."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाई,पायालपुराउ वन्दणाहेउं,सिरिमालासन्निहिओ,किक्किन्धी पत्थिओ मेरुं"
english: "Oh! what a strange thing it is to be asked, To be greeted at the foot of the pyre, To fall at my feet like a lotus."

prakrit: "सो बन्दिउँ नियत्तो,दक्खिणभाए समुद्दतीरत्थं,महुपवयं महन्तं,पेच्छइ घणसामलायारं"
english: "So shut up, Nitya, Look down the sea from the south, For the jasmine is very large, Like a mass of gold."

prakrit: "अह पेच्छ पेच्छ सुन्दरि! घणतरु वरकुसुम-पल्लवसणाहं,गुमुगुमुगुमेन्तमहुयर,सबत्तो सुरहिगन्धड्ड"
english: "Look at that girl! She's so beautiful! The thick, fragrant flowers - Like a palanquin in bloom - Make her whole body resplendent." ""

prakrit: "एयं मोत्तूण गिरिं,न मणो मज्झं समुच्छहइ गन्तुं,नयरं सुरपुरसरिसं,करेमि एत्थं न संदेहो"
english: "This is the pearl that fell, Don't think I've ever touched it. For I swear by its fragrance. No doubt of it." ""

prakrit: "भणिऊण वयणमेयं,तो चडिओ पवयस्स सिहरम्मि,पायार-भवणसोहं,सिग्धं च निवेसियं नयरं"
english: "If you say,'I can play the flute,'you'd better keep quiet, For straightforwardness is not the right word."

prakrit: "अह निययनामसरिसं,तेण कयं महियलम्मि विक्खायं,सुरपुरसोभायारं,किक्किन्धिपुरं ति नामेणं"
english: "Oh! fair name! That makes a beehive of nectar, Like the fragrance of a sweetmeat." - That's the name given to Kikindipuram.

prakrit: "सो तत्थ बन्धुसहिओ,अणेयसामन्तषणयचलणजुओ,भुञ्जइ रायवरसिरिं,सम्मपिट्ठी जिणमयम्मि"
english: "So there you are, my friend, A bunch of mischievous young men, Running around in circles, Jumping on top of each other And winning big time."

prakrit: "चन्द-दिवायरसरिसा,सिरिमालाए सुया समुप्पन्ना,पढमो आइच्चरओ,रिक्खरओ होइ बीओ य"
english: "The moon is bright, The sky is clear, The roads are slippery, The rivers are swollen, And the roads are impassable."

prakrit: "धूया य सूरकमला,जाया वरकमलकोमलसरीरा,कमलदहवत्थवा,कमलसिरी चेव पञ्चक्खा"
english: "Dhuya ya surkamala, jaya varkamala komala sarira, kamala dahavatthawa, Kamalasiri sev panchakkha"

prakrit: "रयणपुरम्मि य नयरे,मेरुमहानरवइस्स भज्जाए,जाओ य माहवीए,मयारिदमणो वरकुमारो"
english: "Ryanpurammi ya nayare, Merum mahanaravise bhajje, ya mahaviye, My poor man is a bridegroom."

prakrit: "दिन्ना य सूरकमला,मयारिदमणस्स वाणरिन्देणं,वत्तं पाणिग्गहणं,किक्किन्धिपुरे अणन्नसमं"
english: "Dinna ya surkamala, Mayaridmanasa varnarindhena, Vattam panigagahana, Kikindhipure annannasam."

prakrit: "अह कण्णपबओवरि,नयरं चिय कण्णकुण्डलं तेणं,विणिवेसियं महन्तं,सुरपुरसोहं विडम्बन्तं"
english: "Oh! the blinking of the eyes, The twitching of the eyelid, The greatness of detachment, The beauty of melody, Is like a miracle."

prakrit: "पायालंकारपुरे,इंन्दाणीगब्भसंभवा तइया,जाया सुकेसपुत्ता,देवकुमारा इव सुरूवा"
english: "Payalkarpure, Indanigabbhasambhava taiya, jaya sukesaputa, devakumara yaava shuruva."

prakrit: "पढमेत्थ होइ माली,तह य सुमालि त्ति नाम विक्खाओ,तइओ य मालवन्तो,अमरकुमारोवमसिरीओ"
english: "First let me be a gardener, then let me know your name: you are a poor man, not an immortal."

prakrit: "पत्ता सरीरविद्धि,विजाबल-दप्पगविया जाया,कीलन्ति नहिच्छाए,काणण-वणरम्मदेसेसु"
english: "The leaf is full of flesh, The needle is sharp, The nail is not pierced, The ear is bare, And the tongue is smooth."

prakrit: "अह ते चवलकुमारा,जं तेण निवारिया सुकेसेणं,मा जाह दक्खिणदिसिं,अन्नत्तो रमह वीसत्था"
english: "Ah! the rice farmer! The pleasure you get out of it Is nothing compared to going to the south. Yet pleasure eludes you."

prakrit: "परिपुच्छिओ नरिन्दो,विणयं काऊण तेहि परमत्थं,परिकहइ जहावत्तं,लङ्कापुरिमाइयं सवं"
english: "Purify Narindo, Weave how she pleases, Travel as far as she can, Purify all Lanka."

prakrit: "नयरीऎ तीऎ सामी,निग्घाओ नाम दाणवो वसइ,अगणियपडिवक्खभओ,ठविओ सो असणिवेगेणं"
english: "A virgin is like a good man, Whose name is Jealousy, And whose name is Charity. Be careful not to offend."

prakrit: "अम्हं परंपराए,सा नयरी आगया गुणसमिद्धा,तस्स भएण विमुक्का,पुत्तय! अञ्चन्तरमणिज्जा"
english: "In our tradition, That maiden is endowed with virtuous qualities, And by virtue of that, Vimukka, my son!" ""

prakrit: "जन्ताणि तेण निययं,सबत्तो विरइयाइँ पावेणं,मारन्ति जाइँ पुत्तय,लोयं भीमेण रूवेण"
english: "Animals are determined by that, Everything is hunted down, They kill, my son, The world is dominated by bees."

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,रुट्ठा विज्जासु लद्धमाहप्पा,अह ते कुमारसीहा,पायालपुराउ निप्फिडिया"
english: "Listen to my voice, Root and branch laden with wisdom: It is the trumpet call of a virgin. Payal pura niphidia."

prakrit: "चउरङ्गबलसमग्गा,सिग्धं उप्पइय अम्बरतलेणं,हन्तूण जन्तनिवहं,लङ्कानयरी समणुपत्ता"
english: "The four limbs are powerful, The plowman's bow is straight, The ox is slender, The hunter's wife is fierce, The lankan maiden is proportionate."

prakrit: "सोऊण रक्खसभडे,निग्याओ निग्गओ सेवडहुत्तो,असि-कणय-किरणपउरो,दिवायरो चेव पज्जलिओ"
english: "She protects everyone, Protects the poor and needy, Spares the bees and bees foraging, Illuminates the sky with flames."

prakrit: "गयमेहकण्णपवणो,मयबिन्दुझरन्तसलिलसंघाओ,असिविज्जुलाउलपरो,सहसा रणपाउसो जाओ"
english: "Gone are the thunderclaps, The myriad streams of water, The raindrops falling from the sky, But suddenly the rain clouds are gone."

prakrit: "अन्नोन्नरहसपसरिय-फलउक्कासन्निहेहि सत्थेहिं,दोसु वि बलेसु सुहडा,जुज्झन्ति विमुक्कजीयासा"
english: "The plowman's wife sighs without saying a word:" "The fruit is ripe for harvest, But both speak plainly." "They are won over by jealousy."

prakrit: "निग्घाओ विहु माली,आवडिया दो वि रणमुहे सुहडा,मुच्चन्ता''उहनिवहं,असुरा इव दप्पिया सूरा"
english: "The poor widow, Seeing that the two women were embracing each other, Wrapped her skirt twice around her thighs and said:" "No, I'm pregnant." "Such a bold tune."

prakrit: "एयारिसम्मि जुज्झे वट्टन्ते उभयलोगसंघट्टे,मालिभडेण य पहओ,निग्याओ पाविओ मरणं"
english: "This is just a show of anger: It grows louder by the minute, It fills the air with anger, And, with it, it destroys the soul."

prakrit: "नाऊण निययसेन्नं,निग्घायं मारियं समरमज्झे,भग्गं भयाउलमणं,जह वेयड्ड समणुपत्तं"
english: "A new dawn is dawning, A dark night, A fierce battle is on the horizon, A fearful storm is brewing, And an uneasy truce is holding."

prakrit: "तो षडह-भेरि-झल्लरि-जयसदुग्घुट्ठमङ्गलरवेणं,लङ्कापुरि पविठ्ठो,माली सह बन्धुवग्गेणं"
english: "So the gooseflesh is everywhere - everywhere swinging - Every time there's a thunderclap On the horizon: The sanctum sanctorum of Lankapuri, The relatives of the gardeners." ""

prakrit: "पिइ-माइ-सयणसहिओ,परियणपसरन्तभोगवित्थारं,निक्कण्टयमणुकूलं,भुञ्जइ रज्जं गुणसमिद्धं"
english: "Drink - My - wise friends, Feast yourselves on the abundance of freshly plucked flowers, In harmony with the virtues of true love."

prakrit: "एत्तो हेमङ्गपुरे,भोगवईगब्भसंभवा कन्ना,हिमरायस्स य दुहिया,चन्दमई नाम नामेणं"
english: "Here is the name of the moon - Hemangapure, the fire of ecstasy, The fire of jealousy, Or the two winds of love."

prakrit: "मालिकुमारेण तओ,परिणीया सा महाविभूईए,जा निययरूवजोवण-गुणेहि दूरं समुबहइ"
english: "Proud mother - in - law! The great beauty of Parinaya Behold! The virtuous qualities of her husband Prostrate far and wide."

prakrit: "पीइंकरस्स दुहिया,पीइमइसमुब्भवा विसालच्छी,पीइपुरम्मिं जाया,पीइमहा सुन्दरी नाम"
english: "Dear girl, This is a lovely name for me. Please, please, don't go to the fair. It's beautiful." ""

prakrit: "सा वि हु सुमालिभज्जा,जाया अच्चन्तसुन्दरावयवा,लक्खणगुणोववेया,रूवेण रई विसेसेइ"
english: "She too is full of beauty, Jealous of what is lovely, Virtuous and virtuous., Like the jewel in a jewel, She is extraordinary."

prakrit: "कणयसिरीकणयसुया,कन्ना कणयावलि त्ति कणयपुरे,तं चेव मालवन्तो,परिणेइ गुणाहियं लोए"
english: "Some girls are smarter than others, Some girls aren't as good as boys, Some have more than one mother - in - law, And some have even lost their talents."

prakrit: "जुवइसहस्ससमग्गो,संपत्तो उभयसेढिसामित्तं,आणाविसालमउलं,भुञ्जइ माली महारजं"
english: "Young and attractive, Rich and fragrant, Like the blossom of a creeper, A roasting farmer's king."

prakrit: "एयम्मि देसयाले,सुकेसि-किक्किन्धिजणियसंवेगा,पबइया खायजसा,पवंगमा रक्खसभडा य"
english: "Aimee deshayale, sukessi - Kikkindhi janiye samvega, paavayya khayaja, pavangama rakshasa sabda ya"

prakrit: "तवचरणसमग्गा दीहकालं गमित्ता,ववगयर्भय-सोगा नाण-चारित्तजुत्ता,जणियविमलकम्मा रक्खसा वाणरा य,सिवम यलमणन्तं सिद्धिसोक्खं पवन्ना"
english: "The passage of time is like a panorama; long and windy are the pleasures and sorrows of love, Like the path of a fierce warrior."

prakrit: "इति पउमचरिए रक्खस-वाणरपव्वज्जाविहाणो नाम छट्टो उद्दसओ समत्तो"
english: "Praise be to the name of the pious warrior, For he is worthy of all praise."

prakrit: "एत्थन्तरम्मि राया,सहसारो नाम निग्गयषयावो,वसइ सया सुहियमणो,रहनेउरचक्कवालपुरे"
english: "Here is my daughter - in - law's name: Niggyashayao, stay where you are, my dear." ""

prakrit: "तस्स य गुणाणुरूवा,अह माणसासुन्दरी पवरभज्जा,तं पेच्छिऊण राया,तणुयङ्गी पुच्छए सहसा"
english: "What makes you think he's handsome?" asked the girl's husband, Smiling at the sight of him. "That's the beauty of men." ""

prakrit: "किं अत्थि तुज्झ सुन्दरि,चिन्ता दुक्खं व दारुणं अङ्गे?,हियइच्छियं च दवं,जं मग्गसि तं पणामेमि"
english: "Are you so beautiful, Or are you so sorrowful And so cruel? But I will give you what you ask for."

prakrit: "जं एव पुच्छिया सा,पसयच्छी भणइ को वि मे एसो,जत्तो पभूइ गब्भो,'संभूओ कम्मदोसेण"
english: "Whatever you ask me, I will tell you in due course. As long as I am within reach," said the farmer, "Everything is bound to happen."

prakrit: "तत्तो पभूइ नरवइ!,इच्छामि सुराहिवस्स संपत्ती,दटुं ते परिकहियं,मोत्तूण कुलागयं लज्जं"
english: "There goes the man! I wish I had a good life, But to look at him again Would be a shame." ""

prakrit: "अह तेण तक्खणं चिय,विजाबलगबिएण होऊण,इन्दस्स परमरिद्धी,परिसाई दरिसिया तीए"
english: "Oh! the love of that star, To be captivated by its beauty, To transcend the greatness of the Indus, To turn it into a panorama."

prakrit: "संपुण्णडोहला सा,जाया मण-नयणनिबुइपसत्था,काले तओ पसूया,सुरवइसरिसं वरकुमारं"
english: "A woman who has reached her climax, Who in due course disappears into thin air, Is only a model of beauty."

prakrit: "कारावियं च सवं,जम्मूसवमङ्गलं नरवईणं,इन्दो य तस्स नाम,जणियं इन्दाभिलासेणं"
english: "Karaviyam is everything, Jammu and Kashmir is manmade, India is its name, the people are indifferent to it."

prakrit: "अह सो कमेण एत्तो,जोवण-बल-विरिय-तेयमाहप्पो,विज्जाहराण राया,जाओ वेयड्डवासीणं"
english: "Oh! what a wretched man he is, Young and vigorous, Steady and full of desire, Not so wise a person as Raya: Go, you crook of hell."

prakrit: "चत्तारि लोगपाला,सत्त य अणियाइँ तिण्णि परिसाओ,एरावणो गइन्दो,वजं च महाउहं तस्स"
english: "The watchman is the master of the people, The traveler has three wives for seven dresses, The hunter is the hunter's son, And the weights are very great."

prakrit: "चत्तालीसं ठविया,तस्स सहस्सा हवन्ति जुवईणं,मन्ती बिहप्फई से,हरिणिगमेसी बलाणीओ"
english: "Forty-seven thousand rubies, That young man must be having a good time, Thinking aloud of the plowman's wife."

prakrit: "तो सो नमि ब नज्जइ,सबेसि खेयराण सामित्तं,कुणइ सुवीसत्थमणो,विज्जाबलगविओ धीरो"
