prakrit: "कोवग्गिसंपलित्तो,वाली मन्तीहि उवसमं नीओ,बहुभडजीयन्तकरं,मा कुणह अकारणे जुज्झं"
english: "Take me in your arms, sweetheart, Don't be so hasty: It's a struggle for gain, Not one for gain."

prakrit: "अह भणइ वाणरिन्दो,संगामे रावणं बलसमग्गं,करयलघायाभिहयं,करेमि संयलं कुलं चुण्णं"
english: "I speak with a mouthful of nectar, Raavan with a strong voice is with me, I yawn with a trembling heart, I keep my head tightly shut."

prakrit: "काऊण पावकम्म,एरिसयं भोगकारणट्ठाए,नरय-तिरिएसु दुक्खं,भोत्तवं दीहकालम्मि"
english: "What a sinful act, Such an extravagant pastime, Such a wretched man's misery, Like the ruin of a long life."

prakrit: "पुवं मए पइन्ना,आरूढा साहुसन्नियासम्मि,मोत्तूण जिणवरिन्द,अन्नस्स थुई न कायबा"
english: "Fool, don't spit on the rice That grows out of the husks of your husband's hands." ""

prakrit: "न करेमि समयभङ्ग,न य जीवविराहणं महाजुझं,गिण्हामि जिणुद्दिटुं,पचज्जं सङ्गपरिहीणं"
english: "I will not waste time, Nor waste time thinking. I will count the days as long as I live, For I cannot keep pace with the times."

prakrit: "वरनारिथणयडोवरि,जे हत्था'लिङ्गणुज्जया मज्झं,ते न य करेन्ति एत्तिय,अन्नस्स सिरञ्जलिपणामं"
english: "Varnaarithana Dovari, Those who worship the'lingam'with their hands Do not do so much as bow before it: It is the penance of annasa siranjali."

prakrit: "सद्दावेऊण तओ,सुग्गोवं भणइ वच्छ! निसुणेहि,तस्स करेहि पणामं,मा वा रज्जे मए ठविओ"
english: "" "Well done, you decent cowboy! Take it easy, you damned bastard. Don't stop me if you have to."

prakrit: "ठविऊण कुलाधारं,सुग्गीवं उज्झिऊण गिहवासं,निक्खन्तो च्चिय वाली,पासे मुणिगयणचन्दस्स"
english: "A cool stream of water, A hot spring, A cool winter's breeze, A steady stream of rain, A moonlit night."

prakrit: "सुद्धक्कभावनिरओ,संजम-तव-नियमगहियषरमत्थो,अन्नोन्नजोगजुत्तो,कम्मक्खयनिज्जरट्ठाए"
english: "Be vigilant, be vigilant, abide by the rules and regulations, do not be negligent, for this is the path to true karma."

prakrit: "चारित्त-नाण-इंसण-निम्मलसम्मत्तमोहपरिमुक्को,विहरइ मुणिवरसहिओ,गामा-''गरमण्डियं वसुहं"
english: "Charitta - nana - insan - nimalasammattha - passionate embrace, Vihrayi munivarasahiyo, gamma -" "The hot spring is everywhere." ""

prakrit: "भुञ्जइ पाणनिमित्तं,पाणे धारेइ धम्मकरणत्थं,धम्मो मोक्खस्स कए,अज्जेइ सया अपरितन्तो"
english: "The roast is for water, the leaf is for dharma, dharma is for liberation, the unbending fire is for truth."

prakrit: "सुग्गीवो वि हु कन्नं,सिरिप्पभं देइ रक्खसिन्दस्स,किक्किन्धिमहानयरे,करेइ रजं गुणसमिद्धं"
english: "A prosperous man is also a virtuous one, Through Siripamba the king of rakshasas, Through Kikindhimaan the king's virtues are combined."

prakrit: "विज्जाहरमणुयाणं,कन्नाओ रूवजोवणधरीओ,अकमिय विक्कमेणं,परिणेइ दसाणणो ताओ"
english: "Wretched men, Decorated women, fair women, Incompetent wise men, It is the tongue that tells the tale."

prakrit: "निच्चालोए नयरे,निच्चालोयस्स खेयरिन्दस्स,रयणावलि ति दुहिया,सिरिदेवीगब्भसंभूया"
english: "The blind are blind, The dry are thin, The rainy season is long, The God of Love is powerful."

prakrit: "तीए विवाहहेडं,पुप्फविमाणट्टियस्स गयणयले,वच्चन्तस्स निरुद्धं,जाणं अट्टावयस्सुवरिं"
english: "She is the head of the marriage, The husband is at home, The wife is abroad, The husbands are abroad, And everyone knows the bridegroom."

prakrit: "दठूण अवच्चन्तं,पुप्फविमाणं तओ परमरुट्ठो,पुच्छइ रक्खसनाहो,मारीइ! किमेरिसं जायं?"
english: "When she sees him, Exhausted from her pyre, She asks:" "O demoness, How can I die?" ""

prakrit: "अह साहिउं पयत्तो,मारीई को वि नाह! मुणिवसहो,तप्पइ तवं सुघोरं,सूराभिमुहो महासत्तो"
english: "Oh! my poor girl, There's nothing for me to kill! You fool, You who stumble when you're wrong, Your face reveals a great deal."

prakrit: "एयस्स पभावेणं,जाणविमाणं न जाइ परहुत्तं,अवयरह नमोक्कारं,करेह मुणि पावमहणस्स"
english: "Such is the power of love, Never be negligent in what you do, Always be courteous, Always act with discretion and with discretion."

prakrit: "ओयारियं विमाणं,पेच्छइ कविलासपवयं रम्मं,दूरुन्नयसिहरोहं,मेहं पिव सामलायारं"
english: "She observes the horizon, Sees the poetry of love, Travels through the distance, Drinks wine, And manages to drink wine."

prakrit: "घणनिवह-तरुणतरुवर-कुसुमालिनिलीणगुमुगुमायारं,निज्झरवहन्तनिम्मल-सलिलोहप्फुसियवरकडयं"
english: "A lot of them - young and lanky - Are covered with gooseflesh, Like the nail marks on the cheek of a lotus."

prakrit: "कडयतडकिन्नरोरग-गन्धव्वुग्गीयमहुरनिग्घोसं,मय-महिस-सरह-केसरि-वराह-रुरु-गयउलाइण्णं"
english: "Clouds covered the horizon - The fragrance of the hot sun, The mynah - the buffalo - The border - The saffron - The bridegroom - The cry - The singing of the flute."

prakrit: "सिहरकरनियरनिग्गय-नाणाविहरयणमणहरालोयं,जिणभवणकणयनिम्मिय-उब्भासेन्तं दस दिसाओ"
english: "From the top of the pyre - The wide expanse of the river - To the tops of the trees - Ten directions to the sky."

prakrit: "अवइण्णो दहवयणो,अह पेच्छइ साहवं तहिं वाली,झाणपइट्टियभावं,आयावन्तं सिलावट्टे"
english: "She is invisible to the naked eye, I see what she wants to see, Like a banner affixed to a banner proclaiming victory."

prakrit: "वित्थिण्णविउलवच्छं,तवसिरिभरियं पलम्बभुयजुयलं,अचलियझाणारूढं,मेरुं पिव निच्चलं धीरं"
english: "A flock of parrots is scattered about, A plowman's bow hangs from a tree, A tireless hunter is on the loose, My husband is always at hand."

prakrit: "संभरिय पुववेरं,भिउडिं काऊण फरुसवयणेहिं,अह भणिऊण पवत्तो,दहवयणो मुणिवरं सहसा"
english: "Foolish girl, Why are you bothering about the flowers? Tell me, you fool, It's just the way things happen."

prakrit: "अइसुन्दरं कयं ते,तवचरणं मुणिवरेण होऊणं,पुवावराहजणिए,जेण विमाणं निरुद्ध मे"
english: "What is beauty, That meditation should be done with humility, That flowers should flow with love, That planes should be stopped?"

prakrit: "कत्तो पवज्जा ते?,कत्तो तवसंजमो सुचिण्णो वि?,जं वहसि राग-दोसं,तेण विहत्थं तुमे सर्व"
english: "Where is that pride?, How can I appease you?, That anger and resentment Are the cause of all your faults." ""

prakrit: "फेडेमि गारवं ते,एयं चिय पवयं तुमे समयं,उम्मूलिऊण सयलं,घत्तामि लहुँ सलिलनाहे"
english: "Fedemi garvon te, Is that the time for you? Take it easy, you fool, I've gotta take it." ""

prakrit: "काऊण घोररूवं,रुट्ठो संभरिय सबविज्जाओ,अह पवयस्स हेट्ठा,भूमी भेत्तु चिय पविट्ठो"
english: "Whom are you looking out for? A roaring crow, Roots sticking out, All your knowledge lost, An old cow, An earth torn to shreds And sacred to all."

prakrit: "हक्खुविऊण पयत्तो,भुयासु सबायरेण उप्पिच्छो,रोसाणलरत्तच्छो,खरमुहररवं पकुवन्तो"
english: "When you shake it off, You shake it with your hands, When you brush it off with your fingers, You start to cry. The bitter gourd ripens."

prakrit: "आकम्पियमहिवेढं,विहडियदढसन्धिबन्धणामूलं,अह पवयं सिरोवरि,भुयासु दूरं समुद्धरइ"
english: "Because of the tight bandage on her thighs She is unable to lift her arms Above the waterfall."

prakrit: "लम्बन्तदीहविसहर-भीउद्द्यविविहसावय-विहङ्गं,तडपडणखुभियनिज्झर-चलन्तघणसिहरसंघायं"
english: "Lengthy rivers, vast valleys, wide valleys, streams gushing out from the treetops, Flowing streams, Thighs bristling with excitement."

prakrit: "खरपवणरेणुपसरिय-गयणयलोच्छइयदसदिसायकं,नायं तम-'न्धयारं,तहियं अट्ठावउद्धरणे"
english: "Weeds cover the ground - Singing is frowned upon - Decent poems, Not so long -" "In the middle of the night, That's how you wake up" ""

prakrit: "उबेल्ला सलिलनिही,विवरीयं चिय वहन्ति सरियाओ,निग्घायपडन्तरवं,उक्का-'सणिगब्भिणं भुवणं"
english: "Boiling saliva, Varying cheeks, Straightforward whisperings, Ucka -" "Flicker of affection." ""

prakrit: "विजाहरा वि भीया,असि-खेडय-कप्प-तोमरविहत्थं,किं किं? ति उल्लवन्ता,उप्पइया नहयलं तुरिया"
english: "Vijahara bhi bhiya, asi-khedaya-kappa-tomara vihitha tha, kya kya? She mutters, The spiky turia has burst open." ""

prakrit: "परमावहीऎ भगवं,वाली नाऊण गिरिवरुद्धरणं,अणुकम्पं पडिवन्नो,भरहकयाणं जिणहराणं"
english: "God almighty, stop dragging the girl's name down the hill, make her slip through the mud, and let the hunter's wife live."

prakrit: "एयाण रक्खणटुं,करेमि न य जीवियवयनिमित्तं,मोत्तूण राग-दोसं,पवयणवच्छल्लभावेण"
english: "Protect her, I will not do so for the sake of living. Or else she will die of anger and resentment, Because she does not want to be protected."

prakrit: "एव मुणिऊण तेणं,चलणगुट्टेण पीलियं सिहरं,जह दहमुहो निविट्ठो,गुरुभरभारोणयसरीरो"
english: "It is the nectar of a pearl, The tip of a yellow bud on a bunch of rice, That seeps through the mouth of a flame, Like the arrow of a God of Love."

prakrit: "विहडन्तमउडमोत्तिय-नमियसिरो गाढसिढिलसबङ्गो,पगलन्ततक्खणुप्पन्नसेयसंघायजलनिवहो"
english: "Vihādantāmudāmuttyā - Silly girl, The waters of the Sanghāyā flow from the drops of the lotus that fall when one steps on it." ""

prakrit: "ववगयजीयासेणं,रओ कओ जेण तत्थ अइघोरो,तेणं चिय जियलोए,विक्खाओ रावणो नामं"
english: "Wretched forest, If the people there are so poor, They will burn with great jealousy. But wretched is the name of Ravana."

prakrit: "सोऊण मुहरवं तं,मूढा सन्नज्झिऊण रणसूरा,किं किं? ति उल्लवन्ता,भमन्ति पासेसु चलवेगा"
english: "" "What is it, you foolish hermit, You silly little rake?" "He mutters," "The stag will go by on his own"

prakrit: "मुणितवगुणेण सहसा,दुन्दुहिसदो नहे पवित्थरिओ,पडिया य कुसुमवुट्ठी,सुरमुक्का गयणमग्गाओ"
english: "Because of sagging bosoms, There are no fresh flowers in the kitchen, No need to sulk, Just sit and listen."

prakrit: "जाहे अणायरेणं,सिढिलो अङ्गुट्टओ कओ सिग्छ,मोत्तूण पवयवरं,विणिग्गओ दहमुहो ताहे"
english: "Like a fire in a fire, Like the tips of a string on a ladder, Like a pearl pierced by a sharp arrow, A fire burns in the fire of love."

prakrit: "सिग्धं गओ पणामं,दसाणणो मुणिवरं खमावेउं,थोऊण समाढत्तो,तव-नियमबलं पसंसन्तो"
english: "Go straight, sacrifice yourself, For if you had to sacrifice yourself You would have won the war."

prakrit: "मोत्तूण जिणवरिन्दं,अन्नस्स न पणमिओ तुम जं से,तस्सेयं बलमउलं,दिल्र̥ चिय पायडं अम्हे"
english: "Don't worry, dear go - between. You're right. The stronger you are, the thinner your heart's bound to get."

prakrit: "रूवेण य सीलेण य,बलमाहप्पेण धीरपुरिस! तुमे,सरिसो न होइ अन्नो,सयले वि य माणुसे लोए"
english: "Be strong and of good courage! For thou, being honest, art not worthless. Even in truth one can be won round by men."

prakrit: "अवकारिस्स मह तुमे,दत्तं चिय जीवियं न संदेहो,तह वि य खलो अलज्जो,विसयविरागं न गच्छामि"
english: "No doubt about it, my dear, You're not to be trifled with, I won't go anywhere else."

prakrit: "धन्ना ते सप्पुरिसा,जे तरुणत्ते गया विरागत्तं,मोत्तूण सन्तविहवं,निस्सङ्गा चेव पबइया"
english: "Happy the Sapphurisa! For what is passed through youth Is passed through desertion, Like a peaceful marriage After its dissolution."

prakrit: "एवं थोऊण मुणी,दसाणणो जिणहरं समल्लीणो,निययजुवईहि सहिओ,रएइ पूयं अइमहन्तं"
english: "And the sage says:" "Knowledge is supreme, Knowledge is universal, Life is eternal, And patience is the greatest virtue." ""

prakrit: "तो चन्दहासअसिणा,उक्कत्तेऊण निययबाहं सो,हारुमयतन्तिनिवह,वाएइ सविन्भमं वीणं"
english: "So the moon smiled, Stirred by the breeze, Destroyed by the rays of the sun, Like a lute blown by the wind"

prakrit: "थोऊण समाढत्तो,पुण्णपवित्तक्वरेहि जिणयन्दं,सत्तसरसंपउत्तं,गीयं च निवेसियं विहिणा"
english: "Restraint is the essence of virtue, For merit and merit are the supreme virtues, And song is the supreme virtue."

prakrit: "मोहन्धयारतिमिरं,जेणेयं नासियं चिरषरूढं,केवलकरेसु दूर,नमामि तं उसभजिणभाणुं"
english: "Dear friend, The man who made my nose last so long, Only a few strokes away, I bow to him in worship." ""

prakrit: "अजियं पि संभवजिणं,नमामि अभिनन्दणं सुमइनाहं,पउमप्पहं सुपासं,पणओ हं ससिपमं भयवं"
english: "I will never forget," he said, "My husband's greeting, My good name, And my good fortune. But yes, I am afraid of sins."

prakrit: "थोसामि पुप्फदन्तं,दन्तं जेणिन्दियारिसंघायं,सिवमग्गदेसणयरं,सीयलसामि पणमिओ हं"
english: "I am the watermelon, The flowers are white, The teeth are yellow, The girdle is red, And the hair is white."

prakrit: "सेयंसजिणवरिन्दं,इन्दसमाणन्दियं च वसुपुजं,विमलं अणन्त धम्मं,अणन्नमणसो पणिवयामि"
english: "The Vindhya is the spring of wisdom, The Indus is the ocean of beauty, Dharma is endless, I pledge allegiance to the highest mind."

prakrit: "सन्ति कुन्थु अरजिणं,मल्लिं मुणिसुवयं नमि नेमि,पणमामि पास वीरं भवनिग्गमकारणट्ठाए"
english: "I beg of you, my dear, Don't stop to rub the jasmine. I can't help getting angry with you If you approach me with a brave face."

prakrit: "जे य भविस्सन्ति जिणा,अणगारा गणहरा तवसमिद्धा,ते वि हु नमामि सवे,वाया-मण-कायजोएसु"
english: "Those who believe in the existence of the soul, Anger compounded by resentment, Are as humble as all others; Vaya - mana - kayajoysu."

prakrit: "गायन्तस्स जिणथुई,धरणो नाऊण अवहिविसएण,अह निग्गओ तुरन्तो,अट्ठावयपवयं पत्तो"
english: "The singer is won over, The dancer is denied a name, A nigga is hurriedly introduced, And so are the songs sung."

prakrit: "काऊण महापूयं,वन्दित्ता जिणवरं पयत्तेणं,अह पेच्छइ दहवयणं,गायन्तं पङ्कयदलच्छं"
english: "Who is a great man, Who observes all forms of life with devoted attention, Who sees all forms in a row While singing?"

prakrit: "तो भणइ नागराया,सुपुरिस! अइसाहसं ववसियं ते,जिणभत्तिरायमउलं,मेरुं पिव निच्चलं हिययं"
english: "So say the nāgarāya, Your Highness! It's the wind that makes the sky blue." "I've got to drink the nectar of victory!" ""

prakrit: "तुट्ठो तुहं दसाणण,जिणभत्तिपरायणस्स होऊणं,वत्थु मणस्स इ८,जं मग्गसि तं पणावेमि"
english: "" "Stop being so touchy, you fool, I'll give you what you ask for." "8"

prakrit: "लङ्काहिवेण सुणिउं,धरणो फणमणिमऊहदिप्पन्तो,भणिओ किं न य लद्ध,जिणवन्दणभत्तिराएण?"
english: "Listen to the Lankan elephant, Hold on to the lamp that shines on his wife's bosom, Say why not fight? It is the flame of victory that begets it." ""

prakrit: "अहिययरं परितुट्ठो,धरणिन्दो भणइ गिण्हसु पसत्था,सत्ती अमोहविजया,जा कुणइ वसे सुरगणा वि"
english: "Be honest here, Dharanindo says count the days, Satti says nothing, Vijaya says something, Whoever it is Lives in heaven too."

prakrit: "अह रावणेण सत्ती,गहिया अहिउञ्जिऊं सिरपणामं,धरणो वि जिणवरिन्द,थोऊण गओ निययठाणं"
english: "Ah, the stillness of Ravana's life, Like a banner proclaiming victory over adversity, Like the banner of victory proclaims victory." ""

prakrit: "अट्ठावयसेलोवरि,मासं गमिऊण तत्थ दहवयणो,अणुचरिउं पच्छित्तं,वालिमुणिन्दं खमावेइ"
english: "Every woman who is eight years old, When the month is up And the day is almost over, Thinking how wretched it is To lose sight of her husband."

prakrit: "जिणहरपयाहिणं सो,काऊण दसाणणो तिपरिवारे,पत्तो निययपुरवरं,थुबन्तो मङ्गलसएसु"
english: "He who knows how to weep must weep." "How can one tell if one has already weeped?" "Once one knows how long one can weep?"

prakrit: "झाणाणलेण कम्म,दहिऊण पुराकयं निरवसेसं,अक्खयमयलमणहरं,वाली सिवसासयं पत्तो"
english: "To lose sight of knowledge is to lose heart, To lose heart Is to lose faith, To forsake pride and selfishness Is the path to eternal bliss."

prakrit: "एवंविहं वालिविचेट्ठियं जे,दिणाणि सवाणि सुणन्ति तुट्ठा,काऊण कम्मक्खयदुक्खमोक्खं,ते जन्ति ठाणं विमलं कमेणं"
english: "And just like that, Those who sit on the fence And listen attentively To what's being said And speak plainly Are guilty of committing adultery."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए वालिनिव्वाणगमणो नाम नवमो उद्देसो समत्तो"
english: "May the passage of time bring new meaning to our name." ""

prakrit: "एयं ते परिकहियं,मगहाहिव! जं पुरा समणुवत्तं,निसुणेहि एगमणसो,भणामि जं अन्नसंबन्धं"
english: "" "Here I am, you fool! The whole point is conciliatory." "Without hesitating I will say what concerns food."

prakrit: "जलणसिहखेयरसुया,जोइपुरे सिरिमईऎ देवीए,ताराहिवसरिसमुही,तारा नामेण वरकन्ना"
english: "The water is crystal clear, The goddess of joys and sorrows, Face to face with the stars: The bridegroom is called Tara."

prakrit: "चक्कङ्करखेयरसुओ,पेच्छइ सो अन्नया परिभमन्तो,नामेण साहसगई,दुट्ठो अहिलसइ परिणे"
english: "Trembling and rapturous, She looks around for a stranger, Courageous in name, Undeterred by adversity."

prakrit: "मयणसरसल्लियङ्गो,चिन्तिन्तो तीऎ दंसणोवायं,पेसेइ निययदूए,उवरोवरि मग्गणट्ठाए"
english: "Deer - eyed girl, Thinking of the way she looks at you, Standing her ground, Counting the days as long as you live."

prakrit: "सुग्गीवो वि कइवरो,तं कन्नं मग्गिऊण आढत्तो,चिन्तेइ जमलहियओ,जलणसिहो कस्स देमि? त्ति"
english: "Who is a good man, If you ask him what he would like to eat, He will reply:" "Whom should I give to if I burn your heart?" ""

prakrit: "जलणसिहेण मुणिवरो,विणयं काऊण पुच्छिओ भयवं!,कस्सेसा वरकन्ना,होही महिला? परिकहेहि"
english: "Drenched with jealousy, Who is afraid to ask how she is knitting? Whom are the groomsmen looking for? They are women." ""

prakrit: "अह भणइ मुणिवरिन्दो,चक्कङ्कसुओ न चेव परमाऊ,होही चिराउसो पुण,सुगीवो वाणराहिवई"
english: "Oh! you fool, Don't try to stop me, my lord, You stupid fool," he said. "Who cares? It's the poor girl's son, The rich man's daughter - in - law."

prakrit: "दीवं वसहं च गयं,परमनिमित्ताइँ विन्नसेऊणं,सुग्गीवस्स वरतणू दत्ता कयमङ्गलविहाणा"
english: "The lamp has passed away, Weeping for the Hereafter has ceased, Useful is the fruit of goodly affection, For what use is a virtuous wife?"

prakrit: "परिणेऊण सुतारा,सुग्गीवो उत्तमं विसयसोक्खं,भुञ्जइ पसन्न हियओ,इन्दो इव देवलोगम्मि"
english: "A mature woman is smarter, gives pleasure to the most sophisticated of pleasures, roasts more often, and is thus more like a god."

prakrit: "एवं कमेण तीए,पुत्ता जाया सुरूवलायण्णा,पढमो य अङ्गयभडो,बीओ य भवे जयाणन्दो"
english: "And what a miser she is, A son who has begun to walk, A brother who has reached his prime, A husband who has grown very thin."

prakrit: "न य मुयइ साहसगई,अणुबन्धं तोऎ कारणट्टाए,चिन्तेइ उवायसए,दुक्खियमणसो विगयलज्जो"
english: "Never have I had the courage To leave you, To forsake your enemies, To think aloud of your faults."

prakrit: "कइया'रविन्दसरिसं,तीऎ मुहं विप्फुरन्तबिम्बोठं,चुम्बीहामि कयत्थो? पाडलकुसुमं महुयरो व"
english: "" "What do you mean, Ravindrasar, Her face is like a lotus in bloom, Where can I get a kiss? It looks like a beehive stuck in a conch shell."

prakrit: "चिन्तावरेण एवं,संभरिया तत्थ अइबला विज्जा,रूवपरिवत्तणकरी,साहेइ हिमालयगुहाए"
english: "Thinking and pondering, Where then, unfettered by knowledge, Can transform form, There beside the Himalayan caves."

prakrit: "एत्थन्तरे पुरीए,दहवयणो निग्गओ बलुम्मत्तो,दीवन्तरवत्थवे,जिणइ तओ खेयरे सबे"
english: "In this world, poor thing, A burning fire is burning brightly, In the world beyond, For if you conquer, you conquer all."

prakrit: "संझायार सुवेलो,कञ्चणपुण्णो अओहणो चेव,पल्हाय-हंसदीवाइया उ सवे कया सवसा"
english: "The dusk is swollen, The nights are long, The roads are slippery, The streets are deserted, Laughter is in the air, So what is the use of sleeping in the sun?"

prakrit: "एवं चिय दहवयणो,पायालंकारपुरवरसमीवे,आवासिओ सुमणसो,पभूयसामन्तखन्धारो"
english: "And behold, a fire is burning, Near the gate of the house of worship, Inhabitants are burning, The bow is bowed under the arrows of the God of Love."

prakrit: "खरदूसणो वि एत्तो,सुणिऊण दसाणणं पुरवराओ,अह निग्गओ तुरन्तो,पेच्छइ रयणग्धदाणेणं"
english: "Here is a man suffering from eczema. Once he hears it, He hurries away. Soon he will see the rays of the sun." ""

prakrit: "तेण वि ससंभमं सो,गाढं सम्माण-दाणविहवेणं,पडिपूइओ सिणेहं,समयं चिय चन्दणक्खाए"
english: "So be it with all my might, With deep respect and charity, With affection and affection in abundance, For the moonlight hastens in due course."

prakrit: "चोद्दस साहस्सीओ,मणरूववियारियाण जोहाणं,दावेइ तक्खणं चिय,रक्खसनाहस्स परितुट्ठो"
english: "Fourteen are brave, The left is clever, The right is shrewd, And the right is vigilant."

prakrit: "विज्जाहरो हिडिम्बो,हेहय डिम्बो य वियड तिजडो य,हय माकोडो सुजडो,उको किक्किन्धिनामो य"
english: "Vijjaharo hidimbo, hey there's Dimbo ya weed tijdo ya, yes there is Makodo sujdo, uko kikindhinamo ya."

prakrit: "तिउरामुहो य हेमो,बालो कोलावसुन्दरो चेव,एए अन्ने वि बहू,विज्जाहरपत्थिवा सूरा"
english: "Tiuramuho ya hemo, baalo kolaosundaro chevu, anne vi bahu, the surah on the path to knowledge." ""

prakrit: "अक्खोहिणीसहस्सं,जायं सुहडाण कुलपसूयाणं,बलदप्पगबियाणं,रणरसकण्डू वहन्ताणं"
english: "Friendship with the God of Love, Which gives pleasure to all beings, Is the making of bullock carts, Like the tendrils of a wild ox."

prakrit: "कुम्भ निसुम्भ बिहीसण इन्दइ अह मेहवाहणाईया,साहोणा सयलभडा,कयाइ पासं न मुञ्चन्ति"
english: "The Kumbh is endless, The nights are long, The roads are slippery, No one wants to go near."

prakrit: "उप्पन्ना रयणवरा,बहुगुणसंघायधारिणो दिवा,देवसहस्सेणं चिय,रक्खिज्जइ एक्कमेक्केणं"
english: "Uppanna rayanavara, the lamp that manifests many virtues, Deva's penance, Protects one and the same."

prakrit: "सियछत्त-चामरुद्भुय–धय-विजयषडाय-वेजयन्तीहिं,पुप्फविमाणारूढो,इन्दस्सुवरिं अह पयट्टो"
english: "Bees - white, brown, white, triumphant - Spring is on the horizon, Puffing up the planes of love, Like the first rays of the sun."

prakrit: "गय-रह-विमाण-वाहण-वगन्ततुरङ्ग-चडुलपाइक्कं,चलियं दसाणणबलं,दसाणणबलं,उच्छायन्तं उच्छायन्तं गयणमग्गं"
english: "Go - stay - Plane - Vehicle - Waggon - Tune - Roll - Pile - pail. Let there be dancing - dancing - strength, dancing - power, Singing - song from top to bottom."

prakrit: "वचन्तस्स कमेणं,अत्थं चिय दिणयरो समल्लीणो,विञ्झइरिपवरसिहर,सिबिरनिवेसो को तत्थ"
english: "The arrows of the God of Love, Which pierce through the heart, Are sharp, powerful, and piercing."

prakrit: "विज्जाबलेण रइओ,सयणा-''सणविविहपरियणावासो,गमिऊण तत्थ रत्ति,मङ्गलतूरेहि पडिबुद्धो"
english: "Cry out for enlightenment, Sayana -" "Celebrate the festival in all its glory, For when it is over The chariot is tied with auspicious threads." ""

prakrit: "आहरणभूसियङ्गो,अह पुणरवि उज्जओ य गयणेणं,वच्चन्तो च्चिय पेच्छइ,विमलजलं नम्मयं विउलं"
english: "Foolish girl, do you see her singing again? It's just the way she likes it: The jasmine water has washed her away." ""

prakrit: "कत्थइ सललियषवहा,कन्थइ वरसरविमुक्कसमवेगा,कत्थइ वियडावत्ता,कल्लोलुच्छलियजलनिवहा"
english: "How easy it is to make love, How hastens the tides of summer, How long has it been a struggle For love's sake?"

prakrit: "कत्थइ मयरकराहय-दूरसमुच्छलियमच्छविच्छोहा,कत्थइ तरङ्गरङ्गन्तफेणपरिवड्डियावयवा"
english: "How often do I stare at my lover - When he looks at me from a distance, When he waves at me, When I look at him from behind?"

prakrit: "कत्थइ पवणाघुम्मिय–तरुकुसुमखिरन्तपिञ्जरतरङ्गा,कत्थइ उभयतडट्ठिय--सारसकलहंसनिग्धोसा"
english: "How the wind blows, How the crickets twitch, And the cicadas sway, And how the elephants sway."

prakrit: "एयारिसगुणकलियं,पवरनई दहमुहो समोइण्णो,अह मजिउं पवत्तो,विमलजले,पवरलीलाए"
english: "Eris gunakalyam, The fire of love is burning, Such is the beauty of love, Like the flame of a flame, Like a power play."

prakrit: "ताव य उत्तरपासे,नईऎ माहेसरे महानयरे,राया सहस्सकिरणो,पढमयरं सलिलरइसत्तो"
english: "So here you are, on the north side, With new great moons, With thousands of rays of the sun, Moving across the horizon Just like that"

prakrit: "जुवइसहस्सेण समं,कीलइ नइउदयमज्झयारम्मि,उभयतडट्टियसाहण-सामन्तुग्घुट्ठजयसद्दो"
english: "Youth is equal to wisdom, Keel is not worthless At midday, Sand is worthless When struck with an arrow - Feudal thunderclap"

prakrit: "विविहजलजन्तविरइय-निरुद्धजलभरियकूलतीराए,सोहन्ति रमन्तीओ,सहस्सकिरणस्स महिलाओ"
english: "A variety of water creatures - hips full of stagnant water, lovely lovers, women with thousands of rays."

prakrit: "एक्का तत्थ वरतणू,थणयुयलं अंसुएण छायन्ती,अवहरियउत्तरिज्जा,सहस त्ति जले अह निबुड्डा"
english: "Use the same arrow, Thighs quivering, Tears streaming down her cheeks, And her eyes burning." ""

prakrit: "ईसामिसेण कुविया,उदयं घेत्तूण कोमलकरेसु,कन्तस्स हरिसियमणा,घत्तइ वच्छत्थलाभोए"
english: "Jealous of Jesus, When morning dawns It is like embracing a young bull, When winter makes one thirsty, When the bullock falls asleep The pleasure is endless."

prakrit: "इन्दीवरदलनयणा,घेत्तु इन्दीवरं हणइ अन्ना,अन्नाऎ सा वि तुरियं आहम्मइ सहसवत्तेहिं"
english: "Indeevaradalanayana, ghettu indeevaram hanaayi anna, anna se vi turiyam ahamayi sahasvatheen"

prakrit: "अन्ना दद्दूण उरे,नहक्खयं बालचन्दसंठाणं,अवहरियउत्तरिज्जा,छाएइ थणं करयलेणं"
english: "Anna, look! There's nothing wrong with your breasts. It has to be the unbending stream of blood flowing through your veins."

prakrit: "काएत्थ षणयकुविया,मोणं परिगिण्हिऊण वरजुवई,तोसं पुण उवणीया,दइएण सिरप्पणामेणं"
english: "Where are you going? It's the cowgirl, The bridegroom is getting married, You're making him happy, There must be something on your mind."

prakrit: "जाव पसाएइ पिया,एका रोसं गया तओ अन्ना,कहकह वि कोवभङ्गो,कओ नरिन्देण जुबईणं"
english: "Jawa pasaayi piya, ek rosa gaye toh anna, kahaan bhi koovabhango, karo narindane jabayan."

prakrit: "घत्थायड्डण-पेल्लण-करपरिहत्थुच्छलन्तसलिलाओ,वञ्चण-वलण-निबुड्डण-सएसु कीलन्ति जुवईओ"
english: "Jealousy, deceit, pretence, slyness, guile - The plowman's bow - These are the words of a wise woman."

prakrit: "अङ्गपरिभोगलग्गं,कुङ्कुमधोवन्तपिञ्जरारुणियं,जायं खणेण सलिलं,जुवईहि तहिं रमन्तीहि"
english: "Love is sweet when eaten with one's body, When drunk with kumkum, And when drunk with liquor."

prakrit: "एवं रमिऊण निवो,जलजन्तविसज्जिए कए उदए,वियडे नईऎ पुलिणे,लीलाकयभूसणनिओगो"
english: "And let the waters abate For the pleasure of bathing in them, For the jasmine has arisen, And the grasshopper has fled For fear of the lilies."

prakrit: "ताव चिण दहवयणो,हाउत्तिण्णो सियम्बरनियत्थो,ठावेइ कणयपीढे,पडिमाओ जिणवरिन्दाणं"
english: "That is the sign of the doe, That of the crows in the thicket, And that of the hunter's wife. The doe is tormented by thorns, And the shrew is led astray."

prakrit: "वरवालयापुलीणे,धरियवियाणय-पडायरमणिज्जे,काऊण महापूयं,संथुणइ जिणिन्दपडिमाओ"
english: "The plowman's wife, Who is the headmistress of many a household, Is content with surviving her husband's death."

prakrit: "तस्स थुणन्तस्स तओ,नइपूरसमोत्थया हिया पूया,रुट्ठो लङ्काहिबई,भणइह किं एरिसं जायं?"
english: "There you are, Sucking in her breasts, Wiping out fresh acacia flowers, Rooting like a snake, Saying:" "Is this the way it should be?" ""

prakrit: "एयं अयालसलिलं,भणइ गवेसेह पेसिया पुरिसा,गन्तूण पडिनियत्ता,जं दिट्टं तं निवेदेन्ति"
english: "It's a mess, You silly girl, Goose pimples settle on your face, And what you see is what you get."

prakrit: "अह नाह को वि पुरिसो,जुवइसमग्गो नईऎ पुलिणत्थो,अच्छइ लीलायन्तो,सुरो व मन्दाइणीसलिले"
english: "Oh! what a man he is, Like a young man playing the flute To a novice Pulling a string of strings."

prakrit: "तेणेयं नइसलिलं,रुद्धं जलजन्तसंपओगेणं,रमिऊण पुणो मुक्कं,वहइ पहू उब्भडावत्तं"
english: "Never mind that, Stopping for a moment At the sound of the raptor's horn, The doe opens her mouth again To make love." ""

prakrit: "बहुतूरजयालोयण–सदं सोऊण परमरुटेणं,वीसजिया य सुहडा,तस्स वहत्था बलसमग्गा"
english: "With great ecstasy She sleeps soundly, Sweating profusely, Her arms brimful of strength."

prakrit: "तो पेसिऊण सुहडे,पुणरवि पूया करित्तु पडिमाणं,संथुणइ एगमणसो,दहवयणो मङ्कलसएहिं"
english: "So embrace me, my dear, I'll do it all over again, Calm down a bit, Give me time to think."

prakrit: "सन्नद्धबद्धकवया,विज्जाहरपत्थिवा गयणमग्गे,दट्ठूण सहसकिरणो,ओइण्णो नइपुलीणाओ"
english: "The girl is ready, The songs are blaring from the fireplace, The doting husband is with her, And she has nothing to hide."

prakrit: "सोऊण कलयलरवं,माहेसरनयरसन्तिया सुहडा,सन्नज्झिऊण तुरियं,सहस्सकिरणं समल्लीणा"
english: "A son is full of joys, A daughter in law is pure joy, A wife in love is pure delight, A thousand rays combine to make a hundred."

prakrit: "अह जुज्झिउं पवत्ता,निसायरा भूमिगोयरेहि समं,चक्क-'सि-सत्ति-तोमर-मोग्गरनिवहं विमुञ्चन्ता"
english: "Ah! the struggle of the landowner's daughter - in - law! It is like tilling the ground:" "I'm at a loss what to do with the paddy." ""

prakrit: "रह-गय-तुरङ्गदप्पिय–अन्नोन्नावडियचडुलपाइक्का,जुज्झन्ति सवडहुत्ता,नामं गोतं च सावेन्ता"
english: "Rah - gayya - Turangadappiya - Anonnavadiyachadulaipaikka, jujanti savadhuta, namam gota savanta"

prakrit: "रक्खसभडेहि भग्गं,निययं दट्ठूण साहणं समरे,रुटो सहस्सकिरणो,आउहनिवहेण पन्जलिओ"
english: "Destroy the raksha sabha, For as soon as you see it, You will see it with your own eyes. Roots give birth to thousands of rays."

prakrit: "वाहेइ रहवरं सो,रक्खससेन्नस्स अहिमुहं तुरीओ,मुञ्चन्तो सरवरिसं,धारानिवहं व नवमेहो"
english: "Wayfarer, stay the course; The arrows of the God of Love travel far and wide; The river is torrential And the new moon is rising."

prakrit: "गरुयपहाराभिहयं,निवडन्तगइन्द-तुरय-पाइक्वं,विज्जाहराण सेन्नं,जोयणमेत्तं समोसरियं"
english: "Love between flocks, The choicest of cows, The loudest of bulls, The bravest of warriors, Love between bulls And bullocks."

prakrit: "पडिहारेण 'क्खाए,निययबले समरदूमियसरीरो,आरूढो दहवयणो,भुवणालङ्कारमत्तगयं"
english: "" "Fallen from the tree, Destroyed by the arrows of the God of Love," "The arrow flies high, Like a banner proclaiming victory."

prakrit: "एवं ठूण रणे,दसाणणं आउहाणि मुञ्चन्तं,बहुसमरलद्धविजओ,सहस्सकिरणो ठिओ पुरओ"
english: "And with a furtive cry, The hunter comes to tell the hunter What he craves most: The victory of many battles, The triumph of thousands of rays."

prakrit: "दोहं षि समावडिए,जुझे वहुसत्थघायसंपाए,विरहो सहस्सकिरणो,कओ खणद्धेण संगामे"
english: "The two meet, The war rages on, And the quarrels rage on. One is separated by thousands of rays, One is united by bitterness."

prakrit: "मोत्तूण रहवरं सो,आरूढो गयवरं गिरिसरिच्छं,मुञ्चइ सुनिसियबाणे,दहमुहसन्नहणभेयकरे"
english: "Wait a moment, my dear. Wait a minute, I hear you whispering, Tears streaming down my cheeks." ""

prakrit: "सिक्खाहि ताव रावण!,धणुवेयं निययपुरवरिं गन्तु,ताहे मए समाणं,जुज्झसु ता अवहिओ होउं"
english: "Learn how to instruct Ravana!" "Count his enemies off in due course." "Peace be with me then; I will avoid war."

prakrit: "रत्तारुणसवङ्गो,दवयणो कड्डिऊण सरनिवहं,मुञ्चइ चलग्गहत्थो,सहस्सकिरणस्स देहम्मि"
english: "Mother - in - law, You're a bitter - smelling snake, Moving away with a limp, In a body of a thousand rays."

prakrit: "जाव य सहस्सकिरणो,पहारवसवेम्भलो जणियमोहो,ताव य रक्खसवइणा,गहिओ रणमज्झयारम्मि"
english: "Behold, the thousand rays of the sun, Like the jewels in a garland of jewels, Are protecting you From the wrath of the God of Love."

prakrit: "अह बन्धिऊण नीओ,निययावासं सविब्भममणेहिं,विज्जाहरेहिं दिट्ठो,सहस्सकिरणो महासत्तो"
english: "O bound and girded Nio, Destroy everything in the universe, Gaze upon the vast expanse of knowledge; A thousand rays are a great strength."

prakrit: "ताव च्चिय दिवसयरो,अत्थाओ विगयकिरणसंघाओ,गयणं समोत्थरन्तो,बहलतमो वड्डिओ सहसा"
english: "So long a day, so long a period of time, So concentrated is the song, Suddenly the louder the talk"

prakrit: "ससियरजोण्हाधवले,रणभग्गुच्छाहजणियकम्मन्ते,अक्खयदेहाणं चिय,निदाऎ सुहं गया रयणी"
english: "Dear girl, The nights are long, The roads are slippery, The streets are deserted, And the roads are impassable."

prakrit: "अह उग्गमम्मि सूरे,सामन्तत्थाणिमज्झयारत्थो,अच्छइ लङ्काहिवई,ताव चिय मुणिवरो पत्तो"
english: "Oh! beautiful woman! Aunt, The path is smooth, The paths are meandering, And so is the path of the sage Lanka."

prakrit: "ठूण समणसीह,सिग्धं अब्भुट्ठिओ कयपणामो,दिन्नासणोवविठ्ठो,साहू तवलच्छिसंपन्नो"
english: "Be careful not to fall over, you fool, I beg of you, Stop wasting away in your dreams, You coward, Like a quiver of parrots."

prakrit: "ओणमियउत्तिमङ्गो,पुच्छइ लङ्काहिवो मुणिवरिन्दं,केणेव कारणेणं,भयवं! जेणा''गओ एत्थं?"
english: "Aunt, Onam is on its way! The lankan elephant asks the sage," "What's wrong with you?" "For whom is it that you are afraid?"

prakrit: "भणइ तओ मुणिवसहो,कुल-बल-विरियाइवण्णणं काउं,माहेसरनयरवई,राया हं आसि सयबाहू"
english: "Tell me, you sage, How can I describe you in detail, Clumsy girl, Being the daughter-in-law of a great king? The answer is yes, my lord."

prakrit: "पुत्तं सहस्सकिरणं,रज्जे ठविऊण जायसंवेगो,मोक्खत्थं पवइओ,जिणवरधम्मुज्जयमईओ"
english: "My son, don't be alarmed: There must be something on your mind. Liberation means liberation. But victory means victory."

prakrit: "बद्धं सहस्सकिरणं,सोऊणमिहागओ तुह सगासं,मुञ्चसु इमं सुयं मे रावण! मा कुणसु वक्खेवं"
english: "Enough of your sulking, My husband is asleep, I want to sleep with you, Ravana! Don't turn your back on me." ""

prakrit: "तो भणइ रक्खसिन्दो,पूया पडिमाण विरइया महई,सा नइपूरेण हया,एयस्स विचेट्ठियगुणेहिं"
english: "So he says,'Rakshasinda ', Pooya, poor man, Wretched bee, She is not whole. Such are the virtues of a wretch." ""

prakrit: "पूयाहरणनिमित्ते,बद्धो य विमाणिओ इमो सुहडो,तुज्झ वयणेण साहव! मुच्चइ नत्थेत्थ संदेहो"
english: "" "Friend, It's my pleasure to meet you at the altar. Stop your words! There's no doubt about it."

prakrit: "दहमुहवयणेण तओ,सहस्सकिरणो खणेण परिमुक्को,अह पेच्छइ मुणिवसभं,पणमइ य पयाहिणं काउं"
english: "Because of the burning flame, Because one can see thousands of rays, And because one can't see the moon, I bow before the assembly of sages. For who is worthy to be worshipped?"

prakrit: "भणिओ य रावणेणं,अज्जपभूई तुम महं भाया,मन्दोदरीऎ भइणी,सयंपभा ते पणामेमि"
english: "Tell me, Ravana, you fool, My brother - in - law is angry with you. I will repay you, my dear."

prakrit: "तो भणइ सहसकिरणो,न य मच्च कोइ जाणइ विवेगं,सरए व घणायारो,नासइ देहो न संदेहो"
english: "So he says,'Friend, no one knows what's wrong with you, except the wise."

prakrit: "जइ नाम हवइ सारो,इमेसु भोगेसु अइदुरन्तेसु,तो न य गहिया होन्ती,पवज्जा मज्झ ताएणं"
english: "If my name were Hawaai, I would suffer the same as you, So don't be so hasty. Praise be to my heart." ""

prakrit: "ठविऊण निययरज्जे,पुत्तं आपुच्छिऊण दहवयणं,निस्सङ्गो पवइओ,सहस्सकिरणो पिउसयासे"
english: "Prostrate in your heart, Destroy your son, Destabilize him, Make him poor again. A thousand rays make a man thirsty."

prakrit: "संभरियं चिय वयणं,जं तं अणरण्णमित्तसामक्खं,भणियं अईयकाले,तं एवं परिफुडं जायं"
english: "Speak thoughtfully, Say what you have to say, Speak clearly; Speak slowly, speak slowly, and act with discretion."

prakrit: "जइया हं पढमयरं,परिगिण्हीहामि जिणवरं दिक्खं,तइया तुज्झ नराहिव,वत्ता दाहामि निक्खुत्तं"
english: "If you spare me, my dear, I will look after your life, For you are not worthless. Besides, I am worthless in my own right."

prakrit: "संपेसिओ य पुरिसो,साकेयपुराहिवस्स गन्तूणं,साहइ जिणवरविहियं,सहस्सकिरणस्स पवज्जं"
english: "Contentment is the fate of men, Sacrifice is the destination of long lives, Friendship is the marriage of souls, Love is the arrow of the thousand rays."

prakrit: "सुणिऊण पवरदिक्खं,सहस्सकिरणस्स जणियसंवेगो,अणरण्णो पवइओ,पुत्तं ठविऊण रज्जम्मि"
english: "Listen to the powerful eye, Be attentive to the thousand rays of the sun, Listen carefully to what goes on in the sky, For my son is bound to fall."

prakrit: "एवं सहस्सकिरणस्स विचेट्ठियं जे,बीयं सुणन्ति अणरण्णनराहिवस्स,ते उत्तमेसु भवणेसु सुहोवगाढा,देवा भवन्ति विमलोयरकन्तिजुत्ता"
english: "And those who sit astride thousands of rays, Listening for the seeds That germinate, Rejoice in the most beautiful buildings. God is like a flame burning in the dark."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए दहमुह-सुग्गीवपत्थाण-सहस्पकिरण-अणरण्णपव्वज्जाविहाणो नाम दसमो उद्देसओ समत्तो"
english: "Praise be to the name of the pious woman Whose face lights up with happiness, Whose path opens with ecstasy, And whose path cuts through with difficulty."

prakrit: "अह रावणो नरिन्दो,जे जे पुहईयलम्मि विक्खाया,ते ते जिणिऊण वसे,ठवेइ विजाबलसमग्गो"
english: "Oh, Ravana, Narindo, all those who have pierced the jasmine in the past, Live in it, Thinking they have mastered it."

prakrit: "सवे काऊण वसे,महिवाले विविहदेससंभूए,रह-गय-तुरङ्ग-वाहण-पभूयजोहाउलाडोवे"
english: "All the cows live here, The bees inhabit all the different parts of the forest, The trees that grow there, The oxen that pull the strings, The elephants that carry the cattle."

prakrit: "कारेइ जिणहराणं,समारणं जुण्ण-भग्ग-पडियाणं,पूया य बहुवियप्पा,विरएइ जिणिन्दपडिमाणं"
english: "One must conquer, One must forget, The old and the broken; One must sacrifice, one must sacrifice; Separation is the god of victory."

prakrit: "जिणवरपडिकुट्ठा पुण,विद्धंसइ पूयई य समणवरे,एवं परिहिण्डमाणो,पुवदिसिं पत्थिओ नवरं"
english: "The lotus bud is white, The flowers are white, And the flowers are yellow."

prakrit: "अह पत्तो नरवसहो,तेण सुओ रायपुरवरे नयरे,लोइयसत्थत्थरओ,उवउत्तो जन्नकम्मन्ते"
english: "Ah! the leaf is a man made of nectar, So is the sleeper only found in Raipur, The plowman's son - in - law is in Jannakam." ""

prakrit: "सुणिऊण जन्नवयणं,पुच्छइ मगहाहिवो मुणिपसत्थं,जन्नस्स समुप्पत्ती,कहेहि भयवं! परिफुडं मे"
english: "Listening to what people have to say, Asking what people want to hear, Begging what people don't know, Sitting on the fence Saying:" "I'm scared!" ""

prakrit: "अह भाणिउं पयत्तो,अणयारो सुमहुराऎ वाणीए,आसि अओज्झाहिवई,इक्खागुकुलुब्भवो राया"
english: "Oh! you fool," said the doe, "A lovely man's voice has spoken; Here comes the elephant's wife: Look how she has smeared herself With red ghee."

prakrit: "नामेण महासत्तो,अजिओ भज्जा य तस्स सुरकन्ता,पुत्तो य वसुकुमारो,गुरुसेवाउज्जयमईओ"
english: "Great is the name, great is the sound, my son, my elder brother, Your service to my master is bound to increase."

prakrit: "खीरकयम्बो त्ति गुरू,सत्थिमई हवइ तस्स वरमहिला,पुत्तो वि हु पवयओ,नारयविप्पो हवइ सीसो"
english: "Khirkayambo is my guru, Satthimayee is my wife, My son, I am pious too, The only way out is through a bottle."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाई,सत्थं आरण्णयं वणुद्देसे,कुणइ तओ अज्झयणं,सीससमग्गो उवज्झाओ"
english: "Oh! what a strange thing it is to do, To weep and wail loudly, To groan and groan loudly; It's only the sound of whispers."

prakrit: "अह बम्भणस्स पुरओ,आगासत्थेण तेण साहूणं,जीवाण दयट्ठाए,भणियं अणुकम्पजुत्तेणं"
english: "Ah! the fullness of the womb, With fire as its support, With life as its medicine, With the fire that animates the bowels."

prakrit: "चउसु वि जीवेसु सया एक्को वि हु नरगभाविओ भणिओ,सुणिऊण उवज्झाओ,खीरकयम्बो तओ भीओ"
english: "Even if you die, You'll be alive Alone." Say the words of an evil spirit. When you hear them You will appreciate them. Even when you cry, You will too.

prakrit: "वीसज्जिया सहाया,निययघरं तो लहुं समल्लीणा,भणिओ सत्थिमईए,पुत्त! पिया ते न एत्था''ओ"
english: "The poor girl answered:" "It's your house, your clothes are red." "Tell me, My son, you won't fall in love That's all right."

prakrit: "तेणं तीए सिटुं,एही ताओ अवस्स दिवसन्ते,तदंसणू सुयमणा,अच्छइ मग्गं पलोयन्ती"
english: "There she sits, Yet the days are fleeting, And the nights long, Like a good man's pastime."

prakrit: "अत्थमिओ च्चिय सूरो,तह वि घरं नागओ उवज्झाओ,सोगभरपीडियङ्गी,सत्थिमई मुच्छिया पडिया"
english: "Aunt, It's safe for you to go home, But the nasty snake is hiding in the attic, Sweating all over." ""

prakrit: "आसन्था भणइ तओ,हा! कटुं मन्दभागधेज्जाए,किं मारिओ सि दइओ!,एगागी कं दिसं पत्तो?"
english: "You fool, he says:" "Stop! It's a sharp parting shot. Can you shoot it? What do you think it's going to be?" ""

prakrit: "किं सबसङ्गरहिओ,पवइओ तिबजायसंवेगो?,एवं विलवन्तीए,निसा गया दुक्खियमणाए"
english: "Are all lovers of love like this?" he asked, "And you, my poor girl, are you afraid of being angry?"

prakrit: "अरुणुग्गमे पयट्टो,पवयओ गुरुगवेसणट्टाए,पेच्छइ नईतडत्थं,षियरं समणाण मज्झम्मि"
english: "In Arunugama the traveler is alone, In the village gurus are absent, They look for a new destination, The winter is my equal."

prakrit: "निग्गन्थं पबइयं,दट्ठूण गुरुं कहेइ जणणीए,सुणिऊण अइविसण्णा,सत्थिमई दुक्खिया जाया"
english: "When one sees a good man, One sees a great man, When one hears a wise woman, One forgives a poor man."

prakrit: "अह नारओ वि तइया,गुरुषत्ति दुक्खियं सुणेऊणं,आगन्तूण पणामं,करेइ संथावणं तीए"
english: "Oh, you naughty girl, make the master listen to your troubles. The visitor is welcome, That's how you make him feel."

prakrit: "तइया जियारिराया,पबइओ वसुसुयं ठविय रज्जे,आगासनिम्मलयरं,फलिहमयं आसणं दिवं"
english: "You stubborn girl, The nights are fleeting And the nights unreturning. Let the sun find its place in my heart."

prakrit: "पवयय-नारयाणं,तच्चत्थनिरूवणी कहा जाया,अह नारएण भणियं,दुविहो धम्मो जिणक्खाओ"
english: "Praise be to the Narayani, She is said to produce sharp reflexes:" "I speak with a narayani's voice." "Both these dharmas are triumphs."

prakrit: "पढममहिंसा सच्चं,अदत्तपरिवज्जणं च बब्भं च,सबपरिग्गहविरई,महत्वया होन्ति पञ्च इमे"
english: "First violence is true, then separation and separation are real, then freedom in all directions; the five great vows are true."

prakrit: "सेसा अणुबयधरा,गिहिधम्मपरा हवन्ति जे मणुया,पुत्ताइभेयजुत्ता,अतिहिविभागे य जन्ने य"
english: "They are poisonous, polluting the air, Like humans born blind, Like the fire that consumes one's life, Like people who are extremely thin."

prakrit: "एत्तो अजेसु जन्नो,कायबो नारओ भणइ एवं,ते पुण अजा अविज्जा,जवाइयंकूरपरिमुक्का"
english: "Here is a man who is still young, Who sometimes speaks nonsense And who, once again, is unable to master it." ""

prakrit: "तो पबएण भणियं,वुच्चन्ति अजा पसू न संदेहो,ते मारिऊण कीरइ,जन्नो एसा भवइ दिक्खा"
english: "So tell me, do not doubt the beast. He will kill anyone who thinks he sees him." ""

prakrit: "तो नारएण भणिओ,पवयओ मा तुमं अलियवादी,होऊण नासि नरयं,दुक्खसहस्साण आवासं"
english: "So tell that man:" "My lord, don't be so naïve As to be a traitor." ""

prakrit: "भणइ तओ पबयओ,अत्थि वसू अम्ह एत्थ मज्झत्थो,एगगुरुगहियविज्जो,तस्स य वयणं पमाणं मे"
english: "Speak thou, O husbandman, speak thyself, O mother - in - law, Speak the truth in one go."

prakrit: "अह पबएण य लहुँ,माया वीसज्जिया वसुसयासं,भणइ पहु! पक्खवायं,पुत्तस्स महं करेजासि"
english: "" "Ah, my poor girl, Maya, don't be so hasty!" "You fool, son - in - law, tell me."

prakrit: "अह उग्गयम्मि सूरे,पवयओ नारओ य जणसहिया,पत्ता नरिन्दभवणं,जत्थ'च्छइ वसुमहाराया"
english: "Oh! you stupid girl, You silly girl, Don't go anywhere else: It's your husband's house, Your wife's... Where are you going?"

prakrit: "भणिओ य नारएणं,वसुराया सच्चवाइणो तुम्हे,जं गुरुजणोबइ८,तं चिय वयणं भणेज्जाहि"
english: "Tell me, darling, Is it really you who speak the truth? The way you speak, my dear, Is quite different from speaking the truth."

prakrit: "नइ वीहिया अविज्जा,वुच्चन्ति अजा पसू गुरुवइट्टा,एयाणं इक्कयरं,भणाहि सच्चेण सत्तो सि"
english: "No, you impudent wretch, You always look out for the beast Who needs a guide, Always act with discretion, Always speak with truth."

prakrit: "अह भणइ वसुनरिन्दो,तच्चत्थं पबएण उल्लवियं,अलियं नारयवयणं,न कयाइ सुयं गुरुसयासे"
english: "Ah! it's the spring wind, That makes the sound of the flute resounding, Alas, it is the fluttering of the drums: There is no need for anybody to fall asleep before his teacher."

prakrit: "एवं च भणियमेत्ते,फलिहामयआसणेण समसहिओ,धरणिं वसू पविठ्ठो,असच्चवाई सहामज्झे"
english: "And as the saying goes:" "Deal with fruitful desires, Be generous with land, Be honest with it, Be truthful with it." ""

prakrit: "पुढवी जा सत्तमिया,महातमा घोरवेयणाउत्ता,तत्थेव य उववन्नो,हिंसावयणालियपलावी"
english: "Go ahead, Satmiya, the great man is about to be strangled, Then come here, you violent criminal."

prakrit: "धिद्धि! त्ति अलियवाई,पवयय-बसू जणेण उग्घुटुं,पत्तो चिय सम्माणं,तत्थेव य नारओ विउलं"
english: "Fool! It's a stray dog, A passing fowler, On the very first day of the festival A man with big breasts Appears on the scene, But the name has already been dropped." ""

prakrit: "पावो वि हु पबयओ,जणधिक्कारेण दूमियसरीरो,काऊण कुच्छियतवं,मरिऊणं रक्खसो जाओ"
english: "The poor thing is past, The miser is past his prime, The cow is past its prime, And the dog is still on the loose. Protection against death is the way to go."

prakrit: "सरिऊण पुबजम्म,जणवयधिक्कारदूसहं वयणं,वेरपडिउञ्चणत्थे,बम्भणरूवं तओ कुणइ"
english: "When a woman makes love, She acts as if she were pregnant, When a man is angry, When her anger has been kindled, And when he is angry she acts as though she were jealous."

prakrit: "बहुकण्ठसुत्तधारी,छत्त-कमण्डलु-गणित्तियाहत्थो,चिन्तेइ अलियसत्थं,हिंसाधम्मेण संजुत्तं"
english: "A man of many talents, With hands like that of an arrow, With eyes like those of a mathematician, Is won over by thought, And by violence."

prakrit: "सोऊण तं कुसत्थं,पडिबुद्धा तावसा य विप्पा य,तस्स वयणेण जन्नं,करेन्ति बहुजन्तुसंबाहं"
english: "One can spoil a man's image by making him look ugly, by covering his face with mud, or by causing him to look like a man suffering from fever."

prakrit: "गोमेहनामधेए,जन्ने पायाविया सुरा हवइ,भणइ अगम्मागमणं,कायचं नस्थि दोसो त्थ"
english: "In the middle of the cowshed, Wherever the poor man goes, There he says :'It's going to rain again '. What's wrong with his nose?"

prakrit: "पिइमेह-माइमेहे,रायसुए आसमेह-पसुमेहे,एएसु मारियवा,सएसु नामेसु जे जीवा"
english: "Love - my life, Write long, wide and wide, As if it were marriage, As though it were a name of the soul."

prakrit: "जीवा मारेयवा,आसवषाणं च होइ कायवं,मंसं च खाइयवं,जन्नस्स विही हवइ एसा"
english: "Life must be killed, Hope must be destroyed, And the mind must be eaten. For without wisdom, there is no air."

prakrit: "एवं विमोहयन्तो,भणइ जणं रक्खसो महापावो,तिविहं च परिग्गहिओ,तस्सुवएसो अभविएहिं"
english: "And when he is astounded, he says," "Protection is great, so how can I help it?" "Such, indeed, is the nature of love."

prakrit: "हिंसाजन्नं तु इम,सेणिय! जे परिहरन्ति भवियजणा,ते जन्ति देवलोगं,जिणवरधम्मुज्जयमईया"
english: "Violence is your fault, soldier! Those who seek redemption are gods, For the dharma of victory is supreme." ""

prakrit: "ताव च्चिय दहवयणो,रायपुरं पत्थिओ जणसमिद्धं,मरुओ त्ति नाम राया,जत्थ'च्छइ जन्नवाडत्थो"
english: "So call me Dahavayana, Raipur is the street where people meet, And the name of the place where I die Is Raya, Wherever I am from Jannavada."

prakrit: "जन्नारम्भं सुणिऊण बम्भणा तत्थ आगया बहवे,पसवो य विविहरूवा,बद्धा अच्छन्ति दीणमुहा"
english: "When one hears the start of a festival The flames rush in, When one has had time one is bound to hear the next." ""

prakrit: "गयणेण वच्चमाणो,पेच्छइ तं नारओ जणसमूहं,परमकुतूहलभावो,तं चिय नयरं समोइण्णो"
english: "He is fond of singing, He listens to people talk, He is extremely curious, He knows how to deal with nasty people."

prakrit: "पुच्छइ मगहाहिवई,भयवं! को नारओ? सुओ कस्स?,के व गुणा से अहिया? कहेहि मे कोउयं गुरुयं"
english: "Ask the elephant," "Who is afraid? Shout out to me?" "Whom do you ask? Who is worthy of my praise? Tell me, please, whose teacher am I?"

prakrit: "भणइ तओ गणनाहो,विप्पो नामेण अत्थि बम्भरुई,महिला से वरकुम्मी,सा गुरुभारा समणुजाया"
english: "If you ask me,'How is the counting going on?'I will reply with a broad smile :'It's the bridegroom's marriage to a woman.'He will answer you with a loud voice." ""

prakrit: "कालन्तरेण केणइ,विहरन्ता साहवो तमुद्देसं,पत्ता तावसनिलयं,तेहि य परिवारिया तुरियं"
english: "Time flies, Traveler's arrows tremble, Leaves twitch, And so do the trumpets of the family."

prakrit: "दिन्नासणोवविठ्ठा,साहू पेच्छन्ति तत्थ बम्भरुई,महिला य तस्स कुम्मी,गुरुभारा पीणथणजुयला"
english: "The poor girl is sitting on the bed, The rich man is looking at her, The poor woman is sitting there Smiling, The elders are sipping their drinks."

prakrit: "अह साहवेण भणियं,संसारसहावजाणियच्छेणं,हा! कर्ट कह जीवा,नचाविज्जन्ति कम्मेसु?"
english: "Oh! my poor brother - in - law! Cutting off the ties of friendship From the world! How can one live without dancing?"

prakrit: "चइऊण बन्धवजणं,गिहवासं चेव धम्मबुद्धीए,गहिओ तावसधम्मो,तह वि य सङ्गं न छड्डेइ"
english: "Try to conceal your feelings with a friend, For they are the same as true ones, But do not leave them at that."

prakrit: "जह छड्डिऊण भत्तं,पुणरवि लोगो न भुञ्जइ अभक्खं,तह छड्डिऊण कम्मं,न करेन्ति जई अकरणिज्जं"
english: "One who quits bread, Never again roasts a person, Always does what one wants to quench his thirst For, Never acts so rashly As when one is absent"

prakrit: "चइऊण महिलियं जो,पुणरवि सेवेइ लिङ्गरूवेणं,सो पावमोहियमई,दीहं अज्जेइ संसारं"
english: "To choose a woman who will serve you again and again as a lingruven, one who loves sin, Is the reward of a long and rewarding life."

prakrit: "सोऊण समणवयणं,पडिबुद्धो तक्खणेण बम्भरुई,जिणदिक्खं पडिवन्नो,सर्व सङ्गं पयहिऊणं"
english: "To fall asleep in silence, To collapse under the weight of anger, To lose sight of life, Is to take it all in stride."

prakrit: "कुम्मी वि सुणिय धम्मं,मोत्तण कुदिट्टि जिणसुइमईया,अह दारयं पसूया,दसमे मासे अरण्णम्मि"
english: "Even a virgin has heard of Dharma, When her eyes are closed They twitch like jinns, When she walks in the door They see the forest in the tenth month."

prakrit: "संभरिय साहुवयणं,असासयं जाणिऊण मणुयत्तं,संवेगसमावन्ना,कुम्मी चिन्तेइ हियएणं"
english: "To think clearly, To know the impossible, To be humane, To have emotion, Is the highest form of thinking."

prakrit: "रण्णे समुद्दमज्झे,जलणे गिरिसिहर-कन्दरत्थं वा,रक्खन्ति पयत्तेणं,पुरिसं निययाइँ कम्माइं"
english: "The forest warms the sea, The burning gorges, The reed beds, Protecting the paths, Are the duties of a man's destiny."

prakrit: "गहियाउहेहि जइ वि हु,रक्खिज्जइ पञ्जरोयरत्थो वि,तह वि हु मरइ निरुत्तं,पुरिसो संपत्थिए काले"
english: "Though covered with gooseflesh, Protected by the arrows of the God of Love, Yet I die penniless."

prakrit: "एवं सा परमत्थं,मुणिऊण विमुच्च बालयं रणे,आणत्था लोगपुरं,गन्तुं अज्जाऎ पासम्मि"
english: "And she's the last one, Slipping in and out of sight of the man She loves, Like a bunch of peacock's tail - feathers Waved by the God of Love."

prakrit: "अह इन्दमालिणीए,पबइया तिबजायसंवेगा,काऊण समाढत्ता,तवचरणं तग्गयमईया"
english: "Oh! poor girl, You'll have to suffer the same fate As me If you don't pay attention."

prakrit: "अह सो वि तत्थ बालो,आगासत्थेहि जम्भयगणेहिं,दठूण य अवहरिओ,पुत्तो इव पालिओ नेउं"
english: "There you are, my boy, Going up and down the hill, Watching and avoiding. My son, Don't be so hasty."

prakrit: "सत्थाणि सिक्खवेडं,दिन्ना आगासगामिणी विज्जा,संपुण्णजोवणो सो,जाओ जिणसासणुज्जुत्तो"
english: "Learn the seven vows, Give wisdom to the firefighter, Go, young man, Illuminate your soul."

prakrit: "द₹ण निययजणणी,परिणाया अङ्गमङ्गचिन्धेहिं,तुट्ठो लएइ धम्म,उत्तमचारित्त-सम्मत्तं"
english: "A virtuous woman, Destroyed by empty limbs, Taken hostage by dharma, With good character - Consent."

prakrit: "कन्दप्प-कुक्कुयरई,निच्चं गन्धव-कलहतल्लिच्छो,पुज्जो य नरवईणं,हिण्डइ पुहवी जहिच्छाए"
english: "Kandappa - Kukkuyrai, neech gandhava - There must be a quarrel between the two. Please, do not try to mislead people. India is like a man making love."

prakrit: "देवेहि रक्खिओ जं,देवगई देवविब्भमुल्लावो,देवरिसि त्ति पयासो,जाओ च्चिय नारओ लोए"
english: "Protect the gods, for the gods are divine and the gods divine. Fear the gods. Let there be no more noise."

prakrit: "गयणेण वच्चमाणो,जणनिवहं पेच्छिऊण अवइण्णो,भणइ मरुयं नरिन्द,किं कजं ते समाढत्तं?"
english: "He walks around singing, He looks at his wife in silence, He mutters:" "Daughter - in - law, what's the point?" ""

prakrit: "पसवो वि बहुवियप्पा,बद्धा अच्छन्ति केण कजेणं?,केणेव कारणेणं,इहागया बम्भणा बहवे?"
english: "Passover is a long way off, bound to happen. Why so?, Because of whom?, Is this how pride is spread?" ""

prakrit: "संवत्तएण भणिओ,विप्पेणं किं न याणसे जन्नं,मरुयनरिन्देण कयं,परलोयत्थे महाधम्मं?"
english: "Say in all honesty: Why not sacrifice oneself, What about those who die, For what is the greater dharma than renunciation?"

prakrit: "जो चउमुहेण पुर्व,उवइट्ठो वेयसत्थनिप्फण्णो,जन्नो महागुणो वि हु,कायबो तोसु वण्णेसु"
english: "One who has been kissed before, Who has been nourished while still standing, Even as I have great virtues, So tell me something else."

prakrit: "काऊण वेदिमज्झे,मन्तेसु पसू हवन्ति हन्तवा,देवा य तिप्पियबा,सोमाईया पयत्तेणं"
english: "Whom are you looking out for? The Vedas are burning, The beasts are howling, The gods are busy making offerings, The rivers are overflowing with water."

prakrit: "एसो धुवो त्ति धम्मो,जोएण य पायडो कओ लोए,इन्दिय-मणाभिरामं,देइ फलं देवलोगम्मि"
english: "This is dharma, which washes away, For what use is a cow made of jasmine, A man's love for India? One day the gods will give him fruit."

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,भणइ तओ नारओ मइपगब्भो,आरिसवेयाणुमयं,कहेमि जन्नं निसामेहि"
english: "Listen to me when you speak, Speak my name when I speak, Ask what I have to say, And I'll tell you the truth."

prakrit: "वेइसरीरल्लीणो,मणजलणो नाणघयसुपज्जलिओ,कम्मतरुसमुप्पन्नं,मलसमिहासंचयं डहइ"
english: "Like a fire burning in the middle of the night, Like the flame of the ebb and flow of sweat, Like a heap of faeces, It burns with jealousy."

prakrit: "कोहो माणो माया,लोभो रागो य दोस-मोहो य,पसवा हवन्ति एए,हन्तवा इन्दिएहि समं"
english: "Anger is like pride, Greed is like anger, Love is like enmity, Jealousy is like jealousy, And hatred is like love."

prakrit: "सच्चं खमा अहिंसा,दायबा दक्खिणा सुपजत्ता,दसण-चरित्त-संजम-बम्भाईया इमे देवा"
english: "Truth alone forgives non - violence, righteousness alone triumphs, charity - conduct - restraint - jealousy - this is the God of Love."

prakrit: "एसो जिणेहि भणिओ,जन्नो तच्चन्थवेयनिद्दिठ्ठो,जोगविसेसेण कओ,देइ फलं परमनिवाणं"
english: "Say this out loud :'People who know what's in store For you, Work hard at finding a mate That will give you fruit.'"" "

prakrit: "जे पुण करेन्ति जन्नं,अणारिसं अलियवेयनिष्फण्णं,मारेऊण पसुगणे,रुहिर-वसा-मंसरसलोला"
english: "Those who do good work deserve to be punished, The ignorant foolish, Those who commit adultery deserve to die, The fats of the heart - The saliva of the mind."

prakrit: "ते पावकम्मकारी,वाहा विव निद्दया निरणुकम्पा,मरिऊण जन्ति निरयं,अज्जेन्ति य दीहसंसारं"
english: "They act immodestly, The widow sleeps soundly, They die peacefully, They live for the rest of their lives."

prakrit: "जं नारएण भणिया,सबे वि य बम्भणा परमरुट्ठा,पहणेऊण पयत्ता,दढमुट्ठि-करप्पहारेहिं"
english: "Whatever people say, Everything they say Is based on falsehood, On what they wear, On how they shake their heads."

prakrit: "ते नारओ वि विप्पे,भुयबल-अइचडुलपण्हिपहरेहिं,वारेइ पययमणसो,संसयपरमं समणुपत्तो"
english: "They scrape through the mud, Scorch the ground, Swirl around in circles, Play with fire and water, And bow before the God of Love."

prakrit: "बहवेहि वेढिऊणं,गहिओ कर-चरण-अङ्गमङ्गेसु,पक्खी व पञ्जरत्थो,अवसीयइ नारओ धणियं"
english: "The hunter must pierce through the fence, Cut through the grass - the limbs at the feet, The bird through the feathers, And the doe through the paws."

prakrit: "एयन्तरम्मि पत्तो,दूओ दहवयणसन्तिओ तत्थ,अह पेच्छइ हम्मन्तं,विप्पेहि य नारयं दीणं"
english: "Here's the letter, There it is, Two hundred and ninety seconds passed. I can see that it's still there. It's like saying goodbye." ""

prakrit: "गहियं विप्पेहि तहिं,दट्ठूणं नारयं पभूएहिं,गन्तुं कहेइ दूओ,जन्ननिओगं दहमुहस्स"
english: "The fire is gone, The hearth is burning, The street is empty, The streets are deserted, And the streets are empty."

prakrit: "जस्स सयासं सामिय!,विसज्जिओ हं तए नरिन्दस्स,तस्स बहुबम्भणेहिं,हम्मन्तो नारओ दिट्ठो"
english: "Jus saiyasam saamiya!, Visajjio hume narindasa, tamas bahumabhivyane hain, hamanto naarao gaze." ""

prakrit: "तत्था''उलं नरिन्द,नाऊण भउदुयसरीरोहं,एत्थागओ नराहिब,तुझं जाणावणट्ठाए"
english: "That's it," said Narinda, "You silly girl, Don't go anywhere without telling me you know."

prakrit: "रुट्ठो लङ्काहिबई,सुहडे पेसेइ साहणसमग्गे,गन्तूण तेहि सहसा,परिमुक्को नारओ विप्पो"
english: "Stop being a lame duck, Take a good walk, Be patient while you're at it, Stop being so hasty, Stop dragging your feet."

prakrit: "हणिऊण बम्भणगणे,भग्गो जन्नो य मेल्लिया पसवो,भणिया य सुत्तकण्ठा,जह पुण एयं न कारेह"
english: "Be angry with yourself, Be angry, For someone who is dead Has passed away, Or for some reason is sleeping again, So don't do that again."

prakrit: "अह नारओ वि एत्तो,बम्भणकरकढिणगाहपरिमुक्को,उप्पइऊणं सहसा,पेच्छइ लङ्काहिवं तुट्ठो"
english: "Oh! what a mess! There she is, Heading towards the rafters of her husband's cupped hand. Suddenly she sees that the elephant in the langar Has broken free." ""

prakrit: "कल्लाणं होउ तुमं,विउलं मा हणसु बम्भणे पावे,पियजीविए वराए,भमन्तु पुहई जहिच्छाए"
english: "Well done, you fool, Don't throw your arms around me. Life goes on, Drunkard said, As long as you don't fall over." ""

prakrit: "निसुणेहि ताव सुपुरिस!,उप्पत्ती तावसाण एगमणो,उसभजिणस्स भगवओ,पबज्जादेसयालम्मि"
english: "Without a doubt, Your Holiness!, Once you have reached your goal, O God of Love, You have proved your worth." ""

prakrit: "चत्तारि सहस्साई,मरीइसहियाण नरवरिन्दाणं,घेत्तूण जिणसयासे,पब ज्जा षडिनियत्ताई"
english: "Trembling saucers, Bees clinging to men Who are dying, Clinging to their necks As if they were sleeping."

prakrit: "तण्हा-छुहाकिलन्ता,आरण्णं पविसिऊण दीणमुहा,तरुवरफलासणा ते,तावसपासण्डिणो जाया"
english: "Aunt, When he touches you, You turn your face away, When you ask him what he wants, He refuses to budge."

prakrit: "एवं ते पुहइतले,मोहेन्ता जणवयं कुसत्थेसु,जाया तावसविप्पा,विजं षिव वड्डिया बहवे"
english: "And when he reached there, He could not help laughing:" "My husband is ill, Going to bed early, The lightning flashes like a lion's tail." ""

prakrit: "तित्थयरेसु वि न कयं,धम्मेक्कमणं जणं निरवसेसं,किं पुण दसाणण तुमे,कीरइ जिणसासणमतीयं?"
english: "There is nothing wrong with that, my dear, I have always known the true nature of Dharma. How can you explain it to me? What is the use of concealing one's soul?"

prakrit: "सुणिऊण पगयमेयं,उसभजिणं पणमिऊण दहवयणो,वारेइ सुत्तकण्ठे,हम्मन्ते रक्खसभडेहिं"
english: "Listen to the traveler, Pay attention to what he has to offer You, O hunter of reeds, Always be on guard against evil spirits."

prakrit: "मरुओ वि नरवरिन्दो,अञ्जलिमउलं करेवि नियसीसे,पणमइ लङ्काहिवई,भिच्चो हं तुज्झ साहीणो"
english: "Even a man who dies is a barber, A good man makes an ornament, A poor woman is a coward, And a beggar is your enemy."

prakrit: "कणयप्पभा कुमारी,दिन्ना मरुएण रक्खसिन्दस्स,परिणीया चन्दमुही,जोवण-लायण्णपडिपुण्णा"
english: "Bride - to - be, Daughter - in - law, Destroyed by the rays of the moon, For the moon is full of wonders."

prakrit: "रममाणस्स रइगुणे,तीए संवच्छरस्स उप्पन्ना,दुहिया विचित्तरूवा,कयचित्ता नाम नामेणं"
english: "Virtuous are the virtues of a virtuous person, Upanishads are those of good and evil, Wretched is the name given to any kind of deviousness."

prakrit: "पुहईयलम्मि सुहडा,जे सूरा दप्पिया बलसमिद्धा,ते ते ठावेइ बसे,दसाणणो अत्तणो सबइ"
english: "Aunt, The surahs that are thick with energy Remain in place. Knowledge of nature is everything"

prakrit: "गयणेण वच्चमाणो,गामा-''गर-नगर-पट्टणसमिद्धं,पेच्छइ य मज्झदेसं,काणण-वणमण्डियं रम्मं"
english: "To sing is to speak, Gama -" "To grow - to grow - To mix town and city, To watch the midday sun, To hear - To play the forest drum." ""

prakrit: "अवइण्णो दहवयणो,नयरब्भासे ठिओ जणवएणं,नर-नारीहि सहरिसं,पेच्छिज्जइ कोउहल्लेणं"
english: "A woman is immodest, Speaking in a tongue that is not her own, Speaking through the eyes of a man or a woman."

prakrit: "मरगयमऊहसामो,वियसियवरकमलसरिसमुहसोहो,वित्थिण्णविउलवच्छो,पीणुन्नयदीहबाहुजुओ"
english: "Tears were streaming down my cheeks, The lotuses smeared all over my face, The crows peeping out from the treetops, The elephants swooping down to drink."

prakrit: "करयलगिज्झमझो,सीहकडी हत्थिहत्थसरिसोरू,कुम्मवरचारुचरणो,बत्तीससुलक्खणसमग्गो"
english: "A flock of parrots falling from the sky, Strawberries clinging to the hands of the hunter, The crows hovering over the potter's wheel, Are like thirty-two scruples."

prakrit: "सिरिवच्छभूसियङ्गो,सबालङ्कारसुकयनेवच्छो,इन्दो व महिड्डीओ,दिट्ठो लोएण दहवयणो"
english: "Deer - eyed monkeys, humps of gold, gooseflesh, buffalo and buffalo, The eyes of the world are like a fire."

prakrit: "तं मोत्तण पुरवरं,अन्नं देसं गओ सह बलेणं,तत्थ वि नरिन्द-पुर-जणवएण अहिणन्दिओ मुइओ"
english: "The poor man is dying, The food has run out, And the poor man has passed away."

prakrit: "जं जं वच्चइ देसं,सो सो वि य सग्गसन्निहो होइ,धण-धन्न-रयणपुण्णो,दुब्भिक्ख-भयाइपरिमुक्को"
english: "Whatever the world sees, let it be also with good people, Wealthy people, Wretched people, Fearful people."

prakrit: "पुण्णेण परिग्गहिया,ते देसा पुवजम्मसुकएणं,सिरि-कित्ति-लच्छिनिलओ,दहवयणो जेसु संचरइ"
english: "Destroyers of virtue, They devour the flowers of the earth, Steady - thin - limp, Those who practice renunciation Travel the Jesu."

prakrit: "ववगयसिसिर-निदाहे,गङ्गातीरट्ठियस्स रमणिज्जे,गज्जन्तमेहमुहलो,संपत्तो पाउसो कालो"
english: "Spring is sweet, The rivers are swollen, The streams of the Ganges are delightful, The streets are bustling with activity, But the rainy season is short."

prakrit: "धवलबलायाधयवड-विज्जुलयाकणयबन्धकच्छा य,इन्दाउहकयभूसा,झरन्तनवसलिलदाणोहा"
english: "The thunderclap, The lightning flashes, The bandages, The fingernails of the rainbow, The cascade of lilies From the waterfall"

prakrit: "अञ्जणगिरिसच्छाया,घणहत्थी पाहुडं व सुरवइणा,संपेसिया पभूया,रक्खसनाहस्स अइगुरुया"
english: "Anjanagiri - The shadow of the God of Love, Covered with thick handkerchiefs, Like a fragrant garland of jewels, Fills the heart with ecstasy, Like the pyre of fire."

prakrit: "अन्धारियं समत्थं,गयणं रवियरपणट्ठगहचक्कं,तडयडसमुट्टियरवं,धारासरभिन्नभुवणयलं"
english: "Blindness is the same thing, singing is like a pinprick in a poem, Drunken stupor like water, Varying moods in a play."

prakrit: "धारासरभिन्नङ्गो,कन्ता सरिऊण मुच्छिओ पहिओ,पुणरवि आससिओ च्चिय,तीए सुहसंगमासाए"
english: "The doors are ajar, The wheels are twisting, The roads are slipping, The streets are empty, And the streets are deserted."

prakrit: "अहिणवकयम्बगन्धं,अग्घाएऊण मूढमणहियया,जे अमुणियपरमत्था,भमन्ति तत्थेव पहियगणा"
english: "The stench of non - activity, The fire of delusion, That traveler's favorite pastime, Is to cause alarm."

prakrit: "ददुर-मऊर-जलहर-सद्दो वप्पीहयाण एयत्थं,पारद्धं पिव तालं,वारणलीलासहावेणं"
english: "Dadur, maur, jalhar, sadho, vappihayana, etc., imply the flow of water., Accompanied by the lilies of the forest."

prakrit: "सुट्ठ वि उक्कण्ठुलया,पहिया जलफलिहरुद्धपयमग्गा,कन्तासमागममणा,पंखारहिया विसूरेन्ति"
english: "Even the withers are twisted, The wheel is aglow, The road is slippery, The moon is red like a lotus, The fan is full of bees."

prakrit: "हरियतणसामलङ्गी,महिविलया सलिलवत्थपरिहाणी,वरकुडयकुसुमदन्ती,हसइ व दसाणणागमणे"
english: "Lush green, fragrant with the fresh nectar of jasmine, Pretending to be sighing, Smiling and making love."

prakrit: "एवं सुहेण गमिओ,पाउसकालो महन्तघणवन्द्रो,षणयारिपक्खजणवय-सएसु अहिणन्दमाणस्स"
english: "And go in peace, rainy season's heavy clouds, Birds of a feather flocking around the hunter - Such is the life of a non - violent man."

prakrit: "एवं पुण्णफलोदएण पुरिसा पावन्ति तुङ्गं सिरिं,कित्तीछन्नसमत्थमेइणितला भग्गारिपक्खासया,दिवाणं रयणाण होन्ति निलया लोगस्स पुज्जा नरा,पच्छा ते विमलाणुभावचरिया पावन्ति सिद्धालयं"
english: "And when the flowers are plucked, The headman's wife throws a towering lotus at him, Like a banner proclaiming good luck, But when the lamp is switched on He does not perform the worship of the blue lotus. But when it is turned on, He acts as a healer Of faults."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए मरुयजन्नविद्धंसणो जणवयागुरागो नाम एकादसमो उद्देसो समत्तो"
english: "Aunt, The intention of the eleventh day is the same As that of the first day of spring."

prakrit: "एत्तो लङ्काहिबई,समयं मन्तीहि संपहारेइ,कस्स इमा दायबा,दुहिया मे जोबणापुण्णा"
english: "Here is a lame girl. Time is fleeting. Whom can I blame? The poor thing is I'm late."

prakrit: "मन्तीहि वि सो भणिओ,महुराहिवई विसुद्धकुलवंसो,हरिवाहणो त्ति नाम,तस्स य पुत्तो महुकुमारो"
english: "Tell me, mother - in - law, What is the name of the hunter's son? He is the bee's mate, And the farmer his son." ""

prakrit: "सो लक्खणोववेओ,जोवण-बल-विरिय-सत्तिसंपन्नो,तस्सेसा वरकन्ना,दिज्जइ एवंमणो अम्हं"
english: "So behold, young and strong, Sparse and fragrant, Seven hundred and ninety rupees; The bridegroom is dear to me, And I am dear to him."

prakrit: "अह भणइ रक्खसिन्दो,हरिवाहणनन्दणो महुकुमारो,सूरो विणयगुणधरो,लोगस्स य वल्लहो अहियं"
english: "Oh! I speak raksha sindhu, Harivahanananda is the bee, Sura is the observer of virtues, And I am the lover of the world."

prakrit: "हरिवाहणो वि पुत्तं,घेत्तूण दसाणणं समल्लीणो,परितुट्ठो नरवसभो,टुं तं सुन्दरायारं"
english: "Even a coward's son, When he touches a bull, Assemble a herd of oxen, But you, handsome man, You are handsome."

prakrit: "हरिवाहणस्स मन्ती,भणइ तओ इय पहु! निसामेहि,एयस्स सूलरयणं,दिन्नं असुरेण तुटेणं"
english: "" "Dear traveler, tell me,'Come here! Silly girl, It's your turn. Don't let the demon break you.'"

prakrit: "अह जोयणाण संखा,दोण्णि सहस्साणि दोणि य सयाणि,गन्तूण सूलरयणं,पुणरवि य तहिं समल्लियइ"
english: "Ah, the confusion of youth, Two lovers at a time, A deserted town gone astray, To be reassembled there again."

prakrit: "दिन्ना वरकल्लाणी,मणोरमा तस्स महुनरिन्दस्स,वत्तं पाणिग्गहणं,अणन्नसरिसं वसुमईए"
english: "Dinna varakallani, manorma tasa mahunarindasa, vattam panigagahana, spring without rain."

prakrit: "एयन्तरम्मि पुच्छइ,गगनाहं सेणिओ कयषणामो,दिन्नं तिसूलरयगं,केण निमित्तेण असुरेणं?"
english: "At this juncture she asks," "How come I am angry with Gagan?" "I give her a tight slap." "For whose sake, then, is being rude to her?"

prakrit: "तो भणइ इन्दभूई,उप्पत्ती सुणसु सूलरयणस्स,धायइसण्डेरवए,सयदारपुरे दुवे मित्ता"
english: "So speak the God of Love, Then listen carefully, Silly man, In the middle of the night, Friend of two good men."

prakrit: "एक्को स्थ हवइ पभवो,सुमित्तनामो तओ भवे बीओ,एगगुरुसन्नियासे,सिक्खन्ति कलागमं सयलं"
english: "May there be prosperity in one place, may there be bliss in another place, teacher; we learn by doing and by doing."

prakrit: "जाओ रज्जाहिवई,तत्थ सुमित्तो गुणेहि पडिपुण्णो,पभवो वि तेण मित्तो,अप्पसरिच्छो कओ ताहे"
english: "Go, be polite, be courteous, be nice to each other, be a good friend to everyone. So what are you doing out in the open?"

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाई,रण्णं तुरएण पेसिओ सिघं,गहिओ सुमित्तराया,भिल्लेहि अगजसीलेहि"
english: "Oh! my poor coward, Trying to cut through the forest To pacify the angry lion, You silly girl, There must be something wrong with you."

prakrit: "मिच्छाहिवेण दिन्ना,वणमाला तत्थ नरिन्दस्स,परिणेऊण नियतो,सय हारपुरं अह पविठ्ठो"
english: "Wrong views dominate the day, Forests dominate the night, Marriage is the destiny, The sanctum sanctorum is the sanctuary."

prakrit: "दट्ठण मित्तभज्जू,पभवो कुसुमाउहस्त बाणेहिं,विद्धो असत्थदेहो,खणेग आयल्लयं पतो"
english: "One sees a friendly buffalo, One feels the scorching heat, One puts on a white hand, And one loses faith."

prakrit: "दुक्खभरपीडियङ्ग,पभवं दट्ठ ण पुच्छइ सुमितो,दुक्खस्स समुप्पत्ती,कहेहि जा ते षणासेमि"
english: "I am so full of sorrow, I do not ask when I see you, Dear friend, In the midst of sorrow I always hear you."

prakrit: "अह भणइ तत्थ पभवो,वेज्जनरिन्दाग मित्तपुरिसाणं,आहाणओ य लोए,एयाण फुडं कहेयचं"
english: "Oh! what a feast it is to be had there, Like a friendly town full of crooks, Like food in a deserted place."

prakrit: "नमिऊण तस्स चलणे,पभवो परिकहइ दुक्खउप्पत्तो,द₹ण तुज्झ महिलं,सामिय आयल्लयं पतो"
english: "If you ask me, How will I ever make her walk? She turns her back on you With great difficulty. Please, my lady, let her find a good man."

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,भणइ सुमित्तो निसासु वणमालं,वच्च तुमं वीसत्या,पभवसयासं पसनमुही"
english: "Listen to me, sweetheart," he said, "Stop your sighing. It's just you. Tomorrow I'll face my husband again."

prakrit: "गामसहस्सं सुन्दरि,देमि तुमं जइ करेहि मित्तहियं,जइ तं नेच्छसि भद्दे! घोरं ते निग्गहं काई"
english: "Village girl, let me give you something to do, Friend, But if you hate me, you'd better stop! It's just a bunch of crap." ""

prakrit: "भणिऊण वयणमेयं,वणमाला पत्थिया समपओसे,पत्ता पभवागारं,तेण य सा पुच्छिया सहसा"
english: "Tell me, tell me," she said, with a trembling voice: "Are you sure the forest is burning, The leaves are firm, That's why I asked you at once?"

prakrit: "कासि तुमं वरसुन्दरि! केण व कजेण आगया एत्थं?,तीए वि तस्स सिटुं,निययं वीवाहमाईयं"
english: "Who are you, my handsome? Who is it that has brought you here in the first place? It must be her, Sitting on top of her, Destroying the marriage." ""

prakrit: "वट्टइ जावुल्लावो,ताणं तावा''गओ तहिं राया,पच्छन्नरूवधारी,चिट्ठइ भवणन्तरनिलुको"
english: "Vattai javullavo, tanam tavva," "There goes the raja, Wrapped in his own hair, Stands by his words." ""
