prakrit: "सन्नज्झिऊण इन्दो,समयं चिय लोगपालचक्केणं,एरावणमारूढो,विणिग्गओ निययनयराओ"
english: "Look around you, Time is fleeting, People circle around, The roads are slippery, Trades are haphazard And so on."

prakrit: "पडपडह-भेरिपउरं,काहल-वरसङ्खगहिरसद्दालं,रसिऊण समाढत्तं,तूरं घणसद्दनिग्योसं"
english: "Fall - wide open, Spring - hot, Summer - thick, Tremendous... please, don't go dancing around your neck."

prakrit: "सोऊण तूरसई,रक्खससेन्नं पि आयरुप्पित्थं,सन्नज्झिउं पयत्तं,पयत्तं,हय-गय-रह-तुरय-पाइक्कं"
english: "The sun is sharp, The rays of the sun are powerful, The moon is bright, The sea is calm, The sky is clear, The paths are smooth, The rivers are meandering."

prakrit: "सर-सत्ति-चक्क-तोमर-असि-मोग्गरगहियपहरणावरणं,तक्खणमेत्तेण कयं,रणपरिहत्थं तओ सबं"
english: "Sir - Satti - Chakka - Tomar - Asi - Moggar - The forest canopy of the gorge, So what's the matter with that arrow? It's all about the opponent's bow"

prakrit: "विसमाहयतूररवं,तुरङ्गवम्गन्त-चडुलपाइक्कं,रक्खसबलं महन्तं,अभिट्ट इन्दसुहडाणं"
english: "Vismayathurravam, Turanga Vamaganta - Chadulpaikkam, Rakshasabalam Mahantam, Abhitta Indasuhudana"

prakrit: "सुरवइभडेहि एत्तो,फलिहसिलाकुन्तसत्तिषहरेहिं,रक्खसबलस्स पमुहं,भग्गं विवडन्तगय-तुरयं"
english: "Here are the fragrant flowers, The silken buds of the lotus, Seventy-seven rays of the sun, Strong bowed face of the God of Love, With trumpet and flute."

prakrit: "ठूण निययसेन्नं,भज्जन्तं सुरभडेहि संगामे,सवाउहकयजोगा,आवडिया रक्खसा ताणं"
english: "Be steady, burn as much heat as you can muster, Be always vigilant, Be ever vigilant, Always protect yourself."

prakrit: "वज्जो य वज्जवेगो,हत्थ-पहत्थो तहेव मारीई,सुर-सारणो य जढरो,गयणुज्जलमाइया सुहडा"
english: "Vajjo ya vajbego, Hath - pahto the festival is over, Sur - sarano ya jadro, Gaynu jjalmayya suhda."

prakrit: "सन्नद्ध-बद्ध-कवया,दढरोसुज्जलियदप्पमाहप्पा,तह जुज्झिउं पवत्ता,जह इन्दबलं समोसरियं"
english: "Ready - bound - Poet, Wait till the moon is bright, Then fight the warrior woman, For her strength is equal to that of a samoser."

prakrit: "दठूण सेन्नपमुह,भजन्तं रक्खसेहि संगामे,इन्दसुहडा वि ताणं,समुट्ठिया सहरिसुच्छाहा"
english: "See the sage's face, In the company of the devout Rakshasa, Even the pleasures of the moon Are quenched, When the whole city is illuminated"

prakrit: "घणमाली तडिपिङ्गो,जलियक्खो अद्दिपञ्जरो चेव,जलहरमाई एए,जुज्झन्ति समं निसयरेहिं"
english: "Thick sesame seeds, Like water in a thicket, Like a river in spate, Like an endless stream in torrential rain."

prakrit: "हय-जाण-वहियजोहं,दठूण कइद्धओ महिन्दसुओ,उद्धाइओ य सहसा,पसन्नकित्ती रणपयण्डो"
english: "Yes, you clever girl, When you see her you rejoice. When you awaken, Suddenly, your lover shoots a trumpet."

prakrit: "अह मालवन्तपुत्तो,सिरिमाली सरसयाइँ मुञ्चन्तो,पविसरइ सुराणीए,रण्णे जह वणदवो दित्तो"
english: "Ah! the son of Malavant, The headman seeks a mustard seed, The husbandmen search for it, The forest gives forest fires."

prakrit: "सिहि-केसरिदण्डो वि य,उग्गो कणयप्पभाइया सुहडा,जुज्झन्ति तेहि समयं,सिरिमालि-पसन्नकित्तीहिं"
english: "Sweet - Saffron bandage too, angry bridegroom, Lovely couple, It's that time of the year again, Silly - The flowers of the lotus bloom."

prakrit: "सिरिमालीण रणमुहे,एयाण भडाण अद्धयन्देहिं,छिन्नाइँ पडन्ति महिं,सिराइँ जह पङ्कयाई व"
english: "Bees hide among the lotuses, The bees hide in the mud, And the bees hide under the branches That bend at the seams."

prakrit: "दट्ठूण मारिया ते,भिच्चा सयमेव उट्ठिओ इन्दो,धरिओ य अल्लियन्तो,पुत्तेण तओ जयन्तेणं"
english: "Behold, my daughter - in - law! The begging bowl is empty Nowadays it grows thicker Every time I touch it." ""

prakrit: "अच्छ पहू! वीसत्थओ,जावेए रणमुहे विवाडेमि,नक्खेण जं विलुप्पइ,तत्थ य परसूण किं कज्जं?"
english: "Well done! You fool, I beg of you, Let me wander off to war. For what use is the moon to a man who makes love On top of his nose?"

prakrit: "सिरिमालि-जयन्ताणं,आवडियं दारुणं महाजुज्झं,विविहाउहसंघटुं,उट्ठन्तफुलिङ्गजालोहं"
english: "Silly flame, Such a lovely mass of fire, So many different associations, So full of blossoming flames."

prakrit: "सिरिमालीण सहरिसं,चावं आयड्डिऊण कणएणं,विरहो कओ जयन्तो,मुच्छावसवेम्भलो जाओ"
english: "Silly townspeople, Make a mess of it by sitting idle. For who wants to be apart, Let alone cover your face With a mask?"

prakrit: "आसासिऊण समरे,तत्थ जयन्तेण परमरुटेणं,पहओ थणन्तरोवरि,सिरिमालि गयप्पहारेणं"
english: "Assassin's ointment, The supreme bread of abundance, The lotus of the mother - in - law, The garland of lotuses Wrapped around the head."

prakrit: "दट्ठूण विगयजीयं,सिरिमालि इन्दई रणमुहम्मि,वाहेऊण रहबरं,अभिमुहिहूओ जयन्तस्स"
english: "See the wide open sky, See the silhouette of a warrior's face, See how the wife behaves; Face to face with the giants."

prakrit: "रावणपुत्तेण रणे,सुरिन्दपुत्तो सरेहि निब्भिन्नो,रुहिरारुणियसरीरो,गिरि बजह गेरुयालिद्धो"
english: "The son of Ravana roams the streets, The sons of Surindade wander the streets freely, The wives weep bitterly, And the elders weep loudly."

prakrit: "दट्ठूण तं जयन्तं,पुत्तं सरघायरुहिरविच्छड्ड,उद्घाइओ य सहसा,इन्दो एरावणारूढो"
english: "See him triumphantly, son - in - law! A stream of angry tears, Suddenly rising, Sounds like a rainbow." ""

prakrit: "ढक्कारवेण महया,वियडघडा-रह-तुरङ्ग-पाइक्कं,वेढेइ इन्दसेन्नं,समन्तओ इन्दइकुमारं"
english: "The bee with the drum, The weasel with the reed, The stag with the crow, The fowler with the eagles, The hunter with the fowls, Are all indifferent."

prakrit: "आलोइऊण पुत्तं,वेढिजन्तं रणे सुरबलेणं,लङ्काहिवो पयट्टो,इन्दाभिमुहो रहवरत्थो"
english: "My son, The fowler has grown so thin on the fence As to resemble a wild boar." "The lankan elephant is scared of bees, His face is red like the moon"

prakrit: "इन्दस्स लोगपाला,आवडिया रक्खसा य रणसूरा,मुञ्चन्ता सरवरिसं,परोप्परं दारुणामरिसा"
english: "The Indus is the palanquin of the people, The Rakshasa is the doe of the sky, The Sarvarishta is the wretch, The other is a cruel messenger."

prakrit: "असि-कणय-चक्क-तोमर-मोग्गर-करवाल-कोन्त-सूलेहिं,पहरन्ति एकमेक्क,अदिन्नपट्टी रणे सुहडा"
english: "Assi-kanya-chakka-tomar-moggar-karwal-kont-sulehin, Guard each other, Undifferentiated forest, Suhda"

prakrit: "हण हण हण त्ति कत्थइ,कत्थइ खण खण खणन्ति खग्गाइं,तड तड तड त्ति कत्थइ,सद्दो सरभिन्नदेहाणं"
english: "Money begets money, wells spring up, ditches are dug, rivers flow, and then the river flows. All this is due to different gods."

prakrit: "हत्थी हत्थीण समं,आलम्गो रहवरो सह रहेणं,तुरएण सह तुरङ्गो,पाइको सह पयत्येणं"
english: "An elephant is equal to a stag; we live in harmony with one another; the trumpet is with a trumpet; the crow travels with a bird."

prakrit: "सीसगहिएकमेक्का,सामियसम्माणलद्धमाहप्पा,जुज्झन्ति समरसूरा,कायरपुरिसा पलायन्ति"
english: "Seems like a mere trick, Like the nail mark on the head of a warrior's bow, Like a fight between warriors; Cowardly men flee."

prakrit: "जुज्झन्ताण सहरिसं,अन्नोन्नावडियसत्थघायग्गी,पज्जलइ सबओ च्चिय,जणयन्तो सुहडसंतावं"
english: "A town at war, A village by the sea, Illuminated by the rays of the sun, Is a happy place to live."

prakrit: "पडपडह-भेरि-काहल-गयगज्जिय-तुरयहिंसियरवेणं,न सुणन्ति एकमेकं,उल्लावं कण्णवडियं पि"
english: "Covered with gooseflesh, Scorched with smoke, Yellow with trumpeting, Not listening to each other."

prakrit: "खग्ग-सर-सत्ति-तोमर-पहया लोलन्ति केइ महिवढे,पडिउट्ठियं करेन्ता,अवरे हिण्डन्ति वरजोहा"
english: "Khagga - Sir - Satti - Tomar - The traveler's wife is swaying like a bee, Staring at her husband While the bridegroom walks." ""

prakrit: "तक्खणमेत्तुक्कत्तिय-निवडियसिररुहिरदिनचच्चिका,विसमाहयतूररवे,नचन्ति कबन्धसंघाया"
english: "Takkhanmetukkutty - Nivedyasirruhirdinachchikka, Vismayathurrave, Nachanti kabandha sanghaya"

prakrit: "एयारिसम्मि जुज्झे,निवडन्ते सुहडसत्थसंघाए,लङ्काहिवेण भणिओ,अह एत्तो सारही सुमई"
english: "They fight all the time, They gather the very best, Say the Lankahaven. Ah! the sum of all these." ""

prakrit: "वाहेहि रहवरं मे,तुरियं इन्दस्स अहिमुह समरे,किं मारिएहि कीरइ,अन्नेहि अतुलविरिएहिं?"
english: "Vahini rahavaram mein, turiam indus ahimuh samrae, kya mariye keerai, anne hi atul viriyein?"

prakrit: "गुण-रूवअसामन्नं,इन्दत्तं जं इमेण आढत्तं,फेडेमि सबमेयं,गवं विज्जाबलुप्पन्नं"
english: "Virtuous - The color of the hair is immaterial, Whatever is inherent in it is intrinsic to it, Fedemi is everywhere, The cow is brilliantly illuminated."

prakrit: "एवभणिएण सिग्धं,सारहिणा धय-बडायकयसोहो,मण-पवणसरिसवेगो,इन्दाभिमुहो रहो छूढो"
english: "By these words the straight, the wide, the broad, the smooth, the windy, Remove your face from the sky."

prakrit: "ठूण रावणं ते,एजन्तं सुरभडा भउबिग्गा,अह नासिउं पयत्ता,लङ्घन्ता चेव अन्नोन्नं"
english: "Stop crying, you silly girl, Don't be so hasty: There's nothing more to be said for being angry about."

prakrit: "भग्गं ठूण बलं,इन्दो एरावणढिओ कुद्वो,मुञ्चन्तो सरवरिसं,रक्खसनाहस्स अल्लीणो"
english: "Foolish boy, you'll have to kneel down before the God of Love, Who is there to guide you around the world, And who is not there to protect you?"

prakrit: "तं रावणो वि एन्तं,सरवरिसं निययबाणपहरेहिं,सिग्धं दुहा विरिकं,करेइ धगुवेयचलहत्थो"
english: "So is Ravana, Everything is arranged in such a way That it is difficult for him to escape, Because the flame in his hand moves so much."

prakrit: "घेत्तण तो सरोसं,अग्गेयं पहरणं सुरिन्देणं,लकाहिवस्स उवरिं,विसज्जियं जलणपज लियं"
english: "To burn is a torture, To kindle a fire is to burn, To smoke a poison, To make a fire burn is to grovel."

prakrit: "आरोलियं समत्थं,घणतावुम्हवियरक्खसाणीयं,अह रावणेण सिग्धं,वारुणसत्थेण विज्झवियं"
english: "Aureolium is equanimity, density is the ornament of the forehead, I am enlightened by Ravana, knowledge is acquired through Varuna."

prakrit: "इन्देण पुणरवि लहुँ,विसज्जियं तामसं महासत्थं,तं रावणो वि सिग्छ,उज्जोयत्येण नासेइ"
english: "In this world there are rebirths, In the other there is abundance, And in that there is anger, Even at Ravana's instigation."

prakrit: "जमदण्डसरिसरूवा,नायसरा फणमणीसु पज्जलिया,लङ्काहिवेण मुक्का,सयलं बन्धन्ति सुरसेन्नं"
english: "A flock of jasmine snakes, A bunch of funny women, Puzzles thrown by a lankan elephant, Straightforward ties making all the noise."

prakrit: "दट्टण निययसेन्नं,बद्धं नाएहिं विगयसुहवेढें,गरुडत्थेण सुरवई,भुयङ्गपासे पणासेइ"
english: "Through thick mud, Destroyed by fate, Through thickets of reeds, Stretched by the pleasures of love, Through eagles'feathers, Through bows and arrows."

prakrit: "लङ्काहिवो सुरिन्द,दट्टणं नागपासपरिमुक्कं,आरुहइ तक्खणं चिय,भुवणालङ्कारमत्तगयं"
english: "Lankahaivu Surindha, Dandana nagapasa parimukkam, Aruhana takkhana chiya, Bhuvanalankaramatta gayam."

prakrit: "सक्को वि गयवरिन्दे,चडिओ एरावणे गिरिसरिच्छे,जुज्झइ दसाणणेणं,समयं हत्थी वि हत्थीणं"
english: "The hunter is always on the move, The bird is constantly moving through the forest, The dog is constantly on the prowl, And the time is fleeting."

prakrit: "दोण्णि वि महागइन्दा,आवडिया कढिणदप्षमाहप्पा,उत्तुङ्गमुसलदन्ता,उप्पाइयपचया चेव"
english: "Both are great signs; the south wind blows thickly, The south wind whirls, And the north wind blows softly."

prakrit: "दोण्णि वि छुहन्ति घाए,दन्तेसु करेसु पुरिसगत्तेसु,गजन्ति गुलगुलेन्ति य,मेहा इव पाउसे काले"
english: "The two touch, The wounds fester, The teeth quiver, The cheeks grow hoarse, It's as though the rainy season had arrived."

prakrit: "पगलन्तदाणसलिला,- महुयरगुञ्जन्तबद्धपरिवेढा,चवलपरिहत्थदच्छा,जुज्झन्ति रणे महाहत्थी"
english: "A sliver of grass, A fence bristling with bee stings, Eyes hovering above one's cheeks, Are the great warriors in battle."

prakrit: "जाव य जुज्झन्ति गया,ताव च्चिय दहमुहेण सुरनाहो,अभिलचिऊण गहिओ,हत्यारोहं विवाडेउं"
english: "When the fight has reached its climax, The hunter is ready to go, When the hunter has set out on a quest, The slayer will be destroyed."

prakrit: "दिवंसुएण बद्धो,निययगइन्दं च वलइडं सिग्धं,ववगयदप्पुच्छाहो,चन्दो इव राहुगहणम्मि"
english: "The sun is bound to the moon, The moon is fixed on the horizon, The horizon is straight, The sky is clouded by clouds, And the moon is like a rainbow."

prakrit: "घेत्तूण पुणो मुक्को,इन्दसुओ इन्दईण संगामे,किं वा तुसेसु कीरइ,तन्दुलसारम्मि संगहिए?"
english: "Get down, punch again, suck in some fresh air, Tell me, What makes you so angry? It's just the way things are." ""

prakrit: "एत्तो इन्दस्स बलं,सबं गयवर-तुरङ्ग-पाइक्कं,भग्गं पलायमाणं,वेयडगिरिं समणुपत्तं"
english: "Such is the strength of the Indus, All the Gayavar - Turang - Paikam, The rapture is fleeting, Veyadgiri is beyond compare."

prakrit: "घेत्तूण सुराहिवई,दसाणणो निययसाहणसमग्गो,लङ्काहिमुहो चलिओ,छायन्तो अम्बरं विउलं"
english: "Get up, take a bath, Be careful not to fall asleep, For the moon is hovering over your face, And the amber is beginning to wilt."

prakrit: "दट्टण समासन्ने,लङ्कापुरिजणवओ परियणो य,आगन्तूण अभिमुहो,अहिणन्दइ मङ्गलसएसु"
english: "In the thick of the traffic, The Lankapuris are busy making love, Moving towards the visitor, Non - violence is the way to good fortune."

prakrit: "ऊसियसियायवत्तो,सुललियधुवन्तचामराजुयलो,लङ्कापुरिं पविट्ठो,देवावसहिं व देविन्दो"
english: "The God of Love, The King of Silence, The Holy One of Lanka, Is like a god in worship."

prakrit: "संपत्तो निययघरं,नाणाविहमणिमऊहपज्जलियं,जयसदुग्घुट्ठरवो,पुप्फविमाणाउ अवइण्णो"
english: "Wealth is like a fixed house, Like a coin beads, Like the flame of a lamp: Fluttering with excitement, Like an aeroplane in midair."

prakrit: "सन्नद्ध-बद्ध-कवया जिणिऊण सत्तू,आणामिया य बहवे वरभूमिपाला,पुवज्जिएण विमलेण सुहोदएण,लङ्काहिवो रमइ तत्थ सुहावगाढो"
english: "When a warrior is ready, He conquers all; When a woman is carried away, He carries away the spoils of marriage; When women worship, They rejoice; When elephants frolic, There is great joy."

prakrit: "इह पउमचरिए वेयडूगमण-इंदबन्धण-लङ्कापवेसणो नाम बारसमो उद्देसो समत्तो"
english: "O daughter - in - law, The Veydugamana - The Indrabandhana - The name given to the worship of Lanka - Is the same as the intention behind it all."

prakrit: "एत्तो इन्दस्स भडा,पुरओ काऊण तं सहस्सारं,पत्ता रावणभवणं,पडिहारनिवेइओ दिट्ठो"
english: "Here is the bhadra of the Indus, There are thousands of them all over the town. Look also at the Ravan Bhawan, Behind the curtains." ""

prakrit: "काऊण सिरपणामं,उवविट्ठो आसणे समासन्ने,तो भणइ सहस्सारो,दहवयणं आयरतरेणं"
english: "Who is going to say:" "We bow our heads," "When we sit down together, He speaks a thousand words; When we cry out, We clap our hands."

prakrit: "जो तुज्झ पुरिसयारो,निबडिओ विक्रमो पयावो य,मुञ्चसु न किंचि कजं,इमेण इन्देण रुद्धणं"
english: "Whoever it is that is angry with you, Stop threatening me, For no reason at all. Stop being angry with me."

prakrit: "भणइ तओ दहवयणो,जइ मह लङ्काऎ कज्जवकयारं,फेडेहि अपरितन्तो,दियहे दियहे निययकालं"
english: "You fool, If I tell you the truth, You lie. If I lie to you, you lie to me, You deceive."

prakrit: "संमज्जिओवलित्ता,काऊण मही इमाऎ नयरीए,कुसुमेहि अच्चियवा,सुरहिसुगन्धेहि दिवेहिं"
english: "Who is not captivated by a woman's breasts, Which give the air of tenderness, Which, for some reason, give the appearance of fragrance?"

prakrit: "एयारिसे निओगे,अज्जपभूई महं जइ करेहि,मुञ्चामि तओ इन्दं,कत्तो पुण अन्नभेदेणं?"
english: "You fool, If you ask me what I want to eat today I will do it again. So where am I going to find food again?"

prakrit: "जं रावणेण भणिओ,सलोगपालो तओ सहस्सारो,इन्दस्स मोयणढे,अह इच्छइ सबमेयं तु"
english: "As Ravana said:" "If you talk politely, you are welcome." "At the mention of the Indus River, I wish you all the time."

prakrit: "लङ्काहिवेण मुक्को,इन्दो वरदाण-माण-विभवेणं,सम्माणिऊण भणिओ,अज्जषभूई महं भाया"
english: "When the lankan elephant punches, When the elephant throws a garland of flowers, When it shakes its head, It says:" "Honor to me, my dear." ""

prakrit: "भुञ्जसु वेयड्डगिरिं,रहनेउरचक्कवालनयरत्थो,इन्दिय-मणाभिरामं,अणुहवसु सुहं जहिच्छाए"
english: "Bhunjasu veeddagiri, rehne aur chakkavalanyaratho, India - mana bhiram, anuhvasu sukhanachya."

prakrit: "भणिऊण एवमेयं,सहस्सारो सुरवईण संजुत्तो,पत्तो सलोगपालो,रहनेउरचक्कवालपुरं"
english: "Say this out loud :'There are thousands of people dancing around, But the street is deserted.'"" "

prakrit: "निययभवणं पविट्ठो,सक्को विजाहरेहि थुवन्तो,सेसा वि लोगपाला,सपुराइँ गया सपरिवारा"
english: "Destiny is sacred, Suckle with a sharp arrow, But people are clever. The whole family has gone astray."

prakrit: "इन्दो उबिग्गमणो,न य भवणे आसणे धिई कुणइ,न य कुसुमवरुज्जाणे,पउमसरे नेव रमणिज्जे"
english: "It's hot, it's humid, It doesn't make you feel right when you sit in a chair, Nor does it make you sweat." The husband is always so pleasant To his wife.

prakrit: "कन्तासु न देइ मणं,इन्दो चिन्तावरो जिणाययणं,गन्तूण पणमिऊण स,इच्छइ भङ्गं विचिन्तेन्तो"
english: "Give no thought to what's coming from the heart; think only of winning; go ahead, sacrifice your mind; wish only to break it."

prakrit: "धिद्धी! अहो! अकज्जं,किं कीरइ खेयराण रिद्धीए,विजु व चञ्चलाए,इन्दाउहलेहसरिसाए?"
english: "Dhiddhi! Ah! incompetence! What is it to be so anxious about? It is like running out of water, Like being startled by lightning?" ""

prakrit: "ताओ च्चिय विज्जाओ,ते य भडा ते य गय-तुरङ्गा य,तिणसरिसं व भुयबलं,जायं पुण्णावसाणम्मि"
english: "That is true knowledge; that is, the bow and arrow, the axe and the bow, which are the weapons of rebirth."

prakrit: "वेरियनिहेण मज्झं,जाओ लङ्काहिवो परमबन्धू,निस्सारसुहासत्तो,जेणं पडिबोहिओ इहई"
english: "Friend, go away, you silly elephant, You're the only one who can make me laugh. This is the way things happen."

prakrit: "इन्दिय-मणाभिरामं,सर्व मुहसंगमं पयहिऊण,गिण्हामि पावमहणी,पवज्जा जिणवरमयम्मि"
english: "India - Pride of mind, May all facial expressions flourish, I will count the poor ladies, Pride triumphs."

prakrit: "एयम्मि देसयाले,साहू निवाणसंगमो नामं,तं चेव जिणाययणं,अवइण्णो गयणमग्गाओ"
english: "Aimee deshayale, sahu nivana sangamo naam, taise cheve jinayayan, aise indifferent gayanam gaao."

prakrit: "दट्टण मुणिवरिन्द,सको अब्भुट्ठि) सपरितोसो,ओणमियउत्तमङ्गो,वन्दइ परमेण भावेण"
english: "Drenched with mud, Scorched with mud) Satisfied, Onam is in full swing, Praise be to God." ""

prakrit: "साहू वि जहायारं,काऊण जिणिन्दचन्दपडिमाणं,दिन्नासणोवविट्ठो,तवतेयसिरीऎ दिप्पन्तो"
english: "Friend, The moon is bright, The nights are long, And the nights are fleeting."

prakrit: "पुणरवि नमिऊण मुणी,पुच्छइ सको परेण विणएणं,सामिय! कहेहि मज्झं,पुबभवं जं जहावत्तं"
english: "" "Foolish girl, if you ask me again what I knit for you, you'd better ask!" "Say something now:" "It's my husband's birthday." "Write it down."

prakrit: "अह साहिउं पवत्तो,साहू तं पुबजम्मसंबन्धं,कह वि भमन्तेण तुमे,लद्धा वि हु माणुसी जाई"
english: "Ah, my poor girl, Sahu, That is just a pretence. However much you think you speak, Despite the fact that you are a warrior, You are a human being."

prakrit: "नयरे सिहिपुरिनामे,दालिदकुलम्मि तत्थ उप्पन्ना,दुहिया अलक्खणगुणा,वाहीसयपीडियसरीरा"
english: "Nayare sahi puriname, daalidkulammi tatha uppanna, duhya alakhanaguna, vaheesayapedia sarira."

prakrit: "माया पिया य तीए,कालगया दो वि कम्मजोएणं,कहकह वि जीविया सा,लोगुच्छिट्टेण भत्तेणं"
english: "Love is like drinking water, Like the marriage of two lovers, Like being alive for a while, Like a draught of logs."

prakrit: "फुडियकर-पायजुयला,लुक्खसरीरा कुवत्थपरिहाणो,परिभमइ दुक्खियमणा,भेसिज्जन्ती जणवएणं"
english: "The cook is wearing trousers, The hostess is wearing a dress, The traveler is making love, The wife is distressed, The husband is abroad And the wife is abroad."

prakrit: "कम्मपरिनिज्जराए,कालं काऊण तत्थ उववन्ना,किंपुरिसस्स महिलिया,नामेणं खीरधार त्ति"
english: "Time marches on, Time stands still, Women tremble all the time, For no one knows what it is worth."

prakrit: "तत्तो चुया समाणी,रयणपुरे धारिणीऎ गब्भम्मि,गोमुहकुडम्बियसुओ,सहस्सभाओ समुप्पन्नो"
english: "There you are, fair lady, Standing on the river bank Trembling with excitement, Sucking in your cow - dung cakes, Gathering thousands of people."

prakrit: "सम्मत्तं पडिवन्नो,सहस्सभाओ अणुबयसमग्गो,कालं काऊण तओ,सुक्कविमाणे समुप्पन्नो"
english: "Time is of the essence, Decisions are made in succession, Meetings of thousands and thousands, Prostrate affairs take place, Events are concluded in a peaceful manner."

prakrit: "चविऊण विमाणाओ,पुविल्ले रयणसंचए नयरे,गुणवल्लीए पुत्तो,जाओ चिय मणिरए नयरे"
english: "Chew the poison, See that the flowers do not rustle, Know that merit prevails, My son; Go and see that the jasmine does not budge."

prakrit: "अह नन्दिवद्धणो सो,रजं काऊण जिणवरेण समं,पबइओ करिय तवं,गेविजं उत्तम पत्तो"
english: "Ah! thanksgiving, for a king's name is like a jeweler's. But poetry is like that too: It is the noblest of jewels."

prakrit: "अहमिन्दपवरसोक्खं,भोत्तूण चुओ इहं भरहवासे,मणसुन्दरोऎ जाओ,सहसारसुओ तुम इन्दो"
english: "Taste the fragrance of my heart, Sweat it all over, Beautify yourself, Friend, You're the only one who loves me."

prakrit: "इन्दत्तं पडिवन्नो,मणाभिलासेण गब्भसमयम्मि,इह चकवालनयरे,जाओ विजाहराहिबई"
english: "Come on, you silly girl, It's past your prime. Go and win the victory."

prakrit: "किं परितप्पसि दीहं,नह संगामे विणिज्जिओ अहयं?,एयनिमित्तेण तुमं,कम्मकलङ्काउ मुच्चिहिसि"
english: "Why are you distressed, my dear, Or am I merely passing the buck? This is why you conceal your faults in your actions."

prakrit: "किं न सरसि जं पुवं,कीलन्तेण वि य दुण्णएण कयं,तं सर्व फुडवियडं,कहेमि निसुणेहि एगमणो"
english: "Why not make a flower of mustard seeds, Because they are bitter, And because they are astringent? I will tell you the truth." ""

prakrit: "नयरे अरिंजयपुरे,जलणसिहो नाम खेयराहिवई,महिला से वेगवई,दुहिया वि य होइ आहल्ला"
english: "Nayre arinjaypure, Jalnasiho naam kheyraahiwai, Vegwai with women, Duhyahiya viye aholla"

prakrit: "तीए सयंवरट्टे,मिलिया विज्जाहरा बहुवियप्पा,बल-रिद्धिसमुदएणं,तुमं पि पत्तो तहिं चेव"
english: "She is always so attentive, Is extremely knowledgeable, Is always full of energy, And you, too, are always at her feet."

prakrit: "चन्दावत्तपुरुत्तम-सामी आणन्दमालिणो नामं,गहिओ सयंवराए,परभवकम्माणुभावेणं"
english: "Chandavatpuruttam - The name of the lover of fairies, Who is affectionate with women, Brings out the highest state of consciousness."

prakrit: "परिणेऊण नरिन्दो,तं कन्नं रूव-जोवणापुण्णं,रइसागरोवगाढो,भुञ्जइ भोगे सुरवरो व"
english: "Married Narindo, Her ears full of jewels, Her hair like a garland of raisins, Her breasts like sweetmeats."

prakrit: "तत्तो पभूइ तुहयं,ईसावसरोसपसरियसरीरो,न य छड्डसि अणुबन्धं,तस्सुवरिं नन्दिमालिस्स"
english: "There you are, O God of Love, Surprised at the outpouring of your anger. Do not forsake the bondage You have made. Thanks be to you who bear it all."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाई,संजमकम्मोदएण पडिबुद्धो,निक्खमइ नन्दिमाली,चइऊण परिग्गहा-''रम्भं"
english: "Oh! what a strange land, Bowed down by the warm moonlight, Destroyed by the fire of love -" "The rhombus." ""

prakrit: "विहरन्तो संपत्तो,नदीऎ हंसावलीए तीरम्मि,समणसहिओ महप्पा,दिट्ठो य तुमे भमन्तेण"
english: "Vihrant wealth, River, swarm of geese, Friend, great love, Look how you roam!"

prakrit: "ओलक्खिओ य साहू,झाणत्यो पबए रहावत्ते,सरियं ते जं वत्तं,आहल्लाकारणं सबं"
english: "Aunt, The days are fleeting And the nights unreturning. What's the point? It has to do with happiness."

prakrit: "रुटेण तुमे बद्धो,समणो सवेसु चेव अङ्गेसु,तह वि न कम्पइ समणो,मेरू विव वायगुञ्जाहिं"
english: "Because you are bound by rote, You embrace everything that is commanded, Yet you do not tremble at the commandment, For it is as though there were a violent wind."

prakrit: "समणस्स निययभाया,साहू कल्लाणगुणधरो नामं,दट्ट ण य उवसग्गं,रुट्ठो पडिमं समाणेइ"
english: "Renunciation is the norm, Sahu, virtue is the name of the virtuous one, Destiny is not the end, Root is the remover of faults."

prakrit: "कोवाणलेण सिग्धं,डहिऊण निरूविओ समाणेणं,सबसिरीऎ महरिसी,उवसमिओ तुज्झ महिलाए"
english: "Straight from cow - dung, Without burning the fire of love, Lovely lady, Rest assured your wife is well."

prakrit: "सम्मत्तभावियमई,तं महिलं पेच्छिउं दयावन्नो,समणो पसन्नमणसो,जाओ चिय तक्खणं चेव"
english: "I agree, lady, look at that woman. Please, be polite. Go and see how she feels." ""

prakrit: "निम्ममनिरहङ्कारं,जो निन्दइ साहवं दढचरित्तं,आहणइ सवइ मूढो,सो पावइ दीहसंसारं"
english: "Silly man, Who condemns kindness and bad conduct, Who calls all fools: He can save the world in a day."

prakrit: "एवं नाऊण तुमे,पुण्णस्स पराभवस्स य विसेसं,धम्मेण नवरि छिज्जइ,एयं दुक्खासयं सर्व"
english: "And you, my dear, are unique; Dharma begets women; this is the path to sorrow."

prakrit: "सुणिऊण निययचरियं,सक्को संवेगजायसब्भावो,पणमइ मुणी निसण्णो,पुणो पुणो मुणियपरमत्थो"
english: "Listening is routine, Suckling is emotional, Deceit is immutable, Reflecting again and again on one's past."

prakrit: "दाऊणं उवएस,साहू संपत्थिओ निययठाणं,इन्दो वि सयलरज्जे,ठवेई पुत्तं विरियदत्तं"
english: "Daughter - in - law, rich and powerful are bound to fall, India too is bound to prosper, A stubborn son is given free rein."

prakrit: "आपुच्छिऊण सक्को,माया-पिय-सयण-महिलियाओ य,गिण्हइ जिणोवइटुं,पवजं दुक्खमोक्खट्टे"
english: "You fool, Maya - loving - wise - ladies - yes, she counts the wretched ones out., The poor thing is at the mouth of sorrow."

prakrit: "अन्नोन्नजोगकरणेहि तवोविहाणं,काऊण कम्मकलुसस्स य सक्कनासं,उप्पन्ननाणविमलामलसुद्धभावो,इन्दो सिवं उवगओ परिनिट्ठियट्ठो"
english: "What pleasure is there to be had In making friendships, What satisfaction is there in making love, How satisfaction is elicited by doing business, Like the pen of a god."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए इन्दनिव्वाणगमणो नाम तेरसमो उद्देसओ समत्तो"
english: "Proud lady, Your name is Terasmo and these are your intentions."

prakrit: "अह सो सुरिन्दनाहो,मेरुं गन्तूण चेइयहराइं,थोऊण पडिनियत्तो,आगच्छइ निययलीलाए"
english: "Oh! what a delight it is to see me go - between the trees. Once you have passed by, It's as if I were walking beside you."

prakrit: "घणगुरुगभीरसरिसं,सदं सोऊण रावणो खुहिओ,पेच्छइ य पलोयन्तो,कुंकुमवण्णं दिसाचक्कं"
english: "Loud thunder, Loud crashing of drums, Sound of the raven's horn, Seeing as it flies Away, Sounds like a pot of saffron."

prakrit: "परिपुच्छइ मारीई,कस्सेसो मेहसरिसनिग्घोसो?,किं वा इमं समत्थं,भुवणं रत्तारुणच्छायं?"
english: "Whom are you looking out for? Your eyes are red? Who is laughing at you? Your face is smeared with red ghee?"

prakrit: "भणइ तओ मारीई,सुवण्णतुङ्गे अणन्तविरियस्स,लोगा-'लोगपगासं,उप्पन्नं केवलं नाणं"
english: "Speak and you will be killed, People will speak and speak Without ceasing -" "People speak, Wealth is nothing but coin." ""

prakrit: "जन्ताण साहुमूलं,देवाणं एस तूरनिग्घोसो,मणिमउडकिरणपसरिय-रएण भुवणं पि विच्छुरियं"
english: "Animals are precious, The gods are distant, The rays of the jasmine scatter the fragrance of pastime."

prakrit: "सुणिऊण तस्स वयणं,अवइण्णो रावणो जणियतोसो,वन्दइ मुणिवरवसहं,तिक्व॒त्त पयाहिणं काउं"
english: "Listen to that voice, you ignorant Ravana, Speak like a sage. Tell me, Who is the patron saint of women?"

prakrit: "ताव च्चिय पढमयरं,देवा अभिवन्दिऊण उवविठ्ठा,बीओ सुराहिवो इव,तत्था''सीणो दहमुहो वि"
english: "There it is, The first morning, When the gods greet it, And the next morning It's like wine being poured out." Even the fire of sin Is like a flame of fire.

prakrit: "देव-मणुएसु एत्तो,खेयरवसहेसु आसणत्थेसु,सीसेण तत्थ समणो,जोवहियं पुच्छिओ धम्मं"
english: "Here are the gods and the men; Sit here and there sighing; Make your name known to those who ask you a question of dharma."

prakrit: "तो फुड-वियडपयत्थं,निम्मल-निउणं सहावमहुरगिरं,कहिऊण समाढत्तो,बन्धं मोक्खं च मुणिवसहो"
english: "So eat food, drink water, make love among your relatives, Say goodbye to gossip, And be free from attachment."

prakrit: "अट्ठविहकम्मबद्धो,जीवो परिभमइ दीहसंसारं,दुक्खाणि अणुहवन्तो,उदएणं वेयणिज्जस्स"
english: "Be bound by eight vows, Live as long as you can, Endure suffering, Rise and take your vows."

prakrit: "जइ कह वि माणुसत्तं,लभइ य परिनिज्जराऎ कम्माणं,तह वि य न कुणइ धम्म,रस-फरिसवसाणुगो जीवो"
english: "However much humanity, If it finds one's karma to be perfected, It still does not attain dharma. For such a being is a poisonous poison."

prakrit: "रत्ता दुट्ठा मूढा,जे एत्थ कुणन्ति पावयं कम्मं,ते जन्ति नरयलोयं,बहुवेयणसंकुलं घोरं"
english: "A fool is one who twists things so much That they ruin one's chances of succeeding." Those who spice things up are like an ox, Covered with gooseflesh.

prakrit: "वञ्चन्ति महारम्भा,महाहिगरणा परिग्गहमहन्ता,तिबकसायपरिणया,ते वि य नरयं पवजन्ति"
english: "Deceitful is the great head, great is the circumambulation, bitter is the subtlety of nature; they, too, worship hell."

prakrit: "माया-पिइ-गुरु-भाया-भगिणी-पत्ती-सुयं च घाएन्ति,ते चण्डकम्मकारी,वच्चन्ति मइया महानरयं"
english: "They devour the mother - in - law, the elder brother, the younger sister, the leaf, and the needle; they practice moon - acting; they follow the great path of Maya."

prakrit: "मंसरसलुद्धगा वि य,वाउरिया वाह-मच्छबन्धा य,आलीविया वि चोरा,गामा-''गर-देसघाया य"
english: "The poor man is a thief, The woman is a coward, The buffalo is tied to the buffalo's head, And the ox is a robber." "The ox is wounded."

prakrit: "जे वि य मारेन्ति पसू,पुरोहिया होमकारगुज्जुत्ता,गुम्माहिवई वि नरा,ते वि य नरगोवगा हुन्ति"
english: "Anyone who kills an animal, an old man or a cowherd, Who is addicted to liquor, Is also an abomination to hell."

prakrit: "सीह-'च्छभल्ल-चित्तय-तन्तुय-तिमि-मयर-सुंसुमारा य,वच्चन्ति ते वि नरयं,जीवाहारा महापावा"
english: "See -" "Gorgeous - shrivelled - mind - fibrous - whale - hair - scent - Like the rays of the sun They perish, Like a large stream of water." ""

prakrit: "पाडिप्पवग-बलाया,गिद्धा कुरुला य वञ्जुला चेव,उरगा महोरगा वि य,सबे ते नरयषहगामी"
english: "Padippavaga - Balaya, Vulture Kurula or Vanjula Cheva, Orga Mahoraga too, They are all doomed to perish."

prakrit: "एए उ महारम्भा,भणामि एत्तो महाहिगरणा य,जे नरवईण मन्ती,दूया आएसदाया य"
english: "Oh! my greatness, I say: Such a great man, who thinks in terms of men, Is only given to others."

prakrit: "ईसत्थउवज्झाया,विसजोगपउञ्जणा अलियवादी,मरिऊण जन्ति निरयं,नरिन्दनेमित्तिया जे य"
english: "I will never forget how angry you were, How jealous you made love, How careless you are when you die, What pleasure you got from loving someone else."

prakrit: "अन्ने वि एवमाई,वायाए अज्जिणन्ति जे पावं,ते सवे अहिगरणा,हवन्ति नरओवगा मणुया"
english: "Everything is impermanent, Everything that passes must pass, For man is like a man possessed by a demon."

prakrit: "चक्कहरा य नरिन्दा,मण्डलिया रट्ठसामिणो जे य,अन्ने वि एवमाई,बहवे नरओवगा होन्ति"
english: "The wheel is Narinda, The chariot is Mandalia, And so is the buffalo. The buffalo turns into a man"

prakrit: "मण-वयण-कायगुत्तं,निरहंकारं जिइन्दियं धीरं,समणं च जो दुगुञ्छइ,सो वि य नरयं समज्जेइ"
english: "One who desires virtue, modesty, patience, and modesty understands vice."

prakrit: "एवंविहा य जीवा,नरए वहुवेयणा समुप्पन्ना,छिज्जन्ति य भिज्जन्ति य,करवत्त-'सिपत्त-जन्तेसु"
english: "And the living creatures that live here, Like men spoilt by wine, Like water that has boiled or soaked, Act like warriors -" "Sipatta-jantesu" ""

prakrit: "सीहेसु य वग्घेसु य,पक्खीसु य लोहतुण्डमाईसु,खजन्ति आरसन्ता,पावा पावन्ति दुक्खाई"
english: "Bees are like tigers, Birds are like peacock's tail, Treasure is like a rainbow, Birds find treasure and bees make love."

prakrit: "जे पुण नियडीकुडिला,कूडतुला-कूडमाणववहारी,रसभेदिणो य पावा,जे य ठिया करिसणाईसु"
english: "If you want to have a good night's sleep, Wear cool clothes, Drink plenty of fluids, And do your best."

prakrit: "अन्ने वि एवमाई,इन्दियवसगा विमुक्कधम्मधुरा,अट्टज्झाणेण मया,ते वि य गच्छन्ति तिरियगई"
english: "Still the same, you stupid fool, Foolish girl, I've no time for words But they go away as well."

prakrit: "निच्चं भयदुयमणा,असण-तिसा-वेयणापरिग्गहिया,अणुहोन्ति तिरियजीवा,तिक्खं दुक्खं निययकालं"
english: "I have no fear, My heart is full of longing, It is as thin as a thread, It has no life left in it, Sharp is the period of sorrow"

prakrit: "गो-महिसि-उट्ट-षसुया,तणचारी एवमाईया बहवे,मरिऊण होन्ति मणुया,मन्दकसाया नरा जे य"
english: "A cow - buffalo - camel - bull, A wasp - eating fowl, A woman whose limbs are swollen by the heat, A man who is bent on dying, Is not worthy to suffer such a fate"

prakrit: "आरिय-अणारिया वि य,कुलेसु अहमुत्तमेसु उववन्ना,अप्पाउया य दीहाउया य जीवा सकम्मेसु"
english: "Aarya - Anarya viz., Kuleshu, Ahmutmesu, Uvanna, Apaouya, Dihauya, Jiva, Sakmesu." ""

prakrit: "केएत्थ अन्ध-बहिरा,मूया खुज्जा य वामणा पङ्गु,धणवन्ता गुणवन्ता,केइ दरिदेण अभिभूया"
english: "Where are the blind, the deaf, the mute, the lame, the wealthy, the virtuous? Some people are overcome by poverty."

prakrit: "लोभमहागहगहिया,केई पविसन्ति रणमुहं सूरा,अवरे य सायरवरे,वीईसंघट्टकल्लोले"
english: "Greed is great, There are only sinners Who win the battle, And there are sinners who lose heart Even in the midst of fierce battles."

prakrit: "केएत्थ अडविमझे,सत्थाहा पविसरन्ति बीहणयं,अन्ने वि करिसणाईवावारसएसु संजुत्ता"
english: "Wherever there is adversity, There is always plenty of wind blowing, And everywhere there is plenty of good and bad."

prakrit: "एवं मणुयगईए,सबत्तो जाणिऊण दुक्खाइं,सहरागसंजमा वि य,करेन्ति धम्मं बहुवियप्पं"
english: "And being mindful, knowing all sorrows, Even the slightest resentment, Makes Dharma more abundant."

prakrit: "पञ्चाणुवयजुत्ता,केएल्थ अकामनिज्जराए य,एवंविहा मणुस्सा,मरिऊण लहन्ति देवत्तं"
english: "The fire of the five senses, Like the thunderbolt of the sky, Like humans on the move, Destroys the gods."

prakrit: "केएत्थ भवणवासी,वन्तर-जोइसिय-कप्पवासी य,जोगविसेसेण पुणो,हवन्ति अहमुत्तमा देवा"
english: "Where are the forest dwellers, The hunter-gatherer, The woodpecker, Living in the jungle again and again? The sky is the supreme god."

prakrit: "एवं चउप्पयारे,संसारे संसरन्ति कम्मवसा,जीवा मोहपरिणया,तं सिवसोक्खं अपावेन्ता"
english: "And behold, the whole world is aglow with activity; The soul, being captivated, Attracts it with the pleasures of love."

prakrit: "दाणेण वि लभइ नरो,सुमाणुसत्तं तहेव देवत्तं,जं देइ संजयाणं,चारित्तविसुद्धसीलाणं"
english: "Charity alone confers virtue, the supreme being, and the supreme deity, Which gives wisdom, The purest seal among four."

prakrit: "जे नाण-संजमरया,अणन्नदिट्ठी जिइन्दिया धीरा,ते नाम होन्ति पत्तं,समणा सबुत्तमा लोए"
english: "One who is content with wealth, Who has endured enough to live without it, Is worthy of the name Hanti Patam; His name alone testifies to it."

prakrit: "सुह-दुक्खेसु य समया,जेसिं माणे तहेव अवमाणे,लाभा-'लाभे य समा,ते पत्तं साहवो भणिया"
english: "Suh - Dukhisu ya samaya, As the gods take pride in showing disrespect, Labha -" "As the time goes by, So does the leaf sahava." ""

prakrit: "भावेण य जं दिन्नं,फासुयदाणोसहं मुणिवराणं,तं इन्दियाभिरामं,विउलं पुण्णप्फलं होइ"
english: "Whatever love gives, Succeeds in trapping it, And whatever love takes, It triumphs in India."

prakrit: "मिच्छदिट्ठीण पुणो,जं दिज्जइ राग-दोसमूढाणं,आरम्भपरिणयाणं,तं चिय अफलं हवइ दाणं"
english: "A wrong view begets a wrong belief; What gives rise to a raga - a couple of sentences, A fait accompli - That gives it extraordinary air."

prakrit: "कूएक्करसजलेणं,अहिसित्ता पायवा बहुवियप्पा,तित्तं च महुर-कडुया,हवन्ति निययाणुभावेणं"
english: "Water from the well, Too much water on the path, Too little water, Too bitter - bitter - must be the nature of fate."

prakrit: "एवमिह भत्तमेयं,सुसीलवन्ताण सीलरहियाणं,दिन्नं अन्नम्मि भवे,सुहमसुहफलावहं होइ"
english: "May I have a good time, May my days be uneventful, may my pleasures bear fruit."

prakrit: "अप्पसरिसाण दाणं,जं दिजइ कामभोगतिसियाणं,तं न हु फलं पयच्छइ,धणियं पि हु उज्जमन्ताणं"
english: "Give charity, which gives pleasure, But does not produce fruit; Wealth, too, is a powerful weapon."

prakrit: "हा! कट्ठ चिय लोओ,कहयं वेयारिओ कुलिङ्गीहिं,कुम्गन्थकत्थएहिं,उम्मग्गपलोट्टजीवेहिं?"
english: "Hey! How are you doing, you silly boy! Where did you get your bracelets from? You stupid girl, You stupid bitch?" ""

prakrit: "उवइ८ चिय मंसं,जागं काऊण भुञ्जह न दोसो,इन्दियवसाणुरोहिं,परलोगनियत्तचित्तेहिं"
english: "Foolish mind, wake up, don't blame the cow - dung cakes, For being poisonous to the human body, Like a poisonous poison."

prakrit: "काऊण धम्मबुद्धी,जे मंसं देन्ति जे य खायन्ति,उभओ वि जन्ति नरयं,तिवमहावेयणं घोरं"
english: "Those who believe in dharma, Those who eat what is good for the soul, Are as good as dead: The burning of the fire is most heinous."

prakrit: "जइ वि हु तवं महन्तं,कुणइ य तित्थाभिसेवणं सयलं,मंसं च जो न भुञ्जइ,तं तेण समं न य भवेज्जा"
english: "However great you may be, As long as you practice righteousness, You will never be equal to a man Who does not bow down."

prakrit: "गो-इत्थि-भूमिदाणं,सुवण्णदाणं च जे पउञ्जन्ति,ते पावकम्मगरुया,भमन्ति संसारकन्तारे"
english: "The cow - the elephant - The land - Donation, the golden offering - They fall by the wayside. They wander the ends of the world." ""

prakrit: "बन्धण-ताडण-दमणं,तु होइ गाईण दारुणं दुक्खं,हल-कुलिसेसु य पुहई,दारिज्जइ जन्तुसंघायं"
english: "Tie, clap, tame, you'll be the worst kind of grief in all singing. When the plowman has reached his goal, The poor animal will join him."

prakrit: "जो वि हु देइ कुमारी,सो वि हु रागं करेइ गिद्धिं च,रागेण होइ मोहो,मोहेण वि दुग्गईगमणं"
english: "Whatever a virgin gives me, that too I grudge and swallow. Anger is seductive, And deceit is debauchery."

prakrit: "हेमं भयावहं पुण,आरम्भ-परिग्गहस्स आमूलं,तम्हा वजन्ति मुणी,चत्तारि इमाणि दाणाणि"
english: "I am fearful again, The beginning is fleeting, The climax is surreal, Your voice is thunderous, And your words are thunderous."

prakrit: "नाणं अभयपयाणं,फासुयदाणं च भेसनं चेव,एए हवन्ति दाणा,उवट्ठा वीयरागेहिं"
english: "Wealth is an inexhaustible supply, Deceit is a disguise, Pretending to be a pawn, Like a band of warriors."

prakrit: "नाणे उ दिवनाणी,दीहाऊ होइ अभयदाणेणं,आहारेण य भोगं,पावइ दाया न संदेहो"
english: "No doubt about it, my dear, It's been a long day, Thanks to you, Eating and drinking isn't the answer."

prakrit: "लहइ य दिवसरीरं,साहूणं भेसजस्स दायारो,निरुवमअङ्गोवङ्गो,उत्तमभोगं च अणुहवइ"
english: "Every day is a struggle, The poor man in disguise, The landowner in poverty, The hunter in distress, And the good woman in want of pleasure."

prakrit: "जह वड्वइ बडबीयं,पुहइयले पायवो हवइ तुङ्गो,तह मुणिवराण दाणं,दिन्नं विउलं हवइ पुण्णं"
english: "As the farmer sows, So the farmer's field grows, So does the beekeeper's corn., In one day the farmer will reap The rewards of hard work."

prakrit: "जह खेत्तम्मि सुकिट्टे,सुबहुत्तं अब्भुयं हवइ बीयं,तह संजयाण दाणं,महन्तपुण्णावहं होइ"
english: "As the jasmine withers, As the early morning breeze carries the seeds, So does the charity of sunshine, May the great be perfected."

prakrit: "जह ऊसरम्मि बीयं,खित्तं न य तस्स होइ परिवुड्डी,तह मिच्छत्तमइलिए,पत्ते अफलं हवइ दाणं"
english: "As soon as a seed is sown, If it does not germinate Then it goes astray, As when a leaf is unripe The kernel is damaged."

prakrit: "सद्धा सत्ती भत्ती,विन्नाणेण य हवेज जं दिन्नं,तं दाणं विहिदिन्नं,पुण्णफलं होइ नायबं"
english: "Truth alone triumphs; what we give out in charity, we withhold; the reward is sure to come."

prakrit: "विविहाउहगहियकरा,सवे देवा कसायसंजुत्ता,कामरइरागवसगा,निच्चकयमण्डणाभरणा"
english: "Diverse people, all gods, But one man stands in the way: The woodcutter is at hand, His work is done, And his heart is set on fire."

prakrit: "जे एवमाइ देवा,न हु ते दाणस्स होन्ति नेयारो,सयमेव जे न तिण्णा,कह ते तारन्ति अन्ननणं?"
english: "One who does not eat anything else, Who is not a god, Is not a hunter of gifts?"

prakrit: "जइ पङ्गुलेण पङ्ग,निजइ देसन्तरं सखन्धेणं,तह एएसु वि धम्मो,देवेसु न एत्थ संदेहो"
english: "If a person is paralyzed by a limp, One should seek refuge in one's own country, For this is the dharma; Do not doubt it, O god."

prakrit: "जे य पुण वीयरागा,तित्थयरा सबदोसपरिमुक्का,ते होन्ति नवरि लोए,उत्तमदाणस्स नेयारा"
english: "One who is completely free, who has overcome all faults, is a novice in the world; the leader of good men is not."

prakrit: "जे जिणवराण धम्मं,करेन्ति पडिमाण तिण्णसङ्गाणं,पूयासु य उज्जुत्ता,ते होन्ति सुरा महिड्डीया"
english: "One who observes dharma, who practices penance, who experiences ecstasy, who is completely enlightened - that is, the God of Love."

prakrit: "धयवडय पट्टयं वा,धूवं दीवं च जे जिणाययणे,देन्ति नरा सोममणा,ते वि य देवत्तणमुवेन्ति"
english: "Those who give victory to the gods, Like the banner of victory, Like smoke and lamp, Do not commit adultery; They are worshipers of the gods."

prakrit: "एवंविहं तु दाणं,दाऊण नरा परंपरसुहाई,भोत्तूण देवमणुयत्तणम्मि पच्छा सिवं जन्ति"
english: "In this way you are a charity, Not a charity without tradition, But a god who knows the faults of nature Like a wise lion."

prakrit: "सुणिऊण भाणुकण्णो,दाणं सयवित्थरं कयपणामो,पुच्छइ अणन्तविरियं,सामिय धम्म परिकहेहि"
english: "One who listens shares what one has to say, Who gives charity to others, Asks questions without ceasing; A true follower of dharma"

prakrit: "तो भणइ अणन्तबलो,दुविहो धम्मो जिणेहि उवइट्ठो,सायार निरायारो,सो वि हु बहुपज्जओ होइ"
english: "He says," "Be strong, both right and wrong, Always be vigilant, Always remain vigilant, And always be vigilant." ""

prakrit: "हिंसा-'लिय-चोरिका मेहुण-परिग्गहस्स नियत्ती,एयाइं पञ्च महत्वयाणि समणाण भणियाणि"
english: "Violence -" "Liye - chorika brother - in - law - Destiny is the periphery, these are the five great vows." ""

prakrit: "इरिया भासा तह एसणा य आयाणमेव निक्खेवो,उच्चाराई समिई,पञ्चमिया होइ नायबा"
english: "Iriyah is a slang word, Such is the nature of such words That one does not know how to pronounce them."

prakrit: "मणगुत्ती वयगुत्ती,तहेव कायस्स जा हवइ गुत्ती,एयाउ मुणिवरेणं,निययमिह धारियबाओ"
english: "The plowman's daughter is about to depart. When will she leave? It's the jasmine's son, Who will rule forever and ever!"

prakrit: "कोहो माणो माया,लोभो रागो य दोससंजुत्तो,एए निरुम्भियबा,देहे लीणा महासत्तू"
english: "Anger is like pride, Greed is like anger or enmity, Jealousy is like jealousy, Being indifferent is like a heavy burden."

prakrit: "अणसणमूणोयरिया,वित्तीसंखेव कायपरिपीडा,रसपरिचागो य तहा,विवित्तसयणासणं चेव"
english: "Unreasonable woman, How distressing it is to store money, Whether it be for a pastime Or simply for that matter, Vivid meditation is the way to go."

prakrit: "पायच्छित्तं विणओ,वेयावच्चं तहेव सज्झाओ,झाणं चिय उस्सग्गो,तवो य अन्भिन्तरो एसो"
english: "Weave the pyre, Decorate the altar on the altar, Make the fire abound, For there is nothing more to be done There."

prakrit: "एसो बारसभेओ,होइ तवो जिणवरेहि उद्दिट्टो,कम्मट्ठनिज्जरटुं,करेन्ति समणा समियपावा"
english: "Here are the bars: The more one touches them, the more one has to work hard. Time will tell." ""

prakrit: "देहे वि निरवयक्खा,निरहंकारा जिइन्दिया धीरा,बारसअणुपेक्खासु य,निययं भावन्ति अप्पाणं"
english: "The body is also free from illness, The arrogant live patiently, Forget about the wind, Fate will judge for itself."

prakrit: "वासी-चन्दणसरिसा,मन्नन्ति सुहं तहेव दुक्खं वा,जत्थत्थमियनिवासी,सीहा इव निब्भया समणा"
english: "The inhabitant - The sandalwood tree, Believing that happiness and sorrow are one and the same, An inhabitant of the earth, Fearful of the river and of the sea."

prakrit: "धरणी विव सबसहा,पवणो इव सबसङ्गपरिमुक्का,गयणं व निम्मलमणा,गम्भीरा सायरं चेव"
english: "The earth is vast, The winds blow with all its might, The rivers churn, The songs play softly, The sighs are loud."

prakrit: "सोमा निसायरं पिव,तेएण दिवायरं व दिप्पन्ता,मेरु व धीरगरुया,विहगा इव सङ्गपरिहीणा"
english: "Soma drinks nymphomaniacally, therefore is dimwitted and aloof, Meru is impatient and impetuous, Vihga is thus without mate."

prakrit: "अट्ठारस य सहस्सा,सोलङ्गाणं धरन्ति सप्पुरिसा,चिन्तन्ता परमपयं,विहरन्ति अणाउला समणा"
english: "Eighteen thousand yaws bear the brunt, The sapphurishas carry the Solangas, The contemplative ones the supreme lovers, The wise ones the immodest."

prakrit: "उप्पन्नरिद्धि-विहवा,जिणवरधम्मेण साहवो धीरा,तवसिरिविहूसियङ्गा,अब्भुयकम्माणि कुबन्ति"
english: "Upanariddhi-vihava, dheera sahabo dharma mein, tavsiri vihusiyanga, abhuyakammani kubanthi."

prakrit: "केएत्थ दियसनाहं,नित्यं तक्खणेण कुवन्ति,उच्छाइऊण चन्दं,केई मेह व वरिसन्ति"
english: "Where are we going to sleep forever? The moon will rise, There will be clouds and rain clouds."

prakrit: "चालन्ति मन्दरगिरि,नभेण वच्चन्ति पवणसमवेगा,चलणरएण मुणिवरा,पसमन्ति अणेयवाहीओ"
english: "A walking temple, A breeze is blowing from the south, The rainy season is approaching, The moon is setting with its movements, The dry land is drying up And the rivers are in spate."

prakrit: "महु-खीर-सप्पिसविणो,अमयस्सविणो य कोट्ठबुद्धी य,केई पयाणुसारी,अवरे संभिन्नसोया य"
english: "Honey, kheer, lack of taste, wisdom without guile, Some people are like travelers; They have different tastes."

prakrit: "एवंविहा य समणा,कालं काऊण निययजोगेणं,ठाणाइँ देवलोए,पावन्ति सिवालयं केइ"
english: "And what a feast it is to be had here, For how long shall I have to wait? It is the temple of the God of Love, For where does the fire reach?"

prakrit: "उववन्ना कयपुण्णा,सोहम्माईसु वरविमाणेसु,केई हवन्ति इन्दा,सामाणिय अङ्गरक्खा य"
english: "You look so handsome, You smile so much, They look so different, They resemble the inside of a person's body."

prakrit: "एवं बहुप्पयारा,अहमुत्तम-मज्झिमा सुरा भणिया,अवरे वि य अहमिन्दा,केइत्थ सिवालयं पत्ता"
english: "And many a traveler, The most ahimsa - loving woman, He is always so forthright. Where then, my dear, Is the leaf of silence?"

prakrit: "अह तत्थ देवलोए,बहुभत्तिविचित्तकन्तिकलियाई,देवाण विमाणाई,सूर पिव पज्जलन्ताई"
english: "Ah! the gods there, The many - eyed kantikaliyas, The Gods fly in planes, The sun shines brightly."

prakrit: "वजिन्दनील-मरगय-वेरुलियविचित्तभत्तिरम्माई,दढवियडपेढनिग्गय थम्भसहस्सोहनिवहाई"
english: "Vazindanil - The husbandman's wife - A tremulous beauty, Like a column of smoke rising from a dead tree."

prakrit: "गय-वसह-सरह-केसरि-वराह-रुरु-चमरकोट्टिमतलाइं,मिउपवणबलाघुम्मिय-नचन्तधयग्गहत्थाइं"
english: "Gone - Wrapped - Surrounded - Saffron - Varaha - Stirred - Lays on the roof of the Chamarkottai, Young girls twitching and twisting - Hands clutching their bracelets"

prakrit: "गोसीससरसचन्दण-कालागरुसुरहिधूवगन्धाइं,जलथलयकुसुमबहुविह–कयच्चणाई विमाणाइं"
english: "The fragrance of the scent of the sage - The fragrant fragrances of the jasmine - Like the rays of the crescent moon." ""

prakrit: "गन्धवगीय-वाइय-वीणा-वरवंसमहुरसदाइं,एयारिसेसु देवा,भुञ्जन्ति महन्तसोक्खाइं"
english: "The fragrant flowers of the gandh - Vaiyya - Veena - Varavamsamahuras, The gods who fly, Who roast, Who enjoy great pleasures."

prakrit: "रयणमिव निरुवलेवा,मंस-'ट्ठिविवज्जिया अणोवङ्गा,देवा अगब्भनाया,अणिमिसनयणा सभावेणं"
english: "The mind is immovable, The senses are infinite, The gods are invisible, The courts are impermanent."

prakrit: "समचउरंसट्टाणा,मणिमउड-विचित्तकुण्डलाभरणा,अमरबहूमज्झगया,रमन्ति रइसागरोगाढा"
english: "Samachuran Sthana, Manimood - Vichitakundala Bharana, Amar Bahumajjajjagaya, Ramanti Raisagarogadha"

prakrit: "तत्थ य सुरवहुयाओ,वियसियवरपउमसरिसवयणाओ,नयण-इसणा-'इरा-'मलथणजुयलुब्भिन्नसोहाओ"
english: "That's why the women are so beautiful, The flowers are so fragrant, The bathrooms are so empty, The bedsheets are so tiny, The nights are so long." ""

prakrit: "रत्तासोगसमुज्जल-कोमलकर-चरण-पिहुलसोणीओ,छन्दाणुवत्तणीओ,सहावमि उ-मणहरगिराओ"
english: "The rays of the sun illuminate the whole sky - soft and fragrant, The feet thrill, The ears twitch, The wind stirs the sky - Gorgeous roars."

prakrit: "एयारिसासु समयं,देवीसु मणोहरं विसयसोक्खं,भुञ्जन्ति निययकालं,देवा धम्माणुभावेणं"
english: "The air is auspicious, The gods rejoice, Destiny roasts, And the gods tremble."

prakrit: "जे वि य ते अहमिन्दा,गेविजाईसु वरविमाणेसु,उवसन्तमोहणिज्जा,सोक्खमणन्तं अणुहवन्ति"
english: "Whatever they ask for, I promise, They will give it to you, Always delighting in it, Until they taste it."

prakrit: "सिद्धालयम्मि पत्ता,समणा जे सबसङ्ग उम्मुक्का,ते तत्थ अणन्तसुह,अणन्तकालं अणुहवन्ति"
english: "The leaf of perfection, the pledge that unites all, There is boundless happiness, Endlessly renewed."

prakrit: "सयलम्मि वि तेलोक्के,जं होइ नरा-'मराण विसयसुहं,तं सिद्धाण न अग्वइ,अणन्तकोडीण भागम्मि"
english: "Even a dry lotus is oil, Whatever it is, it's not oil -" "To die is a vast pleasure, It cannot be perfected, It's a succession of endless bumps." ""

prakrit: "देवाण माणुसाण य,जं सोक्खं होइ सयलजियलोए,तं सर्व धम्मफलं,जिणवरवसहेहि परिकहियं"
english: "Whatever pleasure one gets from being a human being, that too with right views; I welcome it with all my heart."

prakrit: "देवत्तं इन्दत्तं,अहमिन्दत्तं च जं च सिद्धत्तं,तं सर्व मणुयभवे,जीवा धम्मेण पावन्ति"
english: "Whatever is the principle of divinity, of existence, of non - existence, is realized through Dharma."

prakrit: "जह पंक्खिणाण गरुडो,राया सीहो य सब पसवाणं,तह माणुसो भवाणं,गुणेहि दूरं समुबहइ"
english: "As the fanatic Garuda, Raya Siho, and all the pasawans, So is human emotion. Only virtues attain greatness."

prakrit: "एक्को गुणो महन्तो,मणुयभवे जो न होइ अन्नत्तो,जं जाइ इओ मोक्खं,जीवो कम्मक्खयं काउं"
english: "One virtue is great, human life is endless, wherever one goes there is liberation; the soul is the arrow of karma."

prakrit: "जह सागरम्मि नटुं,रयणं न य पेच्छए गवेसन्तो,तह धम्मेण विरहिओ,जीवो न य लहइ मणुयभवं"
english: "One who does not see the ocean, When one is in search of the sky, Is separated by dharma; Either one lives or one dies, This is human behavior."

prakrit: "एवं केवलिविहियं,धम्मं सोऊण परमसद्धाए,अह भणइ भाणुकण्णो,अणन्तविरियं पणमिऊणं"
english: "And only in marriage, When dharma is supreme, Do I say it out loud, Constantly asking for favors."

prakrit: "अज्ज वि न वीयरागो,भयवं! भोगाभिलासिणो अहयं,उग्गं तवोविहाणं,असमत्थो समणधम्मम्मि"
english: "Even now I am not afraid, be not afraid! For I am consumed by desire. Once I am awake I can never go out again." ""

prakrit: "तो भणइ अणन्तबलो,गिहत्थधम्मं सुणाहि एगमणो,काऊण जं विमुच्चसि,कमेण संसारवासाओ"
english: "So you speak without ceasing, you stubborn man, You fool, You worldly dweller."

prakrit: "सोयार निरायारो,दुविहो धम्मो जिणेहि उवइट्टो,समणाण निरायारो,होइ गिहत्थाण सायारो"
english: "The hearer is restless, Both dharmas are won, Both vows are vain, And the hunter is weary of silence."

prakrit: "कहिओ ते पढमयरं,धम्मो साहूण महरिसीणं तु,एत्तो सावयधम्म,सुणाहि सायारचारित्तं"
english: "Tell me, mother - in - law, That you are a sage, Your dharma is Sahoon, Such is the pure dharma, Listen, my lord, to your conduct."

prakrit: "पञ्च य अणुबयाई,तिण्णेव गुणवयाइ भणियाई,सिक्खावयाणि एत्तो,चत्तारि जिणोवइट्ठाणि"
english: "The five are powerful, the three are talented, the two are eloquent, the one is learned, and the other is won."

prakrit: "थूलयरं पाणिवहं,मूसावायं अदत्तदाणं च,परजुवईण निवित्ती,संतोसवयं च पञ्चमयं"
english: "Water is for the plowman, Musa for the shepherd, Adat for the donkey, Nivitti for the midwife, and Pancham for the merrymaker."

prakrit: "दिसिविदिसाण य नियमो,अणत्थदण्डस्स वजणं चेव,उवभोगपरीमाणं,तिण्णेव गुणबया एए"
english: "The sight of the God of Love is the law, The weight of hatred is the burden, The taste of love is the criterion, And the virtues of love are everything."

prakrit: "सामाइयं च उववासपोसहो अतिहिसंविभागो य,अन्ते समाहिमरणं,सिक्खासु वयाइँ चत्तारि"
english: "Time and again it has been a struggle, Too much division, And finally, mass death. Even the Sikhs cry out for help."

prakrit: "राईभोयणविरई,महु-मंस-सुराविवज्जणं भणियं,पूया-सोलविहाणं,एसो धम्मो गिहत्थाणं"
english: "Without fear of rebirth, honey - Manasa - Suravibhijna - Vanim, Puya - Sol - Vivahana; this is the greatness of Dharma."

prakrit: "एवं सावयधम्म,काऊण नरा विसुद्धसम्मत्ता,मरिऊण नन्ति सग्गं,सोहम्माईसु कप्पेसु"
english: "And save dharma, For who does not renounce righteousness, Shall not prosper in death, Please, dear girl, Keep your senses closed."

prakrit: "देवत्ताओ मणुया,होन्ति पुणो सुरवरा महिड्डीया,सत्त'द्य भवे गन्तुं,सिद्धिं पावन्ति धुयकम्मा"
english: "The gods are human, The spring is hot again, The rainy season is on its way, The dry land is dry And the straight road leads to perfection."

prakrit: "लहिऊण माणुसत्तं,जो धम्मं जिणवराण सद्दहइ,सो वि हु न दीहकालं,परिहिण्डइ नरय-तिरिएसु"
english: "However long humanity lasts, The one who conquers dharma Will not last long. The other is doomed to perish."

prakrit: "जो पुण सम्मपिट्ठो,जिणपूया-विणय-वन्दणाभिरओ,सो वि य कमेण पावइ,निवाणमणुत्तरं सोक्खं"
english: "One who embraces virtue, who is fearful of falsehood, Who is averse to worship, Weeps, and groans, Still manages to attain karma; The answer to liberation lies in happiness."

prakrit: "निस्सङ्कियाइएसुं,गुणेसु सहिया य सावया परमा,अभिगयजीवा-'जीवा,ते होन्ति महिड्डिया देवा"
english: "Undisturbed by these qualities, The sahitya understands what is to be done, And the soul knows what it wants -" "Life, the great God of Love." ""

prakrit: "जो कुणइ ससत्तीए,अहमुत्तम-मज्झिमं नरो धम्म,सो लहइ तारिसाई,ठाणाई देवलोगम्मि"
english: "One who is virtuous observes dharma, the highest good, and is devoted to it; one who is generous observes it."

prakrit: "अह भणइ मुणिवरिन्दो,एत्तो तव-संजमं बहुवियप्पं,जं काऊण मणूसा,अक्खयसोक्खं अणुहवन्ति"
english: "Ah! foolish talk, Such is the multiplicity of your senses That one can conceal one's feelings Only by reflecting them."

prakrit: "थेवो थेवो वि वरं कायबो नाणसंगहो निययं,सरियाउ किं न पेच्छह,बिन्दूहि समुद्दभूयाओ?"
english: "Were they meant to be, Are they intended to be a boon or a bane?" asked the doe. "Don't you see, my darling, That the drops are bound to fall?"

prakrit: "एक्कं पि अह मुहुत्तं,परिवज्जइ जो चउबिहाहारं,मासेण तस्स जायइ,उववासफलं तु सुरलोए"
english: "Just one more moment, The traveler has passed through all four directions, The fish follow him, And you must have tasted the fruit."

prakrit: "दसवरिससहस्साऊ,भुञ्जइ जो अन्नदेवयासत्तो,पलिओवमकोडी पुण,होइ ठिई जिणवरतवेणं"
english: "A man who has endured ten thousand lashes, Who has roasted the food of the gods, Is as good as corn on the plow, And who has mastered the craft of weaving."

prakrit: "तत्तो चुओ समाणो,मणुयभवे लहइ उत्तमं भोगं,जह तावसदुहियाए,लद्धं रणे वसन्तीए"
english: "Then shut up, my friend; It is the best pleasure for a man to have at home, Except when he is busy fighting."

prakrit: "भुञ्जइ अणन्तरेणं,दोण्णि य वेलाउ जो निओगेणं,सो पावइ उववासा,अट्ठावीसं तु मासेणं"
english: "Frying is an endless process, The only way to get both is to wilt. You fool, Twenty-eight o'clock is your month."

prakrit: "सो तस्स फलं विउलं,भुञ्जइ सुरजुवइनिवहमज्झगओ,सिरि-कित्ति-लच्छिनिलओ,दिवामलविरइयाभरणो"
english: "So sow that fruit, Roast the sunshine, Sweat the nectar of wilting jasmine, Reflect the rays of the lamp."

prakrit: "अणुभविय विसयसोक्खं,आयाओ माणुसम्मि लोगम्मि,उत्तमवंसुब्भूओ,रमइ य रइसागरोगाढो"
english: "Vicious pleasure, Come, people of humankind, good people, Behold the joys that come with the ocean."

prakrit: "एवं मुहुत्तवुड्डी,उववासे छट्ठमट्ठमादीए,जो कुणइ जहाथामं,तस्स फलं तारिसं भणियं"
english: "And what a foolish man he is, A miserly man, Who, wherever he goes without success, Succeeds only in kindness."

prakrit: "सो तस्स फलं विउलं,सुरलोए भुञ्जिउं सुचिरकालं,लहिऊण माणुसत्तं,बहुजणसयसामिओ होइ"
english: "So sow that fruit, roast it in jasmine, Give it a good time, Take it humanely, And let there be many lovers of it."

prakrit: "जो कुणइ अणत्थमियं,पुरिसो जिणभत्तिभावियमईओ,सो वरविमाणवासी,रमइ चिरं सुरवहूसहिओ"
english: "One who acts with detachment, Who is devoted to the welfare of men, Lives in a plane, Rejoices forever."

prakrit: "अणथन्ते दिवसयरे,जो चयइ चउविहं पि आहारं,सो जगजगेन्तसोहे,वसइ विमाणे चिरं कालं"
english: "One who chooses to eat all day long, Who loves the world, Lives only as long as the plane."

prakrit: "तत्तो चुओ समाणो,उप्पन्नो एत्थ माणुसे लोए,बहुनयर-खेड-कब्बड-रह-गयवरसामिओ होइ"
english: "So be it, my dear, In this world so full of men, Too much gambling - Khed - Kabbad - Rah - Gayavar - You're right." ""

prakrit: "पुणरवि जिणवरविहिए,धम्मे काऊण दढयरं चित्तं,आराहियतव-नियमो,कमेण सिवसासयं लहइ"
english: "May there be prosperity in all beings, may there be patience in Dharma, may it find a permanent home, may its laws be respected, and may its rule last forever."

prakrit: "जे पुण रयणीसु नरा,भुञ्जन्ति असंजया वयविहूणा,ते नरय-तिरियवासे,हिण्डन्ति अणन्तयं कालं"
english: "Those who do not sleep well, Those who are uncircumcised, Or who have reached the age of majority, Live in misery For a long time."

prakrit: "अणुहविऊण य दुक्खं,जइ कह वि लहन्ति माणुसं जम्मं,तत्थ वि होन्ति अणाहा,जे निसिभत्तं न वज्जन्ति"
english: "Suffering is the essence of human life; however great the human suffering, there are also those who do not experience it."

prakrit: "महिला य जा न रत्ति,भुञ्जइ आहार-खाण-पाणविहिं,जिणधम्मभावियमई,सा वि य देवत्तणं लहइ"
english: "Women do not go out, they roast, eat, drink, and are led astray by false gods."

prakrit: "तत्थ विमाणम्मि चिरं,विसयसुहं भुञ्जिउं चुयसमाणी,आयाइ माणुसत्ते,उत्तममहिला सुरूवा य"
english: "There the aeroplane stops, The pleasures of detachment roam freely, Come, my darling, Let the good woman begin."

prakrit: "तीए हवइ पकामं,कञ्चण-मणि-रयण-रुप्पय-पवालं,धण-धन्नं च बहुविहं,जीऎ न भुत्तं वियालम्मि"
english: "The wind blows the lotus, The emerald - pearl - rayon - silver - coral, Wealth - wealth - many a thing. But do not be deceived."

prakrit: "सेज्जाहि पुहनिसण्णा,विज्जिज्जइ चामरेहि विलयाहिं,आभरणभूसियङ्गी,जा निसिभत्तं विवज्जेइ"
english: "She adorns the head, She illuminates the skin, She destroys the ornaments, She spoils the bed."

prakrit: "चक्कहर-वासुदेवाण होन्ति महिलाउ ललियरूबाओ,भुञ्जन्ति विसयसोक्खं,जाओ विवजन्ति निसिभत्तं"
english: "The women of Chakkar - Vasudevan village make lullabies, Roast rice for the pleasure of feasting, Go and make a feast of wine."

prakrit: "जाओ पुण महिलाओ,रत्तिं जेमन्ति धम्मरहियाओ,ताओ वि हु दुक्खाइँ,अणुहोन्ति बहुप्पयाराइं"
english: "Gone are the good women, The virtuous walk the paths of righteousness, Yet for sorrow's sake They become too demanding."

prakrit: "हीणकुलसंभवाओ,धण-धन्न-सुवण्ण-रूवरहियाओ,जायन्ति महिलियाओ,जाओ भुञ्जन्ति निसिभत्तं"
english: "Proud women, Wealthy men, fair and handsome women, Go and roast the groundnuts."

prakrit: "दारिद्द-दूहवाओ,निच्चं कर-चरणफुटकेसीओ,होन्ति इह महिलियाओ,जाओ भुञ्जन्ति निसिभत्तं"
english: "Poverty - sufferers, Make yourselves miserable - Somebody's feet are broken. But these women, Go and roast the groundnuts."

prakrit: "जइ वि हु किंचि निओगं,करेन्ति अन्नाणधम्मसद्धाए,तह वि यतं अप्पफलं,होइ य निसिभोयणरयाणं"
english: "Whatever you do, work at it wholeheartedly; the more fruitless it is, the thinner will be the path to liberation."

prakrit: "तम्हा वजह इम,निसिभत्तं जीवघायणं जं च,अलियं अदत्तदाणं,परदारं तह य महुमंसं"
english: "Your cause is this: The mere thought of losing one's life Is enough to scare away the bees That crowd the curtain."

prakrit: "परिहरह अन्नदिट्ठी,जिणसासणउज्जया सया होह,तो सबसङ्गमुक्का,कमेण मोक्खं पि पाविहह"
english: "Freedom is bound to come, If you are prepared for what comes next, All the struggle is worth it, But even liberation from karma Is elusive."

prakrit: "रयणाइँ रयणदीवे,जह कोइ नरो लएइ लाहत्थी,तह मणुयभवे गिण्हइ,धम्मत्थी नियमरयणाई"
english: "For the king, the king is the lamp; Whoever conquers a man is conquered; The lord of humanity is counted in it; The ruler of dharma is ruled in it."

prakrit: "भणिओ धम्मरवेणं,मुणिणा लंकाहिवो जिणमयम्मि,एक पि गिण्ह नियम,रयणद्दीवे जहा रयणं"
english: "Say :'Praise be to the dharma.'A bow is won by a brave warrior. But one thing is certain: The law of counting. As for the gods, they are real." ""

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,दसाणणो भणइ केवलिं नमिउं,भयवं! असमत्थो'हं,दुक्करचरिया मुणिवराणं"
english: "Listening to my speech, The one who gives advice Says only namaste, Fear not!" "Yes, foolish sage." ""

prakrit: "जइ विहु सुरूववन्ता,परमहिला तो वि हं न पत्थेमि,नियया वि अप्पसण्णा,विलया एयं वयं मज्झ"
english: "If marriage were to begin, Even if it were with a woman, I would not go. Destiny, too, is irresolvable. Vilaya is our mother."

prakrit: "अह,सो वि भाणुकण्णो,गेण्हइ नियमं मुणिं पणमिऊणं,अज्जप्पभिई य मए,जिणाभिसेओ करेयबो"
english: "Oh! that she might speak again, To bend the law before her: Today, my dear, I shall do as she bade me."

prakrit: "पूया य बहुवियप्पा,थुई य सूरुग्गमाइ कायबा,एसो अभिग्गहो मे,जावज्जीवं परिग्गहिओ"
english: "Pooya ya bahuviappa, thui ya suruggamayi kayaba, Is this the way of the blind: Life goes on," he said.

prakrit: "अन्ने वि बहुवियप्पा,नियमा परिगेण्हिउं ससत्तीए,साहुं नमिऊण गया,निययट्ठाणाइँ सुरमणुया"
english: "Still very wide open, Circumventing the rules, My husband has gone astray, Deciding it's better to be polite."

prakrit: "अह रावणो वि एत्तो,मुणिवसहं पणमिऊण उप्पइओ,सुरवरसमाणविभवो,लंकानयरिं समणुपत्तो"
english: "Ah, Ravana! Here we are, Wiping our lips at the pearl of a pearl, Feigning ecstasy, Bowing before a lankan elephant."

prakrit: "एवं तु कम्मस्स खओवएसे,गेण्हन्ति जीवा गुरुभासियत्थं,काऊण तिवं विमलं च धम्म,सिद्धालयं जन्ति विसुद्धभावा"
english: "And you forsake karma, For you neglect the feelings of the soul, And for that matter dharma, Just like the path to purity."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए अणन्तविरियधम्मकहणो नाम चउद्दसमो उद्देसओ समत्तो"
english: "This is the name of the fourteenth day of my wretched existence: The end of time is near."

prakrit: "तस्स मुणिस्स सयासे,हणुमन्त-बिहीसणेहि सम्मत्तं,गहियं अणन्नसरिसं,काऊण सुनिम्मलं हिययं"
english: "His face is white, His hair is brown, His lips are prominent, His cheeks are dark, His ears are sunken."

prakrit: "तह वि य दूरेण ठियं,हणुमन्तस्स य विसुद्धसम्मत्तं,अन्नाणमारुएणं,न चलिज्जइ मन्दरो चेव"
english: "Still a long way off, Bees or bees or bees - The temple will not move." ""

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,परिपुच्छइ गणहरं मगहराया,भयवं! को हणुमन्तो,कस्स सुओ कत्थ वत्थबो"
english: "Listening to my speech, Looking down the road at the crowd Chasing me, I'm afraid! Who's the hunter? Whom is he going to ask me?" ""

prakrit: "अह भासिउं पयत्तो,गणाहियो अस्थि भारहे वासे,वेयड्ढो नाम गिरी,उभओ सेढीसु अइरम्मो"
english: "Oh! the landowner's son, The hunter's wife is heavy with bones, The poor man's name has fallen; Get up, take the ladder!"

prakrit: "तत्था''इच्चपुरवरं,अत्थि वरुज्जाण-काणणसमिद्धं,पल्हाओ नाम निवो,तं भुञ्जइ खेयरो सूरो"
english: "Tathatha" "Itchpuravaram," "Atthi varujjana - The middle of the earring, The plowman's name is Nivo, The field is roasted by the tares."

prakrit: "महिला से कित्तिमई,पुत्तो पवणंजओ त्ति नामेणं,जो सयलजीवलोए,गुणेहि दूरं समुबहइ"
english: "How can I compare to a woman? Name me a son of Pawan, Who, being so full of life, Gives such distance in virtue."

prakrit: "दठूण तं कुमारं,जोवण-लायण्ण-कन्तिपडिपुण्णं,चिन्ता कुणइ नरवई,कुल-वंसुच्छेयपरिभीओ"
english: "Look at that girl, Young and lanky and full of tears, Worried about being called a womanizer, Fearful of being treated like a barber."

prakrit: "ताव'च्छउ संबन्धो,सेणिय! पवणंजयस्स जो भणिओ,तस्स महिलाऎ एत्तो,सुणसुप्पत्ती पवक्खामि"
english: "" "What do you mean, you silly girl!" "That woman said," "I'm off to bed." "She sniffed."

prakrit: "भारहवरिसन्ते खलु,दाहिणपासम्मि सायरासन्ने,दन्ती नाम महिहरो,ऊसियवरसिहरसंघाओ"
english: "The plowman's son is heavy, The right hand is full of sawmills, The tooth is called a beehive, The other is a thicket of reeds."

prakrit: "तत्थ पुरं विक्खायं,महिन्दनयरं कयं महिन्देणं,वरभवण-तुङ्गतोरण-अट्टालय-वियडपायारं"
english: "Tathā pura vikāya, mahindanāyārā, kāyam mahindana, varbhavana - tung torana - atalaya - vidyāpayāra"

prakrit: "अह हिययसुन्दरीए,महिन्दभजाऎ पवरपुत्ताणं,जायं सयं कमेणं,अरिन्दमाई सुरूवाणं"
english: "Ah! beautiful lady! The virtuous steps of Mahindabhaja, Which I took with me when I was young, Are a source of delight to many."

prakrit: "भइणी ताण कणिट्ठा,वरअञ्जणसुन्दरि ति नामेणं,रूवाणि रूविणीणं,होऊण व होज्ज निम्मविया"
english: "A woman's breasts are delicate, A man's name is dear to bridesmaids, Her hair is silly, And her face is pale."

prakrit: "सा अन्नया कयाई,कीलन्ती तेन्दुएण वरभवणे,नवजोबणचिञ्चइया,सहसा दिट्ठा महिन्देणं"
english: "She is so eager to eat, So anxious to please her lover, So eager to think of a new life, That suddenly her eyes light up."

prakrit: "सद्दाविया य मन्ती,कयविणया आसणेसु उवविट्ठा,भणिया य साहह फुडं,कस्स इमा देमि कन्ना हं"
english: "Friend, tell me, How can I help you?" asked the doe, Sitting crossly on top of my brother. "Whom shall I give to?"

prakrit: "मइसायरेण भणिओ,महिन्दविज्जाहरो पणमिऊणं,लङ्काहिवस्स दिज्जइ,एस कुमारी गुणब्भहिया"
english: "Tell me politely," said the doe, "That big vizzy of pearls, Which is offered by the elephant langur, Is a virtuous maiden."

prakrit: "अहवा दिज्जइ कन्ना,दहमुहपुत्ताण रूवमन्ताणं,घणवाहणिन्दईणं,विज्जा-बलगवियमईणं"
english: "Ahava gives birth to kanna, Dahamuhaputana gives rise to nymphs, Ghanavahana provides nourishment, Vijja - Balgavyamayana"

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,सुमई तो भणइ परिफुडुल्लावो,न य रावणस्स कन्ना,दिज्जइ सो'णेयजुवइपई"
english: "Listen to me when you speak, tell me you speak plainly, Don't turn your back on Ravana; He will guide you as a youth."

prakrit: "जइ इन्दइस्स दिज्जइ,तो रूसइ मेहवाहणो नियमा,घणवाहणस्स दिन्ना,तो कुप्पइ इन्दइकुमारो"
english: "If it is given to the inside, it is the rule of the traveler, if it is of the heavy vehicle, then the whole world is dependent on the inside."

prakrit: "गणियाहेउं जुज्झं,जायं सिरिसेणरायपुत्ताणं,पिइ-माइदुक्खजणयं,किं न सुयं जं पुरा वत्तं?"
english: "To reckon with war, To settle scores, To drink wine, To be miserly - Isn't that what a good speech is all about?"

prakrit: "सुमईण तत्थ भणियं,वेयड्ढे दक्खिणिल्लसेढीए,कणयपुरं अस्थि तहिं,हरिणाहो खेयराहिवई"
english: "A swarm of gnats hangs over the tree, The creepers bend to face the south, The grasshoppers twine around the trunk, And the deer follow the branches."

prakrit: "सुमणा तस्स वरतणू,पुत्तो विज्जुप्पहो त्ति नामेणं,रूव-गुण-जोवणेणं,अइसयभूओ तिहुयणम्मि"
english: "Use politeness, my son, be wise, use courtesy, have good looks, and never be rash."

prakrit: "तस्सेसा वरकन्ना,दिज्जइ मा एत्थ संसयं कुणह,अणुसरिसजोवणाणं,अचिरा वि हु होउ संजोओ"
english: "Tasteless bridegroom, Please don't let this trouble you with your young son go in vain. Soon you will be cherishing it too."

prakrit: "धुणिऊण उत्तिमङ्गं,मन्ती सन्देहपारओ भणइ,भविओ सिवषहगामी,होही विज्जुप्पहकुमारो ॥"
english: "One can speak ill of wealth, one can speak doubtingly of wealth; one can be faithful only to one's position; this is the lotus of wisdom."

prakrit: "अट्ठारसमे वरिसे,भोगं मोत्तूण गहियवय-नियमो,सिद्धालयं गमीही,एवा''इट मुणिवरेणं"
english: "At eighteen the bridegroom returns, At three o'clock the feast, At eleven the vows, At seven the funeral." ""

prakrit: "वरजोवणुज्जला वि हु,तेण विमुक्का इमा य वरकन्ना,होही ववगयसोहा,चन्देण विणा जहा रयणी"
english: "There is something very special about the bridegroom: He is so devoted to her That he does not want to see her again. But the moon is like no other woman."

prakrit: "अह भणइ तत्थ मन्ती,निसुणह आइच्चपुरवरे राया,विज्जाहरो महप्पा पल्हाओ नाम नामेणं"
english: "Ah, what a nasty man I am! No need to say such things, my poor Raya. The great tree of knowledge Only needs a name."

prakrit: "भज्जा से कित्तिमई,पुत्तो पवणंजओ पहियकित्ती,रूवेण जोवणेण य,कामस्स सिरिं विडम्बेइ"
english: "What a feast for the eyes, My son, The wheels of heaven have turned upside down, Like youth in a dream." ""

prakrit: "एयन्तरम्मि मासो,संपत्तो फग्गुणो गुणसमिद्धो,जणयन्तो नवपल्लव,दुमाण कमलायराणं च"
english: "After all, it's the month of Maas, Wealth equals virtue, generosity equals youth, and wickedness equals lotus."

prakrit: "छज्जन्ति उववणाई,नाणाविहकुसुमरिद्धिगन्धाइं,गुमगुमगुमन्तमहुयर-कोइलकोलाहलरवाइं"
english: "Loud beating of drums, Tears streaming down one's cheeks, Seems to wash away the scent of jasmine flowers."

prakrit: "एयारिसम्मि काले,देवा नन्दीसरं परमदीवं,गन्तूण अट्ठ दियहे,करेन्ति महिमं जिणवराणं"
english: "This is our time, Deva Nandisara is the supreme god, Destroyers come in eight days, They bring glory to life."

prakrit: "अहवा पाणिग्गहणं,काऊणं तं इहं समुज्झे हं,जेण महं अन्नस्स य,न होइ इट्ठा निययकालं"
english: "Ah, the water supply, But how can I explain it to you? It's my own fault I haven't had time to cook." ""

prakrit: "पल्हाय-महिन्देहि,अणेयउवएससयसहस्साइं,दाऊण कुमारवरो,नियत्तिओ बुद्धिमन्तेहिं"
english: "Wretched men, Ungrateful women, Like the young men of love, Destiny is wiser than wisdom."

prakrit: "पवणंजए नियत्ते,दोसु वि सेन्नेसु होइ आणन्दो,बहुखाण-पाण-भोयण-सएसु लोओ समारद्धो"
english: "Destiny favors the wind; both are agreeable; the earth teems with people addicted to much food and water."

prakrit: "सबम्मि सुपडिउत्ते,सुतिहि-सुनक्खत्त-करण-लग्गम्मि,वत्तं पाणिग्गहणं,कन्नाऎ समं कुमारस्स"
english: "Everything is smooth sailing, sleeping - sleeping - acting - limping, plus water supply, but kanya is equal to kumarasa."

prakrit: "वत्तम्मि य वारिजे,उभओ सम्माणदाणकयविभवा,तत्थेव मासमेगं,अच्छन्ति महिन्द-पल्हाया"
english: "Vattammi ya vaarije, ubhu sammandaan kaayibhava, Tathave masa megam, acchanti mahind - palhaya."

prakrit: "अह ते अवियोहमणा,अन्नोन्नाभासणाइ काऊणं,विज्जाहररायाणो,निययपुराइं समणुपत्ता"
english: "Oh! what a monotonous marriage! How strange it is to conceal one's feelings From another. What a cruel law it is: The equaliser of fate."

prakrit: "हय-गय-रहपरिकिण्णो,ऊसियधय-विजय-वेजयन्तीहिं,पवणंजओ पविठ्ठो,सपुरं चिय अञ्जणासहिओ"
english: "Yes, my dear, It is the festival of lights, The festival of victory and victory, The sacred fire of love, The feast of feasts, And the feast of supper."

prakrit: "दिन्नं से वरभवणं,मणिकोट्टिम-सालिभञ्जियाकलियं,अह सा महिन्दतणया,तत्थ पविट्ठा गमइ कालं"
english: "Dinnam se varabhavan, manikottim-salibhanjiyakaliyam, Oh! great glory! For then the sacred time is lost." ""

prakrit: "परभवजणियं जं दुक्कयं सुक्यं वा,उवणमइह लोए सोक्ख-दुक्खावहं तं,चउगइभयभीया जायसंवेगसड्डा,विमलहिययभावा होह धम्मेक्कचित्ता"
english: "Whatever is the cause of sorrow In this world, Be it happiness or pleasure, Fear or resentment, Anger or jealousy, A tremulous spirit Is the essence of dharma."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए अञ्जगासुन्दरीवीवाहविहाणो नाम पन्नरसमो उद्देसओ समत्तो"
english: "This is the name of the woman whose husband passed away, And whose husband is still alive."

prakrit: "सरिऊण मिस्सकेसी-वयणं पवणंजएण रुटेणं,चत्ता महिन्दतणया,दुक्खियमणसा अकयदोसा"
english: "Wretchedness is the cause of misfortune - The wind makes one weep because one cannot breathe, The fire is a source of great sorrow, And a miser's mind is an inexhaustible evil."

prakrit: "विरहाणलतवियङ्गी,न लभइ विदाणलोयणा निदं,वामकरधरियवयणा,वोउकुमार विचिन्तन्ती"
english: "The deaf and mute girl, Can't find sleep without waking up, Left arm twitching, Is completely at a loss What to do next"

prakrit: "उक्कण्ठिय ति गाढं,नयणजलासित्तमलिणथणजुयला,हरिणी व वाहभीया,अच्छइ मग्गं पलोयन्ती"
english: "She is fierce, Pretending to flee, Like a young stag in midday heat, Fearful of her hunter's bow." ""

prakrit: "अइतणुइयसबङ्गी,कडिसुत्तय-कडयसिढिलियाभरणा,भारेण अंसुयस्स य,जाइ महन्तं परमखेयं"
english: "Tears flow from my eyes, Tears run down my cheeks, Sweating thick and heavy, Which is the supreme sacrifice of me."

prakrit: "ववगयदप्पुच्छाहा,दुक्खं धारेइ अङ्गमङ्गाइँ,एमेव सुन्नहियया,पलवइ अन्नन्नवयणाई"
english: "The wind has blown, The clouds are dark, The limbs are heavy with sorrow, They are numb, The plowman has run out of food."

prakrit: "पासायतलत्था चिय,मोहं गच्छइ पुणो पुणो बाला,नवरं आसासिज्जइ,सोयलपवणेण फुसियङ्गी"
english: "The fire burns bright, The young girl falls in love all over again, The new bride is made of hope, The poor girl is seduced by true love."

prakrit: "मिउ-महुर-मम्मणाए,जंपइ वायाऎ दीणवयणाई,अइतणुओ वि महायस!,तुज्झ'वराहो मए न कओ"
english: "My mother - in - law, Jump up and down, Speak plainly, Though you are a great warrior! Do not say," "Worry not, my lord!" "to me."

prakrit: "मुञ्चसु कोवारम्भ,पसियसु मा एव निठुरो होहि,पणिवइयवच्छला किल,होन्ति मणुस्सा महिलियाणं"
english: "Foolish girl, don't be so naïve: Be careful not to fall asleep next to your lover, you stupid woman."

prakrit: "एयाणि य अन्नाणि य,जंपन्ती तत्थ दीणवयणाई,अह सा महिन्दतणया,गमेइ कालं चिय बहुत्तं"
english: "It's my grandmother's birthday, Jumping up and down. Oh, my goodness, Anytime is too long." ""

prakrit: "एत्थन्तरे विरोहो,जाओ अइदारुणो रणारम्भो,रावण-वरुणाण तओ,दोण्ह वि पुण दप्पियबलाणं"
english: "Enemies, go and start a forest fire, Ravana and Varuna; the two are bound to collide again."

prakrit: "लङ्काहिवेण दूओ,वरुणस्स य पेसिओ अइतुरन्तो,गन्तूण पणमिऊण य,कयासणो भणइ वयणाइं"
english: "Give it to the lankan elephant, For the wind has blown it out of proportion, For it has struck at the mouth of the hunter." ""

prakrit: "विज्जाहराण सामी,वरुण! तुमं भणइ रावणो रुट्ठो,कुणह पणामं व फुडं,अह ठाहि रणे सवडहुत्तो"
english: "Vijjaharana Sámi, Varuna! You speak Ravana's language, You speak Rāvaṇa's speech, You utter falsehoods, And you speak falsehood. It is he who begets the gods." ""

prakrit: "हसिऊण भणइ वरुणो,दूयाहम! को सि रावणो नामं?,न य तस्स सिरपणामं,करेमि आणाषमाणं वा"
english: "He laughed and said," "Varun, Duyaham! Which is the name of Ravana?" "No, not with that word: I swear by it."

prakrit: "न य सो वेसमणो हं,नेय जमो न य सहस्सकिरणो वा,जो दिवसत्थभीओ,कुणइ पणामं तुहं दीणो"
english: "I am not a prostitute, neither am I a woman of birth, nor a man of many talents. Fearful of the day, I will repay you what you give me."

prakrit: "वरुणेणं उवलद्धो,दूओ जं एव फरुसवयणेहिं,तो रावणस्स गन्तुं,कहेइ सबं जहाभणियं"
english: "Varunana is angry, tell me, Whatever you say to him in return, I will tell Ravana," she says, "As far as I am concerned."

prakrit: "सोऊण दूयवयणं,रुट्ठो लङ्काहिवो भणइ एवं,दिवत्थेहि विणा मऎ,अवस्स वरुणो जिणेयवो"
english: "She mutters nonsense, Speaks rudely, Smells like a lame duck, And speaks without saying a word. Nowadays, Varun's victory is certain." ""

prakrit: "एत्थन्तरे पयट्टो,दसाणणो सयलबलकयाडोवो,संपत्तो वरुणपुरं,मणि-कणयविचित्तपायारं"
english: "Here goes the traveler, There goes the donkey, The ox, The bull, And the rich man, The wood - apple farmer."

prakrit: "सोऊण रावणं सो समागयं पुत्तबलसमाउत्तो,रणपरिहत्थुच्छाहो,विणिग्गओ अभिमुहो वरुणो"
english: "When Ravana met his son, The young warrior threw himself on his back, His face turned to that of a hunter." ""

prakrit: "राईवपुण्डरीया,पुत्ता बत्तीसइं सहस्साइं,सन्नद्ध-बद्ध-कवया,अभिट्टा रक्खसभडाणं"
english: "Powder the rice, my son, Thirty-two thousand are ready - bound - Poems, Prakrit songs, Accumulated in the Rakshasa Sabha."

prakrit: "अन्नोन्नसत्थभजन्त-संकुलं हुयवहुट्ठियफुलिङ्गं,अइदारुणं पवत्तं,जुझं विवडन्तवरसुहडं"
english: "Like a flock of elephants, Like flowers on an elephant's back, Like a good fight, Like the pleasures of separation."

prakrit: "रह-गय-तुरङ्ग-जोहा,समरे जुज्झन्ति अभिमुहावडिया,सर-सत्ति-खग्ग-तोमर-चक्काउह-मोग्गरकरग्गा"
english: "Rah-gaya-turang-joha, samre jujjanti aurikahavadya, sar-satti-khagga-tomar-chakauh-mograkaragga."

prakrit: "रक्खसभडेहि भग्गं,वरुणबलं विवडिया''स-गय-जोहं,दट्ट ण पलायन्तं,जलकन्तो अभिमुहीहूओ"
english: "The rakshasa is afraid of the crowd, The treetops are deserted, The elephants are exhausted, The roads are impassable, The rivers are swollen."

prakrit: "वरुणेण बलं भग्गं,ओसरियं पेच्छिऊण दहवयणो,अब्भिडइ रोसपसरिय–सरोहनिवहं विमुञ्चन्तो"
english: "Varun has lost his strength, When he looks at Usuryam he sees Dahavayana, Afraid the rose will turn his back on him - The audience." ""

prakrit: "वरुणस्स रावणस्स य,वट्टन्ते दारुणे महाजुज्झे,ताव य वरुणसुएहिं,गहिओ खरदूसणो समरे"
english: "Varunasa is like Ravana, Vattante darune mahajujjhe, Taveya is like Varunasu, Ghee is like khardusana"

prakrit: "दट्ठ ण दूसणं सो,गहिओ मन्तीहि रावणो भणिओ,जुज्झन्तेण पहु! तुमे,अवस्स मारिज्जए कुमरो"
english: "" "Don't touch me," "said the angry Raven." "Stop being belligerent! You're the only one who should be put to death."

prakrit: "काऊण संपहारं,समयं मन्तीहि रक्खसाहिबई,खरदूसणजीयत्थे,रणमज्झाओ समोसरिओ"
english: "Who's to blame? Time, dear raksha sahib, For wasting away in the mud While the forest fires raged on." ""

prakrit: "पायालपुरवरं सो,पत्तो मेलेइ सबसामन्ते,पल्हायखेयरस्स वि,सिग्धं पुरिसं विसज्जेइ"
english: "Payalpurvaram: So the leaf melts, Everything is in balance, Even the petals of the palm tree, Simply by immersing them in water."

prakrit: "गन्तूण पणमिऊण य,पल्हायनिवस्स कहइ संबन्धं,रावण-वरुणाण रणं,दूसणगहणं जहावत्तं"
english: "Destruction is the remover's business, The winter is long, The forest is barren, Ravana - Varuna rule the roost, And the elephant is the spoil."

prakrit: "पडियागओ महप्पा,पायालपुरट्ठिओ ससामन्तो,मेलेइ रक्खसवई,अहमवि वीसज्जिओ तुझं"
english: "Fallen tree is great, Trapped tree is always tall, Protecting tree is easy, Venerable tree is yours."

prakrit: "सोऊण वयणमेयं,पल्हाओ तक्खणे गमणसज्जो,पवणंजएण धरिओ,अच्छ तुमं ताव वीसत्थो"
english: "Take me in your arms, Hold on tight, Hold onto me by the wind, My love, you'll never see me again."

prakrit: "सन्तेण मए सामिय!,कीस तुमं कुणसि गमणआरम्भं?,आलिङ्गणफलमेयं,देमि अहं तुज्झ साहीणं"
english: "Peace be with me, Samia! How are you going to start the journey? Embrace the fruit of my embrace. I will give it to you." ""

prakrit: "भणिओ य नरवईणं बालो सि तुमं अदिट्ठसंगामो,अच्छसु पुत्त! घरगओ कीलन्तो निययकीलाए"
english: "Tell me, my boy, You're a man of few words, And I agree with you. It's only fair that you stay home, my son." ""

prakrit: "मा ताय! एव जंपसु,बालो त्ति अहं अदिट्ठरणकज्जो,किं वा मत्तवरगए,सीहकिसोरो न घाएइ?"
english: "Don't be so hasty! Shout out, Child, I'm a man of few words. Or get drunk. Stop being a coward?" ""

prakrit: "पल्हायनरवईणं,ताहे वीसज्जिओ पवणवेगो,भणिओ य पत्थिवजयं,पुत्तय! पावन्तओ होहि"
english: "You silly girl, Tell me," "My son, You're going to have to walk a bit longer." "Say:" "Traveler, you won't be late!" ""

prakrit: "तातस्स सिरपणाम,काउं आपुच्छिऊण से जणणिं,आहरणभूसियङ्गो,विणिग्गओ सो सभवणाओ"
english: "That headgear, That you gave birth to the girl you wanted, That bracelet you used to pull on your thighs, Is a miracle."

prakrit: "सहसा पुरम्मि जाओ,उल्लोल्लो निग्गओ पवणवेगो,सोऊण अञ्जणा वि य,तं सदं निग्गया तुरियं"
english: "Hurry up, you fool, Get out of the way! There's nothing wrong with you. Try to leave now, my dear." ""

prakrit: "अइपसरन्तसिणेहा,थम्भल्लीणा पई पलोयन्ती,वरसालिभञ्जिया इव,दिट्ठा बाला जणवएणं"
english: "Aunt, When you cross each other's path, A weary woman runs after her lover, Like a flood of rain clouds, When one sees a young bull."

prakrit: "पेच्छइ य तं कुमारं,महिन्दतणया नरिन्दमग्गम्मि,पुलयन्ती न य तिप्पइ,कुवलयदलसरिसनयणेहिं"
english: "You look at that girl, You stare at the rafters, You turn your back on her." The doe is so full of love That she cannot turn her back on you.

prakrit: "पवणंजएण वि तओ,पासायतलट्ठिया पलोयन्ती,दूरं उवियणिज्जा,उक्का इव अञ्जणा दिट्ठा"
english: "Though the wind was blowing, There were parrots by her side, She stared into the distance, Unsure how to look." ""

prakrit: "तं पेच्छिऊण रुट्ठो,पवणगई रोसपसरियसरीरो,भणइ य अहो! अलज्जा,जा मज्झ उवट्ठिया पुरओ"
english: "Wait a moment, you silly girl," she said, wiping away her tears As she took a bath in the backyard of her husband's house. "Oh, my! Please, go get me a blanket!"

prakrit: "रइऊण अञ्जलिउडं,चलणपणामं च तस्स काऊण,भणइ उवालम्भन्ती,दूरपवासो तुमं सामी!"
english: "Stay awake, Anjali, stop moving, tell me, You naughty girl, You're a loner!" ""

prakrit: "वच्चन्तेण परियणो,सबो संभासिओ तुमे सामि!,न य अन्नमणगएण वि,आलत्ता हं अकयपुण्णा"
english: "Traveler, all you have to do is look! No need to beg. I'm usually so naïve." ""

prakrit: "जीयं मरणं पि तुमे,आयत्तं मज्झ नत्थि संदेहो,जइ वि हु जासि पवासं,तह वि य अम्हे सरेज्जासु"
english: "As long as you are alive, death will follow, I have no more doubts, But whatever comes of it, I shall overcome."

prakrit: "एवं पलवन्तोए,पवणगई मत्तगयवरारूढो,निग्गन्तूण पुराओ,उवट्ठिओ माणससरम्मि"
english: "And the plowmen, Running on foot, Drunken cowboys, Stupid old men, Standing above the crowd."

prakrit: "विज्जाबलेण रइओ,तत्थ निवेसो घरा-''सणाईओ,ताव चिय अत्थगिरिं,कमेण सूरो समल्लीणो"
english: "Be enlightened, stay indoors -" "Go to bed, you naughty girl, Don't go out in the middle of the night."

prakrit: "अह सो संझासमए,भवण-गवक्खन्तरेण पवणगई,पेच्छइ सरं सुरम्मं,निम्मलवरसलिलसंपुण्णं"
english: "Oh! in the twilight of dawn She walks about with high brow, Looking out for the scent of jasmine, Whose face is smeared all over with crimson."

prakrit: "मच्छेसु कच्छभेसु य,सारस-हंसेसु पयलियतरङ्गं,गुमुगुमुगुमन्तभमरं,सहस्सपत्तेसु संछन्नं"
english: "Flesh pierces the turtles, The storks and geese twine themselves around the jasmine, Bees hover around the beehive, The flowers sway in unison."

prakrit: "अइदारुणप्पयावो,लोए काऊण दीहरजं सो,अत्थाओ दिवसयरो,अवसाणे नरवई चेव"
english: "O wretched man, How long has the earth endured? Yet in this day and age There are few men left."

prakrit: "दियहम्मि वियसियाई,निययं भमरउलछड्डियदलाई,मउलेन्ति कुवलयाई,दिणयरविरहम्मि दुहियाइं"
english: "The lamp is poisonous, The bee is plentiful, The apple is juicy, The cucumber is fragrant, The day is long, And the night is long."

prakrit: "अह ते हंसाईया,सउणा लीलाइउं सरवरम्मि,दटुं,संझासमयं,गया य निययाइँ ठाणाइं"
