prakrit: "अञ्चन्तनिट ठुरा सा,केउमई लोयधम्मकयभावा,निदोसा एस पहू!,बाला निद्धाडिया तीए"
english: "Aunt, Why should I waste my time In this damned world? It's the poor girl! The boy is already dead." ""

prakrit: "भणइ य महिन्दराया,पुवि पि मए सुयं जहा एसा,षवणंजयस्स वेसा,तेण य गब्भस्स संदेहो"
english: "Say," "Your Highness, The way I sleep is just like that." "Don't be alarmed: It's just the way you sleep."

prakrit: "मा होहिइ अववाओ,मज्झं पि इमाऎ संकिलेसेणं,भणिओ य दारवालो,धाडेह लहुं पुरवराओ"
english: "Don't be alarmed, mother - in - law! Tell that to the doorkeeper," "The door is locked." ""

prakrit: "तो दारवालएणं,लद्धाएसेण अञ्जणा तुरियं,निद्धाडिया पुराओ,सहीऎ समयं परविएसं"
english: "So you gatekeeper, Don't be alarmed: Time is fleeting, my poor man." ""

prakrit: "सुकुमालहत्थ-पाया,खरपत्थर-विसमकण्टइल्लेणं,पन्थेण वच्चमाणी,अइगरुयपरिस्समावन्ना"
english: "Succulent palms - found, Weeds - scattered, Wet - smeared with mud, The path is slippery, Like a river in spate"

prakrit: "जं जं सयणस्स घरं,वच्चइ आवासयस्स कज्जेणं,तं तं वारेन्ति नरा,नरिन्दसंपेसिया सबं"
english: "Whatever the scientist's house, Whatever the housewife's business, That he does not mind at all. It is the relative of the wealthy gentleman."

prakrit: "एवं धाडिज्जन्ती,सबेण जणेण निरणुकम्पेणं,घोराडविं पविट्ठा,पुरिसाण वि जा भयं देइ"
english: "And the poor girl, Everyone is innocent, The traveler is pious, Even men give cause for fear."

prakrit: "नाणाविहगिरिपउरा,नाणाविहपायवेहि संछन्ना,महई अणोरपारा,नाणाविहसावयाइण्णा"
english: "A coin tossed by a farmer, A coin dropped by a traveler, A bee sniffed at a man Who had passed by without a coin."

prakrit: "वाया-''यवपरिसन्ना,तण्हाऎ छुहाऎ पीडियसरीरा,एगुद्देसम्मि ठिया,करेइ परिदेवणं बाला"
english: "Via -" "You silly girl, Touching your breasts, Standing here beside you, Doing your best to please the God of Love." ""

prakrit: "हा कट्ठ चिय पहया,विहिणा हं विविहदुक्खकारीणं,अणहेउवइरिएणं,के सरणं वो पवज्जामि?"
english: "Oh! the tightrope walker, The widower is a man of many sorrows, Unhappy travelers. Who am I to cross That path?"

prakrit: "भत्तारविरहियाणं,होइ पिया आलओ महिलियाणं,मह पुण पुण्णेहि विणा,सो वि हु वइरीसमो जाओ"
english: "Being absent from work, Being dear to all women, Is like being absent without a husband. Even so, I am away for the winter."

prakrit: "ताव च्चिय हियइट्ठा,माऊण पिऊण बन्धवाणं च,जाव न धाडेइ पई,महिला निययस्स गेहस्स"
english: "There you go, Silent man, Drinking wine and making love, Not shying away from it: It's the nature of women to be jealous."

prakrit: "ताव सिरी सोहग्गं,ताव य गरुयाउ होन्ति महिलाओ,जाव य पई महग्धं,सिणेहषक्खं समुबहइ"
english: "Be nice to yourself, be nice to other women, be courteous to each other, be affectionate and affectionate."

prakrit: "माया पिया य भाया,वच्छल्लं तारिसं करेऊणं,अवराहविरहियाए,कह मज्झ पणासियं सर्व?"
english: "Maya, you fool, tell me what to do with the buffalo: It is running out of fuel, My husband is out, How can I pay for it all?"

prakrit: "न य मज्झ सासुयाए,न चेव पियरेण मूढभावेणं,अयसस्स मूलदलियं,दोसस्स परिक्खणं न कयं"
english: "I am not a mother-in-law, There is no foolishness among lovers, Stupidity is the root of jealousy, And there is nothing to test one's character."

prakrit: "एवं बहुप्पयारं,रोवन्ती अञ्जणा निवारेउं,भणइ य वसन्तमाला,सामिणि! वयणं निसामेहि"
english: "And the plowman, Stop crying and stop crying! It's the spring garland That speaks, darling! The wind is relentless." ""

prakrit: "अवलोइऊण बाले!,पेच्छ गुहा सुन्दरा समासन्ने,एयं वच्चामु लहुं,एत्थं पुण सावया घोरा"
english: "Come on, you silly girl! You look so well put together, It's only the wind that blows, There's the whole of Savaya again." ""

prakrit: "गब्भस्स मा विवत्ती,होही भणिउं वसन्तमालाए,हत्थावलम्बियकरा,नीया य गुहामुहं तुरिया"
english: "Don't be alarmed. Tell me, spring garland, Hands clasped around your waist, Turiya in front of your husband's face." ""

prakrit: "दिट्ठो य तत्थ समणो,सिलायले समयले सुहनिविठ्ठो,चारणलद्धाइसओ,जोगारूढो विगयमोहो"
english: "Look where you are going, Sit comfortably when you're sewing, Walk among the pastures, Jog through the thickets."

prakrit: "करयलकयञ्जलीओ,मुणिवसहं वन्दिऊण भावेणं,तत्थेव निविट्ठाओ,दोण्णि वि भयवज्जियङ्गीओ"
english: "Fettered by affection The women of Karaikudi, swooning with excitement, At the same time holding their breath, Both tremble with fear."

prakrit: "ताव य झाणुवओगे,संपुण्णे साहवो वि जुवईओ,दाऊण धम्मलाहं,पुच्छइ देसे कहिं तुम्हे?"
english: "So you won't see, you clever young man, Who in his right mind would ask you Where you at?"

prakrit: "तो पणमिऊग साहू,वसन्तमाला कहेइ संबन्धं,एसा महिन्दधूया,नामेणं अञ्जणा चेव"
english: "So, you sage, tell me something about the spring garland. It's like a rainbow. Name me Anjana Chewa." ""

prakrit: "पवणंजयस्स महिला,लोए गब्भाववायकयदोसा,बन्धवजणेण चत्ता,एत्थ पविट्ठा अरण्णम्मि"
english: "Proud woman, In this world, so full of sins, A man who has lost a relative Dies. For here is a sacred forest."

prakrit: "केण व कजेण इमा,वेसा कन्तस्स सासुयाए य?,अणुहवइ महादुक्खं,कस्स व कम्मस्स उदएणं?"
english: "Who is it for, Mother - in - law, That such a thing should happen?, Such a great sorrow, Such an outburst of anger., Whose karma is it to bring about?"

prakrit: "को वा य मन्दपुण्णो,जीवो एयाऎ गब्भसंभूओ?,जस्स कएण महायस! जीवस्स वि संसयं पत्ता"
english: "Who is retarded, O wretched soul, Living in confusion?, Whom are the great masters? Even the soul knows the world." ""

prakrit: "तत्तो सो अमियगई,कहेइ सवं तिनाणसंपन्नो,कम्मं परभवजणियं,फुड-वियडत्थं जहावत्तं"
english: "There she is, completely at a loss, Saying that she has exhausted all three, That karma is transcendent, That food and drink are the means to eternal bliss."

prakrit: "इह जम्बुद्दीववरे,पियनन्दी नाम मन्दिरपुरम्मि,तस्स जया वरमहिला,पुत्तो से होइ दमयन्तो"
english: "Oh! dear girl, The temple of the beloved's name is in the town, So is the victory of the virtuous woman. My son, I beg of you, Be damned."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाई,दमयन्तो पत्थिओ वरुज्जाणं,पुरजणकयपरिवारो,कीलइ रइसागरोगाढो"
english: "Oh! what a strange land, Like a barren field, Like an old man's house, Like the rustling of a nail."

prakrit: "रमिऊण तओ सुइरं,पेच्छइ साहुं तहिं गुणसमिद्धं,गन्त्र̥̄ण ताण पासे,धम्म सोऊण पडिबुद्धो"
english: "When one makes love, one sees virtue in it, When one embraces virtue, one is carried away by anger, One falls asleep in dharma."

prakrit: "दाऊण भावसुद्धं,सत्तगुणं फासुयं मुणिवराणं,संजम-तव-नियमरओ,कालगओ सुरवरो जाओ"
english: "Be good to yourself, be good to others, be careful not to fall into the trap of deceit seven times over. Time will tell."

prakrit: "दिवा-'मलदेहधरो,सुरसोक्खं भुञ्जिऊण चिरकालं,चविओ य इहा''याओ,जम्बुद्दीवे वरपुरम्मि"
english: "Diva -" "A garland of lotuses, Succeeding in making fragrant roasts Last a long time, If you want to taste it" "Ya, yo, The jasmine is the bridegroom's lotus."

prakrit: "हरिवाहणस्स पुत्तो,जाओ गब्भे पियङ्गुलच्छीए,नामेण सीहचन्दो,सबकलापारओ सुहओ"
english: "Go, son of the hunter, Go, go, peep into the manger. The white moon, by the way, is the delight of all poets."

prakrit: "जिणधम्मभावियमणो,कालं काऊण वरविमाणम्मि,सिरि-कित्ति-लच्छिनिलओ,देवो जाओ महीड्डीओ"
english: "Time flies, Silly girl, The God of Love is gone."

prakrit: "तत्तो वि देवसोक्खं,भोत्तूण चुओ इहेव वेयड्डे,कणओयरीऎ गब्भे,सुकण्ठपुत्तो समुप्पन्नो"
english: "There too the gods rejoice, The foolish sleeps here and there, The cowherd's womb, The dry man's son is everywhere."

prakrit: "अह सीहवाहणो सो,अरुणपुरं भुञ्जिऊण चिरकालं,लच्छीहरस्स पासे,निक्खन्तो विमलजिणतित्थे"
english: "Oh! true savage! For a long time the arrows have been roasting in the arbor, At the approach of the lanky hunter, And at the crossroads of the Vimala."

prakrit: "काऊण तवमुयारं,आराहिय संजमं तवबलेणं,जाओ लन्तयकप्पे,देवो दिवेण रूवेणं"
english: "Whom to worship: The lotus flower, The arrow of the God of Love, The lamp to weep for, And the lotus to wail for?"

prakrit: "तं अमरपवरसोक्खं,भोत्तूण चुओ महिन्दतणयाए,गब्भम्मि समावन्नो,इह जीवो पुब कम्मेहिं"
english: "Enjoy that immortal power, For when you kiss it with great relish It reassures you, For how long will you go on doing this?"

prakrit: "एसो ते परिकहिओ,इमस्स गब्भस्स संभवो भद्दे!,तुह सामिणीऎ हेडं,सुणेहि घणविरहदुक्खस्स"
english: "Come on, you fool, Is it possible that I'm pregnant? It's too early to tell, Your face already smeared with soot." ""

prakrit: "एसा आसि परभवे,बाला कणओयरी महादेवी,लच्छि ति नाम तइया,तीऎ सवत्ती तहिं बीया"
english: "Such is the nature of love, Child of barbering The great goddess. But what's her name, darling, All the rest is but seed to her?"

prakrit: "सम्मत्तभावियमई,सा लच्छी ठाविऊण जिणपडिमा,अच्चेइ पययमणसा,थुणइ य थुइमङ्गलसएहिं"
english: "She is agreeable, She is plump, She knows what to do, She has a kind heart, She licks her lips But keeps it to herself."

prakrit: "तो निययसवत्तीए,गाढं कणओयरीऎ रुवाए,घेत्तण सिद्धपडिमा,ठविया घरबाहिरुदेसे"
english: "So destiny's daughter - in - law, thick and fragrant, With tears streaming down her cheeks, Taken aback, Stops outside her house." ""

prakrit: "नामेण संजमसिरी,तइया अज्जा कएण भिक्खाए,नयरम्म परिभमन्ती,पेच्छइ घरबाहिरे पडिमा"
english: "You shameless girl, Why are you begging so much? It's like walking around in the dark, Seeing your neighbor outside the house." ""

prakrit: "मुणियपरमत्थसारा,अज्जा कणओयरिं भणइ एत्तो,भद्दे! सुणाहि वयणं,जं तुज्झ हियं च पत्थं च"
english: "" "Silly girl, You're the only one who says such nasty things! Listen to what I have to say: There's something between you and the stone."

prakrit: "नरय-तिरिएसु जीवो,हिण्डन्तो निययषावपडिबद्धो,दुक्खेहि माणुसत्तं,पावइ कम्मावसेसेणं"
english: "Deceit is bound to fate, Human beings suffer, Creatures perish at will."

prakrit: "तं चेव तुमे लद्धं,माणुसजम्मं कुलं चिय विसिढें,होऊण एरिसगुणा,मा कुणसु दुगुञ्छियं कम्मं"
english: "There you will find a warrior, The totality of humanity is at hand. Be virtuous. Do not act wickedly."

prakrit: "जो जिण-गुरुपडिकुट्ठो,पुरिसो महिला व होइ जियलोए,सो हिण्डइ संसारे,दुक्खसहस्साइ पावेन्तो"
english: "One who conquers both men and women, Who conquers all else in the world, Suffers suffering."

prakrit: "सोऊण अज्जियाए,वयणं कणओयरी सुपडिबुद्धा,ठावेइ चेइयहरे,जिणवरपडिमा पयत्तेणं"
english: "Aunt, It's sunny outside, The wind is blowing, The midday sun is setting, The wife is busy making love, And the husband is abroad."

prakrit: "जाया गिहिधम्मरया,कालं काऊण संजमगुणेणं,देवी होऊण चुया,उप्पन्ना अञ्जणा एसा"
english: "Go and worship her, Time will tell what kind of beauty to conjure up, The goddess must be asleep, Such is the state of ignorance."

prakrit: "जं बाहिरम्मि पडिमा,ठविया एयाऎ राग-दोसेणं,तं एस महादुखं,अणुहूयं रायधूयाए"
english: "That outside speech is bad, But anger mixed with hatred Is a great sorrow."

prakrit: "गेण्हसु जिणवरधम्मं,बाले! संसारदुक्खनासयरं,मा पुणरवि घोरयरे,भमिहिसि भवसायरे घोरे"
english: "Gone are the days! Life goes on, Child! The world goes on. Don't be alarmed: The geese roam the skies." ""

prakrit: "जो तुज्झ एस गब्भो,होही पुत्तो गुणाहिओ लोए,सो विज्जाहरइड्डेइ,सम्मत्तगुणं च पाविहिइ"
english: "That which is yours, my son, Is a store of virtues But lacks wisdom And is agreeable to judgment."

prakrit: "थोवदिवसेसु बाले!,दइएण समं समागमो तुझं,होही निस्संदेहं,भयमुकेयं विवजेहि"
english: "It's only a matter of days! Let's meet each other again. No doubt about it, you timid girl." ""

prakrit: "भावेण वन्दिओ सो,समणो दाऊण ताण आसीसं,उप्पइय नहयलेणं,निययट्ठाणं गओ धीरो"
english: "Friend, I beg of you, Be careful not to fall into the trap of flattery. But be patient as you go to bathe."

prakrit: "पलियङ्कगुहावासे,तोए उवगरण-भोयणाईयं,सबं वसन्तमाला,करेइ विज्जानिओगेणं"
english: "In the caves of Paliyanka, therefore, Spring is everywhere, So is the waning of wisdom"

prakrit: "एवं कमेण सूरो,अत्थाओ सयलकिरणपरिवारो,उत्थरिऊग पवत्तो,बहलतमो कजलसवण्णो"
english: "And what a miserly man he is, With a household full of crooks, Who rises up early, Who overcomes many troubles."

prakrit: "ताव च्चिय संपत्तो,सीहो दढदाढकेसरारुणिओ,पज्जलियनयणजुयलो,ललन्तजीहो कयन्तो व"
english: "So what is wealth, you stubborn and stubborn girl, Like a young man puzzled by a riddle, Like someone who is content?"

prakrit: "तं पेच्छिऊण सीहं,दोणि वि भयविहलपुण्णवयणाओ,अञ्चन्तमसरणाओ,दस वि दिसाओ पलोयन्ति"
english: "When I look at him, I see a lion: Both men are full of fear, They play the flute five times, They follow ten directions."

prakrit: "दटुं वसन्तमाला,तिहत्थमेत्तट्टियं गयवरारिं,पासेसु अञ्जणए,कुरलि ब नहङ्गणे भमइ"
english: "Look, the garland of spring, The guavas hovering among the trees That meet at Tihath, Noticing the paths. But the stag is wandering in the courtyard."

prakrit: "हाहा! हया सि मुद्धे!,पुवं दोहग्गविरहदुक्खणं,बन्धवजणेण चत्ता,पुणरवि सीहेण पडिरुद्धा"
english: "Haha! Hey, you fool! The grief of separation from your husband, Like the death of a relative, Resurrects with a sigh." ""

prakrit: "एसा महिन्दतणया,पवणंजयगेहिणी गुहामज्झे,सीहेण खज्जमाणी,रक्खसु वणदेवए! तुरियं"
english: "Such is the glory of the forest, The cave temples of the joys of love, A treasure chest of jewels, Protecting the forest gods!"

prakrit: "दटू ण गुहावासी,मणिचूलो नाम तत्थ गन्धबो,काऊण सरहरूवं,धाडेइ गुहाउ पञ्चमुहं"
english: "Datu is not a caveman, Manichoolo nama tatha gandhabo, Kauna is a mustard plant, Dhadei is a cave with five faces."

prakrit: "सीहभयम्मि ववगए,संपडिए जीवियवए बाला,सयणिज्जम्मि निसण्णा,वसन्तमालाऎ रइयम्मि"
english: "Fearful woman has passed away, Wealth has ceased to exist, Silly woman is no more, Spring is on the horizon."

prakrit: "एवं बहुप्पयारं,षवणगई विलविऊण दीणमुहो,भूयरवं नाम वणं,संपत्तो सो गवेसन्तो"
english: "And the plowman's daughter - in - law has grown very handsome. The landowner's son has grown quite wealthy." ""

prakrit: "तत्थ वि य अपेच्छन्तो,महिलं पवणंजओ विगयहासो,तो सुमरिउं पइन्नं,सत्थेसु समं मुयइ हत्थी"
english: "If he wants to meet a woman again, He'll arrange for her to come with him, Then let him come with his wife, And the elephant will go with him."

prakrit: "नं परिहवो महन्तो,तुज्झ कओ वाहणाइसत्तेणं,तं खमसु मज्झ गयवर! विहरसु रण्णे जहिच्छाए"
english: "" "Don't be alarmed, my lord. Who is going to give you a ride? Stop wasting away! It looks just like the rainbow in my heart."

prakrit: "एवं चिय बोलीणा,रयणी पवणंजयस्स तम्मि वणे,जं पिउणा तस्स कयं,तं मगहवई सुणसु एत्तो"
english: "And when he speaks, The talker tells the traveler," "What you want to drink, That's what I want you to hear." ""

prakrit: "पवणंजयव्र̥त्तन्ते,मित्तेण निवेइए गुरूण तओ,सबो सयण-परियणो,जाओ अइदुक्खिओ विमणो"
english: "The wind does not blow, Friend, do not try to stop me, Teacher, everyone is busy making love, Go and rescue me, my dear."

prakrit: "सुयसोगगग्गरगिरा,केउ मई भणइ पहसियं एत्तो,पुत्तं मोत्तूण ममं,एगागी किं तुमं आओ?"
english: "Suicide bomber, someone please tell me :'Here I am, my dear, My son, do you want to come?'"

prakrit: "सो भणइ देवि! तेणं,अहयं संपेसिओ इहं तुरिओ,विरहभयदुक्खिएणं,काऊण इमं पइन्नं तु"
english: "She says," "My god!" "But then, you cease to be so. Fearful of separation, my poor girl, You're the only one who knows."

prakrit: "जइ तं एत्थ वरतणू,न य हं पेच्छामि सोमससिवयणं,ता मज्झ एत्थ मरणं,होही भणियं तुह सुएणं"
english: "If I use it here, For it is not my passion That makes me swoon, It is my death. I swear to put you to sleep."

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,केउ मई मुच्छिया समासत्था,जुवईहि संपरिखुडा,कुणइ पलावं तओ कलुणं"
english: "Listen to me, darling: Someone may frown, Someone may mutter, A young couple may quarrel, Somebody may run away, But it's a lie."

prakrit: "अमुणियकज्जाऎ मए,पावाए एरिसं कयं कम्मं,जीवस्स वि संदेहो,जेण य पुत्तस्स मे जाओ"
english: "Tremendous! What have I to do with my life? This, dear boy, Is the only thing I know for sure."

prakrit: "एयं आइच्चपुरं,आरामुज्जाण-काणणसमिद्धं,मह पुत्तेण विरहियं,देइ सोहं अरण्णं व"
english: "This is Ayichpuram, A place of pleasantries and pleasantries, Separated from me by my son, Giving me the beauty of a forest."

prakrit: "संठाविऊण महिलं,पल्हाओ निग्गओ पुरवराओ,पुत्तस्स मम्गणद्वे,पुरओ च्चिय पहसियं फाउं"
english: "Slow down, ladies, Stop dragging your feet, boys, stop being angry, Stop being angry." ""

prakrit: "सबइ वि खेयरिन्दा,वाहरिया उभयसेढिवत्थबा,सिग्धं चिय संपत्ता,पल्हायनराहिवसयासं"
english: "Everything is hunter-gatherer, The hunter is both farmer and farmer, The straightforward are the treasures of love, The crooked are the delights of love."

prakrit: "हिण्डन्ति गवेसन्ता,पवणगई ते समन्तओ पुहई,पडिसुज्जएण दिट्टा,दूया पल्हायनिवतणया"
english: "Hindanti govesanta, When the wind has blown it hits the full moon, The bird's eye is set on the parrot, And the dooja on the palanquin."

prakrit: "परिपुच्छिएहि सिटुं,पवणंजयकारणं अपरिसेसं,सोऊण अञ्जणा वि य,अहिययरं दुक्खिया जाया"
english: "Sit in silence, For the reason that the wind does not blow, For though you do not know how to breathe, There is no sorrow anywhere."

prakrit: "रोवन्ती भणइ तओ,हा नाह! कओ गओ अपुण्णाए,बहुदुक्खभाइणोए,अलद्धसुहसंगमासाए?"
english: "The weeper says," "No! How come you are so indifferent, So miserly, And live in such happy company?" ""

prakrit: "पडिसुजओ वि एत्तो,आसासेऊण अञ्जणा तुरियं,उप्पइओ गयणयले,पेच्छइ विजाहरे सवे"
english: "Even the poor traveler is like this: He wonders what's in store for him, He ponders aloud, He listens attentively, And he ponders all sorts of questions."

prakrit: "अह ते गवेसमाणा,भूयारण्णं वणं समगुपत्ता,पेच्छन्ति तत्थ हस्थि,पवणंजयसन्तियं मत्तं"
english: "Oh! they are cowherd women, The whole forest is full of gooseflesh, They twitch about with their hands, The children of the wind are drunk on wine."

prakrit: "दट्ठण गयवरं तं,सबे विजाहरा सुपरितुट्ठा,जंपन्ति एकमेक,पवणगई एत्थ निक्खुत्तं"
english: "At a glance, it is plain to see; all are victorious; they speak for each other; The wind blows through this place."

prakrit: "अञ्जणगिरिसमसरिसो,सियदन्तो चडुलचलणगइगमणो,पासेसु परिभमन्तो,रक्खइ सामी सुभिच्चो व"
english: "Anjanagiri - The summer nights are long, The roads are slippery, The paths are winding, The rivers are swollen, And the sea is smooth." ""

prakrit: "दट्ठण पवणवेगं,ओइण्णा खेयरा नहयलाओ,वारेइ अल्लियन्ते,तस्स समीवं गयवरो सो"
english: "Look at that woman walking past. No, you're not supposed to be there. They're just passing by." ""

prakrit: "काऊण वसे हत्थि,पवणसमीवम्मि खेयरा पत्ता,पेच्छन्ति अचलियङ्गं,मुणि व जोगं समारूढं"
english: "Who dwells where? The elephant is at the head, The crows on the wings, The parrots on the tail, The sage says:" "Joga is over." ""

prakrit: "आलिङ्गिऊण पुत्तं,पल्हाओ रुयइ बहुविहपलावं,हा वच्छ! महिलियाए,कएण दुक्खं इमं पत्तो"
english: "Cuddle up, my boy, She is crying her heart out, Having had too much to bear! Women, why trouble this way?"

prakrit: "परिवज्जियमाहारं,कयमोणं मरणनिच्छिउच्छाहं,नाऊण साहइ फुडं,पडिसूरो अञ्जणापगयं"
english: "Traveler, I beg of you, When will I die? The plowman's son will come, And the hunter's daughter will come undone."

prakrit: "एत्तो कुमार! निसुणसु,संझागिरिमत्थए मुणिवरस्स,उप्पन्नं नाणवरं,नामेण अणन्तविरियस्स"
english: "" "Here is a boy! Be restless, sage through the mud, Thanks to your good name, Restless traveler."

prakrit: "तं वन्दिऊण समणं,आगच्छन्तेण तत्थ रयणीए,पलियङ्कगुहाऎ मए,रोवन्ती अञ्जणा दिट्ठा"
english: "Come, tell me," said the hunter, "I will go to that village, Then the women will come, And I will lie in wait in the cowsheds To weep and weep."

prakrit: "परिपुच्छिया य तीए,सिटुं निवासकारणं सवं,आसासिया मए च्चिय,सयणसिणेहं वहन्तेणं"
english: "Aunt, The reason why I sit here is simple: I live in Asia, And women live in it."

prakrit: "तदिवसं चिय तीए,जाओ पुत्तो सुरूवलायण्णो,दिवविमाणारूढो,निज्जन्तो महियले पडिओ"
english: "That day my son," she said, "When the sun has risen, My son, The lamp has flown by, And my beloved has fallen in a heap."

prakrit: "ओइण्णो च्चिय सहसा,गयणाओ अञ्जणाऎ समसहिओ,पेच्छामि बालयं तं,पडियं गिरिकन्दरुद्देसे"
english: "Hey, you silly girl, Can't you see I'm singing to you? It's just a bunch of crap." ""

prakrit: "संचुण्णिओ य सेलो,सहसा बालेण पडियमेत्तेणं,तेणं चिय सिरिसेलो,नाम से कयं कुमारस्स"
english: "Consider what sort of man you are: Suddenly a young boy hits the pavement, Suddenly he starts thinking:" "Siricello, what kind of boy is his name?" ""

prakrit: "सहियाऎ समं बाला,गहियसुया आयरेण लीलाए,नीया हणुरुहनयरं,तत्थ पमोओ कओ विउलो"
english: "Friend, let the sand be still, Let the fresh mud settle on the iron. Wait a moment, my dear: There goes the crow's tail." ""

prakrit: "तत्तो य हणुरुहपुरे,जेणं संवड्डिओ य सो बालो,हणुओ त्ति तेण नाम,बीयं चिय पायडं जायं"
english: "That's the flower of the mango, The one who sows the seed Is the child, The name of the fruit is the bee, And the seed is the grass that grows."

prakrit: "एसा ते परिकहिया,समयं पुत्तेण मह पुरे बाला,अच्छइ महिन्दतणया,मा अन्नमणं तुम कुणसु"
english: "That's the way it goes: Time has run out for me, my dear, It's only because I've had too much fun. So don't waste your time thinking." ""

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,चलिओ पवणंजओ परमतुट्ठो,विज्जाहरेहि समयं,हणुरुहनयरं समणुपत्तो"
english: "Listen to me, wind, let's go. Let the wind blow with all your might. It's the same as winter." ""

prakrit: "विज्जाहरेहि परमो,तत्थेव कओ समागमाणन्दो,बहुखाण-पाण-भोयण-नड-नट्टरमन्तअइसोहो"
english: "Knowledge is supreme, there must be some meeting place for it, There must be plenty of food, water, pastime, and dancing."

prakrit: "गमिऊण दोण्णि मासे,तत्थ गया खेयरा नियपुराइं,पवणंजओ वि अच्छइ,तम्मि पुरे अञ्जणासहिओ"
english: "Gone are these two fish, Gone are those long - eyed parrots. The wind also blows nicely. Take care not to lose sight of them." ""

prakrit: "तत्थेव य हणुमन्तो,संपत्तो जोवणं सह कलासु,साहियविज्जो य पुणो,जाओ बल-विरियसंपन्नो"
english: "Then come what may, For wealth comes with long life, For wisdom comes with perseverance, For strength goes with persistence."

prakrit: "पुत्तेण महिलियाए,सहिओ पवणंजओ हणुरुहम्मि,अच्छइ भोगसमिद्धिं,भुञ्जन्तो सुरवरो चेव"
english: "Young women, Friend, The pleasures of love, Like the fragrance of a sweetmeat, Are delicious When roasted."

prakrit: "पवणगइविओगे अञ्जणासुन्दरीए,परभवजणियं जं पावियं तिबदुक्खं,हणुयभवसमूहं जे सुणन्तीह तुट्ठा,विमलकयविहाणा ते हु पावन्ति सोक्खं"
english: "Aunt, The pleasures you hear Are incomprehensible, The joys you experience Are palpable, The sorrows you suffer Are nothing to be ashamed of, And the sighs you make at the sight of the God of Love Are inexhaustible."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए पवणंजयञ्ज गासुन्दरीसमागमविहाणो नाम अट्ठारसमो उद्देसओ समत्तो"
english: "Praise be to the wind, Which blows the moon, Which makes the sky blue And the moon white."

prakrit: "अह रावणो वि दीहं,कोहभरुवहणदूमियसरीरो,वरुणस्स विग्गहत्थे,मेलेई खेयरे सबे"
english: "Ah, the burning fire of Ravana, The thunderclap of kohl - laden clouds, The clenched fists of Varuna; The fields of melai Are everywhere."

prakrit: "किक्किन्धिपुरनिवासी,पायालङ्कारपुरवरे जे य,रहनेउरवत्थवा,सबे विज्जाहरा मिलिया"
english: "A resident of Kikindipura, a visitor to Payalankarapura, If you stay here all day, You'll have found a treasure of knowledge."

prakrit: "अह रावणेण दूओ,सिग्धं संपेसिओ हणुरुहम्मि,गन्तूण सामिवयणं,कहेइ पडिसूर-पवणाणं"
english: "Oh! Ravana gave it to me, Destroyed the Siddha With a twig of the hunter's bow, Gone is the solemn song, Said the traveler." ""

prakrit: "सुणिऊण दूयवयणं,गमणसमुच्छाहनिच्छियमईया,हणुयस्स निरूवणं ते,करेन्ति रज्जाभिसेयस्स"
english: "Listening is deceitful, Going to and fro is disgusting, Keeping the bees busy, Doing whatever you can to please them."

prakrit: "जणिओ य तूरसदो,पडुषडह-गभीरभेरिनिग्धोसो,मन्ती वि कलसहत्था,हणुयस्स अवट्ठिया पुरओ"
english: "A man who is distressed by anger, Who dwells on deep sorrows, Is always full of trouble, And who is not satisfied with good words?"

prakrit: "परिपुच्छिया य तेणं,साहह किं एरिसं इमं कजं?,मन्तीहि वि परिकहियं,कीरइ रज्जाभिसेओ ते"
english: "Are you sure you don't want to go?" he asked, "What are you doing here, my dear? Even my mind is wandering. What do you expect me to do About it?"

prakrit: "पवणंजएण भणिओ,पुत्तय! सद्दाविया दणुवईणं,अम्हेहि सामिकजं,लङ्का गन्तूण कायबं"
english: "Pawan Jain said," "My son, don't be so hasty. We have to meet again. Let's go to Lanka." ""

prakrit: "अत्थि रसायलनयरे,वरुणो नामेण तस्स पडिसत्तू,पुत्तसयबलसमत्थो,अइचण्डो दुज्जओ समरे"
english: "Atthi rasayalanayare, varuno naame uske padishathu, Putra saibasa samatha, Aisa badho dujjo samarae."

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,हणुमन्तो भणइ विणयनमियङ्गो,सन्तेण मए तुज्झं,न य जुत्तं रणमुहे गन्तुं"
english: "Listen to me when I speak, Honey, tell me when to knit. In my heart I bow before you. I will not turn my back on a warrior."

prakrit: "भणिओ पवणगईणं,पुत्तय! बालो महारणे घोरे,रुट्ठाण भडाण तुमं,अज वि वयणं न पेच्छाहि"
english: "Say:" "Singing girl, Child! The hair grows thicker, The bracelets grow thicker. You still can't hear the wind." ""

prakrit: "भणइ तओ सिरिसेलो,किं ताय! वएण कायरस्स रणे?,बालो वि हु पञ्चमुहो,मत्तगइन्दे खयं नेइ"
english: "You fool, tell me! Why so timid? Does the wind make the cowardly raven? Even the hair of a bull have five faces. Drunken cowgirls will not care." ""

prakrit: "वारिजन्तो वि बहुं,गमणग्गाहं जया न छड्डइ,अणुमन्निओ कुमारो,गुरूण ताहे च्चिय पयट्टो"
english: "There are many who inherit, And those who inherit do not inherit. Dear sons, The teacher has proved your worth." ""

prakrit: "हाओ कयबलिकम्मो,आपुच्छेऊण गुरुयणं सर्व,आरुहिय वरविमाणं,चलिओ लेङ्का सह बलेणं"
english: "Hey, Kayabalikamma! When you touch a teacher, You touch him, When he touches you, You abuse him. Let's talk to him." ""

prakrit: "जलवीइपवओवरि,रत्तिं गमिऊण उग्गए सूरे,पेच्छन्तो सलिलनिहिं,पइसइ लङ्कापुरि हणुओ"
english: "Water lilies, Birds of a feather flock everywhere. When the moon is high It looks like a lotus Powdered by the rays of the moon."

prakrit: "साहणकयपरिहत्थो,सबालङ्कारभूसियसरीरो,निसियरजणेण दिट्ठो,हणुयन्तो सुरकुमारो व"
english: "Friend, You are beyond reproach, You weary beauty, You look at people who are indifferent, When they are angry You look like a handsome man."

prakrit: "एवं दसाणणसहं,हणुओ पविसरइ रयणविच्छुरिओ,सामन्तकयाडोवो,अणेयकुसुमच्चणविहाणो"
english: "And with the Dasana, The hunter is purified, The raptor is dispersed, And the hunter's crows, Undisturbed, Are scattered about the horizon."

prakrit: "मत्तगयलीलगामी,पणमइ लाहिवं पवणपुत्तो,तेण वि ससंभमेणं,अब्भुढेऊण उवगूढो"
english: "Drunken cowgirl, Your husband is angry with you, And you are angry with him For not doing enough."

prakrit: "दिन्नासणे निविटुं,पुच्छइ हणुयं दसाणणो कुसलं,कुणइ य सम्माणवरं,अइगरुयं दाणविभवेणं"
english: "One day he will ask for water, The next day one will tell you where it is, And the next one will give you something to eat."

prakrit: "एवं समत्थसाहण-सहिओ लङ्काहिवो पुरवरीए,रणपरिहत्युच्छाहो,विणिग्गओ वरुणपुरहुत्तो"
english: "And the good warrior pursues the Lankan elephant, The hunter seeks refuge with the wild beast, And the hunter pursues Varuna."

prakrit: "विज्जाऎ सायरवरं,भेत्तूण य वरुणसन्तियं नयरं,संपत्तो च्चिय सहसा,सन्नाहकयङ्गरायबलो"
english: "Knowledge is supreme, Friendship is bound to come, Childhood is barren, Wealth is fleeting, Spring is imminent, Travel is difficult."

prakrit: "सोऊण रावणं सो,समागयं तत्थ सबबलसहिओ,सन्नद्ध-बद्ध-कवओ,विणिग्गओ अहिमुहो वरुणो"
english: "When the sun is hot, Raven is there, When it is high, Strong, ready, committed, Poetesses." "Non - violence is the enemy of virtue."

prakrit: "वरुणस्स सुयाण सयं,अब्भिर्टे रक्खसाण संगामे,सर-सत्ति-खग्ग-मोग्गर-आउहविच्छूढघाओहं"
english: "With the sun in the Varuna, With the heavenly host in the company of heavenly beings, Sir, seventy-seven - The crows, the begging bowl - Here and there I am."

prakrit: "वरुणसुएहि रणमुहे,निद्दयपहरेहि रक्खसाणीयं,भग्गं दठूण सयं,समुट्ठिओ रावणो तुरियं"
english: "The hunter's bow faces the warrior, The sleeper faces the rakshasa, The God of Love looks at him with the straight eye, And at his side is the trumpet of Ravana."

prakrit: "जुज्झन्तो दहवयणो,वरुणस्स सुएहि वेढिओ समरे,मेहेहि व दिवसयरो,पाउसकाले समोत्थरिओ"
english: "War is like a fire, The fences of the sun are like battlefields, The rainy season is like daylight; In the rainy season, it's like a flood."

prakrit: "इन्दइ-बिहीसणा वि य,सुहडा तह भाणुकण्णमाईया,चक्कं व समारूढा,वरुणेण भमाडिया सबे"
english: "Even the darkest night, Like a panorama of fire and water, Is a pleasure to behold, Like the flame of a rainbow."

prakrit: "रक्खसबलं विसण्णं,हणुमन्तो पेच्छिऊण परिकुविओ,बाणासणिं मुयन्तो,समुट्टिओ निययबलसहिओ"
english: "When one looks at the sky, one looks back, When one tries to shoot arrows, One is always stronger."

prakrit: "खग्गेण मोग्गरेण य,चक्कण य पवणनन्दणो सुहडे,आहणइ चडुलपसरन्तविक्कमो जह कयन्तो व"
english: "Because people are angry, Because people make fun of one's behavior, And because people mock one another, They turn their backs on one another."

prakrit: "जुज्झं काऊण चिरं,गिण्हइ वरुणस्स नन्दणे हणुओ,अह रावणो वि बन्धइ,वरुणं चिय नागपासेहिं"
english: "Who will win the fight? The hunter's hunter, Counting the nectar of the Varuna: Even Ravana is in bondage. For the varuna is like a snake possessed by a demon."

prakrit: "घेत्तण पुत्तसहियं,वरुणं आवासिओ वरुज्जाणे,लङ्काहिवो कयत्थो,तत्था''सोणो ससामन्तो"
english: "Wretched son, For the landowner is a barber's son. Where are the lankans going to lodge Their son - in - law will come."

prakrit: "विद्धत्थं नयरवरं,रक्खससुहडेहि नायगविहूणं,गहियवरदवसारं,बन्दीजणसंकुलारावं"
english: "Vidhātma nayāravarāma, rakshasa suhadei nāga vihūna, geheera dharmasāra, prāyaṃśāraṇa jñākula rāṇa"

prakrit: "दिट्ठ रक्खसवइणा,तं नयरं सबओ विलुप्पन्तं,सिग्घं दयालुएणं,निवारियं पवरपुरिसेणं"
english: "Look at that demon, He does not look at you, He is completely indifferent, He shows no mercy, And protects you with all his might."

prakrit: "मुक्को य वरुणराया,सुयसहिओ रावणं पणमिऊणं,हणुयस्स देइ कन्नं,सच्चमई नाम नामेणं"
english: "Come on, you crook, Suicide bomber, Pay attention to Ravana's name. Please, don't touch me if you have to. Name me honestly!"

prakrit: "बत्ते पाणिग्गहणे,वरुणं ठविऊण निययनयरम्मि,रणरसलद्धामरिसो,दहवयणो आगओ लकं"
english: "Wait till the water recedes, The plowman is at hand, The road is slippery after the storm, And the fires are burning."

prakrit: "हणुयस्स रावणेण वि,दिन्ना कन्ना गुणेहि संपुण्णा,धूया चन्दणहाए,अणङ्गकुसुम ति नामेणं"
english: "Even Ravana's wife is poisonous, Dinna kanna guna hi sampurna, Dhuya chandana hai, Anangkusum is her name." ""

prakrit: "काऊण करग्गहणं,तीऎ समं कण्णकुण्डले नयरे,भुञ्जइ भोगसमिद्धि,सिरिसेलो सुरकुमारो छ"
english: "Who is not fond of a loom, Who has eyes like those of an eyelid, Who is fond of feasting? Siricello is a handsome man."

prakrit: "तत्तो नलेण दिन्ना,कन्ना हरिमालिणि ति नामेणं,हणुयस्स किन्नरपुरे,किन्नरकन्नासयं लद्धं"
english: "That is why the river is salty. Can't you see? The golden girdle is yellow? There are eunuchs among the deer And the kinnow tree is red."

prakrit: "किक्किन्धिपुराहिवई,दुहियं ताराऎ तत्थ सुग्गीवो,नामेण पउमरागं,दटुंचिन्तावरो जाओ"
english: "Aunt, There are two stars in one sky And one sunshine in the other. Name my lover; Stop staring at him."

prakrit: "तीए वरस्स कज्जे,बिज्जाहरपत्थिवाण रूवाइं,लिहिऊण आणियाई,कमेण बोला पलोएइ"
english: "She has grown thin, The leaves are drooping, The roads are slippery, The streets are empty, And the streets are deserted."

prakrit: "एवं पलोयमाणी,पेच्छइ हणुयस्स सन्तियं रूवं,कुसुमाउहसमसरिसं,तं चेव अवट्ठियं हियए"
english: "And the doe looks down at the plowman's face; She sees the swelling of the hips, And the twang of the hair falls off." ""

prakrit: "मुणिऊण तीऎ भावं,सुग्गीवो पवणनन्दणं सिग्धं,आणेइ सदूएणं,महया विभवेण साहीणं"
english: "One who prostrates oneself attains that state, One who is well - nourished learns to appreciate one's pastimes, Another who is full of greatness."

prakrit: "हणुएण वरतणू सा,परिणीया दाण-माण-विभवेहिं,सिरिपुरगओ महप्पा,भुञ्जइ भोगे रइगुणड्डे"
english: "Use the gooseflesh, Parinaya gives charity, Mana gives affection, Siripuragao is a great pleasure, Bhunjai bhogay raigundade"

prakrit: "एवं सहस्समेगं,जायं हणुयस्स पवरमहिलाणं,रूव-गुणसालिणीणं,संपुण्णमियङ्कवयणाणं"
english: "And the cloud of happiness, Which is like a column of white smoke rising from the fire of love, Like a banner proclaiming good and evil."

prakrit: "अह रावणो वि रज्जं,कुणइ तिखण्डाहिवो विजियसत्तू,सिरि-कित्ति-लच्छिनिलओ,विजाहरनमियषयवीढो"
english: "Oh! Ravana too has a king, He makes sharp knives triumphant, Staircases quiver, And temples resound." ""

prakrit: "चक्कं सुदरिसणं तं,दिवं मज्झण्हकालरविसरिसं,दण्डरयणं पि जायं,भयजणणं सबरायाणं"
english: "A good night's sleep is like a full moon in the middle of the day; To walk in darkness is like going through the night; To be afraid is like walking in the street."

prakrit: "एवं जिणिन्दवरसासणसुद्धभावा,काऊण पुण्णमउलं इह माणुसत्ते,ते देवलोगजणियं विमलं सरीरं,पावन्ति उत्तमसुहं च सया समिद्धं"
english: "And what pleasure is there to be had in sitting on a lotus Leaf? It is the lotus of humanity, Like the body of a God of Love, Endowed with supreme bliss."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए रावणरज्जविहाणो नाम एगूणवीसइमो उद्देसओ समत्तो"
english: "My dear, The name of the warrior Ravana means" "God of Love." ""

prakrit: "एवं मगहाहिवई,चरियं सोऊण रक्खसिन्दस्स,पुच्छइ गणहरवसहं,जिण-चकहराण उप्पत्ती"
english: "And the tiger - eyed woman, Who finds a spot in the forest To protect her husband, Asks what people want in return." ""

prakrit: "अट्ठमओ पुण जो सो,बलदेवो तिहुयणम्मि विक्खाओ,वंसे कस्स महायस!,उप्पन्नो किं व से चरियं?"
english: "The eighth is the first, The third is the last, And who is the greatest in the world?" "What is the use of saying such a thing?"

prakrit: "एवं गणाहिवो सो,जं भणिओ सेणिएण नमिऊणं,तो साहिउं पवत्तो,उसभाईणं जिगवराणं"
english: "And what he said:" "O warrior, bow down before your enemy." "That expression must mean something else."

prakrit: "उसभो अजिओ य जिणो,सुरमहिओ संभवो भवविणासो,अहिणन्दणो य सुमई,पउमसवण्णो सुपासो य"
english: "He who conquers knows what is possible, Who conquers what is impossible, Who destroys what is beautiful, Who restores what is peaceful, Who preserves what is pure."

prakrit: "चन्दाभो कुसुमरदो,दसमो पुण सीयलो य सेयंसो,भयवं पि वासुपुज्जो,विमलो'णन्तो य धम्मो य"
english: "The moon is red like a safflower, The tenth day is full of wind and rain, And fear is like the scent of a wasp. Vimal's name is Dharma." ""

prakrit: "सन्ती कुन्थू य अरो,मल्ली मुणिसुबओ नमो नेमी,पासो य वद्धमाणो,जस्स इमं वट्टए तित"
english: "Santhi kunthu ya aro, Malli munisubba, Namo nemi, paaso ya vaddhamana, Jas mein vattaye tita."

prakrit: "परलोयम्मि पहाणा,आसि पुरी पुण्डरीगिणी पढमा,तयणन्तरं सुसीमा,खेमपुरी रयणवरचम्पा"
english: "Paraloyami pahana, Asi puri pundrigini padma, Taiantar susima, Khempuri rayanvarachampa."

prakrit: "उसभाई तित्थगरा,जाव च्चिय वासुपुज्जजिणवसभो,तावेयाउ पुरीओ,आसि पुरा रायहाणीओ"
english: "Ustaibhai Titthagara, Jawab chiye vasupujjina vasobhai, Tawayau puriyo, Asi puri raihanio"

prakrit: "एत्तो य महानयर,रिट्ठपुरं भदिलं च विक्खायं,अह पुण्डरीगिणी वि य,हवइ सुसीमा महानयरी"
english: "Such a great warrior, Wretched man and woman, Such a wise woman. Such is the greatness of Susima"

prakrit: "खेमा ववगयसोगा,चम्पा नयरी तहेव कोसम्बी,नागपुरं साएया,छत्तायारं पुरं रम्मं"
english: "Khema vavgayasoga, Champa nairi deva kosambi, Nagpur saeya, Chhatayaran pura ram"

prakrit: "सेसाण जिणवराणं,अणुपरिवाडीऎ पुवजम्मम्मि,नरवइधम्मपुरीओ,एयाओ सुरपुरिसमाओ"
english: "Love is a living organism, The flowers of one's family are jasmine, The pleasures of man's dharma are pure, Such is the virtue of love."

prakrit: "पढमो'त्थ वजनाभो,बीओ पुण विमलवाहणो होइ,अह विउलवाहणो वि य,महाबलो अइबलो चेव"
english: "Reader, That's the weight of my breasts. Once again I will be the bearer of lotuses. Once more I will carry wiles. The greatest are the weak."

prakrit: "अवराइओ'त्थ अन्नो,हवइ तहा नन्दिसेणनामो य,पउमो य महापउमो,एत्तो पउमुत्तरो चेव"
english: "Our mother - in - law said:" "There it is, A name with which we express our gratitude, A great name to our wife." ""

prakrit: "राया पङ्कयगुम्मो,अणुपरिवाडीऎ नलिणिगुम्मो य,पउमासणो य एत्तो,पउमरहो दढरहो चेव"
english: "It's like a river in spate, Like a drain in a barber's house, Like the river in distress." ""

prakrit: "मेहरहो सीहरहो,वेसमणो चेव हवइ सिरिधम्मो,सुवइट्ठो सुरजेट्ठो,सिद्धत्थो चेव आणन्दो"
english: "Kindness is pure, detachment is eternal, modesty is straightforward, politeness is beautiful, purity leads to perfection, and honesty leads to virtue."

prakrit: "तह चेव सुणन्दो खलु,इमाणि तित्थंकराण पुवभवे,नामाणि आसि सेणिय,सिट्ठाइँ मए कमेणं तु"
english: "There you are, Trembling with excitement, Sounding like a warrior's bow, Doing your best to please him." ""

prakrit: "पढमो य वज्जसेणो,अरिदमणो तह सयंपभो चेव,अह विमलवाहणो पुणो,गुरवो सीमंधरो वीरो"
english: "The hunter is a wise man, The arrow is cruel, And the traveler is clever; The warrior is the master of the frontier."

prakrit: "पिहियासवो महप्पा,अरिदमणो तह जुगंधरो य मुणी,सबजणाणन्दयरो,सत्थाओ वज्जदत्तो य"
english: "The wise are great, The arid are arid, And the wise are sages; Everyone knows the good., The clever are wise."

prakrit: "गुरवो य वजनाभो,सबसुगुत्तो तहा मुणेयवो,चित्तारिक्खो अह विमलवाहणो घणरहो चेव"
english: "A teacher is weighty, one who knows all pleasures puts them to the test, And a good draughtsman is clever."

prakrit: "अह संवरो य एत्तो,साहू वि य संवरो मुणेयवो,वरधम्मो य सुनन्दो,नन्दो य वईयसोगो य"
english: "Ah, the summer is here, The summer is past, The rainy season is almost over, And winter is just around the corner; So is the rainy season."

prakrit: "भणिओ य डामरमणी,पोट्टिल्लो चेव पुवजम्मम्मि,तित्थयराणं एए,कमेण गुरवो मुणेयवा"
english: "Say: Damarmani, Puttilo chevu pujammami, Titthayaran aye, Kamen guru munaywa." ""

prakrit: "सबटुं विजयन्तं,गेविजं बे जयन्तनामं च,उवरिम-मज्झिम भणिया,गेविज्जा वेजयन्तं च"
english: "Everything is triumphant; Gevism and chaste names, Uvrim-Majjhim bhania, Gevizja and vegetable vows."

prakrit: "अवराइयं विमाणं,नायवं आरणं महाभागं,पुप्फोत्तरं च एत्तो,काविळं अह सहस्सारं"
english: "The unmanned aircraft, the new ones, form the bulk of the fleet, and the later ones, constitute the bulk."

prakrit: "पुप्फोत्तरं च विजयं,एत्तो अवराइयं वरविमाणं,तह चेव वेजयन्तं,अन्ते पुप्फोत्तरं होइ"
english: "Victory to virtue and vice versa, So abundant is the promise of abundance, So plentiful is the harvest; In the end, virtue will be supreme."

prakrit: "एएसु विमाणेसुं,चइया तित्थंकरा समुप्पन्ना,इह भारहम्मि वासे,सुर-असुरनमंसिया सिद्धा"
english: "This is Vimanesu, Chaiya Titthankara Samuppanna, This is Bharahammi Vasaye, Sura - Asuran - Manasiya Siddha"

prakrit: "नयरी माया य पिया,नक्खत्तं नाणपायवो चेव,निबाणगमणठाणं,कहेमि सबं जिणवराणं"
english: "Nayri maya ya piya, nakhttam naan payavo chevu, nirvangamanthanam, I say make all alive."

prakrit: "साएयं मरुदेवी,नाही तह उत्तरा य आसाढा,वडरुक्खो अट्ठावय,पढमजिणो मङ्गलं दिसउ१"
english: "Our desert goddess, No, there is no hope of an answer. Wait for the banyan tree. May the first day bring good luck!"

prakrit: "अह कोसला य विजया,जियसत्तू रोहिणी जिणो अजिओ,रुक्खो य सत्तवण्णो,सेणिय! तुह मङ्गलं दिसउ२"
english: "Ah, victory to the kosala! As long as Rohini is alive, The tree is alive and well, And so is the warrior. May there be auspiciousness for you." ""

prakrit: "सावत्थी सेणा वि य,विज़यारी संभवो जिणवरिन्दो,इन्दतरू वरसालो,मगहाहिव! फुसउ पावं ते३"
english: "Savatthi sena vi, vijayari sambhavo jinvarindo, Indratru varsalo, Magahahiwa! Blow on that foot." ""

prakrit: "सिद्धत्था पढमपुरी,रिक्खं तु पुणबसू सरलरुक्खो,अह संवरो नरिन्दो,जिणो य अहिणन्दणो पुणउ४"
english: "Siddhata Padampuri, Rest assured you will live long. Be well, my dear Narindo. As for victory or non - violence, rest assured." ""

prakrit: "मेहप्पभो पियङ्ग,सुमङ्गला पुरवरी य साएया,रिक्खं मघा य सुमई,मङ्गलमउलं तुह नरिन्द!५"
english: "Dear peacock, A full moon is ahead of you, A fragrant sunny day awaits you, And a fragrant moonlight welcomes you! 5" ""

prakrit: "कोसम्बी य सुसीमा,पियङ्गु चित्ता य पत्थिवो य धरो,पउमप्पभो जिणिन्दो,हवउ सया मङ्गलं तुज्झ६"
english: "Koshambi ya Susima, Piyangu chitta ya pathivo ya dhor, Poomappu bhor jinindo, hawa saya mangalam tumja 6."

prakrit: "सुषइट्ठो कासिपुरं,पुहइ विसाहा सिरीसरुक्खो य,तित्थंकरो सुपासो,एसो ते मङ्गलं परमं७"
english: "Rest in peace Kashipur, complete rest in a few days, long sleep, this is the supreme auspiciousness." 7

prakrit: "चन्दाभो चन्दपुरी,महसेणो लक्खणा य अणुराहा,नागढुमो य परमं,मङ्गलमउलं तिहुयणन्मि८"
english: "The moon is Chandapuri, Mahasena is characterized by its fragrance, Nagadhuma is supreme, Mangala is the fruit of three vows."

prakrit: "कायन्दी सुग्गीवो,रामा मूलं च पुप्फदन्तजिणो,मल्लीदुमो य तुझं,सेणिय! पावं पणासेन्तु९"
english: "May the harvest be abundant, May the jasmine blossom into a flower, May your bow become fragrant, O warrior! 9" "Pay attention to your feet!"

prakrit: "भदिलपुरं सुनन्दा,पुवासाढा य दढरहो राया,तुह सीयलो जिणिन्दो,निग्गोहदुमो य पावहरो१०"
english: "Foolish girl, stay awake for a while, Wait till the moon is full. Your lips find a place to rest, But don't go anywhere else." 10

prakrit: "सीहपुरं विण्हुसिरी,समणो विण्ह य नरवई होइ,सेयंसो तित्थयरो,तिन्दुगरुक्खो सुहं दिसउ११"
english: "Friend, tell me, A weaned woman, Or a man made of fine twigs, Would be more pleasant to eat Than a teaspoonful." 11

prakrit: "चम्पा पाडलरुक्खो,जया य वसुपुज्जपत्थिवो होइ,भयवं तु वासुपुज्जो,नक्खत्तं सयभिसा पुणउ१२"
english: "You silly girl, Wherever the wind blows, There must be something wrong with you. Fear the wind; Stop twisting your nose so that it does not speak." 12

prakrit: "कम्पिल्ला कयधम्मो,सम्मा विमलो य जम्बुरुक्खो य,उत्तरभद्दवया वि य,सेयं कुबन्तु ते निययं १३"
english: "Kambilla kayadhamma, samma vimlo ya jamburukkho, uttar bhadra vidya ya, se kubuntu the same niyama 13."

prakrit: "अउसत्थो सबजसा,नक्खत्तं रेवई अणन्तजिणो,राया य सीहसेणो,साएया ते सुहं दिसउ१४"
english: "Always be vigilant, always be on the lookout, Always remain vigilant, Always smile, Always look out for the bad guy." 14

prakrit: "रयणपुरं दहिवण्णो,भाणू धम्मो य सुबया जणणी,पुस्सो य हवइ रिखं,एए तुह मङ्गलं देन्तु१५"
english: "Rayanpur: Daughter - in - law, Speak dharma, Give birth to happiness, Write wealth, O god of good fortune." ""

prakrit: "अइराणी नागपुरं,भरणी रिक्खं च नन्दिरुस्खो य,राया य विस्ससेणो,सन्तिजिणो कुणउ तुह सन्ति१६"
english: "Dear Nagpur, Thanks to your generous support, Dear Vissay Sen, The virtues of kindness belong to you." ""

prakrit: "नागपुरं तिलयसिरी,कुन्थुजिणो कित्तिया य नक्खत्तं,सूरनराहिवसहियाणि तुज्झ पावं पणासन्तु१७"
english: "Nagpur tilayashiri, kunthujino kitiya ya nakshattam, suranarahiva sahayani tumse paavam panasanthu17"

prakrit: "मित्ता सुदरिसणो वि य,पढमपुरी अरजिणो य चूयदुमो,रिक्खं च रोहिणी तुह,कुणउ सया मङ्गलविहाणं १८"
english: "Dear friend, I beg of you All the best. Please, my dear, Stop being so touchy And stop being so angry With you. Happy wedding day! 18." ""

prakrit: "मिहिला कुम्भनरिन्दो य,रिक्खया अस्सिणी जिणो मल्ली,नाणदुमो य असोगो,सोगं नासन्तु वो सिग्घ१९"
english: "Friend, if you are rich, Conquer your enemies, Create wealth, Promote good and evil, And sigh not, For there is no mourning." 19

prakrit: "पउमावई कुसग्गं,समणो वि हु चम्पओ सुमित्तो य,मुणिसुवओ जिणिन्दो,तुह पावमलं पणासेउ२०"
english: "You silly girl, I swear I'm still a champ. But you fool, You won't win. Pay attention to your faults." ""

prakrit: "विजओ य मिहिल वप्पा,बउलदुमो अस्सिणी नमिजिणिन्दो,मयहाहिवई! तुझं,समागमं देन्तु धम्मस्स२१"
english: "" "Victory to you, my dear! Be reasonable! For your part, my lord, You have proved excellent." "21 Give your word, dharma."

prakrit: "सोरियपुरं तु एत्तो,समुद्दविजओ सिवा य उज्जेन्तो,चित्ता य रिट्ठनेमी,नरिन्द! तुह मङ्गलं देन्तु२२"
english: "Soriyapur:" "Here you are, O ocean of wisdom, Only rising and setting in your mind, Friend! May goodness bless you22." ""

prakrit: "वाणारसी विसाहा,पासो वम्मा य आससेणो य,अहिछत्ता बाहिरओ,तुह मङ्गलकारयाणि सया२३"
english: "Vanarasi Visaha, paasa vamma yasa asesena, non - activity outside, your good deeds are in vain." ""

prakrit: "सिद्धत्थो कुण्डपुरं,सरलो पियकारिणी य हत्थो य,भयवं वीरजिणिन्दो,देन्तु सया मङ्गलं तुज्झ२४"
english: "Siddhattho kundapuram, Saralo drinker, Ya haatho ya, Bhairav, Veera jinindo, Daathu saya, Mangalam is yours24"

prakrit: "अट्ठावयम्मि उसभो,सिद्धो चम्पाऎ वासुपुज्जजिणो,पावाऎ वद्धमाणो,नेमी उज्जेन्तसिहरम्मि"
english: "The south wind blows hot, The hot sun scorches the sky, The sky is red, The river is swollen."

prakrit: "अवसेसा तित्थयरा,सम्मेए निव्वुया सिवं पत्ता,जो पढइ सुणइ पुरिसो,सो बोहिफलं समज्जेइ"
english: "Awase! A lotus is growing on the lotus leaf. One who reads it understands what it is to hear it."

prakrit: "सन्ती कुन्थू य अरो,तित्थयरा चक्कवट्टिणो आसि,सेसा पुण जिणवसभा,हवन्ति सामन्नरायाणो"
english: "Santee kunthu ya auro, Titthayara chakkavattinu aasi, Sesa pun jivanvasabha, Havanti samanraya?"

prakrit: "चन्दाभो चन्दनिभो,बीओ पुण पुप्फदन्तजिणवसभो,कुसुमपियङ्गुसवण्णो,हवइ सुपासो विगयमोहो"
english: "The moon is bright, The bees are plentiful, The jasmine trees are fragrant, The sky is fragrant with fresh flowers."

prakrit: "वरतरुणसालिवण्णो,पासो नागिन्दसंथुओ भयवं,पउमाभो पउमनिभो,वसुपुज्जो किसुयसुवण्णो"
english: "The wretched night is past, The sighs of fear settle on the young man's face, The husband is about to depart, And the wife has a kiss on the mouth."

prakrit: "अञ्जणगिरिसरिसनिभो,हवइ य मुणिसुबओ तियसनाहो,बरहिणकण्ठावयवो,नेमिजिणो जायवाणन्दो"
english: "Be attentive to those who are sagging under the weight of resentment, Be considerate when making love, Be thoughtful when embracing one's enemy."

prakrit: "निद्धन्तकणयवण्णा,सेसा तित्थंकरा समक्खाया,मल्ली अरिट्ठनेमी,पासो वीरो य वसुपुज्जो"
english: "Niddhantakanayavanna, Sesa Titthankara Samakhya, Malli Arithanemi, Paaso veero ya Vasupujjo"

prakrit: "एए कुमारसीहा,गेहाओ निग्गया जिणवरिन्दा,सेसा वि हु रायाणो,पुहई भोत्तूण निक्खन्ता"
english: "Oh! you foolish girl, Are these the only words that come out of my mouth When I tell you the truth?"

prakrit: "एए 'जिणिन्दचन्दा,सुर-नरमहिय-'च्चिया निययकालं,पत्ता महाभिसेयं,जम्मणसमए गिरिन्दम्मि"
english: "Ah, the moonlit night, The scent of jasmine - Niyayamkaalam, pata mahabhiseyam, Girindami at the time of bathing"

prakrit: "संपत्ता कल्लाणं,परमपयं सासयं सिवं ठाणं,तिहुयणमङ्गलनिलया,देन्तु गई जिणवरा सवे"
english: "Wealth is auspicious, loving mother - in - law is dear to all beings, long - suffering is inevitable, and all beings prosper."

prakrit: "आउपमाणं तह अन्तरं च तित्थयर-चक्कवट्टीणं,जो जस्स हवइ तित्थे,बलदेवो चक्कवट्टी वा"
english: "As the wind blows, So the lightning flashes, So does the god of lightning."

prakrit: "तुज्झ पसाएण अहं,एवं इच्छामि जाणिउं भयब!,साहसु फुड-वियडत्थं,जह वत्तं कालसमयम्मि"
english: "I am afraid of your anger, And I want you to know that I am scared! Be brave, my dear, For the time is at hand." ""

prakrit: "एवं च भणियमेत्ते,मगहनरिन्देण गोयमो ताहे,जलहरगम्भीरसरो,कहेइ सबं निरवसेसं"
english: "And she said," "I've never been so angry." "And then, with a heavy sigh, She said:" "It's all for naught."

prakrit: "जो वित्थरेण अत्थो,संखाऎ अवडिओ अइमहन्तो,सो बुहयणेण एत्तो,गहिओ-संखेवओ सबो"
english: "One who is scattered abroad is at home, Those who are stranded are in great distress; Here's to you, my dear: Everyone is stranded."

prakrit: "जं जोयणवित्थिण्णं,ओगाढं जोयणं तु वालस्स,एगदिणजायगस्स उ,भरियं वालग्गकोडीणं"
english: "That which was yoked together, that which was wet between yokes, You fool, Is the yoke of one day." ""

prakrit: "वाससए वाससए,एकेके अवहियम्मि जो कालो,कालेण तेण एवं,हवइ य पलिओवमं एकं"
english: "A man who lives in a village, Who hates each other Because he is black, Has time for that, And because he loves nature Has only one mother."

prakrit: "दस कोडाकोडीओ,पल्लाणं सागरं हवइ एकं,दसकोडाकोडीओ,उदहीण'वसप्पिणी हवइ"
english: "Ten kodakodas, one for the ocean beyond, Ten for the kodaka, One for the grasshopper without roots."

prakrit: "उस्सप्पिणी वि एवं,सरिसा परियत्तदेसभावेणं,जह बहुलसुक्कपक्खे,ओसरइ पवड्डई चन्दो"
english: "Like the full moon, Like the south wind blowing across the horizon, Like a lotus in bloom, The moon is slipping away."

prakrit: "छब्भेया उद्दिट्ठा,कालविभागस्स होन्ति नायबा,भरहेरवएसु सया,कुणन्ति परियट्टणं एए"
english: "Impossible, silly girl, The passage of time is impossible, The roads are impassable, And so is the traveler's pen."

prakrit: "कालो अइसुसमाए,कोडाकोडीउ हवइ चत्तारि,सुसमा पुण तिण्णि भवे,सूसमदुसमा य दो चेव"
english: "In the dark season, Kodakodi's breeze is scorching, There must be three good nights, And there must be two good nights."

prakrit: "एक्का कोडाकोडी,बायालीसं भवे सहस्सेहिं,वासेहि य ऊणो खलु,दूसमसुसमाऎ कालोउ"
english: "Ekka Kodakodi, Forty two ways to be happy, Only one way to be warm, Only time will tell when it's bad"

prakrit: "एगावीससहस्सा,कालो च्चिय दूसमाऎ परिणमइ,अच्चन्तदूसमाए,तावइओ चेव नायबो"
english: "One day you will be angry, Another day it will be worse, And then the next. So do not be alarmed."

prakrit: "पन्नाससयसहस्सा,उदहीकोडोण अन्तरं पढमं,बीयं तु हवइ तोसा,तइयं दस होन्ति नायवं"
english: "Fifty sighs, Let me read the difference between the two. The seed is yours to sow. You have sown it all in ten days."

prakrit: "नवनउई य चउत्थं,नउइ सहस्साणि पञ्चमं भणियं,नव चेव सहस्सा पुण,सायरनामाण छटुं तु"
english: "A new word means four, a new breath is a fifth, A new spirit is a whole."

prakrit: "नव चेव सया भणिया,सत्तमयं अन्तरं सुयधरेहिं,नउइं पुण अट्ठमयं,नवमं नव चेव नायवं"
english: "A new beginning is always foretold, A new ending is always dawning, Anew the eighth is never to return."

prakrit: "छावद्विसयसहस्सा,छवीससहस्स वाससंखाए,उदहिसएण य ऊणा,एगा कोडी य दसमम्मि"
english: "Two hundred and twenty thousand feet long, Twenty-six thousand wide, One hundred and fifty feet high, This is the tenth month of the year."

prakrit: "चउपन्नसागराइं,तीसा नव चेव होन्ति चत्तारि,एया अन्तराई,अणुपरिवाडीऎ भणियाइं"
english: "Four hundred and fifty sarees, Teesa nava cheva hanti chatari, Eya antarai, these are the words of one family." ""

prakrit: "तिण्णेव सागराइं,तीसु य भागेसु होन्ति पल्लस्स,ऊणाणि य पन्नरसं,जिणन्तरं होइ नायव"
english: "The three seas are blue, The three rivers are white, The five rivers are swollen, And the last river is barren."

prakrit: "पल्लद्धं सोलसमं,सत्तरसं अन्तरं चउन्माओ,पल्लस्स हवइ ऊणो,कोडिसहस्सेण वासाणं"
english: "The plowman is only sixteen, the begging bowl is seventy, the wind is lukewarm, the flute is seven hundred."

prakrit: "कोडिसहस्सं वासाण,होइ अट्ठारसन्तरं एत्तो,चउपन्नसयसहस्सा,जिणन्तरं ऊणवीसइमं"
english: "One hundred and twenty thousand lusts, Eight hundred and fifty thousand here and there, And after that twenty-nine."

prakrit: "छ च्चेव सयसहस्सा,वीसइमं अन्तरं समुद्दिटुं,पञ्चेव हवइ लक्खा,जिणन्तरं एगवीसइमं"
english: "Six hundred thousand dollars, The sea is full of twenties, The wind blows five hundred dollars, And after that twenty thousand dollars."

prakrit: "पन्नासा सत्त सया,तेयासीई सहस्स बावीसं,अड्डाइज्जा य सया,तेवीसं अन्तरं होइ"
english: "Fifty is seven hundred, thirty is eighty-two, whether it's one hundred or another, There must be a difference."

prakrit: "एयावीस सहस्सा,तित्थं वीरस्स कालसंखाए,होही परं तु नियमा,अइदुसमा तत्तिया चेव"
english: "Such patience, so short a period for such valour, But you are the rule. Such is the state of things."

prakrit: "परिनिव्वुए जिणिन्दे,वीरे अइसयविवज्जिओ कालो,बल-चक्क-हरिविमुक्को,होही नाणुत्तमविहीणो"
english: "Those who attain perfection win, The brave, those who attain them, Are black as a mark of distinction, Strong as a seal, Who are devoid of virtue."

prakrit: "होहिन्ति पुहइपाला,दुट्ठा दुस्सीलनिवया पावा,बहुकूडकवडभरिया,नरा य कोहुज्जयमईया"
english: "Hohenti poohipala, dutta dushilaniva paava, bahudakadakaavadya, nara ya kohujjayamayi." ""

prakrit: "गोडण्डयसरिसेसुं,नट्टा सयमेव ते कुहम्मेसु,नासेहिन्ति बहुजणं,कुदिट्ठिसत्थेसु बहुएसु"
english: "Goddammit, never mind that you're hot. Too many people for your nose. Too much water for your eyes."

prakrit: "अइविट्ठि अणाविट्ठो,विसमा वि हु विट्ठिसंपया काले,होहिन्ति दुस्समाए,सभावपरिणामजोगेणं"
english: "Go away from here, you fool, I'm still here. In due course you'll have to suffer the consequences."

prakrit: "सत्तेव य रयणीओ,आयषमाणं नराण दुसमाए,हाणो कमेण होही,अन्ते पुण दोण्णि रयणोओ"
english: "The wretched women live only for the sake of wealth, The simple men suffer only in misery, The mean ones die only in bitterness, And finally both wretches die."

prakrit: "वाससयं पुण आउं,दुसमाए आदिमं समुद्दिट्ट,परिहाइ इह कमेणं,जावं तेवीस वरिसाइं"
english: "May the spring come again, May the tenth primordial ocean, May it last a year, May there be twenty-three more"

prakrit: "अइदुस्समाऎ होहिइ,आयपमाणं तु दोण्णि रयणीओ,वरिसाणि वीस आउं,नराण निद्धम्मबुद्धीणं"
english: "It's going to be rough weather, you two - nasty women, The wedding is in full swing, And the bridegroom is about to depart." ""

prakrit: "अइदुस्समाऎ अन्ते,एगा रयणी नराण उच्चत्तं,आउं सोलस वरिसाणि,ताण कालाणुभावेणं"
english: "At the end of the rainy season, Here comes the wretched woman On top of her husband, And there comes the solitary bridegroom. Time is of the essence To her."

prakrit: "न य पत्थिवा ण भिच्चा,न गिहाणि न उस्सवा न संबन्धा,होहिन्ति धम्मरहिया,मणुया य सरिस्सवाहारा"
english: "There is no pathiva, no begging, no yoking, no making contact. But the dharma-rahya is here, Like the stream of water in a man's womb." ""

prakrit: "आउ बलं उस्सेहो,एवं अवसप्पिणोऎ अवसरइ,वड्डइ य कमेण पुणो,उस्सप्पिणिकालसमयम्मि"
english: "May there be strength, And may there be occasion for sighing, When one has grown weary Of doing one's business again, In due course of time."

prakrit: "एवं जिणन्तराई,नरवइ कालो य तुज्झ परिकहिओ,एत्तो कमेण निसुणसु,उस्सेहा''उं जिणिन्दाणं"
english: "And you won't win, you silly girl. Stop being so mean. It's his life to lose." ""

prakrit: "अट्ठारस तेर अट्ठ य,सयाणि सेसेसु पञ्चधणुवीसं,पडिहायन्तो कमसो,उस्सेहो कुलगराण इमो"
english: "Eighteen is three o'clock, the elder is two, the younger is three, and the younger one is less." ""

prakrit: "पञ्च सयाणि धणूणं,उस्सेहो आइजिणवरिन्दस्स,अट्ठसु पन्नासा पुण,परिहाणी होइ नियमेणं"
english: "Five young men are enough for one husband, One hundred and fifty is enough for two wives, And the law is fair."

prakrit: "सीयलजिणस्स नउई,भवइ असीया सत्तरी य सट्ठि त्ति,पन्नासा य कमेणं,उस्सेहो जिणवराणं तु"
english: "There is no such thing as pure wisdom, There are seventy of us sitting here, And fifty of us working here. So you must be making a living."

prakrit: "अट्ठसु य पञ्चहाणी,नव रयणी सत्त होन्ति रयणीओ,तित्थयराण पमाणं,एयं संखेवओ भणियं"
english: "Eight hundred and fifty women, seven hundred and ninety women, That is the whole of Tithyara; This is the speech of the Sankha."

prakrit: "पल्लस्स अट्ठभागो,तस्स वि य हवेज्ज जो दसमभागो,तं कुलगरस्स आउं,पढमस्स जिणेहि परिकहियं"
english: "The Pallasa is the eighth part, so also the Hwaja, who is the tenth part, Let him gather the jasmine, For the first month I shall conquer."

prakrit: "एवं दसमो दसमो,भागो अवसरइ आउखन्धस्स,सेसाण कुलगराणं,नाभिस्स य पुत्र कोडीओ"
english: "And on the tenth day or the tenth, She runs away, Shesha groans, Nabhi's son is puzzled." ""

prakrit: "चुलसीइ सयसहस्सा,पुवाणं आउयं तु उसभस्स,बावत्तरी य अजिए,छण्हं पुण दस य परिहाणी"
english: "You silly girl, When the time comes you'll have to make love again."

prakrit: "दोण्णि य एक्कं लक्खं,कमेण दोण्हं जिणाण पुवाउं,चुलसीती बावत्तरि,सट्ठी तीसा य दस एकं"
english: "Two are worth a million, One earns two, And the other is worth a hundred and thirty."

prakrit: "एए हवन्ति लक्खा,वासाणं जिणवराण छण्डं पि,पञ्चाणउइ सहस्सा,चउरासीई य नायबा"
english: "Oh! there are signs, Like the syllables of a song That revive a passion, Like five vows Endured By one's neighbor."

prakrit: "पणपन्ना पणतीसा,दस य सहस्सा सहस्समेगं च,वासाण सयं एत्तो,हवन्ति बावत्तरि वासा"
english: "Love is like thirty vows, Ten vows, and a hundred vows. Vasa is like these: The wife vows unto her husband." ""

prakrit: "एवं तित्थयराणं,आउं सेणिय! मए समक्खाय,जो जस्स अन्तरे पुण,चक्कहरो तं इओ सुणसु"
english: "" "And Titty, come on, girl! I agree. What's going on inside, you fool, listen to this."

prakrit: "उसभे सुमङ्गलाए,जाओ भरहो य पढमचक्कहरो,अह पुण्डरीगिणीए,बाहू सो आसि अन्नभवे"
english: "By the way, Sumangala, go - between, For he is full of flour, And I am full of rice. So come, my dear, Let him eat." ""

prakrit: "जिणवइरसेणपुत्तो,मरिऊणं पत्थिओ य सबटुं,तत्तो चुओ समाणो,भरहो होऊण सिद्धिगओ१"
english: "Life is short, To die is long, To suffer is hard, To prosper is to be wealthy."

prakrit: "पुहईपुरम्मि राया,विजओ नामेण जसहरं गुरवं,लहिऊण य निक्खन्तो,गओ य विजयं वरविमाणं"
english: "Praise be to the full moon, Glory to the God of victory. But if you neglect it, Victory will be yours."

prakrit: "चइऊण कोसलाए,विजएणं जसवईऎ जाओ सो,सगरो पुत्तविओगे,काऊण तवं गओ मोक्खं२"
english: "He who seeks victory Goes in vain, My son, go in vain; For who can find it And who can escape it?"

prakrit: "अह पुण्डरीगिणीए,ससिप्पभो विमलमुणिवरसयासे,घेत्तूण य जिणदिक्खं,गेविज्जे सुरवरो जाओ"
english: "Hey, you silly girl, Stop your whispering, you fool, You won't see him live. But go, you coward." ""

prakrit: "तत्तो चुओ समाणो,सावत्थीए सुमित्तरायस्स,जाओ य भामिणीए,मघवं नामेण चक्कहरो"
english: "There you are, my good friend, Going out in the middle of the night, Going by the wrong name."

prakrit: "धम्मस्स य सन्तिस्स य,जिणन्तरे भुञ्जिउं भरहवासं,काऊण जिणवरतवं,सणंकुमारं गओ कप्पं३"
english: "Dharma means contentment, Wherever you roast rice, There is hope for a long life. But go, girl, For the harvest is abundant." 3

prakrit: "एत्तो सणंकुमारो,अइरूवो तिहुयणम्मि विक्खाओ,उप्पन्नो चक्कहरो,तत्थेव जिणन्तरे धीरो"
english: "Here is a poor man's house, There are many trees on the street, And the streets are empty. So be patient while you live."

prakrit: "तो भणइ मगहराया,केण व पुण्णाणुभावजणिएणं,जाओ सो अइरूवो,कहेहि मे कोउयं भयवं!"
english: "So he says," "Please, tell me, Who would you like to make friends with again?" "Go and tell him:" "I'm scared of someone!" ""

prakrit: "संखेवेण गणहरो,कहेइ सर्व पुराणसंबन्धं,अत्थेत्थ भरहवासे,गामो गोवद्धणो नामं"
english: "Sankhaven Ganaharo, says everything about the Puranas, resides in true faith; the village is the name of the cowherd."

prakrit: "सावयकुलसंभूओ,जिणदत्तो नाम गहवई तत्थ,सायारतवं काउं,कालगओ पत्थिओ सुगई"
english: "Savoy kulasambhuo, Jinda datta naam ghavai tath, Sayaratvam kaun, Kaalgao pathiyo sugai."

prakrit: "महिला तस्स विओए,विणयवई जिणहरं अइमहन्तं,काराविय दढचित्ता,पवजं गिहिऊण मया"
english: "In the absence of a wife, I will dedicate my life to protecting her."

prakrit: "नामेण मेहबाहू,तत्थेगो गहवई परिवसइ,भद्दो सम्मद्दिट्ठी,धीरो उच्छाहवन्तो य"
english: "In name only, Mehboob, That is why the villagers are so distressed; The wicked are always ready; The patient are welcome."

prakrit: "ठूण जिणाययणे,विणयमईसन्तिए महापूयं,सद्दहिऊण मओ सो,तत्तो जक्खो समुप्पन्नो"
english: "Be nice to each other, be polite, be courteous, be reasonable, and never be rude."

prakrit: "कुणइ य वेयावच्चं,चाउचण्णस्स समणसङ्घस्स,जिणसासणाणुरत्तो,विसुद्धसम्मत्तदढभावो"
english: "Virtuous is the highest form of behavior, Equitable is the union of four sexes, In the consciousness of one being, Wisdom prevails over reason."

prakrit: "तत्तो चुओ समाणो,महापुरे सुप्षभस्स भज्जाए,अह तिलयसुन्दरीए,धम्मरुई नरवई जाओ"
english: "There you are, my good man, Sucking at my good breath, Oh! you silly beauty, Running out of dharma." ""

prakrit: "सुप्पहमुणिस्स सीसो,जाओ वय-समिइ-गुत्तिसंपन्नो,सङ्काइदोसरहिओ,सए वि देहे निरवयक्खो"
english: "Go to sleep, bow down, go away, go to bed, come back to life, stay awake, stay calm, stay safe."

prakrit: "सङ्घस्स भावियमई,वेयावच्चुज्जुओ गुणमहन्तो,काऊण कालधम्मं,माहिन्दे सुरवरो जाओ"
english: "The future belongs to the Sangha, The virtuous couple live in harmony, Time alone governs everything, For great is the master of all."

prakrit: "अमरविमाणाउ चुओ,सहदेवनराहिवस्स महिलाए,जाओ सणंकुमारो,चक्कहरो गयपुरे नयरे"
english: "Behold the immortal airman, The woman who dwells among the co - gods, Go, traveler, Do not go anywhere else."

prakrit: "सोहम्माहिवईणं,रूवं चिय जस्स वण्णियं सोउं,दो संसयपडिवन्ना,देवा ठूण ओइण्णा"
english: "A lotus is a beautiful ornament, Like the colour of a lotus, Like two emeralds: God is subtle."

prakrit: "दठूण चक्कवष्टि,देवा जंपन्ति साहु! साहु! त्ति,अइसुन्दरं तु रूवं,पसंसियं तुज्झ सक्केणं"
english: "Look! There is smoke rising from the fire, God willing! There it is! You are beautiful, Your form is lovely, Your affection is genuine." ""

prakrit: "तो भणए चक्कवट्टी,जइ देवा! आगया मए दटुं,एक्कं खणं पडिच्छह,मज्जिय-जिमियं नियच्छेह"
english: "So you fool, Oh my god! Just look at me. It's just the way things happen. You're making a mess of yourself." ""

prakrit: "हाओ कयबकिम्मो,सबालंकारभूसियसरीरो,सीहासणे निविट्ठो,दिट्ठो देवेहि चक्कहरो"
english: "How wretched a thing it is to fall asleep on top of your rivals, To stare into the abyss At the very sight of a god."

prakrit: "एत्तो मणन्ति देवा,तुज्झ इमं सुन्दरं परमरूवं,एको'त्थ नवरि दोसो,जेणं खणभंगुरसहावं"
english: "Such a man of God, your heart is made of so much beauty, You alone are to blame for the misfortune of being widowed."

prakrit: "जा पढमदरिसणे च्चिय,आसि तुमं जोबणाणुरूवसिरी,सा कह खणेण हीणा,सोहा अइतुरियवेगेणं?"
english: "Go and see her. Come, you stubborn woman. How can she be so negligent As to be so reckless?"

prakrit: "सोऊण देववयणं,माणुसजम्मं असासयं नाउं,निक्खमइ चक्कवट्टी,कुणइ य घोरं तवोकम्मं"
english: "One cannot describe divinity, one cannot describe human nature, one can only describe nature in rough and tidy terms, and one can hardly describe it in words."

prakrit: "अहियासिऊण रोगे,अणेयलद्धी-सुसत्तिसंपन्नो,कालं काऊण तओ,सणंकुमारं गओ सग्गं४"
english: "Because you are ill, Unable to sleep - Restless nights, Time is running out. So go to heaven, dear girl." 4

prakrit: "अह पुण्डरीगिणीए,मेहरहो घणरहस्स सोसत्तं,काऊण कालधम्म,सबढे सुरवरो जाओ"
english: "Oh! lovely lady, The secret of many a secret, Is in the passage of time. Everything goes smoothly."

prakrit: "तत्तो चुओ समाणो,नागपुरे वीससेणमहिलाए,गब्भम्मि सुओ जाओ,सन्ती जीवाण सन्तिकरो"
english: "Then shut your eyes, you silly girl, You wasted your time in Nagpur, Going to bed early, Living a contented life."

prakrit: "भोत्तूण भरहवासं,तित्थं उप्पाइऊण सिद्धिगओ,सोलसमो य जिणाणं,पञ्चमओ चक्कवट्टीणं५"
english: "Bhotuna is the residence of the mind, Tittha is the attainment of perfection, Solasam is the victory of the soul, Panchama is the consummation of chakravattinam5."

prakrit: "कुन्थू अरो य चक्की,दोण्णि वि तित्थंकरा समुप्पन्ना,हन्तूणं कम्ममलं,सिवमयलमणुत्तरं पत्ता६-७"
english: "Kunthu aroo ya chakki, dono bhi titthankara samuppanna, hunthuna kammalam, sivamayalam are the answer. 6 - 7" ""

prakrit: "धम्मस्स य सन्तिस्स य,सणंकुमारो जिणन्तरे आसि,तिण्णि जिणा चक्कहरा,अन्तरमेयं तु नायवं"
english: "Dharma is content, happy are the virtuous, victory is attainable for all three. From within, you are invincible."

prakrit: "धण्णपुरे ए नराहिव!,नराहिवो मुणिविचित्तगुत्तस्स,सीसो होऊण मओ,पत्तो च्चिय देवलोयं सो"
english: "Blessed are the meek! They are the ones who prosper, The stubborn ones the foolish ones, The cowherd is the cause of death, And the elephant is the arbor of the gods."

prakrit: "चविऊण विमाणाओ,सावत्थीसामियस्स महिलाए,ताराऎ समुप्पन्नो,पुत्तो सो कत्तविरियस्स"
english: "Aunt, It's the fire of love, A busy woman at work, A mass of stars. My son, That's a cruel man." ""

prakrit: "नामेण सो सुभूमो,जमदग्गिसुयं रणे परसुरामं,हन्तूण चक्कवट्टी,जाओ रयणाहिवो सूरो"
english: "In name only, I swear: Jamadagni, the forest lord, The hunter is a crook. Go, shoot the lion." ""

prakrit: "निब्बम्भणा य पुहईं,काऊण य विरइवज्जिओ कालं,सत्तमपुढविं पत्तो,घणपावषसङ्गजोएणं८"
english: "" "Time is full of uncertainties, Time is fleeting, The passage of seven great vows, The joining of many vows." "8"

prakrit: "चिन्तामणि ति नाम,नराहिवो वीयसोगनयरीए,लहिऊण सुप्पभगुरुं,पञ्चमकप्पे समुप्पन्नो"
english: "Consideration is the name of the bewildered woman; cowardice is the watchword; falsehood is the master of dreams; the fifth person is the observer of dreams."

prakrit: "चइऊणं नागपुरे,पउमरहनराहिवस्स महिलाए,जाओ य मऊराए,अह चक्कहरो महापउमो"
english: "Come on Nagpur, you naughty girl, Go away, you fool, It's the great wind." ""

prakrit: "रूवगुणसालिणोओ,दुहियाओ अट्ठ तस्स कन्नाओ,नेच्छन्ति हि भत्तारं,खेयरवसहेहि हरियाओ"
english: "Handsome women, Two wheelers, Eight to three canes, Lovely women, Like the greenery of a field."

prakrit: "उवलभिय आणियाओ,पब जं गेण्हिऊण सबाओ,अह पच्छिमम्मि काले,उववन्नाओ य सुरलोए"
english: "Swollen buds, Plumes of smoke rising from the sky, Everything that grows from the wheat, Looks like the rays of the sun in the west."

prakrit: "जे वि य ते अट्ठ जणा,ताण विओगे उ खेयरकुमारा,निविण्णा पबइया,तियसविमाणुत्तमं पत्ता"
english: "Whatever eight people have in common, That one will wither, you miserly little girl, By drinking your way through the fire Is the greatest blessing."

prakrit: "पडिबुद्धो चक्कहरो,दुहियाहेउम्मि जायसंवेगो,पउमस्स देइ रज्जं,निक्खन्तो विण्हुणा समयं"
english: "The bow twists, The twang twines, The woman bends, The husband throws the girdle, And then it's time to weave."

prakrit: "समणो वि महापउमो,काऊण तवं महागुणसमिद्धं,पत्तो इसिपब्भारं,अर-मल्लिजिगन्तरे धीरो९"
english: "Praise be to the great woman, Who, like the great sage, Has a heavy heart, Is able to withstand the arrows of the God of Love." 9

prakrit: "आसी महिन्ददत्तो,विजयपुरे नरवई महिड्डीओ,नन्दणमुणिस्स सीसो,होऊण गओ य माहिन्दं"
english: "Asi Mahindadatta, Vijayapura naravai Mahiddya, Nandanamunnimsa seeso, ho gaya ya Mahindam"

prakrit: "चइऊण य कम्पिल्ले,हरिकेउनराहिवस्स वप्पाए,जाओ चिय हरिसेणो,चक्कहरो पुहइविक्खाओ"
english: "Come on, you silly bitch! Every time you see her She acts like a naughty girl. Go, fawn on her: The roads are impassable."
