english: "Who cares about me, Wretched man, Like the pearl of a pearl Saved by churning twigs? 10." ""

prakrit: "अमियप्पभो नरिन्दो,रायपुरे मुणिसुहम्मसीसत्तं,काऊण बम्भलोयं,पत्तो तव-संजमगुणेणं"
english: "Amiyappabho Narindo, Raipurer muni, Suhammasyatra, Kaun Bambhaloyam, Pato Taja - Samjhamunena."

prakrit: "तत्थ चुओ रायपुरे,जसमइदेवीऎ नन्दणो जाओ,जयसेणो चक्कहरो,समत्तभरहाहिवो सूरो"
english: "There you are, Raipur, Just as the goddess Nandana departed, So does Jayasena, The son of a brave warrior."

prakrit: "संवेगजणियभावो,दिक्खं जिणदेसियं गहेउं जे,कम्मट्ठनिट्ठियट्ठो,नमि-नेमिजिणन्तरे सिद्धो११"
english: "Feelings of excitement, See how I am going to go on living, Hold on to what you have put forth, Prove your self to be pure." 11

prakrit: "वाणारसीऎ पुचिं तिलिङ्गसमणस्स पायमूलम्मि,संभूओ पबइओ,कुणइ तवं बारसवियप्पं"
english: "When the forest dweller asks why the tiller has such long hair, The farmer replies," "It's the turn of the wind." ""

prakrit: "तत्तो समाहिबहुलं,कालं काऊण कमलगुम्मम्मि,जाओ सुरवरवसहो,ललियङ्गय-कुण्डलाभरणो"
english: "There you are, handsome girl, Time is ticking, Go, enjoy the scent of the lotuses." ""

prakrit: "सो तत्थ वरविमाणे,सुरगणियासहगओ महिड्डीओ,भुञ्जइ मणोभिरामं,विसयसुहं उत्तमगुणोहं"
english: "So there it is, The wind whirls, Gorgeous women with fragrant breasts, Filling the heart with ecstasy, Virtuous pleasure and excellent virtues."

prakrit: "चइऊण विमाणाओ,बम्भरहनराहिवस्स महिलाए,जाओ य बम्भदत्तो,कम्पिल्ले पुप्फचूलाए"
english: "Come on, you silly girl, Don't be so naïve: Go get the buffalo breasts. They're covered with gooseflesh." ""

prakrit: "भोत्तण भरहवासं,काऊण य विरइवज्जिओ कालं,सत्तमखिइं पविठ्ठो,जिणन्तरे नेमि-पासाणं १२"
english: "A long stay in poverty, A lonely time, Seven hundred months of chastity, A period in which one's life is dominated 12"

prakrit: "एए भरहाहिवई,बारस चक्की मए समक्खाया,सेणिय! पुण्णविवायं,दावन्ति जणस्स पच्चक्खं"
english: "Oh! brave woman! The wheel of the wind has struck me hard, my dear! A fresh victory awaits, Like the victory of one's rival." ""

prakrit: "गिरिसिहरसमेसु नरा,भवणेसु वसन्ति जं सया सुहिया,तं धम्मदुमस्स फलं,सबं इह पायडं लोए"
english: "Do not sit in the middle of the rainy season, The pleasant people live in mansions, It is the fruit of Dharma's month. May all these attain enlightenment."

prakrit: "छिड्डसयमण्डिएसुं,घरेसु धण-धन्नविप्पमुक्कसु,जं परिवसन्ति पुरिसा,तं पावदुमस्स हवइ फलं"
english: "A skinny man sits at home Thinking how lucky he is To have a bunch of peacock feathers On his back."

prakrit: "तुरएसु कुञ्जरेसु य,चलचामरमण्डिएसु विविहेसु,वच्चन्ति जं नरिन्दा,तं धम्मदुमस्स हवइ फलं"
english: "The turmeric flowers are auspicious, The fragrant jasmine flowers are varied, And what is left standing Is the fruit of the month of Dharma."

prakrit: "तण्हा-छुहाकिलन्ता,दुखं सी-उण्हपरिगयसरीरा,वचन्ति य पाएसुं,तं सर्व पावरुक्खफलं"
english: "Aunt, There must be something very painful about it All the fruit of the nectar - Like the nail marks on a palm leaf."

prakrit: "अट्ठारसगुणकलियं,सोवणियभायणेसु वरभत्तं,भुञ्जन्ति जं नरिन्दा,तं सबं पुण्णरुक्खफलं"
english: "Eighteenfold virtuous kaliyam, Lovely women bestow abundance. What Narinda roasts, That all the trees bear fruit once again."

prakrit: "रसवज्जियं च भत्तं,घडखप्परथल्लियासु य विदिन्नं,जं भुञ्जन्ति कुभत्तं,तं पावदुमस्स चेव फलं"
english: "The rice is juicy, The wheat is tender, The chickpeas are fragrant, And those who roast the husks Are the fruit of the palm tree."

prakrit: "तित्थयर चक्कवट्टी,बलदेवा वासुदेवमाईया,जं होन्ति महापुरिसा,तं धम्मदुमस्स होइ फलं"
english: "Tithyare chakkavatti, Baladeva Vasudevamayi, To whomever the great sage wishes, May the month of Dharma bear fruit."

prakrit: "धम्मा-'धम्मतरूणं,फलमेयं वणियं समासेणं,एत्तो सुणाहि सेणिय!,जम्मं बल-वासुदेवाणं"
english: "Dharma -" "Criticism of Dharma, fruit, forest, ocean, Listen to this, O warrior!" "- The god of strength and spring"

prakrit: "नागपुरं साएया,सावत्थी तह य होइ कोसम्बी,पोयणपुर सीहपुरं,सेलपुरं चेव कोसम्बी"
english: "Nagpur is my mother - in - law, Savatthi is my kosambi, Poynapur is my husband's, Selpur is my chevu."

prakrit: "पुणरवि पोयणपुरं,इमाणि नयराणि वासुदेवाणं,आसी कमेण परभवे,सुरपुरसरिसाइ सबाई"
english: "Punarvi Poyanpuram, Imani Nayarani Vasudevan, Asi Kamen Parbhave, Surpursarisai Sabai."

prakrit: "पढमो य विस्सभूई,पबयओ तह य हवइ धणमित्तो,सागरदत्तो वि तओ,पियमित्तो ललियमित्तो य"
english: "Reading is vanity, Reading is delusion, Traveling is wealth, The ocean is charity, Love is luxury, Travel is pleasure."

prakrit: "तह य पुणवसुनामो,नवमो उण होइ गङ्गदत्तो उ,आसि मुणी गयजम्मे,सबे वि य केसवा एए"
english: "There's the full moon, The new moon has burst, The Ganges has given birth, The sage has departed, Everything is saffron."

prakrit: "पढमस्स गवापडणं,जुज्झन्तं महिलियाहरणहेउं,उज्जाणरण्णमरणं,हवइ य वणकीलणं चेव"
english: "The gate is locked at dawn, Women stay up until dawn, Life goes on as usual, And the streets are deserted."

prakrit: "अच्चन्तविसयसङ्गो,तह य विओगो विरूवणा परमा,एयाइ नियाणाई,केसीणं आसि पुवभवे"
english: "Awesome God, So angry is the forest lord, So naïve is he, For some reason flowers keep coming."

prakrit: "तम्हा सनियाणतवं,मा कुणह खणं पि मूढभावेणं,संसारवड्डणकरं,आमूलं सबदुक्खाणं"
english: "Your sobriety, your not caring at all about what's going on, Is the cause of all the suffering in the world."

prakrit: "संभूय संभवो वि य,सुदरिसणो तह हवइ सेयंसो,अइभूई वसुभूई,तह चेव य घोससेणरिसी"
english: "Everything is possible," he said; "everything is beautiful, everything is peaceful, everything flows smoothly, and so is the lover of gossip."

prakrit: "एत्तो य' परं उयही,दुमसेणो चेव मुणिवरा एए,गुरवो आसि परभवे,कमेण इह वासुदेवाणं"
english: "There must be something more than this. The doomsday man is a sage. The master has to come and get him. Instead, it's Vasudeva." ""

prakrit: "कप्पो य महासुक्को,पाणयकप्पो य अचुओ चेव,सहसारो सोधम्मो,माहिन्दो चेव सोधम्मो"
english: "A cup is a great treasure, A can of water is precious, Friendship is pure, Love is pure."

prakrit: "कप्पो सणंकुमारो,तह य महसुक्कनामहेओ य,एएसु चुया सन्ता,उप्पन्ना केसवा सवे"
english: "Aunt, The rainy season is here, And so is the rainy season. So are all the hungry and the thirsty. So is all the hair on the head."

prakrit: "पोयणपुर वारिपुरं,महापुरं सन्तिनामनयरं च,चक्कपुरं च कुसग्गं,मिहिला साएय महुरा य"
english: "Poynapur, Varipuram, Mahapurram, Santinamnayaram, Chakkapuram, Kusaggam, Mihila, these are the great bees." ""

prakrit: "एएमु य नयरेसुं,उप्पन्ना केसवा बलसमिद्धा,एत्तो कमेण वोच्छं,पियरो एयाण सवाणं"
english: "Aimless being this, Thinking how much love one has for one's neighbor, Like a bunch of peacock's tail feathers Waved by the hunter."

prakrit: "पढमो य पयावइ बम्भभूह एत्तो य रुदनामो य,सोमो सिवंकरो वि य,समसुद्धो अग्गिदाणो य"
english: "Weeping and wailing, Like the sound of a lute, We recite aloud to one another:" "Righteous is the flame of fire." ""

prakrit: "दसरहनराहिवो वि य,वसुदेवो पत्थिवो कमेणं तु,एए हवन्ति पियरो,सबाण वि वासुदेवाणं"
english: "Though the sun is hot, Though the moon is dark, Though you work, Yet love prevails. Everything is dominated by the sun."

prakrit: "पढमा मिगावई माहवी य पुहई तहेव सीया य,अह अम्बिया य लच्छी,केसी वि य केगई चेव"
english: "Padma migavai, Mahavi ya puhai tayav seeya, Ah, ambia ya lacchi, Keshi bhi kegai chev"

prakrit: "तह देवई य एत्तो,इमाउ जणणीउ वासुदेवाणं,महिलाओ च्चिय ताणं,भणामि एत्तो निसामेहि"
english: "There the goddess is here, There the God of Love, The God of Spring, Women are so busy making love, I say, There she is always so busy."

prakrit: "पढमा सयंपभा रुप्पिणी य पभवा मणोरमा हवइ,तह य सुनेत्ता अह विमलसुन्दरी चेव नन्दवई"
english: "Aunt, When I hear that the moon is shining my whole body Seems to blossom like a sapphire tree."

prakrit: "एत्तो पहावई रुप्पिणी य गुणरूवजोवणधरीओ,आसि महादेवीओ,सबाण वि वासुदेवाणं"
english: "So proud are these beautiful women, Such virtuous young men, Such great ladies! All are devoted to Vasudeva."

prakrit: "धवलब्मसण्णियासा,पढमपुरी पुण्डरीगिणी भणिया,पुहई आणन्दपुरी,नन्दपुरी चेव नायबा"
english: "Dhavalambamasannyasa, padampuri, pundrigini bhanya, pūhai, andandapuri, nandapura, cheva nayaba." ""

prakrit: "नयरी आसि असोगा,विजयपुरं मणहरं सुसीमा य,खेमा वि य नागपुरं,इमाणि रामाण गयजम्मे"
english: "A Nayari comes from Asoga, Vijayapuram is pleasant, Khema is pleasant even in Nagpur, I am Rama's guest."

prakrit: "सुबलो य पवणवेगो,नन्दि सुमित्तो महाबलो चेव,पुरिसवसभो य एत्तो,सुदरिसणो होइ नायवो"
english: "Blessed are the meek, Thanks be to the righteous, Great are the brave, For all men are like this: They know how to be good."

prakrit: "समणो वसुंधरो च्चिय,सिरिचन्दो हवइ पच्छिमो सङ्खो,एयाइँ पुवजम्मे,बलदेवमुणीण नामाणि"
english: "Praise be to the jasmine, To the crescent moon, And to the setting sun, I bow before you." - The name of the patron saint is thus given to him in worship.

prakrit: "अणयारो मुणिवसभो,हवइ तओ समणसीहनामो य,तइओ य सुवयरिसी,वसभो य तहा पयापालो"
english: "Silly sages, If you want to make love, Make love to one another; If you desire to be affectionate, Keep away from one another."

prakrit: "अह दमधरो सुधम्मो,सायरघोसो य विद्यमाभो य,एए आसि परभवे,गुरवो चिय सीरधारीणं"
english: "Oh! stammering, good mother - in - law; yea, sulking, sighing, or clamoring; oh! the arrows of the God of Love!"

prakrit: "तिणि य अणुत्तराओ,सहसाराओ हवन्ति तिण्णेव,दोण्णि य बम्भाउ चुया,एको पुण दसमकप्पाओ"
english: "There are three ways to say it: one is wrong, the other is false, and the third is false. One thing is true: Both are true."

prakrit: "एएसु चुया जाया,बलदेवमुणी तबोधरा सबइ,एत्तो कहेमि सेणिय! जणणीओ ताण इह जम्मे"
english: "" "This is the way it goes: The headman's wife is clever, and everyone knows her." "That's what I call a warrior! It's the birthright of women."

prakrit: "भद्दा सुभद्दनामा,सुदरिसणा सुप्षभा तहा विजया,अन्ना वि वेजयन्ती,सीला अवराइया चेव"
english: "Foolish name, good character, good fortune, and victory are few and far between. Anna is also a vegetable grower, Sila is something unattainable."

prakrit: "सबन्ते पुण एत्तो,भणिया वि हु रोहिणी पवररूवा,एयाओ आसि एत्थं,जणणीओ सीरधारीणं"
english: "Everything is in order here, my brother - in - law is at hand, Rohini is hovering over me, I have come all the way here, My wife is wearing a headscarf."

prakrit: "सेयंसाइ तिविट्ठ,वंदन्ति य केसवा जिणा पञ्च,पुरिसवरपुण्डरीओ,अर-मल्लिजिणन्तरे आसो"
english: "Always be vigilant, whether it's a salve or a handful of raisins. Come, you silly hussies, Into the fire of jasmine."

prakrit: "मल्लि-मुणिसुबयाणं,दत्तो वि य केसवो समक्खाओ,सुबय-नमीण मज्झे,केसी पुण लक्खणो हवइ"
english: "Malli - Munisubhavayana, Datto - Vyas, Kesava - Samakhya, Suvaya - Namina Majje, Kaise Puna Laksmana Hava."

prakrit: "वन्दइ अरिट्ठनेमी,अपच्छिमो केसवो बलसमग्गो,एत्तो घडिसत्तूणं,भगामि नयराणि सबाणि"
english: "Vande arithnemi, apachimo kesamo balsamgogo, Etko gadhistuna, Bhagami nayarini sabani." ""

prakrit: "अलकापुरि विजयपुरं,नन्दणनयरं हवइ पुहइपुरं,एत्तो य हरिपुरं पुण,सूरपुरं सीहनामं च"
english: "Alakapuri is Vijaypuram, Nandanayaram is Havi Poohipuram, Etoy Haripuram is Puna, Surpuram is Sihanama." ""

prakrit: "लङ्कापुरी य भणिया,रायगिहं चेव होइ नायवं,एयाणि आसि सेणिय! पुराणि पडिवासुदेवाणं"
english: "The Lankapuri is my brother - in - law's son, And I am his wife's daughter. As for me, here comes the soldier! An old demon lives in my village." ""

prakrit: "आसग्गीवो तारग,मेरग तत्तो य हवइ महुकेडो,हवइ निसुम्भो य बली,पल्हाओ रावणो चेव"
english: "The star is close at hand, The bee is hot when it touches it, The wind is relentless when it scapegoats it, And the raven is on the loose."

prakrit: "नवमो य जरासन्धू,एए पडिकेसवा कमेणं तु,इह भारहम्मि वासे,आसी पडिसत्तु केसीणं"
english: "Aunt, you nasty bastard. How are you supposed to do this To someone else's wife?"

prakrit: "पढमो सुवण्णकुम्भो,कित्तिधरो तह सुधम्मनामो य,हरिणकुसो य कित्ती,हवइ सुमित्तो भुवणसोहो"
english: "How beautiful is the jasmine, How fragrant is its fragrance, How delicious is the deer's conch shell, How pleasant it is to breathe"

prakrit: "भणिओ य सुवयमुणी,सिद्धत्थो पच्छिमो हवइ एत्तो,बलदेवाणं एए,आसि गुरू इह भवे सवे"
english: "Say :'She is a virtuous woman; herein lies the path to perfection; There must be a strong god; Here is the teacher.'"" "

prakrit: "अट्टेव य बलदेवा,सिवमयलमणुत्तरं गई पत्ता,एक्को य बम्भलोए,अपच्छिमो चेव उप्पन्नो"
english: "Aunt, There is nothing more to be said for my poor blossom, It's only the first time I've seen one."

prakrit: "एवं कम्ममहावणं सुविउलं वाहीलयालिङ्गिय,सर्व झाणमहाणलेण डहिउं केइत्थ मोक्खं गया,अन्ने थेवभवावसेसकलुसा कप्पालएसु ट्ठिया,भवा धम्मफलेण होन्ति विमला निचं सुहावासया"
english: "And behold, the lotus of Karma's mouth, Swollen by all the joys of love, Looks as though it had been burnt at the stake: There is something very special about that flower, Like the jasmine's blossom." ""

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए तित्थयराइभवाणुकित्तणो नाम वोसइमो उद्देसओ समत्तो"
english: "My name is Vossaimo, the intention is the same," said the doe.

prakrit: "अट्ठमरामस्स तुम,सेणिय! निसुणेहि ताव संबन्ध,कुल-वंसनिग्गमं ते,कहेमि सबइ जहावत्तं"
english: "Eighth month, you warrior! Without leaving a trace Of your relatives, I'd say, It's all hell." ""

prakrit: "सीयलजिणस्स तित्थे,सुमुहो नामेण आसि महिपालो,कोसम्बीनयरीए,तत्थेव य वीरयकुविन्दो"
english: "There is the jasmine tree, The bee - eyed bee by the name of Sumuho, The crows by the kosambinaris, And there the drop of semen."

prakrit: "हरिऊण तस्स महिलं,वणमालं नाम नरवई तत्थ,भुञ्जइ भोगसमिद्धं,रईऎ समयं अणङ्गो व"
english: "The hunter is his woman, The forest dweller's name is Naravai Tattha, The rooster is his lover's mate, The farmer's time is short." ""

prakrit: "अह अन्नया नरिन्दो,फासुयदाणं मुणिस्स दाऊणं,असणिहओ उववन्नो,महिलासहिओ य हरिवासे"
english: "Oh! dear Narindo! Those hanging around are the bow and arrow of a sage. Those hanging down are the wiles of women who have lost their husbands."

prakrit: "कन्ताविओयदुहिओ,पोट्टिलयमुणिस्स पायमूलम्मि,घेत्तूण य पबजं,कालगओ सुरवरो जाओ"
english: "Can't you see? It's two o'clock! A bunch of peacock's tail feathers Are sticking out of one's paws. Time, dear go - between." ""

prakrit: "अवहिविसएण नाउं,देवो हरिवाससंभवं मिहुणं,अवहरिऊण य तुरियं,चम्पानयरम्मि आणेइ"
english: "By non - violence I mean, the God of Love Who is able to vanquish all misfortunes, by non - abuse He means the trumpet, the champaner."

prakrit: "हरिवाससमुप्पन्नो,जेणं हरिऊण आणिओ इहई,तेणं चिय हरिराया,विक्खाओ तिहुयणे जाओ"
english: "Deer - eyed woman, If the deer come running in this way It's because the crows have gone wild." ""

prakrit: "जाओ च्चिय तस्स सुओ,महागिरी नाम रूवसंपन्नो,तस्स वि कमेण पुत्तो,उप्पन्नो हिमगिरी नामं"
english: "Go and make love to her. The name of the great woman is Rupasampanno, She is also a son of Karma. Above all, she is called Himagiri."

prakrit: "वसुगिरि इन्दगिरी वि य,जाओ च्चिय पत्थिवो रयणमाली,राया वि य संभूओ,एत्तो पुण भूयदेवो य"
english: "Vasugiri, Indagiri, Jago, Chiti, Pathi, Rayanmali, Raya, and Sambhuo. Such is the nature of the earth."

prakrit: "राया महीधरो वि य,नरवसभा एवमाइया बहवे,उप्पन्ना हरिवंसे,वोलीणा दीहकालेणं"
english: "Praise be to Raya Mahidhar, The arrows of the Narmadā flow everywhere, But from Harivansh Upanna, A long time has passed."

prakrit: "तत्थेव य हरिवंसे,उप्पन्नो पत्थिवो वि हु सुमित्तो,भुञ्जइ कुसग्गनयरं,महिला पउमावई तस्स"
english: "There you are, Harivansh, There I am, Standing beside you And beside you, Smiling cow - dung cakes, And a woman embraces her husband."

prakrit: "अह सा सुहं पसुत्ता,रयणीए पच्छिमम्मि जामम्मि,पेच्छइ चउदस सुमिणे,षसत्थजोगेण कल्लाणी"
english: "Ah! she is a pleasant girl. The wife looks at her husband from the west, She looks at him with fourteen sweet smears, And at his wife with sixty."

prakrit: "गय वसह सीह अभिसेय दाम ससि दिणयरं झयं कुम्भं,पउमसर सागर विमाण-भवण रयणुच्चय सिहिं च"
english: "Gone are the days When the sky was bare, The days were long, The summers were hot, The seas were stormy, The rivers were swollen, And the lions were singing." ""

prakrit: "पडिबुद्धा कमलमुही,चोद्दस सुमिणे कहेइ दइयस्स,तेण वि सा पडिभणिया,होही तुह जिणवरो पुत्तो"
english: "The lotus is smeared all over her face, And the fourteenth day she says," "Please, my son, be careful not to fall asleep by it." ""

prakrit: "नाव य एसा''लावो,वट्टइ तावं नहाउ सयराहं,पडिया य रयणवुट्टी,उज्जोवन्ती दस दिसाओ"
english: "The boat is like this:" "Take a bath as soon as you can walk in it." "The paddock is like a rainbow, Brightening up in ten directions."

prakrit: "तिण्णेव य कोडीओ,अद्धं च दिणे दिणे य रयणाणं,पाडेइ धणयजक्खो,एवं मासा य पन्नरस"
english: "All three are puzzles, Each one is a day's play, The other is song, And the other is wine."

prakrit: "कमलकणवासिणीहिं,देवीहिं सोहिए तओ गब्भे,अवइण्णो कयपुण्णो,कमेण जाओ जिणवरिन्दो"
english: "The lotus is a resident of the womb, The gods delight in it, And the cowgirls rejoice." "Because by their actions they have won the victory" ""

prakrit: "सो तत्थ जायमेत्तो,सुरेहि नेऊण मन्दरस्सुवरिं,इन्दाइएहि एहविओ,विहिणा खीरोदहिजलेणं"
english: "So there you are, my friend, Straightforward women with dark breasts, Like bees in a fire That has not yet been quenched."

prakrit: "अह तं कयाहिसेयं,सबालङ्कारभूसियसरीरं,इन्दाई सुरपवरा,थुणन्ति थुइमङ्गलसएहिं"
english: "Oh! what a cruel man he is, With a handsome body, Feasting heavily on liquorice, Sucking at one's own saliva."

prakrit: "अह ते थोऊण गया,विबुहा सेणाणिओ वि जिणचन्दं,ठविऊण जणणिअङ्के,सो वि य देवालयं पत्तो"
english: "Oh! he is gone, Wretched woman, Yet the moon lives on, Stuck between the genitals; This too must go to the temple."

prakrit: "गब्भट्ठियस्स जस्स य,जणणी वि हु आसि सुवया रज्जे,मुणिसुबओ त्ति नामं जिणस्स रइयं गुरुजणेणं"
english: "As the pregnant woman puts it:" "I have a wife who is completely satisfied with my husband's return." "To her parents he gives the name of Jina."

prakrit: "परिवडिओ कमेणं,रज्जं भोत्तूण सुइरकालम्मि,ठूण सरयमेहं,विलिज्जमाणं च पडिबुद्धो"
english: "Love is bound to fall, A string is tied to a string, A needle is threaded through the string, And a bow is tied around the string."

prakrit: "मुणिसुवयजिणवसभो,पुत्तं ठविऊण सुवयं रज्जे,सुरपरिकिण्णो भयवं,पवइओ नरवईहि समं"
english: "All living beings sigh, When a son is rebuked His beloved is thrilled, When he is comforted He is afraid, When the daughter - in - law is the same as a man."

prakrit: "छट्टोववासनियमे,रायगिहे वसभदत्तनरवइणा,परमन्नेण य दिन्नं,पारणयं जिणवरिन्दस्स"
english: "In the winter solstice, When the clouds settle, The wind does not blow, The God of Love is present, Life goes on as usual."

prakrit: "पत्तो य वसभदत्तो,पञ्चाइसए जिणप्पहावेणं,सुर-असुरनमियचलणो,विहरइ तित्थंकरो वसुहं"
english: "A flock of parrots gives birth, Flutters five times a day, Travels in unison, Spreads like a thicket"

prakrit: "चम्पयदुमस्स हिटे,एवं घाइक्खएण कम्माणं,झायन्तस्स भगवओ,केवलनाणं समुप्पन्नं"
english: "Champayadumasa is a hit, and karma is acquired through speech; only renunciation is complete, O false god."

prakrit: "अह सुबओ वि रज्जं,दाऊण सुयस्स तत्थ दक्खस्स,पवइओ चरिय तवं,कालगओ पाविओ सिद्धिं"
english: "Ah, the good man is a king too, The wise man is asleep then the right one, The poor man is always on the move, Time has proved him right."

prakrit: "तित्थं पवत्तिऊणं,मुणिसुवयसामिओ वि गणसहिओ,सम्मेयपबओवरि,दुक्खविमोक्खं गओ मोक्खं"
english: "There goes the farmer's wife:" "Even the youngest wife sighs, But my husband is absent." "He is free from sorrow."

prakrit: "दक्खस्स पढमपुत्तो,जाओ इलवद्धणो त्ति नामेणं,सिरिवद्धणो कुमारो,तस्स वि य सुओ समुप्पन्नो"
english: "Go and call him by the name of Ilavadhana, you stubborn boy; he too has a good reputation."

prakrit: "सिरिवक्खो तस्स सुओ,जाओ चिय संजयन्तनरवसभो,कुणिमो महारहो वि य,हरिवंसे पत्थिवा बहवे"
english: "Go, sleep on that tree whose branches are bowed, Go, rejoice, And the river whose banks are swollen, So that the stream of tears flows from the jasmine."

prakrit: "कालेण अइक्कन्ता केइत्थ तवेण पाविया सिद्धिं,अन्ने पुण सुरलोए,उप्पन्ना निययजोएणं"
english: "Time is of the essence, Wherever you go There's bound to be progress. Once you've reached your goal There is always room for improvement."

prakrit: "एवं महन्तकाले,वोलीणेसु य निवेसु बहुएसु,मिहिलाऎ समुप्पन्नो,वासवकेऊ यं हरिवंसे"
english: "And when it's time to rejoice, We bow our heads and take our vows. But when it comes to love, We forsake each other."

prakrit: "महिला तस्स सुरूवा,नामेण इला गुणाहिया लोए,तीए गब्भम्मि सुओ,जाओ जणओ त्ति नामेणं"
english: "A woman is born with a name. In this world, so called, Virtuous People Sleep in her womb. Go and tell that person by name."

prakrit: "जणयस्स पसूई खलु,सेणिय! कहिया मए समासेणं,निसुणेहि जत्थ वंसे,उप्पन्नो दसरहो राया"
english: "" "Friend, tell me, How old is your husband? I have problems with him. He's still young. You'll have to go back in time. The tenth day is almost over."

prakrit: "गच्छन्ति काल-समया,तप्पन्ति तवं सुउज्जया समणा,विलसन्ति विसयलग्गा,सुस्सन्ति य अंकयसुहकम्मा"
english: "They travel in time, They travel far and wide, They make beautiful women sleep well, They wander freely, They cause delight - Such is the happiness of numbers."

prakrit: "अणुयत्तन्ति य जीवा,दुक्खाणि सुहाणि जीवलोगम्मि,तेसिं परिवत्तन्ति य,वसणाणि महोच्छवा चेव"
english: "The soul is immovable, Suffering is pleasant, Life goes on, It keeps changing, It resides only in the eyes of the God of Love."

prakrit: "झायन्ति मुणी झाणं,मुक्खा निन्दन्ति रागिणो मत्ता,अभिनन्दन्ति बुहा जे,मुज्झन्ति सुरामिसासत्ता"
english: "A sulking sage tells a lie, An angry mother scorns a blunder, A proud wife flatters a man, And a sulking mother - in - law admires him."

prakrit: "गायन्ति विसयमूढा,रोवन्ति य रोगपीडिया जे य,सुहिणो चेव हसन्ति य,किलिसन्तं पेच्छिऊण जणं"
english: "They make fools sing, They make sick people cry, And they make happy people laugh. One can't help it if one's eyes stray too far Into the forest."

prakrit: "विवदन्ति कलहसीला,वग्गन्ती तह य केवि धावन्ति,लोभवसेण वि केई,संगामं जन्ति तण्हत्ता"
english: "Everyone runs when there's a dispute, Everyone races when there is a quarrel, Even people in a state of greed, A struggle is as stressful as a fight."

prakrit: "एवं विविहपगारं,अवसप्पइ दियह-कालमाईहिं,चित्तपडो व विचित्तो,खीयइ अवसप्पिणी कालो"
english: "And a variety of pastimes, Disappearing diyas - Time flies, The mind wanders and wanders, And the pastime fades."

prakrit: "अह एत्तो वीसइमे,जिणन्तरे वट्टमाणसमयम्मि,विजओ नाम नरिन्दो,साएयपुराहिवो जाओ"
english: "Ah! what a wretched thing it is! For all the time I have devoted to it, Victory, Narindo, my dear, Go to the fire of heaven."

prakrit: "तस्स महादेवीए,हिमचूलाए सुया समुप्पन्ना,पढमो य वज्जबाहू,बीओ य पुरंदरो नामं"
english: "Your name is Mahadevi, your shadow is Samuppana, your reading is Vajjabahu, your writing is Purandara."

prakrit: "तइया पुण नागपुरे,राया बहुवाहणो परिबसइ,चूडामणि से भज्जा,दुहिया य मणोहरा होइ"
english: "You naughty girl, Don't be so naïve: The nights are long, The nights long, And the nights long."

prakrit: "अह वाहणेण दिन्ना,सा कन्ना विजयपढमपुत्तस्स,गन्तूण वज्जबाहू,परिणेइ पराऎ पीईए"
english: "Ah, the waggon Dinna, That can hardly pass for victory, Mr. Vajabahu the traveler, Aunt, It's the wife who drinks abroad."

prakrit: "वत्तम्मि य वारिज्जे,तं कन्नं उदयसुन्दरो भाया,आढत्तो वि य नेउं,ससुरघरं तेण समसहिओ"
english: "Vattammi, you're the heir; your ears are prickly, your eyes are bright, and your husband is absent. Please, father - in - law, help me sort this out."

prakrit: "एत्तो वसन्तकाले,वसन्तगिरिमत्थए मुणिवरिन्दो,वोलन्तएण दिट्ठो,झाणत्थो बज्जबाहूणं"
english: "Here in springtime, O moon - faced bird of prey on the spring horizon, Looks like a wobbly bird, Jumps like a thunderbolt"

prakrit: "जह जह तस्स समीवं,गिरिस्स अल्लियइ वजवरबाहू,तह तह वड्डइ पीई,कुसुमियवरपायवोहेणं"
english: "The more her husband, though absent, the thinner her waist, The thinner become her husband."

prakrit: "रत्तासोय-हिलदुम-वरदाडिम-किंसुएसु दिप्पन्तो,कोइलमुहलुग्गीओ,महुयरझंकारगीयरवो"
english: "Ratasoy - Hildum - Vardadim - Kinsuessu dipanto, Koil curtains, Bees twitching loudly."

prakrit: "वरबउल-तिलय-चम्पय-असोय-पुन्नाय-नायसुसमिद्धो,पाडल-सहयार-'जुग-कुन्दलयामण्डिउद्देसो"
english: "Varbula - Tilaya - Champaya - Asoya - Punnaya - Nyasa - Mithu, Paadal - Sahayara -" "Jug - Kundalayama - Mandyuddeso" ""

prakrit: "बहुकुसुमसुरहिकेसर-मयरन्दुद्दामवासियदिसोहो,दाहिणपवणन्दोलिय-नच्चाविजन्ततरुनिवहो"
english: "Long - eyed woman - Dear friend, The days are fleeting, And the nights unreturning."

prakrit: "दट्ठण वज्जबाहू,मुणिवसहं तो मणेण चिन्तेइ,धन्नो एस कयत्थो,जो कुणइ तवं अइमहन्तं"
english: "See, wise man, If you are sage, think carefully. Blessed is the one who does what is most important."

prakrit: "समसत्तु-मित्तभावो,कञ्चण-तणसरिस विगयपरिसङ्गो,लाभा-'लाभे य समो,दुक्खे य सुहे य समचित्तो"
english: "Contentment is the opposite of friendship, Contempt is the enemy of reason, Profit is the adversary of gain, Suffering is the arbiter of happiness, And so is equanimity."

prakrit: "एएण फलं लद्धं,माणुसजम्मस्स ताव निस्सेसं,जो झायइ परमत्थं,एगग्गमणो विगयमोहो"
english: "This is the fruit of struggle: The human race is helpless when it comes to the ultimate goal: victory over adversity."

prakrit: "हा! कट्ठ चिय पावो,बद्धो हं पावकम्मषासेहिं,अइकढिण-दारुणेहि,चन्दणरुक्खो व नागेहिं"
english: "Ah! the thick mud of the field! I am bound by the sweat of my feet, Like a doe by the scent of the moon." ""

prakrit: "मुणिवसभदिन्नदिट्ठी,भणइ य तं उदयसुन्दरो वयणं,किं महसि समणदिक्खं?,कुमार! अहियं निरिक्खेसि"
english: "The sage asked," "Are you sure you want to see me again?" "He replied:" "You look so handsome, Don't you see? My son, I am waiting for you." ""

prakrit: "तो भणइ वज्जबाहू,एव इमं जं तुमे समुल्लवियं,उदएण वि पडिभणिओ,तुज्झ सहाओ भविस्से हं"
english: "So you speak, Vajjabahu; this is what you have to say: Even in my youth I speak plainly; your help is bound to come."

prakrit: "वीवाहभूसणेहिं,विभूसिओ गयवराउ ओइण्णो,आरुहिऊण गिरिवरे,पणमइ य मुणिं पयत्तेणं"
english: "Weeping, She embraces him, Covered with gooseflesh, Jumps over his shoulder And throws him over her head."

prakrit: "अह सो नमिऊण मुणी,सुहासणत्थं पणट्ठमय-रायं,पुच्छइ संसारठिई,बन्धण-मोक्खं च जीवस्स"
english: "Oh! she is a sage by nature, at the root of goodness are decrees made, The laws of the world are questioned, And liberation is the way of life."

prakrit: "भणइ तओ मुणिवसभो,जीवो जह अट्ठकम्मपडिबद्धो,दुक्खाइँ अणुहवन्तो,परिहिण्डइ दीहसंसारं"
english: "Say,'O sages, the soul which is bound by the cycle of eight karma, Desperately yearning for suffering, Encompasses the world of Deha"

prakrit: "कम्माण उवसमेणं,लहइ नया माणुसत्तणं सारं,तह वि य बन्धवनडिओ,न कुणइ धम्मं विसयमूढो"
english: "Deceit is immutable, Love is the essence of new human behavior, Friendship is eternal, Dharma is not distorted."

prakrit: "दुविहो जिणवरधम्मो,सायारो तह य होइ निरयारो,सायारो गिहिधम्मो,मुणिवरधम्मो 'निरायारो"
english: "Two is the jinaverdharma, one is the saṃvara, the other is the nirayar, the former is the giddha dharma, the latter is the mūnivaradharma, and so on."

prakrit: "सावयधम्म काऊ-णं निच्छिओ अन्तकालसमयम्मि,कालगओ उववज्जइ,सोहम्माईसु सुरपवरो"
english: "Savayadharma - Why waste your time in the Hereafter? The passage of time is precious. Proud women are the ornaments of beauty."

prakrit: "देवत्ताउ मणुत्तं,मणुयत्ताओ पुणो वि देवत्तं,गन्तूण सत्तमभवे,पावइ सिद्धि न संदेहो"
english: "Deities are supreme, humanity is supreme, and so is divinity; the path is straightforward; there is no doubt of their accomplishment."

prakrit: "अह पुण जिणवरविहियं,दिक्खं घेत्तूण पवरसद्धाए,हन्तूण य कम्ममलं,पावइ सिद्धिं धुयकिलेसो"
english: "Ah, the pleasure of being married, The joy of seeing one's true nature Revealed, The pleasure of playing the flute, And the desire to learn a new skill."

prakrit: "एवं मुणिवरविहियं,सोऊणं नरवरो विगयमोहो,हिययं कुणइ दढयरं,षत्वज्जानिच्छिउच्छाहं"
english: "And like a sage, she sleeps soundly, Like a man possessed by poison, Like one who has attained enlightenment But lacks wisdom."

prakrit: "एक्कम्मि वरं जम्मे,दुक्खं अभिभुञ्जिउं समणधम्मे,कम्मट्ठषायववणं,लुणामि तवपरसुघाएहिं"
english: "I will grant you one blessing, I will bear your sorrows in my heart, And make you feel at home in my thoughts. I will always delight in you."

prakrit: "दठूण वज्जबाहुँ,विरत्तभावं मुणिस्स पासत्थं,वरजुवईउ पलावं कुणन्ति समयं नववहूए"
english: "Behold the warrior's bow, The wretched man is swooning from ear to ear, The young bridegroom is making love While running away."

prakrit: "अह उदयसुन्दरो तं,विन्नवइ सगग्गरेण कण्ठेणं,परिहासेण महायस!,भणिओ मा एव ववसाहि"
english: "Oh! handsome man! One cannot help falling asleep at your feet. One day you will have to kneel again!" Say: "No, it's only the wind."

prakrit: "तं भणइ वज्जबाहू,परिहासेणोसहं नु बह पीयं,सुट्ठ वि उदिण्णसंती,किं न हरइ वेयणं अङ्गे?"
english: "She says," "Vazhbaahu, do not drink too much with jealousy's arrows, Even a stubborn woman is restless." "Isn't that the way of a wicked wife?"

prakrit: "तो भणइ वज्जबाहू,मुणिवसभं पणमिऊण भावेणं,तुज्झ पसाएण अहं,निक्खमिउं अज्ज इच्छामि"
english: "So I will tell you, Vajjabahu, That all sages make love At the mere mention of your name. I will spare you this day."

prakrit: "नाऊण तस्स भावं,साहू गुणसायरो भणइ तुझं,धम्मे हवउ अविग्धं,पावसु तव-संजमं विउलं"
english: "By your name only, your feelings, my dear, speak for yourself, The air in Dharma is impenetrable, The wind blows your restraint away."

prakrit: "निक्खमइ वज्जबाहू,मुणिवरपासम्मि जायसंवेओ,सुन्दरपमुहेहि समं,छवीसाए कुमाराणं"
english: "Wretched beauty is equal to a poor man's face, Like the smooth stream of water Through the sesame field."

prakrit: "सोयरनेहेण वहू,भत्तारस्स य विओयदुक्खेणं,सा वि तहिं पवइया,मणोहरा मुणिसयासम्मि"
english: "Wife, It's too late for that. A man who is sober Will fall at your feet Like a sage." ""

prakrit: "सोऊण वज्जबाहू,पबइयं विजयपत्थिवो भणइ,तरुणत्ते मज्झ सुओ,कह भोगाणं विरत्तो सो?"
english: "He is a wise man, Always speaks triumphantly, Always sleeps young; How can he avoid trouble?"

prakrit: "अहयं पुण नीसत्तो,इन्दियवसगो जराऎ परिगहिओ,ववगयदप्पुच्छाहो,कं सरणं वो पवज्जामि?"
english: "I'm off again. Take care of the Indians a bit. I've got sunburnt cheeks. What should I do?" ""

prakrit: "षसिढिलचलन्तगत्तो,अहयं पुण कासकुसुमसमकेसो,विवडियदसणसमूहो,तह वि विरायं न गच्छामि"
english: "I am constantly on the move, Like a bunch of parrots once upon a time, Making eye contact But I will not go away."

prakrit: "एवं विजयनरिन्दो,दाऊण पुरंदरस्स रायसिरिं,निक्खन्तो खायजसो,पासे निवाणमोहस्स"
english: "And Vijayarindo, the demon of victory, sighs loudly, walks freely, Has a penchant for deceit."

prakrit: "एत्तो पुरंदरस्स वि,पुहईदेवीए कुच्छिसंभूओ,जाओ च्चिय कित्तिधरो,जणम्मि विक्खायकित्तीओ"
english: "Such an old woman, Such a bunch of bunnies. Where are you going to hide your breasts? They look just like women's breasts."

prakrit: "राया कुसत्थलपुरे,धूया वि य तस्स नाम सहदेवी,कित्तिधरेण वरतणू,परिणीया सा विभूईए"
english: "How can you use that name for a fellow goddess? It's Raya Kushthalpure, the dhoya, and she looks like a widow." ""

prakrit: "खेमंकरस्स पासे निक्खमइ पुरंदरो विगयनेहो,पारंपरागयं सो,कित्तिधरो भुञ्जए रज्जं"
english: "The poor wretch is dying on the farmer's side. Tradition has passed, So how long can a broken string last?"

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाई,कित्तिधरो आसणे सुहनिसन्नो,पेच्छइ गयणयलत्थं,रविबिम्ब राहुणा गहियं"
english: "Oh! what a strange man he is, Sitting pretty on a chair, Watching him play the flute, Always thinking of Rahuna."

prakrit: "चिन्तेऊण पयत्तो,जो गहचकं करेइ नित्तेयं,सो दिणयरो असत्तो,तेयं राहुस्स विहडेउं"
english: "One who ponders deeply stays forever, One who is indifferent remains indifferent, The same is the case with Rahusa."

prakrit: "एव घणकम्मबद्धो,पुरिसो मरणे उदिण्णसन्तम्मि,वारेऊण असत्तो,अवसेण विवज्जए नियमा"
english: "It is only by hard work that one can achieve perfection; men die, and children are born. But if one does not have them, then the law of separation prevails."

prakrit: "तम्हा असासयमिणं,माणुसनम्मं असारसुहसङ्गं,मोत्तूण रायलच्छी,जिणवरदिक्खं पवज्जामि"
english: "Your absence is inexcusable, Human life is an inexhaustible supply of pleasures, I long to see you again."

prakrit: "सोऊण वयणमेयं,मन्ती बन्धवजणा य दीणमुहा,जंपन्ति नरवराहिव!,मा ववससु एरिसं कम्मं"
english: "Listen to me, my thin face, Like a kindred spirit. Don't be alarmed: This is the work of a wise man."

prakrit: "सामिय! तुमे विहूणा,अवस्स पुइई विणस्सइ वराई,पुहईऎ विणवाए,धम्मविणासो सया होइ"
english: "Samia! You are widowed, you are now poor, You are a naked widow, You have grown old, You must be dying without dharma." ""

prakrit: "धम्मे पणट्ठ सन्ते,किं व न नटुं नरिन्द! सबस्सं?,तम्हा करेहि रज्जं,रक्खसु पुहई पयत्तेणं"
english: "Dharma has many branches, Why not Narinda? Everything?, Your hand will do the work, Rakshasa should be performed first." ""

prakrit: "नं एव अमच्चेहि,भणिओ गेण्हइ अभिग्गहं धीरो,सोऊण सुयं जायं,तो अहयं पवइस्सामि"
english: "No, you are not to be outdone. Tell me, my darling, If I fall asleep on top of you I will return."

prakrit: "एवं रायवरसिरिं,भुञ्जन्तस्स य अणेयकालम्मि,जाओ सहदेवीए,गब्भम्मि सुकोसलो पुत्तो"
english: "And the line of rays, Bhunjantasa ya aneyakalammi, Go my fellow goddesses. The earth is parched, my son." ""

prakrit: "थोवदिवसाणि बालो,निगूहिओ मन्तिणेहि कुसलेहिं,परिकहिओ च्चिय पुत्तो,एक्कण नरेण रायस्स"
english: "Long - eyed girl, Mistaken for a mystery, Wretched boy, Such a naïve person Makes you wretched."

prakrit: "सोऊण सुयं जायं,मउडाइविभूसणं निरवसेसं,तस्स षयच्छइ राया,गामसएणं तु घोसपुरं"
english: "Go to sleep, lie still, lie motionless. Please, Raya, go to sleep. It's like playing the flute In the village hall." ""

prakrit: "अह एक्कपक्खजायं,ठविऊण सुयं निवो निययरज्जे,पवइओ कित्तिधरो,परिचत्तपरिग्गहारम्भो"
english: "Oh! one side of the fence! By staying put You have fixed the path. Where else can one go But up and down the familiar path?"

prakrit: "घोरं तवं तप्पइ गिम्हकाले,मेहागमे चिट्ठइ छन्नठाणे,हेमन्तमासेसु तवोवणत्थो,झाणं पसत्थं विमलं च रेइ"
english: "In summer the thicket disappears, In the rainy season the raindrops are scattered, The summer months are fleeting, Jhan and Pastham, Vimalam, are raining down."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए सुव्वयवज्जबाहुकित्तिधरमाहप्पवण्णणो एकवीसइमो उद्देसओ समत्तो"
english: "This is the way of all women: The arrows of the God of Love travel through the skies One at a time, But our intentions are the same."

prakrit: "अह एत्तो कित्तिधरो,मुणिवसभो मलविलित्तसवङ्गो,मज्झण्हदेसयाले,नयरं पविसरइ भिक्खटुं"
english: "Oh! how poor you are! You silly girl, You shameless coward! In the middle of the rainy season A begging bowl empties itself." ""

prakrit: "तं पेच्छिऊण साहुं,जालगवक्खन्तरेण सहदेवी,रुट्ठा पेसेइ नरे,धाडेह इमं पुरवराओ"
english: "Look at that elephant, The goddess with the snake in her womb, Traveler on a tightrope, For here in this damned river There is plenty to see."

prakrit: "अन्ने वि लिङ्गिणो जे,ते वि य धाडेह मा चिरावेह,मा धम्मवयणसई,सुणिही पुत्तो महं एसो"
english: "Even a woman of either sex should be warned :'Don't be so hasty, don't turn your back on me, my son,'says the monk." ""

prakrit: "एत्थन्तरे य तेहिं,नयराओ धाडिओ मुणिवरिन्दो,अन्ने वि जे पुरत्था,निच्छूढा लिङ्गिणो सबइ"
english: "Here and there, Blind and drowsy, Young and old alike, The penis is bare and bare."

prakrit: "तं नाऊण मुणिवरं,कित्तिधरं कोसलस्स जा धाई,रुवइ किवालुयहियया,सुमरन्ती सामियगुणोहं"
english: "What a silly girl, How heartless of a woman can you be, Who cries when her husband is away, Who has no friends And who has no enemies?"

prakrit: "निसुणेऊण रुवन्ती,भणिया य सुकोसलेण केण तुमं,अम्मो परिभूय च्चिय?,तस्स फुडं निग्गरं काहं"
english: "Whom are you looking out for? Your wife is crying, Your face is swollen, Your hair is smeared with faeces?"

prakrit: "तो भणइ वसन्तलया,पुत्तय! जो तमभिसिञ्चिउं रज्जे,ठविऊण य पवइओ,सो तुज्झ पिया इह पविट्ठो"
english: "" "So you tell me, spring, my son! The water in your cucumber, which has cooled a little, Is pure water for you to drink."

prakrit: "भिक्खट्टे विहरन्तो,जणणीए तुज्झ दुट्टपुरिसेहिं,धाडाविओ य अज्जं,पुत्तय! तेणं मए रुणं"
english: "Begging around for alms, Daughter - in - law! Your wicked acts have made me wail." "My son, that makes me cry."

prakrit: "ठूण य पासण्डे,मा निबेओ य होहिइ सुयस्स,तेणं चिय नयराओ,निच्छूढा लिङ्गिणो सबे"
english: "Stop being so touchy, Don't go out in the middle of the night. It's as if you're in a trance." ""

prakrit: "उज्जाण-काणणाई,पुक्खरिणी-बाहियालिमाईणि,नयरस्स'ब्भिन्तरओ,तुज्झ कयाइं च जणणीए"
english: "Bright - eyed, fluffy - bahialimayini, fair - faced, dark - complexioned, you and your maidservants!"

prakrit: "अन्ने वि तुज्झ वइसे,पुत्तय! जे नरवई अइक्वन्ता,ते वि य भोत्तूण महि,पवज्जमुवागया सबे"
english: "Still your heart, my son! One who is naïve cannot be stupid, Yet you foolish woman, You shameless woman." ""

prakrit: "एएण कारणेणं,न देइ नयरस्स निग्गमं तुज्झ,मा निसुणिऊण धम्म,निक्खमिही जायसंवेगो"
english: "That's why I won't let you touch me. Stop bothering, dharma, For I am not worthy of your affection." ""

prakrit: "सोऊण वयणमेयं,सुकोसलो निग्गओ पुरवराओ,पत्तो य पिउसयासं,वन्दइ परमेण विणएणं"
english: "On the other hand, When the wind blows, The dry grass withers, And the leaves wither. God has made the cotton weave."

prakrit: "तं वन्दिऊण समणं,उवविट्ठो सुणिय धम्मपरमत्थं,भणइ य सुकोसलो तं,भयवं! निसुणेहि मे वयणं"
english: "Listen carefully, you fool, To speak the truth about dharma While you're out there, Say what you have to say. Fear not! Speak in silence." ""

prakrit: "आलित्ते निययघरे,जणओ घेत्तूण पुत्तभण्डाई,अवहरइ तूरमाणो,सो ताण हियं विचिन्तन्तो"
english: "It's your own house, Sitting on the veranda Looking out for someone who might be about to depart, Always thinking of someone else."

prakrit: "मोहग्गिसंपलित्ते,जियलोयघरे मए पमोत्तूणं,निक्खन्तो नाह! तुमं,न य जुत्तं एरिसं लोए"
english: "Dear girl, Stop dragging me into your house! You're not the only one who has this trouble." ""

prakrit: "तम्हा कुणह पसायं,मोहाणलदीविए सरीरघरे,निक्खममाणस्स महं,हत्थालम्ब पयच्छाहि"
english: "Your face is pale, O lovely lamp, In the house of the God of Love, My mind is pure, The palm of my hand is pure."

prakrit: "एवं सो अणगारो,चित्तं नाऊण निययपुत्तस्स,ताहे भणइ सुभणिओ,होउ अविग्धं तुहं धम्मे"
english: "And he says,'You fool, My son - in - law, You clever girl, You are invincible in Dharma." ""

prakrit: "वट्टइ एसा''लावो,ताव य भडचडयरेण परिकिण्णा,पत्ता विचित्तमाला,गुरुभारा पणइणी तस्स"
english: "Wait a moment; bring it on. Try it with a sharp knife Or with a wide girdle: It's the landowner's son-in-law's daughter." ""

prakrit: "सा भणइ पायपडिया,सामिय! पुहई ममं च मोत्तूणं,मा ववससु षवज्जं,दुच्चरिया मुणिवराणं पि"
english: "She says," "Paypadiya, Samiya!" "Then kisses my forehead." "Don't touch me, my poor daughter - in - law. For being such a nasty fool You have to bow down."

prakrit: "संथाविऊण गाढं,सुकोसलो भणइ तुज्झ गब्भम्मि,भद्दे! होही पुत्तो,सो अहिसित्तो मए रज्जे"
english: "" "Calm down, you coward! He's dry and you call him by the wrong name." "My son, he's already angry."

prakrit: "आपुच्छिऊण सवं,बन्धुजणं परिजणं च महिलाओ,जिणदिक्खं पडिवन्नो,सुकोसलो पिउसयासम्मि"
english: "You see, all you want to see are women, relatives and friends. However long your sight lasts, It's as good as your husband's." ""

prakrit: "अह सो निच्छियहियओ,संवेगपरायणो दढधिईओ,अन्नन्नविहिनिओगं,काऊण तवं समाढत्तो"
english: "Oh! you sagging soul, Struggling with emotions, Running out of food, Who is there to comfort you?"

prakrit: "रयणावलि मुत्तावलि,कणयावलि कुलिसमज्झ जवमज्झं,जिणगुणसंपत्ती वि य,विही य तह सबओभद्दा"
english: "Rayna valli muttavalli, kanyavalli kulisamajja jamajamma, Jina gunasampathi, or else it's all nonsense."

prakrit: "एत्तो तिलोयसारा,मुइङ्गमज्झा पिवीलियामज्झा,सीसंकारयलद्धी,दंसणनाणस्स लद्धी य"
english: "Here is a swarm of parrots, Mooing bees, Rolling pearls, Flicking reeds, Struggling with stinging needles."

prakrit: "अह पञ्चमन्दरा वि य,केसरिकोला चरित्तलद्धी य,परिसहजया य पवयण-माया आइण्णसुहनामा"
english: "Ah, the panchmanda! The kesarikola is in full swing, The path is winding, And the path is smooth." - Maya's Aina Suhanama

prakrit: "पञ्चनमोक्कारविही,तित्थट्ठसुया य सोक्खसंपत्ती,धम्मोवासणलद्धी,तहेव अणुवट्टमाणा य"
english: "One who observes the five vows, Who attains happiness through tithing, Who conquers pleasure, Who renounces dharma, Is always mindful of one's actions."

prakrit: "एयासु य अन्नासु य,विहीसु दसमाइपक्खमासेसु,बेमासिय तेमासिय,खवेइ छम्मासजोएसु"
english: "Ayasu ya annasu ya, washes away, One month is left for the tenth day, The unreturned summer is gone, The poor see the shadow of summer."

prakrit: "ते दो वि पिया-पुत्ता,नव-संजम-नियमसोसियसरीरा,विहरन्ति दढधिईया,गामा-''गरमण्डियं वसुहं"
english: "The two of them are dear - son, new - temperament - rules, busy - going, long - starved, Gama -" "The hot spring is everywhere." ""

prakrit: "सा पुत्तविओगेणं,सहदेवी तत्थ दुक्खिया सन्ती,अझज्झाणेण मया,उप्पन्ना कन्दरे वग्घी"
english: "That daughter - in - law is old, That friend of mine is poor, And I am content with that sorrow. For my part, I have grown very thin."

prakrit: "एवं विहरन्ताणं,मुणीण संपत्थिओ जलयकालो,पसरन्तमेहनिवहो,गयणयलोच्छइयसबदिसो"
english: "And when you are on a journey, You sow seeds of nectar, When you are sowing seeds of ecstasy, You scorch the ground with burning fire."

prakrit: "वरिसइ घणो पभूयं,तडिच्छडाडोवभोसणं गयणं,गुलगुलगुलन्तसद्दो,वित्थरइ समन्तओ सहसा"
english: "The rainbow is very wide, The grasshopper is singing loudly, The parrots are chirping, The hunter is hurrying."

prakrit: "धाराजज्जरियमही,उम्मग्गपलोट्टसलिलकल्लोला,उब्भिन्नकन्दलदला,मरगयमणिसामला जाया"
english: "The stream is swollen, Like a lotus plucked out of the eaves, Like an emerald bud torn by the rays of the sun."

prakrit: "एयारिसम्मि काले,जत्थत्थमिया मुणी निओगेणं,चिट्ठन्ति सेलमूले,चाउम्मासेण जोएणं"
english: "Aries smear black, Jatthamiya sage neogene, Scribbles on the roots of the plant, Joints it with rice."

prakrit: "एवं उत्तासणए,रण्णे कवाय-सत्त-तरुगहणे,फासुयठाणम्मि ठिया,पसत्थझाणुज्जयमईया"
english: "And in this state of excitement, The crows run in circles, Seven clutches, Hang on by the snare, As if they had been hit by lightning."

prakrit: "वीरासणजोएणं,काउस्सग्गेण एगपासेणं,उववासेण य य नीओ,एक्कणं पाउसो कालो"
english: "To join in a sweat, To partake of cow - dung cakes, To weep for bamboo shoots, Is but the passage of one rainy day."

prakrit: "सरयम्मि समावडिए,कत्तियमासस्स मुणिवरा एत्तो,संपुण्णनियमजोगा,नयरं पविसन्ति भिक्खट्ठा"
english: "In autumn the months are long, So is the month of full moon. The full moon will come, And the night will tell on the monks." ""

prakrit: "लीलाऎ वच्चमाणा,दिट्ठा वग्घीऎ तोऎ मुणिवसहा,रुसिया नखेहि मही,विलिहइ नायं विमुञ्चन्ती"
english: "Lila, you stupid girl, When you see a tiger You're a fool, If you touch a peacock's tail You don't have to bend over."

prakrit: "अह सो सुकोसलमुणी,वन्धी दटुं बहुज्जयमईयं,ताहे वोसिरियतणू,सुक्कज्झाणं समारुहइ"
english: "Oh! she is a dry bow, Bandhi's teeth are many and shiny; So is the arrow of the God of Love, Which celebrates the joys of love."

prakrit: "दाढाकरालवयणा,उप्पइऊणं नहं चलसहावा,पडिया सुकोसलोवरि,विजू इव दारुणा वग्धी"
english: "The plowman's son, You have not grown tall enough For him to walk, You are a dry man's daughter, And Viju is a cruel wretch."

prakrit: "पाडेऊण महियले,मंसं अहिलसइ अत्तणो वयणे,मोडेइ अट्ठियाई,तोडेइ य पहारुसंघाए"
english: "The buffalo is singing, The deer is sitting cross-legged, The ox is bending over, The shepherd is pulling the fence."

prakrit: "इय पेच्छसु संसारे,सेणिय! मोहस्स विलसियं एयं,जणणी खायइ मंसं,जत्थ सुइट्ठस्स पुत्तस्स"
english: "Look at the world, soldier! Love is precious. For what use is a man to a woman? It's like eating a man, Like a good son." ""

prakrit: "खज्जन्तस्स भगवओ,सुक्कज्झाणावगाहियमणस्स,समणस्स जीवियन्ते,जीवियन्ते,केवलनाणं समुप्पन्नं"
english: "Forgiveness is dear to the soul, For wisdom leads to happiness, And honesty leads to life; Only renunciation leads to death."

prakrit: "एवं सहदेवीए,कोसलअगाइँ खायमाणीए,जायं जाईसरणं,पुत्तयदन्ताइँ दट्टणं"
english: "And fellow goddesses, eat food only for the sake of kosala, Which is to be eaten only in jasmine, Drunk only on account of sonship."

prakrit: "सा पच्छायावेणं,तिण्णि य दिवसाइँ अणसणं काउं,उववन्ना दियलोए,वग्घी मरिऊण सोहम्मे"
english: "It's past due, I can't imagine how it would be for three whole days. The only way to tell is to die."

prakrit: "देवा चउप्पगारा,समागया मुणिवरस्स कुबन्ति,निबाणगमणमहिमं,नाणाविहगन्धकुसुमेहिं"
english: "God is kind, People worship sages, Sweating profuse with the scent of nectar."

prakrit: "कित्तिधरस्स वि एत्तो,समुग्गयं केवलं जगपगासं,महिमकराण य एक्का,जत्ता जाया सुरवराणं"
english: "How stupid is that? The whole world is just a stage, glorifying one another, As long as one does not make noise."

prakrit: "महिमं काऊण तओ,पणमिय सबायरेण तिक्खुत्तं,देवा चउप्पगारा,निययट्ठाणाइँ संपत्ता"
english: "What is the use of glory? Money is sharpened by flattery. God is all round; Destiny is the god of wealth."

prakrit: "एयं जो सुणइ नरो,भावेण सुकोसलस्स निवाणं,सो उवसग्गविमुक्को,लभइ य पुण्णफलं विउलं"
english: "He who listens to one's heart, Who is able to pacify a dry one With kindness, Will soon attain true bliss."

prakrit: "देवी विचित्तमाला,संपुण्णे तत्थ कालसमयम्मि,पुत्तं चेव पसूया,हिरण्णगब्भो त्ति नामेणं"
english: "The goddess is strange, Time flies when one is full, And her son is a wild beast. Name me the deer calf."

prakrit: "पत्तो सरीरविद्धिं,कमेण रज्जस्स सामिओ जाओ,हरिवाहणस्स दुहिया,परिणेइ मिगावई कन्नं"
english: "The leaf is tied to the body, The bow to the lotus is tied, The neck is bowed, The trunk is bent, And the wife is covered with gooseflesh."

prakrit: "तोए समं रायसिरिं,भुञ्जन्तो अन्नया नरवरिन्दो,भमरनिहकेसमज्झे,पेच्छइ पलियङ्करं एक्कं"
english: "So do the parrots, The man who is roasting the rice, Or the hen who is breeding the chickpeas." ""

prakrit: "अह सोइउं पयत्तो,मच्चूणं पेसिओ महं दूओ,बल-सत्ति-कन्तिरहिओ,होहामि न एत्थ संदेहो"
english: "Oh! sleep well, sweet passion give it to me, Strength and strength - I have no doubt of it."

prakrit: "विसएसु वञ्चिओ हइ,कालं अइदारुणं सुहपसत्तो,बन्धवनेहविणडिओ,धम्मधुरं नेव पडिवन्नो"
english: "Such a wretched man, Time alone is so kind, Friendship with a strange man, That the dharma has never failed him."

prakrit: "एवं हिरण्णगब्भो,नघुसकुमारं मिगावईपुत्तं,अहिसिञ्चिऊण रज्जे,निक्खन्तो विमलमुणिपासे"
english: "And the deer - nymph, The son of Migavai, Who is the youngest among the nymphs, Is so full of water as to spit it out."

prakrit: "गब्भन्थे च्चिय असिवं,न घोसियं जस्स जणवए जम्हा,नघुसो त्ति तेण नाम,गुरूहि रइयं सुमणसेहिं"
english: "Pride is bound to come, pride is not what one gives birth to, vanity is not one's name, the teacher is bound by duty."

prakrit: "नघुसो परिट्ठवेडं,निययपुरे सीहियं महादेविं,उत्तरदिसं पयट्टो,जेउं सामन्तसंघाए"
english: "Be not negligent: The Vedas are endless, The great gods are infinite, The north is endless, And the south is endless; Like a confederacy of feudal lords."

prakrit: "दाहिणदेसाहिवई,नधुसं नाऊण दूरदेसत्थं,घेत्तुं साएयपुरिं,समागया साहणसमग्गा"
english: "The elephant is on the right, The boat is sailing in the distance, The herd is running in circles, The congregation is full of elephants."

prakrit: "नघुसस्स महादेवी,विणिग्गया सीहिया बलसमग्गा,अह जुज्झिउं पयत्ता,तेहि समं नरवरिन्देहिं"
english: "Naughty Mahadevi, Strong as a sow's tail, Mighty as a warrior's bow, Equal to the might of men."

prakrit: "निद्दयपहरेहि हया,समरे हन्तूण सोहिया सत्तू,रक्खइ साएयपुरी,निययपयावुज्जयमईया"
english: "Niddayapahare hi haya, samre haantun sohia sattu, rakhai sayapuri, niyaypayavujyamayi."

prakrit: "नघुसो वि उत्तरदिसं,काऊण वसे समागओ नयरिं,सुणिऊण सीहियाए,परक्कम दारुणं रुट्ठो"
english: "Traveler, stay where you are, Speak little, Listen carefully, Root out the worst."

prakrit: "भणइ य अहो अलज्जा,न य कुलवहुयाऎ एरिसं जुत्तं,अविखण्डियसीलाए,परपुरिसनियत्तचित्ताए"
english: "I beg of you, my dear, Not so much by virtue of being a farmer as by nature."

prakrit: "परिभूया नरवइणा,दोसं काऊण सा महादेवी,अह अन्नया कयाई,नघुसस्स जरो समुप्पन्नो"
english: "The neighbor is a maniac, The culprit is a coward, The other is a crow, The naughtiest is always the worst."

prakrit: "मन्ताण ओसहाण य,वेज्जपउत्ताण नेव उवसन्तो,दाहज्जरो महन्तो,अहिययरं वेयणं देइ"
english: "If the mind is busy, When the fire is hot, It does not quench at all. But if it is burning, I will give the fire a rest."

prakrit: "नाऊण : तहाभूयं,नराहिवं सीहिया महादेवी,सोयपरिग्गहियमणा,तस्स सयासं समल्लीणा"
english: "Noun: Such a being, such a one, Such a one as Mahadevi who is jealous of men, Such an one as Prakrit, Who embraces all that is real."

prakrit: "सबजणस्स समक्खं,उदयं घेत्तूण सीहिया भणइ,मोत्तूण निययदइयं,जइ अन्नो ना''सि मे हियए"
english: "Everyone is equal, The first thing one does After waking up is speak plainly, The second thing one doesn't know Before setting foot on the road." ""

prakrit: "तो नरवइस्स दाहो,उवसमउ जलेण करविमुक्केणं,एवं भणिऊण सित्तो,राया विगयज्जरो जाओ"
english: "So burn the cow - dung cakes, put them on fire, and say:" "Stop burning them." ""

prakrit: "उल्हवियसबगत्तं,दट्टण नराहिवं जणो तुट्टो,सीलं पसंसमाणो,भणइ अहो! साहु! साहु! त्ति"
english: "Wretched cow, A man torn to shreds By thick grass, Like a good seal, Says:" "Ah! Sahu! Shahu! Titi!" ""

prakrit: "देवेहि कुसुमवुट्ठी,मुक्का सुसुयन्धगन्धरिद्धिल्ला,राया वि य परितुट्ठो,सीलं नाऊण महिलाए"
english: "Deer - eyed girl, Smelling no fragrance As if she had a good time, Reflecting on the night sky, Sealed by a woman's name"

prakrit: "ठविऊण नरवइन्दो,निययपए 'सीहिया महादेवी,भोगे भोत्तण चिरं,संवेगपरायणो जाओ"
english: "By staying awake you become impotent, By staying asleep you become immovable, By going for a walk you gain consciousness."

prakrit: "नघुसो परिवेउं,सोदासं सीहियासुयं रज्जे,निक्खन्तो नरवसभो,परिचत्तपरिग्गहारम्भो"
english: "Be careful not to fall asleep, be sedated by loud noises, be immobile, avoid contact with people you know, and avoid close contact with others."

prakrit: "तोसु वि कालेसु सया,सोदासनराहिवस्स कुलवंसे,न य केणइ परिभुत्तं,मंसं चिय अट्ठ दिवसाइं"
english: "Tosu vi kalesu saya, Sodasanarahivas clansmen, No one has ever gone abroad. Eight days are enough for me"

prakrit: "कम्मोदएण सो पुण,तेसु वि दिवसेसु भुञ्जई मंसं,भणइ य सूयारवई,मंसं आणेहि मे सिग्धं"
english: "Because she is angry, She punishes, Even on those dark days, She destroys the mind, She sows the seeds of prosperity, And brings happiness to the mind."

prakrit: "तइया पुणो अमारी,वट्टइ अट्ठाहिया जिणवराणं,पिसियस्स अलाभेणं,माणुसमंसं च से दिन्नं"
english: "You're right, you fool, You fool, I'm giving my life for nothing But to please people."

prakrit: "माणुसमंसपसत्तो,खायन्तो. पंउरबालए बहवे,सूयारेण समाणं,सुएण निद्धाडिओ राया"
english: "People go to bed early, eat their fill. The young go to sleep early, The young stay up late, And sleep does not last long." ""

prakrit: "तस्स सुओ गुणकलिओ,कणयाभानन्दणो तहिं नयरे,अहिसित्तो सीहरहो,रज्जे सबेहि सुहडेहिं"
english: "Praise be to him, Blessed are the eyes that see him, For, behold, the whole sky is white; For all the rays of the sun Are pleasant."

prakrit: "सीहस्स जहा मंसं,आहारो तस्स निययकालम्मि,तेणं चिय विक्खाओ,पुहईए सीहसोदासो"
english: "Laughter is as good as the mind, Diet is as regular as time, Anger is as bad as sleep."

prakrit: "पेच्छइ परिब्भमन्तो,दाहिणदेसे सियम्बरं पणओ,तस्स सगासे धम्म,सुणिऊण तओ समाढत्तो"
english: "You look around; From the right side go the siyambara; From inside all of you go the dharma; By listening you attain purity."

prakrit: "अह भणइ मुणिवरिन्दो,निसुणसु धम्मं जिणेहि परिकहियं,जेट्टो य समणधम्मो,सावयधम्मो य अणुजेट्ठो"
english: "Ah! foolish talk, Never mind what Dharma says. But if you agree, you win. If you disagree, you lose."

prakrit: "पञ्च य महत्वयाई,समिईओ चेव पञ्च भणियाओ,तिण्णि य गुत्तिनिओगा,एसो धम्मो मुणिवराणं"
english: "The five are important, the seven are alike, the five are brothers, and the three are indistinguishable; this is the principle of dharma."

prakrit: "हिंसालियचोरिका,परदारपरिग्गहस्स य नियत्ती,तिण्णि य गुणवयाई,महुमंसविवजणं भणियं"
english: "A violent girl, Destiny like a curtain raiser, Virtuous by all three, Is the description of a beehive."

prakrit: "भगवं! गेण्हामि वयं,जं भणसि महामुणी पयत्तेणं,एकं पुण हियइट्ठ,नवरि य मंसं न छड्ड मि"
english: "Lord! I beg of you, tell me, What you say to that great woman: You're right in asking me once. But don't turn your back on me." ""

prakrit: "भणिओ तहेव मुणिणा,भुञ्जसि मंसं अयाणओ तं सि,तह पडिहिसि संसारे,तिमिगिली जह गओ नरयं"
english: "Say,'You fool, You stupid man, You traitor to the world.'"" To Whom the whale's tail belongs, That is, to hell. "

prakrit: "गिद्धा सुणय-सियाला,मंसं खायन्ति असण-तण्हाए,जे वि हु खायन्ति नरा,ते तेहि समा न संदेहो"
english: "Vultures are drowsy, Flesh is fickle, Weeping and sighing; Whatever we eat, Be not suspicious of it."

prakrit: "जो खाइऊण मंसं,मज्जइ तित्थेसु कुणइ वयनियमं,तं तस्स किलेसयरं,अयालकुसुमं व फलरहियं"
english: "One who eats meat, Which gives birth to a seed, Makes the wind blow, Such is the beauty of a fortress, Like the blossom of an apple That bears fruit."

prakrit: "जो भुञ्जइ मूढमई,मंसं चिय सुक्क-रुहिरसंभूयं,सो पावकम्मगरुओ,सुइरं परिभमइ संसारे"
english: "One who is full of foolishness, Who cherishes the pleasures of happiness and sorrow, Is guilty of sin, Who treats all beings with kindness."

prakrit: "मंसासायणनिरओ,जीवाण वहं करइ निक्खुत्तं,जीववहम्मि य पावं,पावेण य दोग्गइं जाइ"
english: "Stop being paranoid, the soul must be free to do whatever it wants, the body must be able to live without suffering."

prakrit: "जे मारिऊण जीवे,मंसं भुञ्जन्ति जीहदोसेणं,ते अहिवडन्ति नरए,दुक्खसहस्साउले भीमे"
english: "Those who live by killing, Whom the enemy destroys, They cease to exist, Even in the midst of suffering."

prakrit: "ते तत्थ समुप्पन्ना,नरए बहुवेयणे निययकालं,छिज्जन्ति य भिज्जन्ति य,करवत्त-'सिवत्त-जन्तेसु"
english: "They meet there, Destroy time in many ways, Scorch or soak up water, Make mud -" "Silly - Jantesu." ""

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,मुणिवरविहियं भएण दुक्खाणं,होउं पसन्नहियओ,सोदासो सावओ जाओ"
english: "To lie low is to lie low, To be in love is to suffer, To sulk is to be happy, To seek happiness is to die."

prakrit: "तत्तो महापुरे वि य,कालगए पत्थिवे सुयविहूणे,गयखन्धसमारूढो,सोदासो पाविओ रज्जं"
english: "So great are they, Time has passed, The paths are slippery, The roads are impassable, The poor man's search is for the king."

prakrit: "पुत्तस्स तेण दूओ,विसज्जिओ कुणह मे लहु षणामं,तेण वि भणिओ दूओ,न तस्स अहयं पणिवयामि"
english: "Give me your son, I beg of you, Or else I will hurt him. Tell me, too, What he has to say; I will not bow down to him."

prakrit: "सोऊण दूयवयणं,सोदासो निग्गओ बलसमग्गो,तस्स विसयं च पत्तो,बन्दियणुग्घुट्ट जयसद्दो"
english: "A good man is full of faults, A clever man is wealthy and powerful, A wise man has many talents, And a prisoner has few talents."

prakrit: "सीहरहो वि अहिमुहो,चउरङ्गबलेण तत्थ निग्गन्तुं,आभिट्टो तेण समं,संगामो दारुणो जाओ"
english: "Be straightforward, be non - violent; For with a four - pronged bull it goes astray; With him it is the same as with a doe."

prakrit: "जेऊण सुयं समरे,तस्स य रज महागुणं दाउं,सोदासो पवइओ,कुणइ तवं बारसवियप्पं"
english: "If she loves him, let her royal highnesses pursue her. If he hates her, Let him pursue his passion. If she hates him, Let her pursue his dreams."

prakrit: "सीहरहस्स वि पुत्तो,बम्भरहो नरवई समुप्पन्नो,तस्स वि चउम्मुहो वि य,हेमरहो जसरहो चेव"
english: "Be strong, my son; be strong, be prepared to go through the ordeal of being raped; be careful not to fall into the same trap as your wife."

prakrit: "पउमरहो य मयरहो,ससीरहो रविरहो य मन्धाओ,उदयरहो नरवसहो,वीरसुसेणो य पडिवयणो"
english: "Be it the poor or the dying, The languid or the languid, The rising or the waning, The brave or the vanquished."

prakrit: "नामेण कमलबन्धू,रविसत्तू तह वसन्ततिलओ य,राया कुबेरदत्तो,कुन्थू सरहो य विरहो य"
english: "Name should be Kamalbandhu, Ravishattu and Vasant Tilao, Raya is the son of Kuber, Kunthu is mustard or is it separation."

prakrit: "रहनिग्धोसो य तहा,मयारिदमणो हिरण्णनाभो य,पुञ्जत्थलो य ककुहो,राया रघुसो य नायवो"
english: "You stay where you are, My poor deer lover, The crows stay where they are kept, The raghus stays where he is kept, And the doe stays where she is kept."

prakrit: "एवं इक्खागकुले,समइक्कन्तेसु नरवरिन्देसु,साएयपुरवरीए,अणरण्णो पत्थिवो जाओ"
english: "And Ikkagakulae, samaekkantesu naravarindesu, saeyapurvaris, go to the path of renunciation."

prakrit: "तस्स महादेवीए,पुहईए दो सुया समुप्पन्ना,पढमो य अणन्तरहो,बीओ पुण दसरहो जाओ"
english: "Tasa Mahadevi," said the girl, "First two needles, then the next." "Then, dear girl, the tenth day is over."

prakrit: "माहेसरनयरवई,मित्तं सोऊण सहसकिरणं सो,पवइओ निविष्णो,इमस्स संसारवासस्स"
english: "Friend, if you want to live in harmony with each other, stay indoors, for this is the way of the world."

prakrit: "अणरण्णो वि नरवई,पुत्तं चिय दसरहं ठविय रज्जे,निक्खमइ सुयसमग्गो,पासे मुणिअभयसेणस्स"
english: "Fear not, my son; It is only the twilight of Dasara. Try to rest, dear go - between." ""

prakrit: "छट्ठ-'ट्ठम-दसम-दुवालसेहि मास-'द्धमासखमणेहिं,काऊण तवमुयारं,अणरण्णो पत्थिओ मोक्खं"
english: "Chhath -" "Sixth - tenth - The month of Duvvala -'Twelfth - the month of Kshama, Who is devoted to penance, Is the path to liberation" ""

prakrit: "साहू वि अणन्तरहो,अणन्तबल-विरिय-सत्तिसंपन्नो,संजम-तव-नियमधरो,जत्थत्थमिओ मही भमइ"
english: "The hunter is always on the move, The fowler is constantly on the prowl, The strong are free, The wealthy are wealthy, And the modest are disciplined."

prakrit: "अरुहत्थले नरिन्दो,सुकोसलो तस्स चेव महिलाए,अमयप्पभाऎ धूया,कन्ना अवराइया नामं"
english: "Aruhatthale Narindo, sukosalo tasa seve mahila, amayappabha bhaya dhoya, kanna avaraiya naama." ""

prakrit: "सा दसरहस्स दिन्ना,परिणीया तेण वरविभूईए,अह कमलसंकुलपुरे,सुबन्धुतिलओ निवो तत्थ"
english: "It is the day of Dussehra, The bridegroom is about to part with his bride. I bow before the lotus, For there is fire in the jasmine."

prakrit: "मित्ता य महादेवी,दुहिया चिय केकई ललियरूवा,सा दसरहेण कन्ना,परिणीया नाम सोमित्ती"
english: "Friend, this is Mahadevi; Two ripe bananas are in store for you; She is Kanna for the tenth day; Parinaya's name is Somiti."

prakrit: "एवं जुबईहि समं,परिभुञ्जइ दसरहो महारजं,सम्मत्तभावियमई,देव-गुरूपूयणाभिरओ"
english: "And the days are long, They encompass the whole horizon: The great king, The agreeable wife, The fierce warrior of gods and gurus."

prakrit: "जे भरहाइनराहिवसूरा,उत्तमसत्ति-सिरीसंपन्ना,ते जिणधम्मफलेण महप्पा,होन्ति पुणो विमला-'मलभावा"
english: "One who is overly dependent on others, Who is extremely dependent on one's own energy, Is the greatest gainer of all living beings." - Vimala, The Destroyer of Malabas

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए सुकोसलमाहप्पजुत्तो दसरहउप्पत्तिभिहाणो नाम बावीसइमो उद्देसओ समत्तो"
english: "Proud lady, It's only the twelfth day of spring and summer. I swear I've got nothing to say about it."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाई,सहाऎ मज्झम्मि दसरहो राया,चिट्ठइ सुहासणत्थो,ताव च्चिय नारओ पत्तो"
english: "Ah, what a strange thing it is to do; my friend, the tenth day is almost over; the letter is from a dear friend; so is the name of the letter."

prakrit: "अब्भुट्टिओ य सहसा,नरवइणा आसणे सुहनिसण्णो,परिपुच्छिओ य भयवं!,कत्तो सि तुमं परिब्भमिओ?"
english: "Silly girl, Sitting on a man's lap You're a pleasure to look at, Looking down your nose You must be afraid!" Where are you wandering off to?

prakrit: "दाऊण य आसीसं,भणइ तओ नारओ जिणहराणं,वन्दणनिमित्तहेडं,पुवविदेहं गओ अहयं"
english: "You fool, I promise, If you say so, you are only trying to jinx the slogan. For the sake of flattery, I will go to your house."

prakrit: "अह पुण्डरोगिणीए,सीमन्धरजिणवरस्स निक्खमणं,दिटुं मए महायस!,सुरअसुरसमाउलं तत्थ"
english: "Ah, you foolish girl, The mere thought of crossing the boundary fence Will give you goose pimples!"

prakrit: "सीमंधरभगवन्तं,नमिऊणं चेइयाइँ तत्थ पुणो,मन्दरगिरिं गओ हं,पणमामि जिणालए तुट्ठो"
english: "Lord of the borders, If you want to bow before me again, Go to the temple, For the victory of your mother is certain."

prakrit: "सुरगणसेवियसिहरं,काऊण पयाहिणं नगवरिन्दं,तुरियं च पडिनियत्तो,अभिवन्दन्तो जिणहराइं"
english: "The elephant serves the snake, The crows guide the doe, And the parrots are pollinators. The hunter conquers all."

prakrit: "तो नारएण भणिओ,साएयवई! सुणेहि मह वयणं,अवसारेसु य लोयं,जेण रहस्सं निवेएमि"
english: "So the doe said:" "Say what I have to say!" "Now listen to me speak; It's only a matter of time before the world disappears. I will reveal the secret."

prakrit: "ओसारियम्मि लोए,कहेइ तो नारओ नरवइस्स,वन्दणकएण नवरं,तिकूडसिहरं गओ अहयं"
english: "In this wretched world," she says, "a man is worthless if he speaks nonsense." "For where are you going to go, you bastard?"

prakrit: "तत्थ जिणसन्तिभवणं,अभिवन्देऊण चिट्ठमाणेणं,तुह पुण्णपभावेणं,तं मे अवहारियं वयणं"
english: "That is the feeling of being alive, That of greeting you with a letter, That is how I feel when I speak unasked."

prakrit: "नेमित्तिएण सिटुं,सायरविहिणा उ रावणं समरे,जह दहरहस्स पुत्तो,मारिहिइ न एत्थ संदेहो"
english: "Sit still, my son; don't doubt that Ravana can be killed If you refuse to bow before him, My son, Who has passed away in a day."

prakrit: "जणयदुहियानिमित्तं,सुणिऊण बिहीसणो भणइ एवं,मारेमि दसरहं तं,जाव 'सुओ से न संभवइ"
english: "On the eve of your wedding, The deaf and mute girl speaks up:" "I will kill you by the tenth day, But sleeping on your own is not possible." ""

prakrit: "अहमवि बिभीसणेणं,भणिओ जाणासि कहिं दसरहो सो?,जणओ य साहसु फुडं,भयवं! मा कुणह वक्खेवं"
english: "I beg of you, tell me," "Where are you going next?" "For who would dare say such a thing, You cowardly fool! Don't be alarmed!"

prakrit: "भणिओ बिभीसणो मे,अहयं न सुणेमि ताण उप्पत्ती,दाऊण उत्तरमिणं,इहागओ तुज्झ पासम्मि"
english: "Tell me, Being divided, I will not listen to you. Instead, You will answer me, For here I am beside You."

prakrit: "एवं ते परिकहियं,सम्मदिट्टिस्स तुज्झ नेहेणं,ताव करेहि उवायं,जाव य न बिभीसणो एइ"
english: "And I'll go away, As you always have done, So you must go on making love. Or else there will be no separation."

prakrit: "दाऊण य उवएस,अइतुरियं नारओ गओ मिहिलं,जणयस्स वि निस्सेसं,कहेइ वत्तं मरणहेउं"
english: "You fool, Don't be so naïve: It's time for your husband to die."

prakrit: "मरणमहब्भयभीओ,नराहिवो दसरहो समप्पेउं,मन्तीण कोस-देसं,विणिग्गओ तत्थ पच्छन्नो"
english: "Fearful of death, Destroyer of enemies: The end of Dasara is nigh, For what use is a man afraid of?"

prakrit: "ताव य मन्तीहि लहूं,लेप्पमयं दसरहस्स पडिबिम्बं,कारावियं मणोज,सत्ततले भवणपासाए"
english: "So do not worry, my dear, When the festival of Dussehra starts, The nights are dark, The days are fleeting, And the nights are long."

prakrit: "एसो चिय वित्तन्तो जणयस्स वि कारिओ य मन्तीहिं,नट्ठा भमन्ति दोणि वि,पुहई पच्छन्नरूवधरा"
english: "That's the way it is: Once you've had your moment, Either way," Said the traveler, "Or both."

prakrit: "ताव य बिहीसणेणं,साएयपुरीऎ पेसिया पुरिसा,हिण्डन्ति गवेसन्ता,नराहिवं दिन्नदिट्ठीया"
english: "You stupid girl, Pecia puris, Hindanti govtsanta, Deer - eyed women give birth to deer."

prakrit: "रायहरं असमत्था,पविसेउं जाव ते चिरावेन्ति,ताव य साएयपुरिं,बिहीसणो आगओ तुरियं"
english: "The nights are uncertain, The nights long, But the fire of jealousy is fierce."

prakrit: "तडिविलसिएण सिग्धं,बिहीसणाणत्तियाऎ भवणवरं,पविसेऊण य छिन्नं,सीसं चिय कित्तिमनिवस्स"
english: "Water is poisonous to the eyes, It pollutes the air, It paralyzes the mind, It destroys the senses, And what a disgrace it is to the soul."

prakrit: "लक्खारसपगलन्तं,सीसं तडिविलसिएण घेत्तणं,रयणीऎ सयं दटु,पुणरवि दावेन्ति सामिस्स"
english: "A flock of parrots flies past, Head struck by a raindrop, Eyes fixed on the queen: Once again the left shakes her head."

prakrit: "अन्तेउरे पलावं,सोऊण सिरं महीऎ मोत्तूण,मणपवणजणियवेओ,बिहीसणो पत्थिओ लकं"
english: "The hunter has fled, The farmer has struck his head on the nail mark, The traveler has lost his bow, And the hunter's wife has lost her husband."

prakrit: "परिवग्गो वि पलावं,काऊणं पेयकम्मकरणिजं । दहरहसमू,सुयमणो,अच्छइ य दिसि पलोयन्तो"
english: "Traveler, flee! For how long have you been drinking? It's only right, my dear, That you flee now and then." ""

prakrit: "एत्तो बिभीसणो वि य,गुरूण सम्माण-दाण-पूयाई,कुणइ पयत्तेणं चिय,आणन्दं हरिसियमईओ"
english: "So much for the separation, The teacher's showing honour And charity, The husband praising his wife, And the wife praising her husband."

prakrit: "परभवजणियं जं दुक्कयं सुक्कयं वा,परिणमइ नराणं तं तहा नेव मिच्छं,इइ मुणिय विसेसं घोरसंसारवासं,कुणह विमलभावं मोक्खमग्गे जिणाणं"
english: "What pains people to realize, When it becomes arduous and dry, Is nothing to be ashamed of; This, like a sage, is the abode of the God of Love."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए बिहीसणवयणविहाणो नाम तेवीसइमो उद्देसओ समत्तो"
english: "This is the name of the twenty-third day of my marriage. I agree with it." ""

prakrit: "सस्स भमन्तस्स तया,जं वत्तं तं सुणेहि मगहवई!,तं ते कहेमि सर्व,सुणेहि इह अवहिओ होउं"
english: "Mother - in - law, I beg of you, Listen to what I have to say! I will tell you this: Listen, and it will be enough."

prakrit: "उत्तरदिसाऎ नयरं,इह कोउयमङ्गलं मणभिरामं,तत्था''सी नरवसभो,गुणाहिओ सुहमई नामं"
english: "The river in the north direction, This panoramic expanse of the Kouyamangalam, There you have it:" "Handsome people, Virtuous are the pleasant names." ""

prakrit: "महिला से पुहइसिरी,धूया वि य केगई पवरकन्ना,पुत्तो य दोणमेहो,जोवणलायण्णषडिपुण्णो"
english: "You fool, My daughter - in - law, If you ask a woman what she eats She will give you a bath. My son, Don't be so hasty: It's the fire of love."

prakrit: "कन्तिपडिपुण्णसोहा,रूवाईसयगुणेहि उववेया,विविहकला-''गमकुसला,सा कन्ना बुद्धिसारेणं"
english: "Contentment, virtuous behavior, variety of pastimes -" Gamakusa, That's the secret of wisdom. "" "

prakrit: "नर्से सलक्खणगुणं,गन्धवं सविहत्तिसंजुत्तं,जाणइ आहरणविही,चउबिहं चेव सविसेसं"
english: "The nurse knows what is pleasant, what smells good, and what isn't. She knows how to take it all in and serves it all the time."

prakrit: "विजं सभेयभिन्नं,लिविसत्थं सद्दलक्खणं सयलं,गयतुरयलक्खणं चिय,गणियं छन्दं निमित्तं च"
english: "Wisdom is for all sorts of different things, poetry is for straight speech, eloquence is for speech, mathematics is for rhythm."

prakrit: "आलेक्खं लेप्पमयं,पत्तच्छेज्जं च भोयणविही य,बहुविहरयणविसेसं,कुसुमविसेसं सभेयजुयं"
english: "A painting is like a lotus, A leaf is cut from a leaf, A poem is written on it, A long journey goes by, A kiss is spoken of all the time."

prakrit: "विविहा य गन्धजुत्ती,लोयन्नाणं तहेव सविसेसं,एयासु य अन्नासु य,कलासु कन्ना समुबहइ"
english: "Various smells are poisonous, Knowledge is a panacea for all ills, Such things don't add up to anything, But art does."

prakrit: "दट्ट ण नरवरिन्दो,कन्नं नवजोवणं विचिन्तेइ,को से वरो णु सरिसो,पुहइयले होहिइ इमाए?"
english: "You fool, Don't you ever wonder how young men grow old? Whom do you think grow up to be wise?"

prakrit: "जो से मणस्स इट्ठो,तं गिण्हउ वा सयंवरा कन्ना,एव भणिऊण सहसा,नराहिवा मेलिया सबे"
english: "One who knows the mind, Count it or do not count it, says the wise man, Suddenly:" "The man who knows nothing is dead." ""

prakrit: "ते चिय तहिं समन्ता,दसरह-जणया तओ मिलेऊणं,अन्नोन्नमुणियनिहसा,दो वि तहिं चेव संपत्ता"
english: "That she loves you so much, That you meet her every day, That she admires you very much, Both for your wealth and your talents."

prakrit: "मञ्चेसु य उवविट्ठा,हरिवाहणमाइया नरवरिन्दा,सयलपरिवारसहिया,आहरणविभूसियसरीरा"
english: "The stage is empty, The roads are deserted, The men and women are dying, The whole household is in distress, The streets are deserted."

prakrit: "सा वि तहिं वरकन्ना,सवालंकारसुकयनेवच्छा,मङ्गलसओवगीया,रायसमुदं समोइण्णा"
english: "She's still the same bridegroom, Succeeding in asking questions, Reflecting on the auspicious festival, Not caring what the raisins say."

prakrit: "पासेसु चामराई,उवरिं छत्तं समोत्तिओऊलं,पुरओ य महातूरं,वज्जइ घणसरिसनिग्धोसं"
english: "Passer - by, Leaning on top of the roof, Standing in front of the God of Love, Long - eyed man, Speaking loudly and calmly."

prakrit: "लीलाऎ संचरन्ती,नियन्ति तं पत्थिवा अणिमिसच्छा,उम्माइया खणेणं,बहवे आयल्लयं पत्ता"
english: "Leela is a wanderer, She rules the path, She is inflexible, She knows how to dig, She follows the path wherever it leads."

prakrit: "मयहरयदाविए ते,सबे वि नराहिवे पलोएउं,बालाऎ कया माला,सिग्धं कण्ठे दसरहस्स"
english: "Dear god, Allay my fears. What garland is this on my ear? It must be Dussehra." ""

prakrit: "आलइयकण्ठमालं,दटु णं दसरहं जणो भणइ,रूवेण अणन्नसमो,नवरं तु अणायकुल-वंसो"
english: "Look at that garland of jewels, You silly goose - eyed person." "You stupid bastard, you fool!" ""

prakrit: "केइत्थ नरवरिन्दा,भणन्ति जोगो वरो सुलायण्णो,गहिओ कन्नाऎ इमो,पुवक्कम्माणुजोएणं"
english: "How stupid! They say a woman is cursed, They scold her for being ugly, They mock her for not being handsome."

prakrit: "अन्ने भणन्ति रुट्ठा,देसियपुरिसस्स अमुणियकुलस्स,एयस्स हरह कन्नं,सिग्धं चिय मा चिरावेह"
english: "Anna speaks rudely, Desiya purisus amuniaculus, Ayas harah kannam, Siddha chiye na chiraveh"

prakrit: "अह ते खणेण सबे,सन्नद्धे पेच्छिऊण नरवसभे,तो सुहमई नरिन्दो,वयणं जामाउयं भणइ"
english: "Oh! by looking at him all the time, By staring at him with such longing. So says the handsome Narindo, Speaking in unison." ""

prakrit: "जाव य सरेहि समरे,धाडेमि इमे अहं नरवरिन्दे,ताव य कन्नाऎ समं,पविससु नयरं रहारूढो"
english: "Go and fight, for I am a man of many talents. So be careful not to fall into the same trap As I did yesterday."

prakrit: "जं एव समालत्तो,भणइ तओ माम! किं विसण्णो सि?,थोवन्तरेण पेच्छसु,भज्जन्ते रणमुहे एए"
english: "Whatever you say, Ma'am! What are you talking about? You look at me from behind. I'm running away in a rage." ""

prakrit: "एव भणिऊण तो सो,सन्नद्धो रहवरं समारूढो,पग्गहकरावलग्गा,धुरासणे केगई तस्स"
