prakrit: "भणिओ य सहामज्झे,मन्तीणं सो अणेयबुद्धीणं,अज्जाहि समं बाला,पोयणनयरे मए दिट्ठा"
english: "Say what I have to say: He is clever, he is thoughtful, and I am as clever as ever. For my eyes are fixed on him."

prakrit: "सो एवभणियमेत्तो,सिग्धं चिय पोयणं गवेसेउं,पडियागओ नरिन्दं,भणइ य कन्ता ममं लहसु"
english: "So tell me," She muttered, Straightening her skirt to let me in. "" Please, my poor girl, tell me what kind of garlic you want? "" "

prakrit: "नरवइआणाऎ तओ,पुरुसेहि गलग्गहप्पहारेहिं,निद्धाडिओ पुराओ,भमइ महिं दुक्खिओ विमणो"
english: "Aunt, A flock of parrots hangs on to a man's neck, His tail feathers droop, And his tail feathers twine around his ears." ""

prakrit: "हिण्डन्तो च्चिय पुहई,साहुं दट्ठ ण अज्जगुत्तं सो,पणमइ कयञ्जलिउडो,सुणइ य धम्मं जिणुद्दिटुं"
english: "The hunter's son has reached his goal, His eyes are not shut, His business is carried on, His wife is busy making love, And I hear that dharma is winning."

prakrit: "सोऊण धम्मनिहसं,वइरागुप्पन्नजायसंवेगो,गेण्हइ सङ्गविमुक्कं,पवजं गुरुसयासम्मि"
english: "Praise be to her righteousness, Venerable Mother - in - law! Who is able to withstand adversity?"

prakrit: "गिम्हे आयावेन्तो,चिट्ठइ सिसिरे निसासु एगन्ते,वासारत्तं पि मुणी,गमइ सया पवयगुहत्थो"
english: "When the summer comes, She licks the lotuses, Sighs the sighs, Bees sigh even for a moment, Goes to her husband's house"

prakrit: "घोरं तवोविहाणं,बारसरूवं मुणी पकुवन्तो,सीया-''यवदुहिओ वि य,कन्तामोहं न छड्डइ"
english: "Fettered by the scorching heat, The sage grinds on for the rainy season -" "Even young couples, do not give in to temptation." ""

prakrit: "ताव'च्छउ संबन्धो,एसो अन्नं सुणेहि मगहवई!,अन्तरजोयनिबद्धा,ठिया कहा रयणमाल व"
english: "So what's the matter, you stupid bitch? This is the way you listen to food!," "Friend, tell me, Where is the rice paddy going to be planted?" ""

prakrit: "अणरण्णे रज्जत्थे,अह कुण्डलमण्डिओ महासुहडो,दुग्गमपुरटिओ सो,देसं सबं विणासेइ"
english: "Through barren ropes, O great warrior of the kundal mandi, So does the poor farmer. She weaves the whole country."

prakrit: "अणरण्णसन्तिए जे,सुहडे मारेइ ते बलुम्मत्तो,निद्दय-निराणुकम्पो,देसविणासं कुणइ सबं"
english: "One who does not repent, Makes a fool of oneself, Is intolerant of one's faults, Is indifferent to all else."

prakrit: "घेत्तूणमचायन्तो,अणरण्णो तं अवट्ठियं विसमे,रतिंदिया य निर्दे,न लहइ चिन्तापरिग्गहिओ"
english: "If you want to sleep, sit tight, Don't go out in the middle of the night, For there is nothing you can do About it."

prakrit: "दट्टण दुक्खियं तं,अणरणं तत्थ भणइ सामन्तो,नामेण बालचंदो,सामिय! वयणं निसामेहि"
english: "Dense is the affliction, Rough is the sound, Strong is the name given to the child's name: The moon is childish, Silly is speechless!"

prakrit: "जइ बन्धिऊण समरे,इह कुण्डलमण्डियं न आणेमि,तो एव निग्गओ हं,होहामि इमा पइन्ना मे"
english: "If I don't bring this kundal mandiram with me, I am bound to die. I will die in this pyre."

prakrit: "गन्तूण तेण तुरियं,सहसा चउरङ्गबलसमग्गेणं,वीसत्थओ पमाई,अह कुण्डलमण्डिओ बद्धो"
english: "A trumpet is blown by it, Suddenly the four strings join in unison, And on the twentieth day they join together: Ah, the bracelets of the horoscope."

prakrit: "विद्धंसेऊण पुरं,सिग्धं पडियागओ नियं ठाणं,दावेइ बालचन्दो,बद्धं सत्तु नरिन्दस्स"
english: "Purified by the Vindhya, Destroyed by Siddha, Restored by Niyama, Childish by Dawa Chanda, Constrained by Sattu Narindasa."

prakrit: "तो तेण सुभिच्चेणं,पुहई सत्था कया निरवसेसा,परितुट्ठो अणरण्णो,सम्माणं से तओ कुणइ"
english: "So think well of her, First tell her honestly, Then tell her how you're doing. Then, keeping her cool, She acts with restraint." ""

prakrit: "मुक्को य बन्धणाओ,अह कुण्डलमण्डिओ परिभमन्तो,दट्टण मुणिवरिन्दं,कयविणओ पुच्छए धम्मं"
english: "Fist or clenched fist, The kundal mandi is moving, The crowd is sighing, Some people are asking for dharma."

prakrit: "जो न कुणइ पवज,भयवं! गिहवासपासपडिबद्धो,सो किह संसाराओ,मुच्चिहिइ अणाइमन्ताओ?"
english: "One who does not act with courtesy Is afraid! One who is bound to one's anger Is condemned to silence; What is the use of keeping secret?"

prakrit: "तो भणइ मुणी धम्मो,जीवदया निग्गहो कसायाणं,एएसु चेव जीवो,मुच्चइ घणकम्मबन्धाओ"
english: "So the sage says,'Dharma, nigga, kasayana, is the medicine of the soul."

prakrit: "हिंसा पुण जीववहो,सो वि य मंसस्स कारणं हवइ,तुहमवि खायसि मंसं,कह बन्धविमोयणं कुणसि?"
english: "Violence alone is the cause of sin, For what cause is there for sin in your heart, You foolish man, Who am I to condemn?"

prakrit: "इह खाइऊण मंसं,जिब्भिन्दियवसगओ सरीरत्थो,मरिऊण वच्चइ नरो,तिबमहावेयणे नरए"
english: "It is the mind that eats, the body that breathes, the soul that dies, not the other way around."

prakrit: "ण्हाणेण मुण्डणेण य,दाणेणं विविहलिङ्गगहणेणं,मंसासिणस्स भणियं,नत्थि हु साहारणं किंचि"
english: "Giving is like shaving the head, Giving is Like weighing a bunch of pebbles, Saving is like bathing in the middle of the night: There is no help for it."

prakrit: "संसारत्था जीवा,आसि च्चिय बन्धवा परभवेसु,खायन्तएण मंसं,ते सबे भक्खिया नवरं"
english: "The soul is bound to the world, The relatives are bound to come and go, The mind is conditioned to eat; All who eat are beginners."

prakrit: "न य पायवेसु मंसं,उप्पज्जइ नेय धरणिषट्ठम्मि,वज्जेह सुक्क सोणिय-समुब्भवं पावसंबन्धं"
english: "There is no room for doubt, Not even in heaven, not on earth, Not on the horizon, Not now, my dear, For the whole earth is full of trouble."

prakrit: "जलयर-पक्खि-मिया वि य,हन्तुणं जीववल्लहे सत्ते,एएसु हवइ मंसं,दयावरा तं न भुञ्जन्ति"
english: "Though wet, Though ripe, Though devoid of life, Such is the nature of man, Those who have compassion For him will not forget."

prakrit: "धण्णेण वड्डियं चिय,महिसीखीरेण पोसियं देहं,तह वि य खायन्ति नरा,जणणीए अत्तणो मंसं"
english: "A rich man makes a rich man, A beekeeper makes a poor man, And yet he does not eat meat." That is the way of a wise man.

prakrit: "इह मन्दरहेट्टाओ,पुढवी रयणप्पभा मुणेयवा,तिसु भागेसु विहत्ता,असीयं जोयणा लक्खं"
english: "Here's Mandarhetta, you stubborn girl, Running away again and again, We have millions of young men."

prakrit: "तत्थेव भवणवासी,देवा निवसन्ति दोसु भागेसु,तइए पुण नेरइया,हवन्ति बहुवेयणा निययं"
english: "Then the forest dweller, The god lives, The two flee, You'll never see each other again, It's like many different destinies."

prakrit: "तत्तो य सक्करा वालुया य पङ्कप्पभा महापुढवी,धूमा तमा तमतमा,इमासु नरया महाघोरा"
english: "Tatho ya sakra valuya ya pankapabha mahapudhavi, dhuma tama tamata, imasu naraya mahaghora."

prakrit: "नरओ कुम्भीपाओ,वेयरणी कूडसामली हवइ,असिपत्तवणे एत्तो,तत्थेव खुरप्पधाराओ"
english: "The men are crooks, The bedsheets are bristling, The roads are slippery, And there are streams of mud."

prakrit: "दुग्गन्धा दुप्फरिसा,ससि-सूरविवज्जिया तमब्भहिया,एएसु पावकारी,नरएसु हवन्ति नेरइया"
english: "Dugandha is duplicitous, Sasi - Surabhijya is a tame traveler, Aesu is a poor walker, Neraiya is a nasty man"

prakrit: "जे एत्थ जीववहया,महु-मंस-सुराइलोलुया पावा,ते हु मुया परलोए,हवन्ति नरएसु नेरइया"
english: "Those who live here, Drunken with the pleasures of love and pleasure, Are like parrots dying in the wilderness, Turning their noses away."

prakrit: "केएत्थ धगधगन्ते,नरए डज्झन्ति जलियजालोहे,छिमिछिमिछिमन्तसद्दे,रुहिरवसावट्टणारूवे"
english: "Where are the flames of flame, The flames of a burning flame, Like the rays of a flicker in the sky, Standing in the shade of a rainbow?"

prakrit: "नासन्ति अग्गिभीया,सुतिक्खसूईसु विद्धचलणजुया,वेयरणिजलं दटुं,तिसाभिभूया अहिवडन्ति"
english: "There is no fire, The sleepy hussies are restless, The young men run about in circles, They stare at the swollen waters of the Goda, And their misfortune renders them useless."

prakrit: "कढकढकढेन्तफरिसं,विलोणतउ-तम्ब-सीसयसरिच्छं,वस-केस-पूय-सोणिय-मीसं खारोदयं दुरभि"
english: "Aunt, It's hard to bear. The lotus is twisted round and round, The flowers are white, The hair is gray, The mustache is scruffy."

prakrit: "चडचडचडं ति घेत्त',खण्डन्ति य वेढियं महीवट्टे,पाइज्जन्ति रडन्ता,पाणीयं नरयपालेहिं"
english: "The lightning bolt pierces through, The fence shatters, The bee stings, The hives break out, The crows moan, The water trembles." ""

prakrit: "खारोदयदद्धङ्गा,मयवेगेणं समुट्ठिया सन्ता,छायं अहिलसमाणा,असिपत्तवणं तओ जन्ति"
english: "The poor thing is dogged by anger, The traveler by delusion, The shady one by omission, The thirsty one by inactivity."

prakrit: "खणखणखणन्ति खग्गा,गाढं कणकणकणन्ति सत्तीओ,मडमडमडन्ति कोन्ता,ताण सरीरे निवडमाणा"
english: "They pore, they sigh, They groan, They twitch, They squirm, They swing, They sway."

prakrit: "कर-चरण-कण्ण-नासोट्ठ-फुप्फुसा छिन्नभिन्नसबङ्गा,लोलन्ति धरणिवट्टे,छिन्नभिन्नसबङ्गा,लोलन्ति धरणिवट्टे,मेय-वसा-रुहिरविच्छड्डा"
english: "Kar - charan - eyes - nostrils - lungs, shattered limbs, swaying girdles, shattered bracelets, slipping girdle, May - fat - hair - pallor."

prakrit: "खर-फरुसरज्जुबद्धा,सिग्धं आहिण्डिऊण विरडन्ता,आरुहणोरुहणाई,कारिज्जन्ते अकयपुण्णा"
english: "Straight - bowed, straight - faced, arrows pierced, long - eyed, and extremely skilful at what they do."

prakrit: "पीलिज्जन्ते जन्तेसु केइ कडकडकडेन्ति कावडिया,अवरे मुसुंढि-मोग्गर-चडकघाएसु ओसुद्धा"
english: "The crows of the yellow jauntesses pierce the wood shavings of the crows, They pierce through the thickets of the buffalo - mongoose - crows."

prakrit: "काएसु य गिद्धेसु य,अवरे चडचडचडायखद्धङ्गा,अणुहोन्ति वेयणाओ,चिट्ठइ नरयाउयं जाव"
english: "Because they are vultures, They hover above the thickets, They twine themselves around them, They lie motionless on the ground, And their feathers resemble those of a stag"

prakrit: "एयाणि य अन्नाणि य,दुक्खाणि निरन्तरं अणुहवन्ता,अच्छन्ति दीहकोलं,जेहि अधम्मो को पुर्वि"
english: "Aunt, The trouble keeps coming, It's only for a few days. Anyone can put an end to it."

prakrit: "एयं सोऊण तुमं,दुक्खं नरएसु मंससंभूयं,तम्हा वज्जेह इमं,मंसं दोसाण आमूलं"
english: "Here you are, sleeping, Destroying sorrow from the mind. Your wretchedness is bound up with this. For the mind is completely indifferent."

prakrit: "पुण मंसनिवित्तिं,कुणइ नरो सील-दाणरहिओ वि,सो चिय सोग्गइगमणं,पावइ नत्थेत्थ संदेहो"
english: "A good man is one who restores sanity, One who is careful not to give in to temptation, Is one who mourns; There is no room for doubt."

prakrit: "पञ्चाणुवयधारी,जो पुण तव-नियम-सीलसंपन्नो,जिणसासणाणुरत्तो,सो देवो होइ सुहनिलओ"
english: "A god who has five limbs, who is pure, who knows all existence, and who has all law and order, is a god of happiness."

prakrit: "हवइ अहिंसा मूलं,धम्मस्स जिणुत्तमेहि परिकहियं,सा पुण सुनिम्मलतरी,मंसनिवित्तीऎ संभवइ"
english: "Non - violence is the root of existence; dharma can be perfected only through renunciation; it is possible only through purity of mind."

prakrit: "जो वि य सबर-पुलिन्दो,चण्डालो वा दयावरो निययं,महु-मंसनिवित्तीए,सो पावविवज्जिओ होइ"
english: "Whatever the patience of a wise man, Whether it be in charity or in mercy or in judgment, Be it in separation from duty or pleasure."

prakrit: "पावेण वज्जियस्स य,देवत्तं हवइ अह नरिन्दत्तं,सम्मत्तलद्धबुद्धी,कमेण सिद्धिं पि पाविहिइ"
english: "Power is poison, Deity is love, and non - existence is bliss; the intellect is content, and even the perfection of karma is impermanent."

prakrit: "एयं साहुवएसं,सोऊणं कुण्डलो य दढसत्तो,पञ्चाणुवयसहिओ,जाओ महु-मंसविरओ य"
english: "Here is my brother - in - law's bed, Or the fire of heaven, Or five hundred nines. Go, bee - There is no man left."

prakrit: "जाओ अणन्नदिट्ठी,साहू नमिऊण निग्गओ तत्तो,परिचिन्तिऊण वच्चइ,अस्थि महं माउलो नियओ"
english: "Go and hide, you fool, If you dare touch me you'll be destroyed. If you want to be known, go and steal my bones."

prakrit: "तस्स पसाएण अहं,सत्तु जिणिऊण सभरमज्झम्मि,निययपुरे बलसहिओ,पुणरवि रजं करीहामि"
english: "I will prevail over him, I will triumph over all odds, Always be strong, And I will reign again."

prakrit: "चिन्तेऊण पयट्टो,एगागी दक्खिणावहं तुरिओ,पन्थपरिस्समदुहिओ,मरणावत्थो तओ जाओ"
english: "If you think about it, You'd better leave now. I'll go looking for you On the other side of the fence. Death awaits you."

prakrit: "जम्मि समए विमुञ्चइ,जीवं इह कुण्डलो तहिं अन्ना,सग्गाउ चुया देवी,अवसाणे आउखन्धस्स"
english: "Mother - in - law! Wherever you go, Life goes on in your womb, There is plenty for you to do."

prakrit: "जणयस्स महिलियाए,गब्भे सम्मुच्छिया विदेहाए,जीवा कम्मवसेणं,दोण्णि वि एकोयरम्मि ठिया"
english: "Young women, Facing each other from behind, Living in harmony, Both standing in unison."

prakrit: "एयन्तरम्मि साहू,कालं काऊण पिङ्गलो सग्गे,जाओ सुरो महप्पा,सुमरइ अन्नं तओ जम्मं"
english: "Here comes the poor fellow, Time is fleeting, The plowman is busy making love, The summer is almost over, And so is the evening meal."

prakrit: "अवहिविसएण मुणिउं,जणयस्स वरङ्गणाऎ गब्भम्मि,उववन्नो मह सत्त,समयं अन्नेण जीवेणं"
english: "Take a bath in the God of Love, Sit on the verandah of your wife's husband's lap, Saying:" "I have power." "Time, my dear, is of the essence of life."

prakrit: "सरिऊण विरहदुक्खं,सेणिय! पुवाणुबन्धजोएण,वेरपडिवञ्चणट्टे,तं गब्भं रक्खई देवो"
english: "Separation is painful for the warrior, For God will protect his pride, Like the victory of a husband against a vicious enemy."

prakrit: "नाऊण एवमेयं,दुक्खं चिय न य परस्स कायवं,मा पुणरवि अहिययरं,पाविहह परम्परं दुक्खं"
english: "A new name is thus coined; sorrow is not something to be wished for, nor is it something that one can do for another. For sin is a painful tradition."

prakrit: "अह सा सुहं पसूया,दुहिया पुत्तं च तत्थ वइदेही,पुवभवबद्धवरो,हरइ सुरो बालयं सिग्धं"
english: "Oh! she is a happy woman, With two beautiful sons And her husband at hand. The flowers are blooming, But the young girl's tune is straightforward."

prakrit: "चिन्तेइ तो मणेणं,एयं दढकक्खडे सिलावट्टे,अप्फोडेमि रसन्तं,अह कुण्डलमण्डियं सत्तु"
english: "If you think about it, It's like a seal on a thicket, Like the juice of an apodeme. Yes, the Kundal Mandya is pure."

prakrit: "वक्कलपत्तनियच्छा,मणिमयकडिसुत्तयाभरणदेहा,धाऊकयङ्गरागा,विरइयसिरिमञ्जरीकुसुमा"
english: "Vakalapatna niyaccha, manimayakadasa, bharana deha, dhaukayangaraga, vireyasirimanjarikusuma"

prakrit: "एवंविहेहि समयं,जोहेहिं आयरङ्गनरवसहो,अह लक्खणस्स पुरओ,उवट्ठिओ दंप्पियामरिसो"
english: "Such is the time, O God of Love, As long as there is shade in the sky, For there to be tears in your eyes."

prakrit: "गय-वसह-सोहचिन्धा,सर-सत्ति-करालकोन्तगहियकरा,जुज्झन्ति मेच्छसुहडा,खोहन्ता अज्जवबलोहं"
english: "Go - sit - enjoy - The hunter's deer, The stag - crows, The woodpecker - hunter, The buffalo - elephant, The elephant - buffalo, And the elephant - hare."

prakrit: "अह लक्खणस्स चावं,दुहाकयं आयरङ्गनरवइणा,जाव य गेण्हइ खग्गं,ताव य विरहो कओ सिग्धं"
english: "Oh! what a waste of time! It's the fire of adversity, The fire of jealousy, Or the burning of jasmine. So what is the use of parting?"

prakrit: "दट्टण लक्खणं सो,विरहं सयमेव उट्ठिओ रामो,सर-सत्ति-चक्क -मोग्गर-सएसु सेन्नं विवायन्तो"
english: "That is the characteristic of a thicket. Separation must always follow, Ramo. Sir - Satti - Chakka - Moggar - The whole forest is strewn with bees."

prakrit: "रामेण आयरङ्गो,गरुयपहाराहओ कओ विमुहो,नस्सइ विभग्गमाणो,दस वि दिसाओ पलोयन्तो"
english: "Rama is like a banner, Strong and powerful; He bewails anyone who touches Him; He knows no division; He runs in ten directions."

prakrit: "हय-विहय-विप्परद्धं,सेन्नं काऊण राहवो समरे,मग्गं अमुञ्चमाणो,नियत्तिओ लक्खणेण तओ"
english: "Yes - Vihaya - Vipparadha, Senna kauna rahava samraya, Marga amunchamana, Destiny is to be characterized as such."

prakrit: "जाओ य महाणन्दो,पुहई आवासिया भयविमुक्का,वीसजिओ य रामो,लद्धजसो पत्थिओ नयरिं"
english: "" "Go, you great man; The inhabitants of the town are afraid and trembling; But let us go, O Rama; The paths are slippery even for the warriors."

prakrit: "तं पुरिसयारनिहसं,दट्टण नराहिवेण तुठेणं,रामस्स निययधूया,जणएण निरूविया सीया"
english: "That man's penance, To be torn to shreds by a fierce man, Is the destiny of the Ramas, Like being deprived of one's life."

prakrit: "एवं मणुस्सो सुकएण पुर्व,जयं रणे पाबइ वीरसत्तो,विक्खायकित्ती भुवणे पसिद्धो,ससि व रामो विमलप्पभावो"
english: "And before man is dried up, The brave are victorious in the forest, The wise traveler triumphs on the earth; Like a sapling Rama is bound to wither."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए मेच्छपराजयकित्तणो नाम सत्तावीसइमो उद्देसओ समत्तो"
english: "Aunt, The name of the man who defeated the buffalo Is Samatho, after all, twenty-seven."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाई,पुहइ भमन्तेण नारएण सुया,रामस्स पवररूवा,जणएण निरूविया सीया"
english: "Oh! what a strange thing it is To lie in wait for your lover, To groan for the arrival of the Ramas, To make one feel empty."

prakrit: "ताहे नहङ्गणेणं,उप्पइउं नारओ गओ मिहिलं,कन्नालोयणहियओ,सीयाभवणं समल्लीणो"
english: "There you are, bathing, Stirring the fire, Drunken women, Trying to conceal their feelings."

prakrit: "दट्ठ ण पविसरन्तं,दीहजडामउडभासुरं सहसा,भयविहलवेविरङ्गो,सीया भवणोयरं लीणा"
english: "Don't look around. It's dark outside. Suddenly there are loud noises. Look around. There's a lot of smoke rising from the fire."

prakrit: "अणुमग्गेण रियन्तो,रुद्धो नारीहिं दारवालीहिं,कलहन्तो ताहि समं,गहिओ सो रायपुरिसेहिं"
english: "When a man is angry, A woman is bitter, When a door is shut The quarrel is just the same."

prakrit: "जाव य भणन्ति पुरिसा,को एसो? हणह मुट्ठिपहरेहिं,ताव भउबिग्गमणो,उप्पइडं नारओ नट्ठो"
english: "You mean to tell me," "Who's here?" "With a clenched fist He shook his head."

prakrit: "कहलासपचओवरि,आसत्थो चिन्तिऊण आढत्तो,अह तं पोढकुमारी,वसणसमुद्दे निवाडेमि"
english: "When I think of you, dear girl, I will leave you to your own devices."

prakrit: "परिचिन्तिऊण एवं,सिग्धं रहणेउरं गओ नयरं,ताहे उज्जाणहरे,सीयारूवं पडे लिहइ"
english: "Get to know each other, stay straightforward, go to bed, get up early, and write as you go."

prakrit: "ताव चिय चन्दगई,समयं भामण्डलेण नयराओ,अह निग्गओ महप्पा,कीलणहेउं तमुज्जाणं"
english: "The moon is dark, Time is fleeting, Travelers don't go out in the open, It's too big for you, King of spades."

prakrit: "तत्थेव काणणहरे,कन्नारूवं पडे समालिहियं,दट्टण तं विसण्णो,सहसा भामण्डलकुमारो"
english: "At that moment his ears fell, Like tears streaming down his cheeks. Suddenly the farmer's son appeared." ""

prakrit: "मुञ्चइ दीहुस्सासे,सोयइ पलवइ य अन्नमन्नाइं,रत्ति दिया य निई,न लहइ चिन्तापरिग्गहिओ"
english: "If you want to sleep, sleep, eat, drink, or make love - don't worry about it."

prakrit: "सुसुयन्धगन्धमल्लाइयाइँ,आहार-मज्जणविहीओ,नेच्छइ अणन्नहियओ,परिहायइ अङ्गमङ्गेसु"
english: "Aroma pleasant to the touch, Aromatic to the taste, Nauseating to the eye, Exhausting to the limbs."

prakrit: "नाऊण तं कुमारं,मयणावत्थं तु नारओ ताहे,अह देइ दरिसणं चिय,वीसत्थो तस्स गन्तूणं"
english: "Now you are a boy, Now you make noise While I am with you, Then I will show you the way."

prakrit: "भामण्डलेण दिट्ठो,तुरियं अब्भुट्ठिओ पणमिऊणं,दिन्नासणोवविठ्ठो,भणिओ य मुणी! निसामेहि"
english: "Look at her breasts, Foolish girl, Pay attention to what's going on, Stop wasting your time thinking:" "No, you fool!" ""

prakrit: "केण वि उज्जाणहरे,आलिहिया बालिया मणभिरामा,जइ जाणसि भूयत),साहसु कस्सेरिसा धूया?"
english: "Who is brighter, my darling, If you know ghosts? But who is braver?" ""

prakrit: "जं एव पुच्छिओ सो,भणइ तओ नारओ पसंसन्तो,अस्थि मिहिलाऎ राया,जणओ सो इन्दकेउसुओ"
english: "Whatever you ask me, I will tell you," he said, shaking his head. "That's just the way things happen."

prakrit: "तस्स महिला विदेहा,तीए दुहिया इमा पवरकन्ना,जोबणगुणाणुरूवा,सीया नामेण विक्खाया"
english: "That woman is a stranger; She is so distressed by his absence That she makes him cry out with her sharp arrows."

prakrit: "अहवा किं परितुट्ठो,पडिरूवं पेच्छिऊण आलेक्खे?,जे तीऎ विब्भमगुणा,ते च्चिय को वण्णिउं तरइ?"
english: "Ahava, what are you doing, staring at your lover? Who is it that tells you what to do, That girl so brilliantly?"

prakrit: "एवं कहिऊण गओ,जहिच्छियं नारओ अइतुरन्तो,भामण्डलो वि दियहा,वम्महसरसल्लिओ गमइ"
english: "And let me tell you, as soon as the fire dies down, The whole village disappears." ""

prakrit: "जइ तं कन्नारयणं,न लहामि कईवएहि दिवसेहिं,तो न य जीवामि फुडं,मयणभुयङ्गेण दट्टो हं"
english: "If I cannot play it, If it takes many days, I don't want to live. I give in to jealousy."

prakrit: "सीयारूवविणडियं,पुत्तं नाऊण तत्थ चन्दगई,भामण्डलस्स पासं,समयं कन्ताऎ संपत्तो"
english: "The moon is bright, My son, There is no moonlight anywhere. Time is of the essence, So is wealth."

prakrit: "भणइ तओ चन्दगई,पुत्तय! मा एव दुक्खिओ होहि,कन्ना वरेमि गन्तुं,जा तुज्झ अवट्ठिया दियए"
english: "You fool, My son! Don't be so sorrowful. I'm going to tell you otherwise. Let me give you a rest." ""

prakrit: "संथाविऊण पुतं,चन्दगई,भणइ अत्तणो महिलं,विज्जाहर-मणुयाणं,कह संबन्धो इमो होइ"
english: "The son of a saint, The moon is red, The land is barren, And the women are foolish." "What do you think about men and women?" ""

prakrit: "भूमीगोयरनिलयं,अम्हं न हि जुज्जए तहि गन्तुं,अहवा तेण न दिन्ना,का वयणसिरी तया अम्हं?"
english: "The land is barren, We have not fought a war, Nor will we give in to it, So why am I a barber?"

prakrit: "तम्हा अकालहीणं,कंचि उवायं करेमि भद्दे! हं,कन्नाऎ तीऎ पियरं,एत्थेव ठिओ समाणेमि"
english: "" "You're spotless! How am I supposed to explain it to you?" "Yes, my dear." "Here I am, keeping it to myself."

prakrit: "चवलगइनामधेयं,सद्दावेऊण तस्स एयन्ते,सबं कहेइ राया,भामण्डलदुक्खमाईयं"
english: "The clever call her by name, The clever tell her everything, The wicked lament, The miser's grief."

prakrit: "सामियआणाए लहुं,मिहिलानयरिं गओ चवलवेगो,काऊण आसरूवं,वित्तासन्तो भमइ लोयं"
english: "A flock of parrots, Flying from hill to hill, Moving on foot, Like a flock of geese, Is hovering over the horizon."

prakrit: "दट्टण नरवरिन्दो,आसं उद्दामयं नयरमज्झे,तो भणइ गेण्हह इमं अदिट्टपुवं महातुरयं"
english: "When a man is angry, When he has no cause to be angry, Says he will not complain, It is the doing of a great man That makes him angry."

prakrit: "नरवइवयणेण तओ,गहिओ पुरिसेहि पम्गहकरेहिं,ठविओ य मन्दुराए,कुंकुमचच्चिकछुरियङ्गो"
english: "Because you are a man, Take pride in your husband's name, Make him proud with your bracelets, And stop him with your garland of saffron."

prakrit: "सो तत्थ मासमेगं,अवडिओ ताव तुरियवेगेणं,संपत्तो भणइ निवं,गयवरपयवासिओ एक्को"
english: "There it is, The waning moon, There the lightning flashes, Wealth begets wealth, And the lonely traveler is all one."

prakrit: "सामिय! सुणेहि दिट्ठो,हत्थी एरावणो व रणम्मि,थोवन्तरेण पेच्छह,तं घेप्पन्तं कढिणदप्पं"
english: "Samia! Listen! Your eyes are red, your hands are swollen, You look down the road for a moment, Then suddenly there's a cloud of smoke rising above you." ""

prakrit: "सो एव भणियमेत्तो,विणिग्गओ नरवई गयारूढो,पत्तो य तं पएसं,पेच्छइ वरवारणं मत्तं"
english: "That's what I meant when I said:" "The hunter has turned his back on me," "And then he turns his head aside."

prakrit: "दटू ण सरसि दुग्गे,हत्थी तो नरवई भणइ सिग्धं,आणेह किंचि तुरयं,बलपरिहत्थं विलम्गामि"
english: "You mustn't be angry, you must be angry. But if you are, You must say straightforwardly :'I'm going to be late for something."

prakrit: "ताव च्चिय सो तुरओ,उवणीओ कढिणदप्पमाहप्पो,मोत्तूण कुञ्जरवरं,तत्था''रूढो नरवरिन्दो"
english: "There it is, The trumpet is blowing, The eaves are shaking, The kunjaravarams are crashing, And so on." ""

prakrit: "आरूढस्स य तुरओ,उप्पइओ नहयलं चवलवेगो,हाहारवं महल्लं,काऊण भडा गया सपुरं"
english: "Behold, the trumpet is blown, The river is swollen, The chawl is swaying, The air is stormy, The crow has gone astray"

prakrit: "तत्तो अणेयदेसा,वोलेऊणं जिणालयासन्ने,पायवसाहाऎ लहुं,आलग्गो नरवई धणियं"
english: "There you are, my poor girl, Moving from village to village, Traveling on foot, Always a man's weapon."

prakrit: "सो तस्स तरुवराओ,ओइण्णो कञ्चणामयं तुङ्ग,पेच्छइ वरपासायं,उन्भासन्तं दस दिसाओ"
english: "So tell me, you naughty girl, What do you think? You look at me in all directions, You turn your face away." ""

prakrit: "आयड्डिऊण खग्गं,विगयभओ गोउरं समल्लीणो,अह पेच्छइ तत्थ पुणो,वावी उज्जाणमज्झम्मि"
english: "Foolish cow, You'll have to go elsewhere. I can see you there again. It's as though there were a fire in the fireplace."

prakrit: "दिटुं जिणिन्दभवणं,नाणाविहमणिमऊहपज्जलियं,इन्दस्स वासगेहं,नज्जइ सग्गाउ अवइण्णं"
english: "A glance at a lifeless building, A coin tossed around, A lamp flashed by, The indus in a trance, Or else the heavenly body is empty."

prakrit: "अब्भन्तरं पविट्ठो,पेच्छइ सीहासणट्ठियं पडिमं,आइगरस्स भगवओ,दीहजडामउडकयसोहं"
english: "After all, holiness prevails, I see what's left of my husband's heart. Dear God, It's only a matter of days." ""

prakrit: "रइऊण अञ्जलिउडं,सहसा ओमुच्छिओ समासत्थो,भावेण पययमणसो,करेइ थुइमङ्गलविहाणं"
english: "Stop being angry, Anjali, Suddenly you start to moan, Feel like giving in to passion, And suddenly you're completely at a loss."

prakrit: "काऊण य किइकम्म,उवविट्ठो तत्थ विम्हिओ जणओ,मोत्तूण आसरूवं,चवलगई वि य गओ सपुरं"
english: "Who cares what you do, There it is, Like a pearl on the pyre, Stealthily passed through the whole wall."

prakrit: "नमिऊण सामिचलणे,पत्तो साहेइ अवहियं जणयं,उज्जाणमज्झयारे,ठवियं चिय जिणहरासन्ने"
english: "Without a trace of trembling, Without leaving a trace, In the middle of the night, Wherever you are, There is hope for your life."

prakrit: "सोऊण आगयं सो,जणयं विज्जाहराहिवो तुह्रो,घेत्तूण महापूयं,तं जिणभवणं गओ सिग्धं"
english: "If he comes, you will see him; If he goes, he will go. If he touches you with great difficulty It is as if he had won the victory."

prakrit: "दिवविमाणारूढो,दिट्ठो जणएण सुहडपरिकिण्णो,मुणिओ य कओ एसो,इहागओ खेयराहिवई?"
english: "Like the rays of a sunbeam, Like the pleasure of seeing one's lover, Who is this to beguile?"

prakrit: "अमुणियचित्तसहावो,जणओ सीहासणन्तरनिलुक्को,जावच्छइ ताव चिय,चन्दगईणं कया पूया"
english: "Silly girl, You're the only one with a smile on your face. So why am I laughing? It's the moon. What is the use of moonlight?"

prakrit: "थुइमङ्गलं च विहिणा,काऊणं तत्थ बारसावत्तं,अह गाइउं पवत्तो,जिणगुण वीणा य घेत्तूणं"
english: "Thuimangal and vihina, Kaun tha barasavatam, Ah, the song of the wind, The virtue of which is to pick up the lute."

prakrit: "जो तियसाहिवेहि एहविओ गिरिमत्थए,किन्नर-सिद्ध-जक्खकयमङ्गलसदए,जम्म-जरा-विओग-घणकम्मविणासए,पणमह आयरेण सययं उसभजिणिन्दए"
english: "Those who are sober Now lie low on the pyre, The eunuchs are accomplished, The jars of jasmine Are resplendent, The thickets are fragrant, The banks of the Goda are thick with nectar, And the arrows of the lotus Kindle the fire of desire."

prakrit: "तुहं सयंभू भयवं! चउम्मुहो,पियामहो विण्हु जिणो तिलोयणो,अणन्तसोक्खामलदेहधारिणो,सयंपबुद्धो वरधम्मदेसओ"
english: "You cowardly coward! O mother - in - law! Lovely weaver, Jealous draughtsman, Constant seeker of happiness, Strong-willed warrior." ""

prakrit: "सुर-नर-ससि-रविमहियं,बहुविहगुणसयवरसिरिनिलयं,अणुवमअचलियसिवसुहफलयं,जिणवरसुचरिय तुह मम सरणं"
english: "Love, man, plant, sweetwood tree, Multifaceted virtuous tree, Everlasting fruit, Lifelong happiness: To you belongs the crown of glory."

prakrit: "पणमह जियमच्छर-राग-भयं,भय-दोग्गइमग्गपणासयरं"
english: "Love based on greed, Anger based on fear, Fear based on cowardice."

prakrit: "करणुज्जयधम्मपहस्स गुरुं,गुरुकम्ममहोयहिसोसणयं"
english: "Action begets dharma, love begets guru, karma begets violence."

prakrit: "एवं गायन्तस्स य,सीहासणअन्तराउ निष्फिडिओ,जणओ चन्दगईणं,दिट्ठो य तओ समालत्तो"
english: "And you who sing, Destroy yourself inside your chair, You who sing the moonlight, If you look at it You will see it all."

prakrit: "अवरे भणन्ति एसा,केण वि माया कया अउण्णेणं,ठविया य मरणहेउं,बहुयाणं नरवरिन्दाणं"
english: "They say,'How can anyone love me when I am still alive?'Or,'I will die,'Or'Too many men make love '." ""

prakrit: "ताव य चलन्तकुण्डल-मउडा-'लंकारभूसियसरीरो,पउमो गयवरगामी,अल्लीणो धणुवरन्तेणं"
english: "There goes the go - between - The cowherd bends over -" "Your hair is brown, Your thighs are pallid, You won't make it dry." ""

prakrit: "अह ते महाभुयङ्गा,निययसहावट्ठिया परमसोमा,धणुयं पि विगयजालं,गहियं रामेण सहस त्ति"
english: "Ah! the great fire of love, The supreme love, Which is bound to bear witness, Is a web of deceit Even to the God of Love."

prakrit: "ठविऊण लोहपीढे,सजीवं धणुवरं कयं सिग्छ,ताव चिय संजायं,रय-रेणुसमोत्थयं गयणं"
english: "Anger is the poison of love, What do you seek after in a violent man, If you want to escape from anger, You must first learn to make love, And then sing along."

prakrit: "आकम्पिया य सेला,विवरीयं चिय वहन्ति सरियाओ,उक्का-तडिच्छडालं,विदुमवण्णं दिसायकं"
english: "Like a shipwreck, Like a column of smoke rising from the rafters, Like an expanse of mud scattered on the horizon."

prakrit: "सबत्तो घोररवा,चण्डा निवडन्ति तत्थ निग्घाया,सूरो पणट्ठतेओ,जाओ य जणो भउविग्गो"
english: "The whole of it is thundering, The moon is choosing Where to set it, The sun is setting, And so is the traveler." ""

prakrit: "एयारिसम्मि जाए,पलयावत्ते जए धणुवरं तं,विलएइ पउमनाहो,सबनरिन्दाण पञ्चक्खं"
english: "Aunt, The poor man is as poor as the girl who ran away, And the poor girl is only as poor As the farmer's son."

prakrit: "एयन्तरम्मि गयणे,देवा मुञ्चन्ति कुसुमवरवासं,साहु त्ति जंपमाणा,जयसदुग्घुट्टतूररवा"
english: "Here comes the singing girl, The gods desire a stay for a while, The hunter vows:" "Long live the tiger!" ""

prakrit: "रामेण धणुवरं तं,गाढं अप्फालियं सदप्पेणं,जह बरहिणेहि घुटुं,नवपाउसमेहसङ्काए"
english: "Rama embraces the brazen bull, The bull is large, The buffalo is heavy, The ox is kneeling, The elephant is scared of the new bull."

prakrit: "खुहिओ व सायरवरो,सो जणनिवहो कमेण आसत्थो,ताव चिय पसयच्छी,सीया रामं पलोएइ"
english: "Be nice to each other, be affectionate, be faithful to one's feelings, be kind to one another, and follow the right path."

prakrit: "उल्लसियरोमकूवा,सिणेहसंबन्धजणियपरिओसा,लीलाऎ संचरन्ती,रामस्स अवट्ठिया पासे"
english: "Lovely girl, The passion of love, Running around in circles, Rama standing by her side." ""

prakrit: "ऊयारिऊण धणुयं,पउमो निययासणे सुहनिविठ्ठो,सीयाऎ समं रेहइ,रइसाहीणो अणङ्गो व"
english: "Take rest, my darling, May your husband rest in peace, May his mind be with you, May he never taste anger again."

prakrit: "तं लक्खणेण धणुयं,घेत्तूणं वलइयं सहरिसेणं,आयड्डियं सदप्पं,पखुभियसमुनिग्योसं"
english: "That is the characteristic of a wealthy man, That of an army of townsmen round about., That is, of good men., The headman's son is pious."

prakrit: "दटू ण विक्कमं ते,सबे विज्जाहरा भउबिग्गा,देन्ति गुणसालिणीओ,अट्ठारस पवरकन्नाओ"
english: "They are not wicked, They are all wise and learned, They bestow virtuous qualities On men of letters, They command authority."

prakrit: "विज्जाहरेहि सिग्धं,गन्तूणं चकवालवरनयरं,वित्तन्ते परिकहिए,चन्दगई दुम्मणो जाओ"
english: "A straight line through the sky, Destroyed by the waves of the moon, Travels in midair, Goes dark as the moon"

prakrit: "आलोइऊण भरहो,रामं दढसत्ति-कन्तिपडिपुण्णं,अह सोइउं पयत्तो,तक्खणमेत्तेण पडिबुद्धो"
english: "Filled with ecstasy, Rama stares in agony, But when he falls asleep, He is bound by a tight embrace."

prakrit: "गोत्तं पिया य एक्को,एयस्स ममं पि दोण्ह वि जणाणं,नवरं अब्भुयकम्मो,रामो परलोयसुकएणं"
english: "Both mother and son are familiar to me, My husband is new, I have a lover who loves me no longer."

prakrit: "पउमदलसरिसनयणा,पउममुही पउमगब्भसंकासा,पउमस्स इमा भज्जा,जाया निययाणुभावेणं"
english: "Proud lady, Every woman dreams of her husband's return, Every man dreams of his future. It's my fault he's late, No one cares."

prakrit: "सबकला-''गमकुसला,विमणं नाऊण केगई पुत्तं,दइयस्स साहइ फुडं,भरहकुमारस्स सब्भावं"
english: "All kala -" "Gamakusa," "Vimana's name is Kegai putra, Compassion's help is given to food, The nature of the son of Bharaha"

prakrit: "भरहस्स मए सामिय!,मुणियं सोगाउरं मणं गाढं,तह तं करेहि सिग्धं,जह निबेयं न य उवेइ"
english: "Have faith, Samia!," "My poor man, My sorrowful heart is thick, So make it straight, That it may not boil over Unless it is quenched." ""

prakrit: "अस्थि जणयस्स भाया,कणओ नामेण एत्थ मिहिलाए,जाया य सुप्पभाए,तेण सुभद्दा पवरकन्ना"
english: "The bone grows old, The particle gets mixed up here and there, And when it sleeps It purifies itself."

prakrit: "सिग्धं सयंवरा सा,घोसाविजउ नरिन्दमज्झम्मि,जाव न गच्छइ भरहो,अजं चिय परमनिवेयं"
english: "Simply tell me, my poor girl, Don't go walking in the middle of the night. I'm still counting on you."

prakrit: "भणिऊण एवमेयं,सा वत्ता दसरहेण कणयस्स,कहिया य निरवसेसा,तेण वि य पडिच्छिया आणा"
english: "Tell me, is this the way? It's just another day of trouble, Sometimes unbearably long, And then it all goes to waste."

prakrit: "कणएण तत्थ तुरियं,सवे वि नराहिवा समाहूया,जे वि य गया निवेसं,ते वि तहिं चेवमल्लीणा"
english: "Because there you are, All hell is brewing. Whatever you invest in me Will also be spent there."

prakrit: "उवविढेसु कमेणं,कणयसुया तत्थ आगया कन्ना,परिहरिऊण नरिन्दे,वरेइ भरहं सुभद्दा सा"
english: "Look! There's plenty to do, The fire there is hot, The hearth there is dry, The streets are deserted, I've got plenty to eat And the streets are empty."

prakrit: "अच्चन्तविसमभावं,सेणिय! पेच्छसु खलाण कम्माणं,पडिबुद्धो चिय भरहो,भज्जाऎ विमोहिओ पच्छा"
english: "Disgusting! You fool, You fool! I can see the fire burning brightly, But the fire has already been kindled." ""

prakrit: "जंपन्ति एकमेकं,विलक्खवयणा नराहिवा सके,जा जस्स पुबविहिया,भज्जा सा तस्स उवणमइ"
english: "Jealousy can prevent one from being generous, But what is agreeable to one's neighbor, That one must yield to him."

prakrit: "रामेण तओ सीया,परिणीया संपयाऎ परमाए,भरहेण वि कणयसुया,तेणेव निओगकरणेणं"
english: "For Rama, love is eternal, For Parinaya is supreme, For a husband is supreme Even when his wife is absent, For her part, marriage is immutable."

prakrit: "सके काऊण तहिं,वीवाहमहुस्सवं नरवरिन्दा,निययपुराणि कमेणं,संपत्ता साहणसमग्गा"
english: "How old is she, Like a man in love with a widow's mistress, Destroyed by fate And unable to bear wealth?"

prakrit: "दसरहस्स सुया बलदप्पिया,नववहूहि समं जणसेविया,पविसरन्ति कमेण सुकोसलं,विमलकित्तिधरा पुरिसोत्तमा"
english: "The midday sun is red hot, The bridegroom is as busy as the bride, The lotus is dripping red As soon as it blooms, And the lotus petals are like a purification lotus."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए रामलक्ख गधणुरयणलाभविहाणो नाम अट्ठावीसइमो उद्देसओ समत्तो"
english: "This is the name of the twenty-eighth day of the month when I shall celebrate the auspicious festival of Ramlakha." ""

prakrit: "एत्तो च्चिय आसाढे,राया धवलट्ठमीऎ भूईए,जिणचेइयाण महिमं,काऊण तओ समाढत्तो"
english: "Here's how it goes: The earth trembles with excitement, The sky glitters of victory, And who can stop you?"

prakrit: "सम्मजिओवलित्ता,जिणहरभूमी करन्ति केएत्थ,रङ्गावलीनिओगं,चुण्णेणं पञ्चवण्णेणं"
english: "Love triumphs, Where does the wasteland come from, A riot of colours, The picking of the five ornaments."

prakrit: "केई पुण वरकुसुमे,गहिऊणं तोरणेसु मालाओ,विरयन्ति य भत्तीओ,विचित्तधाऊरसेणं तु"
english: "Come on, you fool, Take care not to break the garland That hangs on your neck. You fool, You foolish warrior."

prakrit: "सबम्मि सुपडिउत्ते,सुयसहिओ नरवई जिणिन्दाणं,ण्हवणं करेइ विहिणा,पडुपडह-मुइङ्गसद्दालं"
english: "Everything is smooth sailing, Suicide helps the man to conquer, Destroying the woman to conceal her naked body - The plow - mooing festival."

prakrit: "दिवसाणि अट्ठ राया,पोसहिओ जिणवराण वरपूयं,काऊण भत्तिमन्तो,संथुणइ परेण विणएणं"
english: "The days are eight nights, The weeks are long, The months are fleeting, And the nights are long. One cannot help but weep."

prakrit: "तं ण्हवणसन्तिसलिलं,नरवइणा पेसियं सभज्जाणं,तरुणविलयाहि नेउं,छूटं चिय उत्तमङ्गेसु"
english: "She has a fresh set of pupils, She is full of energy, She knows everything, She loves young people, She has good friends who are free."

prakrit: "कञ्चुइहत्थावगयं,जाव य गन्धोदयं चिरावेइ,ताव य वरग्गमहिसी,पत्ता कोवं च सोयं च"
english: "A stinging acacia, Like the fragrance of jasmine, Lasts for a long time. So does the fragrant nectar of the raptor."

prakrit: "चिन्तेऊण पयत्ता,एयाओ नरवईण महिलाओ,सम्माणियाउ न य हं,एत्तो जिणसन्तिसलिलेणं"
english: "Think about it, you silly girl, Don't be so disrespectful. It's only to satisfy your feelings." ""

prakrit: "दइयस्स को व दोसो?,पुवं न उवज्जियं मए सुकयं,तेणं चिय पम्हुट्ठा,जुवईणं मज्झयारम्मि"
english: "Who's to blame?," "The flower did not budge." "I am quite at ease with her. She is completely at ease With me, Like a young bridegroom At midday"

prakrit: "अवमाणनलणदड्ढे,एयं मे पावपूरियं हिययं,मरणेण उवसमिज्जइ,कत्तो पुण अन्नभेएणं?"
english: "A man of dishonor, I am full of faults, He is exhausted by death; Where else can I find food?"

prakrit: "भण्डारियं विसाह,सद्दावेऊण भणइ ससिवयणा,एयं न कस्स वि तुमे,संपइ वत्थु कहेयवं"
english: "Bhandary is a waste, Sadaveena says sasivayana, There is no one to tell you this, Only talk." ""

prakrit: "अन्भिन्तरं पविट्ठा,मरणे उच्छाहनिच्छियमईया,कण्ठकरगहियवस्था,ताव च्चिय नरवई पत्तो"
english: "Purity prevails everywhere, Death is in short supply, The throat is slit, And so is the malevolent leaf."

prakrit: "पेसजणस्स नरिन्दो,सदं निसुणेइ तत्थ अइकलुणं,हा देवि! किमारद्धं,जीयन्तयरं इमं कम्मं?"
english: "Dear Narindo, There must be something very wrong with you, my dear! How can I help it If I live up to it?"

prakrit: "घेत्तण पत्थिवेणं,निययङ्कनिवेसिया समालत्ता,कीस अकज्जे सुन्दरि!,मरणुच्छाहा तुमं जाया?"
english: "You stupid girl, Why are you standing here staring at me? You're not supposed to be looking at me, Are you just going to die?"

prakrit: "सा भणइ सामिय! तुमे,सबाण वि महिलियाण सन्तिजलं,संपेसियं महायस!,तस्साहं वञ्चिया नवरं"
english: "She says," "Samya! You, beautiful woman, Are the waters pure, For love is great! For a bridegroom is as deceitful as a bride." ""

prakrit: "अवमाणदूमिएणं,किं कीरइ पणइणीण जीएणं,तुङ्गकुलजाइयाणं?,वरं खु मरणं सुहावेइ"
english: "What makes a woman happy? Life is short, Life is transient, Love is fleeting, And death is certain."

prakrit: "जाव य सा भणइ इमं,ताव च्चिय कञ्चुई समणुपत्तो,एवं समुल्लवन्तो,तुज्झ जलं पेसियं पहुणा"
english: "As soon as she speaks I am through with you," he said, "And just like that, your water will reach your stomach."

prakrit: "सा कञ्चुइणा मुद्धा,अहिसित्ता तेण सन्तिसलिलेणं,निववियमाणसग्गी,पसन्नहियया तओ जाया"
english: "She is stingy, Foolish girl, If you ask her what makes her happy, You'll tell me she isn't. If you don't like her You better stop her."

prakrit: "ताव य नराहिवेणं,भणिओ च्चिय कञ्चुई सरोसेणं,न य आगओ सि सिग्धं,को वक्खेवो तुहं आसि?"
english: "You cruel man, You mean you're a miser, You stupid girl, You fool, Who are you to say that?"

prakrit: "ता कञ्चुई पवुत्तो,भएण अहियं चलन्तसबङ्गो,सामिय! न य वक्खेवो,अस्थि महं कोइ जियलोए"
english: "Aunt, It's just a bunch of mud. Maybe I'm moving around, Samia! But don't be alarmed: The bones will revive me." ""

prakrit: "एयं जराऎ अङ्गं,मज्झ कयं विगयदप्पउच्छाहं,तुरन्तस्स वि धणियं,न वहइ परिजुण्णसयडं व"
english: "Such a tiny part of me, How can I describe it? It's so sharp now And then, It can't move at all"

prakrit: "जे आसि मज्झ नयणा,सामिय! पढमं विषारदिट्टिल्ला,ते वि य न दीहपेही,संपइ जाया कुमित्त व"
english: "Whatever comes of me will not come of me, Samia! I have not seen such poison. But it will not last long. It will come to naught." ""

prakrit: "कण्णा वि पढम वयणं,निसुणन्ता मम्मणं पि उल्लावं,ते सुमहयं पि सई,न सुणन्ति पहू! दुपुत्त व"
english: "Eyes wide open, Eyes closed, Eyes wide shut, Love blossoming, Can't hear you!" ""

prakrit: "जे वि महं आसि पुरा,दन्ता वरकुडयकुसुमसंकासा,ते वि जरवड्डइकया,पडिया अरय व तुम्बाओ"
english: "Whatever has come to me has been accomplished, As long as the tooth is intact And the bud is intact, So are the arrows of the God of Love."

prakrit: "आसि च्चिय पढमयरं,हत्था दढचावकड्डणसमत्था,ते वि य गय व कवलं,मुहाउ दुक्खेहि ढोयन्ति"
english: "Come, come, let us go." "With a clenched fist They clung to each other Like shackles on a fence."

prakrit: "जङ्घाओ वि य मज्झं,आसि पुरा चलण-गमणदच्छाओ,नाह! अणायत्ताओ,संपइ जह दुट्ठमहिलाओ"
english: "The thighs, too, are mine, And so is the whole girdle." "Gone are the girdles!" "The women are exhausted, Unsure what to do next."

prakrit: "नवरं चिय हियइट्ठा,दइया विव नरवई मह लट्ठी,जा कुणइ अवटुंम्भ,घुलन्त-विवडन्तदेहस्स"
english: "The navel is bright, The womb is plump, The lips are prominent, The waist is slender, The body is swollen."

prakrit: "तुरन्तस्स य अङ्गं,कम्पइ बहुला हवन्ति नीसासा,खेओ य समुप्पज्जइ,गई वि मन्दं समुबहइ"
english: "Sudden trembling of the limbs, Long sighing, Consolidation of the body, Though it moves slowly."

prakrit: "कत्तो च्चिय वक्खेवो?,सामिय! अहयं जराऎ परिगहिओ,आणाऎ तुज्झ एन्तो,इमाऎ वेलाऎ संपत्तो"
english: "How old are you? Come on, Samia! Take care of yourself a bit, you bastard. I have plenty of time for this." ""

prakrit: "सुणिऊण तस्स वयणं,राया चिन्तेइ अदुवं देहं,तडिविलसियं व नज्जइ,खणेण जीयं पि नासेइ"
english: "When one listens to him, one thinks of his body, When he speaks, one doesn't know what to expect, And when he listens, one loses one's life."

prakrit: "देहस्स कए पुरिसा,कुणन्ति पावं परिग्गहासत्ता,विसयविसमोहियमई,धम्मं दूरेण वज्जेन्ति"
english: "Men from the body, Who comprehend the path, Who conceal their faults, Who are captivated by delights, Play the dharma at a distance."

prakrit: "पुण्णेण परिग्गहिया,ते पुरिसा जे गिहं पयहिऊणं,धम्मचरणोवएसं,कुणन्ति निच्चं दढधिईया"
english: "Those men who follow purity, Those who follow dharma, Such men never tire of acting honestly."

prakrit: "कइया हं विसयसुह,मोत्तूण परिग्गहं च निस्सङ्गो,काहामि जिणतवं चिय,दुक्खक्खयकारणट्टाए"
english: "How am I supposed to rejoice, How are we supposed to weep, How can I sulk, If I live my life As though I had nothing to lose?"

prakrit: "भुत्तं चिय विसयसुहं,पुहई परिपालिया चिरं कालं,जणिया य पवरपुत्ता,अन्नं किं वा पडिक्खामि?"
english: "It's been a long time coming, I haven't had a good time yet, You fool, How can I find enough food?"

prakrit: "परिचिन्तिऊण एयं,राया पुचिकयस्स अवसाणे,धम्माणुरागरत्तो,भोगेसु अणायरं कुणइ"
english: "Consider this: When Raya is angry, When she is embarrassed, When, out of pity, She acts as if she were angry."

prakrit: "कस्स वि कालस्स तओ,विहरन्तो सुमहएण सङ्घेणं,पत्तो साएयपुरिं,मुणिवसभो सबसत्तहिओ"
english: "To whomsoever the time may belong, To whomever it may suit, The confederacy of good and evil, Whomsoever it may please, It is the sages who dominate."

prakrit: "पन्थायवपरिसमियं,सङ्घ ठविऊण 'सरिसउद्देसं,पविसरइ अप्पदसमो,महिन्दउदयं वरुज्जाणं"
english: "The cycle is eternal, The union is permanent, The passage is sudden, The great day is auspicious, The rainy season is abundant."

prakrit: "तस-पाण-जन्तुरहिए,सिलायले समयले मणभिरामे,नागढुमस्स हेट्टे,चउनाणी तत्थ उवविठ्ठो"
english: "Behold the swarm of crickets, In the midday rush of spring Time, Like a stag's tail, Standing there begging." ""

prakrit: "केई गुहानिवासी,पन्भारेसु य अवट्ठिया समणा,गिरिकन्दरेसु अन्ने,समासिया चेइयहरेसु"
english: "Some people are cave dwellers, Those who travel by foot Traveler or traveler., Others roam the streets, While others travel by road.,"

prakrit: "सो सबभूयसरणो,चाउचण्णेण समणसङ्घणं,तत्थेव गमइ मासं,ताव च्चिय पाउसो पत्तो"
english: "Behold, then, the whole earth trembles; The months go by in succession; Now, dear friend, the rainy season has arrived."

prakrit: "गज्जन्ति घणा गरुयं,तडिच्छडाडोवभासुरं गयणं,धारासयजज्जरिया,नवसाससमाउला पुहई"
english: "There's a lot of singing going on, Loud crashing of drums, Sound of trumpet bells, Drunken jesters, Young girls reaching their climaxes."

prakrit: "परिवड्डन्ति नईओ,जाया पहियाण दुग्गमा पन्था,ऊसुयमणाउ एत्तो,गयवइयाओ विसूरन्ति"
english: "Travelers make new journeys, Travelers traverse difficult paths, Those who are weary go abroad, And those who are lost go abroad."

prakrit: "झज्झ त्ति निज्झराणं,बप्पीहय-दुराण मोराणं,सद्दो पवित्थरन्तो,वारणलीलं विलम्बेइ"
english: "The storm is a steady stream, The rainy season is long, The dry season is torrential, And the rainy season lingers."

prakrit: "एयारिसम्मि काले,समणा सज्झाय-झाण-तवनिरया,अच्छन्ति महासत्ता,दुक्खविमोक्खं विचिन्तन्ता"
english: "In this dark age, Like love, Like passion, Like great power, Like seeing the remover of sorrow."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया नरिन्दो,पभायसमये भडेहि परिकिण्णो,वच्चइ उज्जाणवरं,मुणिवन्दणभत्तिराएणं"
english: "Oh! dear Narindo! When he comes home He goes out for a walk, When he returns he goes to Ujjain, To the shrines of Munivandana."

prakrit: "संपत्तो य दसरहो,अहिवन्देऊण भावओ साहू,तत्थेव य उवविट्ठो,सुणेइ सिद्धन्तसंबन्धं"
english: "Wealth or Dasara, Non - existence or non - existence, Love or absence thereof, Listening is the path to purity."

prakrit: "लोगो दबाणि तहा,खेत्तविभागो य कालसब्भावो,कुलगरपरम्परा वि य,नरिन्दवंसा अणेगविहा"
english: "People are oppressed, Time and space are limited, The Kulgar tradition is also weak, The Narinda dynasty is incompetent."

prakrit: "थुणिऊण पणमिऊण य,मुणिवसहं नरवई पहट्ठमणो,पविसरइ निययनयरी,गमेइ कालं जहिच्छाए"
english: "With a spiteful mouthful of mud, With a frown that goes up to her ears, With sighs that slip away, With eyes that close, Like the passage of time."

prakrit: "एवं राया मुणिगुणकहासत्तचित्तो महप्पा,पूया-दाणं विणयपणओ देइ सबायरेणं,सेविजन्तो गमइ दियहे दिवनारीजणेणं,पुबोवत्तं विमलहियओ भुञ्जई देहसोक्खं"
english: "And when the nights are long, The elephant groans loudly, And when he has served her She is lost in the flames Of the fire That consumes her body." ""

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए दसरहवइरागसव्वभूयसरणागमो नाम एगूगतीसइमो उद्देसओ समत्तो"
english: "On this auspicious day of Pausha, The arrows of the God of Love travel through the sky In the name of the thirty-nine vows." ""

prakrit: "घणगरुयगज्जियरवो,कालो च्चिय पाउसो वइक्वन्तो,उद्दण्डपुण्डरीओ,संपइ सरओ समणुपत्तो"
english: "It's raining heavily, The rainy season is almost over, And the roads are impassable."

prakrit: "ववगयघणसेवालं,ससिहंसं धवलतारयाकुमुयं,लोगस्स कुणइ पीई,नभसलिलं पेच्छिउं सरए"
english: "The elephant serves the calf, The buffalo hunts the buffalo, The crows flutter their wings And the people groan. But let me tell you the truth: They do not see the oxen."

prakrit: "चक्काय-हंस-सारस-अन्नोन्नरसन्तकयसमालावा,निप्फण्णसबसस्सा,अहियं चिय रेहए वसुहा"
english: "The goose, the swan, the stork, The unmanly lotus, Like an endless stream of bees, Lives in my heart."

prakrit: "भामण्डलस्स एवं,सीयाचिन्ताऎ गहियहिययस्स,सरओ च्चिय वोलीणो,मयणमहाजलणतवियस्स"
english: "In the firmament of the earth, So deep are your thoughts, So shallow are your lips, So long are your eyes closed."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कुमारो,लज्जा मोत्तूण पिउसगासम्मि,सीयाऎ कारणढे,भणइ वसन्तद्धयं मित्तं"
english: "Oh! my poor girl, That pearl of shame fell at your feet Like a friend in spring."

prakrit: "मा कुणसु दीहसुत्तं,परकजं सीयलं परिगणन्तो,मयणसमुद्दविवडियं,सुपुरिस! तं मे न उक्खिवसि"
english: "" "Don't be so hasty! You won't see anyone else. You'll be treated just like that." "Silly girl, you fool! Stop yelling at me."

prakrit: "एवं समुल्लवन्तं,भणइ कुमारं महद्धओ वयणं,निपुणेहि कहिज्जन्तं,सम्बन्धं तीऎ कन्नाए"
english: "And the whole crowd, doting on the young boy's big mouth, says as much as she can manage." ""

prakrit: "जणओ कुमार! अम्हे,एत्था''णेऊण मग्गिओ कन्नं,तेणं पि एवं भणियं,रामस्स मए पढमदिन्ना"
english: "O my son! Here I am!" "With those big breasts Of the headman's son, My brother and sister - in - law Have spent the last day of my life In Ramasa."

prakrit: "पुणरवि कहेइ मित्तो,सर्व धणुयाइयं जहावत्तं,रामेण निवइमज्झे,सीया विभवेण परिणीया"
english: "Once again she calls me a friend, All wealth for naught, Ram destroys me, I'm completely through with him, He's through with her."

prakrit: "नीया साएयपुरी,रामेण महाबलेण सा कन्ना,इन्दो वि पुब विहियं,कुमार! न य अन्नहा कुणइ"
english: "Neeya Saiyapuri, Rama has made a mockery of the great, Even the east is full of trees, Kumar! No need to beg." ""

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,रुट्ठो भामण्डलो भणइ एवं,विजाहरत्तणं मे,निरन्थयं तीऎ रहियस्स"
english: "In listening to the wind, She speaks with a shrill voice And, in triumphing, Remains without ceasing."

prakrit: "एव भणिऊण तो सो,सन्नद्धो निययसाहणसमग्गो,अह जाइउं पवत्तो,साएयपुरि सवडहुत्तो"
english: "If you say so, I am ready to go. But let me tell you the truth: The whole world needs help."

prakrit: "तं पेच्छिऊण सहसा,वियब्भनयरं नहेण बच्चन्तो,संभरियपुब जम्मो,मुच्छावसविम्भलो जाओ"
english: "Look at that man Suddenly, with a look of bewilderment But with no words to describe, Get over him With a broad smile."

prakrit: "नीओ य निययभवणं,भडेहि अहियं समाउलमणेहिं,चन्दणजलोल्लियङ्गो,पडिबुद्धो तक्खणं चेव"
english: "It's your destiny, Foolish girl, I'm about to fall at your feet, Sandalwood splashed with water, Like a tight knot tied around your waist."

prakrit: "भणिओ चन्दगईणं,पुत्तय! किं कारणं गओ मुच्छं?,एयं कहेहि मज्झं,मयणावत्थं पमोत्तणं"
english: "Say," "My son, moon - singing! Why must you frown? Tell me, Mother - in - law, how hard it is for you To come." ""

prakrit: "लज्जाओणमियसिरो,भणइ य भामण्डलो विरुद्धं मे,परिचिन्तियं महाजस! घणमोहपसङ्ग जोएणं"
english: "Shy woman, tell me," "Are you ashamed of yourselves? It's the opposite of true love, Your familiarity that counts. Try to enjoy the pleasures of love" ""

prakrit: "जीसे पडम्मि रूवं,आलिहियं नारएण निक्खुत्तं,सा मज्झ निययबहिणी,एक्कोयरगब्भसंभूया"
english: "The woman on top of me is like a jewel, Like the pearl on the nail. She is destined to be mine, Like a garland of gold."

prakrit: "भणइ पुणो चन्दगई,पुत्तय! साहेहि परिफुडं एयं,कह तुज्झ निययबहिणी सा कन्ना? कस्स वा दुहिया?"
english: "" "My son, tell me,'Friend, how is it going to be by your side? It's the moonlight again.'Whom do you mean, the doe?"

prakrit: "सो भणइ ताय! निसुणसु,मह चरियं पुव जम्मसंबन्धं,अस्थि वियब्भा नयरो,महिन्दगिरिसंकडे दुग्गे"
english: "She says:" "Stop! Stop your sulking! It's just a bunch of jasmine flowers falling from my heart. Don't touch the nail marks on my bone. They are bad for me." ""

prakrit: "तत्थाहं आसि पुरा,अह कुण्डलमण्डिओ नरवरिन्दो,भज्जा विप्पस्स हिया,तया मए कामवसएणं"
english: "There it is, my poor boy, The horoscope is full, The fire is fierce, And I have a passion for it."

prakrit: "अणरण्णनरवईणं,बद्धो हं छुट्टिऊण हिण्डन्तो,पेच्छामि तत्थ समणं,तवलच्छिविभूसियसरीरं"
english: "I will never forget how he shook his head, When he clung to my thighs, When I tried to release him, I could not help laughing And bowed my head again."

prakrit: "तस्समणवायमूले,धम्मं सुणिऊण भावियमणेणं,गहियं अणामिसवयं,सद्धम्मे मन्दसत्तेणं"
english: "At the root of true harmony, one hears Dharma, thinks of the future, is deep non - verbal affection, at the root is mental concentration."

prakrit: "जिणवरधम्मस्स इमं,माहप्पं एरिसं अहो लोए,घणपावकम्मकारी,तह वि अहं दुग्गइं न गओ"
english: "Jinaverdharma is my life, my dear, this is the world, I take great pride in my actions; nevertheless, do not harm me."

prakrit: "नियमेण संजमेण य,अणन्नदिद्वित्तणेण मरिऊणं,जाओ य विदेहाए,समयं अन्नेण जीवेणं"
english: "To abide by rules is to suffer, to die is to experience indifference, To depart is to go abroad is to live for the sake of time."

prakrit: "जस्स मए सा महिला,गहिया सो सुरवरो समुप्पन्नो,तेणाहं अवहरिओ,मुक्को मणिकुणुले दाउं"
english: "That woman is mine, That man is your lover, Get away with him, Give me that fistful of rubies."

prakrit: "निवडन्तो ताय! तुमे,दिट्ठो घेत्तूण आणिओ इहई,परिवडिओ कमेणं,पत्तो विज्जाहरत्तं च"
english: "You're the one who made the choice! You, keep your eyes closed And look around. It's the way of love, And leaves a trail of wisdom." ""

prakrit: "सुणिऊण पगयमेयं,चन्दगई सह जणेण विम्हइओ,धिद्धिकारमुहरवो,संसारठिई विनिन्देइ"
english: "Listen, girl, When the moon is full The traveler shares the sky with her, Faces the observer, And answers the call of the world."

prakrit: "दाऊण निययरजं,पुत्तस्स गओ सपरियणाइण्णो,मुणिसबभूयसरणं,राया संसारपरिभीओ"
english: "Be reasonable, my son; be careful not to fall into temptation: Be reasonable in your approach, for fear of the world."

prakrit: "दिट्ठो महिन्दउदए,उज्जाणे वन्दिओ समणसीहो,भणिओ य मज्झ वयणं,भयवं! निसुणेहि एगमणो"
english: "Look at that woman! She is so loud, She mutters loudly, Saying:" "It's my turn!" "Fearful indeed! The fire must go out."

prakrit: "तुज्झ पसाएण अहं,जिणदिक्खं गेण्हिऊण कयनियमो,इच्छामि विणिग्गन्तुं,इमाउ भवपञ्जरघराओ"
english: "It is because of you that I flourish, Because I gain the upper hand in whatever I see, For I wish I could disintegrate, For this is the house of miracles."

prakrit: "भणिओ य एवमेयं,मुणिणा वच्छल्लभावहियएणं,भामण्डलेण वि तओ,निक्खमणमहो कओ विउलो"
english: "Tell me, What makes you think I'm swooning over? It also makes you tremble." ""

prakrit: "जणयमहारायसुओ,जयउ पहामण्डलो वरकुमारो,बन्दिजणुग्घुट्ठरवो,वित्थरिऊणं समाढत्तो"
english: "Long live the farmer's son; The poor boy is the pride of the village. The captive has to kneel on his knees; The dispersed are bound to fall."

prakrit: "भवणे विमुक्कनिद्दा,सीया आयण्णिऊण तं सदं,चिन्तेइ कोवि अन्नो,जणओ जस्सेस पुत्तवरो"
english: "The buildings are in a state of disarray, The streets are empty, The roads are deserted, People are dying, Everyone's business is on hold."

prakrit: "सूयाहरम्मि जो सो,मह भाया अवहिओ वइरिएणं,कम्मस्स उवसमेणं,किं व इहं सो समल्लीणो?"
english: "The sun is hotter than the moon, My brother - in - law is cooler, Work is calmer, Why this confusion?"

prakrit: "तो जणयरायदुहिया,रोवन्ती भणइ राघवो वयणं,नटुं हियं च भद्दे! न सोइयवं बुहजणेणं"
english: "So two grown men, Weeping and wailing, Play the flute to Raghava's tune, Knowingly scold him! No need to sleep or lie down." ""

prakrit: "एवं पभायसमए,उच्चलिओ दसरहो मुणिसयासं,जुवइ-बल-पुत्तसहिओ,कमेण पत्तो तमुज्जाणं ॥"
english: "And on the eve of your festival, Exaltation - The first day of spring, Munisayas, Youth and strength - Your young friends, For with hard work comes true wisdom."

prakrit: "पेच्छद य तत्थ राया,सेन्नं विजाहराण वित्थिण्णं,उवसोहिया य भूमी,धय-तोरण-वेजयन्तीहिं"
english: "The scorched earth, Like a banner proclaiming victory, Is bursting at the seams."

prakrit: "तं वन्दिऊण साहुं,उवविट्ठो दसरहो सह बलेणं,भामण्डलो वि तत्तो,चिट्टइ मुणिपायमूलत्थो"
english: "Tell me, brother - in - law! While he is up there Speaking with the poor farmer, While the field is still wet, A lotus is sticking to the roots of the jasmine."

prakrit: "विजाहरा य मणुया,आसन्ने मुणिवरा जणियतोसा,निसुणन्ति तग्गयमणा,गुरुवयणविणिग्गयं धम्मं"
english: "Victory is human, As soon as one has reached the state of enlightenment One can attain bliss, One can achieve perfection only through penance, And one can attain purity only through dharma."

prakrit: "सायारमणायारं,सुद्धं बहुभेय-पज्जयं धम्मं,भवियसुहुप्पायणयं,अभवजीवाण भयजणणं"
english: "Right attitude, right conduct, right belief, pure dharma, good intention, and fear of the unknown."

prakrit: "सम्मइंसणजुत्ता,तव-नियमरया विसुद्धदढभावा,देहे य निरवयक्खा,समणा पावन्ति सिद्धिगई"
english: "Through penance, through your rules, through hard feelings, Through the body, without restraint, The vows are fulfilled."

prakrit: "जे वि य गिहधम्मरया,पूया-दाणाइसीलसंपन्ना,सङ्काइदोसरहिया,होहिन्ति सुरा महिड्डीया"
english: "Whatever the circumstances, Pooya - the abundance of grains, Sankaidosarahya, Hohenti Sura Mahidya." ""

prakrit: "एवं बहुप्पयारं,जिणवरधम्मं विहोऎ काऊणं,लभिहिन्ति देवलोए,ठाणाणि जहाणुरूवाणि"
english: "And the many temples, The cowherd's houses strewn with jewels, Are the temples of love, The temples of fire and water."

prakrit: "जे पुण अभवजीवा,जिणवयणपरम्मुहा कुदिट्ठीया,ते नरयतिरियदुक्खं,अणुहोन्ति अणन्तयं कालं"
english: "Those who are incompetent, Those who bristle at the prospect of victory, Are doomed to suffer untold misery."

prakrit: "एवं मुणिवरविहियं,धम्मं सोऊण दसरहो भणइ,केण निभेण विउद्धो,चन्दगई खेयराहिवई?"
english: "And when the moon is full, Dharma is spoken of by all; when it is dark, who can escape it? For what is the use of the moon When it is full?"

prakrit: "संसारम्मि अणन्ते,जीवो कम्मावसेण हिण्डन्तो,गहिओ चन्दगईणं,बालो वरकुण्डलाभरणो"
english: "The cycle of rebirth is endless, Creatures move through karma, The moon moves through song, The hair grows thicker."

prakrit: "संवड्डिओ कमेणं,एसो भामण्डलो वरकुमारो,जणयतणयाऎ रूवं,दटुं,मयणाउरो जाओ"
english: "Friend, this is the lotus of the field; it is the ornament of the bridegroom's house; give it a look! It looks like a man making love."

prakrit: "सरिओ य पुवजन्मो,मुच्छा गन्तुं पुणो वि आसत्थो,परिपुच्छिओ कुमारो,चन्दगईणं तओ भणइ"
english: "Aunt, I hope to see you again when I am well," said the farmer, "But let the moon tell you the truth."

prakrit: "अत्थेत्थ भरहवासे,वियन्भनयरं सुदुग्गपायारं,तत्थाहं आसि निवो,वरकुण्डलमंडिओ नामं"
english: "At that moment my heart overflows with joy, At the sound of the lute I repeat: There it is, The fire of renunciation, My name."

prakrit: "विप्पस्स मए भज्जा,हरिया बद्धो य बालचन्देणं,मुक्को मुणिवरपासे,गेण्हामि अणामिसं च वयं"
english: "Wretched man, I am roasting, Green man, Child, moonlight, Fist on the sage, Genghis - ness and immodesty are our lotions."

prakrit: "कालं काऊण तओ,जणयस्स पियाऎ गब्भसंभूओ,जाओ बालाऎ समं,जिणवरधम्माणुभावेणं"
english: "Time is of the essence, People who are as dear as you are Proud, Go as little as you can go, Life is like a rainbow"

prakrit: "महिलाविओगदुहिओ,विप्पो वि य पिङ्गलो तवं काउं,उववन्नो षढमयरं,देवो संभरइ पुवभवं"
english: "Two women are widows, One is widowed, The other is pining away, And the other is bedridden. God knows what to do with her."

prakrit: "तो जायमेत्तओ हं,घेत्तूणं तेण वेरियसुरेणं,मुक्को य धरणिवढे,पुणरवि य तुमे घरं नीओ"
english: "So what do you think? Get away, you fool, Get away again, Put your arms around the farmer, And then you'll be taken home."

prakrit: "परिवड्डिओ कमेणं,जाओ विज्जाहरो तुह गुणेणं,ओमुच्छिएण सहसा,अन्नभवो मे तओ सरिओ"
english: "Foolish girl, Go and multiply your talents. Suddenly I hear you whispering:" "I'm off to eat." ""

prakrit: "माया मे वइदेही,जणओ य पिया न एत्थ संदेहो,सा वि य मज्झ नराहिव! सीया एकोयरा बहिणी"
english: "Deceit is in my heart, Don't doubt it, Daughter - in - law! It also destroys me! It's just another sister." ""

prakrit: "सुणिऊण पगयमेयं,सवे विज्जाहरा सुविम्हइया,चन्दगई वि नरिन्दो,पवइओ जायसंवेगो"
english: "Listen to me when I walk, All knowledge is welcome, Even the moonlit sky is Narindo, Nature is joyful."

prakrit: "एत्थन्तरे मुणिन्दं,पुच्छइ भामण्डलो मह सिणेहं,अहियं वहइ महायस! चन्दगई केण कज्जेणं?"
english: "Here is the moon - faced woman, Asking me what I want out of this damned world: I am a great woman! Why should the moon be angry with me?"

prakrit: "अंसुमईऎ महायस! समप्पिओ वा अहं तओ पढमं,तत्थेव खेयरपुरे,जम्माणन्दो कओ परमो"
english: "Ah, the summer solstice! Is it too late, my dear! I've read so much already. So why waste your time elsewhere? It's the supreme truth." ""

prakrit: "तो सबभूयसरणो,भणइ य भामण्डलं सुणसु एत्तो,माया-वित्तजुवलयं जं आसि परे भवे तुज्झं"
english: "So tell me, my dear," said the traveler, "Here's what you have to say: Whatever comes of your fancy May be yours in return."

prakrit: "विप्पो दारुग्गामे,विमुची नामेण गेहिणी तस्स,अणुकोसा अइभूई,पुत्तो सुण्हा य से सरसा"
english: "Vippo in the doorway, Vimuci on the pretext that she is pregnant, Angry at her husband's absence," "My son, be careful not to fall asleep." ""

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाई,विप्पो सरसं नईऎ,दट्टणं,अवहरइ मयणमूढो,कयाणनामो महापावो"
english: "Oh! strange ship, Vippo mustard is new, Trouble is brewing, The Mayan mud is disappearing, For a ship's name is great."

prakrit: "एत्तो सो अइभूई,कन्तासोगाउरो महिं सयलं,परिभमइ गवेसन्तो,ताव य से लूडियं गेहं"
english: "Here she is, kneeling beside me, Washing away the tears That fall from her cheeks." ""

prakrit: "विमुची वि य पढमयरं,हिण्डइ देसं तु दक्खिणाकडी,सुणिऊण गेहभङ्ग,पुत्तस्स तओ पडिनियत्तो"
english: "You fool, My dear, The south wind is blowing from the south, Your son has fallen at your feet." ""

prakrit: "चीरम्बरपरिहाणिं,अणुकोसं पेच्छिऊण अइदुहियं,संथावेइ य विमुची,तीऎ समं मेइणी भमइ"
english: "I will never forget how she looked at me, When I looked at her face With such longing, When she shivered, And when I frowned. She looked just like me."

prakrit: "पेच्छइ य सच्चरिपुरे,अवहिसमग्गं मुणिं विगयमोहं,सुण्हा-सुयसोगेण य,निवेयं चेव पडिवन्नो"
english: "She looks at you with such longing, Seems to sigh uncontrollably, Looks like a dream: You have already fallen asleep."

prakrit: "दट्ठ ण साहुरिद्धिं,संसारठिइं च तत्थ निसुणेउं,संवेगजणियकरणो,विमुची दिक्खं समणुपत्तो"
english: "The eye is not the arrow, the whole world is. Then let me throw it away. It causes sensation. But when it sees me, it rebukes me."

prakrit: "सा वि तहिं अणुकोसा,पासे अज्जाऎ कमलकन्ताए,संजमतवनियमधरी,जाया समणी समियपावा"
english: "She is so eager to meet him, So are the lotuses scattered all over the place, So is the woman in distress, As if she had time to spare."

prakrit: "अह ताणि दो वि मरिउं,तव-नियमगुणेण देवलोगम्मि,निच्चालोयमणहरं,गयो य लोगन्तियं ठाणं"
english: "Oh! both of you, die! For by your virtuous conduct You have proved a god. For the night is passing, But let's stop here and there." ""

prakrit: "अइभूइ कयाणो वि य,निस्सीलो निद्दओ करिय कालं,हिण्डेइ चाउरङ्गे,दुग्गइभवसंकडे भीमे"
english: "How can I help it? It takes a long time to fall asleep, It's only yesterday that I woke up, And in the middle of the night it got worse."

prakrit: "सरसा वि य पवज्जं,काऊण तवं समाहिणा मरिउं,उववन्ना कयपुण्णा,देवी चित्तुस्सवा नामं"
english: "Even mustard seed should be worshipped, Somebody should be killed so that it may be absorbed, Such is the virtue of compassion; The name of the goddess is Chittussava."

prakrit: "कम्मस्स उवसमेणं,होऊण कमेण तो कयाणो वि,जाओ वि पिङ्गलो सो,पुत्तो च्चिय धूमकेउस्स"
english: "Karma is restless, If you have to work, then do it, But go - get it, son - it's smoke." ""

prakrit: "अइभूई वि भमन्तो,संसारे हंसपोयओ जाओ,सेणेसु खज्जमाणो,पडिओ जिणचेझ्यासन्ने"
english: "The earth trembles, The world is full of geese, The army is exhausted, They have fallen asleep in the mud."

prakrit: "सोऊण नमोक्कारं,कीरन्तं साहवेण कालगओ,दसवरिससहस्साऊ,नगन्तरे किन्नरो जाओ"
english: "Praise be to the sun, For how long a time has past, To bear witness to the festival of Dasara, To go astray into the night."

prakrit: "चुइउं वियब्भनयरे,अह कुण्डलमण्डिओ समुप्पन्नो,अवहरइ पिङ्गलस्स उ,कन्ता मयणाउरो तत्तो"
english: "Dear girl, The horoscope is closing in on us. What are you doing hiding under the blanket? There must be something wrong with you." ""

prakrit: "जो आसि पुरा विमुची,सो एसो चन्दविक्कमो राया,जा वि य सा अणुकोसा,सा अंसुमई इहं जाया"
english: "One who is full of wiles, Such is the nature of the moon. However much she seeks it, The unseasonable rainbow vanishes here."

prakrit: "जो चेव कयाणो खलु,सरसा हरिऊण भमइ संसारे,महुपिङ्गलो त्ति समणो,जाओ पुण सुरवरो मरिउं"
english: "Who cares what people say, Stirring the hornet's nest in the middle of the world, Bowing before the beehive, Go and rejoice, for I shall die."

prakrit: "जो वि य सो अइभूई,सो हु तुमं कुण्डलो समुप्पन्नो,एसो ते संबन्धो,परभवजणियस्स कम्मस्स"
english: "Whatever comes of it, I gather from you in my horoscope; this is the karma of karma."

prakrit: "एयं चिय वित्तन्तं,सब सुणिऊण दसरहो राया,भामण्डलं कुमारं,अवग्र̥हइ तिबनेहेण"
english: "Here I am, sitting on the pyre, Listening to all the gossip: It's the tenth day of summer, Daughter - in - law of the village, And the fire of love has broken out."

prakrit: "तं पेच्छिऊण सीया,सहोयरं जायबन्धवसिणेहा,पगलन्तअंसुनिवहा,रुयइ चिय महुरसद्देण"
english: "She looks at you with such longing, Like a friend in a relationship Running out of tears, Like the mother of bees crying her heart out."

prakrit: "चिरकालदरिसणुस्सुय-हियया आलिङ्गिउं समासत्था,सीया वि य कमलमुही,परिओसुब्भिन्नरोमञ्ची"
english: "Long - eyed girl - Here's an embrace for the ages, Too young to face a lotus, Lovely couple - The pleasures of love are endless."

prakrit: "रामेण लक्खणेण य,अन्नेण पि सेसबन्धवजणेणं,आलिङ्गिओ कुमारो,गरुयसिणेहाणुरागेणं"
english: "Rama is worthy of respect, Friendship is due to him, Embracing sons is due, The victory of good over evil is due."

prakrit: "तं पणमिऊण समणं,विज्जाहर-भूमिगोयरा सके,हय-गय-जोहसमग्गा,साएयपुरि पविसरन्ति"
english: "Praise be to him, O God of wisdom and earth, For true wisdom is everywhere, Even in heaven and earth."

prakrit: "भामण्डलेण समयं,संमन्तेऊण दसरहो लेहं,पेसेइ खेयरवरं,आसेण समं पवणवेगं"
english: "Time for feasting, Lehenga for celebrating Dussehra, Peseyi kheyravaram, As it happens, Equal footfall."

prakrit: "गन्तूण पणमिऊण य,पवणगईणं नराहिवो जणओ,वद्धाविओ य सहसा,पुत्तस्स समागमेणं तु"
english: "Gone are the days When one had to make do With household chores, When one could not make love to one's rival, Increasingly violent Are the occasions When you, my son, Make friends."

prakrit: "लेहं समप्पियं सो,जणओ सुणिऊण तस्स परितुट्ठो,देइ निययङ्गलग्गं,आहरणविहिं निरवसेसं"
english: "I have finished Leah. If anyone listens, let him have his way. Let him settle down On the river bank. There is no need for him to be carried around."

prakrit: "लेहत्थमुणियसारो,सपरियणो नरवई सभज्जाओ,अभिणन्दिओ सुदूरं,कयकोउयमङ्गलरवेणं"
english: "Lying face down, The hunter is a man of principle, The traveler is polite, The adventurer is distant, So is the traveler's wife." ""

prakrit: "विज्जाहरसाहीणं,भज्जाऎ समं नराहिवो तुरियं,आरुहिऊण खणेणं,साएयपुरि समणुपत्तो"
english: "Without a doctor at hand, You'll be just as useless as a fowler. Once you've had your way, Try to find out which one is right for you."

prakrit: "दट्ठूण निययपुत्तं,आलिङ्गिऊण रुयइ नरवसभो,अइदीहविओगाणल-तविओ पगलन्तनयणजुओ"
english: "Aunt, When you see him you are bound to fall asleep. When you embrace him you cry out. The way he acts Like a man possessed by a demon Is extraordinary."

prakrit: "रुइऊण समासत्थो,पुत्तं परिमुसइ अङ्गमङ्गेसु,हियएण जायहरिसो,चन्दणफरिसोवमं महइ"
english: "Cry aloud, my son; my limbs are limp As always. The bee sleeps on the lotus of the moon."

prakrit: "दट्ठ ण सुयं जणणी,मुच्छा गन्तूण तत्थ पडिबुद्धा,रुयइ कलुणं मयच्छी,चिरदसणलद्धजीयासा"
english: "She does not look at you, She puts on a mask, Stands her ground, Weeps bitterly, Lives long without seeing you."

prakrit: "जत्तो पभूइ पुत्तय! केण वि बालत्तणम्मि अवहरिओ,तत्तो इमं सरीरं,दढ चिन्ताग्गिणा मज्झं"
english: "As long as I have a son! There must be someone keeping an eye on me. For there must be a body in me, A mother's womb with deep thoughts."

prakrit: "तुह दरिसणोदएणं,विज्झवियं एत्थ नत्थि संदेहो,परिओससमूसवियं,अज्जप्पभिई महं हिययं"
english: "There is no doubt in your eyes, My wisdom is here, My love for you is abundant, But today my heart is full of fear."

prakrit: "धन्ना सा अंसुमई,जीए अङ्गाई बालभावम्मि,परिचुम्बियाई पुत्तय! कीलणरयरेणुमइलाइं"
english: "Blessed is the unbroken flame, Living in the bosom of youth, Beloved son! The leaves of the jasmine illuminate the sky." ""

prakrit: "फुसिऊण नयणजुयलं,थणेसु खीरं तओ हरिसियङ्गी,अभिणन्दिया विदेहा,समागमे निययपुत्तस्स"
english: "Foolish young woman, When you kiss your lover's cheek You turn away, When he calls you aside You are bound to meet him."

prakrit: "कुणइ जणओ महन्तं,पुत्तनिमित्तं समागमाणन्दं,जिणचेइयपूयत्थं,ण्हवणविहिं चेव सविसेसं"
english: "Somebody is great, A joy to be with for the sake of a son, A pleasure to be had, A delight to be savored, And a blessing to be enjoyed by all."

prakrit: "भामण्डलेण भणिओ,रामो अञ्चन्तबन्धवो तुहयं,सीया न गच्छइ पहू,जह उबेयं पयणुयं पि"
english: "The landowner said," "Rama, your affection is bound to increase. Don't go anywhere else, my dear, Just keep walking so that you don't fall over." ""

prakrit: "संभासिऊण सबे,जणयं मिहिलापुरिं विसज्जेउं,पियरं घेत्तूण गओ,निययं भामण्डलो ठाणं"
english: "Take it all in your stride, Let it all boil over, Hold on tight, For the moment it's too late, It's just a bunch of crap."

prakrit: "एवं सेणिय! पेच्छ धम्मनिहसं तुङ्गं पुरा सेवियं,जाओ नेहनिरन्तरोच्छयमणो बन्धू पहामण्डलो,वज्जावत्तधणुं वसम्मि ठवियं सीया य से गेहिणी,रामस्स'ब्भुयकारणस्स विमलो भन्तो जसो मेईणी"
english: "And you, soldier! Look at your dharma - laden self, Like a friend in distress Standing guard over your eyes While blowing the trumpet Loud with thunder. For Rama's sake, you fool, You seem to be acting like a maid." ""

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए भामण्डलसंगमविहाणो नाम तीसइमो उद्देसओ समत्तो"
english: "Praise be to the name of the God of Love, For it is he who gives us our vows."

prakrit: "पुच्छइ मगहनरिन्दो,गणाहिवं दसरहो महारिद्धिं,केण न कएण पत्तो? एयं साहेहि मे भयवं!"
english: "I beg of you, Your Highness, Is it the tenth day more important than the hundredth? Why not find out for yourself? I am afraid so!" ""

prakrit: "तो भणइ इन्दभूई,सेणिय! निसुणेहि दसरहो राया,मुणिसवभूयसरणं,पुच्छइ निययं भवसमूह"
english: "So she says," "Indubhai, soldier!" "When he says he won't go, Raya, startled by her expression, Asks her what she intends to say."

prakrit: "जं एव नरवईणं,अप्पहियं पुच्छिओ समणसीहो,तो साहिउं पवत्तो,परभवपरियट्टणं बहुसो"
english: "Whatever people say, Ask away, Be courteous; It's the way of love; Too much talk about love."

prakrit: "तो भणइ दसरह! तुमं,मिच्छत्तेणं तु भमिय संसारे,सेणापुरम्मि नयरे,अत्थि च्चिय भावणो नामं"
english: "So tell me, Dussehra! You, errant girl, Are you afraid of the rest of the world? Don't be alarmed: That's just a fancy name." ""

prakrit: "भज्जा य दीविया से,तीऎ उवत्थी सुया समुप्पन्ना,सा मिच्छत्तमइलिया,साहूण अवण्णवाई उ"
english: "Foolish girl, The lamp was lit, She slept soundly, She acted erratically, And the fire was quenched."

prakrit: "मरिऊण उवत्थी सा,भमिय चिरं नरय-तिरियजोणीसु,कम्मपरिणिज्जराए,कमेण पुण्णस्स उदएणं"
english: "When he dies, she rises; When he is gone, the women tremble; When his business fails, he rises again."

prakrit: "जाओ चिय अङ्गपुरे,धरणेणं नयणसुन्दरीपुत्तो,बहुबन्धवो सुरूवो,नामेणं भद्दवरुणो ति"
english: "Go to my limbs, pick up the most beautiful girl in the world, start a long and loving relationship, For her name is offensive."

prakrit: "दाऊण भावसुद्धं,फासुयदाणं मुणिस्स कालगओ,धाइयसण्डम्मि तओ,उत्तरकुरुवाऎ उप्पन्नो"
english: "The doe is ecstatic, The executioner is swooning, The midwife is making love, The high priest is replying."

prakrit: "भोत्तूण मिहुणसोक्खं,कालगओ सुरवरो समुप्पन्नो,चइऊण पुक्खलाए,नयरीए नन्दिघोसस्स"
english: "Aunt, It's time to rejoice, The pleasures of love are at hand, The cheeks are prickly, The nose is full of gratitude"

prakrit: "जाओ च्चिय भज्जाए,पुहईए नन्दिवद्धणो नामं,अह अन्नया नरिन्दो,पडिबुद्धो नन्दिघोसो उ"
english: "Go and break the rice. First let me tell you the name of Nandivaddha. Then, dear Narindo, When the paddy is ripe I will praise you."

prakrit: "संसारभउबिग्गो,ठविऊणं नन्दिवद्धणं रजे,निक्खमइ नन्दिघोसो,पासम्मि जसोहरमुणिस्स"
english: "Praise be to the cycle of rebirth, Thanksgiving is a joy to behold, I give thanks for what I lose: I bow to the arrows of the God of Love."

prakrit: "काऊण तवमुयारं,कालगओ सुरवरो समुप्पन्नो,अह नन्दिवद्धणो चिय,सागारतवं कुणइ धीरो"
english: "Aunt, The passage of time is sweet, And the whole world is full of people. I am filled with gratitude; Be patient, for the sea warms up."

prakrit: "भोत्तण पुवकोडिं,रजं सण्णासणेण कालगओ,विमलामलबोहिधरो,पञ्चमकप्पे सुरो जाओ"
english: "Take a bath, put on your royal robes, go for a walk, cover your face with lotus petals, and tune in to the fifth eye."

prakrit: "तत्तो चुओ समाणो,अवरविदेहे नगम्मि वेयड्ढे,उत्तरवरसेढीए,विक्खाओ ससिपुरे राया"
english: "Then shut up, my poor girl, The streets are empty, The roads are deserted, And the roads are impassable."

prakrit: "नामेण रयणमाली,तस्स षियाए य कुच्छिसंभूओ,विजुलयाए पुत्तो,जाओ सूरंजयकुमारो"
english: "Name me Rayanmali, you sly bitch, you son of a bitch. Go, son of the sun." ""

prakrit: "अह विग्गहेण चलिओ,सीहपुरं रयणमालिणो सबलो,सन्नद्धबद्धकवओ,जत्थ य सो वज्जवरनयणो"
english: "Go ahead, you fool, Strongman of the straight line, Be prepared to be bullied, For where he is going There is a great storm brewing."

prakrit: "कोहाणलविज्जाए,उहिउमणो रिउपुरं रहारूढो,वच्चन्तो च्चिय भणिओ,गयणयलत्थेण देवेणं"
english: "Long - eyed girl, Wait till you see him again. When he comes you will say:" "Singing with a loud voice." ""

prakrit: "भो रयणमालिनरवइ! मा ववससु एरिसं महापावं,निसुणेहि मज्झ वयणं,कहेमि तुह पुव संबन्धं"
english: "" "My dear, you won't understand! It's a big storm coming down the river. I'll tell you the truth," "I whisper to myself."

prakrit: "इह भारहम्मि वरिसे,गन्धारे आसि भूरिणो नामं,दट्ट ण कमलगभं,साहुं तो गेहए नियमं"
english: "It is our heirloom, The name of the poor man who grows myriad flowers, Is not thick as a lotus. But wheat is the law of nature."

prakrit: "न करेमि पुणो पावं,भणइ तओ एरिसं वयं मज्झं,पञ्चपलिओवमाइं,सग्गे अज्जेइ देवाउं"
english: "I will not repeat that mistake again. So tell me, my dear, How can I help you? It's my mother - in - law who has given birth to us?"

prakrit: "उवमच्चुनामधेओ,तत्थेव पुरोहिओ वसइ पावो,तस्सुवएसेण वयं,मुञ्चइ भूरी अकयपुण्णो"
english: "Aunt, The priest lives there, And we live there Because of him. I have brown eyes And he is so skinny."

prakrit: "खन्देण हिंसिओ सो,पुरोहिओ गयवरो समुप्पन्नो,जुझे जज्जरियतणू,लहइ च्चिय कण्णजावं सो"
english: "The hunter is the hunter; the hunted are the hunters; The warrior is the gatherer of good and evil; Yet, like an ox, he is a treasure to the eyes."

prakrit: "कालगओ गन्धारे,तत्थेव उ भूरिणस्स उप्पन्नो,जोयणगन्धाऎ सुओ,अरिहसणो नाम नामेणं"
english: "The passage of time is like sulphur; there it rises, Like the rising of a bull in midday." "Name me Arihasan for his fragrance."

prakrit: "दट्ठण कमलगभं,पुवभवं सुमरिऊण पवइओ,कालगओ उप्पन्नो,सहसारे सुरवरो अहयं"
english: "When I see a lotus, When I think of a flower, I hear it with all my heart."

prakrit: "सो हु तुमं जो भूरी,कालं काऊण दण्डगारण्णे,जाओ दगकित्तिधरो,दवेण दड्डो मओ तत्तो"
english: "It is you who are brown, Who for a while have looked like a criminal. Go, you scoundrel, The doe has bitten me to the teeth."

prakrit: "पावषसङ्गेण गओ,बीयं चिय सक्करप्पभं पुढविं,तत्थ मए नेहेणं,नरए पडिबोहिओ गन्तुं"
english: "Go with the wind, Sow the seeds, Drink the nectar, And then I'll go without a trace."

prakrit: "तत्तो च्चिय नरयाओ,कालेणुबट्टिओ रयणमाली,जाओ तुमं महायस,राया विज्जाहराहिवई"
english: "There you are, my poor girl, Time is ticking, Go - between! You great warrior! The arrows of the God of Love have reached the sky."

prakrit: "जो आसि पुरा भूरी,सो हु तुमं रयणमालिणो जाओ,जो वि य आसुवमञ्चू,पुरोहिओ सो अहं देवो"
english: "One who is pure brown, I am his follower, You are my lover, Whatever else I desire, That, dear, is my god."

prakrit: "किं ते न'णुहूयाई,दुक्खाई नरय-तिरियजोणीसु,जेणेरिसं अकज्जं,करेसि घणरागदोसेणं"
english: "Isn't that a cruel joke? It is hurtful, it is disgusting, It offends you. You are committing a heinous crime."

prakrit: "देववयणं,संवेगपरायणो नरवरिन्दो,कुलणन्दणं ठवेई,रज्जे सूरंजयस्स सुयं"
english: "Devavayana, the passionate man or woman, The bow of the lotus, The sound of the sunshine, Is the essence of sleep."

prakrit: "सूरंजएण समयं,आयरियं तिलयसुन्दरं सरणं,पत्तो य रयणमाली,दिक्खं जिणदेसियं धीरो"
english: "Time for sunshine, Let the scent of sesame seeds settle, Wait till the moon is full, Watch out for those who struggle to stay alive."

prakrit: "सूरंजओ महन्तं,काऊण तवं गओ महासुकं,चविओ अणरण्णसुओ,जाओ चिय दसरहो सि तुमं"
english: "Great is the sun, great is the moon, Such a beauty it is to behold; Yet, behold, thou art only to be seen Through the eyes of another."

prakrit: "नरवइ थोवेण तुमं,पुण्णेण उवत्थिमाइसु भवेसु,वडबीयं पिव विद्धिं,पत्तो सुहकम्मउदएणं"
english: "Put on the cow - dung cakes, let the flowers bloom, Fill with fresh nectar, And smear with red ghee."

prakrit: "जो आसि नन्दिघोसो,तुज्झ पिया नन्दिवद्धणस्स पुरा,सो हं गेविजचुओ,जाओ मुणिसवभूयहिओ"
english: "Whoever it was who thanked you, Your beloved, full of gratitude, I beg of you, Go and bow before him."

prakrit: "जे वि य ते दोण्णि जणा,भूरी-उवमच्चुनामधेया''सि,ते चेव जणय-कणया,इह तुज्झ वसाणुगा जाया"
english: "Whatever it is that the two of you know, brown and buff - your name alone, That by all accounts, It's yours to dispose of." ""

prakrit: "संसारम्मि य घोरे,अणेयभवसयसहस्ससंबन्धे,उवट्टण-परियट्टग,करेन्ति जीवा सकम्मेहिं"
english: "The senses of the world, Undisturbed by strange happenings, Swirl about in ecstasy, Try to conceal their existence."

prakrit: "एवं मुणिवरभणियं,सुणिऊणं दसरहो भउविग्गो,अह संजमामिलासी,जाओ च्चिय तक्खणं चेव"
english: "And you fool," said the landowner, "Listen up! It's the tenth day of spring. Please, gentleman, go and see that tree."

prakrit: "सवायरेण चलणे,गुरुस्स नमिऊण दसरहो राया,पविसरइ निययनयरिं,साएयं जण-धणाइण्णं"
english: "One must walk in harmony with oneself, One must bow before one's teacher, The other must kneel before the other."

prakrit: "चिन्तेइ तो मणेणं,रजं दाऊण पउमनाहस्स,तो सबसङ्गरहिओ,मुत्तिसुहं चेव पत्थेमो"
english: "If you think of it, You'd better keep it to yourself, Your husband is at hand, And so is everyone else. My dear, I love you just the same."

prakrit: "मेरु ब धीरगरुओ,रामो तिसमुद्दमेहलं पुहई,पालेऊण समत्थो,परिकिण्णो बन्धवजणेणं"
english: "Meru, be patient! Rama has reached the holy place of Tisamudram. Support the husbandman's business. Listen to the gossip of relatives." ""

prakrit: "चिन्तावरस्स एवं,नरिन्दवसहस्स रज्जविमुहस्स,अभिलचिओ य सरओ,हेमन्तो चेव संपत्तो"
english: "Thoughts and anger, Though the head is immovable, Aspirations and desires, Are the essence of wealth."

prakrit: "हेमन्तवायविहवो,लोगो परिफुडियअहर-कर-चरणो,रयरेणुपडलछन्नो,ससी व मन्दच्छविं वहइ"
english: "Hemant is windy, people crowd around, He walks on rough ground, He dances on the river bank, He acts like a sage and has dark eyes."

prakrit: "आकुञ्चियकर-गीवा,पुरिसा सीएण फुडियसबङ्गा,सुमरन्ति अग्गिनिवहं,दीणा वि अमन्दपाउरणा"
english: "Aakunchiakar - Geewa, purisa seyen phudiasabanga, sumranti aagginivahan, dina vi amandapaurana"

prakrit: "आवडियदसणवीणा,दारु-तणाजीवया थरथरेन्ता,दारिदसमभिभूया,गमेन्ति कालं अकयपुण्णा"
english: "Like a poor woman in distress, Struggling with wine and the tensions of life, Feigning poverty, One can never be perfect."

prakrit: "पासायतलत्था वि य,अन्ने पुण गीय-वाइयरवेणं,वरवत्थषाउयङ्गा,कालागरुधूवससुयन्धा"
english: "Pasayatlatha viz., Ane puna geeya - Vaiyarvenna, Varvattha shauyanga, Kalagarudhuvasuyaṇḍha"

prakrit: "भुञ्जन्ति सया रसियं,आहारं कणयभायणविदिन्नं,कुंकुमकयङ्गरागा अक्खीणधणा सुकयपुण्णा"
english: "Roasting is the essence of love, Food is the expression of feelings, Like the kumkum kangaroo Whose eyes are red like treasure chests."

prakrit: "कलमहुरभासिणीहिं,संगयवरचारुवेसरूवाहिं,तरुणविलयाहि समयं,कीलन्ति चिरं सुकयपुण्णा"
english: "Long - eyed women, With tears running down their cheeks, Young villains take their time, For the jasmine alone goes dry."

prakrit: "धम्मेण लहइ जीवो,सुर-माणुसविविहभोगसामिद्धिं,नरय-तिरिक्खेसु पुणो,पावइ दुक्खं अहम्मेणं"
english: "Through Dharma, the soul is purified, through pleasure and pleasure, through human marriage, through purification, and through renunciation; this is the sorrow of the ego."

prakrit: "एव सुणिऊण राया,कम्मविवागं जणस्स सयलस्स,संसारगमणभीओ,इच्छइ घेत्तूण पबजं"
english: "Listen to this, Raya; you lazy person who is busy making love, Afraid of the world: He'd like to be hugged And kissed."

prakrit: "सद्दाविया य सिग्धं,सामन्ता आगया समन्तिजणा,काऊण सिरपणामं,उवविठ्ठा आसणवरेसु"
english: "Straightforward business, fire without fire, courtesy without headgear, high up without a seat"

prakrit: "सामिय! देहा''णत्ति,किं करणिज्जं? भडेहि संलवियं,भणिया य दसरहेणं,पवजं गिहिमो अज्जं"
english: "Samiya! Body!" "Naughty girl, what should I do?" "Foolish girl, it's only the first day of Dasara."

prakrit: "अह तं भणन्ति मन्ती,सामिय! किं अज्ज कारणं जायं,धणसयलजुवइवग्गं,जेण तुमं ववसिओ मोत्तु?"
english: "You fool, Sammy! What's the reason today, you greedy young man? Because you are old and dying?" ""

prakrit: "तो भणइ नरवरिन्दो,पञ्चक्खं वो जयं निरवसेसं,सुकं व तणमसारं,डज्झइ मरणग्गिणा धणियं"
english: "He says:" "Narvarindo, panchakham woh nirvasema, sukham woh tanamasarma, dajja is death's arrow." ""

prakrit: "भवियाण जं सुगिज्झं,अग्गिज्झं अभवियाण जीवाणं,तियसाण पत्थणिज्जं,सिवगमणसुहावहं धम्मं"
english: "What's auspicious is auspicious, what's inauspicious is inanimate, What is poisonous is astringent, And what is auspicious is the dharma of liberation."

prakrit: "तं अज्ज मुणिसयासे,धम्मं सुणिऊण जायसंवेगो,संसारभवसमुई,इच्छामि अहं समुत्तरिउं"
english: "Today, sage, If you want to hear Dharma, Be attentive, O observer of worldly affairs, I will reply." ""

prakrit: "अहिसिञ्चह मे पुत्तं,पढमं चिय रज्जपालणसमत्थं,पवज्जामि अविग्धं,जेणाहं अज्ज वीसत्थो"
english: "My son, I am still the same as before, I know how to weep and wail, But today I am well."

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,पवज्जानिच्छियं नरवरिन्दं,सुहडा-'मच्च-पुरोहिय,पडिया सोयण्णवे सहसा"
english: "Listening to the wind, Wishing to be treated with courtesy, Lovely -" "Foolish priest, Suddenly the girl falls asleep." ""

prakrit: "नाऊण निच्छियमई,दिक्खाभिमुहं नराहिवं एत्तो,अन्तेउरजुवइजणो,सबो रुविउं समाढत्तो"
english: "The boat is dead, My face is bruised, And I am unable to help laughing. Everyone is laughing Now, young man."

prakrit: "दट्टण तारिसं चिय,पियरं भरहो खणेण पडिबुद्धो,चिन्तेइ नेहबन्धो,दुच्छेज्जो जीवलोगम्मि"
