english: "Fill your heart with gratitude, Fill it with love, Close it with longing, Friendship with sorrow: Life is fleeting."

prakrit: "तायस्स किं व कीरइ,पवज्जाववसियस्स पुहईए?,पुत्तं ठवेइ रज्जे,जेणं चिय पालणट्टाए"
english: "What's the matter with you, darling? Are you satisfied with your husband's return?" ""

prakrit: "आसन्नेण किमत्थं,इमेण खणभङ्गुरेण देहेणं,दूरट्टिएसु अहियं,का'वत्था बन्धवेसु भवे?"
english: "How can I rest, This body with bristling lips, Running away? Why should I have any other relatives?"

prakrit: "एको'त्थ एस जीवो,दुहपायवसंकुले भवारण्णे,भमइ च्चिय मोहन्धो,पुणरवि तत्थेव तत्थेव"
english: "On the one hand, these creatures live, Twice as long as there are clouds of bees, And once again there are bees."

prakrit: "तो सबकलाकुसला,भरहं नाऊण तत्थ पडिबुद्धं,सोगसमुत्थयहियया,परिचिन्तइ केगई देवी"
english: "So all the arts prosper, All the names already known, Then the poems written on them, And the poems composed in sorrow - The familiar goddess Kegai."

prakrit: "न य मे पई न पुत्तो,दोणि वि दिक्खाहिलासिणो जाया,चिन्तेमि तं उवायं,जेण सुयं वो नियत्तेमि"
english: "Neither have I, my son, Nor do I wish to lose sight of you: I speak as I think, But what I possess I assign to myself."

prakrit: "तो सा विणओवगया,भणइ निवं केगई महादेवी,तं मे वरं पयच्छसु,जो भणिओ सुहडसामक्खं"
english: "So she has wilted, Said she is dying, And so is Mahadevi. I seek a blessing from her, Who says:" "I am well." ""

prakrit: "भणइ तओ नरवसभो,दिक्खं मोत्तण जं पिए भणसि,तं अज्ज तुज्झ सुन्दरि! सर्व संपाडइस्सामि"
english: "You fool, look! Whatever you say after your death I take it all from you. Today you look so beautiful!" ""

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,रोवन्ती केगई भणइ कन्तं,दढनेहबन्धणं चिय,विरागखग्गेण छिन्नं ते"
english: "Listening to the wind, She mutters, Weeping bitterly, Tying the knot between two hands: Separation leads to separation."

prakrit: "एसा दुद्धरचरिया,उबइट्टा जिणवरेहि सबेहिं,कह अज्ज तक्खणं चिय,उप्पन्ना संजमे बुद्धी?"
english: "Such a milkman, Ubittah jinnarehiye, kaha aaj takhan chiye, uppanna sanjame buddhi?"

prakrit: "सुरवइसमेसु सामिय! निययं भोगेसु लालियं देहं,खर-फरुस-कक्कसयरे,कह अरिहसि परिसहे जेउं?"
english: "Surprise me, Samiya! Destroy your body, your hair, your cheeks, and your bosom. How can I escape your arrows?" ""

prakrit: "चलणङ्गुलीऎ भूमि,विलिहन्ती केगई समुल्लवइ,पुत्तस्स मज्झ सामिय! देहि समत्थं इमं रज्जं"
english: "Fingers crossed, The earth trembles, The fingers of the willow tremble, My son, I am ready! Dehi means string." ""

prakrit: "तो दसरहो पवुत्तो,सुन्दरि! पुत्तस्स तुज्झ रज्जं ते,दिन्नं मए समत्थं,गेण्हसु मा णे चिरावेहि"
english: "" "So, my dear, you're in a hurry, my boy! Hold on to your strings. Give me the time I need. Don't overdo it: It won't last long."

prakrit: "तो दसरहेण सिग्धं,पउमो सोमित्तिणा समं पुत्तो,वाहरिओ वसहगई,समागओ कयषणामो य"
english: "So the tenth day is auspicious, The husband is as peaceful as a son, And the wife is as busy as a daughter-in-law; We gather together only when it's auspicious."

prakrit: "वच्छ! महासंगामे,सारत्थं केगईऎ मज्झ कयं,तुद्वेण वरो दिन्नो,सबनरिन्दाण पच्चक्खं"
english: "Butcher! In the great congregation, What is my business in all this? One day you will have to bear with it all The rest of my life Will be spent elsewhere."

prakrit: "तो केगईऎ रज्जं,पुत्तस्स विमग्गियं इमं सयलं,किं वा करेमि वच्छय! पडिओ चिन्तासमुद्दे हइं"
english: "So what have I to do with you, my son? You're the king! My son, I'm the messenger. I have to think." ""

prakrit: "भरहो गिण्हइ दिक्खं,तस्स विओगम्मि केगई मरइ,अहमवि य निच्छएणं,होहामि जए अलियवाई"
english: "The poor thing is counting the days. Somebody lost their temper And died. I am ready to give up my love. I will go wherever it takes me."

prakrit: "तो भणइ पउमनाहो,ताय! तुमं रक्ख अत्तणो वयणं,न य भोगकारणं मे,तुज्झ अकित्तीऎ लोगम्मि"
english: "You fool, he says." "Protect me then, my dear. I won't go to the banquet. You dishonest people!" ""

prakrit: "जाएण सुएण पहू! चिन्तेयवं हियं निययकालं,जेण पिया न य सोगं,गच्छइ एगं पि य मुहुत्तं"
english: "To fall asleep is to fall asleep! To think that this is the appointed time, To drink that which does not grieve, Is to pass away in a moment." ""

prakrit: "जाव च्चिय एस कहा,वट्टइ परिसाणुरञ्जणी ताव,पत्तो भरहकुमारो,संवेगमणो पिउसगासं"
english: "Go - between! It's like saying:" "The wind whirls around, The breeze stirs, The leaves twitch, The wind hastens." ""

prakrit: "भणिओ य दसरहेणं,वच्छ! तुमं होहि रज्जसाहारो,अयं पुण निस्सङ्गो,जिणवरदिक्खं पवज्जामि"
english: "Say:" "It's Dussehra, you bastard! You're the messenger. Once again I'm off guard. I promise I'll see you again." ""

prakrit: "सो भणइ नत्थि कजं,रज्जेण महं करेमि पवजं,मा तिबदुक्खपउरे,ताय! भमिस्सामि संसारे"
english: "She says," "No, I won't. I'll do it for the love of my life." "But don't be so hasty: I am wasting away in trouble."

prakrit: "अणुभवसु पुत्त! सोक्खं,सारं माणुस्सयस्स जम्मस्स,ता पच्छिमम्मि काले,जिणवरदिक्खं करेज्जासि"
english: "Feel free, son! All human life comes to a standstill. In due course you will see life in the west." ""

prakrit: "पुणरवि एव पवुत्तो,भरहो किं ताय मोहसि अकज्जे?,न य बाल-विद्ध-तरुणं,मच्चू पडिवालई कोई"
english: "Once again, you fool, Are you completely captivated?" asked the young man, Not so much by hair as by a fair skin.

prakrit: "गेहासमे वि धम्मो,पुत्त! महागुणयरो समक्खाओ,तम्हा गिहिधम्मरओ,होहि तुमं सयलरज्जवई"
english: "Dharma in Gehasa too, my son! Great virtues, righteous deeds, Your arrows are fierce. Maybe you will be enlightened." ""

prakrit: "जइ लहइ मुत्तिसोक्खं,पुरिसो गिहधम्मसंठिओ सन्तो,तो कीस मुञ्चसि तुमं,गेहं संसारपरिभीओ?"
english: "If you desire to attain enlightenment, If men desire purity, Why are you averse? I am afraid of the world."

prakrit: "मोत्तूण सयणवगं,धण-धन्नं मायरं च पियरं च,सुह-दुक्खं वेयन्तो,एगागी हिण्डइ जीवो"
english: "A pearl is like a pearl, Wealth is like rice and pearls, Kindness is like sharing a sorrow: This is the way of life in India."

prakrit: "सुणिऊण पुत्तवयणं,परितुट्ठो दसरहो भणइ एवं,साहु त्ति साहु अहियं,पडिबुद्धो भवियसठूलो"
english: "Listening is a child's play, Speaking is sweet when spoken to, And speaking is salutary when endured; The bow is firmly rooted in the heart."

prakrit: "तह वि तुमे मह वयणं,पुत्तय! कायवयं अविमणेणं,निसुणेहि कहिज्जन्तं,भूयत्थं सारसब्भावं"
english: "There you are, my son, Saying the words:" "Never mind the words." "The earth is full of them."

prakrit: "सारत्थतोसिएणं,संगामे जो वरो मए दिन्नो,सो अज्ज तुज्झ पुत्तय! जणणीए मग्गिओ इहई"
english: "Dear friend, The wedding dress I gave you today belongs to you, my son. Please, lady, give it to me instead." ""

prakrit: "रजे ठवेहि पुत्तं,भणिओ हं केगईऎ देवीए,तो अणुवालेहि तुमं,सयलसमत्थं इमं वसुहं"
english: "My son, tell me, Have you ever been angry with a goddess? I will always be with you."

prakrit: "पउमो वि तं कुमारं,हत्थे घेत्तूण भणइ नेहेणं,निक्कण्टयमणुकूलं,करेहि रज्जं सुचिरकालं"
english: "Aunt, even he is a little boy; When he touches you, he speaks gently; When you approach him, he acts just like a doe."

prakrit: "तायस्स विमलकित्ती,करेहि परिवालणं च जणणीए,भरहेण य पडिभणिओ,न य तुज्झ वइक्कमं काहं"
english: "You fool, Do what you have to say, And speak plainly. For no one will tell you the truth."

prakrit: "अडविनईसु गिरीसु य,तत्था''वासं करेमि एयन्ते,जह मे न मुणइ कोई,कुणसु य रजं सुचिरकालं"
english: "I will abide so long as no one troubles me: It is the good times of the king That I desire to spend."

prakrit: "भणिऊण वयणमेयं,पणमिय पिउपायपङ्कए सिरसा,रामो वरगयगामी,विणिग्गओ रायपरिसाओ"
english: "Tell me, young and handsome, That my husband is on his way home, That Rama is walking on level ground, That wiles are flowing through the streets."

prakrit: "एत्थन्तरम्मि मुच्छा,राया गन्तूण तत्थ पडिबुद्धो,नज्जइ आलेक्खगओ,अणिमिसनयणो पलोएइ"
english: "Here is my mustache, There is no cause for regret, Then I'll cover it with bandages, Then write it down, Then forget about it."

prakrit: "गन्तूण निययजेणणी,आउच्छइ राहवो कयषणामो,अम्मो! वच्चामि अहं,दूरपवासं खमेज्जासु"
english: "Destination is destiny, The arrow is on its way, Mother! I am on my way. Forgive me the distance." ""

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,सहसा तो मुच्छिऊण पडिबुद्धा,भणइ सुयं रोवन्ती,पुत्तय! किं मे परिच्चयसि?"
english: "Listening to my speech, Suddenly he grinned, Then he muttered," "My son, I'm crying. Are you familiar with me?" ""

prakrit: "कह कह वि अणाहाए,लद्धो सि मणोरहेहि बहुएहिं,होहिसि पुत्ता''लम्बो,पारोहो चेव साहाए"
english: "No matter how hard you try, you'll only get away with it, my son," he said. "Long live your son, The arrows of the God of Love always help him."

prakrit: "भरहस्स मही दिन्ना,ताएणं केगईवरनिमित्तं,सन्तेण मए नेच्छइ,एस कुमारो महिं भोत्तु"
english: "Hope makes one rejoice, For what use is a coward's sake? One who loves me longs for peace Would rather forget me, son."

prakrit: "दिक्खाभिमुहो राया,पुत्तय! दूरं तुमं पि वञ्चिहिसि,पइ-पुत्तविरहिया इह,कं सरणमहं पवज्जामि?"
english: "Foolish face, Raya, my son! You live far away, My son, I am separated from you. Which stream should I follow?" ""

prakrit: "विझगिरिमत्थए वा,मलए वा सायरस्स वा''सन्ने,काऊण पइट्ठाणं,तुज्झ फुडं आगमिस्से हइं"
english: "Vizagirimathay va, malaye va sairas va sanane, kaun paithan... Your feet are bound to fall." ""

prakrit: "जणणीऎ सिरपणामं,काऊणं सेसमाइवग्गस्स,पुणरवि य नरवरिन्दं,पणमइ रामो गमणसज्जो"
english: "Mother - in - law, Give birth to a male child, Try to conceal it with your hands, Use your hands again and again, For Rama is dear to all men."

prakrit: "आपुच्छिया य सबे,पुरोहिया-'मच्च-बन्धवा सुहडा,रह-गय-तुरङ्गमा वि य,पलोइया निद्धदिट्ठीए"
english: "All of you, priest -" "My dear, friends, Be careful not to fall into the trap of delusion." ""

prakrit: "चाउवण्णं च जणं,आपुच्छेऊण निग्गओ रामो,वइदेही वि य ससुरं,पणमइ परमेण विणएणं"
english: "Only a clever man, Only Rama can stop you, Not even his mother - in - law. But let God make a good man."

prakrit: "सवाण सासुयाणं,काऊणं चलणवन्दणं सीया,सहियायणं च निययं,आपुच्छिय निग्गया एत्तो"
english: "Mother - in - law is kind, Kindness is affectionate, Friendship is lawful, This is how you manage to escape"

prakrit: "गन्तूण समाढत्तं,रामं दट्टण लक्खणो रुट्ठो,ताएण अयसबहुलं,कह एयं पत्थियं कज्जं?"
english: "Destiny is supreme, The path to Rama is paved with thickets, Therefore it is arduous; Where is the use of such a path?"

prakrit: "एत्थ नरिन्दाण जए,परिवाडोआगयं हवइ रजं,विवरीयं चिय रइयं,ताएण अदीहपेहीणं"
english: "Here lives Narinda, In front of his family resides the king, And elsewhere lives Chi, So that there is no longer any love."

prakrit: "रामस्स को गुणाणं,अन्तं पावेइ धीरगरुयस्स?,लोभेण जस्स रहियं,चित्तं चिय मुणिवरस्सेव"
english: "Virtuous are the virtues of Ramasa, Are you patient to the end?, Jealousy prevails, The mind is dominated by greed." ""

prakrit: "अहवा रज्जधुरधर,सबं फेडेमि अज्ज भरहस्स,ठावेमि कुलाणीए,पुहइवइं आसणे रामं"
english: "Ahava raja dhurudhara, sab fedemi aaj bharahasa, thavemi kulaniye, puhaiyavi asane Rama." ""

prakrit: "एएण किं व मज्झं,हवइ वियारेण ववसिएण'जं?,नवरं पुण तच्चत्थं,ताओ जेट्ठो य जाणन्ति"
english: "What is the use of saying:" "It's going to be like that?" "When the wind blows, You already know what it means."

prakrit: "कोवं च उवसमेउं,पणमिय पियरं परेण विणएणं,आपुच्छइ दढचित्तो,सोमित्ती अत्तणो जणणी"
english: "Wretched woman, I beg of you, If you wish to weep and wail, You'd better watch out. Anyway, my dear, It's the wife who gives birth."

prakrit: "संभासिऊण भिच्चे,वज्जावत्तं च धणुवरं घेत्तु,घणपीइसंपउत्तो,पउमसयासं समल्लीणो"
english: "Trembling monk, Taking the bow and arrow with him, Thinking how well he can lift it, Assumes the farmer." ""

prakrit: "पियरेण बन्धवेहि य,सामन्तसएसु परिमिया सन्ता,रायभवणाउ एत्तो,विणिग्गया सुरकुमार व"
english: "Dear friends, these are the ways of a decent man; A pariah is a saintly man; The royal palace is like this: The seller is a handsome man." ""

prakrit: "सुयसोगतावियाओ,धरणियलोसित्तअंसुनिवहाओ,कह कह वि पणमिऊणं,नियत्तियाओ य जणणीओ"
english: "Proud women, Sitting on the ground laughing, Paying attention to what one has to offer, Destiny prevails and so do women."

prakrit: "काऊण सिरपणामं,नियत्तिओ दसरहो य रामेणं,सहवड्डिया य बन्धू,कलुणपलावं च कुणमाणा"
english: "Who is worthy of the title, Destiny or Rama, Friend or foe, Calumny or good manners?"

prakrit: "जंपन्ति एक्कमेकं,एस पुरी जइ वि जणवयाइण्णा,जाया रामविओए,दीसइ विझाडवी चेव"
english: "Jumpenti ekemeke, es puri," "If I give birth to a girl, I will sacrifice her." ""

prakrit: "लोगो वि उस्सुयमणो,जंपइ धन्ना इमा जणयधूया,जा वच्चइ परदेसं,रामेण समं महामहिला"
english: "People are also jealous. Happy is the bridegroom's name. Going abroad is like following the path of love: Rama is a great woman."

prakrit: "नयणजलसित्तगत्तं,पेच्छय जणणिं इमं पमोत्तूणं,चलिओ रामेण समं,एसो च्चिय लक्खणकुमारो"
english: "See how the river flows, See how people fondle it, Walk on equal footing with Rama; Such is the way of a virtuous son."

prakrit: "तेसु कुमारेसु समं,सामन्तजणेण वच्चमाणेणं,सुन्ना साएयपुरी,जाया छणवज्जिया तइया"
english: "Teasu kumaresu saman, Samantar janena vachamanemane, sunna sayyapuri, jaya chanavajjya taiya"

prakrit: "न नियत्तइ नयरजणो,धाडिज्जन्तो वि दण्डपुरिसेहिं,ताव य दिवसवसाणे,सूरो अत्थं समल्लीणो"
english: "It is not destined to be so, my dear, For even a damned man can be punished, So when the day is almost over, The sun always rises."

prakrit: "नयरीऎ मज्झयारे,दिहँ चिय जिणहरं मणभिरामं,हरिसियरोमञ्चइया,तत्थ पविट्ठा परमतुट्ठा"
english: "Women, my dear, The passion of love, Which is so pure And so pure, Is the supreme delight of women."

prakrit: "थोऊण अच्चिऊण य,जिणपडिमाओ परेण भावेणं,तत्थेव सन्निविट्ठा,समयं चिय जणसमूहेणं"
english: "The moment one thinks of it, The next moment one feels it: Time is fleeting, People gather around one another."

prakrit: "ते तत्थ वरकुमारा,वसिया सोऊण ताण जणणीहिं,आगन्तूण जिणहरे,दोहिं वि पुत्ता समागूढा"
english: "There the young bridegroom is, Stretching her arms round him, Visiting guests triumphantly, And the two sons gather."

prakrit: "सवाण वि सुद्धीणं,मणसुद्धी चेव उत्तमा लोए,आलिङ्गइ भत्तारं,भावेण'न्नेण पुत्तं च"
english: "Everything is pure, Everything is beautiful in this world: Love embraces everything, Love destroys everything."

prakrit: "पुत्तेहि समं ताओ,सम्मन्तेऊण पडिणियत्ताओ,डोलावियहिययाओ,दंइयसमीवं उवगयाओ"
english: "Be equal to your son, be equal to him, be fair, be reasonable, and act just like him."

prakrit: "नमिऊण य भत्तारं,भणन्ति रामं ससीय-सोमित्तिं,पल्लट्टेहि महाजस! मा उवेयं कुणसु धीर?"
english: "Namun ya bhataram, they say Rama is sasya - somitim, The great men are everywhere! So why are you so stubborn?" ""

prakrit: "तो भणइ दसरहनिवो,न य मे इह अस्थि किंचि सायत्तं,जं जस्स पुवविहियं,तं तस्स नरस्स उवणमइ"
english: "So you might say," "Happy Dussehra!" "But that doesn't mean I've lost any of my bones."

prakrit: "ववगयरज्जभरो ह,विरओ पावस्स संजमाभिमुहो,न य नज्जइ के वेलं,मुणिवरचरियं पवजामि"
english: "Wretched fire, Destroyed water, Facing the arrow of nature. No need to hurry. For sages take refuge in the moon." ""

prakrit: "एवं नरिन्दो जिणसासणुज्जओ,अहो य राओ य सिवाभिलासिणो,सुहं पबुद्धो मिह भवकेसरी,विमुत्तिमग्गे विमले सुहालए"
english: "And Narindo knows how to live, Oh! this Rao, this man of simple speech, Such an enlightened man, My lover, May the Vimutimagga delight in his pleasure."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए दसरहपव्वज्जानिच्छयविहाणो नाम एकतीसइमो उद्देसओ समत्तो"
english: "This is the name given to the festival of Dussehra By the wishful thinking of my husband: Thirty-one is enough for my purposes."

prakrit: "अह तत्थ जिणाययणे,निदं गमिऊण अड्डरत्तम्मि,लोगे सुत्तपसुत्ते,नीसंचारे विगयसद्दे"
english: "Ah, the jinxes there, The twists and turns of sleep, People swooning all over, The wiles of the wise."

prakrit: "घेत्तु धणुवररयणं,सीयासहिया जिणं नमंसित्ता,सणियं विणिग्गया ते,दो चेव जणं पलोयन्ता"
english: "Catch a hunter with a bow, Catch him with a spear, Make him bow before him, And let him pursue after him: Two savages."

prakrit: "को वेत्थ सुरयखीणो,गाढं उवगूहिउं सुवइ कन्तं,पुवं कयावराहो,अन्नो महिलं पसाएइ"
english: "Who is this woman looking at the mirror? How come she can hardly look at you when you are standing by And how come you refuse to look at her?"

prakrit: "परगेहं,गन्तूणं कुच्चिएसु अङ्गेसु,उवासइ मज्जार,जालगवक्खन्तरे धुत्तो"
english: "Traveler, Destroy a bunch of grasshoppers, Wash the roots of a mango, And wipe them with a net."

prakrit: "अन्नो सुन्नाययणे,संकेययदिन्नकन्नसब्भावो,अहियं आकुलियमणो,कुणइ निविटुट्ठियं पुरिसो"
english: "Aunt, If you hear a sound coming from the ear, It indicates that something is amiss, Please, please, make sure you do not hear it again"

prakrit: "एयं चिय सुणमाणा,पेच्छन्ता जणवयस्स विणिओगं,अह निग्गया पुरीओ,सणियं ते गूढदारेणं"
english: "Here's a good man, Looking down the road at his wife's breasts, Running out of things to hide." ""

prakrit: "अवरदिसं वच्चन्ता,दिट्ठा सुहडेहि मग्गमाणेहिं,गन्तूण पणमिया ते,भावेण ससेन्नसहिएहिं"
english: "Our days are fleeting, Our sights are set on a pleasant destination, Our business is transacted elsewhere, And our feelings are constantly renewed."

prakrit: "सीहा सहावमन्थरगईऎ,सणियं तु तत्थ नरवसहा,गाऊयमेत्तठाणं,वच्चन्ति सुहं बलसमग्गा"
english: "The lion has crossed the threshold, my dear, you are a nervous man at that moment, My husband is at hand, I am returning with full force."

prakrit: "गामेसु पट्टणेसु य,पूइज्जन्ता जणेण बहुएणं,पेच्छन्ति वच्चमाणा,खेड-मडम्बा-''गरं वसुहं"
english: "In the village, You go to the streets, Worship one's elder brother, You visit another, Play - The drum -" "The village is empty." ""

prakrit: "अह ते कमेण पत्ता,हरि-गय-रुरु-चमर-सरहसद्दालं,घणपायवसंछन्नं,अडविं चिय पारियत्तस्स"
english: "Oh! it is a lotus leaf, Hari - gayya - ruru - chamara - the border of the plain, thickly covered with bees, Like a vast expanse of forest."

prakrit: "पेच्छन्ति तत्थ भीमा,बहुगाहसमाउला जलसमिद्धा,गम्भीरा नाम नदी,कल्लोलुच्छलियसंघाया"
english: "They see Bhima there, The vast expanse of water, The river named Gambhira, The confluences of the rocky slopes."

prakrit: "तो राघवेण भणिया,सुहडा सबइ वि साहणसमग्गा,तुम्हे नियत्तियवं,एयं रणं महाभीमं"
english: "So Raghavan said:" "All is well, my friend, I can bear it all. Destiny awaits you; this is the greatness of the forest." ""

prakrit: "ताएण भरहसामी,ठविओ रज्जम्मि सयलपुहईए,गच्छामि दाहिणपहं,अवस्स तुब्भे नियत्तेह"
english: "So bear with me, Stop dragging me down the rafters. I'll be right there with you. It's your destiny." ""

prakrit: "अह ते भणन्ति सुहडा,सामि! तमे विरहियाण किं अम्हं,रज्जेण साहणेण य,विविहेण य देहसोक्खेणं?"
english: "Oh! they say,'Well - done, Sammy! Are you parting ways with me? Or are you sharing a pastime, Or enjoying the pleasures of separation?" ""

prakrit: "सीह-'च्छभल्ल-चित्तय-घणपायव-गिरिवराउले रणे,समयं तुमे वसामो,कुणसु दयं असरणाण'म्हं"
english: "In winter, when the trees are in bloom, You take your time, For I will never forget how kind you were."

prakrit: "आउच्छिऊण सुहडे,सीयं भुयावग्र̥हियं काउं,रामो उत्तरइ नइं,गम्भीरं लक्खणसमग्गो"
english: "Come, my dear, I have to go to bed early. Ram won't answer. It's more like a miracle." ""

prakrit: "रामं सलक्खणं ते,परतीरावट्ठियं पलोएउं,हाहारवं करेन्ता,सबइ वि भडा पडिनियत्ता"
english: "If you want to please Rama, Follow the path shown by his wife, Wait till you see her again. Everything goes smoothly."

prakrit: "तेहि नियत्तेहि तहिं,दि८ चिय जिणहरं महातुङ्गं,समणेहि संपरिवुडं,तत्थ पविट्ठा सुहडसीहा"
english: "There it is, Destiny there, The great night sky above, Friendship everywhere, Then purity prevails."

prakrit: "काऊण नमोक्कारं,जिणपडिमाणं विसुद्धभावेणं,पणमन्ति मुणिवरिन्दे,अणुपरिवाडीऎ तिविहेणं"
english: "Who is worthless, Whom do you worship, And how do you treat others?"

prakrit: "पुच्छन्ति साहवं ते,भयवं! संसारसायरं भीमं,उत्तारेहि महाजस! अम्हे जिणधम्मपोएणं"
english: "They ask how I am, they scare me! The Creator of all worlds is Bhima, The Great One is above us! We have to go on living." ""

prakrit: "तो साहवेण धम्मो,कहिओ संखेवओ जिणुट्ठिओ,जह तक्खणेण जाया,संवेगपरायणा बहवे"
english: "So help me dharma, Tell me, my dear, How long will you suffer? Let the passion flow, As if by accident."

prakrit: "निद्दड्डो विजओ वि य,मेहकुमारो तहेव रणलोलो,नागदमणो य बीरो,सढो य सत्तूदमधरो य"
english: "Though sleepy, Though triumphant, Though full of glory, As if on fire, As though possessed by a serpent, Even as though possessed of power."

prakrit: "तह ककडो विणोओ,सबो पियवद्धणो कढोरो य,एवंविहा नरिन्दा,निग्गन्थसिरी समणुपत्ता"
english: "There's the cucumber, The cucumbers are everywhere, Everyone is drunk, And everyone is busy making love."

prakrit: "अन्ने पुण गिहधम्म,घेत्तूण नराहिवा विसयहुत्ता,पत्ता साएयपुरी,भरहस्स फुडं निवेएन्ति"
english: "On the other hand, full dharma, piercing fire, Visayahutta, leaf, full moon, fills the heart with energy."

prakrit: "सीया-लक्खणसहिओ,न नियत्तो राघवो गओ रण्णं,सोऊण वयणमेयं,भरहो अइदुक्खिओ जाओ"
english: "Friend, destiny does not favour Raghava. Go to the forest, sleep on the river bank, be careful not to fall into it." ""

prakrit: "तो दसरहो वि राया,पुत्तविओए अईवसंविग्गो,ठावेइ तक्खणं चिय,विसए रज्जाहिवं भरहं"
english: "So, even on the tenth day, My son, I promise you, You will make it through all the days. I will fill your heart with wisdom."

prakrit: "संवेगजणियकरणो,भडाण बावत्तरीऎ समसहिओ,दिक्खं गओ नरिन्दो,पासे च्चिय भूयसरणस्स"
english: "Get your emotions out of the way, you silly messenger, Go and see Narindo, he's got an earthworm next to him."

prakrit: "तत्थ वि एगविहारी,अणरण्णसुओ तवं पकुवन्तो,मणसा दूमियहियओ,पुत्तसिणेहं समुबहइ"
english: "There also the traveler is uneasy, The sleeper is in a hurry, The man is distressed. I will gather the remains of my son."

prakrit: "अह अन्नयो कयाई,धीरो आरुहिय सुहयरं झाणं,चिन्तेइ तो मणेणं,नेहो च्चिय बन्धणं गाढं"
english: "Oh! what a stranger you are, A man who finds pleasure in being courteous, Who, when he thinks of something, Takes it to heart, And whose bonds are deep."

prakrit: "धण-सयण-पुत्त-दारा,जे अन्नभवेसु आसि णेगविहा,ते कत्थ गया'णाईसंसारे परिभमन्तस्स"
english: "Daughter - in - law, Dara - daara - One who is fond of food Has gone abroad." "Where is the need to travel all the time?"

prakrit: "परिभुत्तं विसयसुहं,सुरलोए वरबिमाणवसहीसु,नरयाणलदाहा चिय,संपत्ता भोगहेउम्मि"
english: "Traveling is a pleasure for many, Traveling with pleasure is like riding a shipwreck: I take pleasure in the fresh waters of the Naryana River, And wealth is my delight."

prakrit: "अन्नोन्नभक्खणं पुण,तिरिक्खजोणीसु समणुभूयं मे,पुढवि-जल-जलण-मारुय भमिओ य वणस्सईसु चिरं"
english: "Eager to feast again, Thinking how happy I am To see my wife again, As if I were burning the forest - The land is burning with fire And the forest is empty."

prakrit: "मणुयत्तणे वि भोगा,भुत्ता संजोय-विप्पओगा य,बहुरोग-सोगमाई,बन्धवनेहाणुरत्तेणं"
english: "Human beings suffer too, Ghosts rejoice - they break down, Many suffer - they are grief - stricken, Friendships turn upside down."

prakrit: "तम्हा पुत्तसिणेहं,एयं छड्डेमि दोसआमूलं,मुणिवरदिटेण पुणो,झाणेण मणं विसोहेमि"
english: "Your son, I am leaving you. I will leave you because of your faults. By showing you kindnesses I will restore your reputation. By making you look good I will make you feel good."

prakrit: "विविहं तवं करेन्तो,अहियासेन्तो परीसहे सवे,दसरहमुणी महप्पा,विहरइ एगन्तदेसेसु"
english: "He does all kinds of things, Everyone loves a stranger, The great sage is generous with gifts, And he travels extensively."

prakrit: "पुत्तेसु पर विएस,गएसु अवराइया य सोमित्ती,भत्तारे पवइए,सोयसमुद्दम्मि पडियाओ"
english: "Sit on my son's lap, Wait till he recovers, Then take a bath, Then lie down on the river bank." ""

prakrit: "सुयसोगदुक्खियाओ,ताओ दट्ठण केगई देवी,तो भणइ निययपुत्तं,वयणमिणं मे निसामेहि"
english: "Sufferers alone, For when they see you They think you are gods; When they speak you are doomed."

prakrit: "निक्कण्टयमणुकूलं,पुत्त! तुमे पावियं महारजं,पउमेण लक्खणेण य,रहियं न य सोहए एयं"
english: "Thanks for the compliment, my son! You silly lord. Please, my dear, stop being so touchy That you don't enjoy it at all." ""

prakrit: "ताणं चिय जणणीओ,पुत्तविओगम्मि जायदुक्खाओ,काहिन्ति मा हु कालं,आणेहि लहुं वरकुमारे"
english: "My son, If you give birth to a girl child Who is poor Does not last long. Let the bridegroom come."

prakrit: "जणणीऎ वयणमेयं,सुणिऊण तुरंगमं समारूढो,तूरन्तो च्चिय भरहो,ताणं अणुमग्गओ लग्गो"
english: "When a woman speaks, When she hears a trumpet Sound, She takes it with her heart."

prakrit: "इय दिट्ठा वि य समयं,महिलाए ते कुमारवरसीहा,पुच्छन्तो पहियजणं,बच्चइ भरहो पवणवेगो"
english: "When he sees her, The woman replies:" "She's a virgin." "When she asks who he is, He says he's pregnant."

prakrit: "अह ते नईऎ तीरे,वीसममाणा महावणे भीमे,सीयाऎ समं पेच्छइ,भरहो पासत्थवरधणुया"
english: "Oh! it is a new shore, Like the great river in summer, Like a river in spate, Like an overflowing torrent."

prakrit: "बहुयदिवसेसु देसो,जो वोलीणो कुमारसीहेहिं,सो भरहेण पवन्नो,दियहेहिं छहि अयत्तेणं"
english: "Behold the landowner's son, Who after many days Was born a virgin, Has grown very thin On account of his wealth."

prakrit: "सो चक्खुगोयराओ,तुरयं मोत्तण केगईपुत्तो,चलणेसु पउमणाहं,पणमिय मुच्छं समणुपत्तो"
english: "So you stupid cowards, Why waste your time picking pearls? Let the water flow through your ears And smear your face with lotus flowers."

prakrit: "पडिबोहिओ य भरहो,रामेणालिङ्गिओ सिणेहेणं,सीयाऎ लक्खणेण य,बाढं संभासिओ विहिणा"
english: "Fallen trees are a source of pride, The langurs of the Ramna are a passion, The steps are a symptom, The paths are difficult to traverse."

prakrit: "भरहो नमियसरीरो,काऊण सिरञ्जलिं भणइ रामं,रजं करेहि सुपुरिस! सयलं आणागुणविसालं"
english: "Dear lord, Who is so modest As to utter a word of sarcasm When addressed by Rama? Your Majesty is right! A smooth and harmonious marriage is on the cards." ""

prakrit: "अहयं धरेमि छत्तं,चामरधारो य हवइ सत्तुं जो,लच्छीहरो य मन्ती,तुज्झ'न्नं सुविहियं किं वा?"
english: "I have a roof, Leathery or the power of the wind, Lucky or the mind; What is the use of your good news?"

prakrit: "जाव इमो आलावो,वट्टइ तावं रहेण तुरन्तीं,तं चेव समुद्देसं,संपत्ता केगई देवी"
english: "Go away, Emo, go away, stay where you are for the moment, serve the community, become a god of wealth."

prakrit: "ओयरिय रहवराओ,पउमं आलिङ्गिऊण रोवन्ती,संभासेइ कमेणं,सीयासहियं च सोमित्तिं"
english: "Be nice to each other, hug your wife, cry, make love, and sleep peacefully."

prakrit: "तो केगई पवुत्ता,पुत्त,! विणीयापुरिम्मि वच्चामो,रज्जं करेहि निययं,भरहो वि य सिक्खणीओ ते"
english: "So how naïve a person is! My son, I've learned to play the flute, To play the drums, To be faithful and to learn." ""

prakrit: "महिला सहावचवला,अदीहपेही सहावमाइल्ला,तं मे खमाहि पुत्तय! जं पडिकूलं कयं तुज्झ"
english: "A woman is a companion, A man is a neighbor, And a daughter is a guest. What do you think you are doing wrong?" ""

prakrit: "तो भणइ पउमणाहो,अम्मो! किं खत्तिया अलियवाई,होन्ति महाकुलजाया? तम्हा भरहो कुणउ रजं"
english: "So he says," "My daughter - in - law, Amma! What are you talking about? It's the great festival of Holi? Your husband is a king." ""

prakrit: "तत्थेव काणणवणे,पच्चक्खं सबनरवरिन्दाणं,भरहं ठवेइ रजे,रामो सोमित्तिणा सहिओ"
english: "There must be something about the sight of the God of Love, That makes all eyes turn their backs on him, That keeps the nights short."

prakrit: "नमिऊण केगईए,भुयासु उवगूहिउं भरहसामि,अह ते सीयासहिया,संभासिय सबसामन्ते"
english: "I will trust in him, If he refuses to budge He will bow before me, If I refuse to bow before him, And if I refuse, He will betray me."

prakrit: "दक्खिणदेसाभिमुहा,चलिया भरहो वि निययपुरहुत्तो,पत्तो करेइ रजं,इन्दो जह देवनयरीए"
english: "The south faces the sun, Though it is full of clouds It passes through due course, But the king's name is Indu, Like the God of Love."

prakrit: "सो एरिसम्मि रज्जे,न करेइ धिई खणं पि सोएणं,नवरं पुण अङ्गसुहं,हवइ च्चिय जिणपणामेणं"
english: "That's the way it is. Don't go to bed early. You'll have a good time again. It's only because you know how to live."

prakrit: "भरहो जिणिन्दभवणं,वन्दणहेउं गओ सपरिवारो,थोऊण पेच्छइ मुणी,नामेण जुई सह गणेणं"
english: "Fill your heart with gratitude, Go and greet your family members, Be attentive to what the sage says, And count your name among the jewels."

prakrit: "भरहो नमिऊण मुणी,तस्स य पुरओ अभिग्गहं धीरो,गेण्हइ रामदरिसणे,पवज्जा हं करिस्सामि"
english: "My lord, I bow before you, O sage, With all my might: I pledge allegiance to you, Lord Rama."

prakrit: "भरहेण धम्मनिहसं,समणो परिपुच्छिओ भणइ एवं,जाव य न एइ रामो,ताव गिहत्थो कुणसु धम्मं"
english: "When he speaks, I speak in the Dhamma, When I speak, He speaks in the Prakrit language :'No, Ram has not come. So who is afraid of Dharma?'"

prakrit: "अञ्चन्तदुद्धरधरा,चरिया निग्गन्थमहरिसीणं तु,परिकम्मविसुद्धस्स उ,होही सुहसाहणा नियमा"
english: "Steady stream of tears, Thinking thou hast walked the tightrope, A steady stream of pleasures: This is the law of happiness."

prakrit: "रयणद्दीवम्मि गओ,गेण्हइ एक पि जो महारयणं,तं तस्स इहाणीयं,महग्घमोल्लं हवइ लोए"
english: "Go to the rainbow: There must be someone who knows what it is to be a great king; he must have something valuable."

prakrit: "जिणधम्मरयणदीवे,जइ नियममणिं लएइ एक पि,तं तस्स अणग्वेयं,होही पुण्णं परभवम्मि"
english: "Jinns and fairies, Whatever rule one adopts, That one should avoid it: It is the supreme good."

prakrit: "पढममहिंसारयणं,गेण्हेउं जो जिणं समन्चेइ,सो भुञ्जइ सुरलोए,इण्दियसोक्खं अणोवमियं"
english: "First violence, then pride, And the one who conquers victory, Then confusion, Then the pleasures of love."

prakrit: "सच्चबयनियमधरो,जो पूयइ जिणवरं पयत्तेणं,सो होइ महुरवयणो भुञ्जइ य परंपरसुहाइं"
english: "A true woman is one who worships nature, Who takes care of living beings, Who in turn cherishes the pleasures of love and tradition."

prakrit: "परिहरिऊण अदत्तं,जो जिणनाहस्स कुणइ वरपूयं,सो नवनिहीण सामी,होही मणि-रयणपुण्णाणं"
english: "The incompetent traveler, Who begets jealousy, Is a novice sage: Such is the perfection of wisdom."

prakrit: "परनारीसु पसङ्गं,न कुणइ जो जिणमयासिओ पुरिसो,सो पावइ सोहग्गं,नयणाणन्दो वरतणूणं"
english: "Love based on pretence, Not based on whimsicality, Is a pleasure to be had, Use of subtlety is bliss"

prakrit: "संतोसवयामूलं,धारइ य जिणिन्दवयणकयभावो,सो विविहधणसमिद्धो,होइ नरो सबजणपुज्जो"
english: "Because of contentment, The stream is alive And the rivers are moist. It is full of diversities. Either they are to be worshipped or they are not."

prakrit: "आहारपयाणेणं,जायइ भोगस्स आलओ निययं,जइ वि य जाइ विएसं,तहवि य सोक्खं हवइ तस्स"
english: "Eating food, going on a pastime, are the rules; whatever the circumstances, they bring happiness."

prakrit: "अभयषयाणेण नरो,जायइ भयवजिओ निरोगो य,नाणस्स पयाणेणं,सबकलापारओ होइ"
english: "Be careful not to fall into temptation, For if you are afraid you will be safe, For wisdom's sake, All art transcendent."

prakrit: "आहारवज्जणं जो,करेइ रयणीसु जिणमयाभिमुहो,आरम्भपवत्तो वि य,लहइ नरो सो वि सुगइपहं"
english: "One who gathers nourishment, Who gathers it from the mouth of the God of Love, Even after it has begun, Is unable to enjoy it."

prakrit: "अरहन्तनमोक्कारं,तिण्णि वि काले करेइ जो पुरिसो,तस्स बहुयं पि पावं,नासइ वरसुद्धभावस्स"
english: "Non - violent lovers, All three of you do what men do in time, Too much of it is gain, Not worth it."

prakrit: "जल-थलयसुरहिनिम्मलकुसुमेसु य जो जिणं समच्चेइ,सो दिवविमाणठिओ,कीलइ पवरच्छराहि समं"
english: "One who conquers life through the pleasures of the water - dish and the scent of nectar - Like the rays of a rainbow on a keel."

prakrit: "भावकुसुमेसु निययं,विमलेसु जिणं समच्चए जो उ,सो होइ सुन्दरतणू,लोए पूयारिहो पुरिसो"
english: "Destiny leads to happiness, To abundance leads to prosperity, To wealth is beauty, To the world we all want to live in Is poverty."

prakrit: "धूयं अगरु-तुरुक्कं,कुंकुम-वरचन्दणं जिणवरस्स,जो देइ भावियमई,सो सुरहिसुरो समुब्भवइ"
english: "The flame is agaru - turukkam, the vermilion - sandalwood paste, The one who gives it to the future mother, She attains auspiciousness."

prakrit: "जो जिणभवणे दीवं,देइ नरो तिवभावसंजुत्तो,सो दिणयरसमतेओ,देवो उप्पज्जइ विमाणे"
english: "One who gives life to a living being, Who gives energy to a lamp, Gives energy to the lamp; Even in the midst of a fire, God is kindled."

prakrit: "छत्तं चमर-पेडाया,दप्पण-लम्बूसया वियाणं च,जो देइ जिणाययणे,सो परमसिरिं समुबहइ"
english: "The roof is made of flint, The lamp is held aloft, And the wind is blowing; The one who conquers the day Gives the supreme victory."

prakrit: "गन्धेहि जिणवरतणू,जो हु समालभइ भावियमईओ,सो सुरभिगन्धपउरे,रमइ विमाणे सुचिरकालं"
english: "The scent of the fragrant flowers, Which I cherish for the rest of my life, Makes me feel good When I'm in a plane."

prakrit: "काऊण जिणवराणं,अभिसेयं सुरहिगन्धसलिलेणं,सो पावइ अभिसेयं,उप्पज्जइ जत्थ जत्थ नरो"
english: "One must learn to weep, One must savor the fragrance of ecstasy, Another must practice penance, Each time one prays the other way."

prakrit: "खीरेण नो'भिसेयं,कुणइ जिणिन्दस्स भत्तिराएणं,सो खीरविमलधवले,रमइ विमाणे सुचिरकालं"
english: "A cucumber does not boil, A worm bites a worm, A bowl of milk melts, And a good time is had in a plane."

prakrit: "दहिकुम्भेसु जिणं जो,एहवेइ दहिकोट्टिमे सुरविमाणे,उप्पज्जइ लच्छिधरो,देवो दिवेण रूवेणं"
english: "He who conquers the fire of the south pole, Like a flame in a fire pit, Scorches the lakeshore with lightning; May the gods weep for the lamp."

prakrit: "एत्तो घियाभिसेयं,जो कुणइ जिणेसरस्स पययमणो,सो होइ सुरहिदेहो,सुरपवरो वरविमाणम्मि"
english: "Such an arrogant woman, One who acts as though she were possessed by a demon, Would be a happy woman, If only there were more beautiful women."

prakrit: "अभिसेयपभावेणं,बहवे सुवन्ति'णन्तविरियाई,लद्धाहिसेयरिद्धी,सुरवरसोक्खं अणुहवन्ति"
english: "They sway in ecstasy, Swirl around silently, Reach for the pleasures of love and affection."

prakrit: "भत्तीऎ निवेयणयं,बलिं च जो जिणहरे पउञ्जेइ,परमविभूई पावई,आरोग्गं चेव सो पुरिसो"
english: "Purify the poor with penance, Sacrifice and sacrifice That find their place in the pantheon, Praise be to the health of the soul."

prakrit: "गन्धव-तूर-नटं,जो कुणइ महुस्सवं जिणाययणे,सो वरविमाणवासे,पावइ परमुस्सवं देवो"
english: "The gandhava, the turmeric, the natam, Who manages to conquer the buffalo, Resides in the Varaha vimana, For he is the supreme god."

prakrit: "जो जिणवराण भवणं,कुणइ जहाविहवसारसंजुत्तं,सो पावइ परमसुह,सुरगणअहिणन्दिओ सुइरं"
english: "One who conceals life, Who manifests it in such a way That it progresses effortlessly, Is the supreme happiness; Compassion is the supreme pleasure of women."

prakrit: "जिणपडिमा कुणइ नरो,जो दढधम्मो अणन्नदिट्ठीओ,सो सुर-माणुसभोगे,भोत्तूण सिवं पि पाविहिइ"
english: "One who treats with kindness or politeness, Who treats with decency or indifference, Is good with people; Even a violent lion will be destroyed."

prakrit: "काऊण एवमाई,धम्मं जिणदेसियं सुरविमाणे,उप्पज्जिऊण चविओ,चक्कहरत्तं पुणो लहइ"
english: "One can become enlightened, one can live in dharma, and one can taste it when one is uplifted; the cycle of rebirth is renewed."

prakrit: "पुणरवि काऊण तवं,पावइ सिद्धिं विमुक्ककम्मरओ,एत्तो सुणसु विभत्ति,जिणवन्दणभत्तिरायस्स"
english: "Listen carefully, you fool," he said, "Tell me again, I beg of you, How will you ever manage to escape?"

prakrit: "मणसा होइ चउत्थं,छठ्ठफलं उठ्ठियस्स संभवइ,गमणस्स उ आरम्भे,हवइ फलं अट्ठमोवासे"
english: "The manasa is the fourth, the sixth fruit is the rising, the last is the beginning, the eighth is the waning."

prakrit: "गमणे दसमं तु भवे,तह चेव दुवालसं गए किंचि,मज्झे पक्खोवासं,मासोवासं तु दिद्वेणं"
english: "The tenth day may be yours, But you have already passed the twilight, My heart is ripe, The whole month is yours to see."

prakrit: "संपत्तो जिणभवणं,लहई छम्मासियं फलं पुरिसो,संवच्छरियं तु फलं दारुद्देसे ठिओ लहइ"
english: "Wealth is the foundation of life; when empty, it bears fruit. When empty, you squander your fruit With drunken pride."

prakrit: "पायक्खिण्णे लहइ य,वरिससयफलं जिणे तओ दिढे,पावइ वरिससहस्सं,अणन्तपुण्णं जिणथुईए"
english: "If you look at the pyre, you will see that the fruit of one's womb Has been harvested, But if you do not look at it, You will not see it again."

prakrit: "जिणवन्दणभत्तीए,न हु अन्नो अस्थि उत्तमो धम्मो,तम्हा करेहि भत्ती,भरह! तुमं जिणवरिन्दाणं"
english: "" "Friend, I am not worthy of the blessing of the living One. I can do anything for you In the true dharma. Take heart! You must be declared a living being."

prakrit: "पच्छा निग्गन्थरिसी,भविऊण सिवं पि जाहिसि कयत्थो,भरहो मुणिस्स पासे,सायारं गेण्हई धम्मं"
english: "Go away, you niggardly girl, For where are you going to meet your lover, Sage, You fool, Going to the monk's house, The nights are numbered in Dharma."

prakrit: "दरिसणविसुद्धभावो,साहुपयाणुज्जओ विणीओ य,जुयइसयद्धेण समं,करेइ रज्जं गुणविसालं"
english: "The finer the feelings of the seer, The thinner the arrows, The more youthful the couple, The better the virtuous conduct."

prakrit: "एवंविहे वि रज्जे,नियएण उवेइ भोगमणुबन्धं,चिन्तेइ तग्गयमणो,फझ्या दिक्खं पवज्जे हं?"
english: "It's the same thing with love, Destiny is the same as passion, Thinking is different, Do you see the mystery in my heart?"

prakrit: "एवं तु राया भरहो विणीओ,जिणिन्दनिग्गन्थकहाहि सत्तो,सकम्मविद्धंसणहेउभूयं,करेइ चित्तं विमलं विसुद्धं"
english: "And you, Vrinda, are so full of faults That nothing can be said with certainty About your existence, Except that your mind is completely disordered."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए दसरहपव्वजारामनिग्गमणभरहरज्जविहाणो नाम बत्तीसइमो उद्देसओ समत्तो"
english: "On this auspicious day of Pausha, the festival of Dussehra is celebrated with great pomp and show. I agree with you on this point." ""

prakrit: "तत्तो ते दो वि जणा,सोयासहिया कमेण वच्चन्ता,पत्ता य तावसकुलं,वक्कल-जडधारिणो जन्थ"
english: "By the way, they both know each other. The one with the soybeans walks on nicely, The other with the rice, A stubborn beast of burden."

prakrit: "नाणासंगहियफलं,अकिट्ठधण्णेण रुद्धपहमग्गं,उम्बर-फणस-वडाणं,समिहासंघायकयपुञ्ज"
english: "Fruit like a coin, Rooted by unflinching affection, A cluster of peacock's feathers, A group of jasmine elephants."

prakrit: "पविसन्ति तावसकुलं,आसण-विणओवयारकुसलेहिं,संभासिया य पयया,सबेहिं तावसगणेहिं"
english: "The poor girl has grown thin, The beds are empty, The hips are wobbly, The arms are pallid, Everything is hunched over."

prakrit: "वसिऊण तत्थ रयणी,पुणरवि वच्चन्ति अडविपहमग्गं,दूरुन्नयसिहरोहं,पेच्छन्ति उ चित्तकूडं ते"
english: "The traveler lives there, Traveling through the forest again and again, Seeing the rivers in the distance, He sees the thickets of reeds."

prakrit: "नाणाविहदुमछन्नं,नाणाविहसावयाण आवासं,नाणापक्खिसमिद्धं,गिरिनइयारुद्धसंचारं"
english: "Coin - like mudflats, the dwelling of a coin - like bird, the congregation of coin - flies, the procession of fallen fowls."

prakrit: "कत्थइ सीहवियारिय-गयवररुहिरच्छडारुणं भीमं,कत्थइ सरभुत्तासिय–हत्थिउलविभग्गतरुनिवहं"
english: "How will the elephant - The elephant - Firmly bear the shadow of the bull, How will I appease the hunter - With its tame elephant - Ornament?"

prakrit: "कत्थइ वराह-केसरिदढदप्पावडियजुज्झसंघ,कत्थइ कढिणोरत्थल वग्घचवेडाहयं महिसं"
english: "How easy it is for a young tiger To pierce a woman's breast, To tear a young stag to shreds, To pull a tiger's tail."

prakrit: "वाणरबुक्काररवं,कत्थइ किलिकिलिकिलन्तपक्खिगणं,कत्थइ सीहभयदुय-हरिणपलायन्तसंघायं"
english: "The stag is a cunning bird, The crickets are spiky, The parrots are fearful, And the deer are playful."

prakrit: "कत्थइ मत्तमहागय–गण्डालीणालिगुमगुमायन्तं,एयारिसविणिओगं,पेच्छन्ति य चित्तकूडं ते"
english: "How can I describe her? She stares at me, Her lips twitching, Her cheeks moving like rhinoceroses." ""

prakrit: "नाणातरुब्भवाइं,नाणाविहसुरहिगन्धकलियाई,खायन्ति जहिच्छाए,फलाइं वरसायकलियाई"
english: "Coin lovers, Those who smell the fragrance of a coin, Eat as they please; Those who bear fruit Are like tax collectors."

prakrit: "लीलाऎ वच्चमाणा,चउसु वि मासेसु साइरेगेसु,पत्ता अवन्तिविसयं,काणण-वणमण्डियं रम्मं"
english: "Lila, what's wrong with you, Please forgive me, Aunt, There must be something amiss Behind the curtain."

prakrit: "जण-धणसमाउलं ते,केत्तियमेत्तं पि वोलिया विसयं,अन्नं पुण उद्देसं,पेच्छन्ति जणुज्झियं सहसा"
english: "They are so full of men and women, So little do they know how to make money, So much so that they waste their time looking for food."

prakrit: "वडपायवस्स हेट्टे,उवविट्ठा''सासिया य वीसन्ता,भणिओ य राघवेणं,लक्खण! देसो इमो विजणो"
english: "Foolish girl, get up!" "Mother - in - law, you fool," "Say:" "Raghaven, behold! This is the victory of the gods." ""

prakrit: "सासा अकिट्ठजाया,उज्जाणदुमा य फलभरोण मिया,पुण्डुच्छवाडपउरा,गामा वि य पट्टणायारा"
english: "Sasa akistajaya, ujanaduma ya fruit bharona miya, puduchchavada paura, gamma ya town yara."

prakrit: "दीसन्ति सरा विउला,अछिन्नपउमुप्पला य पक्खीसु,सयडेसु भण्डएसु य,भग्गेसु विसंठुला पन्था"
english: "The days are long, the nights long, The nights fleet, And the nights chaotic."

prakrit: "चणय-तिल-मुग्ग-मासा,विक्खिरिया तन्दुला य णेगविहा,दीसन्ति बहुद्देसे,जिण्णा य जरग्गवो पडिया"
english: "Chickpeas, til, moong, masa, cucumber, watermelon, ghee, lotus and lotus flowers bloom everywhere." ""

prakrit: "भणिओ य राघवेणं,सोमित्ती पट्टणं व गाम वा,लक्खेहि समब्भासे,परिसमिया दारुणं सीया"
english: "Tell me, Raghaven, A quiet town or village, Filled with trouble and confusion, Like a poor man making love."

prakrit: "तो लक्खणो वलग्गो,नग्गोहं दीहविडववित्थारं,रामेण पुच्छिओ सो,किं पेच्छसि एत्थ सोमित्ति!?"
english: "So tell me, you crook, The path is long and winding, Rama asks you," "What do you see here, young lady?" ""

prakrit: "सो भणइ देव वियर्ड,रूवं पेच्छामि पवयसरिच्छं,सत्ततलधवलएसु य,पासायसएसु परिकिणं"
english: "She says," "God, wierd! I love your silver and your pearl necklaces." "Get away, you sly girl, Just look around you."

prakrit: "आरामुज्जाणेहि य,तलायसहसेहि वेढियं सयलं,धण-जणवयपरिहीणं,दीसइ नयरं इमं वियडं"
english: "Take comfort in this, That with the palm of your hand you may pierce the fence, That without a weapon you may inflict pain."

prakrit: "एक पेच्छामि पहू! पुरिसं अइचवलतुरियगइगमणं,भणिओ य राघवेणं,आणेहि इमं मह समीवे"
english: "Have a heart of gold! For men are wont to be so hasty When it comes to making love. Say:" "Raghavan! Come, follow me." ""

prakrit: "ओयरिय पायवाओ,सोमित्ती तेण आणिओ पुरिसो,रामस्स चलणजुयलं,नमिऊण ठिओ समब्भासे"
english: "Traveler, If you want to be peaceful, Take a walk among the shrines of Rama. If you don't, keep at it Through plain language."

prakrit: "तं भणइ षउमणाहो,भद! कओ आगओ सि? किं देसो,विजणो धणेण रहिओ? साहसु एयं फुडं मझं"
english: "You fool," he said, "How dare you! Are you angry? What do you mean you're angry? Please, stay wealthy for the victory? Braveheart, this is the way of life."

prakrit: "सो भणइ सिरीगुत्तो,अहयं तु कुड्डुम्बिओ य वइएसो,एत्थागओ महाजस! भणामि जं तं निसामेहि"
english: "She says," "Sirigutta, I beg of you, you bastard." "Here you are, my lord! I suppose that's all there is to it."

prakrit: "सीहोदरो ति नामं,उज्जेणीसामिओ नरवरिन्दो,तस्स इह वज्जयण्णो,दसउरनयराहिवो भिच्चो"
english: "Friend, that is my name; I am the first to utter it; It is the elder brother's name." ""

prakrit: "मोत्तूण तिहुयणगुरुं,निग्गन्था साहवो य नाणधरा,अन्नस्स नमोक्कारं,न कुणइ सो चेव पुरिसस्स"
english: "The pearl is the master of the tihuan, The niggantha is the helper of the river, The rice is the dishwasher, No man is good at that."

prakrit: "निग्गन्थपसाएणं,सम्मत्तं वज्जयण्णनरवइणा,पत्तं जगविक्खायं,किं न सुयं देव! तुम्हेहिं?"
english: "Silly woman, If you want to sleep peacefully, Use water only after waking up, Then why not sleep! Are you the god?"

prakrit: "भणिओ य लक्खणेणं,केणोवारण तेण सम्मत्त,लद्धं? कहेहि एत्तो,जायं मे कोउयं परमं"
english: "" "Tell me, What makes you think he's up to it? Are you ready to fight? This is how I feel: I have someone who is more important than me."

prakrit: "एत्तो कहेइ पहिओ,देव! निसामेहि तस्स साहूणं,दिन्नो जहोवएसो,पढमं सम्मत्तर हियस्स"
english: "This is what the traveler says:" "Deva!" "Without leaving her bedside for a moment The days are fleeting For Jehovah's sake."

prakrit: "अह वज्जयण्णराया,पारद्धीफन्दिओ परिभमन्तो,पेच्छइ मन्दारण्णे,निग्गन्थं साहवं एक"
english: "Ah, Vajjayannaraya! The traveler's wife is hovering above him, Watching him with her dark eyes. One can see through the blindfold."

prakrit: "गिम्हे सिलायलत्थो,सूरायवसोसिएसु अङ्गेसु,सीहो व भयविमुक्को,समत्तनियमो दढधिईओ"
english: "Summer is a slippery slope, The limbs of the sun rejoice, The face is red with fear, Equilibrium is firm."

prakrit: "वरतुरयसमारूढो,कयन्तसरिसो अणाइमिच्छत्तो,गन्तूण भणई साहु,किं एत्थं कुणसि आरण्णे?"
english: "What are you doing here, poor girl, Trying to escape, Saying something rashly:" "Is that what you mean?" ""

prakrit: "तो भणइ समणसीहो,एत्थ हियं अत्तणो विचिन्तेन्तो,अच्छामि रण्णमज्झे,दुक्खविमोक्खं च कुणमाणो"
english: "So say," "Be reasonable!" "Here are some of my thoughts: I'm busy making love, And my mood is one of regret."

prakrit: "पुणरवि भणइ नरिन्दो,एयावत्थस्स भोगरहियस्स,थोवं पि नत्थि सोक्खं,किं अप्पहियं तुमं साहू!?"
english: "I'll say Narindo again, It's a busy day here, But I can't get enough of it. What more can I ask for? You coward!"

prakrit: "विसयपसङ्गाभिमुहं,नाऊण सुभासियं भणइ साहू,जं पुच्छसि अप्पहियं,तं ते सर्व निवेएमि"
english: "Visayas abound, I speak plainly, Sahu. Whatever you ask me I reply with." ""

prakrit: "जे विसएसु पसत्ता,ते अप्पसुहेण वञ्चिया मूढा,भमिहिन्ति भवसमुद्दे,दुक्खसहस्साइं पावन्ता"
english: "One who walks in such a way is deceived by one's pleasures, is foolish, is full of pretentious gossip, and experiences sorrow."

prakrit: "हन्तूण विविहसत्ते,इमस्स देहस्स पोसणट्टाए,आयसपिण्डो व जले,जाहिसि नरए निरभिरामे"
english: "Destroyed, mutilated, burnt, and reduced to ashes many a time, For the life of men consists in silence."

prakrit: "नूणं तुमे नराहिव! न य विन्नायाओ सत्त पुढवीओ,बहुनरयसंकुलाओ,घोराणलपज्जलन्तीओ"
english: "No, you are not to be outdone! It's the seven trumpets that are heard, It is the thunderclap of many a night." ""

prakrit: "दुग्गन्धा दुप्फरिसा,नरया ससि-सूरवज्जिया निच्चं,पुडपाय-कूडसामलि-करवत्त'सिवत्तजन्ताई"
english: "Dugandha is wicked, Naraya is a sapling - Suravajjya is pure, Pudapaya is Koodasamali - Karavatta is the eternal flame"

prakrit: "एएसु पावकम्मा,पक्खित्ता जीवहिंसया दीणा,चक्खुनिमिसं पि सोक्खं,न लहन्ति लभन्ति दुक्खाई"
english: "Such a poor woman, Who after a long life Is consumed by violence, Succeeds all the time In tasting pleasure But finds no sorrow."

prakrit: "ते एरिसं महन्तं,दुक्खं पावन्ति विसयसुहलोला,ताणं चिय अप्पहियं,केरिसयं होइ पुरिसाणं?"
english: "They are so great, They bring so much sorrow, So pleasant to the touch, So inexhaustible, Are they the preserve of men?"

prakrit: "किम्पागफलसरिच्छं,विसयसुहं अप्पसोक्ख-बहुदुक्खं,अहियं वज्जेहि इमं,करेहि जं तुज्झ अप्पहियं"
english: "I want to see the kimpag bear fruit, To enjoy its pleasures and pains, To weep and wail much the same, To do what is dear to you."

prakrit: "तेहि कयं अप्पहियं,जेहि उ गहिया महत्वया पञ्च,अहवा'णुवयनिरया,सेसा दुक्खाणि पावन्ति"
english: "There must be something they don't understand, The five greats, The young and the old, They must be suffering."

prakrit: "धम्म काऊण इहं,पाविहिसि सुरालए परमसोक्खं,दुक्खं अणुहवसि चिरं,नरयम्मि गओ अहम्मेणं"
english: "Where is dharma coming from, There is ultimate happiness in what is poor, And there is sorrow aplenty? But go to hell, my lord."

prakrit: "एए मया अणाहा,निचुबिग्गा भउद्या रणे,मा हणसु रसासत्तो,हिंसं तिविहेण वज्जेहि"
english: "Oh! I beg of you, you stupid bitch, Don't touch me if you want to. Violence is the wind that blows."

prakrit: "एएसु य अन्नेसु य,उवएससएसु बोहिओ जाहे,ताहे तुरङ्गमाओ,ओयरिउं पणमई साहुं"
english: "Ah! these are the words of my heart:" "Wretched girl!" "They sound like trumpets."

prakrit: "तो भणइ कयत्थो'हं,विमुक्कपावो न एत्थ संदेहो,जो सुर-नरसंपुजं,साहुस्स समागमं पत्तो"
english: "So somewhere he says," "Yes, do not be afraid; this is the doubt which must be answered." ""

prakrit: "निग्गन्थाण महायस! दुक्करचरिया अहं पुण असत्तो,पञ्चाणुवयधारी,गिहत्थधम्मे अभिरमामो"
english: "Niggunthan mahayas! I am innocent of wicked conduct, Possessor of five senses, And I take refuge in the Dharma of Truth." ""

prakrit: "एवं गिहत्थधम्मं,घेत्तूण नराहिवो समुल्लवइ,जिणसाहवे पमोत्तुं,अन्नस्स सिरं न नामेमि"
english: "And I will not bow my head to hunger. But if you do, You will surely be forgiven."

prakrit: "अह पीइवद्धणं सो,साई पूएइ परमभावेणं,उववासं चिय गिण्हइ,राया उल्लसियरोमञ्चो"
english: "Oh, the desire to drink, Such is the supreme feeling in all beings, The longing for love Counts for itself, Like the ecstasy of making love."

prakrit: "उववासियस्स साहू,कहेइ परमं हियं निययकालं,जं काऊण गिहत्था,भविया मुञ्चन्ति दुक्खाणं"
english: "O thirsty and thirsty Sahu, tell me the supreme fate, Which, for all that, Depends on whom, Beloved, Pretends to suffer."

prakrit: "सागार-निरागारं,चारित्तं दुविहमेव उवइ८,सालम्बणं गिहत्था,करन्ति साहू निरालम्बं"
english: "The ocean is empty, The paths are two - pronged, The rivers are swollen, The roads are impassable, The villagers are helpless."

prakrit: "पञ्च य अणुवयाई,सिक्खाओ तह य होन्ति चत्तारि,तिण्णि य गुणबयाई,जिणिन्दपूया य उवइट्टा"
english: "The five are alike; Learn how to make a flute play, Try to master three, Perform penance, And prosper."

prakrit: "तो वज्जयण्णराया,जिणधम्मं गेण्हिऊण भावेणं,पविसरइ निययनयरं,बहुजणपरिवारिओ तुट्ठो"
english: "So Vajjayannaraya, keep alive your pride, keep your senses, go about your business as usual, And break up most of your family."

prakrit: "गमिऊण स्यणिसमय,मज्जियजिमिओ मणेण चिन्तेइ,सीहोयरस्स विणयं,कह तस्स फुडं करिस्से हइं?"
english: "Going to bed, you silly girl," he thought to himself, "To knit a skirt in midday. Where do you think I'm going to hang out?"

prakrit: "चिन्तेऊण सुमरिउं,कणयमयं मुद्दियं इह 'ङ्गुढे,कारेमि रयणचित्तं,सुवयजिणबिम्बसन्निहियं"
english: "I remember thinking," "Foolish girl, these are my fingers." "I think I've done something wrong, It's just my imagination that has gone awry."

prakrit: "सा नरवईण मुद्दा,कारावेऊण दाहिणङ्गुट्टे,आविद्धा राएणं,हरिससमुल्लसियगत्तेणं"
english: "That's the point of being a man, To be imprisoned on one's right hand, To speak ill of another, To mutter nonsense about others."

prakrit: "सीहोयरस्स पुरओ,काऊण 'ङ्गुट्ठयं निययसीसे,पणमइ जिणिन्दपडिमं,ससंभमो लोगमज्झम्मि"
english: "Foolish girl, Use your fingers when you're busy making love, Always win the round of applause. Everything is fair in the eyes of the people."

prakrit: "परिसुणिय कारणेणं,केणइ वइरीण साहिए सन्ते,दसउरवइस्स रुट्ठो,गाढं सीहोयरो राया"
english: "Because of the churning, Somebody has gone astray, The winter nights are long, The nights are dark, And the nights are rainy."

prakrit: "तो सबबलसमग्गो,माणी सन्नद्धबद्धतोणीरो,चलिओ दसउरनयरं,उवरिं चिय वज्जयण्णस्स"
english: "So go with all your might, you stubborn girl, Get ready for the rainy season. It's over by the wayside." ""

prakrit: "ताव चिय तुरियगई,वेणुलयागहियकरयलो पुरिसो,गन्तूण वज्जयणं,भणइ तओ मे निसामेहि"
english: "Then she burst out laughing." "Whom are you looking out for?" "With a trembling hand She brushed aside the words of her husband's name."

prakrit: "अणमोक्कारस्स पहू! रुट्ठो सीहोयरो सह बलेणं,आगच्छइ तुरन्तो,तुज्झ वहत्थं सवडहुत्तो"
english: "Don't be so naïve! Stop talking to the lioness, She's coming at you quickly, Your hand is bruised." ""

prakrit: "एवं नराहिवो सो,केण वि तुह वेरिएण अक्खाए,अवसेण इहा''गच्छइ,करेहि हियइच्छियं जं ते"
english: "And don't be alarmed: There must be someone looking at you in a different way. So she goes" "I'll do whatever you want." ""

prakrit: "तो भणइ वज्जयण्णो,को सि तुमं? कत्थ देसवत्थबो?,कह वा नरिन्दमन्तो,एसो ते जाणिओ? भणह"
english: "So he says," "Vajjayana, who are you?" "Where do you come from?"

prakrit: "सो भणइ कुन्दनयरे,नामेणं सद्दसंगमो वणिओ,जउणा तस्स वरतणू,पुत्तो वि य विज्जुयङ्गो हं"
english: "She says,'Kundanayare, tell me the name of your favorite, Use it whenever you can, My son, I am also learning '." ""

prakrit: "पत्तो य जोबणसिरी,उज्जेणी आगओ वणिज्जेणं,दट्ट ण अणङ्गलया,वेसा आयल्लयं पत्तो"
english: "A leaf is but a thread, A flame is a flame, A weed is a weed, Weeds are not weeds, A dish is nothing but flour."

prakrit: "वसिओ य एगरत्ति,तीऎ समं तिबनेहराएणं,कढिणयरं चिय बद्धो,हरिणो जह वाउराए व"
english: "The hunter is a farmer's son, She is an equestrian, Caged by the crows, Like a stag who strays into the forest"

prakrit: "जणएण मज्झ निययं,समज्जियं जं धणं असंखेजं,तं छम्मासेण पहू! विणासियं मे दुपुत्तेणं"
english: "If I know my destiny, If I understand the wealth I lack, I will treasure it with a shadow. For what use is a skirt made of cotton?"

prakrit: "जह कमले छ महुयरो,आसत्तो तह य कामगयचित्तो,महिलाणुरागरत्तो,किं न कुणइ साहसं पुरिसो?"
english: "The thinner the bee, the more eager it is to mate, The more attractive it becomes to women: Why not be bolder?"

prakrit: "अह सा सहीऎ पुरओ,निन्दन्ती निययकुण्डलं मुणिया,एएण असारेणं,किं कोरइ कण्णभारेणं?"
english: "Oh! that's right, poor girl, Slipping off the nail mark, Isn't that disrespectful? What do you do with your eyelid?"

prakrit: "भणइ य अहो! कयत्था,धन्ना सा सिरिधरा महादेवी,उत्तमरयणाइद्धं,सोहइ मणिकुण्डलं कण्णे"
english: "Say," "Ah! Where are you going? Blessed are the ears of Siridhara Mahadevi? They rejoice because of her excellent eyesight." ""

prakrit: "अहयं कुण्डलचोरो,रायहरं पत्थिओ निसि पओसे,सीहोयरं सुया मे,पुच्छन्ती सिरिहरा देवी"
english: "Here's the crook of the kundal, The stone of the pyre Slipped off as he slept, The goddess Sirihara asking how he was." ""

prakrit: "नरवइ! न लहसि निदं,किं उबिम्गो सि दारुणं अजं?,सो भणइ मज्झ निद्दा,कत्तो चिन्ताउलमणस्स?"
english: "You fool! Can't you sleep? Are you awake? You fool?" he says. "I sleep well. Where do you think you're sleeping?"

prakrit: "मह विणयपराहुत्तो,न मारिओ जाव सुन्दरी! दुट्ठो,दसउरनयराहिवई,ताव कओ मे हवइ निद्दा?"
english: "Don't kill me, you fool! You fool, You stupid elephant. So why should I sleep?" ""

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,तो हं मोत्तूण चोरियं तुरिओ,एत्था''गओ नराहिव! तुज्झ रहस्सं परिकहेउं"
english: "Listen to me, you fool, So steal my pearl." "Go away, you coward! Let me wander off in your secret" ""

prakrit: "जाव च्चिय उल्लावो,एसो वट्टइ सभाए मज्झम्मि,ताव च्चिय बलसहिओ,पत्तो सीहोयरो राया"
english: "Go and make noise; this is the atmosphere of the fair; At the same time, go out in force; Soon the river will be full of lions."

prakrit: "सो गेहिउं असत्तो,तं नयरं विसमदुग्ग-पायारं,परिवेढिऊण सयलं,पुरिसं पेसेइ तूरन्तं"
english: "Were it not for that cow, That damned tree, Like a fence around a fence, Wouldn't have lasted so long."

prakrit: "गन्तूण वज्जयण्णं,सुणिठुरं भणइ सामिवयणेणं,मुणिउच्छाहियहिययो,जिणवरगवं समुबहसि"
english: "Go - between, Speak softly, Listen attentively, Bow low and bend your knees: You speak as one who is won over."

prakrit: "दिन्नं मए पहुत्तं,भुञ्जसि विसयं जिणं नमसेसि,मायाऎ ववहरन्तो,कह म निबुई कुणसि?"
english: "Give me my clothes, roast me, bow me down as long as you live, O wretched woman, How can I help myself?"

prakrit: "जइ मज्झ चलणजुयलं,न नमसि रे वज्जयण्ण! आगन्तुं,तो निच्छएण तुझं,न य जीयं नेय रजं ते"
english: "If I walk on my own, You are not to be bowed down by me, Vajjayana! If I come, it is because I am yours. If you do not live, then the kingdom is not yours"

prakrit: "तो भणइ वज्जयण्णो,मह विसयं साहणं पुरं कोसं,सबं च गेण्हउ इम,धम्मदारं च मे देउ"
english: "So tell me, wise man, Why waste my time in vain? For all I have to lose, I will give my life For the sake of dharma."
