english: "Aunt, It's a wet mudflat, My bracelets are tied around my neck, My husband is making love, And I live in a deserted village."

prakrit: "राया वि वालिखिल्लो,संपत्तो रुद्दभूइणा समयं,पविसरइ कूववई,बन्दिजणुग्घुट्ठजयसद्दो"
english: "Love is like a bucket of water, When wealth is wasted time is wasted, When poverty is exhausted The well is drained, And the prisoners languish in the mud."

prakrit: "चिरविप्पओगदुहिया,पणमइ कल्लाणमालिणी पियरं,तेण वि य उत्तमङ्गे,धूया परिचुम्बिया तयणु"
english: "Long - eyed girl, Two feet wide open, Lovely girl, Doing her best to please her lover, Washing the towel That held her tight."

prakrit: "पुहवी वि महादेवी,परितुठ्ठा पुलइएसु अङ्गेसु,संभासिया सणेहं,भिच्चा य सनायरा सवे"
english: "The husband is a great man, The wife is a virtuous woman, The husbands are polite, The wives are reasonable, The brothers are honest and the sisters are honest."

prakrit: "बहाओ महारहसुओ,समयं चिय रुद्दभूइणा एत्तो,आहरण-रयण-कणयाइएसु पूएइ मेच्छवई"
english: "Brother - in - law, time is running out. It's already too late. The poor thing is already late." ""

prakrit: "संपूइओ पयट्टो,आउच्छेऊण मेच्छसामन्तो,संपत्तो निययपुर,रमइ सुहं वालिखिल्लो वि"
english: "To finish is a waste of time, To arrive is a feast for the eyes, To settle down is wealth, And to rejoice is the delight Of empty vessels."

prakrit: "सोऊण धीरस्स विचेट्ठियं ते,सीहोदराई बहवे नरिन्दा,पसंसमाणा विमलं नसोहं,जाया ससङ्का पउमस्स निच्चं"
english: "Friend, if you have the courage, You'd better stop me, my dear. I won't touch you again. Unless I catch you with my favorite poison."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए वालिखिल्लउवक्खाणं नाम चउतीसइमो उद्देसओ समत्तो"
english: "This is the name of the thirty-fourth day of the month:" "I agree with you." ""

prakrit: "अह ते कमेण विझं,अइक्कमेऊण पाविया विसयं,मज्झेण वहइ तावी,जस्स नई निम्मलजलोहा"
english: "Ah, the poison of lust, The poison of immodesty, Which my heart pours out like a new lotus."

prakrit: "वचन्ताणुहेसो,जाओ जलवज्जिओ अरण्णम्मि,ताव चिय अइगाढं,सीया तण्हं समुबहइ"
english: "Come, you restless waterman, Let the streams flow through the forest, For then the jungle will grow cold, And then the sea will gather up the grass."

prakrit: "भणइ पउमं वि सीया,सूसइ कण्ठो महं अइतिसाए,परिसमजणियं च तणू,तम्हा उदयं समाणेह"
english: "Tell me, young and old, That my ears are burning with desire, And my mind with worry. Tomorrow morning will be yours."

prakrit: "हत्थावलम्बियकरा,भणिया रामेण पेच्छ आसन्ने,गामं तुङ्गवरघरं,एत्थ तुम पाणियं पियसु"
english: "Hands clasped in your arms, Brother - in - law's eyes fixed on Rama, The village is like a log house, Here you drink water." ""

prakrit: "एव भणिऊण सणियं,सणियं संपत्थिया'रुणग्गामे,गेहम्मि य उवविठ्ठा,कविलस्स उ आहियग्गिस्स"
english: "So say the wise, The wealthy prosper, In the guise of debt, Wherever the poor grow up, In poetry there is plenty to come."

prakrit: "तं बभणीऎ दिन्नं,पीयं सीयाऎ सीयलं सलिलं,ताव चिय रण्णाओ,संपत्तो तक्खणं कविलो"
english: "Give it to the hunter, Drink from it, Sweat from the cucumber, Stir up the forest, But treasure is in that pot."

prakrit: "तरुफल-समिहक्कन्तो,कमण्डलुग्गहियउंछवित्तीओ,अइकोहणो विसीलो,उलुयमुहो कक्कडच्छीओ"
english: "The tamarind is juicy, The lotus is fragrant, The leaves are prominent, And the flowers are prominent."

prakrit: "ते तत्थ सन्निविट्ठा,दट्ठणं बम्भणी भणइ रुट्ठो,एयाण घरपवेसो,किं ते दिन्नो महापावे?"
english: "There it is, Standing there, Looking down the road And saying:" "Stop!" "As soon as you get home."

prakrit: "पहरेणुमइलचलणा,मा मे उवहणह अग्गिहोत्तघरं,तुब्भे निष्फिडह लहुं,किं अच्छह एत्थ निल्लज्जा?"
english: "Traveler, don't set fire to the house you just left, you useless wretch. Isn't it better to stop here?"

prakrit: "तो भणइ जणयधूया,इमेण दुवयणअग्गिनिवहेणं,दड्ढे सरीरयं मे,रण्णं व जहा वणदवेणं"
english: "So she says:" "Bride - to - be, This is the fire of duality, In the thicket that grows by the forest, Wherever the forest fires are burning." ""

prakrit: "अडवीसु वरं वासो,समयं हरिणेसु जत्थ सच्छन्दो,न य एरिसाणि सामिय!,सुवन्ति जहिं दुवयणाइं"
english: "Aunt, tell me the time is ripe Where the deer meet the stag, Not this stag! Where the nymphs sleep Is for the couple to sleep."

prakrit: "लोएण तत्थ बडुओ,वारिजन्तो वि गामवासीणं,न षसज्जइ दुट्ठप्पा,भणइ य गेहाओ निप्फिडह"
english: "The people there are wicked, And so is the headman of the village. She does not reply, My lord, But says:" "The wheat has run out." ""

prakrit: "आरुट्ठो सोमित्ती,गाढं दुबयणफरुसघाएहिं,चलणेसु गेण्हिऊणं,अहोमुहं भामई विष्पं"
english: "Come on, you silly girl, Don't go walking around naked. I'm going to poison your face with poison." ""

prakrit: "भणिओ य राघवेणं,लक्खण! न य एरिसं हवइ जुत्तं,मेल्लेहि इमं विप्पं,पावं अयसस्स आमूलं"
english: "Say:" "Raghavena, characteristic! There is nothing wrong with that! It's like a poisonous snake dying in the mud. The poison is completely useless." ""

prakrit: "समणा य बम्भणा वि य,गो पसु इत्थी य बालया वुड्डा,जइ वि हु कुणन्ति दोसं,तह वि य एए न हन्तबा"
english: "Be polite, be reasonable, be childish, be clever, and if I am guilty, do not trouble yourself."

prakrit: "मोत्तूण बम्भणं तं,सोमित्ती राघवो सह पियाए,अह निग्गओ घराओ,पुणरवि य पहेण वच्चन्ति"
english: "The pearl is prickly, The sweetwood is juicy, The houses are empty, The streets are deserted, And the roads are deserted."

prakrit: "कूलेसु गिरिनईणं,निवसामि वरं अरण्णवासम्मि,न य खलयणस्स गेहं,पविसामि पुणो भणइ रामो"
english: "Cool, poor girl, I am staying in the forest for the time being, Not like a bad man. I will return to my village," Said Rama.

prakrit: "ताव चिय घणकालो,समागओ गजियाइसद्दालो,चञ्चलतडिच्छडालो,धारासंभिन्नपहमग्गो"
english: "A swarm of bees is hovering over you, A flock of geese is gathering, A stream of flies is passing by, And different paths are opening up."

prakrit: "अन्धारियं समत्थं,गयणं रविकिरणववगयालोयं,वरिसन्तेण पलोट्टा,जह पुहई भरियकूव-सरा"
english: "The darkness is equal, The singing is ecstatic, And the street is deserted. The plowman's son has reached his goal." ""

prakrit: "सलिलेण तिम्ममाणा,पत्ता निग्गोहषायवं विउलं,घणवियडपत्तबहलं,नजइ गेहं व अइरम्मं"
english: "Silly man, A leaf grows thin Like a thicket, A thicket of weeds grows tall, No one knows what to do With it."

prakrit: "सो तत्थ दुमाहिवई,इभकण्णो नाम सामियं गन्तुं,भणइ करेहि परित्तं,गिहाउ उवासिओ अहयं"
english: "That's why it took two nights. His name will be known in due course. He'll tell you the truth. It's only because he knows how to lie down."

prakrit: "अवहिविसएण नाउं,हलहर-नारायणा तुरियवेगा,तत्थेव आगओ सो,विणायगो पूयणो नामं"
english: "The plowman's name is Avihivisena, The plowshares are Turiyavega, Then come the fires. Weaving is the name of a poor man."

prakrit: "ताण पभावेण लहुं,वच्छल्लेण य विसालपायारा,जण-धण-रयण-समिद्धा,तेण तहिं निम्मिया नयरी"
english: "Take it easy, you silly girl, Don't overdo it; It's only because people agree on who you want to be."

prakrit: "तत्थेव सुहषसुत्ता,पाहाउयगीय मङ्गलरवेणं,पेच्छन्ति नवविउद्धा,भवणं तूलीनिसण्णङ्गा"
english: "Then they see the beautiful flowers, The plowman's garland of mangals, The young bridegroom's dress, The palace bedecked with tulips."

prakrit: "पासाय-तुङ्गतोरण-हय-गय-सामन्त-परियणाइण्णा,देहुवगरणसमिद्धा,धणयपुरी चेव पच्चक्खा"
english: "Traveler - Tungtoran - Hay - Gay - Feudal - Pretending to visit, Friend of the God of Love, Wealthy woman, They are pure pastime."

prakrit: "नक्खाहिवेण सहसा,रामस्स विणिम्मिया पुरी जेणं,तेणं सा रामपुरी,जाया पुहईऎ विक्खाया"
english: "Suddenly the nail marks appeared on her forehead: Ramasa Vinimiyya Puri Jenam, Then Ramapuri, Now completely shattered." ""

prakrit: "तो भणइ गणाहिवई,सेणिय! निसुणेहि तत्थ सो विप्पो,सूरुग्गमे षयट्टो,दब्भयहत्थो अरण्णम्मि"
english: "So say the elephant, Soldier! While he is asleep, She is shivering. In the hole She is hiding, With her hands choking on the fire of the forest." ""

prakrit: "तेण भमन्तेण तहि,दिवा नयरी घरा-''वणसमिद्धा,उववण-तलाय-जण-धण-समाउला तुङ्गपायारा"
english: "She is so full of flame, The lamp has gone out of the house -" "Vanasamiddha, uvan - talai - Jan - dhara - Samaula tungpayara." ""

prakrit: "चिन्तेइ बम्भणो सो,किं सुरलोगाउ आगया एसा,नयरी मणाभिरामा,कस्य वि पुण्णाणुभावेणं?"
english: "Think about it, brother - in - law! Is this the way to become harmonious, Young woman - lover, Is there anyone who can restore sanity?"

prakrit: "किं होज्ज मए सुमिणो?,दिट्ठो माया व केणइ पउत्ता?,पित्ताहियं व चक?,होज व मरणं समासन्नं १"
english: "" "What's wrong with me, my darling? How can anyone escape your wretchedness?" "Yellow fever, goose pimples, and the prospect of death? 1"

prakrit: "एयाणि य अन्नाणि य,परिचिन्तन्तेण महिलिया दिवा,भणिया य कस्स भद्दे!,एस पुरी देवनयरि व?"
english: "Oh! you ignorant woman, You familiar woman, Who is more wicked than me? Isn't this the whole of the gods?"

prakrit: "साभणइ किं न याणसि?,एस पुरी भद्द! पउमनाहस्स,सीया जस्स महिलिया,हवइ य लच्छीहरो भाया"
english: "Don't you know how to behave? It's completely disgusting! You silly girl, Just like women who want to be pampered." ""

prakrit: "अन्नं षि विप्प! निसुणसु,पउमो दवं जहिच्छियं देइ,तेण वि सा पडिभणिया,कहेहि तद्दरिसणोवायं"
english: "Foolish girl, Don't be so naïve: Your husband treats you just like any other man, So do be careful not to fall over." ""

prakrit: "सा जक्खिणी सुनामा,भणइ य भो विप्प! सुणसु मह वयणं,साहेमि तं उवायं,जेण तुमं पेच्छसी पउमं"
english: "That girl's name is Tsunama, you fool! Listen to me when I tell you what to say. I will explain it to you when I see you again." ""

prakrit: "गयवर-सीहमुहेहिं,वेयालबिहीसिएहि बहुएहिं,नयरीऎ तिण्णि दारा,रक्खिज्जन्ते य पुरिसेहिं"
english: "The cowherd has a white face, The bridegroom has many wives, And the three women are gatekeepers; They protect the men in the house."

prakrit: "पुबद्दारस्स बहिं जं पेच्छसि धय-बडायकयसोहं,तं जिणहरं महन्तं,जत्थ सुसाहू परिवसन्ति"
english: "The elder sister, The more you like to see - Great is the joy of love, For great is the victory of good over evil."

prakrit: "जो कुणइ नमोक्कार,अरहन्ताणं विसुद्धभावेणं,सो पविसइ निविग्धं,लहइ वह जो उ विवरीओ"
english: "One who shows courtesy, who does not show resentment, is pure enlightened; so is one who conceals it."

prakrit: "जो पुण अणुवयधरो,जिणधग्मुज्जयमणो सुसीलो य,सो पुइज्जइ पुरिसो,पउमेण अणेगदवेणं"
english: "One who is fully armed, Who is completely at ease in the middle of the night, Is purified through penance."

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,वच्चइ विप्पो थुई पउञ्जन्तो,संपत्तो जिणभवणं,पणमइ य तहिं जिणवरिन्दं"
english: "Listening is like playing the flute, Running after a snake, Spitting after a bird, Wealth is like winning the game, Money is like staying alive."

prakrit: "तं पणमिऊण साहू,पुच्छइ अरहन्तदेसियं धम्मं,समणो वि अपरिसेसं,साहेइ अणुबयामूलं"
english: "That moneylender sahu, Asking what is right and what is wrong with him, Asks why he refuses to bow down, Is the essence of true love."

prakrit: "तं सोऊण दियवरो,धर्म गेण्हइ गिहत्थमणुचिण्णं,जाओ विसुद्धभावो,अणन्नदिट्ठी परमतुट्ठो"
english: "Give it to me, my dear, For religion begets falsehood, For falsehood is poison. Unseen is the supreme pleasure."

prakrit: "असणाइएण भत्तं,लद्धं अह पाणियं च तिसिएणं,तह तुज्झ पसाएणं,साहव! धम्मो मए लद्धो"
english: "Take it easy, keep it to yourself, and let the water soak in while you're busy making love. My dharma is to fight." ""

prakrit: "एव भणिऊण समणं,पणमिय सबायरेण परितुट्ठो,परिओसजणियहियओ,निययघरं पत्थिओ विप्पो"
english: "Say what you mean: Get away with all your hard work, stay home with your friends, Destroy the foundation of your house."

prakrit: "भणइ पहिठ्ठो कविलो,सुन्दरि! साहेमि जं मए अजं,दि८ अदिट्ठपुवं,सुयं च गुरुधम्मसबस्सं"
english: "You fool, I'm telling you the truth! I know what I want now, my dear. It's the unattainable girl, And I know where to find her." ""

prakrit: "समिहाहेउं संपत्थिएण,दिट्ठा पुरी मए रण्णे,महिला य सुन्दरङ्गी,नूणं सा देवया का वि"
english: "When I meet you, my dear, When I see you in full bloom, A woman so beautiful, Is nothing like a goddess."

prakrit: "परिपुच्छियाऎ सिटुं,तीए मह एस विप्प? रामपुरी,सावयजणस्स पउमो,देइ किलाणन्तयं दव्वं"
english: "Sit on my back, will you heal me?" "Wretched girl, Ramapuri, don't you see I'm about to collapse Under the weight of your husband's arms."

prakrit: "समणस्स सन्नियासे,धम्मं सुणिऊण सावओ जाओ,परितुट्ठो हं सुन्दरि?,दुल्लहलम्भो मए लद्धो"
english: "Listen carefully, Dharma, go to sleep, you handsome man?," "I have a quarrel with a loose man." ""

prakrit: "सा बम्भणी सुसम्मा,भणइ पई जो तुमे मुणिसयासे,गहिओ जिणवरधम्मो,सो हु मए चेव पडिवन्नो"
english: "That naughty girl, Susamma, you fool, Have become what you used to be, Like a worm in a snake's eye. I have become like that already."

prakrit: "सवायरेण सुन्दरि!,फासुयदाणं मुणीण दायवं,अरहन्तो सयकालं,नमंसियवो षयत्तेणं"
english: "Lovely mother - in - law!, Slipping off in the middle of a noose, Doing her best for the poor, Paying homage to her beloved."

prakrit: "तो भुञ्जिऊण सोक्खं,उत्तरकुरवाइभोगभूमीसु,लभिहिसि परम्पराए,निवाणमणुत्तरं ठाणं"
english: "So eat the roasted rice, Restore the fields of fragrant flowers, Embrace the traditions of love, Hold fast to the vows of chastity."

prakrit: "सागारधम्मनिरओ,कविलो तं बम्भणी भणइ एवं,पउमं पउमदलच्छी!,गन्तूण पुरिं च पेच्छामो"
english: "Foolish girl, the poets call it a bumble bee, And the women scold the men for it! We see the destination in all its glory."

prakrit: "दवेण विप्पमुक्कं,पुरिसं दारिद्दसागरे पडियं,उत्तारेइ निरुत्तं,रामो अणुकम्पमावन्नो"
english: "The hunter is stricken with grief, The man is reduced to penury, The seller is utterly helpless, Ram is on his way out."

prakrit: "तो निग्गओ घराओ,पुरओ काऊण बम्भणी विप्पो,कुसुमकरण्डयहत्थो उच्चलिओ रामपुरिहत्तो"
english: "Go home, poor girl! Whom are you looking out for? A bunch of raisins sticking out of your hand Are scattered all over the place."

prakrit: "सो तत्थ वच्चमाणो,पेच्छई नागे फडाविसालिल्ले,वेयाले य बहुविहे,दाढाविगरालबीहणए"
english: "There you are, go - between! You see the snakes fluttering their wings And the jasmine sitting on top of them."

prakrit: "एयाणि य अन्नाणि य,रूवाणि बहुप्पयारघोराणि,कन्ताऎ समं विप्पो,घोसेइ महानमोक्कारं"
english: "Such a woman is Anna's lover, Her words are like many peacock's hooves, Like a rake's bow They break open." ""

prakrit: "मोत्तूण लोगधम्म,अहियं जिणसासणुज्जओ अहयं,जाओ नमो जिणाणं,संपइ'तीए भविस्साणं"
english: "Motoon log dharma, ayyam jinsasuna ajyam, jaaye naam jina, tayyam jinaan." "She is the god of victory."

prakrit: "पञ्चसु पञ्चसु पञ्चसु,भरहे एरवएसु य तह विदेहेसु,एएसु य जायाणं,नमो जिणाणं जियभयाणं"
english: "Five is five is five, To be rich or poor is three, To live is two, To win is to be feared."

prakrit: "जिणधम्मनिच्छियमणो,एवं तु बिहीसियाउ वोलेउं,पत्तो रामपुरी सो,कन्तासहिओ मणभिरामं"
english: "Your heart is made of nectar, And you, my poor girl, Have grown thin. So do the Ramapuris, Who enjoy the pleasures of love?"

prakrit: "अब्भन्तरं पविठ्ठो,दावेन्तो महिलियाऎ भवणवरे,रायङ्गणं च पत्तो,आलोबई लक्खणं विप्पो"
english: "The past is sacred, The present is for women, The future is bright, And the courtyard is deserted. Allay any lingering suspicions."

prakrit: "पेच्छन्तेण सुमरिओ,एसो सो रूव-कन्तिपडिपुण्णो,जो कडुय-कक्कसेहिं,तइया वयणेहि मे सत्तो"
english: "Proud lady, this is the pathos of a bitter man: With a bitter arrow You have dominated my speech."

prakrit: "तस्स भएणं तुरिओ,मोत्तूणं बम्भणी पलायन्तो,लच्छीहरेण दिट्ठो,सिग्धं सहाविओ विप्पो"
english: "When he's there You turn your back on him, When his pearls fly away, When you look at him with longing Eyes, Straightforward love will wither."

prakrit: "वाहरिओ य नियत्तो,द₹णं दो वि ते महापुरिसे,सत्थिं करेइ कविलो,मुञ्चइ पुप्फञ्जली पुरओ"
english: "Destroyers abroad, Those great men and women alike, Poets everywhere doing their best, Purveyors of falsehood."

prakrit: "पउमेण बम्भणो सो,भणिओ कत्तो सि आगओ तुहयं?,तो भणइ आगओ हं,अरुणग्गामाउ तुह पासं"
english: "You fool, tell me,'Where did you get that fire from?'I'll tell you,'It's the fire from behind you.'"" "

prakrit: "कविलो नामेणाहं,हवइ सुसम्मा य रोहिणी एसा,तइया मए न नाओ,पच्छन्नमहेसरो सि तुमं"
english: "Name me a poet, This is the way of good women. Do not take me in your arms, For you are the jewel in my heart."

prakrit: "जइ वि य सर्थ नरिन्दो,परविसयगओ हवेज एगागउ,तह वि य परिहवठाणं,पावइ लोए ठिई एसा"
english: "If anything is true, it is Narindo; if anything is, let the wind blow it away; for that is the nature of love; for this is how the world is."

prakrit: "जस्स'त्थो तस्स सुहं,जस्स'त्थो पण्डिओ य सो लोए,जस्स'त्थो सो गुरुओ,अत्थविहूणो य लहुओ उ"
english: "Where there is joy, there are scholars, and there are teachers; where there is learning, there is jealousy."

prakrit: "तस्स महत्थो य जसो,धम्मो वि य तस्स होइ साहोणो,धम्मो वि सो समत्थो,जस्स अहिंसा समुद्दिट्ठा"
english: "As the dharma is, so is the sahona; so is dharma; non - violence is the supreme truth."

prakrit: "अहवा किं न सुयं ते?,सणंकुमारो समन्तभरहवई,रूवस्स दरिसणटे,जस्स सुरा आगया इहई"
english: "Ah, why don't you sleep?" asked the poor girl, her hair hanging loose in the air Like a fire burning in the middle of the night.

prakrit: "संवेगजणियकरुणो,पवजं गेण्हिउं परिभमन्तो,भिक्खं च अलभमाणो,विजयपुरं पाविओ कमसो"
english: "He is a man of emotion, Makes vows and parades, Is a monk and a gentleman; The poor of Vijayapura have little to lose."

prakrit: "पडिलाहिओ महप्पा,कयाइ दारिद्दसमभिभूयाए,षडिया य रयणवुट्ठी,गन्धोदय-घुप्फवरिसं च"
english: "Clouds are big, many people suffer from poverty, rivers are bursting at the seams, There is no dearth of fragrant flowers."

prakrit: "एवंविहा वि समणा,सुर-नरमहिय-'च्चिया दढचरित्ता,परविसयं विहरन्ता,परिभूया दुट्ठलोएणं"
english: "And still the marriage vows, The solemn vows -" "Cheerful glances, Stretching out over the horizon, Surrounding the whole body." ""

prakrit: "फरुसाणि अणिट्ठाणि य,जं भणिया राग-दोस-मूढेणं,तं खमह अविणयं मे,जो तुम्ह पहू! कओ तइया"
english: "The pharisee is unyielding; What you say, Out of anger and resentment, I utter without remorse: You are a coward!"

prakrit: "कविलं एव रुयन्तं,संथावइ राघवो महुरभासी,सीया वि सुसम्म संभमेण परिनिवुई कुणइ"
english: "Poetry alone weeps, Praise be to the sweetwood flower, Love alone triumphs, And kindness alone vanishes."

prakrit: "कणयकलसेसु कविलो,किंकरपुरिसेहि पउमआणाए,साधम्मिओ त्ति काउं,कन्ताऎ समं तओ ण्हविओ"
english: "Poets like the doe, Poems like kinkara flowers, Saints like the crows, Are not equal to each other."

prakrit: "भुञ्जाविओ विचित्तं,आहारं,भूसिओ य रयणेहिं,दिन्नं च धणं बहुयं,ताहे गेहं गओ विप्पो"
english: "The landowner's son - in - law has plenty of it, The farmer's wife has little food, The husbandman has little money, So the field is empty." ""

prakrit: "आजम्मधणविहीणो,पत्तो जणविम्हयं महाभोगं,तह वि य न करेइ धिई,सम्माणपराहयसरीरो"
english: "Today without food, tomorrow with great pleasure, Then without doing anything else, You dishonorable wretch."

prakrit: "पुवं विहडिय-पडियं,मज्झ घरं आसि विभवपरिहीणं,रामस्स पसाएणं,जायं धण-रयणपरिपुण्णं"
english: "The flowers are scattered all over the place, My husband has come home, Impossible to escape, To please Rama, Who is well-versed in arrows"

prakrit: "हा! क८ सप्पुरिसा,जं मे निभच्छिया अलज्जेणं,तं मे दहइ सरीरं,सल्लं च अवट्ठियं हियए"
english: "Ah! the cursed woman! What I want to conceal, That I burn away in my body, And all the rest I lose." ""

prakrit: "अट्ठारस य सहस्सा,घेणं तं च गेहिणी' मोत्तुं,नन्दजइस्स सयासे,कविलो दिक्खं समणुपत्तो"
english: "Eighteen thousand ya sahassa, take that and burn it." "O pearl of glory!" "In silence you rejoice."

prakrit: "बारसविहं तवं सो,कुणमाणो मारुओ व नीसङ्गो,विहरइ मुणी महप्पा,गामा-''गरमण्डियं वसुहं"
english: "The rainy season is long, The cool breeze is fierce, The rainy months are long, And the rainy season -" "Spring is hot." ""

prakrit: "जो कविलस्स इमं तु पयत्थं,एक्कमणो निसुणेइ मणुस्सो,सो उववाससहस्सविहायं,भुञ्जइ दिवसुहं विमलङ्गो"
english: "That poetry in itself is your treasure, One man alone is your nemesis, One day you will be destroyed." - Vimalango, The delight of a rainy day.

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए कविलोवक्खाणं नाम पञ्चतीसइमो उद्देसो समत्तो"
english: "My dear, thirty-five is the name of the poet's favorite poem. My intentions are justified."

prakrit: "तत्तो कमेण ताणं,तत्थ'च्छन्ताण पाउसो कालो,अहिलविओ सुहेणं,ताव य सरओ समणुपत्तो"
english: "There the heat is turned on, There the rainy season is at hand, Ahilya the pleasure, So is the autumnal equinox."

prakrit: "भणइ तओ जक्खबई,पउमं पत्थाणववसिउच्छाहं,जो कोइ अविणओ मे,सो देव तुमे खमेयबो"
english: "You fool, If I tell you something you want to hear, You lie on my back And tell me something I don't know, God, you'll forgive me."

prakrit: "एव भणिओ पउत्तो,पउमो जक्खाहिवं महुरभासी,अम्हाण वि दुच्चरियं,खमाहि सर्व निरवसेसं"
english: "Say :'My son, The bee speaks in jars, But I am wicked; For starvation is the root of all misfortunes.'"" "

prakrit: "अहिययरं परितुट्ठो,इमेहि वयणेहि रामदेवस्स,चलणेसु पणमिऊणं,हारं च सयंपभं देइ"
english: "Reflect here, Ramdev here, Pay attention today," he said. "I'll give you the garland of jasmine."

prakrit: "मणिकुण्डलं च दिवं,देवो उवणेइ लच्छिनिलयस्स,सीयाऎ सुकल्लाणं तुट्ठो चूडामणि देई"
english: "The moon is bright, The gods proclaim luxury, And give fragrant powder For good measure."

prakrit: "वीणा य इच्छियसरा,दाऊणं ताण उस्सुगमणेणं,मायाविणिम्मिया सा,अवहरिया तक्खणं नयरी"
english: "The veena is an object of desire, The bow is a pleasure to grasp, The violin is a trick of the mind, And the dancer is not afraid of it."

prakrit: "तत्तो विणिग्गया ते,वच्चन्ति फलासिणो जहिच्छाए,रणं बइक्कमेडे,विजयपुरं चेव संपत्ता"
english: "There goes the weaver, Like a flock of parrots on its way, In the middle of the forest, In all the wealth of Vijayapura."

prakrit: "अत्थमिए दिवसयरे,जाए तमसाउले दिसायक्के,नयरस्स समब्भासे,अवट्ठिया उत्तरवरेणं"
english: "Atmany days, as long as there is tamasula in the direction of the horizon, Are dominated by speechless nights, Are incomprehensible."

prakrit: "तम्मि पुरे नरवसभो,महीहरो नाम निग्गयपयावो,महिला से इन्दाणी,धूया वि य तस्स वणमाला"
english: "The whole of you is a mass of men, The name of the female bee has been withheld, The female frog is inside the bush, And even the wasp has been washed away by it."

prakrit: "बालत्तणमाईए,सा कण्णा लक्खणाणुगुणरत्ता,दिज्जन्ती वि हु नेच्छइ,अन्नं पुरिसं सुरूवं पि"
english: "Child, these are the qualities that define a woman's character. Even a woman with eyes wide open Desires to be admired. Let food alone be enjoyed By men."

prakrit: "पवइयम्मि दसरहे,विणिग्गए राम-लक्खणे सोउं,पुहईधरो विसण्णो,दुहियाऎ वरं विचिन्तेइ"
english: "It is Dussehra on the first day of Pausha. Rama is worshipped on the next day. The poor man is full of faults. The miser ponders over his bridegroom."

prakrit: "मुणिओ य इन्दनयरे,नरिन्दवसहस्स बालमित्तस्स,पुत्तो सुन्दररूवो,निरूविया तस्स सा कन्ना"
english: "Bees are lovely, Narinda's arms are supple, My son is handsome, Niruvia is hard on him."

prakrit: "तं वित्तन्तं नाऊण,बालिया लक्खणं अणुसरन्ती,भणइ य मरणं पि वरं,न य मे कज्जं तु अन्नेणं"
english: "You fool, Childish girl, If you think that death is a blessing And you don't know what I do, You are wrong."

prakrit: "अन्नस्स दिज्जमाणी,काऊणं मरणनिच्छयं हिययं,गन्तूण भणइ पियरं,करेमि वणदेवयापूयं"
english: "Food is poison, kindness is fatal, Destiny is dear, I will worship the forest god."

prakrit: "अणुमन्निया य तेणं,पोसहियानिग्गया सह जणेणं,रयणिसमयम्मि पत्ता,जन्थुद्देसं ठिया ते उ"
english: "Aunt, It's just the way things are, Having sex with your lover, Leaving the house in the middle of the night, Like being stuck in the mud."

prakrit: "वणदेवयाऎ पूर्य,काऊणं जणवए पसुत्तम्मि,सिबिराउ विणिग्गन्तुं,तं चिय वडपायवं पत्ता"
english: "The forest god is full of flowers, The cow gives birth to young calves, The sesame plant grows on the creeper, And the leaf is like a panacea."

prakrit: "एक्कुद्देसम्मि ठिया,तम्मि य वडपायवे अइमहन्ते,लच्छीहरेण दिट्ठा,इमाणि वयणाणि जंपन्ती"
english: "You stay in one place, Your steps are uneven, Your gaze is clouded by longing, And your tongue mutters nonsense."

prakrit: "जा एत्थ तरुनिवासी,सुणेउ वणदेवया इमं वयणं,लच्छीहरस्स गन्तुं,कहेज्ज मह मरणसंबन्धं"
english: "Go, young lady, Listen to what the forest god has to say About my death." ""

prakrit: "जह तुज्झ विओगेणं,वणमाला दुक्खिया अणन्नमणा,उल्लम्बिऊण कण्ठं,कालगया रण्णमज्झम्मि"
english: "As long as you are gone, Vanamala, sorrowful man, Ungrateful woman, Long live my throat, Like the river in spate."

prakrit: "भणिऊण वयणमेयं,वत्थमयं पासयं करिय कण्ठे,साहाऎ बन्धमाणी,गन्तुं सोमित्तिणा गहिया"
english: "Speak softly, put your arms around me, put on your bracelets, and walk slowly."

prakrit: "अवगूहिऊण जंपइ,अहयं सो लक्खणो विसालच्छी,समदिट्ठीऎ पलोयसु,अधिइं सोगं च मोत्तूणं"
english: "I will never forget how he shook my head, Looked at me with such puzzled glances, Then looked at me again, And sighed again."

prakrit: "सो लक्खणेण पासो,कण्ठाओ फेडिओ तुरन्तेणं,आसासिया य बाला,धणियं वयणामएणं तु"
english: "So pass the mark, Thinking how quickly your ears will twitch, Assassin's boy, Thanks to your generous speech." ""

prakrit: "सुन्दररूवेण तओ,मुणेइ सा लक्खणं सुविम्हइया,किं वणदेवीऎ इमो,तुट्टाऎ कओ पसाओ मे?"
english: "You handsome hunk, What makes you look so beautiful? Are you a forest goddess? I'm offended. Who's the traitor?"

prakrit: "तो लक्खणेण नीया,वणमाला राघवस्स पामूले,पणमइ कयञ्जलिउडा,सीयासहियं पउमनाहं"
english: "So, behold, the neem tree, Like a palm leaf among thickets of grass, Is standing firm in the shade of the Goda, Like the young wife sitting beside her husband."

prakrit: "दट्ठण अप्पवीय,विहसन्ती लक्षणं भणइ सीया,किं चन्देण समाणं,कुमार! जणिओ य समवाओ?"
english: "The sight is inexhaustible, The signs are startling, Is the moon peaceful, My boy? Is it peaceful Among men?" ""

prakrit: "कह जाणसि वइदेही!,भणिया रामेण जंपई सीया,चेट्टाऎ नवरि सामिय! अहयं जाणामि निसुणेहि"
english: "How do you know what is true? My brother - in - law has spoken falsehood, My wife has spoken lies, I am innocent."

prakrit: "जोण्हाऎ समं चन्दो,जम्मि य वेलाऎ उग्गओ गयणे,तबेलम्मिह पत्तो,सहिओ बालाऎ सोमित्ती"
english: "The moon is the same as the sky, When the clouds are high They rise in unison, And when they are low They fall in love with each other."

prakrit: "जह आणवेसि भद्दे!,एव इमं जपिऊण सोमित्ती,वणमालाए सहिओ,उवविठ्ठो सन्निगासम्मि"
english: "You scoundrel! Praise be to the way in which you have treated me, Friend, help me in the forest." ""

prakrit: "ते तत्थ समुल्लावं,वणमालासंसियं पकुवन्ता,अच्छन्ति सुरसरिच्छा,नग्गोहदुमस्स हेट्टम्मि"
english: "There it is, the whole village, Feasting on the scent of the jasmine, Trying to make love, Like a heap of reeds falling from a cliff."

prakrit: "ताव य वणमालाए,सहीओ निद्दक्खए विउद्धाओ,दट्ठण ताऎ सयणं,सुन्नं ताहे गवेसन्ति"
english: "When you see a forest, You lie still, When you hear a song, You groan, You fall asleep."

prakrit: "सद्देण ताण सुहडा,समुट्ठिया विविहपहरणविहत्था,पायालबलसमग्गा,ते वि गवेसन्ति वणमालं"
english: "The forest is fragrant, The trees are diverse, The paths are impassable, And so is the forest."

prakrit: "दिट्ठा य भमन्तेहिं,वणमाला राम-लक्खणा य तहिं,परिमुणियकारणेहिं,नरेहि सिट्टा महिहरस्स"
english: "Whether you see it or not, Whether it's the forest or the character of Rama, Whether you are captivated by its beauty Or simply disgusted by it, Is nothing to be afraid of."

prakrit: "दिट्ठा नरवइ विद्धी,तुह सामिय! सयलबन्धुसहियस्स,इह लक्खणो य रामो,समागया पुरिसमीवम्मि"
english: "Aunt, Your eyes are impenetrable, Your face is plain! Friend, help is at hand. It is the mark of Rama's face That welcomes men." ""

prakrit: "सा तुज्झ सामि! दुहिया,वणमाला अप्पयं विवायन्ती,रुद्धा य लक्खणेणं,सा च तहिं अच्छई बाला"
english: "That's your wife! You fool, Vanamala, How can you describe her? She's just as good as a girl." ""

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,ताण धणं देइ नरवई तुट्टो,चिन्तेइ य दुहियाए,जं इट्ठसमागमो जाओ"
english: "Listen to me, darling, It's hard to swallow. Worryingly, the moment I see you, I'll break down." ""

prakrit: "सवाण वि जीवाणं,इह इट्ठसमागमो सुहावेइ,जो पुण हवेज्ज सहसा,सो सुरलोगं विसेसेइ"
english: "Life is transient, this is the pleasure of encountering it; what comes naturally to one's being, disappears forever."

prakrit: "एवं महीहरनिवो,भज्जाए परिजणेण समसहिओ,गन्तूण रामदेवं,अवग्र̥हइ लक्खणसमग्गं"
english: "And the fire of love, Accompanying one's cooking, Destroys the whole of Ramdev, Avoiding the whole range of symptoms."

prakrit: "सीया य समालत्ता,कुसलं परिपुच्छिया सरीराइ,तत्थेव ण्हाण-भोयण-आभरणविही कया ताणं"
english: "The mind is pure, the body pure, So what is there to lose In love, Love, Ornament?"

prakrit: "पडुपडह-तूरसद्दो,महूसवो कारिओ नरवईणं,नचन्तवरविलासिणि-जणेण बहुमङ्गलाडोवो"
english: "The hunter is a man of many talents, The husky woman is a woman of few talents, And the dancer is a widow with many enemies."

prakrit: "कुङ्कुमकयङ्गरागा,सीयासहिया रहेसु आरूढा,नयरं महीहरेणं,पवेसिया जण-धणाइण्णं"
english: "Proud lady, Stay safe! No need to hurry, Just stay safe," said the farmer.

prakrit: "ते तम्मि य विजयपुरे,भुञ्जन्ता उत्तमं विसयसोक्खं,अच्छन्ति जहिच्छाए,दसरहपुत्ता गुणमहन्ता"
english: "May they triumph over you, May you enjoy good fortune, May they appreciate what's good, May your talents command merit"

prakrit: "एवं तु पुण्णेण समज्जिएणं,अन्नन्नदेसेसु वि संचरन्ता,पावन्ति सम्माण परं मणुस्सा,तम्हा खु धम्मं विमलं करेह"
english: "And you should understand that by doing good deeds, one can attain bliss, even in difficult situations. But man, whatever his worth, Exceeds all dharmas."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए वणमालानामं छत्तीसइमं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "Praise be to the thirty-six vows of chastity."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया सहाए,राहव-लच्छीहराण पञ्चक्खं,तुरियं च लेहवाहो,समागओ महिहरं नमइ"
english: "Oh! help me Anna! The elephant licks the lotus with its five petals And the turtle with its two young ones. The congregation bows down to the buffalo."

prakrit: "लेहं समप्पिऊणं,सो चेव य आसणे सुहनिविट्ठो,नरवइदिन्नाएसो,वायइ सेणावई लेहं"
english: "Finish the lehenga, it will be pleasant to sit on, like a man blowing a trumpet, It will give you pleasure."

prakrit: "अस्थि सिरीअइविरिओ,नन्दावत्ते नन्दावत्ते पुरे महाराया,पणउत्तमङ्गनरवइ-मउडतडोहठ्ठचलणजुओ"
english: "Flesh is my enemy, Nandawatte nandawatte pura maharaya, But my heart is not in my hands - It's only my feet that move."

prakrit: "भरहेण सह विरोहो,महीहरं आणवेइ विजयपुरे,अइविरियमहाराया,कुसलेणा''भासणं कुणइ"
english: "Fights with her husband, Brings forth the buffalo in triumph, Casts out the winter sky, Performs feigning feigns." ""

prakrit: "जे केइह सामन्ता,सबे वि समागया मह समीवं,चउरङ्गबलसमग्गा,वट्टन्ति अणारिया य वसे"
english: "Whoever it is that is a feudal lord, All are equal before me In the whole wide world, Equally powerful in all walks of life."

prakrit: "अञ्जणगिरिसरिसाणं,मत्ताण गयाण अट्ठहि सएहिं,तिहि तुरयसहस्सेहिं,समागओ विजयसढूलो"
english: "Singing the Anjanagiris, Drunken singing, and dancing together, Are the keys to victory."

prakrit: "कलहो केसरिसहिओ,महाधओ तह रणम्मि माईया,अङ्गाहिवइनरिन्दो,सएहि छहि मत्तहत्थीणं"
english: "Feud with saffron, great slaughter, And the young wife with her limbs tied in knots: The same is the case with drunken brawls."

prakrit: "तुरयाण सहस्सेहिं,सत्तहि एए लहुं समणुपत्ता,पञ्चालवई पत्थो,समागओ करिसहस्सेणं"
english: "Friendship is mutual, Love is sevenfold, Companionship is fivefold, Cooperation is the ornament of true friendship."

prakrit: "पुण्डपुरसामिओ वि य,समागओ साहणेणं बहुएणं,पत्तो य मगहराया,अट्ठहिं दन्तीसहस्सेहिं"
english: "Like a flock of parrots, Like a herd of geese Struggling to find a mate, Like the twig of a doe With eight teeth in a row."

prakrit: "वजहरो य सुकेसो,मुणिभद्दो तह सुभद्दनामो य,नन्दणमाई एए,जउणाहिवई समणुपत्ता"
english: "Those who cause grief are happy, Those who sigh are blessed, And those who rejoice are blessed."

prakrit: "अणिवारियविरिओ वि य,केसरिविरिओ य सीहरहमाई,एए साहणसहिया,समागया निययमाउलगा"
english: "Even the enemies of non - violence, Like the arrows of a warrior, Seem to tremble at the slightest sign of adversity."

prakrit: "वसुसामि मारिदत्तो,अम्बट्ठो पोट्टिलो य सोवीरो,मन्दरमाई एए,समागया तिबबलसहिया"
english: "Vasusamy is a lethal poison, ambrosial potty or a brave man, indecent is the cause of death, falsehood is the cure."

prakrit: "एए अन्ने य बहू,दससु य अक्खोहिणीसु परिपुण्णा,सिग्धं च समणुपत्ता,तियसा विय भोगदुल्ललिया"
english: "Oh! my daughter - in - law! Ten hundred words of affection, One hundred and fifty full, Straight and balanced. Such a woman is beyond reproach."

prakrit: "एएसु परिमिओ हं,भरहं इच्छामि रणमुहे जेउं,महिहर! लेहदरिसणे,आगन्तवं तए सिग्धं"
english: "Such a gentleman, I beg of you, I wish I had a good fight, my dear! But let me tell you the truth: The way you look at it Is straightforward."

prakrit: "परिवाइयम्मि लेहे,जाव च्चिय महिहरो न उल्लवइ,ताव च्चिय तं पुरिसं,वयणमिणं लक्खणो भणइ"
english: "A woman's breasts are tiny, When young the female does not flutter, When old the male does not, The female shows no symptoms."

prakrit: "अइविरियस्स किमत्थं,भरहस्स य जेण विग्गहो जाओ,एयं साहेहि फुडं,भद्द! महं कोउगं परमं"
english: "How odd it is for you to be so indifferent. If you trust him You'd better stop, my dear! My anger is bound to boil over." ""

prakrit: "एवं च भणियमेत्ते,वाउगई साहिउं अह पवत्तो,मह सामिएण दूओ,विसज्जिओ भरहरोयस्स"
english: "And he said," "Friend, let me make love to you again." "I gave in to your anger And you forgave me."

prakrit: "अह सो सुबुद्धिनामो,भरहं गन्तूण भणइ वयणाई,अइविरिएण सुणिज्ज उ,दूओ हं पेसिओ तुज्झ"
english: "Oh! my goodness, I'm at a loss what to say, You silly girl, I forgot to say something. My anger boiled over And I hated you."

prakrit: "सो आणवेइ देवो,भरह! तुम मज्झ कुणसु भिच्चत्तं,अहवा पुरिं अओझं,मोत्तूणं वच्चसु विदेसं"
english: "" "So come on, my god! You fool, You coward. I'm completely at a loss What to do with the pearl That has come out of the mouth of another woman's brother."

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,सत्तुग्धो रोसपूरियामरिसो,अह उढिओ तुरन्तो,जंपन्तो फरुसवयणाई"
english: "Listening is like listening to the wind, Keeping one's breath steady, Running is like blowing a trumpet, Flying is like making a sound."

prakrit: "न य तस्स भरहसामी,कुणई भिच्चत्तणं कुपुरिसस्स,किं केसरि भयभीओ,वच्चइ पासं सियालस्स?"
english: "Not so much the traveler's wife, as the poor beggar's daughter - in - law's, Are you afraid of the hairy woman, Lying snug against the fence?"

prakrit: "अहवा तस्सा''सन्नं,मरणं जेणेरिसाई भासेइ,पित्तजरेण व गहिओ,अणप्पवसगो धुवं जाओ"
english: "Ahava tasa" "Slow down, death seems to be threatening, Sweat running down with bile, Anapa's tongue is washed away." ""

prakrit: "दूएण वि पडिभणिओ,किं गज्जसि एत्थ अत्तणो गेहे?,जाव च्चिय अइविरियं,न पेच्छसी रणमुहे रुटुं"
english: "Speak to me again, tell me," "Are you still here?" "You look around in embarrassment, But you cannot see the ropes of war."

prakrit: "एवं च भणियमेत्ते,घेत्तु चलणेसु कड्डिओ दूओ,सुहडेसु नयरमज्झे,नीओ च्चिय हम्ममाणो सो"
english: "And I said," "Wait a moment, you silly bitch." "It's early afternoon."

prakrit: "सो तेहि विमाणेउं,मुक्को रयरेणुधूलियसरीरो,गन्तूण सबमेयं,कहेइ नियगस्स सामिस्स"
english: "So I'll take that plane," She whispered, Flicker of the moon, Goose pimples all over it, And say, "It's your turn."

prakrit: "महया बलेण भरहो,विणिग्गओ तक्खणं पुरवरीओ,अइविरियस्स अभिमुहो,रणरसकण्डु च वहमाणो"
english: "Be full of great trees, Fill with reeds, Spread with acacia leaves, Face towards the God of Love, And carry with you the reeds of the forest."

prakrit: "सोऊण मिहिलसामी,कणगो सह साहणेण संपत्तो,सीहोयरमाईया,सुहडा भरहं समल्लीणा"
english: "Daughter - in - law, Wealth with wealth in our hearts, Friendship with happiness, Love with abundance in our heart."

prakrit: "अइविरिओ वि नरिन्दो,दूएण विमाणिएण आरुट्ठो,भरहस्स सवडहुत्तो,विणिग्गओ निययनयराओ"
english: "Even the enemy is not happy, The other is annoyed at the slightest provocation, The husband is jealous, The sellers are busy making arrangements."

prakrit: "आगच्छामि लहुं चिय,एत्तो लेहारियं विसज्जेउं,सो महिहरो नरिन्दो,भणिओ रामेण एगन्ते"
english: "I want to taste the garlic, Here's the decoction of lemongrass. The buffalo says:" "Narindo, Rama has arrived." ""

prakrit: "भरहस्स जं सकजं,तं चिय अम्हाण साहणीयं तु,पच्छन्नएहि गन्तुं,अइविरिओ चेव हन्तबो"
english: "Whatever you can get me to do, I promise, you'll do," he said, "But I must go on my way.

prakrit: "अच्छ सुहं बीसत्थो,महिहर! पुत्तेहि तुज्झ सहिओ हं,वच्चामि तस्स पासं,तेण वि अणुमनिओ रामो"
english: "Well - done, my dear! My son, I am at your side. I will come to you. So respect me, Rama." ""

prakrit: "एव भणिऊण तो सो,आरूढो रहवरं सह पियाए,महिहरसुएहि सुमयं,वच्चइ तो लक्खणसमग्गो"
english: "If you say so, he is drunk with your lover, If you ask me how I am, I am sure he is well."

prakrit: "नन्दावत्तपुरं ते,महिहरपुत्ता गया सह बलेणं,आवासिया य एत्तो,पउमो वि तहिं सुहासीणो"
english: "Nandavatpuram te, mahiharaputta gaya saath baleena, abhasiya yaata, paamo is just as delicious." ""

prakrit: "तिण्हं पि समुल्लावो,अइविरियषराजए निसासमए,तो भणइ जणयतणया,राघव! वयणं निसामेहि"
english: "I agree, my lord, In this hour of need The king of jealousy speaks plainly:" "Raghava! The speech is spotless." ""

prakrit: "अइविरिओ वि हु सुबइ,बहुसुहडसहस्सजणियपरिवारो,कह तं जिणिज्ज भरहो,थेवेण बलेण संगामे?"
english: "I am well, my dear, Having many good friends in the family. How can I help you if you refuse to join me?"

prakrit: "चिन्तेह तं उवायं,अइविरिओ जेण जिप्पई पावो,एवं च परिगणेउं,अदीहसुत्तं कुणह कज्जं"
english: "Think about it, you fool, If you have to live on your own You have to act accordingly. What's the point in being so stubborn?"

prakrit: "तो भणइ लच्छिनिलओ,किं दीणं एव जंपसे भद्दे!,पावं च अप्पविरियं,विणिज्जियं पेच्छसू अचिरा"
english: "So he says," "Lucky lady, what nonsense is this!" "Suddenly you see his wife making love."

prakrit: "अह भणइ पउमनाहो,लक्खण! निसुणेहि रणमुहे भरहो,अइविरिएण जइ जिओ,तो अम्हं किं व जीएणं?"
english: "" "Ah, you fool, Lucky man! Your face is smeared with red ghee. If you live by nature, why should I live?"

prakrit: "अन्नं पि सुणसु लक्खण!,सत्तुग्घेणं तु जं कयं कज्जं,दाऊण य उक्खन्दं,सिबिराओ साहणं हणइ"
english: "Listen to me, Laksmana! Anything you say About your business, You fool, Or speak nonsense: The words of a wise man Are poisoned." ""

prakrit: "सहसा निसासु गन्तु,समयं चिय रुद्दभूइणा सिबिरं,हयविहयविप्यरद्धं,काऊण भडे विगयजीए"
english: "Suddenly one heaves a sigh, Time runs out of it, Silly girl, Life is full of complications, Somebody's got to go."

prakrit: "चउसट्ठिसहस्साई,तुरयाणं गयवराण सत्तसया,भुयबलविणिज्जिया ते,नीया भरहस्स पासम्मि"
english: "Sixty-four thousand, The traveler is seven hundred, The landowner is seventy-two, The farmer is ninety-nine." ""

prakrit: "एवं कयसामत्था,रयणी गमिऊण तत्थ पडिबुद्धा,गन्तूण जिणहरं ते पयओ वन्दन्ति परितुट्ठा"
english: "And what's the matter, Rayani? Once the traveler has reached there, His wife will always greet him with a round face." ""

prakrit: "जाव निणवन्दणं ते,कुणन्ति तावा''गया भवणपाली,दिट्ठा असिवरहत्था,देवी दिवेण रूवेणं"
english: "Jawa ninvandan te, kunanti tawa" "Gone are the windmills, The gaze is asinine as ever, The goddess is illuminated by a lamp"

prakrit: "सा भणइ तुज्झ राघव! अइविरियं तक्खणे वसे काउं,करयलकयञ्जलिउडं,सिग्धं चलणेसु पाडेमि"
english: "She says," "Your name is Raghava! I'll sing you a song While you walk straight, Sitting on the lotus of my heart." ""

prakrit: "तो देवयाऎ एत्तो,सिग्धं पुरिसाण महिलियारूवं,लक्खणसहियाण कयं,सुरवहुसरिसं मणभिरामं"
english: "So, my god, why are men and women so devoted to one another? They are so fond of passionate lovers." ""

prakrit: "पुणरवि नमिऊण जिणं,रामो तं नट्टियाजणं घेत्तु,पच्छन्नदेहधारी,रायहरं पत्थिओ सहसा"
english: "To conquer it again and again, Rama took it in his stride, Having mastered it all, Suddenly the stone of Rayara appeared." ""

prakrit: "दिट्ठो सभाऎ राया,आढत्ता नच्चिउं ठिया समुहा,तग्गयमणेण एत्तो,दिट्ठा लोगेण अइरूवा"
english: "Look! The assembly is ripe, The congregation is busy dancing, The mind is attuned to what's going on, The people are eager to see."

prakrit: "गन्धवं तु पगीयं,महुरं सत्तसरगमयसंजुत्तं,बहुविहवियप्पकुहरं,हरइ मणं मुणिवराणं पि"
english: "The scent is fragrant, The nectar of seven myriads of fragrant flowers, A well of many different smells, Yet my heart yearns for a sage."

prakrit: "अह नच्चिउं पवत्ता,एत्तो सा नट्टिया ललियरूवा,रत्तुप्पलबलियम्मं व देइ चलणेसु वियरन्ती"
english: "Oh! my poor girl, This is how a lotus blooms: It grows very thin When you touch it with your finger, But it won't budge."

prakrit: "नयणकडक्खुक्खेवण-लीलापवियम्भमाणकर-चरणा,इसिहसियथणुकम्पण-भमुहासंचाररसभावा"
english: "The trembling of the elephant's trunk, The twitching of its feet, The rustling of its head, Are expressions of ecstasy."

prakrit: "परिभमइ जत्थ जत्थ य,नच्चन्तो नट्टिया मणभिरामा,कुणइ जणो एगमणो,दिलुइ तत्थेव तत्थेव"
english: "One who knows everything knows everything, One who doesn't knows anything knows everything."

prakrit: "गायइ उसभाईणं,जिणाण चरियाई तिण्णसङ्गाणं,परिओसिओ य लोगो,सबो वि य नरवईण समं"

english: "So you naïve girl, are you at peace with your husband, Are you at loggerheads with your boss, Or are you simply annoying him?"

english: "Traveler, if you have to travel a long way, don't go out in the open, for how can you beat a stag?"

english: "By the way, Vimukko, you silly bitch, Don't be so naïve: You're a lousy girl." ""

english: "And bewildered sages, For the arrows of the God of Love pierce through the heart, And the bow of love pierces through the nail."

prakrit: "रज्जे विजयरहं सो,पुत्तं ठविऊण विगयसुयनेहो,आयरियषायमूले,अइविरिओ गेहए दिक्खं"
english: "My son, whatever you say, You're right; It's only because you know how to win."

english: "Wherever the wind blows, There it blows, As long as the water flows, And wherever the clouds roam, It blows, So says the god of Love."

prakrit: "चारित्त-नाण-तव-संजम-सीलजुत्तो,छट्ट'हमेसु निययं परिखीणदेहो,रण्णे गुहासु वसहिं च करेइ धीरो,एवंगुणो विमलनाणधरो तिविज्जो"
english: "Nature, Wealth, Thy restraint, The seal is sealed, But let us try destiny. For through the forest And through the caves Lives the brave. So is the parrot of the lily of the forest."

english: "My dear, thirty-seven is the name of the month in which all purity is concentrated."

english: "Oh! such a victory! Such a sister - in - law is Raimala! Such an elegant woman! She will surely give birth again." ""

english: "If you want to have an earful, Slender both are right, Wealth triumphs, Writing is just like that."

english: "Blessed is the foolish one, Don't laugh! A fool's delight Is the reward for seeing the living one."

english: "She is so full of water, So full of nectar, So abundant in water that it cannot be filled."

english: "Wealth leads to wealth, Beings seek refuge in the valleys, Friendship leads to trouble, Contentment leads to sorrow, And fear leads to disappointment."

prakrit: "पाएसु तस्स पडिओ,भरहो सामन्त-जणवयसमेओ,थोवन्तरं निविट्ठो,तस्स गुणुकित्तणं कुणइ"

prakrit: "नाह! तुम अइविरिओ,एक्को च्चिय एत्थ तिहुयणे सयले,जो निययरायरिद्धि,अवहत्थेऊण पवइओ"

prakrit: "माणुसजम्मस्स फलं,धीर! तुमे पावियं निरवसेसं,तं खमसु मज्झ सुपुरिस!,जं दुचरियं कयं किंचि"

english: "So, beautiful lady, may the great virtues abound, O friend of the king, Be broken asunder, Be content with your wealth."

english: "Daughter - in - law! What a beauty is this! It matches the mood of a forest fire. All is fair in my heart!"

english: "Look! You stupid girl, Don't be so naïve: I'm going to collapse Under the weight of my own anger."
