english: "If I am worthy of Rama's favor, You always shine brightly; What use is that to me, You foolish wretch?"

prakrit: "मन्दोयरीऎ एवं,जं भणिया जणयनन्दिणी वयणं,जाया गग्गरकण्ठा,अंसुजलापुण्णनयणजुया"
english: "The speech of a deaf and mute woman, Like the trembling of a thunderclap, Is the accomplishment of a young man's dreams."

prakrit: "पडिभणइ तओ सीया,सईउ किं एरिसाणि वयणाणि,जंपन्ति सुमहिलाओ,उत्तमकुलजायपुवाओ?"
english: "You sage, Why do you mutter such nonsense, Young and attractive ladies, Who enjoy good company?"

prakrit: "जइ वि हु इमं सरीरं,छिन्नं भिन्नं हयं च पुणरुत्तं,रामं मोत्तूण पेई,तह वि य अन्नं न इच्छामि"
english: "Whatever I have in me is body, torn apart and renewed in spirit. Rama died for me, yet I desire no more food."

prakrit: "जइ वि अखण्डलसरिसं,परपुरिसं सणंकुमाररूवं पि,तं पि यनेच्छामि अहं,किं वा बहुएहि भणिएहिं?"
english: "Though I am alone, Though I look like a peacock's tail, I acknowledge it all the same. What do you mean by large?"

prakrit: "एत्थन्तरम्मि पत्तो,दहवयणो मयणवेयणुम्हविओ,सीयाऎ समब्भासे,अवढिओ भणइ वयणाई"
english: "Here's the last part of the letter: The midday sun is rising, The wind is blowing, And the women are singing along." ""

prakrit: "सुन्दरि! विन्नप्पं सुण,हीणो हं केण वत्थुणा ताणं,जेण ममं भत्तारं,नेच्छसि सुइरं पि भण्णन्ती?"
english: "Lovely lady! Listen to me, you naughty girl! Who is it that scoldes me so much If I tell you the truth? You do not want to hear what I say." ""

prakrit: "भणइ तओ जणयसुया,अवसर मा मे छिवेहि अङ्गाई,विज्जाहराहम! तुम,कह जंपसि एरिसं वयणं?"
english: "Tell me, young man, Don't let the opportunity slip by You won't know how to say it!" "What are you trying to say?" ""

prakrit: "मह जुबईण किसोयरि!,होहि तुम उत्तमा महादेवी,माणेहि विसयसोक्खं,जहिच्छियं मा चिरावेहि"
english: "My poor girl, you are the best Mahadevi, I admire you very much, But don't be so hasty."

prakrit: "तो भणइ जणयतणया,समयं रामेण रण्णवासो य,अहियं मे कुणइ धिई,सुरवइलोगं विसेसेइ"
english: "So she says:" "Time is running out for Rama." "Here I am, doing my best."

prakrit: "भूसणरहिया वि सई,तीए सीलं तु मण्डणं होइ,सीलविहूणाऎ पुणो,वरं खु मरणं महिलियाए"
english: "Though covered with bristles, Thou hast smeared the ground with red ghee; Once sealed, the bridegroom returns: Death is certain for a woman."

prakrit: "जं एव निरागरिओ,माया काउं समुज्जओ सहसा,अत्थमिओ दिवसयरो,ताव य जायं तमं घोरं"
english: "Wherever you are careless, Maya will always be there, And wherever you are nasty, It's always the other way around."

prakrit: "हत्थीसु केसरीसु य,वग्धेसु य भेसिया जणयधूया,न य पडिवन्ना सरणं,दसाणणं नेव सा खुहिया"
english: "Hands are like kesari flowers, wrists are like veils, the street is like a courtyard, the streets are grass - grown, and there is no street to walk around."

prakrit: "रक्खस-वेयालेसु य,अहियं भेसाविया वि नागेसु,न य पडिवन्ना सरणं,दसाणणं नेव सा खुहिया"
english: "Wretched woman, I beg of you, Though disguised, For she knows nothing of running away, Nor does she know how to lie down."

prakrit: "एवं दसाणणेणं,भेसिज्जन्तीऎ ववगया रयणी,नासेन्तो बहलतमं,ताव च्चिय उग्गओ सूरो"
english: "And to tell the truth, You shameless woman, You fool, The widest thing in the world Is a rose."

prakrit: "तत्थेव वरुज्जाणे,ठियस्स सुहडा विभीसणाईया,सिग्धं च समणुपत्ता,पणमन्ति कमेण दहवयणं"
english: "Then the bridegroom is born, The bed is nicely parted, The straight and the crooked are reconciled; Pay attention, burn the lotus"

prakrit: "ताव य तहिं रुयन्ती,दट्ठूण बिहीसणो जणयधूयं,पुच्छइ कहेहि भद्दे!,दुहिया भज्जा व कस्स तुमं?"
english: "When she saw you crying, She looked at you all the time, She said something nasty!" "Who are you, you stupid bitch?" ""

prakrit: "सा भणइ वच्छ! निसुणसु,दुहिया जणयस्स नरवरिन्दस्स,भामण्डलस्स बहिणी,राघवघरिणी अहं सीया"
english: "She says," "You fool, you stupid girl!" "Two - sided men, two - faced women, Two - eyed sisters, Lovely housewives."

prakrit: "जाव य मज्झ पिययमो,गवेसणढे गओ कणिट्ठस्स,ताव अहं अवहरिया,इमेण पावेण रण्णाओ"
english: "Come, let me have a drink," said the hunter, "Let the grasshopper go away, For then I might as well stop, For now he has made a run for it."

prakrit: "जाव न वच्चइ मरणं,मह विरहे राघवो तहिं रणे,ताव इमो दहवयणो,नेऊण मए समप्पेउ"
english: "Death will not come, my wretched self will stay there, So do not harm me by lying low."

prakrit: "सुणिऊण तीऎ वयणं,बिहीसणो भायरं भणइ एवं,दित्ताणलसमसरिसी,कि परनारी समाणीया?"
english: "Listening to her speak, Speaking out loud, Speaking in secret, Are you the only one who knows the truth, Or is it someone else?"

prakrit: "अन्नं पि सुणसु सामिय!,तुज्झ जसो भमइ तिहुयणे सयले,परनारिषसङ्गेणं,मा अयसकलङ्किओ होहि"
english: "Listen to me, Samia! The way you bumble your heart Out, You silly girl, Don't be so naïve." ""

prakrit: "उत्तमपुरिसाण पहू!,न य जुत्तं एरिसं हवइ कम्मं,बहुजणदुगुञ्छणीयं,दोग्गइगमणं च परलोए"
english: "Have a good husband! There is nothing wrong with that. It's just a bunch of crooks Running around Doing their best." ""

prakrit: "पडिभणइ खेयरिन्दो,किं परदवं महं वसुमईए,दुषयचउप्षयवत्थु,जस्स न सामी अहं जाओ?"
english: "Fallen fields, Why should the curtain fall on me, Wretched girl, Lest I lose heart?"

prakrit: "एत्थन्तरे विलग्गो,भुवणालंकारमत्तमायङ्गो,सीया वि य आरुहिया,पुप्फविमाणे दहमुहेणं"
english: "Get away from here, you silly girl, Stirring the fire of love, Like the flame of a perfumed fire."

prakrit: "गय-तुरय-जोह-रहवर-संघटुट्ठन्तमङ्गलरवेणं,अहिणन्दिओ य वच्चइ,तणमिव गणिओ विदेहाए"
english: "Lying motionless, Like a banner proclaiming victory, Like the banner of victory unfurled by the God of Love, Non - humans walk free."

prakrit: "पत्तो समत्तकुसुमं,उज्जाणं विविहपायवसमिद्धं,पुप्फगिरिस्स मणहरं,ठियं च उवरिं समन्तेणं"
english: "The leaf is smooth, the bud broad, the petals prominent, and the flowers prominent."

prakrit: "उज्जाणस्स पएसा,सत्त तुमं ताव सुणसु मगहवई,पढमं पइण्णनाम,आणन्दं तह य सुहसेवं"
english: "Praise be to the bright sun, Listen to me when you're hot. Name me first, Name me later, And I'll do whatever makes you happy."

prakrit: "सामुच्चयं चउत्थं,पञ्चमयं चारणं ति नामेणं,षियदसणं च छठें,पउमुज्जाणं च सत्तमयं"
english: "The fourth is the congregation, the fifth is the pasture, the third is the name, the sixth is the evening worship, and the seventh is the worship of the God of Love."

prakrit: "पढमं पइण्णगं ति य,धरणियले तह परं जणाणन्दं,नाणाविहतरुछन्नं,तत्थ जणो नायरो रमइ"
english: "First love, then happiness, Then wealth, then pleasure. For there the hero delights." ""

prakrit: "तइयम्मि उ सुहसेवे,समुच्चए तह चउत्थए रम्मे,कीलइ विलासिणिजणो,सुयन्धकुसुमोहबलिकम्मो"
english: "You lovely girl, Have fun together, Make love together, Are a pleasure to deal with, Are only pleasures to be had, Are pleasurable."

prakrit: "चारणमणाभिरामे,उज्जाणे चारणा समणसीहा,सज्झाय-झाणनिरया,वसन्ति निच्चं दढधिईया"
english: "In the pastureland, The hunter is always on the lookout, Always alert, Always ready to seize the opportunity."

prakrit: "तम्बोलवल्लिपउरं,केइयधूलीसुधूसरामोयं,पियदंसणं च छटुं,उज्जाणं मणहरालोयं"
english: "Above the Tambol Vallipuram, In the twilight of summer, At the sight of drunkenness, Behind the bright lights of dawn."

prakrit: "पउमवरुज्जाणं तं,सत्तमयं विविहरइयसोवाणं,पुप्फगिरिपवरसिहरे,अहिट्ठियं पण्डगवणं व"
english: "Aunt, There must be something very special going on, A lot of different emotions at the same time, Like being haunted by a mystery."

prakrit: "नारङ्ग-फणस-चम्पग-असोग-पुन्नाग-तिलयमाईहिं,रेहन्ति उववणाई,कोइलमहुरानिणायाई"
english: "Narang - jackfruit - Champag - asog - punang - tilayamaihin, rehanti uvanai, koilmahuraninai"

prakrit: "वावीसु दीहियासु य,जणवयण्हाणावगाहणजलासु,कमलुप्पलछन्नासुं,ताई अहियं विरायन्ति"
english: "Long - eyed woman, Drunk on the pleasures of love, Lovely on the lotus leaf, She stretches out her arms all the time."

prakrit: "तत्थ य पउमुज्जाणे,नामेणासोगमालिणी वावी,कीलणहरेसु रम्मा,विमलजला काणणसणाहा"
english: "There you are, bowed head, Bowing low to the river, Loving the water that flows from the nectar of the lotus."

prakrit: "तत्थासोगमहातरुसंछन्ने ठाविया जणयधूया,पण्डगवणे व नज्जइ,अवइण्णा सुरवहू चेव"
english: "Aunt, There must be something very special about your husband. He must be singing a song of praise, Not swearing an oath."

prakrit: "रावणपवेसियाहिं,जुवईहि अणेयचाडुयारोहिं,निययं पि पसाइज्जइ,वीणागन्धबनट्टेहिं"
english: "Ravana is pretentious, the young girl is reckless, destiny favors her, And the strings of harps are tied."

prakrit: "न करेइ मज्जणविहिं,न य भुञ्जइ नेय देइ उल्लावं,एगग्गमणा सीया,अच्छइ रामं विचिन्तन्ती"
english: "One cannot make a man marry, One cannot roast, One can't make a woman flutter, One has to yawn to conceal one's true nature."

prakrit: "गन्तूण सबमेयं,कहन्ति लङ्काहिवस्स दूईओ,जा न कुणइ आहार,सा किह सामी तुमं महइ?"
english: "Destroy all, say the lankahivas. Don't eat anything else. Are you the only one who loves me?"

prakrit: "तत्तो सो दहवयणो,मयणाणलपज्जलन्तसबङ्गो,पडिओ वसणसमुद्दे,अहियं चिन्ताउरो जाओ"
english: "There he is, burning with desire, Like the flames of a fire burning brightly, Fallen from the ashes. Now think of me." ""

prakrit: "सोयइ गायइ विलवइ,दीहुण्हे तत्थ मुयइ नीसासे,कोट्टिमतलं निसण्णो,अप्फालइ दाहिणकरेणं"
english: "She sleeps, She sings, She moans, She frowns, Her hair falls apart, And her right forehead grows pale."

prakrit: "सहसा समुट्ठिऊणं,वच्चइ भवणाउ निग्गओ सन्तो,पुणरवि नियत्तइ लहुं,सीया सीय त्ति जंपन्तो"
english: "Suddenly one gathers, One leaves the building, One is satisfied, One resumes one's daily routine, One does not utter a single word while sitting."

prakrit: "लोलइ कमलोत्थरणे,सिच्चन्तो बहलचन्दणरसेणं,उट्ठइ चलइ वियम्भइ,गहिओ मयणग्गितावेणं"
english: "A lotus falls when one is wet, The sky is red with the full moon, One gets up while one is moving around, One loses one's concentration."

prakrit: "जंपइ भुयासु तुलिओ,कइलासो खेयरा जिया सबे,सो किह मोहेण अहं,मसिरासिनिरूविओ काउं?"
english: "Jump up, lift up your arms, Foolish girl, you won't make a living at all. So what do you think I am, You silly girl?"

prakrit: "अच्छउ ताव दहमुहो,मन्तीहि समं बिहीसणो मन्तं,काऊण समाढत्तो,भाइसिणेहुज्जयमईओ"
english: "Well, you look so damned hot! The mood is as sombre As ever. But who cares? My brother - in - law will help me out." ""

prakrit: "संभिन्नो भणइ तओ,अम्हं सामिस्स दइवनोगेणं,पडिओ दाहिणहत्थो,जं चिय खरदूसणो निहओ"
english: "If you think differently, You'd better forgive me, my friend, For falling at your feet with your right hand Is nothing like sulking."

prakrit: "सुहकम्मपहावेणं,विराहिओ लक्खणस्स संगामे,सिग्धं च समणुपत्तो,वहमाणो बन्धवसिणेहं"
english: "Forgiveness of faults, Detachment in the company of virtuous people, Friendship between right and wrong, Are nothing compared to true friendship."

prakrit: "चलिया य इमे सबे,कइद्धया पवणपुत्तमाईया,काहिन्ति पखवायं,ताणं सुग्गीवसन्निहिया"
english: "Come, let us all go. Where are you going, my dear, A fortnight from now? There must be a good harvest in store For you."

prakrit: "अह भणइ पञ्चवयणो,मन्ती मा भणह दूसणं वहियं,सूराण गई एसा,सुहडाणं हवइ संगामे"
english: "Ah! speaking of five vows, mother - in - law! Speaking of which one is the worse, The sun is gone, Such is the pleasure Of making love In the company of others."

prakrit: "जइ चिय तस्स सहीणो,विराहिओ असिवरं च रविभासं,लङ्काहिवस्स तह वि य,किं कीरइ लक्खणेण रणे?"
english: "If my heart is right, If my body is weak And my mind is distracted, If I speak ill of others, Then why am I acting so carelessly As a lame duck?"

prakrit: "भणिओ सहस्समइणा,पञ्चमुहो किं व अत्थहीणाइं,वयणाइ भाससि तुमं,अगणिन्तो सामियस्स हियं?"
english: "Say," "Friend, what are five faces to one another that are devoid of meaning?" "You speak nonsense, Are you a man of few words?"

prakrit: "मा परिहवह कयाई,तुब्भे नाऊण वेरियं थोवं,अप्पो वि देसयाले,किं न डहइ तिहुयणं अग्गी?"
english: "Don't be alarmed: There's a fire burning everywhere, You're the only one who knows how to put the fire out."

prakrit: "विज्जाहराण राया,आसग्गीवो महाबलसमग्गो,थोवेण वि संगामे,निहओ पुदि तिवुढेणं"
english: "Knowledge is ripe, Hope is great, Love is fleeting, Friendship is at hand, A spiky powder is brewing."

prakrit: "तम्हा अकालहीणं,करेह लङ्का सुदुग्गपायारं,सम्माणेह जणवयं,भिच्चा य बहुप्पयाणेणं"
english: "Make your hunger unbearable, Make your penance pleasant, Honor your neighbor as yourself, Begging and making much journey."

prakrit: "ताहे बिभीसणेणं,रइओ मायाऎ दुग्गमो सिग्धं,पायारो अइविसमो,निरन्तरो कूडजन्तेसु"
english: "O separation, weeping mother - in - law, Straightforward misfortune, In - lawlessness, Constant confusion."

prakrit: "दिन्ना य रक्खपाला,समन्तओ खेयरा बलसमग्गा,समरे अभग्गमाणा,गहियाउह-पहरणा-''वरणा"
english: "Dinna ya rakhpala, Samantao kheyra balsamagga, Samare abhaggamana, Ghiyauh - the guard -" "The bridegroom." ""

prakrit: "एवमिमं सुणिऊण य तुब्भे,रावणवम्महदुक्खसमूहं,वज्जह निच्चमविं परदारं,जेण जसं विमलं अणुहोह"
english: "Listen to me, Tubbe, The multitude of sorrows that come from Ravana's womb, Vjja, Lay your eyes firmly on me, As if I were a lotus"

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए मायापायारविउठवणं नाम छायालीसं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "Praise be to the plowman's name, For he has perfected the art of shady roads."

prakrit: "एत्तो किक्किन्धवई,कन्ताविरहम्मि दुक्खिओ सन्तो,पत्तो परिब्भमन्तो,तं चेव रणं नहिं वत्तं"
english: "Such a wicked woman, Aunt, The sorrows of longing Are satisfied, And the leaves are ecstatic; There is nothing wrong with that forest."

prakrit: "पेच्छइ तुरय-गइन्दे,विवाइए रहवरे य परिभग्गे,सुहडे विमुक्कजीए,अवरे सत्थाहयसरीरे"
english: "They stare at the turaya - go - between, At the travelers staying at the wedding; The women look on in bewilderment; They follow in succession."

prakrit: "परिपुच्छिओ य साहइ,सुग्गीवनराहिवस्स तत्थेगो,सीयाहरणम्मि इमे,निहया खरदूसण-जडागी"
english: "Friend, I beg of you, If you wish to remain sober For the rest of your life, You'd better take care of yourselves, For here in this damned town There are plenty of good people."

prakrit: "चिन्तेइ वाणरवई,निहओ खरदूसणो रणे जेणं,वच्चामि तस्स सरणं,सो वि हु सन्तीकरो होउ"
english: "Thinking how nice it is to be called a wretch, To have a wife whose husband is a crook, I will go to her again, And she will satisfy me."

prakrit: "तुल्लावत्थाण जए,होइ सिणेहो नराण निययं पि,कारणवसेण सो मे,काही पक्खं न संदेहो"
english: "May the grasshopper live, May the fawn die, May fate follow, For that reason alone, Let there be no doubt of anything."

prakrit: "नाऊण वाणरवई,ठाणं पउमस्स निययबलसहिओ,पडिहारसमक्खाओ,पायालपुरं अह पविट्ठो"
english: "Nowadays women are called Varnavai, Then men take their positions, And women head for the fields. Payalpuram is sacred." ""

prakrit: "संभासिएकमेक्का,उवविट्ठा आसणेसु रइएसु,पुच्छन्ति देहकुसलं,सुग्गीवं राम-सोमित्ती"
english: "Assume one another, Sit you still on that high pedestal, Ask what is the use of one's body, Make conciliation between right and wrong."

prakrit: "एत्थन्तरे पवुत्तो,मन्ती जम्बूनओ निसामेहि,कत्तो सरीरकुसलं,इमस्स अम्हं नरिन्दस्स?"
english: "Get thee hither, my limpid girl, Where then is the sulkiness in my body, My nary a wretch?"

prakrit: "आइचरयस्स सुया,सहोयरा नाम वालि-सुग्गीवा,किक्किन्धिपुराहिवई,वाणरकेऊ महासत्ता"
english: "Aichrayas suya, sahoyara nama vaali - The sweet giver, the kikindhipura hiwai, the great power of the flute."

prakrit: "वाली विक्खायजसो,सुग्गीवं ठाविऊण रज्जम्मि,अहिमाणेण विउद्धो,पवज्जमुवागओ धीरो"
english: "One who goes abroad prospers, One who prospers stays on the path of prosperity, Who is justified by non - violence, Who shows patience when called upon to worship."

prakrit: "सुग्गीवो वि य रज्जं,कुणइ सुताराऎ संजुओ निययं,किक्किन्धिमहानयरे,गयं पि कालं अयाणन्तो"
english: "A good song is like a cord, A good tune makes a good tune, And a bad line makes a bad one." - Time, my dear, has passed.

prakrit: "पुणरवि य वित्थरेणं,जंपइ जम्बूणओ कयपणामो,दुक्खस्स कारणमिणं,एयस्स पहू! निसामेह"
english: "To scrape the nail once more, To yawn, To groan, To cause grief: Ah, my daughter - in - law! It must be silence." ""

prakrit: "अह देव! को वि दुट्ठो,मायावी दाणवो बलुम्मत्तो,वाणरवइस्स रूवं,काऊण पुरं समल्लीणो"
english: "Oh! God! Who is so wicked? A false god, A powerful demon, A crook's wife, Whose face is completely covered?"

prakrit: "मन्तीण अमुणिओ सो,पविसइ सुग्गीवसन्तियं भवणं,वरजुवइकयसणाहं,जत्थ सुतारा सयं वसइ"
english: "Friend, this is the house of pleasantries, The mansion of long life, Where the cottonwood tree lives with us."

prakrit: "दट्टण तं सुतारा,लक्खणरहियं मणेण उबिग्गा,अवसरइ तत्थ सिग्धं,मन्तिजणं चेव अल्लीणा"
english: "If you think deeply, You'd better keep quiet; If you don't think clearly, You better keep straight."

prakrit: "सो वि य लीलायन्तो,सुग्गीवस्सा''सणे सुहनिविट्ठो,ताव य वालिकणिट्ठो,निययं भवणं समणुपत्तो"
english: "So be it, Leelayanto, Be happy with pleasant pastime, Be content with plain sight, For destiny favors the plain." ""

prakrit: "तं निययरूवसरिसं,दट्टणं भवणमज्झयारम्मि,रुट्टो वाणरनाहो,अह गज्जइ गरुयगम्भीरं"
english: "You fool, The roads are impassable, The streets are deserted, And the streets are empty."

prakrit: "मोत्तूण सिंहनायं,अवइण्णो तत्थ अलियसुग्गीवो,अह जुज्झिउं पवत्तो,समयं चिय वाणरिन्देणं"
english: "A peacock is a lion's tail, A woman's back is bare, A warrior's bow is bowed, Time is ripe for making waves."

prakrit: "सिरिचन्दमाइयाणं,मन्तीणं तत्थ सा महादेवी,साहइ लक्खणरहिओ,कोइ इमो खेयरो दुट्ठो"
english: "Dear Siri, There she is, The great goddess of love, Friend of fortune, Someone who has a bad reputation." ""

prakrit: "सोऊण तीऎ वयणं,एगन्ते मन्तिणो उ मन्तेउं,साहन्ति पत्थिवाणं,रक्खह अन्तेउरं एयं"
english: "One who listens to her speaks, Another who thinks attentively, The braver the hunter, The more protected she is."

prakrit: "अक्खोहिणीसु सत्तसु,सहिओ चिय अङ्गओ स सुग्गीवं,परिंगिण्हइ अङ्गो पुण,कित्तिमई तत्तियबलेणं"
english: "Be kind to one's neighbor, Be compassionate to another, Be considerate to others, Be generous to oneself, And never be negligent."

prakrit: "नयरस्स दक्खिणेणं,ठविओ मन्तीहि अलियसुग्गीवो,फुडसुग्गीवो वि लहुं,उत्तरपासे परिट्ठविओ"
english: "Do not neglect the south, Be considerate and polite, Be courteous and forthright, Reflect on the north."

prakrit: "नामेण चन्दरस्सि,पुत्तो वालिस्स असिवरं घेत्तुं,रक्खइ साहणसहिओ,भवणदुवारं सुताराए"
english: "Name me Chandarasi, my son, The hunter is constantly on the prowl, Protecting the friends of the brave, Keeping the skies clear."

prakrit: "अह ते दो वि कइवरा,अलहन्ता दरिसणं सुताराए,जाया समुस्सुयमणा,मयणाणलदीवियसरीरा"
english: "Oh! they are both cowards! Instead of dancing their way through the fire They fall asleep beside each other, Like lovers in a dream."

prakrit: "कन्ताविओयदुहिओ,चिन्तेउं तत्थ सच्चसुग्गीवो,हणुवस्स गओ पासं,कहेइ सर्व निययदुक्खं"
english: "Aunt, Two nights are passing, I think I've had enough of that, Honest man, Go away!" said the doe. "Everything's destined to be miserable."

prakrit: "सोऊण तस्स वयणं,अप्पडिघाएण वरविमाणेणं,हणुओ किक्किन्धिपुरं,गओ य सिग्धं सह बलेणं"
english: "Listen to what he has to say, Reflect on how things have turned out, Play the flute to the tune of a lullaby, Speak kindly and politely."

prakrit: "सोऊण पवणपुत्तं,समागयं अलियवाणराहिवई,निप्फिडइ गयारूढो,बलेण समयं महन्तेणं"
english: "She is won over by affection, Accompanied by a steady stream of visitors, Held in a tight embrace, Cursed by anger, And told that time is of the essence."

prakrit: "दोहं पि ताण रूवं,सरिसं दट्ठ ण अञ्जणातणओ,अमुणियविसेसनिहसो,निययपुरं पत्थिओ सिग्धं"
english: "Both are forms of affection, The first sight is not to be denied, The last is to be avoided, But the last touch is straightforward."

prakrit: "हणुए निययपुरगए,सुग्गीवो भयसमाउलो एत्तो,राघव! तुमं पवन्नो,एयस्स करेहि सामत्थं"
english: "Destroyed by fate, Here's the scarecrow: Raghava! You fool, This is what you want done." ""

prakrit: "भणइ तओ पउमनाभो,अहयं साहेमि कारणं तुझं,सुग्गीव! मज्झ वि तुम,सीयाए लभसु पडिवत्तिं"
english: "You fool, I am telling you this because you love me, sweetheart! But you, too, love me as much as I love you."

prakrit: "सुग्गीवो भणइ पहू!,जइ तुह महिलाए सत्तमे दिवसे,न लभामि'ह पडिवत्ति,पविसामि हुयासणे तो हं"
english: "You clever woman, tell me! If your wife returns home on the seventh day, I won't be able to find her. I'm still a virgin." ""

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,अहियं आसासिओ पउमनाहो,पप्फुल्लकमलनेत्तो,जाओ रोमञ्चियसरीरो"
english: "Listen to me, my lovely girl, It's just the way things are. Go and make love."

prakrit: "अह ते जिणभवणत्था,समयं काउं अदोहबुद्धीया,नीया वाणरवइणा,किकिन्धी राम-सोमित्ती"
english: "Ah, the passion of youth, Time is inexhaustible, Friendship is fleeting, And so is Rama."

prakrit: "पुणरवि य आगओ सो,कूडो नाऊण सच्चसुग्गीवं,निययबलसंपरिखुडो,अहिमुहहूओ रहारूढो"
english: "Come again, come again," said the doe. "With good fortune or bad, you'll find it easier to stay put."

prakrit: "आलग्गो संगामो,उभयभडाडोवसंकडुत्तासो,सुग्गीवो सुग्गीवं,पहणइ गाढप्पहारेसु"
english: "Always be vigilant, never be negligent; be vigilant and be vigilant; be careful not to fall prey to gossip."

prakrit: "असि-कणय-चक्क-तोमर-संघटुट्ठन्तसत्थसंघाए,रामो सरं न मुञ्चइ,ताण विसेसं अयाणन्तो"
english: "Assi-kanya-chakka-tomara-constant meetings, Rama does not ask for advice, He knows everything through experience."

prakrit: "ताहे गयाऎ पहओ,कूडेणं तत्थ सच्चसुग्गीवो,मुच्छानिमीलियच्छो,पडिओ महिमण्डले सिग्धं"
english: "There you go, Traveler, When you jump up and down, Really happy., With a frown, Fallen in glory."

prakrit: "पडियं दटू ण रणे,किक्किन्धी रियइ अलियसुग्गीवो,बन्धवजणेण निययं,सुग्गीवो आणिओ सिबिरं"
english: "One doesn't see the field, One does not hear the farmer's name mentioned, One knows the fate of one's relatives, One hears the pleasures of others."

prakrit: "अह भणइ समासत्थो,सुग्गीवो सामि! वेरिओ इहई,आगन्तूण पुण गओ,किं न तुमे सो हओ पावो?"
english: "Ah, what a nasty man he is, A handsome gentleman! Everyone is here. Once the visitor has left, Aren't you going to sleep?" ""

prakrit: "भणइ तओ पउमाभो,तुब्भं चिय एत्थ जुज्झमाणाणं,न य जाणिओ विसेसो,तेण मए नाहओ सरिसो"
english: "You look at me Like a warrior's wife. I am so jealous of you That I do not know what to say. So do not trouble me." ""

prakrit: "सुग्गीव! पुणरपि तुमं,तं दुटुं दिट्ठिगोयरे मज्झं,ठावेहि जेण पेच्छसु,अचिरा भिन्नं सरसएसु"
english: "Dear friend, Once again you stare at me With such longing. Soon you will start to look at me differently." ""

prakrit: "सुग्गीवेणा''डूओ,समागओ दुट्ठवाणराहिवई,रामेण समरमझे,रुद्धो मेहो इव नगेहिं"
english: "Give thanks," cried the cowherd; The night is long, For Rama's war is fierce; Stop it, for the clouds are not as big as this.

prakrit: "दट्ठण रामदेवं,वेयाली निग्गया महाविज्जा,साहसगई वि जाओ,साहावियरूवसंठाणो"
english: "Behold Ramdev, the traveler is so busy learning great things, Even the bravest can go astray; You're just a bunch of cowards."

prakrit: "सुग्गीवरूवसहियं,दट्ठणं साहसं मरगयाभं,रुट्ठा वाणरसुहडा,मिलिया सबे वि एगढं"
english: "Friend, When I see a good man, I dare not go out in the street, When he speaks a bad man, All the people I meet are angry."

prakrit: "संगामम्मि पवत्ते,धरिओ च्चिय लक्खणेण सुग्गीवो,साहसगईण वि तओ,भग्गं तं वाणराणोयं"
english: "Friend, let me tell you something: Hold on, you lucky girl, Even if you must sing bravely, Don't let the wind rob you of your speech."

prakrit: "भग्गं दट्ठ ण रणे,कइसेन्नं राघवो सरसएसु,आहणइ साहसगई,सुइरं काऊण रणलीलं"
english: "The God of Love does not flee at a glance, So does not seek refuge in a demon, But gathers the courage to flee, For who can defeat a demon?"

prakrit: "तिक्खसरभिन्नदेहो,पडिओ च्चिय साहसो धरणिवढे,दिट्ठो विमुक्कजीओ,वाणरसुहडेहि सबेहिं"
english: "Steady and diverse are they, Scorched and stubborn are they on the earth; Their eyes are indifferent and their lips quiver."

prakrit: "निहयं दट्ठ ण अरिं,सुग्गीवो राघवं संसोमित्ती,पूएइ पययमणसो,पेसेइ य पट्टणं निययं"
english: "Never mind the glances; never mind the sweets. Always remember that love is bound to last."

prakrit: "ठविऊण वरुज्जाणे,पउमाभं वाणराहिवो एत्तो,पविसरइ सिरिहरं सो,दइयाउक्कण्ठिओ सिग्धं"
english: "Here are the bracelets on her wrists:" "Aunt, A hundred strands of hair remain here." "They are straight from her eyes."

prakrit: "जाओ ताराऎ समं,समागमो तत्थ वाणरिन्दस्स,रइसागरमोगाढस्स तस्स दियहा य वच्चन्ति"
english: "Go, be like the stars; When the sky is red, There are clouds of rain clouds, And when the seas are hot, There is plenty to see."

prakrit: "सुहडा विराहियाई,तत्थेवा''णन्दकाणणे सवे,आवासिया ससेन्ना,रामो चन्दप्पहहरम्मि"
english: "Suhada virahiyayi, tatthewa" "Everything is pleasant to look at, the dweller is content, Rama is the savior of the moon." ""

prakrit: "सबङ्गसुन्दरीओ,तेरस कन्नाउ वाणरवइस्स,गन्तूण पउमनाहं,भणन्ति अम्हं वरो तुहयं"
english: "Gorgeous ladies, Your kanau is like a banner, Gone are the days: I swear by you." ""

prakrit: "पढमा वि य चन्दाभा,अन्ना हिययावली हिययधम्मा,एत्तो अणुद्धरी पुण,सिरिकन्ता सुन्दरी चेव"
english: "The moon is bright everywhere, Anna is beautiful everywhere, He is extremely intelligent, She is extremely beautiful," he said.

prakrit: "कन्ना सुरमइनामा,हवइ मणोवाहिणी य चारुसिरी,मयणूसवा गुणवई,पउमाभा जिणमई चेव"
english: "Kanna is a beautiful name, Hawayein is a smooth flowing stream, Maynuswa is a virtuous one, Paumabha is a genial one."

prakrit: "जोबणरूवधरीओ,इमाउ कन्नाउ पेच्छिउं पउमो,उक्कातडीसमाओ,मन्नइ सीयाविओयम्मि"
english: "Young and beautiful women, Mother - in - law, Looking down at our husbands, We bow before our husbands."

prakrit: "रामस्स सन्नियासे,तत्थ निविट्ठाउ ताउ कन्नाओ,मण-नयणहारिणीओ,विणओणयवयणकमलाओ"
english: "Ramasa is in a state of sannyas, There you stay, Then there you go, Deer - eyed women, Weaves woven around their necks, And lotuses."

prakrit: "कन्नाण जोवणधरीण वि रामदेवो,ताणं च सो न य उवेइ मणाभिलासं,नेहेण पुबभवसंचियनिच्छिएणं,सीयं सया विमलतिवगुणं मुणेइ"
english: "Even Rama is devoid of youth, He is not so demanding of women as he is of men, For he always shows them what is right and wrong."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए सुग्गीवपहाणवक्खाणं नाम सत्तचत्ताल पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "Praise be to the pious woman whose name is Sattachattala, Poverty and prosperity."

prakrit: "अह तस्स धिइनिमित्तं,कुणन्ति कन्नाउ विविहविणिओगे,नच्चन्ति य गायन्ति य,लीलासु मणोहरं कुहरं"
english: "Oh! for that very reason! The different styles of dancing, The different kinds of singing, Are the pleasures of love, Like the mist of a man's womb."

prakrit: "विभवो वि तस्स सयलो,समाणिओ ण्हाण-भोयणाईओ,न य कुणइ निबुइसुह,कन्ताहिययस्स रामस्स"
english: "Virtuous people are as simple as that, lovers of beauty are as varied as nasty people, There is no such thing as an inexhaustible supply of happiness, Except in the case of Rama"

prakrit: "न य सुणइ गीयसदं,न य पेच्छइ मणहरं पि सो रूवं,सीयाएगग्गमणो,झायइ सिद्धिं जहा जोगी"
english: "She does not hear the song, Does not look at the man, But looks at him as if he were a jewel." ""

prakrit: "न कुणइ कह पि अन्नं,मोत्तुं सीयासमागमुल्लावं,पासट्ठिए वि सद्दइ,एहेहि लहुं जणयधूए!"
english: "No one gives you food, The pearl is like a sweetmeat, The pastime is sad too: It's the bridegroom's bride!"

prakrit: "देवी व माणुसी वा,नागवहू जक्खिणी व महिला हइं,इह सयलजीवलोए,सीयासरिसी न पेच्छामि"

prakrit: "एत्थन्तरम्मि पहिओ,तं उद्देसं समागओ मूढो,उवरिं पलोयमाणो,पेच्छइ पुरिसं तरुनिबद्धं"
english: "The wheels here and there, Stupid to meet the target, Turn upside down. It looks like a man making love"

prakrit: "आरुहिऊण तरुवरं,मुञ्चइ तं बन्धणाउ सो पहिओ,तुट्ठो य विणयदत्तो,तेण समं पत्थिओ सघरं"
english: "When he touches you, Tie me to him, That's the wheel. When it is broken, That is the warrior's equal." ""

prakrit: "दट्ठ ण विणयदत्तं,नट्ठो विप्पो तओ अइतुरन्तो,पहिओ वि परिग्गहिओ,मऊरसहिओ गिहत्थेणं"
english: "A glance does not make a sound, A gaze is only a distraction, Travelers wander haphazardly, Bees suffer the same fate."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया मऊरो,तस्स वि हरिओ नरिन्दपुत्तेणं,सोगाउरो य पहिओ,जाओ मित्तं भणइ एत्तो"
english: "Oh! my poor girl, That deer is the son of Narindapu, And the cowgirl is a traveler's girl. Go, tell a friend!"

prakrit: "जइ इच्छसि जीवन्तं,तं आणेहिह लहुं मऊरं मे,बद्धो य तरुवरग्गे,मया विमुक्को वणे तइया"
english: "Whatever life you desire, Bring it to me in your womb, bound and girded, For I will never forget you."

prakrit: "तस्सुवयारस्स तुमं,पडिउवयारं करेहि नाऊणं,आणेहि मित्त! सिग्धं,तं पि मऊरं हिययइ८"
english: "You naughty girl, Don't try to play the flute, Daughter - in - law! Straightforward, he'd be more polite." ""

prakrit: "तो भणइ विणयदत्तो,गेहसु अन्नं सिहि व रयणं वा,कत्तो सो हु मऊरो,जो गहिओ रायपुत्तेणं?"
english: "So you say, Vinaya dutta, Gehsu anna sweet va rayan va, where am I but a peacock, Who is the son of Geho Rai?"

prakrit: "न य सो गेण्हइ अन्नं,मोरं रयणं व कणयदवं वा,जंपइ पुणो पुणो च्चिय,निययसिहिं मज्झ आणेहि"
english: "She does not ask for food, She begs for it, Curses it away, Jumps it away again, Destines it for me." ""

prakrit: "जह सो मऊरमूढो,पहिओ न य मुयइ दढमसग्गाहं,तेण सरिसो नरुत्तम!,तुमं पि जाओ निरुत्तेणं"
english: "The more stupid he is, The thinner his wheels, And the thinner their bumps, The more disgusted he becomes." "You're not to be trifled with!"

prakrit: "अहवा रूवमईणं,खेयरधूयाण गुणकरालाणं,होहि तुम भत्तारो,मोत्तूण तुमं असम्गाहं"
english: "Ahava, silly girl, There must be something about you That makes you look good, But you can't." ""

prakrit: "तं भणइ लच्छिनिलओ,जम्बूणय! मह सुणेहि अक्खाणं,आसि पुरा गहवइओ,पभवो महिला य से नंउणा"
english: "He says," "Look! Silly girl! Listen to me, you fool! Come on, you silly girl. Don't be so naïve." ""

prakrit: "तिण्णि जणा तस्स सुया,अप्पासेओ तहा विहाणो य,अन्नो सिलाधरो पुण,उज्जुत्तो सबकज्जेसु"
english: "The three of them sleep there, each in its own place, and the other in its courtyard. One is a silversmith's son, the brighter the wiser the better."

prakrit: "गिह-पसु-खेत्ताईसु य,इयरो वि तहाविहो कुणइ कम्मं,भोगाई अप्पसेओ,नवरं पुण पुवसुकएणं"
english: "Give and take again, Each year the same cycle of karma, Each time it is exhausted And exhausted, To renew the new blossom."

prakrit: "कम्मं अकरेन्तो सो,पत्तो भाईहि पियरसहिएहिं,निन्मच्छिओ य सन्तो,गेहाओ निग्गओ माणी"
english: "Action is inconclusive, Brothers follow suit, And daughters - in - law follow suit: Pride prevails over vanity."

prakrit: "असमत्थो चिय कम्मं,काउं सुकुमालकोमलसरीरो,संवेगसमावन्नो,मरणुच्छाहो तओ जाओ"
english: "Unhappiness is the essence of good karma, For what pleasure is it to make one miserable, Or, for that matter, to cause one to lose one's senses?"

prakrit: "अह तम्मि देसयाले,परभवसुकरण तत्थ आणीओ,एको पहियजुवाणो,भणइ य वयणं मह सुणेहि"
english: "Ah! what a cruel man you are, A handsome young man in a suitcase, Who says that he hears me speak."

prakrit: "भाणू नामेण अहं,रायसुओ गोत्तिएहि अक्वन्तो,देसे विणिग्गओ वि य,कुसुमपुरं पाविओ कमसो"
english: "In a village the name of the farmer is pride, in a village wealth, In a town poor in produce, And in a country poor in commerce."

prakrit: "आयरिएण समाणं,संसग्गी मे तओ समुप्पन्ना,दिन्नं च वेज्जकडयं,तेण महं सुप्पसन्नेणं"
english: "Traveler, be careful not to fall asleep while I'm with you, give thought to what's on the table, and that will put me to sleep."

prakrit: "एयं ओसहिवलयं,गह-भूओरग-पिसाय-वाहीओ,नासेइ छित्तमेत्तं,भणियं निस्संसयं गुरुणा"
english: "This is the Ocean of Plumes, The deep, the grass - grown, The plowman's field, Stretching out the reeds, Without a doubt the master of the field."

prakrit: "नेमित्तियआइट्ठस्स भद्द! कालावही मह समत्तो,निययं वच्चामि पुरं,करेमि रजं तहिं गन्तु"
english: "It's only a matter of time. I've got time for that. Once I get the hang of it, I'll do it again. Then count the days as long as I have time." ""

prakrit: "रज्जासत्तस्स इमं,मा मे छड्डिहिइ वाउलमणस्स,गिण्ह तुमं वरकडयं,विणासणं सबरोगाणं"
english: "King of hearts, don't leave me to my wiles. Count me in your bracelets. Destruction is the end."

prakrit: "तं गेण्हिऊण वलयं,अप्पासेओ गओ निययगेहं,सपुरं च सुभाणू वि य,संपत्तो उत्तम रजं"
english: "Take care of yourself, be careful not to fall into traps; everything is going well, for wealth is a good thing."

prakrit: "ताव य नरिन्दभज्जा,अहीण दट्ठा सरीरनिच्चेट्ठा,पंडहियनिरूविया सा,अप्पासेएण तो दिवा"
english: "You are devoted to Narinda, you look down at her body, you stare at her feet, You act as a lamp." ""

prakrit: "कडयस्स पसाएणं,जीवावइ सो हु तं महादेविं,संपाविओ विभूई,तत्थ नरिन्देण तुटेणं"
english: "Wretchedness prevails, He is the remover of life, So are the great gods., Contemptuous as that, Then is Narinda about to be destroyed."

prakrit: "काऊण उत्तरिज्जे,तं वलयं सरवरं समोइण्णो,गोहेरएण हरियं,ताव य सुहलक्खणं कडयं"
english: "One can go up and down, One can cover the whole circumference with gold, The greener the greener, The thinner the niches."

prakrit: "तरुवरहेम्मि बिलं,तं पविसिऊण घणसिलाछन्नं,गोहेरो कुणइ रवं,पलयमहामेहनिग्धोसं"
english: "A flock of parrots hangs from a rafter's tail, Which is pricked by bees, Like the nail marks on a young bull's neck." ""

prakrit: "हन्तूण य गोहेरं,गेण्हइ वलयं निहाणसंजुत्तं,उच्छाहनिच्छियमई,अप्पासेओ'भिमाणेणं"
english: "Covered all over with gooseflesh, Wrapped tightly around her thighs, Scorched by jealousy, Like a banner proclaiming love"

prakrit: "हन्तूण य गोहेरं,गेण्हइ वलयं निहाणसंजुत्तं,उच्छाहनिच्छियमई,अप्पासेओ जुई पत्तो"
english: "Goose pimples, Feigning excitement, Like a bunch of peacock feathers sticking out of one's beak, Are a blessing in disguise."

prakrit: "अप्पासेएण समो,रामो सीया य वलयमुत्ति व,महइमहानिहिलम्भो,गोहेरो रावणो चेव"
english: "Contrary to popular belief, Rama was a violent demon, Like the God of Love, He was powerful and so was Ravana."

prakrit: "पुरिसा निच्छियहियया,पावन्ति धणं जसं च सोक्खं च,तुम्हे वि होह सत्था,सीया अम्हेहि लहियवा"
english: "Men are vain, women are wealthy, men are happy, you are content, just as we are."

prakrit: "सोऊण उवक्खाणं,जियजम्बूणयकहासमुल्लावं,बहवे विम्हियहियया,विज्जाहरपत्थिवा जाया"
english: "Listen, you fool, The laughingstock of jasmine, Flowing streams of water, Going down the path of wisdom."

prakrit: "जम्बूणयमाईया,सवे वि य संपहारणं काउं,पुणरवि भणन्ति पउमं,एत्थ सुणे सारसब्भावं"
english: "Jambunamayya, why bother mentioning everything? The poets speak of love again. This is the essence of listening." ""

prakrit: "साहू अणन्तविरिओ,मरणं परिपुच्छिओ दहमुहेणं,जंपइ जो कोडिसिलं,उद्धरिही सो तुमं सत्तू"
english: "Friend, the arrows of the God of Love, Which pierce through the fire As if to mark the threshold of death, Are the arrow that rescues you."

prakrit: "तो भणइ लच्छिनिलओ,तुब्भेमा कुणह एत्थ विक्खेवं,दावेह मज्झ सिग्धं,तं कोडिसिलं सुरग्घवियं"
english: "So tell me, Lucky lady, Why so distressed About your feelings? Please, I beg of you, Let me know straight away, It's heaven on earth." ""

prakrit: "सम्मन्तिऊण एत्तो,अरहस्सं वाणरिन्दमाईया,बल-नारायणसहिया,गया य रत्ति विमाणेहिं"
english: "Here's the promise: The arrows of the God of Love, Red all over, Have struck the Vimana with their powerful arrows."

prakrit: "पत्ता सिन्धुद्देसं,अवइण्णा तं सिलं तहिं दटुं,सबे वि पययमणसा,पणमन्ति पयाहिणावत्तं"
english: "The leaf is white, the needle is indistinct, the nail is sealed, and the eye is fixed on it. Everything is relative to the path."

prakrit: "कुकुमरसेण चन्दण-विच्छुरिया अच्चिया य कुसुमेहिं,आभरणभूसियङ्गी,विभाइ देवि व कोडिसिला"
english: "Sandalwood with cucumbers - Vichuriyas, acacia with water lilies, Ornament with ornaments, Vibhai Devi with kodisila"

prakrit: "निम्मज्जियपरिवेढो,करयलमउलञ्जलिं सिरे रइउं,सिद्धाण नमोकारं,करेइ लच्छीहरो एत्तो"
english: "Surround yourself with neem leaves, Remain completely still, Do your best, For here lie the lucky ones."

prakrit: "भवनलही उत्तिण्णा,जे सबसुहालयं समणुपत्ता,निययं अणन्तदरिसी,ते सिद्धा मङ्गलं ममं"
english: "A good man is one who manages everything, Who manages everything in harmony, Who sees destiny through the lens of eternity; That is straightforward auspiciousness for me."

prakrit: "इह जे सिद्धिमुवगया,निवाणसिलाऎ साहवो धीरा,सबे वि कम्मरहिया,ते हं वन्दामि भावेणं"
english: "One who has attained to perfection, Who has endured long enough, Who is always tire of hard work, Is worthy of welcome."

prakrit: "पउमो खेयरसहिओ,आसीसं देइ लच्छिनिलयस्स,अरहन्त सिद्ध साहू,धम्मो तुह मङ्गलं होउ"
english: "Proud wife, may there be auspiciousness in your heart, May there be prosperity in your life, May the arrow of goodness rest on your shoulders."

prakrit: "सा लक्खणेण एत्तो,नाणाकुसुमच्चिया सुरभिगन्धा,बाहासु समुक्खित्ता,सिद्धिसिला कुलवहू चेव"
english: "She is so attractive, The scent of pearls is mesmerizing, The arrows are powerful, The wife is clever, The husband is clever"

prakrit: "साहु त्ति साहुसई,सुराण सुणिऊण अम्बरे महयं,जाया विम्हियहियया,सुग्गीवाई भडा बहवे"
english: "Friend, if you dare, Listen to the tune of the lute: There must be a great storm brewing, A flood of good omens."

prakrit: "सवे नमिऊण सिला,सम्मेयं पवयं गया सिग्धं,उसभाइजिणवगणं,पडिमाउ थुणन्ति भावेणं"
english: "All are captivated by her name, All are mesmerized by her beauty, She touches everyone's feet But does not utter a single word."

prakrit: "अह ते पदक्खिणेउं,भरहं वरजाण-वाहणारूढा,सुहकरण-तिहि-मुहुत्ते,किक्किन्धिपुरं गया सिग्धं"
english: "Ah, those footprints! The bridegroom is full - the carriage is empty, The wedding feast is over, And the fair goes on without a hitch."

prakrit: "सुत्तुट्ठिया पभाए,सुग्गीवाई कइद्धया सबे,गन्तूण रामदेवं,पणमन्ति जहाणुपुबीए"
english: "Slender people, Where are you going to sow the seeds? Everyone is sowing the seeds. The destination is Ramdev, The jeweler is painting the jasmine."

prakrit: "उवविट्ठा भणइ तओ,पउमो सवे वि वाणरा तुब्भे,अज्ज वि य किं पडिच्छह?,चिट्ठइ सीया तहिं दुक्खं"
english: "You talk too much, Daughter - in - law, All the time you speak too little, So what do you think you are doing now?"

prakrit: "मोत्तूण दीहसुत्तं,लङ्कागमणे मई कुणह सिग्धं,मा विरहतणुइयङ्गी,करिही कालं तहिं सीया"
english: "Mortally wounded by a sharp arrow, Headed straight for Lanka, Not to be missed, Only time will tell."

prakrit: "जंपन्ति वओविद्धा,राघव! निसुणेहि अम्ह वयणेकं,जइ इच्छसि वइदेही,तेण समं विग्गहो होही"
english: "Trembling and sighing, Raghava! Stop dragging my feet. Whatever you wish for, Goddess, be just as vigilant!" ""

prakrit: "दुक्खेहि होइ विजओ,रणम्मि असमाणविग्गहो एसो,विज्जासहस्सधारी,न य जिणसिआदसाणणं सामि!"
english: "Be strong, be brave, be fearless, be armed with knowledge, for no one knows wisdom except the sage!"

prakrit: "तम्हा करेहि बुद्धी,अम्हं वयणेण मुयसु रणतत्तिं,अबलस्स बलियएणं,समयं को विग्गहो एत्थ?"
english: "What have you to do with wisdom? I am trying to play the flute, Running out of words, Sacrificing impudence. Where is the time to waste it?"

prakrit: "जो सो अणुबयधरो,बिभीसणो नाम देसविक्खाओ,तस्स अलचं वयणं,काही लङ्काहिवो नियमा"
english: "One who does not repent is innocent, One who renounces divisiveness is a traitor; The speech of one's enemies is immoral; Some falsehoods are the rule."

prakrit: "घणपीइसंपउत्तो,तस्स य वयणेण बोहिओ सन्तो,अप्पेहि जणयतणयं,दसाणणो नत्थि संदेहो"
english: "The cow gives milk to the bull, The bull is satisfied with his speech, He knows how to talk, There is no doubt about it."

prakrit: "तम्हा गवेसह लहुं,नयकुसलं वाणराण सामत्थं,जो सह बिहीसणेणं,दहवयणं पत्तियावेइ"
english: "Your wife is like a banner on the lotus leaf, Like a banner proclaiming victory over adversary, Like the banner of victory."

prakrit: "एयम्मि देसयाले,महोदही नाम खेयरो भणइ,बहुजन्तदुग्गमा सा,कया य लङ्का विसमसाला"
english: "Aimee deshayale, Madam - namae kheyero bhangaye, Bahujantadugama sa, Kya ya lanka visamasala."

prakrit: "एयाण मज्झयारे,एकं पि य खेयरं न पेच्छामि,जो पविसिऊण लङ्क,पुणरवि सिग्धं नियत्तेइ"
english: "Nowadays, my dear, I cannot find a single one who, For lack of a good man, Succeeds in returning to Lanka."

prakrit: "पवणंजयस्स पुत्तो,सिरिसेलो नाम निग्गयपयावो,बल-कन्ति-सत्तिजुत्तो,सो नवरं तं पसाएइ"
english: "My son, take care of your name, Siricello. For he is strong and powerful; The new moon favors him."

prakrit: "सबेहि एवमेयं,कईहि अणुमन्निऊण तं वयणं,हणुयस्स सन्नियासं,सिरिभूई पेसिओ दूओ"
english: "All the same, There are many people who say the same thing: Honey, you fool, Give me the poison."

prakrit: "तुङ्गबलगविएण वि,पुरिसेणं निययसत्तिजुत्तेण सया,होयवं नियमइणा,किंचि गणेन्तेण कारणं चिय विमलं"
english: "Though weighed down by weight, The army of men is constantly on the move, As though by regulation, But for some odd reason The lotus has to be weighed."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए कोडिसिलाउद्धरणं नाम अठ्ठचत्तालं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "Proud lady, Kodisila is the name given to the festival of purification." ""

prakrit: "तत्तो सो सिरिभूई,संपत्तो सिरिपुरं रयणचित्तं,पविसइ हणुयस्स संहा,तावेन्तं पेच्छई दूयं"
english: "There she is, bowed head, Wealth on the head, The mind of a wise man, Drunk on wine, Looking after others as well."

prakrit: "अत्थाणिसन्निविट्ठो,हणुओ समयं अणङ्गकुसुमाए,गुण-रूवसालिणीए,चन्दणहानन्दिणीए य"
english: "Be attentive, time will tell," said the doe, "Because the moon is full of pleasantries."

prakrit: "काऊण सिरपणाम,चन्दणहासन्तिओ तओ दूओ,साहइ हणुयस्स फुडं,दण्डयरण्णाइयं सवं"
english: "Who is the master of penance, Sandalwood smile, Tao doo, Sahai huyas phudam, Dandayaranaya yam." ""

prakrit: "ते लक्खणेण वहिया,सामिय! सम्बुक्क-दूसणा दो वि,सीयाहरणनिमित्ते,इह जाओ विग्गहो परमो"
english: "That characteristic girl, Samiya! Both embarrassment and embarrassment. For the sake of brevity: He is the supreme wizard." ""

prakrit: "सुणिऊण इमं वत्तं,अणङ्गकुसुमा खणं गया मोहं,आसत्था रुयइ तओ,सहोयरं चेव पियरं च"
english: "Listen to me, It's my business, Anangkusuma's desire is gone, Hope is crying, My brother and I are at loggerheads."

prakrit: "तं पेच्छिऊण एत्तो,खुहियं अन्तेउरं रुयइ सर्व,जह वीणा-वंसरवो,खणेण ओहामिओ सबो"
english: "Look at that man! Everyone is crying loudly, Everyone is clapping their hands." ""

prakrit: "हा ताय! हा सहोयर!,कत्तो सि गया महं अपुण्णाए?,चिरकालविप्पमुक्का,किं मज्झ न दंसणं देह?"
english: "Hey, mate! Hey, how come you've missed me? Wait a minute, you stupid bitch. Can't you see I have a body?" ""

prakrit: "एयाणि य अन्नाणि य,दुहिया खरदूसणस्स रोवन्ती,संथावणकुसलेहिं,मन्तीहिं उवसमं नीया"
english: "It's Anna, The poor girl is crying hoarse, Her breasts are drooping, She can't sleep, She's exhausted."

prakrit: "सबं च ताण काउं,पवणसूओ पेयकम्मकरणिज,सुग्गीवरायतणयं,सदाविय पुच्छइ दूयं"
english: "Everything is stressful, The wind blows, Drunken women make love, The traveler makes love, And the traveler always asks how things are."

prakrit: "अह तत्थ भणइ दूओ,देव! निसामेहि अवहिओ होउं,कन्ताविओगदुहियं,सुग्गीवं जाणसी चेव"
english: "Oh! tell me then! O god! Let there be silence for a while." "I beg you, daughter - in - law!" "You know how to rejoice."

prakrit: "महिलादुहियमणो सो,सरणं चिय राघवं समल्लीणो,गन्त्र̥̄ण निययनयरं,जुज्झइ समयं चिय रिवूणं"
english: "A woman's love is pure, A man's senses are pure, Love's laws are eternal, War takes time, And love's rebirth is eternal."

prakrit: "दछ्रण रामदेवं,वेयाली निग्गया महाविज्जा,ताहे सरेहि निहओ,पउमेणं साहसो समरे"
english: "See, Ramdev, the road is slippery, The roads are muddy, And the roads are impassable. The wife must have had more courage Than her husband."

prakrit: "सोऊण वयणमेयं,पवणसुओ भणइ साहु साहु त्ति,राघव! सुग्गीवबलं,वसणनिमग्गं समुद्धरियं"
english: "When he speaks, I reply," "Friend, help me, Raghava! Thanks to your strength, The sea is springing up." ""

prakrit: "सोऊण कमलनामा,पिउसोगपरिक्खयं हणुवभज्जा,सम्माणदाणजुत्तं,कुणइ तओ सा महाणन्दं"
english: "Write a lotus name, Teach your lover to eat honey, Respectful speech, Virtuous conduct, Then he will attain greatness."

prakrit: "दूयवयणेण चलिओ,सिरिसेलो वरविमाणमारूढो,रह-तुरय-गयसमग्गो,संघटुट्ठन्तभडनिवहो"
english: "Prostrate yourselves on the river bank, Firmly bear the rain clouds, Hold your breath, For fear the arrows of the God of Love will fly By."

prakrit: "अह सो कमेण पत्तो,किक्किन्धिपुरं च तत्थ अवइण्णो,सुग्गीवेण सहरिसं,अहियं संभासिओ हणुओ"
english: "Ah, the leaf of bitterness, And the lotus leaf of incompetence. For the town is ripe for prosperity. Here come the hunters!"

prakrit: "पउमस्स चेट्ठियं सो,तस्स कहेऊण वाणराहिवई,रामस्स सन्नियासं,मारुइसहिओ समणुपत्तो"
english: "Proud lady, Tell me, you won't be able to make love again. Rama is always sober. He'll kill you With his sharp arrows."

prakrit: "दठूण य एज्जन्तं,हणुवं अब्भुट्टिओ पउमणाहो,अवग्र̥हइ परितुट्टो,सिणेहसंभासणं कुणइ"
english: "Look at her breasts, They're covered with gooseflesh, Like jewels wrapped around a woman's bosom."

prakrit: "लच्छीहराइएहिं,भडेहि संभासिओ पवणपुत्तो,दिन्नासणोवविट्ठो,सेसा वि जहाणुपुबीए"
english: "Look! They're covered with gooseflesh. Once they've had their way They've turned to ashes."

prakrit: "भद्दासणे निविट्ठो,पउमो वरकणयकुण्डलाहरणो,पीयम्बरपरिहाणो,तस्स ठिओ लक्खणो पासे"
english: "Take a bath in the Bhadrasana, Bow down before the bridegroom, Look beyond the cucumber, Wait till you see him."

prakrit: "सुग्गीव-अङ्ग-अङ्गय-जम्बव-नल-नील-कुमुयमाईया,तह य विराहियसहिया,वेढेत्ता'वट्ठिया रामं"
english: "Well - fed - limbs, limbs, thighs, nails, sapphires, lotuses, etc., There the recluse is, The hunter's stick is Rama." ""

prakrit: "काऊण समुल्लावं,सिरिसेलो भणइ राघवं एत्तो,कह तुज्झ सामि! पुरओ,घेप्पन्ति गुणा अपरिमेया?"
english: "Who's the fool? Siricello, tell me, Raghava! How can you be so naïve? You fool, Don't multiply by yourself?" ""

prakrit: "वज्जावत्तधणुवरं,सहस्स'मररक्खियं वसे ठवियं,वइदेहीसंवरणे,तुज्झ सुय'म्हेहि माहप्पं"
english: "Vazhavattadhanuvaram, Sahasa," "Deer - eyed woman, You have settled in my heart." ""

prakrit: "अम्हं तुमे महाजस!,हियइ८। ववसियं महाकम्मं,सुग्गीवरूवधारी,जं निहओ साहसो समरे"
english: "O thou great One!," exclaimed the hunter. "The summer is great, The well - fed ones, Those brave ones are bound to perish."

prakrit: "उवगारिस्स महाजस!,पडिउवगारं न चेव जो कुणइ,तस्सेव भावसुद्धी,निययं पिकओसमुब्भवइ?"
english: "Your Majesty! Isn't that the way of a good man, A gentleman who acts decently, Proud of his good looks?"

prakrit: "सो सबाण वि पावो,लोद्धय-वाहाण मच्छबन्धाणं,धट्ठो घिणाविमुक्को,जो य कयग्धो इहं पुरिसो"
english: "So drink the whole lotus, The lotus is a mosquito repellent, But rub it all over With whatever you can get your hands on."

prakrit: "सबे वि तुज्झ सुपुरिस!,पडिउवयारस्स उज्जया अम्हे,गन्तूण सामि! लकं,रक्खसणाहं पसाएमो"
english: "Everything is good with you! Come on, you stupid fool! Let's go, Sammy! Wait, I've got to get rid of you." ""

prakrit: "सामिय! देहा''णत्ति,तुह महिला जेण तत्थ गन्तूणं,आणेमि भुयबलेणं,पेच्छसु उक्कण्ठिओ सिग्धं"
english: "Sammy! The body is not yours, Your wife must be on her way. I've got a trembling fever. You look so straight in the eye." ""

prakrit: "जम्बूणएण भणिओ,वच्छ हणूवन्त! साहु भणियं ते,गन्तवं चेव तुमे,लङ्कानयरी सुमणसेणं"
english: "The elephant said," "Behold, Hanuman!" "The hunter replied:" "You're the only one who knows the destination. It's the Lankan navy." ""

prakrit: "भणियं च एवमेयं,मारुइणा नत्थि एत्थ संदेहो,ताहे हरिसवसगओ,पउमो सीयाऎ संदिसइ"
english: "There's nothing wrong with that. No need to be suspicious of that. It's just the way things happen."

prakrit: "मह वयणेण भणेजसु,हणुय! तुम विरहकायरिं सीयं,जह सो तुज्झ विओगे,रामो न य निबुइं लहइ"
english: "Say what I have to say: You coward! Your heart is bursting at the seams With desire. But Rama will not budge." ""

prakrit: "जाणामि मह विओगे,मरसि तुम नत्थि एत्थ संदेहो,तह वि य समाहिहेडं,सुन्दर! जीयं धरिज्जासु"
english: "I know you will die, so don't doubt it. Yet, my dear, Life is worth living." ""

prakrit: "लोगम्मि होइ दुलहो,समागमो तह य दुल्लहो धम्मो,तत्तो य दुल्लहयरं,समाहिमरणं जिणमयम्मि"
english: "When people meet, the bridegroom is there, When everything is going well, the dharma is there; Then everything goes well."

prakrit: "तम्हा रक्खसदीवे,मा काहिसि एत्थ सुन्दरी! कालं,जावा''गच्छामि अहं,वाणरसहिओ तुह सयासं"
english: "Your protection, don't let anyone stop you! Time, Java." "I'm leaving. The arrows of the God of Love pierce your heart" ""

prakrit: "एयं पच्चयकरणं,दावेज्जसु अगुलेययं नेउं,चूडामणिं च मज्झं,आणेज्जसु तीऎ सन्निहियं"
english: "This is pastime, Take care not to go astray, Give ear to gossip and gossip, Bring me into her presence."

prakrit: "जं आणवेसि सामिय!,भणिऊणं मारुई नमइ रामं,लच्छीहरं पि एवं,सेसा वि भडा समालवइ"
english: "What do you mean, Samiya! She said," "Killing Rama, bowing before him, Like the hair of a woman possessed by a demon, Is quite an extravagance." ""

prakrit: "भणिओ च्चिय मारुइणा,सुग्गीवो जाब तत्थ गन्तूणं,एहामि ताव तुब्भे,एत्थं चिय अच्छियवं तु"
english: "Say,'You won't die, you'll prosper, But when you do, I will spare you; For here, dear friend, You are a blessing." ""

prakrit: "एव भणिऊण तो सो,आरूढो मारुई वरविमाणं,उप्पइओ गयणयलं,समयं नियएण सेन्नेणं"
english: "If you say so, then you have committed adultery. Once you have done so, I will sing your song too. Time will tell."

prakrit: "कए वि अन्नस्सुवयारजाए,कुणन्ति जे पच्चुवयारजोगं,न तेसु तुल्लो विमलो वि चन्दो,न चेव भाणू न य देवराया"
english: "No one is born without food, no one has talents equal to those of an ox, not even the moon is wet like a grasshopper's, Not even the buffalo or the God of Love."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए हणुयपत्थाणं नाम एगूणपन्नासं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "Praise be to the nectar of the moon - The power of love is supreme."

prakrit: "अह सो परोवयारी,पवणसुओ नहयलेण वचन्तो,पेच्छइ गिरिस्स उवरिं,महिन्दनयरिं सुरपुराभं"
english: "Ah! the traveler! When he speaks through the fingernails of his wife's skirt, He looks down at her thighs:" "The fragrance of a rainbow fills the air." ""

prakrit: "तं दट्ठूण सुमरियं,वयणं जणणीए नं समक्खायं,विज्जाहरसामन्तो,वसइ महं अज्जओ एत्थं"
english: "Look at that girl, Your face is swollen. No need to scold her. She lives here to give you a drink of wine."

prakrit: "नेण मए उयरत्थे,जणणी मे धाडिया महारण्णे,सीहभउविग्गमणा,पलियङ्कगुहाऎ मज्झम्मि"
english: "Not so high up, my lord, The lines on my thighs Are like a column of smoke rising from the fire of love."

prakrit: "आसासिया य मुणिणा,तत्थ पसूया वणम्मि एगागी,जाओ दइएण समं,समागमो कह वि पुण्णेहिं"
english: "Assassin's bow, Then the herd of oxen Will come crawling In unison. But when will we see each other again?"

prakrit: "तस्स'वराहस्स अहं,पडिदाणं देमि अज निक्खुत्तं,विजाहरगवमिणं,फेडेमि महिन्दरायस्स"
english: "Tis the yearning of the hunter, I will give the field at once, For victory is near, For glory is at hand."

prakrit: "एत्थन्तरम्मि पहयं,तूरं पडुपडहसद्दगम्भीरं,सुहडा य समाढत्ता,ओत्थरिउं तं महानयरं"
english: "Travel this far, For the road ahead of you Is arduous, For it is a pleasure To travel this far And that great wind is blowing."

prakrit: "सोऊण परचलं सो समागयं निययसाहणसमग्गो,अह निग्गओ महिन्दो,नयराओ रोसपज्जलिओ"
english: "The sun has returned, The clouds gather, The rivers swell, The roads are impassable." ""

prakrit: "आवडिओ संगामो,हयगयपउराण उभयसेन्नाणं,असि-कणय-चक्क तोमर-संघटुट्ठन्तसद्दालं"
english: "It's a busy street, With hundreds of people, Both women and boys, Both men and women, Both young and old, Both good and bad."

prakrit: "भग्गं महिन्दसेन्नं,दटू ण महिन्दरोयपुत्तो सो,दढचावगहियहत्थो,हणुवन्तं पाविओ सिग्धं"
english: "The God of Love is not afraid of bees, Not so much when they see a beehive as when they touch it."

prakrit: "ताव चिय मारुइणा,तस्स धणू सुनिसिएसु बाणेसु,छिन्नं रहो य भग्गो,पसन्नकित्ती तओ गहिओ"
english: "Tremble at that dog. Listen to him. Stop sniffing. Get away with that dog!" ""

prakrit: "दट्ठ ण सुयं गहियं,महिन्दराया समुट्ठिओ रुहो,हणुएण समं जुज्झं,आवडिओ पहरणविहत्थो"
english: "Look! She is not asleep, The buffalo is still sleeping, The elephant is still fighting, And the donkey is still without its tail."

prakrit: "सर-झसर-सत्ति-तोमर,महिन्दराया वि मुञ्चई रुट्ठो,हणुओ वि ते महप्पा,आउहनिवहे निवारेइ"
english: "Sir, jasmine, Satti, Tomar, the buffalo is still begging for bread, The ox is still the master of the herd, And now the ox has gone." ""

prakrit: "मायासहस्सकलियं,काऊण य दारुणं महाजुज्झं,गरुडेण विसहरो इव,तेण महिन्दो रणे गहिओ"
english: "My lovely girl, How cruel a thing it is to be weighed down by an ox, Like a poisoned arrow dropped by an eagle."

prakrit: "गहियस्स पवणपुत्तो,पडिओ मायामहस्स चलणेसु,भणइ य इह दुच्चरियं,तं मज्झ गुरू खमेज्जासु"
english: "Go - between! You have fallen at my feet, My lover is passing by. Tell me, you rascal: Forgive me, my teacher, for I have done wrong."

prakrit: "नाऊण य पडिभणिओ,वच्छय! साहु त्ति साहु बलविरियं,जाएण तुमे पुत्तय!,निययकुलं भूसियं सयलं"
english: "Come on, you silly girl, Stop your anger! It's your son's fault you're making a mess of it." ""

prakrit: "तं खामिऊण हणुओ,निययं मायामहं परिकहेइ,सर्व पउमागमणं,अप्पणयं गमणकजं च"
english: "Forgive me that, Destroy me, For I have turned my back on you, All in the name of love, And betrayed myself."

prakrit: "अहयं लङ्कानयरी,अज्जय! वच्चामि तुरियकज्जेणं,तं पुण किक्किन्धिपुरं,गच्छसु रामस्स पासम्मि"
english: "Here is the Lankan maiden, ajay! I will follow the sound of the trumpet. Once again, Kikindipuram, go to Ramasa Pasamami." ""

prakrit: "एव भणिऊण तो सो,उप्पइओ नहयले पवणपुत्तो,लङ्काहिमुहो वच्चइ,इन्दो अमरावई चेव"
english: "If you say so, you are lying on your back. Lanka's face opens wide. India is immortal." ""

prakrit: "गन्तुं महिन्दकेऊ,सुएण समयं पसन्नकित्तीणं,पूएइ रामदेवं,बहुभडपरिवारिओ पयओ"
english: "Go and make a feast of sweets, Sleep well, Time will tell." "Dear Ramdev, Have a lot of family meals!" ""

prakrit: "मायावित्तेहि समं,जाओ च्चिय अञ्जणाऎ संजोगो,पडुपडहतूरपउरो,तत्थेव कओ महाणन्दो"
english: "As the illusion of love, So goes the delusion of ignorance, Stupid traveler, Then who is a great man?"

prakrit: "दट्ठण आगयं ते,तत्थ महिन्दं विराहियाईया,सुहडा परितुट्ठमणा,पुणो पसंसन्ति पउमाभं"
english: "When you see her, You cease to be so loud, When you dream of making love again, You lose yourself in love."

prakrit: "धम्मेण पुवस्सुकएण उत्तमा,सोक्खालया सबजणस्स वल्लहा,पावन्ति तुझं विमलं जसं नरा,तम्हा सया होह सुसंजमुज्जया"
english: "The blossom of dharma is superior to that of jasmine, the joys are for all to see, Your vimla does not last as long as it takes, For with it your whole being enriched."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए महिन्ददुहियासमागमविहाणं नाम पन्नासइमं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "Proud lady, Two hundred and fifty names are enough for me."

prakrit: "अह तस्स नहयलेणं,वच्चन्तस्स'न्तरे तओ जाओ,वररयणपज्जलन्तो,दीवो च्चिय दहिमुहो नामं"
english: "Oh! take a bath there, go to the river next day, The bridegroom is shining, The lamp is burning, Such is the name of my husband."

prakrit: "अह तम्मि पवरदीवे,अस्थि पुरं दहिमुहं ति नामेणं,भवणसहस्साइण्णं,काणण-वणमण्डिउद्देसं"
english: "Ah! the lamp that illuminated her face, That burnt her bones in one fell swoop, With thunder and lightning in her ears - The forest of jasmine."

prakrit: "तस्स पुरस्सा''सन्ने,नाणाविहरुक्खसंकडुद्देसे,हत्थावलम्बियभुयं,दिढे हणुवेण मुणिजुयलं"
english: "Tasa purassa," said the young man, Touching the nail marks on his forehead, As though with a bow held in his hand, He looked down at his mother - in - law As if she had just given birth.

prakrit: "कोसस्स चउभागे,मुणिवरवसभाण तिण्णि कन्नाओ,तप्पन्ति तवं घोरं,विज्जाए साहणट्ठम्मि"
english: "On all four sides of the kosasa, The sage's brothers and sisters play the kanao, Speak softly and speak loudly." ""

prakrit: "अह तं मुणिवरजुयलं,जोगत्थं वणदवग्गिडज्झन्तं,कन्नाहि समं दट्ठ वच्छल्लं कुणइ हणुवन्तो"
english: "Ah! the jujube of the sage, Which, for all intents and purposes, is like a bullock cart, Looks just like the bullocks Of the elephant calf."

prakrit: "आयड्डिऊण एत्तो,सायरसलिलं घणो व विज्जाए,वरिसइ मुणीण उवरिं,मुसलपमाणासु धारासु"
english: "Come here, you fool, A lot of water has flowed, And the rivers are overflowing with rainwater."

prakrit: "सो हुयवहो असेसो,अवहरिओ तेण सलिलपूरेणं,मुञ्चन्ति कुसुमवासं,देवा उवरिं मुणिवराणं"
english: "So be it! The plowman's son, Who in turn has filled the whole lotus with nectar, Wishes the Gods would bow down before him."

prakrit: "ताव चिय कन्नाओ,ताओ उवसग्गसिद्धविज्जाओ,मेरुं पदक्खिणेउं,साहुसयायं पुण गयाओ"
english: "Tao chien kanao, tao uvsagad siddhidwijayao, meru padakshinayo, sahushayaya puna gayao"

prakrit: "नमिऊण मुणिवरिन्दे,झाणत्थे मारुई पसंसन्ति,कन्नाउ साहु सुपुरिस!,तुज्झ दढा जिणवरे भत्ती"
english: "Foolish girl, If you bow down and bow down, You will surely be killed. Can't you touch me again? Your teeth will do the rest for your life!"

prakrit: "घोरुवसग्गो एसो,साहूण निवारिओ तुमे सिग्धं,डज्झन्तीणं रण्णे,अम्हाण वि जीवियं दिन्नं"
english: "Come on, you crook, Stop your anger, you fool, The forest fires are burning, We too have to give our lives."

prakrit: "अह भणइ पवणपुत्तो,तुब्भे किं एत्थ अच्छह वणम्मि?,साहेह मज्झ एत्तो,कम्मि पुरे? कस्स दुहियाओ?"
english: "" "Oh! you fool, Is there anything you want to say?" "My lord, this is all I have to say." "Whose fault is it?"

prakrit: "एक्का भणइ'ह अम्हे,दहिमुहनयराहिवस्स दुहियाओ,गन्धवस्स महाजस! कन्नाओ तिण्णि वि जणीओ"
english: "One says," "O my heart, The fire of love, The poison of cow - dung, Is overwhelming!" "But the three are the same."

prakrit: "अहयं तु चन्दलेहा,बिइया विज्जुप्पभ ति नामेणं,इयरा तरङ्गमाला,अम्हे गोत्तस्स इट्ठाओ"
english: "Here you are, moon - eyed woman, Sitting on a lotus Loaded with bees, Waving your name all over the place, Our gotra is here."

prakrit: "जावइया इह भवणे,हवन्ति केएत्थ खेयरकुमारा,अम्हं कएण सुपुरिस!,जाया अइदुक्खिया सबे"
english: "Daughter - in - law, Where have you been all this time, Dear girl, Why are you always so nice To me!? Go, you miser." ""

prakrit: "अङ्गारओ त्ति नामं,अहियं अम्हेहि मग्गमाणो सो,अलहन्तो च्चिय जाओ,निययविरोहुज्जयमईओ"
english: "Here's my name, Angarao. So what do you mean," "Destroyed by fate?" ""

prakrit: "अट्ठङ्गनिमित्तधरो,अम्हं पियरेण पुच्छिओ साहू,ठाणेसु केसु रमणा,दुहियाणं मज्झ होहिन्ति?"
english: "Friend, ask me politely, How is it going to be for you, my dear? It's Ramna in your heart. Is it for me?"

prakrit: "सो भणइ साहसगई,जो हणिही रणमुहे पुरिससीहो,सो होही भत्तारो,एयाणं तुज्झ दुहियाणं"
english: "She said," "Courageous woman, Those hotheaded men, Who are really angry With you, Are now jealous of you." ""

prakrit: "तत्तो पभूइ अम्हं,ताओ चिन्तेइ को इहं भुवणे,मारेइ साहसगई,पुरिसो वज्जाउहसमो वि?"
english: "There I am, Thinking how it will be before I forget her, Daring to kill her, Though the wretch is a man?"

prakrit: "मग्गन्तीहिं जओ सो,न य लद्धो साहसस्स हन्तारो,तत्तो साहिंसु इहं,रण्णे मणगामिणी विज्जा"
english: "The hunter is not brave enough to fight, For he is won over by his lover's wisdom. So bear with me." ""

prakrit: "अह तेण विरुद्धणं,अम्हं अङ्गारएण पावेणं,मुक्कं फुलिङ्गवरिसं,जेण वणं चेव पज्जलियं"
english: "It is he who opposes me, it is I who put up with it, It is the swollen banyan that bristles, Everything I see in the forest is illuminated."

prakrit: "जा छम्मासेण षहू!,सिज्झइ मणगामिणी महाविज्जा,सा चेव लहुँ सिद्धा,अम्हं उवसग्गसहणेणं"
english: "Go, shoot the elephant! It's a lovely woman with big breasts. She's as straightforward as ever, I dare say." ""

prakrit: "साहु महापुरिस! तुमे,वेयावच्चे कए मुणिवराणं,अम्हे वि मोइयाओ,इमाउ जलणोवसग्गाओ"
english: "Sahu, great man! You have made a fool of yourself By sitting on a pyre. We too have passed away. This is how the rivers burn." ""

prakrit: "कहियं च निरवसेसं,कज्ज पउमागमाइयं सर्व,साहसगइस्स निहणं,निययं लङ्कापुरीगमणं"
english: "Nowhere to go, Everything to do with love, Courage to leave, Destiny to return to Lanka."

prakrit: "परिमुणियकज्जनिहसो,गन्धवो आगओ तमुद्देसं,देवागमणसरिच्छं,कुणइ तओ सो महाणन्दं"
english: "Love is like a panorama, Smell is like fire, Sweat is like jasmine; When one touches a god, He is a great blessing."

prakrit: "घेत्तूण य कन्नाओ,गन्धवो राघवं समल्लीणो,साहेइ कयषणामो,नियागमणकारणं सबं"
english: "Get up, make your bed, Smell the fragrance, Hold on tight, Help me out, It's all about planning." ""

prakrit: "एयासु य अन्नासु य,सेविजन्तो य वरविभूईसु,पउमो सीयाऎ विणा,मन्नइ सुन्नं व तेल्लोक्कं"
english: "One who serves must eat, One who disappears must suffer, A husband who is faithful must abide in silence, And the world must obey."

prakrit: "अहो जणा! सुकयफलेण सुन्दरा,रई सया हवइ विओगवज्जिया,तहा समाजयह जिणिन्दसासणे,सया सुहं विमलयरं निसेवह"
english: "Oh! people! A dry fruit is beautiful, A rich one is lovely, A fragrant one is fragrant, A busy one is won over By your own society, And a pleasant one is obtained By following the Vimalayar."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए राघवगन्धव्वकन्नालाहविहाणं नाम एगपन्नासइमं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "Praise be to the divine name Raghavagandhavakannalalahavihanam, For through it all beings have attained enlightenment."

prakrit: "अह सो पवणाणन्दो,तिकूडसमुहो नहेण वच्चन्तो,पायारेण निरुद्धो,धणुसंठाणेण तुङ्गेणं"
english: "Oh! it's the wind that makes the path slippery, The treacherous traveler's eye, Stuck on the footpath, Touched by the nectar of the cucumber."

prakrit: "भणइ'ह केण निरुद्धो,गइपसरो मह इमस्स सेन्नस्स?,एयं मुणेह तुब्भे,जेण लहुं चेव नासेमि"
english: "He says," "Who is going to stop me, you angry man?" "This is just the sort of thing I do when I'm angry. I don't want to see you again."

prakrit: "पवणतणयस्स मन्ती,साहेइ महामइ ति नामेणं,मायाऎ रक्खसेहिं,कओ इमो तुङ्गपायारो"
english: "Praise be to the nature of love, Help me tell your name, Protect me from falsehood, For who is an imo Tungpayaro?"

prakrit: "अह तस्स देइ दिट्ठी,पेच्छइ बहुकूडनन्तनियरोहं,दाढाविडम्बिओटुं,विउलं आसालियावयणं"
english: "Oh! the way she looked at him, She could see the endless stream of large buds, Her hair twisted around, Her eyes fixed on his face."

prakrit: "भीमाहिफडावियर्ड,विमुक्कसुंकारविससमुज्जलियं,पलयघणसरिसभूयं,समन्तओ घोरपायारं"
english: "Bhimahifdaviard, Vimukkasunkaravisamujalyam, Palayagansagarisubhumi, Samanto ghorpayaram"

prakrit: "सो वजकवयदेहो,हणुओ हन्तूण जन्तपायारं,आसालियाऎ वयणे,पइसरइ तओ गयाहत्थो"
english: "So you stupid coward, Goose pimples on the hunter's wife, Speak plainly, And when she has the money, Go away!"

prakrit: "अह तीऎ फालिऊणं,कुच्छी नक्खेसु निग्गओ सिग्धं,सालं पुणो पुणो च्चिय,गयापहारेसु चुण्णेइ"
english: "Oh! tear it down, Wretched nail marks, Straightforward shoots, Year after year renewed, Gone are the beaks of the fair."

prakrit: "तं घोरमहासई,सुणिऊणा''सालियाऎ विज्जाए,सयमेव सालरक्खो,वज्जमुहो उढिओ रुट्ठो"
english: "You naughty girl, Listen up!" he whispered, "You silly girl, Protect your face always." ""

prakrit: "दट्टण अभिमुहं तं,मारुइसुहडा वराउहसमग्गा,अह जुज्झिउं पयत्ता,समयं पडिवक्खसेन्नेणं"
english: "I will face the crowd, my slim body like a warrior's, But it is time to face the enemy."

prakrit: "तं रणमुहं पयत्तं,अहवा किं जंपिएण बहुएणं?,जह तक्खणम्मि जायं,नच्चन्तकबन्धपेच्छणयं"
english: "His face is like a banner:" "Ah! Why should I yawn so much?" "As if it were a banner That was to be hung on his head."

prakrit: "एयारिसम्मि जुज्झे,वट्टन्ते सुणिसिएण चक्केणं,छिन्नं सिरं च सहसा,मारुइणा वज्जवयणस्स"
english: "It's like fighting a war, you hear it all the time, You shake your head, Suddenly you're hit by lightning." ""

prakrit: "दट्ठ ण पिइवहं सा,अह लङ्कासुन्दरी ससोगमणा,कोवं समुबहन्ती,समुट्ठिया रहवरारूढा"
english: "See, I am not a drunkard, Oh! the fragrance of Lanka's fragrance, The flood of anger, The arrows of the God of Love."

prakrit: "ठा-ठाहि सवडहुत्तो,मह पियरं मारिऊण हणुव! तुमं,जेण सरघायभिन्नं,पेसेमि जमालयं सिग्धं"
english: "" "Stop, you coward! Kill me, my dear! You bastard! If you try to escape, I'll find you hiding under the weight of my own thighs."

prakrit: "सा जाव मुञ्चइ सरे,मारुइणा ताव धणुवरं छिन्नं,पेसेइ तओ सत्ती,सा वि य बाणेसु पडिरुद्धा"
english: "She will go to and fro, He will shoot at you, She will slice at you with a sharp knife, And still you will go away. Even so, her arrows are averted."

prakrit: "विज्जाबलसन्निहिया,मोग्गर-सर-झसर-भिण्डमालाई,मुञ्चइ सिरिसेलोवरि,रुसिया विज्जु व चलहत्था"
english: "Vijjabalasannihia, Moggar-sar-jhasra-bhindamalai, Munchai Siriselowari, Rusia vijju va chalhattha"

prakrit: "अह तं आउहनिवहं,हणुओ छेत्तूण निययबाणेहिं,पेच्छइ सिरिसमरूवं,अह लंकासुन्दरी समरे"
english: "Here I am, Trying to conceal my anger, Looking down the road for the right opportunity: It's the moon of Lanka."

prakrit: "आयण्णपूरिएहिं,कडक्खदिट्ठीवियारनिसिएहिं,तह इयरेहि न भिन्नो,अहयं जह मयणबाणेहिं"
english: "Like the full moon, Like the pearl of a bracelet, Like a banner on a banner That says:" "This year is no different." ""

prakrit: "समरे वरं खु मरणं,एत्थं चिय सरसहस्तभिन्नस्स,न य सुरलोगे वि महं,जीयं तु इमाऎ रहियस्स"
english: "Eternal rest grant unto me, O God of Love, For here I am With you all the days of my separation. Even in my absence you are my life."

prakrit: "एवमणस्स य तो सा,मयणेण व चोइया पलोयन्ती,हणुयं सुन्दररूवं,सहसा आयल्लयं पत्ता"
english: "It's the mind that makes her, Like a peacock plucking a field of bees, Look so beautiful On the inside That suddenly a leaf falls."

prakrit: "चिन्तेइ जइ इमेणं,समयं भोगे न भुञ्जिमो एत्थं,तत्तो दूरेण महं,इहलोगो निप्फलो होइ"
english: "If you think about it, I'd better not waste time here. Far be it from me, For this very thing is doomed to failure."

prakrit: "पप्फुल्लकमलवयणा,तं लङ्कासुन्दरी भणइ एत्तो,देवेसु वि न जिया हं,तुमेव परिणिज्जिया सामि!"
english: "You clever girl, That Lankan beauty says so much, Devesu, I'm not going to live without you, You stingy bastard!"

prakrit: "एत्तो समागया सा,हणुवेण निवेसिया निए अङ्के,कुसुमाउहेण व रई,धणियं अवग्र̥हिया बाला"
english: "Here she is, Decorated with nectar, Scorched with acacia flowers, Like a poor farmer's daughter, With hair twisted around her waist."

prakrit: "कुबन्ति समुल्लावं,दोणि वि घणपीइसंपउत्ताई,दिवसावसाणसमए,ताव य अत्थं गओ सूरो"
english: "The whole of Kubanti, Both my husband and I, Are overflowing with wealth, In broad daylight, So where is the sun then?"

prakrit: "तत्तो गयणुद्देसे,विजाए थम्भिया घणाईया,नयरं च कयं विउलं,सुरपुरिसरिसं मणभिरामं"
english: "There you are, dancing in the rain, Visually exhausted, Scorched by the rays of the moon, Like playing the flute to a dancer's tune."

prakrit: "वसिऊण तत्थ रत्ति,बलेण समयं पहायसमयम्मि,पवणतणओ पयट्टो,तं लङ्कासुन्दरी भणइ"
english: "If you stay there, the charioteer will tell you the time is ripe, If you travel alone, It's the beauty of Lanka."

prakrit: "सुण सुन्दरि! संखेवं,सीया रामस्स अवहिया रणे,संपेसिओ य सिग्घ,निययपुरं रक्खसिन्दाणं"
english: "" "Listen! Lovely girl! The forest fires are fierce, The Ramasa is impatient, The tiger is restless, The lioness is always on the lookout, Protecting the sacred grove of jasmine."

prakrit: "सुग्गीवस्स किसोयरि!,पउमेण कए तओ य उवयारे,पडिउवयारनिमित्ते,एत्तो वच्चामि लङ्का हं"
english: "Well - done girl! You're right, my dear. I'm off to Lanka, To visit you later." ""

prakrit: "कहिऊण य तं सर्व,तीऎ समं पत्थिओ पवणपुत्तो,चण्डाणिलसरिसजवो,तिकूडसिहरामहो सिग्धं"
english: "Tell me, all of you; She walks on the same path As all the other women in the village." ""

prakrit: "एवं इमं तु पेच्छह कम्मविचित्तयाए,सयलजसं उवेइ पियसंगमभत्ताए,लङ्कासुन्दरी' हणुवस्स विरोहाए,ववहरियं सिणेहविमलरइविचित्ताए"
english: "And here you are, staring into my eyes, Like a woman making love On the lotus of her husband's cheek." ""

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए हणुवकन्नालाभलङ्काविहाणं नाम बावन्नं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "Praise be to the pious woman whose name has been forgotten In this damned world." ""

prakrit: "एत्तो मगहाहिवई!,हणुओ लङ्कापुरि समणुपत्तो,पविसइ बिभीसणहरं,दारत्थं चेव एगागी"
english: "This is the land of the God of Love!" sighs the Lankapuri hostess. "The landowner's house is in ruins. There must be another door."

prakrit: "दिट्ठो बिभीसणेणं,हणुओ संभासिओ निविट्ठो य,काऊण समुल्लावं,भणइ तओ कारणं निययं"
english: "Look, there's confusion, There's jealousy, There are quarrels. Who's to blame? If you tell him the reason, It's fate."

prakrit: "मह वयणेण बिभीसण,लङ्कापरमेसरं भणसु एवं,जह परमहिलासङ्गो,पविरुद्धो उभयलोगम्मि"
english: "Because my speech was divided, I wished to make myself heard on the stage above Lanka, Where, my dear friend, I might rise against the wind."

prakrit: "मज्जायाण नरिन्दो,मूलं सरियाण पबओ हवइ,तम्मि अणायारत्थे,अहियं तु पवत्तए लोगो"
english: "Merciless Narindo, Mool sariyan pabo hawai, Tamari aayarathey, Here you are, my dear." ""
