english: "Say what I have to say :'Honey, you silly bitch! You silly messenger.'"" Once again, my friend, This is how the wind blows. "

prakrit: "तत्थुद्देसम्मि मए,चारणसमणा महन्तगुणकलिया,परिवन्दिया तुमे वि य,तिवणं भत्तिराएणं"
english: "There you are, my dear, The greatest virtuous girl in the world, Always looking out for you, Always thinking of you."

prakrit: "विमलजले पउमसरे,वणहत्थी मयगलन्तगण्डयलो,दमिओ तुमे महाजस!,नागो इव मन्तवादीण"
english: "Vimalajale paumasare, Vanahathi melted with anger, Damio tu mahajasa!," chanted the nāga.

prakrit: "अन्ना वि चन्दणलया,कुसुमभरोणमियसुरहिगन्धिल्ला,भमरेसुग्गीयरवा,भुयासु अवगूहिया सामि!"
english: "Anna, V Chandanalaya, Kusuma Bharonmiyasa, Surahigandhilla, Bhamaresuggiyarava, Bhuyasu Vaguhiya Saami!" ""

prakrit: "पउमसरस्स तडत्था,ईसावस किंचिमुवगएण तुमे,उप्पलनालेण हया,अहयं अइकोमलकरेणं"
english: "Aunt, The slightest trace of jealousy is enough to make you tremble; It's only because of the water that has boiled. I am unable to bear the heat."

prakrit: "अह पवयस्स उवरिं,नाह! मए पुच्छिया तुमे सिट्ठा,नीलघणपत्तविडवा,एए णंदिदुमा भद्दे!"
english: "Ah, you fool, no! I beg of you, you scruffy bitch. It's nasty, you nasty bitch!" ""

prakrit: "तीरे कण्णरवाए,नईऎ मज्झण्हदेसयालम्मि,पडिलाहिया य साहू,दोहि वि अम्हेहि भत्तीए"
english: "The banks are slanting, The roads are slippery, The rivers are in spate, And so is my husband." ""

prakrit: "घुटुं च अहो दाणं,पडिया य सकञ्चणा रयणवुट्ठी,पवणो सुरहिसुयन्धो,देवेहि वि दुन्दुही पहया"
english: "The knees are heavy, The feet are firm, The mind is open, The wind is blowing freely, The gods too have misfortune on their shoulders."

prakrit: "तेएण पजलन्ती,तइया चूडामणी इमा लद्धा,एयं नेहि कइद्धय,साहिन्नाणं मह पियस्स"
english: "That's why she is so angry. Your bracelets are so hot. No need to cry. I am thirsty because of you." ""

prakrit: "भणिऊण एवमेयं,गेण्हइ चूडामणि पवणपुत्तो,संथावेइ रुयन्ती,सीया महुरेहि वयणेहिं"
english: "Speak thus: The cow gives milk to the poor farmer's wife, Makes him cry bitterly, And makes him weep bitterly."

prakrit: "मा वच्चसु उबेयं,सामिणि! अहयं दिणेसु कइएसु,आणेमि पउमनाहं,समयं चिय वाणरबलेणं"
english: "" "Don't worry, girl! I'll give you something in return. It's my turn, Time," "whispered the doe."

prakrit: "काऊण तीऎ पणई,तस्सुद्देसस्स निग्गओ तुरिओ,दिट्ठो य पवणपुत्तो,उज्जाणगयाहि नारीहिं"
english: "Who is her husband, Trembling with excitement, Staring at a woman whose breasts are swollen?"

prakrit: "अन्नोन्नसमुल्लावं,कुणन्ति किं वा इमो विमाणाओ,अवइण्णो सुरषवरो,सोमणसवणाहिसङ्काए?"
english: "What is there to be angry about, Or jealousy or jealousy, Or the pleasures of silence Or the fears of dreaming?"

prakrit: "सुणिऊण निरवसेस,दसाणणो हणुवसन्तियं वत्तं,पेसेइ किङ्करबलं,भणइ य मारेह तं दुढे"
english: "One who listens keeps busy, One who knows how to weep and wail keeps busy; One who thinks with a trembling heart Says that killing is difficult."

prakrit: "सामिवयणेण पत्ता,बहवो च्चिय किङ्करा गहियसत्था,ते पेच्छिऊण हणुओ,उम्मूलेउं वणं लग्गो"
english: "A leaf with a smooth surface, A flock of parrots falling from it, A swarm of gnats hovering above it." ""

prakrit: "तं मारुईण भगं,पउमुज्जाणं पणट्ठलायणं,कमलिणिवणं व नज्जइ,विलोलियं मत्तहत्थीणं"
english: "Foolish girl, Stop beating that man, Stop threatening his wife, Stop kissing her on the mouth, And get drunk on liquor."

prakrit: "एयन्तरम्मि पत्त,महाबलं उत्थरन्तपाइक्कं,वेढेइ पवणपुत्तं,दिवायरं चेव घणवन्दं"
english: "This is the autumn leaf, The great emerald is rising, The Veda is waning, The lamp is burning, And the sky is overcast."

prakrit: "सर-झसर-सत्ति-सबल,मुञ्चन्ति भडा समच्छरुच्छाहा,सिरिसेलस्स अभिमुहा,सामियकज्जुज्जया सबे"
english: "The head is bristling, The trunk is swaying, The shoulders are drooping, The hair is loose, The ears are prickly, The limbs are straight."

prakrit: "तं आउहसंघायं,विनिवारेऊण अञ्जणातणओ,पहणइ रक्खससुहडा,फलिहसिला-सेल रुक्खेहिं"
english: "Come on, you shameless girl, Don't go out in the open, Wear protective gear, Sell fruit and rub it in your hair."

prakrit: "एक्कण तेण सेणिय!,आउहरहिएण तं बलं सर्व,हय-विय-विप्परद्धं,जीवियलोलं अह पलाणं"
english: "That's why he's such a strong man!" "Because he has all the strength at his disposal," "Yes, I am spoilt for choice." "I am rooting for the living"

prakrit: "भवणाणि तोरणाणि य,अट्टालयविविहचित्ततुङ्गाइं,चूरेइ पवणपुत्तो,अणेयपासायसिहराई"
english: "Ornament is like a banner, Like a banner on the roof of a house, Like the banner of victory proclaiming the victory of good over evil."

prakrit: "चरणेसु करयलेसु य,गयापहाराहयाणि सवाणि,निवडन्तरयणकूडाणि ताणि कणकणकणन्ताई"
english: "When you set foot on the moon, you have to walk on it. When you step on it You have to travel a long way."

prakrit: "जङ्घावायसमुट्ठिय-रएण बहुवण्णपसरमाणेणं,इन्दाउहखण्डाणि व,कयाणि विउले गयणमग्गे"
english: "The thighs are covered with gooseflesh - The rays of the moon are multi - colored, Like the lobes of an egg - apple tree." ""

prakrit: "अवि धाह-रुण्ण-विलविय-जुवईजण-बालकाहलपलावा,सुवन्ति भउविग्गा,लोया किं किं ति जंपन्ता?"
english: "Without a sound, without a cry, Without any sound, Without a cry from the young men... What is this talk about the world?"

prakrit: "खम्भे हन्तूण गया,तुरया गलरज्जुया वि तोडेन्ति,हिण्डन्ति नयरमज्झे,भेसन्ता जणवयं बहुसो"
english: "The pole is mangled, The trumpet is blown, And the cords of the throat are broken. It's as if the moon were burning brightly, As if it were a woman in disguise."

prakrit: "लङ्कापुरीऎ एवं,भञ्जन्तो भवणसयसहस्साई,हणुओ दढववसाओ,संपत्तो रावणं जाव"
english: "Among the Lankapuris, Those who roam are feared, Among the wild beasts are hunted, And among wealth is Ravana."

prakrit: "दट्ठूण रक्खसवई,निययपुरि भग्गभवणउज्जाणं,जंपइ रोसवसगओ,मह वयणं वो निसामेह"
english: "Look, she protects you, Always be vigilant, Always make sure you're safe, Always speak loudly, And always leave without saying a word."

prakrit: "मय-मालवन्त-तिसिरा,सुय-सारण-वइरदाढ-'सणिवेगा!,कुम्भ-निसुम्भ-विहीसण-हत्थ-पहत्थाइया! सबे!"
english: "May - Malavant - Tisira, Suy - Saran - Vayiradadha -" "Be careful!, Aquarius - Without limb - Without hand - Protect! All of you!" ""

prakrit: "जो कइलासुद्धरणे,आसि जसो मज्झ सयलतेलोक्के,इह भञ्जन्तेण पुरी,सो फुसिओ पवणपुत्तेणं"
english: "One who recites aloud, As if I were speaking to the whole world, Is full of gossip; He is addicted to gossip."

prakrit: "वाणरमलिउज्जाणं,न सुहं दटु पि दुम्मणं लकं,परपुरिसकरकयग्गह-विमणं व पियं पिययमेणं"
english: "A handsome young man, With eyes wide open But not so dark As to deceive others - Love's poison and drunkenness."

prakrit: "जम-वरुण-इन्दमाई,जिया अणेया मए महासुहडा,तं वाणराहमेणं,इमेण कह संपयं छलिओ?"
english: "Jāma-varuna-indāmai, Jīya Aneya is my great warrior, so what is the use of concealing his wealth in words?"

prakrit: "ता हणह महाभेरी,लहुं पराणेह सन्दणं अजियं,दुट्ठस्स तस्स गन्तुं,करेमि इह निग्गहं घोरं"
english: "That man is very proud of me, I have never seen such a thing with another man, I will go to him only if he shows me the way."

prakrit: "एव परिभासमाणं,तायं विन्नवइ इन्दइकुमारो,एयस्स कए सामिय!,परितप्पसि किं तुमं गाढं?"
english: "Such is the state of affairs, Such are the pleasures of love, My dear! Why so anxious? Are you in a hurry?"

prakrit: "उप्पइउं दूरयरं,पणट्ठजोइसगणं दलियमेरुं,पल्हत्थेमि य सयलं,भण ताय! भुयासु तेलोकं"
english: "" "Wait a moment, you silly girl, Wait a minute, Hold on to that pearl That was stuck in my hair! It's like an oil lamp in a suitcase."

prakrit: "नाऊण तस्स चित्तं,ताहे आणवइ दहमुहो पुत्तं,तं गेण्हिऊण दुटुं,आणेह लहुं मह समीवं"
english: "Now think of that man, you stubborn son of a bitch. Once he's had his way You'll have to kneel down beside me."

prakrit: "नमिऊण रावणं सो,गयवरजुत्तं रहं समारूढो,सन्नद्धबद्धकवओ,बलेण सहिओ महन्तेणं"
english: "Be patient, Raven., Be vigilant, join the battle, Be prepared, Say what you have to say."

prakrit: "अह मेहवाहणो वि य,रणपरिहत्थो गयं समारूढो,एरावणं विलग्गो,नज्जइ इन्दो सयं चेव"
english: "Ah, the great storm, Gone are the warriors from beyond the battlefield, Gone is the forest, Not seen from the inside Yet."

prakrit: "रहवर-तुरङ्ग-वग्गिर-संघटुट्ठन्तगयघडाडोवं,चलियं बहुतूरसहस्सनिग्धोसं"
english: "Like the warrior - The trumpet - The stag - The bandaged elephant - Let's fight with it for the long haul." ""

prakrit: "जाव य खणन्तरेक्कं,ताव य सन्नद्धबद्धतोणीरं,हणुवस्स निययसेन्नं,पराइयं दप्पियामरिसं"
english: "Go, be prepared for the harsh winter, Be ready for the rainy season, For the monsoons are fleeting And the nights unbearable."

prakrit: "दोसु वि बलेसु सुहडा,आवडिया रहसपसरिउच्छाहा,असि-कणय-चक्क-तोमर-सएसु घायन्ति अन्नोन्नं"
english: "Both say that it's fine, The stranger whispers a mystery, And the stranger mutters nonsense." ""

prakrit: "अह ते पवङ्गमभडा,इन्दइसुहडेहि तिवषहरेहिं,पहया विभग्गमाणा,ओसरिया मारुई नाव"
english: "Oh! it's a rocky promontory, Like a river in spate, Like the sails of a shipwreck." ""

prakrit: "निययबलपरिभवं सो,दट्ठणं पवणनन्दणो रुट्ठो,अह जुज्झिउं पवत्तो,समयं चिय इन्दइभडेहिं"
english: "Be strong, be brave, stop being angry, keep fighting, for the passage of time will prove fatal."

prakrit: "पयण्डदण्डसासणा,विइण्णहेमकङ्कणा,चलन्तकण्णकुण्डला,सुवण्णबद्धसुत्तया"
english: "Payanda dandasana, vinna hema kankaana, chalantaka kundala, suvannabiddha sutya."

prakrit: "विचित्तवत्थभूसणा,सुयन्धपुप्फसेहरा,सकुङ्कुमङ्गराइया,तिरीडदित्तमोत्तिया"
english: "Stupid woman, Suyandha, puffed up with tears, Succumbing to grief, Tired of sulking."

prakrit: "सचक्क-खग्ग-मोग्गरा,तिसूल-चाव-पट्टिसा,जलन्तसत्ति-सबला,महन्तकुन्त-तोमरा"
english: "Sacchakk - khagg - moggara, Tisool - chaav - pattisa, Jalantasatti - sabala, Mahantakunta - tumhara"

prakrit: "ससामिकज्जउज्जया,पवङ्गघायदारिया,विमुक्कजीयबन्धणा,पडन्ति तो महाभडा"
english: "Socialise, dress, walk, embrace, if you fall, it's a big burden." ""

prakrit: "सहावतिक्खनक्खया,लेसन्तचारुचामरा,पवङ्गमाउहाहया,खयं गया तुरंगमा"
english: "Sahavatik khanakhya, leshantacharchamara, pavangmauhahaya, khyam gaya turangma"

prakrit: "पवङ्गभिन्नमत्थया,खुडन्तदित्तमोत्तिया,पणट्ठदाणदुद्दिणा,पडन्ति मत्तकुञ्जरा"
english: "The wind is blowing with different speeds, The river is bursting at the seams, The rivers are churning, The creeks are swaying, And the rain clouds are falling."

prakrit: "विचित्तहेमनिम्मिया,विणिट्ठकञ्चणट्ठया,पवङ्गघायचुणिया,खयं गया महारहा"
english: "Wretched woman, Drenched with sweat, Covered with gooseflesh, Destroyed great man."

prakrit: "एवं तं निययबलं,विद्धत्थं इन्दई पलोएउं,बाणेहि पवणपुत्तं,छाएऊणं समाढत्तो"
english: "And with that determination, I learned to walk in the dark, To weep and wail, To embrace the moonlight."

prakrit: "अह मारुई बि एन्तं,सरनिवहं रिउजणेण परिमुक्कं,छिन्दइ चलग्गहत्थो,गयणे निसियद्धचन्देहिं"
english: "Oh! what a thrill it is to be killed! For all I have to lose Is the thrill of kissing her lips, Cutting them with my bare hands, Like the steady stream of moonbeams in a song."

prakrit: "घेत्तूण इन्दईणं,विसज्जिओ मोग्गरो अइमहन्तो,हणुमेण विणिच्छूढो,सिलाऎ सिग्धं पडिवहेणं"
english: "Catch the rainbow, Scorched by the bees, Drenched by the rays of the moon, Sealed by the silhouette of the horizon"

prakrit: "हणुयस्स इन्दइभडो,फलिहसिला-सेल-सत्तिसंघाए,मुञ्चइ चलग्गहत्थो,सो वि य एन्तं निवारेइ"
english: "The bee is so indifferent, The pods are swollen, The sails are bristling, I've no time for this sort of thing."

prakrit: "एवं काऊण चिरं,जुज्झं तो इन्दईण पवणसुओ,ससियरनिहेहि सिग्धं,बद्धो चिय नागपासेहिं"
english: "And who cares, If the fight is for the cause of love, The straightforward one for the sake of affection, Is bound only to the ways of the nagas."

prakrit: "भणिया य इन्दईणं,निययभडा सङ्कलासु दढबद्धं,एयं दावेह लहुं,मह पिउणो मारुई दुटुं"
english: "My brother - in - law, The buckets on my shoulders Are firmly fastened. It's my husband who has killed me."

prakrit: "नीओ दसाणणसभं,पुरिसेहिं पुरजणेण दीसन्तो,लङ्काहिवस्स सिटुं,एस पहू! आणिओ दुट्ठो"
english: "Come, let's go. Let the elephant sit among the elephants. Let's do it again! It's his wife! And he's naughty." ""

prakrit: "ते रावणस्स पुरिसा,कहन्ति हणुयस्स सन्तिया दोसा,सुग्गीव-राहवेहिं,सीयाए पेसिओ दूओ"
english: "They say the men of Ravana's house, The hunter's delight is poison, The traveler's pleasure is poison., The arrow is poisoned by poison."

prakrit: "सामिय! महिन्दनयरं,विद्धत्थं सो य निजिओ राया,साहूण य उवसग्गो,निवारिओ दहिमुहे दीवे"
english: "Samiya! The lamp is burning brightly, The fire is burning, The midday sun is rising, And the evening sun is setting." ""

prakrit: "गन्धबस्स महाजस! दुहियाओ तिण्णि षवरकन्नाओ,संपेसियाओ सिग्धं,इमेण रामस्स किक्किन्धि"
english: "Gandhabassa Mahājasa! The two widows bathe together, The one who rests is straight, This is the kikindhi of Rama." ""

prakrit: "भंतूण वज्जसालं,वज्जमुहो मारिओ रणे सिग्घं,एयस्स समभिलासं,अह लङ्कासुन्दरी वि गया"
english: "You silly girl, Stop your anger, Stop being angry. It's the same as swearing: I've also fallen in love with Lanka."

prakrit: "ठविऊण निययसेन्नं,इमेण लङ्काऎ बाहिरुदेसे,भग्गं पउमुज्जाणं,नाणाविहतरुलयाइण्णं"
english: "Destroyed by fate, This Lanka, from the outside, Is like a broken bow, Like a coin tossed around."

prakrit: "भवणसहस्साई पहू!,इमेण भग्गाई रयणचित्ताई,आलोडिया य नयरी,सवुड्ड-बालाउला सयला"
english: "Bhavansahasayi pahu!, This woman has broken the spirit of the king, Alodia ya nairi, Sawudda - Balaula sayala"

prakrit: "सुणिऊण इमे दोसे,रुट्ठो लङ्काहिवो भणइ एवं,दढसङ्कलेसु बन्धह,सिग्धं चिय हत्थ-पाएसु"
english: "Listen to me, you crooks; Speak rudely, speak politely, And bear with me, my poor friend, Simply point at my hands."

prakrit: "खर-फरुस-निठुराए,वायाए रावणो परमरुट्ठो,अह सविऊणा''ढत्तो,हणुवं अत्थाणिमज्झम्मि"
english: "Head - furrowed - sagging, Speaking of which Ravana took the supreme root, Ah sauna" "Drunken, the nectar of the unbending fire" ""

prakrit: "निल्लज्ज! वाणराहम!,दूयत्तं भूमिगोयराण तुमं,कुणसि! अविसेसियगुणो,पविरुद्धं खेयरभडाणं?"
english: "" "Silly girl! Vanaram! You fool, you landowner! What are you doing, being so reckless As to turn your back on the wind?"

prakrit: "अकुलीणयस्स अङ्गे,न चेव चिन्धाइं होन्ति पुरिसस्स,साहेइ निययनम्मं,दुच्चरियं ववहरन्तस्स"
english: "In the body of a man one cannot conceal one's thoughts, For men know what is true And what is false."

prakrit: "पवणंजएण न तुमं,जाओ अन्नेण केण वि नरेण,दुचरिएहि नराहम!,निवडिओ निन्दणिज्जेहिं"
english: "Because of the wind, you are not to be trifled with, For someone else is more to be feared, For wretched people cause misfortune!"

prakrit: "उवयारसहस्सेहि वि,अहिणवसम्माणदाणविभवेणं,जो मे तुमं न गहिओ,सो कह अन्नेण घिप्पिहिसि?"
english: "Though you live in poverty, How can you be so careless About what doesn't concern you?"

prakrit: "रण्णे समासयन्ति'ह,पञ्चमुहं किं न कोल्हुया बहवे,न य सप्पुरिसा लोए,कयाइ नीयं पसाएन्ति"
english: "The rhinoceros speaks in unison:" "Why not make five faces at once? There are no snakes in the world. Some deviate too quickly." ""

prakrit: "हसिऊण भणइ हणुवो,हवइ मुहं उत्तमाण पुरिसाणं,दुवयणसङ्गरहियं अहियं धम्मत्थहिययाणं"
english: "Laughing makes one laugh, blowing into the air Makes one smile, And making one's face look more attractive." ""

prakrit: "रामो लक्खणसहिओ,एही कइसेन्नपरिमिओ सिग्धं,न य रुम्भिऊण तीरइ,मेहो इव पवएण तुमे"
english: "Rama, my handsome friend, This is just the way things happen: You never tire of laughing. Maybe it's because you love to lie down."

prakrit: "आहारेसु न तित्तो,सुसाउकलिएसु अमयसरिसेसु,जह कोइ जाइ नासं,एक्केण विसस्स बिन्दूणं"
english: "Don't eat, be thirsty, be dry, be lazy, go anywhere, it's just a drop of poison."

prakrit: "जुवइसहस्सेसु सया,न य तित्ता इन्धणेसु जह अग्गी,परनारिकयपसङ्गो,तुम पि एवं विणस्सिहिसि"
english: "Young men, go to bed early. The fire isn't as hot as the burnt fuel. Go and make love. You're just like a weasel." ""

prakrit: "पत्ते विणासकाले,नासइ बुद्धी नराण निक्खुत्तं,सा अन्नहा न कीरइ,पुवकयकम्मजोएणं"
english: "When the leaves are woven, The naasi destroys wisdom, She does not eat food. The flowers rejoice in their presence."

prakrit: "आसन्नमरणभावो,जो परमहिलासु कुणसि संसम्गि,पच्छा नरयगइगओ,दुक्खसहस्साणि पाविहिसि"
english: "The prospect of imminent death, That you might attain to what is most desirable, Will surely prevent you from attaining it, Will not bring you nearer to sorrow."

prakrit: "जाएण तुमे रावण! रयणासवमाइयाण सुहडाणं,पुत्ताहमेण जणिओ,कुलक्खओ अणयकारीणं"
english: "When you are Ravana! The pleasures of the rainbow, Born of a son, Are incomparable." ""

prakrit: "सो एव भणियमेत्तो,आरुट्ठो रावणो समुल्लवइ,मारेह नयरमज्झे,एयं दुवयणपब्भारं"
english: "So I said :'Stop being angry, Ravana, you stupid fool! This is the burden of a wicked man."

prakrit: "दढसङ्कलपडिबद्धं,हिण्डावह घरघरेण नयरीए,कयधिक्कारो हु इमो,सोइज्जउ पवरलोएणं"
english: "Trapped in a tight confinement, Visiting from door to door, Every time I'm there I wake up Emo, Soaking up the energy"

prakrit: "जं रावणेण एवं,भणिओ च्चिय मारुई तओ रुट्ठो,छिन्दइ बन्धणनिवहं,सिणेहषासं षिव सुसाहू"
english: "That which Ravana uttered," "If she hits him, cry aloud." "Shattered by the ties of affection, Succeeds in making love."

prakrit: "उप्पइऊण नहयले,थम्भसहस्साउलं रयणचित्तं,भञ्जइ रावणभवणं,हणुवो चलणप्पहारेहिं"
english: "Clouds bathed in nectar, Clouds held aloft by pillars, The mind of the king, Vanquished the house of Ravana; Bees, on the other hand, steal the limelight."

prakrit: "तेण पडन्तेण इमा,गाढं चिय जन्तिया वि तुङ्गेसु,सायरवरेण समय,सयला आकम्पिया वसुहा"
english: "That is why I am falling. Even an animal that is deeply intoxicated Can grow taller. Time, my dear, is fleeting."

prakrit: "बहुभवणतोरणा सा,लङ्का काऊण भग्गषायारा,अगणियपडिवक्खभओ,उप्पइओ नहयलं हणुओ"
english: "She who shows much emotion, Who is jealous of Lanka's beauty, Worries about uncountable troubles, See how the rivers empty their banks."

prakrit: "मन्दोयरीऎ सिट्ठो,सीयाए मारुई इमो भद्दे!,छेत्तूण बन्धणाई,वच्चई किक्किन्धपुरहुत्तो"
english: "The Mandoerite sits still, Kicks the buffalo's tail, And shoots it dead with his bow!"

prakrit: "जन्तस्स जणयधूया,घत्तइ पुप्फञ्जली सुपरितुट्ठा,जंपइ गहा'णुकूला,होन्तु अविग्घं तुमं निच्चं"
english: "The beast's bride, Whom all the women cling to, Shows off her skirt, Jumps on top of her husband, But misses you."

prakrit: "इय सुचरियकम्मा होन्ति विक्खायकित्ती,अरिदढपरिबद्धा ते विमुञ्चन्ति खिप्पं,विविहसुहनिहाणं आसयन्ती विसिटुं,विमलकयविहाणा जे इहं भवजीवा"
english: "This is Such a clever girl, Having grown very thin, With arrows stuck in her eyes They pierce through her body, Seeking pleasure in different pleasures, Visibly distressed, Who knows what life holds in store For her."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए हणुवलङ्कानिग्गमणं नामं तिपञ्चासइमं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "Praise be to the pious woman whose name is derived from the nectar of the lotus."

prakrit: "अह सो कमेण पत्तो,किक्किन्धि मारुई बलसमग्गो,दिट्ठो वाणरवइणा,अब्भुढेऊण आलत्तो"
english: "Oh! what a pathetic leaf! A few drops fall from it, But the warrior's eye is set firmly on her." ""

prakrit: "समरबलियाण एत्तो,सम्माणं वरभडाण काऊणं,सुग्गीवेण समाणं,पउमसयासं समल्लीणो"
english: "Sacrifice with fire is enough, sacrifice with water is sufficient, offering with a generous offering is sufficient; the rainy season is ripe."

prakrit: "काऊण सिरपणामं,हणुवो चूडामणि समप्पेउं,रामस्स अपरिसेसं,साहइ वत्तं पिययमाए"
english: "Whom to call head, Honey, finish the powder, Ram, forever and ever; It's the wind that makes us drink."

prakrit: "गन्तूण मए सामिय!,दिट्ठा तुह रोहिणी वरुज्जाणे,आबद्धकेसवेणी,मलिणकवोला पगलियंसू"
english: "Destroy me, Samiya!, Your eyes are red like jewels in a garland, Like a bandaged woman's breasts." ""

prakrit: "वामकरधरियवयणा,मुञ्चन्ती दीह-उण्हनीसासे,तुह दरिसणं महाजस!,एगग्गमणा विचिन्तेन्ती"
english: "Left - faced woman, Looking down at you With long - eyed sighs, Your gaze towering! It's like looking into the mirror." ""

prakrit: "पायवडिएण सामिय!,समप्पिओ अङ्गुलीयओ तीए,वत्ता य कुसलमाई,सवा तुह सन्तिया सिट्ठा"
english: "Aunt, Stop your snoring! It's only your fingers that are sticking out. Can't you see they're slipping away?"

prakrit: "सुणिऊण तुज्झ वत्तं,परं पमोयं गया जणयधूया,पुच्छइ पुणो पुणो वि य,हरिसवसुब्भिन्नरोमञ्चा"
english: "Listen to what you have to say," said the young bride, turning her face away, Asking again and again What it is to be married with a handsome husband. "

prakrit: "पवणतणएण सीया,जं सिट्ठा राहवस्स जीवन्ती,तं हरिसवसगओ चिय,न माइ नियएमु अङ्गेसु"
english: "Because of your immodesty, The sitter who dwells by the wayside Lives forever. For him to go astray Is nothing to do with me."

prakrit: "आसासिओ य पउमो,अहियं चूडामणीऎ गहियाए,अमएण व फुसियङ्गो,साभिन्नाणाऎ बत्ताए"
english: "Assassins, these are the wives; my husband is at home in the fields, My wife is busy making love, My husband is abroad, My lover is abroad."

prakrit: "अन्नं पि सुणसु सामिय!,वयणं जं तुज्झ तीऎ संदिटुं,जइ ना''गच्छसि तुरियं,तो मरणं मे धुवं एत्थं"
english: "Listen to me, Samia! The words you utter cause her to doubt herself. But if you refuse to listen, Death is sure to wash over me." ""

prakrit: "चिन्तासागरवडिया,तुह विरहविसंठुला जणयधूया,दुक्खं गमेइ दियहा,रक्खसजुवईसु पडिरुद्धा"
english: "Thinking girl, Thinking how you must be grieving, Like a young man suffering separation, Protecting young men from the dark."

prakrit: "सोऊण षउमनाहो,साहिन्नाणं पियाऎ पडिवत्तिं,सोगसमुच्छयहियओ,अहियं चिय दुक्खिओ जाओ"
english: "Be still, my poor girl, For the nights are fleeting And the nights long, For here I am with those who suffer."

prakrit: "चिन्तेऊण पवत्तो,अहोमुहो दीहमुक्कनीसासो,निन्दइ पुणो पुणो चिय,निययं दुक्खासयं जीयं"
english: "Though I think of you, Ahomu, long - suffering man, Criticize again and again, Destiny gives life to sorrow."

prakrit: "तं एव चिन्तयन्तं,सोमित्ती भणइ राहवं एत्तो,किं सोयसि देव! तुमं,देहि मणं निययकरणिजे"
english: "That's the way she thinks. Somebody says," "Rahavam etho, why sleep! You, god, you're the one who determines the mind." ""

prakrit: "कजं तु दीहसुत्तं,लक्खिज्जइ कइवरस्स चित्तेणं,वाहरिओ वि चिरावइ,सो वि हु भामण्डलो सामि!"
english: "Because you are short - sighted, Destroyed someone else's mind, Prolonged by others; I am also a landowner's slave!"

prakrit: "अम्हेहि निच्छएणं,गन्तवं दहमुहस्स निययपुरी,न य बाहासु महाजस!,उत्तरिउं तीरए उदही"
english: "We are about to depart, Destroyer of horrors, Not so great an arrow!" cried the arrow.

prakrit: "अह भणइ सीहणाओ,लक्खण! किं एव भाससे गरुवं,सबेण वि कायचं,अप्पहियं चेव पुरिसेणं"
english: "" "Ah, you naughty girl! What is this talk of pride and vanity Anyway? This is the way of all men."

prakrit: "जं मारुईण लङ्का,भग्गा वरभवण-तुङ्गपायारा,तं रुढे दहवयणे,होहइ संगाममरण'म्हं"
english: "One who kills Lanka, Who destroys the sanctum - sanctorum of the Vraja River - Tungpayara, Escapes with a heavy heart And dies in the fire of love"

prakrit: "तं भणइ चन्दरस्सी,किं व गओ सीहनाय! संतासं?,को रावणस्स बीहइ,संपइ आसन्नमरणस्स?"
english: "He says Chandrassi, why go abroad? Santasam?, Who fears Ravana, who fears imminent death?" ""

prakrit: "अम्ह बले विक्खाया,अत्थि भडा खेयरा महारहिणो,बल-सत्ति-कन्तिजुत्ता,बहवे संगामसोडीरा"
english: "We have grown old, Our arms are bristling, Our hair is wavy, Our limbs are thin, Our eyes are swollen."

prakrit: "घणरइ-भूय-निणाओ,गयवरघोसो तहेव कूरो य,केलीगिलो य भीमो,कुण्डो रवि-अङ्गओ चेव"
english: "Catch the thunder - The earth sighs, The gods groan, The jasmine trees sway, The rafters sway, And the limbs sway."

prakrit: "नल-नील-विज्जुवयणो,मन्दरमाली तहा असणिवेगो,राया य चन्दजोई,सीहरहो सायरो धीरो"
english: "Nala, blue - the light of the sky, Mandaramali, That wretched fire, Like the flame of the moon, Strong is the evening sun."

prakrit: "एत्तो य वज्जदन्तो,उक्काल-'शूल-दिणयरो वीरो,उज्जलकित्ती हणुओ,हवइ य भामण्डलो राया"
english: "That's what Vajdaanto said:" "Foolish men are brave, Bright grasshoppers roam the skies." ""

prakrit: "अन्नो महिन्दकेऊ,पवणगई तह पसन्नकित्ती य,एए अन्ने य बहू,अस्थि भडा वाणरबलम्मि"
english: "Anno mahindake, pawangayi tha pasannakitti ya, anne ya bahu, asthi bhada vaaranar balmami."

prakrit: "दट्ठ ण वाणरभडे,मज्झत्थे राहवो अइतुरन्तो,भिउडीए कुडिलमुहो,खणेण जाओ कयन्तो व"
english: "Look! There are no monkeys in the forest, The roads are impassable beneath my feet, The streets are deserted. One can go anywhere just by looking."

prakrit: "घेत्तूण चावरयणं,अप्फालइ सजलजलहरनिणायं,दिद्धिं च विज्जुसरिसं,देइह लकापुरितेण"
english: "Covered with gooseflesh, Scorched with water, Stirred by lightning and lightning: The days are long and arduous."

prakrit: "पलयरविसन्नियासं,रामं दट्ठ ण वाणरा सवे,सिग्धं च गमणसज्जा,जाया परिहत्थउच्छाहा"
english: "Palayar vishnyasa, Rama is not to be seen, The talker is to be avoided, Simply go and decorate the village, Whatever the mood of the people."

prakrit: "मग्गसिरबहुलपक्खे,पञ्चमिदिवसे दिवायरे उदिए,सुहकरण-लग्ग-जोए,अह ताण पयाणयं जायं"
english: "The plowman's son, Who by the fifth day flew into the deep, Is fond of pleasure and pleasure, But he is won over by travel."

prakrit: "दिट्ठो सिही जलन्तो,निधूमो पयलदाहिणावत्तो,आहरणभूसियङ्गी,महिला सेओ य जच्चासो"
english: "The fire burns with the eye, The midday sun scorches the surface of the fire, The hunter makes love with the hunter, The wife is poisonous."

prakrit: "निग्गन्थमुणिवरिन्दो,छत्तं यहेसियं तहा कलसो,पवणो य सुरहिगंधो,अहिणवं तोरणं विउलं"
english: "Foolish bow, The roof is as big as the kadasa, The wind is as strong as the scent of jasmine, And the arrows are as wide as the lid."

prakrit: "खीरदुमम्मि य वासइ,वामन्थो वायसो चलियपक्खो,वरभेरि सङ्घसद्दो,सिद्धी सिग्धं पयासेन्ति"
english: "The poor girl lives in poverty, The left one is always on the move, The right one is busy making love, And the right is busy finding a mate."

prakrit: "एए अन्ने य बहू,पसत्थसउणा पयाणकालम्मि,जाया य मङ्गलरवा,लङ्काहिमुहस्स रामस्स"
english: "Oh! my daughter - in - law! The pastime is pastime, But come what may, For Rama's face is like Lanka's." ""

prakrit: "जह चन्दो परिवड्डइ,सियपक्खे तह य खेयरबलेणं,आपूरइ पउमाभो,अहियं सुग्गीवसन्निहिओ"
english: "As the moon turns, As the farmer's field grows, So does the water supply. I swear by prosperity."

prakrit: "राया किक्किन्धिवई,हणुओ दुम्मरिसणो नलो नीलो,तह य सुसेणो सल्लो,बहवे कुमुयाइणो सुहडा"
english: "The river is red, The streams are blue, The rivers are swollen, And the streams are sweet with nectar."

prakrit: "एए वाणरचिन्धा,महाबला सयलसाहणसमग्गा,गसमाणा इव गयणं,जन्ति महातूरकयसदा"
english: "Oh! wretched moon! A great man is capable of so much trouble, Like a man who is so won over By his singing."

prakrit: "हारो विराहियस्स वि,चिन्धं जम्बूणयस्स वडरुक्खो,सोहरवस्स य सीहो,हत्थी पुण मेहकन्तस्स"
english: "Even in adversity We forsake the brave. In anger the wise flee, In pride we bow down To our rivals."

prakrit: "जाणेसु वाहणेसु य,विमाण-गय-तुरय-रहवराईसु,गन्तुं समुज्जया ते,लङ्काहिमुहा पवणवेगा"
english: "" "Know how to steer, Fly, Tremble, Travel in all directions: He will steer you in the direction of the Lankahim."

prakrit: "दिवविमाणारूढो,पउमो सह लक्खणेण वच्चन्तो,रेहइ सुहडपरिमिओ,इन्दो इव लोयपालेहिं"
english: "The sun rises in the sky, The traveler walks with his wife, He stays with his beloved, And the night is long."

prakrit: "अह ते खणेण पत्ता,वेलंधरपवयं मणभिरामं,वेलंधरपुरसामी,जत्थ समुद्दो वसइ राया"
english: "Ah, the leaf of the cucumber, The flower of the vine, The lord of the vines, Where the sea dwells Raya."

prakrit: "वाणरबलं निएउं,तत्थ समुद्दो विनिग्गओ सिग्धं,निययबलेण समग्गो,नलस्स जुज्झे समावडिओ"
english: "Take the bow, For there the sea is straight, For by sheer force of will The whole bow, Notwithstanding the struggle in the river."

prakrit: "अह सो समुद्दराया,नलेण जिणिऊण रणमुहे बद्धो,मुक्को य निययनयरे,परिट्ठिओ राहवं पणओ"
english: "Ah! the sea! To conquer it with a spiky oar, To bind it with the bow of war, To break it with an arrow Destroyed by fate."

prakrit: "रयणसिरी कमलसिरी,रयणसलाया तहेव गुणमाला,एयाउ समुद्देणं,दिन्नाओ लच्छिनिलयस्स"
english: "Rayanasiri lotus - head, The virtuous qualities of the Rayanasala, Such is the society, These are the days of luxuries."

prakrit: "तत्थ सुवेलपुरवरे,रयणिं गमिऊण उग्गए सूरे,लङ्काहिमुहा चलिया,जयसढुग्घुट्ठतूररवा"
english: "There you are, swollen waters, Flying rays rising from the sky, Moving with the face of a lankan, Hurling trumpets of victory."

prakrit: "वाणरबलेण ट्ठिआ,लंका वरभवण-तुङ्गपागारा,सागरवरस्स मज्झे,आरामुज्जाणसुसमिद्धा"
english: "The tree with the banyan shoots, The spiky pagoda with the garland of lotuses, The ocean with its vast expanse, Are synonymous with comfort."

prakrit: "नयरीऎ समासन्ने,हंसद्दीवं तओ समणुपत्ता,अह ते हंसरहनिवं,जिणिऊणं वासिया तत्थ"
english: "A woman's business is business, A swan's love is pleasure, And a goose's are pleasure, So long as she lives."

prakrit: "भामण्डलस्स पुरिसो,रामेण पवेसिओ पवणवेगो,गन्तूण तस्स सबं,विग्गहमादी परिकहेइ"
english: "A man from abroad is a man, A woman from Rama is a traveler, Destiny is her relative, The wise traveler leads the way."

prakrit: "जत्तो जत्तो विहियसुकया जन्ति वीरा मणुस्सा,तत्तो तत्तो विजियरिउणो भोगसङ्ग लहन्ति,ताणं लोए न भवइ परं किंचि कजं असज्झं,तम्हा धम्म कुणह विमलं लोगनाहाणुचिण्णं"
english: "As long as there are happy people Like brave men Like conquerors Like warriors Like warriors There is nothing wrong with being lonely But something must be done. For what exactly is dharma And how is it that people recognize it?"

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए लङ्कापत्थाणाभिहाणं नामं चउपन्नासइमं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "In the name of my beloved wife, The path to Lanka Is paved with love and affection."

prakrit: "अह तत्थ वाणरबलं,समागयं जाणिऊण आसन्ने,वेला लवणजलस्स व,खुहिया लंकापुरी सवा"
english: "There it is, The thunderclap, Knowing the place to be, Like salt water on the river bank, Like a goodly Lankapuri shavings."

prakrit: "आरुट्ठो दहवयणो,निययं मेलेइ साहणं सयलं,जाया घरे घरे च्चिय,संगामकहा जणवयस्स"
english: "Prostrate fire, Decorate the streets, Travel from house to house, Make sure you meet people of good age."

prakrit: "संगाममहाभेरी,पहया पडुपडह-तूरसंघाया,सद्देण तेण सुहडा,सन्नद्धा सामियं पत्ता"
english: "Foolish traveler, Traveler, If you must travel by foot - Your tripod is a pleasure to behold, Right on time."

prakrit: "एत्तो लंकाहिवई,संगामसमुज्जयं पणमिऊणं,नयविहिविहूयबुद्धी,बिभीसणो भणइ निसुणेहि"
english: "Such a lonely woman, Paying tribute to the union, With new and different wisdom, Speaks without saying a word of division."

prakrit: "तुह पहु! परिट्ठिया इह,इन्दस्स व संपयां महाविउला,ससि-सङ्ख-कुन्दधवलो,भमइ जसो तिहुयणं सयलं"
english: "Come to me! It's the parrot, The great vulture, Like the jasmine of the treetops, Like a flock of geese crossing the river." ""

prakrit: "महिलाहेउं सामिय!,मा नेहि परिक्खयं खणेण तुमं,अप्पेहि जणयतणया,इमाऎ किं कारणं सिद्धं?"
english: "Women, Samia! Don't look at me If you're ready for the test. What's the reason, mother - in - law, That I'm ready?" ""

prakrit: "न य हवइ एत्थ दोसो,हवइ गुणो केवलो तिहुयणम्मि,सुहसायरे निमग्गो,भुञ्जसु विज्जाहरमहिड्डिं"
english: "There is no such thing as bad air, Only bad air. Soak yourself in the bliss of happiness. Forgive me the arrows of the God of Love"

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,आरुट्ठो इन्दई भणइ एवं,को तुज्झ आहियारो,जेण समुल्लवसि एरिसयं?"
english: "Listen to me, you naughty girl, Speak gently, And who are you to complain? Such is the nature of a gentleman." ""

prakrit: "जइ वेरियाण बीहसि,अहियं संगामकायरो सि तुमं,निक्खित्तसत्थदण्डो,पविससु भवणोदरं सिग्धं"
english: "If you're angry, I'd rather you were angry, You'd better stop, you stupid bastard. The poor thing is straight at the door."

prakrit: "निवडन्तसत्थनिवहे,संगामे मारिऊण अह सत्तुं,खग्गेणा''यड्डिज्जइ,लच्छी वीरेण निक्खुत्तं"
english: "Be careful not to fall into the trap of deceit. If I die in love, I am bound to fall in love with the one who falls in love."

prakrit: "लखूण उत्तमं चिय,महिलारयणं इमं वसुमईए,किं मुच्चइ दहवयणो,जहा तुमे भासियं वयणं?"
english: "Love is supreme, womanhood resides in it, why hide it in your bedroom, when you should be playing the flute?"

prakrit: "भणिओ बिहीसणेणं,निब्भच्छणकारणं तओ वयणं,पुत्तत्तणेण जाओ,वइरी लंकाहिवस्स तुमं"
english: "Speak softly, speak slowly, speak gently, For you are a vicious snake."

prakrit: "भवणे समुट्ठियं चिय,अंग्गी पूरेसि इन्धणेण तुमं,अहियं हियं ति मन्नसि,जंपन्तो एरिसं वयणं"
english: "The houses are full of people, You fill your body with fuel, But here I am, Believing what you say: This is the way of life."

prakrit: "कञ्चणघणपायारं,लङ्का लच्छीहरेण जाव न वि,भज्जइ सरेसु खिप्पं,ताव समप्पेहि वइदेहिं"
english: "Though you are about to depart, Do not trouble yourself By going to Lanka, For the fire will burn all over You will be missed."

prakrit: "वज्जावत्तधणुधरं,रुसियं चिय राहवं समरमज्झे,लच्छीहरेण समयं,तुब्भे न य जोहिउं सक्का"
english: "Thunder, lightning, thunder, lightning and thunder: Time for a good fight, my dear. But don't be so hasty." ""

prakrit: "जे तस्स गया पणई,सुहडा कइदीववासिणो बहवे,माहिन्द-मलय-तीरा,सिरिपबय-हणुरुहाईया"
english: "To him who goes to pay respects, To the traveler from some other island, Mahind - Malay - Teera, Siripabaya - Hanuruhaiya." ""

prakrit: "केलीगिला य रयणा,तह य वेलंधरा य नहतिलया,सञ्झाराया य तहा,दहिमुहदीवासया चेव"
english: "Like the river Keligila, Like the meadow Velandhara, Or like the lake Sandhara, Like a thicket of reeds"

prakrit: "एवं पभासयन्तं,बिभीसणं कोहपूरियामरिसो,आयड्डिऊण खग्गं,दहवयणो उज्जओ हन्तुं"
english: "And as soon as you arrive, you'll be spoilt for choice: Spring is on its way, Summer is on her way, And the fire of burning brightens."

prakrit: "अमरिसवसंगएणं,तेण वि उम्मूलिओ रयणथम्भो,काऊण महाभिउडी,जेट्टस्स अहिट्ठिओ पुरओ"
english: "With immortality he vanishes, And with it the pyre, Which is like a great fire, Which bursts forth without a sound."

prakrit: "जुझं समुज्जया ते,कहकह वि निवारिया य भिच्चेहिं,निययभवणाणि नीया,इन्दइ तह भाणुयण्णेहिं"
english: "The battle is won, For how can I escape, you fool, If you refuse to abide in my heart? It is as if I have renounced it."

prakrit: "रुट्ठो भणइ दहमुहो,निक्खमउ बिहीसणो मह पुरीओ,पडिकूलमाणसेणं,ठिएण किं तेण दुद्वेणं?"
english: "Roots stink, bees sting, Sweat drips from the jasmine's mouth. Why so distressed?" ""

prakrit: "सो एव भणियमेत्तो,बिहीसणो निग्गओ पुरवरीओ,अक्खोहिणीसु सहिओ,तीसाए पवरसेन्नस्स"
english: "That's what I meant when I said," "Women are weak, men are poor, women suffer untold suffering." "That is the power of love."

prakrit: "वजिन्दुघणेमा वि य,विजुपयण्डासणी य घोरा य,कालाइमहासुहडा,बिभीसणस्सा''सणसहीणा"
english: "The thunder is deafening, The lightning is powerful, And the moon is hovering above it. Time, dear friend, Can't wither." ""

prakrit: "सबल-परिवारसहिया,नाणाविहजाण-वाहणारूढा,छायन्ता गयणयलं,हंसद्दीवम्मि अवइण्णा"
english: "Strong - the helper of the family, Knowledgeable in coinage - The rudder of the carriage, Silent in song, Unafraid of the laughter of jesters."

prakrit: "दटुं,बिहीसणवलं,जाओ च्चिय वाणराण आकम्पो,दारिद्दियाण नज्जइ,हिमवायहयाण हेमन्ते"
english: "Stop, you fool, Stop talking nonsense, Poverty destroys people, The winter storm destroys them."

prakrit: "पउमो वज्जावत्तं,गेण्हइ लच्छीहरो वि रविभासं,अन्ने वि आउहकरा,जाया कइसेन्नसामन्ता"
english: "The wife is wise, The husband is generous, The wives are generous, And the children are generous."

prakrit: "जाव य वाणरसेन्नं,जायं चिय गहियपहरणावरणं,ताव य बिहीसणेणं,रामस्स पवेसिओ दूओ"
english: "Go and make a fire in the forest, That in the thickets you will find grass, And that in the meadows you will see flowers."

prakrit: "नमिऊण रामदेवं,दूओ परिकहइ परिफुडं सबं,सीयाऎ कारणेणं,भाइविरोहं जहावत्तं"
english: "No, Ramdev, the two are in a relationship," he said. "Because of you, brother - in - law, Anger prevails."

prakrit: "मज्झ तुम इह सरणं,बिभीसणो भणइ नत्थि संदेहो,आणादाणेण पहू!,सम्माणं मे पयच्छाहि"
english: "You are right, I beg of you, Do not confuse me, do not doubt me, Please, give in to temptation!"

prakrit: "एयन्तरम्मि रामो,मन्तीहि समं तओ कुणइ मन्तं,मइसायरो पवुत्तो,मह वयणं ताव निसुणेहि"
english: "Aunt, Rama, at this moment the mind is equal to the heart. The mind is purified, But my speech fails me." ""

prakrit: "छम्मेण कयाइ पहू!,बिहीसणो पेसिओ दहमुहेणं,अहवा कलुस पि जलं,खणेण विमलत्तणमुवेइ"
english: "What do you mean by that? It is the fire of love! It is poison, It is a poison. Or else it is the water of passion. For what use is a lot of water but only water?"

prakrit: "अह भणइ मइसमुद्दो,मन्ती सत्थागमाण उप्पत्ती,जंपइ जणो विरोहो,जह जाओ ताण दोण्हं पि"
english: "Oh! she is talking to me," whispered the traveler, "And I am talking to her again." As for me, I beg of you, my dear, Let the two become one. "

prakrit: "अन्नं च पहू! सुबइ,बिहीसणो धम्म-नीइ-मइकुसलो,कह कुणइ असब्भावं,तुज्झुवरि एरिसगुणो वि?"
english: "Take food! It's delicious, The dharma is pure, The pleasures are abundant, How can one be indifferent, Even with such virtuous qualities as yours?"

prakrit: "अहवा किं न विरोहो,हवइह एकोदराण लोभेणं,जह वत्तं अक्खाणं,तं एगमणा निसामेहि"
english: "Ahava, do not be angry; this, indeed, is the nature of one's greed; the more one uses it, the thinner it becomes."

prakrit: "गिरिभूई गोभूई,दो वि जुवा णेमिसे परिवसन्ति,तत्थेव सूरदेवो,राया महिला मई तस्स"
english: "The mountain is covered with cow - dung, Two young men lie in wait for me, Then the sun god, The fair woman is everywhere."

prakrit: "सा ताण देइ दाणं,विप्पाणं सुकयकारणट्ठाए,हेमं पुण पच्छन्नं,सुविसुद्धं सुप्पभूयं च"
english: "She gives stress, Makes one's mind dry, Heals all wounds, Restores all beauty And makes one feel good."

prakrit: "दट्टण गिरी हेमं,कुणइ विरोहं सहोयरेण समं,लोभमहागहगहिओ,जाओ रिखुसरिसपरिणामो"
english: "The crowd has swallowed me up, The enemy has made me equal to him in kindness, Greed is great, Go and beg for forgiveness."

prakrit: "अन्नं पि उवक्खाणं,कोसम्बीए महाधणो नाम,वणिओ कुरुविन्दा से,महिला पुत्ता य दो तस्स"
english: "Take food and boil it. Name the rich man, tell him from the bush. It's either a woman or a son." ""

prakrit: "अहिदेवमहीदेवा,परलोयं पत्थिए तओ पियरे,सधणा य गया दोन्नि वि,परकूलं जाणवत्तेणं"
english: "Oh! my god! When the other man leaves, Dear friend, Everything has gone well between the two. We should know the difference."

prakrit: "भण्डेण तेण रयणं,एक्कं घेत्तूण पडिनियत्ता ते,इच्छन्ति एकमेकं,हन्तूणं तिबलोहिल्ला"
english: "They embrace one another, They embrace each other, They make love together, They thrill in unison."

prakrit: "आगन्तूण य सगिह,जणणीऎ समप्पियं तु तं रयणं,सा वि य विसेण इच्छइ,घाएउं अत्तणो पुत्ते"
english: "Friend, tell me, Daughter - in - law, I agree with you. She wants something different. I'll hurt her again, son."

prakrit: "रुद्धेहि तेहि रयणं,छूट जउणानईऎ सलिलम्मि,तं धीवरेण लद्धं,पुणरवि ताणं घरे दिन्नं"
english: "Stop that demon, Free the youngest girl, Fight him with all your might, And bring him home again."

prakrit: "अह ते जणणीऎ समं,सामत्थेऊण जायसंवेगा,संचुण्णिय तं रयणं,सबे वि लयन्ति पवजं"
english: "Oh! it's the same as being married, Whatever your circumstances, Be careful not to fall into the trap of choosing one. Everything else falls into place."

prakrit: "तम्हा लोहेण फुडं,हवइ विरोहो सहोयराणं पि,जह गिरि-गोभूईणं,तह अन्नाणं पि बहुयाणं"
english: "The iron will burst, The wind will blow, And the cow - dung will rustle, So will the abundance of food."

prakrit: "सुणिऊण उवक्खाणं,एयं मन्तीण साहियं रामो,पडिहारं भणइ तओ,आणेहि बिभोसणं तुरियं"
english: "Listen, O yokel: This is the way of a wise man: Speak, O Ram, through your heart: Let me explain to you the confusion of my heart."

prakrit: "पडिहारेण य सिट्ठो,बिभीसणो आगओ पउमनाहं,पणमइ पहट्ठमणसो,तेण वि अवगूहिओ धणियं"
english: "By lying down on your bed, One who is distracted by a fire cannot reach one who is full. But by staying awake the next day, You have proved too much for me."

prakrit: "मिलिए बिहीसणभडे,जाओ चिय वाणराण आणन्दो,ताव य समत्तविज्जो,पत्तो भामण्डलो सिग्धं"
english: "Meet me, God of Love, Go and tell me what you want to say, Then I'll explain it to you. The path leads straight to the village square."

prakrit: "रामेण लक्खणेण य,अहियं संभासिओ जणयपुत्तो,सुग्गीवमाइएहिं,अन्नेहिं वाणरभडेहिं"
english: "Rama is worthy of my name, I will never forget how kindly you were to me, My son, Thanks to your kindnesses And your generous acts."

prakrit: "तत्थेव हंसदीवे,दियहा गमिऊण अट्ठ बलसहिया,लङ्काहिमुहा चलिया,सन्नद्धा राम-सोमित्ती"
english: "Then the swans flew away, The day dawned With eight mighty saucers, The Lanka elephant walked on its face, The holy Ram was immovable."

prakrit: "अह जोयणाणि वीसं,रुद्धं तं तीऎ समरभूमीए,न य नज्जइ परिमाणं,आयामस्सातिदीहस्स"
english: "Oh! what a cruel woman! Stop her! This is the battlefield of your dreams: There is no such thing as insignificant size. It is the breath of eternity that conquers all."

prakrit: "नाणाविहकयचिन्धं,नाणाविहगय-तुरङ्ग-पाइक्कं,दिटुं चिय एजन्तं,वाणरसेन्नं निसियरेहिं"
english: "A coin tossed by a crow, A reed blown by a trumpet, A bird's eye gaze, Like the reed in a flute, Is irresistible."

prakrit: "अह भाणुसरिसवण्णा,मेहनिहा गयणवल्लभा कणया,गन्धवगीयनयरा,सूरा तह कप्पवासी य"
english: "Ah! the fragrance of the peacock's tail, The song of the clouds, With its fragrant nectar And fragrant flowers." ""

prakrit: "मारिज्जेण समाणं,संतावो रणमुहे समावडिओ,पहओ सीहकडीणं,उद्दामो विग्घनामेणं"
english: "Calm with the blows, calm with the battlefront, courage with the reed beds, bold with the arrowhead."

prakrit: "अक्कोस-सारणाणं,जुज्झं सुय-सारणाण अभिट्ट,असि-कणय-चक्क तोमर-संघटुट्ठन्तजालोहं"
english: "One thing is certain: The arrow is powerful, The needle is sharp, The bow is compact, And the bow is powerful."

prakrit: "निहओ च्चिय संतावो,मारीजिभडेण नन्दणेण जरो,पहओ सोहकडीणं,विग्यो उद्दामकित्तीणं"
english: "Be content with your life, be content with my pleasures, be generous with your gifts, be resourceful in your pursuits."

prakrit: "एए रणम्मि सुहडा,सोऊण विवाइया सभज्जाओ,रोवन्ति जाव कलुणं,ताव य अत्थंगओ सूरो"
english: "Oh! the joys of marriage! When women go to bed First they weep, Then they sigh, Then the funeral pyre opens."

prakrit: "सूरुग्गमम्मि पुणरवि,समुट्ठिया उभयसेन्नसामन्ता,सन्नद्धबद्धचिन्धा,गहियाउह-पहरणा-''वरणा"
english: "The swelling girdle resounds, The couple gathers, The scent is peaceful, The mind is ready, The arms are wide open -" "The bridegroom." ""

prakrit: "वज्जक्खो खवियारी,मइन्ददमणो विही य सम्भू य,हवइ सयंभू य तहा,चन्दको वज्जउयरो य"
english: "A thunderbolt is a coward, A lightning bolt is nothing, A violent wind is everywhere, And the moon is like a bolt of the bolt."

prakrit: "कोहभडेण रणमुहे,सहसा आयारिओ य खवियारी,अह सो मयारिदमणो,बाहुबलीणं समाहूओ"
english: "Koh bhaden face to face, Suddenly the hunter's wife appears, Ah! my poor man! Hold on tight, you fool!"

prakrit: "वज्जोयरेण निहओ,सदूलो गरुयसत्तिषहरेणं,कोवेण य खवियारी,सम्भू घाएइ य विसालं"
english: "Be careful not to fall into the trap of bigotry, be cruel to the poor, be stingy to the crow, be extremely rough to the ox, and be extremely sharp."

prakrit: "विजओ य जट्ठिपहओ,मरणं चिय पाविओ सयंभूणं,एवं अन्ने वि भडा,घाइज्जन्ते निसियरेहिं"
english: "Victory is won through perseverance, death is endured through cowardice, and still more through greed."

prakrit: "वाणरकेऊण बलं,अवसीयन्तं रणे पलोएउं,सयमेव पवणपुत्तो,समुट्ठिओ रहवरारूढ़ओ"
english: "Strength comes from being a warrior, perseverance from being one. Always be vigilant, always be vigilant."

prakrit: "एन्तं दट्ठूण रणे,हणुयं जंपन्ति रक्खसा भीया,अज्ज इमो विहवाओ,काहिइ बहुयाउ महिलाओ"
english: "They look so much like this: The hunter is afraid of the hunter's deer, And the hunted are afraid of them. So are most women." ""

prakrit: "हणुयस्स सवडहुत्तो,समुट्ठिओ रक्खसुत्तमो माली,सरनिवहं मुश्चन्तो,मेहो इव सलिलधाराओ"
english: "The hunter is the good hunter; the hunter, the gardener, is the protector of the forest; The farmer, on the other hand, is a crook; The stream is as salty as rain."

prakrit: "सुणिसियखुरुप्पछिन्न,तं सरनिवहं खणेण काऊणं,भञ्जइ मालिनरिन्दं,हणुओ सीहो इव गइन्दं"
english: "Listen to me, you crook, Look at that silly girl! It's like cooking poison." ""

prakrit: "पविसरमुहो निरुद्धो,सहसा वज्जोयरेण पवणसुओ,छिन्नधय-छत्त-कवओ,सो वि य विरहो कओ सिग्धं"
english: "The poor man's face is veiled, Suddenly the wind whirls by a storm, The rafters are torn to shreds, And the street is empty."

prakrit: "अन्नं रहं विलग्गो,जुज्झन्तो सत्ति-सबल-सरेहिं,हणुयन्तेण रणमुहे,सो वि य वज्जोयरो निहओ"
english: "Stop wasting food, The warrior is still strong, The hunter is making war with the hunter, Yet the warrior has not returned."

prakrit: "दट्ठण तं विवन्नं,रुट्ठो लङ्काहिवस्स अङ्गरुहो,नामेण जम्बुमाली,आयारइ पवणपुत्तं सो"
english: "By the looks of it she vanishes; by the roots the limbs of a lankan elephant. By the name of Jambumali she parries the footsteps of birds."

prakrit: "उट्ठियमेत्तेण तओ,रावणपुत्तेण अद्धयन्देणं,हणुयस्स कणयदण्डो,वाणरचिन्धो धओ च्छिन्नो"
english: "Get up and take a bath, Ravana's son shows you how to bathe, The gooseflesh is like a reed stick, The chink of a trumpet Is like a white rag."

prakrit: "कप्पेऊणं तस्स वि,हणुएणं झत्ति धणुवरं छिन्नं,उक्कत्तियं च कवयं,नजइ पोराणयं वत्थं"
english: "Cutting through the mud is still the same as chopping down the roots of a tree, But piercing them with a sharp knife Is nothing like telling an old tale."

prakrit: "रुट्ठो य जम्बुमाली,अन्नं आबन्धिऊण सन्नाहं,पहरइ सरेसु हणुयं,देहे नीलुप्पलाभेसु"
english: "Root or jasmine, Silence when food is tied to it, Covered all over with gooseflesh, Looks like a blue girdle on the body."

prakrit: "पवणसुएणं तत्तो,सोहसयं सट्ठिसंजुयं मुक्कं,दाढाकरालवयणं,ललन्तजीहं जलियनेत्तं"
english: "Taste the breeze, Suckle the pleasant breath, Flicker the subtlety of affection, Stir the burning fire of longing."

prakrit: "तं केसरीहि सेन्नं,विद्धत्थं गय-तुरङ्ग-पाइक्कं,संगामपराहुत्तं,दह्ण महोयरो कुद्धो"
english: "He is armed with a bow and an axe, He can pierce a log, Use a trumpet, And swing a bow When faced with an enemy."

prakrit: "जाव य महोयरेणं,समयं हणुयस्स वट्टए जुज्झं,ताव य निसायरेहि,निवारिया केसरी सबइ"
english: "Time is of the essence, Time is fleeting, War is endless, Love is bound to last, Love's enemies are everywhere."

prakrit: "काऊण वसे सीहा,समुट्ठिया रक्खसा समन्तेणं,मुञ्चन्ताउहनिवहं,उवरिं हणुयस्स ते कुविया"
english: "Whom do you seek? The hunter dwells in the forest, The hunted seek shelter in the thickets, And the hunter is poor."

prakrit: "ते आउहसंघाया,मुक्का हणुयस्स रक्खसभडेहिं,समणस्स जहुक्कोसा,न कुणन्ति मणस्स परितावं"
english: "They come from the forest, Fistfuls of bees meet the rakshasa, Summoners yawn, No one bothers about man's fate."

prakrit: "रयणियरवेढियं तं,दट्ठूण कइद्धया महासुहडा,गय-तुरयसमारूढा,समुट्ठिया पवणपरिहत्था"
english: "The fence of the raion is wide open, At the sight of it one can make out that it is a great arrow, And at the sound of the trumpet one can hear everything going on."

prakrit: "पीइंकरो सुसेणो,नलो य नीलो विराहिओ चेव,संतावो सोहकडी,रविजोई अइबलो सुहडो"
english: "A peacock is pleasant, A neem tree is salubrious, A blue cucumber is fragrant, A sweetwood tree is pleasant to look at, And a rainbow is a joy to behold."

prakrit: "जम्बूणयपुत्ताई,रहेसु गय-तुरय-सीहजुत्तेसु,हणुयस्स सत्तुसेन्नं,जोहेऊणं समाढत्ता"
english: "Jambunayaputtai, rahesu gayi-turaya-sihajuttesu, hanyasa sattusena, johena samadhata."

prakrit: "निद्दयपहराभिहयं,वाणरसुहडेसु रक्खसाणीयं,भग्गं परीसहेहि व,चित्तं असमन्थनोइस्स"
english: "Fearful of sleepless nights, Protecting the pleasures of speech, Protected by fear, Unable to control your mind."

prakrit: "दट्ठण भाणुकण्णो,निययबलं वाणरेसु भज्जन्तं,कुविओ तिसूलपाणी,अहिमुहहूओ रिउभडाणं"
english: "Sigh, roar, Speak loudly, Play the flute, Drink the cool water, Resemble the throng of non - believers."

prakrit: "दट्ठण य एजन्तं,वीरं रणसत्ति-कन्तिदिप्पन्तं,सुहडा सुसेणमाई,तस्स ठिया अभिमुहा पुरओ"
english: "See how far you have come, Venerable warrior - How long you'll have to wait, Lovely woman - Turn your back on her."

prakrit: "नामेण चन्दरस्सी,चन्दाभो चेव तह य जसकन्तो,रइवद्धणो य अङ्गो,सम्मेओ अङ्गओ चेव"
english: "The moon is nothing like the moon, The moon looks like a mirror, The rainbow is like a limb, All limbs are like a bow."

prakrit: "कुन्तो बली तुरङ्गो,चन्दो ससिमण्डलो सुसारो य,रयणजडी जयनामो,वेलक्खो वीवसंतो य"
english: "Kuntu bali turango, chandu saasamandalu susaaro ya, rayanjadi jayanamo, velakkho vivasanto ya."

prakrit: "एए अन्ने य बहू,सुहडा कोलाहलाइबलसहिया,जोहन्ति भाणुकण्णं,सबल-सर-झसरघाएसु"
english: "Oh! my daughter - in - law! Such a loud noise, Such a violent brawl, Such an angry rant, Strong - headed - Jealous."

prakrit: "अह ते वाणरसुहडा,रयणासवनन्दणेण रुटेणं,दरिसणआवरणीए,विज्जाए थम्भिया सबे"
english: "Ah, the pleasure of playing the flute! It is the sound of the trumpet, The beating of drums, The sound of trumpets, That stirs the air." ""

prakrit: "निदाघुम्मियनयणाण ताण हत्थाण आउहवराई,गाढं चिय मूढाणं,सिढिलीभूयाण निवडन्ति"
english: "Niddhamma's young women stretch out their arms, The foolish in the thickets, Choose the slopes of the stairs."

prakrit: "निद्दावसंगए चिय,निययभडे पेच्छिऊण सुग्गीवो,ताणं कएण सिग्छ,विजं पडिबोहणिं मुयइ"
english: "Cheer up while you sleep, Give pleasure by looking at you all the time, Be thankful for what you have, For lightning makes lightning disappear."

prakrit: "अह ते विउद्धसन्ता,हणुयाईया समच्छरुच्छाहा,अहिययरं तेण समं,जुझं काऊणमाढत्ता"
english: "Ah! the silence of the enemy, The sighing of the hunter's bow, Like that of a warrior on the battlefield."

prakrit: "धय-कवय-छिन्नछत्तं,संचुण्णिजन्तरहवर-तुरङ्गं,आलोइऊण सबलं,दहवयणो जुज्झिउं महइ"
english: "Fear - Poems - Tears, Troubles - The trumpet is blowing, The flute is blowing Strongly, The warrior's bow is burning Strongly."

prakrit: "जुझं समुच्छहन्तं,पियरं विन्नवइ इन्दइकुमारो,सन्तेण मए तुज्झं,ताय! न जुत्तं रणं काउं"
english: "The battle rages on, Dear young man, Please stop being angry with me, you fool, For I have nothing to lose By running away." ""

prakrit: "एयं चिय वित्थिण्णं,संघटुढेन्तगयघडाडोवं,थोवन्तरेण पेच्छसु,भजन्तं वाणराणीयं"
english: "Here I am, Spattered with tears, Like a bunch of peacock's tail feathers Waved by the God of Love."

prakrit: "जणयस्स सिरपणाम,काउं तेलोक्कमण्डणं हत्थी,सन्नद्धबद्धकवओ,आरूढो इन्दइकुमारो"
english: "Friend, tell me, How long has it been since you've had your head tonsured? Be prepared, cow - doves, Wait till the moon is full."

prakrit: "तं कइवराण सेन्नं,नाणाविहगय-तुरङ्ग-पाइक्कं,गसियं पिव निस्सेसं,उट्ठियमेत्तेण वीरेणं"
english: "Whom are you looking out for? A cunning hunter, A coin seller, A trumpet caller, A man in need of a drink, A warrior with an uplifting spirit."

prakrit: "आयण्णपूरिएहिं,सरेहि परिहत्थदच्छमुक्केहिं,तं वाणराण सेन्नं,मेहेण व छाइयं सर्व"
english: "Ayanpuriyeh, saare hi parithat tha dakshamukke hain, tha vaaranara senna, henna and shadow are everything."

prakrit: "हयविहयविप्परद्धं,सुग्गीवो पेच्छिऊण निययबलं,भामण्डलेण समय,समुट्ठिओ सुहडपरिकिण्णो"
english: "Life is full of uncertainties, When one looks at a fruitful crop One sees destiny in its own right, When it is time to plant a sapling One sees happiness"

prakrit: "तुरएसु समं तुरया,आवडिया गयवरा सह गएसु,सामियकज्जुजुत्ता,जुज्झन्ति भडा सह भडेहिं"
english: "Turaesu saman turaya, avadiya gayavara saath gayasu, samiyaka jajjuta, jujjanti bhada saath bhadein"

prakrit: "रुटेण इन्दईणं,भणिओ किक्किन्धिनरवई एत्तो,लङ्काहिवं पमोत्तुं,जं सेवसि भूमिगोयरियं"
english: "Foolish woman, tell me,'Here walks the farmer's daughter - in - law, And there steps the elephant in her arms: You have served the motherland well."

prakrit: "एयं अज्ज तुह सिरं,सिग्धं छिन्दामि अद्धयन्देणं,सो कुणउ वाणराहम!,परिरक्खं सामिसालो ते"
english: "Here's your head, I'm just about to rip it straight open. So tell me," "Who's that bitch?" "She puts her face behind her back."

prakrit: "तो भणइ वाणरवई,किं ते भड! बोक्किएहि बहुएहिं?,अज्ज तुह माणभङ्गं,करेमि न हु एत्थ संदेहो"
english: "So the barber says," "Is that a joke?" "He shakes his head." "I don't doubt that, you bastard."

prakrit: "सो एव भणियमेत्तो,चावं अप्फालिऊण सरनिवहं,मुञ्चइ दसाणणसुओ,किक्किन्धिवइस्स आरुट्ठो"
english: "That's what I meant when I said," "I'm off." "With a broad smile on my face I shook my head."

prakrit: "सो वि य तं एजन्तं,आयण्णाऊरिएहि बाणेहिं,छिन्दइ बलपरिहत्थो,निययाणियरक्खणट्टाए"
english: "That's just how she is: Sitting cross-legged, With her arms spread wide apart, Not looking at the judge."

prakrit: "अह मेहवाहणेणं,समरे भामण्डलो समाहूओ,रुद्धो विराहिएणं,पविसन्तो वज्जणको वि"
english: "Ah, the rapture of the festival, The gathering of the faithful in summer, The silence of separation, Even of a wise man in poverty."

prakrit: "चक्केण वज्जणको,पहओ य विराहिएण रुटेणं,तेण वि सो वच्छयले,समाहओ चक्कपहरेणं"
english: "To the wise man with the wheel, To the traveler with the rudder, Or to the wretch with the cudgel, Is the same as riding a buffalo."

prakrit: "वाणरवई निरत्थो,लङ्कानाहस्स नन्दणेण कओ,तेण वि य जट्ठियारी,आउहसयसंकुलं रइयं"
english: "Vanaravai niratho, Lankanaahasa nandanaena ko, tayyari yahi, ayuhasa sankulam rahiye." ""

prakrit: "अवयरिऊण गयाओ,मन्दोयरिनन्दणो रहारूढो,पेसेइ वारुणत्थं,नवजलहरसद्दनिग्घोसं"
english: "Gone are the dry days, The raindrops of the Mandoir remain, Pechei varunatham, Let the freshly scorched waters wash over us."

prakrit: "अन्धारियं समत्थं,सेन्नं दट्ठूण वाणराहिवई,नासेइ वारुणत्थं,सिग्धं सो मारुयत्थेणं"
english: "The blind man understands, The elephant sees, The deaf hear, The straight man knows how to fight."

prakrit: "घणवाहणो वि सत्थं,अग्गेयं मुयइ जणयतणयस्स,भामण्डलो नरिन्दो,नासेइह वारुणत्थेणं"
english: "The heavy vehicle is still standing, The fire is raging, The forest is burning, The fields are bare, The rivers are swollen."

prakrit: "मन्दोयरी' पुत्तो,विरह भामण्डलं रणे काउं,पेसेइ तामसत्थं,कज्जलघणकसिणसच्छायं"
english: "My son, Mandoiri, Why waste away in the forest of separation? She walks on thin grass, Like the shadow of a burning bush." ""

prakrit: "न य पेच्छन्ति महियलं,आयासं नेव अप्पयं न परं,सुहडा पणट्टचेट्ठा,अवहियचक्खू तओ जाया"
english: "They do not see the beehive, Do not object to its size, Like a good draught of water. So do not be alarmed by its absence."

prakrit: "घणवाहणेण एत्तो,विसधूमुग्गारपज्जलन्तेहिं,भामण्डलो 'तिगाढं,बद्धो च्चिय नागपासेहिं"
english: "Crowds gather here, Clouds twine around the banyan Lights, The fields tremble, The doe is tied to the snake's tail." ""

prakrit: "वाणरवई वि सिग्धं,भुयङ्गपासेहि बन्धिउं गाढं,उच्छूढो धरणियले,रावणपुत्तेण जेट्टेणं"
english: "Even the Varnavayi is straight, The ties around the bhuyanga are thick, They stretch out on the ground, Like a banner proclaiming the victory of Ravana."

prakrit: "ते पेच्छिऊण दोणि वि,भुयङ्गपासेसु नरवई बद्धे,सह लक्खणेण पउमं,बिभीसणो भणइ निसुणेह"
english: "When he sees them both, Blindfolded and bound as men are by their arms, He expresses disappointment At being seen with them." ""

prakrit: "अह पेच्छ इन्दईणं,सरसंघट्टेण छाइयं गयणं,भामण्डल-सुग्गीवा,बद्धा वि हु नागपासेहिं"
english: "I see the blind man, Singing in the shade of the mustard seed, Loving the field, Though bound by the snake's tail."

prakrit: "बद्ध वाणरनाहे,विजिए भामण्डले इहं अम्हं,संघायपिण्डियाणं,होहइ मरणं न संदेहो"
english: "In this damned world, bound and gagged, Here I am, my guileless lover, And death is no more to be feared."

prakrit: "अम्हं,बले महायस!,एए दो नायगा महापुरिसा,जाया अणायगा वि हु,विज्जाहर-वाणराण चमू"
english: "We, you great men! Saying this," "Two great men are heroes." "But as for me, I am but a bunch of naysayers."

prakrit: "विच्छिन्नछत्त-केऊ,संचुण्णेऊण रहवरं सिग्छ,गहिओ चिय षवणसुओ,सुबन्तं भाणुकण्णेणं"
english: "A man in disarray, Who, being puzzled, Seeks refuge in heaven, Listens with longing And mutters beautiful sayings."

prakrit: "जाव य धरणिनिसण्णे,भामण्डल-वाणराहिवे एए,न य गिण्हन्ति निसियरा,ताव निवारेहि गन्तूणं"
english: "Traveler or traveler, They cannot be counted on. Instead, they go elsewhere." ""

prakrit: "जाव य सोमित्तिसुयं,आभासइ राहवो ससंभन्तो,जोहेइ भाणुकण्णं,ताव च्चिय अङ्गयकुमारो"
english: "When one is asleep, one can feel the breath coming From the heart, When one speaks, One can hear the limbs."

prakrit: "दोण्हं पि ताण जुझं,वट्टइ विवडन्तसत्थसंघायं,ताव य भुयपासाओ,विणिग्गओ मारुई सिग्धं"
english: "Both are tense, The other is divided, And the other is united. Yet, crossing the boundary, The hunter is condemned to die."

prakrit: "हणुमन्त-अङ्गया ते,आरूढा वरविमाणसिहरेसु,लक्खण-बिभीसणा वि य,आसासेन्ती सयाणीयं"
english: "Bees - the limbs of the earth, The heights of the sky, The beauty of beauty - Even separation, Like the veil of hope."

prakrit: "एयन्तरम्मि पत्तो,बिभोसणो इन्दई समरकंखी,दट्ठण तं कुमारो,इमाणि हियएण चिन्तेइ"
english: "Here's a letter from my mother - in - law, Disillusioned at the sight of her young son, Thinking only of him."

prakrit: "तायस्स य एयस्स य,को भेओ? जइ गविस्सए ताओ,न य मारिऊण पियरं,हवइ जसो निम्मलो लोए"
english: "Who is it that you seek after? If he refuses, don't kill him. It must be someone like you." ""

prakrit: "भामण्डल-सुग्गीवा,भुयङ्गपासेसु दारुणा बद्धा,मरिहिन्ति निच्छएणं,जुत्तं अवसप्पणं अम्हें"
english: "The field is fragrant, The paths are rough, The path is steep, The route is rocky, And the path is slippery."

prakrit: "परिचिन्तिऊण एवं,विणियत्ता ते रणाउ दो वि जणा,लच्छीहरेण दिट्ठा,रावणपुत्ता बलसमग्गा"
english: "The two are familiar, That the forest is deserted, The sight of lacquered trees, The feet of Ravana Are powerful."

prakrit: "अह भाणिउं पवत्तो सोमित्ती सुणसु नाह! मह वयणं,भामण्डल-सुग्गीवा,बद्धा भीमेहि नागपासेहिं"
english: "Tell me, my poor girl, Don't listen to me! I'm playing the flute, Lovely girl, Stuck in the middle of the nagpasa." ""

prakrit: "रावणपुत्तेहि इमे,निज्जन्ता पेच्छ निययपुरिहुत्ता,एएहि विणा अम्हे,किं जिप्पइ दहमुहो को वि?"
english: "In this world, Ravana's son, Destiny prevails, Without him I am empty, And who can withstand the fire of hell?"

prakrit: "पुण्णोदएण एतो,रामो सरिऊण लक्खणं भणइ,चिन्तेहि वरं सिग्धं,जो उवसग्गो तया लद्धो"
english: "Such is the virtue of renunciation, Rama speaks virtuously, He thinks straightforwardly of favors, He who is generous fights bravely."

prakrit: "सरिऊण लक्खणेणं,तत्थ महालोयणो सुरो सहसा,अवहिविसएण नाउं,रामसयासं समल्लीणो"
english: "Because of the line drawn, Then the melody of the great song Came suddenly, Without a syllable in between. For Rama's sake I agree."

prakrit: "पउमस्स देइ तुट्ठो,नामेणं सीहवाहिणी विजं,गरुडा परियणसहिया,पणामिया लच्छिनिलयस्स"
english: "Behold the thunderbolt, The lightning of the flute, The thunder of the bull, The cunning of the hunter, The reckless of treasure."

prakrit: "दोणि य रहे पयच्छइ,दिवामलपहरणपरिपुण्णे,अग्गेय-वारुणाई,अन्नाणि य सुरवरत्थाणि"
english: "The twosome walk on, The lamp stands astride, The fire is burning, The hearth is burning."

prakrit: "गाय विजयणं,देइ गयं लक्खणस्स सुरपवरो,दिवं हलं च मुसलं,पउमस्स वि तं पणामेइ"
english: "The cow is victorious, The day is marked by auspiciousness, The plow is auspicious, And so is the husband."

prakrit: ""संपत्ता--महिमीण,परमं दसरहसुया सुकयपुण्णा,देवो वि पीइपमुहो,कमेण निययं गओ ठाणं"
english: "Wealth... glory, the highest pleasure, dry and fragrant. Even the gods are full of trouble. But fate has decreed the destination." ""

prakrit: "अरिभङीयरोहे तत्थ पावन्ति कित्ती,विमलधवलचित्ता जे हु कुबन्ति धम्मं"
english: "How can one reach there While in a state of arousal, If one's consciousness is clouded By the fire of dharma?"

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए विज्जासन्निहाणं नाम एगूणसट्ठ पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "Praise be to the knowledge of this virtuous land, For its name signifies purity." ""

prakrit: "एयन्तरम्मि पउमो,केसरिजुतं रह समारूढो,लच्छीहरो वि एवं,हणुमाइभडेहि परिकिष्णो"
english: "Here am I, Your Majesty's daughter - in - law, Living in the middle of the desert, Looking down the road for dear friends."

prakrit: "संपत्तो रणभूमी,पढम चिय लक्खणो गरुडकेऊ,वह ण त पलाणा,भुयापासा दसदिसासु"
english: "Wealth is the battlefield; at first sight is the mark of an eagle's wings; at present it does not fly; during the next ten days it disappears."

prakrit: "अह ते खेयरसामी,भीमोरगबन्धणाउ परिमुक्का,भामण्डल सुग्गोवा,निययबलं आगया सिग्धं"
english: "Ah! the fire of renunciation, The climax of a passionate embrace, The dawn of heaven, The fire of determination."

prakrit: "ततो ते पवरभडा,सिरिविक्खाया भणन्ति पउमाभं,सामिय! परमविभूई,कह तुज्झ खणेण उप्पन्ना?"
english: "So proud they are, Silly girl, They keep on saying:" "Proud lady!" "How can you underestimate them, you supreme being?"

prakrit: "तो भणइ पउमनाहो,परिहिण्डन्तेण साहवो दिट्ठा,देसकुलभूसणा ते,गिरिसिहरे जायउवसम्गा"
english: "You fool," he said, "Your eyes are glued to your cheeks, And your face is smeared with gooseflesh."

prakrit: "चउकाणणं तु पडिम,साहन्ताणं समत्थचित्ताणं,भवतिमिरनासणयरं,केवलनाणं समुप्पन्नं"
english: "To look at you is virtue, to be patient is righteousness, To walk in silence is immorality; One can only utter falsehood."

prakrit: "गरुडाहिवेण तइया,तुट्टेणं अम्ह जो वरो दिन्नो,सो चिन्तियमेत्तेणं,विजाण समागमो माओ"
english: "You fool, The thought that broke my heart Which gave me such a longing Has made me think again And again: Knowledge is the essence of wisdom."

prakrit: "एवं रावभणिय,सोऊणं खेयरा सविम्हइया,मुणिवरकहाणुरचा,नाया हरिसाइयसरीरा"
english: "And the women of Ravana's house, Wherever you stay, Take rest; It's the hunter's wife Who is wealthy And who is poor?"

prakrit: "न त पिया नेव करेन्ति बन्धू,न चेव मित्ता सकलत्त-भिवा,जहा मणुस्सस्स हिओवएस,कुणन्ति साहू विमलप्पहावा"
english: "Friend or foe you are not, Friend or rival, As far as humanity is concerned, There are plenty of good men."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए सुग्गीवभामण्डलसमागमं नाम सटिम पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "Praise be to the auspicious land, For in its name lies prosperity and abundance."

prakrit: "भन्ने रणपरिहत्था,सूरा सन्नद्धबद्धतोणीरा,वाणरभडाण समुहा,समुट्ठिया रक्खसा बहवे"
english: "Saying:" "The warriors of the plain, The women who compose the surahs, The warriors who carry the banner, The rakshasas who gather the elephants." ""

prakrit: "पड्डषडह-मेरि-झलरि-काहल-तलिमा मुइनसदेणं,फुडियं पिव आयास,दो अद्ध महियलं व गयं"
english: "The curtain falls - Meri-jhalri - kahal - Talima sighs, Drunken with thirst, Two and a half months old and gone."

prakrit: "एत्यन्तरे महप्पा,लहापरमेसरो सह बलेणं,परिसकह रणभूमि,पुरओ देविन्दसमविहवो"
english: "Here and there, great and mighty, Speaking with waves and waves, The whole plain is a battlefield; The whole is like a god."

prakrit: "नाणाउहगहियकरा,नाणाविहवाहणेसु आरूढा,नाणाविहवरचिन्धा,आवडिया समरसोडीरा"
english: "The traveler is fond of coins, Proud of coin carriers, Worried about coin sellers, Summer travelers everywhere."

prakrit: "सर-झसर-सत्ति सबल-करालकोन्तेहि खिप्पमाणेहिं,नह निम्मलं पि गयणं,खणेण गहणं कयं सयलं"
english: "You silly girl, You're right - You look so plump Now you look at me with your eyes closed. How can you swallow a pear If you don't know how to bend it?"

prakrit: "तुरयारूढेहि समं,आसवलम्मा तओ समावडिया,जोहा जोहल्लीणा,रहिया रहिए विवाएन्ति"
english: "Turayarudehi saman, asavalamma toh samavadiya, joha johallina, rakhe rakho vivayanti."

prakrit: "मत्तगइन्दत्था वि य,अभिट्टा कुञ्जरोवरिठियाणं,एवं समसरिसबला,आलम्गा समरकम्मन्ते"
english: "Drunken indignation, Overflowing buds, And trembling limbs: The whole world is at war."

prakrit: "तं वाणराण सेन्नं,भग्गं चिय रक्खसेहि परहुत्तं,नीलाइकहभडेहिं,पुणरवि आसासियं सई"
english: "The arrow is fierce, The bow is powerful, The arrows shoot from the sky, And the bow is blue; We hope to see you again soon."

prakrit: "निययंत्रलपरिभवं ते,द?,लकाहिवस्स सामन्ता,जोहन्ति सवडहुत्ता,अरिसेन्नं सत्थपहरेहिं"
english: "Controlled by Nature, That?, The arrows of the God of Love, Which travel through the air In unbroken streams."

prakrit: "सुय-सारण-मारीनी-चन्दका विज्जुवयणमाईया,नीमूतनायको वा,कयन्तवयणा समरसूरा"
english: "Suy - saran - marini - chandaka, vijjuvayanamayi, neemutnayakko va, kyantavayana samarasura"

prakrit: "तं पि य संगाममुहे,भग्गं कइसाहणं पलोएउं,सुग्गीवसन्तिया जे,समुट्ठिया सुहडसंघाया"
english: "Let her face the fair, Let her go elsewhere, Let the pleasant breeze settle on her. Let the congregation enjoy a pleasant evening."

prakrit: "तं वाणरेहि सेन्न,दूर ओसारियं अइबलेहिं,दटूण रक्खसवई,वाहेइ रहं सवडहुत्तं"
english: "A warrior's wife, A helpless woman far away, Protects her eyes And shows her true nature."

prakrit: "अह तेण तक्खणं चिय,पवंगमा गरुयसत्यपहरेहिं,भग्गा पलोइऊणं,विहीसणो अहिमुहो हूओ"
english: "That is why I am so anxious, My husband is so angry, My affairs are going smoothly, I am running out of things to do, And I am completely helpless."

prakrit: "तं भणइ रक्खसिन्दो,अवसर मह दिट्ठिगोयरपहाओ,न य हवइ जुत्तमेयं,हन्तुं एक्कोयरं समरे"
english: "He says rakshas - singh, Opportunity meets my eye, Traveler, It doesn't take long to reach me, We struggle on our own." ""

prakrit: "अह तं भणइ कुमारो,विहीसणो अमरिसं तु वहमाणो,उभयबलाण समक्खं,न देमि पट्टि सुकन्त छ"
english: "Oh! you naughty boy! You fool, You immortal wretch, Who has the strength for both sexes, No longer does his bandage dry up."

prakrit: "पुणरवि भणइ दहमुहो,दुट्ठ! तुम उज्झिउं निययवंसं,भिञ्चत्तं पडिवन्नो,पुरिसाहमपायचारीणं"
english: "" "Foolish girl, tell me again! You fool, Destroyed by fate, Falling at the feet of a fierce fowler."

prakrit: "पुणरवि भणइ सुभणिओ,विहीसणो रावणं मह सुणेहि,वयणं हियं च पच्छं,सुहनणणं उभयलोएसु"
english: "Speaking again and again makes one sound more beautiful, Listening to me when I am angry, Speaking more often than not, Calm down when both speak and are heard."

prakrit: "एवगए वि जइ तुम,इच्छसि धण-रजसंपयं विउलं,सह राहवेण पोई,करेहि सीया समप्पेहि"
english: "In the same way, if you wish to gain wealth, go and lie with your lover, you will surely succeed."

prakrit: "मोचण निययमाणं,दसरहपुत्तं लहु पसाएहि,मा अयसमलकला,करेहि महिलानिमित्तम्मि"
english: "Redemption is the rule, Those who have passed the tenth month by themselves are not worthy of it, For what use is a woman supposed to make of herself?"

prakrit: "सोऊण तस्स वयणं,दसाणणो तिबकोहपज्जलिओ,अल्लियइ गबियमई,आयड्डियनिसियवरवाणो"
english: "One who listens to her speaks, One who knows how to kindle a fire, Another who sings while she's asleep, Is more like a dancer than an artist."

prakrit: "रह-गय-तुरयारूढा,सामिहिया गहियपहरणा-''वरणा,अन्ने वि य सामन्ता,आलागा वाणरभडाणं"
english: "Rah - gay - Turayarudha, Samihya - Ghyapaharana -" "Bridegroom, Anyone can be a feudal lord, Like the pride of a weaver." ""

prakrit: "एन्तं दहण रणे,सहोयर तस्स अद्धयन्देणं,छिन्दइ धयं सरोसो,बिहीसणो अहिमुहावडिओ"
english: "She gives so much milk, Tears at her breasts, And tears at her friends That they cannot breathe."

prakrit: "तेण वि य तस्स घणुय,छिन्नं लहाहिवेण रुटेणं,चावं दुहा विरिक,जेट्ठस्स बिभीसणभडेणं"
english: "That makes him very ugly, To be torn to shreds by the waves, To cause pain in the limbs, And to cause confusion in the thighs."

prakrit: "बहुभडजीयन्तकरे,वट्टन्ते ताण दारुणे जुज्झे,जणयस्स परमभत्तो,समुट्टिओ इन्दइकुमारो"
english: "Through much strife, Through much strain and strain, Through many battles, O supreme warrior, The whole of India has been reduced to a mass."

prakrit: "सो लक्खणेण रूद्धो,तुनेण व सायरो समुल्ललिओ,पउमेण कुम्भकर्णो,सिग्धं आयारिओ एन्तो"
english: "So stop looking, you silly girl, All the hussies are laughing, The potter is angry with his wife, And the maid is straight."

prakrit: "आवडिओ सीहकडी,नीलेण सम नलो य सम्भूणं,सुहडो सयंभुनामो,आयारइ दुम्मई समरे"
english: "Listen! The river is red, The stream is blue, And the stream is smooth. I will help you find the water That flows through it."

prakrit: "दुम्मरिसो घडउवरिं,कुद्धो इन्दासणी तहा काली,चन्दणभेण समाणं,कन्दो भिन्नञ्जणाभेण"
english: "Foolish girl, Stop being angry, Indias position is black, Sandalwood is peaceful, Tremors cause by differing perceptions."

prakrit: "सिग्धं विराहिओ वि य,आयारइ अङ्गयं समाकुद्धो,अह कुम्भयण्णपुत्तं,कुम्भं पत्तो य हणुवन्तो"
english: "Destroy the Siddha, Restore the ayyar limbs, Ah, the potter's son, The leaf of the kumbha Is the same as that of the jasmine."

prakrit: "सुग्गीवो वि सुमाली,केउं भामण्डलो तहा काली,नोहेइ दढरहो वि य,रणकण्डु चेव वहमाणो"
english: "A prosperous woman is always beautiful, A wealthy man is always handsome, A miser is always courageous, And a warrior is always fierce."

prakrit: "एवं अन्ने वि भडा,समसरिसबला रणम्मि आवडिया,आहबणमुहररवा,जुज्झन्ति समच्छरुच्छाहा"
english: "And still the buffalo, Like a warrior on equal footing, Makes loud clamor, Looks like a warrior's bow"

prakrit: "हण छिन्द भिन्द निक्खिव,उत्तिद्रुत्ति? लहु पडिच्छाहि,पप्फोड ताड माग्य,सह घत्तुबत्तणिहणन्ति"
english: "Money is tight, Are you alright? You want to lie down, Papad asks for a palm leaf, And the women kneel beside you." ""

prakrit: "बहुतूरनिणाएणं,विमुकचुकारमुहडसद्देणं,गजन्तीव दिसाओ,घणसत्थतमन्धयाराओ"
english: "Long - eyed woman, With sly smile on her face, Eyes fixed on the horizon, Eyes hovering above the horizon"

prakrit: "सूरासूराण इमो,वट्टइ अहियं परिक्खणाकालो,जह भुञ्जइ आहारो,न तहा जुज्झिज्जए समरे"
english: "Love's arrows are immortal; Those that pierce through my veins Are for real, Those that roast are for food, And those that do not are for war."

prakrit: "मा भाहि कायर! तुमं,दीणं न हणामि जं च परहुत्तं,तेण वि सो पडिभणिओ,अज्ज तुमं चेव नट्ठो सि"
english: "Don't be so cowardly! I won't hurt your feelings. So tell me," "You're the only one who has this problem." ""

prakrit: "कोइ भडो समाई,सहसा विच्छिनबन्धणं दर्दू,संघेइ साहुपुरिसो,वह नेह विहडियं सन्त"
english: "Someone has gone astray, Suddenly the ties of separation are painful, The husband is angry, He is not a saint without a wife."

prakrit: "दन्तेसु घरिय खम्गं,आबन्धेऊण परियर सुहडो,जुज्झइ अविसनमणो,सामियपरितोसणुज्जुत्तो"
english: "The tooth marks the door, The bracelets pierce the sweet tooth of the fairie, The fight rages on In silence, The fire is kindled by love."

prakrit: "मत्तगयदन्तमिन्नो,विजिजन्तो य कण्णचमरेहिं,सामियकयकरणिजो,सुवइ भडो वीरसेज्जासु"
english: "A drunkard is mean, A wise man is kind to the blind, A good man is courteous, A handsome gentleman is brave."

prakrit: "सीसगहिएकमेका,छुरियापहरेसु केइ पहरन्ति,असि कणय-तोमरेहि,सुहडा घायन्ति अन्नोन्नं"
english: "They shoot at each other, They carry knives and spears, They pierce through all sorts of wounds."

prakrit: "रत्तासोयवणं पिव,किंसुयरुक्खाण होजसंघायं,जायं खणेण सेनं,पयलियरचारुणच्छायं"
english: "To drink the juice of the red lotus, To make one happy, Is the business of the guild, To rob one of one's senses, To cast a shadow on the face of another."

prakrit: "केएत्य गलियसत्था,गरुयपहाराहया'हिमाणेणं,पडिउट्टियं करेन्ता,अन्ने लोलन्ति महिवढे"
english: "How often do people sit on the street, Watching the wind blow through the thickets, Scorching the ground." ""

prakrit: "हत्थी जज़रियतणू,मुञ्चन्ता रुहिरकद्दमुद्दाम,छजन्ति बलयकाले,गिरि व बह गेल्यालिद्धा"
english: "The elephant is passionate, The fowler is angry, The bull is bold, The tiger is fierce, The elephant has long been hunted down, And the tiger is on the loose."

prakrit: "गयतुरयखुरखउक्खयरएण उच्छाइए दिसाचके,अविभावियदिट्ठिपहा,नियया नियए विवाएन्ति"
english: "Gone are the days When rough patches of grass, Scorched by the sun, Were a distraction from everyday life, Destroyed the ways of destiny."

prakrit: "एयारिसम्मि जुज्झे,इन्दहणा लक्खणो सवडहुत्तो,छन्नो सरेहि सिग्धं,तेण वि सो तह विसेसेणं"
english: "This is our fight, The red hot sun is our characteristic trait, We know how to win the fight, So why this difference?"

prakrit: "अह रावणस्स पुत्तो,सिग्धं पेसेह तामसं अत्थं,नासेइ लक्खणो त,दिवायरत्येण परिकुविओ"
english: "Ah, son of Ravana! Straightforward pursuits, full of thrills, But if you neglect these virtues, Travel by daylight."

prakrit: "पुणरवि दसाणणमुओ,भीमेहि सरेहि वेदिउं पयओ,आढत्तो सोमिति,सरहं सतुरङ्गमावरणं"
english: "Resume dancing again, Praise be to the good lady, Love embrace her lover, Love embraces all beings, Love encompasses all beings."

prakrit: "तेण वि य वयणतेय,अत्थं च वीसजिउ पवणवेगं,ववगयविसाणलसिहा,भुयङ्गपासा निरायरिया"
english: "That's why you walk so much, And at the same time you live so long, Like an elephant in the middle of a forest, With its back to the ground Running free."

prakrit: "जुझं काऊण चिरं,रामकणिट्टेण इन्दकुमारो,बद्धो निस्संदेह,भुयापासेसु अइगाढं"
english: "The battle rages on, Ramakanitten Indakumaro, bound without a doubt, The arrows of the sky are fierce."

prakrit: "पउमो वि भाणुकणं,विरहं काऊण नायपासेहिं,बन्धइ बलपरिहत्थो,दिवायरत्थं पणासेउं"
english: "The poor fellow will cry out," "Separation is the only way out, For one's life depends on strength." ""

prakrit: "मगहाहिव! ते बाणा,भुयङ्गपासा हवन्ति निमिसेणं,अमरा आउहभेया,चिन्तियमेत्ता नहारूवा"
english: "Bees! Those arrows, Flying doves, Are the breath of the immortal, Never to be missed." ""

prakrit: "सो नायपासबो,निट्ठो राहवस्स क्यणेणं,भामण्डलेण गन्तुं,निययरहे विलो सिन्ध"
english: "So do not be negligent: Stop being negligent, For the land is slipping away. It's only the willow that matters."

prakrit: "इन्वइमहो वि एवं,बद्धो थिय लक्खणस्स आणाए,सिधं विराहिएण वि,आरुहिमओ सन्दणे नियए"
english: "Even so, if one is bound, One can bring about good fortune, Even if one has to part ways with one's self; The arrows of the arrow are appointed by the senses."

prakrit: "एवं असे वि भडा,घणवाहणमाइया रणे गहिया,बद्धा य वाणरेहि,पवेसिया निययसिबिरं ते"
english: "And still the buffalo, Covered with thick veils, Stands in the middle of the forest, Stuck between the streams, Steady as a cudgel." ""

prakrit: "एयन्तरम्मि समरे,बिभीसणं भणइ दहमुहो रुहो,विसहसु पहारमेक,जब रणकण्डु समुबहसि"
english: "On this day of summer The enemy speaks in hushed tones, The enemy stands guard, While the battle rages on." ""

prakrit: "तेण वि य धोरमहणा,भणिओ एक्कण किं व पहरेणं!,होऊण अप्पमत्तो,आहणसु मए बहिच्छाए"
english: "So be honest with me, tell me, What is the use of keeping so aloof? But let me tell you the truth: I have to eat." ""

prakrit: "सो एवमणियमेत्तो,घत्तइ सूलं सहोयरस्स रणे,तं पि य सरेहि एन्तं,रामकणिटो निवारेइ"
english: "So with these words:" "My poor brother - in - law is dying," "But my dear friend, all the same, Rama's anger has been appeased."

prakrit: "दट्टण निरागरियं,सूलं लंकाहिवो परमरुहो,गेहह अमोहविजयं,सत्ति उक्का इव जलन्ती"
english: "The thicket is empty, The treetops are deserted, The arrows of the God of Love are burning, The streets are empty, And the street is empty."

prakrit: "ताब य जलहरसामं,पेच्छइ गरुडद्धयं ठियं पुरओ,वित्थिष्णविउलवच्छं,पलम्बबाहुं महापुरिसं"
english: "Then you will see the lotus of the water. When it is full of water It looks like an eagle standing on its back. When distressed it looks like a great lion sitting on a pole."

prakrit: "त भणइ रक्खसबई,अन्नस्स मए समुजयं सत्थं,को तुज्झ आहियारो,घट्ट! मम ठाविउ पुरओ?"
english: "You tell me, Rakhshabai," "My heart is full of hunger." "Who is your suitor, dude? Wait a minute, my lord."

prakrit: "जइ वा इच्छसि मरि,लक्खण! इह भडसमूहसंघट्टे,तो ठाहि सवडहुत्तो,विसहसु सत्तीपहारं मे"
english: "" "Either you wish to die or you don't." "These angry groups clash."

prakrit: "ओसारिऊण एत्तो,विहीसणं लक्खणो सह रिऊणं,जुज्झइ रणे महप्पा,दढक्वसाओ भयविमुक्को"
english: "Here's a rainbow, With traces of separation To weep with, A forest of burning jasmine, A herd of ravenous elephants." ""

prakrit: "अह रावणेण सत्ती,मुक्का जालाफुलिङ्गनियरोहा,गन्तूण लक्खणं सा,भिन्दइ वच्छत्थलाभोगे"
english: "Ah, the silence of Ravana, The rustle of pearls, The trembling of young elephants, The arrows of the God of Destruction: You will find the bull's tail!"

prakrit: "सो तेण पहारेणं,सोमित्ती तिववेयणुम्हविओ,मुच्छानिमोलियच्छो,धस ति धरणीयले पडिओ"
english: "So watch out, you dimwit, You're covered with gooseflesh. Suddenly she's fallen to the ground." ""

prakrit: "एयन्तरम्मि रामो,पडियं दहण लक्खणं समरे,अह जुझिउँ पवत्तो,समयं विज्जाहरिदेहिं"
english: "Here is Rama, Trying to conceal his illness, Ah, the struggle of the feet: Time has proved elusive."

prakrit: "सो तेण तक्खणं चिय,दसाणणो छिन्नचावधयकवओ,विरहो कओ य माणी,चलणेसु ठिओ धरणिवढे"
english: "So look at that tree, For it is torn to shreds By tens of thousands of trees, And now it is deserted By the proud. Please, keep walking Up to the earth."

prakrit: "अन्न रहं विलग्गो,जाव य धणुयं लएइ तुरन्तो,ताव चिय दहवयणो,पउमेण कओ रणे विरहो"
english: "Go away for food, For if you take a lotus, You'll burn it instantly, But what do you do when you have to go away On account of it?"

prakrit: "रामस्स सरवरेहि,निसायरो विम्भलो को सिग्छ,न य गेण्हिउँ समत्थो,पाणं न सरासणं चेव"
english: "Ramasa sarvarehi, nisayero vimbhalo ko lagta hai, nahi jaayega samathyo, paani nahi sharana chewa." ""

prakrit: "बाणेहि लोदिओ चिय,धरणियले राहवेण दहक्यणो,दोसइ पुणो पुणो चिय,अन्नन्नरहे समारूढो"
english: "Fear the fire of love, Fear the flame of fire from the rustle of the earth; Fear the burning fire again and again; For without food the streets are empty."

prakrit: "विच्छिन्नचावक्रवओ,छबारा रावणो कओ विरहो,तह वि य न य साहिब्जह,अन्भुयकम्मो समरसूरो"
english: "Separation, separation, separation from Ravana. Yet not this Sahib, my brave warrior." ""

prakrit: "पउमो विम्हियहियओ,पद जो मह सराहओ न मओ,पुण्णेहि रक्खिओ विहु,परभवजणिएण तुलेणं"
english: "Poems are useless, Positions should not be taken that please me, Poems should be protected, Respect should be shown to people with good feelings."

prakrit: "निमुणेहि भणिजन्त,मह वयणं रक्खसाहिवइ! एक,जो मज्म तुमे भाया,निहओ सत्तोपहारेणं"
english: "You fool, tell me: My speech is protected! One, the one you said was true, Is the weapon of conquest." ""

prakrit: "तस्साणुमग्गलम्गं,नेमि तुमे जमपुरि न संदेहो,होउ ति एव भणिओ,दसाणणो अइगओ लई"
english: "Don't doubt me: You're right, Tassanumgalamum. But tell me," She said, looking down the road. "

prakrit: "चिन्तेई सावलेवो,एक्को मे वेरिओ मओ निहओ,किंचि हरिसाइयमणो,पविसइ निययं महाभवणं"
english: "Think only of yourself, speak only of others, speak nothing at all, speak little, for in this world one's destiny is great."

prakrit: "रुद्ध सोऊण सुए,त चिय एकोयरं समरसूरं,सोयइ निसासु एत्तो,दहवयणो तिबदुक्खन्तो"
english: "If you sleep soundly, you will find yourself sleeping all day long. But if you fall asleep with your breath stuck in it, It's as if you're burning up."

prakrit: "केएत्थ पुक्दुकरण रणम्मि भङ्गं,पावन्ति बन्धणमिणं अवरे हयासा,अन्ने पुणो सुचरिएण जयन्ति धीरा,लोए सया विमलकित्तिधरा भवन्ति"
english: "Wherever a good fight is fought, There is bound to be some sort of struggle, And wherever there is bitterness, There are triumphs for good reason. For the worlds beside are strewn with wiles."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए सत्तिसंपायं नाम एगसह पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "Praise be to the pious woman, Her name is Sati and her wealth is wealth."

prakrit: "तत्तो समाउलमणो,पउमो सोगेण ताडिओ गाढं,पत्तो य तुरियवेगो,नत्थ'च्छइ लक्खणो ठाणे"
english: "That is the way of a wise man; The palm is thick with grief; The trumpet is blown on the leaf; One cannot help feeling it."

prakrit: "दट्ठूण सत्तिभिन्नं,सहोयरं महियलम्मि पल्हत्थं,रामो गलन्तनयणो,मुच्छावसविम्भलो पडिओ"
english: "A bee stings at the tooth of a friend's eye, A swarm of bees gathers around it, And Rama falls face down in a sweat." ""

prakrit: "सीयलजलोलियो,आसत्यो वाणरेहि परिकिष्णो,मह बिलबिउ पयतो,रामो लुणेण सहण"
english: "The crickets are burning, The acacia trees are drying, The mango trees are withering, And Rama is suffering from saliva."

prakrit: "हा वच्छ! सायरवर,उत्तरिऊर्ण इमं अइदुलई,विहिनोएण अणत्यं,एरिसर्य पविओ सि तुर्म"
english: "Hey, you stag! It's only your husband who has grown thinner by the day, And you, my poor girl, are wasting away elsewhere." ""

prakrit: "किं माणेण महाजस! ण य वायं देसि विलवमाणस्स,जाणसि य विओगं ते,न सहामि मुहुत्तमे पि"
english: "What do you mean, Your Majesty! You're not going to give a damn. You know you're going to break down. I can't help it for a moment." ""

prakrit: "तुहं मे गुरूहि वच्छय! समप्पिओ आयरेण निक्लेवो,किं ताण उत्तरमिणं,दाहामि विमुक्कलजो'हं!"
english: "You look at me like a teacher! Once the iron has gone out, How can I reply? I bow before you Who say:" "Yes!" ""

prakrit: "सुलभा नरस्स लोए,कामा अत्था अणेयसंबन्धा,नवरं इहं न लब्मइ,भाया माया य जणओ य"
english: "In the simplest of worlds, there is no such thing as easy love, no other kind of love, just lust," he said.

prakrit: "अहवा परम्म लोए,पावं अइदारुणं मए चिणं,तस्सेयं पावफलं,नायं सीयानिमित्तम्मि"
