english: "Now listen to me, you crooks: The weight of the body is on the shoulders Of the wives of the servants. Do not be negligent."

prakrit: "एवं मे हयहिययं,वज्जमयं निम्मियं कयन्तेणं,जेणं चिय न य फुट्टइ,दट्ठ ण सहोयरं पडियं"
english: "And I have to go on. Wait a minute, you silly bitch. The fire does not break out, I did not see it coming."

prakrit: "सत्तुदमेण तइया,सत्तीओ पञ्च करविमुक्काओ,गहियाउ तुमे सुपुरिस!,संपइ एका वि न वि रुद्धा"
english: "With seven strokes you made it, with seven to spare, You silly girl! Not a single one of you stopped." ""

prakrit: "मुणिया य निच्छएणं,सत्ती वजद्दलेहि निम्माया,सिरिवच्छभूसिय पि हु,जा भिन्दइ लक्खणस्स उरं"
english: "A sage is something to be desired, A wise woman is nothing to be trifled with, Even if she were covered with gooseflesh. What difference does it make to a man's being?"

prakrit: "उद्धेहि लच्छिवल्लह!,धणुयं घेत्तण मा चिरावेहि,मज्झागया वहत्थे,एए सत निवारेहि"
english: "Get up, you lazy wretch! Don't be so hasty. For the midday breeze will come, But this truth alone will last." ""

prakrit: "ताव य एस परियणो,वच्छय! दिट्ठीसु रमइ पुरिसस्स,आवइपडियस्स पुणो,सो चेव परम्मुहो ठाइ"
english: "That's your husband! Look! He's having fun with you, Man. Go and ask him again. It's the same old place." ""

prakrit: "ताव य गज्जन्ति परा,अणुनीविगया मणोहरं वयणं,नाव बहुसत्थदाद,वेरियसीह न पेच्छन्ति"
english: "They cannot see the river, They cannot hear the stream, They are unable to hear the wind, They lie motionless on the riverbank."

prakrit: "माणुनओ वि पुरिसो,एगागी वेरिएहि पडिरुद्धो,अवलोइडं दिसाओ,सुमरइ एकोयरं सूरं"

prakrit: "मोत्तण तुमे वच्छय!,एत्थ महाविम्गहे समावडिए,को ठाहिइ मह पुरओ,निययं तु हियं विचिन्तेन्तो"
english: "Death awaits you!" "Here are the words of a great woman." "Whom can I blame?" "Destiny favors you."

prakrit: "मुश्च परायत्ता हं,इमाऎ परिनिजिया तवबलेण,वच्चामि निययठाणं,खमसु महं सामि! दुश्चरियं"
english: "I must depart, Mother - in - law, For my part, I have made up my mind. Please forgive me, my poor girl!"

prakrit: "काऊण समुल्लावं,एवं तो सत्तिदेवयं हणुओ,मुच्चइ संभमहियओ,निययहाणं च संपत्ता"
english: "Who is to blame, the hunter of false gods, Silly women, Destroyers of wealth and fortune?"

prakrit: "सा दोणमेहध्या,समयं कन्नाहि विणयसंपन्ना,नमिऊण रामदेवं,उबविट्ठा लक्खणसमीवे"
english: "She is both affectionate and affectionate; Time, indeed, is of the essence; We bow before Ramdev, Weeping and embracing."

prakrit: "परिमुसइ लस्वर्ण सा,मुद्धा वरकमलकोमलकरेसु,गोसीसचन्दणेण य,अणुलिम्पइ अङ्गमनाई"
english: "Pretending to be decked out with lotuses, The gooseflesh is smeared all over with lotus petals, And the moonlight is reflected in the woman's cheeks."

prakrit: "अन्नं पिव संपत्तो,जम्मं लच्छोहरो सुहपसुत्तो,आयम्बनयणजुयलो,पचलियबाहू समुस्ससिओ"
english: "Wealth alone is sufficient for food, Wealth is scarce, Happiness is abundant, Youth is bound to come, Anxious relatives dominate."

prakrit: "संगीयाण तो सो,उवगिज्जन्तो समुट्टिओ सहसा,रुट्ठो पलोयमाणो,जपइ सो रावणो कत्तो?"
english: "Friend, the crowd is impatient, Get up early, take a rest, And chant: Where is Ravana?" ""

prakrit: "रोमञ्चककमेणं,विहसियवयणेण पउमनाहेणं,अवगूहिओ कणिट्टो,भणिओ य रिवू पणटो सो"
english: "Lovely woman, Lovely girl, Don't be so naïve: Say what you have to say." ""

prakrit: "सिटुं च निरवसेसं,सत्तीपहराइयं जहावत्तं,नणिओ य महाणन्दो,मन्दरपमुहेहि सुहडेहिं"
english: "Sitting still, In silence, Staring at the horizon, Young girls, Great men, Blessed are those who face the dark."

prakrit: "पउमवयणेण दिन्न,करेण तं चन्दणं विसल्लाग,दियाउहपहयाणं,इन्दइषमुहाण मुहडाणं"
english: "One does not give milk by mouth, One throws sandalwood paste at one's face, One forgets about lamps, One remembers oneself only with indecent gestures."

prakrit: "ते चन्दणोदएणं,अहिसित्ता खेयरा गया तुरिया,जाया य विगयसला,संपत्ता निव्वुई परमं"
english: "It is the moonlit night, The trumpet is blown, Destruction of wealth is supreme."

prakrit: "सा तत्थ चन्दवयणा,दोणसुया ललियरूवलायण्णा,लच्छीहरस्स पासे,विभाइ देवि व इन्दस्स"
english: "There is the moonlight, The lily of the field, The lotus of the lotus, The goddess Vibhai, And the Indus." ""

prakrit: "सबम्मि मुपडिवत्ते,सोमित्ती राहवस्स वयणेणं,परिणेइ दढधिईओ,तत्थ विसल्ला विभूईए"
english: "Everything is illuminated, The path is smooth, The songs are melodious, The couple are firm, There is a vast expanse to be explored."

prakrit: "एवं नरा पुषभवज्जिएणं,धम्मेण नायन्ति विमुक्कदुक्खा,पावन्ति दिवाणि जहिच्छियाणि,लोए पहाणं विमलं जसं च"
english: "And people do not decorate themselves with flowers, They do not bow down before Dharma, They walk on dry land Like the feet of a diviner, And in the world they wear lotuses."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए विसल्लाआगमणं नामं चउहिमं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "Praise be to the divine power of the four vows."

prakrit: "अह लक्षणं विसई,चास्थिपुरिसेसु साहियं एत्तो,सुणिण रक्खसवई,मन्तीहि सम कुणह मन्तं"
english: "Ah! characteristic wisdom, Such is the activity of the discerning mind; To listen is protection; To think is equanimity."

prakrit: "विविहकलागमकुसलो,मयनामो तओ भणइ मन्ती,रूससि बह वा तूससि,तह वि य निसुणेहि मह वयगं"
english: "I speak in tongues, You speak in hushed tones, Russia speaks in whispers, Yet without saying a word I am speechless."

prakrit: "रामेण लावणेण य,विज्जाओ सीहारुडनामाओ,लद्धाउ अयत्तेणं,तुझ समक्खं इह सामि!"
english: "Rama has introduced love, Knowledge has given birth to wisdom, War is on its way, This struggle is against you!"

prakrit: "बद्धो य भाणुयण्णो,समयं पुत्तेहि तुझ संगामे,सत्तोऎ निरत्थतं,जायं च अमोहविज्जाए"
english: "You fool, Time is fleeting with you," he said, "And everything in between is meaningless."

prakrit: "जइ जीवइ निक्खुतं,सोमित्ती तह वि तुज्झ पुत्ताणं,दीसइ सामि! विणासो,समय चिय कुम्भयण्णेणं"
english: "If she survives, It's safe for you, my son. But if she doesn't, She's still alive." "Time is of the essence, darling."

prakrit: "सयमेव एवमेय,नाऊण'म्हेहि जाइओ सन्तो,अणुचरसु धम्मबुद्धि,सामिय! सोयं समप्पेहि"
english: "Always be so, do not be so hasty: Be content in your presence, be reasonable in your behavior, be wise in your dealings!"

prakrit: "पुबपुरिसाणुचिण्णा,मजाया पालिया सह जणेणं,बन्धवमित्ताण हियं,होइ फुड सन्धिकरणेणं"
english: "It's the mark of a good man's day, To have fun with a froward friend, To share a friendly hug, To arrange a meal together."

prakrit: "पायवडिएहि एवं,जे भणिओ मन्तिणेहि दहवयणो,गमियं करेह दूर्य,सामन्तं नाम नामेणं"
english: "Those who walk the path And those who think speak the truth, Those who travel the distance Say the name of the landowner."

prakrit: "मन्तीहि समुदएणं,संदिट्ट सुन्दरं तु दूयस्स,नवरं महोसह पिव,सुदूसियं रावण 'ज्येणं"
english: "Dear community, you are undoubtedly handsome, Have a fresh drink with your beloved, May the good Ravana live." ""

prakrit: "उत्तमकुलसमूओ,दूओ नय-विणय-सत्तिसंपन्नो,रामस्स सन्नियासं,सामन्तो पत्थिओ सिग्धं"
english: "A group of excellent people, Two hundred and seventy ninety - seven, Proud of Rama, Straightforward on his path as feudal lord."

prakrit: "पायवडिओ निविट्ठो,सामन्तो भणइ राहवं एत्तो,लक्षाहिवस्स वयगं,कहिज्जमाणं निसामेहि"
english: "Get down on your feet, you shamans! Speak rudely here, Traveler with a long life, For how long can I keep silent?"

prakrit: "जुझेण किर न कजं,सपञ्चत्राएण नणविणासेणं,बहवो गया खयन्तं,पुरिसा जुज्झाहिमाणेणं"
english: "War makes nothing, Dreaming makes nothing of it, Driven by fear, Like the heroism of a man in battle."

prakrit: "नंपइ लवाहिवई,कुणसु पयत्तेण सह मए संघी,न य घेप्पइ पञ्चमुद्दो,विसमगुहामन्यारत्थो"
english: "I will never forget how she kissed me, How I made love to her, And how she clung to my heart While I was asleep." - The five pearls do not pierce each other, Nor do they pierce the walls of a cave.

prakrit: "बद्धो जेण रणमुहे,इन्दो परिनिजिया भडा बहवे,सो रावणो महप्पा,राहव! किं ते असुयपुवो!"
english: "A captive elephant faces the battle, And his hostages run amok. Ravana is the great god, Rahava! Is he unhappy?" ""

prakrit: "पायाले गयणयले,जले थले जस्स वचमाणस्स,न खलिजइ गइपसरो,राहब! देवासुरेहिं पि"
english: "The songs on the pyre, The words beneath the burning fire, Are not to be missed: Traveler, Rahab! Fear the God of Love." ""

prakrit: "स्वणोदहिपरियन्त,वसुई विजाहरेसु य समाणं,लहापुरीऎ भागे,दोणि तुम देमि तुट्टो हइ"
english: "Friend, you won't give in. Vasui, Vijayaresu, Samman, Lahapuri, run away. You'll both be broken." ""

prakrit: "पंसेहि मय पुत्ते,मुञ्चसु एकोयरं निययबन्धु,अणुमण्णसु जणयसुया,जइ इच्छसि अत्तणो खेमं"
english: "You're right, my son, I have a new best friend. Anything you want, my dear, I'll give you."

prakrit: "तो भणइ पउमनाहो,न य मे रजेण कारणं किंचि,जं अन्नपणइणिसमं,भोगं नेच्छामि महयं पि"
english: "So tell me, my dear, There's no reason why I shouldn't eat rice. I should rather eat rice than drink it." ""

prakrit: "पेसेमि तुज्झ पुत्ते,सहोयरं चेव रावण! निरुत्तं,होहामि सुपरितुट्टो,नइ मे सीयं समप्पेहि"
english: "I am your son, Please help me, brother - in - law! Ravana! Do me a favor, please, I promise, But I won't give in to your anger." ""

prakrit: "एयाऎ समं रण्णे,भमिहामि सुमितिपरिमिओ अयं,भुञ्जमु तुमं दसाणण!,सयलसमत्थं इमं वसुहं"
english: "Come, let me run with you. I'll do my best to explain to you What it's like to be paralyzed By lightning."

prakrit: "एवं चिय दूय! तुम,तं भगमु तिकूडसामियं गन्तुं,एयं तुज्झ हिययरं,न अन्नहा चेव कायर्व"
english: "And give me a kiss! You fool, I'd rather go to bed early, It's your turn, There's nothing to eat But cow - dung." ""

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,दूओ तो भणइ राहवं एत्तो,महिलापसत्तचित्तो,अप्पहियं नेव लखेसि"
english: "If you hear me speak, You are bound to say so. What do you think? This is the way of a woman's heart. Never write such a thing."

prakrit: "गरुडाहिवेण नइ वि हु,पत्रेसियं जाणजुवलयं तुज्झ,जइ वा छिदेण रणे,मह पुत्ता सहोयरा बद्धा"
english: "I am not possessed by an eagle, Dear girl, you are clever, But if you try to pierce it with a twig, My son will join you."

prakrit: "तह वि य किं नाम तुमं,गवं अइदारुणं समुबहसि,जेणं करेसि जुझं?,न य सोया नेय जीयं ते"
english: "So what's your name, you cowardly bandit, How are you going to fight?, Either you sleep or you don't live." ""

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,अहिययर जणयनन्दणो रुट्ठो,भडभि उडिकयाडोवो,जंपइ महएण सदेणं"
english: "Listen to me when you speak; Stop being so judgmental: It's like riding a buffalo That has run out of fuel." ""

prakrit: "रे पावदूयकोल्हुय!,दुवयणावास! निमओ होउं,जेणेरिसाणि नंपसि,लोगविरुद्धाई वयणाई"
english: "Hey, you coward! Come on, you fool! Don't be so naïve As to speak against the people." ""

prakrit: "सीयाए कहा का वि हु,किं वा अहिखिवसि सामियं अहं?,को रावगो ति नाम,दुट्टोय पसू अचारित्तो?"
english: "Where am I at present, my dear? Or am I some sort of acolyte? Who is this man calling me by the name of Ravgo? Or is he speaking through other people?"

prakrit: "भणिऊण वयणमेयं,नाव य खग्गं लएइ जणयसुओ,लच्छीहरेण ताव य,रुद्धो नयचक्खुणा सहसा"
english: "Tell me, tell me," he said, looking down the aisle At the sound of the bolt From the ship. "Suddenly his eyes closed." ""

prakrit: "पडिसदएण को वि हु,भामण्डल! हवा दारुणो कोवो,एएग मारिएणं,दूषण जसो न निवडइ"
english: "Who is there to pollinate the earth? The wind is a cruel foe. So kill him, lest he choose to cause harm." ""

prakrit: "न य बम्भणं न समणं,न य दूर्य नेय बालय वुटुं,न य घायन्ति मणुस्सा,हवन्ति जे उत्तमा लोए"
english: "One doesn't have to bend or bend, One can't walk on fire for long distances, One cannot hurt people, But one has to excel."

prakrit: "लच्छीहरेण रुद्ध,एत्तो भामण्डले भणइ दूओ,राहव! वेयारिजसि,इमेहि भिधेहि मूढेहिं"
english: "Stop being pretentious, you fool, Rahav! You fool, This very thing is stupid." ""

prakrit: "नाऊण य अपहिय,अहवा यिएण मुणिय दोस-गुणं,परिचयमु जणयतणय,भुञ्जसु पुहविं चिरं कालं"
english: "Nowadays people take it for granted, Ahava people are known for their friendliness, Friendship is known for its kindness, Bhunjasu flowers last a long time."

prakrit: "पुप्फविमाणारूढो,सहिओ कन्नाण तिहि सहस्सेहिं,राहव! लीलायन्तो,इन्दो इव भमसु तेलोकं"
english: "Flying buffalo, Friend, Kannan, That too with good company, Rahav, Leelayanto, This is the world of buffalo oil."

prakrit: "एवं समुल्लवन्तो,भडेहि निब्मच्छिओ गओ दूओ,साहइ रक्खसवइणो,न भणियं रामदेवेणं"
english: "And the poor man, Foolish girl, Stop being angry, Help being protective, Don't bother about Rama." ""

prakrit: "बहुगाम-नयर-पट्टणसमाउला वसुमई महं सामी,देह तुह गय-तुरने,पुष्फविमाणं च मणगमणं"
english: "Daughter - in - law, The inhabitants of this town are like me: The body has passed away, The flowers have withered, And the mind is at peace with itself."

prakrit: "वरकन्नाण सहस्सा,तिण्णि उ सीहासणं दिणयगर्भ,ससिनिम्मलं च छतं,जइ से अणुमन्नसे सीया"
english: "The bridegroom is happy, The threesome are embracing, The bed is empty, And the attic is bare. Anyone can learn anything From a gentleman."

prakrit: "वयणाई एवमाई,पुणरुत्तं देव! सो मए भणिओ,परमो एगग्गमणो,सोयागाहं न छईइ"
english: "Vayanai evamai, Punarutta deva! So I said," "The supreme fire; The soybean must not be burnt." ""

prakrit: "भणइ पउमो महाजस!,नह तुज्झ इमाई जंपमाणस्स,जीहा कह न य पडिया,पसिदिलवासिष्फलं चेव?"
english: "Tell me, Proud lady! Isn't this your oath? It's a false promise. How can it be otherwise? It must be the fruit of a passionate love." ""

prakrit: "सुरवरभोगेसु वि मे,सीया विणा न निव्वुई मज्झं,भुञ्जमु तुम दसाणण!,सयलसमत्थं इमं वसुहं"
english: "I will eat sweetwood, Without water I will not be able to sleep, Bhunjamu, you tell me!," That is the essence of true cooking.

prakrit: "मण-नयणहारिणीओ,भयसु तुमं चेव सबजुबईओ,पत्त-फलाहारो हइ,सोयाऎ समं भमीहामि"
english: "Fear not, fair and handsome ladies. Everything you do Will go wrong. I'm as sleepy as a leaf or a fruit."

prakrit: "वाणरचई वि एत्तो,हसिऊण भणइ जह तुमं सामी,किं सो गहेण गहिओ,वाऊण व सा''सितो होज्जा?"
english: "The barber is still here, Laughing, Saying:" "You are a Sami." "Is that an insult?"

prakrit: "जेणेरिसाई पलवइ,विवरीयत्थाणि चेव वयणाई,किं तत्थ नस्थि वेज्जा,जे तुह सामि तिगिच्छन्ति!"
english: "Generosity begets eloquence, Variety begets chewiness, What nasty gossip your friends spew!"

prakrit: "संगाममण्डले वि हु,आवासं सरवरेसु काऊणं,हरिही लक्खणवेजो,कामग्गहवेयणं तस्स"
english: "I am still in the sangam mandala, The crows roam freely, The hunter is always on the lookout, The lover is always there."

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,तो मे रुटेण वाणराहिवई,भणिओ अहिक्विवन्तो,तुज्झ वि मरणं समासन्नं"
english: "If you listen to me When I speak, you will not hear me speak Because I am angry. Saying:" "My life means more to me than you." ""

prakrit: "भणिओ मे दासरही,कुबुरिसवेयारिओ तुम संधी,न कुणसि कुणसि विरोह,कज्जाकजं अयाणन्तो"
english: "Say :'I am a slave woman; you talk nonsense, you make deals, you do not cause discord, for the business of business is transacted in secret '." ""

prakrit: "पायालवीइपउर,मयगलगाहाउल रहावत्तं,राहव! भुयासु तरिउं,कि इच्छसि रावणसमुई :"
english: "Payalveepur, maygalgahaul rahavatam, rahava! Be reasonable! For what do you want Ravana's wife to do?"

prakrit: "चण्डाणिलेण वि जहा,न चलिज्जइ पउम! दिणयरो गयणे,तह य तुमे दहवयणो,न य जिप्पइ समरमज्झम्मि"
english: "Wherever the moon is sighted, There is no room for it! The nights are passing, So do not burn yourself out, Nor forsake the warrior's mother." ""

prakrit: "सोऊण मज्झ वयणं,रुट्ठो भामण्डलो सहामज्झे,खगं समुगिरन्तो,निवारिओ लक्खणेणे ति"
english: "Listen to my voice, Root and plow your way through the thickets, For the river empties into the sea, Destroying your character."

prakrit: "नायरजणेण एवं,गाढं हाहारवं करेन्तेणं,खुब्भइ दसाणणहर,अन्नोन्नं लक्ष्यन्तेणं"
english: "Knowing nothing else, Making thick, fragrant raindrops, Being extremely fearful of telling the truth, Noticing everything"

prakrit: "कायस्थ गलियरयणा,भउया तुडियमेहलकलावा,हत्थावलम्बियकरा,अन्ना पुण वच्चइ तुरन्ती"
english: "The Kayastha walks down the aisle, The buffalo steps in front of him, Hands clasped around his ears, And then suddenly Anna returns." ""

prakrit: "अन्ना भएण विलया,गरुयनियम्बा सणेण तुरन्ती,हंसि व पउमसण्डे,कह कह वि पयं परिवइ"
english: "Being poor is vanity, Being thin is haste, Laughing is pleasure, And the rainy season is fever; How can one pay attention to things?"

prakrit: "पीणुन्नयथणजुयला,अइगरुयपरिस्समाउला बाला,अह दारुणे वि य भए,वच्चइ लीलाऎ रच्छासु"
english: "Drunken girl, You silly girl, Even if you're so cruel, There must be someone who loves you."

prakrit: "अन्नाऎ गलइ हारो,अन्नाए कडयकुण्डलाहरणं,अन्नाऎ उत्तरिज,विवडियवडियं न विनायं"
english: "Anna won't give in, Anna threw in the towel, Anna kicked in the face, Anna answered," "No need to go elsewhere." ""

prakrit: "एवं तु नायरजणे,भयविहलविसंतुले मओ राया,सनज्झिऊण सबलो,रावणभवणं समल्लीणो"
english: "And you, Naira, with all your fear and trembling, Have become immovable, Like everyone else in the world." ""

prakrit: "जुझं समुबहन्तो,तेहि समं रावणस्स महिलाए,मन्दोयरोऎ रुद्धो,जिणवरसमय सरन्तीए"
english: "The battle rages on, So do the women of Ravana's men, Stop the arrows of Mando, For the time is ripe for victory."

prakrit: "एयन्तरम्मि द९,नयरनणं भयसमाउलं देवा,सन्तीहराहिवासी,वच्छल्लं उज्जया काउं"
english: "Attracted by nature, The God of Fear and Longing, Who dwells in the desert, Has illuminated the banks of the Vechchalla"

prakrit: "सन्तीहराउ सहसा,उप्पझ्या नहयलं महाघोरा,दाढाकरालवयणा,निदाहरविसनिहा कूरा"
english: "Spring is sudden, Spring is in full swing, Summer is heavy, The rainy season is late, Sleeplessness has worn off."

prakrit: "आसा हवन्ति हत्थी,सीहा बग्घा य दारुणा सप्पा,मेहा य अग्गिपवणा,होन्ति पुणो पचयसरिच्छा"
english: "There must be an elephant in the forest, A fierce snake on the boundary fence, A fire burning in the thickets, A fresh pair of emeralds on the horizon."

prakrit: "अह ते घोरायारे,देवे दटूण वाणराणीयं,भग्गं भउद्यमणं,संपेल्लोपेल्ल कुणमाणं"
english: "Oh! they are hoarse; The gods look on, And the women speak: Fearful talk is the characteristic of all women."

prakrit: "विद्धत्थं पवययलं,सन्तीहरवासिएहि देवेहिं,नाऊण सेसचेइय-भवणनिवासी सुरा रुट्ठा"
english: "Wisdom is pure, The gods live in harmony, The rivers flow in harmony - The woman who lives in harmony Lives in harmony."

prakrit: "देवाण य देवाण य,आवडियं दारुणं महाजुझं,विच्छूढघायपउर,अन्नोबाहवणारावं"
english: "God or gods, such fierce beasts, Such hideous monsters, Such poisonous grasshoppers, Such cowards."

prakrit: "सन्तीहरसुरसेन्नं,दूरं ओसारियं तु देवेहिं,दहण वाणरभडा,पुणरवि य ठिया नयरिहुता"
english: "The sound of the trumpet, A long way off, You god of thunder, Never to be seen again."

prakrit: "नाऊण पुण्णभद्दो,रुट्ठो तो भणइ माणिभई सो,पेच्छमु किं व विमुक्का,वाणरकऊ महापावा?"
english: "When a man speaks, He speaks politely; When he speaks, I reply," "Why am I silent?" "Is the orator a great man?"

prakrit: "सन्तीहरमल्लीणं,नियमत्थं रावणं विगयमङ्गं,हन्तूण समुजुत्ता,मिच्छादिट्टी महाघोरा"
english: "Santheeramallina, niyamasthanam ravanam vigayamanganam, hunthuna samujutta, misadventure mahaghora"

prakrit: "तो भणइ माणिभद्दो,नियमत्थं रावणं जिणाययणे,खाऊण न नीरइ,जइ वि मुरिन्दो सयं चेव"
english: "He says," "Manibhaddo, regularly conquer Ravana, do not lose heart by eating him; even if he dies, I will accompany him." ""

prakrit: "भणिऊण एवमेयं,रुट्टा जक्खाहिवा तहिं गन्तुं,तह जुझिउं पवत्ता,जेण सुरा लजिया नट्टा"
english: "Say what I have to say :'There you go, you stubborn girl, There you must fight, Not so shy girl."

prakrit: "अह ते जक्खाहिबई,पत्थरपहर वाणराणीयं,गन्तूण उवलहन्ते,गयणत्थं राहवं ताहे"
english: "Oh! she is worthless, Like a barber standing on a boulder. Destroyers sigh, Like the arrows of a demon."

prakrit: "अह भणइ पुण्णभद्दो,राम! तुमं सुणमु ताव मह वयणं,उत्तमकुलसंभूओ,विश्वाओ दहरहस्स सुओ"
english: "" "Oh! you fool, Rama! When I hear you speak My speech, Excellent boy, Believe me, You who have twice had the pleasure of laughing."

prakrit: "नाणसि धम्माधम्म,कुसलो नाणोदहिस्स पारगी,होऊण गरिसगुणो,कह कुणसि इमं अकरणिजं?"
english: "You fool, When will you realize your worth, If you don't know what it is To be virtuous? How can you be so negligent?"

prakrit: "नियमत्थे दहवयणे,धीरे सन्तीहरं समल्लीणे,लङ्कापुरोऎ लोयं,बित्ताससि नियभिच्चहि"
english: "Regularly playing the dahavayana, slowly gathering the nectar of spring, Always thinking of the world around us, As though you were sowing seeds."

prakrit: "जो जस्स हरइ दवं,निक्खुत्तं हरइ तस्स मो पाणे,नाऊण एवमयं,राहव! मुहडा निवारेहि"
english: "One who loses virtue, loses true virtue, gains merit. Nowadays, my dear, Rahu's face is pure." ""

prakrit: "तं भणइ लच्छिनिलओ,इमस्म रामस्स गुणनिही सीया,रक्वसनाहेण हिया,तम्स तुम कुणमु अणुकम्पं"
english: "She says," "Lucky are you, I'm sure of your virtues Rama, Are you afraid of the anger that will come from your anger, For you are a model of virtue." ""

prakrit: "कश्चणपत्तेण तओ,अग्धं दाऊण वाणराहिवई,भणइ य जवनरिन्दं,मुञ्चमु एयं महाकोवं"
english: "A man is born blind, A woman gives birth deaf, A man speaks nonsense, Aunt, this is a great sin."

prakrit: "इहरा वि न साहिजइ,दहवयणो गरुयदप्पमाहप्पो,बहुरूविणी,किं पुण,विजा वसं उवगयाए?"
english: "She is not well, Daughter - in - law, Strong and vigorous, Wretched woman, Is it for nothing That you have acquired knowledge?"

prakrit: "पेच्छमु ममं महायस!,वच्च तुमं अत्तणो निययठाणं,ववगयकोवारम्भो,पसन्नचित्तो य होऊणं"
english: "Look, my great man! But you are so determined. It's only the beginning of a virtuous cycle. Be of good cheer." ""

prakrit: "तो भणइ पुण्णभद्दो,एव इमं एत्थ नवरि नयरीए,जह न वि करेह पोई,जुण्णतणादीसु वि अकजं"
english: "Well said, then, you fool, There's nothing the young lady can do About it. Even the old gentleman can't do It himself." ""

prakrit: "भणिऊण वयणमेये,साहम्मियवच्छला तओ जक्खा,परमेट्ठिसंपउत्ता,गया य निययाई ठाणाई"
english: "Tell me, you naughty girl, How stupid of you to lie down and ask me questions? It's the way of God."

prakrit: "एवं निणिन्दवरसासणभत्तिमन्ता,उच्छाहनिच्छियमणा इह जे मणुस्सा,विज्जाऎ कि व सुहसाहणसंपयाए,सिद्धालयं पि विमलं खलु जन्ति धीरा"
english: "And the arrows of the God of Love, Which pierce and pierce through the whole body, Are a blessing to mankind, As knowledge is to those who attain bliss."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए सम्महिट्टिदेवकित्तणं नाम सत्तसढ़ पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "Come, let us embrace one another: The arrows of the God of Love are powerful."

prakrit: "नाऊण य उवसमियं,नक्खवई अङ्गओ गयवरिन्द,किकिन्धिदण्डनाम,आरूढो दप्पियामरिसो"
english: "Naun ya ussamiyam, naakhwai ang gayavarind, kikindhidandanaam, arudho daadyamriso"

prakrit: "लकापुरी पयट्टा,मुहडा कुमुइन्दणीलमाईया,नाणाउहगहियकरा,नाणाविहवाहणारूढा"
english: "Lakapuri Payatta, Mukhda Kumudindani Leelamaya, Slender girl, Covered with reeds"

prakrit: "कुटुमकयङ्गराया,' नाणालंकारभूसियसरीरा,विसमाहयतूररवा,कुमारसीहा बला चण्डा"
english: 'Kutumkayangaraya,'bowed by lotus petals,'moonlit by the waning moon,'is the lotus of kumarsiha.

prakrit: "अह ते वाणरसुहडा,अङ्गयपमुहा बलेण परिपुण्णा,लकापुरि पविट्ठा,धयछत्तसमुज्जलसिरीया"
english: "Ah! the beauty of the Varna, The fullness of its body and face, The purity of Lakapuri, Like a stream of flame draining from the ashes."

prakrit: "मेसन्ता नयरजणं,दहमुहभवणङ्गणं समणुपत्ता,दट्टण कोट्टिमतलं,जलगाहसमाउलं भीया"
english: "The messenger is a poor man, The solemn courtyard is deserted, The streets are congested, The banks of the Goda are swollen."

prakrit: "अचलन्तनयणरूवाई तत्थ नाऊण कोट्टिमकयाई,रावणभवणदुवारं,संपत्ता गिरिगुहायार"
english: "The arrow of the immovable Nayanar, That boatman's name is Kottimakayai, The roof of Ravana's house, A mountain cave of wealth."

prakrit: "तो इन्दनीलकोट्टिम-तलम्मि सीहा करालमुहनन्ता,दट्टण वाणरा ते,नाया य पलायणुजुत्ता"
english: "So, you silly girl, Don't turn your head away. But don't be alarmed: It's not your fault you ran away." ""

prakrit: "परिमुणियकारणेणं,नियत्तिया अगएण दुक्खेहिं,पुणरवि पविसन्ति घरं,सबत्तो दिनदिट्ठीया"
english: "Destroyed for no other reason than fate, Going home again, seeing you all day long."

prakrit: "फलिहमयविमलकुडु,आगासं चेव मन्नमाणा ते,कढिणसिलावडियसिरा,पडिया बहवे पवयनोहा"
english: "Fruitful lotus blossom, From fire to man, From lotus to lotus, From plant to plant, From tree to plant."

prakrit: "परिफुडियजन्नु-कोप्पर,अइगाढं वेयणापरिग्गहिया,पविसन्ति नाणियपहा,अन्नं कच्छन्तरं भीया"
english: "People around - The cowherd, The girl with the tight braid, The farmer with the empty pots and pans, The poor man with the scantily clad wife - The rice has already been cut."

prakrit: "तत्थ वि य कजलनिभा,वसुंधरा इन्दनोलनिम्माया,संसइयदिन्नपसरा,नाउँ कढिणं न देन्ति पर्य"
english: "Even so, Kajalanibha, drowsy and rainbow -clad mother - in - law, Doesn't give a damn By the name of her husband." ""

prakrit: "दिवा य तत्थ एका,तरुणी फलिहामयम्मि सोवाणे,पुच्छन्ति दिसामूदा,भद्दे! कत्तो जिणहर त:"
english: "The lamp is burning, And the young women are dancing in ecstasy, Asking what's wrong with their husbands?" ""

prakrit: "जाहे सा पडिवयणं,न देइ ताणं विमग्गमाणाणं,ताहे करेहि फुसियं,लेप्पयमहिला विनाणन्ति"
english: "When she tries to escape, He refuses to give her a rest. But when she refuses, He acts in such a way That the women of the town disapprove."

prakrit: "अह ते विलक्खवयणा,अन्नं कच्छन्तरं समल्लीणा,तत्थ महानीलमए,कुछ सहस ति आवडिया"
english: "Ah! that wretchedness, That grinds after a meal, That thirsts for the great love, Something more is in store for her."

prakrit: "ते चक्खुवज्जिया इव,सुहडा एक्कम अपेच्छन्ता,परिमुसिऊणा''दत्ता,करेसु अइदीहकुडाई"
english: "Te chakkuvajjiya eva, suhada ekkam apechanta, parimuseuna" Datta, do as the hunter tells you. "" "

prakrit: "परिमुसमाणेहि नरो,सजीवो जाणिओ य वायाण,केसेसु खरं गहिओ,भणिओ दावेहि सन्तिहरं"
english: "People like me, Those who are alive Know what is true and what is not, But say what is false."

prakrit: "एवं ते पवयभडा,पुरओ पहदेसयं नरं काउं,सब वि समणुपत्ता,सन्तिजिणिन्दस्स वरभवणं"
english: "And he is pure and pure, Like a man without a wife, Like everyone else in harmony, Like the essence of one's being."

prakrit: "दिट्ट सरयब्भनिभ,नाणाविहचित्तयम्मकयसोहं,ऊसियध्यावडायं,सम्गविमाणं व ओइण्णं"
english: "A glance reveals everything, A thought with a coin, A playful glance, A languid walk, A song without words."

prakrit: "वजिन्दनील मरगय--मालाओऊलभूसियदुवार,नाणारयणसमुजल-मुयन्धवरकुसुमकयपूर्य"
english: "Vazindanil Maragayya - garland - Wrapped around the head, Water flowing from the nadir - Filled with the fragrance of jasmine."

prakrit: "विच्छड्डिय बलियम्म,कालागरुबहलध्वगन्धड्ड,तक्खणमेत्तुप्पाडिय-वरकमलकयञ्चणविहाणं"
english: "Vichhaddiya baliyam, Kaalagaruba haladhwaja gandhadad, Takkan mettuppadiya - The four vows of the bridegroom"

prakrit: "एयारिसं च द९,जिणभवणं विम्हिया तओ जोहा,पणमन्ति सन्तिनाह,तिक्वुत्तपयाहिणावत्वं"
english: "Air is the enemy, Life is fleeting, Love is boundless, Deceit is immutable, And greed is rife."

prakrit: "एवं सो निययबलं,बाहिरकच्छन्तरे ठवेऊणं,पविसाइ सन्तिभवणं,दहियओ अङ्ग्यकुमारो"
english: "And that's sheer willpower, To slap on the outside, To smear on the inside, To burn the body of a poor man."

prakrit: "भावेण वन्दणं सो,काऊणं तस्स पेच्छण पुरओ,कोट्टिमनले निविट्ट,जोगत्थं रक्खसाहिवई"
english: "Vindication is for the soul, Penance is for those who see it, Calmness prevails on the body, Jogyam means protection."

prakrit: "अह भणइ अङ्गओ तं,रावण! किं ते समुट्टिओ डम्भो,तिजगुत्तमम्स पुरओ,हरिझणं नणयरायसुयं?"
english: "Ah, the limp body! Ravana! Is that the whole damn thing? It's the full moon of the Tijaguttams. Isn't it the sunshine of the horizon?" ""

prakrit: "धिद्धि! ति रक्खसाहम!,दुचरियावास! तुज्झ एताहे,तं ते करेमि नं ते,न य कुणइ नमो सुरुट्टो वि"
english: "Dhiddhi! Your protection! You rascal! Here you are, I'll do it for you. There's nothing I can do about it, not even a scratch." ""

prakrit: "अह सो सुग्गीवसुओ,महयं काऊण कलयलारावं,आमट्ठो दहवयणं,पहणइ वत्थंण वलहत्थो"
english: "Ah, you handsome hunter, Why don't you paint a pattern for me? It takes ten inches to grind. It takes the weight of a bow To grip it."

prakrit: "तस्स पुरओ ठियाई,तुरियं घेत्तण सहसवत्ताई,पहणइ धरणिनिविट्ठ,अहोमुहं जुवइवम्गं सो"
english: "The whole of her body is fixed, The trumpet is held aloft, She sits on the housetop Wearing it all over, I am still a youth."

prakrit: "सो तस्स अम्खमालं,कराउ हरिऊण तोडइ कुमारो,पुणरवि संघेइ लहुं,भूओ अप्पेइ विहसन्तो"
english: "So what's wrong with that? The plowman's son is breaking the plow, The farmer's daughter-in-law is dying, The land is drying up again." ""

prakrit: "सा तस्स अश्वमाला,करम्मि मुविमुद्धफलिहनिम्माया,रेहइ डोलायन्ती,मेहस्स बलाहपन्ति च"
english: "She is like a garland of jewels, Like the fruit on the hand of a woman in labor, Like a banner proclaiming victory."

prakrit: "वररयणपजलन्ती,छेत्तण य कण्ठियं अइतुरन्तो,निययंसुएण बन्धइ,गलए लकाहिवं एत्तो"
english: "The bridegroom is burning with ecstasy, His throat is choking with soot, He is bound by a covenant, And the lac on his cheek is like this."

prakrit: "घेत्तण य तं वत्थं,उलम्बइ रहसपूरियामरिसो,पुणरवि य भवणथम्भे,दहवयणं बन्धइ कुमारो"
english: "Get up, that is to say, get up, full of fresh flowers, Reach the housetop again, Put on your robes," said the young man.

prakrit: "दीणारेसु हसन्तो,पञ्चसु विकइ रक्खसाहिवई,निययपुरिसस्स हत्थे,सवइ पुणो तिवसदेण"
english: "The wise laugh, The wise sell their five talents, And the wise manage theirs. All are renewed by the twilight of love."

english: "Oh! take a bath in the lake, Chant and cling to the fragrant cow - dung cakes, My heart is made of two halves; I will make it my moon - elephant."

prakrit: "भामण्डलं पि घेत्तु,पाचं दढसङ्कलाहि सुनिषद्धं,मोग्गरघायाहिहयं,करेमि गयनोवियं अन्ज"
english: "I'll go to the temple, Then wait a moment, Then close the curtain, Then bend over and cover it with your long hair. I will do whatever you say."

prakrit: "करवत्तेण महसुर्य,फालेमिह कट्ठजन्तपडिबद्धं,मारेमि सेसमुहडे,लक्वणरामे पमोत्तूणं"
english: "Karavatten mahasurya, phalemih katha jantapadiye, maremiye sesamuhade, lakavanarame pramothuna."

prakrit: "एवं निच्छयहियए,नाए लङ्कादिवे निमित्ताई,नायाइ बहुविहाई,मगहवई अनयवन्ताई"
english: "And do not neglect women. Lanka's goddesses are immutable, Her husbands are many, And their wives are countless."

prakrit: "अको आउहसरिसो,परिवेसो अम्बरे फरुसवण्णो,नट्टो सयलसमन्थो,रयणीचन्दो भएणेव"
english: "Come on, you naughty girl, Don't be so naïve: It's just the moonlight of the night."

prakrit: "जाओ य भूमिकम्पो,घोरा निवडन्ति तत्थ निग्घाया,उक्का य रुहिरवण्णा,पुबदिसा चेव दिप्पन्ती"
english: "If the earth trembles, The stag chooses to sleep there, If the sky is over It will stay dark, And if the moon is full It will die."

prakrit: "नालामुही सिवा वि य,घोरं वाहरइ उत्तरदिसाए,हेसन्ति फरुसविरसं,कम्पियगीवा महातुरया"
english: "The plowman has nothing to say but sighs, Sighs loudly, Looks the same as the farmer's wife, And trembles violently."

prakrit: "हत्थी रडन्ति घोरं,पणन्ता वसुमई सहत्येणं,मुञ्चन्ति नयणसलिलं,पडिमाओ देवयाणं पि"
english: "The elephant cries aloud, The hunter seeks shelter with the landowner, The plowman with the weasel, The farmer with the ox, The shepherd with the buffalo."

prakrit: "वासन्ति करयररवं,रिट्टा वि य दिणयरं पलोएन्ता,भञ्जन्ति महारुक्खा,पडन्ति सेलाण सिहराई"
english: "The rainy season makes the roads impassable, The hot summer nights are long, And the rainy days are long."

prakrit: "विउलाई पि सराई,सहसा सोसं गयाइ सबाई,वुटुं च रुहिरवासं,गयणाओ तडयडारावं"
english: "The field is still dry, Suddenly it's swollen, But the trees are still standing There, Singing the tune of the cascade of rivers."

prakrit: "एए अन्ने य बहू,उप्पाया दारुणा समुप्पन्ना,देसाहिवस्स मरणं,साहेन्ति न एत्थ संदेहो"
english: "Oh! my poor daughter - in - law! What a cruel man he is. Death to the God of Love. No doubt of it at all!"

prakrit: "नक्खत्तबलविमुक्को,गहेसु अञ्चन्तकुडिलवन्तेसु,वारिज्जन्तो वि तया,अह कहइ रणमुहं माणी"
english: "Aunt, There must be something very special about your husband's face. Even his elder brother is absent. Your eyes are glued to his face." ""

prakrit: "निययनसभाभीओ,गाई बीरेकरसगओ धीरो,सत्थाण वि जाणन्तो,कजाकजं न लक्वेइ"
english: "Be careful about what you say, cowherd; he knows the truth but does not know how to reason."

prakrit: "लाहिवस्स एत्तो,नं हिययत्थं तु कारणं सई,साहेमि तुझ सेणिय,मुणहि विगह पमोत्तणं"
english: "Loud beating, No need to scream, You're the reason, I'm your warrior," He sighed.

prakrit: "जिणिऊण सत्तुसेन्नं,मोत्तण य पुत्तबन्धवा सबइ,पविसामि ण लका हं,करेमि पच्छा इमं कजं"
english: "If I win, it's all good, If I lose my husband, I don't care. But if I lose him, I'll do it myself." ""

prakrit: "सयलम्मि भरहवासे,उखासेऊण पायचारा हं,बल-सत्ति-कन्तिजुत्ता,ठवेमि विजाहरे बहवे"
english: "I am full of water, I walk on dry grass, I yawn loudly, I make my way through thickets of reeds."

prakrit: "जेणेत्थ वंसे मुरदेवपुजा,जिणुत्तमा चकहरा य रामा,नारायणा तिबबला महप्पा,जायन्ति तुझामकित्तिमन्ता"
english: "Whence the worship of the dead, O Rama, Through the churning of the jinn, Or the burning of the pyre, As if by accident; For to you, O Lord, belongs what is precious."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए रावणचिंताबिहाणं एगणसत्ता पच्वं समत्तं"
english: "Consider the thought of Ravana on this auspicious day. Everything is peaceful."

prakrit: "ततो सो दहवयणो,दियहे अइभासुरे सह भडेहिं,अस्थाणी निविट्ठो,इन्दो इव रिद्धिसंपन्नो"
english: "So burn that fire, Let the fire burn with unbearable fury, Stop burning the fire of immortality, For inside it is the same as inside it."

prakrit: "वरहार-कणयकुण्डल-मउडालंकारभूसियसरीरो,पुलयन्तो निययसहं,अहियं चिन्तावरो जाओ"
english: "The bridegroom - The bracelets on the bride's bosom, Decorated with pearls and pearls, Are a constant source of worry To me."

prakrit: "भाया य भाणुकण्णो,इन्दइ घणवाहणो महं पुत्ता,हत्थ-पहन्था य भडा,एत्थ पासे न दीसन्ति"
english: "Brother, tell me, My son, That very heavy vehicle, Whether it is a donkey or a handkerchief, Will not get through here."

prakrit: "ते तत्थ अपेच्छन्तो,रुट्टो भडभिउडिभासुरं वयणं,काऊण देइ दिट्टी,दहवयणो चक्करयणस्स"
english: "That's what he wanted: Roots, loud thunderclaps, Eyes staring at the fence, Dahavayana's whirligig." ""

prakrit: "रोसपसरन्तहियओ,आउहाला समुज्जओ गन्तं,ताव य समुट्ठियाई,सहसा अइदुणिमिताई"
english: "Tears flow down her cheeks, The crowd gathers, And suddenly the moon disappears." ""

prakrit: "अन्नेण वच्चमाणो,पहओ चलणेण पायमम्मम्मि,छिन्नो य तस्स मग्गो,पुरओ वि हु किण्ट्सप्पण"
english: "Aunt, The path is slippery after a long walk, If you want to touch it, You'll have to bend over Before you can touch it."

prakrit: "हा हा धो! मा वच्चसु,तस्स सुणन्तम्स अकुसला सदा,जाया सहसुप्पाया,सउणा अजयावहा बहवे"
english: "" "Oh! come on! Don't touch me! You'll never hear of him again." "That dream must have been true The moment he'd spoken it."

prakrit: "पडियं च उत्तरिज,भगं वेरुलियदण्डयं छत्त,ताहे कयञ्जलिउडा,दइयं मन्दोयरी भणइ"
english: "The plow is high, The fence is wide and the fence is steep, So is Kanjliuda," Says the compassionate Mandoyari. "

prakrit: "विरहसरियाऎ सामिय!,वुमन्ती दुक्खसलिलभीमाए,उत्तारेहि महायस!,सिणेहहत्थावलम्बेणं"
english: "Separation is common!, Women suffer, Fear prevails, The great heat of love prevails!, Love embraces the weak." ""

prakrit: "अन्न पि मुणसु सामिय!,मह वयणं जइ विनेच्छसि मणेणं,एवं पिय तुज्झ हियं,होहइ कडुओसह व जहा"
english: "Sigh, Samia! If you want to hear my speech You must listen, And if you must drink your wine, It must be with a bitter tooth." ""

prakrit: "संसयतुलं बलग्गो,किं वा संसयसि णाह! अत्ताणं!,उम्मग्गेण रियन्त,धरेह चित्तं समज्जाय"
english: "Friend, tell me, Why do you groan so much? You fool, Don't be alarmed. Please, keep your senses." ""

prakrit: "तुङ्ग विभूसमु कुलं,सलाहणिजं च कुणमु अप्पाणं,अप्पेहि भूमिगोयर-महिला कलहस्स आमूलं"
english: "You stupid family, You greedy farmer, You selfish person, Your landlord - Women are the root of all quarrels."

prakrit: "वहरिस्स अत्तणो वा,मरणं काऊण निच्छयं हियए,जुझिजइ समरमुहे,तह वि य किं कारणं तेणं?"
english: "It's been a year already, Death is nigh at hand, The battle rages on, So what's the reason?" ""

prakrit: "तम्हा अप्पेहि इमा,सीया रामस्स पणयपीईए,परिवालेहि वयं तं,जं गहियं मुणिसयासम्मि"
english: "Your heart, my dear, I beg of you, O Ramasa, My family, We bow before you Like a sage's son."

prakrit: "देवेहि परिगहिओ,नइ वि समो हवइ भरहनाहेणं,तह वि अकित्ति पावइ,पुरिसो परनारिसङ्गेणं"
english: "Believe in gods, not in fair weather, And never in vain. For men are like unto other men."

prakrit: "जो परनारीसु समं,कुणइ रई मूढभावदोसेणं,आसीविसेण समय,कीलइ सो उग्गतेएणं"
english: "One who is equal to those who are different, Who suffer from superstitious delusions, At odd hours, Is a spiky bee."

prakrit: "हालाहल पिव विसं,हुयवहजालं व परमपज्जलियं,वग्धि व विसमसोला,अहियं वज्जेह परमहिला"
english: "The plowman's son, A flame of fire, Is the supreme illumination, Is a poisonous snake, Is like a lightning bolt: It is the supreme woman."

prakrit: "इन्दीवरघणसामो,गवियहसियं दसाणणो काउं,भणइ पिया ससिवयणे,किं व भय उवगयासि तुमं"
english: "My poor girl, How can you tell me you're pregnant? Tell me, darling, How are you supposed to know? You look so scared."

prakrit: "न य सो हं रविकित्ती,न चेव विज्जाहरो असणिघोसो,न य इयरो को वि नरो,जेण तुम भाससे एवं"
english: "I am not a coward, No one is wise or dishonest, Nor is anyone hurt by what you say, Just as you are."

prakrit: "रिउपायवाण अग्गी,सो हइ लाहिवो सुपडिकूलो,न य अप्पेमि ससिमुही,सीया मा कुणसु भयसकं"
english: "The spring is on fire, It's hot and humid outside, I can't sleep, But don't be afraid of the fire." ""

prakrit: "एव भणियम्मितो सा,ईसावसमुवगया महादेवी,जंपइ सीयाऎ समं,कि सामिय! रइसुहं महसि?"
english: "He said," "You fool, Isn't that the way of a God of Love? Speak as one speaks, Are you really happy with me?" ""

prakrit: "ईसाकोवेण तओ,पहणइ कण्णुप्पलेण सा दइयं,भणइ य गुणाणुरूवं,किं दिट्ट तीऎ सोहम"
english: "Because she is jealous, She wears compassion on her eyelid, Says virtue bestows virtue, And what beauty is that to her eyes?"

prakrit: "किं भूमिगोयरीए,कीरइ अहियं कलाविहीणाए.?,विज्जाहरीऎ समयं,भयसु पहू! नेहसंबन्धं"
english: "What on earth are you doing? You cowherd, Why am I here without art? It's high time you went abroad. Fear not, my dear! Concerning Neha!" ""

prakrit: "आणवसु केरिसी हं,होमि पहू! ना तुम हिययइट्टा,किं सयलपास्यसिरी?,अहवा वि मुरिन्दवहुसरिसा?"
english: "You silly girl, Aren't you jealous? Are you sure you're not jealous? Or are you just dying?"

prakrit: "सो एव भणियमेतो,अहोमुहो लज्जिओ विचिन्तेइ,परमहिलासत्तो हइ,अकित्तिलहुयत्तर्ण पत्तो"
english: "That is what I meant when I said :'I am ashamed and embarrassed, I am extremely frustrated."

prakrit: "अह सो विलक्खहसियं,काऊण य भणइ अत्तणो कन्तं,तं मज्झ हिययइट्टा,अहियं अन्नाण महिलाणं"
english: "Oh! what a silly woman! How can one say such a thing? It's just the way I like it."

prakrit: "लद्धपसायाऎ तओ,भणिओ मन्दोयरीऎ दहवयणो,किं दिणयरम्स दोवो,दिजइ वि हु मग्गणट्टाए?"
english: "When he ran out of the house, She said," "Daughter - in - law, Dinner is too short, Can't you count the days?" ""

prakrit: "जाणन्तो वि नयविही,कह वि पमाय गओ विहिवसेणं,तह वि य पबोहणीओ,हवइ नरो अन्नपुरिसेणं"
english: "Anyone who knows how to cook food should know how to knead it, especially those with weak bones."

prakrit: "आसि पुरा मुणिवसहो,विण्हू वेडबलद्धिसंपन्नो,सिद्धन्त-गोइयासु य किं न पाहं तया नीओ?"
english: "You fool, You stupid fool, Don't you see That I am clever, And you are clever - go - between?"

prakrit: "नइ पयणुओ वि कीरइ,मज्झ पसाओ इमं भणन्तीए,तो मुञ्चमु नाह! तुमं,'सीया रामस्स हियइट्टा"
english: "No, I don't care what people say, I speak plainly, So do not be embarrassed! You, my dear, have become a laughingstock." ""

prakrit: "तुह अणुमएण सोया,नेऊणं राहवं पसाएमि,आणेमि भागुकण्णं,पुत्ता य अलं रणमुहेणं"
english: "I slept in your presence, I walked in your path, I ran out of the house, My son, I am ready to face the battle."

prakrit: "सो एव भणियमेत्तो,जंपइ लकाहियो परमरुट्टो,लहु गच्छ गच्छ पावे!,जत्थ मुहं ते न पेच्छामि"
english: "So I said," "Wait a moment, you silly bitch!" "But I can't find the place where my mouth fell."

prakrit: "एव भणिय पवुत्ता,सुणसु पह! बहुजणेण जं सिढें,हलहर-चकहराणं,जम्म पडिवासुदेवाणं"
english: "Say this, dear girl:" "Listen! The stairs are crowded with many people, The plowman is running around, The gods of the plain are everywhere." ""

prakrit: "आसि तिविट्ठ दुविट,सयंभु पुरिसोतमो पुरिससीहो,पुरिसवरपुण्डरीओ,दत्तो वि हु केसवा पए"
english: "Come, you stubborn man; With men at heart, with men at the head, You foolish girl; Even my husband has turned turtle."

prakrit: "अयलो विजय सुभद्दो य सुप्पहो तह सुदरिसणो चेव,आणन्द नन्दणो वि य,इमे वि हलिणो वइकन्ता"
english: "Alas, victory is sure, so is sleep for the sound of the trumpet, And so is bliss for the meek; This, too, is the fate of the wicked."

prakrit: "अह भारहम्मि वासे,एए बल केसवा वइकन्ता,संपइ वद्र̥न्ति इमे,राहव-नारायणा लोए"
english: "Oh! the weight of our body, O powerful kesava, Vayikanta, The path to prosperity runs through him, In this world Rahava-narayana."

prakrit: "एएहि तारगाई,पडिसत घाइया तिखण्डवई,संपइ सामि विणासं,तुहमवि गन्तुं समुच्छहसि"
english: "This is the way of the targa, This is how the tikhandavayi goes, winding its way through the tika, And you are on your way."

prakrit: "भोत्तूण कामभोए,पुरिसा जे संजमं समणुपत्ता,ते नवरि बन्दणिज्जा,हवन्ति देवा-'सुराणं पि"
english: "Blessed are the faithful, The husband who disciplines modesty, The bridegroom who dresses modestly, The God of Love -" "Praise be to the gods!" ""

prakrit: "तम्हा तुमे वि सामिय!,भुत्तं चिय उत्तमं विसयसोक्खं,भमिओ य जसो लोए,संपइ दिक्खं पवजासु"
english: "Thou art a Samyan! But what a pleasure it is to visit a good man. For behold, As the world Goes on, Pay attention to what you see."

prakrit: "अहवा अणुब्बयधरो,होऊणं सोल-संजमाभिरओ,देव-गुरुभत्तिजुत्तो,दहमुह! दुक्खक्खयं कुणसु"
english: "Ahava anubhayadhara, hunter of the soul, warrior of the senses, lover of gods and goddesses: Fear not! Act in grief." ""

prakrit: "अट्ठारसहि दसाणण!,जुबइसहस्सेहि जो तुमं तित्ति,न गओ अणङ्गमूढो सो कह एकाऎ वञ्चिहिसि!"
english: "Eighteen thousand dollars! How can you be so naïve As to be so stubborn And so stupid? You're only talking to yourself!"

prakrit: "इह सयलजीवलोए,विसयसुहं मुञ्जिउं मुचिरकालं,जइ कोइ गओ तित्ति,पुरिसो तं मे समुद्दिससु"
english: "Ah, the pleasures of long life! It is the end of an era for me. But whichever one goes there, Men - take me to the sea." ""

prakrit: "तम्हा इमं महाजस!,विसयमुई अप्पसोक्खबहुदुक्खं,वजेहि वजणिजं,परमहिलासंगम एवं"
english: "Your name is great!, Visayamuyi, my heart overflows with joy, Vjayehi, my heavy weights, The supreme heavenly union, And so on."

prakrit: "बहुभडखयंकरेणं,देव! न कजं इमेण जुज्झेणं,बद्धञ्जलिमउडा हइ,पडिया वि हु तुज्झ पाएम"
english: "" "Don't be so hasty! I've a lot of catching up to do, God! This isn't the way to fight. I'm bound and gagged. Even my feet are like your feet."

prakrit: "हसिऊण भणइ वोरो,उट्टहि किसोयरी : भउबेयं,मा वच्चसु पसयच्छी!,नामेणं वासुदेवाणं"
english: "Laughing she says," "Worry not!" "To which the butcher replies:" "Fear not! Please, my poor girl! Name me Vasudevan." ""

prakrit: "बलदेव-वासुदेवा,हन्ति बहवो इहं भरहवासे,तह वि य कि संजायइ,सिद्धी खलु नाममेत्तेणं?"
english: "Baldev - Vasudeva, The hunter has already crossed this threshold, So what do you think will happen If you lose the name Siddhi?"

prakrit: "रहनेउरनयरवई,जह इन्दो'णिबई मए नीओ,तह य इमं कीरन्तं,पेच्छमु नारायणं सिग्धं"
english: "The longer I stay, the thinner my mind, the more powerful my thoughts become. I shall learn to recognize Narayan again."

prakrit: "भणिऊण घयणमेयं,समयं मन्दोयरीऎ दहवयणो,कीलणहरं पविट्ठो,ताव य अत्थं गओ सूरो"
english: "Tell me, my poor girl, Time has come to burn the candles on the lampstand. The sacred thread in the nail marks the funeral pyre. So what is the use of crying then?"

prakrit: "अत्थायम्मि दिणयरे,संझासमए समागए सन्ते,मउलेन्ति कमलयाई,विरहो चक्कार्यामहुणाणं"
english: "In the mean time there are long nights, In the twilight there are days of peace, When lotuses bloom, And when there are no more they break up."

prakrit: "जाए पओससमए,पजलिए रयणदीवियानिवहे,लकापुरी विभायइ,मेरुस्स व चूलिया चेव"
english: "When it's time to play, Puzzles line the diyas, Lakapuri divides, Merus and chuliya play." ""

prakrit: "पेसिजइ जुवइजणो,विरइजइ मण्डणं पिययमाणं,मोहणमुहं महिज्जइ,मइर चिय पिज्जइ पसन्ना"
english: "Love is a young man's passion, Friendship is a drink offered at the altar, Love's face is smeared with red ghee, And affection prevails over dead people."

prakrit: "का वि पियं वरजुवई,अवग्र̥हेऊण भणइ चन्दमुहो,अपि एक पि य रति,माणेमु तुमे समं सामि!"
english: "Whom else can I love? The bridegroom is a virgin, The moon is red as a rainbow, And I take pride in saying that you are just like him!"

prakrit: "अन्ना पुग महुमत्ता,वरकुसुमसुयन्धगन्धरिद्धिल्ला,पडिया पियस्स अङ्क,नवकिसलयकोमलसरीरा"
english: "Anna pug mahumatta, Varkusuma suyandha gandhariddhilla, Padiya pious marks, Navakisalayakomlasareera"

prakrit: "का वि य अपोढबुद्धी,बाला दइएण पाइया सीधु,पोढत्तणं पवना,तक्वणमेत्तण चडुकम्मं"
english: "One can never be wise, Child, if one gives in to temptation, Be straightforward, Make love with kindness, And act with decency."

prakrit: "जह नह वलग्गइ मओ,जुवईणं मयणमूढहिययाणं,तह तद वढइ राओ,लज्जा दूरं समोसरइ"
english: "As the girl does not bend over, As the young man bends over, So does the boy. Shame fills the distance."

prakrit: "अणुदियहमणियमाणा,पभाइए जाणिऊण संगामं,धणविरहभीयहियया,अवगूहइ पिययमं धणियं"
english: "Aunt, If you want to know what's in store For you, Know what it's like To be without a lover."

prakrit: "विजाहरमिहुणाई,कीलन्ति घरे घरे जहिच्छाए,उत्तरकुरूमु नजइ,वड्डियनेहाणुरागाई"
english: "The rainy season is approaching, The bees are flocking from house to house, The scent of the kadamba fever has reached the housetops, And the houses of the elders are emptying out."

prakrit: "वीणाइ-वंस-तिसरिय-नाणाविहगीय-वाइयरवेणं,जंपइ व महानयरी,महानयरी,जणेण उलावमन्तेणं"
english: "The harp - the flute - the tisriya - the nāṇavīhāgi - the viol - the veil, the trumpet, and the māhanāyari, the great queen, a woman making waves."

prakrit: "तम्बोल-फुल्ल-गन्धाइपमु देहाणुलेवणसामु,एव विणिओयपरमो,लोगो मयणुस्सवे तइया"
english: "Tambol - phul - Gandhaipamu dehanullevanamu, E vinioiparamu, Logon mayaanuswaye taaya."

prakrit: "लङ्काहिवो वि एतो,निययं अन्तेउरं निरवसेसं,सम्माणेइ महप्पा,अहियं मन्दोयरी देवी"
english: "Even Lankahivo is here, Destiny awaits, And eternity awaits. I bow before the great god, For here is the goddess Mandoiri."

prakrit: "एवं मुद्देण रयणी,वोलीणा आगया'रुणच्छाया,संगोय-न्र̥रसदो,भवणे भवणे पवित्थरिओ"
english: "And the angry wife, Turning her back on the fire, Looked away indifferently, Filled with resentment, Stealthily went from building to building."

prakrit: "ताव य चक्कायारो,दिवसयरो उम्गओ कमलबन्धू,कह कह विपणइणिजणं,संथानिय दहमुहो भणइ"
english: "You fool, Every day you look like a lotus. How can a marketwoman say:" "Daughter - in - law, Santhanam is burning with fire?" ""

prakrit: "सन्नाहसमरभेरी,पहणह तूगई मेहघोसाई,रणपरिहल्थुच्छाहा,होह भडा! मा चिरावह"
english: "" "You brave warrior, Don't be so hasty! It's just the tip of the first feather on your head, Like a banner proclaiming victory over the enemy."

prakrit: "तस्स वयणेण सिम्बं,नरेहि पया तओ महाभेरी,सद्दण तेण सुहडा,सन्नद्धा सयलबलसहिया"
english: "To speak of her is like playing the flute, To be affectionate is like being very proud, To walk before the sun Is like bathing in the spring."

prakrit: "मारीजी विमलाभो,विमलघणो नन्दणी मुणन्दो य,मुहडो य विमलचन्दो,अन्ने वि य एबमाईया"
english: "Mariji vimalabho, vimalaghana nandani munando ya, muhado ya vimalchanda, anne vi ya ebemaya ya."

prakrit: "तुगामु रहवरेसु य,पवयसरिसेमु मत्तत्थीम,सरह-वर-कसरीसु य,वराह-महिसमु आमदा"
english: "Thou hast always been so, I will always be so," he said. "The rainy season has arrived, And the rainy season - the rainy one - Has arrived."

prakrit: "असि-कणय-चाव-खेडय-चमुनन्दय-चक-तोमरविहत्था,धय-छत्तबद्धचिन्धा,अमुरा इव दप्पियाडोवा"
english: "Asi-kanya-chava-khedaya-chak-tomarvihatha, dhae-chaatbandha chinda, amura, etc., are bold words." ""

prakrit: "निष्फिडिऊण पवत्ता,सुहडा लङ्कापुरोग रणसरा,ऊसिसियायवत्ता,संपेलोपेल कुणमाणा"
english: "Disgusting girl, Lovely lankan tiger, Strong breasts, Simple manners."

prakrit: "बहुत्र̥निणापणं,हयहसिय गजिगण हत्थीणं,फुट्टइ व अम्बरतलं,विमुकपाइकनापर्ण"
english: "Lots of nymphs, Loads of gooseflesh, Hanging from the elephant's trunk, Bloating like the bottom of a pyre, Like the nail marks of a beehive."

prakrit: "अह ते रक्खसमुहडा,सन्नद्धा ग्यणमउडकयसोहा,वचन्ता गयणयले,छज्जन्ति घणा इव सविन"
english: "Ah! the beauty of the sky, Like a bunch of peacock's tail feathers Waved by the conjuror to distract his audience, Seems to deceive many."

prakrit: "महाभडा कवइयदेहभ्र̥सणा,समन्तओ तुरय-गइन्दसंकुला,सज्जाउहा दिणयरतेयसन्निहा,विणिग्गया विमलनसाहिलासिणो"
english: "The body of a great poetess is full of illusions, The bow is like a turret - conch shell, The bower is made of twigs, The lid is of an emerald tree."

prakrit: "इय परमारण उज्जोयविहागग नाम मत्तरं पञ्वं समत्तं"
english: "May the name of this heavenly abode enlighten all who seek it."

prakrit: "अह सो रक्खसनाहो,कमेण आपुच्छिऊण घरिणीओ,कोहं समुबहन्तो,विणिग्गओ निययनयरीओ"
english: "Oh! what a cruel man he is, How miserly of you housewives, How heartless of you!"

prakrit: "इन्दं नाम रह सो,पेच्छइ बहुरूविणीऎ निम्मविय,विविहाउहाण पुण्णं,दन्तिसहस्सेण संजुरी"
english: "May the name of India abide in your heart; may you see women with large breasts, thin hair, and a goodly countenance."

prakrit: "अह ते मत्तगइन्दा,एरावणसन्निभा चउविसाणा,गेरुयकयङ्गराया,घण्टासु य कलयलारावा"
english: "Ah! the drunken songstress, Excited by the breeze, Wretched by the saffron yangaraya, Can conjure anything in hours."

prakrit: "अह सो महारहं तं,आरूढो केउमण्डणाडोवं,आहरणभूसियङ्गो,इन्दो इव रिद्धिसंपन्नो"
english: "Oh! that great man! Wait a moment, you shameless wretch, As if you had to bend your neck And bend your knees so that the whole body would bend."

prakrit: "तस्स विलग्गस्स रहे,समूसियं चन्दमण्डलं छत्तं,गोखीर-हारधवलं च उधुयं चामराजुयलं"
english: "May there be separation, may the whole moon be a canopy of clouds, May the sky be white with gooseflesh"

prakrit: "पडपडह-सङ्ख-काहल-मुइङ्ग-तिलमा-गहीरपणवाणं,पहर्य पहाणतूर,पलयमहामेहनिग्योसं"
english: "Fallen tree - Song - Cauldron - Mooing - Tilma - Powder - Strong wind, Guard - Strong arrow - Like the rain clouds in a field."

prakrit: "अप्पसरिसेहि समय,दसहि सहस्सेहि खेयरभडाणं,सुरसरिसविक्कमाणं,रणकण्डू उवहन्ताणं"
english: "At the same time as the midday sun, With ten thousand strokes of the kheer, The sound of the trumpet Succeeds, Like the sound of a trumpet"

prakrit: "एयन्तरम्मि पउमो,पुच्छइ मुहडा सुसेणमाईया,भो भो! कहेह एसो,दीसइ कवणो नगवरिन्दो?"
english: "Come on, girl, tell me," "Your face is smeared with red ghee!" "Tell me, Who is this?"

prakrit: "अलिउलतमालनीलो,जम्बूनयविविहसिहरसंघाओ,चञ्चलतडिच्छडालो,नजइ मेहाण संघाओ"
english: "Yellow is the nectar of immortality, blue is the color of jasmine, white is the shade of dazzling raindrops, yellow is the ornament of beauty."

prakrit: "तो भणइ जम्बुवन्तो,सामिय! बहुरूविणीऎ विज्जाए,सेलो कओ महन्तो,दीसइ लाहिवो एसो"
english: "He says," "Jambuvanto, Samiya! Knowledge prevails among many women." "Who is the greatest in the world? This is the way of good people."

prakrit: "जम्बूणयस्स वयणं,सोऊणं भणइ लक्खणो एत्तो,आणेह गरुडकेड,महारहं मा चिरावेह"
english: "Jambuna's speech, The sound of her voice Shows the signs of longing. Come on, you crook, Don't be so hasty." ""

prakrit: "अह तत्थ महाभेरो,समाहया'णेयतूरसमसहिया,सद्देण ती' सिग्धं,सन्नद्धा कइवरा सधे"
english: "Ah, that great pride! A long distance journey awaits you, But straightforward it is. Anyone can do it." ""

prakrit: "असि-कणय-चक्क तोमर-नाणविहपहरणा-''वरणहत्था,रुम्भन्ति पवयजोहा,रणपरिहत्था सकन्ताहिं"
english: "Assi-kanya-chakka tomar-nana-vihaparana-" "Varna hands, the couple who fall asleep, Can't make love on the battlefield" ""

prakrit: "सुमहुरवयणेहि तओ,संथाविय कइवरा पणइणीओ,सन्नद्धाउहपमुहा,पउमसयासं समल्लीणा"
english: "Be kind to one another, Be considerate of one's neighbor, Be courteous to another, Make love always with open eyes, Be attentive to ones feelings."

prakrit: "रामो रहं विलग्गो,केसरिजुतं निबद्धतोणीरं,लच्छोहरो वि एवं,आरूढो सन्दणं गरुडं"
english: "Ram, stay away, Your hair is tied in a bangle, Your eyes are red, And your face is smeared with red ghee."

prakrit: "भामण्डलमाईया,अन्ने वि महामडा कवइयगा,रह गय-तुरयारूढा,संगामसमुजया जाया"
english: "Mother - in - law, There must be something very special going on. The trumpet has been blown, The fair goes on." ""

prakrit: "एवं कइबलसहिया,सन्नद्धा पउमनाह-सोमित्ती,सेणिय! विणिग्गया ते,जुज्झत्थे वाहणारूढा"
english: "And the cowherd's wife, Daughter - in - law, The warrior! The weasel is like a chariot in battle." ""

prakrit: "जन्ताण ताण सउणा,महुरं चिय वाहरन्ति सुपसत्थं,साहन्ति निच्छएणं,पराजय चेव आणन्दं"
english: "Bees sting, bees sting, Bees purr, Sweat drips from their beaks. Defeat always brings bliss."

prakrit: "दहण सत्तुसेन,एजन्तं रावणो तओ रुहो,निययबलेण समग्गो,वाहेइ रहं सवडहुत"
english: "As long as Ravana is alive, so long shall I weep, O God of Destiny, As the arrow of the God of Love"

prakrit: "गन्धब-किन्नरगणा,अच्छरसाओ नहङ्गणत्याओ,मुञ्चन्ति कुमुमवास,दोसु वि सेन्नेसु सुहडाणं"
english: "Gandhab - eunuch song, Rakhsao - nahangnatyao, munchanti - kumumumavasa, dosu - vi senesu - the pleasures of love."

prakrit: "वियडफर-फलय-खेडय-वसु-नन्दयगोविएसु अङ्गेसु,पविसन्ति समरभूमि,चलदिट्ठी पढमपाइका"
english: "Viyadfar - fruit - field - wasu - nandayagoviyesu angesu, pious summer field, slippery paddy field."

prakrit: "आसेसु कुञ्जरेसु य,केइ भडा रहवरेसु आरूढा,नाणाउहगहियकरा,आभिट्टा सहरिसुच्छाहा"
english: "Come, you crook," said the farmer, "stay awhile, make hay, carry on with your business, get out of town, and take a bath."

prakrit: "सर-असर-सत्ति-सबल-फलिहसिला-सेल-मोग्गरसयाई,वरमुहडपत्तियाई,पडन्ति नोहे वहन्ताई"
english: "Sir - Asar - Satti - Sabal - Falihsila - Sel - Moggarsayai, Varmuhuddapathiyani, The stream of falling noses"

prakrit: "खग्गेहि केइ सुहडा,संगामे वावरन्ति चलहत्था,अन्ने य गयपहारं,देन्ति समत्थाण नोहाणं"
english: "They are pleasant to deal with, they keep company, they are approachable, they give pleasure, and they help one another."

prakrit: "सोसगहिएकमेका,अन्ने छुरियापहारजजरिया,दप्पेण समं जीयं,मुन्ति देहं च महिवढे"
english: "Be kind to one another, be sharp with your knife, live as long as you can, heal as well as heal."

prakrit: "खजन्ति धरणिपडिया,वायस-गोमाउ-गिद्धनिवहेणं,ओयड्डियन्तरुण्डा,महिर वसाकद्दमनिबुहा"
english: "The treasure is the earthworm, The wasp - the bumble bee, The vulture - the crickets, The woodpecker - the hornbill, The stag - the stickman's bud."

prakrit: "हत्थी हत्थीण समं,जुज्झइ रहिओ समं रहत्थेणं,तुरयबलग्गोसुहडो,तुरयारूदं विवाएइ"
english: "The elephant is equal to the elephant, The warrior remains the same, The trumpet is blown, The bull is smeared with red ghee."

prakrit: "असि-कणय-चक-तोमर-अन्नोन्नावडियसत्थघायम्गी,अह तक्खणम्मि जाओ,संगामो सुहडदुषिसहो"
english: "Assi, kanya, chak, tomar, Anonnavadya, saath sthayangi, Ah! go to that place. May the association be a happy one." ""

prakrit: "उम्मेण्ठा मत्तगया,भमन्ति तुरया''सवारपरिमुक्का,भजन्ति सन्दगवरा,छिन्जन्ति धया कणयदण्डा"
english: "Ummmanta matgaya, bhamanti turaya," "The rider is turned upside down, The fowler is struck by the sand, The hunter scratches the paddy with his bow." ""

prakrit: "खणखणखण ति सद्दो,कत्थइ खग्गाण आवडन्ताणं,विसिहाण तडतडरवो,निवडन्ताणं गयङ्गेसु"
english: "It hurts to look down the road, To sigh, To sulk, To groan, To flutter in ecstasy, To make a song of choice."

prakrit: "मणिकुण्डलुजलाइं,पडन्ति सीमाई मउडचिन्धाई,नचन्ति कबन्धाई,रुहिरवसालित्तगत्ताइं"
english: "The jingles of the crickets, The drops of mud on the boundary, The twanges of the peacock's tail, The claps of the doe, The rustle of the water lilies."

prakrit: "अन्नो अन्ने पहणइ,अन्नो अन्नं भुयाबलुम्मत्ती,आयड्डिऊण निहणइ,जोहा जोहं करो करिणो"
english: "One wears nothing, one smears everything on the surface, One is consumed by thoughts, One does whatever one likes."

prakrit: "उभयवलेसु भडेहि,उप्पयनिवयं रणे करेन्तेहिं,गयणगणं निरुद्धं,पाउसकाले व मेहेहिं"
english: "Both sexes run away, The nymphs make love in the forest, The cows are restrained in their singing, The rainy season and the rainy season."

prakrit: "एयारिसम्मि जुज्झे,मुय-सारणमाइएसु सुहडेसु,मारोजीण य भग्गं,सेन्नं चिय वाणरभडाणं"
english: "Aries struggle on, Mother - in - law rejoices, Those who have passed away Faintly rejoice, But the arrows of the God of Love fly high."

prakrit: "सिरिसेलेण बलेण य,भूर्यानणापण तह य नोलणं,कुमुयाइवाणरेहि,भग्गं चिय रक्खसाणीयं"
english: "Sirisela said," "The earth trembles, So do not move; It trembles like a potter's bow; The God of Love is my protector." ""

prakrit: "मुन्दो कुम्भ निमुम्भो,विक्कम कमणो य जम्बुमाली य,मयरद्धओ य मूरो,असणिनिघायाइणो सुहडा"
english: "Mundo kumbha nimumbho, vikkam kamana ya jambumali ya, mayardho ya muro, asaninigaya ya suhada."

prakrit: "एए. रक्स्वसवसभा,निययबलुच्छाहकारणुज्जुत्ता,वाणरभडेहि समय,जुझं काऊण आढत्ता"
english: "Ah. The solemn assembly of the Rakshasa, The vigor of valiant warriors, The time of the great storm, The patience of the warrior's wife." ""

prakrit: "भुयवरबलसम्मेया,वियडा कुडिलङ्गया सुसंणा य,चण्डुम्मियङ्गयाई,समुट्टिया कइवरा एए."
english: "Bhuyavarbalasammeeya, vyada kudilangaya is pleasant, chandummyangayai, samuttiya kaivara aye."

prakrit: "रक्खस-कइद्धयाणं,जुझं अइदारुणं समावडियं,अन्नोनकरग्गाहं,घणसत्थपडन्तसंघायं"
english: "The battle rages on, The arrows pierce through the thickets, The warriors fight fearfully."

prakrit: "एयन्तरम्मि हणुओ,गयवरजुतं रहं समाहिउँ,लोलेइ रक्खसबलं,पउमसरं चइव मत्तगओ"
english: "Here and there we make love, There and then there is jealousy, Love is a powerful protection, The husband loves his wife And drinks wine."

prakrit: "एकंण तेण संणिय!,सूरेण महाबलं निसियराणं,गम्यपहाराभिहयं,भयजरगहियं कयं सर्व"
english: "Foolish girl! One by one, The sun has unleashed a powerful wind, Destruction awaits, Fear grips us all." ""

prakrit: "तं पेच्छिऊण सेन्नं,भयविहलविसंटुलं मओ रुट्ठो,हणुयम्स समावडिओ,मुश्चन्तो आउहसयाई"
english: "I will never forget how, While looking at him, I will cry out with a trembling voice, And when I think of him I will surely laugh."

prakrit: "सिरिसेलेण वि सिग्घ,आयण्णाऊरिणसु बाणेसु,कञ्चणरहो विचित्तो,तुको मयसन्तिओ भम्गो"
english: "Sirisela is still angry, Come on, you silly girl, Don't be so hasty. Your heart is bursting with anger."

prakrit: "अन्नं रहे विलग्गो,मयराया जुज्झिउं समाढत्तो,सो वि य सिरिसेलेणं,भग्गो निसियद्धयन्देहिं"
english: "Far be it from food, Dear girl, The struggle is over, Yet you persist, Destroyed as well as destroyed as ever."

prakrit: "विरह दट्टण मर्य,दसाणणो'णेयरूवविजाए,सिग्धं विणिम्मिय रहं,समुरम्स तओ समप्पेइ"
english: "Through separation one dies, Through renunciation one renounces, Through straightforward separation one persists; Only then will true love be consummated."

prakrit: "सो तत्थ सन्दणवरे,आरुहिऊणं मओ सरसएहिं,विरहं करेइ हणुयं,तक्खणमेतेण आरुट्टो"
english: "There you are, Sandra, Touching me with your mustache, Cutting me to pieces, Scorched by the arrow of your arrow."

prakrit: "आलोइऊण हणुय,विरह अह धाइओ जणयपुत्तो,तस्स वि य सन्दणवरो,मरण भग्गो सरवरेहिं"
english: "The fire burns, The separation hurts, And the wife scorns. Even then, my dear, Death is a complete disaster."

prakrit: "सयमेव वाणरवई,समुडिओ तस्स रोसपज्जलिओ,सो वि मएण निरस्थो,कओ य धरणीयले पडिओ"
english: "The good shepherd, The sea burns with her rose, Yet I am undisturbed Because someone has fallen into the earth."

prakrit: "एत्तो मएण समय,बिहीसणो जुज्झिउं समाढत्तो,छिन्नकवया-''यवत्तो,कओ य बाणाहयसरीरो"
english: "It's my time, you silly girl, To break up the fight in such a way -" "Wait a minute, you nasty bastard." ""

prakrit: "पयलन्तरुहिरदेहं,बिहीसणं पेच्छिण पउमाभो,केसरिरहं विलम्गो,छाएइ मयं सरसपहिं"
english: "The body trembles with longing, The husband sighs, The wife looks on, The hair falls loose." ""

prakrit: "रामसरनियरघत्थं,भयविहलविसंडुलं मयं दह,सयमेव रक्स्वसवई,समुद्रिओ कोहपज्जलिओ"
english: "The wrath of the God of Love, Like the flame of a flame of fire, Destroys the mind; She is the protector of all beings; The seas are fuel for the flames of anger."

prakrit: "सो लक्खणेण दिट्टो,भणिओ रे दुट! मज्झ पुरहुत्तो,ठा-ठाहि पाव तक्कर!,जा ते जीयं पणासेमि"
english: "He looked at me with such longing That I said," "You fool!" "My poor boy, Wait till you reach your goal. I'll live up to that."

prakrit: "अह भणइ लक्खणं सो,किं ते हं रावणो अमुयपुबो,निस्सेसपुहइनाहो,उत्तमदिवारहो लोए?"
english: "Oh! what a traitor! Is it Ravana or Amuypubo? No, my dear, It's the best wall?"

prakrit: "अन्ज वि मुञ्चसु सीयं,अहवा चिन्तेहि निययहियएणं,किं रासहस्स सोहइ,देहे रइया विजयघण्टा?"
english: "Though I am angry, I cannot control my thoughts. How pleasant it is to laugh at someone else's faults: It is the hour of victory!"

prakrit: "देवा-'सुरलद्धजसो,अहयं तेलोक्पायडपयावो,सह भूमिगोयरेणं,अहिंयं लज्जामि जुझन्तो"
english: "Deva -" "I am completely awake, I have a soft palate, I sing with my mother - in - law, I do not want to be ashamed." ""

prakrit: "नइ वा करेहि जुझं,निविण्णो निययजीवियवणं,तो ठाहि सवडहुत्तो,विसहमु मह सन्तियं पहरं"
english: "No, I will not wage war; it is the law of the soul to give one's life to another."

prakrit: "तो भणइ लच्छिनिलओ,जाणामि पहुत्तणं तुम सबं,नासेमि अज सिग्धं,एयं ते गजियं गरुयं"
english: "So you look at me, Silly girl, I know you're all right. I can't take it anymore. Let's do something else." ""

prakrit: "एवं भणिउं सरोसो,चावं घेत्तण बाणनिवहेणं,छाएऊण पबत्तो,तुङ्ग पिव पाउसे मेहो"
english: "And say: Saros, When the rice is sown, The arrow is prattled, And when the water is boiled, It pours like rain." ""

prakrit: "जमदण्डसन्निहेहिं,सरेहि लच्छीहरो गयणमग्गे,वलपरिहत्थुच्छाहो,दहमुहबाणे निवारेइ"
english: "At the sight of the Jamadanda, Long - eyed women sing along, Eyes fixed on their necks, Destroyed by fierce anger."

prakrit: "दसरहपुत्तण कओ,रयणासवनन्दणो वियलियत्थो । ताहे मुयइ दणुबई,आरुट्ठो वारुणं अत्थं"
english: "Perform Dasarahputna, the winter solstice. Then bow before me, For behold, the new moon is here." ""

prakrit: "तं लक्खणो खणेणं,नासेइ समीरणत्थनोपणं,मुञ्चइ लक्काहिवई,अग्गेयं दारुणं अत्थं"
english: "To look at a person's face is to discover his character, to smile is to appreciate oneself, to sulk is to be captivated, to burn is to cherish oneself."

prakrit: "नालासहस्सपउरं,दहमाणं तं पि लच्छिनिलएणं,धारासरेहि सिग्घ,विज्झवियं वारुणत्थेणं"
english: "Like the water in a drain, Like smoke from a fire, Like the flame of a banner, Like wisdom bathed in thunder."

prakrit: "अह तस्स रक्खसत्थं,विसज्जिय रावणेण अइघोरं,धम्मत्येण पणासइ,तं दसरहनन्दणो सिग्धं"
english: "Ah, the heavenly abode of protection, darkened by the poisonous Ravana, polluted by dharma; it is the straight path to the bliss of Dasara."

prakrit: "लच्छीहरेण सेणिय!,विसजिय इन्धर्ण महासत्थं,पडिइन्धणेण नीय,दिसोदिसिं रक्खसिन्देणं"
english: "An army of lepers!, A vast mass of fuel, Needless to say, Protecting the decrepit"

prakrit: "अह रावणेण सिग्धं,तमनिवहत्थन्धयारियदिसोहं,विमलं करेइ तं पि य,दिवायरत्येण सोमित्ती"
english: "Ah, the rebirth of Ravana, A glimpse of the moonlit night beneath your eyes, A drink of water beneath your bosom, A dream fulfilled by daylight."

prakrit: "फणिमणिकिरणुजलियं,उरगत्थं रावणेण विक्खित्तं,तं लक्खणेण नीयं,दूरं गरुडत्थनोएणं"
english: "The water is crystal clear, Ravana's pyre hangs upside down, A needle is drawn to mark him, A distant thunderclap is heard."

prakrit: "मुञ्चइ विणायगत्थं,रक्खसणाहस्स लक्खणो समरे,तं वारइ महप्पा,तिकूडसामी महत्येणं"
english: "He knows how to weave, Likes the courage of a warrior, And is won over by greatness; He knows what it takes to master it."

prakrit: "भग्गे विणायगत्थे,सरेहि लच्छीहरो तिकूडवई,छाएइ सेन्नसहियं,सो वि य तं बाणवरिसेणं"
english: "Destroyed by weaves, Stretched by long hair, Reduced by hundreds of inches, He is still the arrow of the God of Love"

prakrit: "संगामसूरा जणियाहिमाणा,जुज्झन्ति अन्नोन्ननयत्थचित्ता,घोरा नरा नेव गणन्ति सत्थं,न मारुयरिंग विमलं पि भाणुं"
english: "Those who join hands are wise, Those who fight have a discerning mind, And those who roam do not count at all. Not even the warrior Vimal can utter a single word."

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए लक्खण-रावणजुज्मं नाम एगसत्तरं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "This is the characteristic of a virtuous person: Ravana's name means" "righteousness," "and egos mean" "power." ""

prakrit: "खिन्नाण दिज्जइ जलं,तिसाभिभूयाण सीयलं सुरहिं,भत्तं च बहुवियप्पं,असणकिलन्ताण मुहडाणं"
english: "For regret gives water, For resentment begets affection, For pride multiplies, For dishonesty begets disharmony."

prakrit: "सिञ्चन्ति चन्दणेणं,सुहडा वणवेयणापरिग्गहिया,आसासिज्जन्ति पुणो,देहुवगरणेसु बहुएसु"
english: "Water drips from the moon, Sweets drip from the treetops, Sweat trickles down from the rafters, And the rainy season returns." ""

prakrit: "लाहिवेण समय,सोमित्तिसुयस्स वट्टए जुझं,विविहाउहविच्छङ्क,विम्हयणिज्ज सुरवराणं"
english: "At the moment of taking rest, The battle is on in right earnest, The arrows of the God of Love hovering above the horizon, And the sails of the sky are blowing."

prakrit: "गन्धवकिन्नरगणा,अच्छरसहिया नहट्टिया ताणं,मुश्चन्ति कुसुमवासं,साहुक्कारेण वामीसं"
english: "The sulphurous girl's tongue, The delicate stretch of hair, The stubborn yolk of the hair, Are poisonous to the archer."

prakrit: "विजाहरस्स ताव य,दुहियाओ चन्दवद्धणस्स नहे,दिबविमाणत्थाओ,अट्ट अणोओ सुरुवाओ"
english: "The night is long, The day is short, The moon is not full, The sky is dark, And the night is passing."

prakrit: "मयहरयपरिमियाओ,कन्नाओ अच्छरेहि भणियाओ,साहेह कस्स तुम्हे,दुहियाओ इहं पवन्नाओ?"
english: "My dear friends, How are you doing, my dear? Who are you, my lord, This wretched man?"

prakrit: "साहन्ति ताण ताओ,अम्ह पिया चन्दबद्धणो नाम,वइदेहीसंवरणे,दुहियासहिओ गओ मिहिलं"
english: "Friend, tell me, My beloved, The name of the crescent moon, Ornament of the God of Love: With the help of these two words I will depart."

prakrit: "सो लक्खणस्स अम्हे,दाऊणं पत्थिओ निययगेहं,तत्तो पभूइ एसो,हियाम्म अवट्टिओ निययं"
english: "So take heed: I have decided on a wise path, But let me get to the bottom of it: Time is of the essence." ""

prakrit: "सो एस महाघोरे संगामे संसयं समावन्नो,न य नजइ कह वि इमं,होहइ दुहियाओ? तेण'म्हे"
english: "So do you see the world in this great congregation? No one can tell, Can't you see? It must be the poor?" ""

prakrit: "लच्छीहरस्स एत्थं,ना होही हिययवल्लहस्स गई,सा अम्हाण वि होही,नियमा अट्टण्ह वि जणीणं"
english: "Lucky are they here, No one has ever laughed at them, They're still here, The rules are pretty much the same."

prakrit: "सोऊण ताण सद,उडुमुहो लक्खणो पलोयन्तो,भणिओ य बालियाहिं,सिद्धत्यो होहि कजेसु"
english: "When he touches you, You turn your face away, When he tries to reason with you Saying:" "Daughter - in - law, let there be perfection." ""

prakrit: "सोऊण ताण सई,ताहे संभरइ दहमुहो अत्थं,सिद्धत्थनामधेयं,घत्तइ लच्छीहरस्मुरिं"
english: "When she is asleep, She remembers all the aches and pains Of being awake, When she observes the passage of time, She recollects the pleasures of love"

prakrit: "रामणि द्वेण तओ,तं विग्यविणायगन्थनोएणं,नीयं विहलपयावं,संगाममुहे अभीएणं"
english: "Be devoted to Rama, Consideration should be given to his subtlety, Be attentive to his feelings, Be conciliatory and forthright."

prakrit: "जं जं मुश्चइ अत्थं,तं तं छेत्त्र̥ण लक्षणो धोरो,छाएइ सरवरेहि,रवि व सयलं दिसायकं"
english: "Whatever there is to believe in, look for signs to dispel it. The horizon is endless, Like the sky in a straight line." ""

prakrit: "पत्थन्तरम्मि सेणिय!,बहुरूवा आगया महाविज्जा,लङ्काहिवस्स नाया,सन्निहिया तत्थ संगामे"
english: "Patthantarammy soldier!, The big fire is a great feast, Not the lankahivas, Dear friends, In that very confluence." ""

prakrit: "अह लकवणेण छिन्नं,सीसं लवाहिवस्स संभ्यं,छिन्नं पुणो पुणो चिय,उप्पज्जइ कुण्डलाभरणं"
english: "Oh! paralysis has torn me apart, The long - eyed girl has grown thin, The fire of love is burning, And I am thirsty again."

prakrit: "छिन्नम्मि उत्तिमङ्गे,एक्के दो होन्ति उत्तिमङ्गाई,उक्कत्तिएमु तेमु य,दुगुणा दुगुणा हवइ वुड्डी"
english: "Two hips are enough for one husband, One can hold two wives, The wood is twice as thick As that of the wife."

prakrit: "छिन्नं च भुयाजुयलं,दोण्णि वि जुयलाई होन्ति बाहाणं,छिन्नमु तमु वि पुणो,जायइ दुगुणा भुयात्रुड्डी"
english: "Both are torn to shreds, Both are gambles made on false pretenses, But when they are torn apart They are renewed, Which makes the journey twice as long."

prakrit: "वरमउडमण्डिपहि,सिरेहि छिन्नेहि नहयलं छन्नं,केऊरभूसियासु य,भुयायु एवं च सविससं"
english: "The lotus is white, The branches are shrivelled, The beds are bare, The floor is bare, And the kitchen is empty."

prakrit: "असि-कणय-चक तोमर-कुन्ताइअणेयसत्थसंघाए,मुञ्चइ रक्खसणाहो,बहुविवाहासहस्सेहिं"
english: "Assi-kanya-chak Tomar-kuntaiseya saath sanghaye, munchai rakshasneho, polygamy with love."

prakrit: "तं लक्खणो वि एन्तं,आउहनिवहं सरेहि छेत्तर्ण,छाएऊण पवत्तो,पडिसत्तुं बाणनिवहेणं"
english: "That's just the way it is: Here and there I see a whole lot of shavings, Like a banner proclaiming victory." ""

prakrit: "एकं च दोणि तिण्णि य,चत्तारि य पञ्च दस सहस्साई,लक्खं सिराण छिन्दइ,अरिस्स नारायणो सिग्धं"
english: "One is two and three are one, five is ten and a half, One million is one hundred thousand, The straightforward one is Arisa Narayan."

prakrit: "निवडन्तएमु सहसा,बाहासहिएसु उत्तिमङ्गेसु,छन्नं चिय गयणयलं,रणभूमी चेव सविसेसं"
english: "I have chosen suddenly, Hands on my thighs, Chanting my song for the first time, The battlefield is my savior."

prakrit: "नं न सिरं सबाई,उप्पज्जइ रावणस्स देहम्मि,तं तं सरेहि सबं,छिन्दइ लच्छीहरो सिग्धं"
english: "She does not shake her head, does not lift Ravana's body, has good relations with him, and touches him with her long hair."

prakrit: "रावणदेहुक्कत्तिय-पयलन्तुद्दामरुहिरविच्छदु,जायं चिय गयणयलं,सहसा संझारुणच्छायं"
english: "Ravana's Deokkatte - The peacock peeps through the rafters As he sings the song of victory, Suddenly a shadow of dawn"

prakrit: "पयलन्तसेयनिवहो,बणियमहायासदीहनीसासो,चिन्तेइ सेणिय! तओ,चकं लकाहिवो रुटो"
english: "" "Foolish girl, Don't think too much about it: The roads are slippery," "Thinks the army."

prakrit: "वेरुलियसहस्सारं,मोत्तियमालाउलं रयणचित्तं,चन्दणकयचचिर्क,समच्चियं सुरभिकुसुमेहिं"
english: "The fragrance of pearls, The passion of the sky, The twang of the moonlight, All through the fragrant summer sky."

prakrit: "सरयरविसरिसतेयं,पलयमहामेहसरिसनिग्योसं,चिन्तियमेत्तं चर्क,सन्निहियं रावणस्स करे"
english: "May the cycle of rebirth, May the plowman's journey, Be fruitful in thought; May the wretched soul of Ravana do the same."

prakrit: "किन्नर-किंपुरिसगणा,विस्सावसु-नारया सह'च्छरसा,मोत्तण समरपेक्वं,भएण दूरं समोसरिया"
english: "Eunuchs - Kingpurisagana, Vissavasu - Narya sahatcharasa, The pearl is worth the effort, For with it the distance Is like a samosara."

prakrit: "तं चक्करयणहत्थं,दसाणणं भणइ लक्खणो धीरो,जइ काइ अस्थि सत्ती,पहरसु मा णे चिरावेसु"
english: "That dizzy hand, That shows no signs of wear and tear, Is just a bone bruise. Please, don't make it last long."

prakrit: "सो एव भणियमेत्तो,रुट्टो त भामिऊण मणवेगं,मुञ्चइ पलयकणिहं जयसंसयकारणं चकं"
english: "That's what I meant when I said:" "The buffalo has run out of fuel." "I took it in my stride And amused myself at the sight of the elephant."

prakrit: "दट्टण य एजन्तं,चक्कं सवडम्मुहं घणनिणायं,आढत्तो सोमित्ती,वारेउं तं सरोहेणं"
english: "The thicket is long, The thickets are wide, The roads are narrow, The streets are quiet, Everyone should listen to him."

prakrit: "वज्जावत्तेण य नंगलेण पउमो निवारणुज्जत्तो,सुग्गीवो वि गयाए,पहणइ भामण्डलो असिणा"
english: "The wretched woman has grown thin, The poor woman has become thin, And the well - to - doers have become thin. The landowner's name is Asina."

prakrit: "वारेऊण पवत्तो,सूलेण विहीसणो महन्तेणं,हणुओ वि मोग्गरेणं,सुग्गीवसुओ कुठारेणं"
english: "The wind blows the crows, The swine thrash the buffalo, The goats moan, The hussies swoon." ""

prakrit: "सेसा वि सेसपहरण-सएमु समजोहिउं समाढत्ता,तह वि य निवारिउं ते,असमत्था वाणरा सर्वे"
english: "There must be something wrong with that man - He cannot understand anything, cannot speak anything, He is always at peace."

prakrit: "तं आउहाण निवहं,भन्तूण समागयं महाचकं,सणियं पयाहिणेउं,अहिट्ठियं लक्खणस्स करे"
english: "I will never forget how he said:" "Tomorrow is a big day, Tomorrow a big one." "Now think again what he meant by non - violence."

prakrit: "परे भवे सुकयफलेण माणवा,महिड्डिया इह बहुसोक्खभायणा,महारणे जयसिरिलद्धसंपया,ससी जहा विमलपयावपायडा"
english: "Far be it from me To pluck a dried fruit, Dear lady, This is the highest pleasure. Please, my lord, Don't overdo it: It's the mother - in - law Whom all the bees worship."

prakrit: "इइ पउमचरिए पकरवणुप्पत्ती नाम बावत्तरं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "Praise be to the pious woman, For her name is synonymous with purity."

prakrit: "उप्पन्नचक्करयणं,दट्टणं लक्षणं पवयजोहा,अहिणन्दिया समत्था,भणन्ति एक्कमेकेणं"
english: "Stupid couple, Non - Indians get along well, Speak for each other."

prakrit: "एयं तं फुडवियडं,अणन्तविरिएण जं पुरा भणियं,जायं संपइ सबं,कजं बल केसवाणं तु"
english: "Here's the riddle: Everything you say ends badly, Everything you do, Because you're the only one who can." ""

prakrit: "नो एस चक्कपाणी,सो वि य नारायणो समुप्पन्नो,सीहरहम्मि विलम्गो एसो पुण होइ बलदेवो"
english: "No, this is not a trick; it's all Narayani Samuppanno. Please, my dear, delay it a moment; this is the way of good fortune."

prakrit: "एए महाणुभावा,भारहवासम्मि राम-सोमित्ती,बलदेव-वासुदेवा,उप्पन्ना अट्टमा नियमा"
english: "O great-natured woman, Rama is the lord of burden and wealth, Vasudeva is the god of wisdom, and law is the supreme rule."

prakrit: "दद्रूण चक्कपाणि,सोमित्ती रामणो विचिन्तेइ,तं संपइ संपन्नं,अगन्तविरिएण जं भणियं"
english: "The blind man is astute; The peaceful Rama is discerning; He knows what is to be done; I speak out of bounds."

prakrit: "ट्ठण आयवत्तं,जस्स रणे सयलगयघडाडोबा,भजन्ति ग्वेयरभडा,भयविहलविसंठुला सत"
english: "There goes the farmer's son, As the forest fire consumes the whole forest, Like a column of smoke rising from the God of Love." ""

prakrit: "सायरसलिलसमत्था,हिमगिरिविजत्थली पुहइनारी,आणापणामकारी,दासि व महं वसे आसि"
english: "Friend, let me settle on a frosty winter's day, A woman full of fresh flowers, A wife full of affection, And a maid servant."

prakrit: "सो हं मणुएण कह,जिणिऊणा''लोइओ दसग्गीवो?,वट्टइ इमा अवस्था,कि न हु अच्छेरयं एयं?"
english: "So tell me, human being," "Are you sure you want to die?" "But isn't this just the way things happen?"

prakrit: "घिद्धि! ति रायलच्छी,अदीहपही मुहुत्तरमणिज्जा,परिचइऊणा''ढत्ता,एकपण दुजणसहावा"
english: "Disgusted! She is a royal girl. Aunt, Your face is smeared with red ghee." "Daughter - in - law, one poor man's help" ""

prakrit: "किंपागफलसरिच्छा,भोगा पच्छा हवन्ति विसकडया,बहुदुक्खदोग्गइकरा,साहूणं गरहिया निश्चं"
english: "A worm likes a fruit, A hungry man likes to be thirsty, A thirsty cow gives milk, And a poor farmer's wife is indecisive."

prakrit: "भरहाइमहापुरिसा,धन्ना जे उज्झिऊण रायसिरिं,निक्खन्ता चरिय तवं,सिवमयलमणुत्तरं पत्ता"
english: "Blessed are the poor in abundance, Happy are the sighs of the rising sun, For the south wind does not blow, A leaf dropped by the moonlit night."

prakrit: "सो कह मोहेण जिओ,अहयं संसारदीहजणएणं?,किं वा मरेमि इण्हि,उवट्टिए पडिभए घोरे?"
english: "So how can I live, my dear, If I give in to the temptations of the world?" ""

prakrit: "दठूण चक्कहत्थं,सोमित्तिं रावणो सवडहुत्त,महुरवयणेहि एचो,बिहोसणो भणइ दहवयणं"
english: "To see is to shake hands; To think is to hear Ravana's supplication; To taste is to speak greatness; To make speech is to burn."

prakrit: "अज वि य मज्झ वयणं,कुणसु पह! जाणिऊण उ.पहियं,तुहु पउमपसाएणं,जीवसु सीयं समप्पेन्तो"
english: "It's still my fault, my dear! If you knew उ.पहियं, You'd better stop being angry. Life goes on as usual." ""

prakrit: "सा चेव तुज्झ लच्छो,एव कुणन्तस्स आउयं दीहं,हवइ नियमेण रावण!,नरस्स इह माणभङ्गेणं"
english: "That is your characteristic trait, Such virtuous conduct, Such is the nature of Ravana!, Nor is it to be treated with disrespect." ""

prakrit: "एक्कोयरस्स वयणं,अवगणेऊण रावणो भणइ,रे तुज्झ भूमिगोयर!,गवं चिय दारुणं जायं"
english: "Speak one line at a time, For Ravana will listen, O cowherd of your land! But let the tongue be cruel to me." ""

prakrit: "ताव य गजन्ति गया,जाव न पेच्छन्ति अहिमुहावडियं,दाढाविडम्बियमुह,वियडनडाभासुरं सीह"
english: "You'd better stop, you fool, For you can't see him without blinking." "Your face looks like a doe's tail."

prakrit: "रयणासवस्स पुत्तो,अयं सो रावणो विनियसत,दावेमि तुह अवत्थं,जीयन्तयरी निरुत्तेणं"
english: "My son, Ravana, this is the way of life; I will defend your right to life."

prakrit: "भणिओ य लक्खणेणं,किं वा बहुएहि भासियहिं,उप्पन्नो तुज्य अरिवू,हन्ता नारायणो अहयं"
english: "Tell me, What characterization do you have of me, That I speak in tongues, That you are immortal. I am hunted by the Naryanas."

prakrit: "निवासियस तइया,पियरेणं वणफलासिणस्स मया,नारायणत्तणं ते,विनायं दोहकालेणं"
english: "Dweller, I am addicted to wild fruits, Friend, They are poisonous, For they cause grief."

prakrit: "नारायणो निरुत्तं,होहि तुम अहवं को वि अन्नो वा,इह तुज्झ माणभङ्ग,करेमि निस्संसयं अजं"
english: "Narayan, you're not stupid. Either you are or you aren't. This is your fault. I will deal with it as usual." ""

prakrit: "अइगन्विओ सि लक्खण,हत्थविलग्गेणिमेण चक्केणं,अहवा होइ खलेण वि,महूसवो पाययजणस्स"
english: "It's the mark of incompetence, The nail mark of hand and foot, Or else it might be the nail in the wound, Like the pearl in a pyre."

prakrit: "चक्कण खयरेहि य,समय सतुरङ्गमं सह रहेणं,पेसेमिह पायाले,किं च बहुत्तेण भणिएणं?"
english: "Well said, Time will bear down on me, my dear. But what more can I say?"

prakrit: "सो एवमणियमेतो,चकं नारायणो भमाडेउं,पेसेइ पडिवहेणं,लङ्काहिवइस्स आरुट्टो"
english: "So what's this nonsense, you stupid buffalo? It's just the way you dress, You stupid elephant." ""

prakrit: "आलोइसण एन्तं,चकं घणघोसभीसणं दित्तं,सर-झसर-मोग्गरेहि,उज्जुत्तो तं निवारेउं"
english: "The plowman has done so much, He has given the horse many hips, His head is bowed low And he is exhausted." ""

prakrit: "रुब्भन्तं पि अहिमुह,तह वि समलियइ चक्करयणं तं,पुष्णावसाणसमए,सेणिय! मरणे उवगयम्मि"
english: "Non - violence even in the face of adversity, That at the same time makes one dizzy, At the moment of consummation, O warrior! Death is imminent." ""

prakrit: "अइमाणिणस्स एत्तो,लाहिवइस्स अहिमुहस्स रणे,चक्केण तेण सिग्घ,छिन्नं वच्छत्थलं विउल"
english: "Such is the mind, Such are the ways of the God of Love, Non - existent, Like a sigh between wheels, Like the plucked girdle of a bull."

prakrit: "चण्डाणिलेण भग्गो,तमालघणकसिणअलिउलावयवो,अञ्जणगिरि पडिओ,दहवयणो रणमहोवढे"
english: "The moon is broken by the moonlight, The lotus is peeping through the thicket of tomatoes, The anjanagiri has fallen, The forest fires have broken out."

prakrit: "सुत्तोब कुसुमकेऊ,नजइ देवो व महियले पडिओ,रेहइ लकाहिबई,अत्थगिरित्थो व दिवसयरो"
english: "Give birth to new shoots, do not scorch the sky, Fallen like a bee, Remains like a medicine, Gives birth to fresh shoots, And disappears in broad daylight."

prakrit: "एत्तो निसायरवलं,निहयं दट्ठूण सामियं भग्गं,विवरम्मुहं पयर्ट,संपेल्लोप्पेल्ल कुणमाण"
english: "Such a silly word, When I see it, I break out in anger, And when I speak it makes me angry."

prakrit: "जोहो तुरङ्गमेणं,पेल्लिज्जइ रहवरो गेयवरेणं,अइकायरो पुण भडो,विवडइ तत्थेव भयविहलो"
english: "Whoever throws a trumpet, Who is startled by a thunderclap, Or sings a dirge, Who in turn gets angry again, Is terrified of that man."

prakrit: "एवं पलायमाणं,निस्सरणं तं निसायराणीनं,आसासिउं पयत्ता,सुग्गीव-बिहीसणा दो वि"
english: "And flight, And sleeplessness, And the absence of hope, Are two causes of happiness."

prakrit: "मा भाह मा पलायह,सरणं नारायणो इमो तुम्हें,वयणेण तेण संणिय!,सर्व आसासिय सेनं"
english: "No, no, don't run away. It's Narayan Sarna who has made you what you are: A man so wise as to understand speech! It is the army of the Assassins." ""

prakrit: "जेट्टस्स बहुलपरखे,दिवसस्स चउत्थभागसेसम्मि,एगारसीऎ दिक्से रावणमरणं वियाणाहि"
english: "The jets are multiplied, The days are divided into four quarters, And from one to the other Ravana's name is chosen."

prakrit: "एवं पुण्णावसाणे तुरय-गयघडाडोबमज्झे वि सूरा,संपत्त मच्चुकाले असि-कणयकरा जन्ति नासं मणुस्सा,उज्जोएउंसतेओ सयलनयमिणं सो वि अस्थाइ भाणु,जाए सोक्खप्पओसे स विमलकिरणो किन चन्दो उवेइ?"
english: "And when the moon is full the trumpet sounds of thunder, When wealth is spattered all over the place, Like a man's nose, Like the flame of a lamp burning bright, Remain motionless. But when it is dry Why does the moon rise because of the rays of the Vimala?"

prakrit: "इइ पउमचरिए दवयरणवह विहाणं नाम तिहत्तरं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "Praise be to the pious woman, Whose name is seventy-three and whose power is supreme."

prakrit: "दछ्र̥ण धरणिपडियं,सहोयरं सोयसल्लियसरीरो,छुरियाऎ देइ हत्थं,विहीसणो निययवहकजे"
