english: "The hunter has covered the ground with mud, The cowherd is so touchy, His arms twine around his wife's breasts, And his bow hangs over his head."

prakrit: "रामेण तओ रुदो,मुच्छं गन्तुं पुणो वि आसत्यो,एकोयरस्स पासे,ठिओ य तो विलविउ पयत्तो"
english: "Rama, you cry, I must go away and come again. One step at a time. If you stay, you will wail." ""

prakrit: "हा भाय रावण! तुमं,इन्दो इव संपयाऎ होऊणं,कह पत्तो सि महाजस!,एयावत्थं महापावं!"
english: "O brother Ravana! How is it that you, O Indu, wish to attain this supreme state! This is the greatness of the world!"

prakrit: "न य मज्झ तुमे वयणं,पडिच्छियं हिययरं भणन्तस्स,दढचकताडिओ वि हु,पडिओ धरणीयले फरसे"
english: "You are not mine to speak of, You speak only from ear to ear, I hear you whisper loudly, You lie flat on the floor."

prakrit: "उद्देहि देहि वयणं,सुन्दर! मह एवविलवमाणस्स,उत्तारेहि महाजस!,सोगमहासागरे पडियं"
english: "" "That body with eyes wide open, That is beautiful! I am a violent man, That with ears wide open Is a great man! I have fallen into the ocean of grief."

prakrit: "सोऊण विगयनीय,दहवयणन्तेउरं सपरिवार,सोगाउरं रुयन्तं,रणभूमि आगयं दीणं"
english: "The sun is brilliant, The fire is burning, The mourning is with the whole family, The mourners are weeping, The battlefield is burning."

prakrit: "ठूण सुन्दरीओ,भत्तारं रुहिरकद्दमालित्तं,धरणियले पल्हत्थं,सहसा पडियाउ महिवढे"
english: "Thin beauties, But my dear, The weight of your breasts Is overwhelming, Like a beehive stuck in the soil."

prakrit: "रम्भा य चन्दवयणा,तहेव मन्दोयरी महादेवी,पवरुबसी य नीला य रुप्पिणी रयणमाला य"
english: "Rambha is the moon, Mahadevi is the festival mandoire, Pravarubasi is blue, and Rupini is the night sky."

prakrit: "ससिमण्डला य कमला य सुन्दरी तह य चेव कमलसिरी,सिरिदत्ता य सिरिमई,भद्दा य तहेव कणयपभा"
english: "Aunt, A lotus is beautiful only when it is wet, And a lotus grows thin when it isn't wet; It's a bad thing when it has to be wet."

prakrit: "सिरिकन्ता य मिगावइ,लच्छी य अणङ्गसुन्दरी नन्दा,पउमा वसुंधरा वि य,तडिमाला चेव भाणुमई"
english: "Sirikanta is Migawai, Lacchi is Anang Sundari, Nanda is Puma Vasundhara, Tadimala is Chew Bhanumai."

prakrit: "पउमावती य कित्ती,पीई संझावली सुभा कन्ता,मणवेया रइवेया,पभावई चेव माणवई"
english: "Proud lady, how are you? It's sunny outside, The roads are smooth, The streets are deserted, And the streets are empty."

prakrit: "जुवईण एवमाई,अट्ठारस साहसीउ अइकलुणं,रोवन्ति दुक्खियाओ,आभरणविमुक्ककेसीओ"
english: "A young man is only as good as a woman, Eighteen are as brave as eunuchs, The wretched are as weepy as cowards, And jewellers are as miserly as cowboys."

prakrit: "काइत्थ मोहवडिया,चन्दणबहलोदएण सित्तङ्गी,उल्लसियरोमकूवा,पडिबुद्धा पउमिणी चेव"
english: "Kaithe mohavadiya, chintangi with loads of sandalwood, flirtatious girl, Proud wife, Chew the paddy."

prakrit: "अवगूहिऊण दइय,अन्ना मुच्छं गया कणयगोरी,अञ्जणगिरिस्स लग्गा छज्जइ सोयामणी चेव"
english: "Ungrateful girl, Anna has gone berserk. Anjanagiri seems to be hiding behind the soya bean." ""

prakrit: "काइत्थ समासत्था,उरतालणचञ्चलायतणुयङ्गी,केसे विलुम्पमाणी,रुयइ चिय महुरसद्देणं"
english: "Kaithe samastha, urtalana, chanchalayata, yangi, kese vilumpamani, kei chiye, chiye mahurasadena." ""

prakrit: "अङ्के ठविऊण सिर,अन्ना परिमुसइ विउलवच्छयलं,काइ चलणारविन्दे,चुम्बई करपल्लवे अवरा"
english: "Hold on to that cool head, Anna, You fool, How can you walk on? Kiss me, you fool, While I kiss you."

prakrit: "नंपइ काइ सुमहुरं,रोवन्ती असुपुण्णनयणजुया,हा नाह! किं न पेच्छसि,सोगसमुद्दम्मि पडियाओ?"
english: "What a lovely woman, Crying inconsolably, Young man! Do you not see? Fall into a pit of grief?" ""

prakrit: "विजाहराण सामी,होऊणं सत्ति-कन्ति-बलजुत्तो,रामस्स विमाहे किं,सुवसि पहू धरणिपल्लो"
english: "Vijaharana Sāmi, may be satti-kanti-balajutta, what is the use of worshiping Rama? Your husband is the lord of the earth." ""

prakrit: "उद्धेहि सयणवच्छल!,एक पि य देहि अम्ह उल्लावं,अवराहविरहियाणं,कि कोवपरायणो जाओ?"
english: "Foolish girl! One day I'll make a laughingstock of myself, Without leaving her bedside for a while, Or go to the cowshed?"

prakrit: "परिहासकहासत,विसुद्धदसणावलीपरमसोमं,वयणिन्दुमिमं सामिय!,कि धारसि अम्ह परिकुविओ?"
english: "Jokes apart, I'm the only one who has ever had a bad day, Daughter - in - law! How dare you turn your back on me?"

prakrit: "अइसुन्दरे मणोहरवित्यिण्णे जुवइकीलणहाणे,कह ते चक्केण पर्य,दिनं वच्छत्थलाभोए"
english: "Lovely young girl, How can you go on like this? The days are fleeting."

prakrit: "वइरीहि नियलबद्धे,इन्दइ-घणवाहणे परायत्ते,मोएहि राहवेणं,गुणनिहि! पोई करेऊणं"
english: "Venerable ones are bound by rules, generous ones go abroad, wise ones follow the path of death, virtuous ones! All this must be done." ""

prakrit: "उठेहि सयणवच्छल!,अत्याणिसमागयाण सुह्डाणं,बहुयाणे असरणाण,देहि पहू! दाण-सम्माण"
english: "Get up, you silly girl! No need to hurry! The pleasures of love, Like too much travel, Are for sale! Charity - Respect." ""

prakrit: "विरहग्गिंदीवियाई,विज्झवसु इमाइं नाह! अङ्गाई,अवग्र̥हणोदएणं,चन्दणसरिसाणुलेवेणं"
english: "Disjointed woman, Don't be so naïve! Your limbs are swollen, Your eyes are red from lack of sleep, And your face is smeared with the rays of the moon."

prakrit: "हसियाणि विलसियाणि य,अणेगचडुकम्मकारणाणि पहू!,सुमरिजन्ताणि इहं,दहन्ति हिययं निरवसेसं"
english: "Laughing girl, Don't make me cry! It's the reason why you smile so much. It makes your heart burn." ""

prakrit: "एवं रोवन्तीणं,रावणविलयाण दीणवयणाणं,हिययं कस्स न कलुणं,नायं चिय गग्गरं कण्ठं"
english: "And the cries of weeping, The wailings of Ravana's bow, And his bowing down to no one. Or the growl of anger." ""

prakrit: "एयन्तरम्मि रामो,लक्खणसहिओ विभीसणं भणइ,मा झयसु भद्द! दीणं,नाणन्तो लोगवित्तन्तं"
english: "Here is Rama, Friend of nature, Speaking in confusion, Don't be alarmed! Deer, Those who follow do not live among people." ""

prakrit: "जाणसि य निच्छएणं,कम्माणं विचिट्ठियं तु संसारे,पुषोवत्तं पावइ,जीवो किं एत्थ सोएणं?"
english: "You know how to weep, How much trouble you cause in this world, Living on empty stomachs, Why sleep here?"

prakrit: "बहुसत्थपण्डिओ वि हु,दसाणणो सयलवमुमईनाहो,मोहेण इममवत्थं,नीओ अइदारुणयलेणं"
english: "I have many friends, But my mother - in - law is always with me, She loves me no longer, And takes me only for granted."

prakrit: "रामवयणावसाणे,विभीसणं भणइ तत्थ जणयसुओ,समरे अदिन्नपट्टी,किं सोयसि रावणं धीरं!"
english: "At the sound of the lute Rama says:" "Tell me, my poor boy, How can you sleep when you think differently?" ""

prakrit: "मोत्तण इमं सोय,निपुण अखाणयं कहिजन्तं,लच्छीहरद्धयसुओ,अक्वपुरे नरवई वसई"
english: "One sleeps in it with great difficulty, One speaks with mastery, One sweats with longing, One is completely immortal."

prakrit: "अरिदमणो ति पयासो,परविसए भञ्जिमण रिउसेन्नं,कन्तादरिसणहियओ,निययपुर आगओ सिग्धं"
english: "The arid people are thirsty, The rainy season is in full swing, The thorny trees are wilting, The fires are burning steadily."

prakrit: "तं पविसिऊण नयरं,तोरण-धयमण्डियं मणभिरामं,पच्छइ य निययमहिलं,आहरणविभूसियं सगिहे"
english: "It is the fire of purification, The fan of torans, The fire of ecstasy, The woman who rules fate, With the arrow that vanishes."

prakrit: "तं पुच्छह नरवसभो,सिट्ठो हं तुज्झ केण सयराहं!,सा भणइ मुणि वरेणं,कित्तिधरेणं च मे कहिओ"
english: "You silly girl, why are you sitting here?" she whispered. "Tell me, sage, where did I meet you?"

prakrit: "ईसा-रोसवसगओ,भणइ मुणी नइ तुम मुणसि चित्तं,तो मे कहेहि सर्व,किं मज्झ अवट्टियं हियए?"
english: "Jesus, tell me," "You're not a sage, you're a thinker." "Tell me, then, Have you heard me out?"

prakrit: "तं भणइ ओहिनाणी,तुज्झ इमं भद्द : वट्टए हियए,नह किल कह मरणं मे,होहिइ? कइया व? कत्तो वा"
english: "She says," "You fool, you fool!" "Instead, he replies," How can I help her if I die? "" Where is she? "

prakrit: "भणिओ य सत्तमदिणे,असणिहओ तत्थ चेव मरिऊणं,उप्पज्जिहिसि महन्तो,कीडो विट्ठाहरे नियए"
english: "Say :'It's the seventh day, for if you don't come, you will surely die.'Your heart is overflowing With ecstasy. The worm has made its way through the cracks." ""

prakrit: "सो आगन्तूण सुर्य,भणइ य पीयंकरं तुमे अहयं,अवसेण घाइयबो,कीडो विट्ठाहरे थूलो"
english: "So the visitor is the sun, Saying:" "Here you are, Drinker." "Under the scorching sun I will spit on the wormhole."

prakrit: "अह सो मरिऊण तहिं उप्पन्नो पेच्छिऊण तं पुत्तं,मरणमहाभयभीओ,पविसइ विट्ठाहरे दूर"
english: "Oh! he is dying, But seeing him up there, my son, Afraid of death, You fool, You wretch, Far from home."

prakrit: "‘पीयंकरो मुणिन्द,पुच्छइ सो तत्थ कीडओ दूर,मारिज्जन्तो नासइ,भयवं! केणेव कज्जेणं?"
english: "" "Who is afraid of being stung?" "She asks," "The worm is away." "He refuses to be killed."

prakrit: "अह भणइ साहवो तं,मुञ्च विसायं इहेव संसारे,जो नत्थ समुप्पजई,सो तस्थ रई कुणइ जीवो"
english: "Oh! what a gentleman he is, Such is my business in this world, And such is the state of all beings."

prakrit: "पीयंकरस्स चरियं सुणिऊण एयं,तोसं परं उवगया वि हु खेयरिन्दा,लाहिवस्स अणुओ पडिबोहिओ सो,जाओ पुराणविमलामलसुद्धबुद्धी"
english: "Listen to my peacock's croak, I can hear you quivering But don't be alarmed: There must be something wrong With him." ""

prakrit: "इइ पउमचरिए पीयंकरउवक्खाणयं नाम चउहत्तरं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "This is the name of the seventy-fourth power." ""

prakrit: "अह भणइ पउमनाहो,मरणन्ताई हवन्ति वेराणि,लवाहिवस्स एत्तो,कुणह लहुं पेयकरणिजं"
english: "Ah! what a wretched woman! When she is dying She is a barber. When lovers live together It is the doing of many a drunkard."

prakrit: "भणिऊण एवमेयं,संबं वि विहीसणाइया सुहडा,पउमेण सह पयट्टा,गया य मन्दोयरी नत्थ"
english: "Tell me, Is this the way to end the affair? It's all right, my dear, To part with my husband. It can't be Mandoyari." ""

prakrit: "जुवइसहस्सेहि समं,रोवन्ती राहवो मइपगम्भो,वारेइ महुरभासी,उवणय-हेऊ-सहस्सेहिं"
english: "The young men are like lovers in love, The weeping wretches are like fairies, The wise are like bees in speech, They make love and make love."

prakrit: "गोसीसचन्दणा-'गुरु-कप्पूराईसु सुरहिदवेसु,लाहिवं नरिन्दा,सकारेउं गया वप्पं"
english: "Gosisandana -" "Guru - Kapuraisu Surahidavesu, Lahivaam Narinda, Sakaareyoon gaya vappam" ""

prakrit: "पउमसरस्स तडत्थो,पउमाभो भणई अत्तणो मुहडे,मुञ्चह रक्खसवसभा,जे बद्धा कुम्भकण्णाई"
english: "The wind blows the lotus flower, The woman speaks through her mouth, And the God of Love protects her, Who is bound only by the bow of love."

prakrit: "रामवयणेण एत्तो,नरेहि ते आणिया तहिं मुहडा,मुक्का य बन्धणाओ,भोगविरत्ता तओ जाया"
english: "Here's what Rama said:" "He hates you, And there is nothing wrong with that." "The ties of affection, like a knot, Do not break."

prakrit: "सुहडो य भाणुकण्णो,इन्दइ घणवाहणो य मारीई,मय-दाणवमाईया,हियएण मुणित्तणं पत्ता"
english: "Aunt, It's the buffalo's ears that burn, A herd of oxen that kill, A flock of parrots that eat the corn."

prakrit: "अह भणइ लच्छिनिलओ,जह विहु अवयारिणो भवइ सत्त,तह विय पसंसियबो,अहियं माणुनओ सुहडो"
english: "Oh! what a pleasure it is to talk, For as much pleasure as the rest of my life Provides, So much pleasure I derive from it."

prakrit: "संथाविऊण भणिया,इन्दइपमुहा भडा नियंयभोगे,भुञ्जह जहाणुपुवं,सोउवयं पमोत्तणं"
english: "Foolish girl, you'll make a mess of it: The buffalo's face is smeared with red ghee, And the elephant's tail is pricked by ants."

prakrit: "भणियं तेहि महायस!,अलाहि भोगेहि विससरिच्छेहिं,घणसोगसंगपहि,अणन्तसंसारकरणेहिं"
english: "I swear it's a big deal! The more you suffer the thinner you become. It's like having too much sex. It keeps happening all the time." ""

prakrit: "रामेण लक्खणेण य,भण्णन्ता वि य अणेगउवासे,न य पडिवन्ना भोगे,इन्दइपमुहा भडा बहवे"
english: "Rama knows good and bad, He does not speak evil or abuse anyone, And when he speaks good and kind, He is always generous."

prakrit: "अवयरिऊण सरवरे,व्हाया सब वि तत्थ विमलजले,पुणरवि य समुत्तिण्णा,गया य निययाई टाणाई"
english: "Undisturbed, everybody, Everything is still in a state of flux, Restarting work, Gone is the draught of destiny"

prakrit: "वणियाण मारियाण य,भडाण लोगो कहासु आसत्तो,लकापुरीऎ चिठ्ठद,वियलियवादारकम्मन्तो"
english: "Trader, kill me, brother - in - law, Where have you been? A letter written in lac on lac, Is the remembrance of a violinist."

prakrit: "केई उवालभन्ता,रुवन्ति सुह्डा दसाणणगुणोहं,अन्ने विरत्तभोगा,संजाया तखणं चेव"
english: "One can make a fool of oneself, One can weep bitterly, Two can make one angry, And one can break one's fast."

prakrit: "केइ भना अइघोरं,संसारं निन्दिऊण आढत्ता,अन्ने पुण रायसिरी,भणन्ति तडिचञ्चलसहावा"
english: "Some people say the world is dark, Some condemn it, And others say it is dark." ""

prakrit: "दीसह पञ्चकम्वमिणं,सुहमसुहफलं रणम्मि मुहडाणं,भङ्गण य विजण्ण य,ममसरिसबलाण वि इहेव"
english: "Happy are the days of the five vows, The pleasant fruits of war, The triumphs of victory, And the joys of love."

prakrit: "थोवा वि मुकयपुण्णा,पावन्ति जयं रणम्मि नरवसभा,बहवो वि कुच्छियतवा,भजन्ति न पत्थ संदेहो"
english: "A thief is also mature, A warrior is always victorious, A coward is always vicious, A traveler is always mischievous, And there is no room for any doubt."

prakrit: "अबलस्स बलं धम्मो,रक्खइ आउं पि सुचरिओ धम्मो,धम्मो य हवइ पक्खो,सबत्तो पेच्छा धम्मो"
english: "Impotent strength is dharma, protection is given to the virtuous, dharma is passed on to the wise, and dharma prevails over all."

prakrit: "आसेमु कुञ्जरेनु य,भडेसु सन्नद्धबद्धकवण्सु,न य रखिज्जइ पुर्व,पुण्णेहिं विजिओ पुरिसो"
english: "Come, you crook, Foolish girl, Get ready for the fight, But don't stop before you have to. Let's get this straight again." ""

prakrit: "केइ भणन्ति एसा,हवइ गई वरभडाण संगामे,अन्ने जपन्ति भडा,सत्ती वि हु रामकेसीणं"
english: "Some people say this, The wind has blown, The fair is going on, The buffalo is singing, The elephant is sleeping, And so is Rama."

prakrit: "भञ्जन्ति आउहाई,अवरे धत्तन्ति भूसणवराई,संवेगसमावन्ना,अन्ने गिण्हन्ति पवजं"
english: "They whisper, They groan, They flutter, They gather emotion, They count the vows."

prakrit: "एवं घरे घरे चिय,लहानयरीऎ सोगगहियाओ,रोवन्ति महिलियाओ,कलुणं पयलन्तनयणाओ"
english: "And cheers from house to house, Young girls mourning, Weeping women, Tears streaming down their cheeks."

prakrit: "अह तस्स दिणस्स'न्ते,साहू नामेण अप्पमेयबलो,छप्पन्नसहस्सजुओ,मुणीण लहापुरी पत्तो"
english: "Ah! the dishonesty of that man, Aunt, Your name is Appamebal, Young men with big breasts, Sage Lahapuri leaves." ""

prakrit: "जइ सो मुणी महप्पा,एन्तो लाहिवम्मि जीवन्ते,तो लक्खणस्स पोई,होन्ती सह रक्खसिन्देणं"
english: "If that sage is great, If that wretched woman survives, Destiny will follow, And if that woman's husband is poor, She must be rich."

prakrit: "जोयणसयं अग्रणं,जत्थ'च्छह केवली समुद्देसे,वेराणुबन्धरहिया,हवन्ति निययं नरवरिन्दा"
english: "Love without fire, Wherever you are, Only from the sea, Barren bound, Destroyed by fate"

prakrit: "गयणं नहा अरूवं,चलो य वाऊ थिरा हवह भूमो,तह केवलिस्स नियमा,एस सहावो य लोयहिओ"
english: "Singing is not an arrow, Let the wind blow through the sky, That's the only rule, It is the law that helps." ""

prakrit: "सङ्केण परिमिओ 'सो,गन्तुं कुसुमाउहे वरुज्जाणे,आवासिओ मुणिन्दो,फासुयदेसम्मि उवविट्ठो"
english: "Sankara parimaya," "Go and wash the cotton buds off the young bridegroom's feet." "The landowner is stung."

prakrit: "झायन्तस्स भगवओ,एवं घाइक्खएण कम्माणं,रयणिसमयम्मि तइया,केवलनाणं समुप्पन्नं"
english: "Jealous God, and my dear girl, You're right when it comes to making love, Only your name should be mentioned."

prakrit: "एगग्गमणो होई,तस्साईसयसमूहसंबन्धं,निसुणेहि ताव सेणिय,भण्णन्तं पावनासयरं"
english: "Be nice to each other, be courteous to every group of people, never be rude to anyone, say,'It's the wind that blows"

prakrit: "अह मुणिवसहस्स तया,ठियस्स सोहासणे सुरवरिन्दा,चलिया भिसन्तमउडा,जिणदरिसणउज्जया सबे"
english: "Ah! sighs the sage," "Tears flow from her cheeks." "Long live the wise woman!"

prakrit: "धायइसण्डविदेहे,सुरिन्दरमणे पुरे य पुबिल्ले,उप्पन्नो तित्थयरो,तिलोयपुज्जो तहिं समए"
english: "Daughter - in - law, The whole of Surinderman is full of flowers. But you, Titthyayro, worship the sesame seed Only in that place."

prakrit: "असुरा नाग-सुवण्णा,दीव-समुद्दा दिसाकुमारा य,वाय-ग्गि-विज्जु-थणिया,भवणनिवासी दसवियप्पा"
english: "The asura is the nymph Suvanna, the diya is the ocean Disakumara, the vayagi are the vijju nymphs, and the dasaviyappa is the inhabitant of the air."

prakrit: "किन्नर-किंपुरिस-महोरगा य गन्धब-रक्खसा जक्खा,भूया य पिसाया वि य,अट्टविहा वाणमन्तरिया"
english: "Eunuchs, Kingpuris, Mahorgas, Gandhab, Rakshasa, Jakha, Bhuyas, Pisayas, Ataviha, Vana Mantriya." ""

prakrit: "चन्दा सूरा य गहा,नक्खता तारगा य नायबा,पञ्चविहा जोइसिया,गइरइकामा इमे देवा"
english: "Chanda surah ya gaha, nakhta taraga ya nayaba, panch viha joysiya, gairikama: This is the god of tomorrow."

prakrit: "सोहम्मीसाण-सणंकुमार माहिन्द-बम्भलोगा य,लन्तयकप्पो य तहा,छटो उण होइ नायबो"
english: "Proud girl, Mahinda - The bomb blast is inevitable, But if you give in to it, It's nothing to hide."

prakrit: "एचो य महासुको,हवइ सहस्सार आणओ चेव,तह पाणओ य आरण,अनुयकप्पो य बारसमो"
english: "This is the great sun; the wind blows with it, And the water flows with it; There is no wind or rain."

prakrit: "एएमु य कप्पेसुं,देवा इन्दाइणो महिड्डीया,चलिया भिसन्तमउडा,अन्ने वि सुरा सपरिवारा"
english: "Here's my cup of coffee: The God of Love is everywhere, Always around, Always with the whole family."

prakrit: "आगन्तूण य नयरे,घेतण जिणं गया सुमेरुगिरिं,अहिसिञ्चन्ति सुरवरा,खीरोयहिंवारिकलसेहिं"
english: "The visitor is absent, The victory is won by the swollen girdle, The thrill is unbearable, Like a field of cucumbers."

prakrit: "वत्तम्मि य अहिसेए,आहरणविहूसियं निणं काउं,वन्दन्ति सबदेवा,पहट्ठमणसा सपरिवारा"
english: "Vattammi ya ahiseye, aharan vihurushyam ninam kaun, vandanti sab devata, pathamanasa parivarasa."

prakrit: "एवं कयाभिसेयं,नणणीए अप्पिऊण तित्थयरं,देवा नियतमाणा,सरन्ति मुणिकेवलुप्पत्ती"
english: "And what a waste of time, Little girl, You're right on top of that, God willing, Running around bouncing mudflats."

prakrit: "गय-तुरय-वसह-केसरि-विमाण-रुरु-चमर-वाहणारूढा,गन्तूण पणमिऊण य,साहुं तत्थेव उवविट्ठा"
english: "Gone - the trumpet, The flute, The kesari, The aeroplane, The crow, The wheel, The traveler's wife, Gone to the river For lack of money, Already there."

prakrit: "सोऊण दुन्दुहिरवं,देवाण समागयाण पउमाभो,खेयरबलपरिकिग्णो,साहुसयासं समल्लीणो"
english: "Love is like a bunch of peacock's tail feathers, Like a flock of parrots Struggling to find a mate."

prakrit: "तह भाणुकण्ण-इन्दइ-घणवाहण-मरिजि-मयभडादीया,एए मुणिस्स पासं,अल्लीणा अडरत्तम्मि"
english: "There goes the buffalo - The elephant - The carrier - The heifer - The mybhadra - The landowner's wife:" "O my son - In - law! It is a rough passage." ""

prakrit: "एवं थोऊण मुणी,देवा विज्जाहरा य सोममणा,निमुणन्ति मुणिमुहाओ,विणिम्गय बहुविहं धर्म"
english: "And the sage says:" "God is vast, Knowledge is abundant, Love is endless, Faces are blurred, Dharma is manifold." ""

prakrit: "भणइ मुणी मुणियत्थो,संसारे अट्टकम्मपडिबद्धा,जीवा भमन्ति मूढा,सुहा'सुह चेव वेयन्ता"
english: "He says,'The sage is a fool, The world is full of crooks, Life is haunted by ghosts, Happiness prevails.'"" "

prakrit: "हिंसा'लिय-चोरिकाइएसु परजुवइसेवणेसु पुणो,अइलोभपरिणया वि य,मरिऊण हवन्ति नेरइया"
english: "Violence leads to theft, servitude to the prostitute begets remorse, And even jealousy leads to death."

prakrit: "रयणप्पमा य सकर-वालय पप्पभा धूमपमा,एत्तो तमा तमतमा,सत्त अहे होन्ति पुढवीओ"
english: "Rayanappama ya sakara-valaya paapabha dhoomapama, itna tama tama, saat ahe hanti leaders."

prakrit: "एयासु सयसहस्सा,चउरासीई हवन्ति नरयाणं,कक्खडपरिणामाणं,असुईणं दुरभिगन्धाणं"
english: "These are the days of sighs, The nights of longing, Of men making love, Of wretched husbands, Of bad smells."

prakrit: "करवत्त-जन्त-सामलि वेयरणी-कुम्भिपाय-पुडपाया,हण-दहण-पयण-भक्षण-कुट्टणघणवेयणा सबे"
english: "The crows - The beasts - The jasmine - The minnows - The water - The paddy - The milking - The journey - The eating - The grass - Everything."

prakrit: "पजलियङ्गारनिहा,हवइ मही ताण सबनरयाणं,तिम्खासु पुणो अहियं,निरन्तरा वजमुईसु"
english: "You puzzled hunter, The wind blows all the time, It makes you shiver again And again." ""

prakrit: "एएमु पावकम्मा,पक्खित्ता तिबवेयणसयाइं,अणुहोन्ति सुइरकालं,निमिस पि अलद्धसुहसाया"
english: "Aunt, The good old days are fleeting, The winter nights are long, And I have always had a good laugh."

prakrit: "कूडतुल-कूडमाणाइण्मु रसमेइणो य कावडिया,ते वि मया परलोए,हवन्ति तिरियो उ दुहभागी"
english: "Kudatula - The kavadiya in the koodamanaimanamu rasa, That too in front of my eyes, Looks like a painting in progress." ""

prakrit: "वय-नियमविरहिया विहु,अज्जव-मद्दवगुणेसु उववेया,उप्पजन्ति मणुस्सा,तहा''रिया'णारिया चेव"
english: "Age - devoid of rules, Blessed are the meek, The generous are the humane, So is" "Rhea's wife Chew" ""

prakrit: "वय-नियम-सील-संनम-गुणेसु भावेन्ति जे उ अप्पाणं,ते कालगय समाणा,हवन्ति कप्पालएसु सुरा"
english: "Age, rules, seal, name, quality, whatever they call themselves, They alter with time, Like the melody of a couplet."

prakrit: "तत्तो वि चुयसमाणा,चक्कहराईकुले समुप्पन्ना,भोत्तण मणुयसोक्खं,लएन्ति निस्सङ्गपषजं"
english: "Even then they are self - sacrificing, Traveling in circles, Jealousy of false men, Taking no shelter at all."

prakrit: "चारित्त-नाण-दसण-विसुद्धसम्मत्त-लेसपरिणामा,घोरतव-चरणजुत्ता,डहन्ति कम निरवसेसं"
english: "Charity - Wealth - Decency - Wisdom - Consent - Les parinamas, vanity - The burning of the feet, Dahanti - Less non - existent."

prakrit: "पइफोडियकम्मरया,उप्पाडेऊण केवलं नाणं,ते पावेन्ति सुविहिया,सिवमयलमणुत्तरं ठाणं"
english: "Aunt, You're only supposed to toss the coin, They're supposed to say nice things, Right? The answer is always the same."

prakrit: "ते. तत्थ सङ्गरहिया,अबाबाहं मुहं अणोवमियं,भुअन्ति सुइरकालं,सिद्धा सिद्धिं समल्लीणा"
english: "Te., Tattha sangrahaya, Ababaaha muha anovamiyam, Bhuanti suyarkalam, Siddha siddha samallina."

prakrit: "अह सो मुणिवरवसभो,इन्दइ-घणवाहणेहि निययभवं,परिपुच्छिओ महप्पा,कहिऊण तो समाढत्तो"
english: "Ah, you fool, The destiny of many vessels hangs in the balance, But ask me, dear friend, If I tell you the truth."

prakrit: "कोसम्बीनयरीण,सहोयरा आसि तत्थ धणहीणा,घणपीइसंपउत्ता,नामेणं पढम-पच्छिमया"
english: "Friendly woman, When one is with one's neighbor, One is without wealth, One carries wealth abroad, One goes by the first name - West."

prakrit: "अह तं पुरी भमन्तो,भवदत्तो नाम आगओ समणो,तस्स सयासे धम्मं,सुणेन्ति ते भायरा दो वि"
english: "Ah! the whole of him is wandering, The fire is burning, His name has been given, The Dharma is with him forever. Both brothers hear it." ""

prakrit: "संवेगसमावन्ना,जाया ते संजया समियपावा,नयरी' तो राया,नन्दो महिला य इन्दुमुही"
english: "Love without emotion, Wherever the sun is shining, There is no cause for alarm: It is the woman with the moon"

prakrit: "अह तत्थ पट्टणवरे,परमविभूई कया नरिन्देणं,धय-छत्त-तोरणाईसु चेव कुसुमोवयारिला"
english: "Ah, town, what a cruel sight it is to behold the supreme beauty. Every drop of nectar falls from the eaves of the roof."

prakrit: "दट्टण तं विभूई,कयं नियाणं तु पच्छिमजईणं,"होमि अहं नन्दसुओ,जइ मे धम्मस्स माहप्पं"
english: "Because the crowd has dispersed, Because you are a westerner," "I am blissful, Because I have reached the greatness of dharma." ""

prakrit: "बोहि जन्तो वि मुणी,अणियत्तमणो नियाणकयगाहो,मरिऊण य उववन्नो,गन्भम्मि उ इन्दुवयणाए"
english: "A wise man is always wise, A brave woman is always prudent, When she dies he always rises; At the crossroads they make their mark."

prakrit: "गन्भट्टियस्स रन्ना,बहूणि कारावियाणि लिङ्गाणि,पायारनिवसणाई,नायाइं रज्जकहणाई"
english: "The cowherd is the hunter, The daughter - in - law is the jailer, The linga is the wife, The crows are the hunters of the rafters."

prakrit: "नाओ कुमारसीहो,अह सो रइवद्धणो ति नामेणं,अमरिन्दरूवसरिसो,रज्जसमिद्धि समणुपत्तो"
english: "No, you fool, That's my name, Your husband's... You fool, You dishonest messenger."

prakrit: "पढमो वि तवं काउं,कालगओ सुरवरो समुप्पन्नो,संभरइ कणिटुं सो,जायं नन्दस्स अरुहं"
english: "Reading is like reading a book, Time passes, Sound waves gather, Compassion fills the mind, Which is the arrow of happiness."

prakrit: "तस्स पडिबोहणटे,'चेल्यरूवेण आगओ सिग्छ,पविसरइ रायभवणं,दिट्ठो रइवद्धणेण तओ"
english: "He stammered,'Chelyaruvena aga sigshu, Pavisrayi rai bhavan, gaze is for stay." ""

prakrit: "अन्मुडिओ निविट्ठो,कहेइ रइवद्धणस्स पुषभवं,सबं सपञ्चयगुणं,जं दिटुं जं च अणुहूयं"
english: "Be still, sweetheart," she says, "The pleasures of love, all dreamlike; the sight of which is irresistible."

prakrit: "तं सोऊण विबुद्धो,अह सो रहवद्धणो विगयसङ्गो,गिण्हइ जिणवरदिक्खे,देवो वि गओ निययठाणं"
english: "He is deeply enlightened, He is a man of discernment, He can count on victory, Even a god is doomed."

prakrit: "रइवद्धणो वि य तवं,काऊणं कालधम्मसंजुत्तो,पढमामरस्स पासं,गओ य वेमाणिओ जाओ"
english: "The wedding is imminent, Time is fleeting, We're nearing our final destination, But go, you fool!" ""

prakrit: "तत्तो चुया समाणा,विजए नाया विउद्धवरनयरे,एकोयरा नरिन्दा,चरिय तवं पत्थिया सम्र्ग"
english: "Tattoo chuya samana, vijaya naya, viuddhavarnayare, ekoyara narinda, chari tavam patthiya samraga."

prakrit: "तत्तो वि चुया तुब्भे,इन्दइ-घणवाहणा समुप्पन्ना,लाहिवस्स पुत्ता,विजा-बल-रुवसंपन्ना"
english: "There too the mist has melted, The heavy vehicles are stuck in the mud, The poor son of Lahivas is languishing, The strong ones are withering."

prakrit: "जा आसि इन्दुवयणा,सा इह मन्दोयरी समुप्पन्ना,जणणी बीयम्मि भवे,जिणसासणभावियमईया"
english: "Come, young lady, This is the Mandovi Samuppana. Let the seed be with the wife, For what use is a wife supposed to be?"

prakrit: "सुणिऊण परभवं ते,दो वि जणा तिबनायसंवेगा,निस्सा पाइया,समय विजाहरभडेहिं"
english: "Listen, you fool, The two will meet again. Time has proved elusive." ""

prakrit: "धीरो वि भाणुकण्णो,मारीजी चेव खेयरसमिद्धी,अवहस्थिऊण दोष्णि वि,पबइया जायसंवेगा"
english: "Be patient, my dear, There must be something very wrong with you. But if I'm not careful, You'd better take care of yourself."

prakrit: "मन्दोयरी वि पुत्ते,पछज्जमुवागए सुणेऊणं,सोयसराहयहियया,मुच्छावसविम्भला पडिया"
english: "Aunt, Even the Mandoeris have grown thin. When they return they are heard only with sighs and groans. They are covered with gooseflesh." ""

prakrit: "चन्दणजलोल्लियङ्गी,आसत्था विलविउं समाढत्ता,हा इन्दइ! घणवाहण!,जणणी नो लक्खिया तुम्भे"
english: "Sandal - water lily, Hope helps sooth the weeping lotus, Oh! my poor girl! There is nothing you can do About it." ""

prakrit: "भत्तारविरहियाए,पुत्ता आलम्बणं महिलियाए,होन्ति इह जीवलोए,चत्ता तेहिं पि पावा हइ"
english: "The landowner is dead, The women are pregnant, The husband is abroad, The wife has expired, And the husband is dead."

prakrit: "तिसमुद्दमेइणिवई,मह दइओ विणिहओ रणमुहम्मि,पुत्तेहि वि मुक्का हइ,के सरणं वो पवजामि!"
english: "Tis only a matter of time, My handsome son, The moment I see him I will kiss his forehead. Whom else can I blame?"

prakrit: "एवं सा विलवन्ती,अजाए. तत्थ संजमसिरीए,पडिबोहिया य गेण्हइ,पन्वजं सा महादेवी"
english: "And she is a wretch, without a husband. Then, with sighs of remorse, She sings of old wives. And, behold, she is the great goddess of wealth." ""

prakrit: "चन्दणहा वि अणिञ्चं,जीयं नाऊण तिबदुक्खत्ता,पवइया दढभावा,निणवरधम्मुज्जया जाया"
english: "Even the moon is invisible, Life is transient, Love is impermanent, Death is inevitable."

prakrit: "अट्ठावन्नसहस्सा,तत्थ य जुवईण लद्धबोहीणं,पबइया नियमगुणं,कुणन्ति दुक्खक्खयहाए"
english: "Aunt, When a young man is laden with trouble He acts according to the rules of the land."

prakrit: "इवं इन्दइ-मेहवाहणमुणी धम्मक्कचित्ता सया,नाणालद्धिसमिद्धसाहुसहिया अब्भुज्जया संजमे,भवाणन्दयरा भमन्ति वसुहं ते नागलीलागई,अबाबाहमुह सिर्व सुविमलं मम्गन्ति रनिंदिवं"
english: "This is the nature of love - The arrow of the God of Love sways through the whole sky, The bow of love sighs through the gaps in the sky, And the landowner's wife whispers to him," "It's the fire of love." ""

prakrit: "इय पउमचरिए इन्दइआदिनिक्खमणं नाम पचहत्तरं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "Proud lady, This is the seventy-fifth day of my life."

prakrit: "एत्तो दसरहतणया,हलहर-नारायणा महिड्डीया,लकापुरिं पविट्ठा,हय-गय-रह-जोहपरिकिण्णा"
english: "Here is the festival of Dussehra: The plowman's wife, Mahidya the dancer of fire and water, Lakapuri the holy one, Hay - gayi - rah - the lover of fire."

prakrit: "पडपडह-मेरि-झल्लरि-काहल-तिलिमा मुइगसद्देणं,जयजयसद्देण तहिं,न सुणिज्जइ कण्णवडियं पि"
english: "Fallen - Merry - Flicker - Sigh - The tiller - The twang is dead, Like the sound of a clap of thunder, Yet its ears are not heard."

prakrit: "तत्थेव रायमग्गे,पउमं सहलक्खणं पलोयन्तो,न य तिप्पइ नयरजणो,संपेल्लोप्पेल्लकुणमाणो"
english: "There goes the rhyme, The husband embraces his wife, Nor does he turn his back On her: It's just a bunch of gossip." ""

prakrit: "विजाहरीहि सहसा,भवणगवक्खा निरन्तरं छन्ना,वयणकमलेसु अहियं,रेहन्ति पलोयमाणीणं"
english: "Travelers come suddenly, Birds fly all the time, I am addicted to cooking, And women stay up late making love."

prakrit: "अन्नोन्ना भणइ सही,एसो वरपुण्डरीयदलनयणो । सीयाए हियइट्ठो,रामो इन्दो,सवेणं"
english: "Unknown is true, such is the confusion in the Varapundara. The sky is red, Rama is dead, Heaven is asleep." ""

prakrit: "इन्दीवरसरिसाभो,इन्दीवरलोयणो महाबाहू,चक्करयणस्स सामी,पेच्छ सही लक्खणो एसो"
english: "The rain clouds hover over Indivar, The delights of Indivar are great, The joys of detachment are fleeting, But this is the true nature of love."

prakrit: "पउमो सीयाए सम,भुञ्जन्तो उत्तमं विसयसोक्खं,दोगुन्दुगो व देवो,गयं पि कालं न लक्खेइ"
english: "Poem is like wine, Bhunjanto is the pleasure of a good meal, Dogundugu is like a god; Even though one has passed, one cannot remember the time."

prakrit: "सम्गसरिसो वि देसो,पियविरहे रणसन्निहो होइ,इट्ठजणसंपओगे,रणं पि सुरालयं जिणइ"
english: "Traveler, let there be no strife apart from love, There are plenty of people like that, Even the wilderness conquers the real world."

prakrit: "तह य विसल्लासहिओ,अच्छद लच्छीहरो जणियतोसो,रइसागरोवगाढो,सुरवइलील विडम्बन्तो"
english: "Such a vast expanse of water, So abundant are the joys and sorrows of love, Like the rustle of a rainbow, So full of melodious irony."

prakrit: "एवं ताण रइसुह,अणुहवमाणाण'णेयवरिसाई,वोलोणाणि दिणं पिव,अइसयगुणरिद्धिजुत्ताणं"
english: "And the tension is palpable, The impulse is irresistible, The trembling twang is deafening, The excitement is overwhelming."

prakrit: "अह लक्खणो कयाई,पुराणि सरिऊण कुवरादीणि,कन्नाण कए लेहे,साहिन्नाणे विसज्जेइ"
english: "Ah! a man of many talents, An old cowherd on good terms, A man decked out with cotton So that he may bathe in the fresh nectar"

prakrit: "विज्जाहरेहि गन्तुं,ताण कुमारीण दरिसिया लेहा,लक्षणमणुस्सगाणं,अहियं नेहं वहन्तीणं"
english: "Going abroad, That virgin's dress, That lehenga, That characteristic human song, Is the one I take with me."

prakrit: "दसपुरवईण ध्या,स्वमई वजयण्णनरवइणा,वीसज्जिया य पत्ता,लहानयरि सपरिवारा"
english: "Be attentive, girl of ten, Be observant, Be discerning, Be watchful, Be considerate, Be thoughtful, And show consideration to your neighbor's needs."

prakrit: "अह वालिखिल्लदुहिया,कुबरनयराहिवस्स गुणकलिया,सा वि तहिं संपत्ता,कन्ना कलाणमाल ति"
english: "Ah! worthless couplets, Virtuous couplets of cow - dung cakes, Such is the wealth of a woman, So is black magic." ""

prakrit: "पुहवीधरस्स दुहिया,पुहहपुरे तत्थ होइ वणमाला,विजाहरेहि नीया,सा वि य लच्छीहरसमोवं"
english: "The full moon is dark, The forest is moist, The rivers are swollen, And so is the elephant calf."

prakrit: "खेमञ्जलीयनयरे,नियसत्तू नाम तस्स जियपउमा,ध्या परियणसहिया,सा वि य लकापुरि पत्ता"
english: "Khemanjalienayre, niyasattu naam tasa jyapuma, dhya parinasahiya, sai ya lakapuri pata." ""

prakrit: "उज्जेणिमाइएसु य,नयरेसु वि जाओ रायकन्नाओ,लहापुरी गयाओ,गुरूहि अणुमन्नियाओ य"
english: "Come on, you bright sunshine girl, Don't go out in the middle of the night. Go to Lahoripuri. Please, my dear, Please, don't come in between."

prakrit: "परिणेइ लच्छिनिलओ,परमविभूई- ताओ कन्नाओ,सबसुन्दरीओ,मुरवहुसमसरिसरुवाओ"
english: "Married women are attractive, the supreme beauty is everywhere - Tao, Kanao, all beautiful women, The creation of the universe is bound to happen."

prakrit: "परिणेइ पउमणाहो,कनाओ जाओ पुबदिन्नाओ,नवजोषणुजलाओ,रइगुणसार वहन्तीओ"
english: "Marry the virtuous, Go to the fair, Give birth, Rejoice, Behave virtuously."

prakrit: "एवं परमविभूई,हलहर-नारायणा समणुपत्ता,लकापुरोऎ रज्जं,कुणन्ति विजाहरसमग्गा"
english: "And the supreme beauty, The harmony of Halahar-Narayan, The razor of Lakapura, Virtuous victory."

prakrit: "छबरिसाणि कमेण य,गयाणि तत्थेव पवरनयरीए,सोमित्ति-हलहराणं,विजाहररिद्धिजुत्ताणं"
english: "Every woman loves to sing, Every man loves to dance, Every woman dreams of victory."

prakrit: "एयं तु कहन्तरए,पुणरवि निसुणेहि अन्नसंबन्धं,इन्दइमुणिमाईणं,सेणिय! लद्धीगुणहराणं"
english: "" "What are you talking about? No need to go anywhere else. It's all about the food. Take it easy, my darling! The qualities of a warrior that bring glory."

prakrit: "झाणाणलेण सर्व,दहिऊणं कम्मकयवरं धीरो,इन्दइमुणी महप्पा,केवलनाणी तओ जाओ"
english: "Everyone should know this, Righteous woman, Be patient in all actions, Wretched woman, Only the wise should go."

prakrit: "अह मेहवाहणो वि य,धोरो अन्नोन्नकरणजोएट,जिणिण कम्ममलं,गेहइ सो केवलिपडायं"
english: "Ah! the pleasures of love! For what pleasure is there to be had In making love? For where there is karma, There is only pride."

prakrit: "दसण-नाण-चरित्ते,सुद्धो तव चरण-करणविणिओगे,केवलनाणाइसय,संपत्तो भाणुयण्णो वि"
english: "Sacrifice, coin, and bangle: First let your feet be uncircumcised, Then only the eyes of the God of Love; But wealth is more important than words."

prakrit: "अणेसु जेसु एए,सिवमयलमणुतरं सुहं पत्ता,दोसन्ति ताणि सेणिय!,ते पुण साहू न दीसन्ति"
english: "Anesu Jesu aye, Siivamayalamantram suham patram, Dosti tha seniya!, They won't help you again." ""

prakrit: "विझत्थलीसु जेण उ,इन्दइ तह मेहवाहणो सिद्धो,तित्थं मेहरवं तं,विक्खायं तिहुयणे जायं"
english: "As vast as the horizon, So vast is the expanse of the sky, So great is the firmament of love, So wide is the horizon."

prakrit: "समणो वि जम्बुमाली,कालं काऊण तो निमित्तम्मि,अहमिन्दत्तं पत्तो,सुचरियकम्माणुभावणं"
english: "Compassion is also immutable, Time is of the essence, Non - violence is the path, Good conduct is the highest feeling."

prakrit: "ततो चुओ य सन्तो,होहइ एरावए महासमणो,केवलसमाहिजुत्तो,सिद्धिं पाविहिइ धुयकम्मो"
english: "Only the pure can attain purity, Only the simple can attain it, And the pure cannot."

prakrit: "अह नम्मयाग तीरम्मि निबुओ कुम्भयण्णमुणिवसभो,पीढरखड भण्णइ,तं तित्थं देसविक्खायं"
english: "Ah, the arrows of the God of Love, Which spring up like the first rays of the moon."

prakrit: "मारोजि तवञ्चरणं काऊणं कप्पवासिओ जाओ,नो जारिसम्मि ववसइ,फलं पि सो तारिसं लभइ"
english: "Go and cover your face with ghee, for there is nothing wrong with you," he says, "But the fruit will be yours."

prakrit: "पुर्व काऊण बहु,पावं मयदाणवो वि मुणिवसभो,तवचरणपभावेणं,जाओ बहुलद्धिसंपन्नो"
english: "The former is dear to the countenance, The latter is dear even to the sages. But go in search of the more virtuous." ""

prakrit: "एयन्तरम्मि राया,पुच्छइ गणनायगं पणमिऊणं,कह सो मओ महानस!,जाओ च्चिय लद्धिसंपन्नो"
english: "Here comes the poor girl, Asking how she fared While counting the money, Saying:" "I am very rich!" "Go and fight over the spoils."

prakrit: "अन्नं पि सुणसु सामिय!,जा हवइ पइबया इहं नारी,सा सीलसंजमरया,साहसु कवणं गई लहइ"
english: "Listen to me, Samia! Let the wind blow, little girl, It's the twang of the seal, Courage has struck." ""

prakrit: "तो भणइ इन्दभूई,ना दढसीला पइवया महिला,सीयाऎ,हवइ सरिसी,सा सग्गं लहइ सुकयस्था"
english: "So speak the God of Love, Not a woman so stubborn as this girl. But let her heart be pure. Let her dry up completely."

prakrit: "जह तुरयरहवराणं,पत्थरलोहाण पायवाणं च,हवइ विसेसो नरवइ!,तहेव पुरिसाण महिलाणं"
english: "Like the blowing of a trumpet, Like the rolling of a boulder, Like a violent wind, This is the way of men!"

prakrit: "एसो मणमत्तगओ,उद्दामो विसयलोलुओ चण्डो,नाणङकुसेण धरिओ,नरेण दढसत्तिजुत्तेणं"
english: "Here is a man in a hurry: The moon is brimful of excitement, The lotus is eager to grab hold of it, And the fire is irresistible to anyone."

prakrit: "निसुणेहि ताव सेणिय!,सीलविणासं पराभिमाणेणं,जायं चिय महिलाए,तं तुज्झ कहेमि फुडवियर्ड"
english: "Silly girl! What you mean, Silly woman, I call you a foodie." ""

prakrit: "बइया आसि जणवओ,काले बहुरोगपीडिओ सबो,धन्नग्गामाउ तया,नट्टो विप्पो सह पियाए"
english: "Come, let's go. Everyone is very sick these days, Thanks be to you, I promise, Not one drop of poison will be drunk with you."

prakrit: "सो अग्गिलो अडयणा,सा महिला माणिणी महापावा,चत्ता य महारण्णे,विप्पेणं माणदोसेणं"
english: "So, fire - eyed woman, That woman is very proud, And death is great; The fire of separation is the medicine of sin."

prakrit: "दिट्ठा य कररुहेणं,नरवहणा अतणो कया मज्जा,पुष्फावइण्णनयरे,अच्छह सोक्ख अणुहबन्ती"
english: "To gaze at something, To groan at something so sensuous, To weep at the sound of a flower, Is an inexhaustible pleasure."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाई,लद्धपसायाऎ तीऎ सो राया,चलणेण उत्तिमझे,पहओ रहकेलिसमयम्मि"
english: "Oh! what a strange girl! She is slipping in the mud And falling at every step. Traveler, you silly girl!"

prakrit: "अस्थाणम्मि निविट्टो,पुच्छह राया बहुस्सुए सबे,पारण जो नरिन्द,हणइ सिरे तस्स को दण्डो"
english: "Destroy Asthanami, ask how many wives you have, Paran who is naarind, punish those who have turned their backs on him."

prakrit: "तो पण्डिया पवुत्ता,नरवह! सो तस्स छिज्जए पाओ,हेमरेण निरुद्धा,विप्पेणं अपमाणा ते"
english: "So what's the matter, you stupid bitch! Get away with it, you damned bastard? It's a disgrace to break in." ""

prakrit: "हेमहो भणइ निवं,तस्स उ पायस्स कीरए पूया,भजाऎ वल्लभाए,तम्हा कोवं परिचयसु"
english: "Hema, tell me, Nivam, Where did you get that pyre, Mr Pooya? Come, my dear! Let me know your anger." ""

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,हेमको नरवईण तुटेणं,संपाविओ य रिद्धी,अणेगदाणाभिमाणेणं"
english: "To listen is to hear, To hear is to break, To embrace is to cherish, To fall in love is to suffer."

prakrit: "तइया हेमंकपुरे,मित्तजसा नाम अच्छइ वराई,सा भम्गवस्स भजा,अमोहसरलद्धविजयस्स"
english: "Your name is Hemankapure, your name is Mitjasa, you good wretch; you wicked coward, You shameless conqueror of many battles."

prakrit: "अइदुक्खिया य विहवा,हेमई पेच्छिण धणपुष्णं,सिरिवद्धियं सुर्य सा,भणइ रुयन्ती मह सुणेहि"
english: "Aunt, The sun is shining brightly, Her eyes are red with jealousy, And she says," "I hear you crying." ""

prakrit: "ईसस्थागमकुसलो,तुज्झ पिया आसि भग्गवो नाम,धरिद्धिसंपउत्तो,सबनरिन्दाण अइपुजो"
english: "Is this the way of love? Come, let your lover come. For what use is a poor man's name? Let him suffer for lack of affection."

prakrit: "संथाविऊग जणणि,वन्यपुरं सो कमेण संपत्तो,सर्व कलागमगुणं,सिक्खइ गुरवस्स पासम्मि"
english: "A man of modest means, With wild flowers and lotus flowers, Makes him wealthy And learns all the virtues of the arts By being near a gentleman."

prakrit: "जाओ समत्तविजो,तत्थ पुरेसस्स सुन्दरा धूया,छिद्देण य अवहरिई,वञ्चइ सो निययघरहुत्तो"
english: "Go, visit her, Then wash away all that beauty, Except for a splash of water. She's been tricked into going to his house." ""

prakrit: "सीहेन्दुनामधेओ,भाया कन्नाऎ तोऎ बलसहिओ,पुरओ अविट्टिऊणं,जुज्झइ सिरिवद्धिएण समं"
english: "Friend, if you dare to fight, Be strong first. For the warrior's arrows are equal to those of a warrior."

prakrit: "सोहेन्दुरायपुत्तं,बलसहियं निजिणित्तु एगागी,सिरिवद्धिओ कमेणं,गओ य जणणीऎ पासम्मि"
english: "Sowhendurayputta, balsam nijinittu aegagi, sirivaddhiyo kamen, go - yo - go - To the woman next door." ""

prakrit: "विनाणलाघवेणं,तोसविओ तेण कररुहो राया,सिरिवद्धिएण लद्धं,रज्जं चिय पोयणे नयरे"
english: "Without touching it, For it is hard for him To bend it, To fight with it firmly fixed, For the string cannot pierce it."

prakrit: "कालगयम्मि मुकन्ते,सीहेन्दू वेरिएण उच्छित्तो,निक्खमइ सुरङ्गाए,समय घरिणीए भयभीओ"
english: "The clock is ticking, The reed beds are overflowing with bees, The road is slipping, Time is running out, Fearful housewives!"

prakrit: "एक्कोदराऎ सरणं,पोयणनयरम्मि होहती मज्झं,परिचिन्तिऊण वञ्चइ,सिग्धं तम्बोलियसमग्गो"
english: "One step at a time, Proud lady, If my heart is set on making love, It betrays familiarity, Straightforward as a tablet."

prakrit: "चारयभडेहि रति,सहसा विचासिओ पलायन्तो,भीमोरगेण दट्ठो,सीहेन्दू पोयणासझे"
english: "Traveler, all of a sudden the wretches flee, Behold the buffalo herd, The elephant herd is on the move."

prakrit: "मुच्छाविहलसरीर,खन्धे काऊण दझ्ययं मुद्धा,संपत्ता विलवन्ती,जत्थ मओ अच्छइ समणो"
english: "A broad moustache, bristling cheeks, dazzling bracelets, and a broad smile on her face - that's all right." ""

prakrit: "पडिमं ठियस्स मुणिणो,तस्सा''सन्ने पियं पमोत्तणं,समणस्स फुसइ चलणे,पुणरवि दइयं परामुसइ"
english: "Be nice to each other, be polite, be courteous, be reasonable, and be compassionate."

prakrit: "मुणिपायपसाएणं,सोहेन्दू जीविओ महुच्छाहो,जाओ पियाऎ समय,पणमइ त साहवं तुट्टो"
english: "Bees love your husband, Honey, honey, It's time for a drink, But when the penny is gone, The bow is broken."

prakrit: "अह उग्गयम्मि सूरे,समत्तनियम मुणी विणयदत्तो,अहिवन्दिऊण पुच्छइ,सीहेन्दु महिलियासहियं"
english: "Ah, you naughty girl, That sage sage of Samtaniyam asked without saying a word What he wanted me to say:" "Aunt, I have something to tell you." ""

prakrit: "गन्तूण सावओ सो,कहेइ सिरिवद्धियस्स संदेसं,सबं फुडवियडत्थं,जं भणियं सोहचन्देणं"
english: "Destroy everything, Savo sao," she says, "Tell me the message of prosperity, All in the name of prosperity."

prakrit: "तं सोऊणं रुडो,सहसा सिरिवद्धिओ उ सन्नद्धो,महिलाऎ उवसमं सो,नीओ मुणिपायमलम्मि"
english: "Get up early, make your bedside cry, get ready for the heat of the night." "Woman, you're in a hurry. No need to kneel down."

prakrit: "तं वन्दिऊण समणं,समय भजाऎ तत्थ परितुट्ठो,संभासेइ सिणेहं,साल सिरिवद्धिओ पयओ"
english: "Take it with you, promise to forgive, For when the time has run out You will be forgiven, For the anger of your enemies Will outlive you."

prakrit: "काऊण नरवरिन्दो,पियाइ बन्धूसमागमाणन्दं,निययं तत्थ परभवं,पुच्छइ य मयं महासमणं"
english: "Who is a man of many talents, Who receives pleasure from a friend's company, Who acquires power through good people, Who asks what I value most?"

prakrit: "अह तस्स साहइ मुणी,भदायरिओ ति नाम सोभपुरे,ते वन्दओ नरिन्दो,नाइ सुमालो सह जणेणं"
english: "Ah, sage, brother - in - law! That is the true name of Sobhapure, That is, Vandao Narindo, Not to be confused with Sumalo."

prakrit: "अह तत्थ कुट्ठवाही,महिला मुणिवन्दणाऎ अल्लीणा,अग्घायइ दुग्गन्धं,तीए देहुब्भवं राया"
english: "There she is, ugly girl, Pretending to be swooning over the fire, Hurrying up the stink of burning fuel."

prakrit: "गेहं गए नरिन्दे,भदायरियस्स पायमूलम्मि,सा कुट्टिणी क्याई,घेत्तण सुरालयं पत्ता"
english: "Gone are the days of Narinda, The rough and tumble mother - in - law, Why this little girl? Get her hands dirty."

prakrit: "तत्तो सा चविऊणं,जाया इह सीलरिद्धिसंपन्ना,रूवगुणनोवणधरी,जिणवरधम्मुज्जयमईया"
english: "There she is, Staring at the mirror, Like a treasure chest full of pearls, Blessed with golden jewels."

prakrit: "अह सो सुमालराया,रज्जं दाऊण जेट्टपुत्तस्स,कुणइ चिय संतोस,अट्टहिं गामेहिं ददचित्तो"
english: "Oh! he is handsome, Thinking how lucky he is To have a pair of razors, Doing what makes him happy, Such is the mood of the village."

prakrit: "अट्टहिं गामेहिं निवो,संतुट्ठो सावयत्तणगुणेणं,देवो होऊण चुओ,जाओ सिरिवद्धिओ तुहयं"
english: "Here in this village you live, Satisfied with your hard work, Proud to be a god." ""

prakrit: "जणणी तुज्झ नरवइ!,कहेमि अह पुषजम्मसंबन्धं,एक्को च्चिय वइदेसो,पविसह गार्म छुहासत्तो"
english: "Mother - in - law, you're a man! I tell you, As for the new born, You're the only one who has ever touched a warm person." ""

prakrit: "भोयणहरम्मि भतं,अलहन्तो भणइ कोवपज्जलिओ,सर्व डहामि गाम,तत्तो य विणिग्गओ गामा"
english: "Fearful woman, When he speaks loudly The flames of the fire burn the whole village. So does this weaver's son." ""

prakrit: "विहिसंजोएण तओ,पजलिओ हुयवहेण सो गामो,गामिल्लएहि घेत्तु,छूढो अग्गीऎ सो पहिओ"
english: "Because it is hot, The village is full of puzzles, The villagers surround it, The fire touches it, And the wheels travel on."

prakrit: "मरिऊण समुप्पनो,अह सो सूयारिणी नरवइस्स,तत्तो वि य कालगया,जाया अइवेयणे नरए"
english: "Die, my poor girl, It's only the passage of time That makes you wretched."

prakrit: "नस्याओ समुचरिउं,उप्पन्ना तुज्झ नरवई माया,एसा वि य मित्तनसा,भागवघरिणो सुसीलमई"
english: "Destroy all living beings; above all, you are the mother of men; this, too, is friendship; I am the peaceful wife of the God of Love."

prakrit: "अह पोयणनयरवरे,वणिओ गोहाणिओ ति नामेणं,भुयवत्ता से महिला,मओ य सो ती उत्पन्नो"
english: "Ah, lovely lady, tell me, you fool, What makes you think she's a woman?"

prakrit: "जायस्स उ भुयवत्ता,रइवद्धणकामिणी गुणविसाला,अह गद्दभाइपीडा,पुरभारुबहणय चेव"
english: "Jealousy is the nature of love, Virtuous is the virtue of a virtuous wife, Compassion is the poison of falsehood, Purabharu is the weapon of deceit."

prakrit: "एयं मओ कहेउं,गयणेण गओ नहिच्छियं देसं,सिरिवद्धिओ य राया,पोयणनयरं अह पविट्ठो"
english: "Tell me, my dear, singing isn't what I want to sing about. It's the streets that are empty. I'm pious about money." ""

prakrit: "पुण्णोदएण सेणिय!,कस्स वि रज नरस्स उवणमइ,तं चेव उ विवरीयं,हवइह सुकयावसाणम्मि"
english: "Army of rebirth!, To whomsoever the Narsa may be addressed, There must be something very special about it: It is the dry air of the forest." ""

prakrit: "एकस्स कस्स वि गुरू,लधुणं धम्मसंगमो होइ,अन्नस्स गई अहमा,जायइ सनियाणदोसेणं"
english: "Anyone can be a guru, A laddu must be a dharma sangam, Food must be eaten, And pride must be consumed."

prakrit: "एवं नाऊण सया,कायचं बुहनणेण अप्पहियं,जे होइ मरणकाले,सिवसोग्गइमग्गदसयरं"
english: "And I will never forget how, at the moment of my death, I shook my head In gratitude for what I had to say."

prakrit: "एवं दया-दम-तओट्टियसंजमस्स,सोउं जणो मयमहामुणिभासियत्थं,सामन्त-सेट्ठिसहिओ सिरिवद्धिओ सो,धम्म करेह विमलामलदेहलम्भ"
english: "And pity - Dum - Tautiya Samjamas, Those who bow before me in great ecstasy, Like feudal lords rising up early, Perform dharma - Vimalamaldehlambha."

prakrit: "इइ पउमचरिए मयवक्खाणं नाम सत्तहत्तरं पञ्वं समत्तं"
english: "This is the name of the blessed mother -in - law: Seventy five hundred and fifty."

prakrit: "भत्तार-सुयविओगे,एगन्तेणेव दुक्खिया भवणे,अवराइया पलोयइ,दस वि दिसाओ सुदीणमुही"
english: "Traveler - You'll fall asleep, Then the miser will rise again, And the traveler will flee, But even in ten directions she will face the sun."

prakrit: "पुत्तस्स दरिसणं सा,कङ्खन्ती ताव पेच्छइ गवस्खे,उप्पयनिवयकरेन्त,एक चिय वायसं सहसा"
english: "My boy, She looks at me all the time, Her cheeks quivering, Her lips moving, Like a sudden burst of excitement."

prakrit: "तं भणइ वायसं सा,जइ मे पुत्तस्स तत्थ गन्तूणं,वत्तं आणेहि लहूं,देहामि य पायर्स तुज्झ"
english: "She says,'It's your turn.'If my son goes there, it's his turn. I'll bring him. The pyre is yours to keep." ""

prakrit: "एव भणिऊण तो सा,सुमरिय पुत्स्स बहुगुणं चरियं,कुणइ पलावं कलुणं,मुश्चन्ती अंसुजलनिवहं"
english: "If you say so, she is a virtuous daughter - in - law; her talents are many and her husband is poor; she runs away in distress And is reduced to tears."

prakrit: "हा वच्छ! कत्थ देसे,कोमलकर-चरण! कक्खडे पन्थे,परिसक्कसि सीया-''यव-दुहिओ घरिणीए समसहिओ"
english: "Ah! the calf! How desolate, How tender - footed! Wherever you may wander -" "Trouble for the young and miserly housewife!" ""

prakrit: "मोत्तण मन्दभम्गा,चिरकालं पुत्त! पवसिओ सि तुम,'इअ दुहियं नियनणणिं,सुविणे वि ममं न संभरसि"
english: "Mortally wounded, my son, you will live forever." "These two must make up your mind. Even I can't remember what I said."

prakrit: "एयाणि य अन्नाणि य,पलवन्ती जाव चिट्टए देवी,ताव य गयणयलाओ,ओइण्णो नारओ सहसा"
english: "It's Anna, the flower seller's daughter, The goddess of fairies, And he or she is a singer's son. Suddenly people shout" ""

prakrit: "सेयम्बरपरिहाणो,दोहजडामउडधारिणो भयवं,पविसइ ससंभमाए,अम्भुट्टाणं कयं तीए"
english: "The apple tree is gone, The doe is afraid of the woodpecker, The grasshopper is asleep, What is she to do with the nectar?"

prakrit: "दिन्नासणोवविट्ठो,पेच्छइ अवराइयं पगलियंसुं,काऊण समुल्लावं,पुच्छइ किं दुम्मणा सि तुमं?"
english: "You silly girl, You stare at everyone else's face, You fool, Why are you so angry?"

prakrit: "एव भणियाऎ तो सो,देवरिसी पुच्छिओ कहिं देसे,कालं गमिऊण इह,समागओ? साहसु फुडं मे"
english: "So what do you mean," "Where are you going?" "Ask the God of Love, Time will tell."

prakrit: "अह नारओ पवुत्तो,कल्लाणं आसि धायईसण्डे,पुबिल्ले सुररमणे,नयरे तित्थंकरो जाओ"
english: "Oh! my poor girl, Tomorrow at noon You'll find a good man. Never mind the loud noises."

prakrit: "सुर-असुरेहि नगवरे,कीरन्तो निणवरस्स अभिसेओ,दिट्ठो मए पमोओ,भावेण य वन्दिओ भयवं"
english: "Be nice to each other, Be courteous, Be attentive, Always be vigilant, Always treat me with kindness And never be afraid to speak your mind."

prakrit: "जिणदरिसणाइसत्तो,गमिउं तेवीस तत्थ वासाई,जणणि व भरहभूमि,सरिऊण इहा''गओ अहयं"
english: "As long as I remain alive, Goes the saying:" "There must be another man." "As for me, my husband is at hand And I am at hand."

prakrit: "अह तं भणइ सुभणिया,महरिसि! निमुणेहि दुक्खसंभूई,जं पुच्छिया तुमे हं,तं ते साहेमि भूयत्थं"
english: "Oh! she speaks well of you, my dear! Your face opens wide with sorrow. What you ask me is my true nature." ""

prakrit: "भामण्डलसंनोगे,पंधइए दसरहे सह भडेहिं,रामो पियाऎ समय,विणिग्गओ लक्खणसमग्गो"
english: "Foolish people, The Pandyas quarrelled with each other on Dussehra. Rama was drunk at the time. The Vindhya is full of faults."

prakrit: "सोयाऎ अवहियाए,जाओ सह कइवरेहि संजोगो,लकाहिवेण पहओ,सत्तीए लक्खणो समरे"
english: "To fall asleep is to be avoided, To go on with you Is to get into trouble, To travel in search of happiness, To suffer seventy thousand symptoms."

prakrit: "लकापुरि विसल्ला,नीया वि हु लक्खणस्स जीयत्थे,एवं ते परिकहियं,सर्व संखेवओ तुझं"
english: "Lakapuri Visalla, Neeya is still alive in Lakshmanas, And he is gone. Everything you see belongs to you." ""

prakrit: "तत्थ'च्छइ वहदेही,बन्दी अइदुक्खिया पइविहूणा,सत्तिपहाराभिहओ,किं व मओ लक्खणकुमारो?"
english: "There she is, The captive widow, The unhappy husband, Struggling for power: How is it, my poor son?" ""

prakrit: "ते अज्ज वि एह न वी,वत्ता संपरिफुडा मह एयं,सुमरन्तियाऎ हियए,सोगमहादारुणं जाय"
english: "Not so much today, my dear, As all the tears in my eyes Forgiveness's sake." ""

prakrit: "सुणिण क्यणमेयं,अकाओ घत्तिऊण वरवीणं,जाओ उबिम्गमणो,दीहुस्सासे मुयइ विप्पो"
english: "Listening to what's being said, Wrapped up in a bangle, Goose pimples, Sighs and twists." ""

prakrit: "भणिया य नारएणं,भद्दे! छड्डेहि दारुणं सोगं,तव पुत्तस्स असेस,गन्तूणा''णेमि वत्तमहं"
english: "Foolish girl, you're not supposed to cry! It's only your son who has to go." "I'm off"

prakrit: "एव भणिउं पयट्टो,वीणा कक्खन्तरे ठवेऊणं,उप्प नहयलेणं,लङ्का पत्तो खणद्धणं"
english: "Say this :'Traveler, weep on the harp, bathe in salt, pluck the leaves of the chilli.'"" "

prakrit: "हियएण मुणइ विप्पो,जइ वत्ता राहवस्स पुच्छे'हं,तो मे कयाइ दोसं,काहिन्ति निसायरा पावा"
english: "If he asks the wayfarer," "Is it my fault?" "He replies," It is my fault. "

prakrit: "ताए चिय वेलाए,पउमसरे अङ्गओ सह पियाहिं,कोलइ जलमजणयं,गउ छ समयं करेग्र̥हि"
english: "That's why I am so thirsty, My limbs are swollen, I am thirsty for water. Time is running out for me."

prakrit: "सो रावणस्स कुसलं,पुच्छन्तो अङ्गयस्स भिच्चेहिं,नीओ पउमसंयासं,दहगोवहिओ त्ति काऊणं"
english: "So what is the use of cursing Ravana? When he asks what he wants done, The monk replies:" No, it's your own fault. But don't hurt the cow - dung cakes. "" "

prakrit: "अब्बंभणं करेन्तो,आसासेऊण पउमणाहेणं,परिपुच्छिओ य अजय! साह तुम आगओ कत्तो?"
english: "You startled woman, Expecting a kiss from your husband. Please, Ajay! Where are you going?" ""

prakrit: "सो भणइ देव! निसुणसु,सुयसोगाणलपलितहिययाए,जणणोऎ तुज्झ पास,विसजिओ नारओ अहयं"
english: "He says," "My God!" "Calm down. Your lips are silly And your cheeks are sunken." "With you, my dear, tell me the name of the poisoner."

prakrit: "सीही किसोररहिया,कलहयपरिवज्जिया करेणु छ,तह सा तुज्झ विओगे,अञ्चन्तं दुक्खिया जणणी"
english: "A jealous wife, With quarrels and quarrels to sort out, Will desert you, Such a miserly wife."

prakrit: "विवइण्णकेसभारा,रोवन्ती दुक्खिया गमइ कालं,जणणी तुज्झ महाजस!,सोगमहासागरे पडिया"
english: "Dear wife, The time is running out For your husband! He has fallen into an ocean of grief." ""

prakrit: "लक्खण! तुम पि जणणो,पुत्तविओगम्मिंदीवियसरीरा,रोवन्ती अइकलुणं,कालं चिय दुक्खिया गमइ"
english: "Dear girl, You're the only one who gives birth. Your husband is still alive, And you're still crying. Time, dear friend, has passed." ""

prakrit: "ना''हारे न य संयणे,न दिवा न य सबरीसु न पसे,खणमवि न उवेन्ति घिई,अञ्चन्तं तुम्ह जणणीओ"
english: "No, you are not to be trifled with, Not to be seduced by a lamp or a beauty or a fancy. But do not be alarmed: Fear not, my dear." ""

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,हलहर-नारायणा सुदीणमुहा,रोक्न्ता उबसमिया,कह कह वि पवंगमभडेहिं"
english: "Listen to the lilting wind, Make sure the plowman has a pleasant face, Stop the loud trumpet caller, And tell him how to play the flute."

prakrit: "तो भणइ नारयं सो,पउमो अइसुन्दरं ववसिय ते,वत्तादाणेण'हं,जणणीणं जीवियं दिन्नं"
english: "So she says:" "My daughter - in - law, You look so beautiful And you look so handsome." "With a sigh Of relief, He says :'Yes, I will give life to my wife.'"

prakrit: "सो चेव सुकयपुण्णो,पुरिसो जो कुणइ अभिगओ विणयं,जणणीण अप्पमत्तो,आणावयणं अलवन्तो"
english: "So you dry up, you fool, The man who paints a pattern, Weaves a weave, Brings pleasure to a wife, Performs ablutions."

prakrit: "जणणीण कुसलवत्तं,सोऊणं राम-लक्खणा तुट्ठा,पूयन्ति नारय ते,समय विज्जाहरभडेहिं"
english: "Women wear white, men wear black, women wear red, men flaunt them, and women wear white. Time has proved elusive."

prakrit: "एयन्तरम्मि पउमो,बिभीसणं भणइ सुहडसामक्खं,अम्हे साएयपुरी,भद्द! अवस्सेण गन्तबं"
english: "Here comes the housewife, The confusion begets pleasantries, And here comes the nasty one:" "Destruction by accident!" ""

prakrit: "सुयसोगाणलतवियाण ताण जणणीण तत्थ गन्तूणं,दरिसणजलेण अम्हे,णिव वियबाई अगाई"
english: "Suicide is the path to eternal bliss. But if I give in to it, It is only through water That I attain enlightenment."

prakrit: "काऊण सिरपणामं,विभोसणो भणइ सुणसु वयणं मे,राहव! सोलस दियहा,अच्छेयब महं भवणे"
english: "" "Who's the headman? Be delirious. Listen to me when I speak: Rahav! It's only the day of judgment. It will be better for me" ")."

prakrit: "अन्नं पि सामि! निसुणसु,पडिवत्ताकारणेण साएए,पेसिज्जन्ति नरुत्तम!,दूया भरहस्स तूरन्ता"
english: "Food is dear to me! Don't be alarmed, my dear, For all the trouble you're having is getting lost in the mud." "Your heart is bursting with anger."

prakrit: "राहववयणेण तओ,दूया संपेसिया तुरियवेगा,गन्तूण पणमिऊण य,भरहस्स कहन्ति पडिवत्तं"
english: "Because of Rahavavyāna, The arrow will pierce the pen, And because of Gātuna the bow will bend," Says the swordsman. "" "

prakrit: "पत्तो हलं समुसलं,रामो चक्कं च लक्खणो धोरो,निहओ लहाहिवई,'सीयाऎ समागमो जाओ"
english: "The leaf is a bunch of plums, The thread marks the tip of the ram's wheel, And the elephant says," "Here goes the fair." ""

prakrit: "अह बन्धणाउ मुक्का,इन्दइपमुहा भडा उ पबइया,लद्धाओ गरुड-केसरिविजाओ राम-चक्कीणं"
english: "Ah, the bracelets on the bangle, The buffalo faces the doe, The elephant fights, The girdle is tied, And the lance is twisted Around the ram's neck."

prakrit: "जाया बिभीसणेणं,समयं च निरन्तरां महापीई,लकापुरीऎ रज्ज,कुणन्ति बल-केसवा मुइया"
english: "Where there is division, Time is perpetually great, The razor of the lac, Purified by nature, Deceives the hair of the tasty."

prakrit: "एवं राघव-लक्षण-रिद्धी,सुणिऊण हरिसिओ भरहो,तम्बोल-सुगन्धाइसु द्र̥ए पूएइ विभवेणं"
english: "And Raghava - the symptom - riddhi, When one hears it, One is filled with ecstasy, When the scent of the tambola fills the whole body With its fragrance."

prakrit: "घेत्तण तओ दूए,भरहो जणणीणमुवगओ मूलं,सुयसोगदुक्खियाणं,कहेन्ति वत्ता अपरिसेसा"
english: "Being angry is one thing, being jealous is another, Being possessive is something else, Suicide is something more," They say, laughing hysterically.

prakrit: "सोऊण कुसलवत्ता,सुयाण अभिणन्दियाउ नणणीओ,ताव य अन्ने वि बहू,नयरी विज्जाहरा पत्ता"
english: "Blessed is the daughter-in-law, Lovely are the women who make love, Yet without a daughter - in - law, A woman lacks wisdom."

prakrit: "अह ते गयणयलत्था,बिभीसणाणाए खेयरा सधे,मुञ्चन्ति रयणवुढेइ,घरे घरे तीऎ नयरीए"
english: "Oh! she sang so much, Played so much in a row, Wrapped herself in braids, Goes from door to door Without saying a word." ""

prakrit: "अह तत्थ पुरवरीए,विजाहरसिप्पिएसु दक्खेसु,सयलभवणाण भूमी,उवलिता रयणकणएणं"
english: "Ah! the full moon of the sky, See how the sky above you widens, The land of subtlety, Seems to blossom Like a rainbow."

prakrit: "जिणवरभवणाणि बहू,सिग्धं चिय निम्मियाई तुङ्गाई,पासायसहस्साणि य,अट्ठावयसिहरसरिसाई"
english: "The daughter - in - law is content in living, The headman is straight, The waistman is short, The husband is busy making ends meet, And the wife is always busy making love."

prakrit: "वरकणयथम्भपउरा,वित्थिण्णा मण्डवा रयणचित्ता,रइया समन्तओ वि य,विजयपडागासु रमणिब्जा"
english: "The bridegroom stands tall, The bedchamber is wide, The nights are stormy, And the street is deserted." ""

prakrit: "कवणरयणमयाई,मोतियमालाउलाई विउलाई,रेहन्ति तोरणाई,दिसासु सबासु रमाई"
english: "Kavanarayanmayi, motimalamalai viulai, rehanti thoranai, disasu sabasu ramayi."

prakrit: "सुरवहभवणसमेहुँ,लग्गा ण्हवणुसवा निगहरेसु,नडनट्टगीयवाइय-रवेण अभिणन्दिया अहियं"
english: "In a pleasant mood, Look at the freshly squeezed eyelid, I'm completely at ease With my dancing partner's expression." ""

prakrit: "तरुतरुणपाल्चुग्गय नाणाविहकुसुमगन्धपउराई,छज्जन्ति उपवणाई,कोइलभमरोवगीयाई"
english: "A flock of parrots falls from a rafter's cudgel, Like a bunch of peacock's tail feathers Slipping off its tip." ""

prakrit: "वावीसु दीहियासु य,कमलप्पलपुण्डरीयछन्नासु,जिणवरभवणेसु पुणो,रेहद सा पुरवरी अहियं"
english: "Wretched day, Long live the lotus flower girl, Life returns to you with renewed vigor, For behold, I have reached my full potential."

prakrit: "एवं साएयपुरी,सुरनयरिसमा कया दणुवईहिं,रामस्स समक्खाया,अहियं गमणुस्सुयमणस्स"
english: "And what do you mean, my poor girl, You have given birth to a son - in - law? A promise made to Rama:" "I have reached my goal." ""

prakrit: "अचिन्तियं सयलमुवेइ सोभणं,नरस्स तं मुकयफलस्स संगमे,अहो जणा! कुणह तवं सुसंतयं,नहा सुहं विमलयर निसेवह"
english: "How strange it is to think that the sky is blue, That the fire is red with the fruit of one's mouth, Oh man! Life is transient in such a way, Never mind how fleeting it may be." ""

prakrit: "इइ पउमचरिए साएयपुरोव गणं नाम अट्ठहत्तरं पव्वं समत्त"
english: "This is the seventy-eighth month of my husband's reign." ""

prakrit: "अह सोलसमे दियहे,कओवयारा पभायसमयम्मि,राहव-सोमित्ति-सिया पुप्फविमाण समारूढा"
english: "Oh! daylight in solace! The cowherd is always busy making love, And the traveler is always late - Such is the business of flying kites."

prakrit: "सबे वि खेयरभडा,विमाण रह गय-तुरङ्गमारूढा,रामेण समं चलिया,साएयपुरी नयलेणं"
english: "Everything is a mess, The plane has left - Turang Marudha, Running parallel to Rama, Silly girl!"

prakrit: "पउमइसन्निविद्या,पुच्छइ सोया पई अइमहन्तं,जम्बुद्दीवस्स ठियं,मझे किं दीसए एयं"
english: "You fool," asked the girl, "Are you really asleep? Wait a minute, you fool, What do you expect from me?"

prakrit: "पउमेण पिया भणिया,एत्य जिणा सुरवरेसु अहिसित्ता,मेरू नाम नगवरो,बहुरयणवलन्तसिहरोहो"
english: "Proud lady, Pia bhania, Yet you live in such a way That you produce no pleasure at all. Meru naam nagavroo, Long live the brave."

prakrit: "जलहरपन्भारनिर्भ,नाणाविहरुक्खकुसुमफलपउरं,एयं दण्डारणं,जत्थ तुम अवहिया भद्दे!"
english: "Water - laden with love, With spiky blossoms of nectar, This is the punishment You deserve, Wherever you are impatiently sulking!"

prakrit: "एसा वि य कण्णरवा,महानई विमलसलिलकल्लोला,जीसे तडम्मि साहू,सुन्दरि! पडिलाहिया य तुमे"
english: "Such a lovely girl, Such a great lily of the lotus, Such an elegant woman, So beautiful! You're the one who has fallen." ""

prakrit: "एसो दीसइ सुन्दरि!,वंसहरी जत्थ मुणिवरिन्दाणं,कुल-देसभूसणाणं,केवलनाणं समुप्पन्न"
english: "Such is the beauty of the day!, Like the rustle of emeralds, Like a bunch of peacock's tail - feathers, Only the name matches." ""

prakrit: "भवणुज्जाणसमिद्धं,एवं तं कुब्बर पिए! नयरं,इह वसइ वालिखिल्लो,अणओ कल्लाणमालाए"
english: "Come with me, you fool, And drink that kubbar! Nay, it lives in the hollow of the wall. Call it the garland of stones." ""

prakrit: "एवं पि पेच्छ भद्दे!,दसण्णनयरं नहिं कुलिसयन्नो,राया अणन्नदिट्ठी,वववतिपिया परिवसइ"
english: "And then you look at me! You bastard! Don't touch me if you don't want to. Stop staring at me If you can't see me. It's like walking around in circles." ""

prakrit: "तत्तो वि वइकन्ता,भणइ पियं नणयनन्दिणी एसा,दीसइ पुरी पहाणा,कवणा सुरनयरिसंठाणा"
english: "Then too vaikanta, saying:" "Dear friend, this is the way of a good hostess." ""

prakrit: "भणिया य राहवेणं,सुन्दरि! एसा महं हिययइट्टा,विजाहरकयभूसा,साएयपुरी मणभिरामा"
english: "Daughter - in - law, Rahven, you beauty! Such is my heart, Victory - wearing garland, Such is the beauty of pure heart." ""

prakrit: "दह्रण समासन्ने,पुप्फविमाणं ससंभमो भरहो,निष्फडइ गयारूढो बलसहिओ अहिमुह सिग्धं"
english: "In the thick of the fire, The smoke from the fire Fills the whole room." "The roads are impassable But the non - violent arrows are straightforward."

prakrit: "दट्टण य एजन्तं,भरहं भडचडगरेण पउमाभो,ठावेइ घरणिवट्टे,पुप्फविमाणं तओइण्णो"
english: "Because it is thick, I will go to my husband with a loud bang, Sit at home alone, Wait till I see him again While blowing on the wind."

prakrit: "भरहो मत्तगयाओ,ओयरिउं नमइ सहरिसो सिग्धं,रामेण लक्खणेण य,अवगूढो तिघनेहेणं"
english: "Get drunk, get drunk, bow down and worship the town straightaway. Rama is worthy of being praised. He is incomparable to all three."

prakrit: "संभासिएक्कमेक्का,पुप्फविमाणं पुणो वि आरूढा,पविसन्ति कोसलं ते,विज्जाहरसुहडपरिकिण्णा"
english: "Take care, sweetheart, Don't overdo it again. It's like learning a new skill While you're asleep." ""

prakrit: "रह-गय-तुरङ्गमेहिं,संघटुट्टेन्तनोहनिवहेहिं,पविसन्तेहि निरुद्धं,गयणयलं महियलं नयरं"
english: "The roads are impassable, The streets are deserted, The rivers are overflowing with people Stuck in the mud, And the rivers are swollen."

prakrit: "भेरी-मुइङ्ग-तिलिमा-काल-सलाउलाई,घणरवाई,चारणगन्धवमीसाई"
english: "Fishing - Mooing - Tilima - Time - Salalai, thicket, Prey - The smell of pastures."

prakrit: "गय-तुरयहेसिएणं,तूरनिणाएण बन्दिसदेणं,न सुणंति एक्कमेकं,उल्लावं कण्णवडियं पि"
english: "You fool, Don't stop because you're not sure how to smile. You stupid bitch, You bastard who won't listen to each other."

prakrit: "एवं महिड्डिजुत्ता,हलहर-नारायणा निवइमम्गे,वच्चन्ते नयरजणो आढत्तो पेच्छिउं सबो"
english: "And the great flame, The plowman's son - in - law's wife, Is dying. Everyone looks on While the fireman is away." ""

prakrit: "नायरवहूहि सिग्धं,भवणगवक्खा निरन्तरा छन्ना,रेहन्ति वयणपतय-सराण रुद्धा व उद्देसा"
english: "The naïve wife is straightforward, the haughty daughter - in - law is constantly on the loose, The husband is always on his toes, And her intentions are pure."

prakrit: "अह कोउएण तुरिया,अन्ना अन्न करेण पेल्लेउं,पेच्छन्ति पणदणीओ,पउमं नारायणसमेयं"
english: "Ah! the crows are trumpeting, Anna wants to eat, The women are singing, The husband is angry And the wife is angry."

prakrit: "अन्नोना भणइ सही! सीयासहिओ इमो पउमणाहो,लच्छीहरो वि एसो,हवइ विसल्लाऎ साहीणो"
english: "He's right! It's true, my dear. Even a stray dog can get away with it. The wind is blowing thick and fast." ""

prakrit: "सुग्गीवमहाराया,एसो वि य अङ्गओ वरकुमारो,भामण्डलो य हणुवो,नलो य नीलो सुसेणो य"
english: "Auspicious mother - in - law, Such a limb is the lotus of the bridegroom, Such is the beauty of the field, For blue is the essence of a stream."

prakrit: "एए अन्ने य बहू,चन्दोयरनन्दणाइया सुहडा,पेच्छ हला! देवा इव,महिड्डिया रूवसंपन्ना"
english: "Oh! my daughter - in - law, The pleasures of the moonlight Are over for the moment! Like a god, A jeweler has acquired a fortune." ""

prakrit: "एवं ते पउमाई,पेच्छिज्जन्ता य नायरजणेणं,संपत्ता रायघरं,लुलियचलुच्चलणधयसोहं"
english: "And there it is, the housewife's daughter - in - law's husband, Looking out for the poor gentleman's son, Staring at the empty house, Lulling with excitement."

prakrit: "सा पेच्छिऊण पुत्ते,घराउ अवराइया समोइण्णा,अह केकई वि देवी,सोमिती केगया चेव"
english: "She looks after her son, At home she treats him as husband, And at home as wife." ""

prakrit: "अन्नं भवन्तरं पिव,पत्ताओ पुत्तदंसणं ताओ,बहुमङ्गलुज्जयाओ,ठियाउ ताणं समासन्ने"
english: "Food should be eaten first, then leaves, then sight should be given to the child, then long - eyed people should be welcomed, then things should settle down."

prakrit: "आलोइऊण ताओ,अवइण्णा पुप्फयाउ तूरन्ता,सयलपरिवारसहिया,अह ते जणणीओ पणमन्ति"
english: "Come on, you silly girl, Stop your husband from hanging out with us, Stop playing pranks on our husbands, And settle down with our families."

prakrit: "सुयदरिसणुस्सुगाहिं,ताहि वि आसासिया सिणेहेणं,परिचुम्बिया य सीसे,पुणो पुणो राम-सोमित्ती"
english: "The pleasures of love, Even so, Seems to be fleeting, Like finding love Once more, Like seeing Rama again."

prakrit: "पण्हुयपओहराओ,जायाओ पुत्तसंगमे ताओ,पुलइयरोमञ्चीओ,तोसेण य वीरजणणीओ"
english: "Praise be to the arrows of the God of Love, To go and play with children, To pull the strings of warriors. For with them brave women are born."

prakrit: "दिन्नासणोवविट्ठा,समयं जणणीहि राम-सोगित्ती,नाणाकहासु सत्ता,चिट्ठन्ति तहिं परमतुट्टा"
english: "The nights are long, Time flies, Rama is angry, The coin tosses, The powers that be Scream the same."

prakrit: "जं सुविऊण विउज्झई,जं च पउत्थस्स दरिसणं होई,जं मुच्छिओ वि जोवइ,किं न हु अच्छेरयं एयं"
english: "That which is seeped in by a needle, Which is pierced through by a tooth, Which, even with a clenched fist, Fills the air, Is not good enough?"

prakrit: "चिरपवसिओ वि दोसइ,चिरपडिलग्गो वि निबुइं कुणह,बन्धणगओ विमुच्चइ,सय त्ति झीणा कहा लोए"
english: "Even an old cow gives birth, Even a parrot by the skin of its head Dies, And a hostage is snatched from its feet. Where then, Mr Jinnah, Is it said?" ""

prakrit: "एक्को वि कओ नियमो,पावइ अच्चन्भुयं महामुरलच्छि,तम्हा करेह विमलं,धम्मं तित्थंकराण सिवसुहफलयं"
english: "One can make any number of rules, For they are extremely powerful, For their action is bound to cause resentment, And the attainment of dharma is the fruit of eternal bliss."

prakrit: "इइ पउमरिए राम-लक्खगःसमागमविहाणं नाम एगूणासीयं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "This is the path to purity: Rama and Lakshmibai: Together we shall overcome all obstacles, For one thing purity prevails over all."

prakrit: "पुणरवि नमिऊण मुणिं,पुच्छइ सिरिवित्थरं मगहराया,हलहर-सोमित्तीणं,कहेइ साहू समासेणं"
english: "When he calls her again she rebukes him, When he asks her what she craves most She turns her back on him, And tells him:" "Your husband is dead." ""

prakrit: "निसुणेहि सेणिय! तुम,हलहर-नारायणाणुभावेणं,नन्दावत्तनिवेसं,बहुदारं गोउरं चेव"
english: "Silly warrior! You, plowman - In the spirit of Narayan, Stop wasting your time in the nondescript village, Like a herd of cows in distress." ""

prakrit: "सुरभवणसमं गेह,खिइसारो नाम हवइ पायारो,मेरुस्स चूलिया इव,तह य सभा वेजयन्ती य"
english: "Travel to a pleasant place, For someone whose name is familiar, Traveler, Merus, like a stove, So goes the festival of feasts."

prakrit: "साला य विउलसोहा,चक्कमिणं हवइ सुविहिनामेणं,गिरिकूड पासायं,तुङ्ग अवलोयणं चेव"
english: "Aunt, It's sunny outside, The wind blows nicely, The grasshopper is passing by, You better take care of yourself."

prakrit: "नामेण वद्धमाणं,चित्तं पेच्छाहरं गिरिसरिच्छं,कुक्कुडअण्डाक्यवं,कूई गम्भग्गिहं रम्मं"
english: "By name I mean wisdom; by mind I mean the scent of emeralds; by cucumber the action of the eyes; by water the play of the bow."

prakrit: "कप्पतरुसमं दिवं,एगत्थम्भं च हवइ पासायं,तस्स पुण सबओ च्चिय,ठियाणि देवीण भवणाई"
english: "The day is dark when full of clouds, The wind blows from here to there, And then everything goes wrong. The goddess told her to stay." ""

prakrit: "अह सीहवाहीणी विय,सेज्जा हरविट्ठरं दिणयराभं,ससिकिरणसन्निभाई,चमराई मउयफरिसाइं"
english: "Ah! the jealous wife! Every part of her body Goes through the ordeal. My brother - in - law goes through it All. The jasmine keeps her distance."

prakrit: "वेरुलियविमलदण्डं,छत्तं ससिसनिहं सुहच्छायं,विसमोइयाउ गयणं लङ्घन्ती पाउयाओ य"
english: "A flock of parrots hangs from the rafters, The roof is bare, And the cowgirl's skirt is limp." ""

prakrit: "वन्थाइ अणग्धाइं,दिवाई चेव भूसणवराई,दुन्भिज्ज चिय कवयं,मणिकुण्डलजुवलयं कन्तं"
english: "The forest fires are inexhaustible, The lamp burns bright, The fire burns hot, And the fire burns bitter."

prakrit: "खग्गं गया य चकं,कणयारिसिलीमुहा वि य अमोहा,विविहाइ महत्थाई,अन्नाणि वि एवं मादीणि"
english: "The cycle has passed, The silly face of the bridegroom is immaterial, The vows are great, And so are the vows."

prakrit: "पन्नाससहस्साई,कोडीणं साहणस्स परिमाणं,एक्का य हवइ कोडी,अब्भहिया पवरघेणूर्ण"
english: "Fifty is a thousand, a spade is the measure of courage, a breeze is the spade, an abyss is the weight of pride."

prakrit: "सत्तरि कुलकोडीओ,अहियाउ कुड्डुम्बियाण जेट्टाणं,साएयपुरवरीए,वसन्ति धणरयणपुण्णाओ"
english: "Seventy kulkadis, Here's the jettison of kudumbiyas, Like women with long hair Who settle down to brush their teeth."

prakrit: "कहलाससिहरसरिसोवमाइ भवणाइ ताण सेवाणं,बलय-गवा महिसीहिं,समाउलाई सुरम्माई"
english: "To say that summer is hot Is to say that winter is long, to speak of autumn is to say nothing of it; it is the joys of summer."

prakrit: "पोक्खरिणिदीहियासु य,आरामुज्जाणकाणणसमिद्धा,जिणवरघरेसु रम्मा,देवपुरी चेव साएया"
english: "The pleasures of love, Like the pleasure of seeing a woman's face, Are immutable Only in the household of God."

prakrit: "जिणवरभवणाणि तहिं रामेणं कारियाणि बहुयाणि,हरिसेणेण व तइया,भवियनणाणंदयकराई"
english: "When Rama came home, He made his wife very happy; When he left, She made him very happy." ""

prakrit: "गाम-पुर-खेड-कबड-नयरी सा पट्टणाण मज्झत्था,इन्दपुरी व कया सा,साएया रामदेवेणं"

prakrit: "बहुतूरनिणाएणं,नयसदुग्घुटमङ्गलरवेणं,अहिनन्दिया पविठ्ठा,राहवभवण सुरपुरामं"
english: "Long - eyed woman, With eyes wide open, With feet clinging to the mangalsutra, With hands clutching the sanctum sanctorum, Lovely woman."

prakrit: "ओयरिय वाहणाणं,उवविद्या''हारमण्डवं सके,पडिलाहिऊण साहु,परियणसहिया तओ निमिया"
english: "Wretched carriage, poor learning," "Can make a garland of garlands, Sighs the plowman's son, Depends on the husband's hand." ""

prakrit: "ताव य मगहनराहिवं,सवे मंती समागया तत्थ,काऊण सिरपणाम,राहव! निसुणेहि वयण'हं"
english: "" "There you are, proud elephant, Meeting all the bees There, Bowing your head!" "With a sigh The hunter replies:" "No!"

prakrit: "जत्तो पभूइ सामिय!,खुभिऊणं सो समागओ हत्थी,तत्तो पभूह गाद,झायइ किं किं पि हियएणं"
english: "As soon as you touch it, Samia! When you kiss it, You shake it, Then you rub it. Whatever you want to hear It's a lie."

prakrit: "ऊससिऊण सुदीहं,निमीलियच्छो करेण महिवेढं,आहणइ धुणइ सीस,पुणरवि चिन्तावरो होइ"
english: "It's nice to be dry, it's pleasant to be wet, It makes you sweat, And it makes you think again."

prakrit: "थुवन्तो चिय कवलं,न य गेण्हइ निठुर पि भण्णन्तो,झायइ थम्भनिसण्णो,करेण दसणं च वेढेउं"
english: "If you spit, I'll bite you. If you yawn, you won't hear me: If you groan, you'd better shake your head."

prakrit: "लेप्पमओ इव सुहरं,चिट्ठइ सो अचलियङ्गपञ्चङ्गो,किं जीवपरिग्गहिओ,होज न होज? ति संदेहो"
english: "Leppamu is so beautiful, She writes so eloquently, So are the five limbs immovable, Or is it the nature of the soul? Is it doubtful?" ""

prakrit: "मन्तेहि ओसहेहि य,वेजपउत्तेहि तस्स सब्भावो,न य लक्खिज्जइ सामिय!,अहियं वियणाउरो सो उ"
english: "It's the same as mine, The same as yours, Not noticeable at all, Sammy!" exclaimed the weeping farmer.

prakrit: "संगीययं पि न सुणइ,न य कुणइ धिई सरे ण सेजासु,न य गामे न य रणे,आहारे नेव पाणे य"
english: "She doesn't listen to anyone, Doesn't act rashly, Has no sense of humour, Lives in the village or forest, Does not eat food or drink water."

prakrit: "एयावत्थसरीरो,बट्टइ तेलोक्कमण्डणो हत्थी,अम्हेहि तुज्म सिट्ठो,तस्स उवायं पहू कुणसु"
english: "Come, you fool, The palm of our hand is greased with oil, And here you are, Sitting astride us. Make your arms twine around it."

prakrit: "एवं महामन्तिगिरं सुणे,ठिया विचिन्ता बल-चक्कपाणी,बंपन्ति तेलोकविभूसणेणं,हीणं असेस विमलं पि रजं"
english: "And listen to the loud clamor, The thunder of thunder, The crashing of the cauldron, The trembling of the lotus - Even Vimalam is worthless as a king."

prakrit: "इइ पउमचरिए भुवणालंकारसल्लविहाणं नाम एकासीयं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "This is the name of the God of Love, The One and Only, The Supreme Being."

prakrit: "एयन्तरंमि सेणिय!,महामुणी देसभूसणो नाम,कुलभूसणो त्ति बीओ,सुर-असुरनमंसिओ भयवं"
english: "Here I am, soldier! The great woman is the name of Desabhusana, The great wife is that of Kula Bhusana. Sura - Asura - The man is to be feared." ""

prakrit: "जाणं वंसनगवरे,पडिमं चउराणणं उवगयाणं,जणिओ चिय उवसग्गो,पुनरिवूणं सुरवरेणं"
english: "Gone are the dynasties, The poor have grown wretched, The wealthy have grown thin, The rich have grown wealthy Again."

prakrit: "रामेण लक्खणेण य,ताण कए तत्थ पाडिहेरम्मि,सयलजगुज्जोयकर,केवलनाणं समुप्पन्नं"
english: "Rama is worthy of respect, That is why I went there, Wretched coward, Only my name will be remembered."

prakrit: "तुट्टेण जक्खवइणा,दिन्नो य वरो महागुणो तइया,जस्स पसारण जिओ,सत्तू बल-वासुदेवेहिं"
english: "To be broken is poison, to lose one's worthiness is a great virtue, To live as one spreads it Is the supreme power - The Vasudevas"

prakrit: "ते समणसङ्घसहिया,संपत्ता कोसलापुरि पवरं,कुसुमामोउज्जाणे,अहिटिया फासुगुइसे"
english: "He is a good friend, Wealth makes crooked people happy, Love makes crooks happy, And deceit traps them."

prakrit: "अह ते संनमनिलया,साहू सबो वि नागरो लोओ,आगन्तूण सुमणसो,बन्दइ परमेण विणएणं"
english: "Oh! it's a pleasure to meet you, my dear! Everyone is welcome: The visitor is welcome, The hostages are tied up by the gods."

prakrit: "पउमो भाईहि समं,साहूर्ण दरिसणुजओ पत्तो,नाईसर गर्य तं,पुरओ काऊण निष्फिडिओ"
english: "The husband is equal to his wife, The husband to the wife is equal, The wife to the husband is greater, The whole family is poorer."

prakrit: "अवराइया य देवी,सोमित्ती केगई तह'नाओ,जुवईओ मुणिवरे ते,वन्दणहेउं उवगयाओ"
english: "Our goddess, Why so touchy? Young men bow before sages. Praise be to those who bow before them!"

prakrit: "जगडिजन्ततुरङ्गम-हत्यिघडाडोववियडमम्गेणं,बहुसुहडसंपरिवुडो,गओ य पउमो तमुजाण"
english: "Jagadijantaturangam - Slaughterhouse, With many pleasantries to offer, The husband is usually tasty." ""

prakrit: "साहुस्स आयवत्तं,दट्टु ते वाहणाउ ओइण्णा,गन्तूण पउममादी,संघे पणमन्ति मुणिवसमे"
english: "The saviour is at hand, The hunter is at the wheel, The traveler is at his feet, The guild is at its head."

prakrit: "उवविठ्ठाण महियले,ताण मुणी देसभूसणो धम्मं,दुविहं कहेइ भयवं,सागारं तह निरागारं"
english: "Aunt, It is the dharma of false gods. Both speak with fear. The ocean is so empty." ""

prakrit: "पढमो गिहवासीणं,सायारो'णेयपज्जवो धम्मो,होइ निरायारो पुण,निग्गन्थाणं जइवराणं"
english: "The reader is a geek, The observer is a doer, Dharma is a healer, Destruction is a punishment."

prakrit: "लोए अणाइनिहणे,एवं अन्नाणमोहिया जीवा,आणुहोन्ति कुजोणिगया,दुक्खं संसारकन्तारे"
english: "The world is full of wretched people, And the soul, greedy for food, Is burdened with misery As though it were the end of the world."

prakrit: "पामो परमवबन्धु,ताणं सरणं च होइ जीवस्स,धम्मो सुहाण मूल,धम्मो कामदुहा घेणू"
english: "Love is the supreme friend, renunciation and renunciation are the roots of life, happiness is the dharma, lust is the medicine of desire."

prakrit: "सयलम्मि वि तेलोके,नंदवं उत्तमं महग्धं च,तं सर्व धम्मफलं,लभइ नरो उत्तमतवेणं"
english: "Even oil is beneficial, nectar - like oil is excellent and fragrant; it has all the fruits of dharma. One must seek the highest."

prakrit: "निणवरविहिए मग्गे,धम्म काऊण निच्छियं पुरिसा,उम्मुक्ककम्मकलसा,जन्ति सिर्व सासयं ठाणं"
english: "I beg of you, Why so distressed by dharma? It's the pen of a decent man, A pot of karma only for women, As long as they abide in mother - in - law."

prakrit: "एयन्तरमि पुच्छद,साहू लच्छीहरो पणमिळणं,साहेहि गओ खुमिओ,किह पुणरवि उवसमं पत्तो"
english: "Come, ask me a question, my poor fellow. Please, my dear, let me know in a minute, Is there room for it again?"

prakrit: "अह देसभूसणमुणी,भणइ गओ अइबलेण संखुभिओ,संभरिऊण परभवं,पुणरवि सोमत्तणं पत्तो"
english: "Oh! true woman, you seem to be wasting away, Thinking only of what's to come, Remembering only of the past, And thinking again of what is to come."

prakrit: "आसि पुरा इह नयरे,नाभी भज्जा य तस्स मरुदेवी,तीए गर्भमि निणो,उप्पन्नो सयलजगनाहो"
english: "Come, purring girl, Fill your navel with the nectar of a desert goddess. Please, my poor girl, be careful not to fall asleep in her womb."

prakrit: "सुर-असुरनमियचलणो,रज दाऊण जेट्टपुत्तस्स,चउहि सहस्सेहि सम,पबइओ नरवरिन्दाणं"
english: "The sound of the trumpet, The twang of the king's bow, And the sound of his bow, Are conciliatory In nature."

prakrit: "अह सो वाससहस्सं,ठिओ य पडिमाऎ जिणवरो धीरो,जत्थुद्देसंमि फुडं,भणइ नणो अज वि पयागं"
english: "Oh! stay where you are, my poor girl! But bear with me, I beg of you, For I am still a farmer's son." ""

prakrit: "जे ते सामियभत्ता,तेण समं दिक्खिया नरवरिन्दा,दुस्सहपरिस्सहेहिं,छम्मासन्भन्तरे भग्गा"
english: "One who observes a proverb is like a man suffering from an illness: He flees before the moon."

prakrit: "असण-तिसाऎ किलन्ता,सच्छन्दवया कुधम्मधम्मेसु,जाया वक्कलघारी,तरुफल मूलासिणो मूढा"
english: "Asan - tisaya kilanta, sachhandavaya kudhammadhamesu, jaya vakalghari, tarufal is the fool of the moolas"

prakrit: "अह उष्पन्ने नाणे,निणस्स मरिई तओ य निक्खन्तो,सामण्णा पडिभग्गो,पारिवजं पवत्तेइ"
english: "Oh! you fool, Life is fleeting, But if you leave it at that, Your face will break open, And your family will follow."

prakrit: "अह सुप्पभस्स तइया,पुत्ता पल्हायणाऎ देवीए,चन्दोदय सूरोदय,पबइया निणवरेण समं"
english: "Ah, the dreamer of dreams, My son, The moon is like the sunrise At dawn."

prakrit: "भग्गा सामण्णाओ,सीसा मारिजिनामधेयस्स,होऊणं कालगया,भमिया संसारकन्तारे"
english: "Foolish talk, leaden by love, becomes stale, vanishes into the world's darkness."

prakrit: "चन्दोदओ कयाई,नागपुरे हरिमइस्स मज्जाए,पल्हायणाऎ गन्भे,नाओ य कुलकरो राया"
english: "Chandodao kayai, Nagpur haramise majjaye, palhaiyana ganbe, naoy ya kulakar raaya." ""

prakrit: "सूरोदओ वि एत्तो,तमि पुरे विस्समूहविप्पेणं,जाओ सुहरयनामो,गर्भमि य अम्गिकुण्डाए"
english: "Sunrise is here, so is the whole mass. Go, take a good bath. I'll conceive in the middle of the night."

prakrit: "राया कुलंकरो वि य,गच्छन्तो तावसाण सेवाए,अह पेच्छइ मुणिवसों,धीरं अभिणन्दणं नाम"
english: "Even Raya Kulankara, When he goes he serves the poor man. But I see sages. Patience is the name of bliss."

prakrit: "भणिओ'वहिनाणीणं,जत्थ तुम जासि तत्थ कट्टगओ,नरवइ! पियामहो ते,चिट्ठइ सप्पो समुप्पन्नो"
english: "Say:" "Bride - to - be, Wherever you go You'll cut down the roots of the snake. Love, dear friend, Writes all the snakes down." ""

prakrit: "अह फालियम्मि कडे-क्खिस्सइ ताक्सो तुमं दटुं,गन्तूण पेच्छद निवो,तं चेव तहाविहं सर्व"
english: "Hey, you silly girl, I've gotta go look for you. Stop staring at me While you're gone. I see you all the time."

prakrit: "तञ्चत्थदरिसणेणं,मुणिवरवयणेण तत्थ पडिबुद्धो,राया इच्छइ काउं,पबजं नायसंवेगो"
english: "Look at the horizon, Sit there sighing, Trembling, Whom else do you wish to meet, Let alone play football?"

prakrit: "चउपबन्तसुईए,तं विप्पो सुइरओ विमोहेइ,जंपइ कुलागओ चिय,नरवइ! तुह पेइओ धम्मो"
english: "Silly girl, That wretched needle pierces through the wound, Jumps off the nail mark, Like a man possessed by a demon! Your love is dharma." ""

prakrit: "रजं भोत्तण चिरं,निययपए ठाविउं सुयं जेडं,पच्छा करेज्जसु हिय,सामिय! वयणं ममं कुणसु"
english: "The king is in a hurry, Make sure you stay awake, Go and ask how things are going, Samia! Act like a bitch." ""

prakrit: "एयं चिय वितन्त,सिरिदामा तस्स महिलिया सोउं,चिन्तेइ परपसत्ता,अयं मुणिया नरिन्देणं"
english: "Tis the land of plenty, In winter there is plenty of room for women's sleep, And thinking is the ultimate bliss."

prakrit: "तेग इमो पबज्र,राया गिण्हेज वा न गिण्हेज्जा,को जाणइ परहिययं,तम्हा मारेमिह विसेणं"
english: "Tegh imo pujabra, raja guinea or no guineas, who knows what else to say? The difference is your own." ""
