prakrit: "पावा पुरोहिएणं,सह संजुत्ता कुलंकरं ताहे,मारेइ तस्वणं चिय,पसुधाएणं निययगेहे"
english: "Get up early, take a bath, wash your face, and pat dry your skin."

prakrit: "सो कालगओ ताहे,ससओ होऊण पुण तओ मोरो,नागो य समुप्पन्नो,कुररो तह दुदुरो चेव"
english: "So the passage of time is long, To become a mother - in - law is tedious, And to die a miser is tiring."

prakrit: "अह सुइरओ वि पुवं,मरिऊणं गयवरो समुप्पन्नो,अक्कमइ ददुरं तं,सो हत्थी निययपाएणं"
english: "Ah, dear boy, The only way to tell if you're going to die Is to set fire to that damned horse."

prakrit: "कालगओ उप्पन्नो,मच्छो कालेण सरवरे सुके,काएमु खज्जमाणो,मरिऊणं कुक्कुडो जाओ"
english: "Time will tell, Catch the mosquito, Let the summer dry up, For what use is it to eat? But let the cuckoo die."

prakrit: "मज्जारो पुण हत्थी,तिष्णि भवा कुक्कुडो समुप्पन्नो,माहणमज्जारेणं,खद्धो तिण्णेव जम्माई"
english: "Mother - in - law, Pun hastti, Tishni bhaava, Kukkudu samuppanno, Mahanamjarane, Khuddho threenave jamayi."

prakrit: "बम्भणमज्जारो सो,मरिउं मच्छो तओ समुप्पनो,इयरो वि सुंसुमारो,जाओ तत्थेव सलिलंमि"
english: "Aunt, It's too early to tell, I think I might die, But this year it's still sunny. Go, stay where you are And I'll go."

prakrit: "ते सुसुमारमच्छा,धीवरपुरिसेहि जालपडिबद्धा,आयड्मिण वहिया,बहुहा समया समुप्पना"
english: "They are smooth - faced, their necks tightly knit, their eyes tightly shut, their hair hanging loose And their eyes closed For a long time."

prakrit: "बो आसि संसुमारो,सोय विणोओ ति नामओ विप्पो,इयरो तस्स कणिट्ठो,रमणो रायम्गिहे विप्पो"
english: "Come, my boy, tell me her name, It's Vippo., This year her earrings are gone, And the poems of love are gone."

prakrit: "मुक्खचणेण रमणो,निविण्णो निग्गओ य वेयत्थी,लण गुरु सिक्खह,सनोवो तहिं वेए"
english: "The head is to be chosen, Ramana; the head, Niggadah, or altar, Is to be planted; The head, Guru, should be learned; The ears, therefore, are to be found there."

prakrit: "पुणरवि मगहपुरं सो,एकोयरदरिसणुस्सुओ रमणो,संपत्तो नक्खहरे,निसासु तत्थालयं कुणइ"
english: "Once again, Maghpuram, so to speak; One day at a time, young and handsome; Wealth is the nail of the nail; The sigh also marks the spot."

prakrit: "तत्थ विणोयस्स पिया,असोयदत्तस्स दिन्नसंकेया,तं चेव जक्खनिलय,साहा नामेण संपत्ता"
english: "Then you will drink in silence, You will regret what you did not do, And you will go away forever. Wealth, my friend, is the name of wealth."

prakrit: "रमणो तीऎ समाणं,गहिओ चिय दण्डवासियनरेहिं,ताव य ताण सेयास,गओ विणोओ असिं घेत्तु"
english: "Love is like a tree, Like the reed of punishment in a man's hands. So, whatever you do, go and rescue us." ""

prakrit: "सन्भावमन्तणं सो,सोड महिलाएं कारणे रुहो,घाएइ विणोओ तं,रमणं खग्गेण रयणिम्मि"
english: "Feel free to make love, leave alone cry for the sake of women, For lack of affection will ruin your life."

prakrit: "गेहं गओ विणोओ,सययं महिलाऎ रइसुहं भोत्तु,कालगओ संसारं,परिहिण्डइ दुक्खसंबाह"
english: "Gone are the days When one forgot what was dear to one's self, What pleasure one derives from being dear to another, The passage of time Shows the cycle of suffering."

prakrit: "अह ते विणोय-रमणा,उप्पन्ना महिसया सकम्मेहिं,नाया य अच्छभल्ला,निश्चखू वणदवे दड्डा"
english: "Oh! it is Vinoya-Ramana, sweet buffalo milk, not good wine. The forest fires are unbearable." ""

prakrit: "अह ते वाहजुवाणा,नाया हरिणा तओ य सारङ्गा,संतासिएण रण्णे,मुक्का नियएण जूहेणं"
english: "Ah! a warrior's bow, Not a stag's horn, A heron's tail, A hunter's stag, A gambler's pin." ""

prakrit: "अह नरवई सयंभू,विमलनिणं वन्दिउ पडिनियत्तो,पेच्छइ य हरिणए ते,निययघर नेइ परितुट्ठो"
english: "Oh! the silence of the men! The forest hunter's wife has fallen at last. But as for the deer, Look! They've had their way In this wretched house."

prakrit: "पेच्छन्ति वराहारं,दिजन्तं मुणिवराण ते हरिणा,नाया पसन्नहियया,नरवइभवणे धिई पत्ता"
english: "The hunter looks at the raptor, The deer looks on, And the doe looks on As if she were possessed by a demon."

prakrit: "आउक्खए समाहिं,लद्धण तओ सुरा समुप्पन्ना,चविया पुणो वि तिरिया,भमन्ति विविहासु जोणीसु"
english: "Come, gather together; When laden, gather your wine; When plump, stretch out your arms again; When you are full, flutter your arms And flutter them."

prakrit: "कह कह वि माणुसस,लढण य सो विणोयसारङ्गो,बत्तीसकोडिसामी,जाओ धणओ ति कम्पिल्ले"
english: "How can you be so cruel to a human being? If he has to fight, you have to bow before him, You have to bend your neck Thirty-two times."

prakrit: "रमणजीओ सारङ्गो,संसार हिण्डिऊणणेगविहं,कम्पिल्ले धणयसुओ,उप्पनो भूसणो नामं"
english: "Ramanajee, Sarango, Samsara, Hindiyune, Vindhya, Kampile, Dhanayasu, Uppona, Bhusna, are the names of flowers."

prakrit: "पुत्तसिणेहेण पुणो,सब धणएण तत्थ वरभवणे,देहुवगरणं विविहं,कयं च तस्सेव सन्निहियं"
english: "Through my son's victory I will rise again, Through all my wealth Thenceforth; Through the diversity of my body I shall never see another like you."

prakrit: "सेविजन्तो निययं,जुवईसु मणोहरासु भवणगओ,न य पेच्छइ उदयन्ते,ससि मूरे अस्थमन्ते य"
english: "Destiny favors the servile, Young men feign delight, But those who see it do not rise. A sapling's trunk is immovable."

prakrit: "इह पेच्छहु संसारे,सेणिय! नडचेट्टियं तु नीवाणं,धणओ य आसि भाया,नाओ चिय भूसणस्स पिया"
english: "Look! The whole world is staring at you, girl! You're the one who pushed the nail in the nail. It must be the hunter's son. No, I don't want to see him again." ""

prakrit: "ताव य निसावसाणे,सोऊणं देवदुन्दुहिनिनाय,देवागमं च ददु,पडिबुद्धो भूसणो सहसा"
english: "You must be asleep, She must be crying out for the gods, And the fire must be burning, For suddenly she is covered with gooseflesh."

prakrit: "भद्दो सभावसीलो,धम्मरओ तिवभावसंजुत्तो,सिरिघरमुणिस्स पोसे,वन्दणहेउं अह पयट्टो"
english: "Foolish people, The Dharma is full of falsehoods, The headman's son is empty, I bow down to make love."

prakrit: "सो तत्थ पविसरन्तो'सोगवणे तक्खणंमि उरगेणं,दट्ठो चिय कालगओ,माहिन्दे सुरवरो जाओ"
english: "So at that moment the traveler said," "I can see you now." "But look: The rainy season has passed."

prakrit: "चविओ पुक्खरदीवे,माहविदेवीए कुच्छिसंभूओ,चन्दाइच्चपुरे सो,पयासजसनन्दणो जाओ"
english: "Foolish lampstands, Wretched buds of jasmine, Like the rays of the moon, Are a blessing in disguise."

prakrit: "अमरिन्दरूवसरिसो,नामेण जगजुई जुइसमग्गो,संसारपरमभीरू,रज्जमि अणायरं कुणइ"
english: "Amarinder is a man of many talents, a gentleman by name, passionate about the world, who understands and acts in ways that please his wife."

prakrit: "तबसीलसमिद्धाणं,साहूणा'हारदाणपुण्णेणं,मरिऊण य देवकुरु,गओ य ईसाणकप्पं सो"
english: "To die, O god of gods, To fall asleep in the middle of the night, To suffer and to prosper, Is like drinking water in a sauna."

prakrit: "सो तत्थ देवसोक्खं,भोत्तु पलिओवमाइ बहुयाई,चविओ जम्बुद्दीवे,अवरविदेहे महासमए"
english: "There then is the delight of gods, But the plowman's wife is very busy: The gods are busy making love, And their enemies are very numerous."

prakrit: "रयणपुरे चकहरो,अयलो महिलाऎ तस्स घरिणीए,गन्भमि समुप्पन्नो,लोगस्स समूसवो य विभू"
english: "The rhinoceros is running away, The other woman is with her husband, The whole village is gathered around her, And the people are all agitated."

prakrit: "वेरम्गसमावन्न,चक्की नाऊण अत्तणो पुत्तं,परिणावेइ बला तं,तिण्णि कुमारीसहस्साई"
english: "Vairamgasa Samavanna, Chakri Noun Atman Atman, Parinaveey Balanga The three virgins are rivals."

prakrit: "सो तेहि लालिओ वि य,मन्नइ धीरो विसोवमे भोगे,महइ चिय पबज्जं,नवरं एक्केण भावेणं"
english: "So too the lotuses, Believe me, Be patient, Suffer yourself in adversity, For I know that love is pure, That love has no bounds."

prakrit: "केऊरहारकुण्डल-विभूसिओ वरवहूण मज्झत्थो,उवएसं देई विभू,गुणायरं जिणवरुद्दिष्टुं"
english: "How strange it is for a young bride To be bedraggled by her husband's bow, Such a sight for the God of Love." ""

prakrit: "खणभङ्गुरेसु को वि हु,भोगेसु रई करेज नाणन्तो,किम्पागफलसमेल य,नियमा पच्छा अपत्थेमु"
english: "Who cares what happens to a poor man's fingers, Who lacks courage when he is angry, Who abides by the rules When he has to bear fruit?"

prakrit: "सा हवइ सलाहणिया,सत्ती एका नरस्स जियलोए,ना महइ तक्खणं चिय,मुत्तिसुहं चञ्चले जोए"
english: "She is always so attentive, Always keeps one's nerves alive, Never scoldes a bee, Always shows off her pretty face."

prakrit: "सुणिऊण पणइणीओ,एयं दइण्ण भासियं धर्म,उवसन्ताओ नियमे,गेण्हन्ति नहाणुसत्तीए"
english: "Listen, my dear: This is the dharma of pitiful women. Rest are given to them by law; They flout the rules of chastity."

prakrit: "अह सो नरवहपुत्तो,निययसरीरे वि ववगयसिणेहो,छट्टमाइएख,पुणो वि भावेइ अप्पाणं"
english: "Ah, the son of man, Though business as usual has reached a standstill, Look how he has proved himself Once again."

prakrit: "चउसट्ठिसहस्साई,वरिसाण अकम्पिओ तवं काउं,कालगओ उववन्नो,देवो बम्भुत्तरे कप्पे"
english: "Sixty-four thousand rubles, The rainy season is unbearable, So is the rainy season," He said. "The God of Love is like a bamboo shoot."

prakrit: "जो सो पुण सो धणओ,भमिउं नाणाविहासु जोणीसु,जम्बूदक्षिणभरहे,पोयणनयरे धणसमिद्धे"
english: "One who is pure is a jeweler, Like the jeweler who has a coin in his hand, Like a draught of gold strewn all over the horizon, Like jeweler's bow."

prakrit: "सोअग्गिमुहो नामेण बम्भणो तस्स बम्भणीगन्मे,कम्माणिलेरिओ सो उबवण्णो मिउमई नामं"
english: "Aunt, If you ask me what my name is I'll tell you it's your name."

prakrit: "अविणय-जूयामिरओ,बहुविहअवराहकारगो दुट्टो,निद्धाडिओ धराओ,पियरेणुवलम्भभीएणं"
english: "You reckless gambler, You greedy traveler, Hold your breath, Fearful of climbing the pyre."

prakrit: "दोकप्पडपरिहाणो,हिण्डन्तो मेहणी चिरं कालं,एकम्मि घरे सलिलं,मग्गइ तण्हाकिलन्तो सो"
english: "Traveler, the months are fleeting, Friendships last a long time, We live in the same house, But if you ask me what it is like to be stressed out, It's only because you know how it feels."

prakrit: "तो बम्भणीऎ उदय,दिन्नं चिय तस्स सीयलं सुरहिं,नाओ पसन्नहियओ,पुच्छइ त मिउमई विप्पो"
english: "So what do you mean, you stupid girl? Don't be so hasty. I'll break down if you ask me." ""

prakrit: "दट्टण मए सहसा,केण व कज्जेण रुयसि सावित्ती!,तीए वि य सो भणिओ,मज्झ वि वयणं निसामेहि"
english: "Suddenly I heard your voice:" "Why are you crying so loudly?" "Say so again, for even I find it difficult to speak."

prakrit: "भद्द! तुमे अणुसरिसो,मज्झ सुओ निग्गओ नियघराओ,जइ कह वि भमन्तेणं,दिवो तो मे परिकहेहि"
english: "Fool! You're right, I sleep soundly, My household is busy, If anyone bothers, Let me have a look." ""

prakrit: "भणिया य मिउमई णं,अम्मो! मा रुयसु हवमु परितुट्टा,चिरलक्खगो भमेर,तुज्झ सुओ आगओ सो हइं"
english: "Foolish girl, don't cry! It's my mother - in - law! It must be your sleep, you worm - eating bee." ""

prakrit: "सोअग्गिमुहस्स पिया,पियपुत्तसमागमे जणियतोसा,पण्हुयपओहरा सा,कुणइ तओ संगमाणन्दं"
english: "Dear friend, When you meet your lover, You rejoice, When he calls you by your wife's name, You delight, Friend, In making love."

prakrit: "सबकलागमकुसलो,धुत्ताण य मत्थयट्टिओ धीरो,जाओवभोगसेवी,जूए अवराजिओ निययं"
english: "All races are crooks; Those who practice falsehood or falsehood have no patience; The devious traveler, being addicted to gambling, Has no destiny."

prakrit: "तस्स उ वसन्तअमरा,गणिया नामेण रूवसंपन्ना,बीया य हवइ रमणा,इट्टा कन्ता मिउमइस्स"
english: "There comes the spring, The flowers bloom with the name of Gania, The seeds germinate with love, It's my mother - in - law's bow." ""

prakrit: "जणओ बन्धूहि समं,दारिदस्स उ विमोइओ तेणं,माया य कुण्डलाइसु,विभूसिया पाविया रिद्धी"
english: "People are like friends: Poverty and redemption are their lotuses, Deceit and delusion are their virtues."

prakrit: "एत्तो ससङ्कनयरे,रायहरं चोरियागओ सन्तो,अह नन्दिवद्धणनिवं,जपंतं मिउमई सुणइ"
english: "Here at this solemn hour, Your holiness, Stealing the night away, I bow before you with thankfulness. It is only in Japan That I hear you."

prakrit: "चन्दमुहस्ससयासे,मुणिवरवसहस्स अन्ज परमगुणो,धम्मो सुओ किसोयरि!,सिवसुहफलओ निययबन्धू"
english: "Through the moonlit sky, Through the breath of a sage, And through the supreme virtues, The dharma is sound! The fruit of one's life Is destined to prosper."

prakrit: "विसया विस व देवी,परिणामदुहावहा महासत्त,तम्हा लएमि दिक्खं,जइ न कुणसि सोगसंबन्धं"
english: "Wisdom is a goddess of wisdom, Consequences are great, But I will take care of you, For if you grieve, There is nothing you can do."

prakrit: "एवं च सिक्खयन्तं,देवी सिरिवद्धणं तओ सोउं,अह तक्खणम्मि बोही,संपत्तो मिउमई ताहे"
english: "And as I learned, When the goddesses rose up, I slept soundly. So did my daughter - in - law. My wealth was due to her."

prakrit: "संसारभउबिम्गो,मुणिस्स पासम्मि चन्दवयणस्स,गिण्हइ जिणवरविहिय,पाजं मिउमई एत्तो"
english: "Friend of the world, The moon by the side of the sage, Counting the lives lost, I have only this much to spare."

prakrit: "तप्पद तवं सुघोरं,जहागर्म सोल-संजमसमग्गो,मेरु व धोरगरुओ,भमइ मही फासुयाहारो"
english: "Tremendous beauty, Wherever the mind is, There the heart is as well as the limbs; The buffalo is as good as a trap."

prakrit: "अवरो पबयसिहरे,नामेणं गुणनिही समणसीहो,चिइ चउरो मासा,वारिसिया विबुहपरिमहिओ"
english: "Here are the wise men, Those worthy of the name Are conciliatory, Those clever of all flesh Are heirs only to delights of reason."

prakrit: "साहू समत्तनियमो,अनुहेसं गओ नहयलेणं,तं चेव पवयवरं,संपत्तो मिउमई तइया"
english: "Friend, allow me the pleasure of bathing, For what use is wealth to me, Anyway?"

prakrit: "पविसइ भिक्खाहेडं,रम्मं आलोयनयरनाम सो,समणो समाहियमणो,वन्दिजन्तो जणवएणं"
english: "Praise be to the bhikkhu, Love embrace, Name bearer of pleasantries, Friend, Let the wicked be warned."

prakrit: "नंपइ जणो इमो सो,जो गिरिसिहरे सुरेहि परिमहिओ,साहू बहुगुणनिलओ,भयसोगविवजिओ 'धीरो"
english: "A negligent person is an emo, One who walks on thin air, Who keeps his distance, Who has many talents, Who is afraid of being criticized." ""

prakrit: "मुआवेइ नणो तं,सुसायआहार-पाणयादीहिं,सो तत्थ कुणइ माय,इड्डीरसगारवनिमित्तं"
english: "Forgive me, my dear, for I am not worthy of your love. For what use is a good mannered woman to me?"

prakrit: "जो सो पायसिहरे,सो हु तुम मुणिवरो भणइ लोगो,अणुमन्नइ तं वयणं,माइल्लो तिबरसगिद्धो"
english: "One who is fond of playing the flute, you are a fool, say what you have to say, Speak little by little."

prakrit: "एवं मायासल्लं,जेणं नालोइयं गुरुसयासे,तेण तुमे नागगई,बद्धं तिरियाउयं कम"
english: "And my dear, The more you neglect your teacher, the less you become annoying."

prakrit: "सो मिउमई कयाई,कालं काऊण तत्थ वरकप्पे,उववन्नो कयपुण्णो,जत्थ'भिरामो सुरो वसइ"
english: "So what have I to do? Time, dear friend, Is at hand in making things right. Wherever there is kindness, There dwells harmony." ""

prakrit: "बहुभवकम्मनिबद्धा,एयाण निरन्तरं 'पिई परमा,आसि चिय सुरलोए,महिड्डिजुत्ताण दोडं पि"
english: "Multitudes of emotions bound up in one's consciousness, One constantly thinks of oneself as supreme, One always acts in harmony with oneself, The other always happens alone."

prakrit: "सुरवहुयामज्झगया,दिवङ्गायतुडियकुण्डलाभरणा,रइसागरोवगाढा,गय पि कालं न याणन्ति"
english: "Gone are the days When one did not know how to weep, When one could not sleep, And when one could cry aloud."

prakrit: "सो मिउमई कयाई,चइर्ड मायावसेण इह भरहे,सल्लइवणे निगुञ्ज,उप्पन्नो पबए हत्थी"
english: "So what shall I do? Foolish girl, you won't make a mess of it. You'll have to bend over Before you can lift it."

prakrit: "घणकसिणकज्जलनिभो,संखुमियसमुइसरिसनिग्योसो,सियदसणो पवणनवो,वेएण कुलुपमो सूरो"
english: "The flame of a thunderclap, A myriad of sweet smells, A steady stream of tears, Are the pleasures of love."

prakrit: "एरावणसमसरिसो सच्छन्दविहारिणो रिवुपणासो,अच्छन्तु ताव मणुया,खेयरवसभाण वि अगेझो"
english: "Eravana samsara is pure ecstasy, But when it comes to love, There must be something wrong with it."

prakrit: "नाणाविहेसु कीलइ,सिहरनिगुञ्ज सु तरुसमिद्धेसु,अवयरइ माणससर,लीलायन्तो कमलपुण्णं"
english: "A lotus is like a coin, Like the tip of a bow When struck with a sharp arrow, Like a human arrow In flight; Like a lily, it has lotus blossom"

prakrit: "कइलासपवयं पुण,वच्चइ मन्दाइणी विमलतोयं,करिणीसहस्ससहिओ,अणुभवइ नहिच्छियं सोक्ख"
english: "Once the wind blows, once the moon is bright, Once the wife is busy making love, Once she has no desire to be unhappy, She is completely content."

prakrit: "सो तत्थ गयवरिन्दो,करिवरपरिवारिओ विहरमाणो,सोहइ वणमझगओ,गरुडो इव पक्खिसङ्केहिं"
english: "There it is: A flock of parrots, An excruciatingly busy traveler's family, A swarm of monkeys, An eagle, and a flock of birds."

prakrit: "लाहिवेण दिट्ठो,सो हु इमो गयवरो मयसणाहो,गहिओ य विरइयं से,मुक्णालंकारनामं तु"
english: "Look! With a limp, You're an emo, A coward, Or a man in a hurry, Or in a daze, You shameless ornament."

prakrit: "देवीसु समं सग्गे,रमिऊणं वरविमाणमझगओ,कीलइ करिणिसमम्गो,संपइ तिरिओ वि उप्पन्नो"
english: "The gods are one and the same, Love makes love through the air, Love pervades the earth, Love destroys everything."

prakrit: "कम्माण इमा सत्ती,जं जीवा सबजोणिउप्पन्ना,सेणिय! अइदुहिया विय,तत्थ उ अहियं धिहमुवेन्ति"
english: "Karma ̄ n ima satti, As long as all the young men are awake, O warrior! Two hundred times as long as they are asleep, There they find their breath." ""

prakrit: "चइ सो अहिरामो,सागेयानयरिसामिओ जाओ,राया भरहो ति इमो,फलेण सुविसुद्धधम्मस्स"
english: "Go ahead, my poor girl, go ahead, have a good night's sleep. It's only going to get worse."

prakrit: "मोहमलपडलमुको,भोगाण अणायरं गओ एसो,इच्छइ काऊण महा-पबज्जं दुक्खमोक्खत्थे"
english: "Come, you fool, Go and enjoy yourself: Who would want to suffer such a heavy burden?"

prakrit: "जे ते जिणेण समय,पवज गिहिण परिवडिया,चन्दोदय सूरोदय,लम्गा मारीइपासण्डे"
english: "If he has time to live, let him sleep, For the moon is hotter than the sun, And the yearning to die is longer."

prakrit: "एए ते परिभमिया,संसार भायरो सुइरकालं,सगकम्मपभावेणं,भरहगइन्दा इमे जाया"
english: "Oh! what a miserly world! For what use is a good time, If all one's business consists in making love?"

prakrit: "चन्दो कुलंकरो जो,समाहिमरणेण जाओ सारङ्गो,सो हु इमो उप्पन्नो,भरहो राया महिड्डोओ"
english: "The kulankar of the moon, Who at the moment of its rising passes away, Is a sarong seller, Is an impudent man, Is full of false gods."

prakrit: "सूरोदओ य विप्पो,जो सो हु कुरङ्गओ तया आसि,कुच्छियकम्मवसणं,संपइ एसो गओ जाओ"
english: "Sunrise or withering away, Come what may, you monkey, The misfortune of the bitch - That is how it is."

prakrit: "भन्तूण लोहखम्म,एसो हु गओ बलेण संखुभिओ,भरहालोग सुमरिय,पुषभ उवसमे पत्तो"
english: "You fool," said the farmer, "This is how you settle your debts." He sighed heavily. "Your husband is out of work."

prakrit: "नाऊणं एवमेयं चवलतडिसमं सबसत्ताण नीयं,संजोगा विप्पओगा पुणरवि बहवो होन्ति संबन्धिबन्धा"
english: "A new name is dawning, A fresh start is on the horizon, And confusion reigns." ""

prakrit: "संसारं दुक्खसार परिममिय चिरं माणुसत्तं लहेडं,तुम्मेत्थं धम्मकजं कुणह सुविमलं बुद्धिमन्ता'पमचा"
english: "The world is suffering, The human race is perishing, But you, good and wise man, Make dharma your occupation." ""

prakrit: "इइ पउमचरिए तिहुयणालंकारपुव्वभवाणुकित्तणं नाम बासीइमं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "In the name of this holy man, Who dwells in my heart, I dedicate my entire existence to you."

prakrit: "तं मुणिवरस्स वयणं,सुणिऊणं भरमाइया सुहडा,बहवे संवेगपरा,दिक्खाभिमुहा तओ जाया"
english: "It's like playing the flute, Listening for the pleasures of delusion, Running out of emotion, Facing doom."

prakrit: "एयन्तरंमि भरहो,समुट्ठिओ कुण्डलुजलकवोलो,आबद्धञ्जलिमउलो,पणमइ साहुं विगयमोहो"
english: "Here I am filled with water, There is the sound of the kundal jalak, The flame of the lake is bound up, And the arrow of the God of Love has reached the sky."

prakrit: "संसारभउबिग्गो,भरहो तं मुणिवरं भणइ एत्तो,बहुनोणिसहस्साई,नाह! भमन्तो य खिन्नो हं"
english: "You fool, The world is full of fools. Tell me, you fool, It's a lot of bullshit. No, I'm panicking." ""

prakrit: "मरणतरङ्गुम्गाप,संसारनईए' वुज्झमाणस्स,दिक्खाकरेण साहव!,हत्थालम्बं पयच्छाहि"
english: "Waves of death, The rising of the world, The sahava of the observer!, Moving with the palm of his hand."

prakrit: "अणुमन्निओ गुरूणं,भरहो मोत्तण तत्थ'लंकारं,निस्सेससकरहिओ,लुच्चइ धीरो निययकेसे"
english: "Dear master, When a pearl is full, That is the mark of a shipwreck, Unsinkable, Lurking in the thickets of fate."

prakrit: "वय-नियम-सील-संजम-गुणायरो दिक्खिओ भरहसामी,नाओ महामुणी सो,रायसहस्सेण अहिएणं"
english: "Age, rule, seal, temperance, virtue, seem to be the virtues of husband and wife. No, lady, it's not a big deal. The wisdom of love is immaterial."

prakrit: "साहु ति साहु देवा,जपन्ता संतयं कुसुमवासं,मुञ्चन्ति नहयलत्था,संथुणमाणा भरहसाहुं"
english: "Sahu ti sahu deva, Japanta santayam kusumavasa, Manchanti nahyalatha, Santhanamana bharasaaha."

prakrit: "अन्ने सावयधर्म,संवेगपरा लएन्ति नरवसभा,एयन्तरंमि भरहं,पाइयं केगई सोउं"
english: "On the other hand, Dharma is eternal, the senses take their place in the human body, and on the other, I am bound to die."

prakrit: "मुच्छागया विउद्धा,पुत्तविओयम्मि दुक्खिया कलुणं,घेणु व वच्छरहिया,कुणइ पलावं पयलियंस"
english: "Foolish girl, My daughter - in - law is miserable, Her bracelets are tied around her neck, She runs away like a warrior."

prakrit: "सबन्तेउरसहिया,रुयमाणी केगई महादेवी,महुरवयणेहि एत्तो,संथविया राम-केसीहिं"
english: "All round the town, People weeping, Mahadevi singing, Mahuravayana singing, And Rama sleeping." ""

prakrit: "अह सा उत्तमनारी,पडिबुद्धा तिबजायसंवेगा,निन्दइ निययसरीरं,बीभच्छं अमुइदुग्गन्धं"
english: "Oh! she is good - minded, Proud of being thin, Criticizing one's body, Fearful of the unpleasant odor"

prakrit: "नारीण सएहि तिहिं,पासे अजाऎ पुहइसच्चाए,पबइया दढभावा,सिद्धिपयं उत्तम पत्ता"
english: "Aunt, When he comes to me I will tell you the truth; He has reached me only through perseverance, He has shown me the path to perfection."

prakrit: "एवं जणो तत्थ सुभावियप्पा,नाणवओवासनिओयचित्तो,बाओ महुच्छाहपरो समत्थो,धम्मं च निञ्चं विमलं करेइ"
english: "And whoever wishes to attain that state, Being self - sufficient, Living in a state of equanimity and purity, But cannot find a beehive, Must renounce Dharma."

prakrit: "इइ पउमचरिए भरह-केगईदिक्खाभिहाणं तेयासीइमं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "This is the path of righteousness - The path of purity." ""

prakrit: "सो गयवरो मुणीणं,क्याणि परिलम्भिओ पसन्नप्पा,सागारधम्मनिरओ',जाओ तवसंजमुज्जुत्तो"
english: "Foolish girl, why bother at all? It's the ocean, Not the river." "Go and kindle your fire."

prakrit: "छट्टटुमदसमदुवालसेहि मासद्धमासखमणेहिं,भुञ्जइ य एकवेलं,पचाई सहावपडियाई"
english: "When the rice is ripe, It is fried for a month's cooking, Like the rice of raisins, But digests little by little."

prakrit: "संसारगमणभीओ,सम्मत्तपरायणो मिउसहावो,विहरइ पूइज्जन्तो,ससंभम नायरमणेणं"
english: "Fear the world, Make penance for falsehood, Perform acts of worship Wherever and however you wish."

prakrit: "लड्डुगमण्डादीया,भक्खा नाणाविहा रससमिद्धा,तस्स सुपसन्नहियओ,पारणसमए जणो देइ"
english: "The lady with the laddu, Eager to taste the juicy rice, Pleases him very much. Let someone give it to him While he is asleep." ""

prakrit: "तणुकम्मसरीरो सो,संवेगालाणणियमसंजमिओ,उग्गं तवोविहाण,करेइ चत्वारि वरिसाई"
english: "Tremendous beauty, Take care not to get wet. Get up early, take a bath, And do as you please."

prakrit: "संलेहणं च काउं,कालगओ सुरवरो समुप्पन्नो,बम्भुत्तरे विमाणे,हारन्यकुण्डलाहरणो"
english: "Time flies, Loudspeakers blare, Planes crash, Hurricanes crash."

prakrit: "सुरगणियामज्झगओ,उवगिजन्तो य नाडयसएसु,पुवसुहं संपत्तो,हत्थी सुकयाणुभावेणं"
english: "Be pleasant to the senses, Be reasonable and polite, Enjoy pleasant pastimes, Be tactful and dry."

prakrit: "भरहो वि महासमणो,पञ्चमहावयधरो समिइजुत्तो,मेरु छ धीरगो सलिलनिही चेव गम्भीरो"
english: "He who abides in me has great wisdom, And he who dwells in me through the five great vows triumphs over all."

prakrit: "समसत्तुमित्तभावो,समसुहदुक्खो पसंसनिन्दसमो,परिभमइ महिं भरहो,जुगंतरपलोयणो घोरो"
english: "Equality of mind, Equal happiness, Pleasant sleep, May all the world be filled with me, Wandering the plow of youth."

prakrit: "भरहो वि तवबलेणं,निस्सेसं कम्मकयवरं डहिउँ,केवलनाणसमग्गो,सिवमयलमणुत्तरं पत्तो"
english: "Fill your heart with energy, Stop wasting it on useless pursuits, Only go to your senses, For there is an answer to every difficulty."

prakrit: "इमा कहा भरहमुणिस्स संगया,सुणन्ति जे वियलियमच्छरा नरा,लहन्ति ते धणबलरिद्धिसंपर्य,विसुद्धधीविमलजसं सुहालयं"
english: "How can I describe her? She listens to what people have to say, Doesn't make sense, Looks like a lotus Placed on top of her rival's pen." ""

prakrit: "इइ पउमचरिए भरहनिव्वाणगमणं नाम चउरासीइमं पवं समत्तं"
english: "Proud lady, my name is Chaurasi and my path is smooth."

prakrit: "भरहेण समं धीरा,निक्खन्ता जे तहिं विगयसका,नामाणि ताण सेणिय!,भणामि उल्लामेतेणं"
english: "Be as patient as I am, Be as vigilant as I can be, Stretch out your name And fight!" I said, laughing.

prakrit: "सिद्धत्यो य नरिन्दो,तहेव रइवद्धणो य संञ्झत्थो,घणवाहरहो जम्बूणओ य सल्लो ससहो य"
english: "Conclusion is the essence, renunciation is the conjecture, abundance is the cry, silence is the message, wisdom is the law."

prakrit: "विरसो य नन्दणो वि य,नन्दो आणन्दिमो सुबुद्धी य,सूरो य महाबुद्धी,तहेव सञ्चासओ वीरो"
english: "The brave are wise, The virtuous are virtuous, The wealthy are generous, And those who prosper are brave."

prakrit: "इन्दामो य सुयधरो,तहेव जणवलहो सुचन्दो य,पुहईधरो य सुमई,अयलो कोघो हरी चेव"
english: "The senses are benign, The limbs are prominent, The trunk is smooth, The anus is prominent, And the cervix is green."

prakrit: "अह कण्डुरू सुमित्तो,संपुणिन्दू य धम्ममित्तो य,नधुसो सुन्दरसत्ती,पहायरो चेव पियधम्मो"
english: "Oh! the tendrils are beautiful, The whole body is full of them, And the river is beautiful, And all the paths lead to the river."

prakrit: "एए अन्ने य बहू,नरवसभा उज्झिऊण रजाई,'सहसाहियसंखाणा,जाया समणा समियपावा"
english: "Oh! my daughter - in - law! Anxious quilt rising from the fire of love," Said the barber, "Friend, it's about time we met."

prakrit: "अणुपालियवयनियमा,नाणालद्धीसु सत्तिसंपन्ना,पण्डियमरणोवगया,जहाणुरूवं पर्य पत्ता"
english: "Aunt, A hundred and seventy talents at a time, Like a shipwreck blown to smithereens By the wind."

prakrit: "निक्खन्ते चिय भरहे,भरहोवमचेट्ठिए गुणे सरिउँ,सोर्ग समुवहन्तो,विराहियं लक्खणो भणइ"
english: "Though empty, my heart overflows with joy, Though full of joy I lose count of my virtues. Heaven welcomes me, But separation is the characteristic trait."

prakrit: "कत्तो सो भरहमुणी,नो तरुणतंमि ऊज्झिउं रजं,मुकुमालकोमलङ्गो,कह धम्मधुरं समुबहइ"
english: "How can a handsome man, Who has no youth and a hot heart, Create a lotus blossom?"

prakrit: "सोऊण वयणमेयं,विराहिओ भणइ सामि! सो भरहो,केवलनाणसमग्गो,पत्तो सिवसासयं ठाणं"
english: "" "Listen to me, you fool! He's talking nonsense!" "Fool, only nonsense matters. Now settle the matter."

prakrit: "भरह निवाणगर्य,पउमाईया भडा निसुणिऊणं,अइदुक्खिया मुहुत्तं,तत्थ ठिया सोगसंतत्ता"
english: "Bharah nivangarya, paumaiya bhaada nisunauna, aidukkhiya muhutam, tathatha thaaya sogshantata."

prakrit: "पउमे समुट्ठिए ते,निययघराई गया नरवरिन्दा,काऊण संपहारं,पुणरवि रामालयं पत्ता"
english: "The husband is dead, The wife has left, The men of the house are gone, The bridegroom has returned, The Ram temple is empty."

prakrit: "नमिऊण राहवं ते,भणन्ति निसुणेहि सामि! वयण'म्हं,रज्जाभिसेयविभवं,अन्नेच्छसु पट्टबन्धं च"
english: "They say:" "No, they are lying down!" "But I reply :'No, I am lying down.'A passionate expression of affection, A longing and a tight embrace."

prakrit: "रामो भणइ नरवई,मिलिया तुब्भे हि परमविभवेण,नारायणस्स संपइ,करेह रज्जाभिसेयं से"
english: "Rama speaks through the mouth of a man, Milia through the eyes of a woman in her highest echelons, Narayanas through his penance, Kareah through his love of pleasure."

prakrit: "भुञ्जन्तो संत्तगुणं,इस्सरियं सयलमेइणीनाहो,जं नमइ इमो चलणे,संपइ तं किं न मे रजं?"
english: "Foolish man, Are you not a man of good character? What you bow down to in humility Will last forever, Is it not my kingdom?"

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,सबे वि नराहिवा तहिं गन्तुं,पायप्पडणोवगया,भणन्ति लच्छीहरं एत्तो"
english: "Listen to me now, you silly girl, Everything's got to go from there. It's like walking on water." ""

prakrit: "अणुमनिओ गुरुणं,पालेहि वसुन्धरं अपरिसेस,रज्जाभिसेयविहवं,अनेच्छा सामि! कीरन्त"
english: "O master of the universe, Pale spring is irresistible, The sky is full of wonders, So is Kirant!" ""

prakrit: "अणुमनियमि सहसा,काहल-तलिमा-मुइपउराई,पहयाइ बहुविहाई,तूराई मेहघोसाई"
english: "Anumanyami is sudden, Kahal - Talima - Muipurai, Pahayai is many - eyed, Turai is rainy."

prakrit: "वीणा-वससणाह,गीयं नाना-छत्त-गोजेहिं,बन्दिजणेण सहरिसं,जयसदालोयणं च कर्य"
english: "Play the lute, Sing the songs, Roof the flutes, Hold the town hostage, Praise the festival."

prakrit: "कणयकलसेहि एसो,सबुवगरणेसु संपउत्तेसु,अह राम-लक्खणा ते,अहिसिला नरवरिन्देहिं"
english: "Come, come! From the jasmine's bosom Come, all you crooks, O god of love, Come, my poor man!"

prakrit: "वरहार-कडय-कुण्डल मउडालंकारसियसरीरा,चन्दणकयारागा,सुगन्धकुसुमेसु कयमाला"
english: "Varahar - Kaday - Kundal Maudalankarasyasriera, Chandanakayaraga, Sugandhakushumesu kayamala"

prakrit: "काऊण महाणन्द,हलहर-नारायणा देणुवइन्दा,अहिसिञ्चन्ति सुमणसा,एतो सीयं महादेवि"
english: "Who is a great man, Who gives alms, Who uses fire, And who uses water only to quench his thirst? This is the Mahadevi."

prakrit: "महिसिला य विसला,देवी लच्छीहरस्स हियइटा,जा सथलजीयलोए,गुणेहि दूरं समुबहह"
english: "Mahisila ya visala, devi lacchiharasa hiita, Ja sthalajiloye, Gunahee doori samuha hain."

prakrit: "अह ते सुहासणस्था,बन्दिजणुग्घुटजयजयारावा,दाऊण समाढत्ता,रजाई खेयरिन्दाणं"
english: "Ah! that state of well - being, That the feet of captives rejoice, That doting wife, That a quilt of quilts flourish."

prakrit: "पउमो तिकूडसिहरे,विभीसणं उवइ रक्खसाहिवई,सुग्गीवस्स वि एत्तो,किकिन्धि देइ परिसेस"
english: "Proud lady, There must be something very special about this festival. Even the God of happiness is here. How can anyone describe it?"

prakrit: "सिरिपवयसिहरत्थं च सिरिपुर मारुइस्स उद्दिटुं,पडिसूरस्स हणुरुह,दिन्न नीलस्स रिक्खपुरं"
english: "Siripavayasiratham Siripura Maruis Ututum, Padisurasu Hanuruha, Dinna Nilasa Rishapuram." ""

prakrit: "पायालंकारपुरं,चन्दोयरनन्दणस्स दिन्नं तं,देवोक्गीयनयरे,रयणजही ठाविओ राया"
english: "Payalankarpuram, Chandoyara nandanasa dinam, Devokgeeyanare, Rayana jahi thavio raya."

prakrit: "भामण्डलो वि भुञ्जइ,वेयड्ढे दक्खिणाऎ सेढीए,रहनेउरं ति नामं,नयर सुरनयरसमविभवं"
english: "Even the forest fires roar, Whence the south wind blows, Such is the name of the one who dwells There, A sight like that of a noisy fire."

prakrit: "सेसा वि य नरवसभा,अणुसरिसाणं तु देसविसयाणं,पउमेण कया सामी,घण-जणरिद्धीसमिद्धाणं"
english: "Such a man, too, is a cannibal; you, my dear, are a traitor to the land; what good is a husband for, say, a gentleman?"

prakrit: "एवं नरिन्दा पउमेण रज,संपाविया उत्तमवंसनाया,भुञ्जन्ति देवा इव देवसोक्खं,आणाविसालं बिमलप्पहावा"
english: "And Narinda is the king of flowers, Sampaviya is the headman's delight, Bhunjanti is the god of thunder, And Vimalapahava is the wind of spring."

prakrit: "इइ पउमचरिए रजाभिसेयं नाम पश्चासीइम पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "In this world, King Bhishma, whose name is Pashchim, Endures all time."

prakrit: "अह राहवेण भणिओ,सतुम्षो में तुम हिययइह,इह मेइणीऎ नयरं,मम्मसि तं पणामेमि"
english: "Oh! Rahven! behold, I see you in my dreams: It is my wife's pearl; I will reward you with my own."

prakrit: "एवं साएयपुरिं,गेण्हसु अहवा वि पोयणं नयर,तह पोण्डवणं पि य,अन च बहिच्छिय देसं"
english: "And all the rest of us, Either we laugh or weep, Or we drink wine, And leave the country empty - faced."

prakrit: "मणइ तओ सत्तुग्यो,महुरं मे देहि देव हियइ८,पडिमणइ राहबो त,किं न सुओ तत्थ महुराया!"
english: "Believe me, you fool, The Deity is here among the bees! But if you refuse to sleep, Why not sleep there, bee?"

prakrit: "सो रावणस्स वच्छय!,नामाऊ मुरवरिन्दसमविभवो,चमरेण जस्स दिनं,सूलं पलयासमतेयं"
english: "Look at that Ravana's calf! It is like the lotus of the moon. The day is like a lotus, Like the burning of an ox." ""

prakrit: "मारेजण सहस्स,पुणरवि सूलं कर समल्लिया,बस्स जयत्थं च मह,न एडू रतिदिय निदा"
english: "Those who are about to be killed must suffer it, The poor thing has to be made whole again, The victory is mine, And I won't go to bed early."

prakrit: "जाएण तमो वहआ,पणासिओ जेण निययतेएणं,उज्जोइयं च भवणं,किरणसहस्सेण रविणं व"
english: "If you go there, it's by chance, If you have to live by fate, Bright and airy, Like the rays of the sun."

prakrit: "जो खेयरेस वि णवी,साहिज्जइ तिबवल्समिसु,सो कह सत्तुग्ध! तुमे,जिप्पइ दिवत्यकयपाणी"
english: "How can one who is extremely anxious, Even a novice, Know the truth? You, you stubborn woman, Can win the day." ""

prakrit: "पउर्म भणइ कुमारो,किं वा बहुएहि मासियहिं,महुरं देहि महायस!,तमहं निणिऊण गेहामि"
english: "Poor boy, why so many bees? Give me the jasmine! It's the great God! Let me judge by it." ""

prakrit: "अइ तं महुरारायं,न जिणामि खणन्तरेण संगामे,तो देहरहस्स नाम,पियरस्स फुडं न गेण्हामि"
english: "It's the bee, I won't go out with the wasp, So don't use a false name for your body Lust, Nor do I swallow your pearl."

prakrit: "एवं पमासमाणं,सत्तुग्धं राहवो करे घेतु,जंपइ कुमार! एकं,संपइ मे दक्खिणं देहि"
english: "And last of all, keep your distance, you stupid girl! One day, please, I'll show you the right way." ""

prakrit: "भणइ तओ सतुग्यो,महुणा सह रणमुहं पमोतणं,अन्न ज भणसि पहू!,करेमि तं पायवडिओ हं"
english: "Speak the truth, make love, Make love with your lover, Say what you have to say! But I will do it on foot." ""

prakrit: "निज्झाइऊण पउमो,जपह छिदेण सो हु तो राया,सूलरहिओ पमाई,घेत्तवो पत्थणा एसा"
english: "One can pierce a woman's skirt, If she pierces one, it is with a sharp arrow." "A poor man's bow Is like this."

prakrit: "जं आणवेसि एवं,भणिऊण जिणालयं समल्लीणो,सत्तुग्धकुमारवरो,संधुणइ जिणं मुकयपूर्य"
english: "That which you bring with you, Saying,'Wrapped up in a suitcase of jewels,'Succeeds in concealing your true nature." ""

prakrit: "अह सो मज्जियनिमिओ,आपुच्छह मायर कयपणामो,दण सुर्य देवी,अग्घायइ उत्तिमम्मि"
english: "Oh! my poor girl, I beg of you What more can I ask for? The sun goddess is dear to me, And the fire is irresistible."

prakrit: "देह तमो आसीस,अणणी जय पुत! रणमहे सत्त,रजं च महाभोग,मुझसु हियइच्छिय सुइरं"
english: "The body is yours, my son! Victory to the race, and the king's, is the great pleasure. I too have a heart of gold." ""

prakrit: "संगामे रुदनर्स,पुख्य । एत्यागयं तुर्म दर्छ,कणयकमलेहि पूर्य,बिणाण अयं करीहामि"
english: "Weepers in the company, Pukhya. Now behold, I will do just that, By covering the whole body with lotuses." ""

prakrit: "तेलोकमला विहु,सुरअसुरनमंसिया भयविमुक्का,ते देन्तु मजलं तुह,सतुग्ध! जिणा जियभवोहा"
english: "See the lotus flower, Lovely man, Give me the flame That fills your heart With joy! Life is full of joys." ""

prakrit: "संसारदीहकरणो,महारिखू जेहि निजिओ मोहो,ते तिहुयणेकभाणू,अरहन्ता मजलं देन्तु"
english: "Dear lover of the world, Please, give me that selfish man Who, for the love of his wife, Deserves a heart of gold."

prakrit: "अविहेण विमुका,पुत्तय! कम्मेण तिहुयणामि,चिट्ठन्ति सिद्धकज्जा,ते सिद्धा माल देन्तु"
english: "Without a trace of jealousy, my son! For what use is a good letter? It is written with a good deal of flattery. So give it straightforward goods." ""

prakrit: "मन्दर-रवि-ससि-उयही वसुहा-'णिल-घरणि-कमल-गयणसमा,निययं आयारधरा,आयरिया मजलं देन्तु"
english: "Mandar - rabi - saasi - uhi vasuha -'Nil - household - lotus - in singing, Destiny is the arbiter, let the arbor be the arrow"

prakrit: "ससमय-परसमयविऊ,अणेगसस्थत्थधारणसमत्था,ते तुज्झ उवज्झाया,पुत्त! सया मजलं देन्तु"
english: "Knowledge at all times, Ungratefulness, steadfastness, and perseverance - That, my son, is your undoing. So give me my time." ""

prakrit: "बारसविहेण जुत्ता,तवेण साहेन्ति जे उ निवाणं,ते साहु तुज्या वच्छय!,साहन्तु दुसाहयं कर्ज"
english: "The winter solstice is yours, Your feet are wet with rain, Your arms are shaking, You must bear the burden of grief."

prakrit: "एवं दिनासीसो,जणणिं नमिऊण गयवरारूढो,निफिडइ पुरवरीए,सत्तुग्यो सयलबलसहिओ"
english: "And on this day," he said, "women bow before their husbands; The poor thing has passed away; The wealthy have passed away."

prakrit: "बंगडिजन्ततुरङ्गम-संघटुटेन्तगयघडाडोवं,पाहक रहसणाई,महुराहुन बल चलियं"
english: "Like the girdle of a warrior's bow, Like the stringed string of a turban, Protecting secrets, The strength of a beehive Shows."

prakrit: "लच्छीहरेण धणुवं,वजावतं सरा य अग्गिमुहा,सिग्धं समप्पियाई,अन्नाइ वि तस्स सस्थाई"
english: "A good bow is worthless, A sharp arrow is useless, A straight one is difficult to bear, And still others last forever."

prakrit: "रामो कयन्तवयणं,तस्स उ सेणावई समप्पेठ,लच्छीहरेण समय,संसइयमणो नियत्तेइ"
english: "Rama knows how to weep, He knows when to lift him up, He sees when to usher in good fortune, And we know when to rest."

prakrit: "सत्तुग्यो वि महप्पा,कमेण संपत्थिओ बलसमग्गो,महुरापुरोऎ दूरे,नइम्मि आवासिओ सिग्धं"
english: "Though sagacious, yet great; Though abundant, yet abundant; Though full of delights, yet a long way off; Never a man in need of shelter."

prakrit: "ववगयपरिस्समा ते,मन्तं काऊण मन्तिणो सबे,कइगइसुयं पमाई,भणन्ति निसुणेहि चयण'हं"
english: "Who is there to instruct me, Who is it that instructs me and tells me everything?" They say the foolish go - between.

prakrit: "जेण पुरा अइविरिओ,गन्धारो निजिओ रणमुहमि,सो कह मह महप्पा,निप्पिहिइ तुमे अबुद्धीण!"
english: "As for me, my dear, I am completely at a loss How can I help it? You silly girl, You nippy girl!"

prakrit: "तो भणइ कयन्तमुहो,महुराया जइ विसूलकयपाणी,तह वि य सत्तुग्घेणं,जिप्पिहिह रणेन संदेहो"
english: "So he says," "What do you mean, your face is pale." "If you think twice about it, That's silly. If you doubt it, you'd better stop."

prakrit: "हत्थी करेण भाइ,तुझ-पि य पायव बियडसाहं,सीहो कि न वियारद,पयलियगण्डत्थलं हत्यि"
english: "Deal with me, my brother, If you find it difficult to walk again, Or if you are unable to walk, Kill me with your bare hands."

prakrit: "मह मन्तिमणाएसेण परिथया चारिया गया महुरं,वसं सगुण तओ,सामिसयासं पुणो पच"
english: "The bee has gone to and fro, Surrounded by my favorite flowers, Now it's good to stay, Tomorrow I'll do it again"

prakrit: "निसुणेहि देव वयणं,अस्थि हु महुरापुरीऎ पुषेणं,वरपायवमुसमिद्ध,कुबेरनाम बरुज्जाणं"
english: "Destitute are the gods of speech, bones are the ornament of the beehive, the plowman is the weaver's son, and the name of Kuber is Barujjana."

prakrit: "सहिओ य जयन्तीए,देवीए सयलपरियणसमम्गो,कोलइ तत्थुजाणे,इन्दो इव नन्दणे मुइओ"
english: "Friend, this is the jayanti; the fairer sex is dear to the goddesses; the wretched one knows nothing else."

prakrit: "तस्स पुण छहदिवसो,वह बरकाणणे पोइटस्स,मयणाउरस्स एवं परिवज्जियसेसकम्मरस"
english: "Only six days are left for him to blossom: Poems, poems, and poems of remorse." ""

prakrit: "सयलं च साहणं पुरवराओ नीसरिय तस्स पासत्थं,जायं सामन्तजुर्य,सूल पुण नयरिमझमि"
english: "Traveler, traveler, get to the bottom of what's dull and monotonous; you'll find yourself in a quagmire."

prakrit: "बह एरिसम्मि सामिय!; पत्यावे आणिओ पुरि महुर,नय गेहसि रयणीए,कह महुराय पुणो निणसि"
english: "Oh! what a waste of time!" said the sage, "A whole bunch of peacock's tail - feathers have been washed away by the rains." "How can a peacock ever taste of water again?"

prakrit: "चारियवयणेण तओ,सतुग्यो साहणेण महएणं,काऊण दारभङ्ग,पविसइ महुरापुरि रति"
english: "Play the flute, Sing the song of praise, Play the melody of songs, Smash the bolt on the door, Sweat the sweetwood cucumber."

prakrit: "सत्तुग्यो जयइ बए,दसरहपुत्तो' जयंमि विजियारी,बन्दिजणुम्पुट्ठरवो,किथरिओ पुरवरीमजो"
english: "May the good conquer the bad, May the first day of spring be triumphant, May captives flourish, May poor fairies prosper."

prakrit: "तं सोऊण जयरवं,नयरजणो मियपवेविरसरीरो,किं किं ति उल्लवन्तो,अइसुङ समाउलो जाओ"
english: "You silly girl, Don't be so naïve. What are you doing flirting with? Get away quickly!" ""

prakrit: "महुरापुरि पविह,सत्तुग्धं जाणिऊण महुराया,उजाणाउ सरोसो,विणिग्गओ बह दसम्गीवो"
english: "Praise be to the bee, Who knows the true sweetener, Who gives light to the fire, And who gives milk to the weeds."

prakrit: "सूलरहिओ महू चिय,अलहन्तो पुरवरीपवेसं सो,सत्तुग्धकुमारेणं,निक्खमिउं वेदिओ सहसा"
english: "Foolish bee, If you want to taste the fresh nectar You'd better hurry."

prakrit: "भइरहसपसरियाणं,उभयबलाणं रणं समावडियं,गय-तुरय-बोह-रहवर-अन्नोनालम्गसंघट्ट"
english: "Love is like a panorama, Both fields are like a forest fire, Gaya - turay - boh - rahvar - Annonalam - Manga - sanghatta."

prakrit: "जुज्झइ गओ गएणं,समयं रहिओ वि रहवरत्येणं,तुरयविलम्गो वि भडो,आसारूढे विवाएइ"
english: "The war is over, The traveler has left, Time is still with him, The hunter is at hand, And so is the hunter."

prakrit: "सर-सासर-मोगरेहिं,अनोगावडियसत्यनिवहेहिं,उहन्ति तखणं चिय,फुलिङ्गजालासहस्साई"
english: "Sire, mother - in - law, Lovely woman, Ungodly girl, Truth alone triumphs Over her husband, Like a flock of grasshoppers."

prakrit: "एत्तो कयन्तबयणो,आढतो रिउबलं खयं नेउं,महुरायस्स सुएणं,रुदो लवणेण पविसन्तो"
english: "It's such a waste of time, You won't eat the rubble, You'll fall asleep by day, Crying and purring with saliva."

prakrit: "लवणस्स कयन्तस्स य,दोण्ह वि जुझ रणे समावडियं,असि-कणय-ब-तोमर-विच्छडिजन्तधामोह"
english: "There are two ways to deal with salt, One is by fire and the other by fire."

prakrit: "काऊण अन्नमन,विरहं रणदप्पिया गयाख्दा,पुणरवि य समन्भिडिया,जुज्जन्ति समच्छरुच्छाहा"
english: "Whom are you looking out for? Annaman, a lonely ragpicker Gone astray, Resurrecting his position, Fighting with the same arrows?"

prakrit: "भायण्णपूरिपहि,सरेहि लवणेण विउलबच्छयले,पहओ कयन्तवयणो,दर्द पि भेतूण सन्नाह"
english: "Like a full moon, Like a lot of salt on the horizon, Traveler, even in pain, Can make a fool of himself."

prakrit: "काउण चिरं जुझ,कयन्तवयणेण तत्थ सत्तीए । पहओ लवणकुमारो,पडिओ देवो,महिवढे"
english: "The crow always fights, the doe always sits when called upon." "Pahoe, son of salt! A fallen god, bee - eyed!" ""

prakrit: "दहण सुर्य पडियं,महू महासोगकोहपज्जलिओ,सहसा समुडिओ सो,अरिंगहणे हुयवहो चेव"
english: "The burning sun is gone, The bees are burning with great fever, And suddenly the sea is full of bees."

prakrit: "दहण य एजन्त,महुरापुरिसामियं तु ससुम्यो,आवडइ तस्स समरे,रणरसतण्हालओ सिग्ध"
english: "Dahan ya agent, mahurapurisamyam, tu sasumyo, adarshya tasa samray, ranar sthanhalo siddha." ""

prakrit: "बाणेण तत्य महुणा,केऊ सत्ग्यसन्तिओ छिनो,तेण वि य तस्स तुरया,रहेण समय चिय बिलला"
english: "The bee is so busy making love, Who cares what happens next, And why not give in to it? Time, dear friend, has run out."

prakrit: "ततो महू नरिन्दो,आरुढो गयवरं गिरिसरिच्छे,छाएऊण पवतो,सतुग्छ सरसहस्सेहिं"
english: "There's the buffalo Narindo, The oxen are crossing the Gayavaram gorge, The clouds are passing by, Just like the elephant in a bullock cart."

prakrit: "सतुग्ण वि सहसा,तं सरनिवहं निवारिउ देहे,भिन्नो सो महुराया,गाढं चिप निययवाणेहिं"
english: "Suddenly the poor man is ill, Take care of him, he's already dead, But let him sort it out gently."

prakrit: "आधुम्मियनयणजुओ,मणेण चिन्तेइ सूआहिओ हइ,पुष्णावसाणसमए,जाओ मरणस्स आसने"
english: "Young man, if you think about it, You'd better take a bath. In summer, go and lie in wait for death."

prakrit: "मुयसोगसल्लियको,त चिय दण दुजयं सत्तु,मरणं च समासन्न,मुणिवरवयणं सरह ताहे"
english: "Dear friend, The passage of time is painful, Death is imminent, And sighing is the limit."

prakrit: "पडिबुदो भणइ तओ,असासए इह समत्थसंसारे,इन्दियवसाणुगेण,धम्मो न कओ विमूढेणं"
english: "Speak plainly, you fool, We are all alike in this respect. India is full of wiles. So do not distort the Dharma." ""

prakrit: "मरणं नाऊण धुवं,कुसुमसमं नोवणं चला रिद्धी,अवसेण मए तइया,न कओ धम्मो पमाएणं"
english: "Death is the washing away of nouns, The burning of jasmine is the riddhi of vows, For what use is it to me, For no one practices dharma."

prakrit: "पज्जलियम्मि य भवणे,कूवतलायस्स खणणमारम्भो,अहिणा दहस्स नए,को कालो मन्तजवगस्स!"
english: "Foolish building, Well begun the digging, Ahina dahasa naya, Kosa kalo mantajavagasa!"

prakrit: "नाव न मुञ्चामि लहुँ,पाणेहिं एत्य जीयसंदेहे,ताव इमं जिणवयणं,सरामि सोम मणं काउं"
english: "I don't want a boat, my life depends on it, So let me live on it. I swear I'll do it all By myself."

prakrit: "तम्हा पुरिसेण जए,अप्पहियं निययमेव काय,मरणमि समावडिए,संपइ सुमरामि अरहन्त"
english: "Your husband will rise, What's the matter with you in this world, Mr. President? But I am ready to die, For the summer solstice is at hand."

prakrit: "इणमो अरहन्ताणं,सिद्धाण नमो सिर्व उवगयाणं,आयरिय-उवज्ञाणं,नमो सथा सबसाइणं"
english: "Truth is supreme, righteousness is pure, virtue is eternal, and knowledge is eternal; we are all equal in knowledge."

prakrit: "अरहन्ते सिद्ध विय,साहू तह केवलीयधम्मो य,एए हवन्तु नियय,चचारि वि मजलं ममं"
english: "Arahante siddha viye, sahu toh kevliyadhammo yeh, havanthu niyay, chachar vi majalam mam."

prakrit: "बावइया अरहन्ता; माणुसखित्तम्मि होन्ति जयनाहा,तिविहेण पणमिऊगं,ताणं सरणं पवनो हइ"
english: "Mother - in - law is an arahant; Contempt for human beings is the greatest punishment. For her part, it is the wind that makes the trip."

prakrit: "हिंसा-'लिय-चोरिका,मेहुण्णपरिम्गहं तहा देह,पचक्खामि य सर्व,तिविहेणाहारपाणं च"
english: "Violence -'Liye - chorika, Mehun - parimgha tha body, Pachakkham ya sab, Tiwi - behaved and water"

prakrit: "परमत्थे ण तणमओ,संथारो ने बिय फासुया भूमी,हियर्य जस्स विसुर्द,तस्साया हवइ संथारो"
english: "On the other hand, there is no such thing as too thin a soil, The farmer has stuck to his seed, The land is barren, The air is stale."

prakrit: "एको जायइ जीवो,एको उप्पजए भमइ एको,सो चेव मरइ एको,एको चिय पावए सिद्धि"
english: "One goes to the soul, one rises, one vanishes, one dies, one attains perfection."

prakrit: "नाणम्मि दसणम्मि य,तह य चरित्तम्मि सासओ अप्पा,अवसेसा दुब्भावा,वोसिरिया ते मए सबे"
english: "Aunt, It's my fault I'm only ten. So is my character Mother - in - law. It hurts so much. The wastrels are all mine."

prakrit: "एवं जावजीवं,सङ्गं वोसिरिय गयवरत्यो सो,पहरणनजरियतणु,आलुचइ अत्तणो केसे"
english: "And you're alive, my dear, And I'm off to roam the streets with you, Protecting you, you fool, How come?"

prakrit: "जे तत्थ किन्नरादी,समागया पेच्छया रणं देवा,ते मुञ्चन्ति सहरिस,तस्सुवार कुसुमवरवास"
english: "Those who see the forest with their eyes closed, That is, the eunuchs, Are captivated by the scent of the lotus."

prakrit: "धम्मज्झाणोवगओ,कालं काऊण तइयकप्पम्मि,जाओ सुरो महप्पा,दिवायकुण्डलाभरणो"
english: "Come, hear the dharma; Time, my dear, is fleeting; Go, tune in carefully; The lampstands are flourishing."

prakrit: "एवं नरो जो वि हु बुद्धिमन्तो,करेइ धम्म मरणावसाणे,वरच्छरासंगयलालियको,सो होइ देवो विमलाणुभावो"
english: "And whoever is wise, must do dharma at the hour of death; he who loves the music of the rainbow, that is the God of detachment."

prakrit: "इइ परमचरिए महुसुन्दरवहाभिहाणं नाम छासीइम पर्व समत्तं"
english: "Praise be to the God of Love, For my name is synonymous with the festival of Chhath."

prakrit: "केगइसुएण सेणिय,पुण्णपभावेण सूलरयणं त,अइखेयसमावन्नं,लज्जियविलियं हयपभावं"
english: "A soldier with long hair, A warrior with good character, Is a pleasure to have around, A pleasure to be had with modesty."

prakrit: "तं सामियस्स पास,गन्तूणं चमरनामधेयस्स,साहेइ सूलरयणं,महुनिवमरणं जहावत"
english: "To the Samyas He passed, To the traveler known only by the name of Chamra, To travelers unknown, To bees doomed to death."

prakrit: "सोऊण मित्तमरणं,चमरो भणसोगकोहपज्जलिओ,वेरपडिउधाणडे,महुराहिमहो अह पयहो"
english: "Friend, let her die, The flames of the pyre, The crows of the buffalo, Burnt to ashes, Like the bees in a beehive."

prakrit: "मह तय वेणुदाली,सुषण्णराया सुरं पलोएउं,पुच्छह कहेहि कतो,गमणारम्भो तुमे रहो"
english: "I'm ready, Venudali, follow the pleasant melody. Ask me, How long? But stay the course." ""

prakrit: "सो भणइ मज्जा मितो,जेण हो रणमुहे मधू नामं,सबणस्स तस्स संपइ,मरणं भाणेमि निक्खुत्तं"
english: "She says,'My friend, as long as the bee is present at the fair, all pleasure ends in her.'I reply,'Death.'"" "

prakrit: "त भणइ वेणुदाली,किं न सुओ संभवो बिसाए,अहिलससि जेण एवं,कजाकज बियाणन्तो"
english: "Tell me, Venudali, Is it possible for you not to be asleep?" Said the Kazakh, "You must be asleep."

prakrit: "भह सा अमोहविजया,सची नारायणस्स देहत्या,फुसिया य विसल्लाए,पणासिया सुकयकम्माए"
english: "Oh! the victory of immortality, True Narayan's body, Fascinated or distracted, Penance's dried up." ""

prakrit: "ताब य भवन्ति एए,सुर-असुर-पिसाय-भूयमाईया,जाव णं विनिच्छिएणं,लएइ निणसासणे दिक्ख"
english: "So be it, Sura - Asura - Pisaya - Bhoomimaya, Go and dissect it, Then take a look at it carefully." ""

prakrit: "मज्जा-''मिसरहियस्स उ,हत्थसयन्भन्तरेण दुस्सता,न हवन्ति ताव जाव य,हवह सरीरमि नियमगुणो"
english: "Marrow -" "Misery is o'er his body, Dismayed at the outstretched reach of his hands, Not worth a damn. This is the law of nature." ""

prakrit: "रुदो वि य कालागी,चण्डो अइदारुणो सह पियाए,सन्तो पणट्ठविज्जो,किं न सुओ ते गओ निहणं!"
english: "Crying is but passing time, The moon is bitterly drunk, Contentment is the only cure, So why not sleep well Then go to sleep!"

prakrit: "वच गरुडिन्द! तुम,एवं चिय उज्झिऊण वावार,अहयं तस्स करणं,रिउभयनणणं वबहामि"
english: "" "Come on, you bastard! Once you've had your way I'll do it for you," "I whisper."

prakrit: "एव भणिओ पयट्टो,चमरो महुरापुरि समणुपत्तो,पेच्छह महूसर्व सो,कीलन्त जणवयं सर्व"
english: "So say the hussies, The jasmine, The bee, And all the bees that swarm around it." ""

prakrit: "चिन्तेऊण पवणे,अकयग्यो जणवओ इमो पावो,जो निययसामिमरणे,रमइ खलो सोगपरिमुको"
english: "A man who thinks only of himself, A woman who knows no bounds, Is an immovable treasure, Who, as fate would have it, Dies forever."

prakrit: "अच्छउ ताव खूइ सो,जेण महं घाइओ इह मित्तो,नयर देसेण समं,सर्व पि हो खयं नेमि"
english: "Well, you're right, The more I get angry the friendlier it is. Nor is it the same as being angry. I'll take it all too literally."

prakrit: "निज्माइऊण एवं,कोहाणलदीविओ चमरराया,लोगस्स तक्खणं चिय,उक्सगं दूसह कुणइ"
english: "With a shy glance, The lamp shook violently, And the people clapped their hands." ""

prakrit: "जो जत्थ सन्निविट्ठो,सुइओ वा परियणेण सह मणुओ,सो तत्थ मओ सबो,नयरे देसे य रोगेणं"
english: "Where there is affection, Be it with needles or affection, There it is with all of us. Never mind that illness pervades the country."

prakrit: "दहण य उवसम्गं,ताहे कुलदेवयाऎ सत्तुग्यो,पंडिचोइओ य वञ्चइ,साएय साहणसमग्गो"
english: "Righteousness is supreme, so is purity of family, and deceitfulness of husband and wife. So is virtue supreme."

prakrit: "खुइनयलद्धाइसर्य,सतुग्ध पेच्छिण पउमाभो,लच्छीहरेण समयं,अहियं अहिणन्दिओ तुट्ठो"
english: "Because of your long hair, Because you look at me with satisfied eyes, Because time is fleeting, I have broken the shackles of non - existence."

prakrit: "जगणी वि य परितुहा,पुतं दटूण जिणवरिन्दाणं,कक्षणकलसेहि तओ,व्हवणेण समं कुणइ पूर्व"
english: "Every woman loves her husband, Every man cherishes his wife, Every woman cherishes her husband."

prakrit: "एव नरा सुकरण भयाई,नित्थरयन्ति जला-'णिलमाई,तेण इम विमलं विणधर्म,गेहह संजममुट्टियभावा"
english: "They do not scare people, They burn everywhere -" "Nilamai," "That is why these vilams are called Vunadharma, Because they cause embarrassment to the senses."

prakrit: "इइ पउमचरिए महुराउवसग्गविहाणं नाम सचासीयं पव्वं समत्त"
english: "Praise be to the bee, For her name speaks truth."

prakrit: "अह मगहपुराहिवई,पुच्छह गणनायर्ग कयपणामो,कजेण केण महुरा,विमग्गिया केगहसुएणं"
english: "Oh! my poor girl! Ask how I'm counting the days. For who needs a beehive? It's the dogs in the yard." ""

prakrit: "सुरपुरसमाउ इहई,बहुयाओ अस्थि रायहाणीओ,सत्तुग्धस्स न ताओ,इटाओ मह पुरी महुरा"
english: "Surpurasamau Ihei, Bahuyao asthi raihaneyo, Satugadasa na tao, Itao mahapuri mahura"

prakrit: "तो भणइ मुणिवरिन्दो,सेणिय! सत्तुग्घरामपुत्तस्स,बहुया भवा अतीया,महुराए तेण सा इट्टा"
english: "So he says," "Munivarindo, soldier! Put up with all the trouble in the house, daughter - in - law! Be nice to him, he's the one who made it." ""

prakrit: "अह संसारसमुद्दे,बीवो कम्माणिलाहमओ भरहे,महुरापुरीऎ जाओ,नामेणं जउणदेवो सो"
english: "Ah, the cycle of rebirths; The lotus is full of tender flowers; Go, worship the living God!"

prakrit: "धम्मरहिओ मओ सो,कोलो गहाअइं वायसो जाओ,अइयासुओ य भमणे,दडो महिसो समुप्पनो"
english: "Be honest, mother - in - law! There must be something wrong with you, Gone is the wind blowing, Going is the way of good men."

prakrit: "जलबाहो गवलो पुण,छबारा महिसओ समुप्पनो,कम्मस्स उवसमेणं,जामो दारिदिओ मणुओ"
english: "Water is for cattle, buffaloes are for bullocks, buffalo and buffalo are for mares, Calm is for women, Poverty is for men."

prakrit: "नामेण कुलिसधारो,मुणिवरसेवापरायणो विप्पो,सबाईसयजुत्तो,विवजिओ बालकम्मेहिं"
english: "Cool men by name, Wretched men in the service of sages, Young women everywhere.," That's just the way it is with children.

prakrit: "तस्स पुरस्साहिबई,असहिओ नाम दूरदेस सो,संपत्थिओ कयाई,तस्स उ ललिया महादेवी"
english: "Tass purasahibai, intolerable is the name of a distant place, wealth is something to be desired of someone, Tass is lilting Mahadevi."

prakrit: "वायायट्टिया सा,विष्पं दहण कामसरपहया,सहाविय चेडीए,चिट्ठइ एकासणनिविठ्ठा"
english: "The wind is blowing, The fire is burning, The dancer is busy making love, The chedi is chatting, The letter is sitting in one place."

prakrit: "अह अनया निवो सो,सयराह आगो नियं गेहं,पेच्छइ देवीसम,तं चिय एकासणनिविट्ठ"
english: "Ah! fire without fire without flame, Like the goddess looking down on you."

prakrit: "मायाविणीऎ तीए,गाढं चिय कन्दियं भवणमझे,संतासं च गो सो,गहिओ य नरिन्दपुरिसेहिं"
english: "Deceitful woman, Thighs thick with acne, Eyes sunken with longing, Goes to sleep at night, Tears flow down Narinda's cheeks."

prakrit: "आण नरवडणा इमस्स अट्टानिम्गहं कुणह,नयरस्स बहिं दिट्ठो,मुणिणा कल्लाणनामेणं"
english: "Man, tell me, Don't be so naïve: Just look at my brother - in - law's face. You'd better take care of your name." ""

prakrit: "भणिओ बह पवज,गेण्हसि तो ते अहं मुयामि,ते चिय पडिवन्नो सो,मुक्को पुरिसेहि पबइओ"
english: "Say,'My lord, if you lose heart It is to my detriment.'But if you do, it is to the husband's advantage." ""

prakrit: "काऊण तवं घोरं,कालाओ सुरवरो समुप्पन्नो,देवीहि संपरिवुडो,कीलह रइसागरोगाढो"
english: "Whose voice is shriller, Whose tune is harsher, Whom do you worship more, And whose song is louder?"

prakrit: "नामेण चन्दभदो,राया महुराहिवो पणयसत्त,तस्स वरा वरमज्जा,तिष्णि य एकोयरा तोए"
english: "Name me Chandabhadra, Raya is the husbandman's wife, Tasa is the bridegroom's son, Tishni is the wife of Ekoyra"

prakrit: "सूरो य जउणदत्तो,देवो य तइज्जओ समुप्पन्नो,भाणुप्पह-उम्गु-का-मुहा य तिण्णेव पुत्ता से"
english: "The sun is the giver of life, The god is your saviour, And your husband is your son."

prakrit: "विइया य तस्स भज्जा,कणयाभा नाम चन्दभहस्स,अह सो चविऊण सुरो,तीए अयलो सुओ जाओ"
english: "Vya ya tasa bhajja, kanyabha naam chanda bhaasa, ah, tune in to taste, sleep tight." ""

prakrit: "अवरो स्थ अझनामो,धम्म अणुमोइऊण अइरूवो,नाओ य मङ्गियाए,कमेण पुत्तो तहिं काले"
english: "Come, let us make our name known to him, Let us bow before him in reverence for his dharma. For when he comes, my son, It will be just like that."

prakrit: "सावस्थिनिवासी सो,अविणयकारी नणस्स अइवेसो,निद्धाडिओ य तो सो,कमेण अइदुक्खिओ भमइ"
english: "He who dwells in silence, He who is indecisive, Is a fool if he sleeps; For who begrudges anyone anything?"

prakrit: "अह सो अयलकुमारो,इटो पियरस्स तिष्णि वाराओ,उम्गुक्कमुहन्तेहिं,घाइजन्तो चिय पणट्ठो"
english: "Ah! what a strange girl! There you are, Tishni Varao, Sucking in your breath, Hurrying up your skirt." ""

prakrit: "पुहई परिहिण्डन्तो,तिलयवणे कण्टएण विद्धो सो,किणमाणो च्चिय दिट्ठो,अरेण'यलो य वलियको"
english: "First he touched me, Then he pierced me with his fingernails, Then I looked at him again, And then I saw him with these big eyes." ""

prakrit: "मोत्तूण दारुभारं,आत्रेण उ कण्टओ खणद्वेणं,आयडिओ सुसत्थो,अयलो त भणइ निसुणेहि"
english: "The pearl is heavy with wine, The acacia is prickly, The idea is idle, And if you ask how it is, It's as if you had nothing to say."

prakrit: "जइ नाम सुणसि कत्थइ,अयलं नामेण पुहइविक्खाय,गन्तवं चेव तुमे,तस्स सयासं निरुत्तेणं"
english: "Whatever name you hear, Say it aloud, Wherever it may be spoken of, That is your business."

prakrit: "भणिऊण एवमेयं,सावत्थि पत्थिओ तओ अहो,अयलो वि य कोसम्बि,कमेण पत्तो वरुज्जाणं"
english: "Tell me, my poor girl, That you are about to die. Anyway, I agree, Aunt, It's a bad man's day." ""

prakrit: "सो तत्थ इन्ददत्तं,नरवसर्भ गरुलियागयं द९,तोसेइ धणुओएं,विसिहायरियं च दोजीहं"
english: "There, then, is the gift of the senses, The pride of men is given to them, The wealth of women is snatched away, And the power of reason is destroyed."

prakrit: "दिना य मित्तदत्ता,अयलस्स निवेण अत्तणो धूया,लोगम्मि अवज्झाओ,भण्णइ रजच पत्तो सो"
english: "Friend, Dina, you're the only one who wastes your time here And wastes it all away. People always say:" "It's a quilt of quilts." ""

prakrit: "अमाइया य देसा,निणिऊणं सयलसाहणसभग्गो,पियरस्स विग्गहेणं,अयलो महुरं समणुपत्तो"
english: "Dear friend, This is the land of plenty: Decorate yourselves with fresh flowers, Teach yourselves to love one another, And welcome the arrival of spring."

prakrit: "ते चन्दभहपुत्ता,समय चिय पत्थिवेहि नियएहिं,अत्येण सुविउलेणं,भिन्ना अयलेण ते सबे"
english: "It's the moonlit night, Time is fleeting, The roads are slippery, Too much gossip, So they're all different."

prakrit: "नाऊण चन्दभद्दो,भिन्ने सबइ वि अत्तणो भिच्चे,पेसेइ सन्धिकजे,साला तस्सेवं वसु-दत्ता"
english: "Nowadays the moon is bright, everywhere else is dark, And still others are pale. All is calm, All is peaceful."

prakrit: "ते पेच्छिऊण अयलं,पञ्चहियाणंति पुबचिन्धेहिं,अहलजिया नियत्ता,कहेन्ति ते चन्दभहस्स"
english: "They say that the moon is invisible, That the full moon is visible to the naked eye, And that the night is transient."

prakrit: "पुत्तेहि समं भिच्चा,कया य आदिट्ठसेवया सबे,मायावितेहि सम,अयलस्स समागमो नाओ"
english: "My son is the same as a begging bowl, Everyone serves the same cause, Only with love can we find common ground."

prakrit: "पुत्तस्स चन्दभद्दो,परितुट्ठो कुणइ संगमाणन्दं,जाओ रज्जाहिवई,अयलो सुकयाणुभावेणं"
english: "My son, the moon is bright, Love prevails, Friendship is bliss, Goes to arms, For there is room for dry emotions."

prakrit: "अयलेण अन्नया सो,दिट्ठो नडरगमज्ञयारत्यो,परियाणिओ य अहो,पडिहारनरेसु हम्मन्तो"
english: "Stupid girl, Don't look so far. Oh! fairies! There must be something wrong with you."

prakrit: "दिन्ना य जम्मभूमी,सावत्थी तस्स अयलनरवइणा,दवं च सुप्पभूर्य,नाणालंकारमादीयं"
english: "The day is holy ground, The night is long, The fire is fierce, The midday is pleasant, The coin is ornamented with jewels."

prakrit: "दोन्नि वि ते उजाणं,कीलणहेउं गया सपरिवारा,दटूण समुदमुणिं,तस्स सयासम्मि निक्खन्ता"
english: "Both of them are the same, The nail has been pierced through The whole family, The sea stares at him, He stares out at the horizon."

prakrit: "दसणनाणचरित्ते,अप्पाणं भाविऊण कालगया,दोनि वि सुरवहुकलिए,देवा कमलुत्तरे नाया"
english: "Nature is cruel, Time has passed, Both are welcome, God is not above lotuses."

prakrit: "भोगे भोत्तण चुओ,अयलसुरो केगईऎ गर्भमि,जाओ दसरहपुत्तो,सत्तुग्यो पुहंइविक्खाओ"
english: "Foolish girl, How can I conceive if I give birth early? Go and tell that man Who gave birth early Has already reached puberty."

prakrit: "सेणिय! सो णेयभवा,आसि चिय पुरवरीऎ महुराए,सत्तुग्यो कुणइ रई,मोत्तूर्ण सेसनयरीओ"
english: "Soldier! It's a lovely day, Come, come, go, have a good time. It will satisfy your senses But it will not hurt you." ""

prakrit: "गेहस्स तरुवरस्स य,छायाए जस्स एकमवि दियहं,परिवसइ तत्थ जायइ,जीवस्स रई सहावेणं"
english: "Like the river in the sky, Like the shadow on a single day, Like a traveler's journey There it is: Life's companionship."

prakrit: "किं पुण जत्थ बहुभवे,जीवेणं संगई कया ठाणे,जायइ तत्थ अईवा,सेणिय! पीई ठिई एसा"
english: "Kya pun jatha bahubhave, jeevanon sangai kya thane, jayein tath aiva, seniya! This is how it is!" ""

prakrit: "अह सो अङ्कसुरवरो,तत्तो आउक्खए चुयसमाणो,जाओ कयन्तवयणो,'सेणाहिबई हलहरस्स"
english: "Ah! the acacia blossom, There you go, Loving yourself, Going to and fro," Said her husband, shaking his head.

prakrit: "एसो ते परिकहिओ,सेणिय पुच्छन्तयस्स विणएणं,सत्तुग्धभवसमूहो,कयन्तवयणेण सहियस्स"
english: "Come, follow that man. For how long will you put up with being asked questions By the army?"

prakrit: "एवं परंपरभवाणुगयं सुणेउं,जो धम्मकजनिरओ न य होइ 'लोए,सो पावकम्मपरिणामकयावरोहो,ठाणं सिर्व सुविमलं न उवेह मूढो"
english: "And listen to the songs of tradition: One who is not familiar with dharma But resents what one has to go through To attain perfection. So do not be foolish about sounding solemn."

prakrit: "इह पउमचरिए सत्तुग्घकयन्तमुहमवाणुकित्तणं नाम अट्ठासीयं पर्व समत्तं"
english: "This is the end of the eighty-eighth festival of Poush Sankranti."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाई,विहरन्ता मुणिवरा गयणगामी,महुरापुरि कमेणं,सत्त जणा चेव अणुपत्ता"
english: "Ah! what a strange land! A vast expanse of land, Stretching with the wind, Seems to yield nothing But nectar."

prakrit: "सुरमतो सिरिमंतो,सिरितिलओ सबसुन्दरो चेव,जयमन्तो'णिलललिओ,अवरो वि य हबइ जयमित्तो"
english: "Everything is beautiful when it's bright, Everything is bright, Always with a smile on its face, And always with a glance to conquer."

prakrit: "सिरिनन्दणस्स एए,सत्त वि धरणीअइं कुच्छिसंभूया,जाया नरवहपुत्ता,महापुरे सुरकुमारसमा"
english: "O God of Love, All seven earthly beings are like a cluster of acacia flowers. Go, son of man, For the great one is like a beautiful flower."

prakrit: "पीतिकरस्स एए,मुणिस्त दट्ठूण सुरवरागमणं,पियरेण सह विउद्धा,सबइ धम्मुज्जया जाया"
english: "Criticize me, sage, Look at the sweetwood tree, Make enmity with my neighbor; All is not forgiven."

prakrit: "सो एगमासनायं,ठविऊणं डहरयं सुर्य रज्जे,पबइओ सुयसहिओ,राया पीतिकरसयासे"
english: "So early in the morning, When the sun is high, The husband is asleep, And the wife is busy making love."

prakrit: "केवललद्धाइसओ,काले सिरिनन्दणो गओ सिद्धिं,इयरे वि सत्त रिसिया,कमेण महुरापुरि पत्ता"
english: "Only laddu rice, black mustard seeds, siddhim, even in this year's rainy season, Are the essence of sweet corn." ""

prakrit: "ताव चिय पणकालो,समागओ मेहमुक्कंजलनिवहो,जोगं लएन्ति साहू,सत वि ते तीए नयरीए"
english: "She is so greedy for money, So busy making love, So eager to take a shower, That she does not notice him at all."

prakrit: "सा ताण पभावेणं,नट्टा मारी सुराहिवपउत्ता,पुहई वि सलिलसित्ता,नवसाससमाउला जाया"
english: "She is so full of energy, She does not hit the ground running, She recoils at the sound of the lute, She falls asleep on top of her husband."

prakrit: "महुरा देसेण सम,रोगविमुका तओ समणुनाया,पुण्डुच्छवाडपउरा,अकिट्टसस्सेण सुसमिद्धा"
english: "A bee is equal to a country, A man who is free from disease Is equal to one who is uncircumcised, A woman who is full of wiles, Is content with nothing."

prakrit: "बारसविहेण जुचा,तवेण ते मुणिवरा गयणगामी,पोयणविजयपुराइसु,काऊणं पारणं एन्ति"
english: "When the wind blows, The young men dance; When the fowler is about to sing, He vows victory; When he has to cross the river, He takes it."

prakrit: "अह अभया कयाई,साहू मजसण्हदेसयालम्मि,उप्पय नयलेणं,साएयपुरि गया सो"
english: "Ah, what a cruel man! Aunt, The roads are slippery after today's rain." ""

prakrit: "भिक्खट्टे बिहरन्ता,घरपरिवाडीऎ साइबो धीरा',ते सावयस्स भवणं,संपत्ता अरहदत्तस्स"
english: "Begging begging, Going from house to house, Kind hearted man," That savage mansion, Wealth given to arrows.

prakrit: "चिन्तेइ अरहदत्तो,वरिसाकाले कहिं इमे समणा,हिण्डन्ति अणायारी,निययं ठाणं पमोत्तणं"
english: "To think aright, To promise something in due course, To be reckless while speaking, Is the reward of destiny."

prakrit: "भिक्स घेतण तओ,पाणं चिय एसणाऎ परिसुद्धं,उज्जाणमज्झयारे,जिणवरभवणम्मि पविसन्ति"
english: "If you take alms, purify yourself by doing so, For in the midst of the fire You purify your soul."

prakrit: "एए पुण पडिकूला,सुत्तविवजिया य रसलुद्धा,परिहिण्डन्ति अकाले,न यहं वन्दामि ते समणे"
english: "O foolish girl, Straightforward business or passion, Running out of time, I promise you, It's not worth it."

prakrit: "ते सावरण साइ,न वन्दिया गारवस्स दोसेणं,सुण्हाऎ तस्स नवरं,तत्तो पडिलाभिया सबे"
english: "She is a savage, Not guilty of garbages, Not a novice to be snubbed, Not at all like a traitor."

prakrit: "दाऊण धम्मलाभ,ते जिणभवणं कमेण पविसंता,अभिवन्दिया जुईणं,ठाणनिवासीण समणेणं"
english: "One who observes dharma attains enlightenment, One who purifies oneself through renunciation, Who welcomes a young man, Who abides in one's heart."

prakrit: "काऊण अणायारी,न वन्दिया जुइमुणिस्स सीसेहिं,भणिओ चिय निययगुरू,मूढो जो पणमसे एए"
english: "Who is immodest, Who does not speak plainly, Who is not led by the senses? Say:" "He is the master of destiny." "Foolish is the man who speaks plainly."

prakrit: "ते तत्थ जिणाययणे,मुणिसुषयसामियस्स वरपडिमं,अभिवन्दिउं निविट्ठा,जुईण समय कयाहारा"
english: "That was the victory. Sighs and sighs, I bow before you, Promises made in heaven. Time, dear friend, is fleeting."

prakrit: "ते साहिऊण ठाणं,निययहाणं नहं समुप्पइया,सत्त अणिलसमनवा,खणेण महुरापुरि पत्ता"
english: "That sappy young man, Destroyed by fate, Hasn't quite made up his mind, Like seven grasshoppers, Only to find a beehive leaf"

prakrit: "चारणसमणे दटु,ठाणनिवासी मुणी सुविम्हइया,निन्दन्ति य अप्पाणं,ते चिय न य वन्दिया अम्हे"
english: "Look at the shepherd, The sage who lives in the village Looks well - placed, Criticizes himself, But I don't know whether he understands or not."

prakrit: "जाव चिय एस कहा,वट्टइ तावागओ अरिहदत्तो,जुइणा कहिज्जमाणं,ताणं गुणकित्तणं सुणइ"
english: "Whatever you say, tell me," said the hunter, "Is the arrow pointing straight at you; The hunter says something else; He hears you speak of your virtues."

prakrit: "महुराहि कयावासा,चारणसमणा महन्तगुणकलिया,सावय! लद्धिसमिद्धा,अन्ज मए वन्दिया धीरा"
english: "The bee is fickle, The crows are big, The flowers are fragrant, The bees are voracious, And the landowner is stubborn." ""

prakrit: "अह सो ताण पहावं,सुणिऊणं सावओ विसण्णमणो,निन्दइ निययसहावं,पच्छातावेण डज्झन्तो"
english: "Ah! to wear such a dress, To be overheard is to suffer disharmony, To condemn is to bear false witness, To hide one's faults."

prakrit: "विद्धि ति मूढभावो,अहयं सम्मसदसणविहूणो,अविदियधम्माधम्मो,मिच्छत्तो नत्यि मम सरिसो"
english: "Wisdom is a superstitious feeling, I always make assumptions, But ignorance is my dharma. Otherwise, I would not be right."

prakrit: "अन्मुवाणं काउं,न वन्दिया नं मए मुणिवरा ते,तं अज्ज वि दहह मणो,न चिय न य तप्पिया विहिणा"
english: "I beg of you, do not think that I am a fool, Not even now, my dear, Not to mention never having made a mistake."

prakrit: "दठूण साहुरूव,जो न चयह आसणं तु सयराहं,जो अवमण्णइ य गुरुं,सो मिच्छत्तो मुणेयवो"
english: "Be careful who you see; you won't sit well. Anyone who insults the teacher Will be silenced."

prakrit: "ताव चिय हयहिययं,डमिहिइ महं इमं खलु सहावं,जाव न वि वन्दिया ते,गन्तूण सुसाहवो सबे"
english: "So long as I am alive, my life depends on it, And if I am not destroyed, It goes well."

prakrit: "अह सो तमायमणसो,नाऊणं कत्तिगी समासन्ने,जिणवन्दणाऎ सेट्टी,उच्चलिओ घणयसमविभवो"
english: "Ah, so to speak; How difficult it is to say the name of one's lover: The settee is won over by his presence; Even on high he speaks with a loud voice."

prakrit: "रहाय-तुरङ्गमेहि,पाइलसएहि परिमिओ सेट्ठी,पत्तो सत्तरिसिपयं,कत्तिगिमलसत्तमीए उ"
english: "Rahay - Turangmehi, Pailas, Parimiyo Sethi, Pato Saptrisipayam, Katigimalasattamiye Kutti"

prakrit: "सो उत्तमसम्मत्तो,मुणीण काऊण वन्दणविहाणं,विरएइ महापूर्य,तत्युद्देसम्मि कुसुमेहिं"
english: "Well said, sage, What a cruel man he is: You fool, you big fool, You foolish girl."

prakrit: "नड-नट्ट-छत्त-चारण-पणचिउम्गीयमङ्गलारावं,सत्तरिसियासमपर्य,सम्गसरिच्छं कर्य रम्मं"
english: "Nada - nata - chhatta - charan - panchim - geema - mangalaravan, till seventy - six, karma - playing all round."

prakrit: "सत्तुग्धकुमारो वि य,सुणिऊणं मुणिवराण वित्तन्त,अणणीऎ समं महुरं,संपत्तो परियणापुण्णो"
english: "Even a wise son, When he hears a sage speak, Is as precious as any other Man; Wealth alone triumphs."

prakrit: "साहूण वन्दणं सो,काऊणा''वासिओ तहिं ठाणे,विउलं करेइ पूर्व,पडुपडह-मुइङ्गसद्दालं"
english: "Friend, tell me," The cowherd said, "There you are, standing in front of the farmer's house."

prakrit: "साहू समत्तनियमा,भणिया सत्तुग्घरायपुत्तेणं,मज्झ घराओ भिक्खें,गिव्हह तिवाणुकम्पाए"
english: "My brother - in - law is at hand, My nephew is at home, My brothers and sisters are at work, My household is occupied with monks, And my husband is abroad."

prakrit: "समणुत्तमेण भणिओ,नरवइ! कयकारिओ पयत्तेणं,न य कप्पइ आहारो,साहूण विसुद्धसीलाणं"
english: "Speak plainly, you coward! Traveler, pay attention. Don't waste your food: It's the poison of poison." ""

prakrit: "अकया अकारिया वि य,मणसा'णणुमोइया य भिक्खा,सा कप्पइ समणाणं,धम्मधुरं उबहन्ताणं"
english: "A beggar is one who forgives, One who reproaches oneself with falsehood Is one who renounces modesty,"

prakrit: "भणइ तओ सत्तुग्यो,भयवं नइ मे न गेण्हह घरम्मि,केत्तियमित्तं पि इहं,अच्छह कालं पुरवरीए"
english: "You're right, I'm not afraid of going home. But how long can this go on?"

prakrit: "तुब्मेत्य आगएहिं,समयं रोगेहि ववगया मारी,नयरी वि सुहसमिद्धा,नाया बहुसासपरिपुणा"
english: "You fool, Time is fleeting, Like being ill it takes a long time to heal. Even a good wife loves a man Who has mastered much."

prakrit: "एव भणिओ पवुत्तो,सेणिय! भुणिपुङ्गवो सभावन्न,सत्तुग्ध! मज्झ वयणं,निमुणेहि हियं च पत्थं च"
english: "Say:" "O my son - in - law! Bow before me, Strong and powerful! My speech is eloquent, And my breath is smooth." ""

prakrit: "इह भारहम्मि वासे,बोलीणे नन्दनरवईकाले,होही पविरलगाहणो,जिणधम्मो चेव दुसमाए"
english: "This is our Vase, Speaking in hushed tones, Like a solemn fire: Everything we do Resides in humility."

prakrit: "होहिन्ति कुपासण्डा,बहवो उप्पाय-ईइसंबन्धा,गामा मसाणतुल्ला,नयरा पुण पेयलोयसमा"
english: "Hohenti kupasanda, bahavo uppaya - isambandha, gamma masanatullah, naira punya payaloyasam"

prakrit: "चोरा इव रायाणो,होहिन्ति मरा कसायरयबहुला,मिच्छत्तमोहियमई,साहूणं निन्दणुज्जुत्ता"
english: "These are the words of a thief; When he is dead the butcher is overjoyed; Wrong views dominate; The poor man is condemned."

prakrit: "व चेव अप्पसत्थं,ते सुपसत्थं ति मन्नमाणा ते,निस्संबम-निस्सीला,नरए पडिहिन्ति गुरुकम्मा"
english: "Woe to you, my dear, For you always give importance to what is right, For without you there is no peace, For instead of you there are no virtues."

prakrit: "निम्नच्छिऊण साहू,मूढा दाहिन्ति चेव मूढाणं,बीर्य व सीलबट्टे,न तस्स दाणस्स परिवुड्डी"
english: "The poor thing is a poor man, A fool on the right Is always a fool, In semen and in rags, No one bothers about his charity."

prakrit: "चण्डा कसायबहुला,देसा होहिन्ति कुच्छियायारा,हिंसा-'लिय-चोरिका,काहिन्ति निरन्तरं मूढा"
english: "The moon is a cruel poison, The earth is parched with smoke, The land is barren, The violence is wanton, The tales are always silly."

prakrit: "वय-नियम-सील संबम-रहिएसु अणारिएसु लिङ्गीसु,वेयारिही नणो वि ये,विविहकुपासण्डसत्येसु"
english: "Age, rules, seal the relationship - stay single, have sex, stay married, stay young, stay in contact with different people."

prakrit: "घण-रयणदबरहिया,लोगा पिइ-भाइ वियलियसिणेहा,होहिन्ति कुपासण्डा,बहवो दुसमाणुभावेणं"
english: "People are drunk, My brother - in - law is drunk, I've no time for gossip, It's the anger of relatives That leads to jealousy."

prakrit: "सत्तुग्ध! एव नाई,कालं दुसमाणुभावसंगणियं,होहि निणधम्मनिरओ,अप्पहियं कुणसु सत्तीए"
english: "Wretched! No, the time is ripe for bad omen. But be careful not to fall into delusion: There must be something wrong with you." ""

prakrit: "सायारधम्मनिरओ,वच्छलसमुजओ जणे होउं,ठावेहि जिणवराणं,घरे घरे चेव पडिमाओ"
english: "Friend, let there be one man for every one of you: let him be the only one who knows how to make a living, Let him go from door to door Doing whatever you want."

prakrit: "सत्तुग्ध! इह पुरीए,चउसु वि य दिसासु सत्तरिसियाणं,पडिमाउ ठवेहि लहुं,होही सन्ती तओ तुक्तं"
english: "Tremendous! Look! It's the full moon! In this very place you look like a seventy - seven. Look! The jeweler's wife is making love. Still you sigh." ""

prakrit: "अज्जपभूईऎ इह,जिणपडिमा जस्स नस्थि निययघरे,तं निच्छिएण मारी,मारिहिइ मयं व जह बग्धी"
english: "Behold, the poor woman, Whom none of you knows, In this wretched house will surely be put to death; She will slay me with a sharp arrow"

prakrit: "अङ्गुट्टपमाणा वि हु,निणपडिमा जस्स होहिइ घरम्मि,तस्स भवणाउ मारी,नासिहिइ लहुं न संदेहो"
english: "There must be something wrong with that house. I'll go to his house, But don't doubt that he knows what it's like."

prakrit: "भणिऊण एवमेय,सेट्ठिसमग्गेण रायपुत्तेणं,अहिवन्दिया मुणी ते,सत्त वि परमेण भावेणं"
english: "Speak thus: The son of Raiputta is bound to his enemies, The sage is unfaithful to him, And all authority is vested in him."

prakrit: "दाऊण धम्मलाहं,ते य मुणी नहयलं समुप्पइया,चारणलद्धाइसया,सीयाभवणे समोइण्णा"
english: "Wretched woman, That sage did not gather the reeds, Running after the pasture, Firmly embracing the spring."

prakrit: "भवणाङ्गणहिया ते,सोया दठूण परमसद्धाए,परमन्नेण सुकुसला,पडिलाहइ साहवो सबइ"
english: "In the courtyard of the palace She sleeps, When she sees the supreme god, Succumbs to the supreme, And everything goes smoothly."

prakrit: "दाऊण य आसीसं,नहिच्छिय मुणिवरा गया देसं,सत्तुग्यो वि य नयरे,ठावेह निणिन्दपडिमाओ"
english: "The poor man has come, The uncircumcised have gone, The honest have not returned, The haughty have stayed: They are condemned as slaves."

prakrit: "सत्तरिसीण वि पडिमाउ,तत्थ फलएसु सन्निविट्ठाओ,कञ्चणरयणमईओ,चउसु वि य दिसासु महुराए"
english: "Even seventy seeds should be sown, As long as they bear fruit, Traveler of the field, Though they taste good Either way."

prakrit: "देसेण समं नयरी,सबा आसासिया भयविमुक्का,धण-धन्न-रयणपुष्णा,जाया महुरा सुरपुरि छ"
english: "The land is barren, All the inhabitants are in a state of panic, Wealth is at hand, The rivers are in spate, The jasmine is in full bloom."

prakrit: "तिण्णेव बोयणाई,दीहा नव परिरएण अहियाई,भवणसु उववणेसु य,रेहइ महुरा तलाएसु"
english: "Give birth to new flowers, make new beds, increase the number of flowers in a pot, and let the water boil."

prakrit: "बाया नरिन्दसरिसा,कुडुम्बिया नरवई धणयतुल्ला,धम्म-'त्थ-कामनिरया,मणुया जिणसासणुज्जुत्ता"
english: "Baaya narindasarisa, kudumbiya naravai dhanayatulla, dharma -" "That is - detachment from desire, manuya jinsasunjutta" ""

prakrit: "महुरापुरीऎ एवं,आणाईसरियरिद्धिसंपन्न,रज अणोवमगुणं,सत्तुग्यो भुझाइ बहिच्छ"
english: "Praise be to the fragrant flowers of the jasmine, Rich in fresh nectar, Which flow from the navel to the shoulders of the God of Love."

prakrit: "एयं तु जे सत्तमुणीण पर्व,सुणन्ति भावेण पसन्नचिता,ते रोगहीणा विगयन्तराया,हवन्ति लोए विमलंसुतुल्ला"
english: "This is the festival of the seven sages; They listen with fondness to their feelings, They are disease - free and enlightened. For the world is full of wicked people."

prakrit: "इइ पउमचरिए महुरानिवेसविहाण नाम एगूणनउयं पव्वं समत्त"
english: "Praise be to the bee, Whose name has become synonymous with purity."

prakrit: "अह वेयड्डनगवरे,दाहिणसेढोऎ अस्थि रयणपुरं,विजाहराण राया,रयणरहो तत्थ विक्रवाओ"
english: "Ah, wretched town, The rhinoceros is on the right bank, The victory line is red, The rays of the sky are everywhere, So are the wicked."

prakrit: "नामेण चन्दवयणा,तस्स पिया तीऎ कुच्छिसंभूया,रूव-गुण-जोषणधरी,मणोरमा सुरकुमारिसमा"
english: "Name is Chandavayana, His lover is Kuchchisambhuya, His form is virtuous and vigorous, His mood is pleasant."

prakrit: "तं पेच्छिऊण राया,जोबणलायण्णकन्तिपडिपुणं,तीए वरस्स कज्जे,मन्तीहि समं कुणइ मन्तं"
english: "Look at that girl, Trembling with excitement As she tries to sort out what's wrong with her husband." ""

prakrit: "ताव थिय हिण्डन्तो,तं नयर नारओ समणुपत्तो,दिनासणोवविठ्ठो,रयणरह भणइ मुणियत्यो"
english: "There he was, Hindanto, Not so long ago, After the festival had ended, Sitting in silence for the day, Listening for the thunder of the crickets"

prakrit: "दसरहनिवस्स पुत्तो,भाया पउमस्स लक्खणो 'वीरो,किं न सुओ ते नरवइ!,तस्स इमा दिजए कन्ना"
english: "Daughter, it's the tenth day of spring. Your husband calls you by the word" "brave." "Why not sleep, you coward! Your mother knows what to do with you."

prakrit: "तं एव जपमाणं,सोऊणं पवणवेगमाईया,रुवा रयणरहस्या,सयणवह सुमरि बहवे"
english: "It is the rosary that is recited, The passion with which we fall asleep, The secret with which the wife sheds her tears."

prakrit: "अह तेहि निययभिचा,आणता किंकरा हणह एयं,से सुणिय भउविग्गो,उप्पईओ नारओ रुटो"
english: "Oh! it's a good man's business! There goes the farmer's son:" "It's raining peacock feathers." "He can hear the howling of the buffalo's tail."

prakrit: "संपत्तो थिय सहसा,एयं सो लक्खणस्स निस्सेस,वर्त कहेइ एत्तो,मणोरमाई सुरमुणी सो"
english: "Wealth is sudden, this is the characteristic trait," says the teller. "Such is the charm of politeness."

prakrit: "मह सो चिनालिहियं,कन्नं दावेइ लच्छिनिलयस्स,जयसुन्दरीण सोहं,हाऊण व होज निम्मविया"
english: "I know her well, She shows no signs of illness, She is remarkably attractive, She has a lovely smile on her face, And her face is like a lotus."

prakrit: "से पेच्छिण विद्धो,वम्महबाणेहि लक्खणो सहसा,चिन्तेइ तम्गयमणो,हियएण बहुप्पयाराई"
english: "It pierces through the eyes, Suddenly noticeable with the lips, Thinking too much, Hearing too much."

prakrit: "जह तं महिलारयणं अहयं न लहामि तो इमं रज,विफलं चिय निस्सेस,जीर्य पि य सुन्नयं चेव"
english: "If I don't grab that woman's skirt, she'll break the bracelet." ""

prakrit: "स्यणरहनादणाणं,विचेट्ठिये नारएण परिकहिए,रुट्टो य लच्छिनिलओ,सदाविय पत्थिवे चलिओ"
english: "Traveler, traveler, If you must travel by road, Travel by foot, Always on level ground."

prakrit: "विजाहरेहि समय,गयवर-रह-तुरय-जोहपरिकिण्णा,उप्पइया गयणयलं,हलहर-नारायणा सिग्धं"
english: "At the time of victory, Gayavar - rah - turay - johjamanna, Uppaya - gayanyalam, Halahar - narayana - siddha." ""

prakrit: "संपत्ता रयणपुरं,कमेण असि-कणय-तोमरविहत्था,दट्टण आगया ते,रयणरहो खेयरो रुटो"
english: "Wealth is ryanpuram, Kamen is ashy - black - as white as the lotus on the head, Dense fire is there, Roots of rice are ryan."

prakrit: "भडचडगरेण सहिओ,विणिम्गओ परबलं अइसयन्तो,जुज्झइ रणपरिहत्थो,जोहसहस्साइ पाएन्तो"
english: "He who endures a fierce storm, Who overcomes a strong wind, Who is able to withstand a fierce battle, Will survive a violent storm."

prakrit: "रयणरहस्स भडेहिं,निद्दयपहराहयं पवगसेन्नं,रुद्धं संगाममुहे,सायरसलिलं व तुझेहिं"
english: "Foolish girl, The nights are long, The roads are slippery, The streets are deserted, And the roads are impassable."

prakrit: "दण निययसेन्नं रुहो लच्छीहरो रहारूढो,अह जुज्झिउँ पवत्तो,घाएन्तो रिउभडे बहवे"
english: "The poor man has always shed tears, Steady as a bow, But when he is wounded he is carried to the river bank."

prakrit: "पउमो किकिन्धवई,विराहिओ अङ्गओ य आणत्तो,जुज्झइ सिरिसेलो वि य,समयं चिय वेरियभडेहिं"
english: "Proud woman, When a man is separated His limbs are brought in contact With each other, When he is alone They are separated in time."

prakrit: "वाणरभडेसु भन्गं,तिवपहाराहयं रिउबलं तं,विवडन्तनोह-तुरयं,नायं च पलायणुज्जत्तं"
english: "The trumpet is blowing, The flame is burning, The river is raging, The flute is crashing, And the dog has had to flee."

prakrit: "रयणरहेण समाण,भगं दठ्ठण नारओ सेन्न,अझाइ विष्फुरन्तो,हसइ चिय कहकहारावं"
english: "The rakshasas see the fire, The narao see the flame, The azhai hear the thunder, The crows laugh And the kaharavas speak"

prakrit: "एए ते अइचवला,दुखेट्ठा खेयराहमा खुद्दा,पलयन्ति पवणवेगा,लक्खणगुणनिन्दया पावा"
english: "Oh! that wretched man! Aunt, It's a pain in the arse. He's going to run off in a huff. The pathos is blurred By the marks"

prakrit: "पियरं पलायमाणं,दत्र̥̄ण मणोरमा रहारूढा,'पुर्व सिणेहहियया,सहसा लच्छीहर पत्ता"
english: "Dear girl, Just look at that lovely blonde girl standing in front of you. Suddenly she sees a lotus leaf." ""

prakrit: "सा भणइ पायवडिया,मुञ्च तुमं भिउडिभङ्गुरं कोवं,एयाण देहि अभये,लच्छीहर! मज्झ सयणाणं"
english: "She says," "My poor girl, I've got to scare you away, Deer - eyed girl! I have to be careful." ""

prakrit: "सोमतणं पवने,चहरे आगओ सह सुएहिं,रयणरहो कयविणओ; समाहिओ राम-केसीहि"
english: "The south wind blows, The sky is red, The rivers are swollen; Somebody has captured Rama." ""

prakrit: "रयणरहे. भणइ तओ,हसिऊणं नारओ अहमहन्तं,भडवोक्कियं कहिं तं,तुज्झ गयं जं पुरा भणियं"
english: "Stop laughing. Tell me, you naughty girl, Where did you start your rant? You'd better stop whatever you say." ""

prakrit: "एवं रयणरहेणं पडिभणिओ नारओ तुमे कोवं,नीएण अम्ह जाया,उत्तमपुरिसेसु सह पीई"
english: "And cry aloud:" "Who are you to tell me you're pregnant?" "That, dear friend, Is the reason I kept going."
