prakrit: "अह ते रयणरहेणं हलहर-नारायणा पुरि निययं,ऊसियधयापडाय,पवेसिया कणयपायारं"
english: "Ah! the plowman's plow - Narayan's whole stock, Wretched grass - grown on the river bank, Pecks of paddy field."

prakrit: "दिन्ना कणयरहेणं,सिरिदामा हलहरस्स वरकन्ना,लच्छीहरस्स वि तओ,मणोरमा सबगुणपुण्णा"
english: "Dinna kanyarhena, siridama halaharasa varakanna, lacchiharasa vi tao, manorama sabguna purna"

prakrit: "वत्तं पाणिम्गहणं,कमेण दोहं पि परमरिद्धोए,विज्जाहरीहि समय,रयणपुरे राम-केसीणं"
english: "Vattam Panimagana, Kamen dohon bhi paramariddho, Vijjahari hi samay, Rayanpur Ram - Kesin"

prakrit: "एवं पयण्डा वि अरी पणामं,वञ्चन्ति पुण्णोदयदेसकाले,नरस्स रिद्धी वि हु होइ तुझा,तम्हा,खु धर्म विमलं करेह"
english: "And you fool, My dear, Even on the eve of your return You cheat. Even an angry man Can be yours. Your religion will prosper."

prakrit: "इइ पउमचरिए मणोरमालम्भविहाणं नाम नउइयं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "Praise be to the name of the God of Love, For he has perfected purity."

prakrit: "अन्ने वि खेयरमडा,वेयड्ढे दाहिणाऎ सेढीए,निवसन्ति लक्खणेणं,ते सबे निजिया समरे"
english: "Even the poor are distressed, The wicked are on the right side of the fence, They live in secret places, All of them in secret."

prakrit: "जे रामसासणेगया,विजाहरपत्थिवा महिडीया,निमुणेहि ताण सेणिय!,नामाई रायहाणीणं"
english: "Those who have passed through Ramasasana, The great women on triumphant paths, The brave women who have endured humiliation, Prayer for the salvation of the state."

prakrit: "भाइचाह नयरं,तहेव सिरिमन्दिर गुणपहाणं,कयणपुरं च एतो,भणियं सिवमन्दिरं रम्मं"
english: "Brotherly affection is the norm, faithfulness is the virtue of the Siri temple, kindness and purity are the norms. Venerable is the temple of Shiva in Rama."

prakrit: "गन्धवं अमयपुरं तहेव लच्छीहरं मुणेयवं,मेहपुरं रहगोय,चाउरं नेउरं हवा"
english: "Gandhavam amayapuram thayavam, Lachchiharam munayavanam, mehapuram rahagoyam, vast neeram vaavam."

prakrit: "सिरिबहुरवं च भणिय,सिरिमलय सिरिगुहं चरविम्स,तह य हरिद्वयनाम,जोइपुर होइ सिरिछायं"
english: "Say Siribahuravam, Sirimalayam, Siriguham, Charavimsam, That is the name of the two greens; Joypur will be the shadow of Siri."

prakrit: "गन्धारपुरं मलय,सीहपुरं चेव होइ सिरिविजयं,नक्खपुरं तिलयपुरं,अन्नाणि वि एव बहुयाणि"
english: "Gandharpur is Malay, Sihpur is Sevoi Sirivijayam, Nakhpur is Tilaypuram, Annani is also Bahuyani"

prakrit: "नयराणि लवखणेणं,जियाइ विजाहराणुकिण्णाई,वसुहा य वसे ठविया,सत्सु रयणेसु साहोणा"
english: "A Nayarani is to be admired, Jiyai Vijaharanukinnayi, Vasuha ya vaseya, Satsu rayanesu sahona."

prakrit: "चवं छत्तं च धणु,सत्ती य गया मणी असी चेव,एयाइ लच्छिनिलओ,संपत्तो दिवरयणाई"
english: "Wealth, indeed, is everything, But if you lose it, You'll lose it. For wealth is the ornament of the day."

prakrit: "पुणरवि मगहाहिबई,पुच्छह गणनायगं पणमिळणं,भयवं! लवकुसाणं,उप्पत्ति मे परिकहेहि"
english: "Once again, my dear, ask how I am, Counting off my paychecks, Afraid I'm going to trip over the top!" ""

prakrit: "लच्छीहरस्स पुत्ता,कइ वा महिलाउ अग्गमहिसीओ,एव परिपुच्छिओ सो,कहिऊण मुणी समाढत्तो"
english: "Lucky boy, How can a woman be so forthright? Ask her what she wants. The sage will tell you the truth." ""

prakrit: "निसुणेहि मगहसामिय!,पहाणपुरिसाण उत्तम रज्ज,मुमन्ताण य बहुया,मासा बरिसा य वञ्चन्ति"
english: "Without a doubt, Maghasamya!, A man who is full of affection Makes the best husband, A woman who is faithful Is more deceitful than a barista."

prakrit: "तुम कुलनाइयाणं,उत्तमगुण-रूव-जोबणघरीणं,दस छ श्वेव सहस्सा,रामकणिट्ठस्स महिलाणं"
english: "You are the headman, The headman's wife, The housewife with fine qualities, The woman with bright eyes, The wife with a sense of humour."

prakrit: "अट्ठ महादेवीओ,सवाण वि ताण उत्तमगुणाओ,ताओ निसुणेहि नरवइ!,नामेहि कहिज्जमाणीओ"
english: "Eight great goddesses, Even heaven is full of excellent virtues, Yet the world is empty of men!," so say the proud ladies.

prakrit: "दोणघणसुया पढमा,होइ विसल्ल ति नाम नामेणं,बिइया पुण रूवमई,तइया कल्लाणमाला य"
english: "Daughter - in - law, please, tell me her name. I'll give it another go. Your name will be remembered forever."

prakrit: "वणमाला य चउत्थी,पञ्चमिया चेव होइ रइमाला,छट्ठी विय जियपउमा,अभयमई सत्तमी भणिया"
english: "The forest lamp is the fourth, the panchami is the seventh, the rainbow is the sixth, the sky is the twilight, and the seventh is the buffet."

english: "In the end, there will be no more manoramas, She will be nothing like Mahadevi, Such is the case with a lanky hearse, It's the brick of Ruven's mind." ""

english: "Aunt, I have four names: The first for a woman, The second for a man, And the third for a gentleman."

prakrit: "पढमा उ महादेवी,सीया बीया पहावई भणिया,तइया चेव रइनिहा,सिरिदामा अन्तिमा भवद"

english: "O my mother - in - law, Virtuous and virtuous woman, Dear lady, To me you owe a debt of gratitude."

prakrit: "क्सहो धरणो चन्दो,सरहो मयरदमो मुणेयवो,हरिणाहो य सिरिधरो,तहेव मयणो कुमारवरो"
english: "The ox is the moon, The stag is the myrtle, The deer is the reed, The tiger is the stag, The lion is the son-in-law."

prakrit: "अह ताण उत्तमा जे,अट्ठ जणा सिरिधरस्स अङ्गहा,जाण सहावेण जणो,गुणाणुरत्तो घिई कुणइ"
english: "Ah, what a noble man he is: Eight slender limbs, One man for ever and ever. Virtuous conduct begets virtue."

prakrit: "मह सिरिधरो ति नाम,दोणधासुधाऎ नन्दणो वीरो,पुचो रूवमईए,पुहईतिलओ तिलयमूओ"
english: "My name is Siridharo, The brave are the two handsome men, Ask what they want of me, Put my name on his head And put it mildly."

prakrit: "कल्लाणमालिणीए,मालनिलओ सुओ पवररूवो,विमलप्पहो ति नाम,पुत्तो पउमावईए वि"
english: "Who is worthy of being worshipped? A woman worthy of worship, Who possesses great virtues, Whose name is Vimalappa, And whose name is Puma?"

prakrit: "पुत्तो वणमालाए,अज्जुणविक्खो ति नाम विक्खाओ,अइविरियस्स सुयाए,तणओ विय हवइ सिरिकेसी"
english: "My son, The forest is dead, My name is Vikhao, I have slept bitterly, And now my life hangs in the balance."

prakrit: "नामेण सबकित्ती,अभयमहसुओ सुरो । स्वेणं,इयरो सुपासकित्ती,मणोरमाकुच्छिसंभूओ"
english: "Everything is sweet in this name. Sweat, dear girl, makes all the people sigh. Anything at all Makes sense." ""

prakrit: "सो वि स्वमन्ता,सबे बलविरियसत्तिसंपन्ना,पुहइयले विक्खाया,पुत्ता लच्छीहरस्सेए"
english: "He too is self-sufficient, all vigorous and wealthy, completely exhausted, except for one son with a limp."

prakrit: "ते देवकुमारा इव,अन्नोन्नवसाणुगा घणसिणेहा,साएयपुरवरीए,अच्छन्ति सुहं अणुहबन्ता"
english: "He is the son of a god, A man of many talents, A gentleman of many walks, A good husband indeed."

prakrit: "अह अद्धपश्चमाओ,कोडीओ सनिवइपुत्ताणं,सोलस चेव सहस्सा,राईणं बद्धमउडाणं"
english: "Ah, half - grown - up: The puzzles are silly, The solace is simple, The rain is bound to fall."

prakrit: "एवं तिखण्डाहिवइत्तण ते,पत्ता महारजसुहं पसत्थं,गमेन्ति कालं वरसुन्दरीसु,सेविजमाणा विमलप्पहावा"
english: "And when the tree has been cut down, The leaves follow the king's pleasure, As long as the bridegroom is present, The servant will be welcomed with a lot of affection."

prakrit: "इइ पउमचरिए राम-लक्खणविभूइदंसणं नाम एकाणउयं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "This is the path to purity, Rama - The name of the vision that characterizes him - One purity is supreme."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाई,भवणत्या महरिहम्मि सयणिज्जे,सीया निसावसाणे,पेच्छइ सुविणं जणयध्या"
english: "Oh! what a strange thing it is to say, You silly girl, Saying the wrong thing to your husband, And looking away in silence When he tells you the truth."

prakrit: "सा उम्गयंमि सूरे,सवालंकारभूसिया गन्तुं,अत्याणिमण्डवत्थं,पुच्छह दइयं कयपणामा"
english: "I beg of you, my dear, Go and ask how you feel. Please, tell me, How can I get mercy?"

prakrit: "किल सामि! अज्ज सुविणे,दो सरहा तिबकेसरारुणिया,ते मे मुहं पविठ्ठा,नवरं पडिया विमाणाओ"
english: "Calm down! Today, young men and women, Two sharp arrows pierced the young wife's face. It was as if she had just given birth." ""

prakrit: "तो भणइ पउमणाहो,सरहाणं दरिसणे तुर्म भद्दे!,होहिन्ति दोन्नि पुत्ता,अइरेणं सुन्दरायारा"
english: "So tell me, Proud lady, The way you look at everyone is disgusting!" "My two sons, you're already handsome." ""

prakrit: "नं पुष्फविमाणाओ,पडिया न य सुन्दरं इमं सुविणं,सबे गहा'णुकूला,होन्तु सया तुज्झ पसयच्छि!"
english: "Don't blow your nose, girl, It's beautiful out there, Everything's messy around the corner, But I love you anyway!"

prakrit: "ताव य वसन्तमासो,संपत्तो पायवे पसाहेन्तो,पल्लव-पवाल-किसलय-पुप्फ-फलाई च जणयन्तो"
english: "So spring is the month, wealth is the festival of feasts, and the plowman knows what to eat and what not to eat."

prakrit: "अंकोल्लतिक्खणक्खो,मल्लियणयणो असोयदललीहो,कुरययकरालदसणो,सहयारसुकेसरारुणिओ"
english: "Look at the lotus leaf, The jasmine leaf is uneven, The cucumber is red - eyed, The helpers are swooning."

prakrit: "कुसुमरयपिञ्जरलो,अइमुत्तलयासमूसियकरग्गो,पत्तो वसन्तसीहो,गयवइयाणं भयं देन्तो"
english: "Yellow jasmine, you incompetent clown, Spring is on the cards, And cowboys are feared."

prakrit: "कोइलमुहलुग्गीय,महुयरगुमुगुमुगुमेन्तकारं,कुसुमरएण समन्थ,पिञ्जरयन्तो दिसायकं"
english: "The cuckoo is mute, The bee is sly, The guava is fragrant, The shoot of the jasmine Is like a cage."

prakrit: "नाणाविहतरुछन्न,वरकुसुमसमच्चियं फलसमिद्ध,रेहइ महिन्दउदयं,‘उजाणं नन्दणसरिच्छं"
english: "The tree without a seed, Like the nectar of a lotus, Reaches to the sky With ripe fruit." ""

prakrit: "एयारिसंमि काले,पढमिल्लुगगब्भसंभवे सीया,जाया मन्दुच्छाहा,तणुयसरीरा य अहरेगं"
english: "In the rainy season, As soon as you touch the God of Love, You'll lose your cool, Like a tiny snake in a manger."

prakrit: "त भणइ पउमनाहो,किं तुज्झ अवट्टियं पिए! हियए,दई दोहलसमए!,तं ते संपाडयामि अहं"
english: "You fool, tell me," "Why are you drinking all the time?" "Alas! It's too late. I will make up for it."

prakrit: "तो सुमरिऊण बंपइ,जणयसुया निणवरालए बहवे,इच्छामि नाह! दटुं वन्दामि तुह प्पसारणं"
english: "So the summer girl bemoans the absence of her beloved. I don't want to see you again! I bow to your embrace." ""

prakrit: "सोऊण तीऎ वयणं,वउमाभो भणइ तत्थ पडिहारिं,कारेह निणहराणं,सोहा परमेण विभवेणं"
english: "When he speaks to her She speaks to him, When she replies he speaks, When he replies she does not speak."

prakrit: "सबो वि नायरजणो,तत्थ महिन्दोदए वरुजाणे,गन्तूण सविभवेणं,जिणालयाणं कुणउ पूर्व"
english: "Everyone is a hero, So please, my poor girl, Be careful where you go, For the victory of the former is yours alone."

prakrit: "सा एव भणिय सन्ती,पडिहारी किंकराण आएसं,देइ विहसन्तवयणा,तेहिं पि पडिच्छिया आणा"
english: "She said :'Calm down! The hunter has come screaming. Give me the rest of the mess. Then bring on the hunter.'"" "

english: "Ah, that poor girl, Why do you groan so much When you utter such nonsense? Everyone should fall asleep Now, dear go - between!"

prakrit: "एतो जिणभवणाई बणेण संमजिओबलिताई,कयवन्दणमालाई,वरकमलसमञ्चियतलाई"
english: "Such is the beauty of conjugal love, Like the lotus of a wedding feast."

english: "Doors are full of potsherds, The street is strewn with reeds, The streets are empty, The roads are deserted, And the streets are deserted."

english: "The housewife is wealthy, The wives are widows, The pearls are beautiful, The women wear long dresses."

english: "What a monstrous thing it is to burn a lotus, To wipe away the tears of longing, To burn all living beings With an endless stream of tears."

english: "Turai is multifaceted, Pahi is fragrant, Mehsaris are noisy, Gandhabani is poisonous, Mahursarai is sacred."

english: "In the fire of passion, Rama is welcomed, In love, youth, and prosperity Are everything."

english: "Narayan, too, treats women just like any other woman; he is only to be treated as a barber When called upon for advice."

english: "And help one's neighbor, The plowman - Narayan - served him there, The innkeeper - gatherer, God - even the God of Love."

english: "Poems are bound to be said, Life is dear to all beings. Love, rasa, form, roast the God of Love, is like a vast expanse of water."

english: "And when he sits on the pyre You rejoice, For he is so beautiful to behold, So handsome is the young wife Who walks beside him, And when she steps on his foot The rays of the Vimalakantidhara are great."

english: "This is the path of righteousness Which leads to purity, Which in turn leads to poverty."

english: "One person is not satisfied, one leaf is not shed, one day you will give birth, for the ultimate good is certain!"

english: "Speak quality, do something, it's useless; detachment is the greatest virtue; renunciation is the supreme virtue!"

english: "So he is at peace, Calm - temperance - rule - decency; He is full of good will; We must abide by our vows."

english: "That's what I meant when I said," "Don't be afraid to give." "You silly girl, The nights are slipping away. I don't know what to say."

english: "Behold, my poor fellow, Being sealed up and sealed up, Doing your best to please him, Is a great sin."

english: "Always be vigilant, always obey your rules, always be vigilant and vigilant, never be negligent or negligent."

english: "The poor girl is bedridden, The streets are deserted, The roads are impassable, And the street is empty."

prakrit: "अह तेण समालता,मयहरया जे पयाऎ रामेणं,साहह आगमकज,मणसंखोमं पमोणं"
english: "Ah, the beauty of love, For what it is I desire is the presence of the divine Rama."

english: "Victory to the sun god, fragrance to the bee, powder to the peacock, blackness to the turtle, jealousy to the buffalo."

english: "Oh! they are good friends; They do not cause trembling; They cause delight to the young man; Their faces are not ashamed."

prakrit: "संथाविऊण पुणरवि,पुच्छइ आगमणकारणं रामो,साहह मे वीसत्था,पयहिय सबं भउबेयं"

prakrit: "किं होज देवकना,सुरवइसावेण महियले पडिया?,कुसुमाउहस्स किं वा,कुविया य रई इहोइण्णा?"
english: "How are you, my poor girl, Fallen in midday with these hot sighs? What do you mean by sighing in the heat of summer? Is this the way of a good wife?"

prakrit: "एवं सवियकमणा,नवि ते वञ्चन्ति तत्थ पुरहत्ता,सबइ वि भउबिग्गा,वग्गीभ्या य चिद्वन्ति"
english: "And good natured people; new men deceive them, and new women seduce them; all the same they roam freely, Though they hear no one speak."

prakrit: "तत्थ वणे महयं पि बलं तं,महिलारुण्णसरं सुणिऊणं,जायभयं अइचञ्चलनेतं,खायजस विमलं पि निरुद्धं"
english: "Then tell me, My girl, How powerful it is For women to listen to men in such a way That their fear leads them astray. Even Vimala's anger is turned down."

prakrit: "इइ पउमचरिए सीयानिव्वासविहाणं नाम चउणउये पन्वं समत्तं"
english: "This is the way of virtue: By choosing a name one trusts in, One attains to purity."

prakrit: "गाव य सा निययचमू,रुद्धा गाव पबयवरेणं,ताव करेणुविलम्गो,पराइओ वजनानियो"
english: "The village is always busy, The wind blows through the village, The tax gatherer's wife is busy making love, And the poor man's wives are heavy."

prakrit: "पुच्छह आसनत्थे,केणं चिय तुम्ह गहपहो रुद्धो,दीसह समाउलमणा,भयविहलविसंठुला सो!"
english: "Why are you sitting here? Stop your anger! It's only because you are afraid." ""

prakrit: "नाव चिय उल्लावं,देन्ति नरिन्दस्स निययचारमडा,ताव य वरजुवईए,सुणइ रुवन्तीऎ कणसरं"
english: "The boat sways, The waves crash, The Naryndus is immobile, And so is the young bride. She hears the rustle of weeping shears."

prakrit: "सरमण्डलविनाओ,भणइ निवो जा इहं रुवइ मुद्धा,सा गुषिणी निरुत्त,पउमस्स भवे महादेवी"
english: "Without a syllable, She says," "Stop being nimble." "With these angry words She refuses to budge."

prakrit: "भणिओ मिचेहि पह,एव इमं ज 'तुमे समुल्लवियं । न कयाइ अलियवयणं,देव,सुर्य जपमाणस्स"
english: "Say:" "You are mistaken. In this way you will all be proved right." "Make no mistake: God, the sun is a begging bowl."

prakrit: "नाव य एसालावो,वह तावं नरा समणुपत्ता,पेच्छन्ति जणयतणय,पुच्छन्ति य का तुम भद्दे!"
english: "The boat is empty, He does not reply, He looks at you with familiarity, Asks why you are being rude!"

prakrit: "सा पेच्छिऊग पुरिसे,बहवे सन्नद्धवद्धतोणीरे,भयविहलवेविरली,ताणाभरणं पणामेइ"
english: "She looks at you with such longing, With such ready embrace, So fearless and without fear That she vows to carry you."

prakrit: "तेहि वि सा पडिभणिया,किं अम्ह विहूसणेहि एएहिं,चिट्ठन्तु तुज्झ लच्छी!,ववगयसोगा इओ होहि"
english: "There you are, my poor girl, Why are you bothering about me? Write me down, you bastard! It must be the wind." ""

prakrit: "पुणरवि भणन्ति सुन्दरि!,मोत्तु सोगं भयं च एताहे,जंपस सुपसन्नमणा,किण्ण मुणसि नरबई एयं"
english: "Once again the talk is of beauty!" "Death and sorrow and fear are the only words one can speak Of happiness." "Whom else can one call a man?"

prakrit: "पुण्डरियपुराहिवई,एसो इह वजनकनरवसभो,चारित्त-नाण-दंसण-बहुगुणनिलओ जिणमयंमि"
english: "Powder is an inexhaustible supply of energy; this is the essence of wisdom; I win by virtue of my many talents."

prakrit: "सकाइदोसरहिओ,निच्चं निणवयणगहियपरमत्थो,परउवयारसमत्थो,सरणागयवच्छलो वीरो"
english: "Be vigilant, never be negligent; be vigilant, always be vigilant; for a true singer is a brave man."

prakrit: "'दीणाईण पुणो वि य,विसेसओ कलुणकारणुज्जुत्तो,पडिवक्खगयमइन्दो,सबकलाणं च पारगओ"
english: "" "Through humility, one learns more, Through faults and faults, Through immodesty and dishonesty, And through good and bad conduct, One learns more."

prakrit: "एयस्स अपरिमेया,देवि! गुणा को इह भणिउकामो,पुरिसो सयलतियणे,जो वि महाबुद्धिसंफ्नो"
english: "Oh! immodesty! That is what we mean by virtue! Let the wise say this:" "A true warrior is a man who conquers all." ""

prakrit: "नाव य एसालावो,वट्टइ ताबागओ नरवरिन्दो,अवयरिय करेणूए,करेइ विणयं जहाजोग्गं"
english: "A boat is what you make of it; a man makes of it what it is not; a ship is what he weaves."

prakrit: "तत्थ निविट्ठो नंपइ,वजमओ सो नरो न संदेहो,इह मोनु कल्लाणिं,जो जीवन्तो गओ सगिह"
english: "There is nothing wrong with that, Vazhamoy, so don't doubt me: It's Monu Kallani who has come back to life." ""

prakrit: "प्रत्यन्तरे पवुत्तो,मन्तो संथाविऊण जणयसुर्य,नामेण वज्जनको,एसो पुण्डरियपुरसामी"
english: "Traveler, tell me another man's name." "That is the saying of the wise man."

prakrit: "पञ्चाणुक्यषारो,बच्छे सम्मत्तउत्तमगुणोहो,देव गुरुपूयणरओ,साहम्मियवच्छलो बीरो"
english: "Virtuous people, All virtuous people are equal to one another; The gods are the masters of virtue, The brave are the enemies of the brave."

prakrit: "एवं चिय परिकहिए,सीया तो पुच्छिया नरवईणं,साहेहि कस्स दुहिया!,कस्स व महिला तुम लच्छी"
english: "And you look around. Ask a man what he likes. Friend, who's the bad guy? Whom do you like better?"

prakrit: "४ एव पुच्छिया सा,सीया तो भणइ दीणमुहकमला,अइदीहा मज्झ कहा,नरबह! निसुणेहि संखेवं"
english: "4 When she asked him, He replied," "Deer - faced lotuses." "This is my reply:" "It's a man!" "He simply closed his eyes."

prakrit: "बणयनरिन्दस्स सुया,बहिणी भामण्डलस्स सीया हइ,दसरहनिवस्स सुण्हा,महिला पुण रामदेवस्स"
english: "The weaver's son is asleep, The sister is awake through the night, The hunter's daughter is asleep during the day, And the woman is pure women."

prakrit: "केहगइवरदाणनिहे,दाउं भरहस्स निययरज सो,अणरणपस्थिवसुओ,पाइओ जायसंवेगो"
english: "There must be something wrong with you, my dear. You're right, you won't make it. It's just the way things happen." ""

prakrit: "रामेण लक्खणेण य,समं गया दण्डयं महारणं,संबुकवहे नराहिब,हरिया हइ रक्खसिन्देणं"
english: "Rama is worthy of respect, The great warrior is justified in punishment, The savage is not to be trifled with, The hunter is to be protected."

prakrit: "अह ते बलेण सहिया,नहेण गन्तूण राम-सुग्गीवा,लहापुरीऎ जुझं,कुणन्ति समय दहमुहेणं"
english: "Ah! by saying that one can bear it, By not touching it, Rama - the sweetwood tree, The flame of war in Lahapuri, The burning of a flame While making love."

prakrit: "बहुभडजीयन्तकरे,समरे लहाहिवं विवाएउं,रामेण आणिया हइ,निययपुरि परमविभवेणं"
english: "Through abundance, through abundance, Through wealth, through wealth, Through love, Through righteousness, Through purity, Through supreme renunciation."

prakrit: "दण रामदेवं,भरहो संवेगजायसन्भावो,घेत्तण व पयज,सिद्धिमुहं चेव संपत्तो"
english: "Charity is the essence of wealth; abundance, emotion, and feeling are its virtues."

prakrit: "सुयसोगसमावन्ना,पार्ज केगई वि घेतणं,सम्माराहियचरिया,तियसविमाणुत्तमं पत्ता"
english: "Suyoshoga samavanna, Parja ke gaayi bhi ladane, Samarahyacharya, Tisvimanutam pata"

prakrit: "लोगो वि अमज्जाओ,जंपइ अलियं अवण्णवायं मे,नह रावणकयसका,पउमेण इहाणिया सोया"
english: "People are still amused, Alas, I have grown weary of talking nonsense. But Ravana's wife has fallen asleep beside him." ""

prakrit: "सुणिऊण लोगवयणं,पउमेणं अयसदोसभीएणं,जिणवन्दणाभिलासी,डोहलयनिहेण'हं भणिया"
english: "Listening to people speak, Being angry with women, Being indifferent to people's feelings, Speaking in hushed tones." ""

prakrit: "मा होहि उस्मयमणा,सुन्दरि! जिणचेइयाइ विविहाई,वन्दावेभि सहीणो,अहियं सुर-असुरनमियाई"
english: "Don't be alarmed, you beauty! Everything you see is different, And the vows are the right ones. Such is the nature of beauty." ""

prakrit: "गन्तूण पिए! पढर्म,अट्ठावयपबए जिणं उसहं,वन्दामि तुमे सहिओ,जस्स इहं जम्मणं नयरे"
english: "Go and drink! It's past eight o'clock. I will bear with you, dear friend, As long as it doesn't burn." ""

prakrit: "अजिय सुमइमणन्तं,तहेव अहिनन्दणं इह पुरोए,नायं चिय कम्पिल्ले,विमलं धर्म च रयणपुरे"
english: "Long - eyed woman, The pleasures of love are endless, No one is free from illness, But Vimal and Dharma are eternal."

prakrit: "चम्पाऎ वासुपुजं,सावत्थी संभवं समुप्पन्न,चन्दपहं चन्दपुरे,कायन्दीए कुसुमदन्तं"
english: "The moon is the vasupuzha, The fire is the solemn assembly, The moonlight is the chandapure, The kayande is the tooth of the safflower."

prakrit: "वाणारसी सुपास,कोसम्बीसंभवं च पउमा,भदिलपुरसंभूय,सीयलसामि विगयमोहं"
english: "Vanarasi is peaceful, kosambhava is plentiful, badhilpurasambhuya, seyalasam is vigayamohana." ""

prakrit: "सेयसं सीहपुरे,मल्लिं मिहिलाऎ गयपुरे सन्ति,जायं कुन्थु च अरं,तत्थेव य कुअरपुरंमि"
english: "There are lotuses everywhere, jasmine flowers everywhere, nectar - like flowers on the kundu tree. Then there is the virgin's full moon." ""

prakrit: "जायं कुसम्गनयरे,मुणिसुबयसामियं जियभवोहं,जस्स इह धम्मचकं,अज्ज वि पज्वलइ रवितेयं"
english: "As for Kusumganyare, I will live with you, sage, As long as this dharma is practiced. Even today the nights are long."

prakrit: "एयाइ जिणवराणं,जम्मट्ठाणाइ तुज्न सिहाई,पणमसु भाषेण पिए!,अन्नाणि वि अइसयकराई"
english: "This is your victory, Your victory is at hand, Drink from your poisonous tongue!" cried Anna, Exhausted.

prakrit: "पुप्फविमाणारूढा,मह पासत्था नहेण अमरगिरिं,गन्तूण पणमसु पिए!,सिद्धाययणाइ दिखाई"
english: "Puff of smoke rising from the aeroplane, Not seeing my past self - immortalize it All - over again!," The siddha yajna appeared.

prakrit: "कोट्टिम-अकोट्टिमाई,जिणवरभवणाइ एत्थ पुहइयले,अहिवन्दिऊण पुणरवि; निययपुरि आगमीहामि"
english: "Kottim - akottimai, Once the vows are fulfilled here, again and again with the vows; I will come in due course."

prakrit: "एको वि नमोकारो,भावेण कओ जिणिन्दचन्दाणं,मोएइ सो हु जीवं,घणपावपसाजोगाओ"
english: "One can bow down, One can make the moon shine brightly, For this is the way of life."

prakrit: "नं पिययमेण एवं,भणिया हइ तत्थ सुमणसा जाया,अच्छामि जिणहराणं,चिन्तती दरिसणं निचं"
english: "I won't go out with you. I'll go in there empty handed. It's better for me to stay alive Than to think about leaving the house empty."

prakrit: "चलियस्स मए समय,जिणहरपरिवन्दणुस्सुयमणस्स,दइयस्स ताव वत्ता,जणपरिवाई लहुं पत्ता"
english: "Long live my time, As long as people live in harmony With each other In harmony with my heart. Allow one's family to blossom."

prakrit: "अववायभीयएणं,तत्तो परिचिन्तियं मह पिएणं,लोगों सहाववंको,न अन्नहा जाइ संतोसं"
english: "Be fearful of the wind, Drink honey from people you know, Be kind to people you don't know, And eat only what makes you happy."

prakrit: "तम्हा वरं खु एसा,सीया नेऊण छडिया रण्णे,न य मज्झ नसस्स इहं,होउ खणेक्कं पि वाघाओ"
english: "Your highness, It's only the neem tree that grows in the forest. No, it's not my nose. Let alone a tiger's." ""

prakrit: "सा हं तेण नराहिव!,जगपरिवायस्स भीयहियएणं,परिचत्ता विह रण्णे,दोसविमुक्का अकयपुण्णा"
english: "That's why I am angry! The whole world is angry with me, I have no feelings of jealousy Or anger at anything."

prakrit: "उत्तमकुलस्स लोए,न य एवं खत्तियस्स अणुसरिसं,बहुसत्थपण्डियस्स य,धम्मठिई जाणमाणस्स"
english: "The most virtuous people are simple, not stingy, not self-centred, not polytheists, not people who know Dharma."

prakrit: "एयं चिय वित्तन्तं,परिकहिऊणं तओ जणयधूया,माणसजलणुम्हविया,रोवइ कलुणेण सद्देणं"
english: "It's like walking on water, Like walking on grass, Like wading in the water of a man's embrace, Like being seduced by a lover's kiss."

prakrit: "रोयन्ति जणयसुर्य,दठूण नराहिवो किवावन्नो,संथावणमइकुसलो,जपइ एयाइ वयणाई"
english: "One can cry, One can't help it, One cannot help it: It's the cow that makes the cow cry, The ox that screams the cow - dung crickets, And the donkey that screeches the bull."

prakrit: "मा रुयसु तुम सीए!,निणसासणतिबत्तिसंपन्ने,किं वा दुक्खायाणं,अट्टज्माणं समारुहसि?"
english: "Don't cry! You coward! How are you supposed to manage your anger And your tears?"

prakrit: "किं वा तुमे न नाया,लोयठिई एरिसी निययमेव,अधुवत्ता'सरणता,कम्माण विचित्तया चेव?"
english: "Why not you, Loythii, This is the law of nature, Non - conduct, Vichitta is the service of karma?"

prakrit: "किं ते साहुसयासे,न सुर्य जह निययकम्मपडिबद्धो,जीयो धम्मेण विणा,हिण्डइ संसारकन्तारे!"
english: "Are they not brave, For the sun is not fixed on the horizon, For they live without dharma, For India belongs to the world!"

prakrit: "संजोय-विष्पओया,सुह-दुक्खाणि य बहुप्पयाराई,पत्ताइ दोहकालं,अणाइनिहणेण जीवेणं"
english: "Love is a vast array of emotions, Love is many and sorrow is many, Love has two ends, To suffer one's fate Is to live another's."

prakrit: "खजन्तेण जल-थले,सकम्मविष्फण्डिएण जीवेणं,तिरियभवे दुक्खाई,छुह-तण्हाईणि भुत्ताई"
english: "A treasure is like a basin of water; One can live only with a generous supply of it; On the contrary, one can suffer; On touching one's life One can destroy."

prakrit: "'विरहा-'ववाय-तज्जण-निन्मच्छण-रोय-सोयमाईयं,जीवेणं समणुभूयं,मणुएमु वि दारुणं दुक्ख"
english: "" "Wretched - The wind is blowing, The sun is setting, The nights are dark, Life is fleeting, Even humans suffer terribly."

prakrit: "कुच्छियतवसंभूया,देवा दठूण परमसुरविहवं,पावन्ति ते वि दुक्खं,विसेसओ चवणकालंमि"
english: "Wretched body, When God sees the supreme beauty, He feels sorrow too, For I have a special treasure."

prakrit: "नरएसु वि उववन्ना,जीवा पावन्ति दारुणं दुक्खं,करवत्त-जन्त-सामलि-वेयरणीमाइयं विविहं"
english: "Even the dead are born again, The living suffer terribly, The suffering inflicted by living beings Is manifested in many different ways."

prakrit: "तं नस्थि जणयधूए!,ठाणं ससुरासुरे वि तेलोक्के,नम्म मञ्च य जरा,जत्थ न जीवेण संपत्ता"
english: "That damned girl! Even her parents are in tears, Our stage is empty, Where there is no more wealth for the living."

prakrit: "इह संसारसमुद्दे,नियकम्माणिलहएण जोवेणं,लद्धे वि माणुसत्ते,एरिसियतणु तुमे पत्ता"
english: "In this world, Youth won't fight because they don't have rules, But because they are human, You have to suffer."

prakrit: "रामस्स हिययइट्टा,अणुहविऊणं सुहं तु वइदेही,हरिया रक्खसवइणा,जिमिया एक्कारसे दिवसे"
english: "Dear Rama, It's a pleasure to meet you, Deepti; I will protect you with greenery As long as I have one good day."

prakrit: "तत्तो वि य पडिवक्खे,निहए पडिआणिया निययठाणं,पुणरवि य सुहं पत्ता,रामस्स पसायनोएणं"
english: "Yet the field is empty, The plowman has not yet reached its destination, A good leaf has once again been plucked from the ground, A peaceful pastime awaits Rama."

prakrit: "असुहोदएण भहे!,गब्भादाणेण संजुया सि तुमं,परिवाजलणदवा,निच्छूटा एत्य आरणे"

english: "Destroyed marriage, Destroying destiny, Destroy destiny, For the son of a bitch Shall fall."

english: "I beg of you, Stop being nasty, Forgive me my faults, For I am not worthy of your affection."

prakrit: "पुहइपुरसामियं ते,संभासेऊण महुरखयणेहिं,जाया पसन्नहियया,समय चिय बजजोणं"
english: "Long - eyed girl, Try to catch a glimpse of the bees While making love, Time is ticking."

prakrit: "लवणहुसेहि समय,पिहुस्स पीई निरन्तरा जाया,आणामिया य बहवे,तेहि महन्ता पुहहपाला"
english: "At the same time as salting, The water that flows from the hips Flows unceasingly, Like a great flood."

prakrit: "आवासिएहि एवं,भडेहि तो वजनकनरवइणा,भणिओ य नारयमुणी,कहेहि लवण-'कुसुप्पत्ती"
english: "Those who live in the village, If they roam freely They produce poison, Say the Naryamuni, Say some salts -" "Kusuppatti." ""

prakrit: "तो भणइ नारयमुणी,अस्थि इहं कोसलाऎ नरवसभो,इक्खागवंसतिलओ,विक्खाओ दसरहो नाम"
english: "So say the Naryamuni," "Here are the bones of this fatal animal." "I am telling you this because it is the tenth name of the God of Destruction."

prakrit: "चत्तारि सायरा इव,तस्स सुया सत्ति-कइन्ति-बलजुला,विन्नाणनाणकुसला,ईसत्यकयस्समा वीरा"
english: "The watchman is a brave man, So is her daughter - in - law, Steady and vigorous, Wretched and fragile, Like a warrior in distress."

prakrit: "जेट्टो य हवइ पउमो,अणुओ पुण-लक्खणो तहा भरहो,सत्तुग्धो र कणिट्ठो,जो सत्तु जिणइ संगामे"
english: "Whatever the wind blows, Let it be with the full force of the atom and its characteristic features. For the mind of the sage is the arrow that conquers sage."

prakrit: "पालेन्तो पिउवयणं,लक्खणसहिओ समं च परिणीए,मोत्तण य साएय,डण्डारणं गओ पउमो"
english: "Nature is dear to all beings, Equal and equal in worth and merit, Like the pearl in a pearl's eye, So is the husband to the doe."

prakrit: "लच्छीहरेण वहिओ,चन्दणहानन्दणो य सम्बुको,सुयवेरिएण समय,करेइ खरदूसणो जुझं"
english: "One who is carried away by luxuries, Who enjoys the pleasures of the moon, Or experiences them in silence, In due course commits them by mistake."

prakrit: "संगामम्मि सहाओ,नाव गओ लक्खणस्स पउमाभो,ताव य छलेण हरिया,जणयसुया रक्खसिन्देणं"
english: "Friend, tell me, Can't you see that the ship is teeming with tourists? But let's face it: It's green with the waves, Not red with the sun."

prakrit: "सुग्गीव-हणुव-जम्बव-विराहियाई बहू गयणगामी,रामस्स गुणासत्ता,मिलिया पुर्व व सुकरणं"
english: "The daughter - in - law is free to sing, Rama's virtuous qualities are known, Happiness prevails and is attained."

prakrit: "रामेण रक्ससई,विणिऊणं आणिया तओ सीया,साएया वि य नयरी,सम्गसरिच्छा च्या तेहिं"
english: "Rama is the patron saint, Weaving is cool, The streets are deserted, And so is her lover." ""

prakrit: "परमिड्डिसंपउत्ता,हलहर-नारायणा तहिं रजं,मुआन्ति सुरवरा इव,सत्सु रयणेसु साहीणा"
english: "A man of modest means, With plowman's hair, That is king of jewels, And a warrior's bow, Which is the weapon of the true warrior."

prakrit: "मह अन्नया फयाई,गणपरिवायाणुगेण पउमेणं,परपुरिसबणियदोसा,जणयसुया छडिया रणे"
english: "I have grown very thin, The husband is busy with his affairs, The wives are busy making love, And the young men make love."

prakrit: "कहिऊण य निस्सेसं,वत्तं तो नारओ सरिय सीयं,बंपइ समंसुनयणो,सबनरिन्दाण पञ्चरखं"
english: "Tell me, are you sure? The only thing I don't know is that the sound of the drum is deafening, That the silence is surreptitious, That all the nights are punctuated by tears."

prakrit: "पउमस्स अम्गमहिसी,अट्टहं महिलियासहस्साणं,रयणं व निरुवलेवा,उत्तमसम्मत-चारिता"
english: "A virtuous wife is full of affection, full of kindness and affection, Full of wisdom and discretion, Well - endowed with good character."

prakrit: "नूर्ण चिय अन्नभवे,पावं समुवज्जियं विदेहाए,तेणेत्थ माणुसत्ते,अणुहूयं दारुणं दुक्खं"
english: "A hundred grains of rice are enough, A hundred grams of rice is too much, Human life is too short, Suffering is too great."

prakrit: "परतचिरयस्स इहं,बणस्स अलियं पभासमाणस्स,वासीफलं व नोहा,कह व न पडिया धरणिवढे!"
english: "Look! There you are, acacia fruit, pomegranate fruit, Noha! How can one not step on the ground?" ""

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,अणालवणो मुणि भणइ एसो,साहेहि इहन्ताओ,केदूरे कोसला नयरो?"
english: "Listening to my speech, The parrot says:" "Come, my friend. Where are you going to lay your hands?" ""

prakrit: "सो भणइ बोयणाणं,सयं ससद्ध इमाउ ठाणाओ,साएया वरनयरी,जत्थ य परिवसइ पउमाभो"
english: "She speaks nonsense, Stands by what's reasonable, And mutters nonsense Whenever she has to." ""

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेयं,भगइ लवो वजजङ्घनरवसभं,मामय मेलेहि भडा,साएवं जेण वच्चामो"
english: "Listen to me, darling, Take me for a traveler's boy, My mother - in - law will help me out, For all I know is that the road is wide."

prakrit: "एयन्तरम्म पिहुणा,दिना मयणसस्स निययसुया,वत्तं पाणिम्गहणं,तत्थ कुमारस्स तद्दियह"
english: "Anyway, my husband is back, The day is almost over, The winter is over, And so is the boy's day."

prakrit: "गमिऊण एगरति,· तत्तो वि विणिग्गया कुमारवरा,परदेसे य जिणन्ता,पत्ता आलोगनयरं ते"
english: "Going up and down, That too without a piercing girdle, That through the curtain one conquers, Like a leaf unfurling."

prakrit: "तत्तो वि य निम्गन्तुं,अब्भण्णपुरं गया सह बलेणं,तत्थ वि कुबेरकन्त,जिणन्ति समरे नरवरिन्दं"
english: "There too I go down, There also the God of Love goes up and down, And there also the god of Love, Kuberkant, Conquers the men of war."

prakrit: "गन्तूण य लम्पागं,देसं बहुगाम-नगरपरिपुण्णं,तत्थ वि य एगकण्णं,नराहिवं निजिणन्ति रणे"
english: "Destruction is like a lotus, The country is many, The city is full of it, And yet the forest is single - eyed."

prakrit: "तं पि य अइकमेडं,पत्ता विनयन्थलि महानयरिं,तत्थ वि जिणन्ति वीरा,भाइसयं नरवरिन्दाणं"
english: "There the brave are victorious, Then the arrows of the sky, Then leaves behind a great banner proclaiming victory.," "For fear of the God of Love." ""

prakrit: "गङ्गं समुत्तरेउं,कइलासम्मुत्तरं दिसं पत्ता,जाया य सामिसाला,लव-सा गेयदेसाणं"
english: "The Ganges is the whole, The horizon is black and white, The paths are uneven, Love is the teaching of songs."

prakrit: "झस-कंबु कुंत-सोहल पण-गंदण-सलहलंगला भीमा,भूया य वामणा वि य,जिया य बहुवाइया देसा"
english: "Jhas - kambu, kunt - sohal, pan - gatang - salhal, langla, bheema, bhuya or vamana, jya or many - eyed desa."

prakrit: "उत्तरिऊण य सिन्धु,अवरेण जिणन्ति ते बहू देसा,आरिय-अणारिया वि य,इमेहि नामेहि नायया"
english: "After all, it is the Indus that conquers, after all, Those daughter - in - law's countries, Even the Aryan and the non - Aryan. Such is the name of the nayya."

prakrit: "आहीर-बोय-जवणा,कच्छा सर्गकेरला य नेमाला,बरुला य चारुवच्छा,वरावडा चेव सोपारा"
english: "Ahir - boy - young man, Kaccha sargakerla ya nemala, Barula ya charuvaccha, Varavada chev sopara."

prakrit: "कसमीर-विसाणा वि य,विजातिसिरा हिडिंबय-'बट्ठा,सूला बब्बर-साला,गोसाला सरमया सबरा"
english: "Kasmir - Visana Viy, Vijatisira Hidimbayi -" "Butcher, Sula Babbar - Sala, Gosala Saramaya Sabara" ""

prakrit: "आणंदा तिसिरा वि य,खसी तहा चेव होन्ति मेहलया,सुरसेणी वल्हीया,खंधारा कोल उलुगा य"
english: "Come on, Tisra! There you go, Lovely woman, Whose hair grows thin On the riverbank." ""

prakrit: "पुरि-कोबेरा कुहरा,अन्धा य तहा कलिझमाईया,एए भन्ने य बहू,लव-'सेहिं निया देसा"
english: "Puri - The cowherd's fog, Andha - ya - That black mist, O daughter - in - law, Love -" "Such is the course of nature." ""

prakrit: "एवं लव-'सा ते,सेविजन्ता नरिन्दचक्केणं,पुणरवि पुण्डरियपुरं,समागया इन्दसमविहवा"
english: "And love -" "That is it, servant Narindachakkenam, Punaravi Pundariyapuram, The confluence of the two is like the Indus." ""

prakrit: "सोऊण कुमाराणं,आगमणं वजनकसहियाणं,धय छत्त-तोरणाई,लोएण कया नयरसोहा"
english: "Son of a bitch, The arrival of a thunderclap, The burning of the roof - arrows, What pleasure is there to hear in the world?"

prakrit: "उक्सोहिए समत्थे,पुण्डरियपुरे सुरिन्दपुरसरिसे,लवणकुसा पविठ्ठा,नायरलोएण दीसन्ता"
english: "With a good deal of excitement, Surrounded by piles of mud, The sacred grove of brimstone Looks like a mirror illuminated by the rays of the sun."

prakrit: "सीया दहण सुए,समागए निग्गया वरघराओ,लवण-'ङ सेहि पणया,जणणी सबायरतरेणं"
english: "The bridegroom is asleep, The wedding feast is in full swing, And the wife is making love On the river bank." ""

prakrit: "तीए वि ते कुमारा,अवग्र̥ढा हरिसनेहहिययाए,अङ्गेसु परामुट्ठा,सिरेसु परिचुम्बिया अहियं"
english: "She is still a child, I have grown up hating her, Have grown very thin, Have matured a great deal, And am extremely proud of myself."

prakrit: "सपस्थिवा सगयतुरंगवाहणा,विसन्ति ते सियकमलायरे पुरे,मणोहरा पयलियचारुकुण्डला,लव-' सा विमलपयावपायडा"
english: "The snake is the bearer of affection, The scent of lotuses fills the whole body, The fragrance of jasmine is palpable; Love -" "That Vimalapayavada." ""

prakrit: "इइ पउमचरिए लवकसदेसविजयं नाम अट्ठाणउयं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "Praise be to the divine name of Lavakasa, For he has perfected purity."

prakrit: "एवं ते परमगुणं,इस्सरियं पाविया वरकुमारा,बहुपस्थिवपरिकिण्णा,पुण्डरियपुरे परिवसन्ति"
english: "And that supreme virtue, Isriyam paviya varakumara, like the many positions, dwells in the purification of the senses."

prakrit: "तत्तो कयन्तवयणं,परिपुच्छइ नारओ अडविमज्झे,विमणं गवेसमार्ण,जणयसुर्य उज्झिउद्देसे"
english: "There is so much kyantavayana, so much ado about flattery, And so much pride in speech, That the senses are aroused by it."

prakrit: "सयले य समक्खाए,वित्तन्ते नारओ गो तुरियं,पुण्डरियपुरं गन्तुं,पेच्छह लवण-'कुसे भवणे"
english: "Sayle ya samakhaye, baiteinte naarao gau turiyam, pundariyapuranam gathun, peechha laan -" "Which building is this?" ""

prakrit: "'संपुइओ पविट्ठो,भणइ तमो नारओ कुमारवरे,बा राम-लक्खणसिरी,सा तुम हवउ सविसेसा"
english: "" "Be holy, my son; tell me your name is Kumara, or Rama: Laksmanasiri; you have already served him well."

prakrit: "काऊण समालावं,खणमेकं नारओ कुमाराणं,साहेइ य वित्तन्त,कयन्तवयणाइयं सर्व"
english: "Whom to blame, poor boy, Friend or foe, Everyone to blame."

prakrit: "तं नारयस्स वयणं,सुणिऊण लव-'कुसा परमरुट्टा,जंपन्ति समरसज्जं,कुणह लहुं साहणं सबं"
english: "It's like playing the flute, Listening to love -" "Kusa paramrutta," "Jampanthi samarasajjanam, Kunham lahum sahanam sabam." ""

prakrit: "पउमस्सुवरि पयट्टे,पुत्ते दट्टण तत्थ वइदेही,रुवइ ससंभमहियया,दइयस्स गुणे अणुसरन्ती"
english: "Aunt, There must be something very special about your son's absence: He must be crying, His wife must be weeping, His qualities tempered by compassion."

prakrit: "सीयाऎ समीवत्थो,सिद्धत्यो भणइ नारयं एत्तो,एस कुडुम्बस्स तुमे,भेओ काउं समाढतो"
english: "You're right here," said the farmer, "And I'm right here with you. Come on, you crook. Who is going to stop you?"

prakrit: "सिद्धत्थं देवरिसी,भणइ न जाणामि हइ इमं कजं,नवरं पुण एत्थ गुणो,दीसइ सत्थो तुम होहि"
english: "I do not know what to say to you, my dear, I cannot say how it all began. Once again this quality prevails: You are the one who shows it."

prakrit: "सुणिऊण य रुयमाणिं,जणणि पुच्छन्ति दोणि वि कुमारा,अम्मो! साहेहि लहुँ,केण तुमं एत्थ परिभूया"
english: "Listen, you crying mother - in - law! They both ask me," "My little girl!" "Dear friend, Why are you standing here crying?"

prakrit: "सीया भणइ कुमारे,न य केणइ एत्थ रोसिया अहयं,नवरं रुयामि संपइ,तुम्ह पियं सरिय गुणनिलयं"
english: "She says,'Daughter - in - law, No one cares so much about me as about you." The young wife has run out of things to cry about. You, my dear, are a model of true virtue. "

prakrit: "भणिया य कुमारेहिं,को अम्ह पिया? कहिं वि सो अम्मो?,परिवसह किं च नाम?,एवं साहेहि भूयत्थं"
english: "Daughter - in - law, Who is my lover? Where is he, Amma?, What is his name, My family?, And what is his real name?"

prakrit: "जं एव पुच्छिया सा,निययं साहेइ उब्भवं सोया,रामस्स य उप्पत्ती,लक्खणसहियस्स निस्सेसं"
english: "Whatever you ask me, I will answer honestly, As long as I am asleep, And as long as you are awake, My mind is unfettered."

prakrit: "दण्डारण्णाईय,नियहरणं रावणस्स वहणं च,साएयपुरिपवेस,जणाववायं निरवसेसं"
english: "The executioner, Taking care of Ravana's wife, Proves faithful in all respects: The speech is uninterrupted."

prakrit: "पुणरवि कहेइ सीया,जणपरिवायाणुगेण रामेणं,नेऊण उज्झिया हं,अडवीए केसरिरवाए"
english: "Again and again she says," "Lord Ram, because of the crowd that has passed by, Never to rise again." ""

prakrit: "गयगणपविटेणं,दिट्ठा हं वजनइनरवइणा,काऊण धम्मबहिणी,भणिऊण इहाणिया नयरं"
english: "The cow gives milk, The bull's eye is heavy, The buffalo is weak, The cow is dharmabahini, The ox is deaf."

prakrit: "एवं नवमे मासे,संपत्ते सवणसंगए चन्दे,एत्थेव पसूया हइ,तुमहिं राहवस्स सुया"
english: "And on the ninth day of the month, Wealth mixed with affection, So let me make love. Your path leads to sleep."

prakrit: "तेणेह लवणसायर-परियन्ता वसुमई रयणपुण्णा,विजाहरेहि समयं,दासि व वसीकया सबा"
english: "Then came the rainy season - Spring was in full swing, The rainy season was here, And everything went smoothly As slaves." ""

prakrit: "आवडिए संगामे,संपइ किं तुम्ह किं व रामस्स,मुणिहामि असोभणयं,व तेणं मए रुग्णं"
english: "Come, join me, tell me, What have you to do with me, Mr. Ramsay? I am completely at a loss How can I help it?"

prakrit: "सो तेहि वि पडिभणिया,अम्मो! बल केसवाण अहरेणं,सुणिहिसि भाणविभङ्ग,समरे अम्हेहि कारन्त"
english: "So tell me, mother - in - law! Strong hair grows thicker. Listen to the muttering of falsehoods. Our enemies will be destroyed in the fight." ""

prakrit: "सीया भणइ कुमारे,न य जुत्तं एरिसं क्वसिउं जे,नमियबो चेव गुरू,हवइह लोए ठिई एसा"
english: "You fool, Don't ask me what I mean. Anyway, my lord, You're a good teacher. Maybe this is the way things happen in the world."

prakrit: "ते एव जपमाणि,संथावेमण अत्तणो जणणि,दोणि वि मज्जिमनिमिया,आहरणविभूसियसरीरा"
english: "They are the same japa māṇi, the same as penance, both solemn and solemn, each with its own solemnity."

prakrit: "सिद्धाण नमोक्कार,काऊणं मत्तगयवरारुढा,तो निम्गया कुमारा,बलसहिया कोसलाभिमुहं"
english: "A virtuous person is modest; someone who is drunk is extravagant; Someone who is poor is weak; A violent person is full of faults."

prakrit: "एयाणि य अन्नाणि य,बंपन्तो लक्खणेण उवसमिओ,पउमो नरवइसहिओ,साहुसयासं समणुपत्तो"
english: "Aunt, It's my fault. When I see you, It annoys the hell out of me. I can't take it anymore."

prakrit: "सरयरविसरिसतेयं,दहणं सयलभूसणं रामो,ओयरिय गयवराओ,पणमइ तं चेव तिविहेणं"
english: "Aunt, There must be something very special about Rama's body That does not burn, That is, That it grows very thin."

prakrit: "पउमो पुत्तेहिं समं,उवविट्ठो,मुणिवरस्स आसन्ने,चन्दा-''इञ्चसमग्गो,सुराण ईसो इव निणस्स"
english: "You fool, The moon is just like a son; It rises high, Like the ebb and flow of a moon -" "Inchasmaggo, this is the way of wisdom." ""

prakrit: "अन्ने वि नरवरिन्दा,लच्छीहरमाइया जिणं नमिउं,उवविठ्ठा धरणियले,पुबनिविद्येसु देवेसु"
english: "Still a man, How lucky I am To have won the victory! Behold, on earth, The gods of ancient learning."

prakrit: "आहरणवज्जिया वि य,सियवत्थनियंसणी जणयधूया,अज्जाहि समं रेहइ,तारासु व सयलससिलेहा"
english: "The plowman's wife is still alive, And the maidservant's eyes, Already fixed, Are like stars torn to shreds by the current."

prakrit: "सुर-मणुय-खेयरेहिं,उवविटेहिं तओ सयलनाणी,सिस्सेण पुच्छिओ सो,जिणधर्म अभयसेणेणं"
english: "Be nice to each other, Be polite when you ask him questions, Always be polite." ""

prakrit: "विउलं निउणं च तहा,तच्चत्थं सुहनिबोहणं धम्मं,साहेइ मुणिवरिन्दो,जलहरगम्भीरनिग्धोसो"
english: "To weep and to weep is the same thing as to rejoice; to be joyful is dharma; to sigh freely is to be wretched."

prakrit: "एत्थ अणन्ताणन्ते,आगासे सासओ सहावत्थो,लोगो तिमेयभिन्नो,हवइ चिय तालसंठाणो"
english: "Here and there one knows nothing, In the morning the mother - in - law is always with one another, People differ from one to another; For the wind is the same as the rhythm."

prakrit: "वेत्तासणयसरिच्छो,अहलोगो चेव होइ नायबो,झल्लरिनिहो य मज्झे,उवरिं पुण मुरवसंठाणो"
english: "You fool, Don't be so naïve: It's the fire of love, Not my business, Not mine, But someone else's." ""

prakrit: "मेरुगिरिस अहत्था,सत्तेव हवन्ति नरमपुहवोओ,रयणप्पहाइयाओ,जीवाणं दुक्खनणणीओ"
english: "Merugiris are impudent, The powers that be are mild - tempered, The kings are generous, Life is arduous."

prakrit: "'रयणप्पमा य सकर-वालय-पप्पमा य धूमपभा,एत्तो तमा तमतमा,सत्तमिया हवइ अइघोरा"
english: "" "Rayanappama ya sakara-valaya-pappa ya dhoompava bhaava, itna tama tamaama, saatmya hawai aayigora" "(The south wind is blowing, so you have to smoke)."

prakrit: "तीसा य पन्नवीसा,पणरस दस चेव होन्ति णायबा,तिण्णेकं पञ्चूर्ण,पञ्चेव अणुत्तरा नरया"
english: "Teesa is the husbandman's wife, pannirasa is the wife of ten husbands, nayaba is the mother of three, the five are the wives of one another."

prakrit: "एए चउरासीई,लक्खा सीमन्तयाइया घोरा,खर-फरुस-चण्डवाया,ससि-सूरविवजिया भीमा"
english: "Aya chaurasiayi, laksha seemantayaaiya ghora, khara-pharus-chandavaya, saasi-survibhajiya bhima."

prakrit: "दसतिगअहिया एकाहिया य नव सत्त पञ्च तिण्णेक्का,नरईदए कमो खलु,ओसरमाणो उ रयणाए"
english: "Ten steps, one arm, or nine steps, or five steps, more or less empty, are the duties of a husband." ""

prakrit: "अउणावन्न नरया,सेढी सोमन्तयस्स पुषेणं,चउसु वि दिसासु एवं,अट्ट चेव परिहाणी"
english: "You fool, Aunt, Every woman desires to please her husband, Even her husband needs directions. There are plenty of ways to avoid this."

prakrit: "चत्तालीसट्टहिया,सत्त य छप्पञ्च तह य चत्तारि,अवसरमाणा य पुणो,नाव चिय अप्पइट्टाणो"
english: "Forty-seven hundred and fifty-six, Then three times as many, Once again for all time; Isn't the boat already full of people?"

prakrit: "तवायससमफरिसा,दुमान्धा वजसूइअइदुगमा,सीउण्हवेयणा विय,फरवल-'सिवतजन्ता में"
english: "Tavayasasamfarisa, Dumandha vajasuyaayudugama, Seenavyavena viyaya, Faraval -" "In the fire of the sky" ""

prakrit: "रस-फरिसवसगया जे,पाक्यरा विगयधम्मसम्भावा,ते चिय पडन्ति नरए,आयसपिण्डं पिब बलोहे"
english: "Those who like to drink wine, Who like to be pampered, Like lovers of pleasure and pleasure, Fall when they are angry."

prakrit: "हिंसा-'लिय-चोरिकाइएसु परजुवइसेवणाईसु,पावं कुणन्ति जे बि हु,भीम वञ्चन्ति ते नरयं"
english: "Violence -" "Liye - stealers, Serve the parasites, Whatever it is that causes sin, It is the men who betray Bhima." ""

prakrit: "सयमेव पावकारी,परं च कारेन्ति अणुमयन्ती य,तिबकसायपरिगया,पडन्ति जीवा धुवं नरए"
english: "Always a wrongdoer, But only when he acts dishonestly, When he has crossed the line of duty, Lives are not to be washed away."

prakrit: "ते तत्थ समुप्पना,नरए दित्तग्गिवेयणा पावा,डज्झन्ति आरसन्ता,वलवलणं चेव कुणमाणा"
english: "There is something very special about that man; he is a man of few words, a traveler of many talents, full of fear and longing; crawling is the highest virtue."

prakrit: "ततो य अग्गिभीया,वेयरणिं बन्ति अइतिसाभूया,पाइज्जन्ति रडन्ता,तत्तं खारोदयं दुरहिं"
english: "So fearful is the fire, So anxious are the women sitting on the rafters, And so weeping; Such a wretched man is too cruel."

prakrit: "मुच्छागया विउद्धा,असिपत्तवर्ण तओ य संपत्ता,छिजन्ति आउहेहिं,उवरोवरि आवयन्तेहिं"
english: "Foolish girl, When you brush your teeth against the rafters, You spice up everything, But don't turn your face away."

prakrit: "छिनकर-चरण-जा,छिन्नमुया छिन्नकण्ण-नासोट्टा,छिन्नसिर-तालु-नेता,विभिन्नहियया महिं पडिया"
english: "Be torn to shreds, Be shattered by tears, Be bruised by bruises, Be battered by wounds, Beheaded by wounds of many different kinds."

prakrit: "रजहिं गलनिबद्धा,वलएऊणं च सामलिं पावा,कडिजन्ते य पुणो,कण्टयसंछिन्नभिन्नका"
english: "The king is bound to his bow, And the doe is unable to support the young stag, For he must go again, For the thorn in his flesh Is completely different."

prakrit: "केइत्य कुम्भिपाए,पञ्चन्ति अहोसिरा धगधगेन्ता,बन्तकरवछिन्ना,अन्ने अन्नेसु खजन्ति"
english: "Some people are mischievous, others are greedy, and still others are dishonest."

prakrit: "असि-सत्ति-कणय-तोमर -सूल-मुसुंढीहिं भिन्नसबङ्गा,विलवन्ति धरणिपडिया,सीहसियालेहि खज्जन्ता"
english: "Assi-satti-kanya-tomara-sool-mussed woman with a different armour, Vilavanthi dharnipadiya, Sihasialeye khajjanta"

prakrit: "एक च तिणि सत्त य,दस सत्तरसं तहेव बाबोसा,तेत्तीस उयहिनामा,आउँ रयणप्पभादीसुं"
english: "One, three, seven, ten, seventy-three: The festival is my father's, the next thirty - three are my high vows; Now come, my lord, the festival of rains."

prakrit: "एवं अणुक्कमेणं,कालं पुढवीपु नरयमज्झगया,अणुहोन्ति महादुक्खें,निमिस पि अलद्धसुहसाया"
english: "And with it the pleasures of love, Like the joys and sorrows that follow the passage of time."

prakrit: "सीउण्हछुहातण्हाइयाई दुक्खाई जाइ तेलोके,सबाई ताई पावइ,जीवो नरए गरुयकम्मो"
english: "Everything is oil, Everything is fuel, The soul is immortal, And so is the body."

prakrit: "तम्हा इमं सुणेउ,फलं अधम्मस्स तिबदुक्खयरं,होह सुपसत्नहियया,जिणवरधम्मुज्जया "निधं"
english: "Listen to me, my dear: The fruit of iniquity is like three sorrows. Be pleasant to heart: Life is like a treasure chest." ""

prakrit: "रयणप्पमाऎ भागे,उवरिल्ले भवणवासिया देवा,असुरा नाग सुवण्णा,वाउसमुहा दिसिकुमारा"
english: "The rhinoceros ran away, The gods dwelt in the open forest, The asura nāga slept, The vaṃsūha Disikumāra"

prakrit: "दीवा विज्जू पणिया,अग्गिकुमारा य होन्ति नायका,भुञ्जन्ति विसयसोक्लं,एए देवीण मज्झगया"
english: "The lamp is poisonous, The fire - potter or hunter - hunter is a nayika, The hearth is overflowing with poison, The goddess has had her fair share."

prakrit: "चउसट्ठी चुलसीई,बावरि तह य हवह छनउई,छावत्तरि मो लक्खा,सेसाणं हवइ छह पि"
english: "Sixty-four are hot, two hundred and fifty are dry, one hundred and seventy are salty, the other three are poisonous."

prakrit: "एएसु य भवणेसु य,देवा संगीयवाइयरवेणं,निच्चं सुहियपमुइया,गयं वि कालं न याणन्ति"
english: "Such is the state of affairs, God is with you, Ways and means are being chosen, But even he does not know the passage of time."

prakrit: "ताण भणन्तरोवरि,दीवसमुद्दा भवे असंखेज्जा,जम्बुद्दीवादीया,एते उ सयंभुरमणन्ता"
english: "Stress should be avoided, The lamp should be illuminated, Unsure what to do, Jambuddivadiya; This much silence will satisfy you."

prakrit: "एएसु वसन्ति सुरा,किन्नर-किंपुरिस-गरुड-गन्धवा,नक्खा भूयपिसाया,कोलन्ति य रक्खसा मुइया"
english: "Such beings inhabit the air, The eunuchs, the kimpuris, the garuds, the gandhavas, The earth trembles without a trace, And the warriors, the rakshasas, go into hiding."

prakrit: "पुढवि नल-जलण-मारुय-वणस्सई चेव थावरा एए,काया एको य पुणो,हवइ तओ पश्चमेयजुओ"
english: "The foolish plowman's son - Burning, killing, and weeping - Always keeps at it, Always does, Once again. But to the backward young man it belongs."

prakrit: "एइन्दियाउ जाव उ,जीवा पश्चिन्दिया मुणेयबा,फरिस-रस-गन्ध-चक्खू सोउबओगा बहुवियप्पा"
english: "Come on, India! Life is like sowing seeds in the jasmine of the west. The seeds, juicy, fragrant, taste and taste just like watermelons."

prakrit: "दुविहा थावरकाया,सुहुमा तह बायरा य नायबा,उभभो वि होन्ति दुविहा,पजत्ता तह अपजत्ता"
english: "There are two ways out, the good way out and the bad way out. Even on the first day of spring The two are incompatible."

prakrit: "जीवाणं उवओगो,नाणं तह दंसणं जिणक्खायं,नाणं अट्ठवियप्पं,चउविहं दसणं भणियं"
english: "Life is like that; to touch a coin is to conquer; to coin an eighth is to suffer; to speak fourfold is to command."

prakrit: "अण्डाउय-पोयाउय-जराउया गब्भजा इमे भणिया,'सुर-णारओवयाइय,सेसा समुच्छिमा जीवा"
english: "Aunt," he said, with a trembling voice, "A bunch of gooseflesh hangs around in the air."

prakrit: "ओरालिय विउ,आहार तेजसं च कम्मइयं,सुहुमं परंपराए,गुणेहि संपज्जइ सरीरं"
english: "Oral view, diet, vigor, and activity are the pleasures of tradition; merit characterizes the body."

prakrit: "घम्मा-'धम्मा-''गासं,कालो जीबो य पोग्गलेण समं,एयं तु हवइ दवं,छम्मेयं सत्तभङ्गजुयं"
english: "Ghamma -'dharma -'go, black jibes are the same as pogroms. This is how you treat the wind, You deceitful one." ""

prakrit: "एयं दाविसेसो,नरवह! कहिओ भए समासेणं,निसुणेहि भणिजन्तं,दीवसमुदाण संखेवं"
english: "It's the devil, you fool! Anyway, all right? As the saying goes," "Let the sunshine in my heart." ""

prakrit: "जम्बुद्दीवाईया,दीवा लवणाझ्या य सलिलनिही,एगन्तरिया ते पुण,दुगुणा दुगुणा असंखेजा"
english: "Jambuddivaiyya, the lamp is salty, The traveler is pure, The incompetent is twice as good."

prakrit: "अन्ते सयंभुरमणो,जम्बुद्दीवो उ होइ मज्झम्मि,सो बोयणाण लक्वं,पमाणओ मण्डलायारो"
english: "In the end, my poor man, The sun will be hotter Than the moon."

prakrit: "तस्स वि य हवइ मज्झे,नाहिगिरी मन्दरो सयसहस्सं,सबपमाणेणुचो,वित्थिण्णो दससहस्साई"
english: "There must be something in it for me, A deserted temple, A hundred thousand doors, A man who loves everything, And a woman who hates men Ten thousand doors."

prakrit: "दाहिणउत्तरभागे,तस्स उ कुलपचया लवणतोयं,उभओ फुसन्ति सबे,कञ्चणवररयणपरिणामा"
english: "On the right, up and down, Like a bunch of peacock's tail feathers Pulling back and forth, Like the nail marks on a young elephant's forehead"

prakrit: "हिमवो य महाहिमवो,निसढो नउलो य रुप्पि सिहरी य,एएहिं विहत्ताई,सत्तेव हवन्ति वासाई"
english: "A frost or a heavy rain, A dry river or a rough stream, These are the winds that blow, The wind is powerful."

prakrit: "भरह हेमवयं पुण,हरिवासं तह महाविदेहं च,रम्मय हेरण्णवयं,उत्तरओ हवइ एरवयं"
english: "Praise be to the hot wind, To the horizon and the great expanse of the sky. Love triumphs everywhere, And the answer is the wind."

prakrit: "गङ्गा य पढमसरिया,सिन्धू पुण रोहिया मुणेयवा,तह चेव रोहियंसा,'हरी नदी चेव हरिकन्ता"
english: "The Ganges is the first stream, The Indus is the second, The Rohyans the third, The green rivers the seventh and the last."

prakrit: "सीया वि य सीओया,नारी य तहेव होइ नरकन्ता,रुप्पयसुवण्णकूला,रत्ता रत्तावई भणिया"
english: "Aunt, There must be something wrong with a woman's body, It must be the fire of hell, A bunch of red flowers, A flock of rats and mice."

prakrit: "वोसं वक्खारगिरी,चोत्तीस हवन्ति रायहाणीओ,उत्तरदेवकुरूओ,सामलिजम्बूसणाहाओ"
english: "They are the Vakkaragiri, the thirty-four Havanti warriors, the gods of the north, the warriors of the Himalayas."

prakrit: "जम्बुद्दीवस्स ठिओ,चउग्गुणो तस्स धायई सण्डो,तस्स वि दुगुणपमाणं,पुक्खरदीवे हवइ अद्धं"
english: "Be careful not to fall asleep; the midday sun gives you trouble when you're awake; it also gives you a double dose of sleep; full moonlight is the essence of love."

prakrit: "पञ्चसु पञ्चसु पञ्चमु,भरहेरवासु तह विदेहेसु,भणियाउ कम्मभूमी,तीसं पुण भोगभूमीओ"
english: "Five is five is five, many is one and many is another. Speak the language of karma; it is the land of pleasure."

prakrit: "हेमवयं हरिवास,उत्तरकुरु तह य हवइ देवकुरू,रम्मय हेरण्णवयं,एयाओ भोगभूमीओ"
english: "The wind is fierce, The sky is heavenly, The gods are fierce, Love is everywhere, This is the land of pleasure."

prakrit: "आउ-ठिईपरिमाणं,भोगो मिहुणाण जारिसो होइ,तं सर्व संखेवं,भणामि निसुणेहि एगमणो"
english: "Come, let me tell you something. Let the pleasure be for your lover's sake, That everything will be in vain. I think I've got it all figured out already."

prakrit: "नाणाविहरयणमई,भूमी कप्पडुमेसु य समिद्धा,मिहुणयकयाहिवासा,निचुजोया मणभिरामा"
english: "The coin is worn out, The land is bare, The women are busy making love, The husband is busy making friends, The wife is busy with household chores."

prakrit: "गिह-जोइ-भूसणङ्गा,भोयण भायण तहेव वत्थङ्गा,चित्तरसा तुडियङ्गा,कुसुमङ्गा दीवियङ्गा य"
english: "Gih - joi - bhusnanga, bhoyana bhaiyana thevathanga, chittarasa theudiyanga, kusumanga the divyangya ya."

prakrit: "बहुरयणविणिम्माया,भवणदुमा अट्टभूमिया दिवा,सयणासणसन्निहिया,तेएण निदाहरविसरिसा"
english: "Long - eyed girl, The lamp is on the housetop, The nights are fleeting, So sleepless nights are commonplace."

prakrit: "जोईदुमाण उवरिं,ससि-सूरा जत्थ वच्चमाणा वि,ताण पहावोवहया,निययं पि छविं विमुञ्चन्ति"
english: "Joys and sorrows follow, Like wine and wine Which, when strained, Destroy the image of destiny."

prakrit: "वरहार-कड्य-कुण्डल-मउडालंकार-नेउराईणि,निययं पि भूसणाई,आहरणदुमेसु जायन्ति"
english: "The bridegroom - The bride - to - be, The garland - the ornament - The maidens, even at the moment of swearing, Go to and fro."

prakrit: "अट्ठसयक्खजयजुओ,चउसट्टो तह य वक्षणवियप्पा,उप्पज्जइ आहारो,भोयणरुक्खेसु रसकलिओ"
english: "Eight hundred and ninety six young men, Sixty-four hundred and sixty three women, With their mouths full of poison, Are feasting on fresh food."

prakrit: "भिकार-थाल-बट्टय-कचोलय बद्धमाणमाईणि,कञ्चण-रयणमयाई,नायन्ति भायणनेसु"
english: "Beggar - The dish - The bowl - The churning pot - The bound mother - in - law, The angry wife - The false wife - Do not be afraid of telling the truth."

prakrit: "खोमय-दुगुल्ल बालय-चीणंसुयपट्टमाईयाई च,वत्थाई बहुविहाई,वत्थगदुमा पणामेन्ति"
english: "The poor girl is spoilt for choice, The poor boy is pinched by needles, And the wife is too busy talking; The husband is busy making love"

prakrit: "कायम्बरी पसन्ना,आसवनोगा तहेव णेगविहा,चित्तंगरसेसु सया,पाणयनोगा उ जायन्ति"
english: "The cucumber is fragrant, the distilled oil is fresh, the sweetwood flowers are juicy, and the water is refreshing."

prakrit: "वीणा-तिसरिय-वेणू-सच्चीसयमाइया सरा विविहा,निययं सवणसुहयरा,तुडियङ्गदुमेसु जायन्ति"
english: "Veena-tisriya-venu-satchisyamayya sara vividha, niyayam savanasuhayara, tudiyangadumesu jayanti."

prakrit: "वरबउल-तिलय-चम्पय-असोय-पुन्नाय-नायमाईणि,कुसुमाई बहुविहाई,कुसुमङ्गदुमा पणामेन्ति"
english: "Varbula-tilaya-champaya-asoy-punaya-naimaini, Kusumai is very versatile, the kusumangaduma is full of promise."

prakrit: "ससि-सूरसरिसतेया,निच्चं जगजगजगेन्तबहुविडवा,विविहा य दीवियङ्गा,नासन्ति तमन्धयारं ते"
english: "Aunt, There are so many different colours in the sky, So many different shades of red. There is nothing wrong with that."

prakrit: "एयारिसेसु भोगं,दुमेसु भुञ्जन्ति तत्थ मिहुणाई,सबङ्गसुन्दराई,वड्डियनेहाणुरायाई"
english: "The air is fragrant, The nights are hot, And the nights are pleasant. Everything is beautiful, Only the wind stirs the air."

prakrit: "आउठिई हेमवए,पल्लं दो चेव होन्ति हरिवासे,देवकुरुम्मि य तिण्णि,एस कमो हवइ उत्तरओ"
english: "Here come the hare, There are only two crows left in the herd, And the crows are three. The answer is more or less the same."

prakrit: "दो चेव धणुसहस्सा,होइ पमाणं तु हेमवयवासे,चत्तारि य हरिवासे,छच्चेव हवन्ति कुरुवाए"
english: "There are two ways to be wealthy: Either you are a hermit or a farmer's son, Or you are an ox or a stag." ""

prakrit: "नय पत्थिवा न भिचा,न य खुज्जा नेय वामणा पङ्ग,न य मूया बहिरन्धा,नदुक्खिया नेव य दरिदा"
english: "There is no pathiva or begging, no pleasure or playing, no deaf and mute, no sorrow or poverty."

prakrit: "समचउरससंठाणा,बलि-पलियविवज्जिया य नीरोगा,चउसट्ठिलक्खणधरा,मणुया देवा इव सुरूवा"
english: "Right organization, Sacrifice, separation, or indifference, Sixty - six banks of the Goda, Begin with man as god."

prakrit: "ताणं चिय महिलाओ,वियसियवरकमलपत्तनेत्ताओ,सबङ्गसुन्दरीओ,कोमुइससिवयणसोहाओ"
english: "Lovely women, Venerable lotuses, Gorgeous women of all hues, Lovely people who enjoy communal harmony."

prakrit: "भुञ्जन्ति विसयसोक्खं,नं पुरिसा तत्थ भोगभूमीसु,कालं चिय अइदीहं,तं दाणफलं मुणेयचं"
english: "Bhunjanti is a vast pleasure, Not for men that is an enjoyable pastime. Time is of the essence Here, That is, To reap the fruits of charity."

prakrit: "दाणं पुण दुवियप्पं,सुपत्तदाणं अपत्तदाणं च,नायवं हवइ सया,नरेण इह बुद्धिमन्तेणं"
english: "Charity alone is inexhaustible, Supt. charity and non - charity are immutable; the naïve must learn wisdom by heart."

prakrit: "पचमहायकलिया,निवं सझाय-माण-तवनिरया,घण-सयणविगयसना,ते पर साहबो भणिया"
english: "The fifth eye is delicate, Life is peaceful, Honor is tender, Love is abundant, Knowledge is abundant; Therefore, too, speak harshly."

prakrit: "सद्धा-सत्ती-भत्ती-विनाणेणं हवेज नं दिन्न,साहूण गुणधराणं,ते दाणं बहुफलं भणियं"
english: "Sacrifice, sacrifice, almsgiving, are not to be given; they are to be multiplied by charity."

prakrit: "तस्स पभावेण नरा,हेमवयाईस चेव उबवन्ना,मुझन्ति विसयसोक्ल,वरतरुणीमज्झयारत्या"
english: "Don't get angry because of that, you stupid bitch. I'm completely at a loss What to do with this mess."

prakrit: "संजमरहियाण पुणो,न दिज्जा राग-दोसकलुसाणं,तं न हु फलं फ्यच्छद,धर्णिय विधिउज्जमन्ताणं"
english: "To rejoice in the sunshine, Not to give in to anger or blame, To reap undeservedly; To prosper through righteousness."

prakrit: "एवं तु भोगभूमी,तुझं कहिया मए समासेणं,तह उज्जमेह संपइ,जेण निरुत्तेण पावेह"
english: "And you are the pleasure ground; your part is my part. The bright day is over, As you will find it irresolvable."

prakrit: "अन्तरदोवा मणुया,अट्ठावीसाविहा उ सीहमुहा,उक्कोसेणं आउं,ताण य पलियटुमं भागं"
english: "The man with the dark breasts, Twenty-eight inches across, His face red, Looks like an ox, But that's just the way it is."

prakrit: "वन्तरसुराण उवरिं,पञ्चविहा नोइसा तओ देवा,चन्दा सूरा य गहा,नक्खा तारया नेया"
english: "The moon is full of rays, The sky is clear, There are no clouds in the sky But the sky is blue."

prakrit: "एए भमन्ति मेलं,पयाहिणंता सहावतेयंसी,रइसागरोवगाढा,गर्य पि कालं न याणन्ति"
english: "Oh! a flock of peacocks, You who endure long enough, Like the nectar of a rainbow, Yet you know not how long."

prakrit: "नोइसियसुराणुवरि,कप्पो नामेण हवइ सोहम्मो,तह य पुणो ईसाणो,सणंकुमारो य माहिन्दो"
english: "Noisy, sunny day, Spring is on the cards, So is it spring again? It's the rainy season, Or the rainy days."

prakrit: "बंभो कप्पो य तहा,लन्तयकप्पो य होइ नायबो,तह य महासुको वि य,तह अट्ठमओ सहस्सारो"
english: "A bumble bee is one thing, A creeper is something else, A doe is something more, And a stag is something much more."

prakrit: "तत्तो य आणओ पाणओ य तह आरणो मुणेययो,कप्पो अच्चुयनामो,उत्तमदेवाण आवासो"
english: "There must be someone to bring the water, or there must be others to sow the seeds, or else it is the wrong way round; we have a better god."

prakrit: "कप्पाणं पुण उवरिं,नव गेवेज्जाई मणमिरामाई,ताण वि अणुद्दिसाई,पुरओ आइचपमुहाई"
english: "Restore the tree, Give it a fresh look, Make room for the freshly plucked flowers, Allay any lingering suspicions."

prakrit: "विजयं च वेजयन्तं,जयन्तमवराइयं मणभिरामं,अहमिन्दवरविमाणं,सबटुं चेव नायकं"
english: "Victory is bound to triumph, Pride is won through perseverance, Courage is acquired through hard work, Everything is a hero."

prakrit: "तस्स वि य नोयणाई,बारस गन्तूण उवरिमे भागे,इसिपब्भारा पुढवी,चिट्ठन्ति जहिं ठिया सिद्धा"
english: "There too the path is blurred, The roads are slippery, Travelers wander everywhere, Write letters where they are true."

prakrit: "पणयालीसं लक्खा,जोयणसंखाऎ हवइ विस्थिण्णा,अटेव य बाहल्ला,उत्ताणयछत्तसंठाणा"
english: "The plowman's son - in - law has set his sights on the village, The young hunter's wife has gone abroad, The poor farmer's daughter is abroad, Travelers have to travel far and wide, And women have to carry their burdens."

prakrit: "एतो विमाणसंखा,कहेमि बत्तीससयसहस्साई,सोहम्मे ईसाणे,अट्ठावीस तु भणियाई"
english: "That's a bunch of airplanes. I said," "Thirty-two thousand eight hundred." "In jest, you fool. Twenty-eight are your number."

prakrit: "बारस सणकुमारे,माहिन्दे चेव अट्ट लक्खाई,बचारि पुणो बम्मे,विमाणलक्खा तहिं होन्ति"
english: "Baras, poor girl, Mahindey sev atta lakhai, Bachaari puno bumme, Viman lakha is the way to go."

prakrit: "पवाससहस्साई,संखाए लन्तए विमाणाणं,तत्तो य महासुके,चत्तालीस सहस्साई"
english: "Traveler, traveler, When you fly a plane, That's why it's so big: Forty-seven trips." ""

prakrit: "छमेव सहस्स खलु,हवन्ति कप्पे तहा सहस्सारे,आणय-पाणयकप्पेसु होन्ति चत्तारि उ सयाई"
english: "Love is the essence of friendship, When one is making love One can drink water at a time, If one's heart is overflowing with joy One can breathe freely."

prakrit: "तिण्णेव सया भणिया,आरणकप्पे तह''ए चेव,तिण्णि सया अट्ठारस,उवरिमगेवेजमाईसु"
english: "The three brothers are sitting side by side, The other is standing behind him, And the third is standing beside him." ""

prakrit: "पाइक तुरय-रह गय-गोविस-गन्धव-नट्टियन्ताई,अणियाई होन्ति एयाई सत्त सकस्स दिवाई"
english: "Pike, turay, reh gayi, cow - gandhava, nattiyantai, Anything that touches a woman's breasts, This is the lamp that gives strength."

prakrit: "बाउ हरि मायली वि य,तहेव एरावणो य दामिड्डी,रिहास णीलंजस,एए अणियाण मयहरया"
english: "My dear, You're a damned thing, you crook, You silly bastard. What do you mean, You stupid bitch?"

prakrit: "तत्थ सुधम्मविमाणे,एरावणवाहणो उ वजधरो,इन्दो महाणुभावो,जुइमन्तो रिद्धिसंपन्नो"
english: "There the stream is smooth, The aeroplane is weighty, The wind is great, The flame is rich with energy."

prakrit: "चत्तारि लोगपाला,जम-वरुण-कुबेर-सोममाईया,सामाणियदेवाण वि,चउरासीई सहस्साई"
english: "The observer is the lord of the people, Jam - Varuna - Kuber - Somamaya, the common god is also the patron, The four round fellow is the patron."

prakrit: "तत्थ सुधम्मसहाए,परिसाओ तिण्णि होन्ति देवाणं,समिया चन्दा नउणा,मणाभिरामा रयणचित्ता"
english: "There are three gods in a row: The good and the ugly, The virtuous, The generous, And the selfish."

prakrit: "पउमा सिवा य सुलसा,अजू सामा तहा,विहा अयला,कालिन्दी भाणू विय,सक्कस्स य अग्गमहिसीओ"
english: "Puma seva ya sulasa, aju sama taha, viha ayala, kalindi bhanu viya, sakasa ya agamasyo."

prakrit: "एकेका वरजुवई,वरजुवई,सोलसदेवीसहस्सपरिवारा,उत्तमरूवसिरोया,संकं रामेन्ति गुणनिलया"
english: "One's youth, one's virginity, One family of solitary goddesses, One tree of excellence, One arbor of sacred virtues."

prakrit: "सो ताहि सम इन्दो,भुअन्तो उत्तम विसयसोक्खं,कालं गमेइ बहुयं,विसुद्धलेसो तिनाणीओ"
english: "So be of good cheer, The world is full of good people, Time flies fast, Discontent is rife, And so are the wise."

prakrit: "सो तस्स विउलतवपुण्णसंचओ संजमेण निष्फनो,न चइज्जइ वण्णेउं,अवि वाससहस्सकोडीहिं"
english: "So he has no desire to go abroad, To waste his time with pleasure Or else he will stay abroad." ""

prakrit: "एवं अन्ने वि सुरा,जहाणुरूवं सुहं अणुहवन्ता,अच्छन्ति विमाणगया,देविसहस्सेहिं परिकिण्णा"
english: "And still others, As if by accident the pleasures of love had ceased, So did the traveler's search for the God of Love."

prakrit: "एवं बह सोहम्मे,तह ईसाणाइएसु वि कमेणं,कप्पेसु होन्ति इन्दा,सलोगपाला सदेवीया"
english: "And how pleasant it is to walk in that manner: It makes one feel good too. But what is the use of walking in that darkness? It only makes one happy."

prakrit: "दो सत्त दस य चोइस,सतरस अट्ठार वीस बावीसा,एक्कोत्तरपरिवड्डी,अहमिन्दाणं तु तेतीसं"
english: "Two, seven, ten, twenty choices, seventeen, eighteen, twenty-two, one family at a time. You're the same as me." ""

prakrit: "एयाई सागराई,कप्पाईणं सुराण परमाउं,अहमिन्दाणं नियय,हवइ इम मोहरहियाणं"
english: "Aiya is the ocean, kapain is the heavenly abode, ahmindan is the destiny, hawaii is the fire of love."

prakrit: "एयन्तरम्मि रामो,परिपुच्छइ साहवं क्यपणामो,कम्मरहियाणं भयवं १,सिद्धाणं केरिसं सोक्ख!"
english: "Here am I, Rama; I will try my best, But how can I appease her? 1 Fear the absence of activity; For what use is principle but pleasure?"

prakrit: "तो भणइ मुणिवरिन्दो,सुणेहि को ताण वण्णिउं सोक्खं,तीरइ नरो नराहिव,तह वि य संखेवओ सुणसु"
english: "So say the foolish wretch, Stress the deaf and drowsy one, Make him unhappy, And at the same time listen to the wretched one."

prakrit: "मणुयाण नं तु सोक्खं,तं अहियं हवइ नरवरिन्दाणं,चक्कीण वि अहिययरं,नराण तह भोगभूमाणं"
english: "Man, you are not to be enjoyed; you are to be savored, even by the clever."

prakrit: "वन्तरदेवाण तओ,अहियं तं जोइसाण देवाणं,तह भवणवासियाणं,गुणन्तरं कप्पवासीणं"
english: "Vantaradeva is there, I've got to give him his joy, He lives in the forest, And after him in the jungle."

prakrit: "गेवेज्ज गाण तत्तो,अहियं तु अणुतराण देवाणं,सोक्खं अणन्तयं पुण,सिद्धाण सिवालयस्थाणं"
english: "Gave birth to a song, Now you are a god of rebirth, Sokha is eternal bliss, Siddha is the abode of truth."

prakrit: "ज तिहुयणे समत्थे,सोक्खं सबाण सुरवरिन्दाणं,तं सिद्धाण न अग्घइ,कोडिसयसहस्सभागम्मि"
english: "One who is content with trifles, Who enjoys pleasure and finds pleasure in it, Fails to realize his true nature."

prakrit: "ते तत्थ अणन्तबला,अणन्तनाणी अणन्तदरिसी य,सिद्धा अणन्तसोक्वं,अणन्तकालं समणुहोन्ति"
english: "They are there for ever and ever, Watchfull and attentive, Straight and easy to understand, Always courteous."

prakrit: "संसारिणस्स नं पुण,जीवस्स सुहं तु फरिसमादीणं,तं मोहहेउगं निययमेव दुक्खस्स आमूलं"
english: "Don't talk nonsense, you fool, For the pleasures of life Are an endless stream of sorrows."

prakrit: "नोवा अभवरासी,कुधम्मधम्मेसु नइ वि तवचरणं,घोरं कुणन्ति मूढा,तह वि य सिद्धिं न पावेन्ति"
english: "A nova is impermanent, One does not meditate on dogmas, One acts foolishly, One never attains perfection."

prakrit: "जिणसासणं पमोत्त,राहव! इह अन्नसासणरयाणं,कम्मक्खओ न विजइ,धणियं पि सगुज्जमन्ताणं"
english: "The victory is supreme, Rahava! It is the victory of the hunter's food. But victory does not come to the warrior. Even a warrior's mind is dominated by wisdom." ""

prakrit: "नं अन्नाणतवस्सी,खवेइ भवसयसहस्सकोडीहिं,कम्मं तं तिहि गुत्तो,खवेइ नाणी मुहुत्तेणं"
english: "No need to worry, you fool, It's just the way things happen."

prakrit: "भविया जिणवयणरया,जे नाण-चरित्त-दसणसमग्गा,मुक्कज्झाणाईया,ते सिद्धि जन्ति धुयकम्मा"
english: "Virtuous people are those who attain purity Through renunciation, charity, and the practice of charity."

prakrit: "एवं सुणिऊण तओ,रहुत्तमो साहवं भणइ भयवं!,साहेहि जेण सत्ता,संसाराओ पमुच्चन्ति"
english: "And listen: Friend, I speak with fear! But friends, when it comes to power, Surprise the world."

prakrit: "एयन्तरे निणधम्म सयलभूसणो साहू,सम्मईसणमूलं,अणेयतवनियमसंजुत्तं"
english: "At the moment nindharma is in full swing, Sahu is making good use of it, Unhappiness has set in." ""

prakrit: "जो कुणह सदहाण,जीवाईयाण नवपयस्थाणं,लोइयसुरेसु रहिओ,सम्महिटी उ सो भणिओ"
english: "Say what you have to say :'Be happy, live your life, be happy, be peaceful '." ""

prakrit: "संफाइदोसर हिमओ,कुणइ तवं सम्मदसणोवार्य,इन्दियनिरुद्धपसर,तं हवइ सया सुचारित्तं"
english: "Tremendous frost, Kind and agreeable to touch, Like the passage of an Indian proverb, Hastened our happiness."

prakrit: "अस्थ अहिंसा सर्च,अदरपरिवज्जणं च बम्भं च,दुविहपरिग्गहविरई,ते हवइ सया सुचारित्तं"
english: "Non - violence is the essence, Detachment and violence are the two extremes. Such is the state of happiness."

prakrit: "विणो दया य दाणं,सउलं नाणं दमो तहा शाणं,कीरइ जं मोक्खट्टे,तं हवइ सया सुचारित्तं"
english: "Without mercy or charity, For what's worthless Is worthless, Such wisdom. What's free Will Must mean happiness."

prakrit: "ने एवगुणं राहव!,तं चारितं जिणेहिं परिकहियं,विवरीयं पुण लोए,तं अचरित्तं मुणेयवं"
english: "The same Rahava! The more I see of him, the more I forget him, For he is completely destroyed." ""

prakrit: "चारित्तेण इमेणं,संजुत्तो दढधिई अणन्नमणो,पुरिसो दुक्खविमोक्खें,करेइ नत्थेत्य संदेहो"
english: "All around me I see him; Suddenly he is startled, Suddenly I hear him say something. But when men are free from sorrow There is no room for doubt."

prakrit: "न दया दमो न सचं,न य इन्दियसंवरो न य समाही,न य नाणं न य झाणं,तत्थ उधम्मो को हवइ!"
english: "No mercy, no truth, no understanding of Indian beliefs, no treasure, no knowledge; that is the fate of the wicked!"

prakrit: "हिंसालियचोरिका,इत्थिरई परिगहो बहिं धम्मो,न य सो हवइ पसस्थो,न य दुक्खविमोक्खणं कुणइ"
english: "A violent girl, so devoted is not bound by dharma, Nor is she swayed by passion, Nor does she act in such a way As to relieve suffering."

prakrit: "हिंसालियचोरिक्का,इत्थिरई परिगही अविरई य,कोरइ धम्मनिमित्त,नियमेण न होइ सो धम्मो"
english: "One who practices violence, Who practices it, And persists in it, Acts for the sake of dharma; This is dharma, not law."

prakrit: "दिक्ख घेत्तण पुणो,छजीवनिकायमदणं कुणइ,धम्मच्छलेण मूढो,न य सो सिवसोग्गई लहह"
english: "Look! She embraces life again, Performs penance for the sake of living. Be foolish in the pursuit of dharma, For she is not worthy of eternal life."

prakrit: "वह-बन्ध-वेह-तालण-दाहण-छेयाई कम्मनिरयस्स,कय-विक्कयकारिस्स उ,रन्धण-पयणाइसत्तस्स"
english: "She - the bandha - the wedding - the talaan - the fire - the burning fire - The busyworker's wife, The cook - The travelling servant's son." ""

prakrit: "व्हाणुबट्टण-चन्दण-मल्ला-''भरणाइभोगतिसियस्स,एवंविहस्स मोक्खो,न कयाइ वि हवइ लिंगिस्स"
english: "Vahanubattana - sandal - garland -" "Sacrifice the empty vessels, And release the marriage bed. No one will touch the lingam" ""

prakrit: "मिच्छादसणनिरओ,अन्नाणी कुणइ जइ वि तवचरणं,तह वि य किंकरदेवो,हवइ विसुद्धप्पओगेणं"
english: "Stop acting wrongly, Anything that a woman does out of consideration Will cause embarrassment. Or, for that matter, anger; It's like being poisoned."

prakrit: "जो पुण सम्मदिही,मन्दुच्छाहो वि निणमयाभिरओ,सचट्ट भवे गन्तुं,सिंज्झइ सो नत्थि संदेहो"
english: "One who is always vigilant, who is dim-witted but fearful of the dark, Will always be vigilant; The throne is hers to keep; There is no doubt about that."

prakrit: "उच्छाहदढधिईओ,जो निययं सोलसंजमाउत्तो,दो तिण्णि भवे गन्तुं,सो लहइ सुहेण परलोयं"
english: "A man who is determined to have two or three wives goes on to have a happy marriage."

prakrit: "कोइ पुण भवियसीहो,एकभवे भाविऊण सम्मत्तं,धीरो कम्मविसोहिं,काऊण य लहइ निवाणं"
english: "One can be virtuous only once, one can be generous only once and one can never be greedy only once."

prakrit: "लढूण वि निणधम्मे,बोहिं स कुडुम्बकद्दमनिहुत्तो,इन्दियसुहसाउलओ,परिहिण्डइ सो वि संसारे"
english: "She is afraid of the poor man, Of being kicked about in the buttocks, Of enjoying the pleasures of India; She also fears the world."

prakrit: "एत्तो कयञ्जलिउडो,परिपुच्छइ राहवो मुणिवरं त,भयवं! किं भविओ हइ! केण उवारण मुचिस्स!"
english: "Such a coward, Looking down the road at the sage, You coward! What will become of me, You fool! Who will open my eyes?" ""

prakrit: "अन्तेउरेण समय,पुहई मुश्चामि उदहिपरियन्त,लच्छीहरस्स नेहं,एक न य उज्झिउं सतो"
english: "At the last moment, When I opened my eyes, I could not help laughing. There was not a trace of anger Left." ""

prakrit: "अषणनेहनलाए,दुक्खावंचाऎ विसयसरियाए,वुझन्तस्स महामुणि! हत्थालम्ब महं देहि"
english: "Dear friend, The arrows of the God of Love, Which travel through the vast expanse of grief, Are powerful! Give me the palm of your hand." ""

prakrit: "भणिओ य मुणिवरेणं,राम! इमं मुयसु सोयसंबन्ध,अवसेण भुजियवा,बलदेवसिरी तुमे विउला"
english: "Say:" "O sage, Rama! In this my affection has turned to jealousy. You have become like a bull in a bullock cart." ""

prakrit: "भोत्तर्ण उत्तमसुहं,इह मणुयभवे सुरिन्दसमसरिसं,सामण्णसुद्धकरणो,केवलनाणं पि पाविहिसि"
english: "It is a good pleasure to travel, It gives pleasure to the senses, It helps to restore balance, But you have only to pay attention."

prakrit: "एवं केवलिभणिय,'सोउं हरिसाइओ य रोमचइओ,जाओ सुविमलहियओ,वियसियसयवत्तलोयणो य पउमाभो"
english: "And only say,'Listen, you angry girl, Go - between, Vicious lover, Come - between.'"" "

prakrit: "इइ पउमचरिए रामधम्मसवणविहाणं नाम दुरुत्तरसयं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "This is the path to purity, Rama, Dharma, renunciation, and purity." ""

prakrit: "विजाहराण राया,बिभीसणो सयलभूसणं नमिउं,पुच्छइ विम्हियहियओ,माहप्पं रामदेवस्स"
english: "Praise be to the victory, Criticize the falsehood of division, Ask questions of wise men: The God of Love is Ramdev."

prakrit: "किं राहवेण सुकर्य,भयवं! समुवज्जियं परभवम्मि?,जेणेह महारिद्धी,संपत्तो लक्खणसमम्मो"
english: "What pleasure is there to be had in travel, What fear is there? Is it the supreme power? Wealth is the greatest virtue." ""

prakrit: "एयस्स पिया सीया,दण्डारण्णे ठियस्स छिद्देणं,लङ्काहिवेण हरिया,केण व अणुबन्धनोगेणं!"
english: "Aise pyaasa seeya, peeping through the fence, Lanka elephant green, Who needs a fence!" ""

prakrit: "साकलागमकुसको वि राहवो कह पुणो गओ मोहं,परजुवइसिहिपयो,कह जाओ रक्खसाहिबई"
english: "How can I satisfy your cravings? Get used to it again. Try surviving on your own: Tell that to Rakshasahibai." ""

prakrit: "विज्जाहराहिराया,दसाणणो अइबलो वि संगामे,कह लक्खणेण वहिओ!,एयं 'साहेहि मे भयवं?"
english: "Vis ̣ aha ̄ ra ̄ ya ̄, Even a cow gives milk, So how can one describe it? It's like," "My brother, am I afraid?" ""

prakrit: "अह भणिउ आढत्तो,केवलनाणी इमाण अन्नभवे,वेरं आसि विहीसण!,रावण-लच्छीहराणं तु"
english: "Say :'My lord, It's only food for the poor. Let there be no more anger! You licentious demon, Ravana!" ""

prakrit: "इह जम्बुद्दीववरे,दाहिणभरहे तहेब खेमपुरे,नयदत्त णाम सिट्ठी,तस्स सुणन्दा हवइ मजा"
english: "Oh! you stubborn girl! There's a lot of kempure on your right side. It's true, my dear. It is fun to listen to you." ""

prakrit: "पुत्तो से घणदत्तो,बीओ पुण तस्स हवइ वसुदत्तो,'विप्पो उ नन्नवक्को,ताण कुमाराण मित्तो सो"
english: "Be good to your son, be good to him, be bad to him." "Vippo, you fool, Such a young man is a friend to many."

prakrit: "तत्थेव पुरे वणिओ,सायरदत्तो पिया य रयणाभा,तस्स सुओ गुणनामो,धूया पुण गुणमई नाम"
english: "Then the whole forest will dry up, The farmer will give milk, And the farmer will drink. So is virtue a name, And charity is a name." ""

prakrit: "सा अन्नया कयाई,सायरदत्तेण गुणमई कन्ना,नोबण-गुणाणुरूवा,दिना धणदत्तनामस्स"
english: "She is generous, Kind and compassionate, Virtuous and virtuous., Dina is the name given to wealth."

prakrit: "तत्येव पुरे सेट्टी,सिरिकन्तो नाम विस्सुओ लोए,सो मग्गइ तं कन्नं,जोषण-लायण्णपरिपुणं"
english: "Tityava pura setti, sirikanto naam visuo loi, so she seeks his ear, passion - The perfection of the line."

prakrit: "धणदत्तस्स'वहरिउं,सा कन्ना तीऎ अत्थलुद्धाए,रयणप्पभाऎ दिन्ना,गूढं सिरिकन्तसेट्टिस्स"
english: "Daughter - in - law, What makes her so powerful? It's her arrows that pierce through the dark arrows of the God of Love."

prakrit: "नाऊण जन्नवको,त गुणमइसन्तियं तु वित्तन्तं,साहेइ अपरिसेस,सिग्धं वसुदतमित्तस्स"
english: "You are ignorant, So meritless are you, Friend, You impudence, Straightforwardness is the essence of wisdom."

prakrit: "तं सोऊणं रुटो,वसुदत्तो नीलवत्थपरिहाणो,वच्चइ असिवरहत्थो,रत्ति जत्थ'च्छए सेट्ठी"
english: "Root for the sun, Spring for the moon, The river for the fire, The ocean for the elephant, The chariot for the tiger."

prakrit: "दिवो उजाणत्थो,सेट्ठी आयारिओ ठिओ समुहो,पहओ य असिवरेणं,तेण वि सो मारिओ सत्त"
english: "The lamp is shining, The servants are standing by, The traveler is making trouble, And so he is the cause of death."

prakrit: "एवं ते दो वि जणा,अन्नोन्नं पहणिऊण कालगया,जाया विझापाए,कुरजया पुत्रदुकरणं"
english: "And the two of them know each other. If you wear them all the time, They last a year, If you waste them, They spoil your son."

prakrit: "भाइमरणा'दुहिमओ,धणदत्तो दुजणेहिं तं कन्नं,पडिसिद्धो य घराओ,विणिग्गओ भमइ परदेसं"
english: "Brother - in - law," "Wretched man, Give wealth to the poor, Pay no attention to it." "Destroyed houses, Dealings with stray dogs."

prakrit: "मिच्छत्तमोहियमई,सा कन्ना विहिवसेण मरिऊणं,तत्थुप्पन्ना हरिणो,जत्थ मया ते परिवसन्ति"
english: "Deceitful lover, How is it that she would rather die than suffer such a fate As this? That, my dear, is the way of the deer."

prakrit: "तीए कएण ते पुण,कुरझ्या घाइऊण अन्नोन्नं,घोराडवोऎ जाया,दाढी कम्माणुभावेणं"
english: "It's because she has a good mane, Can't bend over when she's crooked, Cannot move around, Has a weak feeling in her beard."

prakrit: "हत्थी य महिस-वसहा,पवङ्गमा दीविया पुणो हरिणा,घायन्ता अन्नोन्नं,दो वि रुरू चेव उप्पन्ना"
english: "Hasti ya mahis-vasaha, pavangama diya, harina again, ghayanta annanna, do vi ruru chevu uppanna"

prakrit: "सलिले यले य पुणरवि,पुर्व दढबद्धवेरसंपण्णा,उप्पजन्ति मरन्ति य,पायन्ता चेव अबोटं"
english: "When the streets are deserted, When the trees are empty, When people die Already, You'll have to go back again."

prakrit: "अह सो माइविओगे,धणदत्तो वसुमई परिभमन्तो,तण्हाकिलामियको,रति ससणासमं पत्तो"
english: "Ah! the way of love, That which gives wealth Circulates in the air, Like a fragrant lotus, Which bursts forth in a sweat When one is busy making love"

prakrit: "सो भणइ मुणिवरे ते,देह महं पाणियं सुतिसियस्स,सयलनगज्जीवहिया,महियं धम्मप्पिया तुम्मे"
english: "She says," "Sage, my body, my water, your breath, my life, my dharma, are pure." ""

prakrit: "तं एको भणइ मुणी,संथाविन्तो य महुरवयणेहिं,अमयं पि न पायवं,भद्द! तुमे किं पुणो सलिलं"
english: "You fool," said the sage, "Are you satisfied with your husband's return this summer? In other words, I can't find him. Foolish girl, are you really well?"

prakrit: "मच्छी-कीड-पयमा,केसा अन्न पि नं असुज्झं त,मुअन्तएण रति,तं सर्व भक्खियं नवरं"
english: "Fish - worm - Fear, Why eat any food at all? It's completely useless for a man to eat."

prakrit: "अत्यमिए दिवसयरे,जो मुआइ मुढभावदोसेणं,सो चउगइवित्थिण्णं,संसारं भमइ पुणरुतं"
english: "In a very short period of time, The man who died was haunted by delusions of love, He was completely awoken, The world went round and round Again."

prakrit: "लिङ्गी व अलिङ्गी वा,नो भुइ सबरीसु रसगिद्धो,सो न य सोग्गइगमणं,पावइ अचरित्तदोसेणं"
english: "There is no penis or penis, There are no other juices in the world, So don't be embarrassed: This is the wrong path."

prakrit: "जे सबरीसु पुरिसा,भुञ्जन्तिह सीलसनमविहूणा,महु-मज-मसनिरया,ते जन्ति मया महानरयं"
english: "A man who has everything, A wife who is full of fragrance, A lover who is busy making love, Is as great as I am."

prakrit: "हीणकुलसंभवा वि हु,पुरिसा उच्छन्नदार-धण-सयणा,परपेसणाणुकारी,जे भुत्ता रयणिसमयम्मि"
