english: "I am the same as a hunter; men are taller, more powerful, more discerning; women are like ghosts in a dream."

prakrit: "करचरणफुट्टकेसा,बीभच्छा दूह्वा दरिदा य,तण-दारुजीविया ते,जेहि य भुतं वियालम्मि"
english: "A crooked man, A miser, A poor woman, A grass - grown man, Is like a demon possessed by poison."

prakrit: "जे पुण जिणवरधम्म,घेत्तु' महु-मंस-मज्जविरई च,न कुणन्ति राइभत्तं,ते हुन्ति सुरा महिड्डीया"
english: "One who does not practice renunciation, who is completely devoid of jinavar dharma, attains mahu, manas, and marrow, does not master raibhattam; this is the greatness of Sura."

prakrit: "ते तत्थ वरविमाणे,देवीसयपरिमिया विसयसोक्खं,मुंजन्ति दोहकालं,अच्छरसुग्गीयमाहप्पा"
english: "Te Tattha varavimane, devisaparimiya visayasokkha, munjanti doha kalam, pratyaksugyamahappa."

prakrit: "चइऊण इहायाया,नरवहवंसेसु खायकित्तीसु,उवभुजिऊण सोक्खें,पुणरवि पावन्ति सुरसरिस"
english: "By choosing them You give birth, By breeding them for food You deprive them of their nourishment, By making them swell up again."

prakrit: "पुणरवि जिणवरधम्मे,बोहिं लहिऊण गहियवय-नियमा,काऊण तवमुयारं,पाविति सिवालयं वीरा"
english: "In rebirth, Jina Varadharama, With bow and arrow - The rules of chastity, With cow - dung cakes, Are immutable."

prakrit: "अइआउरेण वि तुमे,भद्द! वियाले न चेव भोत्तम,मंसं पि वज्जियवं,आमूलं सबदुक्खाणं"
english: "Though you are ill, you are wicked! In my heart I am not so sure What to do next. Even my mind is wasted: It is the root of all suffering."

prakrit: "तं साहवस्स क्यण,सुणिऊणं सावओ तओ जाओ,कालगओ उक्वनो,सोहम्मे सिरिषरो देवो"
english: "How can you help it? Listen, burn, go away, Wait a moment, For the God of Happiness will come." ""

prakrit: "सो हार-कडय-कुण्डल-मउडालंकारभूसियसरीरो,सुरगणियामज्झगओ,भुजइ भोगे सुरिन्दो छ"
english: "He is wearing a garland, a bracelet, a shawl, Ornament and other ornaments: His arms are covered with gooseflesh." ""

prakrit: "अह सो चुओ समाणो,महापुरे धारिणीऎ मेरूणं,'सेट्टीण तओ जाओ,जियपउमरुद ति नामेणं"
english: "Ah, that's just the way it is, Your Majesty, My lovely wife," he said, "There you go, my dear. The only thing I know is that your husband is dead."

prakrit: "तस्स पुरस्साहिबई,छत्तच्छाउ ति नाम नरवसभो,भज्जा से सिरिकन्ता,सिरि सा रूवसारेणं"
english: "Praise be to the man, Your name is Chhatrapati, You are a man of many talents, You scold him with slander, You rob him of his true nature."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाई,गोष्टुं गच्छन्तएण जरयसभो,दिट्ठो पउमरुईणं,निच्चेट्ठो महियलत्यो सो"
english: "Oh! what a strange thing it is To do With other people's business, To stare at a dead woman, To look at a swarm of bees."

prakrit: "अह सो तुरनमाओ,ओयरिउं तस्स देइ कारुणिओ,पञ्चनमोक्कारमिणं,मुयह सरीरं तओ जीवो"
english: "Oh! what a cruel man he is, O wretched man, Who gives his life for my pleasure And leaves no stone unturned."

prakrit: "सो तस्स पहावेणे,सिरिकन्ताए य कुच्छिसंभूओ,छत्तच्छायस्स सुओ,बसहो वसहद्धओ नाम"
english: "So watch out for him, you stingy bitch, You sleep in the shade of the roof, You're just a bunch of bastards."

prakrit: "अह सो कुमारलोलं,अणुहवमाणो गओ तमुद्देसं,जत्थ मओ जरवसभो,जाओ जाईसरो ताहे"
english: "Oh! what a silly boy! Gone are those days when one could only make love Wherever one wanted to be, There he went."

prakrit: "सी-उण्ह-छुहा-तण्हा-बन्धण-वहणाइयं वसहदुक्खं,सुमरइ तं च कुमारो,पञ्चनमोकारदायारं"
english: "See - Through - Touched - Thighs - Ties - Vows - Sufferings - Behold the son of a woman Who has reached the pinnacle of perfection."

prakrit: "उप्पनबोहिलाभो,कारावेऊण निणहरं तुङ्गं,ठावेइ तत्थ बालो,णियअणुहुयचित्तियं पडयं"
english: "Foolish girl, The moment you are thrown into prison You will find that your heart is bursting at the seams."

prakrit: "भणइ य निययमणुस्सा,इमस्स चित्तस्स जो उ परमत्थं,जणिहिइ निच्छएणं,त मज्झ कहिज्जह तुरन्ता"
english: "If I were to say that you are reasonable, If you meant what you said, You'd better tell me right away."

prakrit: "अह वन्दणाहिलासी,पउमरुई तं जिणालयं पत्तो,अभिवन्दिऊण पेच्छइ,तं चित्तपडं विविहवष्णं"
english: "Oh! lover of bananas, The landowner has given him a victory address. When he greets him He is seen with wide - eyed eyes And his mind is full of different views."

prakrit: "जाव य निबद्धदिट्ठी,तं पउमरुई निएइ चित्तपडं,ताव पुरिसेहि गन्तुं,सिर्ट चिय रायपुत्तस्स"
english: "As soon as I set eyes on her, She takes them all in her stride, Then leaves on her own, Like a daughter in law's bed." ""

prakrit: "सो मत्तगयारूढो,तं निणभवणं गओ महिड्डीओ,ओयरिय गयवराओ,पउमरुई पणमइ पहट्टो"
english: "So you inebriated fool, Go and rescue her. The poor cowherd is gone, And the girl's husband is abroad." ""

prakrit: "चलणे निवडमाणं,रायसुर्य वारिऊण पउमरुई,साहेह निरवसेस,तं गोदुखं बहुकिलेसं"
english: "It is a matter of choosing the path, The path is smooth, The husband is busy making ends meet, My lord, It has been a long journey."

prakrit: "तो भणइ रायपुत्तो,सो हं वसहो तुह प्पसाएणं,जाओ नरवइपुत्तो,पत्तो य महागुणं रजं"
english: "So you say, Rayputta; I will settle for you, my dear. Go, you silly boy; The king is a man of great merit."

prakrit: "तं चिय न कुणइ माया,नेय पिया 'नेव बन्धवा सके,न कुणइ सुप्पसनो,समाहिमरणस्स दायारो"
english: "No one can stop him, Not even Maya, not even the lover of his lover, Not a dreamer of his dreams, Not the doer of death."

prakrit: "अह भणइ तं कुमारी,भुञ्जसु रज इमं निरबसेस,पउमरुद! निच्छएणं,मज्झ वि आणं तुम देन्तो"
english: "Oh! you fool, My daughter - in - law! Have a carefree moment, sweetheart! Please, my dear, give me some milk too." ""

prakrit: "एवं ते दो वि जणा,परमिडिया सुसावया बाया,देवगुरुपूयणरया,उत्तमसम्मत्तदढभावा"
english: "And they both know, Parmidia, the pleasurable boy, That, being devoted to the gods, They have a good deal in common."

prakrit: "वसहद्धओ कयाई,समाहिबहुलं च पाविउं मरणं,उववनो ईसाणे,देवो दिषेण सवेणं"
english: "The elephant is helpless, The hunter is exhausted, Death has overtaken him, He is alone, The sight of a god is enough."

prakrit: "पउमरुई वि समाहीमरणं लळूण सुचरियगुणेणं,तत्थेव' य ईसाणे,महिड्डिओ सुरवरो जाओ"
english: "Proud wife, Allow yourself to be captivated By the pleasant qualities then apparent In your husband's presence." ""

prakrit: "तं अमरपवरसोलं,भोत्तण चिरं तओ चुयसमाणो,मेरुस्स अवरभाए,वेयड्डे पथए रम्मे"
english: "May he attain immortality, May his soul rest in peace, May he blossom again And again, May the path be smooth." ""

prakrit: "नयरे नन्दावते,कणयाभाकुच्छिसंभवो नाओ,नन्दीसरस्स पुत्तो,नयणाणन्दो ति नामेणं"
english: "Nayare Nandavate, kanyabhabhaku kuchsimbhavo nao, son of Nandisarasa, Nayanaanando is her name."

prakrit: "भोत्तण खेयरिद्धि,पबजमुवागओ य निग्गन्थो,चरिय तवं कालगओ,माहिन्दे सुरवरो जाओ"
english: "When the wind blows, It's raining heavily, When it rains it pours, And when it rains, It pours heavily."

prakrit: "पश्चिन्दियाभिरामे,तत्थ वि भोगे कमेण भोत्तणं,चइओ खेमपुरीए,पुबविदेहे सुरम्माए"
english: "In the wilderness of West India, There too the arrows of the God of Love Flicker." ""

prakrit: "सो विउलवाहणसुओ,जाओ पउमावईऎ देवीए,सिरिचन्दो त्ति कुमारो,जोबण-लायण्ण-गुणपुष्णो"
english: "So go, you foolish girl, Go, take care of your husband, God of Love, For Sirichand is a man of many talents."

prakrit: "कन्ताहिं परिमिओ सो,भुञ्जन्तो उत्तम बिसयसोक्रवं,न य जाणइ वच्चन्तं,कालं दोगुन्दुओ चेव"
english: "Aunt, you're right; roasting is the most virtuous pastime. If you don't know how long it will take, Time will tell."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया मुणिन्दो,समाहिगुत्तो ससङ्घपरिवारो,पुहई च विहरमाणो,तं चेव 'पुरि समणुपत्तो"
english: "Ah! sighs the elder," "The whole family gathers together." "Our daughter - in - law goes on a journey."

prakrit: "सोऊण मुणिवरं तं,उजाणे आगयं पुहइवालो,वच्चा तस्स सयासं,नरवइचक्केण समसहिओ"
english: "A sage is as good as dead, A firefighter is as powerful as alive, A traveler is as clever as a traveler, A man suffering from menopause is more difficult to deal with."

prakrit: "दट्टण साहवं तं,अयइण्णो गयवराओ सिरिचन्दो,पणमइ पहट्टमणसो,समाहिगुत्तं सपरिवारो"
english: "It's the traveler's business, The tourist's, The travelers ', The travelers ', And the travelers'That take the whole family for granted."

prakrit: "कयसंथवो निविट्ठो,दिन्नासीसो समं नरिन्देहिं,राया पुच्छइ धर्म,कहेइ साहू वि संखेवं"
english: "How can one calm down, When one is busy passing the day And the other is busy making ends meet?" asks Raya, "Dharma tells us." Even the hunter's son speaks nonsense. "

prakrit: "जीवो अणाइकालं,हिण्डन्तो बहुविहासु बोणीसु,दुक्खेहिं माणुसतं,पावइ कम्माणुभावेणं"
english: "The soul has infinite duration, One can sow many seeds at a time, All human beings are suffering, But this is the nature of the soul."

prakrit: "पत्तो वि माणुसतं,विसयसुहासायलोलुओ मूढो,सकलत्तनेहनडिओ,न कुणइ निणदेसियं धर्म"
english: "Even the leaf is human, Silly people with big smiles, Hands clenched with wisdom, No one condemns this religion."

prakrit: "इन्दधणु-फेण-मुम्बुय-संझासरिसोवमे मणुयजम्मे,जो न कुणइ जिणधर्म,सो हु मओ वचए नरय"
english: "The man who does not practice righteousness, Who is not addicted to pleasures of love, Is a mortal man," he said.

prakrit: "होइ महावेयणियं,नरए हण-दहण-छिन्दणाईयं,जीवस्स सुइरकाल,निमिस पि अलद्धसुहसायं"
english: "May there be great joys, may there be no more burning or burning of wealth, May there ever be more happiness for all beings."

prakrit: "तिरियाण दमण-बन्धण-साडण-तण्हा-छुहाइयं दुक्खं,उप्पज्जद्द मणुयाण वि,बहुरोगविओगसोगकर्य"
english: "Stupid man, Worried at being betrayed, Angry at having to suffer humiliation, Tired of being bullied and bullied."

prakrit: "भोत्तण वि मुरलोए,विसयसुह उत्तम चवणकाले,अणुहवइ महादुक्खें,जोवो संसारवासत्थो"
english: "Though broken, They fade away, In a season of abundant pleasures And great sorrows They cease to exist, Like the inhabitants of the world."

prakrit: "जह इन्धणेसु अग्गी,न य तिप्पइ न य जलेमु वि समुद्दो,तह जीवो न य तिप्पइ,विउलेसु वि कामभोगेसु"
english: "As the fire burns with fuel, So neither does it boil nor the water boil with the sea." "The soul does not boil, So do you, fool, Even if you want to have sex."

prakrit: "बो पयरसुरसुहेसु वि,न य तित्ति उवगओ खलो जीवो,सो कह तिप्पइ इण्हि,माणुसभोगेसु तुच्छेसु"
english: "She is so pleasant to look at, But if she does not look at you With such longing, How can she turn your back on you? You look so much like a human being."

prakrit: "सम्हा नाऊण इम,'सुमिणसम अर्धवं चलं जीयं,नरवइ! करेहि धर्म,जिणविहियं दुक्खमोक्खट्टे"
english: "Name me, Suminasum ardhavum chalaam jeeva, Naravai! Do what is right, For victory lies in the face of suffering." ""

prakrit: "सायार-निरायार,धर्म निणदेसियं विउपसत्थं,सायारं गिहवासी,कुणन्ति साहू निरायारं"
english: "Sayar - nirayar, Dharma - nirdesiyam - vipusasthaam, sayaram - gehwasi, kunanti - sahū -nirayāram."

prakrit: "हिंसा-'लिय-चोरिका-परदार-परिग्गहस्स य नियत्ती,एयाई सावयाणं,अणुक्याई तु भणियाई"
english: "Violence -" "Liye - Chorika - Pardar - Circumstance is destiny," "Such is the savagery of marriage."

prakrit: "एयाई चेव पुणो,महबयाई हवन्ति समणाणं,बहुपज्जयाई नरवइ!,संसारसमुद्दतरणाई"
english: "Always renewing oneself, The great wife makes vows, The many - faced one becomes a man - beater!, The ocean returns." ""

prakrit: "सावयधम्म काऊण निच्छिओ लहइ सुरवरमहिड्डि,समणो पुण धोरतवो,पावइ सिद्धिं न संदेहो"
english: "Savayadharma is only to be practiced by those who practice virtue, not those who practise virtue. Therefore, do not doubt the perfection of virtue."

prakrit: "दुविहो वि तुज्झ सिट्ठो,धम्मो अणुओ नहेव उक्कोसो,एयाणं एकयर,गेण्हसु य ससत्तिनोगेणं"
english: "Both are yours to bear; the dharma cannot pierce you, only you. Or else live together: This is the path to eternal bliss."

prakrit: "तं मुणिवरस्स वयणं,सिरिचन्दो निसुणिऊण परितुट्टो,तो देह निययरजं,सुयस्स घिइकन्तनामस्स"
english: "That sage's speech, That Sirichandas sigh, But the body is immovable, Is nothing to be ashamed of."

prakrit: "मोजण पणइणिजणं,रुयमाणं महुरमञ्जलपलावं,सिरिचन्दो पबइओ,पासम्मि समाहिगुत्तस्स"
english: "Counting the beads, Weeping lotuses, Sweating lotus flowers, The passage of the moon Is a struggle."

prakrit: "उत्तमवयसंजुत्तो,तिजोगधारी विसुद्धसम्मत्तो,चारित्त-नाण-दसण-तव-नियमविभूसियसरीरो"
english: "A man of good years, Strong and able-bodied, Well versed in knowledge, Well-versed in conduct, Virtuous and virtuous."

prakrit: "सज्झाय-शाणनिरओ,निइन्दिओ समिइ गुचिसंजुत्तो,सत्तभयविप्पमुको,सए वि देहे निरवक्खो"
english: "Be careful not to fall prey to falsehoods, be suspicious of gossip, be fearful of the dark, for even in this body there is no cause for alarm."

prakrit: "छट्ट-'टमाइएहिं,जेमन्तो मासखमणजोगेहिं,विहरइ मुणी महप्पा,कुणमाणो बजरं कर्म"
english: "Chhath -" "Bees, As the months grow long, Vihari sage, Great God, Virtuous is the virtue of good karma." ""

prakrit: "एवं भावियकरणो,सिरिचन्दो दढसमाहिसंजुत्तो,कालाओ उववनो,इन्दो सो बम्भलोगम्मि"
english: "And predictable! When the moon is full of clouds, When the sky is dark, And when it is dim, It looks like a bomb."

prakrit: "तस्थ विमाणे परमे,चूडामणिमउडकुण्डलाभरणो,'सिरि-कित्तिलच्छिनिलओ,निदाहरविसन्निभसरीरो"
english: "There is a God in that plane, Trembling wood - apple - eyed woman, Visibly distracted by sleep"

prakrit: "मणनयणहारिणीहिं,देवीहिं परिमिओ महिड्डीओ,भुइ विसयमुह सो,सुराहिवो बम्भलोगत्थो"
english: "Lovely women, Dearest ladies, The earth is full of wonders, And the arrows of the God of Love travel through it."

prakrit: "एवं सो धणदत्तो,तुझ बिहीसण! कमेण परिकहिओ,संपइ साहेमि फुड,पायं वसुदत्तसेट्ठीणं"
english: "And he is the wealth giver, Thy blessing! Forget about work, dear friend, I have to gather food, To gather water for my feet." ""

prakrit: "नयरे मिणालकुण्डे,परिवसइ नराहिवो विजयसेणो,नामेण रयणचूला,तस्स गुणालंकिया भज्जा"
english: "Nayare Meenalkunde, parivasa narahivo vijaya seno, naamen rayanachula, tasa guna lankiya bhajja."

prakrit: "पुत्तो य वज्जकंचू,तस्स वि महिला पिया उ हेमवई,तीए सो सिरिकन्तो,जाओ पुत्तो अह सयंभू"
english: "My son, you fool, That woman is so thirsty And so jealous. Go, my son, stay the course." ""

prakrit: "निणसासणाणुरत्तो,पुरोहिओ तस्स होइ सिरिभूई,तस्स वि गुणाणुरूवा,सरस्सई नाम वरमहिला"
english: "The sage says:" "Be nice to her, be polite to her; she also shows courtesy." "First of all, a virtuous woman is the name of a sage."

prakrit: "ना आसि गुणमई सा,भमिउं नाणाविहासु नोणीसु,इत्थी सकम्मनडिया,उप्पन्ना गयवहू रण्णे"
english: "There is no merit in this, my poor girl, Don't be so naïve: It's only the good wife Who can do it All."

prakrit: "मन्दाइणीऎ पड़ए,तीऎ निमग्गाए नीयसेसाए,अह देइ कण्णजावं,तरङ्गवेगो गयणगामी"
english: "The Mandainese fell, She sank, She languished, Eyes wide open. The speed of a wave Makes her sing." ""

prakrit: "ततो सा कालगया,सरस्सईकुच्छिसंभवा जाया,वेगवई वरकन्ना,दुहिया सिरिभूइविप्पस्स"
english: "So she is past her prime, Like a bunch of mustard seeds dropped from a mustard seed, Like wedding vows, Like two women bowing before the God of Love."

prakrit: "भह सा कयाइ गेहे,साहु भिक्खागय उवहसन्ती,पियरेण वारिया निच्छएण तो साविया जाया"
english: "Oh! what a cruel man he is, A cowardly hermit, A man so devoted to love That he has lost his temper."

prakrit: "अइरूविणीऎ तीऎ,करण उक्कण्ठिया पुहइपाला,नाया मयणावस्था,सबे वि सयभुमादीया"
english: "You stupid girl, Don't be so naïve, It's all over the place." ""

prakrit: "मह वि य कुबेरसरिसो,मिच्छादिट्टी नरो हवइ लोए,तह वि य तस्स कुमारी,न देमि तो भणइ सिरिभूई"
english: "Even I am a cruel man, A wicked man is welcome, And so is a virgin. But if I do not, she will be condemned."

prakrit: "रुहो सबभुराया,सिरिभूई मारिऊण वेगवई,आयाइ रयणीए,पुणो वि अवग्र̥हह रुयन्ती"
english: "Ruho sab bhuraya, siribhui mareun vegavai, aayi raaniye, Puno vi avagraha: Oh, the wretched cryer!"

prakrit: "कलुणाई बिलबमाणी,नेच्छन्ती चेव सबलकारेणं,रमिया वेगबई सा,सयंभुणा मयणमटेणं"
english: "A sulking mother - in - law, Who does not want to be touched by a bad omen, Is always cheerful, Always ready to make love"

prakrit: "रुवा भणइ तमो सा,पियरं वहिऊण जं तुमे रमिया,उप्पजेज वहत्थे,पुरिसाहम! तुज्झ परलोए"
english: "Tears flow from your eyes, Love flows from what you hold dear, Love overflows, Friendship flows from you!"

prakrit: "अरिकन्ताऎ सयासे,वेगवई दिक्खिया समियपावा,जाया संवेगमणा,कुणइ तवं बारसवियप्पं"
english: "Steady as an arrow, able to see quickly and with the eye of the seer, Well-trained as one goes, Strong as one's bow."

prakrit: "घोरं तवोविहाणं,काऊण मया समाहिणा तत्तो,बम्भविमाणे,देवी नाया अइललियरूवा सा"
english: "Trembling flame, Which did not quench my thirst, Like a violent wind, Is not the goddess of thunder, Nor is it the lily."

prakrit: "मिच्छाभावियकरणो,तत्थ सयभू वि कालधम्मेणं,संजुत्तो परिहिण्डइ,नरय-तिरिक्खासु जोणीसु"
english: "Wrong impression, Then the whole earth is full of darkness, Time is passing by, Always on the lookout for men - Look at these young men!"

prakrit: "कम्मस्स उवसमेणं,जाओ उ कुसद्धयस्स विपस्स,पुत्तो सावित्तीए,पभासकुन्दो ति नामेणं"
english: "Karma is restless, go - between, Wretched man and wicked man, My son, my daughter - in - law; The pond of prosperity is her name."

prakrit: "अह सो पभासकुन्दो,मुणिस्स पासम्मि विजयसेणस्स,निग्गन्थो पबइओ,परिचत्तपरिम्गहारम्भो"
english: "Ah! the plowman's son, The victory army is passing by in silence. Get out of the way! It's like climbing a steep hill." ""

prakrit: "रइरागरोसरहिओ,बहुगुणधारी जिइन्दिओ धीरो,छटु-'ट्ठम-दसमाइसु,भुअन्तो कुणइ तबकम्मं"
english: "Long live the God of Love, Long live those who have many virtues." "Sixth - the tenth month."

prakrit: "एवं तवोधरो सो,सम्मेयं वन्दणाऎ वच्चन्तो,कणगप्पहस्स इड्डी,पेच्छइ विजाहरिन्दस्स"
english: "And behold, as he walks along The solemn vows are repeated:" "Iddie, my lovely husband, Looks down the road to victory." ""

prakrit: "अह सो कुणइ नियाणं,होउ महं ताव सिद्धिसोक्खेणं,भुञ्जामि खेयरिद्धि,तवस्स जइ अस्थि माहप्पं"
english: "Oh! what a cruel man he is, Let me straighten him out, I beg of you, It's as if he had a heart attack."

prakrit: "पेच्छह भो! मूढत्तं,मुणीण सनियाणदूसियतवेणं,रयणं तु पुहइमोल्लं,दिन्नं चिय सागमुट्ठोए"
english: "Look! Stupidity, silly girl, You fool, You stupid girl, Don't give a damn. It's just the way things are." ""

prakrit: "छेतण य कप्पूरं,कुणइ वई कोदवस्स सो मूढो,आचुण्णिऊण रयणं,अविसेसो गेहए दोरं"
english: "A rake is a coward, A coward is foolish when he misbehaves, A farmer is greedy when he makes love, And a weasel is a poor man's rope."

prakrit: "दहिऊण य गोसीस,गेहइ छारं तु सो अबुद्धीओ,जो चरिय तवं घोरं,मरइ य सनियाणमरणेणं"
english: "You're right, you coward, But you fool, Who cares how much you stink? It's like dying in a sauna."

prakrit: "अह सो नियाणदूसियहियओ महयं पि करिय तवचरणं,कालगओ उववन्नो,देवो उ सणंकुमारम्मि"
english: "Oh! please, my poor girl, Pay attention to what I have to say: It's about time you said yes. God, you shameless girl!"

prakrit: "तत्तो चुओ समाणो,जाओ चिय केकसीऎ गब्भम्मि,रयणासवस्स पुत्तो,विक्खाओ रावणो नाम"
english: "There you are, doting mother - in - law, Going to and fro, Some gooseflesh in your womb, Rayanasa - nourished son: Problem - Ravana's name." ""

prakrit: "नं एरिसी अवस्था,हवइ मुणोणं पि दूमियमणाणं,सेसाण किं च भण्णइ,वय-गुण-तव-सोलरहियाणं"
english: "This is not the state of affairs; it is only sighing, But distressed consciousness. What can one say to anger? It is the nature of the soul."

prakrit: "बम्भिन्दो वि य चविउ,जाओ अवराइयाऎ देवीए,दसरहनिवस्स पुत्तो,रामो तेलोकविक्खाओ"
english: "Taste the bomb dropped on you, Go and worship other gods, my son, Who has passed the tenth month: Lord Ram has already been anointed with oil."

prakrit: "जो सो नयदत्तसुओ,धणदत्तो आसि बम्मलोगवई,सो हु इमो पउमाभो,बलदेवसिरिं समणुपत्तो"
english: "One who does not give charity, who is merely a go - between, is an imbecile; I, too, bow before a powerful god."

prakrit: "वसुदत्तो वि य जो सो,सिरिभूई आसि बम्भणो तइया,सो लक्षणो' य नाओ,संपइ णारायणो एसो"
english: "Even Vasudeva, Who was born deaf, Has attained enlightenment, Has acquired extraordinary qualities, Is a consummate hero"

prakrit: "सिरिकन्तो य सयम्भू,कमेण जाओ पहासकुन्दो सो,विज्जाहराण राया,जाओ लाहिवो सूरो"
english: "Sirikanto ya samyambhu, Kamen jao pahaskundo so, vijjaharana raya, jao lahivo surro."

prakrit: "सा गुणमई कमेणं,सिरिभूइपुरोहियस्स वेगवई,दुहिया बम्भविमाणे,देवी इह बट्टए सीया"
english: "She is full of virtuous qualities, Straightforward and elegant, Like a two - wheeled airship. The goddess is only known through her waist."

prakrit: "जो आसि गुणमईए,सहोयरो गुणधरो ति नामेणं,सो जणयरायपुत्तो,जाओ भामण्डलो एसो"
english: "One who comes should be called virtuous, One who associates virtues should be named virtuous. So, son of nature, Go to the village hall." ""

prakrit: "जो अन्नवकविप्पो,सो हु बिहीसण! तुम समुप्पन्नो,वसहद्धओ वि जाओ,सुम्गीवो वाणराहिवई"
english: "The one who spoils the food, that is what I will eat! You are wrong, even the poor go - between. A handsome woman has no voice." ""

prakrit: "एए सबे वि पुरा,आसि निरन्तरसिणेहसंबन्धा,रामस्स तेण नेह,वहन्ति निययं च अणुकूला"
english: "Oh! everything is complete, There is a constant stream of love, Rama is not bound by it, Destiny is bound to it."

prakrit: "एतो बिहीसणो पुण,परिपुच्छइ सयलभूसणं नमिउं,वालिस्स पुवजणिय,कहेहि भयवं! भवसमूह"
english: "Such a cruel man, I beg of you, Don't try to cover your face with your shawl, You silly fool, Such a coward!"

prakrit: "निसुणसु बिहीसण तुर्म,एको परिहिण्डिऊण संसारं,जीवो कम्मवसेणं,दण्डारण्णे मओ जाओ"
english: "Be restless, be vigilant, unite and conquer the world; the soul must be destroyed by karma."

prakrit: "साहु सज्झायत,सुणिऊणं कालधम्मसंजुत्तो,उप्पन्नो एरवए,मघदत्तो नाम धणवन्तो"
english: "Be patient, listen; With time you will come to terms; First of all, forgive me, For I am worthy of your name."

prakrit: "तस्स पिया विहियक्खो,सुसावओ सिवमई हवइ माया,मघदत्तस्स वि जाया,जिणवरधम्मे मई विउला"
english: "There is love, There is jealousy, Love prevails, Love vanishes, Even in the darkest hour There is no end to it."

prakrit: "पश्चाणुषयधारी,मओ य सो सुरवरो समुप्पन्नो,वरहार-कुण्डलधरो,निदाहरक्सिन्निहसरीरो"
english: "The one with the hind limbs, The mother - in - law, Is completely devoid of senses, Like the doe with the plowman's bow, Is entirely dependent on the axe of sleep."

prakrit: "चइओ पुषविदेहे,गामे विजयावई' आसन्ने,अह मत्तकोइलरवे,कंतासोगो तहिं राया"
english: "Cheo, you fool, There must be a victor in the village. Ah, sweet quail. Anyway, It's raining there." ""

prakrit: "तस्स रयणावईए,भजाए कुच्छिसंभवो जाओ,नामेण सुप्पभो सो,रज्जं भोत्तूण पदइओ"
english: "There must be something wrong with him. Come on, you angry bitch. Sleep in my name. Don't let the rope slip away." ""

prakrit: "चरिय तवं कालगओ,सबढे सुरवरो समुप्पन्नो,तत्तो चुओ वि जाओ,वाली आइच्चरयपुत्तो"
english: "The passage of time is like this: Everything goes smoothly, Everyone is satisfied, So too is silence; It is the son of nature that prevails."

prakrit: "काऊण विरोहं नो,तइया सह रावणेण संविग्गो,पबइओ कहलासे,कुणइ तवं धीरगम्भीरो"
english: "I have nothing against you, Ravana; go and talk to me," said the wife, "But be patient as I am."

prakrit: "सवायरेण तइया,उद्धरिओ रावणेण कालासो,अगुहएण सो पुण,नीओ वाली ण संखोह"
english: "Mother - in - law! Rescue Ravana from the clutches of time. Punishment awaits him. No one can stop him." ""

prakrit: "शाणाणलेण दहिउँ,निस्सेस कम्मकयवर वाली,संपत्तो परमपर्य,अजरामरनीरयं ठाणं"
english: "Righteousness prevails because of wisdom, Necessity prevails over action, Wealth is supreme, The stream of immortality prevails."

prakrit: "एवं अनोमवह,कुणमाणा 'पुबबद्धदढवेरा,संसारे परिभमिया,दोष्णि वि वसुदत्त-सिरिकन्ता"
english: "And anomie, virtue boundless, encompassing the whole world; even guilt is a waste - Sirikanta."

prakrit: "जेणं सा वेगवई,आसि सयंभुस्स वल्लहा तेणं,अणुबन्धेण'वहरिण,सीया वि हु रक्खसिन्देणं"
english: "Because she is affectionate, Because she loves you, Because you protect her, And because you love her, You protect her."

prakrit: "जो वि य सो सिरिभूई,वेगवईए कए सयंभूणा,वहिओ धम्मफलेणं,देवो नाओ विमाणम्मि"
english: "Whoever wishes may bow down, Who wishes to fly, May he bear fruit in Dharma. For a god is not an aeroplane."

prakrit: "चहउँ पइटनयरे,पुणवसू खेयराहिवो जाओ,महिलाहेउ सोयं,करिय नियाणं च पबइओ"
english: "Well done ladies, Go away for a while, Rest assured, The women are asleep, And the crows have already left."

prakrit: "काऊण तवं घोर,सर्णकुमारे सुरो समुप्पन्नो,चइओ सोमित्तिसुओ,जाओ वि हु लक्खणो एसो"
english: "Whom are you looking out for? Your voice is hoarse, Your face is pale, Your lips are sunken, You'd better stay calm. Yet this is the characteristic trait of all women."

prakrit: "सत्तू जेण सयंभू,सिरिभूइपुरोहियस्स आसि पुरा,तेण इह मारिओ सो,दहवयणो लच्छिनिलएणं"
english: "If Sattu's wife comes home empty handed, If he returns empty handed He will kill her, If she does not return safe he will be burnt at the stake."

prakrit: "जो जेण हमओ पुवं,सो तेण वहिज्जए. न संदेहो,एसा ठिई बिहोसण,संसारस्थाण जीवाणं"
english: "Whatever we ask for, let it be with us. No doubt about it; this is the way of life in the world." ""

prakrit: "एवं सोऊण इम,जीवाणं पुबवेरसंबन्धं,तम्हा परिहरह सया,वेरं सबे वि दूरेणं"
english: "And sleep, my dear, Life is relative to old age, Your absence is permanent; separation, too, is something far away."

prakrit: "वयणेण वि* उबेओ,न य कायबो परम्स पीडयरो,'सीयाऎ नह'णुभूओ,महाववाओ वयणहेऊ"
english: "Vayanon bhi * ube, ya kayabo paramas pathiryo," "No need to be angry, Vayanayyo is a big deal." ""

prakrit: "मण्डलियाउज्जाणे,सुदरिसणो आगओ मुणिवरिन्दो,दिट्टो य वन्दिओ सो,सम्मदिट्ठीण लोएणं"
english: "At the sound of the mandala, The good seer opens the fire, And sighs loudly. But when he speaks, It is as if he has seen the world."

prakrit: "साहुं पलोइउं सा,वेगवई कहइ सयललोयस्स,एसो उज्जाणत्यो,महिलाऎ सम मए दिट्टो"
english: "She will follow you, You won't see each other again, You'll be surprised: It's the same woman As I am."

prakrit: "तत्तो गामजणेणं,अणायरो मुणिवरस्स आढत्तो,तेण वि य को सिग्धं,अभिग्गहो धीरपुरिसेणं"
english: "There the village headman, The barber, A man of modest means, Has proved his worth. Behold, the army of the patient." ""

prakrit: "नइ मज्झ इमो दोसो,फिट्टिहिइ असण्णिदुजणनिउत्तो,तो होही आहारो,भणियं चिय एव साहूणं"
english: "No, I don't blame you, you fool, You stupid fool, So eat only what's right and avoid everything else."

prakrit: "तो वेगवईऎ मुह,सूर्ण चिय देवयानिओगेणं,भणइ तओ सा अलियं,तुम्हाण मए समक्खायं"
english: "So you fool, Your face is pale, Your cheeks pale, Like the lips of a god. You fool, You lie to me."

prakrit: "तत्तो सो गामनणो,परितुद्रो मुणिवरस्स अहिययरं,सम्माणपीइपमुहो,जाओ गुणगहणतत्तिलो"
english: "There he is, Headman of the village, Looking out for the stranger, Bowing low at the mere mention of his name." ""

prakrit: "नं दाऊण'ववाओ,विसोहिओ मुणिवरस्स कन्नाऎ,तेण इमाए विसोही,नाया वि हु जणयतणयाए"
english: "You fool, Don't be so naïve: You stupid fool, So do not be so stupid As to cause embarrassment to others."

prakrit: "दिवो सुओ व दोसो,परस न कयाइ सो कहेयबो,जिणधम्माहिरएणं,पुरिसेणं महिलियाए वा"
english: "The lamp is good and is to be blamed, But tell me, I suppose, Not for nothing do women suffer the same as men."

prakrit: "रागेण व दोसेण व,जो दोसं जणवयस्स भासेइ,सो हिण्डद्द संसारे,दुक्खसहस्साई अणुहुन्तो"
english: "One who speaks ill of anger and hatred, Who speaks evil of old age, Is like one who experiences sorrow in this world."

prakrit: "तं मुणिवरस्स वयणं,सोऊण गरा-'मरा सुविम्हइया,संवेगसमावन्ना,विमुक्वेरा तओ जाया"
english: "That sage's speech, Sowon gar -" "Died nicely, full of passion, Gone too soon." ""

prakrit: "बहवो सम्मदिट्टी,जाया पुण सावया तहिं अन्ने,भोगेसु विरत्तमणा,समणतं केइ पडिवन्ना"
english: "Behave modestly, Go back to your old self, Stop being pretentious, Resemble in silence, For someone else will fall."

prakrit: "एत्तो कयन्तवयणो,सुणिऊणं भवसहस्सदुक्खोहं,दिक्खाभिमुहो पउम,भणइ पहू सुणसु मह वयणं"
english: "It's my lover's turn, I can hear the crashing sound of his voice, My husband is about to depart, And I must say," "Listen." ""

prakrit: "संसारम्मि अणन्ते,परिहिण्डन्तो चिरं सुपरितन्तो,दुक्खविमोक्खट्टे हइ,राहव! गेण्हामि पहज्जं"
english: "The cycle of rebirth is endless, One keeps busy, One remains content, One is free from suffering, Rahva! Genghis is my weapon."

prakrit: "तो भणइ पउमनाहो,कहसि तुम उज्झिउं महं नेहं,गेण्हसि दुद्धरचरियं,असिघारं जिणमयाणुगयं"
english: "So you fool, tell me, Don't touch me if you want to wake me up, You coward," he said, "I'm having my period."

prakrit: "कह चेव छुहाईया,विसहिस्सिसि परिसहे महाघोरे,कण्टयतुल्लाणि पुणो,क्यणाणि य खलमणुस्साणं"
english: "How come you touch me, you stupid bitch? In your twenties you grew very large. Once again you made me thirsty. How can anyone resist a bad man?"

prakrit: "उन्भडसिराकवोलो,अट्ठियचम्मावसेसतणुयङ्गो,गेण्हिहिसि परागारे,कह भिक्खादाणमेचाहे!"
english: "You silly bitch, You stupid dog, You coward, How can I beg?"

prakrit: "जंपइ कयन्तवयणो,सामिय! जो तुज्झ दारुणं नेहं,छड्डेमि अहं सो कह,अन्नं कर्ज न साहेमि:"
english: "Tell me, you stubborn bitch! I'm going to leave you alone If you don't want to eat. I won't go into debt." ""

prakrit: "एवं निच्छियभावो,कयन्तवयणो वियाणिओ जाहे,ताहे च्चिय अणुणाओ,लक्खणसहिएण रामेणं"
english: "And the empty feelings, Like the words spoken while making love, Are the very essence of nature, Like that of the god Rama."

prakrit: "आपुच्छिऊण पउम,सोमित्तिसुयं च सबसुहदाय,गेण्हइ कयन्तवयणो,मुणिस्स पासम्मि पवज"
english: "If you want to be pure, Then all pleasure must be given to you, And if you don't, You have to beg."

prakrit: "अह सयलभूसणन्ते,सुरासुरा पणमिऊण भावेणं,निययपरिवारसहिया,जहागया पडिगया सबे"
english: "Ah, the pleasant pastime Of dressing up, Of fondling your lover's breasts, Of setting out with a steady stream of friends, Of going to bed early."

prakrit: "रामो वि केवलिं तं,अभिवन्देऊण सेसया य मुणी,सीयाऎ सनियास,संपतो अप्पबीओ सो"
english: "Rama is only to be wished for, A sage is to be greeted by those who bow before him, A wise man by others; But wealth is nothing to be begotten by others."

prakrit: "रामेण तो सीया,दिहा अजाण मज्झयारत्था । सेयम्बरपरिहाणा,तारासहिय,ससिलेहा"
english: "Ramen toh siya, diya agyaan mujhe yaaratha. Seimbar pariahana, Tara sahiyan, Sasileha." ""

prakrit: "एवंविहं निएई,संजमगुणधारिणि पउमनाहो,चिन्तेइ कह पवन्ना,दुकरचरिय इमा सीया?"
english: "And now that I am well, my young wife, Proud of her virtues, How can I help thinking? It is the wicked nature of my life."

prakrit: "एसा मज्झ 'भुमओयरमल्लीणा निययमेव सुहललिया,कह दुग्यणचडयर,सहिही मिच्छत्तमहिलाणं!"
english: "Such is the case with me, O earth - loving woman, Always pleasant to be with, How wretched is the cowardice Of being mistreated?"

prakrit: "बाए बहुप्पयार,मुत्तं चिय भोयणं रससमिद्धं,सा कह लद्धमलद्धं,भिक्खं मुंनीहि परदिन्नं!"
english: "My dear, My husband is very angry, My life is full of trouble, So tell me, you fool, How can I appease him If he refuses to bow down?"

prakrit: "वीणावंसरवेणं,उवगिजन्ती य ना सुहं सइया,कह सा लहिही निर्दे,संपइ फरसे धरणिवट्टे?"
english: "Who is not captivated by a lute, Who does not sigh or groan, Who is completely unfaithful to a woman's voice, And who is unable to rest on her feet?"

prakrit: "एसा बहुगुणनिलया,सीलमई निययमेव अणुकूला,परपरिवाएण मए,मूढेणं हारिया सोया"
english: "Such a multi-faceted woman, Seelamai niyameva munnula, I have to die for what's next, Foolish person loses sleep"

prakrit: "एयाणि य अन्नाणि य,पचिन्तेऊण तत्थ पउमामो,परमत्थमुणियकरणो,पणमइ ताहे जणयतणयं"
english: "If you ask me what I want to eat, I'll eat it, If I tell you what it is To make me thirsty again, It's only because I know how to eat it."

prakrit: "तो भणह रामदेवो,एकट्टे चेव परिवसन्तेणं,जं चिय तुह दुश्चरियं,कयं मए त खमेज्जासु"
english: "So tell me, Ramdev, why are you wandering around all by yourself? Whatever is your fault, forgive me." ""

prakrit: "एवं सा जणयसुया,लक्खणपमुहेहि नरवरिन्देहिं,अहिवन्दिया सुसमणी,अहियं परितुहियएहिं"
english: "And she is a happy woman, Like a man affronted with many afflictions, Like an old woman in distress."

prakrit: "अहिणन्दह वइदेही,एवं मणिऊण राहवो चलिओ,भडचक्केण 'परिवुडो,संपत्तो असणो भवणं"
english: "Non - happiness is the supreme deity, And humility is the path to bliss." "Fear the fire; Wealth is an empty building."

prakrit: "एयं राहवचरिय,पुरिसो जो पढइ सुणइ भावियकरणो,सो लहइ बोहिलाह,हवइ य लोयम्मि उत्तमो विमलनसो ॥ १७५ ॥"
english: "It is the way of conduct; men who read and listen make predictions; the tongue is the arrow; the wind is the most excellent wind in the world." 175

prakrit: "इइ पउमचरिए रामपुव्वभवसीयापव्वजाविहाणं नाम तिउत्तरसयं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "Praise be to the name of the pious woman on whose name the sacred thread of love has been strung."

prakrit: "एत्तो बिहोसणो पुण,परिपुच्छइ सयलभसणं साहुं,भयवं परभवनणियं,कहेहि लवणं-'कुसच्चरिय"
english: "Such greatness is pure, Such purity embraces true love, Such fear encompasses everything, Such is the nature of love -" "Wretched woman." ""

prakrit: "तो भणइ मुणी निसुणसु,कायन्दिपुराहिवस्स सूरस्स,रइवद्धणस्स महिला,सुदरिसणा नाम विक्खाया"
english: "So the sage says," "Be still, for behold, the sun has risen above the horizon." "The wise woman replies:" "Sudarishana is a name given to wisdom."

prakrit: "तीए गन्भुप्पन्ना,दोणि सुया पियहियंकरा धोरा,मन्ती उ सबगुत्तो,तत्थ नरिन्दस्स पडिकूलो"
english: "She is Ganbhupanna, The river is swollen by both, Dear friend, He knows everything. Then comes Narindas." ""

prakrit: "विजयावलि ति' नाम,परिणी मन्तिस्स सा निसासमए,गन्तूण नरवरिन्द,भणइ पहू! सुणसु मह वयणं"
english: "Vijayavali is her name, Parineeti is her mind, Destined to go, Nervous, Says Pahu! Listen to me when I speak." ""

prakrit: "तुज्शाणुरायरत्ता,कन्तं मोत्तण आगया इहई,इच्छसु मए नराहिव! मा वक्खेवं कुणम एत्तो"
english: "Your Majesty, How much longer can I go on in this fire? Please, do not harm me! This is the end of your life." ""

prakrit: "भणिया य नरवईणं,बिनयावलि! नेव एरिसं जुतं,परणारिफरिसणं विय,उत्तमपुरिसाण लज्जणय"
english: "Daughter - in - law! This is nothing to be ashamed of! It's a shame for a good man To lie low While making love." ""

prakrit: "नं एव नरवईणं,भणिया विजयावली गया सगिहँ,परपुरिसदिन्नहियया,मुणिया सा तत्थ मन्तीणं"
english: "No, it's not a manmade disaster, Daughter - in - law has triumphed, The days are fleeting And the nights unreturning."

prakrit: "अइकोहवसगएणं,तं नरवइसन्तियं महामवणं,मन्तीण रयणिसमए,सहसा आलोवियं सर्व"
english: "It's like singing a hymn, Like saying:" "Praise be to the God of Love, Like chanting: Suddenly everything seems to be alright." ""

prakrit: "तो गूढसुरङ्गाए,विणिग्गओ नरवई सह सुएहिं,महिलाय ठविय पुरओ,गओ य वाणारसीदेसं"
english: "So you silly girl, Go and sleep with the men in your bedsheets, Stop being a woman. Let's go to the forest fence." ""

prakrit: "मन्ती वि सबगुत्तो,अकमिऊणं च सयलरज सो,पेसेइ निययदूर्य,कासिनरिन्दस्स कासिपुरं"
english: "The mind is also omnipotent, inaction is blissful, patience is the only remedy, Kasinrindasa Kasipuram is everything."

prakrit: "गन्तूण तओ दूओ,साहइ कसिवस्स सामियादिढे,तेणावि उवालद्धो,दूओ अहनिठुरगिराए"
english: "Destroy them, O Duo; help is at hand, At the approach of a fierce wind; They are blown over by the same wind."

prakrit: "को तुज्झ सामिघायय,गेहह नाम पि उत्तमो पुरिसो,नाणन्तो चिय दोसे,पडिवज्जइ नेव भिश्चत्तं"
english: "Who is your rival? Even in this name some good men get away with it. But if my heart is guilty, There is no remorse."

prakrit: "सह पुत्तेहिं सुसामी,जं ते वहिओ तुमे अणज्जेणं,तं ते दावेमि लहुं,रइवद्धणसन्तियं मग्गं"
english: "Friend, you are a good daughter - in - law. What you carry I do not know, But what you give me I promise, As long as I live I will give birth to children."

prakrit: "कसिवेण निठुराए,गिराऎ निच्छिओ गओ दूओ,सर्व सवित्थर तं,कहेइ निययस्स सामिस्स"
english: "Somebody has fallen asleep, gone to bed, gone away, Everything is hunched over again," She tells him, "It's just the way things are."

prakrit: "सुणिऊण दूयवयणं,अह सो भडचडयरेण महएणं,निष्फिडइ सवगुत्तो,कसिवस्सुवरि अहतुरन्तो"
english: "Listening is deceitful, Oh! it's a big fire with flames, It destroys everything, But the God of Love is always at hand."

prakrit: "पइसरइ सबगुत्तो,कासोपुरिसन्तियं तओ देस,कसिवो वि निययसेन्नं,तुरियं मेलेइ ददसतो"
english: "Money destroys everything, But when it is empty, It vanishes forever."

prakrit: "रहबद्धणेण पुरिसो,कसिवस्स पवेसिओ निसि पसे,पत्तो साहेइ फुड,देव! तुमं आगओ सामी"
english: "" "Wait a minute, you silly man, You're not supposed to fall asleep on top of everyone else. Please, God, help me find food. You shamans!"

prakrit: "सुणिऊण अपरिसेसं,वत्तं कसिवो गओ अइतुरन्तो,पेच्छइ उज्जाणथं,सपुत्त-महिलं निययसामि"
english: "I've never heard of her before, But now that she's gone I can see her everywhere. I am quite used to seeing women with breasts"

prakrit: "अन्तेउरेण समयं,पणमइ सामि तओ सुपरितुट्ठो,कसिवो कुणइ महन्तं,निययपुरे संगमाणन्दं"
english: "In the end, time is of the essence, A good husband is supreme, A bad husband is great, Friendship is eternal."

prakrit: "रइवद्धणेण समरे,कसिवसमग्गेण सबगुत्तो सो,भग्गो पइसइ रणं,पुलिन्दसरिसो तओ जाओ"
english: "The hunter is a warrior by nature, He knows everything through the eyes of a neighbor, He destroys the pastime of the hunter; But go your way, Pulindasara."

prakrit: "पुणरवि कायन्दीए,राया रहबद्धणो कुणइ रज्जं,कसिवो वि भयविमुक्को,भुइ वाणारसिं मुइओ"
english: "Restoration is the order of the day, Unhappiness is the restraint, The ropes bend, But even the coward is afraid. The earth teems with monkeys."

prakrit: "काऊण सुइरकालं,रज रइवद्धणो सुसंविग्गो,समणस्स सन्नियासे,सुभाणुनामस्स पबइओ"
english: "What a lovely time it is, To enjoy a good night's sleep, To dream a good dream, To say the name of a good man."

prakrit: "विनयावली वि पढम,चत्ता मन्तीण सोगिणी मरिउँ,नियकम्मपभावेणं,उप्पन्ना रक्खसी घोरा"
english: "Even the pen of humility is past, The solemn vows of chastity are final, Death is certain, The path of purity is sacred, And above all, There must be a guardian angel."

prakrit: "तइया तस्सुवसग्गे,फोरन्ते रक्खसीऎ पावाए,रइवद्धणस्स सहसा,केवलनाणं समुप्पन्नं"
english: "You silly girl, Protect yourselves in the forest, Always be vigilant, Only speak plainly."

prakrit: "काऊण य पबजं,दो वि जणा पियहियंकरा समणा,पत्ता 'गेवेजिवि,चउत्थभवलद्धसम्मत्ता"
english: "Who is to blame? Two lovers making love At the same time: The husband and wife Prostrate in mutual affection."

prakrit: "सेणिय! चउत्थजम्मे,सामलिनयरीऎ वामदेवसुया,वसुनन्द-सुनन्दभिहा,आसि चिय बम्भणा पुर्व"
english: "Soldier! On the fourteenth day of Shravan, Summer girl, Left devout, Spring - beautiful, Come, make love before the sun rises." ""

prakrit: "अह ताण महिलियाओ,विस्सावसु तह पियंगुनामाओ,विप्पकुलजाइयाओ,जोवण-लायण्णकलियाओ"
english: "Oh! thin women, Whisperers and peepers, Wretched grasshoppers, Weeping reeds."

prakrit: "दाऊण य सिरितिलए,दाणं साहुस्स भावसंजुत्तं,आउक्खए सभज्जा,उत्तरकुरवे समुप्पन्ना"
english: "Be kind, be compassionate, be generous, be considerate, answer everyone's questions, and never be negligent."

prakrit: "भोग भोतूण तओ,ईसाणे सुरवरा समुप्पन्ना,चइया बोहिसमग्गा,पियंकर-हियंकरा जाया"
english: "Bhog bhotun toh, Isane surwara samuppanna, Chaiya bohismagga, Pyankara - Hyankara jaya"

prakrit: "सं कम्ममहारण्णं,सयलं माणाणलेण डहिऊण,ईवद्धणो महप्पा,पत्तो सिवसासयं मोक्वं"
english: "Sacrifice karma, burn true decency, sacrifice greatness, then there will be redemption for all beings."

prakrit: "कहिया जे तुज्झ मए,एलो पियंकर-हियंकरा भवा,गेवेजचुया सेणिय!,जाया लवर्ण-'कुसा धीरा"
english: "Somebody tell me," "Who is your lover?" "Allow yourself to be captivated By your lover."

prakrit: "देवी सुदरिसणा वि य,सणियाणा हिण्डिऊण संसारे,निजरिय जुवइकम्म,सिद्धत्यो खुडओ जाओ"
english: "May the goddess be purified, May the whole world rejoice, May her youth blossom, may her accomplishments flourish."

prakrit: "पुबसिणेहेण तओ,कया य लवण-कुसा अईकुसला,सिद्धत्येण नराहिव!,रणे य अवराइया धीरा"
english: "You fool, What a draught of salt Is this, Such an inexhaustible waste of time!" cried the hunter, "Without finding a single drop of gold."

prakrit: "एवं सुणेऊण भवोहदुक्ख,जीवाण संसारपहे ठियाणं,तुम्मे य स वि सया'पमचा,करेह धम्म विमलं समत्था"
english: "And when you hear that my life is passing, You rejoice, For all my life I have endured, Always upholding the dharma."

prakrit: "इह पउमचरिए लवणं-'कुसपुब्बभवाणुकित्तणं नाम चउरुत्तरसय पर्व समत्त"
english: "This is the lotus flower -" "The festival of fragrant flowers is concluded in the name of Kusapubbavanukittan." ""

prakrit: "चइऊण य पइ-पुत्ते,निक्खनसा तिबजायसंवेगा,जं कुणइ तवं सीया,ते तुज्झ कहेमि मगहवई!"
english: "My son, you must be careful not to fall over by the wayside. Whatever you do, my dear, I promise, will be in your favor."

prakrit: "तइया पुण सबजणो,उवसमिओ सयलभूसणमुणोणं,जाओ निणधम्मरओ,भिक्खादाणुजओ अहियं"
english: "You good man, Stop your sulking, go and beg. I am a begging bowl." ""

prakrit: "जा आसि सुरवणं,सरिसी लायण्ण-जोबणगुणेहिं,सा तवसोसियदेहा,सीया दहा लया चेव"
english: "Come, make love; You'll have a hard time finding a lover Who shares your talents."

prakrit: "पञ्चमहत्वयधारी,दुब्भावविवज्जिया पयइसोमा,निन्दन्ती महिलतं,कुणइ तवं बारसवियप्पं"
english: "The wearer of five great vows, Pretending to suffer ill - will, Is a reprehensible womaniser, Can bend and bend all the time."

prakrit: "लोयकयउत्तमङ्गी,मलकञ्चुयधारिणी तणुसरीरा,छट्ठ-'टम-मासाइसु,सुत्तविहीणं कयाहारा"
english: "The plowman's wife, wearing a garland of emeralds, Looks like a woman wearing braids:" "It's summer, goose pimples free." ""

prakrit: "रह-अरइविप्पमुक्का,निययं सज्झाय-झाणकयभावा,समिईसु य गुत्तीसु य,अविरहिया संजमुज्जुत्ता"
english: "Be still - a broad smile, a steady stream of rebukes, a trembling countenance, a sigh that goes away but does not last."

prakrit: "परिगलियमस-सोणिय-हार-छिरा पायड'ट्ठियकवोला,सहवहिएण वि तया,जणेण नो लक्खिया सीया"
english: "Pariglliamus - Sonya - Necklace - Slipped footwear, Still ready to make love, One cannot find a dear friend"

prakrit: "एवंविहं तवं 'सा वि सटिवरिसाणि सुमहयं काउं,तेत्तीस पुण दियहा,विहिणा सलेहणाउता"
english: "And just like that, The wife is so full of affection for her husband That she refuses to sleep with him again."

prakrit: "विहिणा''राहियचरणा,कालं काऊण स्थ वइदेही,बावीससायरठिई,पडिइन्दो अच्चुए जाओ"
english: "" "Separation" "is the way of life; Time, my dear, stands still for the twelfth day."

prakrit: "मगहाहिय! माहप्पं,पेच्छमु जिणसासणस्स जं जीवो,मोत्तण जुबइमावं,पुरिसो जाओ सुरवरिन्दो"
english: "Oh! my lord! I see your face in the mirror, Living creature to the death, Like the nail marks on a young cow." ""

prakrit: "सो तत्थ वरविमाणे,सुमेरुसिहरोवमे रयणचित्ते,सुरजुबईहिं परिखुडो,' सीइन्दो रमइ सुहपउरो"
english: "There it is, Like a rainbow in bloom, Like the rays of the moon on a sunny day, Like winter's fragrance." ""

prakrit: "एयाणि य अन्नाणि य,जीवाणं परभवाणुचरियाई,निसुणिज्जन्ति नराहिव!,मुणिवरकहियाई बहुयाई"
english: "Life is pretentious, Deceitful men are helpless!, Too much talk of foolishness."

prakrit: "तो भणइ मगहराया,भयवं कह तेहिं अच्चुए कप्पे,बावीससागरठिई,भुत्ता महु-केढवेहिं पि"
english: "So tell me, Magharaya, How scared you must be To see those shrivelled breasts Of a woman sitting on the river bank? They look just like bees." ""

prakrit: "भणइ तओ गणनाहो,वरिससहस्साणि चेव चउसही,काऊण तवं विउलं,जाया ते अच्चुए देवा"
english: "If you speak, you are to be reckoned with; If you abuse one's position, one is to be blamed; But if you neglect one, it is to God."

prakrit: "कालेण चुयसमाणा,अह ते महु-केढवा इहं भरहे,कण्हस्स दो वि पुत्ता,उप्पना सम्ब-पज्जुष्णा"
english: "Time consumes itself, Oh! the jasmine's nectar fills the air, The two gooseflesh in one's ear, Uppana samba - worship." ""

prakrit: "छस्समहिया उ लक्खा,वरिसाणं अन्तरं समक्खायं,तित्थयरेहिं महायस!,भारह-रामायणाणं तु"
english: "Six hundred miles is a long way to go, A long journey lies ahead, And with it the greatness of love!" "For you are the burden of the Ramayana."

prakrit: "पुणरवि य भणइ राया,भयवं! कह तेहिं दुल्लहा बोही,लद्धा तवो य चिण्णो?,एय साहेहि मे सर्व"
english: "Once again she mutters," "Fear not! How is it you confuse her? You know she's been robbed?" "That's all my friend said."

prakrit: "तो भणइ इन्दभूई,सेणिय! महु-केढवेहिं अन्नभवे,जह निणमयम्मि बोही,लद्धा तं सुणसु एगमणो"
english: "So tell me, Indubhai, soldier! The fragrance of nectar From the mango blossom, Which your daughter - in - law has plucked, Let me hear it again." ""

prakrit: "इह खलु मगहाविसए,सालिग्गामो ति नाम विक्खाओ,सो भुञ्जह तं कालं,राया निस्सन्दिओ नाम"
english: "It's true, my dear, I know your name is Vikhao, so forget about it, you bastard. No, it's a false name."

prakrit: "विप्पो उ सोमदेवो,तत्थ उ परिवसइ सालिवरगामे,तस्स'ग्गिलागू पुत्ता,सिहिभूई वाउभूई य"
english: "Vippo oh, Somadeva! There she is, Stretching her bosom across the rainy season, Like a son possessed by a poisonous snake."

prakrit: "अह ते पण्डियमाणी,छक्कम्मरया तिमोगसम्मूढा,सम्मइंसणरहिया,जिणवरधम्मस्स पडणीया"
english: "Oh! that punditess! Aunt, You fool, Who, out of consideration for me, Have fallen at last into the dharma of victory!"

prakrit: "कस्सह कालस्स तओ,विहरन्तो समणसङ्घपरिकिष्णो,अह नन्दिवद्धणमुणी,सालिगाम समणुपणे"
english: "There must be some time," said the traveler, "When we meet we bow before each other, Like lovers making love."

prakrit: "तं चेव महासमण,उज्जाणत्यं जणो नियुणिऊणं,सालिगामाउ तओ,बन्दणहेउं विणिप्फिडिओ"
english: "He has a great reputation, He is sharp, He can be controlled, He knows how to play the flute, He understands how to weep."

prakrit: "तं अग्गि-वाउभूई,दठ्ठ पुच्छन्ति कत्थ अइपउरो,एसो जाइ जणवओ,सबाल-बुड्डो अइतुरन्तो!"
english: "How naïve of him, That fire - bowed woman, Asking at random Where the poor man was going!"

prakrit: "भन्नेण ताण सिटुं,उज्जाणे आगयस्स समणस्स,वन्दणनिमित्तहेउं,तस्स इमो नाइ गामजणो"
english: "By saying: Sit down, By rising early, By swearing, I mean, Not a man of the village."

prakrit: "अह ते जेट्ट-कणिट्टा,वायत्थी उवगया मुणिसयासं,जंपन्ति दोणि वि नणा,मुणीण पडिकुट्टवयणाई"
english: "Oh! it's the jet - crank, The breeze is blowing, The sage is swooning, The couple are chatting, Yet the sage refuses to budge."

prakrit: "भो भो तुम्मे स्थमुणी!,नइ नाणह किंचि' सत्थसंबन्धं,तो भणह लोयमझे,अइरा मा कुणह वक्खेवं"
english: "Well, you stubborn woman! No, I don't know what to say. Tell me, Loyama, Don't be so rash." ""

prakrit: "एक्कण मुणिवरेणं,भणिया तुन्भेहि आगया कत्तो?,जंपन्ति आगया वि हु,सालिग्गामाओ अम्हेहिं"
english: "Aunt, tell me," "Where did you get that fire from, Daughter - in - law?" "I'm still burning."

prakrit: "पुणरवि मुणोण भणिया,कवणाओ भवाओ आगया तुब्मे,एवं माणुसनम्मं?,कहेह नइ अस्थि पण्डिचं"
english: "Punarvi munon bhanya, kavanao bhavao agya tumhe, aur humankind mein?, Kahin nai asthi pandicha." ""

prakrit: "तं ते अयाणमाणा,अहोमुहा लज्जिया ठिया विप्पा,ताहे ताण परभवं,कहिऊण मुणी समाढत्तो"
english: "That is what you mean, you shameless wretch, That is how the sage summed up his situation."

prakrit: "गामस्स वणथलीए,इमस्स तुम्मे हि दोष्णि वि सियाला,आसि चिय परलोए,मंसाहारा बहुकिलेसा"
english: "The village is deserted, The guilty one is still with you, The wretched one has returned, The hapless one has grown very thin."

prakrit: "एत्थेव अत्थि गामे,पामरओ करिसओ 'गओ छेतं,मोत्तण य उवगरणं,तत्थ पुणो आगओ सगिहं"
english: "Here in this village," said the farmer, "You'll have to go elsewhere, To retrieve the pearl That will light the fire again."

prakrit: "ते दो वि सियाला त,उवगरणं खाइऊण कालगया,कम्मवसेणुप्पन्ना,पुत्ता वि हु सोमदेवस्स"
english: "They are both sly, When the time has come to eat their fill, Karmavasena, My son, I am also a Somadeva."

prakrit: "अह सो पभायसमए,पामरओ पत्थिओ नियं खित्तं,पेच्छइ दोणि सियालो,उवगरणं खाइऊण मए"
english: "Oh! my goodness, The farmer must have been angry with his wife's parting words:" "It's my turn to eat." "He looked at me with both eyes closed."

prakrit: "दिविए काऊण तओ,दोणि वि ते पत्थिओ निययगेहं,पामरओ कालगओ,नाओ गम्भम्मि सुण्हाए"
english: "How can I help it? The lamp is burning, The path is slipping, The farmer has run out of time, No one cares." ""

prakrit: "सरिऊण पुबनाई,मूग कुणइ तत्थ सो बालो,कह वाहरामि पुत्तं,तायं सुहं च नणणी हं?"
english: "When the wife prays, When the husband is away, That child is there to weep, How can I help it, my son? Such is the state of a good wife."

prakrit: "जइ नत्थि पञ्चओ भे,तो तं वाहरह एत्थ पामरयं,एवं चिय वित्तन्तं,जेण असेसं परिकहेमि"
english: "If there are no more than five, I will carry them abroad, Here and there, And if there are none, Then I will go on like this."

prakrit: "वाहरिओ य मुणीणं,भणिओ जो आसि वच्छ पामरओ,सो हु तुम दुकएणं,जाओ गन्मम्मि सुण्हाए"
english: "Foolish girl, tell me,'Whoever it is that sees you walking by, You're not to be trifled with. Let the bull go and sniff you out.'"" "

prakrit: "राया बायइ मिचो,मिचो रायत्तणं पुण उवेइ,माया वि हवइ धूया,पिया वि पुत्तो समुन्भव"
english: "Wrong speech triumphs, wrong speech vanishes, delusion too washes away, greed too leaves a son."

prakrit: "एवं अरहट्टघडीजन्तसमे इह समत्थसंसारे,हिण्डन्ति सबनीवा,सकम्मविष्फदिया सुइरं"
english: "And among the myriad beings it is the Samasthasara, The whole of the human body, That alone can produce wisdom."

prakrit: "एवं संसारठिई,वच्छ! तुम जाणिऊण मूग,मुश्चसु फुडक्खरवयं,बंपसु इह लोयमज्झम्मि"
english: "And the observer of the world, you fool! Smile, smile, whisper, It's the flame of the flame." ""

prakrit: "सो एव भणियमेत्तो,परितुट्ठो पणमिण मुणिवसह,सबइ जणस्स साहइ,वितन्तं कोल्हुयाईयं"
english: "That's what I meant when I said," "Stupid person, everything goes smoothly." ""

prakrit: "संवेयवणियभावो,पामरओ दिक्खिओ मुणिसयासे,सुणिऊण तं अणेगा,जाया समणा य समणी य"
english: "Reminds me of your own feelings: You look at the farmer's face, You turn your back on him, And he listens. Anything you want to hear You must hear."

prakrit: "ते वणवएण विप्पा,उवहसिया कलयलं करेन्तेणं,एए ते मंसासी उ कोल्हुया बम्भणा जाया"
english: "Foolish girl, Don't make a fuss of it: It's the mind that makes you think." ""

prakrit: "वय-सीलवज्जिएहिं,इमेहिं पसुएहिं पावबुद्धीहिं,मुसिया सबेह पया,धम्मत्थी भोगतिसिएहिं"
english: "Seal the age, purify the mind, renounce falsehood, become devoted to dharma."

prakrit: "सबारम्भपविता,अबम्भयारी य इन्दियपसत्ता,भण्णन्ति चरणहीणा,अबम्भणा बम्भणा लोए"
english: "The pious through all, The impudent through most of India, Speak without feet, Behave without conceit In the world of love."

prakrit: "एए तव-चरणठिया,सुद्धा समणा य* बम्भणा लोए,वयबन्धसिहाडोवा,खन्तिखमाबम्भसुत्ता य"
english: "O thou who art at thy feet, Thou who hast attained to the state of equanimity, In this world of falsehood and falsehood, Who has renounced the bond of love."

prakrit: "शाणमिगहोत्तनिरया,डहन्ति निययं कसायसमिहाओ,साहन्ति मुत्तिमग्गं,समणा इह बम्भणा धीरा"
english: "Calm down, take it easy, Decide what's best for you, Be patient until the very end, Resolve how soon you'll make it."

prakrit: "जह केइ नरा लोए,हवन्ति खन्दिन्द-रुद्दनामा उ,तह एए वयरहिया,अबम्भणा बम्भणा भणिया"
english: "As long as there are no more people, There must be tears in the eyes of the beholder. So speak the deaf." ""

prakrit: "एवं साहूण थुई,जंपन्तं जणवयं निसुणिऊणं,मरुभूइ-अमिगभूई,लज्जियविलिया गया सगिह"
english: "And you, Sahun Thuyi, have become so ashamed of yourselves That you are no longer able to conceal your true nature."

prakrit: "नाऊण य उवसर्ग,एजन्तं अत्तणो मुणिवरिन्दो,पडिमाइ पेयभवणे,ठाइ तओ धीरगम्भीरो"
english: "Nowadays it's a bust, Nowadays people go to the barber, Sometimes they drink wine, And everywhere they are sober."

prakrit: "रोसाणलपज्जलिया,निसासु ते बम्भणा मुणिवहत्थे,पविसन्ति पिउवणं ते,असिवरहत्था महापोरा"
english: "The flame of the fire, That sigh, That tremble, That drink, pure and pure, Is the arrow of the God of Love"

prakrit: "बहुविहचिया पलीबिय,जलन्तडज्झन्तमढयसंघार्य,गह-भूय-बम्भरक्खस-डाइणि-येयालभीसणयं"
english: "The plowman's wife, Scorched by the flames, Struggling in the mud, Loud with fire and water - The buffalo - The witch - The fire of jealousy."

prakrit: "किलिकिलिकिलन्तरक्खस-सिवामुहुजलियपेयसंघायं,कवायसत्थपउर,मडयसमोत्थइयमहिवीढं"
english: "Kilikilikilantarakshas - The flame of the sky, The confederacy of fire and water, The flute of the God of Love, Like the bow of the mother - in - law"

prakrit: "पश्चन्तमडर्यपुष्फससिमिसिमियगलन्तरुहिरविच्छ,डाइणिकबन्धकड्डियभीम,रुष्टन्तम्यगणं"
english: "In the middle of the night Sweat dripping from the back of the head, Rolling drops of sweat running down his cheeks, A fierce wind whirls through his body"

prakrit: "कडपूयणगहियरडन्तडिम्भय कयतिगिच्छमन्तरवं,मण्डलरयपवणुधुयइन्दाउहजणियनहमग"
english: "A swarm of bees hovers over the rafters Like a thicket of nectar From the jasmine's mother." ""

prakrit: "विजासाहणसुट्टियनंगूलियतारमणियमन्तरवं,वायसअवहियमसं,उद्धमुहुन्नइयजम्बुगणं"
english: "ViswasahanasuttiyananguliTaramaniyamantravam, Vayasahayamasam, Udha muhunnaiyyamjambuganam"

prakrit: "कत्थइ पेयायड्डियमडयविकीरन्तकलहसदाल,कथइ यालाहयतरुणियरममन्तभूयगणं"
english: "How easy it is to make love In the middle of the night, Wherever you are, There must be something on your mind."

prakrit: "कत्थइ रडन्तरिट्ट,अन्नत्तो भुगुभुगेन्तनम्बुगणं,धुधुघुघुधुएन्तपूर्य,कथइ कयपिङ्गलाबोल"
english: "Where is the cry of distress, There is the hum of trembling, And there is the sound of crashing thunder?"

prakrit: "कथइ कढोरहुयवहतडतडफुट्टन्तमट्ठिसद्दालं,कथइ साणायड्डिय-मडयामिसंलग्गजुद्वधणि"
english: "She tells the story with the sharpest hand, With the thickest blade of cotton, And with the thinnest twig."

prakrit: "कत्थइ कवालधवल,कत्थइ मसिधूमधूलिधूसरियं,किंसुयवर्ण व कत्थइ,नालामालाउलं दित्तं"
english: "How white is the kavaldhaval, How black is the sunshine, How yellow is the varnam, How pale is the lotus"

prakrit: "एयारिसे मसाणे,झाणथं मुणिवरं पलोएउं,विप्पा वहुजयमई,सविऊण मुणिं समाढत्ता"
english: "Jealous husband, If you ask me what made me angry, I will tell you the truth."

prakrit: "रे समण! इह मसाणे,मारिजन्तं तुम धरउ लोओ,पञ्चक्खदेवए वि हु,नं निन्दसि बम्भणे अम्हे"
english: "" "Hey, Saman!" "You fool, Hold on till you're dead. There are five other gods too. Don't condemn us for our pride."

prakrit: "अम्हेहिं भाससि तुम,नह एए जम्बुगा परभवम्मि,आसि किर दोष्णि वि जणा,एए विष्या समुप्पन्ना"
english: "Here you are, thinking how you feel; There must be something more going on."

prakrit: "ते एव भाणिऊणं,दट्ठोट्ठा असिवराई कडेउं,पहणन्ता मुणिवसहं तु थम्भिया ताव जक्खेणं"
english: "Tell me," he said, "When I see you, my dear, You'll have to bend over before I can touch you."

prakrit: "एवं कमेण रयणी,विष्वाणं थम्भियाण वोलीणा,उइओ य दियसणाहो,साहूण समाणिओ जोगो"
english: "And the poor woman, Whom all the wise men have tried to pacify, Has proved useless both now and then."

prakrit: "तावागओ समत्थो,सो सह जणवएण मुणिवसभं,वन्दइ विम्हियहियओ,पेच्छन्तो थभिए विप्पे"
english: "You are right, my friend, It's the assembly of sages that I am about to join. I will tell you in due course What I want to tell you."

prakrit: "भणिया य नणवएणं,एए विप्पा पराइया वाए,समणेण गुणवरेणं,नाया वि हु तेण पडिकुट्ठा"
english: "Foolish girl, Don't be so naïve: Be nice to each other, Be courteous, And never be so hasty."

prakrit: "चिन्तेन्ति तओ विप्पा,एस पहावो मुणिस्स निक्खुत्तं,बलविरियसमत्था वि य,तेण'म्हे थम्भिया इहई"
english: "Thinking how wretched it is to be sagging under the weight of your breasts, That makes me tremble."

prakrit: "एयाऎ अवत्थाए,बइ अम्हे कह वि निष्फिडीहामो,तो मुणिवरस्स वयणं,निस्सन्देहं करीहामो"
english: "Ah! what a foolish thing it is to say, my dear: Of course I can do it."

prakrit: "एवन्तरम्मि पत्तो,समय चिय अग्गिलाऎ तुरन्तो,विप्पो उ सोमदेवो,पणमइ साहुं पसाएन्तो"
english: "Aunt, Time goes by in a flash, The fire is fleeting, And when it's gone, It's the God of Summer."

prakrit: "पणो पुणो पुणो चिय,'समणं तो बम्भणो भणइ एवं,जीवन्तु देव एए,दुप्पुण तुज्झ ययणेणं"
english: "But come again, my dear," he said, "I promise you this: The gods are alive, and you are safe."

prakrit: "समस-मित्तभावा,समसुह-दुक्खा पसंस-निन्दसमा,समणा पसत्यचिता,हवन्ति पावाण वि अपाबा"
english: "Equality of mind, friendliness, equanimity, sorrow, favor, and condemnation are the virtues of love. Even a poor man's worth is immaterial."

prakrit: "ताव घिय संपत्तो,जक्खो त बम्भणं भणह रुहो,मा देसि संपइ तुम,अन्भक्खाणं मुणिवरस्स"
english: "You're a wealthy man, Speak politely when you want to, Don't give in. Be reckless when you don't." ""

prakrit: "पावा य कलसचिला,मिच्छादिट्ठी मुणो दुगुंछन्ता,रे विप्प तुज्झ पुला,इमे मए थम्भिया दुवा"
english: "Pava ya kalaschila, Mischievous peeper, You stupid fool, This is my thumbs up." ""

prakrit: "मारेन्तो लहइ वह,सम्भाणेन्तो य लहइ सम्माणं,जो जं करेइ कम्म,सो तस्स फलं तु अणुहबइ"
english: "One who kills attains wisdom, One who understands virtue attains virtue, Whatever one does, it is by virtue of that that one attains merit."

prakrit: "तं एव जपमाणं,अइचण्डं दारुणं महादुक्खं,विनवइ पायवडिओ,साहुं च पुणो पुणो विप्पो"
english: "It is the same rosary, Such an awful lotus, Such a wretched path, Like walking on fire and water, Ends again and again."

prakrit: "तो भणइ मुणी नक्खें,मरिसस दोस इमाण विप्पाणं । मा कुणसु जीवधाय,मज्झ कए भद्द,दीणाणं"
english: "So he says," "Bees, nails, these are poisonous." "Please, don't let him live. Worse is in store for me, Dinah."

prakrit: "जं आणवेसि मुणिवर!,एवं भणिऊण तत्थ नक्खणं,ते बम्भणा विमुक्का,आसत्था साहवं पणया"
english: "You fool! When he says:" "Look at that nail!" "That reassurance is muted. Hope helps too."

prakrit: "ते अम्गि-वाउई,वेयसुई उज्झिऊण उवसन्ता,साहुस्स सन्नियासे,दो वि जणा सावया जाया"
english: "They wail loudly, They flutter slowly, They sigh bitterly, Both are consumed by grief."

prakrit: "जिणसासणाणुरचा,गिहिधम्मं पालिऊण कालगया,सोहम्मकप्पवासी,दोणि य" देवा समुप्पन्ना"
english: "The God of Love, Who dwells in the womb, Has prepared for eternity a heavenly abode"

prakrit: "तत्तो चुया समाणा. साएयाए समुद्ददत्तस्स,सेट्ठिस्स धारिणीए,पियाऎ पुत्ता समुप्पन्ना"
english: "There you are, sweetheart. The sea is fresh. The rivers are swollen. My son is thirsty. I have to gather water." ""

prakrit: "नन्दण-नयणाणन्दा,पुणरवि सायारधम्मजोएणं,मरिऊण तओ जाया,देवा सोहम्मकप्पम्मि"
english: "Nandana - Nayana ̄ nanda, To rejoice again in the eternal dharma, To die is to depart from it; Deva is the remover of happiness."

prakrit: "ते तत्थ वरविमाणे,तुडिय-अजय-कडय-कुण्डलाहरणा,भुञ्जन्ति विसयसोक्ख,सुरवहुपरिवारिया सुइरं"
english: "There it is, the wind in the sky, The thunder - lightning, the kadaya - the churning of the kundalahar, The blowing of the trumpet, The pleasures of love, The pleasure of loving one's neighbor."

prakrit: "चइया अमरवईए,देवीए कुच्छिसंभवा बाया,ते हेमणाहपुजा,विणियाए सुरकुमारसमा"
english: "The bee is immortal, The goddess is a woman of few talents, He is the God of Love, The weaver is the god of beauty."

prakrit: "महु-केढवा नरिन्दा,जाया तेलोकपायडपयावा,भुञ्जन्ति निरवसेस,पुहई जियसतुसामन्ता"
english: "Mahu - kedhwa narinda, jaya telokpaidapayawa, bhunjanti niravases, puhai jyasatusamanta."

prakrit: "नवर ताण न पणमइ,भीमो गिरिसिहरदुमामावत्यो,उबासेइ य देस,उइण्णसेन्नो कयन्तसमो"
english: "The bridegroom does not object, I swear, When he calls her by the first drop of sweat I give in to his anger."

prakrit: "वडनयरसामिएणं,भीमस्स भएण वोरसेणेणं,संपेसिया य लेहा,तूरन्ता महुनरिन्दस्स"
english: "Foolish warrior, If you want to be brave you have to fight. If you don't, keep on keeping on: It's the bee that runs away."

prakrit: "सुणिऊण य हत्थ,देसविणासं तओ परमरुट्ठो,निम्फिड य महुराया,तस्सुवरि साहणसमम्गो"
english: "Listen, my hand; Despair is the supreme root; Nymphid, my bee; To that woman belongs all my strength."

prakrit: "अह सो कमेण पचो,वडनयरं पविसिउँ कयाहारो,तं वीरसेणभज्नं,चन्दाम पेच्छइ नरिन्दो"
english: "Ah, what a miser! Aunt, When you ask how he got past your old self, You fool, Not to mention his arrows of fire. It's the moon that Narindo sees." ""

prakrit: "चिन्तेइ तो मणेण,इमाऎ सह जा न मुञ्जिमो भोगे,तो मज्झ इमं रज,निस्सारं निष्फलं 'नीयं"
english: "If I think about it, I am content. If I don't go to bed early, It's my pleasure. However insignificant, It is useless." ""

prakrit: "फज्जा-'कजवियन्न,पडिसनु निजिऊण' संगामे,पुणरवि साएयपुरि,कमेण संपत्थिओ राया"
english: "Fudge -" "Be reasonable, make your husband happy" "At the fair, Rejoice and rejoice, For true prosperity begets wealth."

prakrit: "काऊण य मन्तणय,राया पूएइ सबसामन्ते,वाहरइ वीरसेणं,ताहे अन्तेउरसमग्गं"
english: "Who cares, The path is smooth, Everything is in balance, The brave army is streaming in, So is the rest of the village."

prakrit: "सम्माणिओ य सो वि य,विसज्जिओ सबनरवइसमग्गो,नवरं चिय चन्दाभा,महुणा अन्तेउरे "छूटा"
english: "Respect, my dear," said the doe, "Rest assured, The new moon is bright, The bees have finally parted."

prakrit: "अभिसेयपट्टबन्धं,चन्दामा पाविया नरिन्देणं,जाया य महादेवी,सबाण वि चेव महिलाणं"
english: "Abhisaya bandha, Chandama paviya narindena, Jaya ya Mahadevi, Everything is for good women."

prakrit: "अह सो महू नरिन्दो,चन्दाभासहगओ तहिं भवणे,रइसागरोवगाढो,गर्य पि कालं न लक्खेइ"
english: "Ah! the bee, Narindo! The moon looks like that, Like a banner proclaiming spring, But time does not seem to notice." ""

prakrit: "सो य पुण वीरसेणो,हरियं नाऊण अत्तणो कन्तं,घणसोगसल्लियङ्गो,सहसा उम्मत्तओ जाओ"
english: "Well, you braveheart, How can you do that when you're freshly plucked from the river? Suddenly, you goose pimples." ""

prakrit: "एवं अणुहविय चिरं,कन्ताविरहम्मि दुस्सहं दुक्खं,मण्डवसाहुसयासे,पबहओ वीरसेणो" सो"
english: "And stay undisturbed, Constant torment, Unbearable grief, Unhappiness on the part of the people." ""

prakrit: "सो वीरसेणसाहू,तवचरणं अजिऊण कालगओ,दिवङ्गयमउडधरो,देवो वेमाणिओ जाओ"
english: "So brave men, Stop wasting your time in vain imagining. The God of Love has gone astray."

prakrit: "अह सो महू नरिन्दो,चिट्टइ धम्मासणे सुहनिविट्ठो,मन्तीहिं सहालावं,ववहारवियारणं कुणइ"
english: "Oh! that bee, Narindo, Sitting in a state of bliss, Taking care of the bees, Doing her best to weep and wail."

prakrit: "सं चेव उ ववहार,राया मोतुण पत्थिओ सगिह,भणिओ चन्दाभाए,कि अज चिरावियं सामि"
english: "Friend, When the moon was full The traveler said:" "Long live the moon." ""

prakrit: "तेण वि सा पडिमणिया,ववहारो पारदारियस्स पिए!,आसि न तीरइ छेतु,चिरावियं तेण अज मए"
english: "That's why she is so proud. The wretched woman, Drunk on liquor, Can't make ends meet. But that is why I am still alive." ""

prakrit: "तो भणइ विहसिऊणं,चन्दामा पारदारियं सामि,पूएहि पयत्तेणं,न तस्स दोसो हवह लोए"
english: "So he says," "The moon is bright, The sky is clear, There must be something on it." "There's nothing wrong with that."

prakrit: "सुणिऊण तीऎ वयणं,रुहो महुपस्थिवो भणइ एवं,जो निग्गहस्स भागी,सो कह पूइज्जए दुट्ठो!"
english: "Listening to her speak, One can say that she weeps much, And one can only laugh Because one's heart is full. So why this wicked worship?"

prakrit: "बइ निमाहं नराहिव!,कुणसि तुम पारदारियनरस्स,घोरं तु महादण्डं,किं न हु तं अत्तणो कुणसि"
english: "Bookmark the permalink." "You coward, you traitor, you bigot, don't you think that's how you are?" ""

prakrit: "पढमपरदारसेवी,सामि! तुम सयलवसुमईनाहो,पच्छा हवइ य लोओ,जह राया तह पया सबा"
english: "" "First gentleman, Sammy! You're not a good man, you're just a bunch of hussies." "As the saying goes," "Everything's fair."

prakrit: "सयमेव नरवरिन्दो,जत्थ उ परदारिओ हवइ दुट्ठो,तत्य उ किं ववहारो,कोरइ लोगस्स मज्झम्मि?"
english: "Right minded man, Wherever the wind blows from the sky, What is there to do with it? For who is it that makes people angry?"

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेय,पडिबुद्धी तक्खणं महू राया,निन्दइ पुणो पुणो चिय,अप्पाणं जायसंवेगो"
english: "Listen, Vayanmayee, you silly girl, Take me in your arms again and again, Criticize me, Take care of yourself."

prakrit: "कुलवद्धणस्स रज्ज,दाउँ सह केढवेण महुराया,निक्खमइ दढधिईओ,पासे मुणिसोहसेणस्स"
english: "The bow of the family, The bee with the plowman's bow, Standing firm on its right side, Seems to pierce through the mud."

prakrit: "चन्दामा वि महाकुलसंभूया उशिऊण रायसिरिं,तस्सेव पायमूले,मुणिस्स दिक्खं चिय पवना"
english: "Though the moon is full, The rays of the moon illuminate the sky with great ecstasy, But when they set foot on it They are nothing like the rays of a moonlight."

prakrit: "घोरं काऊण तर्व,कालगया आरणच्चुए कप्पे,महु-केढवा'णुनाया,दोणि वि ते इन्दपडिइन्दा"
english: "The thick cow - dung beds, The rafters twine around the elephant's feet, The jasmine bedspreads on its trunk And both are covered with gooseflesh."

prakrit: "समणी वि य चन्दामा,संजम-तव-नियम-जोगजुत्तमणा,कालगया उववन्ना,देवी दिवेण रूवेणं"
english: "The moon is like a mirror, Calm and order are like rules of conduct, Time flies and vanishes, The goddess is illuminated by a lamp."

prakrit: "बावोससागराई,नह तेहि सुहं मणोहरं भुत्तं,सेणिय! अच्चुयकप्पे,सीया इन्दो' विय तहेव"
english: "" "Foolish girl, isn't that what happiness is all about? It's the fire of love, my dear! That's just the way it is, you stupid bitch."

prakrit: "इमं महू-केढवरायचेट्ठियं,समासओ तुज्झ मए निवेइयं,नरिन्द! धीरटुकुमारसंगर्य,सुणेहि एत्तो विमलाणुकित्तणं"
english: "Here's my beehive: Everything I have against you Is yours alone, Narinda! What a poor man's concoction. Listening is like listening to a flute." ""

prakrit: "इइ पउमचरिए महु-केढवउपक्खाणं नाम पञ्चुत्तरसयं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "Praise be to the pious woman! The essence of purity resides in the five great vows: The name of the auspicious bee and its nectar."

prakrit: "करणनयराहिबई,कणयरहो णाम खेयरो सूरो,महिला तस्स 'सयहुया,दोणि य धूयाउ कनाओ"
english: "Aunt, It's true that my name is Karen, But women are just like men. Either one of you is a waster Or the other is a robber."

prakrit: "ताणं सर्यवरटे,सबइ वि य खेयरा समाहूया,कणयरहेण तुरन्तो,रामस्स वि पेसिओ लेहो"
english: "Everything is hunched over, Everything is uneven, The roads are slippery, Even the Ramasa is slipping through the cracks."

prakrit: "सुणिऊण य लेहत्थं,हलहर-नारायणा सुयसमग्गा,विजाहरपरिकिण्णा,तं कणयपुरं समणुपता"
english: "Listen, Lehtath, The plowman's son is in a hurry, The conqueror's daughter - in - law has arrived, And the bridegroom has arrived."

prakrit: "ताव सहासु निविट्ठा,सबे वि य उभयसेढिसामन्ता,आहरणभूसियाना,देवा व महिड्डिसंजुता"
english: "He is always at hand, everything is peaceful, he is always ready for anything, He is the God of Love," says the sage.

prakrit: "रामो लक्खणसहिओ,कुमारपरिवारिओ विमाणाओ,अवयरिऊण निविट्ठो,तत्येव सहाऎ सुरसरिसो"
english: "Rama is the patron saint, Kumara and his family the patron saints, The fire of immortality prevails, And ecstasy prevails everywhere."

prakrit: "ताव य दिणे पसत्ये,कन्नाओ दो वि कयविभूसाओ,तं चेव रायउदहि,जणकल्लोलं पविट्ठाओ"
english: "Every day is fair, no matter how difficult, It's always sunny, Every drop of blood is holy."

prakrit: "ताणं चिय मयहरओ,दावेइ नराहिवे बहुवियप्पे,हरि-वसह-सिहि-पर्वगम-गरुड-महानागचिन्धाले"
english: "The south wind blows hot, The doves fly high, The jasmine trees sway, The sweetwood trees twine, The garuda tree twines And the great eagles hover."

prakrit: "मयहरयदाविए ते,महरूम नरवई पलोएउं,कन्नाहि कया दिट्ठी,लव-कुसाणं घणसिणेहा"
english: "Please, my poor girl, Please, don't turn your back on me. How can you look at me When love has taken such a heavy toll?"

prakrit: "मन्दाइणीऎ गहिओ,अणालवणो अणगसमरूवो,चन्दमुहीए वि तओ,गन्तुं मयणंकुसो वरिओ"
english: "Foolish woman, When the moon is full The moon is still bright, And when it is dark The moon looks like a lotus."

prakrit: "अह तस्थ जणसमूहे,जाओ चिय हलहलारखो गहिरो,जय-हसिय-गीय-वाइय-विमुकहुंकारखुकारो"
english: "There you are, huddled in the crowd, Chewing gum like a plow, Laughing, singing, whimpering, Smiling." ""

prakrit: "साहु ति साहु लोगो,जंपइ सीसङ्गुलिं भमाडेन्तो,अणुसरिसो संजोगो,अम्हेहि 'सयवरे दिट्ठो"
english: "Sahu, ti sahu logon, Jump up and down, Flicker the lotus flowers." "Our eyes are always on you, my dear."

prakrit: "गम्भीरधोरगरुयं,एसा मन्दाइणी गया लवणं,मयणंकुसं सुरूवं,चन्दमुही पाविया धीरं"
english: "Loud thunder, Such a tepid woman, Made of salt, Looks like a wretched tree: The moon - faced woman Is patient."

prakrit: "साहुकारमुहरवं,लोगं सुणिऊण लक्खणस्स सुया,लवणं-कुसाण रुट्ठा,सन्नोई समाढत्ता"
english: "Friendly faces, People listen, People take notice, Salt - nourished people eat, Gold is the remover of wealth."

prakrit: "देवीण विसल्लाईण नन्दणा अट्ठ वरकुमारा ते,पन्नासूणेहिं तिहिं,सएहि भाईण परिकिण्णा"
english: "The God of Love has selected eight groomsmen, The other five are married, And so are his brothers."

prakrit: "माणसाला कुद,भाइवर तेहिं बहुहिं बजेहिं,मन्तेहि क उवामप,मुगल समई"
english: "Woe to man, brother - in - law! So many loud noises from it, So much anger in my heart, Mughal times."

prakrit: "कहे लव-माणे,पणिम्गहण कोण निव,बहुसूर सापडर,नचन्तविलसिणिणोहं"
english: "Say Love - Respect, Who's going to take your vows, The handsome snake charmer, The man who does not dance?"

prakrit: "ते लक्खणस्स पुज,दहण सांवरि महारिदि,अह भाणिर्ड फ्या,सामरिसा. दुखमणाई"
english: "That worship of Lakshmana, That of the great sage Dhana Saveri, Is nothing short of a miracle, Samarisa. Suffering." ""

prakrit: "'अम्हे किं केण हीणा,गुणेहिं एयाण जाणामुयाण!,जेणं चिय परिहरिया,कमाहि विनेगरहियाहिं"
english: "" "Why are we so thin, We know so little about each other! For how long can we go on talking like this? We know nothing about people's faults."

prakrit: "प्याणि य. अमआणि य,सोयन्ता तत्थ वरकुमारा ते,भणिया रूवमईए,सुएण अहबुद्धिमन्तेण"
english: "Dear friend, It's too early to tell, The bridegroom is fast asleep, And her brother - in - law is frowning." ""

prakrit: "महिलाएं कए कहा,सोयह तुम्मेत्य दारुणं सबे,'होहह उवहसणिज्जा,इमाऎ चेट्टाऎ लोगस्स!"
english: "The women said to him," "So you are so handsome!" "Oh, what a disgusting woman!"

prakrit: "बजेण कयं कम्म,मुहं व असुहं व एत्थ संसारे,तं तेण पावियवं,तुम्मे मा कुणह परितावं"
english: "When he says:" "What have you to do with the world?" "With that word I take no pleasure in saying: You have no enemies."

prakrit: "एयाण अधुवाणं,कयलीथम्भ व साररहियाणं,भोगाण विससमाणं,करण मा दुक्खिया होह"
english: "Action is immaterial, Love is eternal, Compassion is infinite, Do not be sorrowful in what you do."

prakrit: "तायस्स मए अडे,ठिएण बालेण पोत्थयम्मि सुयं,वयणं जह मणुयभवो,भवाण सन्युत्तमो एसो"
english: "Though I am at rest, I sleep peacefully, Though I speak politely, I am completely at peace."

prakrit: "तं एवं इमं लदूध,माणुसजम्मं जयम्मि अइदुलहं,कुणह' परलोयहियय,निणवरधम्म पयत्तेणे"
english: "He and I are inseparable, I have conquered the human race, We have conquered it all, And he has destroyed it all."

prakrit: "दाणेण साहवाणं,भोगो लब्भइ तवेण देवत्तं,नाणेण सिद्धिसोक्वं,पाविजइ सीलसहिएणं"
english: "Charity begets charity, pleasure begets ecstasy, ignorance begets perfection, sin seals the soul."
