prakrit: "थुणिमण अहिच्छाए,विणिम्गमो जिणहराउ हणुवन्तो,पायक्खिणेइ मेरु,वन्दन्तो सिद्धभवणाई"
english: "Sweating is non - existent, Weeping is alive and well, Lying on the pyre Is lethal, Bowing is pure worship."

prakrit: "भरहं एन्तस्स तओ,कमेण अत्यंगओ दियंसनाहो,हणुवस्स सयलसेन्नं,ठियं च सुरदुन्दुहिगिरिम्म"
english: "My heart is overflowing with joy, My limbs are extremely thin, I can't breathe without water, And my life hangs in the balance."

prakrit: "सो तत्थ बहुलपक्खे,गयणयलं मारुई पलोयन्तो,पेच्छह घणझणनिहं,ताराम समन्तभो छन"
english: "He is so versatile, He can kill and plunder with his voice, He listens with rapt attention, And the stars are flat."

prakrit: "चिन्तेइ तो मणेणं,मह एवं चन्दविरहियं गयणं,न य सोहह कुलगयणं,तहा विणा पुरिसचन्देणं"
english: "To think is to think; to sing is to be free from the moon and the moon; it is not to sing of pleasure; without it, the moon is for men."

prakrit: "तं नस्थि नए सयले,ठाणं तिलतुसतिभागमेतं पि,जत्थ न कोलह मच्छ,सच्छन्दो सुरवरेहिं पि"
english: "Drink only until your nose is new, Drink until it has exhausted all your juices, And when it has run out of juice, Do nothing else."

prakrit: "नइ देवाण वि एसा,चवणावत्या उ हवइ सवाणं,अम्हारिसाण संपद,का एत्य कहा मणुसाणं!"
english: "No, not even God! For what good is a man But gold? For what use is wealth to us?"

prakrit: "वुमन्ति जत्य हत्थी,मत्ता गिरिसिहरसनिहा गल्या,तो एत्थ किं व भण्णइ!,पढम चिय अवहिया ससया"
english: "As long as the woman has hands, Mother - in - law has fallen asleep on top of her husband, so what do you mean by that?"

prakrit: "अन्नाणमोहिएणं,पश्चिन्दियवसगएण जीवेणं,तं नस्थि महादुक्खें,जं न'णुहूर्य भमन्तेणं"
english: "To love food, to live in harmony with the West, Is nothing like the great sorrows one experiences When one is deprived of it."

prakrit: "महिलाकरेणुयाणं,लुद्धो घरवारिनियलपडिबद्धो,अणुहवइ तत्थ दुक्खं,पुरिसगओ वम्महासत्तो"
english: "A woman's breasts, Wrapped around the skirt of her husband's skirt, Are like two bracelets fastened on the head of a man Suffering from illness."

prakrit: "पासेण पञ्जरेण य,बज्झन्ति चउप्पया य पक्खी य,इह जुवइपञ्जरेणं,बद्धा पुरिसा किलिस्सन्ति"
english: "A passage is like a cage, Buzzing with peacock feathers Or a bird in a cage: These are the feathers of a yoke: A bound man shoots at the nail."

prakrit: "किंपागफलसरिच्छा,भोगा पमुहे हवन्ति गुलमहुरा,ते चेव उ परिणामे,नायन्ति य विसमविससरिसा"
english: "When the raisins are ripe, The flowers bloom, And when they are empty They wither but never wither."

prakrit: "तं नाणिऊण एवं,असासयं अद्ध्वं चलं नीयं,अवहत्थिऊण भोगे,पबजं गिहिमो अजं"
english: "Take it easy, you fool, We're all in this together," he said, "But let's face it: It's still summer."

prakrit: "एयाणि य अन्नाणि य,परिचिन्तेन्तस्स पवणपुत्तस्स,रयणी कमेण झीणा,पभासयन्तो रवी उइओ"
english: "Anyone who knows me knows me, A wise man knows his friends, A generous woman knows how to make love, And a jealous God knows when she's angry."

prakrit: "पडिबुद्धो पवणसुओ,भणइ तओ परियणं पियाओ य,धम्माभिमुहस्स महं,निसुणेह परिप्फुडं वयणं"
english: "Fallen bow, Foolish girl, If you say so, You are only acting as a lover, My heart is set on purity, No need to speak nonsense."

prakrit: "वसिऊण सुइरकालं,माणुसनम्मम्मि बन्धवेहिं समें,अवसेण विप्पओगो,हवइ य मा अद्धिई कुणह"
english: "Dwell in good times, In time of human bondage, In the midst of wretchedness. Or else be warned: Don't be negligent."

prakrit: "ताहे भणन्ति हणुवं,महिलाओ महुरमम्मणगिराओ,मा मुञ्चसु नाह! तुम,अम्हे एत्थं असरणाओ"
english: "They say:" "Honey, ladies, please stop being so mean. Don't bother! You're the one who introduced us here." ""

prakrit: "भणइ तओ हणुवन्तो,परिहिण्डन्तस्स मज्झ संसारे,महिलाण सहस्साई,गयाई कालेण बहुयाई"
english: "You talk as if you were a buffalo, The world is your own, Women are your companions, The times are long past."

prakrit: "न य माया नेव पिया,न पुतदारा इहं मरन्तस्स,पुरिसस्स परिचाण,न कुणन्ति बहा कुणइ धम्मो"
english: "Love has no drink, son or daughter - in - law, it never dies, men are known by name, no one knows what dharma is."

prakrit: "तं एव अणुहवेडं,नस्यतिरिक्खेसु दारुणं दुक्खं,कह पुण नाणन्तो हं,करेमि महिलासु सह नेहं"
english: "Such is the nature of love, So cruel is the sorrow associated with loss, How can I forgive myself If I do not want to be with women?"

prakrit: "संसारम्मि अणन्ते,भोओ हइ जाइयव-मरणाणं,संपइ लएमि दिक्वं,मरिसह मे अविणयं सर्व"
english: "The cycle of rebirth is endless, Death is inevitable, I am bound to die, And with it all that is inevitable."

prakrit: "मेरुं पिव थिरगरुयं,हिययं नाऊण तस्स महिलाओ,ताहे कुणन्ति परमं,अकन्दं लोलनयणाओ"
english: "A woman's name is supreme, So are all women's dress, And so is all affection."

prakrit: "आसासिऊण धीरो,जुबईओ ठाविउ सुर्य रज्जे,निष्फिडइ विमाणाओ,विजाहरसुहडपरिकिण्णो"
english: "Be patient with hope, youth, The sun is setting, The roads are empty, And the roads are impassable."

prakrit: "मारुहिय पुरिसनाणं,नाणाविहरयणकिरणपज्जलियं,संपत्थिओ कमेणं,उज्जाणत्यं जिणाययणं"
english: "Brutal men, Illuminated by the rays of the moon, Earning wealth, Winning glory."

prakrit: "'काऊणं वन्दणय,जिणभवणे साहवं सुहनिविटें,नामेण धम्मरयणं,तं पणमइ मारुई तुट्ठो"
english: "" "One who embraces a wife finds happiness in what one conceives, One who practices dharma in name only - That woman is to be killed and torn to shreds."

prakrit: "काऊण य किहकर्म,हणुवो तो भणइ मुणिवरं एत्तो,भयवं! होहि गुरू मे,विहेहि संखेवो दिक्ख"
english: "Who is to say what kind of work he has done? The hunter will say:" "Daughter - in - law!" "But fear not! Behold the teacher in me."

prakrit: "अणुमनिओ गुरूणं,ताहे मउडं सकुण्डलाहरणं,देइ सुयस्स नरिन्दो,संजममग्गे कउच्छाहो"
english: "Your highness, That makes your face look even more beautiful. Please, Narindo, tell me something fishy About your breasts"

prakrit: "परिचत्तकामभोगो,कुणइ सिरे मारुई तो लोयं,हणुवन्तो पबइओ,पासे मुणिधम्मरयणस्स"
english: "Familiar lovers, When one touches a woman's head, it means the world to one's side. When the other is asleep, one knows the way around."

prakrit: "पन्नासा सत्त सया,संवेगपरायणा य नरवइणो,पवइया खायनसा,चारणसमणं पणमिऊणं"
english: "Fifty is seven hundred, passionate love is two hundred and ninety, love is one hundred and fifty, sacrifice is one thousand and one."

prakrit: "हणुयस्स महिलियाओ,सबाओ दइयसोगदुहियाओ,लच्छीमईऎ सयासे,बायाओ चेव समणीओ"
english: "Happy women, all compassionate, all kindness, all shyness, All flattery, All jealousy."

prakrit: "सिरिसेलो कम्मवणं,सबं झाणाणलेण दहिऊण तओ,केवललद्धाइसओ,संपत्तो विमलनिम्मलं परमपयं"
english: "Work hard, learn everything through penance, learn only what is difficult for you, For wealth is ultimate bliss."

prakrit: "इह पउमचरिए हणुनिव्वाणगमण नाम अठुत्तरसयं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "Praise be to the pious woman whose name is derived from her husband's name." ""

prakrit: "अह तत्य कुमाराणं,हणुयस्स य निसुणिऊण पवज,भणइ पउमो हसन्तो,कह भोगाणं विरचा ते"
english: "Ah, you naughty boy," said the wife, laughing, "Are you sure you don't want to sulk?" ""

prakrit: "सन्ते वि य परिचहउँ,भोगे गिण्हन्ति जे हु पबज्ज,नूणं ते गहगहिया,वाऊण विलहिया पुरिसा"
english: "Saints too are familiar, Those who suffer count the days. Those who are young Are heavy - bodied, Like men suffering from wind."

prakrit: "अहवा ताण न विज्जा,अस्थि सहोणा पओगमहकुसला,जेणुझिऊण भोगा,ठिया य तव-संजमाभिमुहा"
english: "Ah, the strain is nothing to do with knowledge; the bone has to endure, Like the axe on a young girl's forehead, To bear still is your lotus face."

prakrit: "एवं भोगसमुहे,तस्स निमग्गस्स रामदेवस्स,बुद्धी आसि भइनडा,सेणिय! उदएण कम्मस्स"
english: "And the pleasures, That is the essence of Ramdev, Wisdom comes from fear, Soldier! The dawn is karma." ""

prakrit: "अह अन्नया सुरिन्दो,सहाऎ सीहासणे सुहनिविट्ठो,चिट्ठइ महिद्विजुत्तो,देवसहस्सेहिं परिकियो"
english: "Oh! what a pleasure it is to hear your friend's name, To see your lover's face reflected in your husband's...

prakrit: "नाणालंकारधरो,घीरो बल-विरिय-तेयसंपन्नो,अह संकहागयं सो,वयणं चिय भणइ देविन्दो"
english: "Decorator of coins, Strong and powerful, Teeming with plenty, O God of love, He speaks through the mouth of the tongue."

prakrit: "देवत्तं इन्दत्तं,जस्स पसाएण पवरसिद्धत्तं,लब्भइ तं नमह सया,ससुरासुरवन्दियं अरह"
english: "Deity is Indatm, by what means one manifests the supreme principle, Namah sayah to that which appears to be, The arrah of the God of Love."

prakrit: "जेण इमो निस्सारो,संसाररिवू जगे अजियपुछो,संनमसंगाममुहे,पावो नाणासिणा निहओ"
english: "When the soul is lowly, When the worldly beings awake, Asking how they are, Facing courtship, They utter nonsense."

prakrit: "कन्दप्पतरनाद,कसायगाहाउलं भवावर्त,संसारसलिलनाहं,उत्तारइ जो अणं भवियं"
english: "The sound of the lute, The flourish of the butcher's hips, The churning of the worlds, Are the harbingers of what is to come."

prakrit: "जायस्स जस्स तइया,सुमेरुसिहरे सुरेहिं सबेहिं,जणिओ श्चिय अहिसेओ,खीरोयहिवारिकलसेहिं"
english: "That's just what you did, you handsome hussy, you nice bloke, you silly girl, Just like the waterlily in a cucumber salad."

prakrit: "मोहमलपडलछन्नं,पासण्डविवजियं नयविहीणं,नाणकिरणेहि सबं,पयासिय जेण तेलोकं"
english: "Disillusioned by love, Destroyed by separation, Newly wedded, Like two rays of the moon, Anxious because the world is oil"

prakrit: "सो जिणवरो सबभू,भाणु सिवो संकरो महादेवो,विण्हू हिरण्णगब्भो,महेसरो ईसरो रुद्दो"
english: "He is the Creator of all beings, The sage is the sage, The hunter is the great, The wolf is the deer, The buffalo is the buffalo, And the ox is the ox."

prakrit: "जो एवमाइएहिं,थुबइ नामेहिं देव-मणुएहिं,सो उसहो जगबन्धू,संसारुच्छेयणं कुणइ"
english: "One who is so called, so named, so deified, is called a juga bandhu; he performs the ablutions of the world."

prakrit: "बह इच्छह अणुहविउं,कल्लाणपरंपर निरवसेसं,तो पणमह उसहजिणं,सुर-असुरनमंसियं भयवं"
english: "If you want to enjoy yourself, you have to go through the ordeal of marriage, for that would be an act of treason."

prakrit: "जीवो अणाइनिहणो,सकम्मपवणाहओ परिभमन्तो,कह कह वि माणुसतं,पत्तो न कुणेइ जिणघमं"
english: "The soul is restless, The powers that be wander, How can anyone be more humane? But no one conquers life."

prakrit: "मिच्छादसणचरिय,कामर्ण जइ वि लहइ देवत्तं,तह वि य चुओ समाणो',मुझे इह माणुसे जम्मे"
english: "Wrong views, Whatever gods there are at work, They are the same as true ones. For me they are born of men."

prakrit: "निन्दइ जिणवरधम्म,मिच्छतो नाण-दसणविहूणो,सो हिण्डइ संसारे,दुक्खसहस्साई अणुहोन्तो"
english: "One who condemns jinavaradharma, one who deceives, One who renounces wealth, Is condemned to suffer in this world."

prakrit: "पेच्छह महिड्डियस्स वि,सुनाणजुत्तस्स माणुसे नम्मे,दुलहा उ हवइ बोही,किं पुण अन्नाणजुत्तस्स?"
english: "You fool, Don't you believe that a decent man is worthy of a good wife; It's the bridegroom who has to go. Are you really worthy of anything?"

prakrit: "इन्दो भणइ कया हइ,बोहिं लद्रूण माणुसे जम्मे,कम्मट्टविप्पमुक्को,परमपयं चेव पाविसं?"
english: "What is to be said for this? A boy is born of man, A girl is spoilt for choice, Love is supreme, And sin is ultimate."

prakrit: "तं भणइ सुरो एको,जइ तुझ वि एरिसी हवइ बुद्धी,अम्हारिसाण नियमा,माणुसजम्मे विमुज्झिहिइ"
english: "She speaks in one voice, And if you disagree with her she expresses her own," That's common sense, My own way of thinking, And I'm disgusted with humanity. "

prakrit: "इन्दं महिड्डिजुत्तं,बम्भविमाणे सुरं चुयसमाणं,रामं किं च न पेच्छह,माणुसभोगेसु अइमूढं?"
english: "The sky is red, The wind is blowing, The drums are swaying, You cannot see Rama, Are you stupid as a human being?"

prakrit: "तो भणइ देवराया,सवाण वि बन्धणाण दूरेणं,कढिणो उ नेहबन्धो,संसारत्थाण सत्ताणं"
english: "He says," "Deva ̄ ra ̄ ya, silence is the remover of ties." "Sometimes it is the bonds of love; in the world, power."

prakrit: "नियलेहि पूरिओ चिय,वच्चइ पुरिसो जहिच्छिय देसं,एक पि अङ्गुलमिणं,न जाइ घणनेहपडिबद्धो"
english: "Fill your eyes with tears, Like a man gone astray In this wretched land, Not a single finger stuck to the nail that stuck to your nail."

prakrit: "रामस्स निययकालं,सोमित्तो घणसिणेहमणुरत्तो,सो वि य तस्स विओगे,मुञ्चइ जोयं अइसमत्थो"
english: "Ram's time is finite, Whether he sleeps or sleeps We forget him, But our joy is bound to come."

prakrit: "सो त लच्छिनिकेयं,पउमो न य मुयइ नेहपडिबद्धो,कम्मस्स य उदएणं,कालं चिय नेइ मइमूढो"
english: "So take it easy, girl, don't look down your nose At what's coming up, For the moment I can't see you."

prakrit: "सुरवइमणियं नं तच्चमग्गाणुरत्तं,जिणवरगुणगहणं सुप्पसत्थं पवितं,सुणिय विबुहसङ्घा तं च इन्दं नमेउं,अइविमलसरोरा जन्ति सं सं निकेयं"
english: "Love is not something to be trifled with, It is something pure to be cherished, Like the sound of a trumpet When one is swooning over one's heart."

prakrit: "इइ पउमचरिए सकसकहाविहाणं नाम नवुत्तरसयं पव्यं समत्तं"
english: "Praise be to the pious woman, For with her virtuous husband She has perfected the virtues of renunciation."

prakrit: "अह तत्थ दोण्णि देवा,कुऊहली रयणचूल-मणिचूला,नेहपरिक्खणहेडं,समागया राम-केसोणं"
english: "Ah, then, both gods, The misty rice - spice beds, The bare heads of the fairies, The marriage of Rama and Kesona."

prakrit: "रामं सोऊण मयं,करिसियं कुणइ लक्खणो चेहूं?,रूसइ किं वा गच्छइ?,किं वा परिभासए वयणं?"
english: "Rama is dear to me, How can one characterize charisma?, Why go to Russia?, What is the use of swearing feigning?"

prakrit: "अहवा सोगाउलियं,पेच्छामो लक्खणस्स मुहयन्दं,ते एव कयालावा,साएयपुरि अह पविट्ठा"
english: "Ahava sugauliyam, we see the laconic expression on his face. So do the kayalavas. Our holiness is pure." ""

prakrit: "देवा रामस्स घरे,कुणन्ति मायाविणिम्मियं सदं,पउमो मओ मओ त्ति य,वरजुवईणं चिय विलावं"
english: "God is in the house of Rama, Deceit has taken root in my heart, My husband is dead, The bridegroom is making love And I am leaving him."

prakrit: "रामस्स मरणसई,सोउं अकन्दियं च जुबईहिं,लच्छीहरो विसण्णो,जंपइ ताहे इमं वयणं"
english: "Ramasa is about to die, The sun and the acacia are about to set, The hair on the head is limp, The speech is like that only."

prakrit: "हा किं व इमं वत्तं,एव भणन्तस्स तस्स सयराहं,वायाऎ,समं जीय,विणिग्गय लच्छिनिलयस्स"
english: "What is this matter with you? Speak thus, speak thus, Live at the same time: Behave as though you were alone." ""

prakrit: "कञ्चणथम्भनिसन्नो,अणिमोलियलोयणो तहावत्थो,लक्खिज्जइ चक्कहरो,लेप्पमओ इव विणिम्मविओ"
english: "Look at the grasshopper's snout, At the unbending lotus of the tree, At its prominent tip, Like a lapidary's bow."

prakrit: "दट्टण विगयजीयं,सोमित्तिं सुरवरा विसण्णमणा,निन्दन्ति य अप्पाणं,दोण्णि वि लज्जासमावन्ना"
english: "One is consumed by grief, The other by ecstasy, One is disgusted with oneself, Both are ashamed of one another."

prakrit: "लक्खणमरणनिहेणं,गाणं एत्थ पुरविहिएणं,जायं परितावयरं,अम्हाण मणं तु अप्पाणं"
english: "Praise be to nature, Sing here and there, Travel abroad, For we believe in you."

prakrit: "पच्छातात्रुम्हविया,जीयं दाऊण तस्स असमत्था,निन्दन्ता अप्पाणं,सोहम्मं पत्थिया देवा"
english: "Love based on prejudice, Life based on greed, Self based on condemnation, Beauty based on pretence."

prakrit: "असमिक्खियकारीणं,पुरिसाणं एत्थ पावहिययाणं,सयमेव कयं कम्मं,परितावयरं हवइ पच्छा"
english: "Non - activity, men here and there, Traveling on foot, Always doing something, Traveler's wind blowing from side to side."

prakrit: "सुरवरमायाऎ कयं,कम्मं अविजाणिऊण जुबईओ,पणयकुविओ ति काउं,सबाउ पई पसाएन्ति"
english: "What is the use of sulking? Aunt, If you don't know what you are doing, You cannot help it. Everything goes awry."

prakrit: "एक्का भणइ सुणिया,जोवणमयगवियाऎ पावाए,सामि! तुमं रोसविओ,कवणाए पावबुद्धोए"
english: "" "Listen to me, you naughty girl! You silly bitch! How can you fool around?"

prakrit: "पणयकलहम्मि सामिय!,भणिओ जं अविणयं तुम ताए,तं अम्ह खमसु संपइ,जंपसु महुराऎ बायाए"
english: "Foolish thing! Say what you have to say: I've run out of rice now. Tell me what you want to eat: It's the jasmine's fruit." ""

prakrit: "वरकमलकोमलङ्गी,अवग्र̥हइ कावि निभरसिणेहं,चलणेसु पडइ अन्ना,पत्तिय सामी! कउल्लावा"
english: "Bride - to - be, The lotus is blossoming, The crows are closing in, The roads are slipping, And the street is deserted!" ""

prakrit: "घेत्तण काइ वीणं,तस्स य गुणकित्तणं महुरसह,गायइ वरगन्धर्व,दइयम्स पसायजणणटुं"
english: "Whom to embrace: The lute, The melody of his virtuosity, The song of the thunderclap, The passionate song of affection"

prakrit: "अवगूहिऊण काई,चुम्बइ गण्डत्थलं मणभिरामं,जंपद पुणो पुणो चिय,अम्ह पहू! देहि उल्लावं"
english: "Don't be so naïve: It's the cow that kisses the cow - dung cakes, It is the elephant that scratches the ground, And again it is the tiger. Ah, my girl! Let the sun rise." ""

prakrit: "संपुण्णचन्दवयणा,कयनेवच्छा कडक्वविच्छोहं,नच्चइ कावि मणहरं,पियस्स पुरओ ससम्भावं"
english: "The whole moon is illuminated, I see a lot of mud, Sweat dripping down my cheeks, Poisonous flowers are everywhere."

prakrit: "एयाणि य अन्नाणि य,ताण कुणन्तीण चेट्टियसयाई,नायं निरत्ययं तं,जोवियरहियम्मि कन्तम्मि"
english: "Aunt, The quality of your breasts is extraordinary, They never sag like this, They last forever, Like the tendrils in a woman's hands."

prakrit: "चारियमुहाउ सुणिउं,तं वित्तन्तं ससंभमो रामो,तं लक्खणस्स भवणं,तूरन्तो चंब संपत्तो"
english: "Listen to my lover, He knows everything in between, Ram knows everything, There are millions of mansions; Suddenly wealth overtakes everything."

prakrit: "अन्तेउरं पविट्ठो,पच्छइ विगयप्पमं सिरीरहियं,लच्छीहरस्सा बयणं,पभायससिसन्निहायारं"
english: "Always keep yourself pure, Always be vigilant, Always speak kindly, Always carry your heart with you."

prakrit: "चिन्तेइ तो पउमो,केण वि कज्जेण मज्झ चकहरो,रुट्टो अब्भुट्टाणं,न देइ चिट्टइ अविणयङ्गो"
english: "If you think about it, Proud lady, Why should anyone bother about it? That would be foolish. But don't let it get to you." ""

prakrit: "विरलक्कमेसु गन्तुं,अग्घायइ मत्था घणसिणेहं,पउमो भगइ कणिटुं,कि मज्झ न देखि उलावं?"
english: "I'm off in a hurry, My face is smeared with red ghee, My husband is running away, Why don't you look at me?"

prakrit: "चिन्धेहि जाणि ऊण य,गयनीयं लकावणं नहावन्थं,तह वि य तं जीवन्तं,सो मन्नइ निम्भरसिणेहो"
english: "The mind knows wool, The guinea fowl is bathed in nectar, Yet it lives on; It trusts in the ruler of its kind."

prakrit: "न य हसइ नेव जपइ,न चेव उस्ससइ चेट्ठपरिहीणो,विट्ठो य तहावत्थी,सोमित्ती रामदेवेणं"
english: "He neither laughs nor chants, He is neither impetuous nor hasty. But when he is angry or agitated He is always sympathetic to Rama."

prakrit: "मुच्छागओ विउद्धो,परमो परिमुसइ तम्स अङ्गाई,नक्खक्खयं पि एकं,न य पेच्छइ मग्गमाणो वि"
english: "The mustache is twisted, The supreme pleasure is in that part of the body, The nail mark is still the same, One cannot see the inside of the head."

prakrit: "एयावत्थस्स तओ,वेज्जा सद्दाविऊण पउमाभो,कारावेइ तिगिच्छं,मन्तेहि तहोसहि पि"
english: "It's too late, Your wife is busy making love, Prison is fast approaching, I still think of you."

prakrit: "वेजगणेहिं जया सो,मन्तोसहिसंजुपहिं विविहेहिं,न य पडिवन्नो चेट्ट,तो गओ राहवो मुच्छ"
english: "Traveler, tell me what you want to do. If the roads are slippery And the roads impassable, Don't go."

prakrit: "कह कह वि समासत्थो,कुणइ,पलावं तओ य रोवन्तो,रामो समुनयणो,दिट्ठो जुबईहिं दीणमुद्रो"
english: "How can anyone explain it? It makes one cry when one is running away. Rama is the bringer of peace. The eyes of a young man are like diyas."

prakrit: "एयन्तरम्मि ताओ,सबाओ लपवणस्स महिलाओ,रोवन्ति विहलविम्भलमणाओ अङ्ग हणन्तीओ"
english: "At the same time Tao, all hiding women, Weeping and wailing and twisting their limbs."

prakrit: "हा नाह! हा महाजस!,उद्धेहि ससंभमाण अम्हाणं,पणिवइयवच्छल! तुम,उल्लावं देहि वियसन्तो"
english: "Oh no! Oh! Your Majesty! The arrows pierce my heart, Like the arrows of a bird! You, angry soul, are jealous." ""

prakrit: "हा दक्खिण्णगुणायर,तुज्झ सयासम्मि चिट्ठए पउमो,एयस्स किं व रुट्टो,न य उट्ठसि आसणवराओ"
english: "Hey, you sagacious girl, Why are you in such a hurry, Daughter - in - law? Don't get up." ""

prakrit: "'अस्थाणियागयाणं,सुहाणं नाह! दरिसणमणाणं,होऊण सोमचित्तो,आलावं देहि विमणाणं"
english: "" "Destitute traveler, not so much the pleasure! As the consciousness of others." "Being sombre, indeed, Is the renunciation of the soul."

prakrit: "हा नाह! किं न पेच्छसि,एवं अन्तेउरं विलवमाणं!,सोयाउरं च लोय,किं न निवारेसि दीणमुहं"
english: "Oh! no! Why don't you see? The cucumber is wilting, And the yokel is limping. Why not get rid of the daylily?" ""

prakrit: "सोयाउराहिं अहिय,जुवईहिं तत्थ रोवमाणीहिं,हिययं कस्स न कलुणं,जायं चिय गग्गरं कण्ठं?"
english: "The crows are here, The young men are there, And the women are weeping. To whom can I complain if I don't want to see my husband's neck?"

prakrit: "एवं रोवन्तीहिं,जुवईहिं हार-कडयमाईयं,खितुझिएहिं छन्ना,सबा रायङ्गणत्थाणी"
english: "And the weeping ones, The young men with necklaces, And the poor women with bracelets on their cheeks. All hail from the king of the field."

prakrit: "एयन्तरम्मि सोउं,कालगयं लक्खणं सुसंविग्गा,लवणं-'कुसा विरत्ता,भोगाणं तक्खणं धीरा"
english: "Nowadays one sleeps, Times are numbered, Happiness prevails, Love is consumed -" "Where is the detachment, There is the patience to suffer?" ""

prakrit: "चिन्तेन्ति जो सुरेसु वि,संगामे लक्षणो अनियपुरो,बल-विरियसमत्थो विहु,सो कह कालारिणा निहओ?"
english: "One who thinks clearly, When one's senses are imperfect, Is full of energy and detachment, How can one avoid wasting time?"

prakrit: "किं वा इमेण कीरइ,कयलीथम्भो छ साररहिएणं,देहेण दुक्ख-दोग्गइकरेण भोगाहिलासीणं?"
english: "What do you mean by this, That the whole body is burning with grief And the rest without?"

prakrit: "गन्भवसहीऎ भीया,पियर नमिऊण परमसंवेगा,दोण्णि बि महिन्दउदय,उज्जाणं पत्थिया धीरा"
english: "Fearful woman, When my husband returns home I will make love to him again. Both will rejoice, But bear with me when I return."

prakrit: "अमयरसनामधेयं,साई पडिवजिऊण ते सरणं,पबइया खायजसा,उत्तमगुणधारया जाया"
english: "In the guise of immortality, If Sai comes alive again, He will go away, For what use is a good stream of merit?"

prakrit: "एक्कत्तो सुयविरहो,मरणं च सहोयरस्स अन्नत्तो,घणसोयमहावत्त,रामो,दुक्खण्णवे पडिओ"
english: "One day there will be no more sleep, One day death, Another long life, One too many joys, Another too many sorrows."

prakrit: "रामस्स पिया पुत्ता,पुत्ताण उ वलहो य सोमित्ती,विरहे तस्स नराहिव!,रामो अइदुक्खिओ जाओ"
english: "Rama's dear son, My son, If you want to make love, Be nice to him, But in separation you will have to suffer!" ""

prakrit: "एवं कम्मनिओगे,संपत्ते सबसंगए बन्धुजणे,सोगं वेरग्गसमं,जायन्तिह विमलचेट्ठिया सप्पुरिसा"
english: "And you workmen, Wealth and relatives in all company, Grief and separation - Such are the pleasures of the Vimal Chettiya Sappurisa."

prakrit: "इइ परमचरिए लवणं-'कुसतवोवणपवेसविहाणं नाम दसुत्तरसयं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "This is the highest form of love -'Kushtavobhana, Pavesha, Vivaha, Nama, Dasutra, Pavasa, Samastha.'"" "

prakrit: "अह कालगयसमाणे,सेणिय! नारायणे जुगपहाणे,रामेण सयलरज,बन्धवनेहेण परिचत्तं"
english: "Oh, the passage of time! An army of warriors! War is waged by the Naryanas, love is practiced by the Ramas, Friendship is cherished by all." ""

prakrit: "लच्छोहरस्स देह,सुरहिसुगन्धं सहायओ मउयं,जीएण वि परिमुक्त,न मुयह परमो सिणेहेणं"
english: "A luxuriant body, a fragrant scent, Help me to breathe, For though I live, I am free from illness; No, my love is supreme."

prakrit: "अग्घायइ परिचुम्बइ,ठवेइ अके पुणो फुसइ अङ्गं,रुयइ महासोगाणलसंतत्तो राहवो अहियं"
english: "I will never forget how she kissed me again, Stretched her limbs in a sweat, Cryed out loud And wept bitterly."

prakrit: "हा कह मोत्तण मए,एक्कागि दुक्खसागरनिमग्गं,अहिलससि वच्छ! गन्तुं,सिणेहरहिओ इव निरुतं"
english: "Oh! my poor thing! This is the path that leads to the ocean of sorrow. Stop being so touchy! It's just the way things are." ""

prakrit: "उठेहि देव! तुरियं,तवोवणं मज्झ पत्थिया पुत्ता,जाव न वि नन्ति दूर,ताव य आणेहि गन्तूणं"
english: "Get up! My son, God! It's just the way you walk. Don't go too far, for it could be anything." ""

prakrit: "धीर! तुमे रहियाओ,अइगाढं दुक्खियाओ महिलाओ,लोलन्ति धरणिवटे,कलुणपला कुणन्तीओ"
english: "Be patient! You remain, you miserly women, Struggling earthworms, People of unsound mind." ""

prakrit: "वियलियकुण्डलहार,चूडामणिमेहलाईयं एयं,जुवइजणं न निवारसि,वच्छ्य! अहियं विलवमाणं"
english: "Valiyakundalhar, chudamani mehlaiyam aye, don't stop the young man. Look! It's like making a bow." ""

prakrit: "उद्देहि सयणवच्छल!,वाया मे देहि विलवमाणम्स,किं व अकारणकुविओ,हरसि मुहं दोसरहियस्स?"
english: "In other words:" "Deer - eyed girl!" "With these empty words I mutter," "What is the use of laughing at someone else's face?" ""

prakrit: "न तहा दहइ निदाहो,दिवायरो हुयवहो व पजलिओ,नह दहइ निरवसेस,देहं एकोयरविओगो"
english: "There is no burning fire, There are no flames, No puzzles. The fire does not burn, It only destroys the body."

prakrit: "किं वा करेमि वच्छय!? कत्तो वच्चामि हइ तुमे रहिओ?,ठाणं पेच्छामि न तं,निधाणं जत्थ र लहामि"
english: "What do you want me to do? Where am I supposed to go? You stay? I won't go anywhere. I'll go somewhere else." ""

prakrit: "हा वच्छ! मुश्चसु इमं,कोवं सोमो य होहि संखवं,संपइ अणगाराणं,वट्टइ वेला महरिसीणं"
english: "" "Hey, you stag! Be angry with yourself, be angry, be suspicious, be careful not to fall into trouble, for the wind is blowing through the sky."

prakrit: "अत्थाओ दिवसयरो,लच्छीहर! किं न पेच्छसि इमाई,मउलन्ति कुवलयाई,वियसन्ति य कुमुयसण्डाई?"
english: "Ah, the long - eyed girl! Don't you see Imai, the cool - nasty girl? It's Kumusandai who is angry?" ""

prakrit: "अस्थरह लहुँ सेजं,काऊण भुयन्तरम्मि सोमित्ति,सेवामि जेण निदं,परिवज्जियससवावारो"
english: "The unbending lotus is green, The cow on the ground is lukewarm, The servant sleeps soundly, The traveler is full of trouble."

prakrit: "संपुण्णचन्दसरिसं,आसि तुमं अइमणोहरं वयणं,कजण कंण सुपुरिस!,संपइ विगयप्पभं नायं?"
english: "" "A full moon, Please, come on, you impudent wretch. How can anyone be too nice! When the end has come, Not so cleverly?"

prakrit: "नं तुज्झ हिययइटुं,दवं संपाययामि तं सर्व,सबावारमणहरं,काऊण मुह समुल्लवसु"
english: "I won't hurt you, I'll forgive you, Every one of you. Whose face should I kiss?"

prakrit: "मुश्च विसायं सुपुरिस!,अम्हं चिय खेयरा अइविरुद्धा,सबे वि आगया वि हु,घेत्तुमणा कोसलं कुद्धा"
english: "Foolish girl! It's my fault I'm so anxious. Everything's against me Now That I've reached my goal." ""

prakrit: "महयं पि सत्तुसेन्नं,जिणयन्तो जो इमेण चक्केणं,सो कह सहसि परिभवं,कयन्त चक्कस्स धीर तुमं"
english: "I am satisfied, my dear, with the victory you have won by dint of this trickery. How can you put up with it? Your patience is inexhaustible."

prakrit: "सुन्दर! विमुञ्च निदं,वोलीणा सबरी रवी उइओ,देहं पसाहिऊणं,चिसु अस्थाणमझगओ"
english: "Beautiful! Just go to sleep! It's raining heavily. Once you've done that, Your body will start to break down. The tears will stop flowing." ""

prakrit: "सबो वि' य पुहइनणो,समागओ तुझ सन्नियासम्मि,गुरुभत्त! मित्तवच्छल!,एयस्स करेहि माणत्थं"
english: "Everyone, please, gather around you, you sage! Friendship! This is how the mind works." ""

prakrit: "निययं तु सुप्पहायं,जिणाण लोगावलोगदरिसीणं,भवियपउमाण वि पुणो,नायं मुणिसुबओ सरणं"
english: "Destiny favors you, Life favors those who suffer it, And love finds a place in the world. No, I'm not turning my back on you."

prakrit: "वच्छ! तुमे चिरसइए,सिढिलायइ जिणहरेसु संगीयं,समणा जणेण समय,संपत्ता चेव उबेयं"
english: "You bastard! You'll last a long time, You won't last forever, Friendship takes its toll, Time flies when one is alone, Wealth grows everywhere."

prakrit: "जाव कयन्तेण सम,परमो रामस्स बट्टइ विवाओ,रयणकलेबरखन्धो,ताव जडाऊ समणुपत्तो"
english: "Jawa kyenten sama, parama ramasa batai vivaao, rayanakalebara khandho, taav jadau samanupaato."

prakrit: "दहण अभिमुहं तं,हलाउहो भणइ केण कज्जेणं,एयं कलेवरं चिंय,मइमूढो वहसि खन्धेणं?"
english: "I am about to burn, What makes you think you're hot? Who cares? It scares the hell out of you. It makes you shiver." ""

prakrit: "भणिओ सुरेण पउमो,तुमं पि पाणेसु वज्जियं मडयं,वहसि अविवेगवन्तो,अहिययर बालबुद्धीओ"
english: "Tell me, fair lady, You're the only one who knows how to play the flute. You, stupid girl, Are so naïve As to be of little use."

prakrit: "वालग्गकोडिमेतं,दोसं पेच्छसि परस्स अइसिग्धं,मन्दरमेत्तं पि तुम,न य पेच्छसि अत्तणो दोसं"
english: "You see the fault in each other's faults, Not so much in your faults as in your own."

prakrit: "दट्टण तुमे परमा,मह पीई संपयं समणुजाया,सरिसा सरिसेसु सया,रज्जन्ति सुई जणे एसा"
english: "Because you are supreme, my dear, all this wealth should be compared to one another. Always in succession, O needlewoman, is one such person."

prakrit: "काऊण मए पुरओ,जणम्मि सबाण बालबुद्धीणं,पुवपिसायाण तुम,राया मोहं उवगयाणं"
english: "Whom are you looking out for? My poor boy, You childish girl, I've no time for gossip."

prakrit: "अम्हे मोहवसगया,दोणि वि उम्मत्तयं वयं काउं,परिहिण्डामो वसुहं,कुणमाणा गहिलियं लोयं"
english: "We are infatuated, The two converge in our hearts, The other is beyond our reach, Quality is supreme in the world."

prakrit: "एवं भणियं सुणिउ,पसिढिलभावं च उवगए मोहे,सुमरइ गुरुवयणं सो,पउमो लज्जासमावन्नो"
english: "And listen to my speech; my dear, You have grown so cool. Please, teacher, don't be so rash: I'm embarrassed." ""

prakrit: "ववगयमोहघणो सो,पडियोहणविमलकिरणसंजुत्तो,चन्दो छ सरयकाले,छज्जइ पउमो दढधिईओ"
english: "Loud with the wind, Like the rays of the crescent moon As if they were clouds, The moon is in the horizon, Like a banner proclaiming victory."

prakrit: "असणाइएण व जहा,लद्धं चिय भोयणं "हिययइटुं,ताहाघत्थेण सरं,दि८ पिव सलिलपंडिपुण्णं"
english: "Where there is silence, There is strife, And there is anger," Said the headman, Touching him with the arrow of his wife's bow. "

prakrit: "लद्धं महोसह पिव,अच्चन्तं वाहिपीडियतणूण,एव पउमेण सरिय,गुरुवयणं चेव दुक्खेणं"
english: "Fight with your lover, Teach with your wife, Make him angry, And forgive him if he offends you."

prakrit: "पडिबुद्धो नरवसहो,नाओ पप्फुल्लकमलदलनयणो,चिन्तेइ'ह उत्तिण्णो,अयं मोहन्धकूवाओ"
english: "Foolish man, Don't be so naïve As to think that the lotus is swollen." "Hey there, you fool!" ""

prakrit: "विमलं चिय संजाय,तस्स मणं गहियधम्मपरमत्थं,मोहमलपडलमुकं,नजइ सरण व रविबिम्बं"
english: "Vimala is like a mirror, her mind is deep, her body like the pinnacle of delusion, her face like a rainbow, Not visible to the naked eye."

prakrit: "अन्नं भवन्तरं पिव,संपत्तो विमलमाणसो रामो,चिन्तेऊणाढतो,संसारठिई सुसंविग्गो"
english: "After food there is drink, after wealth there is longing, For Rama, the one who ponders, Shows goodwill in the world."

prakrit: "परिहिण्डन्तेण मया,संसारे कह वि माणुसं नम्मं,उद्धं अलद्धपुष,मूढो चिय जाणमाणो हइं"
english: "I am what I am because of my parents, We are what we are as humans in the world, We rise as adults, We fall as fools."

prakrit: "लब्भन्ति कलताई,संसारे बन्धवा य णेयविहा,एका निणवरविहिया,नवरं चिय दुलहा बोही"
english: "They look like potsherds, Like relatives from the world without. One after the other is married, Like the bridegroom's daughter at the wedding."

prakrit: "एवं पडिबुद्ध त,देवा नाऊण अप्पणो रिद्धिं,दावेन्ति हरिसियमणा,विम्यजणणिं तिहुयणम्मि"
english: "And when bound together, The gods name themselves Riddhim, The right one begets Harisiyamana, The wrong one deceives people."

prakrit: "पवणो सुरहिसुयन्धो,नाणविमाणेसु छाइयं गयणं,सुरजुवईसु मणहरं,गीयं वरवीणमहुरसरं"
english: "The wind is pleasant, The shadows on the horizon are soothing, The sun rises soothingly, The song is soothing Like the wail of a rainbow."

prakrit: "एयन्तरम्मि देवा,दोणि वि पुच्छन्ति तत्थ रहुणाहं,कह तुज्झ नरवराहिब!,सुहेण दियहा' बइकन्ता"
english: "Dear god, The two of you keep on asking me," "How are you going to survive?" "Happy days!"

prakrit: "तो भणइ सीरधारी,कत्तो कुसलं महं अपुण्णस्स,निययं तु ताण कुसलं,बाण दढा निणवरे भत्ती"
english: "So tell me, headman, How can I help you If you refuse to bow down? It's only because you persist in your anger That I dare shoot an arrow"

prakrit: "पुच्छामि फुडं साहह,के तुम्मे सोमदंसणसहावा!,केणेव कारणेणं,जणियं च विचेट्ठियं एय:"
english: "I beg of you, my dear, Is it because you suffer from fever, Because you are so distracted?"

prakrit: "तत्तो 'बडाउदेवो,जपह नाणासि दण्डयारण्णे,मुणिदरिसणेण तइया,गिद्धो तुभं समल्लीणो"
english: "There you are, great god, Jumping up and down, Bowing your head And looking down your nose, Vulture embracing you." ""

prakrit: "घरिणीऎ तुज्झ नरवइ!,अणुएण य लालिओ चिरं कालं,सीयाऎ हरणसमए,निहओ चिय रक्खसिन्देणं"
english: "Housewife, you're a maniac! That's why the lilies last so long. It's only the deer that survive, Not the elephant that survives." ""

prakrit: "तस्स मरन्तस्स तुमे,महिलाविरहाउलेण वि किवाए,दिन्नो य नमोकारो,पञ्चमहापुरिससंजुत्तो"
english: "There you are, dying man, How can you treat a woman with so much humiliation? It's only because she refused to bow before you That the five great vows are annulled."

prakrit: "कालगओ माहिन्दे,सामिय! सो हं सुरो समुष्पन्नो,तुज्झ पसाएण पहू!,परमिड्डि चेव संपत्तो"
english: "Time will tell, Mahinde, Samiya! So I will sort things out for you, Pahu, as you please! Anything is possible with wealth." ""

prakrit: "तिरियभवदुक्खिएणं,बं सुरसोक्खं मए समणुपतं,तं चेव तुमं राहव!,पम्हुट्ठो एत्तियं कालं"
english: "I will never forget how you made me feel When I tried to kiss your lips." "So you must have been laughing all this time!"

prakrit: "तुज्झ'वसाणे राहव!,अकयग्यो हइ इहागओ पायो,किर किंचि थेवयं पि य,करेमि एयं तु उवयारं"
english: "Your residence is Rahav, I have already reached here, so how can I help you? I will do as you say." ""

prakrit: "तं भणइ कयन्तसुरो,इहासि सेणावई अहं तुझं,नामेग कयन्तमुहो,सो सुरपवरो समुप्पन्नो"
english: "She says," "Kyantasura, I am yours in this embrace." "I dare not say so."

prakrit: "सामिय! देहाणत्ति,दवं चं उत्तमं तिहुयणम्मि,तं तुज्झ संपइ पहू!,सबं तु करेमि साहीणं"
english: "Samiya! Heart, You have shown me the best of kindness, So bear with me all your faults! I will bear with you all." ""

prakrit: "रामो भणइ रिखुबलं,भग्गं तुम्मेहि बोहिओ अहयं,दिवा कल्लाणंमुहा,एयं चिय किन्न पजतं?"
english: "Rama says," "Lord, tell me, Your face is smeared with red ghee." "What do you mean, The lamp is burning bright?"

prakrit: "तं मासिऊण राम,निययं संपस्थिया सुरा ठाणं,भुनन्ति उत्तमसुह,जिणवरधम्माणुभावेणं"
english: "Praise be to him, Ram, Destroyed by fate, In thrall to pleasure, For the dharma of renunciation prevails."

prakrit: "पेयविभवेण एतो,सकारेऊण लक्खणं रामो,पुहईऎ पालणढे,सिग्धं चिय भणइ सत्तुग्धं"
english: "Such is the diversity of drinks; Rama characterizes what is drunk; The husband rears his head; Straightforward people speak plainly."

prakrit: "बच्छ। तुम सयलमिणं,भुञ्जसु रजं नराहिवसमग्गो,संसारगमणभोओ,पविसामि तवोवणं अहयं"
english: "My boy, You're a simpleton. My lord, Don't spoil the dish of rice, For fear of the world, I promise you this." ""

prakrit: "सत्तुग्यो भणइ तओ,अलाहि रज्जेण दोग्गइकरेणं,संपइ मोत्तण तुमे,देव! गई नस्थि मे अन्ना"
english: "Speak the truth, speak falsehood, Or else anger will overtake you, For death is yours, O god! Gone is the anger I feel in my heart."

prakrit: "न कामभोगा न य बन्धुवग्गा,न चेव अत्थो न बलं पभूयं,कुन्ति ताणं सरणं च लोए,नहा सुचिण्णो विमलो हु धम्मो"
english: "There is neither sex nor friendship, There are neither attachments nor strength. But to be honest, In this world there is no such thing as true love. Therefore, a wise person's dharma is simple."

prakrit: "इइ पउमचरिए कल्लाणमित्तदेवागमणं नाम तेरसुत्तरसयं पव्वं समत्तं"
english: "Praise be to the pious woman whose name is Terasutra and whose power is supreme."

prakrit: "परलोगनिच्छियमणं,सत्तुग्धं जाणिऊणं पउमाभो,पेच्छइ आसन्नत्थं,अणङ्गलवणस्स अङ्गरुहं"
english: "Reflecting on the past, Knowing what is true And what is not, One sees the meaning in the present: The limbs of unmanly love."

prakrit: "तं ठवइ कुमारवरं संमत्तवसुहाहिवं निययरज्जे,रामो विरत्तभोगो,आउच्छइ परियणं ताहे"
english: "He is waiting for Kumaravarma, For his return, For Rama's farewell Supper, Which is about to begin." ""

prakrit: "एत्तो बिहीसणो वि य,सुभूसणं नन्दणं निययरज्जे,ठावेइ अङ्गयं पि य,सदेसणाहं तु सुग्गीवो"
english: "Such a cruel man, Such a handsome man, Decorated with pleasantries, With limbs as thin as your own, You will surely prosper."

prakrit: "एवं अन्ने वि भडा,मणुया विज्जाहरा य पुत्ताणं,दाऊण निययरज्जं,पउमेण समं सुसंविग्गा"
english: "And still others run away, People who know how to reason, And young men who know what to do: Love's equal to prosperity."

prakrit: "पउमो संविम्गमणो,सेट्टि तत्थागय अरहदास,पुच्छइ स सावय! कुसलं,सबालबुद्धस्स सङ्घस्स"
english: "Proud lady, The arrow is about to fly, And so is Arhadasa. Ask him how he is! It's the bush, The confederacy of the wise." ""

prakrit: "तो भणइ अरहदासो',सामि! तुमे दुक्खिए जणो सबो,दुक्खं चेव पवनी,तह चेव विसेसओ सङ्घो"
english: "So he says," "O arhadasa, Sami! You are a sorrowful person, All sorrow is Pavani, And all detachment is Sangho." ""

prakrit: "भणियं च सावएणं,सामिय! मुणिसुवयस्स वसम्मि,संपइ चारणसमणो,इहागओ सुबओ नामं"
english: "The field is deserted, Samia! The spring is sagging, The pasture is exhausted, Such is the name of the town." ""

prakrit: "सुणिऊण वयणमेय,जणियमहाभावपुलहयसरीरो,रामो मुणिस्स पास,गओ बहुसुहडपरिकिण्णो"
english: "Listen to me, Vayanmayee, you won't find it difficult to conceal your feelings. Ram went to the sage. Go, you handsome man." ""

prakrit: "समणसहस्सपरिमियं,महामुणिं पेच्छिऊण पउमाभो,पणमइ ससंभममणो,तिक्खुत्तपयाहिणावत्तं"
english: "Consciousness is supreme, When looking at the great moon one sees beauty, When considering everything one does, One sees sharp fire."

prakrit: "विजाहरा य मणुया,कुणन्ति परमं तु तत्थ महिमाणे,धय-तोरणमाईय,बहुतूरसहस्ससंदालं"
english: "Praise be to the great man, For you are the supreme being, Like a banner fluttering on the wind, With a banner that says" "Long live the brave." ""

prakrit: "गमिऊण तत्थ स्यणि,दिक्सयरे उग्गए महाभागो,रामो भणइ मुणिवरं,भयवं! इच्छामि पबहउं"
english: "" "Go, tell me, There must be something very special going on up there." "Rama replies," "Without hesitation, I'm afraid! I wish I could come."

prakrit: "अणुमन्निओ य गुरुणा,पयाहिणं कुणइ मुणिवर रामो,उप्पन्नबोहिलाभो,संवेगपरायणो' धीरो"
english: "Every man is a teacher; The sage Rama is the one who disciplines the learned; He is the wise one who instructs the wise." ""

prakrit: "छेत्तण मोहं पास,संचुण्णेऊण नेहनियलाई,ताहे मुञ्चइ पउमो,मउडाइं भूसणवराई"
english: "Try to hide your feelings, Try to conceal them with a soft brush, Then you'll meet your lover, Who is fond of kissing you."

prakrit: "काऊण तत्थ घोरो,उववासं कमलकोमलकरहिं,उप्पाडइ निययसिरे,केसे वरकुसुमसुसुयन्धे"
english: "Whom are you looking out for? A lotus blossoms everywhere. You look down at the horizon. How long has it been since the sun was up?"

prakrit: "वामप्पासठियस्स उ,सह स्यहरणेण दाउ सामइयं,पवाविओ य पउमो,सुषयनामेण समणेणं"
english: "Vamappasathiyasu, saath saath shayad daath samayyam, pavaviyo ya paumom, samanem by the name of Sushayana."

prakrit: "पञ्चमहत्बयकलिओ,पञ्चसु समिईसु चेव आउत्तो,गुत्तीसु तीसु गुत्तो,बारसतवधारओ धीरो"
english: "He who has five great vows, Who has five good vows, Comes first among all, And who has three bad vows, Is the braver than the wind."

prakrit: "मुक्का य कुसुमवुट्ठी,देवेहि य दुन्दुही नहे पहया,पवणो य सुरहिगन्धो,पडुपडहरवो य संजणिओ"
english: "A kiss is kissable, a hug is sweet, a kiss is salutary, There is no grief in marriage, The wind is pleasant, The festival is joyful."

prakrit: "मोत्तण रायलच्छि,निययपए ठाविउं सुर्य जेहूँ,सत्तुग्यो पबइओ,इन्दियसत्तू निणिय सबे"
english: "I am about to die, The sun will be up soon, Travelers will come, India's waters will last a lifetime."

prakrit: "राया बिहीसणो वि य,सुग्गीवो नरवई नलो नीलो,चन्दनहो गम्भीरो,विराहिओ चेव दढसत्तो"
english: "Though the sky is dark, When the rivers are fragrant, The rivers are blue, The sandalwood is vigorous, And when they are free They are extremely sharp."

prakrit: "एए अन्ने य बहू,दणुइन्दा नरवई य पवइया,रामेण सह महप्पा,संखाए सोलस सहस्सा"
english: "Oh! my daughter - in - law! Being both pregnant and giving birth Is a great pleasure for me, Lord Ram included." ""

prakrit: "जुबईण सहस्साई,तीसं सत्तुत्तराई तद्दिवसं,पबज्जमुवगयाई,सिरिमइअज्जाऎ पासम्मि"
english: "A long tongue is helpful, a sharp arrow is powerful, a loud trumpet is sung, And a bow is passed at the right time."

prakrit: "काऊण य पबज्ज,सहि वासाई मुबयसयासे,तो कुणइ मुणिवरो सो,एक्ल्लविहारपरिकम्मं"
english: "Somebody is clever, A fellow traveler is greedy, So who is a sage? He alone knows what it is to be widowed."

prakrit: "विविहाभिम्गहधारी,पुबक्सुएण भावियमईओ,तवभावणाइयाओ,भावेडे भावणाओ य"
english: "Beings of different hues, beings destined to prosper, Beings endowed with loving - kindness, Are the bearers of good will."

prakrit: "मह निग्गओ मुणी सो,गुरूण अणुमोइओ पउमनाहो,पडिवनो य विहार,एक्काई सत्तभयरहिओ"
english: "My lord, You are a fool, My master is a coward, My husband is a poor man, I live in poverty, And I fear the wrongs of others."

prakrit: "गिरिकन्दरट्टियस्स य,रयणीए तोऎ तस्स उप्पन्न,पउमम्स अवहिनाण,सहसा झाणेकचित्तस्स"
english: "If you want to climb a mountain, yawn, Then throw yourself on top of it, For suddenly you lose your mind."

prakrit: "अवहिविसरण ताहे,सुमरइ लच्छीहरं पउमणाहो,अवियण्हकामभोगं,नरयावत्थं च दुक्खत्तं"
english: "Non - immersion is the way out, The pleasures of luxury and love, The pleasure of unrequited love, And sorrow in the midst of misery."

prakrit: "संयमेग कुमारत्ते,तिष्णेव संयाणि मण्डलित्ते य,चत्तालीस य विजए,जस्स उ संवच्छरो'तीया"
english: "Daughter of restraint, Tishneva, Restraint, Forty-seven triumphs: That's how she described herself." ""
