prakrit: "मारुअ-भरन्त-कन्दर-गारव-परिमन्थरं वलग्गन्ति,वेअ-विअसन्त-पाअव-णूमिअ-कडअन्तरा गिरिणो"
english: "Bees circle around in circles, Trees bend at the seams, Clouds grow thicker, And grass grows thinner."

prakrit: "आरोहन्ति णह-अलं तारुज्जोइअ-गुहा-मुहाहोआ,अण्णोण्ण-पेहुणाणिल-हीरन्त-विसण्ठुलासेला"
english: "Ascending arrows pierce the skin of the face, Guha - the mouth, Anonn - the tongue - the penis - the heart - the sinews." ""

prakrit: "उप्पअणोहुर-पीलिअ-सरीर-मौलन्त-विवर-णिव्वूढा,उद्धं णिबद्ध-वेआ णिज्झर-धाराओ णिवडन्ति"
english: "Red - faced - Yellow - bodied - bristling - broad - sunken, bound - held high - They quench the streams of the waterfall"

prakrit: "मुक्क-तुसारासारंलीलुड्डीणम्मितुहिण-सेलम्मि,वेवइ अच्छक्कागअ-हिमकाल-किलामिओ लोओ"
english: "Mukka - Tussar - Like a flock of parrots - Silly girl, It's getting dark By the way - The winter months - Long live the jasmine"

prakrit: "उप्पअण-रुद्ध-गअणा दूरुग्गम-णिव्वडन्त-णह-लहुआ,सूएन्ति मूल-मडहं खमग्ग-विअडं व धरणि-हरा"
english: "Lying low, Rooted down, Gone - Far - reaching, Straight - draining, Root - dead, Slipping - Vivid, Standing - Green."

prakrit: "दूरअरं उप्पइआ अद्ध-वहत्थमिअ-णिज्झर-तुसारा,दीसन्ति विअड-लहुआ पणट्ठ-काया महा-गिरिणो"
english: "A half - blown waterfall is rising in the distance, A torrent of rain clouds is passing by, And a big lake is brewing." ""

prakrit: "जं जं समुप्पअन्ता मुअन्ति सेला णहङ्गणुद्देसं,तं तं पुञ्जिअ-बहलॊ भरेइ मुहलुब्भडो पवणो"
english: "Whatever the crowd Seems to be pulling at one's heels, That very moment the wind fills the courtyard with capital." ""

prakrit: "उत्पतनावाङ्मुखपीडितशरीरमुकुलीभवद्विवरनिर्व्यूढाः,ऊर्ध्वं निबद्धवेगा निर्झरधारा निपतन्ति"
english: "On the eve of his return The stream of tears Pours down from his face, Cutting through the rough surface of his face." ""

prakrit: "पासोसरन्त-तल-मग्ग-घडिअ-कम-लहुअ-मासल-च्छाया,उड्डन्ति पक्ख-विअलिअ-दिग्गअ-दाणॊज्झरा गिरिणो"
english: "A flock of parrots, Flying from side to side, Fluttering from bottom to tip, Climbed from foot to foot, Lips thick with flesh, Like a grasshopper with teeth"

prakrit: "एन्तिगअणोसरन्तेसु कह वि उम्मुह-समीर-हीरन्ता,थोउप्पअइ-णिविट्ठा सेलेसु विहङ्ग-सङ्घाआ"
english: "Antiga anosrantesu kahin bhi ummuh-sameer-hiranta, thuppayi-nivittha selesu vihanga-sanggha"

prakrit: "ओअरण-विसेसिज्जन्त-रवि-अरालोअ-चञ्चल-च्छाया,दीसन्ति पविरलाओ ववेउद्ध-दला वणालीओ"
english: "Trembling clouds, Scorched earth, Clouds hovering over the horizon, Venerable monsters hovering above the horizon."

prakrit: "इअ जेण णहङ्गण-गोअराण खुडिआओ पक्ख-मालाओ,सेलाण सो वि तं चिन्तिऊण अन्दोलइ महिन्दो"
english: "Like the plowman's pen, Like the shepherd's cudgel, Like a garland on the side of a fence, So does the weeping buffalo."

prakrit: "अणुधारंसन्दट्टॆभ-मॊत्तिए तुह असिम्मि सच्चविआ,लीला-दर-दाविअ-हार-मॆत्त-पअडव्व जय-लच्छी"
english: "Aunt, You're absolutely right: Lila, Dar, Dabi, Haar, Met, Padwa, Jai, Lacchhi!"

prakrit: "अयसेण रिऊण करम्बिआओ कित्तीओ तुहधरिज्जन्ति,कुवलय-दल-संवलिआ मालइ-मालाओ व दिसाहिं"
english: "How much longer can you go on weeping Because you refuse to weep? The lotuses, the garlands, the decks, Are covered all over with tears."

prakrit: "पडिबद्धंणवरतुमे णरिन्द-चक्कं पआव-विअडं पि,गह-वलयमणुच्छित्तॆ धुवॆ व्व परिअत्तइ णरिन्द"
english: "While you are standing there Drenched with sweat, Scorched with soot, Wretched with sweat streaming down her cheeks, She is completely naked."

prakrit: "समरम्मि करेविप्फुरइ णवर ऎक्को असी तुह च्चेअ,जो पावइ णिअ-जस-सोम-मण्डले लञ्छण-च्छायं"
english: "We will do our best, for we owe it to you alone, Who, for all our affection, have shown us the characteristic trait of kindness."

prakrit: "सविमो अणज्जुणमिमंअमहिन्दमवासुइं च अप्पाणं,सेवञ्जलि-दंसण-गुण-कहासुतुहजो ण पज्जत्तो"
english: "Selfishness, ignorance, humility, and selfishness are the attributes of a man who knows nothing."

prakrit: "णिवडइ पडण-समुच्छलिअ-जलण-कण-जाल-जडिल-धारग्गो,विमुह-गह-मण्डलाअट्टिऒ व्व खग्गो तुह रिऊसु"
english: "The stream is slipping, The cluster is burning, The net is webbed, The river is in spate, The lake is vast, The mandala is endless And so is your husband."

prakrit: "तुह पडिवक्खेसु भया कत्थ वि अविलासमावसन्तेसु,आरोवेइ ण काअर-गणणाऎ व चावमसमसरो"
english: "How afraid you must be of your neighbor, Who, being absent, Stands by you in need of your help And does not care what you have to say."

prakrit: "सुहडाअट्टिअ-कोअण्ड-चण्ड-रव-दारुणे रणे तं सि,परिरद्धॊ भीयाऎ व सहसा गाढं जय-सिरीए"
english: "In a forest of sweetwood - acacia - moon - red grass - you will meet him, Protected by fear - Suddenly the streets will resound with joy."

prakrit: "सोहइ समागमेसुं अहिअ-पआव-प्पईव-मालासु,वावारेन्ती कण्णुप्पलं व खग्गं तु जय-लच्छी"
english: "May you rejoice in pleasant encounters, May your cheeks, Eyes, foreheads, and foreheads Be joyful."

prakrit: "जंइअरोवद्दव-विद्दुआ विमज्जन्तितुह रिऊ णाह,बहु-रूवा ता धाराओ णवर तुह मण्डलग्गस्स"
english: "Wherever you go There are many streams of tears, Vindhya and Vimajjantitu. Never again will there be a stream of tears in your eyes"

prakrit: "पणइ-अणत्थं आमुअइ कणअमिणमो इह ट्ठिआ लच्छी,कवआवडिआ असिणो तु णेन्ति णामी सिहि-फुलिङ्गा"
english: "You fool, My darling, It's the lotus of your mouth That makes your name prominent." ""

prakrit: "कोवेण व कअ-कम्पं रहसुद्ध-परिट्ठिआऎघडिआइं,तुह तज्जणीऎ कज्जाइं चण्ड-भुअ-दण्ड-दूईए"
english: "In the middle of a storm, Like a cloudburst, Running amok, Your sharp arrows pierce the moon - Give punishment."

prakrit: "आरूढो पासाअक्कमेण तह तं सि उवरिलोअस्स,ऎक्को अ सो जहा वो अण्डअ-बन्धाअएमौली"
english: "Foolish girl, you're the only one who knows how to fawn - That's where the eggs are - Tied together by their beaks."

prakrit: "बाहु-सिहरेसुदीसइ कामिणि-सङ्कामिएण मअ-तिलओ,भू-भारुव्वहण-वसा परिट्ठिओ पङ्क-लेसॊ व्व"
english: "Hands - straight, smooth lashes - A mother - in - law in distress, Earth - weight - carrying - Fats strewn all over The place Like a bunch of feathers."

prakrit: "भुमअग्ग-भमिर-लच्छी-चलणालत्तअ-णिहो तुवि प्फुरइ,अवअंसारुण-मणि-मञ्जरी-भवो राअ-विच्छड्डो"
english: "The earth - swollen by bees - Looks like a lotus - Flutters beneath you, Covered by nectar - Bees - beads - Flesh like a rainbow - Is like a pyre."

prakrit: "होन्ति कअत्था पणई णह-माला-चलण-रोहणे तुज्झ,आअम्ब-मणि-गुहाओ व विसिऊणपणाम-सङ्कन्ता"
english: "How easy it is for you to weep, To weep and wail, To sulk and sigh, To sigh and groan."

prakrit: "अल्लीणारहसागम-परिवत्तिअ-केसवंसुअ-धर व्व,कवअ-दलणुग्गआणल-सिह-च्छला वो असिं लच्छी"
english: "Alien marriage - Parivrttiya - Kesavaansuya - Dharu, Kava - Dalanugga - Aanala - Siha - Chalasa He loves us." ""

prakrit: "इअ जॊ थुव्वइ पहरिस-पूर-परिक्खलिअ-विसम-कण्ठेहिं,बन्दीहĩकइन्देहĩचभूअत्थेहिं चिअगुणेहिं"
english: "He who pierces one's body Through the eyes, Through the ears, And through the breasts, Is not worthy to be called a prisoner, But is possessed by a divine nature."

prakrit: "इअ चाडु-चौर-चारण-सञ्चारिअ-चन्द-चारु-चरिएण,णअराओ णर-वरिन्देण णिग्गअं णिग्गअ-जसेण"
english: "This is the pasture - The pastures - The roads - The moon - The paths - The rivers - The trees - The creepers - The shrines - The houses - The dwellings - The living"

prakrit: "जवपचमाणस्स सरीर-चारिणो गब्भ-वसहि-गेहेसु,जाण परिअत्तणेण व आवत्त-गईओणिव्वडिआ"
english: "The whole body is like a column of smoke rising from the fire of love, Wrapped in gauze and sealed with rose petals."

prakrit: "जे कुङ्कुम-त्थलीसुं केसर-भङ्गारुणेहिं दावेन्ति,पइ-परिहोअं व महीऎणव-णहङ्कं खुर-वएहिं"
english: "Those who eat kumkum, lotus, saffron, and rubble, Lay their hands on the ground Like the nails of a buffalo calf."

prakrit: "जे पोह-खण-परिट्ठिअ-सङ्खाअ-प्फेण-पिण्ड-घडिएहिं,हेसा-रवेहĩ पूरिअ-पयाण-सङ्ख व्व दीसन्ति"
english: "Those who see the moon, The clouds, The circles, The waves, The whole sky, Like a column of smoke."

prakrit: "आयाण-मरगअ-च्छवि-विच्छड्डाडम्बरेण मुञ्चन्ति,जेबाल-जव-रसं पिवसयराहापीअमङ्गेहिं"
english: "The ayans - the stag - The parrots - Munch on the sweetwood tree, The jebal - the barley - The juice with which the turmeric is mixed With the mango"

prakrit: "दिण्णाओ पणालीओ व सम-वारि-विणिग्गमाअ धारेन्ति,परिछिण्ण-मज्झ-रेहा-णिहेण जे जहण-बन्धेण"
english: "The days are fleeting And the evenings wear thin, Like a wedding feast For those who have something to hold on to."

prakrit: "मग्गेसु गुरु-बला वेअ-गाढ-णिवडन्त-कोडि-टङ्केहिं,उच्चरिऊणं व लिहन्ति जे टआरॆ खुर-उडेहिं"
english: "Magsaysay teachers - Strong ones - Thick ones - Drunken ones - Firm ones - Wretched ones - Write in syllables Which fly from the hoof to the head."

prakrit: "जे अज्ज वि हिम-सेलन्त-सम्भवा अणह-सीअ-विअण व्व,गुरु-तेअ-प्पसर-रसाठाणेच्चिअ किम्पि कम्पन्ति"
english: "Even today, When the frost has ceased, Like wine without water, The buds of the treetops tremble As they touch the teacher's feet."

prakrit: "आरूढ-जोह-णिवहा ते तस्स तरङ्गिणो जय-तुरङ्गा,सूअन्ति व्व पहरिसं जाआ पुरओ णरिन्दस्स"
english: "When the river is in spate The victory trumpet of the same wave, Like the trumpet blown by the sun, Succeeds only in vanishingly thin air."

prakrit: "उवहाणं पिव लीला-वलिअ-ट्ठिअ-पिहु-करत्तणा देन्ति,जे विअड-दन्त-पल्लङ्क-कअ-णिवेसाऎ लच्छीए"
english: "They give him yellow leelas, violets, trees, feathers, and bristles: To look at him with wide - eyed teeth, palanquins, and shackles."

prakrit: "दीसन्ति जाण परिअत्त-चलण-दलिआरि-सीस-भावेण,अज्ज वि कवाल-सअल व्व पास-खुत्ता णह-क्खण्डा"
english: "He knows what's best - move - porridge - cheese - passion - even today he is a cow - apple - poor man's man - There is nothing wrong with him."

prakrit: "असरल-लीला-गइ-विअलिआहĩजे तीहĩ दाण-धाराहिं,राअ-सिरीऎ रअन्ति व विलास-वेणी-लअं सुरहिं"
english: "Asral-Leela-Gayi-Velayahinje teehin dan-Dharahin, Ra-Siriye raanti, Vilasa-Beni-La sanrahan."

prakrit: "पासल्लिआण जे पडिगआण खुत्तग्ग-दन्त-भावेण,विब्भम-मुणाल-दण्डेहĩ रुहिर-सलिलं पिवपिअन्ति"
english: "A man who walks on the grass, Who walks on it, Who licks it with his teeth, Who pours it on with his tongue, Whose hair is tied in a knot, Is a true gentleman."

prakrit: "जेचञ्चल-चामर-पम्हलेहĩ सोहन्ति कण्ण-तालेहिं,उप्पअण-तरल-पक्ख व्व तिअस-गअ-जुज्झ-बुद्धीए"
english: "Jechenchal - Chamar - Slender - beautiful - eyes, Tears - liquid - wings, Teas - cows, Wars - wisdom."

prakrit: "सुत्त-णिवेसं पिव देन्ति दीहरं दाण-वारि-धाराहिं,पडिवासरं पवित्थारिणीऎ जेपत्थिव-सिरीए"
english: "The sutta - nivesha gives drink After a long day of charity, And the stream of water after a day of penance, Like the flame of a lamp lit by a purification lamp."

prakrit: "ते तस्स जय-गइन्दा सिअ-पिट्ठन्तरिअ-सामल-च्छाया,सरआवणीअ-कलुसा जाआ पुरओ जलहर व्व"
english: "He conquers her, Succeeds her, Steals her back And carries her away, Like a floodwater carried by the current of the river."

prakrit: "णवरि अ थोअ-त्थोअं अग्घन्ति णिसीह-मुहल-कल-हंसा,दर-दूमिआरविन्दा असार-सूराअवा दिअसा"
english: "The fire is burning everywhere - Once in a while - Laughing - Silly - Every wretched day - Sound of nonsense."

prakrit: "सौण-मराल-जणवआ धूमाबद्ध-तिमिरा विराअन्ति,सञ्ज्झा-णिअम्ब-णव-पल्लव व्व रअणीण गो-सग्गा"
english: "The sauna is smeared with smoke, The temples are deserted, The sanjha - the fire - is bare, The Pallava - is stuffed with cows Like queens."

prakrit: "कासार-विरल-कुमुआअमलिअ-विच्छाय-चन्द-परिवेसा,होन्ति बहलावसाया पहाअ-सिसिरा णिसा-बन्धा"
english: "Casser - Wirral - Pumpkin - Amla - Bee - The moon - The surroundings, The mountain streams overflowing with water - Sesame seeds - Tied up"

prakrit: "घोलइ अलद्ध-किरणो तुसार-लव-लम्भ-धूसर-च्छाओ,रविणो अलम्बुसा-कुसुम-पाडलो बिम्ब-परिणाहो"
english: "The sun's rays are yellow, The moon is red, The sky is blue, The clouds are red, And the clouds are white."

prakrit: "अग्घन्ति सिसिर-सलिला अणिउञ्चिअ-कोञ्च-सारस-विरावा,खल-चुण्णिअ-कलमामोअ-वाहिणो गाम-सीमन्ता"
english: "Fettered by fire, Whirligigig - Silly, wobbly, cunning - Destroyed, Faint - Slippery - Calm - The stream flows along the village boundary."

prakrit: "कं व ण हरन्ति णिबिडावसाय-सम्भिण्ण-सामल-करीसा,गोहण-विणिवेसुद्देस-धूसरारण्ण-पेरन्ता"
english: "One doesn't lose faith - One manages it - One practices it - The cattle - One forgives - One sheds their hair - One turns gray."

prakrit: "अक्कन्त-करीसुम्हा-सुह-णिक्कम्प-जहणंविणिक्कमइ,कह वि जडाअव-परिभोअ-मन्थरं रोहिणी-जूहं"
english: "Akanta - Karisumha - Suha - Nikamp - Jahanavinikam, Kaha vi jadaav - Paribhava - Manthram Rohini - Juhu"

prakrit: "इअ हेमन्त-समिद्धासु गाम-सीमासु मेइणी-णाहो,दिठ्ठिं दिन्तो पत्तो कमेण सोणङ्कमुद्देसं"
english: "This is Hemant - the village headman's village - The men of the borders - The streets are deserted. Every day I see his wife Whose face is smeared with ghee."

prakrit: "मलिआ पूअ-प्फल-कोस-वडण-रज्जन्त-पल्ललातस्स,सेणा-भडेहĩ णव-सालि-सालिणो गाम-सीमन्ता"
english: "Malia, flowers, fruits, grass - roots, wood - apple - pearl - rose - lotus, army - buffalo, buffalo - bull, farmer - doe - the whole village is on the fence."

prakrit: "मत्त-कुररासु दिट्ठी सहरी-विप्फुरण-कम्पिअ-जलासु,वीसमइ व वञ्जुलिणीसुताण आहार-लेहासु"
english: "Drunken groans, Staring out at the town, Whispering, Shaking, Stirring, Sweating, Like wasting water in the rainy season, Eating and drinking."

prakrit: "ताणणिसम्मइ हिअअं अणाविलाहार-सलिल-सुहआसु,आ-मञ्जरी-परिग्गह-सुअन्ध-कलमासु सीमासु"
english: "To the man who has no other occupation - Salil - Suhasu, to the manjiri - Parigraha - Sundha - The limits of the pen."

prakrit: "ल्हसमाण-जुओवत्तिअ-तुरङ्गम-क्खन्ध-केसरुप्पङ्को,उम्मुह-धुरं समारुहइ जत्थ रविणो रहो कह वि"
english: "Laksmana - The bow - The trumpet - The shoulder - The hair - The drum - The flame - Wherever the rain may stay Tell me."

prakrit: "बाहिं-गआण जस्स अ णत्थि च्चिअ णह-अलं ति पडिवत्ति,कन्दर-परिट्ठिआण अ सॊ च्चिअ णत्थि त्ति पडिहाइ"
english: "What goes out and comes in and goes out, Falls on the ground like a river, And what remains of the river, Falls by the wayside."

prakrit: "बहु-कुहराविल-कडअत्तणेण णह-महि-अलन्तर-णिवेसो,गहिऊण व वसुहद्धं जो गअणद्धं च णिम्मविओ"
english: "Too much mist - Because it makes the water too thick - Too much rain - All the while - Silly woman, Who forgets what's in store For her."

prakrit: "जेण णहो-गअ-सिहरेण कुहर-पसरिअ-णहङ्गणेणं च,अण्णोण्णं कीलिअ-णिच्चलॊ व्वणह-महि-अलुच्छङ्गो"
english: "Like a waterfall, Like a thicket of reeds, Like an expanse of mist Spreading over the horizon, Like the petals of a parrot, Like bees hiding in a shallow hole."

prakrit: "विञ्ज्झम्मि तम्मि रस-सुरहि-सल्लई-भङ्ग-णिव्वुअ-गअम्मि,रोह-णिरन्तर-ताली-वणम्मि जाओ मही-णाहो"
english: "Vindhya is juicy, sweet, salty, fragrant, refreshing, gooey, angry, non - existent, clap - Vanami Jaao, Mahi - Naho."

prakrit: "बन्दीकअ-महिसासुर-कुल-कण्ठुम्मोइएहĩ व तुमाए,माहवि घण्टा-दामेहĩ मण्डिअं तोरण-द्दारं"
english: "Prisoner - Mahishasura - Clan - Throat - Stifled by you, Month - By - Hour - Damaged by the arrow - Door of the Mandya"

prakrit: "दिट्ठं साहॆज्जारूढ-तुहिण-गिरी-खण्ड-दिण्ण-पीढं व,महिसासुरस्स सीसं तुहचलण-णह-प्पहा-भरिअं"
english: "When you look at him He can see you everywhere - in circles, in sections, and from generation to generation - But the head of the demon Mahishasura is full of your movements." ""

prakrit: "भमरावलिओभइरवि तुज्झंभवणाइरम्मि सामोए,थुइ-मॆत्तुम्मोइअ-जन्तु-णिअल-मालाओ व लुढन्ति"
english: "In front of your face Bees hover around you, Thighs quivering, Beasts swinging and beads falling." ""

prakrit: "णणु तुम्हं सम्भरणे रणम्मि विहडन्ति वारण-घडाओ,दूराऒ च्चिअ वाहण-मइन्द-रव-विद्दुआऒ व्व"
english: "You fool, The streets are deserted, The roads are deserted And the roads are impassable."

prakrit: "तुह चण्डि चलण-कमलाणुवत्तिणो कह णु सञ्जमिज्जन्ति,सेरिह-वह-सङ्किअ-महिस-हीरमाणेण व जमेण"
english: "How easy it is for you To mix the moon with the lotus? Be careful not to mix the orange with the white."

prakrit: "तुहिण-गिरी देवि तुमाइ जणअ-भावेण गारवं णीओ,विञ्ज्झाअलो वि कन्दर-णिवास-लीलाऎ कल्लाणि"
english: "Trembling goddess, You have garlanded my heart with your loving - kind words. Even in the midst of a fire This is the stone of immortality."

prakrit: "सोहसि णारायणिरणिर-णेउराराव-मिलिअ-हंस-उले,भवणम्मि कवालाविल-मसाण-राएण व भमन्ती"
english: "Blessed are the women of the night - The ravenous raven - The elephant - The buffalo - The swan - The landowner - The crow - The husbandman - The hunter - The fowler."

prakrit: "अद्धेण सरीरॆ च्चिअ णवर ससि-सेहरस्स तं वससि,हिअए उण से सङ्करि तुह अविहाएण ओआसो"
english: "Your body is like a sapling, You live in it, And your limbs are like a tree: They grow thin Because of you."

prakrit: "खलिओ तĩ रहसुक्खित्त-मणि-तुला-कोडि-कुण्डलाहरणो,सिङ्गोभङ्ग-ट्ठविअ-वलय-बन्धॊ व्व महिसस्स"
english: "Blossom is her secret - pearl - tula - hen - kundalaharana, lion's share - tirthavya - ring - bandha - Like the buffalo calf." ""

prakrit: "तुह दारंथाम-त्थाम-दिण्ण-रुहिरोवहारमाभाइ,हर-पणय-रोस-विससिअ-सञ्ज्झा-सअलावइण्णं व"
english: "Your door - door - thong - day - hair - wavy, brother - in - law - anger - resentment - jealousy - confusion - sulking."

prakrit: "तुह वअण-च्छवि-भिज्जन्त-विअड-तम-मण्डला सआ होन्ति,केहĩ वि दिज्जन्त-महा-महिसा इव भअवइ पओसा"
english: "There must be something very special about you, Your face, your clothes, your breasts, and your heart. It must all be burning like a great fire."

prakrit: "णिद्दा-रूवेण पअं णिमेसि जण-लोअणेसु तं चेअ,पडिबोहे जेण स-जावअ व्व लक्खिज्जए दिट्ठी"
english: "You fool, Don't look at me Like that." She looked at him With such longing That he would never look at her again.

prakrit: "पलयं वा कालि ण णिम्मवेसि रूवस्स ते अणन्तस्स,सव्वङ्गे कह णु कवाल-मण्डलाडम्बरं घडौ"
english: "Tomorrow or the day after tomorrow you will not see him again. So how can you arrange to meet him in person?"

prakrit: "थुव्वसि तक्खण-विहडन्त-लोह-हिञ्जीर-सामल-गलेहिं,परिणअ-गणभावागअ-तिणयण-चिन्धेहिंवणरेहĩ"
english: "You spittle - piercing - iron - hinged - girdle - neck, Parin - mass - ecstasy - spit - marked - arrows."

prakrit: "णिमिसं पि णेअ मुच्चइ आयअणोववण-मण्डलं तुज्झ,संणिहिअ-कुमार-मऊर-णेह-रसिएहĩ व सिहीहिं"
english: "In a minute I'll close my eyes And tell you what to do With your breasts: They are delicate, shapely, soft, and juicy Like sweets."

prakrit: "पाऊण वौवहाराअरेसुसइ धूव-धूम-वडलाइं,उव्वमसि बहुल-रअणी-भावेसु णिरन्तरं तिमिरं"
english: "The wind blows, The clouds twitch, The waves crash, The nights are long and the nights long."

prakrit: "पणअ-जण-रक्खणन्तरिअ-वेरि-करवाल-पञ्जरेणं व,हारिन्द-णील-किरणावलम्बिणाभासि वच्छेण"
english: "Deer - People - Protectors - Varying - Pecks - Birds - Bees - The rays of the sun Orbiting the bamboo shoots"

prakrit: "जाहे रअणी-रूवेण फुरसि ससहर-विडम्बिअ-कवाला,ताहे वि णरट्ठि-पसाहणम्मि तुह घडइ गह-चक्कं"
english: "When the wife is away Having spent the night with her lover, The husband is away having fun, And when she is away You cause embarrassment to the household."

prakrit: "तंकुवलई-कुणन्तीण वा दइच्चाण खग्ग-मालाओ,णिअ-चलण-पङ्कअच्चा-कज्जं वो कह णु सम्पडौ"
english: "Whether because of good manners or greed, Or because of wealth or position, How can one attain wealth?"

prakrit: "मालूर-पत्त-माला-कण्टअ-कअ-सोणिअ व्व आहासि,तं सरस-रत्त-चन्दण-परिसोण-थणन्तरा देवि"
english: "Malur, leaf, garland, thorn, lotus, my dear, you are lucky; she is the goddess of plenty - blood, sandalwood, flowers, and nipples."

prakrit: "सङ्कन्ताउ व रोसारुर्णच्छि-वलय-प्पहाओ महिसम्मि,तुह सबरि सोणिअ-सिहा तिसूल-मग्गेसु दीसन्ति"
english: "Proud lady, The rainy season is upon us, And the golden sighs of your husband Give way to tears of remorse."

prakrit: "वीर-विइण्ण-विकोसासि-धेणु-करवाल-कन्ति-कज्जलिअं,दिअसम्मि वि देवि असङ्क-कोसिअं गब्भ-भवणं ते"
english: "The brave - the wise - The prosperous - The wealthy - The tax collectors - The stingy - The incompetent - The angry goddess of the day - The pitiful - The palace." ""

prakrit: "तं अत्थारुण-रवि-मण्डलेण मुण्डोवहार-पुरवं व,तारा-णिह-कअ-बलि-तन्दुलाऎ पूइज्जसि णिसाए"
english: "Worship him, Attarun, Ravi, Mandalen, Mundowhar, Puravam, Tara, Nih - ka, Sacrifice, Tandula." ""

prakrit: "तं सहसि सजल-जीमूअ-गोअरा गोरि विज्जु-भावम्मि,कंसॊप्पिअ-वज्झ-सिला-सह व्वगअणेसमुप्पइआ"
english: "You suffer from it, Sajal - jimoo - gora, Gori, Vijju - bhavammi, Kansoppia - vajja - Sila - saath vyagamanesumuppu."

prakrit: "हर-फंस-सेअ-संवलिअ-जावआसङ्गि-णह-मणि-च्छाओ,सहइणअ-चन्द-लेहा-सुर-सरि-सञ्ज्झॊ व्वतेचलणो"
english: "Every one is captivated - Love, Love, Friendship, Friend, Friend - The moon, Love - Lustre, Sur - Sur - Sanjho, Movement."

prakrit: "सुलहोवहार-रुहिर-प्पवाह-सम्भावणाऎ लिब्भन्ति,अरुण-पडाआ-पडिमा-गब्भाओ सिला इह सिवाहिं"
english: "Conciliatory - The rough - The plowman's wife - Possibilities await her, The silhouette of Arun - Padua - Padima - Gabbao - These are the rays of the moon."

prakrit: "पूआहिसेअ-विअलिअ-णडाल-जावअ-रसंपिअन्ति व्व,रुहिरासव-परिओसा तुह पुरऒ भूअ-पडिमाओ"
english: "Poor girl, The rivers are overflowing with water, The creeks are bursting with excitement, And your husband is abroad Doing his best to please you."

prakrit: "पच्चक्ख-भाव-तक्खण-मीलन्तच्छि-हअ-दंसण-गुणेहिं,तिअसेहĩ वि तुह णिद्दत्तणम्मि रूवं ण सच्चविअं"
english: "Virtuous - expression, sharp - touch, penetrating - these are the qualities that characterize you. Yet your stubborn look is not true."

prakrit: "तक्काल-विमुह-हर-वढ्ढिएहĩ सासेहिं तावसि तुमाए,पडिवण्णो पाणायाम-णियम-बन्धाअरो कह णु"
english: "Takal-vimuh-har-vadhiye, you look just like that, But tell me, brother - in - law, How are you going to manage your affairs?"

prakrit: "काम-डहणाणुतावाहरस्स तुह विब्भमेहĩ णिव्वडिआ,कट्ठिअ-णडाल-णयणाणल व्व सन्ताविणो सासा"
english: "Without a trace of passion, Without a shadow of a doubt, Your image is breathtaking."

prakrit: "सइसिद्ध-सिद्धि-मण्डल-पईव-परिकम्पिणो पओसेसु,तुज्झोसव-गन्ध-सुहा सुहअन्ति समीरणुग्गारा"
english: "Praise be to you, O God of Love, For the fragrance of your fragrance Makes for a pleasant pastime."

prakrit: "तडिभावम्मिफुरन्ती सवारि-वारिहर-कूड-कोडीए,अक्कन्त-महा-महिस व्व सोहसे अमरिसाअम्बा"
english: "Foolish traveler - Waryhar - Koode - Kodye, Akant - Maha - Mahishya - Like the pleasures of immortality."

prakrit: "जण-दिण्ण-केस-कलणा-लोमस-कलुसेहĩकम्पमुप्पेसि,वेआलेहĩ व पडिअग्गिआइरावाउ-दण्डेहिं"
english: "You fool, You coward, You crook, You liar, You cheat, You lie on your back And fall at your feet Like a punishment."

prakrit: "गम्भीर-गब्भ-मन्द-प्पहाओ तुह देवि दीव-मालाओ,उवहार-मुण्ड-केसन्धआर-मूढाओ व खलन्ति"
english: "May your gods burn your lamp and garland you with fire and water, May your faces grow pale And your hair sag like a fool's bow."

prakrit: "विससिज्जन्त-महा-पसु-दंसण-सम्भम-परॊप्परारूढा,गअणेच्चिअ गन्ध-उडिं कुणन्ति तुहकौल-णारीओ"
english: "Vissasijjanta-maha-pasu-daansana-sambham-parapparuddha, guanchechichye gandha-udam-duing your round breasts."

prakrit: "णह-मणि-सङ्कमणा मडह-पणअ-जण-लञ्छणेहĩ चलणेहिं,सोहसि पणमिज्जन्ति व्व अम्ब तंवालिहिल्लेहिं"
english: "Take it easy, go and take it easy: You're lucky you don't have to mix pennies And mangoes with rice flour."

prakrit: "अह परिअरोअणेओवअरण-पहरण-सहं कर-सहस्सं,ऎक्कस्स वरोरु वरुज्जअस्स ते पाणि-कमलस्स"
english: "Oh! the ornaments worn by one's relatives - That's a hundred thousand rubles. Once a bridegroom has arrived They are like water - lotuses."

prakrit: "धअ-वड-धारा-णिवहेहĩ मन्दिरंवोणवारुणाहेहिं,तद्दिअस-पसु-सिर-च्छेअ-पीअमामुअइ रुहिरं व"
english: "The stream is blue, The temple is red, The trees are white, The head is yellow And the hair is brown."

prakrit: "मेहाअन्तं तुह तइअ-णयण-सिहि-धूम-मण्डलं सहइ,वासुइ-जीहाओ लहन्ति तडि-लआ-विब्भमं जत्थ"
english: "As long as I bear with you the pain, the sweat, the tears, the longing, The joys of separation."

prakrit: "सीसम्मि कओ महिसस्स देवि मरणाअ जो हि सम्पण्णो,सॊ च्चिअ जणस्स जाओ तुह चलणो मङ्गल-ठ्ठाणं"
english: "Silly girl, Mahishasuda, the one who is wealthy will die, so go your way. Good luck to you." ""

prakrit: "कोमारम्मि हराराहणाअ हिअअम्मि मअण-पज्जलिए,तइ विहिओमुद्ध-थणुल्लएहĩमालूर-होमॊ व्व"
english: "Aunt, If you want to hurt my feelings You'd better stop being angry - It's only because you love me."

prakrit: "अङ्गमवलम्बिआलम्बि-सरस-णर-वअण-पाअडं वहसि,अज्जवि कंस-प्फोडण-ललन्त-णिअअट्ठि-सिढिलं व"
english: "There you are, limping on your toes, Sucking in your breath, Stretching your body, Exhausting bristles, Slipping toes - Just like a staircase."

prakrit: "सूएन्तिवीर-विक्कअ-विक्कममिह जामिणी-मसाणेसु,अवलम्बिअ-कुणव-च्छेअ-पाडला साहि-साहाओ"
english: "Suentive - wicked - Wicked - Wretched - Jealous - Compassionate - Virtuous - Silly - Fettered - Friendly - Friend."

prakrit: "सरसट्ठि-दण्ड-लोहेण चण्डि अहर-प्पहारुणे तुज्झ,जीहा णिअ-दसण-मऊह-मण्डलॆ च्चेअ संवलइ"
english: "The moon is your ornament, Like an iron rod, Like a banner affixed to a garland of jewels."

prakrit: "पअइ-पारिसुक्क-काया पुरओ सञ्चरइ रेवई तुज्झ,इहसइसंणिहिअ-महा-परेअ-भय-मुक्क-मासव्व"
english: "The river runs through your body, The rivers through your veins, The monotonous waters of the Goda - great and unfathomable - Fear, sighs and moans."

prakrit: "पूइज्जसि भिण्ण-भुआ-विइण्ण-रुहिरं व पाअवेहिं पि,परसु-प्पहार-विअलिअ-कसाय-रस-सोण-साहेहिं"
english: "Worship thyself, brother - in - law, Wretched body, Weeping and wailing, Friend - lover - butcher - juice - gold - jewels."

prakrit: "अण्णोण्ण-कलह-विअलिअ-केसर-कीलाल-कललिअ-द्दारा,कअवाउणो वि तुह देवि सासणं अणुसरन्ति व्व"
english: "Through affection, strife, jasmine, saffron, lotus, and lotus - Yet your goddess Sasan keeps on threatening." ""

prakrit: "उवहारुल्लूरिअ-मास-मण्डलाडम्बरुब्भडेहिं व,डिम्बं जावअ-पड-मण्डणेहĩ खम्भेहĩविविहेसि"
english: "You fool, A flock of parrots grows from the first day of summer, And a flock of geese flies from the last day of winter."

prakrit: "कुणवत्तण-सुलहूसास-काय-णिव्वडिअ-गारवो अप्पा,तुह धारण-क्खमो कीरइ व्व णणु वाहण-सवेण"
english: "Virtuous woman, What's the matter with you, Daughter - in - law? What do you think you are wearing? It's like having a bow and arrow tied around you."

prakrit: "सोहसि मुह-मुक्कासरिस-रुहिर-धाराहĩरअणि-रूवेसु,भत्ति-विइज्जन्तारुण-धअ व्व तं भवण-माईहिं"
english: "Lovely face - Mukkasaris - Ruhir - Dharahir - Rani - Ruvesu, Wretched body - Vijjantaruna - The dharma is like that - Mother - in - law"

prakrit: "बहुल-पओसाबद्धङ्कुरव्व तुह देवि महिस-सिङ्गेहिं,पारोहिणॊ व्वलम्बिर-मऊर-कण्ठेहिं रेहन्ति"
english: "The many - faced monkey, Your goddess, the buffalo's horn, The parrot's tail, The peacock's eye, Remain in your ears."

prakrit: "णिज्जन्ति मुहल-मूला चल-पाअव-णिज्झरा खलन्त-सिला,सम-विसम-भूमि-लङ्घण-तरङ्गिणोसेल-सङ्घाआ"

prakrit: "जाआ रवि-अर-परिपिल्लणेण थोउम्ह-पिञ्जर-च्छाया,चिर-आल-ट्ठिअ-महिहर-णिरोह-मुक्क व्व णह-मग्गा"

english: "Tomorrow is the first day." "First the clouds, then the bees, Then the seals, And then the clouds."

prakrit: "उक्खअ-गिरि-गहिर-ट्ठाण-भाव-दूरुण्णअन्तर-क्खण्डं,दीसइ तह-सण्ठिअ-सेल-जाल-विसमं व महि-वॆढं"

prakrit: "पेरन्तीकअ-उत्तुङ्ग-गरुअ-गिरि-वलय-बद्ध-परिवेसं,मज्झोणअं व दीसइ पासोणमिअं पि महि-वॆढं"
english: "Mother - in - law - A towering tree - A mountain range - A circle of bees - Tied to the boundary fence - A buffalo - bullock even as it passes through the middle of the forest"

prakrit: "ओसारिअ-गिरि-गारव-विणमिअ-पेरन्त-पुञ्जइज्जन्तं,वित्थारित्थं तञ्चिअजाअं मडहं व महि-वॆढं"
english: "The oasis - The gorge - The grass - The vines - The shrubs - The flowers - The leaves - The thickets - The bees - The creepers - The jasmine." ""

prakrit: "इअ पिहुणॊ धणु-पॆल्लण-णिबिडीकअ-सेल-जाल-दुल्लङ्घा,भू-पेरन्ता जे इर तेसु वि गहिओ करो पहुणा"
english: "Your husband is a rich man, A handsome man, With long hair, A bow and arrows, A landowner's son, And a woman whose husband is abroad."

prakrit: "अरइ-परिसक्कणा रणिर-णेउराराव-सङ्गलन्तीसु,ठिअ-परिअआसुदिट्ठी लग्गइकल-हंस-मालासु"
english: "Arey-parisakkana ranira-neurara Rao-sangalanteesu, Theeya-paria sudithi lagayikal-hansa-malaasu"

prakrit: "विविणेह-मज्जण-ट्ठिअ-थोउब्भिज्जन्त-दाण-राअं व,दीसइ सामाअन्तं सइसुह-भङ्गेसुलाअण्णं"
english: "Diverse - fragrant - sweet - spicy - juicy - rich - delicious - red - with fresh fragrant flowers."

english: "Feigning sleep - Sandalwood - Painted with lotus - Powder, twang - Yellow - Smudged - Pulina - Yellow and white limbs."

prakrit: "बहुसॊ घडन्त-विहडन्त-सइ-सुहासाअ-सङ्गमुल्लोले,हिअऎ च्चेअ समप्पन्ति चञ्चला वीइ-वावारा"

english: "The lotus - silly - garlanded, the snake - sniffling, the bee - moaning, the bird - wearing - prominent - head - yellow body."

english: "Here you are bound, my dear," said the doe, "Because the man who lives there Does not know how to walk."

prakrit: "मुह-विणिमिअ-णव-मङ्गल-किसल-कलाव-च्छलेण गन्तूण,पिज्जन्तं पिव अहि-दीह-दीह-जीहा-सहस्सेहिं"
english: "Mouth - Swollen - new - auspicious - kisses - arts - longing - Destroyed by the churning fire, Like drinking wine - long - suffering - Life - suffering."

prakrit: "अणुणिज्जन्तं रक्खा-परिअर-धुअ-धवल-चामर-णिहेण,बन्दीकआमर-जरा-बन्धूहĩ व बहु-पणामेहिं"
english: "Protect your neighbor - The fire, the smoke, the hides, the leather - The clothes you wear, The prisoners - The relatives, The friends you make, And the treasures you treasure."

prakrit: "मरण-भएण व चिन्ता-सामाअन्तेहĩ जीव-जालेहिं,अवलम्बिज्जन्तं सोरहाअरा महुअर-कुलेहिं"
english: "In the midst of death and worry These are the snares of the soul, Like a snake entangled in a nectar, Like the hips of a bee."

prakrit: "हरि-चक्क-विरिक्क-ट्ठिअ-पाणागअ-राहु-सीस-वलयं व,णिअअ-च्छाया-मण्डल-णिहेण पासे पआसन्तं"
english: "Hari-chakka-virikka-trithiya-panaaga-rahu-sees-the girdle, nishaya-chakshaya-mandala-next to the path."

prakrit: "इअ अमअ-कुम्भमुब्भिज्जमाणमुअहीओ जम्मि दट्ठूण,तिअसेहĩ विम्हिअं तम्मि साअरन्तॆ ट्ठिअं पहुणा"
english: "Aunt, The moment you see her face in the mirror You will instantly recognize her on the plane."

prakrit: "मुक्का णिसासु दप्पिअ-मइन्द-सम्पाअ-विससिअ-गइन्दा,पुञ्जिअ-सेणा-कलुसीकआवडा तेण मरु-मग्गा"
english: "Foolish girl, Don't be so hasty: Fool - The headman's son, The tailor's daughter, Is already dead And the treasure - The army - Is dying."

prakrit: "होन्त-रसा-अल-भय-पिसुण-कसण-घण-धूमकेउ-दण्डेहिं,दीसन्ति भीअ-विवलाअमाण-भुअआओ व दिसाओ"
english: "Thoughts, Tears, Lips, Fear, Curses, Thighs, Smokes, Punishments, Look like clouds Even though they look like clouds."

english: "Plaque - Spread - Liquid - Star - Firm - Strong - Sound - Dazzling - Red - Like a river in spate - Maggo."

english: "Decorate - decorate - tighten - bandage - garland - nimble - bristle - burn - sniffle - seal them."

english: "With a clenched fist, Flicker of excitement, Swirl of flame, One moment I felt my foot fall again."

prakrit: "सम्भम-पुणरुत्तारुण-फुरन्त-जीहा-कडप्प-पल्लविआ,दीसन्ति रोस-कवलिअ-हव्ववह-सिह व्व भुअइन्दा"
english: "Sambhama - reborn - full of life - Kadapa - Pallaviya, burning with anger - Kavaliya - Eve - She is like an elephant in the forest."

english: "Arun - Vissari - Fauna - Raanas - Raas - The streets are drained of water, The rivers are swollen by the current of the moon - Death - Scorching - The clouds of the crescent"

english: "Saffron - Green - Sandal - Particle - Stick - Protect - Red - fringed flowers, Vertical shoots, Swollen arms - Greasy sweet - Sighs"

english: "Look! The burning fire of the jasmine, Like a flock of geese Stretching out their wings, Like two clusters of crickets, Is burning everywhere."

english: "Like the husband who is abroad, Like the wife who is pregnant, Like jewels plundered by many a day - The jeweler's wife makes waves"

prakrit: "भाविअ-भारह-कलहं भारह-कलहेण सरवरे तम्मि,कामं सकामिणीएण सलिल-कीला विरइआओ"

english: "As bound up as I am in my feelings," he said, "so bound are you by your senses, Silly foolish as a woman possessed by a demon."

prakrit: "तइआ ठिओ सि जं किर पलॊट्ट-संरम्भ-सेअ-विणिवुड्डो,एसा सा तइ सलिल-प्पवेस-जॊग्गा कआ आसि"

english: "Aunt, When he comes home crying, I can feel his compassion." ""

prakrit: "गोउर-मॆत्त-विणिग्गअ-ससङ्क-जण-दीसमाण-वॊच्छेअं,जाअं णीसामण्णंपरिहा-वलयं णहञ्चेअ"

english: "Kimpi duma-jajjaresu hi ghosawa bandha-dumaesu, lagayi rila-thitiya-vaisesuuwaatha-gamaesu"

prakrit: "इह गामागअ-धम्मिअ-संमज्जिअ-सुण्ण-लिङ्गमुवसेलं,दल-गन्धि गहीराणील-कुण्डमुरु-पाअवं सण्डं"
english: "This is the village - The dharma - The rites of passage - The white lingam - The lotus - The herd - The donkey - The hemp - The ox - The cow - The bull - The calf - The young bull"

prakrit: "अवमारुअ-मूल-णिमिल्ल-पल्लवाउञ्जिणोपरिसरेसु,इह तरुणो सिहर-वहम्मि णवर झङ्कारिणो होन्ति"
english: "Awmarooo - Root - Nimmel - Pallava - Spring round the corner. This young man is sighing - The wife is shaking like a novice." ""

prakrit: "इह भूरि-भमिर-साहा-सारङ्ग-विराविणो विराअन्ति,आबद्ध-महा-महु-पिण्ड-मण्डला जर-तरु-क्खन्धा"
english: "It is a separation without boundary - the buffalo - the Saha - the sarang - the separation without end, the confining - the great - the bee - the mass - the mandala, the string - the khandha."

prakrit: "परिणाम-सोस-लहुआअमाण-फल-थोअ-पाविओसासा,इह जाआ पढम-समोणआओ मालूर-साहाओ"
english: "Consequence - Sosa - Loha - Aman - Fruit - Thoa - Paviosasa, Here goes the first - Samoan or Malur - Sahao." ""

prakrit: "सावअ-पअवी-भिण्णावसाय-हरिअन्तरा विराअन्ति,एए पहाअ-सरसावण-त्थली-सद्दलद्धन्ता"
english: "The south wind blows, The greenery disappears, The mountains tremble, The valleys quiver." ""

prakrit: "परिसडिअ-वेणु-दल-रङ्ग-पिङ्गलं गलइ गिरि-अड-दरीसु,जलमिणमो मल-हरिआअमाण-जरढोवल-क्खलिअं"
english: "Parisadiya - Venu - Dal - Colour - Pingalam Galai Giri - Ad - Drisu, Jalminmo Mal - Hariyaman - Zardhovala - Khaliyan"

prakrit: "इह सॊत्तागम-विहडिअ-सिलासु मुणिणो गुहासु णिवसन्ति,कासायमुव्वहन्ता पुराण-बोरट्ठि-विच्छायं"
english: "It is like a mudflat, Like the mud in a mud cave, Like a treasure chest: Puranas are scattered all over the place."

prakrit: "इह फलइ दुमवइसुं पणऒ भमराण कुसुम-पीआणं,सिद्ध-परिग्गहिअ-गुहा-गेहासु णिअम्ब-मालासु"
english: "It bears fruit: The doom - eyed bee, The safflower - Drunken, the siddha - circumambulated, The guha - hollow, The nectar - garland of wheat."

prakrit: "इह कड्ढिअ-विअड-सिला-वडण-ठ्ठिअ-चुण्ण-रासि-पंसुलिआ,विसमुज्जल-मुहल-तडा घडणा-जॊग्गोवला गिरिणो"
english: "It is a thicket of acacia - Vivid - Sila - Vadana - Thathiya - Chuna - Rasi - Pansulia, Visnu - jasmine - Tada - A meadow with tall trees."

prakrit: "इह परिसक्किज्जइ कढिण-कक्करुक्केर-णिसिअ-णह-हीरं,कुरुविन्द-कन्दरा-मन्दिरेसु मन्दं मइन्देहिं"
english: "It goes round and round like a jasmine, Like a pearl pierced by a needle, Like diamonds pierced through the temples of Kuruvinda and Kandara."

prakrit: "इहदर-खल्लइअ-तडोवलाओ परिविरल-बाल-मीणाओ,फेण-च्छाया-सारोअराओ रेहन्ति सरिआओ"
english: "Here live the poor - The plowman's wife, The wretched - the child's - the meadow, The froward - the teeming - The well - to - doers."

prakrit: "अववक्कल-णीसह-मूल-बन्धुराअन्त-बाल-धव-कुञ्जा,इहबहुलंगाढ-कसाय-सीहुणो गिरि-अड-ग्गामा"
english: "Avvakal - the hunter - The roots - The friends - The parents - The bull - The hunters - The heifers - The butcher - The farmer's eagles - The villagers - The village"

prakrit: "इह दिअसम्मि वि सिहरावरोह-परिअत्त-रवि-अरुम्मिल्ला,धूमाअन्ति व दूरावलोअ-मइलागिरि-वणन्ता"
english: "This very day The rivers are overflowing, The valleys are parched, The skies are black, There is no smoke, And the roads are impassable."

prakrit: "चलण-णिसण्णुण्णामिअ-चिबुअ-अलायामि-तलिण-मुहरेहं,सोहइ पसुत्तमिहं केसरीण भर-णिग्गअ-णहग्गं"
english: "Tread - Sweat - Chew - Layer - Brush - Mouth - Yellowish - Yellow - Slippery - Loaded with saffron - Straight - Nose - Toes." ""

prakrit: "इहसुइरेणपसम्मइकप्फाड-परम्परा-पडिक्खलिओ,अहिताडिअ-कंसुग्गार-झञ्झणा-पडिरवाहोओ"
english: "They swoon, Sweat drips, Traditions flutter, Tremors flare, And so on."

prakrit: "इह दीसइविमलाअन्त-मणि-सिला-सण्ड-सन्धिउज्जोअं,परिदलिअ-दाडिमी-कुसुम-दल-सिहाअम्बिरं गअणं"
english: "These days flowers, beads, silas, buds, and the like are everywhere: Nature, the pomegranate, the safflower, the swarm, And the lion, are everywhere."

prakrit: "इहदूर-ट्ठिअ-सिहरा वित्थारासण्ण-पाअड-णिअम्बा,दीसन्ति अग्ग-मइला कमेण मूलुज्जला गिरिणो"
english: "Here's the fire - The grass - The shrubs, The leaves, The flowers, The shoots, And the grass - Roots burning with filthy fire."

prakrit: "इह ताओखण्डिउव्वाअ-पाअवालग्ग-वल्लि-कलिलाओ,सबरुक्खअ-कन्दुद्देस-विवर-विसमाऒ भूमीओ"
english: "This is the land of the parrot, The young bull, The doe, The lizard, The crickets, And all the trees of the field."

prakrit: "इह वाहेहĩ वराहाणबाण-विहआणमणुसरिज्जन्ति,अग्गग्ग-समुज्जल-रुहिर-बिन्दु-मुद्दाओ पअवीओ"
english: "It is like a rainbow, Like a column of smoke rising from the fire, Like the tips of a rafter's bow."

prakrit: "मणि-वित्थार-परिट्ठिअ-वसुहा-पअडाअमाण-पेरन्तो,लक्खिज्जइ सेस-फणा-अडॊ व्व अह णिम्मलो जलही"
english: "Bees - Vithara - Paritthiya - Vasuha - Pada - Amman - Peranto, Lakshija - Shes - Fauna - The fire that burns in the eardrum"

prakrit: "णिबिड-दल-णाल-परिजडिल-दीहरुद्दण्ड-पिण्ड-खज्जूरा,एआओ जलहिणो तड-तमाल-णीला वणालीओ"
english: "Nibid - dal - nal - parijadil - dehrudand - pind - khaajjura. Oh! the waterless lotus - The tamarind tree is worthless!"

prakrit: "गोसे विअसन्ति मराल-चञ्चु-परिचुम्बिआओ सरसीसु,इह कमलिणीओ महुअर-पुलिन्द-विणिवेस-पल्लीओ"
english: "Gorgeous lotuses, swollen buds, lotus petals, lotuses and lotuses: These are the beehive of the jasmine, Pulinda and Vinives - The villagers." ""

prakrit: "एइ इहं जलणिहिमुत्तरेण उअ-महिहरे णह-विसारी,सामीरं रअमणुवत्तिऊण गन्धो वण-लआणं"
english: "Here's a forest fire burning with the scent of burning coals, Like a river in spate, Like the fragrance of a fire burning in the forest"

prakrit: "पाडलिअ-भू-रओणिहसणेण पूआण परिमल-कसाओ,कविलिअ-णियंसणो इह जणस्स सञ्ज्झाअइ रओहो"
english: "Parimal - kasao for a poor man Who loves to make love, Poet - nonsense, This man makes people cry." ""

prakrit: "इहपवण-भिण्ण-ताली-रस-च्छडा-पिच्छिले परिक्खलिआ,कइणो महुर-सुअन्धे लिहन्ति हत्थे गिरि-अडीसु"
english: "It's the festival - The crowd - The claps - The juices - The pastimes - The slippery roads. Somebody has to write on the scent - The bees - The shrubs - The grasshoppers - The jasmine"

prakrit: "रङ्खोलिर-परिणअ-गब्भ-सार-सम्भिडण-मुहल-फल-कोसा,इह पवणो णच्चावेइ णालिएर-वणालीओ"
english: "Range - the fruit - the shoot - The weight - the essence - The fragrance - The blossom - The forest - The weeds - The wind blows them away." ""

prakrit: "मुहलन्दोलिअ-ताडी-पल्लव-संवॆल्लिआइहवहन्ति,बन्धण-दलन्त-तणराअ-फल-चडक्कारिणो पवणा"
english: "The plowman's wife - The toddy - The Pallava - The flute - The shackles - The draught - The straw - The fruit - The hunter's wind." ""

prakrit: "अह केलासो वोलेइ जम्मि हिम-कण-किलामिअ-च्छायं,सम्भरिअ-मअण-विणिवाअ-खेअ-विहुरं व ससि-बिम्बं"
english: "Oh! summer is just the passage of time: The jasmine is frost - particles - Kilamiya - shadow, The maiden is sweet - weeping, The field is bare, And the sapling is white."

prakrit: "इह हर-जडाहिसञ्जमण-गण्ठि-णिबिडिअ-गलेण वासुइणा,उप्फुल्ल-फणा-धरिआ मुच्चन्ति समीरणुग्गारा"
english: "Here's Vasuina with all her limbs bristling, her cheeks hanging loose, Her skirt hanging loose Around her thighs." ""

prakrit: "इह णेअ णिसासु वि णिव्वडन्ति आमोअ-पॆल्लिअ-भुअङ्गा,रअण-च्छवि-संवलिआ कडएसु महोसही-विडवा"
english: "These damned nymphs too give birth to mango - pale - bristled, raven - eyed - swollen buds Like great widows."

prakrit: "इह मणि-अडाण दीसइ उव्वत्तिअ-बरहि-पिच्छ-विच्छाओ,णीहार-पड-परिक्खलिअ-णिग्गमो किरण-विच्छड्डो"
english: "It is the nectar of the moon That illuminates the sky, The raindrops of the rafters, The rays of the crickets, And the flames of the pyre."

prakrit: "इह फुरइ पण्डु-भावो वासागम-भङ्ग-गहिअ-सिहराण,अणवरअ-विसज्जिअ-विज्जु-रुहिर-धाराण व घणाण"
english: "This is the pathos - The emotion of the phantoms - The presence of the breath - The breaking - The shaking - The twisting - The piercing - The wisdom - The flow - The stream - The manifold." ""

prakrit: "इह सिद्ध-सुन्दरीणं थणाण णव-णह-वआण णिव्वडइ,आअम्ब-राइ-लञ्छिअ-विइत्त-भुअवत्त-लाअण्णं"
english: "This perfect beauty Is nourished by new breasts, By new nails, By long hair, By wilting, By brown hair."

prakrit: "इह मुणिवराण णिक्कम्प-णियम-पडिबन्ध-सन्धिआलोआ,झाण-विरमम्मि जाअन्ति णवर मलिणागिरि-गुहाओ"
english: "These sage - nimble - shrivelled - twanged - hairless, Jhan - wobbling - navel - grooves." ""

prakrit: "इह मुक्क-पल्ललुम्मुह-पसण्ण-महिसावलोइआ होन्ति,सेल-सिहरन्तरिज्जन्त-रवि-अरा दिअस-परिणामा"
english: "It is the hunch of a peacock's face, A beehive of pollen, A field of reeds, A rainy day, And the end of days."

prakrit: "छाया-णिव्वाविअ-सद्दलाण भद्दं दिणावसाणाण,णअर-विणिअत्त-गोवी-परिगीअ-वणन्त-मग्गाण"
english: "Shade - nirvavīya - silence, filthy dainties, naked women - cowgirls - wretched women - beggars."

prakrit: "इह पल्ली-धूमुब्भेअ-धूसरिज्जन्त-कुञ्ज-रमणिज्जा,होन्ति गिरि-अडअ-दण्डाणिसागमारम्भ-गम्भीरा"
english: "This is a village - Smoky buds - Dhoosrijant - Kunj - Slender, The banks of the Hanti - Steep - The start of the rainy season - Gorgeous."

prakrit: "उअय-च्छविं मुअन्तो पुराण-करि-दन्त-पिङ्गल-मऊहो,इह सोहइसिहरासत्त-मण्डलो जामिणी-णाहो"
english: "O! The churning fire Is only a myth - Karie - Tooth - Pingle - Mauho, This is the heavenly abode - The jasmine - Naho"

prakrit: "धाराहिसित्त-णव-कन्दलाण इह ताचलन्तिमालाओ,जरढ-कलविङ्क-गल-मण्डलाहिलीणा जलहराण"
english: "The torrential downpour, The churning of the new lotus, Is like a flood of water From the jarring jars of the jasmine."

prakrit: "इह सो तरुअल-वसुआअ-सलिल-सम्भिण्ण-केसरामोओ,परिणअ-किण्ण-सुरा-अन्ध-गाढ-महुरोविणिम्महइ"
english: "Here she is, Swollen by the arrows, Scorched by the rays of the sun, Decorated by the fragrance of nectar, Like a bee in a thicket, Blind and blind."

prakrit: "पढमासारे इह तत्त-भू-णिवेसाĩ वण-कुरङ्गेहिं,दर-घडिअ-मुहंपिज्जन्तिअग्ग-सिसिराĩ तोयाइं"
english: "First the parrots, then the forest monkeys, Then the peacock's tail - Every hour the bees flutter their beaks, And then the bees swoop down."

prakrit: "इह वॆल्लन्त-दुमुज्झिअ-भिण्ण-वओ-अण्ड-कलल-सीअरिणो,वाअन्ति मेह-सीअल-धूलि-लवुत्थङ्घिणोपवणा"
english: "It is white - smeared with gooseflesh, Vow - egg - bud - jasmine, Promising sweet - seals - dust - clove - the sweetwood tree."

prakrit: "एए विराअ-गोमय-हरिअन्तर-बुब्बुआ परिवहन्ति,सद्दल-सन्दाणिअ-सहर-चित्तला पूर-वित्थारा"
english: "O separation - The cattle - The greens - The doves - The travelers, The meadows - The evenings - The cities - The whole of the plain - The widowers."

prakrit: "इह धारा-विच्छोलिअ-फलट्ठि-णिग्गअ-कसाय-गन्धाण,विरल-भमराणघोलइ लच्छीजम्बू-तरुअलाण"
english: "It's the stream - The creeper - The fruit - The needle - The butcher - The brimstone, The sparrow - The swallow - The lacquered jumbo - The swordman"

prakrit: "उक्कन्दलाण घोलइ इहसेरिह-दलिअ-केसर-वणाण,गन्धो उब्बुद्ध-कलम्ब-सीअलो सेल-कडआण"
english: "Ukkandalan dissolves Iheserih - Dalia - Kesar - Vanaan, fragrant - Ubuddha - Kalamba - Sialo - Kadaan"

prakrit: "इह सलिल-किलिण्णाअम्ब-विरस-मालूर-सार-सुरहीण,जलअ-समयम्मि रण्णाणिलाण णिव्वडइ सोहग्गं"
english: "This salil - Kilinaamba - Virasa - Malur - Saras - Soundless, Water - Time - The forest fires of the forest Give pleasure."

prakrit: "णव-धारा-पडिबज्झन्त-रेणु-परिसामला थली-मग्गा,धूसर-हरिण-खुर-च्छेअ-कब्बुरा इह विराअन्ति"
english: "A new stream, a fresh stream, A fresh lotus, A fragrant dish of jasmine, A grey deer, Hoofs and buds - Kabbura is the end of an era."

prakrit: "अवमेहाओ वि मइल-चन्दिमा होन्ति सोम्म-पवणाओ,सलिलन्ध-गअण-दर-णिव्वडन्त-ताराओ रअणीओ"
english: "Even the waning moon gives birth to sunshine, And the moonlight fills the sky with stars."

prakrit: "इह सा उम्मुद्दिअ-सिन्दुवार-मअरन्द-बन्ध-सुहआण,सरअ-दिअसाण विअसइ लच्छी उग्गन्ध-कमलाण"
english: "Here's that lotus - vermilion - dead - bandaged - beautiful, fragrant - thick - busy - lush - with orange blossom."

prakrit: "इअ सअल-दिसा-अड-विअय-मिलिअ-महि-मण्डलेहĩ सच्चविआ,सेणा-भडेहĩ से सुहअ-संणिवेसा वणुद्देसा"
english: "It is true love, Friendship, Love and affection - Like a good man's business, Like treasure hunted by the army, Like a forest fire."

prakrit: "एए विरत्त-सुरचाव-विरस-विरलाहिलक्खिअ-च्छाया,महिस-खुर-च्छेअ-विहाविअ-प्पहा मणि-अडुद्देसा"
english: "Oh! absence - Surachao - Virasa - Viral - Silly - The eyes of the God of Love, The ears of the buffalo - The hoofs - The hips - The feet of the beast - The beads - Aduddesa"

prakrit: "इच्छा-परिअत्त-लआ-विआण-उद्देस-पीडिअ-दुमाण,छाया सच्चिअ अण्ण व्व रण्ण-फरुसा उववणाण"
english: "Desire - complete - longing - desire - anger - pain - suffering - wretchedness, shadow - greed and falsehood - these are the words of one man."

prakrit: "विब्भमवईण भिज्जन्तमलअ-परिगूढ-केसरं जाण,ताणञ्चिअ विअलइ इह लआण फल-पॆल्लिअं कुसुमं"
english: "A lotus soaked in vibhama - Know the difference between jasmine and saffron - Looks like a lotus Placed on top of the fruit"
