prakrit: "जे भिक्खू दारुदण्डयं पायपुञ्छणं विसुयावेति विसुयावॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those monks who make it a point to touch one's feet with an axe go as far as the axe or sickle."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अचित्तपतिट्ठियं गन्धं जिङ्घति जिङ्घन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those monks who smell the fresh perfume, Smell the poison, Or are sober."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू पयमग्गं वा सङ्कमं वा आलम्बनं वा सयमेव करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who follows a path of pathos or of suffering or of vows always acts as one who renounces them."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू दगवीणियं सयमेव करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who practices asceticism always acts as a healer or healer."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सिक्कगं वा सिक्कगनन्तगं वा सयमेव करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जिति."
english: "That a bhikkhu takes a coin or a whole bunch of coins or does the same thing over and over again."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सॊत्तियं वा रज्जुयं वा चिलिमिलिं सयमेव करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who does everything by himself, whether it's a sotya or a cord or a spiky handshake, is called a saint."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सूईए उत्तरकरणं सयमेव करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The monk who sleeps always does the same in reply, or is more truthful."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू पिप्पलयस्स उत्तरकरणं सयमेव करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who manages to get the answer from the layman must do so either in person or in private."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू नहच्छेयणगस्स उत्तरकरणं सयमेव करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who does not practice penance always performs penance or penance."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू कण्णसोहणयस्स उत्तरकरणं सयमेव करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who satisfies the eye always does the same in reply, or satisfies it."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू लहुसगं फरुसं वयति वयन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who treats leprosy with kindness or kindness grows old."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू लहुसगं मुसं वयति वयन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That monk with whom I used to lie for a long time Is really my enemy."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू लहुसगं अदत्तं आदियति आदियन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the bhikkhu lashes out at one's opponent, or at least at the other."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू लहुसएण सीओदग-वियडेण वा उसिणोदग-वियडेण वा हत्थाणि वा पादाणि वा कण्णाणि वा अच्छीणि वा दन्ताणि वा नहाणि वा मुहाणि वा उच्छोलॆज्ज वा पधोवॆज्ज वा उच्छोलॆन्तं वा पधोवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That which is eaten by a monk with a leech on it, By the hand or foot or eye or fingernail or tooth or nail or mouth or lip or tongue or tongue Or feet on the ground."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू कसिणाइं चम्माइं धरेति धरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those monks who catch hold of cousins by the scruff of the neck suffer torture."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू कसिणाइं वत्थाइं धरेति धरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those monks who catch turtles by the scruff of the neck suffer as well as those who do not."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अभिन्नाइं वत्थाइं धरेइ धरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the bhikkhu holds aloft with his bare hands Or walks in silence."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू लाउयपायं वा दारुपायं वा मट्टियापायं वा सयमेव परिघट्टेति वा सण्ठवेति वा जमावॆन्ति वा परिघट्टॆन्तं वा सण्ठवॆन्त वा जमावॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who is fond of laudatory talk or drinking wine or playing the flute, Who is always on the fence or standing in line or sitting in line, Is always righteous."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू दण्डगं वा लट्ठियं वा अवलेहणियं वा वेणुसूइयं वा सयमेव परिघट्टेति वा सण्ठवेति वा जमावॆन्ति वा परिघट्टॆन्तं वा सण्ठवॆन्तं वा जमावॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who is won over by a stick or a baton or an indentured servant or a needle of bamboo or someone who is constantly being circumscribed or bullied or cooped up is a true saint."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू नियग-गवेसियं पडिग्गहगं धरेति धरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who seizes a poor man's footing holds on to him or him in silence."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू पर-गवेसियं पडिग्गहगं धरेति धरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The monk who is angry at the stranger Holds the pyre with him Until he is captured or executed."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू वर-गवेसियं पडिग्गहगं धरेति धरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who seizes the bridegroom's hand holds on to the altar or sits beside it."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू बल-गवेसियं पडिग्गहगं धरेति धरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The monk who seizes the reed by force holds on to it or seizes it."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू लव-गवेसियं पडिग्गहगं धरेति धरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who seizes hold of the fallen arrow in love - affection is condemned to eternal damnation."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू नितियं अग्गपिण्डं भुञ्जति भुञ्जन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who constantly roasts the fire is called a bhunjant or a satyagraha."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू नितियं पिण्डं भुजन्ति भुञ्जन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those monks who daily fry the pindams roast or sauté them."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू नितियं अवड्ढं भुञ्जति भुञ्जन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Jis bhikkhu nityam awadh bhunjati bhujant or satijjati."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू नितियं भागं भुञ्जति भुञ्जन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who roasts the daily portion roasts it, or the one who gathers it."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू नितियं अवड्ढभागं भुञ्जति भुञ्जन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who would roast the leftovers daily would be roasted or sautéed." ""

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू नितियं वासं वसति वसन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The monk who resides in nature resides in spring or in winter."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू पुरेसन्थवं वा पच्छासन्थवं वा करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That a bhikkhu purifies or purifies, or that he corrects or tolerates."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू समाणे वा वसमाणे वा गामाणुगामं वा दूइज्जमाणे पुरे सन्थुयाणि वा पच्छासन्थुयाणि वा कुलाइं पुव्वामेव पच्छा वा भिक्खायरियाए अनुपविसति अनुपविसन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those monks who, in a dream or a dream, visit a village or make offerings, Put on their clothes, Wash their hands and put them on their feet - Either they are wise or they are begging - for help, Unsure or indifferent."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नउत्थिएण वा गारत्थिएण वा परिहारिओ वा अपरिहारिएणं सद्धिं गाहावइ-कुलं पिण्डवाय-पडियाए अनुपविसति वा निक्खमति वा अनुपविसन्तं वा निक्खमन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the bhikkhu should offer food or garland it, Or that he should give it to the poor or the needy - The whole mass - Fallen and unmanageable or inexhaustible or inconclusive Or worthless or worthless - Sacrifice."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नउत्थिएण वा गारत्थिएण वा परिहारिओ वा अपरिहारिएण सद्धिं बहिया वियारभूमिं वा विहारभूमिं वा निक्खमति वा पविसति वा निक्खमन्तं वा परिसन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the bhikkhu goes to bed hungry or thirsty or poor or indigestible, Succeeds in everything, Escapes from bedside to bedside, Resides in sanctum sanctorum, Is a blessing in disguise."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नउत्थिएण वा गारत्थिएण वा परिहारिओ वा अपरिहारिएहिं सद्धिं गामाणुगामं दूइज्जति दूइज्जन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who is deprived of food, or deprived of it, or who is indisposed, Is condemned to travel the distance Through the village, Or is condemned to die."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नयरं भोयण-जायं पडिगाहॆत्ता सुब्भिं-सुब्भिं भुञ्जति दुब्भिं-दुब्भिं परिट्ठवेति परिट्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who is angry at others Succeeds only when they are angry - Sucking in his heart When he is angry And rebuking when he is embarrassed Or being treated with kindness."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नयरं पानग-जायं पडिगाहॆत्ता पुप्फयं-पुप्फयं आइयइ कसायं-कसायं परिट्ठवेति परिट्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who comes after another Asks whether he wants to drink wine or drink wine Butcher - The butcher replies:" "Either you agree with me or you disagree." ""

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू मणुण्णं भोयण-जायं पडिग्गाहॆत्ता बहुपरियावण्णं सिया अदूरे तत्थ साहम्मिया सम्भोइया समणुण्णा अपरिहारिया सन्ता परिवसन्ति ते अनापुच्छित्ता अनिमन्तिया परिट्ठवेति परिट्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those monks who travel far and wide, As though they had nothing to offer, As if they had no friends, Are won over by incompetence, Are irresolute, indifferent, persistently pursue one's vocation or desire."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सागारिय-पिण्डं गेण्हति गेण्हन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those bhikkhu who gather the ocean - mass gather it, or those who gather it."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सागारिय-पिण्डं भुञ्जति भुञ्जन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those monks who roast the sagari - ground meat roast it or sauté it."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सागारिय-कुलं अजाणिय अपुच्छिय अगवेसिय पुव्वामेव पिण्डवाय-पडियाए अनुप्पविसति अनुप्पविसन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those monks who, unbeknownst to the seer's family, Are unable to blink an eyelid, Fall at every step, Succeed in regretting it, Or are content with it."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सागारिय-निस्साए असनं वा पानं वा खाइमं वा साइमं वा ओभासिय-ओभासिय जायति जायन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "As long as the bhikkhu is sagacious - As though he were asleep - or drinking - or eating - or bathing - Or is in a state of intoxication - As if he are intoxicated - He is safe."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू उडुबद्धियं सॆज्जा-सन्थारयं परं पज्जोसवणाओ उवातिणाति उवातिणन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those monks who make offerings made of wood, Decorate themselves with the purest fragrance, Perform penance every day, Or suffer as long as they are boiled."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू वासावासियं सॆज्जा-सन्थारयं परं दसरायकप्पाओ उवातिणाति उवातिणन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who spends the night in the spring sets the sunrise and the sunset aside." ""

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू उड्डुबद्धियं वा वासावासियं वा सॆज्जा-सन्थारगं उवरि सिज्जमाणं पेहाए न ओसारेति न ओसारॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu who has grown up wearing white robes, Or who resides in the desert, Or whose clothes are smeared with turmeric powder, Is not worthy of worship Nor is he worthy of being worshipped."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू पाडिहारियं सॆज्जा-सन्थारयं दॊच्चम्पि अणुण्णवॆत्ता बाहिं नीणेति नीणॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who guards the sanctum - sanctorum, sniffs at the scruff of the neck, puts his arms around the woman sleeping soundly or stands by silently."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सागारियसन्तियं सॆज्जासन्थारयं अणुण्णवॆत्ता बाहिं नीणेति नीणॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the bhikkhu is so absorbed in sagara That he does not move his arms or move them unless called upon to do so."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू पाडिहारियं सागारियसन्तियं वा सॆज्जासन्थारयं दॊच्चं पि अणुण्णवॆत्ता बाहिं नीणेति नीणॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who has reached the pinnacle of renunciation, Or who, even after reaching the top of the ladder, Has reached the bottom of the pyre, Decides whether to go down to the water or stay there."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू पाडिहारियं सॆज्जा-सन्थारयं आयाए अपडिहट्टु सम्पव्वयति सम्पव्वयन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who comes to a holy and orderly place Performs ablutions throughout the whole month or season."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सागारियं-सन्तियं सॆज्जा-सन्थारयं आयाए अविगरणं कट्टु अणप्पिणित्ता सम्पव्वयइ सम्पव्वयन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who comes to the saṃgāryam - saṃjñā - sañjā - śāntarāya is bound to go astray, either completely or completely, as long as he stays awake."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू पाडिहारियं वा सागारिय-सन्तियं वा सॆज्जा-सन्थारयं विप्पणट्ठं न गवेसति न गवेसन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "One who does not seek the pen of a bhikkhu, Pāḍihāryam, Sāgārya, or Sējjā, Satijātya, Does not seek refuge with a monk, nor with one who is devoted to learning."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू इत्तरियम्पि उवहिं न पडिलेहेति न पडिलेहॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu who is so eager does not fall at all, neither falls until he falls, nor is he satisfied."

prakrit: "तं सेवमाणे आवज्जइ मासियं परिहारट्ठाणं उग्घातियं."
english: "He is welcomed with service, For months the traveler has threatened to leave." ""

"Be it the monks who are visitors or the hostages or the pilgrims at the guest house or the relatives or the friends at the banquet hall or the food served or the garlands served, The asanas served with water or the khaimams served with rice or rice, The sathyamas performed with rice and wheat, Or the satires performed with milk and flour." ""

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू आगन्तारेसु वा आरामागारेसु वा गाहावतिकुलेसु वा परियावसहेसु वा अन्नउत्थिया वा गारत्थिया वा असनं वा पानं वा खाइमं वा साइमं वा ओभासति ओभासन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the bhikkhu treats the visitor or the guest of repose or the pilgrims treat him with kindness or affection or with food and drink or food and water or with affection or affection."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू आगन्तारेसु वा आरामागारेसु वा गाहावतिकुलेसु वा परियावसहेसु वा अन्नउत्थिणीं वा गारत्थिणीं वा असनं वा पानं वा खाइमं वा साइमं वा ओभासति ओभासन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the monks visit, or rest, or make offerings, or embrace, or bring food, or garland, or lie down, or drink, or eat, or swim, Or lie in wait, Or make supplication."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू आगन्तारेसु वा आरामगारेसु वा गाहावतिकुलेसु वा परियावसहेसु वा अन्नउत्थिणीओ वा गारत्थिणीओ वा असनं वा पानं वा खाइमं वा साइमं वा ओभासति ओभासन्तं वा सातिज्जति ।."
english: "That the monks visit, or take rest, or go to bed, or make love, or bring food, or garland, or lie down, or drink, or eat, or swim, Or lie down in silence, Or make love."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू आगन्तारेसु वा० कोउहल्ल-पडियाए पडियागतं समाणं अन्नउत्थियं वा गारत्थियं वा असनं वा पानं वा खाइमं वा साइमं वा ओभासति ओभासन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who is a visitor or a visitor who is annoyed at being stung all the time Wakes up with food or drink or food or sleep or nausea or vomiting."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू आगन्तारेसु वा० कोउहल्ल-पडियाए पडियागता समाणा अन्नउत्थिया वा गारत्थिया वा असनं वा पानं वा खाइमं वा साइमं वा ओभासति ओभासन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who is a visitor or a traveler gets angry When food is offered to him or her, When he or she is absent, When a meal is served, When there is no drink, Whether there is silence, Or when there is nausea."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू आगन्तारेसु वा० कोउहल्ल-पडियाए पडियागत्तं समाणं अन्नउत्थिणीं वा गारत्थिणीं वा असनं वा पानं वा खाइमं वा साइमं वा ओभासति ओभासन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who is a visitor or a traveler is always annoyed When food is offered to him or her, When he offers it to her, Or when it is refused, Or if it is with his wife or daughter."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू आगन्तारेसु वा० कोउहल्ल-पडियाए पडियागत्तं समाणं अन्नउत्थिणीओ वा गारत्थिणीओ वा असनं वा पानं वा खाइमं वा साइमं वा ओभासति ओभासन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The monks who visit, Or the nuns who fall at every step, Are satisfied with everything - Food, drink, pastime, silence, nausea, vomiting, fever, etc."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू आगन्तारेसु वा आरामगारेसु वा गाहावतिकूलेसु वा परियावसहेसु वा अन्नउत्थिएण वा गारत्थिएण वा असनं वा पानं वा खाइमं वा साइमं वा अभिहडं आहट्टु दिज्जमाणं पडिसेहॆत्ता तमेव अनुवत्तिय-अनुवत्तिय परिवेढिय-परिवेढिय परिजविय-परिजविय ओभासति ओभासन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who is threatened by a visitor or a guest in a guest house or by an angry neighbor or by being threatened with food or drink or food or affection Is threatened with death if he happens to cross the threshold."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू आगन्तारेसु वा जाव परियावसहेसु वा अन्नउत्थिएण वा गारत्थिएण वा असनं वा पाणं वा खाइमं साइमं वा अभिहडं आहट्टु दिज्जमाणं पडिसेहॆत्ता तमेव अनुवत्तिय अनुवत्तिय परिवेढिय-परिवेढिय परिजविय-परिजविय ओभासति ओभासन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who is a visitor or a traveler, Who gathers nourishment or presents it, Who takes it with him or her, Who puts it with his or her mouth, Who scratches the nail marks on the head, Who carries it around with him Or who holds it in his hand, Who transmits it to others."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू आगन्तारेसु वा जाव परियावसहेसु वा अन्नउत्थिएण वा गारत्थिएण वा असनं वा पानं वा खाइमं साइमं वा अभिहडं आहट्टु दिज्जमाणं पडिसेहॆत्ता तमेव अनुवत्तिय अनुवत्तिय परिवेढिय-परिवेढिय परिजविय-परिजविय ओभासति ओभासन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who is a visitor or a traveler, Who gathers nourishment or presents it, Who takes it with him or her, Who puts it down with his or her mouth, Who scratches the nail marks on the head, Who carries it around with him Or who touches it with his tongue."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू गाहावइकुलं पिण्डवाय-पडिवाए पविट्ठे पडियाइक्खिए समाणे दॊच्चं तमेव कुलं अनुप्पविसति अनुप्पविसन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who has reached the pinnacle of purity At the moment when he sees a flock of cows Struggling to find a mate Or even making love With one's mate."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सङ्खडि-पलोयणाए असनं वा पानं वा खाइमं वा साइमं वा पडिग्गाहेति पडिग्गाहॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The monk who gathers and pastures, Drinks, eats, sleeps, walks, sits or sits by himself."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू गाहावइकुलं पिण्डवाय-पडियाए अनुपविट्ठे समाणे परं ति-घरन्तराओ असनं वा पानं वा खाइमं वा साइमं वा अभिहडं आहट्टु दिज्जमाणं पडिग्गाहेति पडिग्गाहॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who has reached the pinnacle of renown, Who after an uneventful assembly Has brought the household to a standstill, Eats little food, Drinks little water, Sweats little milk, Sighs little by little, Succeeds only in this respect."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो पाए आमज्जॆज्ज वा पमज्जॆज्ज वा आमज्जन्तं वा पमज्जतं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu who finds himself in trouble is either tried or acquitted, or is acquitted or acquitted."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो पाए संवाहॆज्ज वा पलिमद्दॆज्ज वा संवाहेतं वा पलिमद्दॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति ।."
english: "A monk who finds himself or herself chained, or bound, or restrained, or till chastised, is chaste."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो पाए तॆल्लेण वा घएण वा वसाए वा नवनीएण वा अब्भङ्गॆज्ज वा मक्खॆज्ज वा अब्भङ्गॆन्तं वा मक्खॆन्त्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who finds himself lost, or wounded, or worn out, or bruised, or battered, or stung, or spiky, or like a snake, Or like a spider, Is condemned to death."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो पाए लॊद्धेण वा क्ककेण वा चुण्णेण वा वण्णेण वा उल्लोलॆज्ज वा उव्वट्टॆज्ज वा उल्लोलॆन्तं वा उव्वट्टॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu who finds himself robbed or groped for, or pinched or gnawed at, or indecent, or groveling, or sulking, or spitting, or yawning, or clinging to, is cursed."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो पाए सीओदग-वियडेण वा उसिणोदग-वियडेण वा उच्छोलॆज्ज वा पधोवॆज्ज वा उच्छोलॆन्तं वा पधोवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu who finds himself alone is purified through penance, through sacrifice, through bathing, through washing, or through being washed."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो पाए फुमॆज्ज वा रऎज्ज या फुमॆन्तं वा रऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The monk who finds himself in a fume, or in a fire, or under a fountain, or over a rainbow, Or in silence."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो कायं आमज्जॆज्ज वा पमज्जॆज्ज वा आमज्जन्तं वा पमज्जन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu does what is right in front of him, whether it be worship or penance or love or anger."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अपप्णो कायं संवाहॆज्ज वा पलिमद्दॆज्ज संवाहॆन्तं वा पलिमद्दॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu who has fallen in love communicates something to me, or who is in a relationship with a woman who is not."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो कायं तॆल्लेण वा घएण वा वसाए वा नवनीएण वा अब्भङ्गॆज्ज वा मक्खॆज्ज वा अब्भङ्गॆन्तं वा मक्खॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That a monk treats himself as though he had been taught something, Or as if he were wounded, Or made fat, Or had been made thin, Or was suffering from nausea, Anorexia, or a bee sting."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो कायं लॊद्धेण वा क्ककेण वा चुण्णेण वा वण्णेण वा उल्लोलॆज्ज वा उव्वट्टॆज्ज वा उल्लोलॆन्तं वा उव्वट्टॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu forgives anyone who restrains him from doing something, Whether it be by being angry or by being suspicious or by showing disrespect."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो कायं सीओदग-वियडेण वा उसिणोदग-वियडेण वा उच्छोलॆज्ज वा पधोवॆज्ज वा उच्छोलॆन्तं वा पधोवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the monk treats himself with courtesy Or with affection Or with reserve Or with disapproval Or with scorn Or with contempt Or with disrespect."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो कायं फुमॆज्ज वा रऎज्ज वा फुमॆन्तं वा रऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu forgives what inflames him, or causes it to inflame, or makes it swell."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो कायंसि वणं आमज्जॆज्ज वा पमज्जॆज्ज वा आमज्जन्तं वा पमज्जन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who renounces himself, Whether you renounce the forest or the pastime or the nature of the past."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो कायंसि वणं संवाहॆज्ज वा पलिमद्दॆज्ज वा संवाहॆन्तं वा पलिमद्दॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who renounces himself, Sacrifices the forest, Or protects the pastime, Or treats it as if it were pastime."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो कायंसि वणं तॆल्लेण वा घएण वा वसाए वा नवनीएण वा अब्भङ्गॆज्ज वा मक्खॆज्ज वा अब्भङ्गॆन्तं वा मक्खॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who renounces himself Because he knows the forest, Or because he hates the grass, Or if he detests it, He despises it, Or when it offends him, It scorns him."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो कायंसि वणं लॊद्धेण वा क्ककेण वा चुण्णेण वा वण्णेण वा उल्लोलॆज्ज वा उव्वट्टॆज्ज वा उल्लोलॆन्तं वा उव्वट्टॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who renounces himself, Because the forest is full of thorns, Or the field is empty, Or because it is overgrown, Or overgrown with weeds, Or still standing."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो कायंसि वणं सीओदग-वियडेण वा उसिणोदग-वियडेण वा उच्छोलॆज्ज वा पधोवॆज्ज वा उच्छोलॆन्तं वा पधोवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who renounces his own forest Resides in it until it is burnt down, or after it has been boiled, or before it is boiled, Or after it is steamed, Or until it has already been boiled."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो कायंसि वणं फुमॆज्ज वा रऎज्ज वा फुमॆन्तं वा रऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who renounces himself, Destroys the forest With fumes or rays of the sun Or with fire with fire."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो कायंसि गण्डं वा पिडयं वा अरइयं वा असियं वा भगन्दलं वा अन्नयरेणं तिक्खेणं सत्थजाएणं अच्छिन्दॆज्ज वा विच्छिन्दॆज्ज वा अच्छिन्दन्तं वा विच्छिन्दन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "If you are a monk, do not trouble yourself, Whether you are angry or annoyed or indifferent Or if you suffer from nausea or vomiting, If you want to be alone, Then go and lie down beside someone else."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो कायंसि गण्डं वा पिडयं वा अरइयं वा असियं वा भगन्दलं वा अन्नयरेणं तिक्खेणं सत्थजाएणं अच्छिन्दित्ता वा विच्छिन्दित्ता वा पूयं वा सोणियं वा नीहरॆज्ज वा विसोहॆज्ज वा नीहरॆन्तं वा विसोहॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who renounces what is dear to him Suffers indignation, Anger, Unhappiness, Nausea, Vaginal cramp, Stiffness, Constipation, Numbness, Weeping, Sweating, Nervousness, Anxiety, Anxiousness, Suffering."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो कायंसि गण्डं वा पिडयं वा अरइयं वा असियं वा भगन्दलं वा अन्नयरेणं तिक्खेणं सत्थजाएणं अच्छिन्दित्ता वा विच्छिन्दित्ता वा पूयं वा सोणियं वा नीहरित्ता वा विसोहॆत्ता वा सीओदग-वियडेण वा उसिणोदग-वियडेण वा उच्छोलॆज्जा व पधोवॆज्ज वा उच्छोलॆन्तं वा पधोवॆन्त वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who renounces himself is like a bull or a buffalo, Like an ox or a donkey, Like a bird in a manger, Like three strands of grass, Like two turtledoves in a cage, Or like two young bulls in a field, Like water in a well, Like nectar, Like poison in a fire, Like wine in a basin, Like the top of a bower."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो कायंसि गण्डं वा पिडयं वा अरइयं वा असियं वा भगन्दलं वा अन्नयरेणं तिक्खेणं सत्थजाएणं अच्छिन्दित्ता वा विच्छिन्दित्ता वा पूयं वा सोणियं वा नीहरित्ता वा विसोहॆत्ता वा सीओदग-वियडेण वा उसिणोदग-वियडेण वा उच्छोलॆत्ता वा पधोऎत्ता वा अन्नयरेणं आलेवणजाएणं आलिम्पॆज्ज वा विलिम्पॆज्ज वा आलिम्पन्तं वा विलिम्पन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who renounces what is dear to him Suffers humiliation Whether it be because of a knot or a bruise or an abscess or a clenched fist Or because of an injury to the anus Or because it is painful to the penis Or because he is distressed by an injury or a cut on the forehead Or simply because he cannot breathe."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो कायंसि गण्डं वा पिडयं वा अरइयं वा असियं वा भगन्दलं वा अन्नयरेणं तिक्खेणं सत्थजाएणं अच्छिन्दित्ता वा विच्छिन्दित्ता वा पूयं वा सोणियं वा नीहरित्ता वा विसोहॆत्ता वा सीओदग-वियडेण वा उसिणोदग-वियडेण वा उच्छोलॆत्ता वा पधोऎत्ता वा अन्नयरेणं आलेवणजाएणं आलिम्पित्ता वा विलिम्पित्ता वा तॆल्लेण वा घएण वा वसाए वा नवनीएण वा अब्भङ्गॆज्ज वा मक्खॆज्ज वा अब्भङ्गॆन्तं वा मक्खॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who renounces himself is condemned to suffer bodily or bodily harm, To be impaled by a knot or an axe, To have a clitoris or an anvil pierced by a sharp arrow, To suffer bruises or cuts or bruises on his forehead, To lose sight of gold or nectar, To grow weary of affection, To shed sweat or tears, To grovel under the weight of other women, To fall into the abyss or to fly free."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो कायंसि गण्डं वा पिडयं वा अरइयं वा असियं वा भगन्दलं वा अन्नयरेणं तिक्खेणं सत्थजाएणं अच्छिन्दित्ता वा विच्छिन्दित्ता वा पूयं वा सोणियं वा नीहरित्ता वा विसोहॆत्ता वा सीओदग-वियडेण वा उसिणोदग-वियडेण वा उच्छोलॆत्ता वा पधोऎत्ता वा अन्नयरेणं आलेवणजाएणं अलिम्पित्ता वा विलिम्पित्ता वा तॆल्लेण वा घएण वा वसाए वा नवनीएण वा अब्भङ्गॆत्ता वा मक्खॆत्ता वा अन्नयरेणं धूवणजाएणं धूवॆज्ज वा पधूवॆज्ज वा धूवॆन्तं वा पधूवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who renounces what is dear to him Suffers torture Whether it be from the girdle, from the wound, or from the fire, From the clenched fist, From other women's tears, From stillborn wounds, From bruises to bruises, From wounds inflicted by wounds inflicted on the body, Or from burns inflicted by the arrow of a sharp arrow, From burns inflicted upon the body of a poor girl to burns inflicted on her face."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो पाउकिमियं वा कुच्छिकिमियं वा अङ्गुलीए निवेसिय-निवेसिय नीहरति नीहरन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who devotes himself to penance, or to lewd acts, Or to bitterness of the fingers, Is as good as dead."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो दीहाओ नह-सिहाओ कप्पॆज्ज वा सण्ठवॆज्ज वा कप्पॆन्तं वा सण्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who does not torment himself - Either because he is angry or angry or frustrated - Is a traitor to the faith."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो दीहाइं जङ्घ-रोमाइं कप्पॆज्ज वा सण्ठवॆज्ज वा कप्पॆन्तं वा सण्ठवेतं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu protects his thighs and thighs for a long time, a cowherd or a shepherd or a hunter."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो दीहाइं वत्थि-रोमाइं कप्पेज वा सण्ठवॆज्ज वा कप्पॆन्तं वा सण्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu who dedicates his days to penance renounces penance, whether it be in marriage or in charity or in marriage."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो दीहाइं चक्खु रोमाइं कप्पॆज्ज वा सण्ठवॆज्ज वा कप्पॆन्तं वा सण्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who has tasted his daily bread, Succeeds in pacifying those who are thirsty, Suffers from nausea, Constipation, or indigestion."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो दीहाइं कक्खाण-रोमाइं कप्पॆज्ज वा सण्ठवॆज्ज वा कप्पॆन्तं वा सण्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu who dedicates his whole life to teaching is like a hunter, Like a farmer's son or daughter."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो दीहाइं मंसु-रोमाइं कप्पॆज्ज वा सण्ठवॆज्ज वा कप्पॆन्तं वा सण्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu who dedicates his days to penance renounces penance, whether for penance or penance."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो दन्ते आघंसॆज्ज वा पघंसॆज्ज वा आघंसन्तं वा वा पघंसन्तं वा सातिज्जति।."
english: "That a monk treats himself with affection, Whether with teeth or with feet or with eyes or with ears..."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो दन्ते उच्छोलॆज्ज वा पधोवॆज्ज वा उच्छोलॆन्तं वा पधोवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति।."
english: "That a monk treats himself with kindness, Either by brushing his teeth or brushing them, Or by bowing them."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो दन्ते फुमॆज्ज वा रऎज्ज वा फुमॆन्तं वा रऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who treats himself with kindness, Whose teeth are set on fire, Or with kindling, Or without fire."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो उट्ठे आमज्जॆज्ज वा पमज्जॆज्ज वा आमज्जन्तं वा पमज्जन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who stands up on his own is either a disgrace or a curse or a blessing."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो उट्ठे संवाहॆज्ज वा पलिमद्दॆज्ज वा संवाहॆन्तं वा पलिमद्देतं वा सातिज्जति ।."
english: "A monk who raises himself up is a messenger or a healer or a communicant or a pacifier or a friend..."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो उट्ठे तॆल्लेण वा घएण वा वसाए वा नवनीएण वा अब्भङ्गॆज्ज वा मक्खॆज्ज वा अब्भङ्गॆन्तं वा मक्खॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That a monk treats himself as though he were a creeper, Or as if he were an ox, Or a fowler, A novice, A stranger, A fly, A wasp, Or even a bee."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो उट्ठे लॊद्धेण वा क्ककेण वा चुण्णेण वा वण्णेण वा उल्लोलॆज्ज वा उव्वट्टॆज्ज वा उल्लोलॆन्तं वा उव्वट्टॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu who finds himself standing up is protected by being robbed or kicked, by being groped for, or by being yoked around, or being propped up, or even being kicked around."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो उट्ठे सीओदग-वियडेण वा उसिणोदग-वियडेण वा उच्छोलॆज्ज वा पधोवॆज्ज वा उच्छोलॆन्तं वा पधोवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the monk treats himself with courtesy Whether by standing up, sitting down, or reclining, or raising up, or bathing, or waving his head, or walking up and down."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो उट्ठे फुमॆज्ज वा रऎज्ज वा फुमॆन्तं वा रऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who rouses himself becomes like a fire or a flame, Like a fountain or a rainbow."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो दीहाइं उत्तरॊट्ठ-रोमाइं कप्पॆज्ज वा सण्ठवॆज्ज वा कप्पॆन्तं वा सण्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति ।- ."
english: "A bhikkhu who dedicates his days to penance renounces penance, whether for penance or penance." ""

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो दीहाइं अच्छि-पत्ताइं कप्पॆज्ज वा सण्ठवॆज्ज वा कप्पॆन्तं वा सठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu who dedicates his whole life to teaching is like a farmer's son - in - law, like an ox or a buffalo."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो अच्छीणि आमज्जॆज्ज वा ."
english: "One who disciplines oneself is worthy of worship."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो अच्छीणि संवाहॆज्जवा० सातिज्जत्ति."
english: "A monk who disciplines himself is a good communicator."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो अच्छीणि तॆल्लेण वा घएण वा वसाए वा नवनीएण वा अब्भङ्गॆज्ज वा मक्खॆज्ज वा अब्भङ्गॆन्तं वा मक्खॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who treats himself well will be treated just as well, if only for the sake of being thin or worn out or thin, if not for his breasts, or for his eyes, or if only to distract him."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो अच्छीणि लॊद्धेण वा कक्केण वा चुण्णेण वा वण्णेण वा उल्लोलॆज्ज वा उव्वट्टॆज्ज वा उल्लोलॆन्तं वा उव्वट्टॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who treats himself well will be treated just as well if he is robbed or groped for, or pinched, or bitten by, or scolded, or kicked, or even kicked."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो अच्छीणि सीओदग-वियडेण वा उसिणोदग-वियडेण वा उच्छोलॆज्ज वा पधोवॆज्ज वा उच्छोलॆन्तं वा पधोवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who treats himself well will be treated just as well, whether by bathing in the spring or summer or autumn."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो अच्छीणि फुमॆज्ज वा रऎज्ज वा फुमॆन्तं वा रऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति ।."
english: "That a monk treats himself with kindness, Kindness, humility, politeness, and courtesy..."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो दीहाइं भमुग-रोमाइं कप्पॆज्ज वा सण्ठवॆज्ज वा कप्पॆन्तं वा सण्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu who dedicates his days to begging, Succeeds in making offerings, Or sits astride a snake, Or walks on its back."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो दीहाइं पास-रोमाइं कप्पॆज्ज वा सण्ठवॆज्ज वा कप्पॆन्तं वा सण्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who has passed his days - The days are fleeting Or the weeks are long, Or the months are long."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो अच्छिमलं वा कण्णमलं वा दन्तमलं वा नहमलं वा नीहरॆज्ज वा विसोहॆज्जा वा नीहरॆन्तं वा विसोहॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the bhikkhu treats himself as if he were an acacia or lotus, or toothache or nail marks, or a nectar or poison mark, or even as though he were a needle."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो कायाओ सेयं वा जल्लं वा पङ्कं वा मलं वा नीहरॆज्ज वा विसोहॆज्ज वा नीहरॆन्तं वा विसोहॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who treats himself with kindness will be treated with courtesy, Whether it be with water or with flour or with feces or with nectar or with poison."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू गामाणुगामं दूइज्जमाणे अप्पणो सीसदुवारियं करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who leads the village walks like a doe, Doing his duty in secret or in secret."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सणकप्पासओ वा उण्णकप्पासओ वा पॊण्डकप्पासओ वा अमिलकप्पासओ वा वसीकरणसुत्तयं करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "One who practices renunciation, whether as a mendicant or as an ascetic, whether in the village pond or in the hamlet, does what is lawful or right."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू गिहंसि वा गिहमुहंसि वा गिहदुवारंसि वा गिहपडिदुवारंसि वा गिहेलुयंसि वा गिहङ्गणंसि वा गिहवच्चंसि वा उच्चारं वा पासवणं वा परिट्ठवेति परिट्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "One who is a bhikkhu observes the vows of his monks, Whether they be solemn or solemn, Whether he be a monk or a hermit, If they be heavy, If he be brave, If ever they be weighty, Or speak plainly, Or go beyond their bounds."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू मडगगिहंसि वा मडगछारियंसि वा मडगधूभियंसि वा मडगआसयंसि वा मडगलेणंसि वा मडगथण्डिलंसि वा मडगवच्चंसि वा उच्चारं वा पासवणं वा परिट्ठवेति परिट्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति ।."
english: "A monk who is addicted to sweets or sweets or who is afraid of sweets or wine or wiles or glances or words or speech or gestures or actions or actions will suffer the same fate as a woman whose husband has passed away."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू इङ्गालदाहंसि वा खारदाहंसि वा गातदाहंसि वा तुसदाहंसि वा भुसदाहंसि वा उच्चारं वा पासवणं वा परिट्ठवेति परिट्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu who is fond of writing in English, or eating salty food, or singing in song, or making love to you, or picking straw, or speaking aloud, or walking past, or sitting in silence, is worthy of respect."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सेयायणंसि वा पङ्कायतणंसि वा पणगायतणंसि वा उच्चारं वा पासवणं वा परिट्ठवेति परिट्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "One who serves a bhikkhu, or gives alms, or offers vows, or speaks eloquently, or follows a path, or persists in a course."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू नवियासु वा गोलेहणियासु नदियासु वा मट्टियाखाणीसु-परिभुज्ज-माणियासु वा अपरिभुज्जमाणियासु वा उच्चारं वा पासवणं वा परट्ठवेति परिट्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who is won over by novices or by bullets, by rivers or by mud mines, by rough terrain or by unfriendly people, by words spoken or passed on, or by refraining, will win favor with others."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू उम्बरवच्चंसि वा नग्गोहवच्चंसि वा असॊत्थवच्चंसि वा पिलक्खुवच्चंसि वा उच्चारं वा पासवणं वा परिट्ठवेति परिट्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That which is true of a monk, Whether you look at him from above, Or speak with him from behind, Or yawn with him, Or make him walk beside you, Or resemble him in appearance."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू इक्खुवनंसि वा सालवनंसि वा कुसुम्भवनंसि वा कप्पासवनंसि वा उच्चारं वा पासवणं वा परिट्ठवेति परिट्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That which is true of a bhikkhu, Ikhuvan, or Salwan, Kusumbhavan, or Kappasavan, Or uttered or passed on, Or practiced in a congregation, Endures."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू डागवच्चंसि वा सागवच्चंसि वा मूलवच्चंसि वा कॊत्थुम्भरिवच्चंसि वा खारवच्चंसि वा जीरयवच्चंसि वा दमणगवच्चंसि वा मरुगहवच्चंसि वा उच्चारं वा पासवणं वा परिट्ठवेति परिट्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those monks, If you see a dog or a fowler or a stag or a grasshopper or a doe or a cricketsnake or a deer or a daman or a desert stag, Or speak loudly or passively or when you speak plainly or with affection."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू असोगवनंसि वा सत्तिवण्णवनंसि वा चम्पगवनंसि वा चूयवनंसि वा अन्नतरेसु तहप्पगारेसु वा पत्तोवएसु पुप्फोवएसु फलोवएसु छाओवएसु उच्चारं वा पासवणं वा परिट्ठवेति परिट्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Whether you are a mendicant in the forest or in the scrub forest, Or whether you are in the champagna forest or among the chickpeas, Or between the paddy and the water in the paddy field or between the petals of a mango and a flower in the shade, Either you speak loudly or you speak passively or you act strangely."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू राओ वा वियाले वा उच्चार-पासवणेण उब्बाहिज्जमाणे सपायंसि वा परपायंसि वा उच्चार-पासवणं परिट्ठवॆत्ता अनुग्गए सूरिए एडेति एडॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति -."
english: "If a bhikkhu speaks or speaks nonsense, If you mutter nonsense And act indecently, Or repent, Or speak nonsense and act negligently, The sun will follow." ""

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू रायं अच्चीकरेति अच्चीकरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who corrects the rāya verges on correcting it or refuting it."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू रायं अत्थीकरेति अत्थीकरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those who follow the bhikkhu's path follow the path of righteousness."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू रायारक्खियं अत्तीकरेति अत्तीकरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the bhikkhu protects Rayarakhyam till the very end Or protects it."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू रायारक्खियं अच्चीकरेति अच्चीकरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who recites the Raya Rakshya acts as if he were a monk or a ascetic."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू रायारक्खियं अत्तीकरेति अत्थीकरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the bhikkhu protects Ra ̄ ya ̄ rā, Attracts it, or protects it."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू नगरारक्खियं अत्तीकरेति अत्तीकरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The monk who guards the city protects it, Or protects it until the very end."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू नगरारक्खियं अच्चीकरेति अच्चीकरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who guards the gate of the city acts as if he is protecting it or protecting it."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू नगरारक्खियं अत्थीकरेति अत्थीकरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The monk who guards the city Or who protects it so long or so long."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू निगमारक्खियं अत्तीकरेति अत्तीकरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the bhikkhu does not join hands with anyone else unless it is for the sake of others."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू निगमारक्खियं अच्चीकरेति अच्चीकरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who manages the congregation acts as if he were the master of the congregation or the patron of the laity."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू निगमारक्खियं अत्थीकरेति अत्थीकरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The monk who observes the fast must abide in silence until the last moment."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू देसारक्खियं अत्तीकरेति अत्तीकरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the bhikkhu protects the whole country And protects it until the very end."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू देसारक्खियं अच्चीकरेति अच्चीकरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who practices austerities in front of the people attains purity or renunciation."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू देसारक्खियं अत्थीकरेति अत्थीकरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the bhikkhu observes the order of the day with great difficulty or with much difficulty."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सव्वारक्खियं अत्तीकरेति अत्तीकरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who observes all vows acts with right intention or with wrong intention."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सव्वारक्खियं अच्चीकरेति अच्चीकरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu who practices austerities attains or attains perfection in all dealings."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सव्वारक्खियं अत्थीकरेति अत्थीकरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who observes all vows persists until the very end." ""

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू कसिणाओ ओसहीओ आहारेति आहारॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The same as a monk who is butchered gathers food or shares it."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू आयरिय-उवज्झाएहिं अविदिन्नं विगतिं आहारेति आहारॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति ।."
english: "The bhikkhu who has attained enlightenment devotes himself entirely to eating and drinking, or to being satiated."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू ठवण-कुलाइं अजाणिय अपुच्छिय अगवेसिय पुव्वामेव पिण्डवाय-पडियाए अनुप्पविसति अनुप्पविसन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those monks who, unbeknownst to the layman, turn their backs on him As if they had nothing to eat, Fall in love with him Or are content with him."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू निग्गन्थीणं उवस्सयंसि अविहीए अनुप्पविसति अनुप्पविसन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those bhikkus who abide in silence Refuse to repent, Or persist in repenting."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू निग्गन्थीणं आगमनपहंसि दण्डगं वा लट्ठियं वा रयहरणं वा मुहप्पॊत्तियं वा अन्नयरं वा उवगरणजायं ठवेति ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who comes unopposed Will be punished by a rod or a staff or a bolt of lightning or a slap on the face or by being kicked about."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू नवाइं अनुप्पणाइं अहिगरणाइं उप्पाएति उप्पाऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who renews vows, Upsets other vows, Escapes until he is forgiven."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू पोराणाइं अहिगरणाइं खामिय विओसमियाइं पुणो उदीरेति उदीरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those bhikkus who spoil the old and worn out vows Resurrect when they grow old Or become sinners."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू मुहं विप्फालिय-विप्फालिय हसति हसन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who has a wide-open smile on his face Is either joking or being sarcastic."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू पासत्थस्स सङ्घाडयं देति दॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who conceals the date of the association of pastimes is either condemned or condemned."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू पासत्थस्स सङ्घाडयं पडिच्छति पडिच्छन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The monk who happens to be in the congregation at the feast falls by the wayside or is persecuted."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू ओसन्नस्स सङ्घाडयं देति दॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the bhikkhu does not know the date of the union of Osannas or that he knows the truth."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू ओसन्नस्स सङ्घाडयं पडिच्छति पडिच्छन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The monk who happens to fall in love with a confederate falls out or is betrayed."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू कुसीलस्स सङ्घाडयं देति दॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those monks who oppose the alliance of the Kusils or those who oppose it."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू कुसीलस्स सङ्घाडयं पडिच्छति पडिच्छन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those monks who fall into the vicious circle fall in love or are lovers of one another."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू नितियस्स सङ्घाडयं देति दॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the bhikkhu does not know the date or place of its union with Nitya."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू नितियस्स सङ्घाडयं पडिच्छति पडिच्छन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who falls into the nectar of eternal union is either doomed to fall or is saved."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू संसत्तस्स सङ्घाडयं देति दॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those monks who oppose or oppose the union of the world."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू संसत्तस्स सङ्घाडयं पडिच्छत्ति पडिच्छन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who wishes to join the Sangha in Parliament falls by the wayside or is persecuted."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू उदऒल्लेण वा ससिणिद्धेण वा हत्थेण वा मत्तेण वा दव्वीए वा भायणेण वा असनं वा पानं वा खाइमं वा साइमं वा पडिग्गाहेति पडिग्गाहॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That a monk worships with open arms or with closed ones, With hands or with eyes or with lips or with tongue, With speech or with speech, With drink or with food, With pen and pen, And with speech or speech."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू गामारक्खियं अत्तीकरेति अत्तीकरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who protects the village will be protected until the very end."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू गामारक्खियं अच्चीकरेति अच्चीकरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who protects the village will be protected until he destroys it."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू गामारक्खियं अत्थीकरेति अत्थीकरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The monk who protects the village is protected until he destroys it."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सीमारक्खियं अत्तीकरेति अत्तीकरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those monks who cross the boundary line At the very end of the circle Or those who stay behind."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सीमारक्खियं अच्चीकरेति अच्चीकरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The monk who marks the boundary line acts as if he were the seal or saviour."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सीमारक्खियं अत्थीकरेति अत्थीकरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those monks who cross the boundary line, Attracted by it, Or pursue it."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू रण्णारक्खियं अत्तीकरेति अत्तीकरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the monk protects the wilderness To the extent that he protects it Or protects it."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू रण्णारक्खियं अच्चीकरेति अच्चीकरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who seeks refuge in the forest does so only to the extent of conquering it."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू रण्णारक्खियं अत्थीकरेति अत्थीकरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The monk who protects the wilderness Attracted by it Or who protects it with it."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स पाए आमज्जॆज्ज वा पमज्जॆज्ज वा आमज्जन्तं वा पमज्जन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "One who finds a monk's food desires it, either as a blessing or a curse, or as a punishment or a favor."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स पाए संवाहॆज्ज वा पलिमद्दॆज्ज वा संवाहॆन्तं वा पलिमद्दॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu who finds food attains enlightenment, either as a messenger or as a follower."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स पाए तॆल्लेण वा घएण वा वसाए वा नवनीएण वा अब्भङ्गॆज्ज वा मक्खॆज्ज वा अब्भङ्गॆन्तं वा मक्खॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who has attained to a state of mindfulness Is as wretched as a parrot, As thin as a cow, As fat as a buffalo, As fresh as a doe, As weak as a stag, As long as he does not stumble or fly."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स पाए लॊद्धेण वा कक्केण वा चुण्णेण वा वण्णेण वा उल्लोलॆज्ज वा उव्वट्टॆज्ज वा उल्लोलॆन्तं वा उव्ट्टॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "One who finds a monk's food regains consciousness, Whether by hiding or by cooking or by begging or by making fun of him, Or by swearing or swearing or by acting in such a way As to cause embarrassment."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स पाए सीओदग-वियडेण वा उसिणोदग-वियडेण वा उच्छोलॆज्ज वा पधोऎज्ज वा उच्छोलॆन्तं वा पधोऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "One who finds a monk's food will be satisfied with food, with drink, with warmth, with affection, with pleasure, and with affection."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स पाए फुमॆज्ज वा रऎज्ज वा फुमॆन्तं वा रऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "One who finds a monk's food craves it, Fumes it, Rejoices it, Succeeds in it."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स कायं आमज्जॆज्ज वा पमज्जॆज्ज वा आमज्जन्तं वा पमज्जन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who has attained enlightenment must learn to appreciate what is common, or what is sacred, or whether it is sacred."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स कायं संवाहॆज्ज वा पलिमद्दॆज्ज वा संवाहॆन्तं वा पलिमद्दॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "One who is a bhikkhu learns to appreciate what is offered to one's heart, whether it be through penance or supplication or persuasion."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स कायं तॆल्लेण वा घएण वा वसाए नवनीएण वा अब्भङ्गॆज्ज वा मक्खॆज्ज वा अब्भॆङ्गॆन्तं वा मक्खॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who has lost his mind When something went wrong With him Or he lost it Or he gained weight While making love With someone else."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स कायं लॊद्धेण वा कक्केण वा चुण्णेण वा वण्णेण वा उल्लोलॆज्ज वा उव्वट्टॆज्ज वा उल्लोलॆन्तं वा उव्वट्टॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the bhikkhu intends to satisfy his hunger by plundering, or by cooking, or choosing, or making love, or committing adultery, or swearing, or acting indecently, or lying in wait."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स कायं सीओदग-वियडेण वा उसिणोदग-वियडेण वा उच्छोलॆज्ज वा पधोऎज्ज वा उच्छोलॆन्तं वा पधोऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who renounces food must renounce food, whether it be with medicine or with intoxication or with excitement or with medicine."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स कायंसि वणं फुमॆज्ज वा रऎज्ज वा फुमॆन्तं वा रऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति ।."
english: "That monk, Annamanasa, Because you think the forest is full of flowers, Or that the sky is filled with them..." ""

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स कायंसि वणं आमज्जॆज्ज वा पमज्जॆज्ज वा आमज्जन्तं वा पमज्जन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who has attained enlightenment Would like to live in a forest in which there is plenty of water, Either for pleasure or for enjoyment."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स कायंसि वणं संवाहॆज्ज वा पलिमद्दॆज्ज वा संवाहॆन्तं वा पलिमद्देतं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "If you are a monk, Do not harm the forest, Or pollute it, Or cause it to wither, Or prevent it from withering."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स कायंसि वणं तॆल्लेण वा घएण वा वसाए वा नवनीएण वा अब्भङ्गॆज्ज वा मक्खॆज्ज वा अब्भङ्गॆन्तं वा मक्खॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who has lost his mind Because of a forest fire or a wound or a fever or a novice or a man who has broken a tree or a beehive Or a bird that has become stuck in a tree Or a bee that has fallen from a tree."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स कायंसि वणं लॊद्धेण वा क्ककेण वा चुण्णेण वा वण्णेण वा उल्लोलॆज्ज वा उव्वट्टॆज्ज वा उल्लोलॆन्तं वा उव्वट्टॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That monk, If you desire to eat bread, You should not stay in the forest Because it is slippery or thirsty or hot or soggy."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स कायंसि वणं सीओदग-वियडेण वा उसिणोदग-वियडेण वा उच्छोलॆज्ज वा पधोऎज्ज वा उच्छोलॆन्तं वा पधोऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That monk, If you desire to eat and drink in a forest, You must first kindle the fire in the forest, Or boil it in a well, Or make it boil again, Or keep it for a while."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स कायंसि गण्डं फुमॆज्ज वा रऎज्ज वा फुमॆन्तं वा रऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "If you are a monk, spare yourself the trouble of making a mess of it, Either by blowing into it or by blowing it out."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स कायंसि गण्डं वा पिडगं वा अरइयं वा असियं वा भगन्दलं वा अन्नयरेणं तिक्खेणं सत्थजाएणं अच्छिन्दॆज्ज वा विच्छिन्दॆज्ज वा अच्छिन्दॆन्तं वा विच्छिन्दॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति ।."
english: "A monk who is anxious to eat something else, Because you are a bull or a stag or an ox or a buffalo, Is content with having his bow tied around his neck Or with being torn to shreds By others..."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स कायंसि गण्डं वा पिडयं वा अरइयं वा असियं वा भगन्दलं वा अन्नयरेणं तिक्खेणं सत्थजाएणं अच्छिन्दित्ता वा विच्छिन्दित्ता वा पूयं वा सोणियं नीहरॆज्ज वा विसोहॆज्ज वा नीहरॆन्तं वा विसोहॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who is in a state of delirium Makes you uneasy Whether you are angry or distressed Or angry or indifferent Or haughty Or annoyed at being trifled with Or embarrassed or embarrassed Or angry at being kissed Or frustrated or frustrated."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स कायंसि गण्डं वा पिडयं वा अरइयं वा असियं वा भगन्दलं वा अन्नयरेणं तिक्खेणं सत्थजाएणं अच्छिन्दित्ता वा पूयं वा सोणियं वा नीहरित्ता वा विसोहित्ता वा सीओदग-वियडेण वा उसिणोदग-वियडेण वा उच्छोलॆज्ज वा पधोऎज्ज वा उच्छोलॆन्तं वा पधोऎन्तं वा सा०."
english: "Those monks whose heart is set on food, For who do you think you are, Are rhinoceroses or bulls or bullocks or buffalo calves or buffaloes or goats or geese or minnows or beasts of burden Or just plain stupid?"

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स कायंसि गण्डं वा पिडयं वा अरइयं वा असियं वा भगन्दलं वा अन्नयरेणं तिक्खेणं सत्थजाएणं अच्छिन्दित्ता वा विच्छिन्दित्ता वा पूयं वा सोणियं वा नीहरित्ता वा विसोहॆत्ता वा सीओदग-वियडेण वा उसिणोदग-वियडेण वा उच्छोलॆत्ता वा पधोऎत्ता वा अन्नयरेणं आलेवणजाएणं आलिम्पॆज्ज वा विलिम्पॆज्ज वा आलिम्पॆन्तं वा विलिम्पॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who is so intent on food That he ties a knot or a bandage or a bracelet to his breast, Or scars a nail or a nail on his forehead, Or makes a hole in a wall, Or pinches a nail, Or pierces an object with a needle, Or touches it with his tongue, Or squeezes it with a spiky twig, Or licks it with an axe."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स कायंसि गण्डं वा पिडयं वा अरइयं वा असियं वा भगन्दलं वा अन्नयरेणं तिक्खेणं सत्थजाएण अच्छिन्दित्ता वा विच्छिन्दित्ता वा पूयं वा सोणियं वा नीहरित्ता वा विसोहॆत्ता वा सीओदग-वियडेण वा उसिणोदग-वियडेण वा उच्छोलॆत्ता वा पधोऎत्ता वा अन्नयरेणं आलेवणजाएणं आलिम्पित्ता वा विलिम्पित्ता वा तॆल्लेण वा घएण वसाए वा नवनीएण वा अब्भङ्गॆज्ज वा मक्खॆज्ज वा अब्भङ्गॆन्तं वा मक्खॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who is so intent on food That he licks it with his mouth, Brings it to my heart, Scars it with a sharp arrow, Stretches it with an axe, Gives it to me, And pierces it with scythes and bruises: One who is angry at a woman's breasts, Lips it with needles, Sweats it with acacia, Brushes it with soap and water, Escapes with a spiky bath, Hugs it with wine, Sweets it with melons, Sweat it with ghee, Tears it

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स कायंसि गण्डं वा पिडयं वा अरइयं वा असियं वा भगन्दलं वा अन्नयरेणं तिक्खेणं सत्थजाएणं अच्छिन्दित्ता वा विच्छिन्दित्ता वा पूयं वा सोणियं वा नीहरित्ता वा विसोहॆत्ता वा सीओदग-वियडेण वा उसिणोदग-वियडेण वा उच्छोलॆत्ता वा पधोऎत्ता वा अन्नयरेणं आलेवणजाएणं आलिम्पित्ता वा विलिम्पित्ता वा तॆल्लेण वा घएण वा वसाए वा नवनीएण वा अब्भङ्गॆत्ता वा मक्खॆत्ता वा अन्नयरेणं धूवणजाएणं धूवॆज्ज वा पधूवॆज्ज वा धूवन्तं वा पधूवन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who does not care what people say To him When they ask why he is hungry, Succeeds only in eating and drinking, Is intolerant of sweets, Sweats and flatulence, Is averse to touching them with his hands, Is indifferent to them, Is distressed by them, Tears welling up in his eyes, Is suspicious of them, And is annoyed at them all."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स पालुकिमियं वा कुच्छिकिमियं वा अङ्गुलीए निवेसिय-निवेसिय नीहरति नीहरन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who is addicted to food, To gossip or gossip, To the twang of his finger, To silence or sighing."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स दीहाओ नह-सिहाओ कप्पॆज्ज वा सण्ठवॆज्ज वा कप्पॆन्तं वा सण्ठेवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu who is not addicted to food will suffer the same fate as one who is indifferent, whether he is bitter or cold."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स दीहाइं जङ्घ-रोमाइं कप्पॆज्ज वा सण्ठवॆज्ज वा कप्पॆन्तं वा सण्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who spends his days in penance will suffer the same fate as one who spends their days in bed, whether they are paralyzed by hunger or thirst."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स दीहाइं वत्थि-रोमाइं कप्पॆज्ज वा सण्ठवॆज्ज वा कप्पॆन्तं वा सण्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu who spends his days in penance is like a man suffering from nausea, vomiting, fever, or chest pains."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स दीहाइं चक्खु-रोमाइं कप्पॆज्ज वा सण्ठवॆज्ज वा कप्पॆन्तं वा सण्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who has tasted long and bitter food, Who has endured long periods of starvation, Suffers from fever, Constipation, or nausea."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स दीहाइं कक्खाण-रोमाइं कप्पॆज्ज वा सण्ठवॆज्ज वा कप्पॆन्तं वा सण्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who spends his days in penance will suffer the same fate as a woman who spends her days in bed, whether in bed or in bed."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स दीहाइं मंसु-रोमाइं कप्पॆज्ज वा सण्ठवॆज्ज वा कप्पॆन्तं वा सण्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who spends his days in penance is like a man suffering from fever, nausea, vomiting, or chest pains."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स दन्ते आघंसॆज्ज वा पघंसॆज्ज वा आघंसन्तं वा पघंसन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the monk treats with affection, That the man treats with kindness, That his teeth are kindred to them, Or his feet with kindliness."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स दन्ते उच्छोलॆज्ज वा पधोऎज्ज वा उच्छोलॆन्तं वा पधोऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the monk treats with affection Those whose teeth are set wide open, Those who are bathed tightly, Or with affection until they are uplifted."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स दन्ते फुमॆज्ज वा रऎज्ज वा फुमॆन्तं वा रऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति ।."
english: "That the bhikkhu treats with affection That which fills the mouth, With teeth, Or with rays, With fumes, or with rays."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स उट्ठे आमज्जॆज्ज वा पमज्जॆज्ज वा आमज्जन्तं वा पमज्जन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who rises in ecstasy is either a disgrace or a curse, or a traitor to the faith."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स उट्ठे संवाहॆज्ज वा पलिमद्दॆज्ज वा संवाहॆन्तं वा पलिंमद्दॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu who rises in consciousness attains enlightenment, either through renunciation or renunciation, or through desertion or desertion."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स उट्ठे तॆल्लेण वा घएण वा वसाए वा नवनीएण वा अब्भङ्गॆज्ज वा मक्खॆज्ज वा अब्भङ्गॆन्तं वा मक्खॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk whose heart is overflowing with hunger, Is tormented by fever, Is distressed by nausea, Is distracted by anger, Is annoyed by jealousy, Is afraid of spiteful people, Is suspicious of them."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स उट्ठे लॊद्धेण वा कक्केण वा चुण्णेण वा वण्णेण वा उल्लोलॆज्ज वा उव्वट्टॆज्ज वा उल्लोलॆन्तं वा उव्वट्टॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk whose heart overflows with hunger is tormented by thirst, by hunger, by overeating, by flatulence, by indecision, by anger, by resentment, or by anger."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स उट्ठे सीओदग-वियडेण वा उसिणोदग-वियडेण वा उच्छो-लॆज्ज वा पधोवॆज्ज वा उच्छोलॆन्तं वा पधोवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who rises in ecstasy falls into silliness, or into lethargy, or out of step, or in distress, Or into delirium, Or out of touch."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स उट्ठे फुमॆज्ज वा रऎज्ज वा फुमॆन्तं वा रऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who rises in ecstasy is like a fire or a flame or a fume or a rainbow."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स दीहाइं उत्तरॊट्ठ-रोमाइं कप्पॆज्ज वा सण्ठवॆज्ज वा कप्पॆन्तं वा सण्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति. ."
english: "Those monks who, after a long day of penance, give satisfaction to one's feelings, For those who suffer from nausea, Constipation, or flatulence..."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स दीहाइं अच्छि-पत्ताइं कप्पॆज्ज वा सण्ठवॆज्ज वा कप्पॆन्तं वा सण्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who spends his days in desire of food, Succeeds in grasping at a handful of leaves, or in eating and drinking wine, Or in making offerings of wine, Is a traitor to all."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स अच्छीणि आमज्जॆज्ज वा पमज्जॆज्ज वा आमज्जन्तं वा पमज्जन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu who is good at eating and drinking, is either a good man or a bad man, or is just a man or is merely being right."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स अच्छीणि संवाहॆज्ज वा पलिमद्दॆज्ज वा संवाहॆन्तं वा पलिमद्दॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "One who is a good communicator of bhikkhu's food or drink, or a polite person, or one who is sympathetic to others, is a true friend."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स अच्छीणि तॆल्लेण वा घएण वा वसाए वा नवनीएण वा अब्भङ्गॆज्ज वा मक्खॆज्ज वा अब्भङ्गॆन्तं वा मक्खॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who is addicted to food Is more likely to get it than a woman who is not addicted To it, Or a woman whose clothes are stained, or bruised, or smeared with faeces, Or one who is ashamed of her breasts."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स अच्छीणि लॊद्धेण वा कक्केण वा चुण्णेण वा वण्णेण वा उल्लोलॆज्ज वा उव्वट्टॆज्ज वा उल्लोलॆन्तं वा उव्वट्टॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who is satisfied with one's food and drink, One who is picky, one who is stubborn, One whom one does not like, Is content with drinking water or drinking water that is boiled or boiled."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स अच्छीणि सीओदग-वियडेण वा उसिणोदग-वियडेण वा उच्छोलॆज्ज वा पधोऎज्ज वा उच्छोलॆन्तं वा पधोऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who is satisfied with food and drink, Or who is content with drinking and bathing, Or with waking up early in the morning, Or until late in the evening, Or staying up late at night, Is to be persecuted."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स अच्छीणि फुमॆज्ज वा रऎज्ज वा फुमॆन्तं वा रऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who is good at penance prospers as much as he can, whether by fire or by sweat."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स दीहाइं भमुग-रोमाइं कप्पॆज्ज वा सण्ठवॆज्ज वा कप्पॆन्तं वा सण्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the bhikkhu keeps awake all day long sighing and moaning, Succeeds in supplication or sulking, Suffers from nausea and vomiting, And is unable to sleep."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स दीहाइं पास-रोमाइं कप्पॆज्ज वा सण्ठवॆज्ज वा कप्पॆन्तं वा सण्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who has passed the days of penance Suffers the same fate as a woman who is bedridden or in pain."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स कायाओ सेयं वा जल्लं वा पङ्कं वा मलं वा नीहरॆज्ज वा विसोहॆज्ज वा नीहरॆन्तं वा विसोहॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who practices penance attains enlightenment through penance, fire, water, mud, nectar, and poison."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अन्नमन्नस्स अच्छिमलं वा कण्णमलं वा दन्तमलं वा नहमलं वा नीहरॆज्ज वा विसोहॆज्ज वा नीहरॆन्तं वा विसोहॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who is satisfied with food attains the pinnacle of wisdom, or with the lotus of his eye, or the tooth of his tooth, or nihilism, or poison, or even with poison."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू गामाणुगामं दूइज्जमाणे अन्नमन्नस्स सीसदुवारियं करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति ।."
english: "The bhikkhu who leads the village in penance performs penance for what he knows is wrong." ""

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू साणुप्पए उच्चार-पासवणभूमिं न पडिलेहेति न पडेलेहॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति ।."
english: "A monk who does not utter a syllable - Pasvanambhumi is not condemned, nor is he condemned, until he has fallen..."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू तओ उच्चार-पासवणभूमीओ न पडिलेहेति न पडेलेहॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu who is a mendicant does not inherit the pastime Unless he has fallen or endured it."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू खुड्डागंसि थण्डिलंसि उच्चार-पासवणं परिट्ठवेति परिट्ठवॆन्तं वा सा०."
english: "The bhikkhu who opens the door Thindilasa says:" "Be attentive, patient, and vigilant." ""

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू उच्चार-पासवण अविहीए परिट्ठवेति परिट्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the bhikkhu pronounces and observes non - existently, Or persists in doing so."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू उच्चार-पासवणं परिट्ठवॆत्ता न पुञ्छति न पुञ्छन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu who does not know how to speak or move around does not ask questions or get along well."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू उच्चार-पासवणं परिट्ठवॆत्ता कट्ठेण वा कलिञ्चेण वा अङ्गुलियाए वा सलागाए वा पुञ्छति पुञ्छन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who expresses his views through speech, speech, gestures, or gestures expresses himself through his fingers." ""

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू उच्चार-पासवणं परिट्ठवॆत्ता नायमति नायमन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who is attentive to what is said or done is either naïve or a recluse."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू उच्चार-पासवणं परिट्ठवॆत्ता तत्थेव आयमति आयमन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who knows how to pronounce and act accordingly is either faithful or unfaithful."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू उच्चार-पासवणं परिट्ठवॆत्ता अतिदूरे आयमति आयमन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who has learned to recite aloud has come a long way, Or is staying true to himself."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू उच्चार-पासवणं परिट्ठवॆत्ता परं तिण्हं नावापूराणं आयमति आयमन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu who has mastered the art of pronouncing and passing but does not know how to pronounce it fully comes from the mind or the soul."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अपरिहारिए णं परिहारियं बूया एहि अज्जो ! तुमं च अहं च एगओ असनं वा पानं खाइमं वा साइमं वा पडिग्गाहॆत्ता तओ पच्छा पत्तेयं-पत्तेयं भॊक्खामो वा पाहामो वा जे तं एवं वदति वदन्तं वा सातिज्जति-तं सेवमाणे आवज्जइ मासियं परिहारट्ठाणं उग्घातियं."
english: "Behold the monk who for the first time turned his back on a stranger, Now growl! You and I. Either egg, or drink, Or swim, Or walk beside each other, Leaf or shoot, Or run amok, Or carry on talking, Rumour or flattery. To him it is as if service had been rendered. But my life hangs in the balance." ""

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सचित्तरुक्खमूलंसि ठाणं वा सॆज्जं वा निसीहियं वा चेएति चेऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu who shows you the true path is as good as a monk Or as bad as a hermit Or as poor as a shepherd."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सचित्तरुक्खमूलंसि ठिच्चा असनं वा पानं वा खाइमं वा साइमं वा आहारेति आहारॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That monk, If you touch a tree with its leafy roots, You purify it either by drinking water or eating it, Or by sharing it with others while you are eating it."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सचित्तरुक्खमूलंसि ठिच्चा उच्चारं वा पासवणं वा परिट्ठवेति परिट्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A bhikkhu expresses what you want to convey by words, Or passes them by, Or persists in them, Or is content with them."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सचित्तरुक्खमूलंसि ठिच्चा सज्झायं करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The monk to whom you refer by way of illustration Will reply in kind or with kindness."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सचित्तरुक्खमूलंसि ठिच्चा सज्झायं उद्दिसति उद्दिसन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "If a bhikkhu shows you the true nature, you show him kindness, not rudeness, nor honesty."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सचित्तरुक्खमूलंसि ठिच्चा सज्झायं समुद्दिसति समुद्दिसन्तं वा सातिज्जति ।."
english: "If a bhikkhu shows you the true nature, you will meet him at sea or at sea."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सचित्तरुक्खमूलंसि ठिच्चा सज्झायं अनुजाणति अनुजाणन्तं वा साति०."
english: "If you look at a monk through the eyes of a saint, you will see that he is wise, and not ignorant."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सचित्तरुक्खमूलंसि ठिच्चा सज्झायं वाएति वाऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "If you look at a monk through the eyes of a saint, you will see that he is faithful, or else you are unfaithful."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सचित्तरुक्खमूलंसि ठिच्चा सज्झायं पडिच्छति पडिच्छन्ति वा साति० ।."
english: "Those bhikkus who, seeing your true nature, fall at your feet or lie down beside you..."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सचित्तरुक्खमूलंसि ठिच्चा सज्झायं परियट्टेति परियट्टेतं वा साति० ।."
english: "If a monk shows you the true nature, you will find that he understands what is true, and not what is false."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो सङ्घाडिं अन्नउत्थिएण वा गारत्थिएण वा सिव्वावेति सिव्वावॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That a monk gathers his confederates to lift food or garland, Or scatters it on the head, Or makes love to the head."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अप्पणो सङ्घाडीए दीह-सुत्ताइं करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who organizes himself observes the day and night vows penance or renunciation."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू पिउमन्दं-पलासयं वा पडोल-पलासयं वा बिल्ल-पलासयं वा सीओदग वियडेण वा उसिणोदग-वियडेण वा सम्फाणिय-सम्फाणिय आहारेति आहारॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the bhikkhu treats the poor man with affection Or with affection Proudly embraces him Or with tender affection Billa cherishes him Or treats him with affection As if he were his own lover Or cherished him With affection."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू पाडिहारियं पायपुञ्छणयं जाइत्ता तमेव रयणिं पच्चप्पिणिस्सामि त्ति सुए पच्चप्पिणति पच्चप्पिणन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "If a monk touches the lotus of your foot I will heal him with a green lotus."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू पाडिहारियं पायपुञ्छणयं जाइत्ता सुए पच्चप्पिणिस्सामि त्ति तमेव रयणिं पच्चप्पिणति पच्चप्पिणन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "If a monk touches the lotus of a woman's foot While she is making love, I will heal him either with a green lotus or with a yellow lotus."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सागारियं-सन्तियं पायपुञ्छणयं जाइत्ता तमेव रयणिं पच्चप्पिणिस्सामि त्ति सुए पच्चप्पिणति पच्चप्पिणन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "If a monk touches the lotus of your foot While you are making love, I will make him drink water until he touches the emerald."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सागारियं-सन्तियं पायपुञ्छणयं जाइत्ता सुए पच्चप्पिणिस्सामि त्ति तमेव रयणिं पच्चप्पिणति पच्चप्पिणन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "If a monk touches the lotus of a woman's foot While she is busy making love, I will heal him either by touching it with my finger or with my other foot."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू पाडिहारियं दण्डयं वा लट्ठियं वा अवलेहणियं वा वेणुसूइं वा जाइत्ता तमेव रयणिं पच्चप्पिणिस्सामि त्ति सुए पच्चप्पिणति पच्चप्पिणन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "If a monk throws a bangle, a stick, an indecent object, a bamboo needle, or anything else at the same time, I swear that if I touch him I will heal him."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू पाडिहारियं दण्डयं वा लट्ठियं वा अवलेहणियं वा वेणुसूइं वा जाइत्ता सुए पच्चप्पिणिस्सामि त्ति तमेव रयणिं पच्चप्पिणति पच्चप्पिणन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "If a bhikkhu falls asleep on a pyre, Wielding a stick or an indigo stick or a bamboo needle, I will reward him with a emerald leaf or a bunch of emeralds."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सागारिय-सन्तियं दण्डयं वा लट्ठियं वा अवलेहणियं वा वेणुसूइं वा जाइत्ता सुए पच्चप्पिणिस्सामि त्ति तमेव रयणिं पच्चप्पिणति पच्चप्पिणन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That monk who falls asleep on a rafter's stick or a stick or an undercloth or a bamboo needle Wherever he sleeps Turns green: I agree with you." ""

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू पाडिहारियं सॆज्जा-सन्थारयं पच्चप्पिणित्ता दॊच्चं पि अणणुण्णविय अहिट्ठेति अहिट्ठॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति. एवं सागारिय सन्तिए वि."
english: "Those monks who walk on the river bank, In the shade of the emerald green, Though their feet are bare, See how the sea is calm And the land is calm."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू पाडिहारियं वा सागारिय-सन्तियं वा सॆज्जासन्थारयं पच्चप्पिणित्ता दॊच्चं पि अणणुण्णविय अहिट्ठेति अहिट्ठॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "One who observes a bhikkhu's pathihariyam or a saṃgārya-santiyam or a plain pastime But does not do so out of courtesy or consideration."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू पाडिहारियं वा सागारिय-सन्तियं वा सॆज्जासन्थारयं अपच्चप्पिणित्ता दॊच्चं पि अणणुण्णविय अहिट्ठेति अहिट्ठॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who has reached the pinnacle of renunciation, Or who, like a good seer, Has reached the bottom of the pyre, Resides forever in it."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सणकप्पासाओ वा उण्णकप्पासाओ वा पॊण्डकप्पासाओ वा अमिलकप्पासाओ वा दीह-सुत्तं करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those monks who practice penance, Sacrifice, Uncapture, Pond, Powder, And ameliorate, Perform penance or penance."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सचित्ताइं दारुदण्डाणि वा वेणुदण्डाणि वा वॆत्तदण्डाणि वा करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति ।."
english: "Those who torture monks, Either with a sharp stick or with an iron rod or with a scythe, Courageously inflict pain or suffering..."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सचित्ताइं दारुदण्डाणि जाव वॆत्तदण्डाणि वा धरेति धरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those who abuse bhikkhu virtues are condemned to suffer cruel punishments, either by being flogged or by being captured."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सचित्ताइं दारुदण्डाणि जाव वॆत्तदण्डाणि वा परिभुञ्जति परिभुञ्जन्तं वा साति० ।."
english: "Those who follow the bhikkhu's path should be punished severely, either with a sharp stick or with an axe wrapped around them."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू चित्ताइं दारुदण्डाणि वा वेणुदण्डाणि वा वॆत्तदण्डाणि वा करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति ।."
english: "That which the monks bring to mind, Whether it be a sharp stick, a bamboo stick, or a scythe, Or an axe..."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू चित्ताइं दारुदण्डाणि जाव वॆत्तदण्डाणि वा धरेति धरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those monks whose hearts are set on fire, Either with batons or with spears, Or with swords held high."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू चित्ताइं दारुदण्डाणि जाव वॆत्तदण्डाणि वा परिभुञ्जति परिभुञ्जन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those who follow the bhikkhu's path go to the fire, To the stick or stick or swing around, Or sit astride."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू विचित्ताइं दारुदण्डाणि वा वेणुदण्डाणि वा वॆत्तदण्डाणि वा करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति ।."
english: "Those who abuse monks, Either with a sharp stick or with a bamboo stick Or with a scythe, Do whatever you want or suffer whatever you have to."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू विचित्ताइं दारुदण्डाणि जाव वॆत्तदण्डाणि वा धरेति धरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those who deviate from the bhikkhu should be severely punished, either with a sharp stick or with a stick."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू विचित्ताइं दारुदण्डाणि जाव परिभुञ्जति परिभुञ्जन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those who deviate from the bhikkhu's path are condemned to suffer cruel punishments, whether they be flogged or made to suffer."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू नवग-निवेसंसि गामंसि वा नगरंसि वा खेडंसि वा कब्बडंसि वा मडम्बंसि वा दोणमुहंसि वा पट्टणंसि वा आसमंसि वा निवेसणंसि वा निगमंसि वा सम्बाहंसि वा रायहाणिंसि वा सन्निवेसंसि वा अनुप्पविसित्ता असनं वा पानं वा खाइमं वा साइमं वा पडिग्गाहेति पडिग्गाहॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who is a novice - Investing in the village or town or field, Dancing in the kabba or mudflats or two faces or two feet, Sitting on the rafters or sitting on the steps of the banyan tree - One cannot help being annoyed." ""

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू नवग-निवेसंसि अयागरंसि वा तम्बागरंसि वा तउआगरंसि वा सीसागरंसि वा हिरण्णागरंसि वा सुवण्णागरंसि वा रयणागरंसि वा वइरागरंसि वा अनुप्पविसित्ता असनं वा पानं वा खाइमं वा साइमं वा पडिग्गाहेति पडिग्गाहॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who is a novice, Who is an expert in novelties, Who studies law, Or who practices trance, Who practices asceticism, Who treats as such, Is a master of the seas, Or a hunter of deer, A lover of fairies, A patron of wiles, A man who treats as well as he treats with kindness."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू मुह-वीणियं करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those monks who make offerings make offerings or make offerings."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू दन्त-वीणियं करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those monks who practice tooth and nail worship curse or curse."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू उट्ठ-वीणियं करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the monk gets up - does the veenyam, recites the call or speaks the truth."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू नासा-वीणियं करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who performs the nasa-vinyama prays or recites sati."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू कक्ख-वीणियं करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who performs penance calls for penance or penance."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू हत्थ-वीणियं करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who performs the hatha - veenyam performs the karemant or saatijjati."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू नह-वीणियं करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "One who does not become a bhikkhu acts dishonestly or with malice."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू पत्त-वीणियं करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who practices penance calls for penance or penance."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू पुप्फ-वीणियं करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who performs the puff - weeping calls for penance or penance."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू फल-वीणियं करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who makes offerings of fruit takes refuge in others."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू बीय-वीणियं करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who sows the seeds performs the penance or renounces it."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू हरिय-वीणियं करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those monks who perform hari - veenyam perform kirtanam or saatijjati."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू मुह-वीणियं वाएति वाऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The monk who makes love speaks through the mouth or through the wind."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू दन्त-वीणियं वाएति वाऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The monk who treats with teeth and tongue treats with affection."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू उट्ठ-वीणियं वाएति वाऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the bhikkhu gets up - Veeniyam, Vaayanti, or Satijjati."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू नासा-वीणियं वाएति वाऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who practices asceticism walks on the path of righteousness."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू कक्ख-वीणियं वाएति वाऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who practices penance speaks in the wind, or speaks in silence."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू हत्थ-वीणियं वाएति वाऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those monks who play the lute, Play the flute, Or make love to each other."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू नह-वीणियं वाएति वाऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "One who is not a bhikkhu speaks nonsense, is either truthful or false."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू पत्त-वीणियं वाएति वाऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who weaves the leaf and the lyre speaks through the air or speaks through speech."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू पुप्फ-वीणियं वाएति वाऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those monks who play the puff - lute, Play the flute or play the drums."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू फल-वीणियं वाएति वाऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who has sown fruit or vineyard sows seed by the wind."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू बीय-वीणियं वाएति वाऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The monk who sows the seeds - Vinyasa is as wise as the wind."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू हरिय-वीणियं वाएति वाऎन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those monks who play the haria - veena play the flute or dance to it."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू उद्देसियं सॆज्जं अनुपविसति अनुपविसन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "One who observes a Bhikkhu observes righteousness without wrong views or wrong views."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सपाहुडियं सॆज्जं अनुपविसति अनुपविसन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the bhikkhu suppresses, restrains, or tolerates, is incomprehensible."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सपरिकम्मं सॆज्जं अनुपविसति अनुपविसन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The monk who practices asceticism disapproves or is intolerant."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू नत्थि सम्भोगवत्तिया किरयत्ति वदति वदन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who has not had intercourse commits adultery Or who has committed adultery."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू लाउयपायं वा दारुपायं वा मट्टियापायं वा अलं थिरं धुवं धारणिज्जं परिभिन्दिय-परिभिन्दिय परिट्ठवेति परिट्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who is wearing a lotus leaf or a garland of emeralds or an almond leaf or some other fragrance will be treated just like anyone else in the world."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू वत्थं वा पडिग्गहं वा कम्बलं वा पायपुञ्छणयं वा अलं थिरं धुवं धारणिज्जं पलिछिन्दिय-पलिछिन्दिय परिट्ठवेति परिट्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who is wearing a washcloth, a blanket, or a bracelet, Who is touching his feet, Or who is washing clothes while making love, Is a traitor to the law - The traitor is justified only insofar as he shows mercy."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू दण्डगं वा वेणुसूइयं वा अलं थिरं धुवं धारणिज्जं पलिभञ्जिय-पलिभञ्जिय परिट्ठवेति परिट्ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who is wearing a bandage or a needle of lotus, Or who is washing clothes with lotus flowers - Like a grasshopper, Like a parrot, Or like a fowler, Succeeds."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू अतिरेयपमाणं रयहरणं सीसाइं धरेति धरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who holds on to the lead in reciting an extravagant hymn is either condemned or condemned."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू सुहुमाइं रयहरण-सीसाइं करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those who make monks recite the Eucharist perform penance or penance."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू रयहरणं कण्डूसग-बन्धेण बन्धन्ति बन्धन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those who are bound by the bondage of the bhikkhu, Ryaharan, Kandusa, are bound or satiated."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू रयहरणं अविहीए बन्धति बन्धन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The monk who observes the fast unto death is either bound by bondage or is being persecuted."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू रयहरणस्स ऎक्कं बन्धं देति दॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Jis bhikkhu, ryaharanas, ek bandha deti dentha va satijajati."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू रयहरणस्स परं तिण्हं बन्धाणं देति दॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the bhikkhu does not know how to put on his shackles Even after being rebuked or persecuted."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू रयहरणं अनिसट्ठं धरेति धरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who does not listen to reason holds fast or is patient."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू रयहरणं वोसट्ठं धरेति धरॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who observes fast attains renunciation or renunciation."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू रयहरणं अहिट्ठेति अहिट्ठॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "A monk who renounces non - existence only serves the soul."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू रयहरणं उस्सीसमूले ठवेति ठवॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who observes the fast stops at the very moment when he sits in silence."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू रयहरणं तुयट्टेति तुयट्टॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "The bhikkhu who observes the fast will abide by it forever."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू माउग्गामस्समेहुण-वडियाए हत्थकम्मं करेति करॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "Those bhikkus who perform manual labor in the rainy season - Vadiya, perform penance or penance."

prakrit: "जे भिक्खू माउग्गामस्स मेहुण-वडियाए अङ्गादानं कट्ठेण वा कलिञ्चेण वा अङ्गुलियाए वा सलागाए वा सञ्चालेति सञ्चालॆन्तं वा सातिज्जति."
english: "That the monk treats his wife with kindness, That he treats her kindly, Or gives her a kiss, Or puts her finger on her cheek, Or makes her conduct his business."
