"By grinding, By pressing, By hanging, Or by smudging, By making the uneven sluice unyielding, By choosing either a non - compact lime Or an inexhaustible one.," Gaha-645.

prakrit: "धम्मो मङ्गलमुक्किट्ठं अहिंसा सञ्जमो तवो,देवा वि तं नमंसन्ति जस्स धम्मे सया मणो"
english: "Non - violence is the essence of dharma; the gods also bow down to what is right in dharma."

prakrit: "जहा दुमस्स पुप्फेसु भमरो आवियइ रसं,न य पुप्फं किलामेइ सो य पीणेइ अप्पयं"
english: "As long as a bee has a mouthful of nectar, It cannot boil juice, And if a bee buries a bee, It is useless to drink it."

prakrit: "एमेए समणा मुत्ता जे लोए सन्ति साहुणो,विहङ्गमा व पुप्फेसु दाणभत्तेसणेरया"
english: "Such are the vows of a virtuous man: In the world they exist for nothing But as offerings made to angels."

prakrit: "वयं च वित्तिं लब्भामो न य कोइ उवहम्मइ,अहागडेसु रीयन्ते पुप्फेसु भमरा जहा"
english: "We don't see anyone there But the buffalo peeps in to see who is standing where." ""

prakrit: "महुगारसमा बुद्धा जे भवन्ति अणिस्सिया,नाणापिण्डरया दन्ता तेण वुच्चन्ति साहुणो त्ति बेमि"
english: "I can see the Buddha in Mahugaras, Unsure if he has teeth or ears, But it's my fault he can't breathe"

prakrit: "कहं नु कुज्जा सामण्णं जो कामे न निवारए,पए पए विसीयन्तो सङ्कप्पस्स वसं गओ?"
english: "How can a bad man, Who does not cease to act, Fall into sinful stupor If he persists in doing so?"

prakrit: "वत्थगन्धमलङ्कारं इत्थीओ सयणाणि य,अच्छन्दा जे न भुञ्जन्ति न से चाइ त्ति वुच्चइ"
english: "Those who smell the lotus Smell like rice, But those who do not roast it Wouldn't see it themselves."

prakrit: "जे य कन्ते पिए भोए लद्धे वि पिट्ठि कुव्वइ,साहीणे चयइ भोए से हु चाइ त्ति वुच्चइ"
english: "Whatever people think They see in a fight, They hear behind their backs; But when they hear of it They Forsake it."

prakrit: "समाइ पेहाइ परिव्वयन्तो सिया मणो निस्सरई बहिद्धा,न सा महं नोवि अहं पि तीसे इच्चेव ताओ विणइज्ज रागं"
english: "When he turns his back on me I think he is slipping away, Not because I don't know him But because he wants me to."

prakrit: "आयावयाही चय सोगमल्लं कामे कमाहि कमियं खु दुक्खं,छिन्दाहि दोसं विणइज्ज रागं एवं सुही होहिसि सम्पराए"
english: "Though you are busy making love, You make love, And though you are unhappy, You ease it all."

prakrit: "पक्खन्दे जलियं जोइं धूमकेउं दुरासयं,नॆच्छन्ति वन्तयं भॊत्तुं कुले जाया अङ्गधणे"
english: "Those who drink the water on the field, Desperate to inhale the fumes, Do not touch them While they are bathing And their limbs are bruised."

prakrit: "धिरत्थु ते'जसोकामी जो तं जीवियकारणा,वन्तं इच्छसि आवेउं सेयं ते मरणं भवे"
english: "The man who made you live, If you wish him to come, May he be the cause of death."

prakrit: "अहं च भोगरायस्स तं च'सि अन्धगवण्हिणो,मा कुले गन्धणा होमो सञ्जमं निहुओ चर"
english: "I am the enjoyer, you blind cowgirl, Don't touch me, I am a scent - seeker." ""

prakrit: "जइ तं काहिसि भावं जा जा दिच्छसि नारीओ,वायाविद्धु व्व हडो अट्ठिअप्पा भविस्ससि"
english: "If you see him lose his temper, ladies, you'd better stop him Before he leaves."

prakrit: "तीसे सो वयणं सॊच्चा सञ्जयाइ सुभासियं,अङ्कुसेण जहा नागो धम्मे सम्पडिवाइओ"
english: "In this way, good sense prevails, In that way," he said, "in Dharma, the Nagas prosper."

prakrit: "एवं करन्ति सम्बुद्धा पण्डिया पवियक्खणा,विणियट्टन्ति भोगेसु जहा से पुरिसुत्तमो"
english: "And I'll do whatever you tell me: Sit in silence While you look on."

prakrit: "सञ्जमे सुट्ठिअप्पाणं विप्पमुक्काण ताइणं,तेसिमेयमणाइण्णं निग्गन्थाण महेसिणं"
english: "To lie in silence Is to throw oneself into despair; To lie low is to lose one's mind."

prakrit: "उद्देसियं कीयगडं नियागमभिहडाणि य,राइभत्ते सिणाणे य गन्धमल्ले य वीयणे"
english: "How easy it is for the eyes to see, For the ears not to hear, Or the tongue not to smell."

prakrit: "संनिही गिहिमत्ते य रायपिण्डे किमिच्छए,संवाहणा दन्तपहोयणा य सम्पुच्छणा देहपलोयणा य"
english: "Love is like blowing into the fire of love, Like brushing one's teeth, Like polishing the whole body."

prakrit: "अट्ठावए य नालीए छत्तस्स य धारणट्ठाए,तेगिच्छं पाहणा पाए समारम्भं च जोइणो"
english: "The fire that burns, The drain that overflows, The roof that collapses, And the funeral pyre that rises from the fire."

prakrit: "सॆज्जायरपिण्डं च आसन्दी पलियङ्कए,गिहन्तरनिसॆज्जा य गायस्सुव्वट्टणाणि य"
english: "The plowman's son has grown very thin, So has the hunter's wife, That he does not know how to bend or bend."

prakrit: "गिहिणो वेयावडियं जा य अजीववत्तिया,तत्तानिव्वुडभोइत्तं आउरस्सरणाणि य"
english: "Get out of this damned mess, you worthless wretch, For there's nothing left to burn But fire and water."

prakrit: "मूलए सिङ्गबेरे य उच्छुखण्डे अनिव्वुडे,कन्दे मूले य सच्चित्ते फले बीए य आमए"
english: "Rooted in pride, Unsure when to root out falsehood, Rooting in falsehood Is the fruit of true faith."

prakrit: "सोवच्चले सिन्धवे लोणे रोमालोणे य आमए,सामुद्दे पंसुखारे य कालालोणे य आमए"
english: "In the middle of the night, The Sindhis fondle the lotus For its fragrance, In the front yard, The parrots for its juice, And in the backyard for its blackness."

prakrit: "धुवणॆत्ति वमणे य वत्थीकम्मविरेयणे,अञ्जणे दन्तवणे य गायब्भङ्गविभूसणे"
english: "To wash away, To vomit, Or to wail, To groan, To brush one's teeth Or to mutilate oneself."

prakrit: "सव्वमेयमणाइन्नं निग्गन्थाण महेसिणं,सञ्जमंमि य जुत्ताणं लहुभूयविहारिणं"
english: "Praise be to Mahesha, the remover of all faults, For he who can kindle a fire consumes nothing."

prakrit: "पञ्चासवपरिण्णाया तिगुत्ता छसु सञ्जया,पञ्चनिग्गहणा धीरा निग्गन्था उज्जुदंसिणो"
english: "The five vows are difficult to grasp, But perseverance in the five vows Makes one bright."

prakrit: "आयावयन्ति गिम्हेसु हेमन्तेसु अवाउडा,वासासु पडिसंलीणा सञ्जया सुसमाहिया"
english: "Come, summer is hot, Hemant is absent, Vasu is busy making love, And Sanjay is absent."

prakrit: "परीसहरिऊदन्ता धूयमोहा जिइन्दिया,सव्वदुक्खप्पहीणट्ठा पक्कमन्ति महेसिणो"
english: "Living in filthy white, Deer - eyed woman, Destroyer of all sorrow and wretched woman"

prakrit: "खवित्ता पुव्वकम्माइं सञ्जमेण तवेण य,सिद्धिमग्गमनुपत्ता ताइणे परिनिव्वुडा"
english: "The poor girl has perfected karma By staying in tune with it, By being able to match it With perfection."

prakrit: "सुयं मे आउसं तेणं भगवया एवमक्खायं इह खलु छज्जीवणिया नामज्झयणं समणेणं भगवया महावीरेणं कासवेणं पवेइया सुअक्खाया सुपन्नत्ता सेयं मे अहिज्जिउं अज्झयणं धम्मपन्नत्ती. कयरा खलु सा छज्जीवणिया नामज्झयणं समणेणं भगवया महावीरेणं कासवेणं पवेइया सुअक्खाया सुपन्नत्ता ? सेअं मे अहिज्जिउं अज्झयणं धम्मपन्नत्ती."
english: "In my sleep I see my beloved God, And suddenly I hear my beloved's name repeated:" "My God, great and beautiful!" "But when did I hear your name repeated again And again and again?"

prakrit: "से जे पुण इमे अनेगे बहवे तसा पाणा तं जहा- अण्डया,पोयया,जराउया,रसया,संसेइमा,संमुच्छिमा,उब्भिया उवावइया,जेसिं केसिं च पाणाणं अभिक्कन्तं पडिक्कन्तं,सङ्कुचियं पसारियं,रूयं,भन्तं,तसियं,पलाइयं,आगइगइविन्नाया,जे य कीडपयङ्गा जा य कुन्थुपिपीलिया,सव्वे बेइन्दिया,सव्वे तेइन्दिया,सव्वे चउरिन्दिया,सव्वे पञ्चिन्दिया,सव्वे तिरिक्खजोणिया सव्वे नेरइया,सव्वे मणुया,सव्वे देवा,सव्वे पाणा,परमाहम्मिआ,एसो खलु छट्ठो जीवनिकाओ तसकाओ त्ति पवुच्चइ."
english: "To whomever it may please, It is as if the water flowed through it - the egg, the cow, the yokel, the juice, the sesame seeds, the prickly pearl, the unripe fruit, the water that stuck to the nail, the shrinkage of the petals, the weeping, the howling, the trembling, the twitching, The fire - eating, The worm - eating jasmine, The crickets that nibbled at the bud, The scorpions that bit it, The parrots that bit

prakrit: "इच्चेसिं छण्हं जीवनिकायाणं नेव सयं दण्डं समारम्भॆज्जा नेवन्नेहिं दण्डं समारम्भावॆज्जा,दण्डं समारम्भन्ते वि अन्ने न समणुजाणॆज्जा,जावज्जीवाए तिविहं तिविहेणं मणेणं वायाए काएणं न करेमि न कारवेमि करन्तं पि अन्नं न समणुजाणामि,तस्स भन्ते! पडिक्कमामि निन्दामि गरिहामि अप्पाणं वोसिरामि."
english: "This man has no life in the world, No sentence for the rest of his life, No punishment for the remainder of his career, No reconciliation even for the last moment. For all the trouble I've had with him In my life He've done nothing wrong. Even when I do something wrong He doesn't know how to eat. Instead, he says:" "I condemn him. I forgive him, And I forget myself." ""

prakrit: "पढमे भन्ते महव्वए,पाणाइवायाओ वेरमणं सव्वं भन्ते! पाणाइवायं पच्चक्खामि से सुहुमं वा,बायरं वा,तसं वा,थावरं वा,नेव सयं पाणे अइवाऎज्जा,नेव'न्नेहिं पाणे अइवायावॆज्जा,पाणे अइवायन्ते'वि अन्ने न समणुजाणामि,जावज्जीवाए तिविहं तिविहेणं मणेणं वायाए काएणं न करेमि न कारवेमि करन्तं पि अन्नं न समणुजाणामि,तस्स भन्ते! पडिक्कमामि निन्दामि गरिहामि अप्पाणं वोसिरामि. पढमे भन्ते ! महव्वए उवट्ठिओमि सव्वाओ पाणाइवायाओ वेरमणं."
english: "At first I thought," "Hey, you fool!" "Then I remembered what you had to say:" "I love you very much." "Once I said that to him, he turned my back on me."

prakrit: "अहावरे दॊच्चे भन्ते! महव्वए मुसावायाओ वेरमणं,सव्वं भन्ते! मुसावायं पच्चक्खामि,से कोहा वा,लोहा वा,भया वा,हासा वा; नेव सयं मुसं वऎज्जा नेव'न्नेहिं मुसं वायावॆज्जा,मुसं वयन्ते वि अन्ने न समणुजाणामि,जाज्जीवाए तिविहं तिविहेणं,मणेणं वायाए काएणं न करेमि न कारवेमि करन्तं पि अन्नं न समणुजाणामि,तस्स भन्ते! पडिक्कमामि निन्दामि गरिहामि अप्पाणं वोसिरामि. दॊच्चे भन्ते महव्वए उवट्ठिओमि सव्वाओ मुसावायाओ वेरमणं."
english: "The hussies will say:" "Ah, you fool!" "They will mutter nonsense." "I'll distort your speech."

prakrit: "अहावरे तच्चे भन्ते! महव्वए,अदिन्नादाणाओ वेरमणं,सव्वं भन्ते ! अदिन्नादाणं पच्चक्खामि से गामे वा,नगरे वा,अरन्ने वा,अप्पं वा,बहुं वा,अणुं वा,थूलं वा चित्तमन्तं वा,अचित्तमन्तं वा,नेव सयं अदिन्नं गिण्हिज्जा,नेव'न्नेहिं अदिन्नं गिण्हाविज्जा,अदिन्नं गिण्हन्ते वि अन्ने न समणुजाणामि,जावज्जीवाए तिविहं तिविहेणं मणेणं वायाए काएणं न करेमि न कारवेमि करन्तं पि अन्नं न समणुजाणामि,तस्स भन्ते! पडिक्कमामि निन्दामि गरिहामि अप्पाणं वोसिरामि. तच्चे भन्ते ! महव्वए उवट्ठिओमि सव्वाओ अदिन्नादाणाओ वेरमणं."
english: "Ahavars will talk nonsense! Believe me, my dear! They will speak nonsense. I will tell you the truth: In every village and town And in every arbor I visit, I will eat bread, drink wine, knead rice, make sweets, and in every town and village I visit. Suddenly everyone is angry With me, Not with me, not with them, counting and counting. Even if I don't know what to count with. As long as I live I can't think of what to eat. I always do it in vain, Not even with my own hands. I

prakrit: "अहावरे चउत्थे भन्ते! महव्वए,मेहुणाओ वेरमणं,सव्वं भन्ते! मेहुणं पच्चक्खामि,से दिव्वं वा,माणुसं वा,तिरिक्खजोणियं वा,नेव सयं मेहुणं सेविज्जा,नेव'न्नेहिं मेहुणं सेवाविज्जा,मेहुणं सेवन्ते वि अन्ने न समणुजाणामि,जावज्जीवाए तिविहं तिविहेणं मणेणं वायाए काएणं न करेमि न कारवेमि करन्तं पि अन्नं न समणुजाणामि,तस्स भन्ते! पडिक्कमामि निन्दामि गरिहामि अप्पाणं वोसिरामि. चउत्थे भन्ते ! महव्वए उवट्ठिओ मि सव्वाओ मेहुणाओ वेरमणं."
english: "Ahavars roam everywhere! Bees, brothers - in - law, hatred, all roam around! I refashion the bridegroom. He is divine, human, round, young. I never serve him. Never have I served him. Though he serves me, I never make love again. Though I think of him often, I do not do so out of consideration. Even when I am busy making love, I refuse to eat food. Instead, I berate myself. Every time I am angry, I make myself feel like a traitor." ""

prakrit: "अहावरे पञ्चमे भन्ते! महव्वए,परिग्गहाओ वेरमणं,सव्वं भन्ते! परिग्गहं पच्चक्खामि,से अप्पं वा,बहुं वा,अणुं वा थूलं वा चित्तमन्तं वा अचित्तमन्तं वा,नेव सयं परिग्गहं परिगिण्हिज्जा,नेव'न्नेहिं परिग्गहं परिगिण्हाविज्जा,परिग्गहं परिगिण्हन्ते वि अन्ने न समणुजाणिज्जा,जावज्जीवाए,तिविहं तिविहेणं मणेणं वायाए काएणं न करेमि न कारवेमि करन्तं पि अन्नं न समणुजाणामि,तस्स भन्ते! पडिक्कमामि निन्दामि गरिहामि अप्पाणं वोसिरामि. पञ्चमे भन्ते ! महव्वए उवट्ठिओमि सव्वाओ परिग्गहाओ वेरमणं."
english: "Ahavars speak in fifths! Believe me, my dear! Circumstances are hateful, Everything is false! I speak in firsts. I refute bread, many words, an atom, a spit, a slap, a thought, or an impudence. Never, never, ever, though I think of myself in the first place, Do not speak plainly. Though I live my life, I do not speak out loud. But when I act, I speak as though I were acting. I utter falsehoods. In fifths I blaspheme myself. What

prakrit: "अहावरे छट्ठे भन्ते! वए,राईभोयणाओ वेरमणं. सव्वं भन्ते! राईभोयणं पच्चक्खामि,से असणं वा,पाणं वा,खाइमं वा,साइमं वा,नेव सयं राइं भुञ्जिज्जा नेव'न्नेहिं राइं भुञ्जाविज्जा,राइं भुञ्जन्ते'वि अन्ने न समणुजाणामि,जावज्जीवाए तिविहं तिविहेणं मणेणं वायाए काएणं न करेमि न कारवेमि करन्तं पि अन्नं न सणुजाणामि,तस्स भन्ते! पडिक्कमामि निन्दामि गरिहामि अप्पाणं वोसिरामि. छट्ठे भन्ते ! वए उवट्ठिओमि सव्वाओ राईभोयणाओ वेरमणं."
english: "Ahavars roam freely! Oh! I hate women. Everything I talk about! I detest women. When they sit by my side They sulk. When I eat they moan; When I roam the streets They moan:" "I don't know what to eat." "When I think of women roasting their breasts They mutter nonsense. I do not do anything wrong But speak plainly. Though I have a husband I do nothing wrong And eat my own, I am angry with myself. I lie still."

prakrit: "इच्चेइयाइं पञ्च महव्वयाइं राईभोअणवेरमणछट्ठाइं अतहियट्ठियाए उवसम्पज्जित्ता णं विहरामि."
english: "Here I am, straddling five great valleys, With my husband on my back And my wife on my shoulders, Wrapping up everything I have."

prakrit: "से भिक्खू वा,भिक्खुणी वा,सञ्जयविरयपडिहयपच्चक्खायपावकम्मे,दिआ वा,राओ वा,एगओ वा,परिसागओ वा,सुत्ते वा,जागरमाणे वा,से कीडं वा,पयङ्गं वा,कुन्थुं वा,पिपीलियं वा,हत्थंसि वा,पायंसि वा,बाहुंसि वा,उरुंसि वा,उदरंसि वा,सीसंसि वा,वत्थंसि वा,पडिग्गहंसि वा कम्बलंसि वा,पायपुञ्छणंसि वा,रयहरणंसि वा,गुच्छगंसि वा,उण्डगंसि वा,दण्डगंसि वा,पीढगंसि वा,फलगंसि वा,सॆज्जंसि वा,सन्थारगंसि वा,अन्नयरंसि वा तहप्पगारे उवगरणजाए तओ सञ्जयामेव पडिलेहिय पडेलिहय पमज्जिय पमज्जिय एगन्तमवणॆज्जा,नो णं सङ्घायमावज्जॆज्जा."
english: "He is a bhikkhu or a mendicant, A begging monk or a hermit, A man or a woman in distress, A farmer's son or daughter, A doe or a doe, A sleeping woman or a wakeful stag, A worm in a field, A creeper on the anvil, A wasp on the hips, A peacock on the hand, A scruffy doe on the thighs, A swarm of crickets on the hip, A flock of parrots hanging down from the rafters Or a blanket

prakrit: "अजयं चरमाणो अ,पाणभूयाइं हिंसइ,बन्धइपावयं कम्मं तं से होइ कडुयं फलं"
english: "Time is of the essence, The waters teem with violence, And the deeds of captive women bear a bitter fruit."

prakrit: "अजयं चिट्ठमाणो उ,पाणभूयाइं हिंसइ,बन्धइ पावयं कम्मं तं से होइ कडुयं फलं"
english: "Ajay is a man of letters, He tortures his enemies, And binds up his enemies: By their deeds comes bitter fruit."

prakrit: "अजयं आसमाणो उ,पाणभूयाइं हिंसइ,बन्धई पावयं कम्मं,तं से होइ कडुयं फलं"
english: "Today the sky is dark, The waters are violent, The captives have committed iniquity, And with it bitter fruit."

prakrit: "अजयं सयमाणो उ,पाणभूयाइं हिंसइ,बन्धइ पावयं कम्मं,तं से होइ कडुयं फलं"
english: "One must remain vigilant; one must torment one's enemies, one must restrain oneself from wrong actions; this will bear bitter fruit."

prakrit: "अजयं भुञ्जमाणो उ,पाणभूयाइं हिंसइ,बन्धई पावयं कम्मं,तं से होइ कडुयं फलं"
english: "Ajay roasts the ground, tortures the water buffalo, binds the poor man, and acts harshly. From him comes a bitter fruit."

prakrit: "अजयं भासमाणो उ,पाणभूयाइं हिंसइ,बन्धई पावयं कम्मं,तं से होइ कडुयं फलं"
english: "Love is an illusion, It torments the bowers of the river, It imprisons the doer, And with it bitter fruit."

prakrit: "कहं चरे कहं चिट्ठे,कहमासे कहं सए,कहं भुञ्जन्तो,भासन्तो,पावकम्मं न बन्धइ"
english: "Whom to feed, how to wean, when to roast, how not to burn?"

prakrit: "जयं चरे जयं चिट्ठे,जयमासे जयं सए,जयं भुञ्जन्तो,भासन्तो,पावकम्मं न बन्धइ"
english: "Forget about victory, victory is certain; victory, indeed, is certain. But do not be alarmed: Love's arrows will not stop you."

prakrit: "सव्वभूयप्पभूयस्स,सम्मं भूयाइं पासओ,पिहिआसवस्स दन्तस्स,पावकम्मं न बन्धइ"
english: "Surround yourself with all your might, stay close to all your enemies, do not grind your teeth against enemies."

prakrit: "पढमं नाणं तओ दया,एवं चिट्ठइ सव्वसञ्जए,अन्नाणी किं काही,किंवा नाही छेयपावगं?"
english: "I don't know whether to write a letter or not. What do I mean by kindness, my dear?"

prakrit: "सॊच्चा जाणइ कल्लाणं,सॊच्चा जाणइ पावगं,उभयं पि जाणइ सॊच्चा,जं सेयं तं समायरे"
english: "The right knows good, the wrong knows bad, and both know wrong. What's right is wrong."

prakrit: "जो जीवे वि न याणइ,अजीवे वि न याणइ,जीवाजीवे अयाणन्तो,कहं सो नाहीइ सञ्जमं?"
english: "One who knows no living being, knows no non - existence, knows only existence; where then is sanjyam lost?"

prakrit: "जो जीवे वि वियाणेई,अजीवे वि वियाणइ,जीवाजीवे वियाणन्तो,सो हु नाहीइ सञ्जमं"
english: "One who understands life, who understands the strange, who is aware of life, is not in a state of consciousness."

prakrit: "जया जीवमजीवे य,दो'वि एए वियाणई,तया गइं बहुविहं,सव्वजीवाण जाणई"
english: "Jaya is for life, both are for knowledge, she has already passed many marriages, and knows all life."

prakrit: "जया गइं बहुविहं,सव्वजीवाण जाणइ,तया पुन्नं च पावं च,बन्धं मुक्खं च जाणई"
english: "Jaya has passed away, is now very old, knows all life, has reached her climax, and knows the main points of her relationships."

prakrit: "जया पुन्नं च पावं च,बन्धं मुक्खं च जाणई,तया निविन्दए भोए,जे दिव्वे जे य माणुसे"
english: "She knows what is good and what is bad, And what is important in a relationship."

prakrit: "जया निव्विन्दए भोए,जे दिव्वे जे य माणुसे,तया चयइ सञ्जोगं,सब्भिन्तरं सबाहिरं"
english: "Jaya nivindaye bhoye, je divye jis humare, she chooses sanjog, the supreme center is everywhere."

prakrit: "जया चयइ सञ्जोगं,सब्भिन्तरं सबाहिरं,तया मुण्डे भवित्ताणं,पव्वइए अणगारियं"
english: "Jaya chooses sanjogam, The supreme center is everywhere, The head is the forehead, The feet are the limbs."

prakrit: "जया मुण्डे भवित्ताणं,पव्वइए अणगारियं,तया संवरमुक्किट्ठं,धम्मं फासे अनुत्तरं"
english: "Jaya munde bhavitthanam, pavvayi ungariyam, tya samvaramukkitam, dharma phasme anuttaram."

prakrit: "जया संवरमुक्किट्ठं,धम्मं फासे अनुत्तरं,तया धुणइ कम्मरयं,अबोहि कलुसं कडं"
english: "Jaya is immortal, Dharma is unfettered, She embraces karma, Nowadays there is so much filth."

prakrit: "जया धुणइ कम्मरयं अबोहि कलुसं कडं,तया सव्वत्तगं नाणं,देसणं चाभिगच्छई"
english: "Where is Jaya washing the blacksmith's clothes? She needs all the money She can muster. She needs the land." ""

prakrit: "जया सव्वत्तगं नाणं,दंसणं चाभिगच्छई,तया लोगमलोगं च,जिणो जाणइ केवली"
english: "Jaya treasures everything, Seeks the sting of love, And knows the world only through knowledge."

prakrit: "जया लोगमलोगं च,जिणो जाणइ केवली,तया जोगे निरुम्भित्ता,सेलेसिं पडिवज्जइ"
english: "One who knows what's wrong with a person knows how to be honest, One who is forthright, Is won over by politeness."

prakrit: "जया जोगे निरुम्भित्ता,सेलेसिं पडिवज्जइ,तया कम्मं खवित्ताणं,सिद्धिं गच्छइ नीरओ"
english: "Jaya is restless, Celes is busy making love, Deceit is at hand in her affairs, Nero is on his way to perfection."

prakrit: "जया कम्मं खवित्ताणं,सिद्धिं गच्छइ नीरओ,तया लोगमत्थयत्थो,सिद्धो हवइ सासओ"
english: "Jaya is the remover of karma, nirao is the purifier of perfection, logmatthyatho, siddho is the mother-in-law of perfection."

prakrit: "सुहसायगस्स समणस्स,सायाउलगस्स निगामसाइस्स,उच्छोलणापहोइस्स,दुल्लहा सुगई तारिसगस्स"
english: "Pleasant is the sound of the ocean, shadowy is the nigma, undulating is the sky, swollen is the starry sky."

prakrit: "तवोगुणपहाणस्स,उज्जुमइ खन्तिसञ्जमरयस्स,परीसहे जिणन्तस्स,सुलहा सुगई तारिसगस्स"
english: "Love's fragrant breath, Bright sunshine, scent of fairies, Delightful lotus."

prakrit: "पच्छा वि ते पयाया,खिप्पं गच्छन्ति अमरभवणाइं,जेसिं पिओ तवो सञ्जमो अ खन्ती अ बम्भचेरं च"
english: "Though past, they have passed, But now they depart for immortal mansions. For as the beloved has left, So has Sanjamo, And so has Khanty, and so has Bambacher."

prakrit: "इच्चेयं छज्जीवणिअं,सम्मद्दिट्ठी सया जए,दुल्लहं लहित्तुं सामन्नं,कम्मुणा न विराहॆज्जासि"
english: "This is the path to a happy life, The straight path is straightforward, The crooked path is difficult, But don't turn your back on it."

prakrit: "सम्पत्ते भिक्खकालंमि,असम्भन्तो अमुच्छिओ,इमेण कम्मजोगेण,भत्तपानं गवेसए"
english: "Wealth begets wealth, immutability begets greed, This is the path to perfection."

prakrit: "से गामे वा नगरे वा,गोयरग्गगओ मुनी,चरे मन्दमणुव्विगो,अव्वक्खित्तेण चेयसा"
english: "Be it in a village or in a town, Be it among cattle or be it among men, You always act with discretion."

prakrit: "पुरओ जुगमायाए,पेहमाणो महिं चरे,वज्जन्तो बीयहरियाइं,पाणे अ दगमट्टिअं"
english: "The full moon is rising, The first clouds are hovering over us, The second rain clouds are approaching, And the third rain shadow is closing in."

prakrit: "ओवायं विसमं खाणु,विज्जलं परिवज्जए,सङ्कमेण न गच्छॆज्जा,विज्जमाणे परक्कमे"
english: "The wind blows the twentieth grain, The lightning flashes the twig, Do not be distracted by sorrow, For lightning is the ultimate triumph."

prakrit: "पवडन्ते व से तत्थ,पक्खलन्ते व सञ्जए,हिंसॆज्ज पाणभूयाइं,तसे अदुव थावरे"
english: "Those who walk on foot walk on water, Those who run on foot sleep on land, And those who suffer violence stay on land."

prakrit: "तम्हा तेण न गच्छॆज्जा,सञ्जए सुसमाहिए,सइ अन्नेण मग्गेण,जयमेव परक्कमे"
english: "Don't be alarmed by that, Sanjay, may I have a good time, Say," "I'll go elsewhere." ""

prakrit: "इङ्गालं छारियं रासिं,तुसरासिं च गोयमं,ससरक्खेहिं पाएहिं,सञ्जओ तं न'इक्कमे"
english: "I have heard so much about you from my father-in-law, I will never forget how you made me feel."

prakrit: "न चरॆज्ज वासे वासन्ते,महियाए व पडन्तिए,महावाए व वायन्ते,तिरिच्छसम्पाइमेसु वा"
english: "There are no fishes in the sky, The bees fall when they see the moon, The winds blow when they hear it, Nor do they travel in circles."

prakrit: "न चरॆज्ज वेससामन्ते,बम्भचेरवसाणुए,बम्भयारिस्स दन्तस्स,हॊज्जा तत्थ विसॊत्तिआ"
english: "I am not afraid of prostitutes, I am afraid of spiky women, I have teeth that are bristling. What's the matter with you?"

prakrit: "अनाययणे चरन्तस्स,संसग्गीए अभिक्खणं,हॊज्ज वयाणं पीला,सामण्णंमि य संसओ"
english: "Traveler, traveler, Try to understand each other, Make your speech pale, Resemble the world as it is."

prakrit: "तम्हा एयं वियाणित्ता,दोसं दुग्गइवड्ढणं,वज्जए वेससामन्तं,मुनी एगन्तमस्सिए"
english: "Such is your wisdom, Wretched is the multiplication of faults, Vjaya is like a prostitute: The sage has reached the climax."

prakrit: "साणं सूइअं गाविं,दित्तं गोणं हयं गयं,सण्डिब्भं कलहं जुद्धं,दूरओ परिवज्जए"
english: "The good guy has left, The bad guy has gone, The quarrels between the brothers Are over, The wars are over, Travels are far away."

prakrit: "अणुन्नए नावणए अप्पहिट्ठे अनाउले,इन्दियाणि जहाभागं,दमइत्ता मुनी चरे"
english: "Unsure what to do with the ship, The Indians are everywhere: The damned sage has passed away."

prakrit: "दवदवस्स न गच्छॆज्जा,भासमाणो य गोअरे,हसन्तो नाभिगच्छॆज्जा,कुलं उच्चावयं सया"
english: "Don't be alarmed: It looks like a cow on fire, Looks like a buffalo, Smiles like a doe, Speaks like an ox, And speaks with a loud voice."

prakrit: "आलोयं थिग्गलं दारं,सन्धिन्दगभवणाणि य,चरन्तो न विनिज्झाए,सङ्कट्ठाणं विवज्जए"
english: "The light illuminates the door, The crossroads the buildings, The cradle does not divider, The narrow passage divides."

prakrit: "रन्नो गिहवईणं च,रहस्सारक्खियाण य,सङ्किलेसकरं ठाणं,दूरओ परिवज्जए"
english: "To run and hide, To fly like a mysterious bird, To stand like a shackle, To wander far and wide."

prakrit: "पडिकुट्ठ कुलं न पविसे,मामगं परिवज्जए,अचियत्त कुलं न पविसे,चियत्तं पविसे कुलं"
english: "A crooked family is not worthy of being called holy, A violent one is not, And a crooked one isn't, For the sake of being chaste is not holy at all."

prakrit: "साणीपावारपिहियं,अप्पणा नावपङ्गुरे,कवाडं नो पणॊल्लिज्जा,उग्गहंसि अजाइआ"
english: "Love your neighbor as yourself, Fingers crossed, Don't yawn. You're bound to laugh." ""

prakrit: "गोअरग्गपविट्ठो उ,वच्चमुत्तं न धारए,ओगासं फासुअं नच्चा,अणुन्नविय वोसिरे"
english: "Bees sit tight, Don't move their beaks, Do not dance in the wet mud." ""

prakrit: "नीय दुवारं तमसं,कॊट्ठगं परिवज्जए,अचक्खुविसओ जत्थ,पाणा दुप्पडिलेहगा"
english: "Aunt, You're right; There must be something wrong with the house. The streets are empty. I'll make a mess of it."

prakrit: "जत्थ पुप्फाइं बीआइं,विप्पइण्णाइं कॊट्ठए,अहुणोवलित्तं उल्लं दट्ठूणं परिवज्जए"
english: "As soon as the buffalo sows seeds, The farmer cuts the paddy, And when the oxen plunder the field, He turns away to look."

prakrit: "एलगं दारगं साणं,वच्छगं वा वि कॊट्ठए,उल्लङ्घिया न पविसे विउहित्ताण व सञ्जए"
english: "Like a doorknob, Like a calf, Or even like a stag, Do not break it, For it is your duty to protect it."

prakrit: "असंसत्तं पलोऎज्जा,नाइदूरा'वलोयए,उप्फुलं न विनिज्झाए,नियट्टिज्ज अयम्पिरो"
english: "Unsatisfied plowman, Don't let the flowers wilt, For they are inexhaustible."

prakrit: "अइभूमिं न गच्छॆज्जा,गोअरग्गगओ मुनी,कुलस्स भूमिं जाणित्ता,मियं भूमिं परक्कमे"
english: "Don't go to that land, you silly cowherd. The farmer knows the land, But I will protect the land." ""

prakrit: "तत्थेव पडिलेहॆज्जा भूमिफागं वियक्खणो,सिणाणस्स य वच्चस्स संलोगं परिवज्जए"
english: "Then he fell at my feet, And I looked at the surface of the earth, And saw that the wind was blowing Strongly."

prakrit: "दगमट्टियआयाणे,बीयाणि हरियाणि अ,परिवज्जन्तो चिट्ठॆज्जा,सव्विन्दिअ समाहिए"
english: "Clouds cover the horizon, Seeds cover the greenery, Travelers cover the rafters, All eyes gather."

prakrit: "तत्थ से चिट्ठमाणस्स आहारे पानभोयणं,अकप्पिअं न गेण्हिज्जा,पडिगाहॆज्ज कप्पिअं"
english: "From then on the rafters will eat and drink, Unhappiness will no longer trouble you, Greed will bite you."

prakrit: "आहारन्ती सिया तत्थ,परिसाडॆज्ज भोयणं,दॆन्तिअं पडिआइक्खे,न मे कप्पइ तारिसं"
english: "Aunt, There she is eating, The messenger is leaving, The doe is lying on her back, And I am not covering for her."

prakrit: "संमद्दमाणी पाणाणि,बीआणि,हरियाणि अ,असञ्जमकरिं नच्चा,तारिसिं परिवज्जए"
english: "Tears flow from her eyes, Bees sit motionless, Hariyans dance in unison." ""

prakrit: "साहट्टु निक्खिवित्ताणं,सचित्तं घट्टियाणि य,तहेव समणट्ठाए,उदगं सम्पणॊल्लिया"
english: "Truth alone triumphs, falsehood alone vanishes, The gods have made peace, The rising sun has destroyed everything."

prakrit: "ओगाहइत्ता चलइत्ता,आहारे पानभोयणं,दॆन्तियं पडियाइक्खे,न मे कप्पइ तारिसं"
english: "Tears flow from my eyes, Food flows from my ears, Teeth fall from my teeth, I can't take them."

prakrit: "पुरेकम्मेण हत्थेण,दव्वीए भायणेण वा,दॆन्तियं पडिआइक्खे,न मे कप्पइ तारिसं"
english: "A poor man's hand, A poor woman's mouth, Has dropped her teeth. I cannot shake them."

prakrit: "एवं उदल्ले ससिणिद्धे,ससरक्खे मट्टिआओसे,हरियाले हिङ्गुलए,मनोसिला अञ्जणे लोणे"
english: "And standing trees, Like earthen pots, Like mother - in - law sitting on the ground, Like branches falling from the sky, Are a source of delight to the eyes."

prakrit: "गेरुअ वण्णिअ सेडिअ,सोरट्ठिय पिट्ठकुक्कुसकएय,उक्किट्ठमसंसट्ठे संसट्ठे चेव बॊद्धव्वे"
english: "A swarm of gnats is hovering above, A flock of parrots is chasing a stag, And a flock of crickets is gathering around it."

prakrit: "असंसट्ठेण हत्थेणं,दव्वीए भायणेण वा,दिज्जमाणं न इच्छिज्जा,पच्छाकम्मं जहिं भवे"
english: "Do not shake hands, do not yawn, Do not speak harshly, For where there is resentment, there must be compassion."

prakrit: "संसट्ठेण हत्थेण,दव्वीए भायणेण वा,दिज्जमाणं पडिच्छिज्जा,जं तत्थेसणियं भवे"
english: "Assembly by hand, speech by day, Decision by letter, as the case may be,"

prakrit: "दोण्हं तु भुञ्जमाणाणं,एगो तत्थ निमन्तए,दिज्जमाणं न इच्छॆज्जा,छन्दं से पडिलेहए"
english: "Both of you, Bhujamanana, Come then and there, Don't be so hasty: You have fallen by the wayside."

prakrit: "दोण्हं तु भुञ्जमाणाणं,दो वि तत्थ निमन्तए,दिज्जमाणं पडिच्छिज्जा,जं तत्थेसणियं भवे"
english: "The two of you are bound to meet, Both are welcome there, I suppose, As long as I am there."

prakrit: "गुव्विणीए उवण्णथं विविहं पानभोयणं,भुञ्जमाणं विवज्जॆज्जा,भत्तसेसं पडिच्छए"
english: "The cowherd paces up and down like a buffalo, Drinking a lot of water, Sweating profusely." ""

prakrit: "सिया य समणट्ठाए,गुव्विणी कालमासिणी,उट्टिआ वा निसीऎज्जा,निसन्ना वा पुणुट्ठए"
english: "Wretched woman, When she sits still, When her husband is away, When he is absent, Or when she recoils."

prakrit: "तं भवे भत्तपानं तु,सञ्जयाण अकप्पिअं,दॆन्तिअं पडिआइक्खे,न मे कप्पइ तारिसं"
english: "Be that as it may: You are the drinker of pleasure, Sanjay is the one who is annoyed, The tooth is still lodged in his mouth, And I am not spitting on him."

prakrit: "थणगं पिज्जामाणी,दारगं वा कुमारिअं,तं निक्खिवित्तु रोअन्तं,आहार पानभोयणं"
english: "The breasts are like pizzamas, Like doorways or virgins'doors. Stopped and cried while eating And drank." ""

prakrit: "तं भवे भत्तपानं तु,सञ्जयाणं अकप्पियं,दॆन्तिअं पडियाइक्खे,न मे कप्पइ तारिसं"
english: "Be that as it may: You will drink, I will atone for what I have done, The teeth will fall by the wayside, And I will not spare you."

prakrit: "जं भवे भत्तपानं तु,कप्पाकप्पंमि सङ्कियं,दॆन्तिअं पडिआइक्खे,न मे कप्पइ तारिसं"
english: "Whatever you want me to drink, I'll have a drink of you, But I can't get enough of you."

prakrit: "दगवारए पिहिअं,नीसाए पीढएण वा,लोढेण वा विलेवेण,सिलेसेण वि केणइ"
english: "One pursues a bad man, One persecutes a bad one, One destroys a good one, And one destroys another."

prakrit: "तं च उब्भिन्दिया दॆज्जा,समणट्ठाए व दावए,दॆन्तिअं पडिआइक्खे,न मे कप्पइ तारिसं"
english: "He is angry and angry, He is demanding and demanding, He has fallen on my back, And I will not forgive him."

prakrit: "असनं पानगं वा'वि,खाइमं साइमं तहा,जं जाणॆज्जा सुणॆज्जा वा,दाणट्ठा पगडं इमे"
english: "Like the water in a pan, Like the soap in a dish, Like gold in a suit, Like a turban with teeth in it."

prakrit: "तं भवे भत्तपानं तु,सञ्जयाणं अकप्पियं,दॆन्तिअं पडिआइक्खे,न मे कप्पइ तारिसं"
english: "Be that as it may: You are the drinker, I am the one who consumes it, The seller is the seller, And I am not the seller of it."

prakrit: "असनं पानगं वा'वि,खाइमं साइमं तहा,जं जाणॆज्जा सुणॆज्जा वा,पुण्णट्ठा पगडं इमं"
english: "As for eating and drinking, I am quite the same as you, Whatever you know about being handsome You know, It's just a matter of having a nice turban."

prakrit: "तं भवे भत्तपानं तु,सञ्जयाण अकप्पियं,दॆन्तिअं पडिआइक्खे,न मे कप्पइ तारिसं"
english: "Be that as it may: You're the drinker, Sanjay is the intoxicant, The teeth are worn out, I can't cover you." ""

prakrit: "असनं पानगं वा'वि,खाइमं साइमं तहा,जं जाणॆज्जा सुणॆज्जा वा,वणिमट्ठा पगडं इमं"
english: "As for me, I walk the path, So do you walk the paths, For all I know is sunshine, For wet is my turban."

prakrit: "असनं पानगं वा'वि,खाईमं साइमं तहा,जं जाणॆज्जा सुणॆज्जा वा,समणट्ठा पगडं इमं"
english: "As for eating and drinking, I will eat and drink, As for what I know about myself, It's only my turban that matches."

prakrit: "तं भवे भत्तपानं तु सञ्जयाण अकप्पिअं,देतियं पडिआइक्खे,न मे कप्पइ तारिसं"
english: "Be that as it may: You have tasted it, You have given it to me, I will not spare you."

prakrit: "उद्देसियं कीयगडं,पूइकम्मं च आहडं,अज्झोयर पामिच्चं,मीसजायं च विवज्जए"
english: "Purpose begets activity, virtue begets action, vanity begets desire, and delusion begets delusion."

prakrit: "उग्गमं से अ पुच्छॆज्जा,कस्सट्ठा केण वा कडं?,सॊच्चा निस्सङ्कियं सुद्धं,पडिगाहॆज्ज,सञ्जए"
english: "I beg of you, tell me, Whom are you looking out for, Or where?"

prakrit: "असनं पानगं वा'वि,खाइमं साइमं तहा,पुप्फेसु हॊज्ज उम्मीसं,बीएसु हरिएसु वा"
english: "As though we had to walk, As though to rest, As if we had only to kneel, And as though to bow our heads We bow our faces."

prakrit: "तं भवे भत्तपानं तु,सञ्जयाण अकप्पिअं,दॆन्तियं पडिआइक्खे न मे कप्पइ तारिसं"
english: "Be that as it may, you're drunk on liquor, My heart is set on it, But I can't get enough of you."

prakrit: "असनं पानगं वा'वि,खाइमं साइमं तहा,उदगंमि हॊज्ज निक्खित्तं,उत्तिङ्गपणगेसु वा"
english: "As though I were walking on water, As if I were cooking a meal, So as not to fall asleep on top of my husband, Are you afraid of falling asleep?"

prakrit: "असनं पानगं वा'वि,खाइमं साइमं तहा,तेउंमि हॊज्ज निक्खित्तं,तं च सङ्घट्टिया दए"
english: "We have to walk together, Eat together, Teach together, Protect together, Give together in unity."

prakrit: "एवं उस्सक्किया ओसक्किया,उज्जालिआ निव्वाविया,उस्सिञ्चिया निस्सिञ्चिया,ओवत्तिया ओवारिया दए"
english: "And when the fire is hot, It burns brightly, When it is dry, It scorches, And when it is wet, It tears."

prakrit: "हॊज्ज कट्ठं सिलं वा'वि,इट्टालं वा'वि एगया,ठविअं सङ्कमट्ठाए,तं च हॊज्ज चलाचलं"
english: "The wind blows thick and hard, The breeze is fierce, The road is bumpy, And the roads are slippery."

prakrit: "न तेन भिक्खू गच्छॆज्जा,दिट्ठा तत्थ असञ्जमो,गम्भीरं झुसिरं चेव,सव्विन्दिअ समाहिए"
english: "Do not approach a monk while he is away; keep your eyes closed, do not be distracted by loud noises; try to catch a glimpse of him."

prakrit: "निस्सेणिं फलगं पीढं,उस्सवित्ताणमारुहे,मञ्चं कीलं च पासायं समणट्ठाए एव दावए"
english: "The plowman's son has grown very thin, He can hardly walk, He walks very slowly, He bends his arms around the stage, And puts his hands between his hips."

prakrit: "दुरुहमाणी पवडॆज्जा,हत्थं पायं व लूसए,पुढवीजीवे विहिंसॆज्जा जे अ तन्निस्सिआ जगे"
english: "Anxious woman, If you find fault with your husband's behavior, Lay your hands and feet flat on the ground, Then wake up your lover."

prakrit: "एयारिसे महादोसे,जाणिऊण महेसिणो,तम्हा मालोहडं भिक्खं,न पडिगिण्हन्ति सञ्जया"
english: "This is a great fault of yours, my lord, Your highnesses are beggars by nature, And Sanjay is not to be outdone."

prakrit: "कन्दं मूलं पलम्बं वा,आमं छिन्नं च सन्निरं,तुम्बागं सिङ्गबेरं च,आमगं परिवज्जए"
english: "Tubers root, Plums wither, Mangoes are plucked and put in the sun. But you, my dear, Take the mango in your turn."

prakrit: "तहेव सतुचुण्णाइं,कोलचुण्णाइं आवणे,सक्कुलिं फाणिअं पूअं,अन्नं वा'वि तहाविहं"
english: "The good nights are short, The hot nights are long, The dry winter is hot, And the rainy season is hot."

prakrit: "विक्कायमाणं पसढं,रएणं परिफासियं,दॆन्तियं पडिआइक्खे,न मे कप्पइ तारिसं"
english: "The wicked are spread abroad, The rays are dispersed, The teeth are set on edge, And I cannot stop them."

prakrit: "बहुअट्ठिअं पुग्गलं,अनिमिसं वा बहुकण्टयं,अत्थियं तिन्दुयं बिल्लं,उच्छुखण्डं वा सिम्बलिं"
english: "Many - eyed parrot, Animism or multitasking, The three eyes are like a billow, An emerald or a cymbal."

prakrit: "अप्पे सिया भोअणजाए बहुउज्झिय धम्मियं,दॆन्तिअं पडिआइक्खे,न मे कप्पइ तारिसं"
english: "Dear friend, The dharma of many vows has been fulfilled, But I will not betray it."

prakrit: "तहेवुच्चावयं पानं,अदुवा वारधोयणं,संसेइमं चाउलोदगं,अहुणाधोयं विवज्जए"
english: "Always drink water, always bathe, Always carry rice with you, Always be careful not to inhale water"

prakrit: "जं जाणॆज्ज चिराधोयं,मईए दंसणेण वा,पडिपुच्छिऊण सॊच्चा वा जं च निस्सङ्कियं भवे"
english: "Whatever a man knows, Whether by flattery, By the touch of a needle, Or by asking a question, Is pure conjecture."

prakrit: "अजीवं परिणयं नच्चा,पडिगाहॆज्ज सञ्जए,अह सङ्कियं भवॆज्जा,आसाइत्ताण रोयए"
english: "How strange it is to dance all the time, To groan loudly, To make one's heart swell with joy, To weep bitterly."

prakrit: "थोवमासायणट्ठाए हत्थगंमि दलाहि मे,मा मे अच्चम्बिलं पुअं,नालं तिण्हं विणित्तए"
english: "Thinking how lucky I am To have you in my arms, My boy, Don't be so naïve As to let the reed weave through your hair."

prakrit: "तं च अच्चम्बिलं पूई,नालं तिण्हं विणितए,दॆन्तिअं पडिआइक्खे न मे कप्पइ तारिसं"
english: "She has painted a pattern on her face, Spattered the nail marks on her cheeks, And covered them with gooseflesh."

prakrit: "तं च हॊज्ज अकामेणं,विमणेणं पडिच्छियं,तं अप्पणा न पिबे,नो वि अन्नस्स दावए"
english: "There must be something wrong with you, You have to think carefully, You must not drink yourself to death; There is no food to tell you otherwise."

prakrit: "एगन्तमवक्कमित्ता अचितं पडिलेहिया,जयं परिट्ठवॆज्जा,परिट्ठप्प पडिक्कमे"
english: "Eguntamavakamitta achitam padilehya, jayam paritthevejja, paritheppa padikkame."

prakrit: "सिया अ गोअरग्गओ,इच्छिज्जा परिभॊत्तुयं,कुट्ठगं भितिमूलं वा,पडिलेहित्ताण फासुअं"
english: "Like a herd of oxen, Like a traveler's bow, Like an axe pierced by a sharp arrow, Like the nail of a pyre."

prakrit: "अणुन्नवॆत्तु मेहावी,पडिच्छिन्नम्मि संवुडे,हत्थगं सम्पमज्जित्ता,तत्थ भुञ्जिज्ज सञ्जए"
english: "Anunnavettu mehavi, padikrammi samvude, hamad sampamajitta, taththa bhunjijjaja sanjaye."

prakrit: "तत्थ से भुञ्जमाणस्स अट्ठिअं कण्टओ सिया,तणकट्ठसक्करं वा'वि,अन्नं वा'वि तहाविहं"
english: "From then on, Look at the water in the pan, Sweat running down the grass, And food flowing down the drain." ""

prakrit: "तं उक्खिवित्तु न निक्खवे आसएण न छड्डए,हत्थेणं तं गहेऊण एगन्तमवक्कमे"
english: "Don't let him get away, for he won't be missed: Hold on to him While he goes on the rampage."

prakrit: "एगन्तमवक्कमित्ता,अचितं पडिलेहिया,जयं परिट्ठवॆज्जा,परिट्ठप्प पडिक्कमे"
english: "Eigantamavakamitta, achitam padilehya, jayam paritthevejja, paritheppa padikkame."

prakrit: "सिया अ भिक्खु इच्छॆज्जा सिज्जमागम्म भॊत्तुयं,सपिण्डपायमागम्म,उण्डुयं पडिलेहिया"
english: "Siyah a bhikkhu, I wish I had forgotten how to sit, How to lie flat on my back, How difficult it is to lie still"

prakrit: "विनएण पविसित्ता,सगासे गुरुणो मुनी,इरियावहियमायाय,आगओ य पडिक्कमे"
english: "Through humility one purifies, Through anger one disciplines, Through jealousy one renounces, And through fire and flame one destroys."

prakrit: "आभोऎत्ताण नीसेसं,अईआरं च जहक्कमं,गमणागमणे चेव,भत्त पाने य सञ्जए"
english: "Discontent is bound to come, And resentment to come. But when it comes to going, One must go in order to get an allowance."

prakrit: "उज्जुप्पन्नो अणुव्विग्गो,अव्वक्खित्तेणं चेयसा,आलोए गुरुसगासे,जं जहा गहियं भवे"
english: "Be bright, be bright, do your best, light shines from the teachers'room, wherever it may be dark."

prakrit: "न सम्ममालोइयं हुज्जा,पुव्विं पच्छा व जं कडं,पुणो पडिक्कमे तस्स,वोसट्ठो चिन्तए इमं"
english: "Never mind the gossip: Everything that goes on behind closed doors, Everything that happens in the past, Happens all over again."

prakrit: "अहो जिणेहिं असावज्जा,वित्ती साहूण देसिया,मुक्खसाहणहेउस्स,साहु देहस्स धारणा"
english: "Ah, the carelessness of the wife, The indecent behavior of the husband, The conceit of the mother - in - law, The pretence of the head."

prakrit: "नमुक्कारेण पारित्ता करॆत्ता जिनसन्थवं,सज्झायं पट्ठवित्ताणं,वीसमॆज्ज खणं मुनी"
english: "One who follows a pattern finds refuge in others, One who learns the meaning of a text is a sage, And one who learns something is a hermit."

prakrit: "वीसमन्तो इमं चिन्ते,हियमट्ठं लाभमस्सिओ,जइ मे अणुग्गहं कुज्जा,साहु हॊज्जामि तारिओ"
english: "I can think only of this, I cannot think of any other gain, For if I lose faith I lose heart."

prakrit: "साहवो तो चियत्तेणं,निमन्तिज्ज जहक्कमं,जइ तत्थ केइ इच्छॆज्जा,तेहिं सद्धिं तु भुञ्जए"
english: "Friend, cheat! I beg of you, If anyone wishes it, Let him have it."

prakrit: "अह कोइ न इच्छिज्जा,तओ भुञ्जिज्ज ऎक्कओ,आलोए भायणे साहु,जयं अपरिसाडियं"
english: "Ah, there is no desire, So yo, get down on your feet, Aloe, brother - in - law! Victory is certain." ""

prakrit: "तित्तङ्गं च कडुयं च कसायं अम्बिलं च महुरं लवणं वा,एय लद्धमन्नत्थपउत्तं,महुघयं व भुञ्जॆज्ज सञ्जए"
english: "Aunt, There must be something very bitter and astringent Between the lotus and the sweetwood. This is the fruit of a long man's affection. It must be the nectar of a beehive."

prakrit: "अरसं विरसं वा'वि,सूइयं वा असूइयं,उल्लं वा जइ वा सुक्कं,मन्थुकुम्मास भोयणं"
english: "Prostrate wind, drowsy wind, sunny day, dry month, rainy month."

prakrit: "उप्पन्नं नाइहीलॆज्जा,अप्पं वा बहु फासुयं,मुहालद्धं मुहाजीवी,भुञ्जिज्जा दोसवज्जिअं"
english: "Uppannam nai hilejja, appam va bahut phasuyum, muhaladh muhajivi, bhunjijja dosavajjiyan." ""

prakrit: "दुल्लहाउ मुहादाई,मुहाजीवी वि दुल्लहा,मुहादाई मुहाजीवी,दो वि गच्छइ सॊग्गइं"
english: "Dullahu, the mouthful is empty, the wife is empty; the husband is empty - both are empty."

prakrit: "पडिग्गहं संलिहित्ताणं,लेवमायाए सञ्जए,दुगन्धं वा सुगन्धं वा,सव्वं भुञ्जे न छड्डए"
english: "Don't leave everything in the frying pan, whether it's the fragrance of rice or milk, Or the smell of perfume." ""

prakrit: "सॆज्जा निसीहियाए,समावन्नो य गोअरे,अयावयट्ठा भॊच्चा णं,जइ तेणं न सन्थरे"
english: "They are useless, Like cattle in a herd, Like buffalo in a flock, If they cannot stand still"

prakrit: "तओ कारणसमुपन्ने,भत्तपानं गवेसए,विहिणा पुव्वउत्तेण,इमेणं उत्तरेण य"
english: "Thou art right in front of the cause, In search of a drink to drink, In raising a wretched flower, Such is the reply."

prakrit: "कालेणं निक्खमे भिक्खू,कालेण य पडिक्कमे,अकालं च विवज्जॆत्ता,काले कालं समायरे"
english: "In summer there are free monks, in winter there are poor people, and famine is commonplace; in winter, time is abundant."

prakrit: "अकाले चरसि भिक्खू,कालं न पडिलेहसि,अप्पाणं च किलामेसि,सन्निवेसं च गरिहसि"
english: "You wretched bhikkhu, Time has not caught up with you, You have made a fortress of yourself, And you are about to be absorbed."

prakrit: "सइ काले चरे भिक्खू,कुज्जा पुरिसकारिअं,अलाभॊत्ति न सोऎज्जा,तवो त्ति अहियासए"
english: "My dear, All four of you are monks; One thing is for certain, The other is for men. But do not trouble yourself: This is the way of life."

prakrit: "तहेवुच्चावया पाणा,भत्तट्ठाए समागया,तं उज्जुयं न गच्छॆज्जा जयमेव परक्कमे"
english: "You fool, Don't let the sunshine go out of your eyes, For you have already won the ultimate victory."

prakrit: "गोयरग्गपविट्ठो उ न निसीऎज्ज कत्थई,कहं च न पबन्धॆज्जा,चिट्ठित्ताण व सञ्जए"
english: "A herd of cows is scattered all over the place, No one bothers about it, Not even the headman's son."

prakrit: "अग्गलं फलिहं दारं,कवाडं वा'वि सञ्जए,अवलम्बिआ न चिट्ठॆज्जा,गोअरग्गगओ मुनी"
english: "The fire has destroyed the door, The crow has stopped the wind, No one is following the rafters, You cowardly fool!"

prakrit: "समणं माहणं वा'वि,किविणं वा वणीमगं,उवसङ्कमन्तं भत्तट्ठा,पाणट्ठाए सञ्जए"
english: "Praise be to the wind, To the ears, or to the forest, For the stream flows steadily Through it, Like water in a pan."

prakrit: "तं अइक्कमित्तु न पविसे,न चिट्ठे चक्खुगोअरे,एगन्तमवक्कमित्ता तत्थ चिट्ठॆज्ज सञ्जए"
english: "That was the end of that letter, Not a single tear from it, Not even a tear from the gauze."

prakrit: "वणीमगस्स वा तस्स,दायगस्सुभयस्स वा,अप्पत्तिअं सिया हुज्जा,लहुत्तं पवयणस्स वा"
english: "Vani mugasa or tasa, daigasa or fear of the forest, aaptiyan siya hujja, lathuta or pathos."

prakrit: "पडिसेहिए व दिन्ने वा,तओ तंमि नियत्तिए,उवसङ्कमिज्ज भत्तट्ठा,पाणट्ठए व सञ्जए"
english: "Come on, you fool, That's my fate. Stop your sulking! It's the paddy field, The paddy fields, And Sanjay." ""

prakrit: "उप्पलं पउमं वा वि,कुमुअं वा मगदन्तियं,अन्नं वा पुप्फ सचित्तं,तं च संलुञ्चिआ दए"
english: "Uppalam poum va vi, Kumuon va magadantiam, anna va pouf sachitam, There must be someone who cherishes it." ""

prakrit: "उप्पलं पउमं वा'वि,कुमुअं वा मगदन्तियं,अन्नं वा पुप्फ सच्चितं,तं च सम्मद्दिया दए"
english: "Uppalam poom va'vi, kumu'an or maagdantiam, annam or pūpūf is truth, so be it with honesty."

prakrit: "सालुअं वा विरालियं,कुमुअं उप्पलनालियं,मुणालिअं सासवनालिअं,उच्छुखण्डं अनिव्वुडं"
english: "The plowman is a virgin, The potter is an upland, The shepherd is a mother - in - law, The ox is a non - growing animal."

prakrit: "तरुणगं वा पवालं,रूक्खस्स तणगस्स वा,अन्नस्स वा वि हरिअस्स आमगं परिवज्जए"
english: "Whether young or old, Whether deciduous or sprigged, Whether ripe or unripe, They bring forth mangoes."

prakrit: "तरुणिअं वा छिवाडिं,आमिअं भज्जियं सयं,दॆन्तियं पडिआइक्खे,न मे कप्पइ तारिसं"
english: "Young girl, I'm off to bed, My teeth are falling out, I can't take them."

prakrit: "तहा कोलमणुस्सिन्नं,वेलुअं कासवनालिअं,तिलपप्पडगं नीमं,आमगं परिवज्जए"
english: "There's the lotus tree, The creeper with the watermelon, The sesame seed with the jasmine, The mango with the neem."

prakrit: "तहेव चाउलं पिट्ठं,विअडं वा तत्त'निव्वुडं,तिलपिट्ठ पूइ पिन्नागं,आमगं परिवज्जए"
english: "The festival is rice pitha, vidaam or tata nibhudam, tilapitha pitha pinnagam, mango parivaje"

prakrit: "कविट्ठं माउलिङ्गं च,मूलगं मूलगत्तियं,आमं असत्थपरिणयं,मनसा वि न पत्थए"
english: "Poetry is the mother tongue, the roots are the roots, we speak falsehood, the mind also does not exist."

prakrit: "तहेव फलमन्थूणि,बीअमन्थूणि जाणिआ,बिहेलगं पियालं च,आमगं परिवज्जए"
english: "You know the fruit tree, the seed tree, The unripe fruit and the ripe mango."

prakrit: "समुयाणं चरे भिक्खू,कुलं उच्चावयं सया,नीयं कुलमइक्कम्म,ऊसढं नाभिधारए"
english: "The monk embraces the crowd, The shepherd carries the flock, The hunter carries the bull, And the shepherd the buffalo."

prakrit: "अदीनो वित्तिमेसिज्जा,न विसीइज्ज पण्डिए,अमुच्छिओ भोअणंमि मायण्णे एसणारए"
english: "My dear, It's not my fault I'm so busy today, My husband is so busy, I don't know what to do next."

prakrit: "बहुं परघरे अत्थि,विविहं खाइमसाइमं,न तत्थ पण्डिओ कुप्पे,इच्छा दिज्ज परो न वा"
english: "Too much at home, too little at a time, Too much cooking, Too little cooking, No need to give in to desire."

prakrit: "सयणासण वत्थं वा,भत्तं पानं च सञ्जए,अदॆन्तस्स न कुप्पिज्जा,पच्चक्खेविय अ दिसओ"
english: "Sayanasana vaathama vaatha, bhaat and paan samjhaaya, Atentasa na kuppijja, Pachchikavyam ya dikhao."

prakrit: "इत्थिअं पुरिसं वा'वि,डहरं वा महल्लगं,वन्दमाणं न जाऎज्जा,नो य णं फरुसं वए"
english: "Whether it is a man's house or a palace, Friendship is not to be wished for. For there is no such thing as a poor man."

prakrit: "जे न वन्दे न से कुप्पे,वन्दिओ न समुक्कसे,एवमन्ने समाणस्स,सामण्णमनुचिट्ठई"
english: "One who does not speak Vande Mataram is not a crook, one who is not spoken to is not deceived; this is the path to purity."

prakrit: "सिया एगइओ लद्धुं,लोभेणं विनिगूहइ,मा मेयं दाइयं सन्तं,दट्ठूणं सयमायए"
english: "Let her fight on, Let the greed settle, Let her give birth to a son. Let the dog see her."

prakrit: "अत्तट्ठ गुरुओ लुद्धो,बहुं पावं पकुव्वइ,दुत्तोसओ य से होइ,निव्वाणं च न गच्छइ"
english: "Atta guru ladho, one commits many sins, Atta dosho ya, one does not practice righteousness."

prakrit: "सिया एगइओ लद्धं,विविहं पानभोयणं,भद्दगं भद्दगं भॊच्चा,विवन्नं विरसमाहरे"
english: "They are still fighting, Drinking a variety of drinks, Speaking nonsense and ranting nonsense."

prakrit: "जाणन्तु ता इमे समणा,आययट्ठी अयं मुनी,सन्तुट्ठो सेवए पन्तं,लूहवित्ती सुतोसओ"
english: "Know that this is the way out, That this is how you should conduct yourself, This is how a sage should be treated, A servant should be satisfied, A lover should be honest."

prakrit: "पूयणट्ठा जसोकामी,मानसम्मानकामए,बहुं पसवइ पावं,मायासल्लं च कुव्वई"
english: "Virtuous people are virtuous, they cherish honor, they are generous, they make love, and they are good men."

prakrit: "सुरं वा मेरगं वा'वि,अन्नं वा मज्जगं रसं,ससक्खं न पिबे भिक्खू,जसं सारक्खमप्पणो"
english: "One should not drink wine, or liquor, or intoxicating juices, For that is the way of a monk." ""

prakrit: "पियए एगइओ तेणो,न मे कोई वियाणइ,तस्स पस्सह दोसाइं,नियडिं च सुणेह मे"
english: "Aunt, There is no one to explain it to me, His enemies are everywhere, And I must listen."

prakrit: "वड्ढइ सुण्डिआ तस्स,मायामोसं च भिक्खुणो,अयसो य अनिव्वाणं,सययं च असाहुया"
english: "The blind man has grown old, The monk is deluded by delusions, The aged are ignorant, And the aged are intolerant."

prakrit: "निच्चुव्विग्गो जहा तेणो,अत्तकम्मेहि दुम्मई,तारिसो मरणन्ते वि,न आराहेइ संवरं"
english: "As for you, you are weak, You will surely die, But there is no end to your sufferings."

prakrit: "आयरिए नाराहेइ,समणे यावि तारिसो,गिहत्था वि णं गरिहन्ति जेण जाणन्ति तारिसं"
english: "Everyone is angry, Everyone hates you, Even those who know you are angry."

prakrit: "एवं तु अगुणप्पेही,गुणाणं च विवज्जओ,तारिसो मरणन्ते वि,न आराहेइ संवरं"
english: "And you are incompetent and devoid of merit. Yet, even in death, There is no end to your virtues."

prakrit: "तवं कुव्वइ मेहावी,पणीयं वज्जए रसं,मज्जप्पमायविरओ,तवस्सी अइउक्कसो"
english: "Water is sweet when boiled, juice is astringent when drunk, Love is intoxicating when drunk."

prakrit: "तस्स पस्सह कल्लाणं,अनेगसाहुपूइअं,विउलं अत्थसञ्जुत्तं,कित्तइस्सं सुणेह मे"
english: "There must be something very special about him, A lot of happiness, An endless stream of pleasures. How can I hear him?"

prakrit: "एवं तु सगुणप्पेही,अगुणाणं च विवज्जए,तारिसो मरणन्ते वि,आराहेइ संवरं"
english: "And you are virtuous and you are unfaithful. Even in death you cause resentment."

prakrit: "आयरिए आराहेइ,समणे यावि तारिसो,गिहत्था वि न पूयन्ति,जेण जाणन्ति तारिसं"
english: "Those who know how to weep and wail, Those who yearn and long for what is dear to them, Never tire of asking."

prakrit: "तवतेणे वयतेणे,रूवतेणे य जे नरे,आयारभावतेणे य कुव्वइ देवकिब्बिसं"
english: "One who does not weep because of thirst, One who is not angry because one has to weep, Is incapable of loving others."

prakrit: "लद्धूण वि देवत्तं,उववन्नो देवकिब्बिसे,तत्थावि से न याणाइ,किं मे किच्चा इमं फलं"
english: "Even the gods are wise, You alone are a god of gods And from then on I will know nothing. What fruit has this in me?"

prakrit: "तत्तो वि से चइत्ताणं,लब्भिही एलमूययं,नरयं तिरिक्खजोणिं वा,बोही जत्थ सुदुल्लहा"
english: "By the way, She is clever, By the looks of her eyes She is eloquent, And by the look of her lips She knows how to bend."

prakrit: "एयं च दोसं दट्ठूणं,नायपुत्तेणं भासिअं,अणुमायं पि मेहावी,मायामोसं विवज्जए"
english: "Such is the scene of guilt, Such are the words of a naïve person, Even an innocent person can be captivated By delights."

prakrit: "सिक्खिऊण भिक्खेसणसोहिं,सञ्जयाण बुद्धाण सगासे,तत्थ मिक्खू सुप्पणिहिन्दिए,तिव्वलज्ज गुणवं विहरिज्जासि"
english: "When you learn to be a monk, When you gain wisdom, You become wise. Then your mind will be completely at peace. The virtues of kindness will be destroyed."

prakrit: "नाणदंसणसम्पन्नं,सञ्जमे अ तवे रयं,गणिमागमसम्पन्नं,उज्जाणंमि समोसढं"
english: "Narmadā is full of vision, Sanjāme is also full of rays, Ganimagmasa is rich, Ujjāṇam is all-encompassing."

prakrit: "रायाणो रायमच्चा य,माहणा अदुव खत्तिया,पुच्छन्ति निहुअप्पाणो,कहं भे आयारगोयरो?"
english: "The rai or the dish of rice, The mango or the bitter gourd, Are you asking me," "Where did you learn to bake rice flour?" ""

prakrit: "तेसिं सो निहुओ दन्तो,सव्वभूयसुहावहो,सिक्खाए सुसमाउत्तो,आयक्खइ वियक्खणो"
english: "There she finds her teeth, all the pleasures of love, the sweetwood flower of learning, the pearl of wisdom."

prakrit: "हन्दि धम्मत्थकामाणं,निग्गन्थाणं सुणेह मे,आयारगोयरं भीमं,सयलं दुरहिट्ठियं"
english: "Hand is devoted to dharma, eye is attentive to reason, tongue is vigilant, speech is impermanent."

prakrit: "नन्नत्थ एरिसं वुत्तं,जं लीए परमदुच्चरं,विउलट्ठाणभाइस्स न भूयं न भविस्सइ"
english: "I have never before seen such a thing; for what is most wretched It is impossible to conceal it."

prakrit: "सखुड्डगवियत्ताणं,वाहियाणं च जे गुणा,अखण्डफुडिया कायव्वा,तं सुणेह जहा तहा"
english: "Virtuous speech, virtuous conduct, undisturbed speech - The more you listen, the more you gain."

prakrit: "दस अट्ठ य ठाणाइं,जाइं बालो'वरज्झइ,तत्थ अन्नयरे ठाणे,निग्गन्थत्ताओ भस्सई"
english: "Ten or eight o'clock, As the child's turn comes, So the other o'clock, Like the eaves of a nigga, Falls."

prakrit: "तत्थिमं पढमं ठाणं,महावीरेण देसिअं,अहिंसा निउणा दिट्ठा,सव्व भूएसु सञ्जमो"
english: "At that moment I will sit down, The great warrior has given me time, Non - violence is my only sight, All the world's troubles are my own."

prakrit: "जावन्ति लोए पाणा,तसा अदुव थावरा,ते जाणमजाणं वा,न हणे नो वि घायए"
english: "In the wilderness people drink wine, In the same way people drink ginger, Knowingly or unknowingly, So that no one will harm them."

prakrit: "सव्वे जीवा वि इच्छन्ति,जीविउं न मरिज्जिउं,तम्हा पाणवहं घोरं,निग्गन्था वज्जयन्ति णं"
english: "All living beings desire the same thing: to live, not to die."

prakrit: "अप्पणट्ठा परट्ठा वा,कोहा वा जइ वा भया,हिंसगं न मुसं बूया,नोवि अन्नं वयावए"
english: "Be angry, be jealous, be fearful, do not provoke violence. No one spoils food."

prakrit: "मुसावाओ य लोगंमि,सव्वसाहूहिं गरिहिओ,अविस्सासो य भूयाणं,तम्हा मोसं विवज्जए"
english: "I am the people, The poor are my relatives, The wicked are my enemies. Let your deceitfulness be known."

prakrit: "चित्तमन्तमचित्तं वा,अप्पं वा जइ वा बहुं,दन्तसोहणमॆत्तं पि,उग्गहंसि अजाइया"
english: "Whether your mind is at peace, Whether your drink is abundant, Whether you enjoy your teeth, You're bound to laugh."

prakrit: "तं अप्पणा न गेण्हन्ति,नो'वि गेण्हावए परं,अन्नं वा गिण्हमाणं पि,नाणुजाणन्ति सञ्जया"
english: "He does not know how to count himself, Not even how much he can gain by counting. But whether it is food or numbers That Sanjaya knows well."

prakrit: "अबम्भचरिअं घोरं,पमायं दुरहिट्ठियं,नायरन्ति मुनी लोए,भेयाययणवज्जिणो"
english: "The impudent are loud, The immodest are stubborn, The foolish are silent, The wretched are fearful."

prakrit: "मूलमेयमहम्मस्स,महादोससमुस्सयं,तम्हा मेहुणसंसग्गिं,निग्गन्था वज्जयन्ति णं"
english: "The greatness of the root, The beauty of the great, The delight of your friends, Play the flute."

prakrit: "बिडमुब्भेइमं लोणं,तॆल्लं सप्पिं च फाणियं,न ते सन्निहिमिच्छन्ति,नायपुत्तवओरया"
english: "Grease is everywhere, Sweat and soap are everywhere, They don't meet, Like the sound of a trumpet."

prakrit: "लोहस्सेसो अणुफासे,मन्ने अन्नयरामवि,जे सिया सन्निहि कामे,गिही पव्वइए न से"
english: "An iron fence is useless, My dear, Those who work in close proximity Cannot travel alone."

prakrit: "जं पि वत्थं च पायं वा,कम्बले पायपुञ्छणं,तं पि सञ्जमलज्जट्ठा,धारन्ति परिहरन्ति य"
english: "Whatever is between a bat and a crow, On a blanket between two crows, That too in broad daylight."

prakrit: "न सो परिग्गहो,वुत्तो,नायपुत्तेण ताइणा,मुच्छा परिग्गहो वुत्तो,इइ वुत्तं महेसिणा"
english: "He is not a parigraha, he is a vutta, he grows thin with his young son, he has a moustachioed head, this is the way of the demon Mahesh."

prakrit: "सव्वत्थुवहिणा बुद्धा,संरक्खणपरिग्गहे,अवि अप्पणो'वि देहंमि,नायरन्ति ममाइयं"
english: "The Buddha is everywhere, Protected and protected, Yet I am myself in the body, Not mine to lose"

prakrit: "अहो निच्चं तवो कम्मं,सव्वबुद्धेहिं वण्णियं,जा य लज्जासमा वित्ती एगभत्तं च भोयणं"
english: "Oh! true karma! All wisdom should be described in this way: To lose one's self Is nothing like being ashamed of oneself."

prakrit: "सन्ति मे सुहुमा पाणा,तसा अदुव थावरा,जाइं राओ अपासन्तो,कहमेसणियं चरे?"
english: "In the world, my dear, Such a man is a good man; Where, Mr Rao, is there room for such a man?"

prakrit: "उदउल्लं बीयसंसत्तं,पाणा निवडिया महिं,दिया ताइं विवजिज्जा,राओ तत्थ कहं चरे?"
english: "The bush is sown, The water is drained, The bees are dispersed, So how can you graze there?"

prakrit: "एयं च दोसं दट्ठूणं,नायपुत्तेण भासियं,सव्वाहारं न भुञ्जन्ति,निग्गन्था राइभोयणं"
english: "It's the same as seeing a guilty man, Drunk on naiput, Not roasting all the food, Running out of niggantha."

prakrit: "पुढविकायं न हिंसन्ति,मनसा वायसा कायसा,तिविहेण करणजोएण,सञ्जया सुसमाहिया"
english: "Prominent people do not torture, Conscious people do, Because they like to be treated with kindness, For love is peaceful."

prakrit: "पुढविकायं विहिसन्तो,हिंसई उ तयस्सिए,तसे य विविहे पाणे,चक्खुसे य अचक्खुसे"
english: "One who is led astray by adversity, Destroys violence, Diffuses it in different ways, Chews it or licks it."

prakrit: "तम्हा एयं विआणित्ता,दोसं दुग्गइवड्ढणं,पुढविकायसमारम्भं,जावज्जीवाए वज्जए"
english: "Such is your wisdom, Blessed is the increase in faults, For the struggle to advance Will begin with the sound of the lute."

prakrit: "आउकायं न हिंसन्ति,मनसा वायसा कायसा,तिविहेण करणजोएण,सञ्जया सुसमाहिया"
english: "No more violence, my dear, What's the matter with your heart, You won't make a mess of it?"

prakrit: "आउकायं विहिंसन्तो,हिंसई उ तयस्सिए,तसे अ विविहे पाणे,चक्खुसे य अचक्खुसे"
english: "One can be violent, one can be cruel, and one can have a variety of tastes."

prakrit: "तम्हा एयं विआणित्ता,दोसं दुग्गइवड्ढणं,आउकायसमारम्भं,जावज्जीवाए वज्जए"
english: "You have described it so well, The growing misery of guilt, The beginning of trouble, The sound of the lute."

prakrit: "जायतेयं न इच्छन्ति,पावगं जलइत्तए,तिक्खमन्नयरं सत्थं,सव्वओ वि दुरासयं"
english: "Many do not wish to, The fire is kindled by faults, Strong mind prevails, All are distressed."

prakrit: "पाईणं पडिणं वा'वि,उड्ढं अणुदिसामवि,अहे दाहिणओ वा'वि,दहे उत्तरओ वि अ"
english: "The python falls, The bird flies, The midday sun, The right wind, The dowry, And the answer too."

prakrit: "भूयाणमेसमाघाओ,हव्ववाहो न संसओ,तं पईवपयावट्ठा,सञ्जया किञ्चि नारभे"
english: "Traveler, The world is passing, There's nothing to worry about, It's only the wind that blows, Sanjay is on fire."

prakrit: "तम्हा एयं वियाणित्ता,दोसं दुग्गइवड्ढणं,तेउकायसमारम्भं,जावज्जीवाए वज्जए"
english: "Such is your wisdom, Wretched is the multiplication of faults, Such is the beginning of victory: The trumpet is sounded."

prakrit: "अनिलस्स समारम्भं,बुद्धा मन्नन्ति तारिसं,सावज्जबहुलं चेयं,नेयं ताईहिं सेवियं"
english: "Non - violence is the norm, the Buddha believes in kindness, the mind is full of kindnesses, we must serve him."

prakrit: "तालिअण्टेण पत्तेण,साहाविहुयणेण वा,न ते वीइउमिच्छन्ति,वीयावेऊण वा परं"
english: "By clapping their hands, By begging their friends, Nor do they want to be seen. Or else by being seen." ""

prakrit: "जं पि वत्थं व पायं वा,कम्बलं पायपुञ्छणं,न ते वायमुईरन्ति,जयं परिहरन्ति य"
english: "Whatever the wind blows, Jump on the kambala feet, They do not move the wind, Victory is avoided."

prakrit: "तम्हा एयं विआणित्ता दोसं दुग्गइवड्ढणं,वाउकायसमारम्भं,जावज्जीवाए वज्जए"
english: "Your fault this is the increase in difficulty, The onset of wind, The sound of the lute."

prakrit: "वणस्सइं न हिंसन्ति,मनसा वयसा कायसा,तिविहेण करणजोएण,सञ्जया सुसमहिआ"
english: "Venerable beings inflict no violence on others, For how old is the mind? The pleasure of doing business with a woman Like this only makes one happy."

prakrit: "वणस्सइं विहिसन्तो,हिंसइ उ तयस्सिए,तसे य विविहे पाणे,चक्खुसे य अचक्खुसे"
english: "One who dwells in the forest, experiences violence, experiences it, finds it in different ways, tastes it or is surprised by it."

prakrit: "तम्हा एयं वियाणित्ता,दोसं दुग्गइवड्ढणं,वणस्सइसमारम्भं,जावज्जीवाए वज्जए"
english: "Such is your wisdom, Blessed is the growing of faults, Such is the beginning of adversity, For words can revive a man."

prakrit: "तसकायं न हिंसन्ति,मनसा वयसा कायसा,तिविहेण करणजोएण,सञ्जया सुसमाहिया"
english: "They do not torture you, Conscious as long as you are awake, Jealous as much as you want to be, Compassionate as you like."

prakrit: "तसकायं विहिंसतो,हिंसई उ तयस्सिए,तसे य विविहे पाणे,चक्खुसे य अचक्खुसे"
english: "One who is touchy is violent, one who is violent is so, too, with different tastes; one who tastes something is so"

prakrit: "तम्हा एयं वियाणित्ता,दोसं दुग्गइवड्ढणं,तसकायसमारम्भं,जावज्जीवाए वज्जए"
english: "Such is your wisdom, Blessed is the growing of faults, Such is the beginning of sorrows; The trumpet is sounded."

prakrit: "जाइं चत्तारि भुञ्ज्जाइं,इसिणा''हारमाइणि,ताइं तु विवज्जन्तो,सञ्जमं अनुपालए"
english: "As the crow flies," whispered the farmer, "You're bound to stumble, So obey the law."

prakrit: "पिण्डं सॆज्जं च वत्थं च,चउत्थं पायमेव य,अक्कपियं न इच्छॆज्जा,पडिगाहॆज्ज कप्पियं"
english: "The body is fragile and fragile, The fourth moment is fleeting, One cannot make love on its own, The fifth moment is empty."

prakrit: "जे नियागं ममायन्ति,कीयमुद्देसिआ''हडं,वहं ते समणुजाणन्ति,इइ वुत्तं महेसिणा"
english: "Those who follow a certain rule, Such as these, become acquainted with it," says the sage. "This is the way of the God of Love."

prakrit: "तम्हा असनपानाइं,कीयमुद्देसियाहडं,वज्जंयति ठियप्पाणो,निग्गन्था धम्मजीविणो"
english: "What are you doing, Sitting idle, Thinking how you will manage the passage of time?"

prakrit: "कंसेसु कंसपाएसु,कुण्डमोएसु वा पुणो,भुञ्जन्तो असनपानाइं,आयारा परिभस्सइ"
english: "Either one consumes the kansapa, or the other one is purified, As the water is boiled, The ayara is turned around."

prakrit: "सीओदगसमारम्भे,मत्तधोयणछड्डणे,जाइं छनन्ति भूयाइं,दिट्ठो तत्थ असञ्जमो"
english: "At the beginning of the day, At the very end of the night, In the shade of a drunken bath, Wherever the eyes may look There is disharmony."

prakrit: "पच्छाकम्मं पुरेकम्मं,सिया तत्थ न कप्पइ,एयमट्ठं न भुञ्जन्ति,निग्गन्था गिहिभायणे"
english: "Past karma is pure karma, She doesn't cover the tatha, Doesn't break the yamatha., Niggantha gehibhayane"

prakrit: "आसन्दी पलियङ्केसु,मञ्चामालालएसु वा,अनायरियमज्जाणं,आसइत्तु सइत्तु वा"
english: "Aasaandi paliyankesu, mancha malaalu, aayaariyamajjna, aasaithu saithu wa"

prakrit: "नासन्दीपलियङ्केसु,न निसॆज्जा न पीढए,निग्गन्था'पडिलेहाए,बुद्धवुत्तमहिट्ठगा"
english: "Cut the nail on the nose, Do not prick it, do not bruise it, For it will pierce through the nail mark. But with wisdom it will be destroyed."

prakrit: "गम्भीरविजया एए,पाणा दुप्पडिलेहगा,आसन्दी पलियङ्को य,एयमट्ठं विवज्जिया"
english: "Have a good victory, you fool, Get away quickly, Don't overdo it! This is the way of victory." ""

prakrit: "गोअरग्गपविट्ठस्स,निसॆज्जा जस्स कप्पइ,इमेरिसमणायारं,आवज्जइ अबोहियं"
english: "Cows grow thin, The grass is bare, The rivers are swollen, The roads are impassable, The streets are deserted."

prakrit: "विवत्ती बम्भचेरस्स,पाणाणं च वहे वहो,वणीमगपडिग्घाओ,पडिकोहो अगारिणं"
english: "Vivid bamboo trees, streams of water, thickets of reeds, paddy fields, and uncultivated fields."

prakrit: "अगुत्ती बम्भचेरस्स,इत्थीओ वा'वि सङ्कणं,कुसीलवड्ढणं ठाणं,दूरओ परिवज्जए"
english: "Aunt, The arrows are loud, The words are shrill, The bracelets are firm, The journey is long."

prakrit: "तिण्हमन्नयरागस्स,निसिज्जा जस्स कप्पई,जराए अभिभूअस्स,वाहियस्स तवस्सिणो"
english: "That damned anger, That rapturous yawn, Is a little overwhelming; It is the penance of the wicked."

prakrit: "वाहिओ वा अरोगी वा,सिणाणं जो उ पत्थए,वुक्कन्तो होइ आयारो,जढो हवइ सञ्जमो"
english: "Wayfarer or healer, The lion that staggers, The hunter who grows wobbly, Is like the breeze in the wind."

prakrit: "सन्तिमे सुहुमा पाणा,घसासु भिलगासु य,जे अ भिक्खू सिणायन्तो,विअडेणुप्पिलावए"
english: "Calmness prevails in a state of mind, Deceit prevails, Those who bow before a monk Prostrate themselves on the pyre."

prakrit: "तम्हा ते न सिणायन्ति,सीएण उसिणेण वा,जावज्जीवं वयं घोरं,असिणाणमहिट्ठगा"
english: "They will not make love to you, For if they did, Life would be cruel, For ignorance is bliss."

prakrit: "सिणाणं अदुवा कक्कं,लुद्धं पउमगाणि अ,गायस्सुव्वट्टणट्ठाए,नायरन्ति कयाइ वि"
english: "Love is tight, Love is firm, Singing is easy, Traveling is smooth, Travel is smooth And travel is smooth."

prakrit: "नगिणस्स वा'वि मुण्डस्स,दीहरोमनहंसिणो,मेहुणा उवसन्तस्स,किं विभूसाए कारियं?"
english: "Silly man, Headless woman, Long - eyed man, Friend - in - law, What delusion can I conjure?"

prakrit: "विभूसावत्तिअं भिक्खू,कम्मं बन्धइ चिक्कणं,संसारसायरे घोरे,जेणं पडइ दुरुत्तरे"
english: "A monk in ecstasy, A cunning man who binds karma, Who roams the world in circles, Who falls when faced with adversity."

prakrit: "विभूसावत्तियं चेयं,बुद्धा मन्नन्ति तारिसं,सावज्ज बहुलं चेयं,नेयं ताईहिं सेवियं"
english: "The mind is full of delights, The Buddha acknowledges them, The soul is abundant in pleasures, Never mind how they are served."

prakrit: "खवॆन्ति अप्पाणमोहदंसिणो तवे रया सञ्जम अज्जवे गुणे,धुणन्ति पावाइं पुरेकडाइं,नवाइं पावाइं न ते करॆन्ति"
english: "Those who despise themselves Are won over by their own virtues, Those who scold their enemies For their faults Do not curse their enemies."

prakrit: "सओवसन्ता अममा अकिञ्चणा,सविज्जविज्जाणुगया जसंसिणो,उउप्पसन्ने विमले व चन्दिमा,सिद्धिं विमाणाइं उवॆन्ति ताइणो"
english: "When the moon is high, Like the lotus of the sky, Like a bunch of peacock's tail feathers Waved by the conjuror to distract his audience, It makes perfect planes."

prakrit: "चउण्हं खलु भासाणं,परिसङ्खाय पन्नवं,दुण्हं तु विनयं सिक्खे दो न भासॆज्ज सव्वसो"
english: "Love is a delicate language, Circumstances are vague, But in suffering you must learn humility. For not everyone understands speech."

prakrit: "जा य सच्चा अवत्तव्वा,सच्चामीसा य जा मुसा,जा य बुद्धेहिं नाइन्ना,न तं भासिज्ज पन्नवं"
english: "" "Be truthful, be unbiased, be honest, be reasonable, do not lie." "That is not the way to speak."

prakrit: "असच्चमोसं सच्चं च,अणवज्जमकक्कसं,समुप्पेहमसन्दिद्धं,गिरं भासिज्ज पन्नवं"
english: "Truth alone triumphs, falsehood alone vanishes, confusion prevails, and falsehood vanishes."

prakrit: "एयं च अट्ठमन्नं वा,जं तु नामेइ सासयं,सम्भासं सच्चमोसं पि,तं पि धीरो विवज्जए"
english: "This is the eighth month. Whatever your name may be, Mother - in - law, Speak the truth to me, And be patient with me."

prakrit: "वितहं पि तहामुत्तिं,जं गिरं भासए नरो,तम्हा सो पुट्ठो पावेणं,कि पुण जो मुसं वए"
english: "Even a widow's name is immaterial. But the man who falls in love's house Should get one, For that reason alone I am content."

prakrit: "तम्हा गच्छामो वक्खामो,अमुगं वा णे भविस्सइ,अहं वा णं करिस्सामि,एसो वा णं करिस्सइ"
english: "I will go to your house, I will stay there, And you will come to mine; I will do this or that; This or that - it's business as usual."

prakrit: "एवमाइउ जा भासा,एसकालंमि सङ्किआ,सम्पयाईयमट्ठे वा,तं पि धीरो विवज्जए"
english: "This is the way of speech; for the moment I am unable to speak, My mind is made up of all my actions; Therefore, be patient."

prakrit: "अईयंमि अ कालंमि,पच्चुप्पन्नमनागए,जमट्ठं तु न जाणिज्जा,एवमेयं ति नो वए"
english: "I am past due, I am nearing maturity, But you do not know how it got there. There is no reason for it."

prakrit: "अईयंमि य कालंमि,पच्चुप्पन्नमनागए,जत्थ सङ्का भवे तं तु,एवमेयं तु नो वए"
english: "I am coming of age, I am passing away, But where there is fear, there is no you."

prakrit: "अईयम्मि य कालम्मि,पच्चुप्पन्नमनागए,निस्सङ्कियं भवे जं तु,एवमेयं तु निद्दिसे"
english: "Ai ammi ya kaalammi, Pachupannamangame, may I have no fear of you, this is how you sleep."

prakrit: "तहेव फरुसा भासा,गुरुभूओवघाइणी,सच्चा वि सा न वत्तव्वा,जओ पावस्स आगमो"
english: "You stupid talker, You stupid coward, You dishonest woman, You fool, You traitor. Whomever commits sin Will suffer it."

prakrit: "तहेव काणं काणे त्ति,पण्डगं पण्डगे त्ति वा,वाहिअं वा'वि रोगि त्ति,तेणं चोरे त्ति नो वए"
english: "The God of Love shows no emotion, No one bothers about what's going on, And the doctor is ill, So don't steal."

prakrit: "एएणन्नेण अट्ठेणं,परो जेणुवहम्मइ,आयारभावदोसन्नू,न तं भासिज्ज पन्नवं"
english: "That's why we meet, that is why we kiss, That is why it hurts. But we don't know how to describe it."

prakrit: "तहेव होले गोले त्ति,साणे वा वसुले त्ति य,दमए दुहए वा'वि,नेवं भासॆज्ज पन्नवं"
english: "Love is like a sphere, Like gold or vasool, Like fire or water, Like a neem leaf, It flows on water."

prakrit: "अज्जिए पज्जिए वा'वि अम्मो माउस्सिअ त्ति य,पिउस्सिए भाइणॆज्ज त्ति,धूए नत्तुणियत्ति य"
english: "Please, tell me," said the wife, "Mother - in - law, Tell me, Brother - in ‐ law, Don't wash your hair."

prakrit: "हले हलॆत्ति अन्नॊत्ति,भट्टे सामिणि गोमिणि,होले गोले वसुले त्ति,इत्थियं नेवमालवे"
english: "When the plow is stirred, There is plenty to eat; When the fire is hot, There are cow - dung cakes."

prakrit: "नामधिज्जेण णं बूया,इत्थीगुत्तेण वा पुणो,जहारिहमभिगिज्झ,आलवॆज्ज लवॆज्ज वा"
english: "A boy is born with a bad name, A girl is reborn with a good reputation, A woman is beguiled with kindness, And a man is always fond of her."

prakrit: "अज्जए पज्जए वा'वि,बप्पो चुल्लपिउ त्ति य,माउलो भाइणॆज्ज त्ति,पुत्ते नतुणियत्तिय"
english: "Aunt, It's past five o'clock, My son has reached the age of fifty, My parents are brothers, And I have a new son."

prakrit: "हे भो! हलित्ति अन्नित्ति,भट्टा सामिय गोमिए,होल गोल वसुलॆत्ति,पुरिसं नेवमालवे"
english: "Hey there! The plowman's wife, Go - between! You silly girl, Get round on all fours. Let the men make fresh garlands." ""

prakrit: "नामधॆज्जेण णं बूया,पुरिसगुत्तेण वा पुणो,जहारिहमभिगज्झ,आलवॆज्ज लवॆज्ज वा"
english: "A man is born with a bad name, Or a good one with a good reputation, Or, for that matter, a poor one. Always a lover of women."

prakrit: "पञ्चिदियाणं पाणाणं,एस इत्थी अयं पुमं,जाव णं न विजाणिज्जा,ताव जाइ त्ति आलवे"
english: "Panchidyāna pañññāna, Is it this way or that, Not going to learn how to walk, But going wherever you will."

prakrit: "तहेव मणुस्सं पसुं,पक्खिं वा'वि सरीसवं,थूले पमेइले वज्झे,पायमित्ति य नो वए"
english: "The sun is like a human being, The wind blows from side to side, The lightning flashes from behind, There is no way out."

prakrit: "परिवुड्ढे त्ति णं बूया,बूया उवचिए त्ति य,सञ्जाए पीणिए वा'वि,महाकाय त्ति आलवे"
english: "The parrot is swooning, The stag is howling, The doe is sighing, And the crows are howling."

prakrit: "तहेव गाओ दुज्झाओ दम्मा गोरहग त्ति य,वाहिमा रहजोगी त्ति,नेवं भासॆज्ज पन्नवं"
english: "Let there be singing, For damnation is frowned upon, For jealousy is a constant, For falsehood is nothing like truth."

prakrit: "अतिन्तिणे अचवले,अप्पभासी मियासणे,हविज्ज उयरे दन्ते,थोवं लध्धुं न खिंसए"
english: "They are extremely agile, they are soft spoken, their teeth are prominent, they do not bite when kicked."

prakrit: "न बाहिरं परिभवे,अत्ताणं न समुक्कसे,सुयलाभे न भज्जॆज्जा,जच्चो तवस्सि बुद्धिए"
english: "Do not travel outside, do not approach others with suspicious eyes, Do not get carried away by gossip, Be thoughtful wherever you are."

prakrit: "से जाणमजाणं वा,कट्टु आहम्मियं पयं,संवरे खिप्पमप्पाणं,बीयं तं न समायरे"
english: "He knows how to weep, Tears flow from his mouth, Sweat drips from his eyes, And seeds do not germinate."

prakrit: "अनायारं परक्कम्म,नेव गूहे न निण्हवे,सूई सया वियडभावे,असंसत्ते जिइन्दिए"
english: "Never give in to temptation, Never allow anger to settle in, Always use reason, Always win the fight."

prakrit: "अमोहं वयणं कुज्जा,आयरियस्स महप्पणो,तं परिगिज्झ वायाए,कम्मुणा उववायए"
english: "Wrong speech is bad, Aries is a great man, Circumstantial speech is wrong, Compassion is wrong."

prakrit: "अधुवं जीवियं नच्चा,सिद्धिमग्गं वियाणिआ,विणिअट्टॆज्जा भोगेसु,आउं परिमियमप्पणो"
english: "Live your life in limbo, Dance your way to perfection, Savor the pleasures of solitude; Come, make the most of it."

prakrit: "बलं थामं च पेहाए,सद्दामारुग्गमप्पणो,खित्तं कालं च विन्नाय,तह'प्पाणं निजुञ्जए"
english: "Strength and weight, guile and finesse, Destiny and time alone, So carry yourself."

prakrit: "जरा जाव न पीडेइ,वाही जाव न वड्ढइ,जाविन्दिया न हायन्ति,ताव धम्मं समायरे"
english: "One does not suffer as long as one is young, one does not grow as large as one can weep, one doesn't become thin as one would like, and therefore dharma is pure."

prakrit: "कोहं मानं च मायं च,लोभं च पापवड्ढणं,वमे चत्तारि दीसे उ,इच्छन्तो हियमप्पणो"
english: "Whom to honour and what not, Greed and the increase of sin: The wicked scream, And he who wishes is robbed of his pride."

prakrit: "कोहो पीइं पणासेइ,मानो विनयनासणो,माया मित्ताणि नासेइ,लोहो सव्वविनासणो"
english: "Anger makes one drink wine, Like modesty destroys modesty, Love destroys friendship, Like greed destroys all."

prakrit: "उवसमेण हणे कोहं,मानं मद्दवया जिणे,मायं च'ज्जवभावेण,लोभं सन्तोसओ जिणे"
english: "With passion one loses courage, with kindness one wins, with chivalry one loses motherhood, with greed one wins satisfaction."

prakrit: "कोहो य माणो य अनिग्गहीया,माया य लोभो य पवड्ढमाणा,चत्तारि एए कसिणा कसाया,सिञ्चन्ति मूलाइं पुनब्भवस्स"
english: "Anger, Which makes one unhappy, Greed, which makes one greedy, But when one has hardened one's grip, Those roots, which have been irrigated, Are reborn."

prakrit: "रायाणिएसु विनयं पउञ्जे,धुवसीलयं सययं न हावऎज्जा,कुम्मॊव्व अल्लीणपलीणगुत्तो,परक्कमॆज्जा तवसञ्जमम्मि"
english: "Silly girl, Don't be so naïve: There's nothing wrong with you, Daughter - in - law. But make sure you don't get it wrong."

prakrit: "निद्दं च न बहु मन्नॆज्जा,सम्प्पहासं विवज्जए,मिहो कहाहिं न रमे,सज्झायंमि रओ सया"
english: "I do not like to sleep much, I don't like to laugh much, But I cry all the time."

prakrit: "जोगं च समणधम्मंमि,जुंसे अनलसो धुवं,जुत्तो अ समणधम्मंमि,अट्ठं लहइ अनुत्तरं"
english: "I take a bath in a lake, I wash clothes in a river, I make shoes in a pond, And I give reply to no one."

prakrit: "इहलोगपारत्तहियं,जेणं गच्छइ सुग्गइं,बहुस्सुयं पज्जुवासॆज्जा,पुच्छिज्ज'त्थविनिच्छयं"
english: "This is the way of love: When one goes to rest, One goes to sleep, One stays up late, One asks when one wants to rest."

prakrit: "हत्थं पायं च कायं च,पणिहाय जिइन्दिए,अल्लीणगुत्तो निसिए,सगासे गुरुणो मुनी"
english: "Hands and feet only, Life goes on according to your own accord, Sweating all over your body, Like a wise sage."

prakrit: "न पक्खओ न पुरओ,नेव किच्चाण पिट्ठओ,न य ऊरुं समासॆज्ज,चिट्ठिज्जा गुरुणन्तिए"
english: "Do not turn aside, do not turn your back on the kitchen, Do not disturb the fire There, For the fire in the kitchen Cannot be quenched."

prakrit: "अपुच्छिओ न भासिज्जा,भासमाणस्स अन्तरा,पिट्ठिमंसं न खाइज्जा,मायमोसं विवज्जए"
english: "Don't be alarmed: It's not the mind that speaks, it's the senses that think, it isn't the heart that thinks."

prakrit: "अप्पत्तियं जेण सिआ,आसु कुप्पिज्ज वा परो,सव्वसो तं न भासिज्जा,भासं अहियगामिणिं"
english: "So long as you are awake, whether you are sipping a glass or drinking water, you will not hear everyone talking." ""

prakrit: "दिट्ठं मियं असन्दिद्धं,पडिपुन्नं वियं जियं,अयम्पिरमणुव्विग्गं,भासं निसिरे अत्तवं"
english: "At first sight I am unsure, then at last I am waking up, Like a man suffering from delirium, Then suddenly my speech stops."

prakrit: "आयारपन्नत्तिधरं,दिट्ठिवायमहिज्जगं,वइविक्खलिअं नच्चा,न तं उवहसे मुनी"
english: "The arrows pierce the sky, The lightning flashes at the sight, And the dancer looks on in amazement; No one is above him."

prakrit: "नक्खत्तं सुमिणं जोगं,निमित्तं मन्तभेसजं,गिहिणो तं न आइक्खे,भूआहिगरणं पयं"
english: "Join in meditation for the sake of concentration, For fear it will not come, For the earth must be moved."

prakrit: "अन्नट्ठं पगडं लयणं,भइज्ज सयणासणं,उच्चारभूमिसम्पन्नं,इत्थीपसुविवज्जियं"
english: "Laying on your turban all day, Sitting on your thighs, Pronouncing aloud, Thinking how you would describe yourself."

prakrit: "विवित्ता अ भवे सॆज्जा,नारीणं न लवे कहं,गिहिसन्थवं न कुज्जा,कुज्जा साहूहिं सन्थवं"
english: "Let there be kindness and affection, For what use is a woman supposed to make, If she has feelings of jealousy Or if she has them?"

prakrit: "जहा कुक्कुडपोयस्स,निच्चं कुललओ भयं,एवं खु बम्भयारिस्स,इत्थिविग्गहओ भयं"
english: "Wherever the cuckoo is, There is nothing to be afraid of But fear itself, And wherever it is threatened There is something to fear."

prakrit: "चित्तभित्तिं न निज्झाए,नारिं वा सुअलङ्कियं,भक्खरं पिव दट्ठुणं,दिट्ठिं पडिसमाहरे"
english: "Don't set your heart on it, you bastard or sulkier; look at the poor man's drink." ""

prakrit: "हत्थपाय पडिच्छिन्नं,कण्णनास विगप्पियं,अवि वाससयं नारिं,बम्भयारी विवज्जए"
english: "Hands and feet are tied, eyes and ears are girdled, the street is empty, the streets are deserted."

prakrit: "विभूसा इत्थिसंसग्गी,पणीयं रसभोयणं,नरस्स'त्तगवेसिस्स,विसं तालउडं जहा"
english: "Vibhusa ittisamsaggi, paniyam rasabhoyana, narasasatgavesis, vissa taluda jaha"

prakrit: "अङ्गपच्चङ्गसण्ठाणं,चारुल्लवियपेहियं,इत्थीणं तं न निज्झाए,कामरागविवड्ढणं"
english: "Restlessness in the limbs, Wretchedness all around, So that one does not swallow it, Increase in libido."

prakrit: "विसएसु मणुण्णेसु,पेमं नाभिनिवेसए,अनिच्चं तेसिं विण्णाय,परिणामं पुग्गलाण य"
english: "Consider such a thing, O navel of love: Unhappiness is the fruit of such longing."

prakrit: "पॊग्गलाणं परिणामं,तेसिं नच्चा जहा तहा,विणीयतण्हो विहरे,सीईभूएण अप्पणा"
english: "Cheating results, The more you dance, The thinner you get, And the more you grovel." ""

prakrit: "जाइ सद्धाइ निक्खन्तो,परिआयट्ठाणमुत्तमं,तमेव अनुपालॆज्जा,गुणे आयरियसंमए"
english: "One who observes siddha, learns wisdom, observes dharma, acquires virtuous qualities."

prakrit: "तवं चिमं सञ्जमजोगयं च,अज्झायजोगं च सया अहिट्ठए,सूरे व सेणाए समत्तमाउहे,अलमप्पणो होइ अलं परेसिं"
english: "Such a child, so full of joys and sorrows, So tireless in battle and in battle, So aloof in thought you are beyond reproach."

prakrit: "सज्झायसज्झाणरयस्स ताइणो,अपावभावस्स तवे रयस्स,विसुज्झई जं सि मलं पुरेकडं,समीरिअं रुप्पमलं व जोइणा"
english: "Aunt, When you are feeling good You become angry. When you feel low You become melancholic. When your mind is full You become suspicious. When people complain of lack of affection You turn away."

prakrit: "से तारिसे दुक्खसहे जिइन्दिए,सुएण जुत्ते अममे अकिञ्चणे,विरायई कम्मघणंमि अवगए,कसिणब्भपुडावगमे व चन्दिम"
english: "May she live through your sorrows, May she sleep in your shoes, May you never forget how you made her feel When you separated From her, May the moonlight flicker on her breasts."

prakrit: "थम्भा व कोहा व मयप्पमाया,गुरुस्सगासे विनयं न सिक्खे,सो चेव उ तस्स अभूइभावो,फलं व कीयस्स वहाय होइ"
english: "A stubborn heart, An angry mother, Does not learn humility through the guru's tongue. So always be indifferent to him. May the fruit bear fruit In some way."

prakrit: "जे यावि मन्दि त्ति गुरुं विइत्ता,डहरे इमे अप्पसुए त्ति नच्चा,हीलन्ति मिच्छं पडिवज्जमाणा,करन्ति आसायण ते गुरुणं"
english: "Who is afraid of the temple master, Afraid that he might cause embarrassment to others By not dancing?" - The teacher does what is expected Of him.

prakrit: "पगईइ मन्दा वि भवन्ति एगे,डहरा विय जे सुयबुद्धोववेया,आयारमन्ता गुणसुट्ठिअप्पा,जे हीलिआ सिहिरिव भास कुज्जा"
english: "There are bad days ahead, For those who are sagging Under the weight of anger There are good and bad nights."

prakrit: "जे यावि नागं डहरं ति नच्चा,आसायए स अहियाय होइ,एवायरियं पि हु हीलयन्तो,नियच्छई जाइपहं खु मन्दो"
english: "Whoever wishes to see a cobra in a manger Should dance in such a way, Should do so alone, Even if only for a moment. But when she wishes, She always leaves empty handed."

prakrit: "आसीविसो वा'वि परं सुरुट्ठो,किं जीवनासाउ परं नु कुज्जा ?,आयरियपाया पुण अप्पसन्ना,अबोहिआसायण नत्थि मुक्खो"
english: "Surprise me, my dear, But why waste your life Doing nothing?" he asked, Exhausted again, Not bothering to say a word.

prakrit: "जो पावगं जलियमवक्कमिज्जा,आसीविसं वा वि हु कोवऎज्जा,जो वा विसं खायइ जीवियट्ठी,एसोवमा''सायणया गुरुणं"
english: "One who consumes poison survives, So does the follower of righteousness, And so does the cow." ""

prakrit: "सिया हु से पावए नो डहॆज्जा,आसीविसो वा कुविओ न भक्खे,सिया विसं हालहलं न मारे,न यावि मुक्खो गुरुहीलणाए"
english: "He who touches a woman does not harm her, He who is angry does not hurt her, Nor does he who touches her flout all decency."

prakrit: "जो पव्वयं सिरसा भॆत्तुमिच्छे,सत्तं व सीहं पडिबोहऎज्जा,जो वा दए सत्तिअग्गे पहारं,एसोवमा''सायणया गुरुणं"
english: "One who turns his head upside down, One who steps on the right hand, Or one who stands guard at the left hand, Is like a wise teacher." ""

prakrit: "सिया हु सीसेणं गिरिं पि भिन्दे,सिआ हु सीहो कुविओ न मक्खे,सिया १न भिन्दॆज्ज व सत्तिअग्गं,न यावि मुक्खो गुरुहीलणाए"
english: "Aunt, If you fall asleep on top of your lover You are safe, But don't turn your face away. One cannot hurt a woman Unless one's heart is set on it."

prakrit: "आयरिअपाया पुण अप्पसन्ना,अबोहिआसायण नत्थि मुक्खो,तम्हा अनाबाहसुहाभिकङ्खी,गुरुप्पसायाभिमुहो रमॆज्जा"
english: "Come, make love again, Do not turn your face away, Dear friend, For the pleasure of seeing you again and again Will amuse you."

prakrit: "जहा''हियग्गी जलणं नमंसे,नाणाहुईमन्तपयाभिसित्तं,एवायरिअं उवचिट्ठऎज्जा,अनन्तनाणोवगओ वि सन्तो"
english: "As long as" "I bow to the flames, Pay attention to what goes on in my heart, Make sure to bend over every step of the way, Even an eternal fire is content." ""

prakrit: "जस्सन्तिए धम्मपयाइ सिक्खे,तस्सन्तिए वेणइयं पउञ्जे,सक्कारए सिरसा पञ्जलीओ,कायग्गिरा भो मनसा य निच्चं"
english: "Only those who practice dharma learn, Those who practice it take vows., But men of good character, Like the doer of hearts, Do nothing out of conscience."

prakrit: "लज्जा दया सञ्जम बम्भचेरं,कल्लाणभागिस्स विसोहिठाणं,जे मे गुरु सययमनुसासयन्ति,ते'हं गुरु सययं पूययामि"
english: "Shyness, mercy, restraint, presence of mind, The rest I treasure in my Guru's presence." ""

prakrit: "जहा निसन्ते तवनच्चिमाली,पभासई केवलं भारहं तु,एवायरिओ सुअसीलबुद्धिए,विरायई सुरमज्झे व इन्दो"
english: "Where there is no sleep, There is only sleep, You are the only burden, Travelers are self-aware, Travel is pleasant, And travel is pleasurable."

prakrit: "जहा ससी कोमुइजोगजुत्तो,नक्खत्ततारागण परिवुडप्पा,खे सोहई विमले अब्भमुक्के,एवं गणी सोहइ भिक्खुमज्झे"
