english: "As the mother-in-law stirs the fire of love, As the arrow pierces the nail mark, So the lotus opens wide, And the headman's wife embraces the bhikkuma."

prakrit: "महागार आयरिओ महेसी,समाहिजोगे सुअसीलबुद्धिए,सम्पाविउकामे अनुत्तराइं,आराहए तोसइ धम्मकामी"
english: "Great are the virtuous, O Mahasi; you will meet with good sense, Unanswered in all practicalities; Desperate are those who practice dharma."

prakrit: "सॊच्चा ण मेहावि सुभासियाइं,सुस्सूसए आयरिय'प्पमत्तो,आराहइत्ताण गुणे अनेगे,से पावइ सिद्धिमनुत्तरं"
english: "One doesn't know what is good for one's self, One only knows what is bad for the other," he says, "One can learn anything from nothing."

prakrit: "मूलाउ खन्धप्पभवो दुमस्स,खन्धाउ पच्छा समुवॆन्ति साहा,साहप्पसाहाविरुहन्ति पत्ता,तओ सि पुप्फं च फलं रसो य"
english: "A leaf twines with a young shoot, A leaf with two young shoots, An emerald with five young shoots Placed on it, Is the fruit of one's husband."

prakrit: "एवं धम्मस्स विनओ,मूलं परमो से मुक्खो,जेण कित्तिं सुअं सिग्घं,नीसेसं चाभिगच्छइ"
english: "And devoid of dharma, turn away from the original supreme, For how much longer can a sigh sigh, Sighing in despair, last?"

prakrit: "जे य चण्डे मिए थद्धे,दुव्वाई नियडी सढे,वुज्झइ से अविणीयप्पा,कट्ठं सोयगयं जहा"
english: "The moon is my bed, The nights are fleeting, I can't sleep without waking up, Where else can I go to sleep?"

prakrit: "विनयम्पि जो उवाएणं,चोइओ कुप्पइ नरो,दिव्वं सो सिरिमॆज्जन्ति,दण्डेण पडिसेहए"
english: "One who curses modesty, Who destroys decency, Destroys the world; By punishment one is condemned to hell."

prakrit: "तहेव अविणीयप्पा,उववज्झा हया गया,दीसन्ति दुहमेहन्ता,आभिओगमुवट्ठिया"
english: "The festival is inconclusive, The festival has come to an end, The days are fleeting, The roads impassable."

prakrit: "तहेव सुविणीयप्पा,उववज्झा हया गया,दीसन्ति सुहमेहन्ता,इड्ढिं पत्ता महायसा"
english: "The festival is over, The festival has begun, The days are fleeting, The great festival is almost over."

prakrit: "तहेव अविणीयप्पा,लोगंमि नरनारिओ,दीसन्ति दुहमेहन्ता,छाया ते विगलिन्दिया"
english: "The gods are incomparable, The men are incompetent, The days are long and the nights are long. The wretched forest is a shadow."

prakrit: "दण्डसत्थपरिज्जुन्ना,असब्भवयणेहि य,कलुणा विवन्नछन्दा,खुप्पिवासपरिग्गया"
english: "Wrong views, wrong views, false pretenses, false pride, and false pride."

prakrit: "तहेव सुविणीयप्पा,लोगंसि नरनारिओ,दीसन्ति सुहमेहन्ता,इड्ढिं पत्ता महायसा"
english: "The gods are generous, The people are good-natured, The days are long and the nights are long. The great victory is certain."

prakrit: "तहेव अविणीयप्पा,देव जक्खा य गुज्झगा,दीसन्ति दुहमेहन्ता,आभिओगमुवट्ठिआ"
english: "The gods are indifferent, The God of Love is always angry, He gives advice in trouble, He is always evasive."

prakrit: "तहेव सुविणीयप्पा,देवा जक्खा य गुज्झगा,दीसन्ति सुहमेहन्ता,इड्ढिं पत्ता महायसा"
english: "The God of Love is everywhere, Always at hand, Always on the lookout, Always with a happy heart."

prakrit: "जे आयरियउवज्झायाणं,सुस्सूसा वयणङ्करा,तेसिं सिक्खा पवढन्ति,जलसित्ता इव पायवा"
english: "Those who learn ayurveda, Those who practice arithmetic, Succeed in acrobatics, Flow like water."

prakrit: "अप्पणट्ठा परट्ठा वा,सिप्पा नेउणियाणि य,गिहिणो उवभोगट्ठा,इहलोगस्स कारणा"
english: "Take it yourself, take it easy, get used to it, eat it whole, drink it whole; this is the cause of the illness."

prakrit: "जेण बन्धं वहं घोरं,परियावं च दारुणं,सिक्खमाणा नियच्छन्ति,जुत्ता ते ललिइन्दिया"
english: "The more fierce the relations, the uglier the lovers, The more learned they become; The looser the shoes"

prakrit: "ते'वि तं गुरुं पूयन्ति तस्स सिप्पस्स कारणा,सक्कारन्ति नमंसन्ति,तुट्ठा निद्देसवत्तिणो"
english: "They worship him because he is dear to them, They bow down because they pity him, And break up because they are bitter."

prakrit: "किं पुण जे सुयग्गाही,अनन्तहियकामए,आयरिआ जं वए भिक्खू,तम्हा तं नाइवत्तए"
english: "What good is a good man, If he pursues an endless occupation, A monk at any age, His name should not be mentioned?"

prakrit: "नीयं सॆज्जं गइं ठाणं नीयं च आसनानि य,नीयं च पाए वन्दॆज्जा नीयं कुज्जा य अञ्जलिं"
english: "You set the stage, You stood the place, You took the chair, And found it empty."

prakrit: "सङ्घट्टइत्ता काएणं,तहा उवहिणामवि,खमेह अवराहं मे,वइज्ज न पुणो त्ति य"
english: "Why this strife, you stubborn girl, For I will never forgive you, For you will never hurt me again."

prakrit: "दुग्गओ वा पओएणं,चोइओ वहइ रहं,एवं दुबुद्धि किच्चाणं,वुत्तो वुत्तो पकुव्वइ"
english: "A poor man or woman is always poor, And a fool cooks food, But wood thrives on it."

prakrit: "आलवन्ते लवन्ते वा,न निसिज्जाए पडिस्सुणे,नत्तूणं आसनं धीरो,सुस्सूसाए पडिस्सुणे"
english: "Always courteous, never condescending, Always patient when sitting down, Always pleasant when sleeping."

prakrit: "कालं छन्दोवयारं च,पडिलेहित्ताण हेउहिं,तेण तेण उवाएण,तं तं सम्पडिवायए"
english: "Time is of the essence, Time is fleeting, There must be something hidden beneath that surface To make it whole."

prakrit: "विवत्ती अविनीयस्स,सम्पत्ती विनियस्स य,जस्सेयं दुहओ नायं,सिक्खं से अभिगच्छइ"
english: "Wealth is something immaterial, wealth is something illusory, Just as love is something that does not exist, It arises from learning."

prakrit: "जे यावि चण्डे मइइड्ढिगारवे,पिसुणे नरे साहसहीणपेसणे,अदिट्ठधम्मे विनए अकोविए,असंविभागी न हु तस्स मुक्खो"
english: "Whoever scorns the moon Because it is dark, Who reproaches him Because he shows no courage, Who turns a blind eye Because he does not see clearly enough, Must be punished."

prakrit: "निद्देसवत्ती पुण जे गुरूणं,सुअत्थधम्मा विणयंमि कोविया,तरित्तु ते ओहमिणं दुरुत्तरं,खवित्तु कम्मं गइमुत्तमं गया"
english: "Niddesvati, the virtuous teacher, A coward who weaves falsehoods, Is always so wicked; But, alas, the true master has departed."

prakrit: "आयरियं अग्गिमिवाहियग्गी,सुस्सूसमाणो पडिज्जागरॆज्जा,आलोइयं इङ्गियमेव नच्चा,जो छन्दमाराहयई स पुज्जो"
english: "The fire is carried on by the fire, The fragrance is given by the rapture, The flame by the flame, The dancer by the rhythm."

prakrit: "आयारमट्ठा विनयं पउञ्जे,सुस्सूसमाणो परिगिज्झ वक्कं,जहोवइट्ठं अभिकङ्खमाणो,गुरुं तु नासाययई स पुज्जो"
english: "Praise be to the subtlety of form, To the way in which one circumambulates nature, To wisdom that calls forth one's thoughts, Teacher, may you never cease to amaze."

prakrit: "रायणिएसु विनयं पउञ्जे,डहरा'वि य जे परिआयजिट्ठा,नीअत्तणे वट्टइ सच्चवाई,ओवायवं वक्ककरे स पुज्जो"
english: "Those who stay indoors Speak the truth, Those who go out in the street Speak plainly, And those who stay up late Speak rudely."

prakrit: "अण्णायउञ्छं चरई विसुद्धं,जवणट्ठया समुयाणं च निच्चं,अलद्धुयं नो परिदेवऎज्जा,लध्धुं न विक्कत्थई स पुज्जो"
english: "Destroy other people's pastures, Destroy men's houses and communities., But do not harm the gods around you; Do not harm women's lives."

prakrit: "सन्थारसॆज्जा''सणभत्तपाने,अपिच्छया अइलाभे'वि सन्ते,जो एवमप्पाणभितीसइज्जा,सन्तोसपाहन्नरए स पुज्जो"
english: "Santar sejda," The festival of feasts, Unhappy even in the light of good omen, Which, like a feast of fire and water, Brings joy to the soul. "

prakrit: "सक्का सहेउं आसाए कण्टया,अओमया उच्छहया नरेणं,अनासए जो उ सहिज्ज कण्टए,वईमए कन्नसरे स पुज्जो"
english: "One can bear to stare at you, One can't help it, You won't get angry at yourself, One cannot help it: The tears well up in one's eyes."

prakrit: "मुहुत्तदुक्खा हुं हवन्ति कण्टया,अओमया ते'वि तओ सुउद्धरा,वायादुरुत्ताणि दुरुद्धराणि,वेरानुबन्धीणि महब्भयाणि"
english: "I can see that her face is smeared with red ghee, I can still see her lips, She is so beautiful, So fierce is the wind that blows, And so fearful is the detestable one."

prakrit: "समावयन्ता वयणाभिधाया,कन्नं गया दुम्मणियं जणन्ति,धम्मु त्ति किच्चा परमग्गसूरे,जिइन्दिए जो सहई स पुज्जो"
english: "Those who practice dharma Know the ultimate truth... But whoever practices dharma Lives in the hands of the pure."

prakrit: "अवण्णवायं च परम्मुहस्स,पच्चक्खओ पडिनीयं च भासं,ओहारिणिं अप्पिअकारिणिं च भासं न भासिज्ज सया स पुज्जो"
english: "Speak plainly, turn your face away, do not speak harshly, Do not speak rudely, And do not turn your back on your enemies."

prakrit: "अलोलुए अक्कुहए अमाई,अपिसुणे आवि अदीनवित्ती,नो भावए नो'वि अ भावियप्पा,अकोउहल्ले अ सया स पुज्जो"
english: "Always be vigilant, never be negligent, always be vigilant and never be reckless."

prakrit: "गुणेहिं साहू अगुणेहि'साहू,गिण्हाहि साहू गुण मुञ्च'साहू,विआणिया अप्पगमप्पएणं,जो रागदोसेहिं समो स पुज्जो"
english: "Gunya hain, sah, agune hain; Guna hain: Gunna hai, guna munch; Vinyaya appagamappayen: One who understands rag dosha faces him." ""

prakrit: "तहेव डहरं च महल्लगं वा,इत्थी पुमं पव्वइअं गिहिं वा,नो हीलए नो'वि य खिंसइज्जा,थम्भं च कोहं च चए स पुज्जो"
english: "There must be something very special about your husband's funeral pyre, Something very sacred about it, Something that you know nothing about, Something you know is wrong with him, And something else must be done."

prakrit: "जे माणिआ सययं माणयन्ति,जत्तेण कन्नं व निवेसयन्ति,ते माणए माणरिहे तवस्सी,जिइन्दिए सच्चरए स पुज्जो"
english: "Those who appreciate kindness, Wherever you go and whatever you invest in, Appreciate what you gain By being honest."

prakrit: "तेसिं गुरुणं गुणसायराणं,सुच्चाण मेहावी सुभासियाइं,चरे मुनी पञ्चरए तिगुत्तो,चउक्कसायावगए स पुज्जो"
english: "His Guru is excellent, His disciples are excellent, He knows how to give advice, And the wise are quick to judge between four and five."

prakrit: "गुरुमिह सययं पडियरिय मुनी,जिनमयनिउणे अभिगमकुसले,धुणिय रयमलं पुरेकडं,भासुरमउलं गइं गय"
english: "Dear sage, When the young girl's husband arrived at the field She could not help laughing. The fragrant flowers of the jasmine had already gone." ""

prakrit: "सुयं मे आउसं तेणं भगवया एवमक्खायं- इह खलु थेरेहिं भगवन्तेहिं चत्तारि विनयसमाहिट्ठाणा पन्नत्ता. कयरे खलु ते थेरेहिं भगवन्तेहिं चत्तारि विनयसमाहिट्ठाणा पन्नत्ता ? इमे खलु ते थेरेहिं भगवन्तेहिं चत्तारि विनयसमाहिट्ठाणा पन्नत्ता तं जहा- विनयसमाही सुयसमाही,तवसमाही,आयारसमाही."
english: "In the same way, when did the good God arrive at me And when did he arrive? It's only because his good nature endeared him to everyone. When did he start to please God? It is also because his kindness endears him to all beings. His kindnesses endure forever, even forever, forever and ever."

prakrit: "विनए सुए अ तवे,आयारे निच्च पण्डिआ,अभिरामयन्ति अप्पाणं,जे भवन्ति जिइन्दिआ"
english: "One cannot sleep without waking up, one cannot go out without bathing, one has to dedicate oneself to rest, for that is the victory of India."

prakrit: "चउव्विहा खलु विनयसमाही भवही,तं जहा- अनुसासिज्जन्तो सुस्सूसइ,सम्मं सम्पडिवज्जइ,वेयमाराहयइ,न य भवइ अत्तसम्पग्गहिए चउत्थं पयं भवइ."
english: "Every good man will be humbled, Every woman will be delighted, Every man who follows her Will prosper, Every marriage will be ruined, No matter how close the ties."

prakrit: "पेहेइ हियाणुसासनं सुस्सूसइ तं च पुणो अहिट्ठिए,न य माणमएण मज्जई विनयसमाहिआययट्ठिए"
english: "One who observes austerities attains perfection again, Not when one observes decency through pride."

prakrit: "चउव्विहा खलु सुयसमाही भवइ तं जहा- सुयं मे भविस्सइ त्ति अज्झाइयव्वं भवइ,एगग्गचित्तो भविस्सामि त्ति अज्जाइयव्वं भवइ,अप्पाणं ठावइस्सामि त्ति अज्झाइयव्वं भवइ,ठिओ परं ठावइस्सामि त्ति अज्झाइयव्वं भवइ चउत्थं पयं भवइ."
english: "Every time I think of it, I become more anxious: When I prance around I get more anxious; When I am more anxious, I feel more anxious. But when I stop myself, I don't think I can stop myself."

prakrit: "नाणमेगग्गचित्तो य,ठिओ य ठावइ परं,सुयाणि य अहिज्जित्ता,रओ सुयसमाहिए"
english: "Calm down, stay put, move on, sleep won't last, cry, sleep will last a lifetime."

prakrit: "चउव्विहा खलु तवसमाही भवइ,तं जहा- नो इहलोगट्ठयाए तवमहिट्ठॆज्जा,नो पहरलोगट्ठयाए तव महिट्ठॆज्जा,नो कित्तिवण्णसद्दसिलोगट्ठयाए तवमहिट्ठिज्जा,नन्नत्थ निज्जरट्ठयाए तवमहिट्ठिज्जा चउत्थं पयं भवइ."
english: "All four will become clear. Wherever you look There will be excitement in your eyes, Where you wait it out, There won't be longing in your heart, Wherever it takes a long time To unfold. Nowadays people think they know everything."

prakrit: "विविहगुणतवोरए य निच्चं भवइ निरासए निज्जरट्ठिए,तवसा धुणइ पुराणपावगं,जुत्तोसया तवसमाहिए"
english: "Because of its many virtues, Nature never disappoints; Instead, it destroys old gods.,"

prakrit: "चउव्विहा खलु आयारसमाही भवइ,तं जहा — नो इहलोगट्ठयाए आयारमहिट्ठिज्जा,नो परलोगट्ठयाए आयारमहिट्ठिज्जा,नो कित्तिवन्नसद्दसिलोगट्ठयाए आयारमहिट्ठिज्जा,नन्नत्थ आरहन्तेहिं हेऊहिं आयारमहिट्ठिज्जा चउत्थं पयं भवइ ."
english: "All four will become equal in stature, As long as they do not cross one's path or cross another, As far as one can reach the other one, So long as one does not cross another's paths Or how long one has to travel the other way."

prakrit: "जिनवयणरए अतिन्तिणे,पडिपुन्नाययमाययट्ठिए,आयारसमाहिसंवुडे,भवइ य दन्ते भावसन्धए"
english: "When women talk too much, When their husbands come home early, When they are busy making love And when their husbands are away, It's like showing emotion on your teeth."

prakrit: "अभिगम चउरो समाहिओ,सुविसुद्धो सुसमाहिअप्पओ,विउलहियं सुहावहं पुणो,कुव्वइ सो पयखेममप्पणो"
english: "Come, join us, We shall have a good time together; We shall meet again, and we shall have some fun together."

prakrit: "जाइमरणाओ मुच्चई,इत्थत्थं च चयइ सव्वसो,सिद्धे वा हवइ सासए,देवे वा अप्परए महिड्ढिए"
english: "Jaimarana is closed, so is the meaning chosen by all, Siddha or Eve is closed by the mother-in-law, Deva or above is great."

prakrit: "निक्खम्ममाणाइ य बुद्धवयणे,निच्चं चित्तसमाहिओ हविज्जा,इत्थीण वसं न यावि गच्छे,वन्तं नो पडियायई जे स भिक्खू"
english: "Praise be to the enlightened one, To the observer of one's mind There is no room for doubt Whatever it may be, For a monk who has arrived Has not yet arrived."

prakrit: "पुढविं न खणे न खणावए,सीओदगं न पिए न पियावए,अगनि सत्थं जहा सुनिसियं,तं न जले न जलावए जे स भिक्खू"
english: "The fire is not to be digged, Not to be scorched, Nor to be drunk, For as long as I am awake The fire cannot be kindled, Nor can it be lit By a monk."

prakrit: "अनिलेण न वीए न वीयावए,हरियाणि न छिन्दे न छिन्दावए,बीयाणि सया विवज्जयन्तो,सचित्तं नाहारए जे स भिक्खू"
english: "An oil seed does not wither, does not shed, is not torn by the anvil, is neither plucked from the seed nor torn by it; the truth is, however, that he is a monk."

prakrit: "वहणं तसथावराणं होइ,पुढवितणकट्ठनिस्सियाणं,तम्हा उद्देसिअं न भुञ्जे नो वि पए न पयावए जे स भिक्खू"
english: "May the Vahan be miraculous, may the next scene be dramatic, may your intentions not be betrayed, may there not be a single cow that falls or is scared of a monk."

prakrit: "रोइय नायपुत्तवयणे,अत्तसमे मन्नॆज्ज छप्पि काए,पञ्च य फासे महव्वयाइं,पञ्चासवसंवरे जे स भिक्खू"
english: "Weeping and wailing, With tears welling up in our eyes, Hidden among them are five great vows, A monk for all five vows."

prakrit: "चत्तारि वमे सया कसाए,धुवजोगी हवॆज्ज बुद्धवयणे,अहणे निज्जायरूवरयए,गिहिजोगं परिवज्जए जे स भिक्खू"
english: "Aunt, If you want to wash away the mud From your hair, Then wash it off with your own hands, Or cover it with your hands, Like a monk who is condemned to die."

prakrit: "सम्मदिट्ठी सया अमूढे,अत्थि हु नाणे तवे सञ्जमे य,तवसा धुणइ पुराणपावगं,मनवयकायसुसंवुडे जे स भिक्खू"
english: "A monk is one who understands what is said, Who knows what is true and what is not, Who interprets old sayings to suit his own feelings."

prakrit: "तहेव असनं पानगं वा,विविहं खाइमं साइमं लभित्ता,होही अट्ठो सुए परे वा,तं न निहे न निहावए जे स भिक्खू"
english: "One can drink only as much as one likes, one can have any number of meals at a time, and one can sleep only while one is asleep; one shouldn't touch one who is a monk."

prakrit: "तहेव असनं पानगं वा,विविहं खाइमं साइमं लभित्ता,छन्दिअ साहम्मियाण भुञ्जे,भुच्चा सज्झायरए जे स भिक्खू"
english: "There must be something very special about you, You must be eating a lot of different things, Having found the right place, And embracing your friends. But a true monk is one who forgives."

prakrit: "न य वुग्गहियं कहं कहॆज्जा,न य कुप्पे निहुइन्दिए पसन्ते,सञ्जमे धुवं जोगेण जुते,उवसन्ते अविहेडए जे स भिक्खू"
english: "I have nothing to say to you about it, Not even the mudflats in which you lie down, Not the slippers on which you wash your feet. What you do not know is that he is a monk."

prakrit: "जो सहइ हु गामकण्टए,अक्कोसपहारतज्जणाओ य,भयभेरवसद्दसप्पहासे,समसुहदुक्खसहे य जे स भिक्खू"
english: "One who endures is like a village headman, Like a man who is constantly threatened, Laughs in the heat of fear, Is like a monk who experiences great sorrow."

prakrit: "पडिमं पडिवज्जिया सुसाणे,नो भीयए भयभेरवाइं दिस्स,विविहगुणतवोरए य निच्चं,न सरीरं चाभिकङ्खई जे स भिक्खू"
english: "A good sage never gets angry, Never shows fear, Never tries on different virtues, Never licks the body of a monk."

prakrit: "असइं वोसट्ठचत्तदेहे,अकुट्ठे व हए व लूसिए वा,पुढविसमे मुनी हवॆज्जा,अनियाणे अकोउहल्ले जे स भिक्खू"
english: "We are lost in confusion, We are clueless and in a hurry, Sage Hawejja is at hand at an early hour, And everyone who calls himself by another name Is a monk."

prakrit: "अभिभूय काएण परीसहाइं,समुद्धरे जाइपहाउ अप्पयं,विइत्तु जाईमरणं महब्भयं,तवे रए सामाणिए जे स भिक्खू"
english: "Behold the cowherd's wife:" "Jump into the sea for a drink of water." "Yet for all my fear of death I must confess that I am a monk."

prakrit: "हत्थसञ्जए पायसञ्जए,वायसञ्जए सञ्जइन्दिए,अज्झप्परए सुसमाहियप्पा,सुत्तत्थं च वियाणइ जे स भिक्खू"
english: "A monk is one who understands everything, Who understands what is said, Who knows what is true, And who knows what isn't."

prakrit: "उवहिम्मि अमुच्छिए अगिद्धे,अन्नायउञ्छं पुलनिप्पुलाए,कयविक्कयसन्निहिओ विरए,सव्वसङ्गावगए य जे स भिक्खू"
english: "A monk is one who, Surprised by what is said, Thrives ahead Undisturbed, Pulls back and forth, Escapes from difficult situations, And gathers all people together."

prakrit: "अलोल भिक्खू न रसेसु गिज्झे,उञ्छं चरे जीविय नाभिकङ्खे,इड्ढिं च सक्कारण पूयणं च,चए ठियप्पा अणिहे जे स भिक्खू"
english: "A solitary monk does not mix juices, One cannot touch a scruffy bird, One has to press one's navel against the snake's body, And one has to stand still Unless one is struck by lightning."

prakrit: "न परं वऎज्जासि अयं कुसीले,जेणं च कुप्पॆज्ज न तं वऎज्जा,जाणिय पत्तेयं पुन्नपावं,अत्ताणं न समुक्कसे जे स भिक्खू"
english: "A wise man does not reap what is due to him, A miser is not worthless if he is sagging over, A monk never stumbles over anything he does not know."

prakrit: "न जाइमत्ते न य रूवमत्ते,न लाभमत्ते न सुएण मत्ते,मयाणि सव्वाणि विवज्जइता,धम्मज्झाणरए जे स भिक्खू"
english: "No victory, no gain, no need to sleep: My wife disciplines all; By observing the dharma, I mean that of a monk."

prakrit: "पवेयए अज्झपयं महामुनी,धम्मे ठिओ ठावयई परम्पि,निक्खम्म वज्जॆज्ज कुसीललिङ्गं,न यावि हासं कुहए जे स भिक्खू"
english: "Praise be to the great bow, Remain firm in Dharma, Refuse to budge, For he does not laugh Who is a bhikkhu?"

prakrit: "तं देहवासं आसुइं असासयं,सया चए निच्चहियट्ठियप्पा,छिन्दित्तु जाईमरणस्स बन्धनं,उवेइ भिक्खू अपुणागमं गइं-"
english: "His body is empty, His limbs are bare, He has broken the shackles of immortality. The same monk has fallen at his feet."

prakrit: "जया य चयई धम्मं,अणज्जो भोगकारणा,से तत्थ मुच्छिए बाले,आयइं नावबुज्झई"
english: "Wherever Dharma is practiced, There must be someone who indulges in it, Like a child who frowns. Nowadays women do not understand it"

prakrit: "जया ओहाविओ होइ,इन्दो वा पडिओ छमं,सव्वधम्मपरिब्भट्ठो,स पच्छा परितप्पइ"
english: "Whomsoever it may concern, I will protect, And whoever it is that falls by the wayside, It is through purity that all dharmas attain."

prakrit: "जया अ वन्दिमो होइ,पच्छा होइ अवन्दिमो,देवया व चुया ठाणा,स पच्छा परितप्पइ"
english: "Whichever is greater, Let there be wretchedness, Whatever is vague, As long as there are gods and goddesses, There is pure renunciation."

prakrit: "जया अ पूइमो होइ,पच्छा होइ अपूइमो,राया व रज्जपब्भट्ठो,स पच्छा परितप्पइ"
english: "Whichever is right is right, whatever is wrong is wrong, And whichever isn't, is right."

prakrit: "जया य माणिमो होइ,पच्छा होइ अमाणिमो,सॆट्ठिव्व कब्बडे छूढो,स पच्छा परितप्पइ"
english: "Where there is affection, there is infidelity, There is dishonesty; The righteous turn their backs on the wicked."

prakrit: "जया अ थेरओ होइ,समइक्कन्तजॊव्वणो,मच्छॊव्व गलं गिलित्ता,स पच्छा परितप्पइ"
english: "May there be victory, may there be longing, May the tongue swallow the cheek of the mosquito, May it ever taste right."

prakrit: "जया अ कुकुडुम्बस्स,कुतत्तीहिं विहम्मइ,हत्थी व बन्धने बद्धो,स पच्छा परितप्पइ"
english: "Jaya is a cuckoo bird, Which flies with the dog, Which is tied with an elephant's shackles, Which turns it upside down." ""

prakrit: "पुत्तदार परिकिण्णो,मोहसन्ताण सन्तओ,पङ्कोसन्नो जहा नागो,स पच्छा परितप्पइ"
english: "A wise man is faithful, A child is loyal, And a traitor is loyal Wherever he strays, There he will be forgiven."

prakrit: "अज्ज आहं गणी हुन्तो,भाविअप्पा बहुस्सुओ,जइ'हं रमन्तो परियाए,सामन्ने जिनदेसिए"
english: "Today I count the days. The days are long, The nights long, If we make love We meet face to face."

prakrit: "देवलोगसमाणो य,परियाओ महेसिणं,रयाणं अरयाणं च,महानरयसारिसो"
english: "The gods are like elephants, the fairies are like the God of Love, the rhinoceros is like a demon, and the lion is like an elephant."

prakrit: "अमरोवमं जाणिय सुक्खमुत्तमं,रयाण परियाए तहारयाणं,निरओवमं जाणिय दुक्खमुत्तमं,रमॆज्ज तम्हा परियायपण्डिए"
english: "I know immortality, I know happiness, Ryan knows love, He knows adversity, Love has mastered your love."

prakrit: "धम्माउ भट्ठं सिरिओ ववेयं,जन्नग्गि विज्झायमि'वप्पतेयं,हीलन्ति णं दुव्विहिअं कुसीला,दाढुद्धियं घोरविसं व नागं"
english: "Dharma makes one walk on empty fire," "I walk on thin air." "As I walk through the streets I see two women kneeling beside one another."

prakrit: "इहेव धम्मो अयसो अकित्ती,दुन्नामधॆज्जं च पिहुज्जणंमि,चुयस्स धम्माउ अहम्मसेविणो,सम्भिन्नवित्तस्स य हॆट्ठओ गई"
english: "This is dharma; I renounce it, And renounce that which is wicked. But the dharma of the soul, Being a servant of the self, Has been destroyed Like all finance."

prakrit: "भुञ्जित्तु भोगाइं पसज्झ चेयसा,तहाविहं कट्टु असञ्जमं बहुं,गइं च गच्छे अणहिज्झिअं दुहं,बोही अ से नो सुलहा पुणो पुणो"
english: "Bhunjittu bhoga, you have made love, And tied her knot, So much for your incompetence That the grief is unbearable. The daughter - in - law cannot make love again." ""

prakrit: "इमस्स ता नेरइयस्स जन्तुणो दुहोवणीयस्स किलेसवत्तिणो,पलिओवमं झिज्जइ सागरोवमं,किसङ्ग पुण मज्झ इम मनोदुहं"
english: "It's just a bunch of nectar - Like the fire of a castle, Like the plowman's field, Like an ocean in spate, Like poison in my heart."

prakrit: "न मे चिरं दुक्खमिणं भविस्सइ,असासया भोगपिवास जन्तुणो,न मे सरीरेण इमेण'विस्सइ,अविस्सई जीवियपज्जवेण मे"
english: "I am not consumed by sorrow, Not by sensual pleasures, Nor am I consumed by the body, Except as a means of sustenance."

prakrit: "जस्सेवमप्पा उ हविज्ज निच्छिओ,चऎज्ज देहं न हु धम्मसासनं,तं तारिसं नो पयलॆन्ति इन्दिया,उविन्ति वाया व सुदंसणं गिरिं"
english: "Mother - in - law, you have to kneel down, Your body must be in a state of dharma, India must not bow down to you, For behold, the vision of good has fallen."

prakrit: "इच्चेव सम्पस्सिअ बुद्धिमं नरो,आयं उवायं विविहं वियाणिया,कएण वाया अदु मानसेणं,तिगुत्तिगुत्तो जिणवयणमहिठ्ठिज्जासि"
english: "Well done, you clever man; I have heard so much about you from so many different people. For what use is a word made of? It makes your heart grow faint."

prakrit: "चूलियं तु पवक्खामि,सुयं केवलिभासियं,जं सुणित्तु सुपुण्णाणं,धम्मे उप्पज्जए मई"
english: "You fool, I beg of you; I can only speak plainly; What you hear I can decipher with good reason; I will instruct you in Dharma."

prakrit: "अणुसोयपट्ठिए बहुजणंमि,पडिसोयलद्धलक्खेणं,पडिसोयमेव अप्पा,दायव्वो होउकामेणं"
english: "I am full of joys, I am abundant in pleasures, I wallow in sorrows, I sulk in troubles, I make false promises."

prakrit: "अनुसोयसुहो लोओ,पडिसोओ आसवो सुविहियाणं,अणुसोओ संसारो,पडिसोओ तस्स उत्तारो"
english: "Blessed are the meek, For good is the hope of the wise, For evil is the way of the world, And falsehood is the answer to it."

prakrit: "तम्हा आयारपरक्कमेण,संवरसमाहिबहुलेणं,चरिया गुणा य नियमा य,हुन्ति साहूण दट्ठव्वा"
english: "Through the perfection of your behavior, Through the abundance of your senses, Through your multiplication and regulation, There is room for discerning friends."

prakrit: "अनिएसवासो समुयाणचरिया,अन्नायउञ्छं पइरिक्कया य,अप्पोवही कलहविवज्जाणा य,विहारचरिया इसिणं पसत्था"
english: "A man who lives alone Travels through the streets, Who seeks rest or pleasure There is also discordant talk, Who loves a pastime"

prakrit: "आइन्नओमाणविवज्जणा य,ओसन्नदीट्ठाहडभत्तपाने,संसट्ठकप्पेण चरॆज्ज भिक्खू,तज्जायसंसट्ठ जई जऎज्जा"
english: "Today is the last day of my life. I will never forget how you made me feel When you tried to kiss my cheek with your hand, When I tried to embrace you."

prakrit: "अमज्जमंसासि अमच्छरीया,अभिक्खणं निव्विगइं गया अ,अभिक्खणं काउस्सग्गकारी,सज्झायजोगे पयओ हवॆज्जा"
english: "You impudent wretch, The observer has gone astray, And the observer is a coward. Be careful not to fall into temptation."

prakrit: "न पडिन्नविज्जा सयणासणाइं,सॆज्जं निसॆज्जं तह भत्तपानं,गामे कुले वा नगरे व देसे,ममत्तभावं न कहिं पि कुज्जा"
english: "Do not play the flute, Do not abuse it, Use it sparingly, In village or town or country, For there is nothing wrong with loving - kindness."

prakrit: "गिहिणो वेयावडिअं न कुज्जा,अभिवायणं वन्दन पूयणं वा,असङ्किलिट्ठेहिं समं वसॆज्जा,मुनी चरित्तस्स जओ न हानी"
english: "Don't be offended by her brazen mannerisms, Praise be to the way she greets you, Pay equal attention to what's not rightfully yours."

prakrit: "न या लभॆज्जा निउणं सहायं,गुणाहियं वा गुणओ समं वा,ऎक्को वि पावाइं विवज्जयन्तो विहरिज्ज कामेसु असज्जमाणो"
english: "Whether merit be equal to merit or disadvantage, Whether one distinguishes right from wrong, My business is undisturbed."

prakrit: "संवच्छरं वा'वि परं पमाणं,बीयं च वासं न तहिं वसॆज्जा,सुत्तस्स मग्गेण चरिज्ज भिक्खू,सुत्तस्स अत्थो जह आणवेइ"
english: "Truth alone triumphs over falsehood, seed alone does not last, And belief in falsehood is useless. For one who seeks truth seeks truth, And who can bring truth to truth is a true monk."

prakrit: "जो पुव्वरत्तावररत्तकाले,सम्पिक्खई अप्पगमप्पएणं,किं मे कडं किं च मे किच्चसेसं,किं सक्कणिज्जं न समायरामि ?"
english: "When the festival is over, When everything is in full swing, What have I to do with it, And how can I help it?"

prakrit: "किं मे परो पासइ किं च अप्पा,किं वा'हं खलियं न विवज्जयामि ?,इच्चेव सम्मं अनुपासमाणो,अनागयं नो पडिबन्ध कुज्जा"
english: "Why should I go past you? What do you mean," "I am innocent" "? I will never forgive you. "

prakrit: "जत्थेव पासे कइ दुप्पउत्तं,काएण वाया अदु मानसेणं,तत्थेव धीरो पडिसाहरॆज्जा,आइन्नओ खिप्पमिव क्खलीणं"
english: "Wherever there is bitterness, For what use is a man's affection? There must be patience, For today's poor man is a farmer's son."

prakrit: "जस्सेरिसा जोग जिइन्दियस्स,धिईमओ सप्पुरिसस्स निच्चं,तमाहु लोए पडिबुद्धजीवी,सो जीवई सञ्जमजीविएणं"
english: "In the world, the wise survive, In nature, everyone survives, And in nature, everything is peaceful."

prakrit: "अप्पा खलु सययं रक्खियव्वो,सव्विन्दिएहिं सुसमाहिएहिं,अरक्खिओ जाइपहं उवेइ,सुरक्खिओ सव्वदुहाण मुच्चइ"
english: "Apa khalu sayyam rakhiyavo, sarvindiye sarvasamahayin, arakkhiyon jaipam uveyi, sarakkiyon sarvaduhon mukhyaan." ""

prakrit: "मुनि दीपरत्नसागरेण संशोधिताः सम्पादिताश्च“दसवेआलिअं मूलसुत्तं”सम्मत्तं"
english: "Sage Dipratnasagar's amendment: After the editorial" "The ten vows are rooted in truth." ""

prakrit: "सञ्जोगा विप्पमुक्कस्स,अनगारस्स भिक्खुणो,विनयं पाउकरिस्सामि,आनुपुव्विं सुणेह मे"
english: "Wretched fool, Ungrateful monk, I beg your pardon. I will listen to you in return."

prakrit: "आणानिद्देसकरे,गुरुणमुववायकारए,इङ्गियागारसम्पन्ने,से विनीए त्ति वुच्चई"
english: "She looked at him with such fondness, With such longing, Like a teacher's speech." ""

prakrit: "आणा'निद्देसकरे,गुरुणमनुववायकारए,पडिनीए असम्बुद्धे,अविनीए त्ति वुच्चई"
english: "Aṇḍeśākare, the words spoken by the teacher, Are incomprehensible to the wife, But she sees them without him."

prakrit: "जहा सुणी पूइकण्णी,निक्कसिज्जई सव्वसो,एवं दुस्सीलपडिनीए,मुहरी निक्कसिज्जइ"
english: "Wherever the blind worship, Wherever they go astray, There the poor wretch will be destroyed."

prakrit: "कणकुं'गं चइत्ताणं,विट्ठं भुञ्जइ सूयरो,एवं सीलं चइत्ताणं,दुस्सीले रमई मिए"
english: "The crows eat grass, The swine roast the field, And the seals eat grass. The wicked rejoice."

prakrit: "सुणिया'भावं साणस्स,सुयरस्स नरस्स य,विनए ठवॆज्ज अप्पाणं इच्छन्तो हियमप्पणो"
english: "Listen," says the sage, "Be not alarmed by falsehoods. But if you forsake yourself, you will rejoice."

prakrit: "तम्हा विनयमेसिज्जा,सीलं पडिलभॆज्जओ,बुद्धपुत्त नियागट्ठी,न निक्कसिज्जइ कण्हुई"
english: "Your modesty is praiseworthy, Your feet are pure, Your mind is pure, And your eyes are not closed."

prakrit: "निसन्ते सिया अमुहरी,बुद्धाणं अन्तिए सया,अट्ठजुत्ताणि सिक्खिज्जा,निरट्ठाणि उ वज्जए"
english: "Without a doubt, love is infinite, wisdom is eternal, learning takes eight vows, and failure takes one's life."

prakrit: "अनुसासिओ न कुप्पिज्जा,खन्तिं सेविज्ज पण्डिए,खुड्डेहिं सह संसग्गिं,हासं कीडं च वज्जए"
english: "Followers, do not be stingy, Be considerate and helpful, Make friends with strangers, Laugh and play pranks."

prakrit: "मा य चण्डालियं कासी,बहुयं मा य आलवे,कालेणं य अहिज्जित्ता,तओ झाइज्ज एगओ"
english: "Do not mess with the moon, do not mess around with it, For the passage of time Is unavoidable, So eat only boiled eggs."

prakrit: "आहच्च चण्डालियं कुट्टु,न निण्हइज्ज कयाइ वि,कडं कडे त्ति भासॆज्जा,अकडं नो कडे त्ति य"
english: "Come on, you silly bitch, You're not supposed to tell me anything, I don't think you know where to look. There's nothing you can do About it."

prakrit: "मा गलियस्सेव कसं,वयणमिच्छे पुणो पुणो,कसं व दट्ठुमाइण्णे,पावगं परिवज्जए"
english: "How can I help you, darling, If you don't want to be seen again?"

prakrit: "अनासवा थूलवया कुसीला,मिउम्पि चण्डं पकरॆन्ति सीसा,चित्ताणुया हु दक्खोववेया,पसायए ते हु दुरासयम्पि"
english: "Aunt, The moon is shining brightly, The roads are slippery, The streets are deserted, The rivers are in spate, And the roads are impassable."

prakrit: "नापुट्ठो वागरे किञ्चि,पुट्ठो वा नालियं वए,कोहं असच्चं कुवॆज्जा,धारॆज्जा पियमप्पियं"
english: "Puttu thoda vaagare kinchi, puttu va nalyam vaaye, koham asaccham kuvejja, dharejja piyyampiyam"

prakrit: "अप्पा चेव दमेयव्वो,अप्पा हु खलु दुद्दमो,अप्पा दन्तो सुही होइ,अस्सिं लोए परत्थ य"
english: "My father is always poor, My mother is always miserly, My teeth are sweet, We must return to this land."

prakrit: "वरं मे अप्पा दन्तो,सञ्जमेण तवेण य,मा'हं परेहि दम्मन्तो,बन्धणेहिं वहेहि य"
english: "Give alms to one's neighbor, Give love to another, Give affection to another; Be generous with affection."

prakrit: "पडिनीयं च बुद्धाणं,वाया अदुव कम्मुणा,आवी वा जइवा रहस्से,नेव कुज्जा कयाइवि"
english: "Love is a mysterious thing, Love is an inexhaustible thing, Friendship is something immutable, And love is something eternal."

prakrit: "न पक्खओ न पुरओ,नेव किच्चाण पिट्ठओ,न जुञ्जे ऊरुणा ऊरुं,सयणे नो पडिस्सुणे"
english: "Do not turn aside, do not turn your back on the hunter, Do not grope for the young."

prakrit: "नेव पल्हत्थियं कुज्जा,पक्खपिण्डं च सञ्जए,पाए पसारिए वा'वि,न चिट्ठे गुरुणन्तिए"
english: "Never let a tooth ache, Never allow a pimple to settle on your foot, And never allow a tear to spread to your eyelid."

prakrit: "आयरिएहिं वाहित्तो,तुसिणीओ न कयाइ वि,पसायट्ठी नियागट्ठी,उवचिट्ठे गुरुं सया"
english: "Traveler, you're not supposed to go anywhere. Anyway, You're supposed to be safe, Right? But your boss is." ""

prakrit: "आलवन्ते लवन्ते वा,न निसीऎज्ज कयाइ वि,चइऊणं आसनं धीरो,जओ जुत्तं पडिस्सुणे"
english: "Always be vigilant, never be negligent. Be careful not to fall into temptation. It's as if you're about to fall."

prakrit: "आसनगओ न पुच्छॆज्जा,नेव सॆज्जागओ कयाइ वी,आगम्मुक्कडुओ सन्तो,पुच्छिज्जा पञ्जलीउडो"
english: "Don't ask me why I'm sitting here. Try to arrange something else too. Please, don't be shy: Ask me what I want to eat."

prakrit: "एवं विनयजुत्तस्स,सुत्तं अत्थं च तदुभयं,पुच्छमाणस्स सीसस्स,वागरिज्ज जहासुयं"
english: "And politeness, subtlety and subtlety, And fearfulness, like asking questions, Are the weapons of the warrior."

prakrit: "मुसं परिहरे भिक्खू,न य ओहारिणिं वए,भासादोसं परिहरे,मायं च वज्जए सया"
english: "I am a bhikkhu without a parish, Not like a hermit, Like a lover without a lover, But like a wise man without a wife."

prakrit: "न लवॆज्ज पुट्ठो सावज्जं,न निरट्ठं न मम्मयं,अप्पणट्ठा परट्ठा वा,उभयस्सन्तरेण वा"
english: "Love is not torn to shreds, Nor is it frustrated or frustrated; It flows from one person to the next, From both directions."

prakrit: "समरेसु अगारेसुं,गिहसन्धीसु य महापहेसु,एगो एगत्थिए सद्धिं,नेव चिट्ठे न संलवे"
english: "Traveler, traveler, go to bed early, get up early, have a good laugh, go for a walk, and don't leave without writing a letter."

prakrit: "जं मे बुद्धाणुसासन्ति,सीएण फरुसेण वा,मम लाभो त्ति पेहाए,पयओ य तं पडिस्सुणे"
english: "What makes me wise, Friend, Makes me wretched, But really, what makes me poor Is what I get."

prakrit: "अनुसासनमोवायं,दुक्कडस्स य चोयणं,हियं तं मन्नए पण्णो,वेसं होइ असाहुणो"
english: "To follow a falsehood, To cheat on a bad one, Is to betray one's feelings; It is impossible to disguise oneself."

prakrit: "हियं विगयभया बुद्धा,फरुसम्पि अनुसासणं,वेसं तं होइ मूढाणं,खन्तिसोहिकरं पयं"
english: "Here is a wise Buddha, Pursuing righteousness, Like a foolish man in disguise, Who is won over by falsehood."

prakrit: "आसने उवचिट्ठॆज्जा,अणुच्चे अकुए थिरे,अप्पुट्ठाई निरुट्ठाई,निसीऎज्ज'प्पकुक्कुए"
english: "As soon as you touch her, You turn your back on her, When she turns her back on you, You become impatient, And when you turn away You turn away."

prakrit: "कालेण निक्खमे भिक्खू,कालेण य पडिक्कमे,कालं च विवज्जिता,काले कालं समायरे"
english: "In summer, the monk is free, in winter, the shepherd is free; in summer, time is free."

prakrit: "परिवाडीए न चिट्ठॆज्जा,भिक्खू दत्तेसणं चरे,पडिरूवेण एसित्ता,मियं कालेण भक्खए"
english: "The poor do not paint their houses, The monks steal their presents, The poor stay empty, The hungry stay for a while."

prakrit: "नाइदूरमणासन्ने,नन्नेसिं चक्खुफासओ,एगो चिट्ठॆज्ज भत्तट्ठा,लङ्घित्ता तं नइक्कमे"
english: "Nightmare, Foolish girl, Don't touch me if you don't want to."

prakrit: "नाइउच्चे व नीए वा,नासन्ने नाइदूरओ,फासुयं परकडं पिण्डं,पडिगाहॆज्ज सञ्जए"
english: "Get up and leave, Don't go out in the middle of the night, Hang on by the threads of the fence, Wait till you reach the river bank"

prakrit: "अप्पपाणे'प्पबीयंमि,पडिच्छन्नंमि संवुडे,समयं सञ्जए भुञ्जे,जयं अपरिसाडियं"
english: "I will drink water from the fire, I will lie down and rest, Time will heal me, Victory will be yours forever."

prakrit: "सुकडित्ति सुपक्कित्ति,सुच्छिन्ने सुहडे मडे,सुनिट्ठिए सुलद्धित्ति,सावज्जं वज्जए मुनी"
english: "A dry girl is a happy girl, A dry one is a pleasant one, A white one is smooth, A sharp one is wise."

prakrit: "रमए पण्डए सासं,हयं भद्दं व वाहए,बालं संमइ सासन्तो,गलियस्सं व वाहए"
english: "A merry mother-in-law makes love, A fierce one makes sighs, A calm one pacifies hair, And a violent one makes frowns."

prakrit: "खड्डुया मे चवेडा मे,अक्कोसा य वहा य मे,कल्लाणमनुसासन्तो,पावदिट्ठित्ति मन्नई"
english: "Khadduya mein cheveda mein, akosa yahi yaad, kallana manooson, pavadiditti mannai."

prakrit: "पुत्तो मे भाय नाइ त्ति,साहू कल्लाण मन्नई,पावदिटठि उ अप्पाणं,सासं दासे त्ति मन्नई"
english: "A son has no brothers, A brother-in-law respects a wife, A stepmother respects herself, A mother - in - law respects her servants."

prakrit: "न कोवए आयरियं,अप्पाणम्पि न कोवए,बुद्धोवघाई न सिया,न सिया तॊत्तगवेसए"
english: "One should not curse oneself, one should not grovel, one shouldn't sulk in front of one's friends, and one should never grovel under oneself."

prakrit: "आयरियं कुवियं नच्चा,पत्तिएण पसायए,विज्झवॆज्ज पञ्जलीउडो,वऎज्ज न पुणॊत्तिय"
english: "The wood shavings are bare, The cotton beds are spread wide, The panjaliwood is bright, The wind does not blow again."

prakrit: "धम्मज्जियं च ववहारं,बुद्धेहायरियं सया,तमायरन्तो ववहारं,गरहं नाभिगच्छई"
english: "Dharma is the supreme behavior, wisdom is supreme, behavior is eternal, the navel is bound to fall."

prakrit: "मनोगयं वक्कगयं,जाणित्तायरियस्स उ,तं परिगिज्झ वायाए,कम्मुणा उववायए"
english: "The mind is vacuous, the intellect is mature, the senses are attuned, the actions are eloquent."

prakrit: "वित्ते अचोइए निच्चं,खिप्पं हवइ सुचोइए,जहोवइट्ठं सुकयं,किच्चाइं कुव्वई सया"
english: "Finance alone is sufficient, Calmness is in the air, Jealousy is dry, But bitterness is the essence of goodness."

prakrit: "नच्चा नमइ मेहावी,लोए कित्ती से जायए,हवई किच्चाणं सरणं,भूयाणं जगई जहा"
english: "Nachcha namai mehavi, loye kiti se jaaye, hawai kichhaan saaran, bhuyanam jagai jaha."

prakrit: "पुज्जा जस्स पसीयन्ति,सम्बुद्धा पुव्वसन्थुया,पसन्ना लाभइस्सन्ति,विउलं अट्ठियं सुयं"
english: "Worshipers cherish jasmine flowers, Those who cherish wisdom find pleasure in making love, While the wind whirls the eighth needle."

prakrit: "स पुज्जसत्थे सुविनीयसंसए,मनोरुई चिट्ठइ कम्मसम्पया,तवोसमायारिसमाहिसंवुडे,महज्जुई पञ्च वयाइं पालिया"
english: "On the first day of her journey She carries a long sheet of gold, On the second night she writes poems, And on the third day she remembers her husband." ""

prakrit: "स देवगन्धव्वमनुस्सपुइए,चइत्तु देहं मलपङ्कपुव्वयं,सिद्धे वा हवइ सासए देवे आ अप्परए महिड्ढिए"
english: "He is the God of wisdom, The God of men, Whose body is like a garland of lotuses, Who is able to heal, Or who is possessed by a demon"

prakrit: "सुयं मे आउसं तेणं भगवया एवमक्खायं। इह खलु बावीसं परीसहा समणेणं भगवया महावीरेणं कासवेणं पवेइया. जे भिक्खू सॊच्चा नच्चा जिच्चा अभिभूय भिक्खायरियाए परिव्वयन्तो पुट्ठो नो विनिहन्नॆज्जा। कयरे खलु ते बावीसं परिसहा समणेणं भगवया महावीरेणं कासवेणं पवेइया,जे भिक्खू सॊच्चा नच्चा जिच्चा अभिभूयभिक्खायरियाए परिव्वयन्तो पुट्ठो नो विनिहन्नॆज्जा?"
english: "Come, let me make love to her. This girl is so beautiful That when she sees her husband The God of Love puts on a saffron bandage. When she sees him The monk dances seductively But does not answer her question. When he tries to kiss her face The god of love Put on his saffron bandages. If she does not dance well The monk is so captivated The girl's indignation Is enough to distract her." ""

prakrit: "इमे खलु ते बावीसं परिसहा समणेणं भगवया महावीरेणं कासवेणं पवेइया,जे भिक्खू सॊच्चा नच्चा जिच्चा अभिभूय भिक्खायरियाए परिव्वयन्तो पुट्ठो नो विनिहन्नॆज्जा; तं जहा-दिगिञ्छा-परीसहे,पिवासापरीसहे,सीयपरीसहे,उसिणपरीसहे,दंसमसगपरीसहे,अचेलपरीसहे,अरइपरीसहे,इत्थी-परीसहे,चरियापरीसहे,निसीहियापरीसहे,सॆज्जापरीसहे,अक्कोसपरीसहे,वहपरीसहे,जायणापरीसहे,अलाभपरीसहे,रोगपरीसहे,तणफासपरीसहे,जल्लपरीसहे,सक्कारपुरक्कारपरीसहे,पण्णापरीसहे,अन्नाण-परीसहे,दंसणपरीसहे."
english: "Here is another one:" "See how the God of Love compares: The monk dances like a man possessed by a demon, The begging bowl turned upside down, And the girl's breasts twine twine round her face." ""

prakrit: "परीसहाणं पविभत्ती,कासवेणं पवेइया,तं भे उदाहरिस्सामि,आनुपुव्विं सुणेह मे"
english: "Proud lady, The turtle has been born, I will give you an example. Then I will listen to you."

prakrit: "दिगिञ्छापरिगए देहे,तवस्सी भिक्खू थामवं,न छिन्दे न छिन्दावए न पए न पयावए"
english: "On the body above the horizon, The thirsty bhikkhu should be restrained, Not torn to shreds Nor groped for shelter."

prakrit: "कालीपव्वङ्गसङ्कासे,किसे धमनिसन्तए,मायन्नो असनपानस्स,अदीनमनसो चरे"
english: "To whom should one attribute purity, To whom is one attributing righteousness, Or else to selfishness, For the mind is deceitful."

prakrit: "तओ पुट्ठो पिवासाए,दोगुञ्च्छी लद्धसञ्जए,सीओदगं न सेविज्जा,वियडस्सेसणं चरे"
english: "Your back is smeared with soot, Your thighs are bristling, Your hips are shaking, You can't take care of yourself, You'd better stop being angry."

prakrit: "छिन्नावाएसु पन्थेसु,आउरे सुपिवासिए,परिसुक्कमुहे'दीने,तं तितिक्खे परीसहं"
english: "Slender people, Get away, Go and sleep well, Face to face with those bitter fairies."

prakrit: "चरन्तं विरयं लूहं,सीयं फुसइ एगया,नाइवेलं मुनी गच्छे,सॊच्चाणं जिनसासनं"
english: "The wind whirls the ship, The sea is rough, The canoe is sagging, The sails are slipping, The sky is slipping."

prakrit: "न मे निवारणं अत्थि छवित्ताणं न विज्जई,अहं तु अग्गिं सेवामि,इइ भिक्खू न चिन्तए"
english: "I will not harm you, neither will I hurt your feelings. I will serve you with fire. So do not worry, monk." ""

prakrit: "उसिणं परियावेणं,परिदाहेण तज्जिए,घिंसु वा परियावेणं,सायं नो परिदेवए"
english: "Wet and fragrant, Tender as a feast, Rough or fragrant as a pastime; There is no god but the evening."

prakrit: "उण्हाहितत्ते मेहावी,सिणाणं नो वि पत्थए,गायं नो परिसिञ्चॆज्जा,न वीऎज्जा य अप्पयं"
english: "Love without violence, Love without pathos, Kindred without affection, Friend without jealousy or anger."

prakrit: "पुट्ठो य दंसमसएहिं,समरे व महामुनी,नागो सङ्गामसीसे वा,सूरो अभिभवे परं"
english: "Putto ya dansamasa, samara ya maha muni, nago sangamasisa va, suru abhibhave par." ""

prakrit: "न सन्तसे न वारॆज्जा,मनं पि न पओसए,उवेहे न हणे पाणे,भुञ्जन्ते मंससोणियं"
english: "There is no separation from the soul, No separation between the soul and the body, No strife between the two."

prakrit: "परिजुण्णेहिं वत्थेहिं,हॊक्खामि त्ति अचेलए,अदुवा सचेलए हॊक्खं,इइ भिक्खू न चिन्तए"
english: "Traveler, I've come a long way, But traveler, don't be so hasty: This monk doesn't care."

prakrit: "एगया'चेलए होइ,सचेले यावि एगया,एयं धम्महियं नच्चा,नाणी नो परिदेवए"
english: "One who follows a certain dharma dances according to it, The true follower follows the false, The false is not a deity."

prakrit: "गामाणुगामं रीयन्तं,अनगारं अकिञ्चनं,अरई अनुप्पवेसॆज्जा,तं तितिक्खे परीसहं"
english: "The village street is deserted, The streets are empty, The roads are deserted, And the streets are deserted."

prakrit: "अरइं पिट्ठओ किच्चा,विरए आयरक्खिए,धम्मारामे निरारम्भे,उवसन्ते मुनी चरे"
english: "They turn their backs on one another, Protect one's actions from another, Begin with non - observance of dharma; Suddenly sages appear."

prakrit: "सङ्गो एस मणूसाणं,जाओ लोगंमि इत्थिओ,जस्स एया परिन्नाय,सुकडं तस्स सामण्णं"
english: "Go, join us. I will join you here. For what's left of this marriage Is as good as dried up."

prakrit: "एवमादाय मेहावी,पङ्कभूया उ इत्थिओ,नो ताहिं विनिहन्नॆज्जा,चरॆज्जत्तगवेसए"
english: "Such a gentleman, Proud of his position, Wouldn't mind leaving it at that. It's just the way things are"

prakrit: "एग एव चरे लाढे,अभिभूय परीसहे,गामे वा नगरे वा'वि,निगमे वा रायहाणिए"
english: "Eggs and greased rice, Overwhelmed by the fairies, In village or town The wind blows, In corporations or royalty."

prakrit: "असमाणे चरे भिक्खू,नेव कुज्जा परिग्गहं,असंसत्ते गिहत्थेहिं,अनिएओ परिव्वए"
english: "As many as four monks, Never cross one's path, Never fall into confusion; On the other hand, they travel in circles."

prakrit: "सुसाणे सुन्नगारे वा,रुक्खमूले य एगओ,अकुक्कुओ निसीऎज्जा,न य वित्तासए परं"
english: "A good man prays when he is sleepy, An egg is hatched from a tree's root, Aunt, he does not weep, Nor is there room for another."

prakrit: "तत्थ से चिट्ठमाणस्स,उवसग्गे'भिधारए,सङ्कामीओ न गच्छॆज्जा,उट्ठित्ता अन्नमासनं"
english: "There you are, Trembling with excitement, Wrapped in a blanket, Running out of fuel." ""

prakrit: "उच्चावयाहिं सॆज्जाहिं,तवस्सी भिक्खू थामवं,नाइवेलं विहन्निज्जा,पावदिट्ठी विहन्नई"
english: "Take it easy, you stubborn monk. Give it a try! One can make a fire with a hoe, One can pierce a step with a twig."

prakrit: "पइरिक्कुवस्सयं लद्धुं,कल्लाणं अदुव पावयं,किमेगराइं करिस्सइ?,एवं तत्थ'हियासए"
english: "Try to fight the anger, Try to stop it, Try not to get angry. How can you help it?" - And then there's Hiyasa.

prakrit: "अक्कोसॆज्जा परो भिक्खुं,न तेसिं पडिसञ्जले,सरिसो होइ बालाण,तम्हा भिक्खू न सञ्जले"
english: "Be a good monk all the time, Not like that in your neighborhood, Always like that, Never be a bad monk."

prakrit: "सॊच्चाणं फसुसा भासा,दारुणा गामकण्टगा,तुसिणीओ उवेहॆज्जा,न ताओ मनसीकरे"
english: "Speak plainly, be courteous, speak village slang, be polite to your wives; you have no reason to be conceited."

prakrit: "हओ न सञ्जले भिक्खू,मनम्पि न पओसए,तितिक्खं परमं नच्चा,भिक्खू धम्मं समायरे"
english: "Be not a bhikkhu in a dream, be not possessed by desire, for thenceforth there is the highest dance; bhikkhus abide by dharma."

prakrit: "समणं सञ्जयं दन्तं,हणिज्जा को'वि कत्थवि,नत्थि जीवस्स नासुत्ति,एवं पेहॆज्ज सञ्जए"
english: "One must control one's teeth, one must control the energies of the body, and one must not control the passions of others."

prakrit: "दुक्करं खलु भो! निच्चं,अनगारस्स भिक्खुणो,सव्वं से जाइयं होइ,नत्थि किञ्चि अजाइयं"
english: "It's hard work! Come on, you nasty monk. Everything must go smoothly. Nothing is impossible." ""

prakrit: "गोयरग्गपविट्ठस्स,हत्थे नो सुप्पसारए,सेओ अगारवासुत्ति,इइ भिक्खु न चिन्तए"
english: "The cowherd is pious, There is no need to sleep on his hands, He is a poor man's servant; This monk has nothing to worry about."

prakrit: "परेसु घासमेसॆज्जा,भोयणे परिनिट्ठिए,लद्धे पिण्डे अलद्धे वा,नाणुतप्पॆज्ज पण्डिए"
english: "Look! The grass is sown, The fields are tilled, The trees are rooted, The paddy fields are strewn with reeds, And the rivers are swollen."

prakrit: "अज्जेवाहं न लब्भामि,अवि लाभो सुए सिया,जो एवं पडिसञ्चिक्खे,अलाभो तं न तज्जए"
english: "I see no cause for regret, For if I had, He would have put me to sleep: The more I see of my relatives, The thinner it would have been."

prakrit: "नच्चा उप्पइयं दुक्खं,वेयणाए दुहट्ठिए,अदीनो ठावए पन्नं,पुट्ठो तत्थहियासए"
english: "Not so long ago there was sorrow, Now there are quarrels, Now the page is stuck, Then the sheet is still there."

prakrit: "तेगिच्छं नाभिनन्दॆज्जा,सञ्चिक्ख'त्तगवेसए,एवं खु तस्स सामण्णं,जं न कुज्जा न कारवे"
english: "That the navel should rejoice, The purse should be carried, And the bow should bow before him Who does not cause embarrassment."

prakrit: "अचेलगस्स लूहस्स,सञ्जयस्स तविस्सणो,तणेसु सुयमाणस्स,हुज्जा गायविराहणा"
english: "Sudden outbursts of anger, Procrastination for pleasure, Suicide for tenderness's sake, And anger for being absent from one's life."

prakrit: "आयवस्स निवाएणं,अउला हवइ वेयणा,एवं नच्चा न सेवन्ति,तन्तुजं तणतज्जिया"
english: "Lifting the age, blowing the wind, And not dancing - That's just the way it is." ""

prakrit: "किलिन्नगाए मेहावी,पङ्केण व रएण वा,घिंसु वा परियावेणं,सायं नो परिदेवए"
english: "May the clouds roam, The rivers flow, The nights are long, There is no god but the moon."

prakrit: "वेऎज्ज निज्जरापेही,आरियं धम्म'नुत्तरं,जाव सरीरभेउत्ति,जल्लं काएण धारए"
english: "Wayfarer, Stop your anger, go and shake your body. Why waste your time in jingling?"

prakrit: "अभिवायणं अब्भुट्ठाणं,सामी कुज्जा निमन्तणं,जे ताइं पडिसेवन्ति,न तेसिं पीहए मुनी"
english: "Praise be to the God of Love, An invitation to good people Who will serve him, Not to sages who are jealous of him."

prakrit: "अणुक्कसाई अप्पिच्छे,अन्नाएसी अलोलुए,रसेसु नानुगिज्झॆज्जा,नानुतप्पॆज्ज पन्नवं"
english: "Anukkasayi appichchhe, annaisi alolue, rasaesu nanugizhajja, nanutappejjj pannavam"

prakrit: "से नूनं मए पुव्वं,कम्मा'नाणफला कडा,जेणाहं नाभिजाणामि,पुट्ठो केणइ कण्हुई"
english: "That spice is my poison, Karma's nectar is bitter, But as for me, I don't know how to brush my teeth."

prakrit: "अह पच्छा उइज्जन्ति,कम्मा'नाणफला कडा,एवमस्सासि अप्पाणं,नच्चा कम्मविवागयं"
english: "Ah, the past is bright, Karma's fruit is bitter, Eternal life is selfish, Without a dance the flow of karma."

prakrit: "निरट्ठगंमि विरओ,मेहुणाओ सुसंवुडो,जो सक्खं नाभिजाणामि,धम्मं कल्लाण पावगं"
english: "I refrain from going out, I embrace what is good, I renounce what is bad, I pursue what is right."

prakrit: "तवोवहाणमादाय,पडिमं पडिवज्जओ,एवं पि विहरओ मे,छउमं न नियट्टई"
english: "You deceive me, I beg of you, And you deceive you: Do not touch me, my dear, While I am abroad."

prakrit: "नत्थि नूनं परे लोए,इड्ढी वा'वी तवस्सिणो,अदुवा वञ्चिओ मित्ति,इइ भिक्खू न चिन्तए"
english: "No need to get angry. This wretched man is also thirsty. Friend, don't worry about this monk." ""

prakrit: "अभू जिणा अत्थि जिणा,अदुवा'वि भविस्सई,मुसं ते एवमाहंसु,इइ भिक्खू न चिन्तए"
english: "Wretched soul, This monk must not think so much as tell me something nasty."

prakrit: "एए परीसहा सव्वे,कासवेण पवेइया,जे भिक्खू न विहम्मॆज्जा,पुट्ठो केणइ कण्हुई"
english: "Oh! fairies, all of you! A turtle has fallen, Those who are not monks Are delirious. Whom else can one ask for?"

prakrit: "चत्तारि परमङ्गाणि दुल्लहाणिह जन्तुणो,माणुसत्तं सुई सद्धा,सञ्जमंमि य वीरीयं"
english: "The hearth is supreme, The bow is powerful, The human heart is sharp, I am fearful, And the senses are powerful."

prakrit: "समावन्नाण संसारे,नाणागॊत्तासु जाइसु,कम्मा नानाविहा कट्ठु,पुढो विस्सम्भया पया"
english: "In this world of ours, Be careful not to get caught up in gossip, For actions take many forms. Let the foolish be led astray."

prakrit: "एगया देवलोएसु,नरएसु वि एगया,एगया आसुरं कायं,अहाकम्मेहिं गच्छई"
english: "Either the gods are angry, or the men are. Either the asuras are angry or they are jealous."

prakrit: "एगया खत्तिओ होइ,तओ चण्डालबुक्कसो,तओ कीडपयङ्गो य,तओ कुन्थुपिपीलिया"
english: "Be carefull here, you crook, you worm, you hunchback."

prakrit: "एवमावट्टजोणीसु,पाणिणो कम्मकिव्विसा,न निविज्जन्ति संसारे,सव्वट्ठेसु व खत्तिया"
english: "Such stubborn women, Worker than water, Destroy not the whole world: They are won over by gossip and gossip."

prakrit: "कम्मसङ्गेहिं संमूढा,दुक्खिया बहुवेयणा,अमाणुसासु जोणीसु,विनिहम्मन्ति पाणिणो"
english: "One who is absorbed in karma is closed, one who is sorrowful is often distracted, One who has no feelings at all is immovable."

prakrit: "कम्माणं तु पहाणाए,आनुपुव्वी कयाइ उ,जीवा सोहिमनुप्पत्ता,आययन्ति मणुस्सयं"
english: "What have you to do? Come, make your bed. Life is precious Except for the humans Who come."

prakrit: "मानुस्सं विग्गहं लद्धुं,सुई धम्मस्स दुल्लहा,जं सॊच्चा पडिवज्जन्ति,तवं खन्तिमहिंसयं"
english: "Man must fight evil, The needle must pierce dharma, For what is true is false, And what is false Must result in violence."

prakrit: "आहच्च सवणं लद्धुं,सद्धा परमदुल्लहा,सॊच्चा नेआउयं मग्गं,बहवे परिभस्सई"
english: "Suddenly the hunter is in a fight, The truth is supreme, The path is smooth, The road is meandering."

prakrit: "सुइं च लद्धुं सद्धं च,वीरियं पुण दुल्लहं,बहवे रोयमाणावि,नो य णं पडिवज्जए"
english: "They lie still, They fight bravely, They twitch violently, They cry bitterly, They make no bones."

prakrit: "मानुसत्तंमि आयाओ,जो धम्मं सॊच्चा सद्दहे,तवस्सी वीरीयं लद्धुं,संवुडे निद्धुणे रयं"
english: "Come, my man; may the righteous rejoice, may the brave fight on. May the sun find rest in your heart."

prakrit: "सोही उज्जुयभूयस्स,धम्मो सुद्धस्स चिट्ठई,निव्वाणं परमं जाइ,घयसित्तिव्व पावए"
english: "She illuminates the whole scene, Writes the dharma in all its purity, Proves the supreme truth, Gives satisfaction to the wounded."

prakrit: "विगिञ्च कम्मुणो हेउं,जसं सञ्चिणु खन्तिए,सरीरं पाढवं हिच्चा,उड्ढं पक्कमई दिसं"
english: "I have to act as if I were a bird, To grasp at its body As if it were a tree, To fly in the opposite direction."

prakrit: "विसालिसेहिं सीलेहिं,जक्खा उत्तरउत्तरा,महासुक्का व दिप्पन्ता,मन्नन्ता अपुणॊच्चयं"
english: "Sealing the vast expanse, Destroying the horizon, The great deep and the great deep, Recognizing the unattainable."

prakrit: "अप्पिया देवकामाणं,कामरुव विउव्विणो,उड्ढं कप्पेसु चिट्ठन्ति,पुव्वा वाससया बहू"
english: "Appiah is the god of love, The woodcutter is a beauty to behold, And the doe is painted all over With white robes." ""

prakrit: "तत्थ ठिच्चा जहाठाणं,जक्खा आउक्खए चुया,उवॆन्ति मानुसं जोणिं,से दसङ्गे'भिजायई"
english: "Wherever you look, There's a lot of smoke rising From the fire That consumes the water." "That's the way humans live."

prakrit: "खॆत्तं वत्थुं हिरण्णं च,पसवो दासपोरुसं,चत्तारि कामखन्धाणि,तत्थ से उववज्जई"
english: "The plowman's son is a stag and a deer, The ox is a servant boy, The shepherd's daughter is an object of desire; Thereby she is rewarded."

prakrit: "मित्तवं नायवं होइ,उच्चागोए य वण्णवं,अप्पायङ्के महापन्ने,अभिजाए जसोबले"
english: "A friend is a hero, A lover is a gentleman, A gentleman is great in his own right, And a gentleman is just the way people are."

prakrit: "भॊच्चा माणुस्सए भोए,अप्पडिरुवे अहाउयं,पुव्विं विसुद्धसद्धम्मे,केवलं बोहि बुज्झिया"
english: "The poor man is hungry, The poor woman is thirsty, The whole world is in a state of confusion, Only the wise are able to understand."

prakrit: "चउरङ्गं दुल्लहं नच्चा,सञ्जमं पडिवज्जिया,तवसा धुयकम्मंसे,सिद्धे हवइ सासए"
english: "Through the fire of love, Through dance, Through song, Through sacrifice, Through penance, To attain purity, Mother - in - law."

prakrit: "असङ्खयं जीवियं मा पमायए,जरोवणीयस्स हु नत्थि ताणं,एवं वियाणाहि जणे पमत्ते,किण्णु विहिंसा अजया गहिन्ति"
english: "Do not trouble yourself by living an uncertain life; I am not violent enough, And someone who is angry is not worthy of being angry."

prakrit: "जे पावकम्मेहिं घनं मनूस्सा,समाययन्ती अमइं गहाय,पहाय ते पासपयट्टिए नरे,वेरानुबद्धा नरयं उवॆन्ति"
english: "Those who walk in silence Are won over by loud noises, Those who travel by foot Are stung by jealousy, And those who sit astray by resentment."

prakrit: "तेणे जहा सन्धिमुहे गहीए,सकम्मुणा किच्चइ पावकारी,एवं पया पॆच्च इहं च लोए,कडाण कम्माण न मॊक्खो अत्थि"
english: "In the world to come, Where there is no end to suffering, There are good men who make misfortune their own, And there are bad men who gain no redemption."

prakrit: "संसारमावन्न परस्स अट्ठा,साहारणं जं च करेइ कम्मं,कम्मस्स ते तस्स उ वेयकाले,न बन्धवा बन्धवयं उवॆन्ति"
english: "The mind of the world is dependent on others, Whatever one does should be supported by actions; actions should be directed towards one another; There is no room for relatives or friends."

prakrit: "वित्तेण ताणं न लभे पमत्ते,इमंमि लोए अदुवा परत्था,दीवप्पणट्ठे व अनन्तमोहे,नेयाउयं दट्ठुमदट्ठुमेव"
english: "The seeds will not find their place in the jars, For the fire will return in one fell swoop, Like the flame of a lamp in an endless flame, Unless one sees it with the naked eye."

prakrit: "सुत्तेसु यावी पडिबुद्धजीवी,नो वीससे पण्डिए आसुपन्ने,घोरा मुहुत्ता अबलं सरीरं,भारण्डपखीव चरे'पमत्तो"
english: "You sleep well, You stay awake, You don't need to lie down on your back, You wander, you moan, You twitch, You squirm, Your body is immovable, Your limbs are like a flock of parrots."

prakrit: "चरे पयाइं परिसङ्कमाणो,जं किञ्चि पासं इह मन्नमाणो,लाभन्त्तरे जीवियं बूहइता,पच्छा परिन्नायमलावधंसी"
english: "All four of us are on good terms, Whatever we have is our belief, Life goes on for ever and ever. But you, dear friend, Have to go through the ordeal of divorce."

prakrit: "छन्दं निरोहेण उवेइ मॊक्खं,आसे जहा सिक्खियवम्मधारी,पुव्वाइं वासाइं चरे'प्पमत्तो,तम्हा मुनी खिप्पमुवेइ मॊक्खं"
english: "He who stops to rhyme opens the mouth, Who comes dressed as a Sikh bridegroom, Who pastures the flowers of the field," Says the sage. "His mouth quivers."

prakrit: "स पुव्वमेवं न लभॆज्ज पच्छा,एसोवमा सासयवाइयाणं,विसीयई सिढिले आउयम्मि,कालोवणीए सरीरस्स भेए"
english: "She is like a mother in law, With eyes like these redolent of flowers, Coming down the steep stairs In such a way That she looks like a woman in black."

prakrit: "खिप्पं न सक्केइ विवेगमेउं,तम्हा समुट्ठाय पहाय कामे,समिच्च लोयं समया महेसी,आयाणरक्खी व चरे'प्पमत्तो"
english: "Knowledge alone will not suffice, Deceit will not satisfy you, Love in due course will satisfy all desires, For greed is the enemy of good and evil."

prakrit: "मुहुं मुहुं मोहगुणे जयन्तं,अनेगरूवा समणं चरन्तं,फासा फुसन्ति असमञ्जसं च,न तेसिं भिक्खू मनसा पउस्से"
english: "Love conquers all virtues, Friendship embraces many, Greed festers and disharmony prevails; Not so much the mind of a monk."

prakrit: "मन्दा य फासा बहुलोहणिज्जा,तहप्पगारेसु मनं न कुज्जा,रक्खिज्ज कोहं विणऎज्ज माणं,मायं न सेवॆज्ज पहॆज्ज लोहं"
english: "A poor man's heart is made up of many vessels, A miser's mind does not corrupt itself When he sits on it, A coward's bow is woven around his neck, And iron is not my service."

prakrit: "जे सङ्खया तुच्छपरप्पवाई,ते पिज्जदोसानुगया परज्झा,एए अहम्मे त्ति दुगुञ्छमाणो,कङ्खे गुणे जाव सरीरभेउ"
english: "One who is treated with contempt, Is burdened with resentment, Is ashamed of one's pride; One's virtue is to gain weight."

prakrit: "अन्नवंसि महॊघंसि,एगे तिण्णे दुरुत्तरे,तत्थ एगे महापन्ने,इमं पण्हमुदाहरे"
english: "Here are three adversaries, There is one great power, In this is the ocean of wealth."

prakrit: "सन्तिमे य दुवे ठाणा,अक्खाया मारणन्तिया,अकाममरणं चेव,सकाममरणं तहा"
english: "There are two ways to live: One is to die, the other is to suffer, The other is only to die."

prakrit: "बालाणं अकामं तु,मरणं असइं भवे,पण्डियाणं सकामं तु,उक्कोसेण सइं भवे"
english: "You alone are worthless, Death is inevitable, Friendship is possible, Love is certain."

prakrit: "तत्थिमं पढमं ठाणं,महावीरेण देसियं,कामगिद्धे जहा बाले,भिसं कूराइं कुव्वई"
english: "Thence the first column, thence the Desyam by the Mahavira, as the young boy walks to and fro among the maidens; for verily the cowherd has quivered."

prakrit: "जे गिद्धे कामभोगेसु,एगे कूडाय गच्छई,न मे दिट्ठे परे लोए,चक्खुदिट्ठा इमा रई"
english: "If you want to have sex with a vulture, Go ahead, don't look at me, It's only because I see you."

prakrit: "हत्थागया इमे कामा,कालिया जे अनागया,को जाणइ परे लोए,अत्थि वा नत्थि वा पुणो?"
english: "I have kama in my hand, Kaliya in my heart, Who knows what else? It's the world, Not here, Not there, Not again."

prakrit: "जनेन सद्धिं हॊक्खामि,इइ बाले पगब्भई,कामभोगानुराएणं,केसं सम्पडिवज्जई"
english: "To whom I bow my head, At whose feet I bend, In love's quest, In wealth I yield."

prakrit: "तओ से दण्डं समारभई,तसेसु थावरेसु य,अट्ठाए य अणट्ठाए,भूयगामं विहिंसई"
english: "The punishment is finished by you, So be it, or else the land will fall into disrepair."

prakrit: "हिंसे बाले मुसावाई,माइल्ले पिसुणे सढे,भुञ्जमाणे सुरं मंसं,सेयमेयं ति मन्नई"
english: "Violence begets jealousy, Greed leads to slander, Sweat fills the heart with resentment, And disharmony begets dishonor."

prakrit: "कायसा वयसा मत्ते,वित्ते गिद्धे य इत्थिसु,दुहओ मलं सञ्चिणइ,सिसुनागु व्व मट्टियं"
english: "How old is the matte, The vulture licks at the seed, The couple gathers the faeces, The sesame seed is the clay."

prakrit: "तओ पुट्ठो आयङ्केणं,गिलाणो परितप्पई,पभीओ परलोगस्स,कम्माणुप्पेहि अप्पणो"
english: "You stupid girl, Are you ready for the challenge? It's your stomach that's bothering you, Your thighs are slipping, Your face is drooping, And your body is slipping."

prakrit: "सुया मे नरए ठाणा,असीलाणं च जा गई,बालाणं कूरकम्माणं,पगाढा जत्थ वेयणा"
english: "The needle has lodged in my nail, And the nail is gone, The nail marks the tip of the nail, The turban is tied tightly."

prakrit: "तत्थोववाइयं ठाणं,जहा मेयमनुस्सुयं,अहाकम्मेहिं गच्छन्तो,सो पच्छा परितप्पई"
english: "Wherever a good man goes, There he will always find a past."

prakrit: "जहा सागडिओ जाणं,समं हिच्चा महापहं,विसमं मग्गमोइण्णो,अक्खे भग्गंमि सोयई"
english: "As far as I know the sea is great, The ocean is vast, The road is bumpy, I can't sleep."

prakrit: "एवं धम्मं विउक्कम्मं,अहम्मं पडिवज्जिया,बाले मच्चुमुहं पत्ते,अक्खे भग्गे व सोयई"
english: "And dharma is wisdom, pride is vanity, fair faces are leaves, The eye is broken, And the sleeper is asleep."

prakrit: "तओ से मरणन्तंमि,बाले सन्तसई भया,अकाम मरणं मरई,धुत्ते व कलिणा जिए"
english: "With you I go on dying, with you I am content, without you I die, With you the dhutta and the kalina live."

prakrit: "एयं अकाममरणं,बालाणं तु पवेइयं,ऎत्तो सकाममरणं,पण्डियाणं सुणेह मे"
english: "It's a sudden death, you silly girl, Get up and die, Listen to the pandits." ""

prakrit: "मरणं पि सपुण्णाणं,जहा मेयमनुस्सुयं,विप्पसण्णमनाघायं,सञ्जयाण वुसीमओ"
english: "Even death is enlightening, Wherever there is love, There is sorrow, And wherever there is remorse, There also is triumph."

prakrit: "न इमं सव्वेसु भिक्खूसु,न इमं सव्वेसु गारिसु,नानासीला गारत्था,विसमसीला य भिक्खुणो"
english: "Not all of them are bhikkus, not all of us are garus, There is no such thing as a helpless wife, There are no such things as helpless monks."

prakrit: "सन्ति एगेहिं भिक्खूहिं,गारत्था सञ्जमुत्तरा,गारत्थेहि य सव्वेहिं,साहवो सञ्जमुत्तरा"
english: "Beings and monks alike, Mothers and sisters - in all walks of life, Saints and wives - are the pillars of sanjumutra."

prakrit: "चीराजिणं नगिणिणं,जडी सङ्घाडि मुण्डिणं,एयाइं वि न तायन्ति,दुस्सीलं परियागयं"
english: "Cheerful women weep, Tears flow down their cheeks, Young men shake their heads, Yet they make no attempt to escape."

prakrit: "पिण्डोलए व्व दुस्सीले,नरगाओ न मुच्चई,भिक्खाए वा गिहत्थे वा,सुव्वए कम्मई दिवं"
english: "The plowman is wicked, The ox is not shut up, The begging bowl is empty, Or the street is empty; Every good day is a working day."

prakrit: "अगारिसामाइयङ्गाइं,सढ्ढी काएण फासए,पोसहं दुहओ पक्खं,एगरायं न हावए"
english: "Straightforward women, Hang on by their slender necks, Wear bright hats, And don't be negligent."

prakrit: "एवं सिक्खासमावन्ने,गिहिवासे वि सुव्वए,मुच्चई छविपव्वाओ,गच्छे जक्खसलोगयं"
english: "And the monsters in the forest, Though they live in darkness, Sleep soundly, Hold on to an image, For fear they will be destroyed."

prakrit: "अह जे संवुडे भिक्खू,दॊण्हं अन्नयरे सिया,सव्व दुक्खपहीणे वा,देवे वा'वि महिड्ढिए"
english: "Ah! the monks at dawn, Stupid as they are at other times, All without sorrow. May the gods also be glorified!"

prakrit: "उत्तराइं विमोहाइं,जुईमन्ताणुपुव्वसो,समाइण्णाइं जक्खेहिं,आवासाइं जसंसिणो"
english: "The streets are deserted, The rivers are swollen, The roads are impassable, The houses are empty."

prakrit: "दीहाउया इड्ढिमन्ता,समिद्धा कामरुविणो,अहुणोववन्नसङ्कासा,भुज्जो अच्चिमालिप्पभा"
english: "Long - eyed girl, Straightforward businesswoman, Unsure how long you'll be away, Your arms hanging loose around your face."

prakrit: "ताणि ठाणाणिं गच्छन्ति,सिक्खित्ता सञ्जमं तवं,भिक्खाए वा गिहित्थे वा,जे सन्ति परिनिव्वुडा"
english: "They go to the thana, They learn meditation, They become monks, Or they become priests. Those who remain, Fulfill their vows."

prakrit: "तेसिं सॊच्चा सपुज्जाणं,सञ्जयाण वुसीमओ,न सन्तसन्ति मरणन्ते,सीलवन्ता बहुस्सुया"
english: "Their dreams are pure, The pleasures of love are fleeting, Those of contentment do not die, Silly men are many."

prakrit: "तुलिया विसेसमादाय,दयाधम्मस्स खन्तिए,विप्पसीऎज्ज मेहावी,तहाभूएण अप्पणा"
english: "Libra is compassionate, Compassionate, Kindhearted, Majestic, Loving your neighbor as yourself."

prakrit: "तओ काले अभिप्पेए,सढ्ढी तालिसमन्तिए,विणऎज्ज लोमहरिसं,भेयं देहस्स कङ्खए"
english: "You black eyed girl, Straightforward claptrap, Weaved hair like a bow, Scorched by the arrows of the God of Love"

prakrit: "अह कालंमि सम्पत्ते,आघायाय समुस्सयं,सकाममरणं मरई,तिण्हमन्नयरं मुनी"
english: "Ah, the passage of time is wealth, The passage of life is suffering, And death is certain; There is no sage like a good man."

prakrit: "जावन्त'विज्जा पुरिसा,सव्वे ते दुक्खसम्भवा,लुप्पन्ति बहुसो मूढा,संसारंमि अनन्तए"
english: "The wise are few, All who know how to hide their faults Are few, And the foolish are many. The world is infinite."

prakrit: "समिक्ख पण्डिए तम्हा,पास जाईपहे बहू,अप्पणा सच्चमेसॆज्जा,मेतिं भूएसु कप्पए"
english: "Friend, tell me, When you pass by Your daughter - in - law's house, Tell her the truth, And bow before her lovers."

prakrit: "माया पिया ण्हुसा भाया,भज्जा पुत्ता य ओरसा,नालं ते मम ताणाए,लुप्पन्तस्स सकम्मुणा"
english: "Maya, you silly girl, Don't touch me if you don't want to. Can't you just hide your feelings?"

prakrit: "एयमट्ठं सपेहाए,पासे समियदंसणे,चिन्ध गेहिं सिणेहं च,न कङ्खे पुव्वसन्थुयं"
english: "Look at that tree, At the fleeting glances of a man, At his wife's breasts, And do not touch the flower of her bracelet."

prakrit: "गवासं मणिकुण्डलं,पसवो दासपोरुसं,सव्वमेयं चइत्ताणं,कामरूवी भविस्ससि"
english: "The cow is the jasmine, the ox is the servant boy, everything is hunted down, you lazy bitch."

prakrit: "थावरं जङ्गमं चेव,धणं धन्नं उवक्खरं,पच्चमाणस्स कम्मेहिं,नालं दुक्खाओ मोअणे"
english: "Wealth makes a man happy, Jealousy makes him wealthy, Greed makes him miserable, And ignorance makes him wretched."

prakrit: "अज्झत्थं सव्वओ सव्वं,दिस्स पाणे पियाउए,न हणे पाणिणो पाणे,भयवेराओ उवरए"
english: "In the world we live in harmony: Everyone is equal, The one who sees is drunk, the one who drinks is not, And the other is not."

prakrit: "आयाणं नरयं दिस्स,नायऎज्ज तणामवि,दोगुञ्छी अप्पणो पाए,दिन्नं भुञ्जॆज्ज भोयणं"
english: "Come, let us look at the fire, Not at the grasshopper, But at the doe finding herself."

prakrit: "इहमेगे उ मन्नन्ति,अप्पच्चक्खाय पावगं,आयरियं विदित्ताणं,सव्वदुक्खा विमुच्चई"
english: "Here they confide, Unsuspecting wretch, Traveler, All sorrow is banished."

prakrit: "भणन्ता अकरॆन्ता य बन्धमॊक्खपइण्णिणो,वायाविरियमॆत्तेण,समासासॆन्ति अप्पयं"
english: "Speak nonsense, Speak indecently, Use your lips as a mask, Make noise with your tongue, And speak plainly."

prakrit: "न चित्ता तायए भासा,कुओ विज्जानुसासनं?,विसन्ना पावकम्मेहिं,बाला पण्डियमाणिणो"
english: "No thought left, Speak the language, Is there any knowledge left?," "Wretchedness is the remit of a poor man's business." ""

prakrit: "जे केई सरीरे सत्ता,वण्णे रुवे य सव्वसो,मनसा कायवक्केणं,सव्वे ते दुक्खसम्भवा"
english: "Whatever the body possesses, Whatever the mind possesses, All are capable of suffering."

prakrit: "आवन्ना दीहमद्धाणं,संसारंमि अनन्तए,तम्हा सव्वदिसं पस्सं,अप्पमत्तो परिव्वए"
english: "Come, long - suffering, my world is endless; To you, all days must pass; Always be devoting yourself."

prakrit: "बहिया उड्ढमादाय,नावकङ्खे कयाइ वि,पुव्वकम्मक्खयट्ठाए,इमं देहं उदाहरे"
english: "The bird flies high, The canoe bends low, The flower beaks bend downward; This is the example of the body."

prakrit: "विविच्च कम्मुणो हेउं,कालकङ्खी परिव्वए,मायं पिण्डस्स पाणस्स,कडं लद्धूण भक्खए"
english: "I have different actions, Time flies, My body is full of water, When will I break my fast?"

prakrit: "सन्निहिं च न कुव्वॆज्जा,लेवमायाए सञ्जए,पक्खी पत्तं समादाय,निरवॆक्खो परिव्वए"
english: "Friendship is not an excuse, Love is not a punishment, The bird welcomes the leaf, The fool is not deceived."

prakrit: "एसणासमिओ लज्ज,गामे अनियओ चरे,अप्पमत्तो पमत्तेहिं,पिण्डवायं गवेसए"
english: "Such is the shame of marriage; in the village the uncouth roam free. But if you ask me what it is to be married I shall tell you the truth."

prakrit: "एवं से उदाहु अनुत्तरनाणी,अनुत्तरदंसी अणुत्तरनाण,दंसणधरे अरहा नायपुत्ते,भगवं वेसालिए वियाहिए"
english: "And that example is that of the unresponsive dancer, That of the unanswerable seer, Who, hiding behind a toothache, Destroys the path of the God of Love."

prakrit: "जहा''एसं समुद्दिस्स,कोइ पोसॆज्ज एलयं,ओयणं जवसं दॆज्जा,पोसॆज्जावि सयङ्गणे"
english: "As in," "There's the sea, Somebody to dress, Someplace to give advice, A yard to be dressed." ""

prakrit: "तओ से पुट्ठे परिवूढे,जायमेए मुहोदरे,पीणिए विउले देहे,आएसं परिकङ्खए"
english: "Whom are you looking out for? Your face, my dear, Drunken body, Looks just like this."

prakrit: "जाव न एइ आएसे,ताव जीवइ से'दुही,अह पत्तंमि आएसे,सीसं छॆत्तूण भुज्जई"
english: "Go, do not come! It hurts to be alive Anyway, Come, come, go, Foolish girl, The roof of the house will collapse."

prakrit: "जहा से खलु उरब्भे,आएसाए समीहिए,एवं बाले अहंमिट्ठे,ईहति नरयाउयं"
english: "From where the plow grows, To where we meet, And from where the boy's ego meets, This is the path to hell."

prakrit: "हिंसे बाले मुसावाई,अद्धाणंमि विलोवए,अन्नदत्तहरे तेणे,माइ कं नु हरे सढे"
english: "Violence begets withering, selfishness begets willow, the giver of food begets it, My karma is not green."

prakrit: "इत्थीविसयगिद्धे य,महारम्भपरिग्गहे,भुञ्जमाणे सुरं मंसं,परिवूढे परन्दमे"
english: "Here and there on the Vindhya Giddha, With great ecstasy, The mind hums like a drum, Moving around in a circle."

prakrit: "अयकक्करभोइ य,तुण्डिल्ले चियलोहिए,आउयं नरए कङ्खे,जहाएसं व एलए"
english: "Fearing the ayacakara, The crickets are torn to shreds, And now the crows of men, Like the jasmine, Have arrived."

prakrit: "आसनं सयनं जाणं,वित्तं कामे य भुञ्जिया,दुस्साहडं धणं हिच्चा,बहु सञ्चिणिया रयं"
english: "One knows how to sit, One knows when to waste one's time on finances, One understands how difficult it is to make a fortune, A lot of things go wrong."

prakrit: "तओ कम्मगुरू जन्तू,पच्चुप्पन्नपरायणे,अएव्व आगया''एसे,मरणन्तंमि सोयई"
english: "Thou art the master of actions, The observer of past lives, Always on the move." "In this way, I sleep until I die" ""

prakrit: "तओ आउपरिक्खीणे,चुया देहा विहिंसगा,आसुरीयं दिसं बाला,गच्छन्ति अवसा तमं"
english: "You look down, Your body trembles, Looks like a demon, And then you walk away." ""

prakrit: "जहा कागिणिए हेउं,सहस्सं हारए नरो,अपत्थं अम्बगं भॊच्चा,राया रज्जं तु हारए"
english: "As for me, I have lost a thousand wives; you have become worthless, You have become useless, And you have forfeited the throne of Raya."

prakrit: "एवं मानुस्सगा कामा,देवकामाण अन्तिए,सहस्सगुणिया भुज्जो,आउं कामा य दिव्विया"
english: "And man is kama, so is the god of desire, So is the saṃhasugunya arm, And kama is the divine arm."

prakrit: "अनेग वासा नउया,जा सा पन्नवओ ठिई,जाणि जीयन्ति दुम्मेहा,ऊणे वाससयाउए"
english: "A man who knows how to walk, Who knows what to wear, Lives in misfortune, In a world where men live."

prakrit: "जहा य तिन्नि वणिया,मूलं घॆत्तूण निग्गया,एगो 'त्थ लहई लाभं,एगो मूलेण आगओ"
english: "Wherever the three go, The root is rooted out, There is always gain, For the root is fire."

prakrit: "एगो मूलं पि हारित्ता,आगओ तत्थ वाणिओ,ववहारे उवमा एसा,एवं धम्मे वियाणह"
english: "One root is lost, another is grown, And so is the speech When it is spoken of; And in Dharma, the wisdom is realized."

prakrit: "मानुसत्तं भवे मूलं,लाभो देवगई भवे,मूलच्छेएण जीवाण,नरगतिरिक्खत्तणं धुवं"
english: "May human nature be the root, may profit be the deity, may detachment be the pathogen, may the horrors of hell be the wash."

prakrit: "दुहओ गई बालस्स,आवई वहमूलिया,देवत्तं मानुसत्तं च,जं जिए लोलुयासढे"
english: "The plowman's boy has been milked, The weaver's girl has been weaned, God and humanity have been annulled, All that lives Is in the hands of wiles."

prakrit: "तओ जिए सइं होइ,दुविहिं दॊग्गइं गए,दुल्लहा तस्स उम्मग्गा,अद्धाए सुचिरादवि"
english: "As soon as you sign the deed, both are bound to go astray; Dullah is as good as dead."

prakrit: "एवं जियं सपेहाए,तुलिया बालं च पण्डियं,मूलियं ते पवसन्ति,मानुसं जोणिमिन्ति जे"
english: "And the grasshopper sleeps, The cotton plant and its young shoots, The roots abide in them, Just like humans in nature."

prakrit: "वेमायाहिं सिक्खाहिं,जे नरा गिहिसुव्वया,उवॆन्ति मानुसं जोणिं,कम्मसच्चा हु पाणिणो"
english: "Learn to hate those who hate you, Those who abuse you, And those who despise you. For what use is a man's affection?"

prakrit: "जेसिं तु विउला सिक्खा,मूलियं ते अइच्छिया,सीलवन्ता सविसेसा,अद्दीणा जन्ति देवयं"
english: "Because you have learned to knit, The roots are unearthed, The seals are sealed, Service rendered, Jealousy given to the gods."

prakrit: "एवमद्दीणवं भिक्खू,अगारिं च वियाणिया,कहण्णु जिच्चमेलिक्खं,जिच्चमाणे न संविदे"
english: "Beggars are like this only, They wander about freely, They play games of chance But victory is not to be won by force."

prakrit: "जहा कुसग्गे उदगं,समुद्देण समं मिणे,एवं मानुसग्गा कामा,देवकामाण अन्तिए"
english: "As long as the dog rises, The sea is equal to the man, And as long as man is alive, Deva kama is the end."

prakrit: "कुसग्गमॆत्ता इमे कामा,सन्निरुद्धंमि आउए,कस्स हेउं पुराकाउं,जोगक्खेमं न संविदे?"
english: "Whom can I blame? This is my business, Come to me, come to me; Who is old enough, I suppose; Can't you understand?" ""

prakrit: "इह कामानियट्टस्स,अत्तट्ठे अवरज्झई,सॊच्चा नेयाउयं मग्गं,जं भुज्जो परिभस्सई"
english: "This is Kamaniattasa, absentmindedness at work, desire or desire alone ruling the roost."

prakrit: "इह कामा नियट्ठस्स,अत्तट्ठे नावरज्झई,पूइदेहनिरोहेणं,भवे देवि त्ति मे सुयं"
english: "This work is endless, There is nothing new to be done, Destroying the whole body. May the gods put me to sleep."

prakrit: "इड्ढी जुई जसो वण्णो,आउं सुहमनुत्तरे,भुज्जो जत्थ मनुस्सेसु,तत्थ से उववज्जई"
english: "Iddhi jui as in forest, Aum suhamantare, Bhujon as in man, There she will be rewarded." ""

prakrit: "बालस्स पस्स बालत्तं,अहम्मं पडिवज्जिया,चिच्चा धम्मं अहंमिट्ठे,नरएसु उववज्जई"
english: "Child, pass the buck, The ego is exhausted, Dharma is exhausted by anger, The Nares are exhausted by jealousy."

prakrit: "धीरस्स पस्स धीरत्तं,सच्चधम्मानुवत्तिणो,चिच्चा अधम्मं धम्मिट्ठे,देवेसु उववज्जई"
english: "Courage passes through perseverance, Truth alone triumphs over dishonor, And wickedness alone is justified."

prakrit: "तुलियाण बालभावं,अबालं चेव पण्डिए,चइऊण बालभावं,अबालं सेवई मुनि"
english: "Tuliyan is childlike, abalam sev pandiye, chiyun is childish, abaram sevai sage"

prakrit: "अधुवे असासयंमि,संसारंमि दुक्खपउराए,किं नाम हॊज्ज तं कम्मयं? जेणाहं दुग्गइं न गच्छॆज्जा"
english: "I am helpless, The world is full of suffering, What is the name of that miser? If he is poor, I will not go." ""

prakrit: "विजहित्तु पुव्वसञ्जोयं,न सिणेहं कहिञ्चि कुव्वॆज्जा,असिणेह सिणेहकरेहिं,दोसपओसेहिं मुच्चए भिक्खू"
english: "Victory befalls flowers, Love does not cause jealousy, Love destroys affection, And falsehood destroys faith."

prakrit: "तो नाणदंसणसमग्गो,हियनिस्सेसाय सव्वजीवाणं,तेसिं विमॊक्खणट्ठाए,भासई मुनिवरो विगयमोहो"
english: "So, you blind seer, All living beings become blind Because of him, As if sages have become wise."

prakrit: "सव्वं गन्थं कलहं च,विप्पजहे तहाविहं भिक्खू,सव्वेसु कामजाएसु,पासमाणो न लिप्पई ताई"
english: "Everything is confusion and strife, The begging bowl is broken, Everyone is busy making love, The neighborhood is empty."

prakrit: "भोगामिसदोसविसन्ने,हियनिस्सेयसबुद्धिवॊच्चत्थे,बाले य मन्दए मूढे,बज्झई मच्छिया व खेलंमि"
english: "I will never forget how she made me feel When I tried to kiss her lips, When she growled rudely, When I muttered aloud, And when I repeated her words."

prakrit: "दुप्परिच्चया इमे कामा,नो सुजहा अधीरपुरिसेहिं,अह सन्ति सुव्वया साहू,जे तरन्ति अतरं वणिया वा"
english: "I have no desire to be poor, No need to be impatient, Just a good man who knows how to make money."

prakrit: "समणा मु एगे वयमाणा,पाणवहं मिया अयाणन्ता,मन्दा निरयं गच्छन्ति,बाला पावियाहिं दिट्ठीहिं"
english: "Samana mu ege vayamana, pannavaham miya ayananta, Manda goes to bed, Bala looks at his wife."

prakrit: "न हु पाणवहं अणुजाणे,मुच्चॆज्ज कयाइ सव्वदुक्खाणं,एवं आयरिएहिं अक्खायं,जेहिं इमो साहुधम्मो पन्नत्तो"
english: "I am not the only one who knows how to weep, Not a handful of water can wipe away all sorrow, And yet I speak in such a way That my heart swells with emotion."

prakrit: "पाणे य नाइवाऎज्जा,से समीइ त्ति वुच्चई ताई,तओ से पावयं कम्मं,निज्जाइ उदगं व थलाओ"
english: "Water is useless, She sees what's next, Then acts as if she had it all: Her body grows thinner and thinner."

prakrit: "जगनिस्सिएहिं भूएहिं,तसनामेहिं थावरेहिं च,नो तेसिमारभे दण्डं,मनसा वयसा कायसा चेव"
english: "Fear the world, Anger and resentment follow, There is no punishment beyond that. How can one know when one is wretched?"

prakrit: "सुद्धेसणाओ नच्चाणं,तत्थ ठवॆज्ज भिक्खू अप्पाणं,जायाए घासमेसॆज्जा,रसगिद्धे न सिया भिक्खाए"
english: "Be careful not to touch the grass, That is why you should take care of yourself, O mendicant monk. But in juicing do not approach a begging bowl."

prakrit: "पन्ताणि चेव सेवॆज्जा,सीयपिण्डं पुराणकुम्मासं,अदु बुक्कसं पुलागं वा,जवणट्ठाए निसेवए मन्थुं"
english: "Pantani sev sevajja, seyya pindam puranakuma maasa, adu bookasam pulaga va, javanatha neesevaye maantha."

prakrit: "जे लक्खणं च सुविणं च,अङ्गविज्जं च जे पउञ्जन्ति,न हु ते समणा वुच्चन्ति,एवं आयरिएहिं अक्खायं"
english: "Those who recognize a sign, Ornament or body part, They do not see the sign, And thus practice falsehood."

prakrit: "इह जीवियं अनियमॆत्ता,पब्भट्ठा समाहिजोएहिं,ते कामभोगरसगिद्धा,उववज्जन्ति आसुरे काए"
english: "Life is unfettered, Everything is peaceful, They are jealous of their lovers, They make false promises."

prakrit: "तत्तो वि य उव्वट्टित्ता,संसारं बहु अनुपरियटन्ति,बहुकम्मलेवलित्ताणं,बोही होइ सुदुल्लहा तेसिं"
english: "Even then the tree is bare, The world is very unappealing, The lotus is very thin, The path is smooth."

prakrit: "कसिणम्पि जो इमं लोयं,पडिपुण्णं दलॆज्ज इक्कस्स,तेणावि से न सन्तुस्से,इइ दुप्पूरए इमे आया"
english: "Somebody who is not satisfied with what I have got done in this world, A decent man who has done well elsewhere, Has come to me only out of desperation."

prakrit: "जहा लाहो तहा लोहो,लाहा लोहो पवड्ढई,दोमासकयं कज्जं,कोडीए वि न निट्ठियं"
english: "As the flame, so the iron; as the iron rustles, So the work of two months; Not a single nail remains."

prakrit: "नो रक्खसीसु गिज्झॆज्जा,गण्डवच्छासु अनेगचित्तासु,जाओ पुरिसं पलॊभित्ता,खेल्लन्ति जहा व दासेहिं"
english: "No rakshasas, only geese, rhinoceroses, wild goose pimples, gooseflesh on the walls of men's houses, Wherever they play There are slaves too."

prakrit: "नारीसु नोवगिज्झॆज्जा,इत्थी विप्पजहे अनगारे,धम्मं च पेसलं नच्चा,तत्थ ठवॆज्ज भिक्खू अप्पाणं"
english: "Women are like novices in the world; here people are afraid to go out, There dharma is practiced, And there the bhikkhu makes himself felt."

prakrit: "इअ एस धम्मे अक्खाए,कविलेणं च विसुद्धपन्नेणं,तरिहिन्ति जे उ काहिन्ति,तेहिं आराहिया दुवे लोग"
english: "This is the dharma of the blind, The poetry of the deaf, And the pen of the wise. But to those who hear it One seeks both."

prakrit: "चइऊण देवलोगाओ,उववन्नो माणुसंमि लोगंमि,उवसन्त मोहणिज्जो,सरई पोराणियं जाइं"
english: "Behold the gods and goddesses; behold, I see a crowd of people; Stop being seductive; Go to the ancient sarai."

prakrit: "जाइं सरित्तु भयवं,सयंसम्बुद्धो अनुत्तरे धम्मे,पुत्तं ठवॆत्तु रज्जे,अभिनिक्खमई नमी राया"
english: "Wherever you are, there is fear; always be vigilant; always answer in Dharma; my son, do not be negligent; for true humility knows no bounds."

prakrit: "से देवलोगसरिसे,अन्तेउरवरगओ वरे भोए,भुञ्जित्तु नमी राया,बुद्धो भोगे परिच्चयई"
english: "She is afraid of the God of Love, Afraid of people who stray from her path, Worried about getting wet, Anxious about Buddha's sufferings."

prakrit: "मिहिलं सपुरजनवयं,बलमोरोहं च परियणं सव्वं,चिच्चा अभिनिक्खन्तो,एगन्तमहिड्ढिओ भयवं"
english: "Silly old men, Strong wretches, Pretending everything is going well, Scream indecently, Fearful women everywhere."

prakrit: "कोलाहलगभूयं,आसी मिहिलाए पव्वयन्तंमि,तइया रायरिसिंमि,नमिंमि अभिनिक्खमन्तंमि"
english: "Loud beating of drums, I will welcome your arrival, You will welcome my arrival, I shall welcome you with open arms."

prakrit: "अब्भुट्ठियं रायरिसिं,पव्वज्जाठाणमुत्तमं,सक्को माहणरूवेण,इमं वयणमब्बवी"
english: "Abhuthiyam rairisimha, pavvajjathaanam muttam, sakko maahanaruven, imman vayanambavi." ""

prakrit: "किं नु भो! अज्ज मिहिलाए,कोलाहलगसङ्कुला,सुव्वन्ति दारुणा सद्दा,पासाएसु गिहेसु य?"
english: "What's this! You silly bitch? It's getting noisier by the day, You stupid girl, Running around late, Running out of things?" ""

prakrit: "एयमट्ठं निसामित्ता,हेऊकारणचोइओ,तओ नमी रायरिसी,देविन्दं इणमब्बवी"
english: "Eyamatham nisamitta, hu causa choio, Toh humi rairisi, devindam inambavi."

prakrit: "मिहिलाए चेइए वच्छे,सीयच्छाए मनोरमे,पत्तपुफ्फफलोवेए,बहूणं बहुगुणे सया"
english: "Look at her cheeks, Look at the freshly plucked flowers, See how the wife multiplies her husband's favor." ""

prakrit: "वाएण हीरमाणंमि,चेइयंमि मनोरमे,दुहिया असरणा अत्ता,एए कन्दन्ति भो! खगा"
english: "I will heal with wind, I will cure with fire, My mother - in - law is poor without milk, O thirsty cow!"

prakrit: "एयमट्ठं निसामित्ता,हेऊकारणचोइओ,तओ नमिं रायरिसिं,देविन्दो इणमब्बवी"
english: "This is nothing but desperation, This is want of reason, So take me in your arms, O God of Love."

prakrit: "एस अग्गी य वाऊ य,एयं डज्झइ मन्दिरं,भयवं अन्तेउरं तेणं,कीस णं नावपॆक्खह"
english: "This fire is fierce, This temple is burning, Fear has taken hold of it, So how can you set fire to it?"

prakrit: "एयमट्ठं निसामित्ता,हेऊकारणचोइओ,तओ नमि रायरिसी,देविन्दं इणमब्बवी"
english: "This is nonsense, You stupid girl, Don't be so naïve: The gods are incompetent."

prakrit: "सुहं वसामो जीवामो,जेसिं मो नत्थि किञ्चणं,मिहिलाए डज्झमाणीए,न मे डज्झइ किञ्चणं"
english: "I have a good life, As long as I don't have to worry about anything, Dear wife, I have nothing to fear."
