prakrit: "जं च मे पुच्छसी काले,सम्मं सुद्धेण चेयसा,ताइं पाउकरे बुद्धे,तं नाणं जिनसासने"
english: "Whatever you ask me, I'll tell you, As long as you keep it simple... That, wise man, Is the merit of my existence."

prakrit: "किरियं च रोयई धीरे,किरियं परिवज्जए,दिट्ठीए दिट्ठीसम्पन्ने,धम्मं चर सुदुच्चरं"
english: "Criticize slowly, criticize gradually, glance at the whole scene, Dharma is the supreme virtue."

prakrit: "एयं पुण्णपयं सॊच्चा,अत्थधम्मोवसोहियं,भरहो'वि भारहं वासं,चिच्चा कामाइ पव्वए"
english: "This is the path to purity, To the highest dharma, To abundance, to weight, And to desire."

prakrit: "सगरो'वि सागरन्तं,भरहवासं नराहिवो,इस्सरियं केवलं हिच्चा,दयाइ परिनिव्वुडे"
english: "Love is bound to the ocean, Dependence is forbidden, Love is only a matter of will, Compassion is the supreme pleasure."

prakrit: "चइत्ता भारहं वासं,चक्कवट्टी महिड्ढिओ,पव्वज्जमब्भुवगओ,मघवं नाम महाजसो"
english: "Love is a heavy weight, Friendship is heavy, Pride is powerful, Praise be to the name of the great one."

prakrit: "सणङ्कुमारो मणुस्सिन्दो,चक्कवट्टी महिड्ढिओ,पुत्तं रज्जे ठवेऊणं,सो'वि राया तवं चरे"
english: "Daughter, be careful not to fall prey to the wiles of men, You clever girl, My son, You'll make a mess of it, But that's just the way things happen."

prakrit: "चइत्ता भारहं वासं,चक्कवट्टी महिड्ढिओ,सन्ती सन्तिकरे लोए,पत्तो गइमनुत्तरं"
english: "Love is a heavy weight, Friendship is heavy, Contentment is abundant, The world is peaceful, The path is endless."

prakrit: "इक्खागरायवसभो,कुन्थू नाम नरीसरो,विक्खायकित्ती भगवं,मुक्खं गओ अनुत्तरं"
english: "Ikka garaivas, kunthu naam nareesaro, vikkaikutty bhagavan, mukhya gaon anutharam."

prakrit: "सागरन्त जहित्ताणं,भरहं नरवरीसरो,अहो य अरयं पत्तो,पत्तो गइमनुत्तरं"
english: "The ocean is endless, I am full of fishes, And the rivers are endless, The answer is yes, the answer is no."

prakrit: "चइत्ता भारहं वासं,चक्कवट्टी महिड्ढिओ,चइत्ता उत्तमे भोए,महापउमे दमं चरे"
english: "A good man is burdensome, A clever woman is heavy, A good woman is generous, And a great man is full of resentment."

prakrit: "एगच्छत्तं पसाहित्ता,महिं माननिसूरणो,हरिसेनो मनुस्सिन्दो,पत्तो गइमनुत्तरं"
english: "Consciousness alone triumphs, Deceit alone vanishes, For greed is the enemy of the human race."

prakrit: "अन्निओ रायसहस्सेहिं,सुपरिच्चाई दमं चरे,जयनामो जिनक्खायं,पत्तो गइमनुत्तरं"
english: "Everyone loves a good joke, A good joke is worth keeping, A false name is worth nothing, And a falsehood is the answer."

prakrit: "दसण्णरज्जं मुदियं,चइत्ताणं मुनी चरे,दसण्णभद्दो निक्खन्तो,सक्खं सक्केण चोइओ"
english: "The king of ten is rich, The sage of seven is clever, The wise rule over ten is prudent, And the wise stealthily steal."

prakrit: "नमी नमेइ अप्पाणं,सक्खं सक्केण चोइओ,चइऊण गेहं वइदेही,सामण्णे पज्जुवट्ठिओ"
english: "Moisturise yourself, so that your skin does not dry out, Chew well, Sweat well, Hold your breath for a moment."

prakrit: "करकण्डू कलिङ्गेसु,पञ्चालेसु य दुम्मुहो,नमी राया विदेहेसु,गन्धारेसु य नग्गई"
english: "Karkandu kalingesu, panchalesu ya dummuho, nami raya vidhahesu, gandharesu yaa naggai."

prakrit: "एए नरिन्दवसभा,निक्खन्ता जिनसासने,पुत्ते रज्जे ठवेऊणं,सामण्णे पज्जुवट्ठिया"
english: "Oh, Narindavasabha! Always be vigilant, son, never be negligent when it comes to falsehoods."

prakrit: "सोवीररायवसभो,चइत्ताण मुनी चरे,उद्दायणो पव्वइओ,पत्तो गइमनुत्तरं"
english: "Long live the brave, The clever foolish walker, The reckless traveler; The answer is obvious."

prakrit: "तहेव कासीराया वि सेओ सच्चपरक्कमो,कामभोगे परिच्चज्ज,पहणे कम्ममहावनं"
english: "Even the God of Love, Kasiraya, speaks truth, But those who practice lust speak falsehood; They wear the great karma."

prakrit: "तहेव विजओ राया,अणट्ठा कित्ति पव्वए,रज्जं तु गुणसमिद्धं,पयहित्तु महाजसो"
english: "Tremendous victory! How hard it is for you, my dear. You are worthy of the throne. Yet my heart is heavy."

prakrit: "तहेवुग्गं तवं किच्चा,अव्वक्खित्तेण चेयसा,महब्बलो रायरिसी,आदाय सिरसा सिरिं"
english: "You always act so rashly, Always act so recklessly, Always speak politely, Always give your head a try."

prakrit: "कहं धीरो अहेऊहिं,उम्मत्तो व महिं चरे?,एए विसेसमादाय,सूरा दढपरक्कमा"
english: "How are you going to be patient? You're just going to stare at me, aren't you?"

prakrit: "अच्चन्तनियाणखमा,सच्चा मे भासिया वई,अतरिंसु तरन्तेगे तरिस्सन्ति अनागया"
english: "Tremendous! Aunt, I am really thirsty. There must be something else going on." ""

prakrit: "कहं धीरे अहेऊहिं,अत्ताणं परियावसे,सव्वसङ्गविनिम्मुक्के,सिद्धे भवइ नीरए"
english: "How are you going to ease yourself, Dear friend, All this in silence?"

prakrit: "सुग्गीवे नयरे रम्मे,काननुज्जाणसोहिए,राया बलभद्दि त्ति,मिया तस्स'ग्गमाहिसी"
english: "Praise be to the good lady, Friend, Your ears are attentive, Your face is firm, I have heard of her"

prakrit: "तेसिं पुत्ते बलसिरी,मियापुत्ते त्ति विस्सुए,अम्मापिऊण दइए,जुवराया दमीसरे"
english: "His son is bald, My daughter - in - law is pale, My husband is weak, Youth is oppressive."

prakrit: "नन्दने सो उ पासाए,कीलए सह इत्थिहिं,देवे दोगुन्दगे चेव,निच्चं मुइयमानसो"
english: "Nandan has passed on, Here and there with the nails, God is at hand in mischief, I am about to die."

prakrit: "मणिरयणकॊट्टिमतले,पासायालोयणट्ठिओ,आलोएइ नगरस्स,चउक्कत्तियचच्चरे"
english: "Beauties, Look around you, The lights of the city, Around the clock."

prakrit: "अह तत्थ अइच्छन्तं,पासई समणसञ्जयं,तवनियमसञ्जमधरं,सीलड्ढं गुणआगरं"
english: "Oh! there it is, Eagerly approaching, Straightforward, Sealed, Virtuous."

prakrit: "तं पेहई मियापुत्ते,दिट्ठीए,अनिमिसाए उ,कहिं मन्नेरिसं रूवं,दिट्ठपुव्वं मए पुरा"
english: "Look at that girl at my feet, Look at her breasts, In my heart they look like jewels. But looking at me is completely useless."

prakrit: "साहुस्स दरिसणे तस्स,अज्झवसाणंमि सोहणे,मोहं गयस्स सन्तस्स,जाईसरणं समुप्पन्नं"
english: "Taste the fire there, Enjoy the fresh breeze, Feel the thrill of love, Seem the satisfaction of victory."

prakrit: "देवलोग चुओ सन्तो मानुसं भवमागओ,सण्णिनाणे समुप्पन्ने जाइं सरइपुराणयं"
english: "The gods are pure, Man is pure, Nature is abundant, Everything is pure in the sun."

prakrit: "जाईसरणे समुप्पन्ने,मियापुत्ते महिड्ढिए,सरई पोराणियं जाइं,सामण्णं च पुरा कयं"
english: "Travelers, gather yourselves together; Be careful not to fall into temptation; Go to the good old town; Prostrate yourselves by all means."

prakrit: "विसएसु अरज्जन्तो,रज्जन्तो सञ्जमंमि य,अम्मापियरं उवागम्म,इमं वयणमब्बवी"
english: "Knowledge is indispensable, Compassion is congenial, Mother - in - law is welcome, For in her is the power of speech."

prakrit: "सुयाणि मे पञ्च महव्वयाणि,नरएसु दुक्खं च तिरिक्खजोणिसु,निव्विण्णकामो मि महण्णवाओ,अणुजाणह पव्वइस्सामि अम्मो"
english: "I have five great nights in a row, I am full of misery And sorrow. But if you ask me what it is Like to be rich, I will tell you the truth."

prakrit: "अम्मताय! मए भोगा,भुत्ता विसफलोवमा,पच्छा कडुयविवागा,अनुबन्धदुहावहा"
english: "Mother - in - law! Suffer me, O fool, If I give in to delusion, But always with bitterness, As if I were a medicine." ""

prakrit: "इमं सरीरं अनिच्चं,असुइं असुइसम्भवं,असासयावासमिणं,दुक्खकेसाण भायणं"
english: "In this body there is reluctance, in this there is uneasiness, there is resentment, There is grief," he said.

prakrit: "असासए सरीरंमि,रइं नोवलभामहं,पच्छा पुरा व चइयव्वे,फेणबुब्बुयसंनिभे"
english: "I have no body, I am only a novice, I make choices based on past experiences, Like a bunch of foam bubbles."

prakrit: "मानुस्सित्ते असारंमि,वाहीरोगाण आलए,जरामरघत्थंमि,खणम्पि न रमाम'हं"
english: "I disapprove of what people say, I condemn what is immoral, I object to what is improper, I make no bones about it."

prakrit: "जम्म दुक्खं जरा दुक्खं,रोगाणि मरणाणि य,अहो दुक्खो हु संसारो,जत्थ कीसन्ति जन्तवो"
english: "All sorrow is but sorrow, Illness is but death; wretched is the world; what kind of animal is there to suffer?"

prakrit: "खॆत्तं वत्थुं हिरण्णं च,पुत्तदारं च बन्धवा,चइत्ताणं इमं देहं,गन्तव्वमवसस्स मे"
english: "The farmer and the deer, The husbandman and his son, Friend and wife, The dog is always with me in my body, Always in my goal."

prakrit: "जहा किम्पागफलाणं,परिणामो न सुन्दरो,एवं भुत्ताणं भोगाणं,परिणामो न सुन्दरो"
english: "Where there is a blossoming of seeds, the results are not beautiful, And where there is an indulgence of ghosts, the outcomes are not pretty."

prakrit: "अद्धाणं जो महन्तं तु,अप्पहॆज्जो पवज्जई,गच्छन्तो सो दुही होइ,छुहातण्हाए पीडिओ"
english: "The more you touch me, the more you will be hated. It will be painful to leave." ""

prakrit: "एवं धम्मं अकाऊणं,जो गच्छइ परं भवं,गच्छन्तो सो दुही होइ,वाही रोगेहिं पीडिओ"
english: "And disregard for dharma; one who goes astray comes to mind; the wretched man is afflicted by illness."

prakrit: "अद्धाणं जो महन्तं तु,सपाहॆज्जो पवज्जई,गच्छन्तो सो सुही होइ,छुहातण्हाविवज्जिओ"
english: "The more you touch me, the more you will please me. If you leave, I will be happy." ""

prakrit: "एवं धम्मं पि काऊणं,जो गच्छइ परं भवं,गच्छन्तो सो सुही होइ,अप्पकम्मे अवेयणे"
english: "And what is dharma, if one goes elsewhere one can be happy; in due course he will go elsewhere."

prakrit: "जहा गेहे पलित्तंमि,तस्स गेहस्स जो पहू,सारभण्डाणि नीणेइ,असारं अवउज्झइ"
english: "As long as I am polite, That is the essence of what I wear. The essence of me disappears, We neglect it."

prakrit: "एवं लोए पलित्तंमि,जराए मरणेण य,अप्पाणं तारइस्सामि,तुब्भेहिं अणुमन्निओ"
english: "And I shall return to you, once I am dead. I shall leave you to fend for yourself."

prakrit: "तं बिन्त'म्मापियरो,सामण्णं पुत्त! दुच्चरं,गुणाणं तु सहस्साइं,धारेयव्वाइं भिक्खुणो"
english: "Excuse me, my son, for being so forthright! You impudent wretch, Who by your virtuous conduct Has become a begging bowl." ""

prakrit: "समया सव्वभूएसु,सत्तुमित्तेसु वा जगे,पाणाइवायविरई,जावज्जीवाए दुक्करं"
english: "Time embraces all beings; waking up in the twilight, separated by the waters, is arduous for the living."

prakrit: "निच्चकालप्पमत्तेणं,मुसावायविवज्जणं,भासियव्वं हियं सच्चं,निच्चाउत्तेण दुक्करं"
english: "To lie still, To lie motionless, To feign delusion, Is true; To lie low is difficult."

prakrit: "दन्तसोहणमाइस्स,अदत्तस्स,विवज्जणं,अणवच्चेसणिज्जस्स,गिण्हणा अवि दुक्करं"
english: "To brush one's teeth is a pleasure; to count is an ordeal; it is difficult to describe."

prakrit: "विरई अबम्भचेरस्स,कामभोगरसन्नुणा,उग्गं महव्वयं,बम्भं,धारेयव्वं सुदुक्करं"
english: "Detachment is immaterial, Love is sensual, Pride is great, Bliss is bound to come, Destruction is sure to come."

prakrit: "धणधन्नपेसवग्गेसु,परिग्गहविवज्जणं,सव्वारम्भपरिच्चाओ,निम्ममत्तं सुदुक्करं"
english: "Take pride in your wealth, In your discernment of the world, In all your virtuous acquaintances, For this is the path to happiness."

prakrit: "चउव्विहे वि आहारे,राईभोयणवज्जणा,सन्निहीसञ्चओ चेव,वज्जेयव्वो सुदुक्करं"
english: "All round there is food, The poor farmer has nothing to eat, The farmer's business is flourishing, And everyone is happy."

prakrit: "छुहा तण्हा य सीउण्हं,दंसमसगा य वेयणा,अक्कोसा दुक्खसॆज्जा य,तणफासा जल्लमेव य"
english: "To touch is to burn with passion, To kiss is to hurt, To groan is to cause grief, To tremble is to rejoice."

prakrit: "तालणा तज्जणा चेव,वहबन्धपरीसहा,दुक्खं भिक्खायरिया,जायणा य अलाभया"
english: "Tears flow from the heart, Friendship fades, Sorrow begging, For lack of love or affection."

prakrit: "कावोया जा इमा वित्ती,केसलोओ य दारुणो,दुक्खं बम्भव्वयं घोरं,धारेउं य महप्पणो"
english: "Be nice to me, my dear, It's hard work, The pain is overwhelming, The burden is heavy, And the burden is great."

prakrit: "सुहोइओ तुमं पुत्ता! सुकुमालो सुमज्जिओ,न हुसी पभू तुमं पुत्ता! सामण्णमनुपालिया"
english: "" "Well done, my son! You handsome gentleman, Don't be so hasty, my boy! Your reputation is safe."

prakrit: "जावज्जीवमविस्सामो,गुणाणं तु महब्भरो,गुरुओ लोहभारु व्व,जो पुत्ता होइ दुव्वहो"
english: "You are full of energy, You are generous with virtues, Teacher, you who are heavy with iron, Are a doting son."

prakrit: "आगासे गङ्गसोउ व्व,पडिसोउ व्व दुत्तरो,बाहाहिं सागरो चेव,तरियव्वो य गुणोदही"
english: "The fire is like the river Ganges, The water is like a donkey's tail, The sea is like an armory, The rivers are like a column of water."

prakrit: "वालुयाकवलो चेव,निरस्साए उ सञ्जमे,असिधारागमनं चेव,दुक्करं चरिउं तवो"
english: "A slant like a bow, In despair a tremble, In misfortune a trembling stream, In difficulty a slippery slope."

prakrit: "अहीं वेगन्तदिट्ठीए,चरित्ते पुत्त! दुक्करे,जवा लोहमया चेव,चावेयव्वा सुदुक्करं"
english: "Look, you naughty boy! The poor thing is, The ironmonger is still alive, And the good man is safe." ""

prakrit: "जहा अग्गिसिहा दित्ता,पाउं होइ सुदुक्करा,तहा दुक्करं करेउं जे,तारूण्णे समणत्तणं"
english: "As long as the fire is kindled, I shall be happy; I shall make it difficult for you to make peace with it."

prakrit: "जहा दुक्खं भरेउं जे,होइ वायस्स कॊत्थलो,तहा दुक्खं करेउं जे,कीवेणं समणत्तणं"
english: "As the sorrow fills me, That I might expiate the wind, So do I grieve, For how can I appease it"

prakrit: "जहा तुलाए तोलेउं,दुक्करो मन्दरो गिरी,तहा निहुयं नीसङ्कं,दुक्करं समणत्तणं"
english: "As the plowman lifts the cotton, As the poor man's temple falls, So the farmer's penance; Difficult is the reconciliation."

prakrit: "जहा भुयाहिं तरिउं,दुक्करं रयणायरो,तहा अनुवसन्तेणं,दुक्करं दमसागरो"
english: "As the earth turns, so the wretched rain forest, So the desert, difficult as it is, Is stifled."

prakrit: "भुञ्ज माणुस्सए भोगे,पञ्चलक्खणए तुमं,भुत्तभोगी तओ जाया! पच्छा धम्मं चरिस्ससि"
english: "" "Foolish human being, you have reached the five lakh mark. But you, devious one, have passed away! You have always followed dharma."

prakrit: "सो बिन्त'म्मापियरो,एवमेयं जहा फुडं,इह लोए निप्पिवासस्स,नत्थि किञ्चि वि दुक्करं"
english: "So rest assured, my dear, As far as I know, This is the world of nippies. Nothing is more difficult"

prakrit: "सारीरमानसा चेव,वेयणाओ अनन्तओ,मए सॊढाओ भीमाओ,असइं दुक्खभयाणि य"
english: "All men are equal, all women are infinite, all husbands are equal to me; we fear such misery."

prakrit: "जरामरणकान्तारे,चाउरन्ते भयागरे,मए सॊढाणि भीमाणि,जम्माणि मरणाणि य"
english: "The nights are long, The roads are dangerous, The streets are treacherous, The houses are deserted, And the streets are deserted."

prakrit: "जहा इहं अगनी उण्हो,ऎत्तो'नन्तगुणो तहिं,नरएसु वेयणा उण्हा,अस्साया वेइया मया"
english: "Where there is fire, there is virtue, There is hell to be desired. Anyway, the fire is mine." ""

prakrit: "जहा इमं इहं सीयं,ऎत्तो'नन्तगुणो तहिं,नरएसु वेयणा सीया,अस्साया वेइया मए"
english: "As long as I have this quality, so long, dear girl, There must be something wrong with me."

prakrit: "कन्दन्तो कन्दुकुम्भीसु,उद्धपाओ अहोसिरो,हुयासणे जलन्तंमि,पक्कपुव्वो अनन्तसो"
english: "Trembling is the arrow of the God of Love, Exhausting is the fingertip of pride, In jealousy I go down to the fire of love, And those who fall by the wayside Are eternal."

prakrit: "महादवग्गिसङ्कासे,मरुंमि वइरवालुए,कलम्बवालुयाए य,दड्ढपुव्वो अनन्तसो"
english: "By the sighs of the great tiger, I will die, By the waves of the cauldron, And the poor man will live forever."

prakrit: "रसन्तो कन्दुकुम्भीसु,उड्ढं बद्धो अबन्धवो,करवत्तकरकयाईहिं,छिन्नपुव्वो अनन्तसो"
english: "Compassion is like a tendril, It flies high, It binds fast, It tightens tightly, It tears apart, It is like an endless stream"

prakrit: "अइतिक्खकण्टगाइण्णे,तुङ्गे सिम्बलिपायवे,खेवियं पासबद्धेणं,कड्ढोकड्ढाहिं दुक्करं"
english: "You silly girl, You goose pimples aside, It's hard to get out of bed." ""

prakrit: "महाजन्तेसु उच्छू वा,आरसन्तो सुभेरवं,पीडिओ मि सकम्मेहिं,पावकम्मो अनन्तसो"
english: "Great vows bring happiness, Delighted are the pleasures of love, Pain consumes me, For sin is eternal."

prakrit: "कूवन्तो कोलसुणएहिं,सामेहिं सबलेहि य,पाडिओ फालिओ छिन्नो,विप्फुरन्तो अनेगसो"
english: "When a well is overflowing, There is no sound from it, When one touches it one can hear it only through speech."

prakrit: "असीहिं अयसिवण्णाहिं,भल्लेहिं पट्टिसेहि य,छिन्नो भिन्नो विभिन्नो य,ओइण्णो पावकम्मुणा"
english: "We are so indifferent, So wrapped in swords, So thin and varied, So indifferent is the act of kissing."

prakrit: "अवसो लोहरहे जुत्तो,जलन्ते समिलाजुए,चोइओ तॊत्तजुत्तेहिं,रॊज्झो वा जह पाडिओ"
english: "The fire burns bright, The flames flicker, The hearth twines, The nights are long and the nights rapturous."

prakrit: "हुयासणे जलन्तंमि,चियासु महिसो विव,दड्ढो पक्को य अवसो,पावकम्मेहिं पाविओ"
english: "I'm burning with desire, My breath is sighing, My cheeks are trembling, My stomach is aflame, My limbs are weak."

prakrit: "बला सण्डासतुण्डेहिं,लोहतुण्डेहिं पक्खिहिं,विलुतो विलवन्तो'हं,ढङ्कगिद्धेहिं'नन्तसो"
english: "The bow is pricked by the sand, The bow by the iron, The arrow by the bow: Yes, you fool, Not so much by the lid."

prakrit: "तण्हाकिलन्तो धावन्तो,पत्तो वेयरिणिं नदिं,जलं पाहिं ति चिन्तन्तो,खुरधाराहिं विवाइओ"
english: "He runs after the grasshopper, When a leaf is tied to a branch And the river is in spate, When he thinks of water He marries the raindrop."

prakrit: "उण्हाभितत्तो सम्पत्तो,असिपत्तं महावनं,असिपत्तेहिं पडन्तेहिं,छिन्नपुव्वो अनेगसो"
english: "Wealth is abundant when it is abundant, greatness is inexhaustible, misfortune is bound to fall, scattered wealth is many."

prakrit: "मुग्गरेहिं मुसण्ढीहिं,सूलेहिं मुसलेहिं य,गया सम्भग्गगत्तेहिं,पत्तं दुक्खं अनन्तसो"
english: "Trouble is endless, Troubles are endless, Fights break out, And quarrels break out."

prakrit: "खुरेहिं तिक्खधारेहिं,छुरियाहिं कप्पणीहि य,कप्पिओ फालिओ छिन्नो,उक्कित्तो य अनेगसो"
english: "The axe is sharp, the knife is blunt, the razor is loose, There must be something wrong with it."

prakrit: "पासेहिं कूडजालेहिं,मिओ वा अवसो अहं,वाहिओ बद्धरुद्धो वा,बहू सो चेव विवाइओ"
english: "I am bound by the fence, She is a woman of means, I am a man of principle, And her husband is a barber."

prakrit: "गलेहिं मगरजालेहिं,मच्छो वा अवसो अहं,उल्लिओ फालिओ गहिओ,मारिओ य अनन्तसो"
english: "Slit your throat, Catch a mosquito or a wasp, Cut an onion and eat it. Kill it or suffer eternal death."

prakrit: "वीदंसएहिं जालेहिं,लॆप्पाहिं सउणो विव,गहिओ लग्गो बद्धो य,मारिओ य अनन्तसो"
english: "The blind man has a snare, The deaf man a noose, The naked man is bound by a cage, Death is an eternal punishment."

prakrit: "कुहाडफरसुमाईहिं,वड्ढईहिं दुमो विव,कुट्टिओ फालिओ छिन्नो,तच्छिओ य अनन्तसो"
english: "Clouds cover the whole sky, The night is long, The nights are dark, The days are fleeting, And the nights are endless."

prakrit: "चवेडमुट्ठिमाईहिं,कुमारेहिं अयं पिव,ताडिओ कुट्टिओ भिन्नो,चुण्णिओ य अनन्तसो"
english: "Sweat is the pearl of wisdom, Milk is the drink of virgins, To toddy is the difference between a boy and a girl, To be fair it takes forever."

prakrit: "तत्ताइं तम्बलोहाइं,तउयाइं सीसयाणि य,पाइओ कलकलन्ताइं,आरसन्तो सुभेरवं"
english: "The parrots are tasty, The rice is juicy, The watermelon is fragrant, And the rainbow is pleasant."

prakrit: "तुहं पियाइं मंसाइं,खण्डाइं सोल्लगाणि य,खाइओ मि समंसाइं,अग्गिवण्णाइ'नेगसो"
english: "You have drunk my wine, You have swallowed my dumplings, I will eat your dish, And you will burn my fire."

prakrit: "तुहं पिया सुरा सीहू,मेरओ य महूणि य,पाइओ मि जलन्तीओ,वसाओ रुहिराणि य"
english: "Your drink is poison, mine is honey, my pyre is burning, my fats are rubies."

prakrit: "निच्चं भीएण तत्थेण,दुहिएण वहिएण य,परमा दुहसम्बद्धा,वेयणा वेइया मए"
english: "Because it pains me, Because it hurts me, It is only because I am bound to others That the knot is tied around me."

prakrit: "तिव्वचण्डप्पगाढाओ,घोराओ अइदुस्सहा,महब्भयाओ भीमाओ,नरएसु वेइया मए"
english: "The clouds are fierce, The rivers are rough, The monsters are fearful, The men of the forest Are addicted."

prakrit: "जारिसा मानुसे लोए,ताया! दीसन्ति वेयणा,ऎत्तो अनन्तगुणिया,नरएसु दुक्खवेयणा"
english: "The poor man's got it, Taya! The poor woman has it, Get up, you infinite virtuous one, For the poor man is a miser."

prakrit: "सव्वभवेसु अस्साया,वेयणा वेइया मए,निमेसन्तरमित्तम्पि,जं साया नत्थि वेयणा"
english: "Everything is impermanent, The wedding dress is dead, Sitting in the middle of the night, Which does not let in any shade"

prakrit: "तं बिन्त'म्मापियरो,छन्देणं पुत्त! पव्वया,नवरं पुण सामण्णे,दुक्खं निप्पडिकम्मया"
english: "Sorry about that, son - in - law! Get on with it, girl, Let's face it again. Sorrow won't heal you." ""

prakrit: "सो बेइ अम्मापियरो,एवमेयं जहा फुडं,पडिकम्मं को कुणई,अरण्णे मियपक्खिणं?"
english: "So, you fool, Where are you going to put that water? It has to go through the whole forest, Not through the fire?"

prakrit: "एगब्भूए अरण्णे वा,जहा उ चरई मिगे,एवं धम्मं चरिस्सामि,सञ्जमेण तवेण य"
english: "As the forest is dry, As the pasture is overgrown, So am I tending to the dharma; The stream is fresh with water."

prakrit: "जहा मिगस्स आयङ्को,महारण्णंमि जायई,अच्चन्त रुक्खमूलंमि,को णं ताहे चिगिच्छिई"
english: "As long as the tiger is alive, The great queen is gone, And the tree is still standing. Who cares?"

prakrit: "को वा से ओसहं देइ,को वा से पुच्छई सुहं,को से भत्तं च पानं वा,आहरित्तु पणामए?"
english: "To whom to give affection, to whom to ask a favor, and who to give a drink, As if it were your own reward?"

prakrit: "जया य से सुही होइ,तया गच्छइ गोयरं,भत्तपानस्स अट्ठाए,वल्लराणि सराणि य"
english: "May she be happy, may she go for a walk, may her drink be abundant, may the good queen enjoy herself."

prakrit: "खाइत्ता पाणियं पाउं,वल्लरेहिं सरेहिं य,मिगचारियं चरित्ताणं,गच्छई मिगचारियं"
english: "To eat is to drink water, to be strong is to be generous, To move is to have character; To walk is to move."

prakrit: "एवं समुट्ठिए भिक्खु,एवमेव अनेगए,मिगचारियं चरित्ताणं,उइढं पक्कमई दिसं"
english: "And all the monks gather together; they are very numerous; Migachariah is a man of character; behold, the road is straight."

prakrit: "जहा मिए एग अनेगचारी अनेगवासे धुवगोयरे य,एवं मुनी गोयरियं पविट्ठे,नो हीलए नो वि य खिंसऎज्जा"
english: "As the foolish cowherd has taught me, So have many other cows. There is nothing wrong with me, Not even mine."

prakrit: "मिगचारियं चरिस्सामि,एवं पुत्ता जहासुहं,अम्मापिऊहिं'णुन्नाओ,जहाइ उवहिं तहा"
english: "I have grown very thin, And my son is still a child. So listen, my dear: There he is." ""

prakrit: "मिगचारियं चरिस्सामि,सव्वदुक्खविमॊक्खणिं,तुब्भेहिं अम्ब! अ'णुन्नाओ,गच्छ पुत्त! जहासुहं"
english: "I have performed miracles. All sorrow and loss are mine, But behold, my son, The arrow of hell has reached me." ""

prakrit: "एवं सो अम्मापियरो,अनुमाणित्ताण बहुविहं,ममत्तं छिन्दई ताहे,महानागो व्व कञ्चुयं"
english: "And so, dear friends, my mind is very wide, my feelings are scattered, Like a large conch shell."

prakrit: "इड्ढी वित्तं च मित्ते य,पुत्तदारं च नायओ,रेणुयं व पडे लग्गं,निद्धुणित्ताण निग्गओ"
english: "Friend, spare your son and daughter, For they will go away in one fell swoop." ""

prakrit: "पञ्चमहव्वयजुत्तो,पञ्चसमिओ तिगुत्तिगुत्तो व,सब्भिन्तरबाहिरओ,तवोकम्मंसि उज्जुओ"
english: "The flame of the five great vows, The sharp arrow of the fifth, Is the brightest light in the world."

prakrit: "निम्ममो निरहङ्कारो,निस्सङ्गो चत्तगारवो,समो य सव्वभूएसु,तसेसु थावरेसु य"
english: "You are shameless, You are loud, You make everyone laugh, And so be it."

prakrit: "लाभालाभे सुहे दुक्खे,जीविए मरणे तहा,समो निन्दापसंसासु,तहा मानावमानओ"
english: "For gain is happiness, For loss is sorrow, For life is death, For sin is condemnation, And so is humiliation."

prakrit: "गारवेसु कसाएसु,दण्डसल्लभएसु य,नियत्तो हाससोगाओ,अनियाणो अबन्धणो"
english: "How are you going to cover your face, Punish me, Destiny will laugh at you, Others are bound to fall"

prakrit: "अनिस्सिओ इहं लोए,परलोए अनिस्सिओ,वासीचन्दनकप्पो य,असने अनसने तहा"
english: "Non - beings live here, non - beings in other worlds, The moon is invisible to the naked eye, We are like that only."

prakrit: "अप्पसत्थेहिं दारेहिं,सव्वओ पिहियासवे,अज्झप्पज्झाणजोगेहिं,पसत्थदमसासने"
english: "At the same moment the doors opened, Everyone looked on in bewilderment, The flames flicked through the windows, And then the next day the fire."

prakrit: "एवं नाणेण चरणेण,दंसणेण तवेण य,भावनाहि य सुद्धाहिं,सम्मं भावॆत्तु अप्पयं"
english: "And by the feet that touch, By the tongue that pierces, By feelings that are pure... So long as the mind is pure, the heart is pure."

prakrit: "बहुयाणि उ वासाणि,सामण्णमनुपालिया,मासिएण उ भत्तेण,सिद्धिं पत्तो अनुत्तरं"
english: "Too much desire, too little concentration, Too much pretence, Too little practice, Is the only answer."

prakrit: "एवं करन्ति सम्बुद्धा,पण्डिया पवियक्खणा,विणियट्टन्ति भोगेसु,मियापुत्ते जहारिसी"
english: "And the doer is Sambuddha, the pundit is Paviyakhna, the weaver is Bhogesu, Miyaputte Jaharisi."

prakrit: "महापभावस्स महाजसस्स मियाइ पुत्तस्स निसम्म भासियं,तवप्पहाणं चरियं च उत्तमं गइप्पहाणं च तिलोगविस्सुतं"
english: "Mahāpabhāvaśa, mahāgasasa, mīyā, puttā, nisammā bhāṣyam, tāvapāhaṇa, and tāpāhañja are excellent." ""

prakrit: "वियाणिया दुक्खविवद्धणं धणं ममत्तबधं च महाभयावहं,सुहावहं धम्मधुरं अनुत्तरं धारॆज्ज निव्वाणगुणावहं महं"
english: "Friend, I am full of grief, Wealth, affection, and great fear. The pleasures of dharma, Unanswered, Are my only virtues." ""

prakrit: "सिद्धाणं नमो किच्चा,सञ्जयाणं च भावओ,अत्थधम्मगइं तच्चं,अनुसिट्ठिं सुणेह मे"
english: "Siddhanam namo kichcha, sanjayanam bhavao, at last dharma has set in. Listen to me in due course." ""

prakrit: "पभूयरयणो राया,सेणिओ मगहाहिवो,विहारजत्तं निज्जाओ,मण्डिकुच्छिंसि चेइए"
english: "Praise be to the God of Love, Soldiers and elephants, Traveler's treasure, The shrinkage of the temples."

prakrit: "नानादुमलयाइण्णं,नानापक्खिनिसेवियं,नानाकुसुमसञ्छन्नं,उज्जाणं नन्दनोवमं"
english: "Nāṇadūmālāyinā, nāñāpakṣināyam, nanākusumāsānā, ujjñānam nandanovam." ""

prakrit: "तत्थ सो पासई साहुं,सञ्जयं सुसमाहियं,निसन्नं रुक्खमूलंमि,सुकुमालं सुहोइयं"
english: "There it is, my friend, The good evening is approaching, I can see the tree springing up again, And the summer is going to be pleasant."

prakrit: "तस्स रूवं तु पासित्ता,राइणो तंमि सञ्जए,अच्चन्तपरमो आसी,अउलो रूवविम्हओ"
english: "That form is your pastime, The rainbow is your present, And I will be there for you in the Hereafter. It is as if you were a bunch of rubies."

prakrit: "अहो वण्णो अहो रूवं,अहो अज्जस्स सोमया,अहो खन्ती अहो मुत्ती,अहो भोगे असङ्गया"
english: "Oh, wretchedness, Oh, a pale complexion, Oh! long - suffering, Oh... a pearl, Oh - the absence of enjoyment."

prakrit: "तस्स पाए उ वन्दित्ता,काऊण य पयाहिणं,नाइदूरमणासन्ने,पञ्जली पडिपुच्छई"
english: "There she finds the vandita, The pathos of kaunas, At nightfall, With the panjali slipping away." ""

prakrit: "तरुणो'सि अज्जो! पव्वइओ,भोगकालंमि सञ्जया,उवट्ठिओ'सि सामण्णे,एयमट्ठं सुणेमि ता"
english: "Young man, this is the day! My dear, I've got time to enjoy myself, Wait till you see me, Then I'll listen to you." ""

prakrit: "अनाहो मि महारायं! नाहो मज्झ न विज्जई,अनुकम्पगं सुहिं वावि,कञ्चि नाभिसमेमहं"
english: "" "Disgusting! No, I'm not jealous! Compassion, my dear, Is the cause of my misfortune."

prakrit: "तओ सो पहसिओ राया,सेणिओ मगहाहिवो,एवं ते इड्ढिमन्तस्स,कहं नाहो न विज्जई?"
english: "So the hunter is Raya, the warrior is Magaha, and so is the thinker. Where is the ignorance?" ""

prakrit: "होमि नाहो भयन्ताणं,भोगे भुञ्जाहि सञ्जया!,मित्तनाईपरिवुडो,मानुस्सं खु सुदुल्लहं"
english: "Homi naho bhayantana, bhoje bhunjahi sanjaya!, Mitnayi parivoodo, Manus khu sudullaham." ""

prakrit: "अप्पणा वि अनाहो'सि,सेणिया! मगहाहिवा,अप्पणा अनाहो सन्तो,कस्स नाहो भविस्ससि?"
english: "You, yourself are useless, my dear! You, my lord, you are useless. Whom else can you blame?" ""

prakrit: "एवं वुत्तो नरिन्दो सो,सुसम्भन्तो सुविम्हिओ,वयणं अस्सुयपुव्वं,साहुणा विम्हयं निओ"
english: "And the tree is empty, So is the well - endowed one, And the tongue is worthless. The sahuna is useless."

prakrit: "अस्सा हत्थी मनुस्सा मे,पुरं अन्तेउरं च मे,भुञ्जामि मानुसे भोगे,आणा इस्सरियं च मे"
english: "Our hands are with man, our limbs are with him, We roam freely among men, And our emotions are with us."

prakrit: "एरिसे सम्पयग्गंमि,सव्वकामसमप्पिए,कहं अणाहो भवइ? मा हु भन्ते! मुसं वए"
english: "I will go to your house in this way. Everyone is satisfied with your work. Where are you going to lodge your anger?" I said,'I am ready.'" ""

prakrit: "न तुमं जाणे अनाहस्स,अत्थं पॊत्थं च पत्थिवा,जहा अनाहो भवई,सनाहो वा नराहिव!"
english: "You do not know whether to act rashly or rudely, or whether to be rash or negligent!"

prakrit: "सुणेह मे महाराय! अव्वक्खित्तेण चेयसा,जहा अनाहो भवई,जहा मेयं पवत्तियं"
english: "Listen, my lord! Anything you can think of, As long as it doesn't hurt, Is as good as mine."

prakrit: "कोसम्बी नाम नयरी,पुराण पुरभेयणी,तत्थ आसी पिया मज्झं पभूयधनसञ्चओ"
english: "Kosambi naam nayari, puran purabheyani, tath asi piya mujhse prabhuyudhan sanchao."

prakrit: "पढमे वए महारायं! अउला मे अच्छिवेयणा,अहॊत्था विउलो दाहो,सव्वगत्तेसु पत्थिवा"
english: "Great is the reading! Aula me achchchiveyana, Ahotha viulo daho, Sarvagatesu patthiwa"

prakrit: "सत्थं जहा परमतिक्खं,सरीरविवरन्तरे,आवीलिज्ज अरी कुद्धो,एवं मे अच्छिवेयणा"
english: "In the world beyond my body, Wherever I am, There is nothing more for me to achieve."

prakrit: "तियं मे अन्तरिच्छं च,उत्तमङ्गं च पीडई,इन्दासणिसमा घोरा,वेयणा परमदारुणा"
english: "Because I long for the inside, My heart aches, I groan under the weight of indignation, I yearn for the ultimate."

prakrit: "उवट्ठिया मे आयरिया,विज्जामन्ततिगिच्छगा,अबीया सत्थकुसला,मन्तमूलविसारया"
english: "Look! There I am, Wrapped in white gauze, Looking down at the horizon. There you have it, Aunt, With sighs and groans." ""

prakrit: "ते मे तिगिच्छं कुव्वन्ति,चाउप्पायं जहाहियं,न य दुक्खा विमोयन्ति,एसा मज्झ अनाहया"
english: "They make me tremble all the time, They paralyze me to no end, They do not relieve me of my sorrows. Such is my helplessness."

prakrit: "पिया मे सव्वसारम्पि,दिज्जाहि मम कारणा,य दुक्खा विमोएइ,एसा मज्झ अनाहया"
english: "Dear friend, all this trouble is my doing, My cause, This misery is my redemption; It is not my doing."

prakrit: "माया वि मे महाराय! पुत्तसोगदुहट्टिया,न य दुक्खा विमोएइ,एसा मज्झ अनाहया"
english: "Mother - in - law, may I have more! My poor son, There is no escape from sorrow. Such is my helplessness." ""

prakrit: "भायरो मे महाराय! सगा जॆट्ठकनिट्ठगा,न य दुक्खा विमोयन्ति,एसा मज्झ अनाहया"
english: "My brother - in - law! My relatives will stay behind, They will not relieve me of my sorrow. Such is my helplessness." ""

prakrit: "भइणीओ मे महाराय! सगा जॆट्ठकनिट्ठगा,न य दुक्खा विमोयन्ति,एसा मज्झ अनाहया"
english: "Brothers and sisters, may I have more! My relatives will stay behind, They will not relieve me of my grief. Such is my helplessness."

prakrit: "भारिया मे महाराय! अनुरत्ता अणुव्वया,अंसुपुण्णेहिं नयनेहिं,उरं मॆं परिसिञ्चई"
english: "Your highness, I beg of you: Please, please, do not touch me while I am busy making love." ""

prakrit: "अन्नं पानं च ण्हाणं च,गन्धमल्लविलेवणं,मए नायमनायं वा,सा बाला नोवभुञ्जई"
english: "Food and drink and nourishment, A stink of sulphur, A sigh of remorse from me: The child has a new taste."

prakrit: "खणं पि मे महाराय! पासाओ मे न फिट्टई,न य दुक्खा विमोएइ,एसा मज्झ अनाहया"
english: "After all, I'm a great man! My limbs are not my own, Nor am I exempt from suffering. Such is my helplessness." ""

prakrit: "तओ'हं एवमाहंसु,दुक्खमाहु पुणो पुणो,वेयणा अनुभविउं जे,संसारंमि अनन्तए"
english: "Yes, O God of Love, sorrow returns, again and again, Feeling the burden That the cycle of rebirth Endures forever."

prakrit: "सयं च जइ मुञ्च्चॆज्जा,वेयणा विउला इओ,खन्तो दन्तो निरारम्भो,पव्वए अनगारियं"
english: "Allow the nail marks to settle on the tooth." "The nail is loose, The tooth is worn out And the girdle is loose."

prakrit: "एवं च चिन्तइत्ताणं,पासुत्तो मि नराहिवा!,परीयट्टन्तीए राईए,वेयणा मे खयं गया"
english: "And just like that, you fool, Don't let me down!" yelled the stranger, "I've run out of things to wear."

prakrit: "तओ कल्ले पभायंमि,आपुच्छित्ताण बन्धवे,खन्तो दन्तो निरारम्भो,पव्वइओ अनगारियं"
english: "Tomorrow I will fear for you, my dear friend, But one's teeth are worthless. So is my husband's." ""

prakrit: "ततो'हं नाहो जाओ,अप्पणो य परस्स य,सव्वेसिं चेव भूयाणं,तसाणं थावराण य"
english: "Then he said," "No, go; keep to yourself, and keep to others; for all men are like that." ""

prakrit: "अप्पा नई वेयरणी,अप्पा मे कूडसामली,अप्पा कामदुहा धेनू,अप्पा मे नन्दनं वनं"
english: "Appa is a new tree, appa is wood - apple, apa is nectar - like, and so on."

prakrit: "अप्पा कत्ता विकत्ता य दुहाण य सुहाण य,अप्पा मित्तममित्तं च,दुप्पट्ठिय सुपट्ठिओ"
english: "Apa katha vikata ya dukhana ya suhan ya, apa mitram mitram, dupattiya supatmiyo."

prakrit: "इमा हु अन्ना वि अनाहया निवा! तमेगचित्तो निहुओ सुणेहि,नियण्ठधम्मं लहीयाण वी जहा,सीयन्ति एगे बहुकायरा नरा"
english: "Mother, I beg of you, Stop wasting your time elsewhere. Please, do not delay in telling me where you are going." ""

prakrit: "जो पव्वइत्ताण महव्वयाइं,सम्मं च नो फासयई पमाया,अनिग्गहप्पा य रसेसु गिद्धा,न मूलओ छिन्नइ बन्धनं से"
english: "A vulture that has no strings attached, That cannot bend even to touch a woman's breasts, Shows no emotion When approached, And does not break a root With its beak."

prakrit: "आउत्तया जस्स न अत्थि काइ,इरियाए भासाए तहेसणाए,आयाणनिक्खेवदुगुञ्छणाए,न वीरजायं अनुजाइ मग्गं"
english: "Aunt, There is nothing more to be said for it: It speaks through the mouth, Through the nose, And with the tongue It acts as a decoy."

prakrit: "चिरं पि से मुण्डरुई भवित्ता,अथिरव्वए तवनियमेहिं भट्ठे,चिरं पि अप्पाण किलेसइत्ता,न पारए होइ हु सम्पराए"
english: "Always keep your head high, Always be vigilant, Always keep yourself protected, Never be negligent in anything you do."

prakrit: "पोल्ले व मुट्ठी जह से असारे,अयन्तिए कूडकहावने वा,राढामणी वेरुलियप्पगासे,अमहग्घए होइ हु जाणएसु"
english: "Like a flock of parrots, Like a handful of acacia flowers, Like the plucked twigs of a gooseflesh, You'll find out by accident."

prakrit: "कुसीललिङ्गं इह धारइत्ता,इसिज्झयं जीविय बूहइत्ता,असञ्जए सञ्जय लप्पमाणे,विनिग्घायमागच्छइ से चिरम्पि"
english: "It holds a lotus, Brings life to me like this, Like a draught of nectar Shows through the naked eye."

prakrit: "विसं तु पीयं जह कालकूडं,हणाइ सत्थं जह कुग्गहीयं,एसो वि धम्मो विसओववन्नो,हणाइ वेयाल इवाविवन्नो"
english: "Poison is as much a drink as wood, as much as an intoxicant as a decoction, and this dharma is like poison; the cucumber is like a weed."

prakrit: "जे लक्खणं सुविण पउञ्जमाणे,निमित्तकोऊहलसम्पगाढे,कुहेडविज्जासवरदारजीवी,न गच्छई सरणं तंमि काले"
english: "Those who like a good omen, Like the cool breeze blowing from the scorched earth, Can't walk upright, Live with broad hips: Time will catch up with them."

prakrit: "तमन्तमेणेव उ से असीले,सया दुही विप्परियासुवेइ,सन्धावई नरगतिरिक्खजोणिं,मोनं विराहॆत्तु असाहुरुवे"
english: "They are so irresolute That they cause grief, Such horrendous acts, Such senseless acts of cowardice And want nothing to do with the soul."

prakrit: "उद्देसियं कीयगडं नियागं,न मुञ्चई किञ्चि अनेसणिज्जं,अग्गी विवा सव्वभक्खी भवित्ता,इत्तो चुए गच्छइ कट्टु पावं"
english: "It's my business to tell you what to do, I don't want anything from you, You'd better eat everything else. The fire will burn all over again, This is how the poor thing gets away."

prakrit: "न तं अरी कण्ठ छॆत्ता करेइ,जं से करे अप्पणिया दुरप्पा,से नाहिइं मच्चुमुहं तु पत्ते,पच्छानुतावेण दयाविहूणो"
english: "You won't cut her throat. What she'll do to you is disgusting. No, you fool, Your face is leafy. Instead, your anger will find a place in your heart."

prakrit: "निरत्थया नग्गरुई उ तस्स,जे उत्तमट्ठे विवज्जा समेइ,इमे वि से नत्थि परं वि लोए,दुहओ वि से झिज्जइ तत्थ लोए"
english: "One who walks aimlessly gets angry, One who sits with one's lover At odd hours, Another who walks behind the other, That who is afraid of both."

prakrit: "एमेव'हा छन्दकुसीलरूवे,मग्गं विराहित्तु जिणुत्तमाणं,कुररी विवा भोगरसाणुगिद्धा,निरट्ठसोया परियावमेइ"
english: "It is the sound of the flute That makes one groan, The song of separation that makes one tremble, The poem About love devoid of passion, Like a farewell song." ""

prakrit: "सॊच्चाण मेहावि सुभासियं इमं,अनुसासनं नाणगुणोववेयं,मग्गं कुसीलाण जहाय सव्वं,महानियण्ठाण वए पहेणं"
english: "Sound judgment is the essence of good fortune, Discipline is the virtue of character, Decency is the means by which all things progress, And prudence is the path of the wise."

prakrit: "चरित्तमायारगुणन्निए तओ,अनुत्तरं सञ्जम पालियाणं,निरासवे सङ्खवियाण कम्मं,उवेइ ठामं विउलुत्तमं धुवं"
english: "Virtuous are the virtues of character; unanswerable are the observances of righteousness; hopeless is the act of counting oneself out; in the same place there washes away the faults"

prakrit: "एवुग्गदन्ते'वि महातवॊधने,महामुनी महापइन्ने महायसे,महानियण्ठिज्जमिणं महासुयं,से काहए महया वित्थरेणं"
english: "They are a great burden, A great duty in a great man's hands. A great burden is too great For them To bear."

prakrit: "तुट्ठो य सेणिओ राया,इणमुदाहु कयञ्जली,अनाहत्तं जहाभूयं,सुट्ठु मे उवदंसियं"
english: "Tut tho ya senio raya, Anumudahu kyanjali, Anahattam yaha bhuyyam, Sutthu mei udvadansyam."

prakrit: "तुज्झं सुलद्धं खु मनुस्स जम्मं,लाभा सुलद्धा य तुमे महेसी!,तुब्भे सनाहा य सबन्धवा य,जं भे ठिया मग्गे जिनुत्तमाणं"
english: "You are a happy man, You are wealthy, You bring wealth, You make friends, Whatever you ask for I will give you."

prakrit: "तं सि नाहो अनाहाणं,सव्वभूयाण सञ्जया,खामेमि ते महाभाग! इच्छामि अनुसासिउं"
english: "I am not angry with him, I am completely at ease with everything, I will forgive him, But I want to follow him." ""

prakrit: "पुच्छिऊण मए तुब्भं,झाणविग्घाओ य जो कओ,निमन्तिया य भोगेहिं,तं सव्वं मरिसेहि मे"
english: "Ask me anything, I will reply, Anything you say or do I will deny."

prakrit: "एवं थुणित्ताण से रायसीहो,अनगारसीहं परमाइ भत्तीए,सओरोहो य सपरियणो सबन्धवो,धम्मानुरत्तो विमलेण चेयसा"
english: "And be content with your breasts, For I am free from indignation, And you are free to make love, As if you were a relative of the poor."

prakrit: "ऊससियरोमकूवो,काऊण य पयाहिणं,अभिवन्दिऊण सिरसा,अइयाओ नराहिवो"
english: "Foolish girl, Why are you laughing so much, You fool, You coward?"

prakrit: "इयरो वि गुणसमिद्धो,तिगुत्तिगुत्तो तिदण्डविरओ य,विहग इव विप्पमुक्को,विहरइ वसुहं विगयमोहो"
english: "Every one is endowed with virtues, Every one has talents, No one is free from them, The world is full of wretched people, The vast majority are wise."

prakrit: "चम्पाए पालिए नाम,सावए आसि वाणिए,महावीरस्स भगवओ,सीसे सो उ महप्पणो"
english: "Champaye paaliye naam, saavaye asi vaaniye, Mahavirasa bhagavayo, Seeso wooh mahapanam."

prakrit: "निग्गन्थे पावयणे,सावए से वि कोविए,पोएण ववहरन्ते,पिहुण्डं नगरमागए"
english: "The streets are empty, The rivers are swollen, And the rivers are overflowing; We have to go back to our villages."

prakrit: "पिहुण्डे ववहरन्तस्स,वाणिओ देइ धूयरं,तं ससत्तं पइगिज्झ,सदेसमह पत्थिओ"
english: "The rainy season is behind us, The dust has settled on the streets, The poor thing is the roads everywhere."

prakrit: "अह पालियस्स घरणी,समुद्दंमि पसवई,अह बालए तहिं जाए,समुद्दपालि त्ति नामए"
english: "Oh! the house of Palias! The sea is pleasant to the eye, And the boy is welcome there. The ship's name is Pali of the sea."

prakrit: "खेमेण आगए चम्पं,सावए वाणिए घरं,संवड्ढई धरे तस्स,दारए से सुहोइए"
english: "Aunt, let's light a lamp, Let's go to the merchant's house, Let the storm spoil it, Let it shine through the door."

prakrit: "बावत्तरी कलाओ य,सिक्खई नीइकोविए,जोव्वणेण य सम्पन्ने,सुरुवे पियदंसणे"
english: "Let the watermelon blossom, Let the girl learn to knit, Let her youth run its course, At first glance she is drunk."

prakrit: "तस्स रूववइं भज्जं,पिया आणेइ रूविणिं,पासाए कीलए रम्मे,देवो दोगुन्दओ जहा"
english: "His hair is red, His robes are white, His jewels are yellow, His bracelets are red. God is kind to both."

prakrit: "अह अन्नया कयाई,पासायालोयणे ठिओ,वज्झ मण्डणसॊभागं,वज्झं पासइ वज्झगं"
english: "Oh! what a strange thing it is To be at your neighbor's side, To be part of his entourage, To sound like a trumpet."

prakrit: "तं पासिऊण संविग्गो,समुद्दपालो इणमब्बवी,अहो'सुभाण कम्माणं,निज्जाणं पावगं इमं"
english: "Come to think of it, you silly girl. Ah, the pleasures of love, Such is the way of good people."

prakrit: "सम्बुद्धो सो तहिं भगवं,परमसंवेगमागओ,आपुच्छ'म्मापियरो,पव्वए अनगारियं"
english: "Be enlightened, then, God, have great compassion, For my dear friends, You are always negligent."

prakrit: "जहित्तु सग्गन्थ महाकिलेसं,महन्तमोहं कसिणं भयाणगं,परियायधम्मं च'भिरोयऎज्जा,वयाणि सीलाणि परीसहे य"
english: "As long as there is good fortune, There is great fear, For great love is but a scarecrow's tail, And falsehood is nothing to fear; Vayani Silani is nothing like a fairy."

prakrit: "अहिंस सच्चं च अतेणगं च,तत्तो य बम्भं अपरिग्गहं च,पडिवज्जिया पञ्च महव्वयाणि,चरिज्ज धम्मं जिनदेसियं विदू"
english: "Non - violence is the essence of truth and non - violence, so is falsehood and falsehood, so are the five great vows of chastity."

prakrit: "सव्वेहिं भूएहिं दयानुकम्पी,खन्तिक्खमे सञ्जयबम्भयारी,सावज्जजोगं परिवज्जयन्तो,चरिज्ज भिक्खू सुसमाहिइन्दिए"
english: "Compassionate in all respects, compassionate in one's life, Kindhearted in another's, Kind and considerate in every way; Qualified monks prosper."

prakrit: "कालेण कालं विहरॆज्ज रट्ठे,बलाबलं जाणिय अप्पणो य,सीहो व सद्देण न सन्तसॆज्जा वयजोग सुच्चा न असम्भमाहु"
english: "Summer is a long way off, You know how to be strong, Always be vigilant, Never be hasty, Never give in to age."

prakrit: "उवेहमाणो उ परिव्वऎज्जा,पियमप्पियं सव्व तितिक्खऎज्जा,न सव्व सव्वत्थ'भिरोयऎज्जा,न यावि पूयं गरहं च सञ्जए"
english: "Wretchedness is the remover's burden, Dear friends, all weariness is wearisome, not all fear is justified, Nor is there room for pride."

prakrit: "अनेगच्छन्दामिह मानवेहिं,जे भावओ से पगरेइ भिक्खू,भयभेरवा तत्थ उइन्ति भीमा,दिव्वा मणुस्सा अदुवा तिरिच्छा"
english: "I have seen so many monsters before me: The monk who is led astray by emotion, The landowner who is so full of fear That he turns his back on all men."

prakrit: "परीसहा दुव्विसहा अनेगे,सीयन्ति जत्था बहुकायरा नरा,से तत्थ पत्ते न वहिज्ज भिक्खु,सङ्गामसीसे इव नागराया"
english: "Aunt, Wherever you go for a long time There are no leaves to be plucked. Don't go walking around like a monk. It's just the way things happen." ""

prakrit: "सीओसिणा दंसमसा य फासा,आयङ्का विविहा फुसन्ति देहं,अकुक्कुओ तत्थ'हियासऎज्जा,रयाइ खेवॆज्ज पुराकडाइं"
english: "The fire was burning, The flames were swelling, The body was aching, The limbs were wobbling, The hair was loose, The nails were bristling."

prakrit: "पहाय रागं च तहेव दोसं,मोहं च भिक्ख सययं वियक्खणो,मेरु व्व वाएण व अकम्पमाणो,परीसहे आयगुत्ते सहॆज्जा"
english: "Love and anger are our faults, Lust and begging are our enemies, Like the axe that pierces through the wind, Friendship with a strange one ensues."

prakrit: "अणुन्नए नावणए महेसी,न यावि पूयं गरहं च सञ्जए,से उज्जुभावं पडिवज्ज सञ्जए,निव्वाणमग्गं विरए उवेइ"
english: "A man who is not captivated by a good boat, Who does not smell of flowers or garlands, Applies a bright fragrance to a poor man's heart, Who empties it of impurities."

prakrit: "अरइरइसहे पहीणसन्थवे,विरए आयहिए पहाणवे,परमट्ठपएहिं चिट्ठई,छिन्नसोए अममे अकिञ्चणे"
english: "Alas! the wheels have come to a standstill, The bolt of lightning has struck hard, The letter is stuck in my heart, And I am at a loss what to write with it."

prakrit: "विवित्तलयणाइ भऎज्ज ताई,निरोवलेवाइं असन्थडाइं,इसीहिं चिण्णाइं महायसेहिं,काएण फासॆज्ज परीसहाइं"
english: "Detachment is the greatest weapon, Destruction is the only weapon, For this reason great sacrifices are made."

prakrit: "सन्नाणनाणोवगए महेसी,अनुत्तरं चरिउं धम्मसञ्चयं,अनुत्तरे नाणधरे जसंसी,ऒभासई सुरिए वं'तलिक्खे"
english: "Silence is the remover of sins, Mahesi is the observer of dharmas, Dhamma is the preserver of answers, Jealousy prevails over words, And delights are banished."

prakrit: "दुविहं खवेऊण य पुण्णपावं,निरङ्गणे सव्वओ विप्पमुक्के,तरित्ता समुद्दं व महाभवॊघं,समुद्दपाले अपुणागमं गए"
english: "The sea is churning, Everyone is trembling, The streets are emptying out, The rivers are overflowing, The banks of the Goda Are overflowing with rainwater."

prakrit: "सोरियपुरंमि नयरे,आसि राया महिड्ढिए,वसुदेव त्ति नामेणं,रायलक्खणसञ्जुए"
english: "Soriyapurami Nayare, Asi Raya Mahidhyae, Vasudeva Tamena, Rayalakshanasanjuye." ""

prakrit: "तस्स भज्जा दुवे आसी,रोहिणी देवई तहा,तासिं दॊण्हं दुवे पुत्ता,इट्ठा रामकेसवा"
english: "There are two bhajans for him, The one for Rohini and the other for her son, And here is Rama's hair." ""

prakrit: "सोरियपुरंमि नयरे,आसि राया महिड्ढिए,समुद्दविजए नामं,रायलक्खणसञ्जुए"
english: "Soriapurami Nayare, Asi Raya Mahidhyae, Samudra Vijaya Naame, Rayalakshanasanjuye."

prakrit: "तस्स भज्जा सिवा नाम,तीसे पुत्तो महायसो,भगवं अरिट्ठनेमि त्ति,लोगनाहे दमीसरे"
english: "His name is simply Bhajja, his son is a great leader. I will never forget him: People are always angry with me."

prakrit: "सो'रिट्ठनेमिनामो उ,लक्खणस्सरसञ्जुओ,अट्ठसहस्सलक्खणधरो,गोयमो कालगच्छवी"
english: "So return, my dear, With hundreds of thousands of jewels in your hands. Let the passage of time go by." ""

prakrit: "वज्जरिसहसङ्घयणो,समचउरंसो झसोयरो,तस्स रायमईकन्नं,भज्जं जायइ केसवो"
english: "Union with the Vajrayana, Shaking the whole wheel, Trembling at the same time, That is the nature of anger: It is the saffron that is burnt."

prakrit: "अह सा रायवरकन्ना,सुसीला चारुपेहणी,सव्वलक्खणसम्पन्ना,विज्जुसोयामणिप्पभा"
english: "Oh! she is Rayavarakanna, Susila is all round, She has all the senses, She is well versed in knowledge."

prakrit: "अहाह जणओ तीसे,वासुदेवं महिड्ढियं,इहागच्छउ कुमारो,जो से कन्नं ददामि'हं"
english: "Ah! people! Such is the greatness of Vasudeva. Look at these little ones! Whom I owe my ear to." ""

prakrit: "सव्वोसहीहिं ण्हविओ,कयकोउयमङ्गलो,दिव्वजुयलपरिहिओ,आभरणेहिं विभूसिओ"
english: "Be kind to all people, Be considerate to all beings, Be courteous to all, Be thoughtful with ornaments."

prakrit: "मत्तं च गन्धहत्थिं च,वासुदेवस्स जॆट्ठगं,आरूढो सोहए अहियं,सिरे चूडामणी जहा"
english: "Intoxicants and myriad smells, The jewels of Vasudeva's heart, Are a pleasure to behold Now, my dear, Where is the powder of my jasmine?"

prakrit: "अह ऊसिएण छत्तेण,चामराहि य सोहिए,दसारचक्केण तओ,सव्वओ परिवारिओ"
english: "Ah, the cotton beds, The beds in the shed, The mirror in the mirror, All the rest of the family."

prakrit: "चउरङ्गिणीए सेनाए,रइयाए जहक्कमं,तुरियाण सन्निनाएणं,दिव्वेणं गगनं फुसे"
english: "The women in the courtyard, The army, The fires burning, The trumpet chimes blaring, The sky is red with lightning."

prakrit: "एयारिसाए इड्ढीए,जुत्तीए उत्तमाइ य,नियगाओ भवनाओ,निज्जाओ वण्हिपुङ्गवो"
english: "Be nice to each other, be polite, be courteous, be reasonable, be honest, and use your senses."

prakrit: "अह सो तत्थ निज्जन्तो,दिस्स पाने भयद्दुए,वाडेहिं पञ्जरेहिं च,सन्निरुद्धे सुदुक्खिए"
english: "Ah! there you are, living among your own people: Fearful of being seen, Afraid of the fence and the fence; In front of you one can find happiness."

prakrit: "जीवियन्तं तु सम्पत्ते,मंसट्ठा भक्खियव्वए,पासित्ता से महापन्ने,सारहिं इणमब्बवी"
english: "As long as you live, you are wealthy, Your mind is free, And your heart is full of love."

prakrit: "कस्स अट्ठा इमे पाणा,एए सव्वे सुहेसिणो,वाडेहिं पञ्जरेहिं च,सन्निरुद्धा य अच्छहिं?"
english: "Whom is it, my dear, That everyone is so fond of? It's the fence and the crows. Is the fence good or bad?"

prakrit: "अह सारही तओ भणई,एए भद्दा उ पाणिणो,तुज्झं विवाहकज्जंमि,भोयावेउं बहुं जनं"
english: "Oh! you naughty girl," he said, "I beg of you to marry me. Too many people will be afraid of you."

prakrit: "सोऊण तस्स वयणं,बहुपाणिविनासणं,चिन्तेइ से महापन्नो,सानुक्कोसे जिएहिं ऊ"
english: "Through affection one can understand speech, through non - violence, through thought one can conceal greatness, through penance one can live a long life."

prakrit: "जइ मज्झ कारणा एए,हम्मन्ति सुबहू जिया,न मे एयं तु निस्सेसं,परलोगे भविस्सई"
english: "If this is my reason, My good wife, Don't be so hasty. You'll fall in love with me."

prakrit: "सो कुण्डलाण जुयलं,सुत्तगं च महायसो,आभरणाणि य सव्वाणि,सारहिस्स पणामए"
english: "So the plowman gambles, The hunter makes great sacrifices, And all the jewellers play the flute." ""

prakrit: "मनपरिणामो य कओ,देवा य जहोइयं समोइण्णा,सव्वड्ढीइ सपरिसा,निक्खमणं तस्स काउं जे"
english: "Let there be penance for what is wrong, For God is kindred spirit, For all good things come to an end."

prakrit: "देवमनुस्सपरिवुडो,सिबियारयणं तओ समारुढो,निक्खमिय बारगाओ,रेवययंमि ट्ठिओ भगवं"
english: "The God of men is Parivudo, Those who worship the God of Love are Samaruddho, And those who worship Him are Bargao."

prakrit: "उज्जाणं सम्पत्तो,ओइण्णो उत्तमाउ सीयाओ,साहस्सीइ परिवुडो,अह निक्खमई उ चित्ताहिं"
english: "He has abundant wealth, He has excellent friends, He is a brave man, And I am completely free."

prakrit: "अह से सुगन्धगन्धीए,तुरियं मउकुञ्चिए,सयमेव लुञ्चई केसे,पञ्चमुट्ठीहिं समाहिओ"
english: "Oh! the fragrant scent of jasmine, Calm the sighs of the trumpet, How easy it is for you to conceal your feelings: Hold on to your five handfuls."

prakrit: "वासुदेवो य णं भणई,लुत्तकेसं जिइन्दियं,इच्छियमनोरहं तुरियं,पावसु तं दमीसरा"
english: "Vasudeva said:" "I will not lie, For what is hidden I will live." "With a willing heart I will shoot."

prakrit: "नाणेणं दंसणेणं च,चरित्तेणं तहेव य,खन्तीए मुत्तीए,वड्ढमाणो भवाहि य"
english: "Weighing and looking at each other, Keeping one's character pure, Careful pearling, Increasingly vigorous bowing."

prakrit: "एवं ते रामकेसवा,दसारा य बहू जना,अरिट्ठनेमिं वन्दित्ता,अभिगया बारगापुरिं"
english: "And that Rama - kesava, the daughter - in - law of Dasara, preached in Arithana, taught in Abhigaya Bargapuri." ""

prakrit: "सोऊण रायकन्ना,पव्वज्जं सा जिनस्स उ,नीहासा य निरानन्दा,सोगेण उ समुच्छिया"
english: "Love is like a poem, Like poetry It consumes much energy, Like tears that make one sigh, Like ecstasy that makes one despair."

prakrit: "राईमई विचिन्तेइ,धिरत्थु मम जीवियं,जा हं तेण परिच्चत्ता,सेयं पव्वइउं मम"
english: "Nature is my imagination, nature is my life, I am content with that, she is my wife."

prakrit: "अह सा भमरसंनिभे,कुच्चफणगपसाहिए,सयमेव लुञ्चई केसे,धिइमन्ता ववस्सिया"
english: "Oh! the bee's beak, Like a flock of parrots falling from a rafter's eye, Is always limping, Like an old farmer's son." ""

prakrit: "वासुदेवो य णं भणइ,लुत्तकेसं जिइन्दियं,संसारसागरं घोरं,तर कन्ने! लहुं लहुं"
english: "Vasudeva says:" "Life is short, The ocean is rough, But the ears! Wear red." ""

prakrit: "सा पव्वइया सन्ती,पव्वावेसी तहिं बहुं,सयणं परियणं चेव,सीलवन्ता बहुस्सुया"
english: "She is satisfied with her husband, She is very fond of him, She loves men very much, She has many lovers who are sealed."

prakrit: "गिरिं रेवतयं जन्ती,वासेणुल्ला उ अन्तरा,वासन्ते अन्धयारंमि,अन्तो लयणस्स साठिया"
english: "In summer the sky is red, In autumn the clouds are high, In spring the skies are dark, And in autumn the lions lie motionless."

prakrit: "चीवराइं विसारन्ती,जहा जाय त्ति पासिया,रहनेमी भग्गचित्तो,पच्छा दिट्ठो य तीइ वि"
english: "She scatters tears Wherever you are by your side She is full of fear, Whether you look at her favourably Or not."

prakrit: "भीया य सा तहिं दट्ठुं,एगन्ते सञ्जयं तयं,बाहाहिं काउ सङ्गॊप्फं,वेवमाणी निसीयई"
english: "Aunt, Look at that girl! There she is, Standing in line, With her arms wrapped around her." ""

prakrit: "अह सो'वि रायपुत्तो,समुद्दविजयङ्गओ,भीयं पवेवियं दट्ठुं,इमं वक्कं उदाहरे"
english: "Oh! he is a son of the soil, The sea is a victory, Fearful people look on; This is the example of the wicked."

prakrit: "रहनेमी अहं भद्दे! सुरुवे चारुभासिणी!,ममं भयाहि सुतनु,न ते पीला भविस्सई"
english: "I am disgusted! You coward! My daughter - in - law is angry. Don't sleep for fear of me. She won't turn yellow." ""

prakrit: "एहि ता भुञ्जिमो भोए,माणुस्सं खु सुदुल्लहं,भुत्तभोगी तओ पच्छा,जिनमग्गं चरिस्सिमो"
english: "Here I am, my poor brother - in - law's son, A decent man indeed; There you are, a poor man's daughter; On the other hand, my character is pure."

prakrit: "दट्ठुण रहनेमिं तं,भग्गुज्जोयपराजियं,राइमई असम्भन्ता,अप्पाणं संवरे तहिं"
english: "To be seen is to be feared, To be feared is a state of affairs, To speak is an impossibility; To cherish oneself is to remain so."

prakrit: "अह सा रायवरकन्ना,सुट्ठिया नियमव्वए,जाई कुलं च सीलं च,रक्खमाणी तयं वए"
english: "Oh! she is Raivarakanna, the soothsayer is Niyamavya, the tree is Jaivikula and Seelam, the protector is Thy vaaya."

prakrit: "जइ सि रुवेण वेसमणो,ललिएण नलकुब्बरो,तहा वि ते न इच्छामि,जइ'सि सक्खं पुरन्दरो"
english: "If you weep like a man in disguise, If you groan like a lily, I shall not wish it on you."

prakrit: "धिरत्थु ते'जसोकामी,जो तं जीवियकारणा,वन्तं इच्छसि आवेउं,सेयं ते मरणं भवे"
english: "Come," said the doe, "Let the man who caused her to live, come, if you will; let him be put to death."

prakrit: "अहं च भोगरायस्स,तं च सि अन्धगवण्हिणो,मा कुले गन्धणा होमो,सञ्जमं निहुओ चर"
english: "I am the enjoyer, so is he, And so is the blind cowherd. But don't let the scent get to you. Take me away, my dear." ""

prakrit: "जइ तं काहिसि भावं,जा जा दिच्छसि नारिओ,वायाविद्धो व्व हडो,अट्ठिअप्पा भविस्ससि"
english: "Whatever your mood, You're going to look like a woman. If you turn your back on me You'd better stop." ""

prakrit: "गोवालो भण्डवालो वा,जहा तद्दव्व निस्सरो,एवं अनिस्सरो तं पि,सामण्णस्स भविस्ससि"
english: "You coward, you hypocrite, Wherever the right is weak And wherever the wrong is true, There you will meet."

prakrit: "कोहं मानं निगिण्हित्ता,मायं लॊभं च सव्वसो,इन्दियाइं वसे काउं,अप्पाणं उवसंहरे"
english: "Whom do you think you are talking about? Love and affection are everywhere. The Indians live in the town. They conceal themselves."

prakrit: "तीसे सो वयणं सॊच्चा,सञ्जयाए सुभासियं,अङ्कुसेण जहा नागो,धम्मे सम्पडिवाइओ"
english: "Through him, speech is pure, through him, wisdom is supreme, through Ankus, the Nagas are everywhere; in Dharma, the world is abundant."

prakrit: "मनगुत्तो वयगुत्तो,कायगुत्तो जिइन्दिओ,सामण्णं निच्चलं फासे,जावज्जीवं दढव्वओ"
english: "Make fool of yourself, make wise ones, Keep alive the arrows of the God of Love, Hold fast the bow of Love."

prakrit: "उग्गं तवं चरित्ताणं,जाया दॊन्नि वि केवली,सव्वं कम्मं खवित्ताणं,सिद्धिं पत्ता अनुत्तरं"
english: "Nature is generous, kindness is free, all action is futile, perfection is elusive."

prakrit: "एवं करॆन्ति सम्बुद्धा,पण्डिया पवियक्खणा,विणियट्टन्ति भोगेसु,जहा सो पुरिसॊत्तमो"
english: "And he calls for meditation, Pandyas call for purification, Vinyattanti bhogesu, As long as I am pure."

prakrit: "जिणे पासि त्ति नामेण,अरहा लोगपूइओ,सम्बुद्धप्पा य सव्वन्नू,धम्मतित्थयरे जिने"
english: "In the name of the living being, O penitent people, In all wisdom, Live according to Dharma."

prakrit: "तस्स लोगपईवस्स,आसि सीसे महायसे,केसी कुमारसमणे,विज्जाचरणपारगे"
english: "Such a man is powerful, Such a one is great, Such an one is like a son; He knows everything through knowledge."

prakrit: "ओहिनाणसुए बुद्धे,सीससङ्घसमाउले,गामाणुगामं रीयन्ते,सावत्थिं पुरमागए"
english: "They like to sleep in the sun, To lie in wait for the arrival of the rainy season, To walk about the village streets, To purify the streets."

prakrit: "तिन्दुयं नाम उज्जाणं,तंमि नगरमण्डले,फासुए सिज्जसन्थारे,तत्थ वासमुवागए"
english: "Thy name is Ujjāna, Thy city is Mandala, Thirsty waters flow from the sky; There the arbor will be."

prakrit: "अह तेणेव कालेणं,धम्मतित्थयरे जिने,भगवं वद्धमाणु त्ति,सव्वलोगंमि विस्सुए"
english: "Ah, those were the days; The Dharma was eternal; The Lord is supreme; I can see the whole world through his eyes."

prakrit: "तस्स लोगपईवस्स,आसि सीसे महायसे,भगवं गोयमे नामं,विज्जाचरणपारए"
english: "His name is Goyame, He knows everything, He is a man of great learning."

prakrit: "बारसङ्गविऊ बुद्धे,सीससङ्घसमाउले,गामानुगामं रीयन्ते,से'वि सावत्थिमागए"
english: "The wise gather around, At the junction of seasons, Reunite village after village, They too shall come to naught."

prakrit: "कॊट्ठगं नाम उज्जाणं,तंमी नगरमण्डले,फासुए सिज्जसन्थारे,तत्थ वासमुवागए"
english: "The name of the town is Ujjāṇa, so is the district of the city, So is the habitation there, Like the straight path." ""

prakrit: "केसी कुमारसमणे,गोयमे य महायसे,उभओ'वि तत्थ विहरिंसु,अल्लीणा सुसमाहिया"
english: "Keshi kumara sammane, goyame ya mahayase, uthavu thatha viharnasu, allena susamahya"

prakrit: "उभओ सीससङ्घाणं,सञ्जयाणं तवस्सिणं,तत्थ चिन्ता समुप्पन्ना,गुणवन्ताण ताइणं"
english: "Arise, awake, awaken, await the moment of reckoning; There the concentration of thought, the training of virtuous children."

prakrit: "केरिसो वा इमो धम्मो,इमो धम्मो व केरिसो?,आयारधम्मपणिही,इमा वा सा व केरिसी?"
english: "Keriso wa imo dharma, emo dhamma wa keriso?, Ayardhammapanihi, ima wa sa wa Kerisi?" ""

prakrit: "चाउज्जामो य जो धम्मो,जो इमो पञ्चसिक्खिओ,देसिओ वद्धमाणेण पासेण य महामुनी"
english: "The follower of dharma, who learns the five vows, Travels the world as one who has attained enlightenment."

prakrit: "अचेलओ य जो धम्मो,जो इमो सन्तरुत्तरो,एगकज्जपवन्नाणं,विसेसे किं नु कारणं?"
english: "What is the reason for such a sudden upsurge in dharma, this outpouring of emotion, this burst of ecstasy?"

prakrit: "अह ते तत्थ सीसाणं,विन्नाय पवितक्कियं,समागमे कयमई,उभओ केसिगोयमा"
english: "Ah, that was the season, Without purification in sight, When can I meet you? Get up! It's like playing the flute."

prakrit: "गोयमे पडिरुवन्नू,सीससङ्घसमाउले,जॆट्ठं कुलमवॆक्खन्तो,तिन्दुयं वनमागओ"
english: "Fallen in the Goya, When the seasons are ripe, When one can see the jasmine in the open, When all three return to the forest."

prakrit: "केसी कुमारसमणे,गोयमं दिस्समागयं,पडिरुवं पडिवत्तिं,सम्मं सम्पडिवज्जई"
english: "Kesi kumarsamane, Goyyam dissa samagayam, Padiruvam padivaruttim, Samam sampadivajjayi."

prakrit: "पलालं फासुयं तत्थ,पञ्चमं कुसतणाणि य,गोयमस्स निसॆज्जाए,खिप्पं सम्पणामए"
english: "The plowman's son is hanging there, The fifth is wrestling, The cows are being weaned, The rest have gone astray."

prakrit: "केसी कुमारसमणे,गोयमे य महायसे,उभओ निसण्णा सोहन्ति,चन्दसूरसमप्पभा"
english: "Keshi kumara sammane, goyame ya mahayase, ubho nisanna suhanti, chandasura samappabha."

prakrit: "समागया बहू तत्थ,पासण्डा कोउगा मिया,गिहत्थाणं अनेगाओ,साहस्सीओ समागया"
english: "Friendship is a daughter - in - law; affection is a passion; jealousy is an obsession; the brave are united."

prakrit: "देवदानवगन्धव्वा,जक्खरक्खसकिंनरा,अदिस्साणं च भूयाणं,आसी तत्थ समागमो"
english: "The gods and goddesses, The hunter of fairies, And the traveler of miseries - behold, we are meeting together there."

prakrit: "पुच्छामि ते महाभाग! केसी गोयममब्बवी,तओ केसिं बुवन्तं तु,गोयमो इणमब्बवी"
english: "I beg your pardon! Who is a cowgirl? But how can you be so naïve? It's the cowgirl in question." ""

prakrit: "पुच्छ भन्ते! जहिच्छं ते,केसिं गोयममब्बवी,तओ केसी अणुन्नाए,गोयमं इणमब्बवी"
english: "They ask:" "How are you going to do it? You go - between?" "Who will tell you what to do? It's not the cow."

prakrit: "चाउज्जामो य जो धम्मो,जो इमो पञ्चसिक्खिओ,देसिओ वद्धमाणेणं,पासेण य महामुनी"
english: "Knowledge is the supreme dharma, Emotion the supreme, Knowledge the supreme."

prakrit: "एगकज्जपवन्नाणं,विसेसे किं नु कारणं?,धम्मे दुविहे मेहावी,कहं विप्पच्चओ न ते?"
english: "What is the reason for this separation? There are two great vows in Dharma; how can one not be wretched?"

prakrit: "तओ केसिं बुवन्तं तु,गोयमो इणमब्बवी,पन्ना समिक्खए धम्मं,तत्तं तत्तविनिच्छियं"
english: "So what are you doing here, you stupid girl? I've always wanted to know everything about Dharma."

prakrit: "पुरिमा उज्जुजडा उ,वङ्कजडा य पच्छिमा,मज्झिमा उज्जुपन्ना उ,तेण धम्मे दुहा कए"
english: "Purima is bright, Vraja is barren, Majjhima is bright; That is why there is sorrow in Dharma."

prakrit: "पुरिमाणं दुव्विसॊज्झो उ,चरिमाणं दुरनुपालओ,कप्पो मज्झिमगाणं तु,सुविसॊज्झो सुपालओ"
english: "You fool, You coward, You swallow a lot of poison, You traitor, You cheat."

prakrit: "साहु गोयम! पन्ना ते,छिन्नो मे संसओ इमो,अन्नो वि संसओ मज्झं,तं मे कहसु गोयमा!"
english: "Sahu Goyam! Panna te, chinno mein sansao imo, anno vi sansano mujham, tahin mein kahsu goyama!"

prakrit: "अचेलगो य जो धम्मो,जो इमो सन्तरुत्तरो,देसिओ वद्धमाणेण,पासेण य महाजसा"
english: "Soon the dharma will be over, the emotions will be at rest, The world will be upended, The passage of time will be overwhelming."

prakrit: "एगकज्जपवन्नाणं,विसेसे किं नु कारणं?,लिङ्गे दुविहे मेहावी,कहं विप्पच्चओ न ते?"
english: "What's the reason for the separation? It's just a mix of both. How can he not be bothered?"

prakrit: "तओ केसिं बुवाणं तु,गोयमो इणमब्बवी,विन्नाणेण समागम्म,धम्मसाहणमिच्छियं"
english: "How old are you, you cowardly fool, Going to and fro in search of happiness? I seek refuge in Dharma."

prakrit: "पच्चयत्थं च लोगस्स,नानाविहविगप्पणं,जत्तत्थं गहणत्थं च,लोगे लिङ्गपओयणं"
english: "Virtuous means logas, varied forms of worship, jathāma and solemn meanings; people worship lingas."

prakrit: "अह भवे पइन्ना उ,मॊक्खसब्भूयसाहणा,नाणं च दंसणं चेव,चरित्तं चेव निच्छए"
english: "Oh! there must be love, There must be affection, Love without pretence, And there must also be sting in the girdle."

prakrit: "साहु गोयम! पन्ना ते,छिन्नो मे संसओ इमो,अन्नो'वि संसओ मज्झं,तं मे कहसु गोयमा!"
english: "Sahu goyam! Panna te, chinno mein sansao imo, anno vi sansano mujham, tahin mein kahsu goyama!"

prakrit: "अनेगाणं सहस्साणं,मज्झे चिट्ठसि गोयमा!,ते य ते अहिगच्छन्ति,कहं ते निज्जिया तुमे?"
english: "You know how difficult it is for me To write a letter to you! But you don't. Where are you going to put it?"

prakrit: "एगे जिए जिया पञ्च,पञ्च जिए जिया दस,दसहा उ जिणित्ताणं,सव्वसत्तू जिणाम'हं"
english: "Aage jiye jiya panch, panch jiya dus, dasa hai woh jeenitthan, sab sawastu jinaam hai." ""

prakrit: "सत्तू य इइ के वुत्ते? केसी गोयममब्बवी,तओ केसिं बुवन्तं तु,गोयमो इणमब्बवी"
english: "Whom do you think you are talking to? A cowboy, yes, a buffalo! But how can you say that? It is a cowboy's daughter." ""

prakrit: "एग'प्पे अजिए सत्तू,कसाया इन्दियाणि य,ते जिणित्तु जहानायं,विहरामि अहं मुनी"
english: "Aunt, You're right; The butcher is an Indian. He's won over by the fires of victory. I'm a wandering sage."

prakrit: "दीसन्ति बहवे लोए,पासबद्धा सरीरिणो,मुक्कपासो लहुब्भूओ,कहं तं विहरसी मुनी!"
english: "Long - eyed girl, With a slender body, Bowed over by pearls, How strange a thing it is to be a hermit!"

prakrit: "ते पासे सव्वसो छित्ता,निहन्तूण उवायओ,मुक्कपासो लहुब्भूओ,विहरामि अहं मुनी!"
english: "By the way, everyone is hiding here, The women are laughing without saying a word, The men are laughing but I'm a sage!"

prakrit: "पासा य इइ के वुत्ता? केसी गोयममब्बवी,तओ केसिं बुवन्तं तु,गोयमो इणमब्बवी"
english: "Is this the way of the dice? Who is a cowgirl? But how can you be so foolish? It's the cowgirl who has to go." ""

prakrit: "रागद्दोसादओ तिव्वा,नेहपासा भयङ्करा,ते छिन्दित्ता जहानायं,विहरामि जहक्कमं"
english: "Anger is a poison, Love is a terrifying poison, It destroys the ship in which I am to rest."

prakrit: "अन्तो हिअयसम्भूया,लया चिठ्ठइ गोयमा!,फलेइ विसभक्खीणं,सा उ उद्धरिया कहं?"
english: "Aunt, The cow is dying! It's a poisonous snake. How can I rescue her?" ""

prakrit: "तं लयं सव्वसो छित्ता,उद्धरित्ता समूलियं,विहरामि जहानायं,मुक्को मि विसभक्खणं"
english: "In that rhythm all are scattered, In that abundance all are dispersed, I travel far and wide, And with my fist I break the fast."

prakrit: "लया य इइ का वुत्ता? केसी गोयममब्बवी,तओ केसिं बुवन्तं तु,गोयमो इणमब्बवी"
english: "Laya, who is this? Who is this go - between man and woman? You are such a fool, you stupid coward." ""

prakrit: "भवतण्हा लया वुत्ता,भीमा भीमफलोदया,तमुच्छित्तु जहानायं,विहरामि महामुनी!"
english: "Lord, what a cruel man you are, A drunken buffalo, A shipwrecked woman, I bow before the great God!"

prakrit: "साहु गोयम! पन्ना ते,छिन्नो मे संसओ इमो,अन्नो'वि संसओ मज्झं,तं मे कहसुं गोयमा!"
english: "Sahu Goyam! Panna te, chinno mein sansao imo, anno vi sansano mujham, tahin mein kahsun goyama!"

prakrit: "सम्पज्जलिया घोरा,अग्गी चिट्ठइ गोयमा!,जे डहन्ति सरीरत्थे,कहं विज्झाविया तुमे?"
english: "Whom are you looking out for? The fire is burning, Goyama! Those who are afraid of the body, How knowledgeable are you?"

prakrit: "महामेहप्पसूयाओ,गिज्झ वारि जलुत्तमं,सिञ्चामि सययं देहं,सित्ता नो डहन्ति मे"
english: "Dear sunshine, I am burning with fever, Water is covering my body, Sitta isn't afraid." ""

prakrit: "अग्गी य इइ के वुत्ता,केसी गोयममब्बवी,तओ केसिं बुवन्तं तु,गोयमो इणमब्बवी"
english: "The fire is my husband's, How can you be so naïve? But you are so stupid That you are beyond reproach."

prakrit: "कसाया अग्गिणो वुत्ता,सुयसीलतवो जलं,सुयधाराभिहया सन्ता,भिन्ना हु न डहन्ति मे"
english: "A burning fire is poison, A well of cool water is a pleasure, And a river of happiness is a delight. I am not afraid to be different."

prakrit: "अयं साहस्सिओ भीमो,दुट्ठस्सो परिधावई,जंसि गोयम! आरुढो,कहं तेण न हीरसि?"
english: "Courageous lady, How dare you! You coward! How can you not be jealous of that?"

prakrit: "पधावन्तं निगिण्हामि,सुयरस्सीससमाहियं,न मे गच्छइ उम्मग्गं,मग्गं च पडिवज्जई"
english: "I will follow you till the very end, I will accompany you all the way; I will not venture into the open, And the road will be impassable."

prakrit: "आसे य इइ के वुत्ते? केसी गोयममब्बवी,तओ केसिं बुवन्तं तु,गोयमो इणमब्बवी"
english: "Come on, who are these people? Who are these cowgirls? They're just like you. I'm a cowboy." ""

prakrit: "मनो साहस्सिओ भीमो,दुट्ठस्सो परिधावई,तं सम्मं तु निगिण्हामि,धम्मसिक्खाइ कन्थगं"
english: "Courage to the heart, Bhim, To the circumspection of the mind, I will follow you. I will instruct the teacher in dharma"

prakrit: "कुप्पहा बहवे लोए,जेहिं नासन्ति जन्तुणो,अद्धाणे कहं वट्टन्तो,तं न नाससि गोयमा!?"
english: "In what way are you afraid of straying Into the wilderness, You vain beast, Or do you want to perish?"

prakrit: "जे य मग्गेण गच्छन्ति,जे य उम्मग्गपट्ठिया,ते सव्वे वेइया मज्झं,ते न नस्सामहं मुनी!"
english: "All who approach on demand, All who follow your path, Are like me; Never be a fool!"

prakrit: "मग्गे य इइ के वुत्ते,केसी गोयममब्बवी,तओ केसिं बुवन्तं तु,गोयमो इणमब्बवी"
english: "I beg of you, What kind of man is this, A cowboy? But how come you're so stupid? I'm a cowboy." ""

prakrit: "कुप्पवयणपासण्डी,सव्वे उम्मग्गपट्ठिया,सम्मग्गं तु जिनक्खायं,एस मग्गे हि उत्तमे"
english: "You stupid girl, Everyone is following you, You're the only one who knows the truth. I beg of you the best."

prakrit: "महाउदगवेगेण,वुज्झमाणाण पाणिणं,सरणं गइं पइट्ठा य,दीवं कं मन्नसी? मुनी!"
english: "The great fire, The great water, Has reached its climax. How can you believe in a lamp? Sage!" ""

prakrit: "अत्थि एगो महादीवो,वारिमज्झे महालओ,महाउदगवेगस्स,गई तत्थ न विज्जई"
english: "Such a great island, Such vast palaces, Such a vast expanse of sky, Has not yet been conquered."

prakrit: "दीवे य इइ के वुत्ते? केसी गोयममब्बवी,तओ केसिं बुवन्तं तु,गोयमो इणमब्बवी"
english: "Who is this going to light the lamp? You go - between, you stupid bunny. I'm going to do it again." ""

prakrit: "जरामरणवेगेणं,वुज्झमाणाण पाणिणं,धम्मो दीवो पइट्ठा य,गई सरणमुत्तमं"
english: "The burning fire of immortality, The flame of dharma, Like a lamp illuminated by water, Have reached the pinnacle of perfection."

prakrit: "अन्नवंसि महोहंसि,नावा विपरिधावई,जंसि गोयममारूढो कहं पारं गमिस्ससि?"
english: "You fool, Can't you walk on water?" asked the doe. "Whom are you going to cross with in this damned river?"

prakrit: "जा उ अस्साविणी नावा,न सा पारस्स गामिणी,जा निरस्साविणी नावा,सा उ पारस्स गामिणी"
english: "One who is pious is not a village girl, one who is generous is not, one whose feelings are not is not."

prakrit: "नावा य इइ का वुत्ता? केसी गोयममब्बवी,तओ केसिं बुवन्तं तु,गोयमो इणमब्बवी"
english: "Whose name is this, you fool? Who is this cowgirl? You fool, you cowgirl." ""

prakrit: "सरीरमाहु नाव त्ति,जीवो वुच्चइ नाविओ,संसारो अण्णवो वुत्तो,जं तरन्ति महेसिणो"
english: "The body is not a boat, the soul is not seen by boats, the world is like a rainbow: It floats on the ocean floor," he said.

prakrit: "अन्धयारे तमे घोरे,चिट्ठन्ति पाणिणो बहू,को करिस्सइ उज्जोयं? सव्वलोयंमि पाणिणं"
english: "In the dark you roam, You scream, Your daughter - in - law, Who makes the light shine? All I want is water." ""

prakrit: "उग्गओ विमलो भानू,सव्वलोयपभङ्करो,सो करिस्सइ उज्जोयं,सव्वलोयंमि पाणिणं"
english: "Behold, Vimalo Bhanu, the worshipper of all virtues, Who makes everything brighter, Is the remover of all vices."

prakrit: "भानु य इइ के वुत्ते? केसी गोयममब्बवी,केसिमेवं बुवन्तं तु गोयमो इणमब्बवी"
english: "Bhanu, who is this boy? How come you're a go - between? You look just like a buffalo." ""

prakrit: "उग्गओ खीणसंसारो,सव्वन्नू जिनभक्खरो,सो करिस्सइ उज्जोयं,सव्वलोयंमि पाणिणं"
english: "Behold, the fire of anger, Which devours all men, He makes bright; For all the light I give to the water."

prakrit: "सारीरमानसे दुक्खे,बज्झमाणाण पाणिणं,खेमं सिवमनाबाहं,ठाणं किं मन्नसी? मुनी!"
english: "The whole mind is sorrowful, The thunder is tormented, The field is swollen, What do you think of yourself? You fool!" ""

prakrit: "अत्थि एगं धुवं ठाणं लोगग्गंमि दुरारुहं,जत्थ नत्थि जरामच्चू,वाहिणो वेयणा तहा"
english: "That is how the fire washes away The long distance I have to travel, Not where there is no fire But through the drain."

prakrit: "ठाणे य इइ के वुत्ते? केसी गोयममब्बवी,केसिमेवं बुवन्तं तु,गोयमो इणमब्बवी"
english: "Then who are these women? Who are these cowherd girls? They look just like you, Like bees in a manger." ""

prakrit: "निव्वाणं ति अबाहं ति,सिद्धी लोगग्गमेव य,खेमं सिवं अनाबाहं,जं तरन्ति महेसिणो"
english: "Truth is immaterial, Siddhi is universal, Love is bound to the world, For where there is love, there is jealousy."

prakrit: "तं ठाणं सासयं वासं,लोगग्गंमि दुरारुहं,जं सम्पत्ता न सोयन्ति,भवोहन्तकरा मुनी"
english: "The stay of one's mother - in - law is long, The passage of people is arduous, Those who possess wealth do not sleep."

prakrit: "साहु गोयम! पन्ना ते,छिन्नो मे संसओ इमो,नमो ते संसायातीत! सव्वसुत्तमहोयही"
english: "Sahu goyam! Panna te, chinno mein sansao imo, Namo te sansayatite! Everything has become pure." ""

prakrit: "एवं तु संसए छिन्ने,केसी घोरपरक्कमे,अभिवन्दित्ता सिरसा,गोयमं तु महायसं"
english: "And how are you hiding in the middle of the night, Whom are you trying to reassure, Sir? You are already in a great trouble."

prakrit: "पञ्चमहव्वयं धम्मं,पडिवज्जइ भावओ,पुरिमस्स पच्छिमंमि,मग्गे तत्थ सुहावहे"
english: "The five great vows are dharma, the vows are vows, the rainy season is purim, I wish there were happiness."

prakrit: "केसीगोयमओ निच्चं,तंमि आसि समागमे,सुयसीलसमुक्कसो,महत्थत्थविनिच्छओ"
english: "No matter how difficult it is, I will come to you in due course. Try to conceal your feelings with pleasantries, For they are a source of great satisfaction."

prakrit: "तोसिया परिसा सव्वा,सम्मग्गं समुवट्ठिया,सन्थुया ते पसीयन्तु,भयवं केसिगोयमे"
english: "Tosya, parishioners, gather all the people together; Believe me, my dear: There is nothing to be afraid of in this town."

prakrit: "अट्ठ पवयणमायाओ,समिई गुत्ती तहेव य,पञ्चेव य समिईओ,तओ गुत्तीउ आहिआ"
english: "Eight vows, one bunch of vows, five vows, and one vow. The pledge has arrived." ""

prakrit: "इरियाभासेसणा''दाने,उच्चारे समिई इय,मनगुत्ती वयगुत्ती,कायगुत्ती य अट्ठमा"
english: "Iriabhasena" - The grains, pronounced "samiei" "- This is the eighth day of the month."

prakrit: "एयाओ अट्ठ समिईओ,समासेण वियाहिया,दुवालसङ्गं जिणक्खायं,मायं जत्थ उ पवयणं"
english: "Here are eight women: Married with much in common, Living side by side with each other, Living wherever my heart may be."

prakrit: "आलम्बणेण कालेणं,मग्गेण जयणाइ य,चउकारणपरिसुद्धं,सञ्जए इरियं रिए"
english: "Summer is the season to rejoice, To triumph over adversity, To purify oneself for good reason."

prakrit: "तत्थ आलम्बणं नाणं,दंसणं चरणं तहा,काले य दिवसे वुत्ते,मग्गे उप्पहवज्जिए"
english: "That is the way to embrace nature, That is how to touch feet, For someday the days will come. Please, please, turn your back on it."

prakrit: "दव्वओ खॆत्तओ चेव,कालओ भावओ तहा,जयणा चउव्विहा वुत्ता,तं मे कित्तयओ सुण"
english: "Deceit is poison, For what use is love then, When one has grown old enough, How much more so can I hear?"

prakrit: "दव्वओ चक्खुसा पेहे,जुगमित्तं च खॆत्तओ,कालओ जाव रीऎज्जा,उवउत्ते य भावओ"
english: "The devil knows what's in store, The seasons are fleeting, Time is fleeting And so is emotion."

prakrit: "इन्दियत्थे विवज्जित्ता,सज्झायं चेव पञ्चहा,तम्मुत्ती तप्पुरक्कारे,उवउत्ते रियं रिए"
english: "In India there is separation, In society there are five ways, In love there are three."

prakrit: "कोहे माने य मायाए,लॊभे य उवउत्तया,हासे भये मोहरिए,विकहासु तहेव य"
english: "Anger leads to jealousy, greed leads to resentment, laughter scares away lovers, deceit leads to disappointment."

prakrit: "एयाइं अट्ठ ठाणाइं,परिवज्जितु सञ्जए,असावज्जं मियं काले,भासं भासिज्ज पन्नवं"
english: "These are the eight stations; The observer is Sanjaya, the observer is Miyam Kale, The speaker is Parnavam"

prakrit: "गवेसणाए गहणे य परिभोगेसणा य जा,आहारोवहिसॆज्जाए,एए तिन्नि विसोहए"
english: "Be it ornaments for the husband or clothes for the wife, Be it food or clothes, They are three different things."

prakrit: "उग्गमुप्पायणं पढमे,बीए सोहॆज्ज एसणं,परिभोयंमि चउक्कं,विसोहॆज्ज जयं जई"
english: "Uggamuppayanam padhame, biye sohejjaje esnanam, paribhoyammi chowkam, visohaijaje jayam jaye."

prakrit: "अहोवहोवग्गहियं,भण्डगं दुविहं मुनी,गिण्हन्तो निक्खिवन्तो वा,पउञ्जॆज्ज इमं विहिं"
english: "Ah, the arrows of the LORD! Two false gods stand in front of me. If I count them They fall by the wayside."

prakrit: "चक्खुसा पडिलेहित्ता,पमज्जॆज्ज जयं जई,आइए निक्खिवॆज्जा वा,दुहओ'वि समिए सया"
english: "Chakkusa padilehitta, pamajjeja jaya jaya, aise nikke veja va, duho vi samijaya saaya"

prakrit: "उच्चारं पासवणं,खेलं सिङ्घाण जल्लियं,आहारं उवहिं देहं,अन्नं वावि तहाविहं"
english: "Speech and speech are passé, play and lion - eyed people, food and their bodies; food and drink are the same thing."

prakrit: "अनावायमसंलोए,अनावाए चेव होइ संलोए,आवायमसंलोए,आवाए चेव संलोए"
english: "Always be vigilant, always be vigilant; always be on the alert."

prakrit: "अनावायमसंलोए,परस्स'नुवघाइए,समे अज्झुसिरे वा'वि,अचिरकालकयंमि य"
english: "I will never forget how, in my wildest dreams, I made love to another man, While he was still a child."

prakrit: "विच्छिन्ने दुरमोगढे,नासन्ने बिलवज्जिए,तसपाणबीयरहिए,उच्चाराईणि वोसिरे"
english: "Foolish girl, Don't be so naïve: Speak softly, Speak plainly, Say loudly."

prakrit: "एयाओ पञ्च समिईओ,समासेण वियाहिया,ऎत्तो य तओ गुत्तीओ,वॊच्छामि अनुपुव्वसो"
english: "Here are five friends, Married for a while, Stretching out thick and thin, As I approach you, You seem to be making love."

prakrit: "सच्चा तहेव मोसा य,सच्चमोसा तहेव य,चउत्थी असच्चमोसा य,मनगुत्ति चउव्विहा"
english: "The true god is Moses, the true is Thomas, the false is Samuel, and so on."

prakrit: "संरम्भसमारम्भे,आरम्भे य तहेव य,मनं पवत्तमाणं तु,नियत्तॆज्ज जयं जई"
english: "Begin with the structure, begin with the idea, you alone control the mind. Destiny triumphs."

prakrit: "सच्चा तहेव मोसा य,सच्चमोसा तहेव य,चउत्थी असच्चमोसा य,वइगुत्ती चउव्विहा"
english: "A true god is a false god, a true God is a true god, and a fourth god is an untruthful god."

prakrit: "संरम्भसमारम्भे,आरम्भे य तहेव य,वयं पवत्तमाणं तु नियत्तॆज्ज जयं जई"
english: "In the beginning was the festival, In the end you triumphed, As you always have."

prakrit: "ठाणे निसीयणे चेव,तहेव य तुयट्टणे,उल्लङ्घणे पल्लङ्घणे,इन्दियाण य जुञ्जणे"
english: "They pierce through the veil, They tear through the walls, They break through the bars, They crush the Indians."

prakrit: "संरम्भसमारम्भे आरम्भंमि तहेव य,कायं पवत्तमाणं तु,नियत्तॆज्ज जयं जई"
english: "I will begin with the first step, then you will follow. Destiny will triumph."

prakrit: "एयाओ पञ्च समिईओ,चरणस्स य पवत्तणे,गुत्ती नियत्तणे'वुत्ता,असुभत्थेसु सव्वसो"
english: "Here are five people: At the feet and at the feet, At the tips of the thickets, And at the withers, All unhappy people."

prakrit: "एआओ पवयणमाया,जे सम्मं आयरे मुनी,सो खिप्पं सव्वसंसारा,विप्पसुच्चई पण्डिए"
english: "Come, traveler; As far as I am concerned, sage, You have covered the whole earth With your wide open eyes."

prakrit: "माहणकुलसम्भूओ,आसि विप्पो महायसो,जायाई जमजन्नंमि,जयघोसे त्ति नामओ"
english: "Praise be to the jasmine! It is a great festival. I will gather it in one go. Let me chant its name in triumph."

prakrit: "इन्दियग्गामनिग्गाही,मग्गगामी महामुनी,गामाणुग्गामं रीयन्ते,पत्तो वाणारसिं पुरिं"
english: "The village headman's daughter - in - law is on her way home, The great sage is on his way, The streets are deserted, And the streets are empty."

prakrit: "वाणारसीए बहिया,उज्जाणंमि मनोरमे,फासुए सॆज्जसन्थारे,तत्थ वासमुवागए"
english: "Venerable woman, I am at home in Ujjain, Trapped under a thick blanket of mud, Now I dwell there."

prakrit: "अह तेणेव कालेणं,पुरीए तत्थ माहणे,विजयघोसे त्ति नामेण,जण्णं जयइ वेयवी"
english: "Oh! the summer there, The full moon there, Through the fire of victory, In the name of the one who conquers."

prakrit: "अह से तत्थ अनगारे,मासक्खमणपारणे,विजयघोसस्स जण्णंमि,भिक्खमट्ठा उवट्ठिए"
english: "Ah! there lies the waste of time, The passage of months, The burning bush of victory, Like a begging bowl."

prakrit: "समुवट्ठियं तहिं सन्तं,जायगो पडिसेहए,न हु दाहामि ते भिक्खं,भिक्खू! जायाहि अन्नओ"
english: "I am satisfied with what I get, not what I give in return: I am a monk, a monk! Whatever you give me is food."

prakrit: "जे य वेयविऊ विप्पा,जन्नमट्ठा य जे दिया,जोइसङ्गविऊ जे य,जे य धम्माण पारगा"
english: "Whatever the mind, wide and wide; Whatever the heart, broad and broad; Whatever is the thinking of the soul; This righteousness is transcendental."

prakrit: "जे समत्था समुद्धत्तुं,परं अप्पाणमेव य,तेसिं अन्नमिणं देयं,भो भिक्खू! सव्वकामियं"
english: "To him who can satisfy all wants, But does not possess any, Let me give you something to eat: I am a bhikkhu! All pleasure comes from work."

prakrit: "सो तत्थ एवं पडिसिद्धो,जायगेण महामुनी,न वि रुट्ठो न वि तुट्ठो,उत्तमट्ठगवेसओ"
english: "So be vigilant and vigilant; be vigilant, do not fall into traps or fall into one's trap; be extremely vigilant."

prakrit: "न'न्नट्ठं पाणहेउं वा,नवि निव्वाहणाय वा,तेसिं विमॊक्खणट्ठाए,इमं वयणमब्बवी"
english: "I will never forget that moment, That moment when he opened my eyes, I felt like blowing into his new one."

prakrit: "नवि जाणासि वेयमुहं,नवि जन्नाण जं मुहं,नक्खत्ताण मुहं जं च,जं च धम्माण वा मुहं"
english: "A new face is what you know, A new birth is what faces give birth to, A not so pure mouth is what it takes, A dharma or a mouthful of good people."

prakrit: "जे समत्था समुद्धत्तुं,परं अप्पाणमेव य,न ते तुमं वियाणासि,अह जाणासि तो भण"
english: "Speak what is true, but do not lie to yourself; speak what you do not know."

prakrit: "तस्स'क्खेवपमॊक्खं तु,अचयन्तो तहिं दिओ,सपरिसो पञ्जली होउं,पुच्छई तं महामुनी"
english: "If you want to see him, just give it to me," said the doe, "Then let it be a calendar." She asked who was that great sage.

prakrit: "वेयाणं च मुहं बूहि,बूहि जन्नाणं जं मुहं,नक्खत्ताण मुहं बूहि,बूहि धम्माण वा मुहं"
english: "The mouth of a prostitute is a door, the mouth of knowledge is a window, the face of an impostor is a gate, and the door is the gate of dharma."

prakrit: "जे समत्था समुद्धत्तुं,परं अप्पाणमेव य,एयं मे संसयं सव्वं,साहू! कहसु पुच्छिओ"
english: "One who is completely satisfied, but not oneself, is the whole world in me, Sahu! Ask me how?" ""

prakrit: "अग्गिहुत्तमुहा वेया,जन्नट्ठी वेयसा मुहं,नक्खत्ताणं मुहं चन्दो,धम्माण कासवो मुहं"
english: "A fire smeared with nectar, A fire burnt with poison, A moon with a nose pierced by a nail, A turtle with a dharma"

prakrit: "जहा चन्दं गहाईया,चिट्ठन्ती पञ्जलीउडा,वन्दमाणा नमंसन्ता,उत्तमं मनहारिणो"
english: "Where the moon is eclipsed, The pen is illuminated, The heart is saluted, There is plenty to like."

prakrit: "अजाणगा जन्नवाई,विज्जामाहणसम्पया,मूढा सज्झायतवसा,भासच्छन्ना इव'ग्गिणो"
english: "The ignorant traveler, Unaware of the power of knowledge, Is a foolish adventurer, Pretending to be sober"

prakrit: "जो लोए बम्भणो वुत्तो अग्गी व महिओ जहा,सया कुसलसन्दिट्ठं,तं वयं बूम माहणं"
english: "The fire that burns in the forest Is like a buffalo calf. Wherever the buffalo is, There it must boil."

prakrit: "जो न सज्जइ आगन्तुं,पव्वयन्तो न सोयई,रमइ अज्जवयणंमि,तं वयं बूम माहणं"
english: "One who does not come prepared, Who does not go to bed on arrival, Who is not amused by today's feast, To him we give a loud cry."

prakrit: "जायरूवं जहामट्ठं,निद्धन्तमलपावगं,रागदोसभयाईयं,तं वयं बूम माहणं"
english: "Whenever there is a clap of hands, When the raga is set to two, There must be a loud noise."

prakrit: "तवस्सियं किसं दन्तं अवचियमंससोणियं,सुव्वयं पत्तनिव्वाणं,तं वयं बूम माहणं"
